content: Strengthen the role of technological support and promote interdisciplinary and cross-domain integration innovation, fight key core and system integration technology battles, build a perfect innovation network, and continuously improve innovation efficiency. Strengthen key core technology research and development. Focus on the entire manufacturing process including design, production, management, and service, break through basic technologies such as design simulation, hybrid modeling, and collaborative optimization, develop advanced process technologies such as additive manufacturing and ultra-precision machining, overcome common technologies such as intelligent perception, human-machine collaboration, and supply chain collaboration, and research and develop applicable technologies such as artificial intelligence, 5G, big data, and edge computing in the industrial field. Accelerate the development of system integration technology. Targeting manufacturing carriers such as equipment, units, workshops, and factories, build manufacturing equipment, production process-related data dictionaries, and information models, develop general data integration and cross-platform, cross-domain business interconnection technologies for production processes. Develop cross-enterprise multi-source information interaction and full-chain collaborative optimization technologies for industrial chain supply chains. Break through technologies such as intelligent manufacturing system planning and design, modeling and simulation, analysis and optimization throughout the manufacturing process. Promote the construction of a new type of innovation network. Focus on key areas such as key processes, industrial hosts, digital twins, and industrial intelligence, support leading companies in the industry to build a batch of manufacturing innovation carriers in collaboration with universities, research institutes, and upstream and downstream enterprises. Encourage research and development institutions to innovate development mechanisms, strengthen data sharing and platform construction, and carry out collaborative innovation. Promote the construction of industrialization promotion organizations and accelerate the transfer and transformation of innovation achievements. Build a batch of trial and verification platforms to accelerate the promotion and application of intelligent manufacturing equipment and systems. Column 1: Action for Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Research and Development. 01 Key core technology breakthroughs: basic technologies such as product optimization design and full-process simulation, mechanism-based and data-driven hybrid modeling, multi-objective collaborative optimization; advanced process technologies such as additive manufacturing, ultra-precision machining, near-net shaping, molecular-level property characterization; multi-dimensional intelligent perception in industrial field, production process optimization based on human-machine collaboration, digital twins of equipment and production processes, precision online quality inspection in production processes, lean control of production processes, equipment fault diagnosis and predictive maintenance, dynamic production planning and scheduling in complex environments, intelligent decision-making throughout the production process, supply chain collaborative optimization and other common technologies; applicability of new technologies such as 5G, artificial intelligence, big data, and edge computing in typical industries for quality inspection, process control, process optimization, planning and scheduling, equipment operation and maintenance, and management decision-making. 02 Development of system integration technology: reusable data integration technology based on information models and standard interfaces; business interconnection technology between manufacturing equipment, product design software, control software, and business management software; enterprise information interaction technology for supply chain collaboration including orders, quality, and production performance; flexible cloud deployment technology for public cloud, hybrid cloud, and edge cloud collaboration; complex system modeling technology covering the entire manufacturing process including design, production, management, and service; model-based value stream analysis and optimization technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate systemic innovation, enhance the new driving force of integrated development.

content: Relying on a strong domestic market, accelerate the development of equipment, software, and system solutions, cultivate and develop emerging industries in intelligent manufacturing, accelerate the improvement of the adaptability of the supply system, and lead and promote the optimization and upgrading of the industrial system. Vigorously develop intelligent manufacturing equipment. Strengthen collaborative innovation between industry, academia, and research institutions to overcome weaknesses in perception, control, decision-making, and execution, and break through a batch of bottleneck basic components and devices. Promote the deep integration of advanced processes, information technology, and manufacturing equipment, and drive the accelerated development and iterative upgrading of general and specialized intelligent manufacturing equipment through the construction of intelligent workshops/factories. Promote the innovative application of new technologies such as digital twins and artificial intelligence, and develop a number of internationally advanced new intelligent manufacturing equipment. Column 4: Actions for the Innovation and Development of Intelligent Manufacturing Equipment. 01: Research and development of basic components and devices such as micro-nano displacement sensors, flexible tactile sensors, high-resolution vision sensors, online composition analyzers, advanced controllers, high-precision servo drive systems, high-performance and high-reliability reducers, wearable human-machine interaction devices, industrial site positioning equipment, and intelligent numerical control systems. 02: Research and development of general intelligent manufacturing equipment such as intelligent vertical/horizontal five-axis machining centers, turn-mill composite machining centers, high-precision CNC grinding machines, etc.; industrial robots such as intelligent welding robots, intelligent mobile robots, semiconductor (clean) robots, etc.; additive manufacturing equipment such as laser/electron beam selective melting equipment, laser selective sintering forming equipment, etc.; advanced laser processing equipment such as ultrafast lasers; industrial control equipment such as high-end distributed control systems, programmable logic controllers, monitoring control and data acquisition systems; intelligent detection equipment and instruments such as digital non-contact precision measurement, online non-destructive testing, laser tracking measurement; intelligent logistics equipment such as intelligent multi-layer and multi-directional shuttle vehicles, intelligent large-scale warehouses, etc. 03: Research and development of specialized intelligent manufacturing equipment such as efficient processing and near-net forming equipment for automobile engines and transmissions, intelligent laying, forming, processing, and testing equipment for large-scale aerospace composite materials, intelligent assembly equipment for aerospace, laser welding equipment for ship plate, high-precision intelligent hot/cold rolling equipment, intelligent ethylene equipment with a capacity of over one million tons, new dry cement full-process intelligent production lines, intelligent complete sets of equipment for high-viscosity fluid filling in the food industry, continuous knitting fabric/polyester fabric printing and dyeing complete sets of equipment, intelligent complete sets of equipment for sterile raw material drugs that meet GMP requirements, large-scale integrated circuit manufacturing complete sets of equipment, new flat panel display manufacturing complete sets of equipment, etc. 04: Research and development of new intelligent manufacturing equipment that integrates new technologies such as digital twins, big data, artificial intelligence, edge computing, virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR), 5G, Beidou, satellite internet, etc., including intelligent industrial control systems, intelligent workstations, collaborative robots, adaptive robots, etc. Focus on the research and development of industrial software products. Promote the collaboration between equipment manufacturers, universities, research institutes, user enterprises, and software enterprises, jointly develop core software for the entire product lifecycle and manufacturing process, develop embedded industrial software and integrated development environments, and develop integrated industrial software platforms for specific industries. Promote the software-based industrial knowledge and open architecture, and accelerate the deployment of industrial software in the cloud. Carry out application demonstrations of secure and controllable industrial software based on major projects and backbone enterprises. Column 5: Actions to Enhance Industrial Software Breakthroughs and Upgrades. 01: Research and development of design software, including computer-aided design (CAD), computer-aided engineering (CAE), computer-aided process planning (CAPP), computer-aided manufacturing (CAM), process simulation, electronic design automation (EDA), product data management (PDM), etc. 02: Research and development of production and manufacturing software, including manufacturing execution systems (MES), advanced planning and scheduling systems (APS), factory material distribution and control systems (TMS), energy management systems (EMS), fault prediction and health management software (PHM), maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) comprehensive management, safety management systems, environmental and carbon emission management systems, etc. 03: Research and development of business management software, including enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), supply chain management systems (SCM), customer relationship management systems (CRM), human resources management (HRM), quality management systems (QMS), asset performance management systems (APM), etc. 04: Research and development of control and execution software, including embedded industrial software and integrated development environments such as industrial operating systems, industrial control software, configuration programming software, etc. 05: Research and development of industry-specific software, including basic knowledge bases such as model libraries and process libraries for specific industries and specific processes, fully integrated optimization software for industries such as petrochemicals and metallurgy, design/production/maintenance integrated platform software for large-scale equipment, comprehensive management platform software for small and medium-sized enterprises, etc. 06: Research and development of new software, including industrial apps, cloud-based software, cloud-native software, etc. Focus on building system solutions. Encourage interaction and collaborative innovation between intelligent manufacturing system solution providers and users, promote the system integration and deep integration of processes, equipment, software, and networks, and develop solutions for typical scenarios and specific industries. Focus on the characteristics and needs of small and micro enterprises, develop lightweight, easy-to-maintain, and low-cost solutions. Accelerate the cultivation of system solution providers, promote standardized development, and guide the provision of professional, high-level, one-stop integrated services.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthening self-sufficiency and enhancing new advantages in the industrial system.

content: Aim at the development trend of intelligent manufacturing, and improve the measurement, standards, information infrastructure, and security guarantee. Continuously optimize the top-level design of standards, coordinate the construction of the national intelligent manufacturing standard system and industry application standard system. Accelerate the revision of basic commonality and key technology standards, strengthen the optimization and coordination of existing standards, and promote the formation of a coordinated and complementary group of national standards, industry standards, group standards, and enterprise standards in areas such as intelligent equipment and intelligent factories. Accelerate the implementation of standards, support enterprises to carry out intelligent workshop/factory construction based on standards. Column 6: Intelligent Manufacturing Standard Leading Action. 01: Regularly revise the Guidelines for the Construction of the National Intelligent Manufacturing Standard System and construct industry application standard systems in sub-sectors such as textiles, petrochemicals, building materials, automobiles, aviation, ships, power equipment, rail transit equipment, home appliances, food, steel, non-ferrous metals, and new energy. 02: Increase the strength of standard testing and verification, promote the revision of basic commonality and key technology standards such as digital twins, data dictionaries, human-machine collaboration, smart supply chains, system reliability, and information security and functional safety integration, meet the needs of technological evolution and industrial development, and accelerate the development of industry application standards. 03: Focus on intelligent workshop/factory construction, new model applications, supply chain collaboration, new technology applications, etc., carry out pilot projects for the application of intelligent manufacturing standards, form a coordinated and supporting group of national standards, industry standards, and group standards, and promote the application of pilot project results in small and medium-sized enterprises and peer enterprises. 04: Strengthen international cooperation in standards, continue to strengthen Sino-German cooperation on intelligent manufacturing/Industry 4.0 standards, expand cooperation with Japan, the UK, and other countries, actively participate in international standardization activities, continuously enhance the contribution of Chinese solutions to international standards, deepen bilateral and multilateral standardization exchanges, and form a batch of standardization achievements. Improve information infrastructure. Accelerate the large-scale deployment of new network infrastructures such as industrial Internet, Internet of Things, 5G, and gigabit optical networks, encourage enterprises to upgrade and transform their internal and external networks, and enhance on-site perception and data transmission capabilities. Strengthen the construction of computing infrastructure such as industrial data centers and intelligent computing centers to support the application of new technologies such as artificial intelligence. Support large group enterprises and industrial parks to establish industrial Internet platforms with distinctive features around internal resource integration, product lifecycle management, industrial chain supply chain collaboration, services for small and medium-sized enterprises, and industrial data processing and analysis, and achieve effective integration and management of all-factor and full-industry chain data. Strengthen security guarantee. content: (1) Key technologies of high-speed wheel-rail transit system. Conduct research on key technologies for cross-border interconnection, high-speed passenger transportation equipment with speeds of 400 kilometers per hour and above; breakthroughs in comprehensive energy-saving based on weight-resistance-power multi-objective balance, active noise control, active safety and operation and maintenance, gauge adaptive variable structure bogie, system integration based on interconnection requirements, etc.; construct a product technology platform for high-speed wheel-rail transit systems with speeds of 400 kilometers per hour and above. (2) Key technologies of maglev transportation system. Conduct research and development on key technologies such as suspension, traction, and guidance of high-speed maglev trains; breakthroughs in high-efficiency, high-reliability suspension and operation control technologies; research on key technologies such as low drag, low noise, and system integration based on the coupling mechanism of vehicle-line-bridge-tunnel; achieve industrialization of medium-high-speed maglev transportation systems and equipment with speeds of 200 kilometers per hour and 600 kilometers per hour; construct a collaborative innovation and integrated testing platform for maglev transportation systems. (3) Key technologies for rapid freight transportation in rail transit. Breakthroughs in systematic key technologies such as rapid loading and unloading of goods, balanced loading, and multimodal freight transportation adaptation; development of 120 kilometers per hour rail-road intermodal transportation, 160 kilometers per hour rapid freight transportation, and high-speed freight trains with speeds of over 250 kilometers per hour and supporting equipment; establishment of rapid freight transportation technology standard system; seamless connection of various transportation modes between major hubs and efficient transfer of logistics; formation of rail transit freight transportation technology and equipment system that meets the comprehensive needs of safe, convenient, efficient, and adaptable transportation processes. (4) Diversification of guided transportation system modes. Conduct research on train kinematics and dynamics theory based on tire/ground coupling; breakthroughs in key technologies such as multi-mode high safety redundant cooperative trajectory control, mixed right-of-way safety cooperative control, and non-contact power supply; development of new ground self-guided urban rail transit equipment; construction of relevant standard system and testing and verification platform. (5) Rapid transfer and transportation tools for urban materials based on urban rail network. Develop intelligent and economical transportation tools suitable for the transportation needs and characteristics of daily necessities between central areas of large cities, as well as between central areas and suburbs during off-peak periods of urban rail passenger transportation; achieve flexible scheduling and management of material transportation between the aforementioned areas. (6) Exploration and research on new modes and technologies of guided transportation systems. Develop low-cost unmanned guided transportation system technologies and equipment that support regional networked logistics; research on new modes and key technologies of ultra-high-speed guided transportation systems; explore urban peripheral transportation microgrid and dedicated network system solutions and technologies.

content: 1. Transportation vehicles. (1) Green ship design and optimization technology. Research on high-speed official ship power system integration technology, multi-engine multi-propeller (pump) optimization matching technology, diesel-electric hybrid power technology, efficient propulsion technology, efficient hybrid propulsion system technology. Research on the design, manufacturing and control technology of non-shaft flange propellers, design and optimization technology of ship propulsion system under composite energy mode, ship intelligent grid operation management technology, canal ship propulsion technology based on shore-based energy. Research on power system prediction and simulation technology, power system vibration and noise acoustic matching technology, design technology of vibration isolation and noise reduction device for ship diesel power equipment, online monitoring and intelligent fault diagnosis technology of important equipment such as ship main power device, power generation device and shaft system, ship energy efficiency intelligent online monitoring, evaluation and optimization integrated technology. (5) Key technologies for intelligent ships. Research on intelligent ship design and manufacturing technology, intelligent ship structure simulation technology, design and manufacturing technology of intelligent deep cabin depth intelligent system equipment, remote monitoring, status evaluation and performance optimization control technology of ship cabin system equipment based on multi-information fusion, ship intelligent collision avoidance auxiliary decision automation technology and verification technology based on international maritime collision avoidance rules, ship intelligent loading technology based on information autonomous perception and trim optimization, ship route optimization and autonomous decision-making technology based on ship-shore coordination, intelligent ship multi-source information autonomous perception, fusion and presentation technology, navigation information intelligent processing and display technology based on e-Navigation ship-side technology architecture, complex water area ship intelligent collision avoidance and risk avoidance auxiliary decision technology, ship traffic intelligent organization and coordinated scheduling technology, shipboard equipment self-organizing Internet of Things technology, ship navigation information automatic enhancement technology under adverse weather conditions and complex encounter situations. 2. Infrastructure. (1) Multi-mode integrated communication and navigation technology. Design of core baseband processing chip and protocol stack for new generation VDES equipment, research on modulation and demodulation technology of new generation ship VHF data exchange system (VDES), signal conflict detection technology of satellite-borne AIS reception, data processing technology of satellite VDES uplink and downlink, R-mode positioning technology based on AIS/ASM/VDES, ship comprehensive PNT technology and ship comprehensive communication technology, development of ship-shore-satellite multi-mode integrated communication and navigation equipment with complete independent intellectual property rights. Research on the interdependence between the traditional waterway navigation and operation system and the natural river ecosystem, research on the overall function of the river ecosystem, improvement of the maintenance, management and information service technology of the inland waterway, integrated technology of cross-basin water network channel design, construction and operation and maintenance, rapid mapping and navigation environment dynamic monitoring technology of inland waterway, online intelligent monitoring and rapid fault diagnosis technology of waterway structures, quality assurance technology of inland waterway dredging and maintenance projects, high-grade waterway natural disaster and foreign body invasion monitoring technology. (3) Efficient port construction technology. Research on video monitoring technology for port traffic control and integration, integration technology of automated yard handling machinery, automated shore-based machinery, automated horizontal transportation machinery and automated control system, infrastructure construction and transformation of large-scale port hubs, research and development of basic equipment, process optimization and transformation technology, construction, maintenance, dredging and navigation guarantee technology of large-scale ports and deep-water channels. 3. Research on ship-ship and ship-shore interconnected ship management information service technology, ship networking and big data technology, ship electronic navigation and intelligent navigation technology, ship fleet intelligent operation management technology, maritime big data standards, single ship and fleet data information collection and intelligent processing technology, port waterway ship traffic self-organizing intelligent scheduling technology. Research on the architecture design technology of ship distributed sensor network, performance degradation perception technology of systems, equipment and components carried by ships, comprehensive perception, evaluation and adaptive technology of ship cabin system equipment, ship abnormal navigation state identification and key equipment risk warning technology, ship status comprehensive perception and operation and maintenance guarantee integrated software and hardware technology applicable to various mainstream ship types, ship operation and maintenance based on knowledge engineering. Knowledge acquisition, knowledge base construction, decision reasoning, simulation analysis and performance evaluation technology, fault diagnosis and maintenance decision technology for intelligent ship equipment. (3) Shipping risk prevention and emergency disposal technology. Research on water traffic safety supervision and service technology, global satellite navigation technology based on Beidou, ship and port pollution prevention and control technology, hazardous goods transportation ship, large passenger ship accident mechanism, risk assessment, early warning and emergency disposal technology, deep saturation diving technology, channel measurement technology, maritime life safety guarantee and search and rescue technology. (4) Intelligent port and terminal operation management technology. Research on intelligent port operation scheduling optimization and decision support technology, intelligent port platform construction technology and collaborative management, intelligent port information system and standards for the construction of the Maritime Silk Road, port optimization scheduling and decision support technology based on Internet of Things and big data background, optimization technology for the whole process of maritime supply chain based on ports, collaborative optimization technology for scheduling of automated container terminal operations, multi-level control and efficient optimization technology for loading and unloading operations. 4. Innovation capability. (1) Multi-mode integrated information communication and navigation test evaluation platform. It can meet the needs of information transmission between ships, ship-shore and ship internal during domestic and international ship navigation, integrate existing ship information interaction methods, realize the integration of various communication protocols, integration of various equipment functions, and functional testing of voice and data services, meet the various operational needs of ships, and formulate relevant standards. (Four) Air traffic.

content: (1) Disaster mechanism and mitigation technology of reclaimed airport runways. With the continuous development of coastal cities, land for constructing large-scale infrastructure such as airports is becoming scarce. Reclaiming land from the sea has gradually become a direction to solve this problem. In response to the disaster caused by settlement of reclaimed airports, research is conducted on the settlement development law of fill materials under various loads (such as aircraft impact loads, wave loads, and time loads), revealing the conditions for the settlement disaster of reclaimed airport runways. Practical prediction and optimization design control technology for long-term settlement are improved, and technologies such as compaction construction controlled by Beidou navigation are developed to achieve prevention and control of settlement disasters in reclaimed airports.(2) Design optimization and evaluation technology for large-scale hub airports based on big data. The scale of airport systems is becoming larger, and the types and quantities of aircraft and related resources are increasing. Traditional airport design technology can no longer meet the needs of large-scale hub airport construction. Breakthroughs are made in real-time data collection, mining, and analysis technology for multiple sources of heterogeneous data within the airport (such as runway and taxiway operation data, passenger-related data within the terminal, comprehensive transportation data, etc.), as well as design optimization and evaluation technology for airport systems based on airport big data.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan Special Plan for Technological Innovation in the Transportation Sector (excerpt) (National Science and Technology Development Agency [2017] No. 121) (Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Transport/June 7, 2017)

content: (1) Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) safety management technology and application demonstration. In response to the safety hazards and flight characteristics brought about by the rapid development of UAVs, research cooperative UAVs. Develop onboard identification and flight tracking technology, develop ground safety monitoring systems to achieve real-time authentication, positioning, tracking, electronic fencing, remote takeover of UAVs; for non-cooperative UAVs, research active and passive low-altitude multi-source surveillance technology and countermeasures technology to achieve real-time detection, positioning, tracking, countermeasures of UAVs; establish UAV safety management standards and specifications, build regional-level UAV management systems, and carry out regional-level demonstration and verification.(2) Research and verification of key technologies for UAV logistics. In response to the upcoming growth of UAVs in express logistics, research safe, efficient, and energy-saving electric-driven vertical/short takeoff and landing (V/STOL) UAV platforms, modular and lightweight structure design and manufacturing technology for UAVs for logistics applications, automatic convergence technology between UAVs and logistics and storage platforms, intelligent flight control and management decision-making technology for UAVs, high-reliability onboard controllers, ground stations, long-distance data image real-time link integration technology, UAV transport network optimization configuration strategies, multi-vehicle, multi-task organization and scheduling strategies. Combine UAV safety management technology to carry out application verification of key UAV logistics technologies.(3) Airport surface safety operation and intelligent control technology. In-depth research and development of intelligent safety operation technology for airport runways and taxiways, breakthroughs in key technologies such as three-dimensional imaging and precise attitude perception of aircraft under the operating conditions of large, complex, and busy airports, distributed multi-sensor space-time fusion, intelligent control and guidance of navigational lights, onboard intelligent routing guidance, seamless switching of ground-air data link networks, etc. Conduct engineering demonstrations of airport surface safety operation and intelligent control systems, and propose corresponding technical standards and operational specifications.(4) Multi-airport collaborative management technology and verification in major terminal areas. Targeting the urgent need for efficient collaborative operation of multiple airports in large terminal areas, construct a technical system architecture for the safe operation management of flight areas in large terminal area airports and the collaborative operation of multiple airports through three levels of data collaboration, platform collaboration, and decision collaboration. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as the management of safe flight areas in large airports, processing, information mining, and collaborative sharing of massive business data in multiple airports, collaborative release of multiple airport flights and monitoring of flight processes, real-time early warning and collaborative scheduling of resources in terminal buildings and on the ground, etc. Develop corresponding technical support platforms and apply them to the actual operation of multiple airports in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, realizing the transformation of the operation mode of large terminal area multiple airports from traditional separation and passive response to collaboration and proactive warning, and improving the collaborative operation capability and efficiency of large terminal area multiple airports.(5) Air-ground collaborative flight control technology based on high-precision aviation meteorological forecasting. Meteorology is one of the main factors causing flight delays and aviation accidents. With the rapid development of the aviation transportation industry, higher requirements are placed on the real-time, precision, and accuracy of aviation meteorological support capabilities. Focus on research breakthroughs in fine integration technology of route meteorological data, high-precision forecast technology for route meteorology, and air-ground collaborative flight control technology. Achieve air-ground collaborative flight control, adopt optimal route flight, and reduce flight delays and fuel consumption.

name: 'Opinions of the State Council on Promoting High-Quality Development of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Creating an Upgraded Version of Double Innovation (excerpt) (State Council [2018] No. 32) (State Council/September 18, 2018)'
content: Promoting mass entrepreneurship and innovation is an important support for implementing the innovation-driven development strategy and an important way to advance supply-side structural reform. With the vigorous development of mass entrepreneurship and innovation, the innovation and entrepreneurship environment continues to improve, the main bodies of innovation and entrepreneurship are increasingly diverse, various supporting platforms are constantly enriching, the social atmosphere of innovation and entrepreneurship is becoming stronger, and the concept of innovation and entrepreneurship is increasingly deeply rooted in people's hearts, achieving significant results. However, at the same time, there are still problems such as the imperfect innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem, the incomplete mechanism for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, the insufficient integration and development of large, medium, and small enterprises, the insufficient depth of international cooperation in innovation and entrepreneurship, and the inadequate implementation of some policies. Building an upgraded version of double innovation and promoting high-quality development of innovation and entrepreneurship is conducive to further enhancing the ability of entrepreneurship to drive employment, promoting technological innovation and industrial development vitality, creating high-quality supply and expanding effective demand, and is of great significance for enhancing the endogenous driving force of economic development.

name: 'Opinions of the State Council on Promoting High-Quality Development of Innovation and Entrepreneurship and Creating an Upgraded Version of Double Innovation (excerpt) (State Council [2018] No. 32) (State Council/September 18, 2018)'
content: Better leverage market forces, accelerate the development of industrial internet, and integrate with smart manufacturing, e-commerce, and other sectors to promote mutual progress. Implement a three-year action plan for industrial internet, strengthen the role of financial and tax policies, and continue to utilize funds for industrial transformation and upgrading to support the development of industrial internet. Promote the construction of industrial internet platforms, establish a multi-level and systematic industrial internet platform system, guide enterprises to migrate to cloud platforms, accelerate the development of industrial software, and cultivate innovation in industrial internet applications. Promote collaborative construction of industrial internet innovation centers for industry, academia, research, and application, establish industrial internet industry demonstration bases, and carry out demonstrations of innovative applications in industrial internet. Strengthen support for professional talents, announce a batch of secondary disciplines related to industrial internet, and encourage the establishment of platforms for attracting talents in the field of industrial internet (Responsibilities are divided among the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, etc.).
titlelist: Vigorously promote the upgrading of innovation and entrepreneurship platform services, and deeply promote the innovative development of industrial Internet.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' Initiative (Excerpt) (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Promote the transformation, upgrading, and acceleration of network construction while reducing costs. Focus on the low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage network needs of enterprises, and vigorously promote the construction of internal and external networks for industrial enterprises. Accelerate the construction and transformation of broadband network infrastructure, expand network coverage, and optimize and upgrade the national backbone network. Promote the IP (Internet Protocol), flat, and flexible technological transformation and construction deployment of internal networks in industrial enterprises. Promote the application of new intelligent gateways and fully deploy IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6). Continue to promote the construction of dedicated lines for connecting small and medium-sized enterprises. Building upon the completion of the network acceleration and cost reduction tasks set out in the 2017 government work report, further improve network speed and reduce tariff levels, especially significantly reducing the access fees for internet dedicated lines for small and medium-sized enterprises. Strengthen resource openness and support the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Increase the guarantee of key resources such as radio frequency spectrum.
titlelist: Main task, solidify network foundation.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' Initiative (Excerpt) (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Increase the efforts in key common technology research. Conduct research on new network interconnection technologies such as time-sensitive networks, deterministic networks, and low-power industrial wireless networks, and accelerate the application research of technologies such as 5G and software-defined networks in the industrial internet. Promote research on key technologies and secure and reliable mechanisms for industrial internet identification resolution, information management, and heterogeneous identification interoperability. Accelerate the research on core technologies such as IPv6. Promote the application research and exploration of emerging frontier technologies such as edge computing, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, virtual reality, and blockchain in the industrial internet. Column 4 focuses on key technology industrialization projects. Advance the research and application of emerging frontier technologies such as new network interconnection and identification resolution in the industrial internet, establish a technology testing and verification system, and support technology and product testing and verification. Focus on key industrial segments of the industrial internet and actively promote the industrialization of key technologies. Accelerate the industrialization of key network equipment for the industrial internet, conduct research and development and industrialization of key technologies and products such as IPv6, industrial passive optical networks, time-sensitive networks, industrial wireless networks, low-power wide area networks, software-defined networks, and identification resolution. Develop and promote key intelligent networked equipment, focusing on key areas such as numerical control machine tools, industrial robots, and large-scale power equipment, to achieve integrated innovation of intelligent control, intelligent sensing, and industrial-grade chips and network communication modules, forming a series of new intelligent equipment with networking, computing, and optimization functions. Develop industrial big data analysis software, focus on key areas, develop industrial big data analysis application software around application scenarios such as production process optimization, quality analysis, predictive maintenance of equipment, and intelligent scheduling, and achieve industrial deployment. By 2020, breakthroughs in a batch of key technologies, establishment of more than 5 technology testing and verification systems, launch of a batch of industrial internet network equipment with advanced domestic levels, active innovation in intelligent networked products, realization of quick access to functions such as industrial big data cleaning, management, and analysis, promotion of the application of technology products in key enterprises and industries, and preliminary realization of industrialization of key technologies in the industrial internet. By 2025, master key core technologies, effectively support the research and experimentation of industrial internet technology products through technology testing and verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment that reaches international advanced levels, achieve large-scale commercial deployment of intelligent networked products and industrial big data analysis application software, and form a relatively sound industrial internet industry system. Establish a dynamic adjustment mechanism for major projects, comprehensively grasp international cutting-edge trends and urgent needs of national economic and social development, select major tasks in areas such as deep earth exploration and artificial intelligence, and timely enrich and improve the layout of major projects.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen industrial support.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' Initiative (Excerpt) (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Promote the innovation and application level of industrial Internet in large enterprises. Accelerate the application of industrial Internet in industrial sites, strengthen the networking and data collection capabilities of equipment in complex production processes, and achieve end-to-end integration of data resources at all levels of the enterprise. Utilize the industrial Internet platform to carry out data integration applications, form capabilities for process optimization, workflow optimization, equipment maintenance, and accident risk warning based on data analysis and feedback, and achieve intelligent decision-making and deep optimization of enterprise production and operation management. Encourage enterprises to integrate resources through the industrial Internet platform, build a collaborative manufacturing system that effectively organizes design, production, and supply chain resources, carry out large-scale customization that accurately matches user individual needs with product design and production, and promote the transformation towards quality traceability, equipment health management, and value-added services. Accelerate the popularization of industrial Internet applications in small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the deployment and application of low-cost, modular industrial Internet devices and systems in small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance their digital and networked capabilities. Encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to fully utilize the cloud-based research and development design, production management, and operation optimization software of the industrial Internet platform, migrate business systems to the cloud, and reduce the cost of digital and intelligent transformation. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises to open up professional knowledge, design creativity, and manufacturing capabilities, and carry out innovative applications such as supply-demand matching, integrated supply chain, industrial e-commerce, and crowdsourcing and crowdfunding based on the industrial Internet platform to improve the efficiency of social manufacturing resource allocation. Column 5: Industrial Internet Integration and Innovation Application Engineering. Led by pioneering applications, organize and carry out innovative application demonstrations, and gradually explore the implementation path and application models of the industrial Internet. In terms of intelligent production applications, encourage large industrial enterprises to achieve extensive interconnection between various production equipment and information systems within the organization, as well as the integration and interoperability of relevant industrial data, and develop applications such as quality optimization, intelligent scheduling, and supply chain optimization based on this foundation. In terms of remote service applications, provide networked services for high-value intelligent equipment, realize remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and other remote service applications for products, and explore the development of remote services for comprehensive support in the defense industry. In terms of networked collaborative manufacturing applications, focus on the intelligent development needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, carry out collaborative design, crowdsourcing, cloud manufacturing, and other innovative applications, and realize various industrial software and modular design and manufacturing resource online access. In terms of intelligent Internet of Things product applications, focus on areas such as smart homes, wearable devices, etc., integrate advanced technologies such as 5G, deep learning, and big data, and meet typical needs such as high-precision positioning, intelligent human-computer interaction, and secure and trustworthy operation and maintenance. In terms of identification resolution and integration applications, implement integrated innovation applications of industrial Internet identification resolution systems and industrial enterprise information systems, support enterprises in exploring applications such as key product traceability based on identification services, multi-source heterogeneous data sharing, and lifecycle management. By 2020, initially establish influential pilot application models of industrial Internet, and establish around 150 application pilots.
titlelist: The main task is to promote integrated applications.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Organize and implement the construction project of the manufacturing industry's Internet-based 'double innovation' platform, supporting manufacturing enterprises in building Internet-based 'double innovation' platforms. Deepen the integrated application of industrial cloud, big data, and other technologies, gather collective wisdom, accelerate the construction of new research and development, production, management, and service models, promote technological product innovation and optimize business management, and enhance the overall innovation capability and level of enterprises. Encourage large-scale manufacturing enterprises to open up various resources gathered on the 'double innovation' platform, strengthen cooperation with various entrepreneurship and innovation bases, and provide specialized services to the whole society, establishing a resource-rich, innovation-active, and efficient collaborative 'double innovation' new ecosystem. Deepen the reform of state-owned enterprises and the reform of the scientific and technological system, promote the deep integration and open sharing of resources for 'double innovation' in production, education, and research, support manufacturing enterprises in collaborating with research institutes, universities, and various innovation platforms, and accelerate the construction of a 'double innovation' system that supports collaborative research and development and technology diffusion.
titlelist: Main task: building an Internet platform for innovation and entrepreneurship for manufacturing enterprises.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Organize and implement the 'Double Innovation' service platform support capability enhancement project, support large-scale internet companies and basic telecommunications companies in building 'Double Innovation' service platforms for manufacturing enterprises, especially small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage basic telecommunications companies to increase support for broadband network infrastructure construction in 'Double Innovation' bases, further accelerate cost reduction, improve the 'Double Innovation' service system for the manufacturing industry, create a new environment for cooperation and win-win between large, medium, and small enterprises, and create a new situation of joint innovation and entrepreneurship among enterprises of different sizes. Encourage local areas to rely on national new industrialization industry demonstration bases, national economic and technological development zones, national high-tech industrial development zones, and other industrial agglomeration areas to accelerate the improvement of talent, capital, and other policy environments, fully utilize the internet, actively develop new types of maker spaces, innovation workshops, open-source communities, and other crowd innovation spaces, and combine them with the construction of 'Double Innovation' demonstration bases to cultivate a batch of 'Double Innovation' demonstration bases that support the development of the manufacturing industry. Organize and implement the enterprise management capability enhancement project, accelerate the formulation and application promotion of informationization and industrialization integration management system standards, promote business process reengineering and organizational transformation, and establish new models of organizational management.
titlelist: The main task is to promote Internet companies in building a double innovation service system for the manufacturing industry.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Encourage manufacturing enterprises to collaborate with internet companies, cultivate new business entities through capital cooperation, and establish a technology system, standard specifications, and business models that are adaptable to integrated development. Formulate advantageous complementary and win-win patterns of integrated development through competition rules. Promote the comprehensive integration of manufacturing resources of small and medium-sized enterprises with internet platforms, realize the online release, collaboration, and transaction of manufacturing capabilities, actively develop a sharing economy for the manufacturing process, break down corporate boundaries, share technology, equipment, and services, and enhance the rapid response and flexible and efficient supply capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises. Support strategic investments, brand cultivation, online sales, and logistics distribution cooperation between manufacturing enterprises and e-commerce companies, integrate online and offline transaction resources, expand sales channels, and create an efficient and collaborative production and circulation integration new ecosystem encompassing manufacturing, marketing, and logistics.
titlelist: The main task is to support the cross-border integration between manufacturing enterprises and internet enterprises.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Implement major projects such as intelligent manufacturing, covering the entire production process, the entire industry chain, and the entire product life cycle. Support enterprises in deepening the integration of quality management and the Internet, promote quality control throughout the industry chain through online measurement, online testing, and other means, and vigorously develop new production models such as networked collaborative manufacturing. Support enterprises in collecting and connecting personalized user demands through the Internet, carry out research and development, production, service, and business model innovation based on personalized products, and promote accurate matching of supply and demand. Promote enterprises to provide online value-added services through the Internet, encourage the development of product life cycle management and services for smart products and equipment, expand the value space of products, and achieve the transformation and upgrading from manufacturing to manufacturing + services. Actively cultivate new formats such as industrial e-commerce, support key industry backbone enterprises in establishing industry online procurement, sales, and service platforms, and promote the construction of a number of third-party e-commerce service platforms.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate a new model of integration between manufacturing industry and the internet.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Promote the implementation of national key research and development programs, strengthen the basic technologies and industrial support capabilities of manufacturing automation, digitization, and intelligence, and accelerate the construction of new manufacturing foundations such as automatic control and perception, industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms, and industrial Internet. Organize the implementation of the Core Fire plan and the sensor industry promotion project, accelerate the industrialization of sensors, process control chips, programmable logic controllers, etc. Accelerate the industrialization of industrial software such as computer-aided design simulation, manufacturing execution systems, and product lifecycle management, and strengthen the software support and definition of the foundational role of manufacturing. Build a reference model and comprehensive technical standard system for cyber-physical systems, establish testing and verification platforms and comprehensive verification testbeds, and support compatibility, interoperability, and interoperability testing and verification.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the basic support for integrated development.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Implement the capability enhancement project for integrated development system solutions, promote the technological breakthroughs and standard development in identification resolution, data exchange, communication protocols, and other areas for industrial product interconnection. This project is aimed at key industries such as intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and intelligent factories. It aims to cultivate a group of system solution providers, organize pilot demonstrations of industry system solution applications, and provide standardized and specialized system solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises. Support eligible enterprises in carrying out system solution business divestiture and restructuring, promote the specialization, scale, and marketization of system solution services, and fully leverage the role of system solutions as a binding agent in promoting the integration of manufacturing industry and the Internet.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance the ability to develop integrated solutions.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Implement the Industrial Control System Security Enhancement Project, formulate and improve policies and regulations for industrial information security management, establish a sound industrial information security standard system, establish a mechanism for collecting, summarizing, analyzing, and reporting industrial control system security risks, and organize inspections and risk assessments of industrial control system information security in key industries. Organize pilot demonstrations of information security assurance in industrial enterprises, support the construction of key common technology platforms such as system simulation testing and evaluation verification, promote the industrialization of core technical products such as access control, traceability, commercial information, and privacy protection. Focus on enhancing the capabilities of industrial information security monitoring, evaluation, verification, and emergency response, rely on existing research institutions, and establish a national industrial information security assurance center to provide security support for the integration of manufacturing and the Internet.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the security level of industrial information systems.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (State Council/March 17, 2016)
content: Give full play to the leading role of technological innovation in comprehensive innovation, strengthen basic research, enhance original innovation, integrated innovation, and introduce digestion and absorption for re-innovation, and strive to enhance independent innovation capabilities, providing sustained power for economic and social development.
titlelist: Implement the strategy of innovation-driven development and strengthen the leading role of scientific and technological innovation.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (State Council/March 17, 2016)
content: Focus on deep structural adjustments, revitalizing the real economy, promoting supply-side structural reforms, cultivating and strengthening emerging industries, transforming and upgrading traditional industries, and accelerating the construction of a modern industrial new system with strong innovation capabilities, high-quality services, close collaboration, and environmental friendliness.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (State Council/March 17, 2016)
content: Implement the Industrial Strong Foundation Project, focusing on breaking through the bottlenecks of key basic materials, core basic components (electronic components), advanced basic processes, and industrial technological foundations. Guide the integration of whole-machine enterprises with four basic enterprises, universities, and research institutes to meet production and demand. Support collaborative innovation and joint research and development along the entire industrial chain, systematically addressing key issues in the engineering and industrialization of the four basic areas. Strengthen the construction of standards, metrology, certification and accreditation, and inspection and testing systems in the basic fields. Implement the construction of manufacturing innovation centers and support the construction of industrial design centers. Establish a national industrial design research institute.
titlelist: Optimize the modern industrial system, implement the strategy of building a manufacturing powerhouse, and comprehensively enhance industrial foundational capabilities.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (State Council/March 17, 2016)
content: Implement the High-end Equipment Innovation Development Project, significantly improving the level of independent design and system integration capabilities. Implement the Intelligent Manufacturing Project, accelerate the development of key technologies and equipment for intelligent manufacturing, strengthen intelligent manufacturing standards, industrial electronic equipment, core supporting software, and other foundations. Strengthen the construction of industrial Internet facilities, technology verification, and demonstration promotion, and promote substantial breakthroughs in Made in China + Internet. Cultivate and promote new intelligent manufacturing models, promote the transformation of production methods towards flexibility, intelligence, and refinement. Encourage the establishment of intelligent manufacturing industry alliances. Implement the Green Manufacturing Project, promote green management throughout the product lifecycle, and build a green manufacturing system. Promote the transformation of the manufacturing industry from production-oriented to production-service-oriented, guide manufacturing enterprises to extend the service chain and promote service value-added. Promote the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing industry clusters, build a number of new industrialization demonstration bases, and cultivate several advanced manufacturing centers.
titlelist: Optimize the modern industrial system, implement the strategy of building a manufacturing powerhouse, and accelerate the development of new types of manufacturing.

name: Outline of the Development Plan for Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta Region (excerpt) (State Council/December 1, 2019)
content: Deeply implement the strategy of innovation-driven development, take the path of 'science and technology innovation + industry', promote the deep integration of innovation chain and industrial chain, take the construction of science and technology innovation centers as the leading force, create an upgraded version of industries and a highland for the development of the real economy, continuously improve the position in the global value chain, and inject strong momentum into high-quality integrated development.

name: Outline of the Development Plan for Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta Region (excerpt) (State Council/December 1, 2019)
content: Enhance original innovation capabilities through collaboration. Strengthen forward-looking layout and resource sharing in scientific and technological innovation, focus on breakthroughs in key bottleneck technologies, and jointly create an innovative ecosystem conducive to enhancing independent innovation capabilities, building a national source of original innovation. Strengthen the construction of Shanghai Zhangjiang and Hefei Comprehensive National Science Centers, and improve open and shared cooperation mechanisms. Promote the cluster development of major scientific and technological infrastructure such as hard X-ray free electron laser devices, future network test facilities, supergravity centrifuge simulation and experimental devices, efficient low-carbon gas turbine test facilities, and comprehensive research facilities for key systems of fusion reactors. Prioritize the layout of national major strategic projects and national major scientific and technological projects, jointly implement international large-scale scientific programs and international large-scale scientific projects. Accelerate the optimization and upgrading of science and technology resource sharing service platforms, promote the rational flow and open sharing of major scientific research infrastructure, large-scale scientific research instruments, scientific literature, scientific data, and other science and technology resources.
titlelist: Strengthen the construction of a collaborative innovation industrial system and build a regional innovation community.

name: Outline of the Development Plan for Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta Region (excerpt) (State Council/December 1, 2019)
content: Promote the high-quality development of the manufacturing industry together. Formulate and implement a coordinated development plan for the manufacturing industry in the Yangtze River Delta, comprehensively improve the level of manufacturing industry development, and create a national advanced manufacturing industry cluster in accordance with the direction of cluster development. Focus on ten major areas including electronic information, biomedicine, aerospace, high-end equipment, new materials, energy conservation and environmental protection, automobiles, green chemicals, textile and clothing, and smart home appliances. Strengthen regional industrial collaboration in advantageous industries, promote the upgrading and transformation of traditional industries, build a number of national strategic emerging industry bases, and form several world-class manufacturing clusters. Focus on ten key areas including integrated circuits, new displays, the Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, new energy vehicles, life and health, large aircraft, intelligent manufacturing, and cutting-edge new materials. Accelerate the development of new energy, intelligent automobiles, and next-generation mobile communication industries, extend the industrial chain of robotics and integrated circuits, and cultivate a group of internationally competitive leading enterprises. Focus on eight major areas including quantum information, neuromorphic chips, third-generation semiconductors, next-generation artificial intelligence, targeted drugs, immune cell therapy, stem cell therapy, and genetic testing. Accelerate the cultivation and layout of future industries.
titlelist: Strengthen the construction of a collaborative innovation industrial system and enhance industrial division and cooperation.

name: Overall Plan for the Lingang New Area of China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone (excerpt) (State Council [2019] No. 15) (State Council/August 6, 2019)
content: Leverage the advantages of an open system and promote the integration of international business, cross-border financial services, cutting-edge technology research and development, and cross-border service trade to strengthen the function of an open economic cluster. Accelerate the transformation and upgrading of existing enterprises to enhance the overall level of regional industries.

name: Overall Plan for the Lingang New Area of China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone (excerpt) (State Council [2019] No. 15) (State Council/August 6, 2019)
content: Build an integrated circuit comprehensive industrial base, optimize the full-process bonded supervision mode for imported materials and parts, support the establishment of offshore research and manufacturing centers by multinational companies, and promote the development of key areas such as core chips, specialized processes, key equipment, and basic materials. Build an innovation and application demonstration zone for artificial intelligence, accelerate the opening of application scenarios, and promote the development of new industries and formats such as smart cars, smart manufacturing, and smart robots. Build a civil aviation industry cluster zone, with large passenger aircraft and civil aviation engines as the core, accelerate the aggregation of supporting industries such as basic research, technology development, product development, and test verification, and promote the development of the entire aviation industry chain including final assembly delivery, production support, operation and maintenance, and cultural tourism services. Build maintenance and green remanufacturing centers for countries and regions along the Belt and Road initiative, establish a green certification and rating system, support the importation of products such as CNC machine tools and engineering equipment for maintenance and remanufacturing in comprehensive bonded zones, and enhance the international competitiveness of the high-end intelligent remanufacturing industry.
titlelist: Build an open industrial system with international market competitiveness, and establish cutting-edge industrial clusters with key core technologies as the breakthrough.

name: Notice of the State Council on Issuing the Overall Plan for the Beijing, Hunan, and Anhui Pilot Free Trade Zones and the Expansion Area Plan for the Zhejiang Pilot Free Trade Zone (excerpt) (Guo Fa [2020] No. 10) (State Council, August 30, 2020)
content: Ningbo area is constructing an international shipping hub that connects the inside and outside, integrates multimodal transportation, has strong radiation power, and forms a cluster with complete chains. It aims to create an internationally influential oil and gas resource allocation center, an international supply chain innovation center, a global new material science and innovation center, and a demonstration zone for high-quality development of intelligent manufacturing. Hangzhou area aims to build a leading national innovation and development experimental zone for the new generation of artificial intelligence, a national financial technology innovation and development experimental zone, and a world-class demonstration center for cross-border e-commerce. It also aims to construct a demonstration zone for high-quality development of the digital economy. Jinyi area aims to build the world's capital of small commodities and establish an international free trade center for small commodities, a digital trade innovation center, an inland international logistics hub port, a manufacturing innovation demonstration site, and an important platform for open cooperation in the Belt and Road Initiative.
