content: Based on factories or workshops, targeting individual or multiple manufacturing processes, extracting key requirements, through the deep integration of new generation information technologies such as 5G, industrial internet, big data, artificial intelligence, Beidou system, and core manufacturing processes, focusing on sorting and refining replicable and scalable intelligent manufacturing excellent scenarios.
titlelist: Trial demonstration content, excellent scenes of intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Pilot Demonstration Action of Intelligent Manufacturing in 2021 (MIIT Letter No. 263 [2021]) (Issued by the Office of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Office of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Office of the Ministry of Finance, and the Office of the State Administration for Market Regulation on November 2, 2021)
content: Focus on the sub-sectors of raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, etc., and build intelligent manufacturing demonstration factories around the entire manufacturing process of design, production, management, and service. This will drive breakthroughs in manufacturing technology, process innovation, scene integration, and business process reengineering, and play a leading role in demonstration.
titlelist: Trial demonstration content, intelligent manufacturing demonstration factory.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Pilot Demonstration Action of Intelligent Manufacturing in 2021 (MIIT Letter No. 263 [2021]) (Issued by the Office of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Office of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Office of the Ministry of Finance, and the Office of the State Administration for Market Regulation on November 2, 2021)
content: Support the creation of intelligent manufacturing pilot zones in regions with distinctive industrial characteristics, urgent transformation needs, and good basic conditions. Improve the policy system, innovate element guarantee mechanisms, accelerate the integration and application of new technologies, build a sound regional ecosystem for the development of intelligent manufacturing, and create a source of innovative technologies for intelligent manufacturing, a demonstration application cluster area, and a key equipment and solution export destination.
titlelist: Trial demonstration content, intelligent manufacturing pilot zone

name: Notice on Carrying out the Pilot Demonstration Action of Intelligent Manufacturing in 2021 (MIIT Letter No. 263 [2021]) (Issued by the Office of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Office of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Office of the Ministry of Finance, and the Office of the State Administration for Market Regulation on November 2, 2021)
content: Based on the current situation and future trends of intelligent manufacturing in our country, focusing on the sub-industries of raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, etc., we will clearly define the tasks of unveiling and leading the demonstration factories of intelligent manufacturing, and formulate annual plans.
titlelist: Key tasks include determining the unveiling mission of the smart manufacturing demonstration factory.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Pilot Demonstration Action of Intelligent Manufacturing in 2021 (MIIT Letter No. 263 [2021]) (Issued by the Office of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Office of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Office of the Ministry of Finance, and the Office of the State Administration for Market Regulation on November 2, 2021)
content: Encourage local industrial and informatization departments, development and reform, finance, market supervision and other competent authorities to jointly promote the construction of provincial-level intelligent manufacturing demonstration factories, and recommend projects with significant achievements, outstanding demonstration effects, and good growth prospects to be listed as national-level intelligent manufacturing demonstration factory tasks. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and other departments will study and formulate evaluation criteria, and select and publish the list of units for intelligent manufacturing demonstration factory listing and the list of intelligent manufacturing demonstration factories. The construction period for intelligent manufacturing demonstration factories is 2 years.
titlelist: Key task: Constructing a smart manufacturing demonstration factory.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Pilot Demonstration Action of Intelligent Manufacturing in 2021 (MIIT Letter No. 263 [2021]) (Issued by the Office of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Office of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Office of the Ministry of Finance, and the Office of the State Administration for Market Regulation on November 2, 2021)
content: Encourage the creation of pilot zones for intelligent manufacturing by individual cities or in collaboration, with distinct industrial characteristics, strong policy measures, and clear development paths. The National Manufacturing Power Construction Strategy Consultation Committee's Expert Committee on Intelligent Manufacturing (referred to as the Consultation Committee) will lead the discussion and evaluation of the pilot zone creation plan through a case-by-case approach. Upon approval through evaluation, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and other relevant departments will initiate the pilot zone creation work.
titlelist: Key work, creating a pilot zone for intelligent manufacturing.

name: Guiding Opinions of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on Further Strengthening the Management of Industrial Safety Production (excerpt) (MIIT Safety [2020] No. 83) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 9, 2020)
content: Establish and improve the intelligent manufacturing standard system for the civil explosive industry, promote the application of intelligent manufacturing technology, achieve less (or no) human operation in industrial explosive hazardous positions, implement human-machine isolation operation in high-risk positions such as industrial detonators, pyrotechnic agents, and seismic source columns in the production process, and promote the automation production technology and equipment for digital electronic detonator assembly.
titlelist: Continuously promote the safe development of the civil explosive industry and constantly improve the level of safety technology.

name: Several Measures on Technological Innovation to Support Resumption of Work and Production and Ensure Stable Economic Operation (excerpt) (National Science and Technology Development Zone [2020] No. 67) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 21, 2020)
content: Create a technology catalog for applications such as recycling and clean production, and build demonstration application scenarios in national high-tech zones, national new generation artificial intelligence innovation and development pilot zones, national agricultural high-tech industrial demonstration zones, national agricultural science and technology parks, etc., to promote the implementation of a batch of emerging industry technology projects in medical health, intelligent manufacturing, unmanned delivery, online education, etc., and guide consumer and investment directions.
titlelist: Key measures, cultivating and strengthening new industries, new business models, and new formats, compiling towards smart healthcare, smart agriculture, public health, smart cities, modern food, and ecological restoration.

name: Three-Year Action Plan to Promote Integrated Development of Large, Medium, and Small Enterprises (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Enterprise [2018] No. 248) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission / November 21, 2018)
content: Action 1: Explore and promote the integrated development model. Focus on key industries, centering around key aspects of industrial development such as supply chain integration, sharing of innovative capabilities, and data application. Promote mechanisms of resource openness and capability sharing, providing useful guidance and references for the construction of an integrated development ecosystem.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Three-Year Action Plan to Promote Integrated Development of Large, Medium, and Small Enterprises (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Enterprise [2018] No. 248) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission / November 21, 2018)
content: Build a new industrial organizational model that promotes deep collaboration and integrated development among large, medium, and small enterprises, and improve the operation of the supply chain. Harness the leading role of industry leaders in driving the supply chain, and establish around 10 large enterprises with outstanding driving capabilities, high levels of resource integration, and distinct characteristics in the fields of intelligent manufacturing and high-end equipment manufacturing. Promote the establishment of a collaborative management system that includes joint training and shared standards. Create a win-win and sustainable supply system to drive the collaborative development of upstream and downstream small and medium enterprises.
titlelist: Main action: Deepening the integrated model based on supply chain collaboration.

name: Three-Year Action Plan to Promote Integrated Development of Large, Medium, and Small Enterprises (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Enterprise [2018] No. 248) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission / November 21, 2018)
content: Build a new industrial innovation model that integrates production and research, improve the efficiency of industrial innovation, and enhance the independent innovation capability of industries. Form around 10 platforms with significant innovation leading effects, and leverage the platforms to aggregate and integrate various innovation capabilities. Encourage large enterprises to establish open industrial innovation platforms, facilitate the connection and transformation of innovation capabilities, achieve multidimensional and multi-touchpoint sharing of innovation capabilities, transformation of innovation achievements, and brand collaboration among large, medium, and small enterprises, leading the integrated development model of platform-enabled industrial innovation. Focus on areas such as resource aggregation, open capabilities, innovative models, and regional cooperation, cultivate a number of manufacturing double innovation platform pilot demonstration projects, and promote platforms to become important carriers for improving quality and efficiency, transforming and upgrading, and cross-border integration.
titlelist: Main action, promoting a collaborative model based on the sharing of innovative capabilities.

name: Opinions of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on the Implementation of Industrial Communication Standardization Work in Service of the 'Belt and Road' Initiative (Excerpt) (MIIT Science [2018] No. 231) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/November 5, 2018)
content: In key areas of advantageous production capacity and equipment manufacturing cooperation, encourage domestic leading enterprises and industry backbone enterprises to strengthen standardization top-level design, carry out standard translation, comparison, and applicability verification work, actively adopt advanced Chinese standards in the design and development, raw material procurement, production and processing, inspection and testing, and after-sales service of cooperative projects, and improve the quality and efficiency of international production capacity and equipment manufacturing cooperation.
titlelist: Focusing on key areas, deepening international cooperation, and promoting standardization cooperation in the manufacturing industry.

name: Opinions of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on the Implementation of Industrial Communication Standardization Work in Service of the 'Belt and Road' Initiative (Excerpt) (MIIT Science [2018] No. 231) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/November 5, 2018)
content: Seize the opportunities of the new round of technological revolution and industrial revolution, aggregate the technical strength of standardization in manufacturing industry, information communication, and other fields, accelerate the promotion of standardization cooperation in the field of integrated innovation industry with countries along the Belt and Road initiative, jointly formulate international standards for technology, products, management, and services in the field of Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing, and support the construction of industrial innovation value chain. In the field of integrated management system for the convergence of informatization and industrialization, establish a market-oriented conformity assessment model, mechanism, and quality assurance system for the integrated management system, and accelerate the formation of a market-oriented acceptance mechanism for management system standards; explore pilot projects for the integrated management system standards in overseas industrial parks and newly built factories in China. In the field of intelligent manufacturing, further improve the standard system for intelligent manufacturing, focus on formulating and promoting standards for intelligent equipment such as identification and sensing, control systems, industrial robots, and standards for intelligent factory design, delivery, production, and integration; explore the standardization demonstration projects for intelligent manufacturing construction based on cloud computing + big data + artificial intelligence in key manufacturing industries and regions along the Belt and Road initiative, and gradually build an ecosystem for intelligent manufacturing.
titlelist: Focus on key areas, deepen international cooperation, deepen standardization cooperation in the field of 'Internet + advanced manufacturing'.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: Accelerating the development of intelligent manufacturing is the only way to cultivate new drivers of economic growth in our country. It is a strategic choice to seize the commanding heights of future economic and technological development. It is of great strategic significance for promoting the structural reform of the supply side of China's manufacturing industry, building new competitive advantages for China's manufacturing industry, and realizing the goal of becoming a manufacturing powerhouse.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: Column 1 focuses on the key areas of innovation and development in intelligent manufacturing equipment. It emphasizes the innovation of collaborative models between industry, academia, research, and application, as well as the research and development of high-end CNC machine tools, industrial robots, additive manufacturing equipment, intelligent sensing and control equipment, intelligent detection and assembly equipment, and intelligent logistics and warehousing equipment. The key breakthroughs include high-performance fiber optic sensors, microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) sensors, vision sensors, distributed control systems (DCS), programmable logic controllers (PLC), data acquisition systems (SCADA), high-performance and highly reliable embedded control systems, and other core products. These products will be integrated and applied in fields such as machine tools, robots, petrochemicals, and rail transportation. By relying on advantageous enterprises, integrated innovation and application demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing equipment will be carried out to accelerate industrialization. The development and industrialization of intelligent connected vehicles, intelligent engineering machinery, intelligent ships, intelligent lighting appliances, service robots, and other areas will be promoted. Intelligent services such as remote unmanned operation, operation status monitoring, work environment warning, and fault diagnosis and maintenance will also be conducted. By 2020, more than 60 types of key intelligent manufacturing equipment will be developed, reaching the international level of similar products, with a domestic market penetration rate exceeding 50%.
titlelist: Key task, accelerate the development of intelligent manufacturing equipment.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance / December 8, 2016)
content: In order to achieve intelligent functions such as perception, control, decision-making, and execution, we will focus on the development and application of key technologies and equipment for intelligent manufacturing, intelligent products, major complete sets of equipment, and digital workshops/smart factories. We will break through a batch of key common technologies, including advanced perception and measurement, high-precision motion control, high-reliability intelligent control, modeling and simulation, and industrial internet security. We will also develop core supporting software for intelligent manufacturing, establish and accumulate a batch of core intellectual property rights, and provide technical support for the intelligentization of manufacturing equipment and processes. This includes business management software, embedded database systems, and real-time data intelligent processing systems for data management. Column 2: Innovation direction of key common technologies for intelligent manufacturing. We will establish several manufacturing innovation centers in the field of intelligent manufacturing and carry out research and development of key common technologies. We will integrate various existing innovation resources, guide enterprises to increase research and development investment, and break through key common technologies such as new sensing technology, modular/embedded control system design technology, advanced control and optimization technology, system collaboration technology, fault diagnosis and health maintenance technology, high-reliability real-time communication, functional safety technology, special process and precision manufacturing technology, identification technology, modeling and simulation technology, industrial internet, and artificial intelligence. We will guide enterprises, universities, research institutes, and users to form intelligent manufacturing innovation alliances to promote the aggregation of innovation resources to enterprises. We will accelerate the development of intelligent manufacturing supporting software, break through computer-aided design (CAD) software, data-driven 3D design and modeling software, numerical analysis and visualization simulation software, design and process simulation software, high-security and high-trust embedded real-time industrial operating systems, embedded configuration software, industrial control software such as manufacturing execution systems (MES), enterprise resource planning software (ERP), and supply chain management software (SCM). By 2020, we will establish a relatively complete intelligent manufacturing technology innovation system, achieve breakthroughs in a batch of key common technologies, and have some technologies reach international advanced levels. The market penetration rate of core supporting software will exceed 30%.
titlelist: Key task: Strengthening innovation in key common technologies.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance / December 8, 2016)
content: Based on the guidelines for the construction of the national intelligent manufacturing standard system, research is conducted on basic common standards, key technical standards, and industry application standards, focusing on bottlenecks such as interconnection and multidimensional collaboration. A standard test and verification platform (system) is established to carry out comprehensive testing and verification throughout the process. The revision of standards is accelerated and promoted comprehensively in various fields of manufacturing. The National Coordination and Promotion Group for Intelligent Manufacturing Standardization, the overall group, and the expert advisory group are established to form a collaborative working mechanism. Existing multi-department coordination and multi-standard committee collaboration mechanisms are fully utilized to gather domestic and international standardization resources and solidly build an intelligent manufacturing standard system that meets the needs of industrial development and is advanced and applicable. Special Action Column 3: Special Action to Enhance Intelligent Manufacturing Standards. Research and formulation of basic common standards such as reference models, terminology definitions, identification resolution, evaluation indicators, safety, and key technical standards such as data formats, communication protocols, and interfaces are organized, and the formulation of key industry intelligent manufacturing standards is explored. Strengthen implementation methods, standard libraries, and standard case collections, and promote standard publicity and implementation through training, consulting, and other means. Promote international exchanges and cooperation in intelligent manufacturing standards. By 2020, the national intelligent manufacturing standard system will be basically established, with the revision of more than 200 national intelligent manufacturing standards, the construction of more than 100 test and verification platforms, and more than 50 public service platforms.
titlelist: Key task: Building an intelligent manufacturing standard system.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: Develop new industrial network equipment and systems, build industrial Internet test and verification platforms and identification resolution systems. Promote the upgrading and transformation of factory internal networks for manufacturing enterprises. Encourage telecommunications operators to improve external networks for factories and carry out industrial cloud and big data platform construction. Research and develop secure and reliable information security software and hardware products, establish information security assurance systems and test and verification platforms for smart manufacturing, and establish sound mechanisms for industrial Internet information security risk assessment, inspection, and information sharing. Column 4 focuses on the construction of the industrial Internet. Research and develop industrial network equipment and systems that integrate IPv6, 4G/5G, short-range wireless, and WiFi technologies, build industrial Internet test and verification platforms and identification resolution systems, and enterprise-level intelligent product identification systems. Develop core information and communication equipment for the industrial Internet, as well as industrial-grade information security products and devices. Support industrial enterprises in transforming industrial site networks using optical communication, industrial wireless, industrial Ethernet, SDN, OPC-UA, IPv6, and other technologies, to achieve network connectivity, data exchange, and business integration within factories. Utilize technologies such as SDN, network virtualization, 4G/5G, and IPv6 to upgrade and transform existing public telecommunications networks, meeting the needs of industrial Internet network coverage and business development. In response to the development needs of smart manufacturing, promote the construction of industrial cloud computing and big data service platforms. Encourage eligible enterprises to carry out pilot demonstrations and promote the integrated application of new technologies, products, and systems in key areas. By 2020, establish new technology experimental networks and carry out application innovation in key manufacturing enterprises.
titlelist: Key task: Building the foundation of the Industrial Internet.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance / December 8, 2016)
content: Column 6 focuses on key areas of intelligent transformation. It revolves around key areas such as new generation information technology, high-end CNC machine tools and industrial robots, aviation equipment, marine engineering equipment and high-tech ships, advanced rail transit equipment, energy-saving and new energy vehicles, power equipment, agricultural equipment, new materials, biomedicine and high-performance medical devices, light industry, textiles, petrochemicals, steel, non-ferrous metals, building materials, civil explosives, etc., promoting the deep application of intelligent and digital technology in key links such as enterprise research and development design, production manufacturing, logistics warehousing, business management, and after-sales service. Support the promotion and application of key technologies and core supporting software for intelligent manufacturing, continuously improve the level of intelligence in production equipment and processes. In areas with good basic conditions, carry out integrated innovation and application demonstrations of digital workshops/smart factories. Support the construction of a number of public service platforms by local areas, industrial parks, leading enterprises, etc., and provide services such as technology research and development, product design, software services, data management, and testing and verification. By 2020, the popularity rate of digital research and development design tools in key areas with large quantity, wide coverage, foundation, and conditions will reach over 70%, and the CNC rate of key processes will reach over 50%. The popularity rate of digital workshops/smart factories will reach over 20%.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting intelligent transformation in key areas...

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance / December 8, 2016)
content: Guide small and medium-sized enterprises with a foundation and conditions to promote the automation transformation of production lines, and carry out pilot applications for management informatization and digitalization upgrades. Establish a development mechanism led by leading enterprises to drive the automation and informatization of small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance the level of intelligence of small and medium-sized enterprises. Integrate and utilize existing manufacturing resources, establish cloud manufacturing platforms and service platforms, provide online key industrial software, various model libraries, and manufacturing capability outsourcing services, and serve the intelligent development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Column 7: Special Action for the Intelligent Transformation of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises. Support third-party organizations to provide analysis and diagnosis, innovation assessment, and other services, encourage system integrators, equipment suppliers, software suppliers, etc., to research and develop simple and feasible intelligent transformation plans based on the actual needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and promote a batch of mature and used unit equipment and advanced technologies. Promote Internet Plus for small and micro enterprises, promote information products and services suitable for the development needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and promote the application of the Internet and information technology in various aspects of production manufacturing, operation management, and marketing. Promote cloud manufacturing and build cloud manufacturing platforms and service platforms. Promote collaborative innovation between small and medium-sized enterprises and large enterprises, encourage large enterprises with conditions to build information service platforms, and open entrances, data information, and computing capabilities to small and medium-sized enterprises. By 2020, the level of production automation of small and medium-sized enterprises with a foundation and conditions will be significantly improved, and the level of management informatization and digitalization will be significantly enhanced.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the intelligent transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: In order to meet the development needs of intelligent manufacturing in enterprises, promote close cooperation and collaborative innovation among different fields such as equipment, automation, software, and information technology, promote division of labor and cooperation among enterprises in various links of the industrial chain, and gradually form an intelligent manufacturing development ecosystem with intelligent manufacturing system integrators as the core, leading enterprises in various fields jointly promoting, and a large number of specialized and refined enterprises in specific fields deeply participating. Accelerate the cultivation of a group of industry-specific system solution providers; vigorously develop leading enterprise groups with international influence; optimize and strengthen a group of specialized and refined supporting enterprises such as sensors, intelligent instruments, control systems, servo devices, and industrial software. Column 8: Special action for cultivating intelligent manufacturing system solution providers. Support the formation of industry-university-research-application consortia or industrial innovation alliances with technology and capital as the link, and encourage their development into intelligent manufacturing system solution providers. Support equipment manufacturing enterprises to take equipment intelligence upgrading as a breakthrough and accelerate the transformation into system solution providers. Support planning and design institutes to extend their business chains based on workshop/factory planning and design, and carry out digital workshop/smart factory general contracting business. Support automation and information technology enterprises to gradually develop into intelligent manufacturing system solution providers through business upgrading. Research and formulate standards or specifications for intelligent manufacturing system solution providers, and publish a recommended catalog of intelligent manufacturing system solution providers. By 2020, there will be more than 40 intelligent manufacturing system solution providers with main business income exceeding 1 billion yuan, and their system integration capabilities will be significantly improved, basically meeting the needs of intelligent transformation in the manufacturing industry.
titlelist: Key task: Cultivating an intelligent manufacturing ecosystem.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: Build an industrial cluster for intelligent manufacturing equipment. Actively promote the construction of an industrial cluster for intelligent manufacturing equipment, which is linked by the industrial chain and gathers resources. Improve the collaborative supporting system of the industrial chain. Strengthen planning and guidance, enhance the level of infrastructure such as information networks and public service platforms, and promote the standardized and orderly development of industrial clusters. Strengthen regional coordination of intelligent manufacturing resources. Build an internet-based collaborative platform for manufacturing resources, continuously improve the system architecture and operating rules, accelerate the integration and connection of innovative resources, design capabilities, production capabilities, and service capabilities among regions, promote parallel organization and collaborative optimization of various stages of the manufacturing process and the entire value chain, and achieve complementary and optimized allocation of regional advantageous resources.
titlelist: Key task: Promoting the coordinated development of regional intelligent manufacturing.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance / December 8, 2016)
content: In the field of intelligent manufacturing, research should be conducted to establish several manufacturing industry innovation centers, establish market-oriented mechanisms for selecting innovative directions, and encourage mechanisms for sharing risks and benefits of innovation, in order to bridge the gap between technological research and industrial application. Major scientific research and experimental facilities should be built around the development needs of key areas in intelligent manufacturing. Support should be provided for the construction of intelligent manufacturing public service platforms to enhance industry service capabilities. Encourage enterprises to increase research and development investment and strengthen innovation in key technologies and equipment for intelligent manufacturing.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, perfecting the innovation system.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: Make full use of existing funding channels to support intelligent manufacturing. In accordance with the requirements of deepening the management reform of scientific and technological plans (special projects, funds, etc.), coordinate support for the research and development of key common technologies in intelligent manufacturing. Improve and implement government procurement policies that support innovation. Promote the pilot work of insurance compensation for the first set of major technical equipment. Implement tax preferential policies, where major technical equipment purchased and actually used by enterprises meet the specified conditions, they can enjoy the preferential corporate income tax policy as stipulated. For major technical equipment or products that enterprises produce to support national development and where it is necessary to import components, raw materials, etc., they can enjoy import tax preferential policies in accordance with the relevant provisions of the import tax policy for major technical equipment.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial and tax support.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance / December 8, 2016)
content: To leverage the guiding role of national financial investment, attract enterprises and social capital, and establish a diversified investment and financing system for intelligent manufacturing. Encourage the establishment of various intelligent manufacturing development funds operated in a market-oriented manner, and encourage social venture capital and equity investment in the field of intelligent manufacturing. Build a platform for government-bank-enterprise cooperation, study and establish new models for integrating production and finance, and guide and promote financial institutions to innovate in products and service methods. Relying on key engineering projects, promote the application and popularization of the first set of major technological equipment, and improve the underwriting and claims settlement mechanism. Support equipment manufacturing enterprises in expanding direct financing, developing accounts receivable financing, and reducing corporate financial costs.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, innovative financial support methods

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: Industry associations should leverage their familiarity with the industry and close proximity to enterprises to promote advanced management models, strengthen industry self-discipline, and prevent disorderly and malicious competition. Relevant industry associations should guide enterprises in deepening reforms, honing their skills, promoting technological innovation, and cultivating talents. They should promptly reflect the demands of enterprises, provide feedback on policy implementation, actively promote and assist enterprises in making full use of various policies. Encourage industry associations and industrial alliances to enhance their ability to serve the development of the industry and guide enterprises in advancing smart manufacturing development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, leveraging the role of industry organizations.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 349) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 8, 2016)
content: Extensively engage in international exchanges and cooperation in the establishment of smart manufacturing standards, intellectual property rights, and continuously expand the scope of cooperation. Support the exchange and cooperation of smart manufacturing technologies between domestic and foreign enterprises and industry organizations, combining investment, technology, and talent attraction. Encourage multinational companies, foreign institutions, etc., to establish smart manufacturing research and development institutions and talent training centers in China, and build smart manufacturing demonstration factories. Encourage domestic enterprises to participate in international mergers and acquisitions and invest in advanced research and manufacturing enterprises abroad.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepen international cooperation and exchanges.

name: Integration Development Plan for Informatization and Industrialization (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 333) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 12, 2016)
content: By 2020, the level of integration between informatization and industrialization will further improve, and the double innovation system that enhances the innovation and development capabilities of the manufacturing industry will become more sound. The infrastructure and industrial ecology that support integrated development will continue to improve. The digitization, networking, and intelligence of the manufacturing industry will make significant progress. New products, new technologies, new models, and new formats will continuously generate new growth points. The national index of integrated development of informatization and industrialization will reach 85, an increase of approximately 12 compared to 2015. The proportion of enterprises entering the stage of integrated development and innovation breakthrough will reach 30%, an increase of approximately 15 percentage points compared to 2015.Based on the Internet, the double innovation system in the manufacturing industry will continue to improve. Double innovation has become the new engine for the transformation and development of the manufacturing industry. The support capacity of the double innovation service platform system has significantly improved, and the level of innovation resources and services being online, platform-based, and shared has significantly increased.The new production mode will be widely popularized in key industries. The level of refinement, flexibility, and intelligence in production methods will significantly improve. The rate of key process digitization will reach 50%. Networked collaborative manufacturing, personalized customization, and service-oriented manufacturing will become important models leading the high-end development of the manufacturing industry. The organizational management model of manufacturing enterprises will further trend towards being flat and open.The service industry based on the Internet will become a new growth point. New service models and formats such as product lifecycle management and industrial e-commerce will flourish, with the transaction volume of industrial e-commerce exceeding 10 trillion yuan.The independent innovation capability of intelligent equipment and products will rapidly improve. Significant breakthroughs will be made in the research, development, and industrialization of key technologies and equipment for intelligent manufacturing, as well as the research and development and industrialization of intelligent products. The market scale of new intelligent hardware products and services will exceed one trillion yuan, and the capability of intelligent manufacturing system solutions will significantly improve.The infrastructure system that supports integrated development will be basically established. Breakthroughs will be made in the research and industrialization of automatic control and sensing technologies, and the supply capacity of industrial software and hardware will steadily improve. Industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms will gradually become key infrastructure for intelligent manufacturing. The support capacity of low-latency, high-reliability, wide-coverage, and more secure network services will further enhance.
titlelist: The guiding ideology and development goals, development goals.

name: Integration Development Plan for Informatization and Industrialization (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 333) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 12, 2016)
content: Promote the development of innovation and entrepreneurship in large enterprises. Support large manufacturing enterprises in establishing internet-based platforms for entrepreneurship incubation, collaborative innovation, crowdsourcing, and investment and financing, in order to promote the construction of new models for research and development, production, management, and services based on platforms, and stimulate the entrepreneurial and innovative vitality of enterprises. Encourage large enterprises to open up platform resources to society, continuously enrich services such as entrepreneurship incubation, professional consulting, talent training, inspection and testing, and investment and financing, and promote the aggregation of innovative elements. Focus on creating new competitive advantages in the industrial chain, promote professional division of labor, service outsourcing, and order production in various forms of collaboration between large enterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, and form an industrial innovation cluster with abundant resources, active innovation, and efficient collaboration. Build a service system for innovation and entrepreneurship for small and medium-sized enterprises. Improve the service system for innovation and entrepreneurship for small and medium-sized enterprises, support the construction of entrepreneurship and innovation bases for small and micro enterprises, and guide the development of bases towards platformization, intelligence, and ecologicalization. Improve the network of public service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises, give full play to the role of national public service demonstration platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises, provide services such as internet-based technological innovation, intelligent manufacturing, and quality branding, and develop information technology application services for entrepreneurship and innovation in small and micro enterprises. Support the construction of the Maker China entrepreneurship and innovation platform. Actively develop new models such as crowdsourcing, crowd support, and crowdfunding, as well as new types of maker spaces, innovation workshops, and open-source communities, cultivate a low-threshold, widely covered, and vibrant ecosystem for innovation and entrepreneurship, and promote the integration of production and demand, traditional industries and emerging industries, and cooperation between large enterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises. Develop new research and development innovation services. Accelerate the construction of innovation centers in the manufacturing industry, promote the research, development, transfer, diffusion, and initial commercialization of generic and cutting-edge technologies, and create an innovative ecosystem that spans the innovation chain and the industrial chain. Promote the online and platform-based transformation of professional research and development services such as inspection and testing, certification, intellectual property rights, and technology transactions, and promote the transformation of research and development achievements and market expansion. Strengthen industry-university-research cooperation, utilize new generation information technologies and platforms such as mobile internet, cloud computing, and big data, and develop virtual online, agile and efficient, and on-demand supply of new research and development services.
titlelist: The main task is to build a new system of double innovation in the manufacturing industry based on the Internet, and stimulate the vitality of entrepreneurship and innovation.

name: Integration Development Plan for Informatization and Industrialization (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 333) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 12, 2016)
content: Enhance the capability of system solution. Conduct research on fundamental key standards such as architecture, models, data, and data chains of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), and break through key core technologies such as physical simulation, real-time sensing, intelligent control, human-machine interaction, and system autonomy. Build an application testing and verification platform for CPS, as well as a comprehensive testbed with verification capability, and organize pilot demonstrations of CPS applications. Accelerate the development of local system solution providers in key industries such as intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and intelligent factories. Strengthen the research and development of excellent solutions that cater to the characteristics and needs of key industries, and promote their widespread adoption.
titlelist: The main task is to create a new ecosystem of cross-border integration and enhance the industry's ability for integrated innovation.

name: Integration Development Plan for Informatization and Industrialization (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 333) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 12, 2016)
content: Accelerate the popularization and promotion of the management system standards for the integration of the two industries. Improve the basic standards of the management system for the integration of the two industries, develop new standards such as classification standards, organizational management change tools and methods, and research and develop a new capability framework system and reference model to guide the transformation of enterprises towards the Internet. Organize the implementation and promotion of the management system for the integration of the two industries, cultivate a group of demonstration enterprises in different industries and fields, accelerate the construction of an open, flat, and platform-based organizational management model, and create core competitiveness for enterprises based on standard guidance and innovation-driven. Improve the market-oriented service system of the management system for the integration of the two industries, establish a mechanism for online and offline collaborative promotion, strengthen policy guidance and financial support, and accelerate the formation of a market-oriented credibility mechanism for the evaluation results of the management system for the integration of the two industries. Continuously carry out the evaluation and benchmarking guidance for the integration of the two industries. Combining with the new trends of intelligent manufacturing and Internet +, optimize the evaluation index system and evaluation model for the integration of the two industries in enterprises, and improve the collaborative work system for the evaluation of the integration of the two industries at the national, local government, and enterprise levels. Build a big data platform for the evaluation of the integration of the two industries in enterprises, periodically organize self-evaluation, self-diagnosis, and self-benchmarking of the integration of the two industries in enterprises, and focus on the identification of the current situation, benefit analysis, problem diagnosis, and trend prediction of the integration of the two industries to form data maps for the integration of the two industries in regions, industries, enterprises, etc., and improve the precision of government policies, institutional services, and enterprise decision-making.
titlelist: The main tasks are to popularize the standard of integrating the two transformations and to innovate the organizational management model of enterprises.

name: Integration Development Plan for Informatization and Industrialization (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 333) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 12, 2016)
content: Accelerate the development of intelligent new products. Focus on building a technical system that supports the industrialization of intelligent hardware, promote the research and development of common key technologies such as low-power CPUs, high-precision sensors, new display devices, lightweight operating systems, etc., and facilitate the rapid transformation of innovative achievements. Support the research and industrialization of key areas of intelligent products, integrated development platforms, and solutions, and support breakthroughs in core technologies of virtual reality and artificial intelligence, as well as product and application innovation. name: Special Action Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization (2013-2018) (excerpt) (MIIT Letter [2013] No. 317) (MIIT/August 23, 2013)
content: By 2018, significant progress has been made in the deep integration of the two industries, and the competitiveness of enterprises under the conditions of informatization has generally increased. The application of information technology and innovation in business models have effectively promoted the adjustment and upgrading of industrial structure. The quality and efficiency of industrial development have been comprehensively improved, and the national level of integration of the two industries has reached 82.The Enterprise Integration Management System has been widely promoted. The integration level of key industries and large and medium-sized enterprises has been gradually improved, with 80% of enterprises at or above the integrated improvement stage. A number of excellent enterprises with strong innovation capabilities, good application effects, and international competitiveness have emerged. The proportion of small and medium-sized enterprises using information technology for research and development, management, and production control has reached 55%, and the proportion of using e-commerce for procurement, sales, and other business activities has reached 50%.Information technology has penetrated into the industrial field comprehensively, and the overall level of integration of traditional industries has been improved. Convergence innovation based on information networks continues to emerge. New productive service industries driven by new technologies and applications such as e-commerce, industrial cloud, and big data have flourished. The transaction volume of electronic commerce (B2B) between enterprises has exceeded 20 trillion yuan. Progress has been made in the construction of quality and safety information traceability systems for key products such as food and drugs. The safety production level of high-risk industries such as civil explosives and dangerous chemicals has been enhanced. The energy utilization efficiency in various industries has significantly improved, with 50% of key industrial energy-using enterprises achieving a high level of application of digital energy solutions, resulting in energy savings of 50 million tons of standard coal.The support service capabilities of information technology have significantly improved. Significant breakthroughs have been made in intelligent manufacturing equipment with digitization, flexibility, and system integration technologies as the core, and they have been rapidly applied in key areas of the national economy. The rate of numerical control in key industries' equipment has reached 70%. The supporting capabilities of secure and controllable information technology products and information services have been significantly enhanced, and comprehensive independent supporting capabilities have been achieved in key areas.
titlelist: Overall requirements, overall objectives

name: Development Plan for High-end Equipment Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/May 7, 2012)
content: Focused on key sectors of the national economy such as advanced manufacturing, light industry and textiles, energy, environmental protection, and comprehensive utilization of resources. The urgent need for development requires a focus on both manufacturing and services, with key breakthroughs in key intelligent technologies, core intelligent measurement and control devices and components, development of intelligent basic manufacturing equipment and major intelligent manufacturing equipment sets, and vigorous promotion of demonstration applications to foster new industries. It aims to improve the digitization, flexibility, and system integration level of the manufacturing process, accelerate the integration and collaborative application of information technology, and promote innovative industrial development models under the conditions of integration of informatization and industrialization. Key common intelligent basic technologies include breakthroughs in nine categories: sensing, decision-making, and execution of intelligent functions, focusing on new sensing technology, modular and embedded control system design technology, advanced control and optimization technology, system collaboration technology, fault diagnosis and health maintenance technology, high-reliability real-time communication network technology, functional safety technology, special processes and precision manufacturing technology, and recognition technology. It strengthens the research and development of common intelligent technologies, algorithms, software architecture, software platforms, software systems, embedded systems, and large-scale complex equipment system simulation software, providing technical support for the intelligentization of manufacturing equipment and processes. Core intelligent measurement and control devices and components include the development of eight typical intelligent measurement and control devices and components, such as new sensors and systems, intelligent control systems, intelligent instruments, precision instruments, industrial robots and special robots, precision transmission devices, servo control mechanisms, and fluid and gas sealing components and systems, and achieving industrialization. Major intelligent manufacturing integrated equipment focuses on the development of eight major types of intelligent manufacturing integrated equipment, such as intelligent complete equipment for petroleum and petrochemicals, intelligent complete equipment for metallurgy, intelligent forming and processing complete equipment, automated logistics complete equipment, complete equipment for building materials manufacturing, intelligent food manufacturing production lines, intelligent textile complete equipment, and intelligent printing equipment. Key application demonstration and promotion areas are selected based on the development level of intelligent manufacturing technology and intelligent measurement and control devices in China. Focusing on the manufacturing industry, during the 12th Five-Year Plan period, key areas such as electric power, energy conservation and environmental protection, agriculture, resource extraction, national defense science and technology industry, and infrastructure construction are selected for promotion and application demonstration in a step-by-step and hierarchical manner, forming a universal and standardized application platform, and accelerating the coordinated development of technology, industry, and application.
titlelist: Development focus and direction, intelligent manufacturing equipment.

For micro-nano manufacturing technology, we will focus on breakthroughs in green nano-printing equipment manufacturing technology, develop a series of practical bio-detection sensors and systems, and develop engineering micro-machining processes and packaging technology. For intelligent sensors and instruments, we will break through the key sensor and instrument product development technology urgently needed for national major projects. For embedded industrial control chips, we will develop two series of on-chip control modules (CMC) for industrial process control and special control, and demonstrate their application in different industries such as industrial instruments and meters, intelligent buildings and energy-saving control systems, equipment numerical control systems, smart meters, and solar thermal control systems. For manufacturing information technology, we will develop core software for manufacturing industry, provide basic platforms, and support the development of manufacturing information technology. For manufacturing process safety and security technology, we will develop safety control systems for the nuclear power and petrochemical industries, and develop software and hardware products for industrial control system security protection.
titlelist: The key tasks are proposed to focus on basic theory and technology research, intelligent equipment, intelligent technology and equipment for manufacturing process, basic technology and components for intelligent manufacturing, system integration, and key technology and component research for intelligent manufacturing based on the characteristics and trends of intelligent manufacturing technology development.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Development Twelfth Five-Year Plan Special Plan (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 193) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: Intelligent high-end equipment refers to equipment that plays an important driving role in the upgrading of industrial technology and the development of strategic emerging industries. It is mainly reflected in the major core technologies and major technical equipment related to high-end equipment manufacturing. The focus is on the research of precision workstations for chassis, high-end manufacturing equipment, intelligent engineering machinery and complete sets of equipment, and manufacturing equipment for new energy products. This lays the technical foundation and industrial foundation for high-end equipment, greatly enhancing the international competitiveness of high-end equipment and intelligent manufacturing technology in China. Precision workstations for chassis aim to master the key technologies for the design and manufacturing of precision workstations for chassis, and initially break the long-term dependence on imports of precision workstations for chassis in China, leading the development of high-end CNC machine tool design and manufacturing technology. Intelligent engineering machinery and complete sets of equipment aim to develop intelligent engineering machinery and complete sets of equipment, develop 8-meter diameter hard rock tunnel boring machines, 12-meter diameter deep-buried mud-water composite shield machines, and major engineering machinery and equipment to meet the increasing urgent demand for large-scale tunneling and major engineering machinery and equipment in national infrastructure construction. Manufacturing equipment for new energy products aims to overcome the core technologies for manufacturing solar cells and semiconductor lighting products, and develop complete sets of equipment represented by MOCVD and PECVD to enhance the industry's independent research and development and competitive capabilities.
titlelist: The key tasks are proposed to focus on the research and development of basic theories and technologies, intelligent equipment, intelligent technology and equipment for manufacturing processes, basic technologies and components for intelligent manufacturing, system integration, and research and development of intelligent high-end equipment, based on the characteristics and trends of the development of intelligent manufacturing technology.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Development Twelfth Five-Year Plan Special Plan (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 193) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: In response to the gap in product design, flexible manufacturing, high-speed and high-precision manufacturing, automation, and networked manufacturing in China's high-end equipment and manufacturing processes, efforts are being made to overcome a batch of intelligent manufacturing process technologies and equipment. Key research areas include industrial robots, automated production lines, core processes in process industries, and complete sets of equipment, aiming to enhance the level of intelligent manufacturing processes and promote the rapid development of the manufacturing industry. For industrial robots, the focus is on tackling the common technologies of the robot body, precision reducers, servo drives and motors, controllers, and other core components, independently developing engineering products for industrial robots, achieving technological breakthroughs and industrialization of industrial robots and their core components. For automated production lines, the goal is to build digital assembly systems for large transport aircraft, component digital assembly systems, and digital assembly systems for aircraft. For core processes and complete sets of equipment in process industries, the aim is to break through key equipment and key process technologies for million-ton ethylene, achieve independent design, independent equipment, and efficient, low-energy operation of million-ton ethylene projects, and develop industrial capabilities.
titlelist: The key tasks are proposed to focus on basic theory and technology research, intelligent equipment, intelligent technology and equipment for manufacturing process, basic technology and components for intelligent manufacturing, system integration, intelligent technology for manufacturing process, equipment research and development based on the characteristics and trends of intelligent manufacturing technology development.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Development Twelfth Five-Year Plan Special Plan (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 193) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: Targeting the seven strategic emerging industries and traditional manufacturing industries, integrate the theory and technology of intelligent manufacturing, basic technologies and components of intelligent manufacturing, intelligent high-end equipment, and intelligent manufacturing processes. Research and implement demonstration applications and industrialization-related technologies to promote the popularization and application of intelligent manufacturing technology and equipment, as well as the development of emerging high-tech industries.
titlelist: The key tasks are proposed to focus on basic theory and technology research, intelligent equipment, intelligent technology and equipment for manufacturing process, basic technology and components for intelligent manufacturing, system integration, and major demonstration applications based on the characteristics and trends of intelligent manufacturing technology development.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Development Twelfth Five-Year Plan Special Plan (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 193) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: Strengthen the innovation capability of intelligent manufacturing technology in enterprises, encourage the establishment of truly effective industry-university-research cooperation alliances with enterprises as the main body and the participation of higher education institutions and research institutes; emphasize vertical integration of the industrial chain, targeting design, manufacturing, sales, maintenance and other links, through long-term support in terms of projects-talents-bases, explore the formation of an effective mechanism combining industry, academia, research, and application.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, establish a truly effective alliance between industry, academia, and research for practical use.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Development Twelfth Five-Year Plan Special Plan (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 193) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: Through government guidance and promotion, fully utilize the risk compensation mechanism for the first domestically produced set of equipment, and enhance the confidence of users in purchasing and using the first set of equipment. Utilize industrial policies to guide social funds, attract investment from various parties, share the financial pressure and innovation risks of enterprises, and address users' concerns. Collaborate with other government departments, science and technology departments at all levels, and relevant industry associations to form a joint force. Encourage social funds and private capital to invest in basic technologies and components of intelligent manufacturing, intelligentization of manufacturing processes, and intelligent high-end equipment manufacturing technologies, promote the implementation of major independent innovation projects, and promote the coordinated development of enterprises in the intelligent manufacturing industry chain.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, fully leverage the guiding role of policies.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Development Twelfth Five-Year Plan Special Plan (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 193) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: Give full play to the role of national high-tech industrial development zones and national-level high-tech industrialization bases, promote the implementation of key projects in intelligent manufacturing, accelerate the industrialization of achievements, and focus on cultivating core competitiveness. Implement the construction of innovative industrial clusters, focus on the main goals determined by key projects, scientifically determine the key directions of cluster construction, reasonably choose technology paths and industrial routes, take effective measures to promote the formation and innovative development of industrial clusters.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote the transformation of industrial clusters for development outcomes.

name: Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Development Twelfth Five-Year Plan Special Plan (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 193) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: Improve the incentive mechanism for intelligent manufacturing technology talents, optimize the environment for the growth of innovative talents, establish a multi-level intelligent manufacturing talent training system that meets the needs of industrial technological development, focus on cultivating a group of high-level scientific research leaders, and pay attention to cultivating a group of innovative scientific and technological talents during the implementation of key special projects in the development of intelligent manufacturing technology.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase the intensity of cultivating high-quality talents.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Internationalization of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (Shang Chan Fa [2011] No. 310) (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Environmental Protection, General Administration of Customs, State Administration of Taxation, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Intellectual Property Office/September 8, 2011)
content: Promoting the international development of strategic emerging industries means grasping the new characteristics of economic globalization, gradually deepening international cooperation, actively exploring new models of cooperation, and participating in international cooperation at a higher level, thereby enhancing the independent development capability and core competitiveness of strategic emerging industries. Promoting the international development of strategic emerging industries in China should have a clear positioning and direction. First, it is to improve the international development level of research and development, manufacturing, marketing, and other aspects of strategic emerging industries, and enhance the competitiveness of the entire industry chain. Second, it is to enhance the international development capabilities of talents, enterprises, industry alliances, and innovation bases in strategic emerging industries, and improve the competitiveness of market entities. Third, it is to create a favorable environment for the international development of strategic emerging industries and improve the supporting guarantee system. Fourth, it is to handle the relationship between the two markets and consolidate the domestic foundation for the international development of strategic emerging industries.
