name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Internationalization of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (Shang Chan Fa [2011] No. 310) (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Environmental Protection, General Administration of Customs, State Administration of Taxation, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Intellectual Property Office/September 8, 2011)
content: Cultivate an international base for energy-saving and environmental protection industries, encourage the development of energy-saving and environmental protection products in the international market, increase the added value of exported products, and promote the transformation from single-machine exports to complete sets of supply. Establish an import and recycling resource supervision zone, encourage eligible recycling enterprises to implement the going global strategy, engage in foreign engineering contracting and labor service exports, and promote international circular economy. Encourage eligible enterprises to provide supporting environmental technical services for investment projects and technical assistance projects abroad. Strengthen international cooperation in the field of energy-saving and environmental protection. Promote the implementation of domestic funding for international environmental cooperation projects, enhance international environmental technology transfer, and increase support for China's participation in international negotiations in the field of environmental services trade.
titlelist: Highlighting industrial characteristics, clarifying development directions, promoting internationalization, and focusing on energy conservation and environmental protection industries.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Internationalization of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (Shang Chan Fa [2011] No. 310) (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Environmental Protection, General Administration of Customs, State Administration of Taxation, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Intellectual Property Office/September 8, 2011)
content: Encourage the high-end equipment manufacturing industry to fully utilize global innovation resources, engage in various forms of research and development cooperation, and enhance innovation capabilities; support the international market development of domestically produced aircraft (including trunk aircraft, regional aircraft, and general aircraft), marine engineering equipment, and advanced rail transit equipment; encourage the import of key components and airborne systems in the aviation industry; encourage subcontracting production and support high-level joint ventures between domestic and foreign enterprises; support the overseas investment and establishment of factories by the aviation, marine engineering equipment, high-end intelligent equipment industries, and engage in component production and equipment assembly activities; encourage high-level joint ventures between domestic and foreign enterprises in the marine engineering equipment industry.
titlelist: Highlighting industrial characteristics, clarifying development directions, promoting internationalization, focusing on high-end equipment manufacturing industry.

name: Opinions on the Full, Accurate, and Comprehensive Implementation of the New Development Concept and the Work of Achieving Peak Carbon Emissions and Carbon Neutrality (Excerpt) (Zhongfa [2021] No. 36) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/September 22, 2021)
content: Accelerate the promotion of green development in agriculture and promote carbon sequestration and efficiency in agriculture. Develop implementation plans for carbon peaking in industries and sectors such as energy, steel, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, building materials, transportation, and construction. Revise the guidance catalog for industrial restructuring with a focus on energy conservation and carbon reduction. Conduct a review of the steel and coal capacity reduction efforts to consolidate the achievements. Accelerate the low-carbon technological innovation and digital transformation in the industrial sector. Carry out pilot projects for carbon peaking in designated areas. Speed up the green transformation of commerce, trade, circulation, and information services, and enhance the level of low-carbon development in the service industry.
titlelist: Deeply adjust the industrial structure and promote the optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure.

name: Opinions on the Full, Accurate, and Comprehensive Implementation of the New Development Concept and the Work of Achieving Peak Carbon Emissions and Carbon Neutrality (Excerpt) (Zhongfa [2021] No. 36) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/September 22, 2021)
content: Accelerate the development of strategic emerging industries such as the new generation of information technology, biotechnology, new energy, new materials, high-end equipment, new energy vehicles, green environmental protection, as well as aerospace and marine equipment. Build a green manufacturing system. Promote the deep integration of emerging technologies such as the Internet, big data, artificial intelligence, and fifth-generation mobile communication (5G) with green and low-carbon industries.
titlelist: Deeply adjust the industrial structure and vigorously develop green and low-carbon industries.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 44 of 2005) (State Council/February 10, 2006)
content: Major special projects are crucial for achieving national goals. They are significant strategic products, key common technologies, and major engineering projects that are completed within a certain time frame through breakthroughs in core technologies and resource integration. They are of utmost importance for the development of science and technology in our country. The 'Outline of the Plan' identifies 16 major special projects, including core electronic devices, high-end general-purpose chips and basic software, large-scale integrated circuit manufacturing technology and complete sets of processes, next-generation broadband wireless mobile communication, high-end CNC machine tools and basic manufacturing technology, large-scale oil and gas fields and coalbed methane development, large-scale advanced pressurized water reactors and high-temperature gas-cooled reactors for nuclear power plants, water pollution control and treatment, genetically modified new crop varieties breeding, major new drug development, prevention and treatment of major infectious diseases such as AIDS and viral hepatitis, large aircraft, high-resolution Earth observation systems, manned spaceflight, and lunar exploration projects. These projects involve strategic industries such as information and biology, as well as urgent issues related to energy, resources, environment, people's health, and dual-use and defense technologies.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 44 of 2005) (State Council/February 10, 2006)
content: (9) Major mechanics problems in aerospace. The focus is on researching hypersonic propulsion systems and ultra-high-speed collision mechanics problems, multidimensional power systems and complex motion control theory, compressible turbulence theory, high-temperature gas thermodynamics, magnetofluid and plasma dynamics, microfluidics and microsystem dynamics, and mechanics of new material structures.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: By 2020, more than 500 general aviation airports will be built, basically achieving the goal of having general aviation airports or transportation airports with general aviation services in cities at or above the prefecture level, covering major agricultural production areas, major forest areas, and over 50% of 5A-level tourist attractions. The number of general aviation aircraft will exceed 5,000, with an annual flight time of over 2 million hours, and a number of competitive general aviation enterprises will be cultivated. The research, development, and manufacturing level of general aviation aircraft and the rate of self-reliance will be significantly improved, and the proportion of domestically produced general aviation aircraft in the general aviation fleet will be noticeably increased. The economic scale of the general aviation industry will exceed 1 trillion yuan, and a preliminary pattern of safe, orderly, and coordinated development will be formed.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Encourage and strengthen the application of general aviation in emergency rescue, medical assistance, and other fields, improve the aviation emergency rescue system, and enhance rapid response capabilities. Expand the area of general aviation agricultural and forestry operations, basically achieve aviation forest protection in major forest areas, and promote the application of general aviation in industrial and energy construction, land and geological resources exploration, environmental monitoring, communication relay, and other fields.
titlelist: Develop the general aviation market, expand public welfare services and production applications.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Promote the integration of general aviation with the internet and the creative economy, and expand new forms of general aviation. Encourage the combination of general aviation and the tourism industry, and carry out aerial sightseeing activities in suitable areas. Encourage the development of flight training and increase the proportion of flight licenses. Actively develop non-commercial general aviation such as personal use and corporate use, and encourage the development of aviation sports and experiential flights. Utilize activities such as exhibitions, air races, and aviation cultural exchanges to support the development of general aviation clubs, associations for general aviation enthusiasts, and other social organizations, and expand the community of general aviation enthusiasts and consumers.
titlelist: Cultivate the general aviation market and encourage aviation consumption.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Taking into account factors such as population, land, airspace resources, transportation, and industrial foundation, and based on market demand and development reality, we will promote the construction of general aviation airports according to local conditions. The scale and standards of general aviation airport construction should be reasonably determined, and the facilities should adhere to the principles of economy, applicability, aesthetics, and environmental friendliness. While ensuring operational safety, investment should be saved and operating costs should be reduced.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction of general airports and determine standards reasonably.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Strengthen regional cooperation, promote the construction of comprehensive general aviation airports in regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other key city clusters, ensure general aviation operational services, and create important nodes in the regional general aviation network. Encourage the construction of comprehensive general aviation airports in cities where hub transportation airports are located to relieve non-core business of hub transportation airports. Prioritize supporting the addition of general aviation facilities at feeder airports to expand business scope and consider comprehensive support for regional general aviation operational services. Encourage general airports to be open to the public and disclose airport and service facility information. Guide neighboring regions to break administrative boundaries and jointly build and use general aviation airports. Accelerate the construction of general aviation air traffic control, fuel storage and transportation, operation, and maintenance service facilities.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction of general airports and coordinate overall development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Build a national general aviation research and development innovation system, encourage the establishment of innovative platforms for general aviation, improve the independent research and development and production capabilities of key technologies and components, accelerate the level of localization, and develop general aviation products with independent intellectual property rights, high quality, and low cost. Support the development and application of large amphibious aircraft, new energy aircraft, light business jets, civil helicopters, multi-purpose fixed-wing aircraft, professional-grade drones, as well as supporting engines, onboard systems, etc. Promote the application of new technologies such as Beidou navigation and broadcast automatic surveillance, research and develop core equipment suitable for China's low-altitude airspace communication, navigation, surveillance, meteorology, and air traffic service needs, carry out major airworthiness certification laboratory construction, and improve the industry's operation, service, safety management, and technical level.
titlelist: Promote industrial transformation and upgrading, enhance manufacturing capabilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Priority should be given to the construction of 50 comprehensive or specialized demonstration zones in areas where conditions such as airspace and land are available, in order to promote the development of the general aviation industry. Cultivate and build leading general aviation manufacturing enterprises with international advanced levels, gradually forming a group of backbone enterprises with core competitiveness, supporting the aggregation and innovation of numerous small and medium-sized enterprises, and developing advanced general aviation equipment, specialized supporting systems, and equipment. Promote operational service innovation, strengthen comprehensive support capacity building, and promote the implementation of management reform measures in the region. Encourage local innovative supporting policies, actively attract social capital, develop general aviation advantageous industries closely linked to the local economy, and leverage the driving role of the general aviation industry in regional economic development.
titlelist: Promote industrial transformation and upgrading, promote industrial clustering.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Actively connect and absorb high-quality resources from the international general aviation industry, strengthen cooperation in areas such as general aviation manufacturing, operation management, and flight training, introduce, digest, and absorb advanced technology, and improve the design and manufacturing level of general aviation products in our country. Innovate international cooperation models, encourage the establishment of international research and development cooperation platforms and international general aviation engineering centers, and enhance technological innovation capabilities. Encourage and support general aviation enterprises to leverage the advantages of policies such as the Belt and Road strategy and free trade zones, promote general aviation products with comparative advantages to go global, actively explore foreign markets, and enhance the international competitiveness of independent brands.
titlelist: Promote industrial transformation and upgrading, deepen international cooperation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Timely summarize and promote the experience of reform pilot projects in low-altitude airspace management, achieve seamless connection between surveillance airspace below 3000 meters and reporting airspace, establish visual flight routes in low-altitude airspace, and facilitate fast and flexible flight of general aviation aircraft. Study, formulate, and organize the implementation of airspace classification standards, establish controlled airspace in important areas such as national (border) zones, restricted airspace, national key prevention and control target areas, and key air defense targets, including civil aviation airspace such as air routes, approach (terminal) areas, and airport control zones, to ensure the safety of important targets and civil aviation flight operations.
titlelist: Expand the opening of low-altitude airspace, scientifically plan airspace.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Improve the basic aviation intelligence data system, develop and publish visual flight aviation charts, real-time release flight dynamics, weather conditions of monitored airspace, and report airspace, enhance the capabilities of low-altitude airspace aviation intelligence, aviation meteorology, flight intelligence, and warning services. Simplify the approval process for general aviation flight missions, flight plan applications, and approvals (filing procedures). In principle, general aviation users only need to apply or report flight plans to one air traffic control unit. For flight activities involving controlled airspace, flight plans and air traffic control permits must be applied for. Long-term flight plans only need to be applied for once. Flight plans involving only monitored airspace and reported airspace can be implemented after reporting.
titlelist: Expand the opening of low-altitude airspace, optimize flight services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: According to the existing division of responsibilities, the National Development and Reform Commission is responsible for approving projects for the manufacturing of general-purpose aircraft weighing 6 tons or more and with 9 seats or more, as well as helicopters weighing 3 tons or more. Other projects are approved by the provincial-level people's governments. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology is responsible for improving industry standards for the production of general aviation aircraft and establishing standards and regulations for the production of civilian drones. The Civil Aviation Administration is responsible for improving airworthiness standards and certification procedures for general aviation aircraft and components, enhancing the capability for approving general aviation aircraft models, strengthening airworthiness management for aviation fuel, and achieving comprehensive airworthiness management coverage.
titlelist: Strengthen overall safety supervision and enhance airworthiness management.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Establish a cross-departmental and cross-domain general aviation joint regulatory mechanism, form a comprehensive and traceable safety regulatory system, led by the Office of the National Air Traffic Control Commission and the Civil Aviation Administration, and in accordance with the principle of ground control as the main, air disposal as the auxiliary, classify and grade responsibilities, and implement safety regulation for general aviation operations. The Civil Aviation Administration is responsible for building a general aviation safety regulatory platform, fully utilizing modern information technologies such as mobile internet and big data, enhancing the monitoring and tracking capabilities of general aviation ground and air activities, and achieving real-time monitoring of flight dynamics. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology is responsible for the planning and management of civil unmanned aerial vehicle radio frequencies. It is responsible for verifying and handling illegal and irregular aerial activities, while the public security department is responsible for on-site investigation and cracking down on illegal and irregular activities such as black flights, ensuring the safety and order of low-altitude flights.
titlelist: Strengthen overall safety supervision to ensure operational safety.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Fully mobilize social forces, adopt multiple methods and multiple sources of funding, increase the funding guarantee for general aviation public services such as medical rescue, emergency response, disaster prevention and reduction, transportation services in remote and inaccessible areas, and ground transportation services. Expand the scope of government purchasing services in the general aviation field, and improve existing subsidy policies. Encourage enterprises and individuals to invest in the general aviation industry, and support government and social capital cooperation in the construction and operation of general aviation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial support.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of General Aviation Industry (State Council Document No. [2016] 38) (State Council General Office/ May 17, 2016)
content: Support the establishment of general aviation programs in vocational colleges and technical schools to cultivate professionals in fields such as flight, airworthiness, aircraft and engine manufacturing, and maintenance. Encourage private investment in general aviation training institutions to enhance the collaborative training capabilities for high-level talents through multiple levels and channels.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen talent cultivation.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of the Geographic Information Industry (Excerpt) (State Council Document No. 2 of 2014) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2014)
content: Develop mapping application satellites, high-altitude aerial photography aircraft, low-altitude drones, and ground remote sensing systems to accelerate the construction of facilities for obtaining aerospace remote sensing data. Form an optical, radar, laser, and other remote sensing data acquisition system to significantly improve the level of remote sensing data acquisition. Strengthen the research and development of remote sensing data processing technology to further improve data processing and analysis capabilities.
titlelist: Promote rapid development in key areas, enhance remote sensing data acquisition and processing capabilities.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of the Geographic Information Industry (Excerpt) (State Council Document No. 2 of 2014) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2014)
content: Cultivate a number of large-scale enterprises producing high-end geospatial information technology equipment with intellectual property rights, and drive related supporting parts production enterprises to develop towards specialization, refinement, and uniqueness, enhancing the specialization, refinement, and uniqueness of equipment manufacturing.
titlelist: Promote the rapid development of key areas and revitalize the manufacturing of geographic information equipment.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of the Geographic Information Industry (Excerpt) (State Council Document No. 2 of 2014) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2014)
content: Combining the development trends of next-generation internet, Internet of Things, cloud computing, and other new technologies, vigorously promote the research and development of geographic information software, especially in the industrialization of core foundational software such as large-scale geographic information systems and high-performance remote sensing data automation processing, to achieve breakthroughs and reach international advanced levels.
titlelist: Promote rapid development in key areas, improve the level of geographic information software research and industrialization.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of the Geographic Information Industry (Excerpt) (State Council Document No. 2 of 2014) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2014)
content: Accelerate the widespread use of modern surveying and mapping benchmarks, combined with the development of the Beidou satellite navigation industry, enhance the service capabilities of navigation electronic maps, internet maps, and other location-based services, actively develop and promote mobile location services products that contribute to national economic development and facilitate people's daily lives, and cultivate new economic growth points.
titlelist: Promote the rapid development of key areas, develop integrated services of geographic information and navigation positioning.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium- and Long-Term Development Plan for the Satellite Navigation Industry (excerpt) (State Council Document No. [2013] 97) (State Council General Office/September 27, 2013)
content: Currently, the international satellite navigation industry has formed a relatively complete industrial system, with continuously improving navigation service performance, expanding application scope, and rapidly growing market size. The application of satellite navigation technology has become an essential means for the economic and social development of developed countries, and has had a profound impact on scientific development in areas such as resource utilization, environmental protection, and public services.
titlelist: The current situation and trends indicate that the satellite navigation industry is developing rapidly internationally, and it has a profound impact on economic and social development.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium- and Long-Term Development Plan for the Satellite Navigation Industry (excerpt) (State Council Document No. [2013] 97) (State Council General Office/September 27, 2013)
content: While China is constructing the Beidou satellite navigation system, the United States is further strengthening and improving the Global Positioning System (GPS). Russia, the European Union, Japan, India, and other countries are also independently developing their own satellite navigation systems. At the same time, the global satellite navigation industry is transitioning from a single GPS application to a multi-system compatible application, from primarily navigation applications to integrated applications with mobile communication, the internet, and other technologies, and from primarily terminal applications to a focus on both products and services. The international landscape consists of both competition and cooperation, and the trend of industry integration will undoubtedly promote the deep application of satellite navigation technology in a wider range of fields and drive the comprehensive development of satellite navigation and related industries.
titlelist: The current situation and trends are that countries around the world are competing to build satellite navigation systems, and the integration and development of industries are accelerating and evolving.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium- and Long-Term Development Plan for the Satellite Navigation Industry (excerpt) (State Council Document No. [2013] 97) (State Council General Office/September 27, 2013)
content: The theoretical research and technological development of satellite navigation applications in our country have progressed rapidly. Key technologies such as navigation chips and antennas have made significant breakthroughs and have been commercialized. The Beidou satellite navigation system has already achieved regional service capabilities and has played an important role in various fields such as transportation and marine fisheries. Currently, it is steadily advancing the construction of a global system. With the integration and development of satellite navigation, transportation, smart terminals, and mobile internet, the level of application technology has significantly improved, and the manufacturing and service capabilities have rapidly increased. Our country has become a major exporter of in-car navigation terminal products.
titlelist: The current situation and prospects: China's Beidou satellite navigation system construction has made breakthrough progress, and the development of the satellite navigation industry has made significant strides.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium- and Long-Term Development Plan for the Satellite Navigation Industry (excerpt) (State Council Document No. [2013] 97) (State Council General Office/September 27, 2013)
content: With the rapid development of modern information society, the public's demand for innovative and comprehensive spatiotemporal information services is becoming increasingly strong. In the future, the Beidou satellite navigation system, based on its characteristic advantages such as short message communication, will greatly expand its applications in key areas of the national economy, industries, public services, and the mass market. The integration of mobile communication and internet technology in location-based services will effectively promote the upgrading of the satellite navigation application industry structure and unleash a broader market space. However, in the context of global competition among multiple satellite navigation systems and the rapid development of the industry, China's satellite navigation industry still faces prominent problems. Firstly, the construction of China's satellite navigation system lags behind the development needs of the industry, and the applications mainly rely on foreign systems. Secondly, there is a lack of overall planning, with insufficient capacity and duplication of ground application infrastructure. Thirdly, there is a lack of independent innovation capability, with a weak grasp of core technologies and integration application capabilities. There is a significant gap between related products and solutions and international advanced levels, resulting in severe market pressure on the Beidou satellite navigation system application market. Fourthly, related policies, regulations, and standards are not yet sound, with low industry concentration and a lack of leading enterprises. The development environment of the industry urgently needs to be optimized. Therefore, it is necessary to accelerate the construction of China's global satellite navigation system, promote the transfer of civil application systems to the Beidou satellite navigation system, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of China's satellite navigation industry.
titlelist: The current situation and prospects of China's satellite navigation industry have vast market potential, but it faces multiple pressures such as lagging system construction compared to industry development needs, core technology constraints, and an urgent need to optimize the industry development environment.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Medium- to Long-Term Plan for the Construction of National Major Science and Technology Infrastructure (2012-2030) (excerpt) (State Council [2013] No. 8) (State Council/February 23, 2013)
content: With the goal of achieving harmonious development between humans and nature, focusing on the processes and changes in the Earth's structure, the composition and fine structure of the Earth's crust, the complex interactions and coupling processes between the various spheres of the Earth system, the response and coupling of the various spheres under the control of the sun and its activities, and the processes and mechanisms of human activities influencing the environment, the key is to build underwater observation, numerical simulation, and benchmark research facilities, gradually forming a research system for complementary observation, detection, and simulation of the Earth system and the environment. In terms of on-site detection and observation, a comprehensive oceanographic research vessel will be built to meet the needs of comprehensive ocean environmental observation, detection, as well as authentic sampling and on-site analysis; an aerial remote sensing system will be established to improve China's remote sensing information technology and equipment research and development capabilities, providing fast, real-time, and accurate remote sensing data for natural disasters and emergencies. The construction of an underwater scientific observation network will provide support for national marine security, resource and energy development, environmental monitoring, and disaster warning and prediction research. Timely initiation of technical monitoring of Earth system science through aerospace and aviation remote sensing, deep-sea exploration and investigation, solid Earth deep exploration and dynamic monitoring, and land-sea Earth environmental observation facilities to achieve comprehensive long-term continuous monitoring and data accumulation at multiple temporal and spatial scales, gradually forming the ability to stereoscopic and dynamically monitor and analyze the Earth system. In terms of benchmark system construction, the construction of precision gravity measurement research facilities will be carried out to obtain high-resolution and high-precision basic data on Earth's mass changes, supporting research on solid Earth evolution, ocean and climate change dynamics, water resource distribution, and geological disaster laws, and meeting the strategic needs of national security, resource exploration, and disaster prevention and mitigation. Timely initiation of benchmark system construction including ground-based benchmarks, environmental benchmarks, and deep space benchmarks. In terms of numerical and experimental simulation, the construction of Earth system numerical simulation devices will be carried out to support research on climate change, Earth system, and processes in various layers, understand the basic laws of Earth's environmental processes, and improve the ability to predict environmental changes and major disasters. Timely initiation of the construction of simulation experimental devices for studying environmental pollution mechanisms and changes, supporting the development of air pollution and watershed pollution prediction models, and research on climate change models, improving the ability to forecast and warn air quality, watershed pollution, and other factors.
titlelist: Overall deployment, Earth system and environmental science field.

Once completed, this facility will provide research and development means for the study of gas turbine components and system characteristics in China, and will provide fundamental support for the sustainable and low-carbon development of fossil energy.

It has a wide range of applications in large-scale mineral resource exploration, environmental change research, and gravity-assisted navigation. The construction of precision gravity measurement research facilities mainly includes: precision gravity measurement reference stations and detection systems, satellite, aerial, and underwater gravity detection environment simulation and physical simulation test systems, and global high-precision gravity field data processing systems. After the completion of these facilities, they will provide important support for solving scientific problems in the study of solid Earth evolution, ocean and climate change, water resource distribution, and geological hazards.

It will have the capability to support research on aircraft takeoff and landing characteristics, engine, fuselage, and wing integration, aerodynamic forces, aerodynamic acoustics, and noise reduction. Once completed, the facility's flow field quality and comprehensive performance will reach international advanced levels.
