name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Promote deep integration with various modes of transportation. Seize the opportunity of concentrated construction of transportation facilities, centering around hub airports and following the principle of connecting as much as possible, strengthen the connection with trunk railways, intercity railways, urban rail transit, expressways, etc., optimize the cargo airport hub-and-spoke system, and form a group of modern comprehensive transportation hubs with airports as the core. Strengthen the overall planning of hub stations, promote the concentration of various transportation modes, shared space, information exchange, and convenient transfers according to the principles of unified planning, design, construction, and coordinated management. Build a comprehensive transportation standard system and coordination mechanism. Summarize the practical experience of Shanghai Hongqiao, Beijing Daxing, Chengdu Tianfu, and other airports, and establish a standard system for the construction and operation management of airport comprehensive transportation hubs. Establish coordination mechanisms for various modes of transportation, optimize interface design, coordinate construction and management cooperation, promote the recognition or unification of construction systems, regulations, standards, etc., and promote the sharing of transportation service and product information. Encourage airports and airlines to invest in and participate in rail transit construction and operation, and leverage the synergistic effect of diverse entities in comprehensive transportation. Establish and improve the management system and mechanism for intermodal transportation between civil aviation and other modes of transportation, break industry segmentation, open up operating rules, promote service integration, and meet the needs of convenient passenger travel and efficient cargo transportation.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system, improve the national comprehensive airport system, and create an integrated airport transportation hub.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Promote the high-quality construction of airports. Strengthen the strategic planning research of hub airports, formulate and revise the overall plan of hub airports in accordance with the principle of moderate advancement, and strengthen the connection with land and spatial planning. Implement the requirements for the construction of four types of airports, innovate planning and design concepts, technical methods, and evaluation indicators, and strengthen implementation in planning and design, project approval, construction and operation, and maintenance to create quality projects. Open up the market access for civil aviation professional engineering design and expand the supply of civil aviation engineering consulting and design. Improve the level of airport operation and management. Promote the revision of the Regulations on the Administration of Civil Airports and continuously improve the airport operation and management system. Strengthen the positioning of airport public infrastructure, guide local governments to adjust performance assessment mechanisms, and pay more attention to safety, service, and other social welfare indicators. Continuously promote the restoration of public welfare functions such as public security, fire protection, and emergency rescue at non-hub airports. Promote the transformation of airports from direct operation to management, and streamline the production and operation relationship between airport management agencies and resident units. Promote the experience of management committees and improve collaborative operational efficiency. Strengthen the operation and safety management of high-altitude airports and military-civilian joint-use airports. Continue to implement airport operation subsidies policy effectively.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system, improve the national comprehensive airport system, and enhance airport construction and operation levels.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Air traffic management is the central system that ensures the safe and efficient operation of civil aviation. With the overall goal of building a strong air traffic control system, it strengthens the guarantee of basic resources, accelerates digital transformation, improves operational service efficiency, and enhances the leading and supporting capabilities of air traffic control for industry development.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system and improve the level of air traffic control services.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen the optimization of operational modes and the application of new technologies to enhance the hourly capacity of airports. Enhance the matching of air and ground resources, with a focus on optimizing airport design by improving runway and taxiway efficiency and increasing the proportion of close-in parking positions. Implement expansion and renovation projects for 9 major international hub airports and 26 regional hub airports. Accelerate the research on optimizing operational standards for multi-runway airports.
titlelist: Building a first-class infrastructure system, hub airport capacity enhancement plan.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Research on establishing a quantitative evaluation model for the capacity and flow of the national airspace system. Construct a high-altitude route network based on high-capacity channels, parallel airways, and one-way circulation to fully meet the aviation traffic demand between urban clusters.
titlelist: Building a first-class infrastructure system, expanding the plan for air routes and navigation routes.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Civil Aviation Development (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Based on the actual time of flight, stopover, and ground taxiing, optimize and reduce the standard flight time of the segments. Improve the precision level of flight scheduling and pre-flight planning, and conduct research on reducing the interval between hub airport schedules.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system, with meticulous management of flight scheduling.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Civil Aviation Development (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Optimize the arrival and departure routes of small and medium-sized airports, establish approach control areas for airports with complex airspace or high flight volumes, and steadily promote the transition of airport surveillance control methods. Accelerate the update and transformation of airport air traffic control facilities and equipment. Incorporate airports with the necessary conditions for air traffic control operations into the collaborative decision-making system. Pilot and promote the application of remote tower and centralized meteorological forecasting technologies at airports in remote areas. Enhance the training support for local airport personnel by civil aviation academies, and promote the establishment of exchange and support mechanisms for air traffic control professionals within the group and between regions. Take multiple measures to enhance the air traffic control capabilities of small and medium-sized airports and improve safety levels.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system, finely manage flight schedule planning, and enhance the air traffic control capabilities of small and medium-sized airports.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: The construction of new infrastructure is the basic condition and foundation support for smart civil aviation. With the goal of enhancing digital perception, data decision-making, lean management, and meticulous service capabilities, and taking digitalization as the key element and technology as the support, we will coordinate the promotion of traditional and new infrastructure construction, build a modern aviation transportation system foundation, cultivate and expand new formats, new services, and new capabilities, and enhance the quality and efficiency of the industry and amplify development momentum.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system and accelerate the construction of new types of infrastructure.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Fully embark on a new journey of smart civil aviation. Adhere to the development path of digitization, intelligence, and wisdom, coordinate the planning and construction of existing and new types of infrastructure, target key areas, and leverage the lever effect of new infrastructure construction. Change the thinking of chimney-style system construction and project promotion, focus on decentralization and platform strategies, apply the concept of a new generation of service-oriented distributed architecture, strengthen the design of the aviation transportation system infrastructure, and promote the interconnection and integration of data among industry entities. Strengthen data sharing and functional reuse, establish an open and smart civil aviation ecosystem that is complementary, smooth, shared, and controllable. Accelerate the release of new driving forces for high-quality development. Guided by improving efficiency, expanding functions, and increasing driving forces, supported by advanced concepts and technologies, formulate an action plan for the construction of new civil aviation infrastructure, clarify the implementation path, and improve supporting policies. Upgrade the intelligentization of industry safety production, operation services, and facility support around flight flow, passenger flow, baggage flow, cargo flow, traffic flow, and energy flow. Strengthen the intelligent interconnection of passengers, baggage, cargo, aircraft, and facilities, and build a smart civil aviation operation infrastructure system.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system, accelerate the construction of new infrastructure, and accurately empower with smart capabilities.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Deploy information infrastructure construction. Actively support the construction of the country's new generation communication network to achieve low latency, high reliability, and high bandwidth civil aviation communication services. Accelerate the deployment of intelligent sensing terminals and promote comprehensive IoT facilities in various industries. Research and open a batch of ground unmanned driving equipment test sites according to different scenarios and risk levels, and support the development of innovative applications for new facilities and equipment. Strengthen the application of the Beidou system in navigation, positioning, and timing. Construct information infrastructure such as industry big data centers to support application support, enhance industry digital processing, digital response, and digital decision-making capabilities. Strengthen the application of smart service scenarios. With the core goal of shortening passenger travel time and improving service quality, focus on hub airports and promote passenger guidance throughout the entire process, contactless customs clearance, differentiated security checks, and customs epidemic prevention one-time inspection to ensure a seamless passenger travel experience. With the core goal of simplifying processes, reducing time, and lowering costs, improve the automation level of air cargo facilities, promote intelligent sorting, loading, and warehousing facilities. Implement electronic waybills and online logistics services, promote information sharing, standardization, and mutual recognition of security checks, and achieve one bill for cargo transportation. Promote seamless connection, efficient transfer, and mutual recognition of security checks for air-land intermodal services, and create an integrated travel service chain. Support the development of value-added services and integrated service products, and promote the construction of a new generation passenger service system. Enhance the industry's intelligent operation capabilities. With aircraft operations as the core, build a civil aviation collaborative operation platform for the entire industry, construct a digital operating environment, form intelligent operation solutions, and enhance overall operational support capabilities. Accelerate the expansion of track-based operations in key air routes and key areas. Explore the collaborative operation of military and civil aviation and the integration of manned and unmanned aircraft operations. Accelerate the application of advanced safety warning and emergency response technologies to improve the industry's emergency response and flight recovery capabilities in emergencies. Strengthen the intelligence hub of airlines, enhance flight operation control, network planning, aircraft management capabilities, and adapt to the needs of operating large-scale fleets. Improve the intelligence level of airport flight support, and achieve comprehensive and precise monitoring and intelligent elements at key airports. Allocate and strengthen proactive security warnings and other intelligent operations. Strengthen the application of new technologies and materials, and promote the intelligent construction, operation, and maintenance of civil aviation infrastructure. Cultivate and develop a new digital ecosystem for civil aviation. Utilize intelligent technology to deepen the integration and development of civil aviation with logistics, tourism, finance, commerce, and other fields, promote the upgrading of the civil aviation service chain to high-end, and cultivate and develop new formats. Apply customized and one-click technology for passenger travel, guide and drive the upstream and downstream industrial chains, explore new models of aviation passenger services, vigorously develop the digital economy of civil aviation, and accelerate the cultivation of the civil aviation digital industry ecosystem.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system, accelerate the construction of new infrastructure, and steadily promote the construction of new infrastructure.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen top-level design, increase the intensity of reform and innovation in key areas, and create policy conditions and an innovative environment to support the construction of new infrastructure. Promote the market-oriented reform in the field of civil aviation information services, open up access to competitive segments, and further introduce market competition mechanisms. With the goal of building intelligent regulation, improving overall efficiency and service quality in the industry, accelerate the construction of a batch of new infrastructure demonstration projects, and form a batch of replicable and promotable successful experiences. Strengthen project organization and guarantee, increase support from policies and funds, and establish project implementation mechanisms that are compatible with the construction of new infrastructure. Innovate investment and financing policies and form a diversified investment and financing pattern. Strengthen government-enterprise collaboration, carry out cross-industry and cross-domain cooperation, and promote mutual promotion and integration of deployment, construction, and application. Establish a dynamic, flexible, inclusive, and prudent evaluation mechanism, conduct full life cycle evaluations of new infrastructure construction projects, and iteratively form a standard system that meets promotion requirements.
titlelist: Build a first-class infrastructure system, accelerate the construction of new infrastructure, and innovate and improve policy supply.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Improving the capability of aviation services is the fundamental requirement for the development of civil aviation. With the goal of serving national strategies and meeting the needs of the people, efforts are being made to tap into internal potential and coordinate externally, strengthen hub support, expand service areas, enhance service quality, and build a comprehensive and efficient aviation service system that integrates both transport aviation and general aviation, covering a wide range of areas.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Focus on improving the policy system, promoting efficient allocation of resources, implementing network expansion and efficiency improvement projects, facilitating domestic and expanding international connectivity, and building a well-connected, interconnected, convenient, and efficient passenger air route network.
titlelist: Developing a first-class aviation service system and building a comprehensive aviation passenger transportation network.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Optimize the domestic route network layout. Build a domestic route network supported by backbone and basic networks. With the goal of improving overall network efficiency, expand the main backbone channels between the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the Chengdu-Chongqing world-class airport hub airports. Ensure smooth secondary backbone channels between the four major world-class airport clusters, international aviation hubs, and regional aviation hubs. Promote the transformation of express lines into bus services, and create a high-frequency, high-quality backbone network. Consolidate the foundation of the route network. Aim to improve accessibility to non-hub airports and activate new market demands. Encourage innovative service products, establish a widely covered and equally serviced basic network, expand the coverage of the route network, and achieve main and branch connectivity throughout the network. Actively promote basic aviation services in remote areas with limited ground transportation. Optimize the international route network layout. Create a circle, six corridors, and five channels framework. Deepen market penetration in Southeast Asia, Northeast Asia, and steadily expand into West Asia, Central Asia, South Asia, and other markets. Build a surrounding air transport circle and enhance international market support capabilities. Gradually improve the accessibility of the six major international economic cooperation corridors of the New Eurasian Land Bridge, China-Mongolia-Russia, China-Central Asia-West Asia, China-South Asia Peninsula, China-Pakistan, and China-Myanmar-India-Bangladesh, which are part of the Belt and Road initiative. Construct five major air transport channels connecting Europe, North America, Latin America, the South Pacific, the Indian Ocean, and Africa to expand the network coverage. Actively sign air transport agreements with countries participating in the Belt and Road initiative, open and increase flight routes, improve transit connections, and promote the construction of the Silk Road in the Air. Improve airport hub functions. Build an aviation hub pattern that promotes the coordinated development of world-class airport clusters, international aviation hubs, and regional aviation hubs. Enhance the global route network radiation capacity of world-class airport clusters and achieve comprehensive international competitiveness. Strengthen the central functions of international aviation hubs, enhance the global service capabilities of Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou, and improve the construction of international aviation hubs in Chengdu, Chongqing, Shenzhen, Kunming, Xi'an, Urumqi, Harbin, and other cities. Enhance the support function of regional aviation hubs for route networks, improve connectivity with non-hub airports in the surrounding areas, and supply passenger sources to international aviation hubs. Expand domestic through-flight services, improve the service level of the domestic basic network, promote international through-flight pilot programs, shorten the minimum transfer connection time, and improve inspection efficiency. Accelerate the construction of a fast transportation service network combining aviation + high-speed rail, extend the aviation network, and expand the service scope.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, build a comprehensive aviation passenger transportation network, and improve the network layout of passenger transportation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Civil Aviation Development (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen policy coordination. Establish a policy system for route networks with aligned goals, integrated measures, and synchronized rhythms to improve the systematic and coordinated nature of policies. Implement dynamic monitoring and evaluation of route networks. Promote the integration of the aviation transportation network system with modern national airport systems and production and operation support systems, enhance information sharing among airlines, airports, and air traffic control, and improve the capacity for coordinated air-ground operations. Focus on improving the capacity, efficiency, and quality of route networks, strengthen airspace security, and enhance policy coordination at ports. Enhance policy flexibility. Construct a policy system that matches the layout of route networks in terms of routes, flights, and schedules. Maintain the continuity, stability, and sustainability of policies for backbone networks, and improve the innovation, flexibility, and inclusiveness of policies for basic networks. Focus on improving the efficiency of airspace utilization and explore flexible mechanisms for the use of air routes. Improve the mechanism for route access and withdrawal, and establish a dynamic assessment mechanism for flight operations. Relax the management of air traffic rights and improve the mechanism for the use and withdrawal of air traffic rights resources. Enhance the alignment between flights and seasonal schedules, improve the flexibility of managing mid-season flights, and better meet market demand. Explore a market-oriented allocation system for aviation schedules to promote efficient flow of existing schedule resources. Improve resource allocation efficiency. Focus on improving route networks and building large-scale network-based airlines with international competitiveness, improve the systematic nature of policies, and optimize resource allocation. Accelerate the construction of a new pattern of open aviation rights with optimized structure, diversified balance, and hub orientation, continuously increase the reserve of aviation rights resources in mainstream markets such as Europe and America, and focus on promoting the opening of aviation rights with countries participating in the Belt and Road Initiative. Improve the allocation of hub-oriented aviation rights resources, support hub operations and the development of main base companies, and guide the concentration of aviation rights resources in international aviation hubs. Improve support policies for international routes, regulate market order, and reduce disorderly competition. Strengthen the guarantee of time resources for domestic backbone networks, and support on-demand applications for basic air services routes.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, build a comprehensive aviation passenger transportation network, and optimize the policy system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Persist in addressing weaknesses, strengthening strengths, improving the environment, and enhancing supply. With the goal of supporting the industrial chain and supply chain, and with cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and quality enhancement as the core, focus on building competitive enterprises. Construct a high-quality, efficient, and self-controlled aviation logistics network.
titlelist: Developing a first-class aviation service system and building an efficient aviation logistics network.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Accelerate the cultivation of market entities. Guide aviation logistics companies to settle in hub airports with strong freight capabilities and establish headquarters or distribution centers. Support the integration and development of large-scale logistics companies and civil aviation enterprises, improve end-to-end service networks, and create globally competitive aviation logistics companies. Support large-scale aviation logistics companies in accelerating the layout of international networks. Support the diversified development of various types of aviation logistics companies, such as professional and platform-based ones. Strengthen the overall coordination of logistics supply chains. Accelerate the construction of information technology in air cargo transportation, and promote the sharing of aviation logistics information. Guide and support the synergy between aviation logistics networks and manufacturing industries, and create a development pattern of coordinated development of aviation logistics and manufacturing industries going global. Focus on enhancing professional logistics capabilities such as cold chain and express delivery, and build a service system for the coordinated development of industrial chains, supply chains, and value chains.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, build an efficient aviation logistics network, and construct a logistics supply chain system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Improve regulations and standards. For all-cargo operations, improve differentiated management policies for freight transportation. Promote the construction of an integrity system, explore a classified and graded cargo security inspection policy, and improve inspection efficiency. Explore the establishment of a multimodal transport logistics network and promote the standardization of different transportation modes. Study and formulate a regulatory standard system that adapts to the development of emerging formats such as unmanned aerial vehicle logistics. Strengthen resource guarantee. With the goal of enhancing international competitiveness, improve the efficiency of key resource allocation such as air rights and time slots. Encourage cross-industry and cross-sector cooperation, promote the layout of overseas freight hubs. With the goal of promoting the construction of freight hubs, promote the implementation of a higher level of air rights opening policy. Support eligible freight hub airports in establishing a flight schedule pool for freight flights, allow freight flights to use daytime slots, and flexibly arrange freight schedules.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, build an efficient aviation logistics network, and improve the policy system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: General aviation is one of the two wings of civil aviation, with a strong driving force for the industry. We will maintain strategic stability, adhere to reform and innovation, increase industry guidance, optimize provincial development platforms, strengthen resource allocation and policy coordination, improve the operating environment, focus on upgrading traditional services and expanding emerging services, and accelerate the development of general aviation.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system and expand a diverse general aviation network.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Guide the construction of general airport networks. Actively support existing feeder airports in increasing general aviation support facilities. Further standardize and simplify approval processes, coordinate and establish a joint coordination mechanism for general airport site audits between military and civilian authorities. Utilize the professional advantages of civil aviation to guide local governments in promoting the construction of general airports and accelerate the establishment of a coordinated network of short-haul transportation airports. Guide the development in key city clusters such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the Chengdu-Chongqing region. Construct large-scale comprehensive general airports to relieve non-hub functions. Tailor the construction of grassland, water, and soil-based simple airports according to local conditions. Support and guide the construction of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) test bases (experimental zones) to meet the needs of multi-scenario, multi-subject, and multi-level development. Support the construction of emergency rescue aviation bases in high-altitude and plateau areas. Enhance low-altitude flight service support capabilities. Make full use of existing Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) ground stations, Beidou flight dynamic information service platforms, and flight service centers to guide the layout of provincial-level flight service stations and strengthen data integration and sharing. Optimize intelligence service support systems and improve low-altitude meteorology, visual navigation charts, and other products. Accelerate the improvement of ground service support levels. Promote the construction of general aviation fuel service networks, support the construction of general aviation maintenance facilities, promote the sharing of general aviation materials support, and encourage the formation of regional, branded, and networked comprehensive support service providers. Continuously promote low-altitude airspace management reforms. Summarize and promote the pilot experiences of low-altitude airspace management reforms in Sichuan, Hainan, Hunan, Jiangxi, and other regions. Increase the density of low-altitude air routes as needed, expand the scope of low-altitude reporting airspace, simplify and optimize flight mission approval, flight plan application and approval (filing) procedures, facilitate declaration channels, and expand the types of business that can be approved on the spot.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, expand a diverse general aviation network, and continuously enhance service support capabilities.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Actively develop short-haul transportation. Establish an aviation transportation micro-circulation system, forming a regional short-haul transportation network supported by feeder airports and connected by general airports. Strengthen coordination between general aviation and transportation aviation in flight schedules, code sharing, sales settlement, complaint supervision, and dangerous goods management. Optimize transfer and connection processes, construct an integrated management service system that is moderate, smooth, and well-coordinated, and enhance the quality of travel services. Enhance general aviation public services. Strengthen the construction of emergency rescue capabilities in high-altitude and plateau areas, support the establishment of a national aviation emergency rescue base network, and improve the coordinated support mechanism. Guide local governments to adopt the method of purchasing services to enhance their capabilities in public services and emergency response. Support general aviation smart agriculture services in Heilongjiang, Xinjiang, and other regions. Promote high-level coordination and linkage between offshore oil, power operations, and industrial development. Focus on providing mass consumer services. Encourage the development of general aviation in conjunction with tourism resource development, guide the combination of entertainment consumption, and provide diversified and specialized low-altitude tourism service products. Promote rapid layout and efficient expansion of flight training capabilities. Actively cultivate aviation culture, strengthen the participation of aviation activities, optimize the pilot license training system, and promote the development of private aviation.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, expand a diverse general aviation network, and strive to improve the level of general aviation services.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Actively expand the service field. Encourage the application expansion of drones and support their use in postal express logistics, urban public services, emergency rescue, public health, and other fields. Promote the widespread application of drones in urban, rural, and remote areas, integrate them into the three-level logistics network system of counties and villages, and serve the modernization of agriculture and rural areas. Improve the regulatory standard system. Insist on promoting development and preventing risks simultaneously, carry out the construction of drone regulations, classification management methods, comprehensive management platforms, and guidance mechanisms, and establish a sound industry management system. Guide the establishment of a market-oriented and socialized service guarantee system. Support the formulation of group standards in the field of drone applications and encourage capable companies to participate in the formulation of international standards. Innovate the drone industry ecosystem. Continuously promote the construction and operation of unmanned aerial vehicle test zones, conduct research on operational theories, risk assessments, and technical verifications based on operational scenarios and risks, and explore regulatory and service models that are in line with the characteristics of unmanned aerial vehicles. With the goal of building a drone industry ecosystem, encourage the construction of innovative platforms, support the development of a low-altitude economic cluster zone with a focus on the entire drone industry chain, leverage the driving force of innovation clusters, and lead the industry towards the high-end of the value chain.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, expand a diverse general aviation network, and vigorously promote the innovative development of unmanned aerial vehicles.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Focus on strengthening institutional supply. Continuously improve the general aviation regulatory system, prioritize urgent repairs, and accelerate the revision of laws and regulations. Timely summarize pilot experience and solidify the achievements of reform. Guided by the goal of improving the effectiveness of streamlining administration, delegating power, and improving services, deepen classification management and actively guide enterprises to self-regulate. Strengthen supervision of passenger-carrying general aviation flight activities. Accelerate the establishment of a statistical and evaluation index system and a comprehensive data release system for the high-quality development of general aviation. Increase policy support and guidance. Support the development of general aviation finance, insurance, and other businesses, encourage innovation of financial products that align with the characteristics of general aviation, and promote increased support from the banking and insurance industries for the general aviation industry. Optimize general aviation subsidy policies and improve the efficiency of fund utilization. Promote multi-dimensional collaborative governance. Promote the construction of a credit system and strengthen service quality management. Promote policy coordination among relevant departments and ministries in the fields of emergency rescue, medical assistance, and short-haul transportation. Actively guide the construction of provincial-level general aviation development platforms, leverage the role of scientific research institutes and industry associations as third-party bridges, and promote cooperation and joint governance in areas such as facility construction, low-altitude airspace reform, low-altitude economic development, and safety supervision. Facilitate the absorption of retired military professionals into the general aviation industry.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, expand a diverse general aviation network, and continuously optimize the general aviation development environment.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Service quality is the concentrated embodiment of the high-quality development of civil aviation. By practicing the concept of sincere service, with the normal operation of flights as the driving force, we focus on the full chain of aviation travel services, taking meeting passenger needs as the starting point and destination. We implement the convenient engineering of aviation services, promote the construction of a new ecosystem of civil aviation services that prioritize passenger experience, and continuously upgrade the quality of transportation services. As a result, the competitiveness and influence of China's civil aviation service brand have significantly improved.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system and improve the quality level of aviation services.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Establish a sound mechanism for the coordinated operation of flights. Continuously improve the coordination mechanism of airport management committees to achieve normalized operation of airport management committees with millions of flights. Taking the intelligent collaborative operation of airport clusters as the starting point, carry out pilot projects for regional collaborative operation of airport management committees, and gradually establish a national mechanism for collaborative operation of airport management committees. Strengthen data sharing and organizational coordination to achieve collaborative operation among airlines, airports, air traffic control, and other operational support entities. Optimize the mechanism for ensuring normal flights. With the goal of balancing civil aviation traffic demand and operational support capabilities, construct an evaluation system for capacity-demand balance and continuously promote the fine management of capacity-demand balance throughout its lifecycle. Establish response mechanisms for adverse weather and other special circumstances to enhance the ability to deal with external disruptions. Summarize and promote the integrated operation experience of Bao Teng Mang to enhance the level of collaborative support among neighboring airports. Improve the mechanism for supervising normal flights. Build an operational efficiency indicator system covering airlines, airports, air traffic control, and other operational support units, and regularly issue operational efficiency monitoring reports. By optimizing indicator settings and appropriately expanding the scope of assessment, further improve the national assessment indicators and control measures for normal flights. Develop unified basic assessment indicators to achieve a nationwide integrated assessment.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, improve the quality level of aviation services, and ensure a high level of normal flight operations.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen the construction of China's civil aviation service brand. Implement the civil aviation service brand strategy, create a brand through service, promote service through the brand, and focus on promoting the construction of service brands. Strengthen the awareness of civil aviation enterprise brand construction, cultivate a service brand culture, and form a number of excellent service brands in various fields. Research and formulate evaluation standards and rules for civil aviation service brands, and carry out evaluations of China's civil aviation service brands. Promote and publicize the best practices and excellent services of outstanding enterprises, fully leverage the role of enterprises and the promotion role of the government, and enhance the influence and competitiveness of China's civil aviation service brands. Build a high-quality service product system. Increase basic aviation service products, enrich express service products, and develop customized products, promote widely covered and fast-connected through flights. Vigorously promote through check-in and interline transfers, actively promote the integration and development of civil aviation with other modes of transportation, and build integrated transportation services for smooth travel throughout the journey. Encourage enterprises to promote business and model innovation through a combination of online and offline methods, and extend and upgrade service products. Encourage diversified and differentiated development of aviation service products, implement a special action of civil aviation + cultural tourism, unleash consumption potential, firmly expand domestic demand, and improve the level of convenience for inbound tourism. Create a brand new experience in civil aviation services. Continuously improve the quality of civil aviation services around the concerns of the people. Continuously improve the efficiency of security check services, fully implement baggage tracking throughout the process, promote smart travel services such as self-service, single certificate clearance, biometric recognition, intelligent guidance, and paperless travel throughout the process. Improve the elderly transportation service system, enhance the capacity for barrier-free travel services, and meet the needs of special passengers such as the elderly, the weak, the sick, the disabled, pregnant women, and infants. Prioritize the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of military personnel and others in accordance with the law. Strengthen care for civil aviation employees and enhance their sense of happiness. Promote mutual service among various entities in the industry and enhance the systematic and collaborative nature of services.
titlelist: Develop a first-class aviation service system, enhance the level of aviation service quality, and build a Chinese service brand.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: With the hub airport as the focus, shorten the time for flight boarding, security check queues, ground taxiing, baggage retrieval, and passenger walking, improve the rate of docking at nearby gates, and reduce the time between other modes of transportation.
titlelist: Developing a first-class aviation service system, optimizing airport ground service guarantee standards to reduce travel time.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Green is the foundation and basic form of high-quality development. The promotion of green development in civil aviation has entered a crucial stage of overcoming obstacles. It adheres to the guidance of achieving carbon peak and carbon neutrality, and pays more attention to the strategic support role of technological innovation. It coordinates and promotes green development in the industry from the aspects of technology, operation, and market mechanisms, accelerating the formation of a green, low-carbon, and circular development pattern, and continuously expanding the development space of the industry.
