name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Establish a sound policy support system. Establish and improve civil aviation policy standards that are in line with the efficient use of resources, environmental governance, and ecological security requirements. Green development requirements should be more reflected in the formulation of various professional policy standards. Improve the pricing mechanism and institutional arrangements for civil aviation carbon emissions, strengthen the construction of civil aviation carbon emissions monitoring, reporting, and verification mechanisms, and guide units to increase investment in green development. Strengthen support for major projects and technological research in green development, and study and promote the implementation of green financing projects. Accelerate the construction of a standard system. Establish a standard system for low-carbon operation and management of airlines. Improve the full life cycle green airport standard system. Accelerate the formation of a safe and efficient air traffic control operation standard system. Actively participate in the formulation of international standards and gradually establish an environmental protection standard system for the airworthiness certification of aircraft and engines. Build an assessment and evaluation system. Improve the industry's energy consumption and emission statistics system, study the establishment of energy and resource consumption and environmental emission assessment mechanisms, strengthen the management of pollution reduction and carbon reduction targets, and improve the mechanism for transmitting responsibility pressure. Strengthen supervision and inspection, incorporate green performance into the industry's main assessment system, establish benchmarks for green and low-carbon civil aviation enterprises, and encourage industry entities to establish more active internal assessment and incentive mechanisms. Improve the mechanism for the release of the Civil Aviation Green Development Blue Book, regularly publish the energy and water efficiency of airlines and airports, and promote international benchmarking. Actively promote the third-party evaluation system and institutional capacity building.
titlelist: Establish a sound ecological-friendly green development system, continuously improve the industry's green governance system, and establish a comprehensive policy and management system for green industry development.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen the basic capabilities for the green development of civil aviation. Establish and improve a three-in-one management system for green development in the industry, including management, supervision, and service. Enhance the personnel of the institutions and improve management capabilities. Establish a green civil aviation expert advisory committee, gather experts from relevant fields within and outside the industry, and expand and improve the civil aviation expert database. Support civil aviation colleges and universities in developing green civil aviation disciplines and textbooks, and cultivate high-level compound reserve talents. Encourage cooperation between civil aviation research institutions, associations, and enterprises, establish and improve a green civil aviation-related skills training system, and enhance the industry's understanding and work capacity for green development. Strengthen the research capabilities for green development in civil aviation. Support universities, research institutions, and industry associations in conducting research on major and forward-looking issues related to civil aviation's low-carbon development strategy, operational efficiency improvement, environmental impact monitoring and analysis, green equipment research and development application, and green competitiveness. In response to the collaborative governance needs of energy conservation, pollution reduction, and carbon reduction, establish 2-3 key laboratories (engineering and technology research centers) in the field of green development in civil aviation, build a comprehensive scientific and technological innovation network for green civil aviation, and strengthen joint research and collaborative research to promote the sharing and application of demonstration projects, research results, data, and information. Promote the industrialization of green civil aviation. Support the establishment of various factor markets that serve the construction of green civil aviation, strengthen market supply and demand information services, and promote information symmetry and rational flow of factors. Guide and cultivate specialized service entities that meet the needs of green civil aviation development, such as technical consulting, system design, operation management, and energy-saving transformation, vigorously promote models such as contract energy management, contract water management, and energy and environmental management services, and improve professional levels. Promote the integration of the civil aviation industry with green technology equipment, clean and low-carbon energy manufacturing industries, and promote the improvement of domestic equipment quality. Actively promote the development of related industries such as dismantling of old aircraft and recycling of aviation materials.
titlelist: Establish a sound ecological-friendly green development system, continuously improve the industry's green governance system, and enhance the support system for green development capabilities in civil aviation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Promote the integration of the concept of green development into the entire operation chain and process of airlines, and enhance the level of refined management. Guide airlines to continuously optimize route network layout and fleet structure, and improve capacity matching. Enhance the transportation organization capability of airlines, increase passenger load factor and payload factor, and effectively improve aircraft efficiency. Implement management and technical measures such as fuel policy optimization, second release, precise fuel management, aircraft performance monitoring and fuel-saving modification, aircraft weight reduction, etc., to improve fleet fuel efficiency. Promote the construction of a digital and intelligent aircraft maintenance system to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient aircraft operation. Enhance pilots' energy-saving awareness and provide relevant knowledge training on energy-saving driving methods for pilots, and implement energy-saving operations under the premise of ensuring safety.
titlelist: Establish a sound ecological-friendly green development system, vigorously promote the efficient and intensive use of resources, and improve the energy efficiency level of airlines.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Further strict control of standards, revision and improvement of indicators for the construction of airport transportation land, and strict control over new construction and expansion. Strengthening the evaluation of land, energy, water, and material conservation, as well as the promotion of technological models in airport project approval, construction, and acceptance. Considering airport ground services and operational efficiency as important variables in airport planning and design, optimizing runway and apron design, as well as aircraft ground operation processes. Promoting the construction of integrated and intelligent airport resource and energy management systems, implementing energy-saving transformations in lighting, heating/cooling systems, and building envelopes, and enhancing the application of new materials, technologies, and products. Supporting the utilization of renewable energy such as solar and geothermal energy according to local resource endowments, and conducting pilot projects for comprehensive utilization of new energy at airports. Steadily improving the utilization rates of rainwater, reclaimed water, and recycled water, and promoting the construction of water-saving airport demonstration projects.
titlelist: Build a sound ecological-friendly green development system, vigorously promote the conservation and intensive utilization of resources, and advance the construction of green airports.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Optimize route and airspace structure with energy conservation as the guiding principle, continuously increase the number of temporary routes, reduce the non-linear coefficient of routes, and shorten flight time. Strengthen operational coordination, improve aviation meteorological and intelligence service capabilities, reduce flight delays and diversions, and provide technical support for fuel-saving flights. Accelerate the energy-saving transformation of air traffic control facilities. Enhance the cultivation and training of controllers' green concepts, research and formulate green air traffic control guidelines and evaluation methods, and encourage controllers to actively apply green control methods in practice.
titlelist: Build a sound ecological-friendly green development system, vigorously promote the efficient and intensive use of resources, and accelerate the green development of air traffic control.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Promote the establishment of a systematic green civil aviation mechanism involving the participation of government, enterprises, and guarantee units. Strengthen the coordinated decision-making and support of airlines, airports, and air traffic control, integrate flight arrival and departure management functions, achieve information sharing in operations, optimize and enhance traffic management, flight sequencing, and runway allocation efficiency, ensure the safe and efficient operation of aircraft, and control the energy consumption intensity of civil aviation transportation. Carry out special actions to optimize fuel-saving during aircraft ground taxiing, with a focus on reducing aircraft ground waiting and taxiing time.
titlelist: Build a sound ecological-friendly green development system, vigorously promote the efficient and intensive use of resources, and strengthen multi-party collaborative operations.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Improve the management system for aviation carbon emissions reduction. Reasonably formulate the peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality pathways and phased emission reduction targets for civil aviation. Following the principles of coordinating domestic and international efforts, aligning goals and measures, and coordinating administrative resources, promote the establishment of an aviation carbon emissions reduction market mechanism that is in line with the national conditions and the development stage of the industry, and actively participate in the construction of a national carbon market. Support the establishment of a carbon emissions management and evaluation mechanism for Chinese airports, and encourage airports with conditions to develop near-zero carbon airports and near-zero carbon terminals. Promote pilot demonstrations for the normalized application of sustainable aviation fuels, and accelerate the development of strategic capabilities in technology, talent, standards, and other areas. Actively participate in global aviation carbon emissions governance. Adhering to the global governance concept of consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, adhere to the principles of fairness, common but differentiated responsibilities, and respective capabilities, and actively undertake international obligations that are in line with China's basic national conditions, the development stage of the civil aviation industry, and its capabilities. Actively participate in the formulation of aviation emissions reduction policies and technical standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization, constructively participate in international negotiations and consultations on aviation carbon emissions reduction, support the role of United Nations agencies in promoting the sustainable development of global civil aviation, enhance the ability to design international cooperation agendas for aviation emissions reduction, and promote the establishment of a fair, just, and mutually beneficial global governance system for aviation carbon emissions.
titlelist: Establish a sound ecological-friendly green development system, make efforts to mitigate the environmental impact of civil aviation industry, and manage industry carbon emissions in a reasonable and effective manner.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen efforts to prevent and control atmospheric pollution at airports. Accelerate the construction of the airport regional environmental quality evaluation system, enhance the monitoring and management of environmental air quality at airports and surrounding areas. Consolidate and deepen the achievements of civil aviation in winning the battle for blue skies, actively promote the efficient application of intelligent network-connected new energy equipment within the airport, promote the replacement of aircraft APUs and the application of airport electric vehicles, improve supporting infrastructure construction, and strengthen safety operation and emergency management. Continuously optimize the energy structure of airports and increase the proportion of clean energy. Enhance the ecological, landscape, and cultural value of airport greening. Improve the comprehensive management capacity of airport noise. Conduct in-depth assessments of aircraft noise impacts around airports, and study the construction of an airport noise management system focusing on noise source management and land compatibility management. Accelerate the construction of a million-level automatic aircraft noise monitoring system at airports, strengthen the construction of noise monitoring and control infrastructure for new and expanded airports, and implement noise pollution prevention and control measures approved in environmental impact assessments. Focus on improving the ability to trace noise events, supporting the refinement of noise control levels. Encourage airports to strengthen coordination with air traffic control and airlines, adjust management rules and optimize arrival and departure procedures to mitigate aircraft noise, and promote technological innovation and upgrades in flight noise reduction. Conduct pilot projects for aircraft noise control at airports in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and other cities. Strengthen the treatment and disposal of airport wastewater and solid waste. Enhance the construction of facilities and pipelines for the collection, treatment, and reuse of rain (oil) wastewater, encourage the use of new sewage treatment technologies and rainwater and sewage separation technologies to reduce energy consumption in treatment. Further standardize the centralized treatment, disposal, and recycling of de-icing (snow) chemical agents, encourage the use of environmentally friendly de-icing fluids and advanced de-icing technologies, and support the accelerated construction of centralized de-icing pads at airports with an annual passenger throughput of over 2 million in northern regions. Improve the system for waste classification, harmless treatment, and recycling, strictly handle aviation waste in accordance with regulations in epidemic areas. Strengthen the management of plastic pollution in the civil aviation industry. Column 8: Civil Aviation Green Low-Carbon Project.
titlelist: Establish a sound ecological-friendly green development system, make efforts to mitigate the environmental impact of civil aviation industry, and promote the harmonious coexistence between airports and the surrounding ecological environment.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Develop and improve standards, regulations, and technical guidance documents for aviation carbon emissions management, green infrastructure construction, green operations, sustainable certification of aviation fuels, and airport pollutant emissions control.
titlelist: Building a sound ecological-friendly green development system, the action of constructing green civil aviation standards.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Focus on breakthroughs in key core technologies. Implement the strategy of technological innovation in civil aviation, coordinate and strengthen basic research and technological development in the field of civil aviation, focus on issues such as insufficient capacity and weak resistance to attacks in key areas, concentrate efforts from all parties to carry out technological innovation, and achieve breakthroughs in key technological research and equipment development in areas such as safety and security, airworthiness certification, air traffic systems, smart airports, smart air traffic control, smart operations, passenger transportation, and aviation logistics. Promote the application of major scientific and technological achievements. Adhere to demand-oriented approach, refine the roadmap for the application of scientific and technological achievements, accelerate the expansion of technologies such as 5G, big data, blockchain, artificial intelligence, and Beidou system in civil aviation applications. Seize the opportunity of concentrated construction of infrastructure, achieve deep integration of new technologies, new products, and infrastructure. Focus on developing new technology application scenarios to improve operational efficiency and service quality. Accelerate the application of domestically produced technological equipment. Strengthen government-enterprise coordination, improve the policy system for the application of domestically produced technological equipment, establish a platform and mechanism for matching supply and demand of domestically produced civil aviation equipment, improve the first set system in the industry, and promote the demonstration application of domestically produced equipment. Support civil aviation enterprises in participating in the entire process of research, development, and manufacturing of domestically produced equipment, accelerate product technology iteration, and improve product quality. Promote the internationalization of China's civil aviation advantageous technologies and standards, and create conditions for domestically produced equipment to enter the international mainstream market. Column 9: Technological Innovation Leading Project (2035).
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, implement a technology innovation-led strategy, and promote breakthroughs in key areas of science and technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen the national team for technological innovation. Optimize and upgrade the civil aviation technological innovation platform, and build a more efficient civil aviation research platform system. Utilize the gathering and driving role of the civil aviation science and education innovation alliance to accelerate major technological innovation in civil aviation and the cultivation of technological leaders. Accelerate the construction of civil aviation technological innovation demonstration zones and science and education industrial parks, and promote the formation of an internationally leading civil aviation high-tech industry cluster. Relying on the Aviation Industry Corporation of China, Civil Aviation University of China, and member units of the civil aviation science and education innovation alliance, accelerate the construction of high-level think tanks to enhance decision-making support capabilities in civil aviation safety management and macro governance. Enhance applied basic theoretical research by leveraging the role of civil aviation colleges and universities. Focus on core technology applications such as big data, artificial intelligence, and basic software, as well as the research and development and localization of key equipment, promote the construction of major experimental platforms and simulation verification platforms, and improve industry experimental testing and verification facilities. Jointly build a national scientific and technological innovation base in the civil aviation field. Strengthen the main force of technological innovation. Consolidate the position of enterprise innovation entities, deploy innovation chains around the civil aviation operation service chain, and build industrial chains. Support enterprises in leading the formation of innovation consortia and undertake major national scientific and technological projects. Promote the establishment of industry alliances and build an innovation ecosystem that integrates enterprises as the main body, market orientation, and deep integration of industry, academia, research, and application. Increase support for independent innovation by transportation, general aviation, and support enterprises, leverage the leading role of large enterprises in innovation, support small and medium-sized enterprises in accelerating applied innovation, and increase research and development investment. Expand the circle of technological innovation. Utilize the role of civil aviation science and technology awards, coordinate the use of innovation resources from within and outside the industry, expand the scope of civil aviation science and technology project awards, attract social science and technology innovation resources to participate in civil aviation technological research, and form a collaborative innovation situation. Actively integrate into the global scientific and technological innovation network, participate in or lead the construction of international civil aviation innovation platforms and research and development centers, and actively promote international scientific and technological cooperation projects.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, carry out research on the basic theory and key technologies of airworthiness for aircraft, focus on breakthroughs in the airworthiness certification technology of the Beidou system, large-scale unmanned aerial vehicles, engines, and domestically produced core components, and strengthen the innovation strength of civil aviation science and technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Improve the talent evaluation and incentive mechanism. Establish a talent utilization mechanism that is guided by morality and ability and targeted at job requirements, guiding civil aviation units to establish the correct direction for personnel use and accelerate the formation of a good situation in which talents are used without restrictions. Further establish and improve the talent evaluation system, including professional and technical personnel's title evaluation, vocational skills assessment, and grade recognition. Improve the talent allocation, incentive, and guarantee system, and establish a sound incentive and guarantee mechanism based on talent value orientation. Improve the talent mobility mechanism. Give full play to the role of market allocation and stimulate the vitality of the civil aviation talent market. Promote international talent exchange in civil aviation. Explore the establishment of talent mobility mechanisms within civil aviation colleges, research institutes, and enterprises and institutions. Promote the realization of market-determined factor prices, autonomous and orderly mobility, and efficient and fair allocation. Column 10 Talent Strong Industry Project.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, strengthen the construction of the civil aviation talent team, and innovate talent management mechanisms.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: With the goal of better serving the national regional major strategies and regional coordinated development strategies, fully leveraging the comparative advantages of civil aviation, and accelerating the construction of a new pattern of integrated development where civil aviation and regional economic and social development mutually drive and support each other.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system to serve and support the coordinated development of the region.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Civil Aviation Development (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Actively support the construction of the aerotropolis economic zone. Enhance the agglomeration effect of various resources such as human flow and logistics, and the function of inducing industrial development of the aviation hub. Adapt to local conditions, be intensive and efficient, support the high-quality construction of national-level aerotropolis economic demonstration zones, and achieve coordinated development between airports and regional economies. Carry out evaluations of the development of aerotropolis economic demonstration zones, summarize the achievements of the demonstration, and form advanced experiences that can be promoted and replicated. Develop the aviation industry ecosystem. Utilize the advantages of the civil aviation transportation market scale, rely on the construction of the aerotropolis economic zone, support and guide the industrial upgrading of aviation research and development, manufacturing, maintenance, logistics, finance, and business services, extend the civil aviation industry chain, drive the development of related domestic industries, actively strive for policy overlaps such as bonded zones, port opening, and free trade pilot zones, and build a well-matched and supportive aviation industry ecosystem. Promote the integration of port, industry, and city development. Strengthen the full connection between the planning of the aerotropolis economic zone and the overall airport planning and urban development planning, reasonably layout the aerotropolis industry, protect the airport environment and land resources, and reserve sufficient space for the long-term development of the airport. Promote the improvement of comprehensive transportation infrastructure around the airport, as well as supporting urban services such as public transportation, education, and healthcare, and build an ecologically livable modern aviation city. Column 11: Industrial synergy demonstration project.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, provide services to support regional coordinated development, and promote the high-quality development of the aviation economy.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Build an evaluation index system for the development of the aerotropolis economy, conduct evaluations and summaries, promote advanced experiences, and promote the upgrading and development of the aerotropolis economy.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, add about 10 new national-level demonstration zones for upgrading the air economy, and promote deep integration between airports and regional economies.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: By integrating major tourist cities and tourist destinations, optimizing the domestic air route network, and increasing the frequency of direct flights between major tourist source cities. In response to the demands of the tourism market and seasonal characteristics, accelerate institutional innovation in flight schedules and route development to expand the domestic air travel consumption market.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, strengthen cooperation with the cultural and tourism departments through special actions in civil aviation and cultural tourism, innovate aviation service products, accelerate the development of low-cost aviation, actively promote red tourism, and tap into market potential.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Grasp the forward-looking, proactive, and controllable nature, serve the new development pattern of dual circulation in domestic and international markets, promote the construction of a broader scope, wider areas, and deeper levels of opening up, fully expand the new space for international development of civil aviation, and provide stronger impetus for the development of global civil aviation.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, and open up new prospects for foreign openness.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Implement broader opening of air rights. Actively promote the liberalization and facilitation of aviation transportation with neighboring countries and regions such as Southeast Asia and Northeast Asia, enhance connectivity with countries in South Asia, Central Asia, and other regions, and advance the construction of comprehensive regional economic partnerships. Increase the reserve of air rights resources in the European and American markets. Promote gradually more open cargo air rights arrangements with major trading partners and relevant countries. Coordinate air rights arrangements, capacity, and fare management measures to provide guarantees for airlines to expand their markets. Promote deeper opening of key regional civil aviation. Further improve hub-oriented air rights policies and enhance the competitiveness of international aviation hubs. Accelerate the enhancement of the aviation hub capabilities in Xiamen and Fuzhou, and support the construction of the economic zone on the west coast of the Taiwan Strait and the core area of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road. Serve the requirements of regional opening-up and deepen the implementation of aviation transport opening-up policies in key areas such as the Hainan Free Trade Port. Optimize the functions of the Qingdao regional aviation hub and support the construction of China-Shanghai Cooperation Organization local economic and trade cooperation demonstration zones. Promote the expansion of civil aviation in a wider range of areas. Scientifically respond to changes in the external environment and create new advantages in international cooperation and competition. Improve the mechanism for civil aviation exchanges and cooperation with foreign countries, carry out extensive bilateral, multilateral, and regional international cooperation and research based on international cooperation platforms. Promote negotiations in the civil aviation field of free trade agreements, further relax market access, give full play to the role of free trade pilot zones in reform and opening up experiments, coordinate domestic and foreign resources, and increase the supply of high-quality civil aviation services and products. Encourage civil aviation enterprises to go global and enhance the international influence of civil aviation products, technologies, services, and standards. Support airlines in expanding the international aviation market through aviation alliances, code-sharing, equity investments, and other means to enhance global competitiveness.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, open up new prospects for opening up to the outside world, and accelerate the high-level opening up of civil aviation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen the integration of international aviation development policies. Scientifically assess the new situation of international aviation market development, strengthen the overall design of international aviation development policies, formulate and implement action plans to support airlines in enhancing international competitiveness, incorporate them into comprehensive industry reform pilot projects, improve the systematic and strategic nature of international policies, achieve multi-party coordination and unified action, and support the high-quality development of international air transport in our country. Strengthen the legal and regulatory guarantees for opening up to the outside world. Study and promote the institutional opening of civil aviation, improve civil aviation laws and regulations, and create an internationally competitive business environment for diverse market entities. Enhance the internationalization and rule of law level of civil aviation, innovate market supervision methods, and provide space for innovation in cooperation models among various entities in international air transport. Strengthen the investment risk prevention and control system, improve regulatory systems that are compatible with foreign investment rules. Strengthen research on foreign-related laws and regulations, and guide airlines and other civil aviation enterprises to enhance their awareness of compliance and protect their own rights and interests.
titlelist: Build a solid and powerful strategic support system, open up new prospects for opening up to the outside world, and strengthen the ability to safeguard opening up.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen governance rules. Adhere to equal access, fair regulation, open and orderly, integrity and law-abiding, and build a high-standard market system. Implement a unified market access negative list system, continue to relax access restrictions, and improve the market exit system. Classify and improve the mechanism for market-oriented allocation of factors, actively and steadily promote differentiated, precise, and coordinated management of resources such as air rights and time slots, moderately expand the autonomy of enterprise entities, and explore the use of existing resources to create a market-oriented mechanism for hubs. Establish a data resource inventory management mechanism and steadily promote data openness and sharing. Improve the service quality management system and strengthen the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of passengers and cargo owners. Improve price behavior rules and strengthen fee supervision. Improve the civil aviation transportation price mechanism and study and promote differentiated aviation service fee reforms. Improve the price behavior rules of the civil aviation transportation market and regulate the fare behavior of civil aviation transportation companies. Strengthen fee supervision in monopolistic links of civil aviation support services. Improve the market supervision system. Strengthen in-process and post-process supervision, shift the focus from regulating market entity qualifications to regulating behaviors, and promote the full coverage, normalization, and institutionalization of random inspections and public disclosure in the field of market supervision. Fully implement the fair competition review system. Enhance regulatory capabilities, strengthen supervision of natural monopoly businesses in the industry, cooperate with relevant departments to strengthen investigations into monopolistic behaviors, and promote fair competition and market openness. Improve the inclusive and prudent regulatory mechanism for new business formats. Improve the credit system construction and build a new regulatory mechanism based on credit supervision. Deepen the reform of state-owned enterprises under the authority of the bureau. Adhere to the direction of market-oriented reform of state-owned enterprises, actively and steadily deepen mixed ownership reform, accelerate the improvement of the corporate governance structure and market-oriented operation mechanism of state-owned enterprises under the authority of the bureau, improve the term system for management and contractual management, and stimulate the vitality of state-owned enterprises. Encourage, support, guide, and direct strategic restructuring and specialized integration of civil aviation enterprises, actively and steadily promote the disposal of zombie enterprises and inefficient and ineffective assets, give full play to the role of the market, and strengthen and refine the main business. In accordance with the requirements of separating government and enterprises and separating affairs and enterprises, rationalize the relationship between civil aviation administrative agencies and institutions at all levels and the enterprises they manage, and explore the reform path for public welfare enterprises.
titlelist: Build a modern civil aviation governance system, improve the market governance system, and accelerate the improvement of market operation mechanisms.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Improve the civil aviation regulatory system. Emphasize both the quality and progress of legislation, continuously improve the regulatory system that adapts to the characteristics of civil aviation development in the new era, promote the revision of the Civil Aviation Law, actively participate in the formulation of the Aviation Law, and continuously strengthen the construction of regulations and rules in important areas such as safety, security, service, and emergency management. Properly handle the relationship between civil aviation reform and legislation, leave room for the development of new areas and new formats such as short-haul transportation and unmanned aircraft, the application of new technologies, and the construction of smart civil aviation, and improve the forward-looking nature of legislation. Improve the legislative work mechanism. Adhere to scientific legislation, democratic legislation, and legislation based on the law. Continuously improve the mechanism for soliciting and handling legislative opinions, strengthen the solicitation of opinions from key stakeholders, and explore the establishment of legislative liaison points. Systematically plan legislative projects, issue and implement industry legislative plans, scientifically formulate annual legislative plans, and study and improve the legislative evaluation mechanism, including all aspects of regulation formulation, implementation, and adjustment. Explore the implementation of third-party evaluations. Deepen the reform of the administrative law enforcement system. Strengthen the awareness of the rule of law, strictly regulate safety supervision, market supervision, and quality. Standardize and improve the decision-making mechanism for the operation of power to ensure that major decisions and administrative law enforcement are in compliance with the law. Improve the civil aviation industry regulatory and law enforcement system, achieve unified management of regulatory and law enforcement in all areas and throughout the process. Strengthen supervision and restraint, promote government transparency as the norm, with exceptions being the cases that are not made public, and comprehensively promote government affairs transparency. Strictly regulate fair and civilized law enforcement, standardize law enforcement discretion, and increase law enforcement efforts in key areas that affect the immediate interests of the people. Establish a regulatory audit system, strengthen punishment for violations, and effectively restrain the abuse of power.
titlelist: Build a modern civil aviation governance system, enhance government administrative efficiency, and improve the capacity for administration according to law.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Deepen the reform of the administrative approval system. Continue to promote streamlining administration and delegating power, adhere to the combination of delegation and regulation, and focus on optimizing services. Improve the list of administrative licensing matters and continue to cancel delegated administrative approval matters. Explore measures such as integrating multiple certificates into one, expand the scope of the commitment system, and simplify the approval process. Establish administrative approval halls and achieve comprehensive acceptance of administrative approvals through one window. Innovate administrative management and service methods, and promote the establishment of intelligent and convenient administrative approval information systems. Improve the mechanism for undertaking and coordinating administrative approval matters.
titlelist: Build a modern civil aviation governance system, enhance government administrative efficiency, and further promote streamlining administration and delegating power.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Make every effort to build a smart aviation government affairs platform. Improve the efficient government service network, expand the achievements of the aviation administrative approval reform of 'one network, one door, one time'. Optimize business processes, improve standard specifications, achieve standardization, standardization, convenience, and platformization of aviation government services, promote cross-regional, cross-departmental, and cross-level business collaboration, and improve administrative efficiency. Relying on the government cloud, enhance the level of online and mobile administrative approval services, promote more government services to be handled online, on mobile devices, and through self-service. Use blockchain technology to build an industry public service credit system. Accelerate the construction of a smart aviation office platform. Promote the intelligent upgrade and transformation of office equipment and conference facilities, realize the interconnection of various terminals, build an efficient, agile, collaborative, and reliable smart aviation office platform, expand mobile office, instant communication, and video conference services, and achieve digital transformation of office work.
titlelist: Build a modern civil aviation governance system, build a civil aviation intelligent supervision system, and promote the application of civil aviation intelligent government affairs.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Guided by the core socialist values and closely integrated with the actual industry, we strive to construct a Chinese civil aviation cultural value system with the contemporary spirit of civil aviation as its core. We aim to enhance the soft power of civil aviation culture and provide a solid cultural support and strong spiritual motivation for the construction of a strong civil aviation country in the new era.
titlelist: Building a modern civil aviation governance system, strengthening the construction of the industry's cultural value system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Civil Aviation (Civil Aviation Development [2021] No. 56) (excerpt) (Civil Aviation Administration of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport / December 14, 2021)
content: Deeply explore the humanistic spirit, values, and moral standards contained in the history and development practice of civil aviation, enriching the cultural values and connotations of the industry. Insist on creative transformation and innovative development, vigorously promote the patriotic spirit of the 'Two Airlines' uprising, promote the contemporary civil aviation spirit characterized by 'loyalty and responsibility, rigorous and scientific professionalism, unity and cooperation in work style, and dedication and professional ethics', and promote the spirit of heroism of Chinese civil aviation crews. Continuously promote the normalization and institutionalization of the propaganda and education of 'respecting life, respecting regulations, and respecting responsibilities', integrate the 'three respects' into the institutional mechanism, root it in the grassroots frontline, and cultivate a culture of civil aviation safety. Practice the industry purpose of 'people's aviation for the people', integrate the concept of sincere service into all aspects of civil aviation work, and expand the civil aviation service culture. Promote the spirit of model workers, work ethic, and craftsmanship, create a good atmosphere of respecting science and respecting talents, and cultivate an open and inclusive culture of civil aviation innovation. Insist on combining education and guidance with punishment and penalties, and build a civil aviation integrity culture where the trustworthy are honored and the untrustworthy are ashamed. Take the construction of a strong civil aviation country and the promotion of harmonious progress in world civil aviation as the main value, actively advocate the consciousness of a world civil aviation community with the core concept of consultation, construction, and sharing.
titlelist: Build a modern civil aviation governance system, strengthen the construction of the industry's cultural value system, and cultivate a civil aviation cultural value system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (excerpt) (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Develop remote sensing target recognition technology for special geological and complex meteorological environments, to achieve high efficiency, high precision, and high adaptability in railway survey methods. Research on technologies such as Beidou satellite navigation, airborne radar, low-altitude remote sensing with unmanned aerial vehicles, aerial geophysics, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), to promote the application of integrated aerial, space, and ground survey technologies and satellite positioning measurement methods. Develop intelligent route selection technology supported by geographic information system big data (GIS) and cloud computing technology, to achieve automatic generation of multiple solutions and multidimensional intelligent evaluation. Research key technologies for geological survey in complex environments, to improve the anti-interference and refinement levels of engineering survey technology. Increase the research and development efforts for fundamental software for railway survey and design, and accelerate testing, verification, and application promotion. Promote railway information modeling technology, to achieve standardization and digitization of information model creation and delivery throughout the lifecycle, and promote integrated design.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a Strong Transportation Country through Technological Innovation (Excerpt) (Jiao Ke Ji Fa [2021] No. 80) (Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Science and Technology / August 25, 2021)
content: Key breakthroughs should be made in core components such as power, perception, and control for transportation equipment, as well as common key technologies such as communication and navigation equipment, emergency rescue equipment, etc. Specialized key technologies in industries such as deep-sea saturation diving, water, and aircraft airworthiness certification should be overcome. Research and development of new material application technology should be strengthened, and the independent controllability of professional software should be enhanced.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a Strong Transportation Country through Technological Innovation (excerpt) (Jiao Ke Ji Fa [2021] No. 80) (Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Science and Technology / August 25, 2021)
content: Accelerate the independent research and development and industrialization of new generation rail transportation, new energy and intelligent connected vehicles, high-tech ships, aviation equipment, modern logistics equipment, etc. Promote the independent and intelligent development of special equipment for emergency transportation and rescue, navigation surveying and mapping, inspection and testing, and monitoring in response to emergencies. Strengthen the research and development, application, and industrial development of new equipment and facilities such as intelligent high-speed rail, smart highways, automated ports, and digital pipelines.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a Strong Transportation Country through Technological Innovation (excerpt) (Jiao Ke Ji Fa [2021] No. 80) (Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Science and Technology / August 25, 2021)
content: Promote the deep integration of technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, blockchain, Internet of Things, cloud computing, new generation wireless communication, Beidou navigation, satellite communication, and high-resolution remote sensing satellites with transportation. Develop a new generation of intelligent transportation systems, accelerate the application of autonomous driving, intelligent shipping, and other technologies. Breakthrough key technologies in comprehensive transportation network operation services, hazardous goods management and control, and establish collaborative supervision, data sharing, and system interconnection mechanisms among departments. Build an integrated transportation safety guarantee and supervision service system for land, sea, air, and space.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese means man or male.

name: Guiding Opinions on Expanding Investment and Cultivating and Strengthening New Growth Points and Growth Poles in Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2020] No. 1409) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance/September 8, 2020)
content: Key support will be provided for the production of high-end equipment, including industrial robots, construction, medical and other special-purpose robots, high-end instruments and meters, rail transportation equipment, high-grade five-axis CNC machine tools, energy-saving asynchronous traction motors, high-end medical equipment and pharmaceutical equipment, aerospace equipment, marine engineering equipment, and high-tech ships. Pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing and intelligent construction will be implemented. Research and development and promotion of urban municipal infrastructure operation and maintenance, agricultural production special sensors, intelligent equipment, automation systems, and management platforms will be carried out. A number of innovation centers, demonstration bases, and pilot counties will be established. Leading enterprises will be encouraged to build Internet+ collaborative manufacturing demonstration factories and establish high-standard industrial Internet platforms. (Responsible departments: National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, China Railway Group, etc., according to their respective responsibilities).

content: Focus on ensuring the stability of the industrial chain and supply chain in key areas such as large aircraft, microelectronics manufacturing, and deep-sea mining, and accelerate breakthroughs in fields such as photoresist, high-purity target materials, high-temperature alloys, high-performance fiber materials, high-strength and high-conductivity heat-resistant materials, corrosion-resistant materials, large-size silicon wafers, and electronic packaging materials. Implement the action plan for innovative development of new materials, improve the technological level of rare earths, vanadium and titanium, tungsten and molybdenum, lithium, rubidium and cesium, graphite, and other characteristic resources in mining, smelting, and deep processing, and accelerate the application of graphene, nanomaterials, and other materials in optoelectronics, aerospace equipment, new energy, biomedicine, and other fields. (Responsible departments: National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, etc., according to their respective responsibilities).
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese means man or male.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Work of Industrial Internet Security (Excerpt) (MIIT Internet [2019] No. 168) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Ecology and Environment, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Energy Administration/July 26, 2019)
content: By the end of 2020, the industrial internet security guarantee system will be initially established. In terms of institutional mechanisms, we will establish industrial internet security management systems including supervision and inspection, information sharing and notification, emergency response, etc. We will establish the main responsibility system for enterprise security, develop at least 20 urgently needed industrial internet security standards for equipment, platforms, data, etc., and explore the construction of an industrial internet security assessment system. In terms of technical means, we will initially establish a national industrial internet security technology guarantee platform, basic resource library, and security testing and verification environment. In terms of industrial development, in key areas such as automobiles, electronic information, aerospace, energy, etc., we will create at least 20 innovative and practical pilot demonstrations of security products and solutions, and cultivate several industrial internet security enterprises with core competitiveness.

name: Remote Sensing and Space Science Satellite Radio Frequency Resource Utilization Plan (2019-2025) (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/ March 29, 2019)
content: Land observation satellites, such as those for land resource, gravity, and electromagnetic monitoring, as well as ocean observation satellites for ocean color, ocean dynamics, and ocean surveillance. There are also atmospheric observation satellites for weather observation, climate observation, and atmospheric composition detection. Land observation satellites primarily use radio frequencies to serve industries such as land resources, environmental protection, emergency management, disaster prevention and reduction, water conservancy, agriculture, forestry, statistics, earthquakes, surveying and mapping, transportation, housing and urban-rural development, and health. The focus is on supporting the construction of high- and medium-resolution optical and synthetic aperture radar observation constellations, developing geophysical field detection satellites, and continuously improving the quantitative application level of land observation satellites. Ocean observation satellites primarily use radio frequencies to serve China's strategy as a maritime power, addressing major needs in marine resource development, environmental protection, disaster prevention and reduction, rights protection, and marine area management. The focus is on supporting the construction of ocean color, ocean dynamics, and ocean surveillance satellites, and continuously improving the comprehensive observation capabilities of ocean observation satellites. Atmospheric observation satellites primarily use radio frequencies to meet the needs of meteorological forecasting, atmospheric environmental monitoring, meteorological disaster monitoring, and global climate observation. The focus is on supporting the construction of weather observation, climate observation satellite constellations, and atmospheric composition detection satellites, forming a complete atmospheric system observation capability.

content: Space science satellites mainly include satellites for space experiments, space astronomy, space physics, space environment, solar physics research, and other purposes. The use of radio frequencies for space science satellites is mainly based on the characteristics and advantages of scientific research in our country, combined with the forefront of world basic science development. It focuses on supporting research activities in space experiments, space astronomy, space physics, space environment, solar physics, and exploring major frontier issues in basic science such as the physics, chemistry, and life of natural phenomena and their laws occurring on Earth, the Earth-Sun space, the solar system, and even the entire universe.
