name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: In response to the application needs in the field of mass consumption, the key breakthroughs include integrated applications of short messages, seamless indoor and outdoor positioning integrating satellites/base stations/sensors, adaptive anti-deception and anti-interference technologies. Accelerate the development and industrialization of high-precision, low-power, low-cost, miniaturized Beidou chips and key components, and form a system solution that integrates Beidou with 5G, Internet of Things, and connected vehicles. Encourage the use of commercial encryption to ensure product security. Enhance the supply capacity of Beidou chips, devices, and modules in the mass consumption field, and ensure the stability of the industrial chain and supply chain.
titlelist: Enhance industrial foundation capabilities, break through key core technologies and products.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Improve the construction of the Beidou Network Assisted Public Service Platform, expand the user base of the platform, and further improve the positioning speed of Beidou. Innovate the Beidou high-precision positioning service platform, promote data interoperability and business collaboration among different ground-based augmentation systems, enhance service quality and efficiency, and expand the application scenarios of high-precision Beidou positioning in the mass consumer field. Construct the Beidou Vehicle Networking Application Service Platform, unify the access to Beidou commercial vehicle data sources and the security interface for data openness, and provide users with highly reliable and accurate Beidou positioning and data application services.
titlelist: Enhancing industrial basic capabilities, constructing Beidou application service infrastructure.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Carry out pilot demonstrations of high-precision positioning for smartphones. Enhance the multi-source fusion positioning capability of smartphones and wearable devices in indoor and obstructed areas, and create a seamless continuous positioning service system indoors and outdoors. Explore the application of high-precision Beidou, short message, and other functions in smartphones and wearable devices, build sub-meter-level positioning application scenarios, and promote their widespread use in emergency communication, health care for the elderly, child care, care for the disabled, emerging consumption, and convenient services.
titlelist: Prosperous Beidou mass consumer market, enriching Beidou location services for smart terminals.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Encourage the standardization of Beidou terminals in vehicles to enhance the penetration rate of Beidou in vehicle applications. Explore the integration of Beidou positioning, short messages, and 4G/5G into a one-click emergency rescue mode for vehicles, and encourage eligible regions, vehicle manufacturers, and service providers to take the lead in trials. Combine Beidou ground-based augmentation system and high-precision maps to promote the application of Beidou high-precision positioning technology in the Internet of Vehicles.
titlelist: Promote the prosperous Beidou consumer market and expand the scale of Beidou applications in car terminals.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Promote the application of Beidou multi-frequency positioning, high-precision positioning, and other technologies in the field of shared bicycles to effectively improve positioning accuracy. Guide shared bicycle operators to increase the use of Beidou, gradually upgrade existing models to support Beidou, standardize the parking order of shared bicycles on urban roads, and support urban intelligent fine management.
titlelist: Promote the prosperous Beidou mass consumer market, empower the orderly management of shared bicycles.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Encourage the use of single-mode BeiDou products or multi-mode BeiDou products that support independent BeiDou functions by enterprises related to devices, systems, software, etc. that provide time, location, and communication services. Enrich the forms of BeiDou products and cultivate new models and formats for mass consumer applications of BeiDou. Organize a BeiDou mass consumer application solicitation competition and innovation forum, form a collection of innovative BeiDou application cases, promote a batch of new BeiDou applications, and broaden the new channel of BeiDou application services.
titlelist: Promote the prosperous Beidou mass consumer market and cultivate new applications for Beidou mass consumer.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Encourage enterprises to combine their own characteristics to achieve differentiated development and effectively enhance the overall strength of Beidou enterprises. Relying on the advantages of the domestic large-scale market, leverage the leading enterprises to drive the industry chain, strengthen the synergy between the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain, promote the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises, cultivate a group of specialized and innovative small giants enterprises, and several manufacturing industry champions, and build a healthy and sustainable Beidou industry chain and supply chain in the mass consumer field.
titlelist: Build a sound and perfect industrial ecosystem, support enterprises to become better and stronger.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Give full play to the coordinating role of industry associations and industry alliances, guide extensive cooperation among units in the Beidou industrial chain, and form a virtuous cycle of mutual cooperation and close collaboration between industry, academia, research, and application. Encourage local governments to promote industrial innovation and cluster development based on regional characteristics and diverse needs. Strengthen Beidou data sharing and analysis, fully tap into the value of Beidou's spatial-temporal big data, and provide services for macroeconomic analysis, precise urban planning, vertical industry applications, and network quality assessment, using digital means to help enhance the modernization level of the system and governance capabilities.
titlelist: Strengthen and improve the industrial ecosystem, stimulate new vitality for industrial development.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: The industrial and information technology authorities at all levels should coordinate and cooperate with relevant departments to ensure the orderly progress of key tasks. Encourage enterprises, industry organizations, research institutions, and other units to strengthen cooperation in technological breakthroughs, product research and development, standard formulation, and application demonstrations, and to build a collaborative innovation and achievement transformation mechanism between industry, academia, research, and application.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational support, enhance coordination and collaboration.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Encourage local integration of resources and tailor local policies to support the development of the Beidou system in the region, and explore more Beidou application scenarios in the mass consumer market. Utilize fiscal funds to guide and encourage increased investment from the capital market, and promote the rapid development of the Beidou industry.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational support and increase support efforts.

name: Several Opinions on the Promotion and Application of Beidou in the Field of Mass Consumption (MIIT Electronics [2022] No. 5) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 17, 2022)
content: Strengthen policy promotion, enhance the visibility of existing BeiDou services, promote the effectiveness of innovative BeiDou service applications, and increase public awareness of BeiDou applications. Encourage enterprises to participate in product evaluation and certification testing, improve the quality and service level of BeiDou products, and promote the healthy and orderly development of the BeiDou industry.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational support, strengthen publicity and guidance.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: By the middle of this century, we will comprehensively build a strong aviation power that guarantees robustness, satisfies the people, and has strong competitiveness, providing important support for building a socialist modernized country and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. The civil aviation industry's service capabilities, innovation capabilities, governance capabilities, sustainable development capabilities, and international influence are at the forefront of the world. This is specifically manifested as follows: - an international and popular aviation market space; - large network-based airlines with strong international competitiveness; - international aviation hubs and domestic airport networks with reasonable layout functions; - a safe and efficient air traffic management system; - an advanced, reliable, and cost-effective security and technical support service system; - a well-functioning general aviation system; - the leading and dominant role in formulating international civil aviation rules and standards; - the ability to lead the development of the international civil aviation industry. The eight basic characteristics of a strong aviation power achieve balanced development, coordinated development, overall leapfrogging, and advance to a state of mutual support and promotion, presenting the comprehensive strength and level of a strong aviation power.
titlelist: Overall goals and strategic steps, overall goals.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: Build world-class super carriers. Encourage airline companies to merge and restructure, transform into mixed ownership, increase the allocation of route and flight resources to main base airlines, and create world-class super carriers with global competitiveness and global service. Encourage global mergers and strategic cooperation, leverage the role of capital, and build a modern civil aviation industry system that covers the entire industry chain, creating a world-class aviation enterprise group with leading service quality and enterprise scale globally. Build a hub-and-spoke and city-to-city combined route network, actively develop air express services, and create a global aviation logistics enterprise. Meet the infrastructure needs of modern aviation logistics companies, promote the construction of specialized aviation logistics facilities and core air cargo hubs. Improve the policy environment for aviation logistics and support the growth and strengthening of aviation logistics companies. Build a multi-level logistics information service system and create a comprehensive aviation logistics information service platform that is globally connected. Regulate the market order of air cargo agents and create several global super cargo agent service providers. Accelerate the global strategic resource layout, build a global aviation logistics service network, and create the most efficient and competitive global aviation logistics enterprise group. Cultivate diversified aviation market entities. Support the establishment of low-cost airlines, regional airlines, and cargo airlines to achieve a more balanced and fully developed market. Innovate operating models in low-cost, regional, and cargo market segments, strengthen distinctive operations, products, and services, and cultivate a group of aviation transport enterprises with unique characteristics. Give full play to the operational and management advantages and social responsibilities of large aviation enterprises, drive small and medium-sized aviation enterprises to develop in a specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative manner, and achieve a new pattern of efficient collaboration and healthy competition among large, medium, and small aviation companies.
titlelist: Main tasks and measures, to build a large network-based airline with strong international competitiveness.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: Enhance airspace resource guarantee. Strengthen the leading role of airspace planning, actively participate in the national overall airspace planning and airspace classification work, continuously optimize the use of civil aviation airspace, and achieve airspace classification and delineation. Promote the implementation of trunk route network planning, promote the implementation of airspace optimization plans in key areas such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and continuously optimize the airspace plans of key hub airports such as Chengdu, Kunming, Shenzhen, Chongqing, Xi'an, Urumqi, and Harbin. Strengthen airspace resource awareness, increase infrastructure investment, and strengthen the development and utilization of airspace resources. Improve airspace operational efficiency. Promote the integrated operation of airspace management, traffic management, and control services. Establish a multi-level flight flow management system at the national, regional, and airport levels, as well as a multi-party collaborative decision-making mechanism involving air traffic control, airports, airspace users, and others. Reduce handover intervals in control. Promote comprehensive fine-grained airspace management. Establish an airspace efficiency evaluation mechanism and continuously improve airspace management work. Implement air traffic control infrastructure projects. Improve the construction of regional control centers, terminal control centers, and tower control rooms. Establish a world-class and efficient civil aviation operation management center, meteorological center, intelligence management center, civil aviation communication network, and Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) surveillance network. Build an integrated, networked data communication, precision navigation, and comprehensive surveillance system, and complete the transition from land-based to satellite-based navigation. Construct smart meteorological projects. Build an automated aviation intelligence system. Establish an air traffic control safety risk management platform and improve the air traffic control emergency management system. Promote the development of domestically produced air traffic control technology and equipment, and achieve the safety and technological independence and controllability of air traffic control equipment.
titlelist: Main tasks and measures, building a safe and efficient air traffic management system.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: Develop and strengthen the service market. Cultivate a vibrant general aviation market, steadily expand the market size of short-haul transportation, public welfare services, aviation consumption, and promote the improvement and efficiency of traditional industrial and agricultural production services. Build a number of comprehensive or specialized general aviation demonstration zones, integrate tourism, Internet+, creative economy, and other sectors to construct a comprehensive operational service system. Create a group of competitive specialized operational service enterprises, cultivate global leading enterprises in key areas, and promote the development of a wide-ranging and high-quality general aviation market. Strengthen the basic support system. Establish a comprehensive basic support system that provides full-service flight processes, covers national airspace, and offers high-quality services. Construct a low-altitude flight service support system for general aviation, establish regional and national general aviation flight service centers, build a well-functioning flight service station (FSS) system, and achieve full coverage of the Beidou navigation system compatible with various surveillance technologies such as ADS-B for domestic general aviation aircraft. Improve the fixed-base operator (FBO) system and create an internationally influential FBO brand. Enhance the aviation fuel and supplies supply system, and establish comprehensive maintenance and support bases (MRO). Build a complete industrial chain. Greatly enhance the competitiveness of upstream industrial markets with manufacturing as the core, actively cultivate downstream modern service industries such as leasing, and construct an independent innovation-capable industrial chain system. Enhance the research and development and manufacturing capabilities of high-performance engines, key components, and complete aircraft for general aviation, and promote the transformation and upgrading of traditional equipment manufacturing. Expand the scale of modern service industries and form a group of internationally leading service enterprises in fields such as leasing, insurance, and consulting. Innovatively lead the application of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Rely on cloud systems to build UAV big data centers, construct a UAV smart industrial ecosystem, and enhance the service capabilities of UAVs in smart logistics, smart cities, smart agriculture, and other fields. Actively promote the construction of demonstration zones for various UAV application scenarios, explore the establishment of a low-altitude transportation system for manned and cargo UAVs, and innovate the UAV+ industrial system. Cultivate a group of globally leading UAV industry leaders in aviation manufacturing, flight monitoring, and operational services.
titlelist: Main tasks and measures, building a well-functioning general aviation system.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: Actively participate in international affairs. Deeply engage in the affairs of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), actively assume the responsibilities and obligations of a Category I Council Member of the ICAO, promote international aviation personnel exchanges, and support the efficient management and orderly operation of international industry organizations. Promote the establishment of branch organizations of international and regional aviation organizations in our country, establish aviation technology cooperation and exchange projects, and provide a new platform for international aviation technology innovation, application, and cooperation. Actively support the development of civil aviation in developing countries and make 'Chinese contributions' to enhancing the sustainable development capabilities of global civil aviation. Deepen international cooperation comprehensively. Build a cooperative mechanism of win-win cooperation and mutual benefit, create a cooperative chain across enterprises, industries, and regions. Fully innovate strategic cooperation platforms and mechanisms, enhance the influence of China's aviation transportation industry in international aviation organizations and alliances. Support and promote the 'going global' of China's civil aviation-related products and services such as Beidou Navigation, domestically produced large aircraft, technical standards, and technical services. Promote the facilitation of global aviation transportation services and inject 'Chinese power' into the development of global civil aviation. Actively participate in global civil aviation governance. Uphold the global governance concept of consultation, joint construction, and shared benefits, and build a community of shared future for the development of global civil aviation. Advocate for the democratization of international civil aviation relations, actively participate in the formulation and revision of relevant international conventions, and gradually increase influence and discourse power in the formulation of international civil aviation standards and rules. Build a new type of international civil aviation cooperation mechanism, work together to create a prosperous aviation path, achieve policy communication, route connectivity, smooth passenger and cargo transportation, and common development, and provide 'Chinese wisdom' for global civil aviation governance.
titlelist: The main task and measures are to enhance the leading and speaking power in formulating international civil aviation rules and standards.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: Enhance confidence in development, maintain strategic determination, strengthen top-level design, overall planning, and systematic advancement, fully leverage the strategic guidance role of industry's medium- and long-term development plans. Strengthen the research and reserve of industry development policies, emphasize the forward-looking, systematic, coordinated, and targeted nature of various policies. Coordinate relevant departments, provide active guidance and support in planning formulation, major project construction, construction land guarantee, and institutional mechanism innovation. Strengthen strategic communication and coordination with the National Air Traffic Control Commission, the military, and other relevant departments, actively promote the reform of the airspace system and mechanism. Strengthen coordination with aviation industry, airport economic zones, local governments, and other relevant departments and units, extend the civil aviation industry chain, and enhance the radiating driving capacity of civil aviation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen overall coordination.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: At the national level, guide the whole society to have a correct understanding of the strategic significance of building a strong civil aviation country, highlighting the leading role and international attributes of civil aviation in comprehensive transportation. Actively connect with national and relevant departments' policy resources, and construct a comprehensive policy support system that is conducive to the construction of a strong civil aviation country. Strengthen communication with departments such as development and reform, finance, land, and environmental protection, and accelerate the advancement and implementation of various strategic tasks. Proactively establish business cooperation mechanisms with related industries and departments such as industry, tourism, foreign trade, and comprehensive transportation, strengthen coordination with joint inspection units, strive for broader support, and create an external policy environment conducive to the development of civil aviation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen policy coordination

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Building a Strong Civil Aviation Power in the New Era (excerpt) (CAAC Document [2018] No. 120) (Civil Aviation Administration of China/November 26, 2018)
content: Comprehensively promote the reform of the civil aviation investment and financing system, broaden financing channels, and reduce financing costs. Give full play to the role of market mechanisms in attracting social capital, explore government and social capital cooperation models, and create a cooperative, open, and innovative investment and financing atmosphere. Innovate multiple cooperation models, focus on supporting the investment and financing reform of large hub airport infrastructure construction, and establish a flexible, diverse, and equal market environment. Actively carry out financial risk analysis and prevention in civil aviation, reasonably control the scale of construction and development pace. Deepen the reform of budget management in the civil aviation sector, improve the policy of civil aviation development fund, and provide strong economic foundation and financial guarantee for the construction of a strong civil aviation country.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial support.

name: Notice on Strengthening Technological Innovation to Promote the Formation of a New Pattern for the Development of the Western Region in the New Era (excerpt) (National Science and Technology Development Zone [2020] No. 336) (Ministry of Science and Technology/November 26, 2018)
content: Leverage the innovative foundation and advantages of integrated development between Xi'an and Xianyang, with a focus on supporting the establishment of national important scientific research and educational centers. Prioritize the construction of major scientific and technological infrastructure such as the Attosecond Light Source, and cultivate the establishment of national technology innovation centers for rare metal materials. Increase support through national science and technology programs for key technological breakthroughs in frontier areas such as electronic information, high-end equipment, aerospace, energy and chemical industry, advanced materials, etc., to provide support for solving key bottlenecks in national strategic areas and industrial development.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of the Civil Unmanned Aircraft Manufacturing Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2017] No. 310) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/December 6, 2017)
content: Encourage enterprises to collaborate with universities, research institutions, and other organizations to carry out collaborative innovation in production, academia, and research. Focus on key technological breakthroughs in civil unmanned aerial vehicle power systems, flight control systems, sensors, etc. Key areas of breakthrough include real-time precise positioning, dynamic scene perception and avoidance, autonomous flight in complex environments, and group operations. Develop miniaturized and universal payload equipment, highly integrated dedicated chips, and long-endurance, heavy-load/hybrid layout unmanned aerial vehicles. Accelerate the conversion of military technology to civilian use, promote the opening of military test flight and verification facilities to civilian unmanned aerial vehicles, and encourage eligible civilian drone companies to participate in military research, production, and maintenance services.
titlelist: The main task is to vigorously promote technological innovation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of the Civil Unmanned Aircraft Manufacturing Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2017] No. 310) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/December 6, 2017)
content: Civil unmanned aircraft that need to be included in airworthiness management should undergo airworthiness review in accordance with airworthiness regulations. Civil unmanned aircraft that do not need to be included in airworthiness management should meet the requirements for safe operation of civil unmanned aircraft through the installation of flight restriction software (including dynamic electronic fences) and obstacle avoidance systems, online activation of associated real-name binding, and other methods. Strengthen the security design of civil unmanned aircraft systems, software and hardware, and communication protocols to enhance the transmission security and data protection capabilities of civil unmanned aircraft. Improve the ability to respond to situations such as link loss and positioning failure, and enhance the protective performance level against external environmental interference. Civil unmanned aircraft products should remind users to fly in accordance with laws and regulations and warn against the hazards of unauthorized flight in prominent positions on the packaging and in the product instructions.
titlelist: The main task is to improve product quality and performance.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of the Civil Unmanned Aircraft Manufacturing Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2017] No. 310) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/December 6, 2017)
content: Research and formulate industry standards and conditions for the production of civilian drones, publish a list of enterprises that meet the standards, and adjust it dynamically in a timely manner to guide social resources to concentrate on enterprises that meet the standards. Promote the intelligent transformation of production and manufacturing in the civilian drone industry. Urge enterprises to implement relevant regulations and policies on safety production and eliminate hidden safety hazards. Encourage enterprises to develop specialization, explore the application demands of segmented markets, and manufacture products accurately. Encourage enterprises to develop internationally, accelerate the expansion of overseas markets, and strengthen the introduction of capital, technology, and talents. Encourage leading enterprises to promote innovation by means of open platforms, shared data, providing experimental verification conditions, and system solutions, and promote the development of distinctive industrial clusters in the civilian drone industry by gathering innovation from large, medium, and small enterprises.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the cultivation of advantageous enterprises.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of the Civil Unmanned Aircraft Manufacturing Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2017] No. 310) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/December 6, 2017)
content: Accelerate the construction of infrastructure and service support systems for the application of civil unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), establish technology application exchange platforms, new technology demonstration and verification centers, and promote innovative applications of civil UAVs in industries such as agriculture, forestry, plant protection, logistics and express delivery, geographic surveying, environmental monitoring, power line inspection, safety patrol, and emergency rescue. Promote the integration and application of artificial intelligence in the field of civil UAVs, accelerate the improvement of entertainment and intelligent operation capabilities of civil UAVs, support the development of diversified derivative products and services. Accelerate the development of productive services such as leasing, insurance, and training for civil UAVs. Expand the application of civil UAVs in fields such as culture and education. Encourage civil UAV companies to utilize the Internet Plus to carry out industry application innovation, develop public service providers, and expand service areas and value.
titlelist: The main task is to expand the application areas of services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of the Civil Unmanned Aircraft Manufacturing Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2017] No. 310) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/December 6, 2017)
content: Implement the Guidelines for the Construction of the Standard System for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Systems (2017-2018 Edition) to accelerate the development of urgently needed standards for the classification and categorization of civil unmanned aircraft, product safety requirements, identity coding rules, basic conditions and evaluation methods for research and development units, and the construction of control platforms, in order to establish a sound standard system for civil unmanned aircraft. Industry associations, industrial alliances, and other social organizations should develop group standards based on market demand to promote the adoption of advanced group standards that have been tested in the market as industry or national standards. Actively promote the internationalization of standards for civil unmanned aircraft and support participation in international standardization activities to strengthen the development of international standards and enhance international influence.
titlelist: The main task is to establish and improve the standard system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of the Civil Unmanned Aircraft Manufacturing Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2017] No. 310) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/December 6, 2017)
content: Research and formulate rules and technical solutions for digital identification of civil unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), achieving one machine, one code; guide companies to incorporate their products into national unified control by installing communication modules, upgrading flight control software, reserving interfaces, or adopting nationally established unified transmission protocols and other technical means; utilize mobile communication networks, broadcast automatic monitoring systems, or satellite communication to achieve identification, monitoring, and management of civil UAVs; promote the construction of product basic information databases and enterprise-level product monitoring service platforms by companies, ensuring the registration of all product information and achieving full lifecycle management of civil UAVs; promote the establishment of provincial-level security management platforms, ensuring effective management and data sharing with enterprise-level monitoring service platforms, and strengthening the security supervision of civil UAVs within the region; accelerate the construction of a national-level control platform based on the identification and flight status of civil UAVs, establish a security protection system, and enhance the security guarantee capabilities of the control platform itself; strengthen the management of civil UAV equipment access permits based on mobile communication networks; accelerate research on countermeasures, monitoring and early warning technologies, and equipment development for civil UAVs, strictly control and regulate the use of countermeasure equipment.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the construction of control and management platform.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of the Civil Unmanned Aircraft Manufacturing Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2017] No. 310) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/December 6, 2017)
content: Strengthen the research on technology and methods for testing, certification, and flight verification of civil unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and establish certification standards for the safety and reliability of civil UAV products. Promote the establishment of a group of professional service organizations with qualifications and testing capabilities for the certification of civil UAVs to meet the needs of the industry. Enhance the safety testing and certification of civil UAV products, establish a certification system for civil UAV systems and key components based on safety, and prioritize the testing and certification of the safety capabilities of civil UAV products, including their ability to be identified, monitored, and managed, as well as their reliability, environmental adaptability, and electromagnetic compatibility.
titlelist: The main task is to promote product testing and certification.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: By 2020, through the introduction of technology digestion and absorption, breakthroughs will be made in heavy-duty gas turbine design technology, high-temperature component manufacturing technology, and operation and maintenance technology. This will solve the equipment bottleneck of gas power generation projects and basically form a complete heavy-duty gas turbine industry system domestically. The independent design and manufacturing systems for various types of small and medium-sized gas turbines will be further improved, and various types of small and medium-sized gas turbine equipment will be initially serialized to meet the needs of various energy projects. The operation and maintenance services of gas turbines will be mainly based domestically, and advanced gas turbine independent research and development will be carried out. An efficient mechanism combining independent research and development, design, manufacturing, testing, maintenance services, and application of gas turbines will be formed, with the ability for independent and sustainable development, effectively ensuring the demand for gas turbines in various energy fields.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: According to the demand of the energy market, accelerate the development of independent intellectual property rights for 300MW-class, F-class gas turbines based on the digestion, absorption, and introduction of technology. Continue to promote the independent development, manufacturing, and testing of 50-70MW-class prototype turbines. While conducting research on F-class gas turbine technology, promote the independent development of advanced and efficient G/H-class turbines.
titlelist: Key tasks, key promotion of the development of heavy-duty gas turbines, accelerate the development of heavy-duty gas turbines.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: By developing 300MW-class, F-class gas turbines, we have mastered gas turbine design tools and standards. The key breakthroughs include overall design, high-efficiency multi-stage axial compressor design, high-efficiency low-emission combustion chamber design, high-performance turbine design, control and protection system design, advanced aerodynamic layout and flow design, wide adaptability multi-fuel combustion, advanced and efficient cooling technologies, and optimized combined cycle system design to improve operational efficiency. We have established a comprehensive independent intellectual property heavy-duty gas turbine design system, as well as corresponding standards, software, and databases.
titlelist: Key tasks, key promotion of the development of heavy-duty gas turbines, comprehensive mastery of design technology.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Improve and enhance the manufacturing technology and capability of key components for heavy-duty gas turbines, with hot components as the focus. Independently manufacture high-performance axial compressors, efficient combustion chambers (including fuel injection systems, combustion chamber liners, and connectors), high-performance turbines (turbine wheels, blades, nozzles), and control and protection systems for heavy-duty gas turbines. Breakthroughs in key auxiliary components such as high-precision gas fuel control valves, high-reliability large sliding bearings, and high-power transmission gearboxes. Further enhance the processing and manufacturing technology and level of components such as cylinders, compressor wheels, compressor blades, and bearing housings.
titlelist: Key tasks, key promotion of the development of heavy-duty gas turbines, independent manufacturing of key components.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Establish and improve the test conditions for the performance and structural strength of the three major subsystems of heavy-duty gas turbines, and possess the capability to conduct performance tests at the component level. In conjunction with the construction of heavy-duty gas turbine power generation projects, establish the testing platform for gas turbine power generation using natural gas and synthetic gas, including various capacity levels up to F-class and below, and consider conducting tests for more advanced-level gas turbine power generation. Carry out systematic testing of self-developed heavy-duty gas turbine power generation under high load conditions, establish relevant testing assessment methods, procedures, and standards, and master the technology for systematic testing and experimental verification of heavy-duty gas turbine systems.
titlelist: Key tasks, key promotion of the development of heavy-duty gas turbines, and improvement of testing and verification capabilities.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Research on high-pressure ratio, high-flow compressor, low NOx emission combustion chamber, isothermal combustion, high-efficiency turbine, and their aerodynamic and cooling design technologies for heavy-duty gas turbines with a single-cycle power of 400MW and a combined-cycle efficiency of over 60%.
titlelist: Key tasks, key promotion of the development of heavy-duty gas turbines, research on advanced heavy-duty gas turbine technology.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: (1) Independently master the design technology of 30MW-class driving gas turbines. Digest and absorb introduced technologies, independently master the design technology of 30MW-class driving gas turbines, and improve the design system. Focus on key technologies such as high-efficiency multi-stage axial flow compressor design, advanced aerodynamic layout and flow design of high-efficiency turbines, efficient stable low-emission combustion, wide adaptability multi-fuel combustion, and advanced efficient cooling.(2) Develop manufacturing capabilities for medium and small-sized driving gas turbines. Construct and improve the research and development, manufacturing, process system, and after-sales service platform for medium and small-sized driving gas turbines. Enhance the capabilities of material design and development, component manufacturing, and overall assembly and testing of driving gas turbines, and achieve mass production of medium and small-sized driving gas turbines.(3) Improve testing and verification capabilities. According to the testing requirements of subsequent new gas turbine products, further enhance the testing and verification capabilities of key components and complete machines for industrial driving gas turbines. Establish and improve testing methods, testing procedures, and testing standards for the assessment of driving gas turbine applications. Focus on improving low-emission combustion testing, multi-fuel combustion testing, combustion monitoring and diagnostics, adjustment technology development testing, thermal process development testing, overall machine testing, application assessment testing, and demonstration platforms.(4) Accelerate demonstration and promotion. Relying on demonstration projects such as natural gas long-distance pipeline engineering and shale gas fracturing vehicle power drive, accelerate the completion of industrial testing, assessment, and demonstration of independently manufactured driving gas turbines. Relying on the construction of natural gas long-distance pipeline engineering, promote the application of independently developed driving gas turbines.
titlelist: Key tasks: develop small and medium-sized gas turbines, improve the industrial system for driving engines.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: (1) Develop micro gas turbine series with small and micro power. Develop micro gas turbines with power below 1MW, break through the design, testing, manufacturing, and system integration of micro gas turbines, and establish a complete manufacturing system for micro gas turbines. Develop small gas turbines with power ranging from 1-10MW, conduct key component testing, prototype manufacturing, and whole machine testing and verification, improve related design and production standards, and achieve the commercialization and serialization of gas turbine products for distributed energy supply and various fuels. Develop medium-sized gas turbines with power ranging from 10-80MW, develop medium-sized industrial gas turbine equipment with independent intellectual property rights and performance reaching international advanced levels, and establish a relatively complete design, manufacturing, and testing system.(2) Breakthroughs in the design and verification of various types of gas turbines. Breakthroughs in the aerodynamic and cooling design, structural design, processing, and testing verification of centrifugal compressors for micro gas turbines, as well as the aerodynamic design, processing, and testing verification of radial inflow turbines, high-temperature and high-efficiency recuperator design and verification, integral plug-in single-can combustor design, integrated design of gas turbines and high-speed motors, structural integrity and dynamic stability technology of bearing shaft systems, gas foil bearing and magnetic bearing technology. Breakthroughs in the aerodynamic and cooling design of two-stage centrifugal compressors/composite compressors/multi-stage axial flow compressors for small gas turbines, high-temperature and high-efficiency low-resistance recuperator design, high-efficiency axial flow turbine design, advanced nozzle design, development of combustion chambers for low-calorific-value fuels such as associated gas and coal gasification, design and integration of distributed cold and heat power supply and multi-energy complementary systems, distributed energy supply system testing and evaluation methods, remote monitoring, diagnosis, and information management technology. Breakthroughs in the design of high-performance compressors for medium-sized gas turbines, high-performance low-emission and dual-fuel combustor design, high-temperature gas-cooled turbine design technology, and digital control system technology, completion of overall machine design, key component testing, prototype manufacturing, and testing verification.(3) Accelerate testing, demonstration, and promotion. Establish and improve universal testing platforms for medium, small, and micro gas turbines to meet the testing needs of various types of gas turbines. Relying on marine platforms and various distributed energy systems, promote the demonstration and application of various types of gas turbines. Accelerate the promotion and application of domestically produced gas turbine generators with a certain level of maturity in marine platforms and distributed energy systems.
titlelist: Key tasks: develop small and medium-sized gas turbines, develop a series of distributed energy use combustion engines.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Accelerate the breakthrough of high-temperature alloy materials such as compressor rotors and blades, combustion chamber components, nozzles, turbine rotors and blades, etc. Carry out research and development of high-temperature master alloys, establish master alloy specifications, and achieve mass production preparation. Construct and improve the mechanical and physical performance testing conditions for key component materials, as well as non-destructive testing, and improve the mechanical and physical performance database of materials for thermal channel components. Further enhance the technology and process level of large-sized high-temperature alloy blade casting (single crystal, directionally solidified, etc.), complex structure high-temperature alloy precision casting, turbine rotor manufacturing, and other equipment castings.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the breakthrough of key materials for combustion engines, key component materials.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Breakthroughs in materials and preparation techniques for coating of compressor blades, combustion chamber liners, turbine blades, and shroud coatings. Research and improvement of processes such as vacuum plasma spraying and physical vapor deposition. Strengthen the development and testing of various advanced long-life thermal barrier coating materials, and establish a sustained research and innovation capability.
titlelist: Key task: Accelerate the breakthrough in key materials for combustion engines, coating materials.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Further improve the level of manufacturing technology for complex ceramic core structures, high-strength and heat-resistant ceramic mold shells, high-precision mold manufacturing technology, and preparation technology for high-performance ceramic-based composite materials.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the breakthrough of key materials for combustion engines, and other materials.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Develop an independent operation and maintenance service system for self-propelled engines, master the core technology and capabilities of engine overhaul and service, establish maintenance and management standards for engine overhaul, and form independent intellectual property drawings and specifications. Focus on breakthroughs in component operation monitoring and evaluation technology, life assessment and extension technology, combustion monitoring and diagnosis, combustion adjustment, combustion chamber optimization and transformation technology, hot channel component detection evaluation and repair technology (including combustion chamber and turbine high-temperature component service damage detection evaluation, high-temperature component matrix welding, coating repair and repair evaluation technology), unit performance improvement and overall machine matching technology, intelligent remote monitoring and diagnosis technology, combined cycle and distributed energy system integration and operational efficiency diagnosis technology, intelligent power plant operation technology, etc. Carry out services such as engine performance upgrades, emission reduction, maintenance, life extension, remote diagnosis, and intelligent operation.
titlelist: Key tasks: Master the operation and maintenance service technology of combustion engines, cultivate an independent operation and maintenance service system.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: Relying on domestic research and development, manufacturing, and operation and maintenance units for internal combustion engines, we will develop professional gas turbine operation and maintenance services. We will conduct reverse engineering, combining independent technology with existing industrial systems, to carry out technological research and development and transformation. We will master the design principles of the main domestic models' hot channel components, and create independent intellectual property drawings and specifications. We will strengthen the repair of hot components of internal combustion engines and on-site maintenance. Key breakthroughs will be made in precise scanning and modeling technology, flow field analysis and structural design technology of flow components (compressors, combustion chambers, turbines), analysis of the overall characteristics of the engine and component matching design technology, and processing specifications, among others.
titlelist: Key tasks: Master the operation and maintenance service technology of combustion engines, and develop third-party operation and maintenance services.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: In coordination with major special projects, we will efficiently utilize the Advanced Manufacturing Industry Investment Fund, the National Emerging Industry Entrepreneurship Investment Guidance Fund, etc., to study and adopt the PPP model to establish a Gas Turbine Industry Development Fund. This will support innovative cooperation mechanisms and investment and financing models among governments, financial institutions, and enterprises, based on risk prevention. We will flexibly apply investment subsidies, loan interest subsidies, low-interest loans, bonds, leasing, securities, etc. We will focus on supporting key technological breakthroughs in various gas turbine technologies, upgrading manufacturing conditions for key components, building testing capabilities, improving operation and maintenance service capabilities, and demonstrating applications. We encourage providing loans, insurance, financing, and other support to projects undertaking national gas turbine key technology equipment demonstration tasks. We also encourage private enterprises and social capital to actively participate in gas turbine research, development, manufacturing, and engineering applications.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, support capacity building.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: The organization undertakes various gas turbine demonstration tests and promotes their application. It organizes demonstration projects for gas peak shaving power generation, cogeneration, IGCC, and low-calorific gas utilization, and conducts key component and whole machine demonstration tests for heavy-duty gas turbines. It organizes gas turbine-driven booster station demonstrations based on the construction of natural gas long-distance pipeline projects and carries out demonstration applications for gas turbine drives. According to the development needs of natural gas distributed energy and offshore platforms, it organizes demonstrations of small and medium-sized gas turbine power generation. Combining with the operation and maintenance service requirements of typical gas turbines, it organizes demonstrations of independent operation and maintenance services for gas turbines. Independent plans must be formulated for various gas turbine demonstration projects and submitted to the competent industry authorities for review and filing according to requirements.
titlelist: Protection measures, organizing demonstration projects.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: The various types of gas turbine demonstration projects that are clearly defined by the state shall be given priority in relevant planning and approved or examined by the investment authorities at all levels according to their respective powers. Experimental power station projects included in major national projects shall be incorporated into relevant planning and approved according to their respective powers by the competent authorities in the project's location. For all types of first demonstration projects, oil and gas enterprises should effectively guarantee gas supply and related supporting conditions; operation and dispatch management departments and power grid enterprises should ensure the smooth connection of demonstration projects to the power grid, study and establish a market-oriented scheduling and operation mechanism that conforms to the characteristics of gas-fired generating units, and ensure the operation time of demonstration projects. Demonstration projects enjoy preferential support policies such as project operation assessment during the demonstration and testing phase. Encourage gas-fired power generation in regions that meet the conditions to determine electricity prices through market competition or negotiation with power users. Improve the mechanism for linking gas and electricity prices, and in areas where conditions permit, actively adopt measures such as financial subsidies to alleviate contradictions in natural gas power generation prices. Refine and improve the methods for connecting and accessing natural gas distributed energy projects to the grid, encourage direct transaction contracts between natural gas distributed energy and power users, and autonomously negotiate the quantity and price of electricity. Encourage each region to formulate corresponding support policies based on local conditions.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve support policies.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Gas Turbines through Energy Engineering (NDRC Energy [2017] No. 920) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/ May 12, 2017)
content: All types of gas turbine equipment bidding and procurement should strictly follow the People's Republic of China Tendering and Bidding Law and relevant regulations, and it is strictly prohibited to establish discriminatory clauses or exclusive conditions that restrict the participation of domestic enterprises in bidding. It is also prohibited to specify imported or practically imported content when setting technical performance, parameter conditions, and other indicators in bidding and procurement. Various demonstration projects, after being approved by the competent department, can adopt flexible bidding methods such as negotiation and competitive bidding to ensure the testing, demonstration, and promotion of independent technical equipment.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strict bidding and procurement

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Civil Space Infrastructure (2015-2025) (Notice No. [2015] 2429 of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/ October 26, 2015)
content: Currently, global space infrastructure has entered a new stage of systematic development and globalized services. Satellite remote sensing has developed towards overall observation of the Earth and network observation with multiple satellites, gradually forming a comprehensive global observation capability that combines three-dimensional, multi-dimensional, and high, medium, and low-resolution observations. Satellite communication and broadcasting services are tending to integrate and develop towards broadband multimedia, and the deployment of the next generation of mobile communication satellite constellations is being accelerated. Satellite navigation has moved from the era dominated by the United States' single GPS (Global Positioning System) to a new era of competition among the four global systems of the United States, Russia, China, and Europe, as well as the two regional systems of Japan and India. The global satellite and application industry has grown rapidly, with an average annual growth rate of over 10% since the 21st century. Developing and improving independent space infrastructure has increasingly become a strategic choice for developed countries and regions to pursue leadership in the space field, seize the high ground of economic and technological competition, develop emerging industries, and safeguard security interests.
titlelist: Current Situation and Trends: Global Space Infrastructure Accelerating Upgrades and Replacements

content: After more than 50 years of construction, China's space infrastructure development has basically been completed, forming a complete and coordinated aerospace industry system. The country's satellite development and launch capabilities have entered the forefront of the world. Remote sensing satellites for resources, oceans, meteorology, and environmental disaster reduction have acquired certain operational service capabilities. The basic guarantee system for satellite communications such as fixed communication and broadcasting has been established. The Beidou satellite navigation system has provided regional services. Satellite applications have become indispensable means for national innovation management, resource and environmental protection, disaster reduction capacity enhancement, universal information services, and the cultivation of emerging industries. At the same time, China's space infrastructure is in a critical period of transformation and development. The technological capabilities are shifting from primarily catching up with advanced technologies to independent innovation. The service model is shifting from primarily experimental and application-oriented to business service-oriented. The industry application is shifting from relying mainly on foreign data and methods to relying mainly on independent data. The development mechanism is shifting from primarily government investment to diversified and commercial development. Grasping the opportunities for transformation and development and accelerating the construction of civil space infrastructure are significant strategic measures to adapt to development needs, promote transformation and upgrading, and cultivate high-end industries.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Civil Space Infrastructure (2015-2025) (Notice No. [2015] 2429 of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/ October 26, 2015)
content: According to the development strategy of one star, multiple uses; multiple stars, networked; multiple networks, coordinated, based on the technical characteristics of observation tasks and user demand, the focus is on the development of three series: land observation, ocean observation, and atmospheric observation. A remote sensing satellite system composed of seven constellations and three types of thematic satellites is constructed to gradually form a comprehensive and efficient global observation and data acquisition capability with reasonable configuration of high, medium, and low spatial resolutions and optimized combinations of various observation technologies. Coordinate the construction of satellite receiving station network, data center, shared network platform, and common application support platform to form global satellite remote sensing data receiving and global service capabilities. 1. Space system construction. It mainly includes land observation satellite series, ocean observation satellite series, and atmospheric observation satellite series.(1) Land observation satellite series. Facing the demand for high-resolution remote sensing data from industries such as land and resources, environmental protection, disaster prevention and reduction, water conservancy, agriculture, forestry, statistics, earthquake, surveying and mapping, transportation, housing and urban-rural construction, and health, while considering the demand for ocean and atmospheric observation, fully utilize the technical foundations of resource satellites, environmental disaster reduction small satellite constellations, and high-resolution Earth observation system, further improve optical observation, microwave observation, and geophysical field detection methods, construct high-resolution optical, medium-resolution optical, and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observation constellations, develop geophysical field detection satellites, and continuously improve the quantitative application level of land observation satellites. High-resolution optical observation constellation. Develop polar high-resolution optical satellite constellations to meet the demand for high-precision and high-revisit observation of basic geographic information, land use, vegetation coverage, mineral development, precision agriculture, urban construction, transportation, water conservancy facilities, ecological construction, environmental protection, soil and water conservation, disaster assessment, and emergency response in industries and market applications, and achieve global fine observation data acquisition capability. Medium-resolution optical observation constellation. Construct medium-resolution optical satellite constellations with reasonable configuration in high and low orbits to meet the demand for large-scale coverage and comprehensive observation in resource survey, environmental monitoring, disaster prevention and reduction, carbon source and carbon sink investigation, geological survey, water resource management, agricultural monitoring, etc., and achieve global daily dynamic observation and national hourly observation. Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observation constellation. Focus on all-weather, all-day, and multi-scale observations of natural disaster monitoring, resource monitoring, environmental monitoring, agricultural monitoring, bridge and tunnel deformation monitoring, ground subsidence, basic geographic information, global change information acquisition, and high-precision deformation observation, give full play to the observation advantages of SAR satellites under complex meteorological conditions, cooperate with optical observation methods, construct satellite constellations with reasonable configuration in high and low orbits and multiple observation frequency bands, and form comprehensive observation capabilities in multiple frequency bands and modes. Geophysical field detection satellite. Develop electromagnetic monitoring and gravity gradient measurement technologies based on the demand for monitoring changes in geophysical environment in industries such as earthquake, disaster prevention and reduction, land, surveying and mapping, and ocean, and form geophysical field detection capabilities to serve earthquake prediction research, establishment of global geodetic framework, etc. (2) Ocean observation satellite series. Serve the major needs of China's marine power strategy in marine resource development, environmental protection, disaster prevention and reduction, rights protection, marine area management, investigation of islands and coastal zones, and polar ocean exploration, while considering the demand for land and atmospheric observation, develop various optical and microwave observation technologies, construct ocean color and ocean dynamics satellite constellations, develop ocean monitoring satellites, and continuously improve the comprehensive observation capabilities of ocean observation satellites. Ocean color satellite constellation. Develop high signal-to-noise ratio visible light, infrared multispectral, and hyperspectral observation technologies to meet the demand for large-scale and global rapid coverage observation of marine environmental elements such as seawater chlorophyll, suspended sediment, soluble organic matter, as well as red tide and green tide, for applications such as marine resource development, ecological monitoring, pollution control, and large-scale change monitoring, construct ocean color satellite constellations with morning and afternoon orbits, and improve observation timeliness. Ocean dynamics satellite constellation. Develop microwave radiometers, scatterometers, altimeters, and other observation technologies to meet the high-precision acquisition demand for ocean dynamic environmental elements such as sea surface height, sea surface wind field, waves, sea surface temperature, and sea surface salinity in applications such as marine disaster prevention and reduction, resource development, environmental protection, marine fisheries, and maritime transportation, and construct ocean dynamics satellite constellations. Ocean environment monitoring satellite. Develop high-orbit staring optical and high-orbit SAR technologies, and combine them with low-orbit SAR satellite constellation capabilities to achieve high and low orbit optical and SAR joint observation, to meet the demand for all-day, all-weather, near-real-time monitoring in applications such as marine environmental monitoring, marine area management, marine rights protection, and disaster prevention and reduction, and to integrate with the observation systems of various industries. (3) Atmospheric observation satellite series. Facing the atmospheric observation needs of various industries and public applications such as weather forecasting, atmospheric environmental monitoring, meteorological disaster monitoring, global climate observation, and global climate change response, while considering the demand for ocean and land observation, develop and improve large-scale active and passive optical, active and passive microwave, and other detection capabilities, construct weather observation and climate observation satellite constellations, and also construct atmospheric composition detection satellites, integrate and share relevant satellite data with the World Meteorological Organization, and form a complete atmospheric system observation capability. Weather observation satellite constellation. Develop high-orbit, high-temporal resolution observation capabilities for accurate weather forecasting and meteorological disaster forecasting, achieve minute-level observation capabilities for national and surrounding regional weather through optical and microwave satellite networks. Climate observation satellite constellation. Develop global coverage, multi-means comprehensive observation capabilities for climate change, meteorological disasters, numerical weather forecasting, and other routine monitoring needs, construct a climate observation satellite constellation composed of morning, afternoon, and twilight satellites, and integrate with ground communication networks to gradually establish a satellite communication and broadcasting system that covers major regions of the world and integrates with ground communication networks, serving the Broadband China and globalization strategies, and promoting the construction of international communication capabilities. 2. Ground system construction. The ground system mainly includes satellite receiving station network, data center, common application support platform, and shared network platform. According to the requirements of efficient networking, coordinated operation, and integrated services, utilizing existing ground system resources, coordinate the construction of receiving station network and other ground facilities, actively expand overseas stations, achieve multi-station coordinated operation, coordinate the services of land, ocean, and meteorological satellite data centers, and comprehensively meet the needs of various fields. (1) Receiving station network. Coordinate the reception of land, ocean, and atmospheric observation satellite data according to relevant needs. On the basis of fully utilizing existing resources, establish new domestic and polar stationary and polar orbit receiving antennas, as well as mobile receiving facilities at sea, to achieve multi-station coordinated and integrated reception of global data. (2) Data center. Make full use of existing infrastructure, coordinate the construction of infrastructure for remote sensing satellite mission management, data processing, storage, and distribution services, achieve mutual support, complementarity, and backup between land, ocean, and meteorological satellite data centers, promote the efficient utilization and sharing of satellite, data, and computing resources. (3) Common application support platform. The common application support platform includes calibration and authenticity verification field network and common technology research and development public support platform. The calibration and authenticity verification field network coordinates the service needs of various satellites and data products, carries out construction and operation, and realizes the sharing and utilization of resources and data. The calibration field network combines various means such as on-orbit calibration, digital calibration, and cross calibration to meet the performance calibration needs of various payloads. The authenticity verification field network is closely integrated with observation systems in various industries, mainly relying on observation stations and test sites with high accuracy and long-term stability. The common technology research and development public support platform mainly focuses on standard specifications, data processing, shared services, inspection and evaluation, simulation and verification, basic databases, and other common technologies, constructs an open architecture, information integration and sharing technology research and development support capability and common technology test system, effectively promotes common technology services and sharing. (4) Shared network platform. Construct a shared network platform to effectively connect the three data centers and various levels of application systems, timely release satellite operation status and user observation needs, efficiently utilize various computing and data resources, widely share application products and technologies, and provide business-oriented service support for users. (II) Satellite communication and broadcasting system. Facing industry and market applications, with a focus on commercialization and guaranteeing the needs of public welfare development, mainly develop fixed communication and broadcasting satellites and mobile communication and broadcasting satellites, and simultaneously construct ground facilities such as measurement and control stations, signal relay stations, uplink stations, and calibration sites to form broadband communication, fixed communication, TV broadcasting, mobile communication, and mobile multimedia broadcasting service capabilities, gradually build a satellite communication and broadcasting system that covers major regions of the world and integrates with ground communication networks, serve the Broadband China and globalization strategies, and promote the construction of international communication capabilities.
titlelist: Building three major systems: satellite remote sensing, communication broadcasting, and navigation positioning. Satellite remote sensing system.

content: To adapt to the needs of globalization, strengthen international cooperation, fully utilize relevant international cooperation mechanisms, promote the application of virtual satellite constellations and global exploration programs, carry out pioneering research, monitoring, and application in the forefront fields of global change, disaster prevention and reduction, human and nature, geophysics, space environment, carbon cycle, and other Earth system fields, enhance independent innovation capabilities and international influence, and contribute to sustainable development for humanity.
