name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Civil Space Infrastructure (2015-2025) (Notice No. [2015] 2429 of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/ October 26, 2015)
content: Serve our country's 'going global' and 'Belt and Road' strategies, build a global comprehensive information service platform integrating satellite remote sensing, satellite communication broadcasting, satellite navigation, and geographic information technology, and provide services for global mapping, global ocean observation, global asset management, food security and major agricultural production monitoring, environmental monitoring, forestry and mineral resource monitoring, water resource monitoring, logistics management, safety and emergency management, etc. Through extensive international cooperation, construct the Beidou global wide-area augmentation system, improve system service performance, and enhance the international competitiveness of Beidou. Facing international applications such as comprehensive disaster reduction, emergency rescue, resource management, and intelligent transportation, cooperate in the development of space infrastructure application products and services, vigorously expand the international market, and actively support the international sharing and service of satellite remote sensing data within the framework of the Group on Earth Observations.
titlelist: Actively promote major applications, internationalized services and applications.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Civil Space Infrastructure (2015-2025) (Notice No. [2015] 2429 of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/ October 26, 2015)
content: Research and formulate relevant policies on the management, construction, operation, and application of national civil space infrastructure, as well as national satellite remote sensing data policies. Establish and improve policies and measures for government procurement of commercial satellite remote sensing data and services, gradually opening up civil satellite remote sensing data with spatial resolution better than 0.5 meters, promoting the open sharing and efficient utilization of satellite data. Improve policies for the commercialization of satellite TV broadcasting. Develop policies and standards for the application of the Beidou satellite navigation system and its compatible technologies and products. Establish a mechanism for coordinating the application and reservation of civil satellite frequency and orbit resources.
titlelist: Policy measures, improving the policy system.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Civil Space Infrastructure (2015-2025) (Notice No. [2015] 2429 of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/ October 26, 2015)
content: Support private capital investment in satellite research and system construction to enhance development vitality. Support various enterprises in developing value-added products, operating services, and promoting industrial application, forming a benign development pattern where basic public services, diversified professional services, and mass consumer services complement each other.
titlelist: Policy measures to promote diversified investment and industrial application.

content: Based on the integration of existing policy resources and the full utilization of existing funding channels, establish a sustainable and stable financial investment mechanism to support the construction of the business satellite system, research and development of scientific research satellites, research and development of common key technologies, and the construction of major common application support platforms. Support and guide major application demonstrations in industries and regions. Encourage financial institutions to innovate financial support methods and increase credit support for space infrastructure construction and applications. Improve and implement tax support policies that encourage innovation.
titlelist: Policy measures, increase financial and taxation policy support.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Civil Space Infrastructure (2015-2025) (Notice No. [2015] 2429 of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/ October 26, 2015)
content: Accelerate the establishment and improvement of the technological innovation system, strengthen the construction of key laboratories, engineering centers, and other innovation platforms, enhance the ability of original innovation, integrated innovation, and innovation through digestion and absorption. Strengthen the innovation of satellite technology and application models that integrate space and ground, deploy common technology research and development in advance through national science and technology plans, focus on promoting innovation and development in key areas and key links such as core key components, effective payloads, and application technologies, encourage open competition, enhance independent development capabilities, promote the rapid application of high-level technologies and products, promote the deep integration of satellites and business applications, and improve service levels. titlelist: Policy measures, strengthening innovation-driven

content: Research and formulate specific measures for international development, promote the development and utilization of resources and markets both domestically and internationally. Strengthen international coordination work, actively participate in the formulation of relevant international organizations, important international rules, and standards. content: The Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Finance, and the National Defense Science and Technology Bureau should work together with relevant departments to study and implement corresponding investment entities based on the nature of the planning tasks. Research and development of scientific and public welfare satellites and ground systems should be primarily funded by the state, while public welfare and commercial projects should be a combination of state and social investment, with social investment being the main focus for commercial projects. name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Innovation and Development of National High-tech Industrial Bases (excerpt) (NDRC High-tech [2014] No. 2499) (National Development and Reform Commission/ October 29, 2014)
content: The goal is to enhance the development level of high-tech industrial bases in order to transform the national high-tech industrial bases into important demonstrations for deepening economic system reform, important engines for improving industrial technology, important platforms for participating in international competition and cooperation, and important carriers for implementing innovation-driven development strategies. Through 5-10 years of effort, a number of high-tech industrial bases with complete industrial support, obvious agglomeration effects, and innovative development advantages will be established in fields such as information technology, biotechnology, aerospace, new energy, new materials, marine industry, and high-tech services. This will form a cluster of high-tech industries and strategic emerging industries with strong independent innovation capabilities, leading industrial technology, and international competitive advantages. It will also cultivate and strengthen a group of leading backbone enterprises that possess core technologies, occupy high positions in the industry, and are at the high end of the industrial value chain.
titlelist: The overall requirements and main principles for enhancing the development level of the national high-tech industrial base.

name: Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Civil Aviation Industry (2013-2020) (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/May 22, 2013)
content: Vigorously developing the civil aviation industry is the fundamental guarantee to meet the rapid growth of civil aviation transportation, and it is an important means to lead technological progress, drive industrial upgrading, and enhance comprehensive national strength. In order to optimize the independent development system of the aviation industry, continuously enhance core competitiveness and sustainable development capabilities, and achieve leapfrog development in the civil aviation industry, this plan is formulated in accordance with the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China, National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan Outline (2006-2020), Twelfth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries, and the overall deployment and requirements of the country for the medium- and long-term development of the aviation industry.

Support enterprises in expanding aviation manufacturing through various forms, encourage international cooperation in the development of civil aviation products, support domestic enterprises in participating in international aviation industry risk cooperation and division of labor, and encourage foreign suppliers to participate in risk cooperation in domestic aviation projects. name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Plan for the Adjustment and Transformation of Old Industrial Bases (2013-2022) (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Northeast [2013] No. 543) (Development and Reform Commission/March 18, 2013)
content: Adhere to the path of new industrialization, transform and upgrade traditional advantageous industries, vigorously cultivate and develop strategic emerging industries, promote the integrated development of productive service industries and manufacturing industries, and comprehensively enhance the overall competitiveness of old industrial bases.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Plan for the Adjustment and Transformation of Old Industrial Bases (2013-2022) (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Northeast [2013] No. 543) (Development and Reform Commission/March 18, 2013)
content: Increase the intensity of adjustment and transformation, enhance the market competitiveness of traditional advantageous industries. (1) Cities with equipment manufacturing industry as the leading industry should enhance the research and development capabilities of major technical equipment, improve the research and application level of basic components, basic processes, and basic materials, and increase the industrial value-added rate. (2) Cities with automobile industry as the leading industry should target market demands at different levels in urban and rural areas and domestic and international markets, enhance product research and development capabilities, and focus on developing independent brand automobiles, engines, and key components. (3) Cities with raw material industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, and chemicals as the leading industries should promote the application of efficient, low-consumption, and low-emission process technologies, extend the industrial chain, focus on the development of various deep processing materials, and improve product quality and comprehensive utilization of resources. (4) Cities with resource extraction and processing as the leading industry should reasonably control the scale and intensity of resource extraction, extend the industrial chain, increase processing depth, and deepen the comprehensive utilization of associated resources. Among them, cities with coal industry as the leading industry should accelerate the merger and reorganization of coal mining enterprises, eliminate backward production capacity, strengthen safety production, and improve the level of coal washing and processing.
titlelist: Create new competitive advantages in industries, and transform and enhance traditional advantageous industries.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Plan for the Adjustment and Transformation of Old Industrial Bases (2013-2022) (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Northeast [2013] No. 543) (Development and Reform Commission/March 18, 2013)
content: Encourage the high-end equipment manufacturing industry to fully utilize global innovation resources, engage in various forms of research and development cooperation, and enhance innovation capabilities; support the international market development of domestically produced aircraft (including trunk aircraft, regional aircraft, and general aircraft), marine engineering equipment, and advanced rail transit equipment; encourage the import of key components and airborne systems in the aviation industry; encourage subcontracting production and support high-level joint ventures between domestic and foreign enterprises; support the overseas investment and establishment of factories by the aviation, marine engineering equipment, high-end intelligent equipment industries, and engage in component production and equipment assembly activities; encourage high-level joint ventures between domestic and foreign enterprises in the marine engineering equipment industry.
titlelist: Rebuilding new competitive advantages in industries, focusing on internationalization, high-end equipment manufacturing industry.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Plan for the Adjustment and Transformation of Old Industrial Bases (2013-2022) (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Northeast [2013] No. 543) (Development and Reform Commission/March 18, 2013)
content: Encourage eligible companies in industries such as new energy, aerospace, new energy vehicles, and high-end equipment manufacturing to invest and establish factories overseas. Encourage the establishment of production demonstration zones for the biological breeding industry overseas and strengthen international promotion. Support eligible environmental protection enterprises in strengthening international cooperation.
titlelist: Create new competitive advantages in industries, encourage the establishment of overseas production systems.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the National Plan for the Adjustment and Transformation of Old Industrial Bases (2013-2022) (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Northeast [2013] No. 543) (Development and Reform Commission/March 18, 2013)
content: By utilizing export credit and export credit insurance, actively support the international market development of key products, technologies, and services in strategic emerging industries. Provide key support in terms of export credit and export credit insurance for strategic emerging industry products in sectors such as aerospace, high-end equipment manufacturing, which have large amounts or can drive the export of domestic patented technologies and standards.
titlelist: Create new competitive advantages in industries, make good use of export credit and export credit insurance.

name: Guidelines for Priority Development of High-tech Industrialization in Current Key Areas (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, State Intellectual Property Office/January 23, 2007)
content: New advanced turbofan regional aircraft, improving and modifying existing turboprop regional aircraft; civil helicopters and general aviation aircraft (including unmanned aerial vehicles), multi-purpose general aviation aircraft and specialized small and ultra-small aircraft (including unmanned aircraft); integrated aviation electronics, environmental control, safety and rescue three major onboard systems, civil aviation engines and important components.
titlelist: Aerospace, civil aircraft

name: Guidelines for Priority Development of High-tech Industrialization in Current Key Areas (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, State Intellectual Property Office/January 23, 2007)
content: Complete sets of air traffic control equipment including civil aviation satellite communication, navigation, surveillance, and air traffic management system (CNS/ATM) control workstation system, CNS/ATM gateway system, flight flow management system, and automated control system, airspace design and evaluation system, digital pre-departure clearance (PDC) system, automatic terminal information service (D-ATIS) system, air traffic arrival and departure sequencing assistance decision system, air traffic control surveillance data fusion processing system, flight plan integration system, satellite navigation ground augmentation system, automatic dependent surveillance system, and multi-point correlated positioning system.
titlelist: Aerospace, air traffic control system

name: Guidelines for Priority Development of High-tech Industrialization in Current Key Areas (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, State Intellectual Property Office/January 23, 2007)
content: Comprehensive public information network platform for industries, security management system, weather observation and forecasting system, airworthiness certification system, airport security inspection system, airport operation support system.
titlelist: Aerospace, the new generation of civil aviation transportation system.

name: Guidelines for Priority Development of High-tech Industrialization in Current Key Areas (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, State Intellectual Property Office/January 23, 2007)
content: Ground user terminals for communication satellites, portable multimedia terminals, satellite ground uplink systems, satellite ground repeater stations, and cost-effective ground communication systems using new satellite communication technologies (new protocols), broadband/high-frequency/laser satellite communication systems; C, Ku, Ka, and L-band transponders, ground terminal equipment and key accessories related to satellite fixed communication services, satellite mobile communication services, TV satellite live broadcasting services (satellite digital audio broadcasting), and internet broadband access.
titlelist: Aerospace, satellite communication application system

name: Guidelines for Priority Development of High-tech Industrialization in Current Key Areas (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, State Intellectual Property Office/January 23, 2007)
content: Satellite navigation multimode enhanced application service system (including continuous observation network, real-time communication network, data processing center, and public service platform), comprehensive service system based on location information and its application service terminal (combined with wireless communication network global navigation satellite system technology and indoor positioning technology), vehicle information system with navigation, communication, audiovisual and other functions, personal navigation information terminal, compatible satellite navigation receiver, satellite navigation chips and embedded software.
titlelist: Aerospace, Satellite Navigation Application Service System

name: Guidelines for Priority Development of High-tech Industrialization in Current Key Areas (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, State Intellectual Property Office/January 23, 2007)
content: The comprehensive application platform for Earth observation satellite systems forms a centralized platform for receiving, quantifying processing, service-oriented distribution, and model-based applications. It is used in various fields such as land surveying and monitoring, meteorological observation and services, resource exploration, urban planning management and monitoring, transportation, agriculture and forestry monitoring, geological exploration, environmental monitoring, and disaster prevention and reduction.
titlelist: Aerospace, Earth Observation Satellite Application System

name: Guidelines for Priority Development of High-tech Industrialization in Current Key Areas (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, State Intellectual Property Office/January 23, 2007)
content: Build a modern infrastructure system that is comprehensive, efficient, practical, intelligent, green, safe, and reliable. Develop new types of infrastructure, accelerate the construction of the fifth generation mobile communication, industrial internet, and big data centers. Accelerate the development of a strong transportation nation, improve comprehensive transportation corridors, comprehensive transportation hubs, and logistics networks. Speed up the urban rail transit network in city clusters and metropolitan areas, and improve transportation accessibility in rural and border areas. Promote energy revolution, improve the energy production, supply, storage, and sales system, strengthen domestic oil and gas exploration and development, accelerate the construction of oil and gas reserve facilities, accelerate the construction of national trunk oil and gas pipelines, build smart energy systems, optimize the layout of power production and transmission channels, enhance the absorption and storage capacity of new energy, and improve the transmission and distribution capacity of electricity to remote areas. Strengthen water conservancy infrastructure construction, optimize the allocation of water resources, and enhance the capacity for water resources management and flood control.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of a modern industrial system, promote the optimization and upgrading of the economic system, and coordinate the advancement of infrastructure construction.

name: Outline of the National Comprehensive Three-dimensional Transportation Network Planning (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/February 24, 2021)
content: Promote effective integration of urban and intercity transportation. Promote the integration of trunk railways, intercity railways, and urban (suburban) railways, and coordinate with urban rail transit to establish an integrated operation, management, and service system, achieving facility interconnection, ticket interoperability, security mutual recognition, information sharing, and payment compatibility. Strengthen the efficient connection between urban peripheral roads and urban roads, optimize the road network for entering and exiting the city, promote coordinated planning, construction, and management, and reduce the division and interference of the city. Improve the urban logistics distribution system, strengthen the organic connection between intercity trunk transportation and urban terminal distribution. Strengthen the organic integration of railway and highway passenger hubs, airports, and urban public transportation networks, guide the rational and orderly development of cities along high-capacity public transportation corridors. Promote the integrated development of transportation within urban agglomerations. Build a convenient and efficient intercity transportation network, accelerate the networkization of urban agglomeration rail transit, improve the expressway network of urban agglomerations, strengthen the smooth connection between roads and rail transit in urban border areas, and basically achieve a 2-hour transportation circle within urban agglomerations. Strengthen the connectivity of important ports, stations, and airports within urban agglomerations, promote the coordinated use of resources, information sharing, division of labor, and cooperation among port clusters and airport clusters within urban agglomerations, and improve the overall efficiency and international competitiveness of the transportation hub system within urban agglomerations. Coordinate intercity networks, capacity, and transportation organization to improve transportation service efficiency. Study the layout of comprehensive general aviation airports, relieve general aviation activities at busy airports, develop urban helicopter transportation services, and build a fast air transportation network within urban agglomerations. Establish and improve the institutional mechanisms for the coordinated development of transportation within urban agglomerations, and promote the integration of relevant policies, regulations, and standards. Promote the integrated development of transportation in metropolitan areas. Build a high-capacity and fast rail transit network connecting the central urban area with satellite cities and new towns, promote bus-based operations, strengthen road transportation connections, and create a 1-hour door-to-door commuting circle. Promote the optimization of the urban road network structure and form a well-graded and smoothly accessible road network system. Develop shared transportation in an orderly manner, strengthen the construction of slow transportation systems such as walking and cycling in cities, reasonably allocate parking facilities, carry out sidewalk purification actions, build dedicated bicycle lanes according to local conditions, and encourage the public to choose green transportation. Implement the strategy of prioritizing public transportation, build a city public transportation system with urban rail transit as the backbone and conventional buses as the mainstay, promote a land development model guided by public transportation, and increase the share of green transportation in cities. Large cities should make full use of underground space and buildings for rail transit and optimize passenger flow evacuation.
titlelist: Promote the integrated development of comprehensive transportation planning and coordination, and promote the coordinated development of various transportation modes.

name: Program for Promoting the Development of Multimodal Transport and Optimizing the Transport Structure (2021-2025) (Excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 54) (State Council General Office/December 25, 2021)
content: Accelerate the research and development of logistics technology and equipment such as railway express delivery, air-rail (public) intermodal containers (boards), etc. Study the development of road dump trucks, shore cranes, and other facilities and equipment suitable for inland container development. Encourage the research and development and promotion of specialized transportation vehicles and ships for cold chain and hazardous chemicals. Promote the research and development and industrial application of new modular transport tools, rapid transfer, and intelligent port inspection equipment. (Led by China National Railway Group Co., Ltd. and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with cooperation from the Ministry of Transport, General Administration of Customs, Ministry of Science and Technology, National Railway Administration, Civil Aviation Administration of China, State Post Bureau, etc.)
titlelist: Accelerate the upgrading of technological equipment and strengthen the research, development, and application of technological equipment.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Modern Comprehensive Transportation System (State Council [2017] No. 11) (State Council/February 3, 2017)
content: Encourage transportation to go global. Promote comprehensive cooperation of enterprises in various ways such as investment, leasing, and technological cooperation to participate in the planning, design, construction, and operation of overseas transportation infrastructure. Actively engage in comprehensive cooperation in rail transportation, enhance the overall competitiveness of high-speed rail, urban rail transit, and other major equipment, accelerate the internationalization of independent brand automobiles, promote the export of various types of domestically produced aviation equipment, and explore the international market for port machinery, liquefied natural gas ships, and other vessels and marine engineering equipment.
titlelist: Accelerate the process of transportation service integration and enhance the international transportation service capabilities.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Modern Comprehensive Transportation System (State Council [2017] No. 11) (State Council/February 3, 2017)
content: Promote the indigenization of advanced technology equipment. Enhance the technological level of high-speed rail, high-power electric locomotives, heavy-duty trucks, medium-low-speed maglev urban transit, etc. Focus on developing and applying Chinese standard multiple-unit train products, research and develop urban (suburban) railway trains, innovate and develop the next generation of high-speed trains, and accelerate the industrialization of key technologies for urban rail transit equipment. Actively develop specialized road transport vehicles, large box trucks, and urban delivery vehicles, encourage the development of large and medium-sized luxury buses, and vigorously develop safe, practical, and economical rural buses. Develop integrated technology equipment for multimodal transportation and increase the proportion of container and special transportation equipment usage. Continue to develop large-scale specialized transport ships. Implement airworthiness research projects and actively develop domestically produced large aircraft and general aviation aircraft. Promote the standardization of technological equipment development. Accelerate the construction of technical standards for railway multimodal transport special equipment and machinery. Actively promote the standardization of cargo vehicle standards and strengthen the standard connection between vehicle announcements, production, testing, registration, and operation. Accelerate the standardization of inland waterway transport ships and vigorously develop river-sea direct ships. Promote the application of containerization and unitized loading technology. Establish standardized network interfaces for shared service platforms and standardized formats for document automation conversion.
titlelist: Accelerate the process of integrating transportation services and develop advanced and applicable technological equipment.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Modern Comprehensive Transportation System (State Council [2017] No. 11) (State Council/February 3, 2017)
content: Implement the Internet Plus convenient transportation and efficient logistics action plan. Integrate the development of informatization and intelligence into various links of transportation construction, operation, service, and supervision, promote the deep integration of technologies such as cloud computing, big data, the Internet of Things, mobile internet, and intelligent control with transportation, and realize the digitization and networking of infrastructure and transportation tools, as well as intelligent operation and management. Utilize information platforms to gather resources, drive the transformation of production organization and management methods, and comprehensively improve transportation efficiency and service quality. Cultivate and strengthen the intelligent transportation industry. Guided by innovation-driven development, focus on market demand and vigorously promote innovation and industrialization in emerging frontier areas such as intelligent transportation. Encourage technological innovation in transportation and promote the application of new technologies, and accelerate the establishment of a development model for the intelligent transportation industry driven by technology, market, and capital.
titlelist: Promote the intelligent development of transportation and facilitate the intelligent transformation of the transportation industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Modern Comprehensive Transportation System (State Council [2017] No. 11) (State Council/February 3, 2017)
content: Build a ubiquitous transportation Internet of Things. Promote the synchronous construction of operation monitoring equipment and transportation infrastructure. Strengthen the data collection system for comprehensive coverage of transportation network infrastructure risks, operational status, mobile device travel conditions, and operational organization dispatch information, forming a dynamic perception, comprehensive coverage, and ubiquitous interconnected transportation operation monitoring system. Construct a new generation of transportation information infrastructure network. Accelerate the construction of vehicle networking, ship networking, etc. Provide high-speed wireless access to the Internet public service in civil aviation, high-speed rail, and other transportation tools, important transportation routes, and passenger transportation hub stations. Build the next-generation mobile communication system for railways and layout a road wireless communication network based on the next-generation Internet and dedicated short-range communication. Research and plan the allocation of intelligent transportation dedicated spectrum. Promote cloud computing and big data applications. Enhance the service function of the national transportation logistics public information platform. Strengthen the collection, mining, and application of transportation information, promote the comprehensive development and utilization of data resources in various transportation fields, and promote cross-departmental sharing and utilization. Promote big data applications in transportation and tourism services. Encourage the industrial application of transportation big data and promote the construction of transportation electronic government cloud platform. Ensure the information security of transportation networks. Build an industry network security trust system, basically achieve the security and controllability of important information systems and key infrastructure, and enhance anti-destruction and disaster recovery capabilities. Strengthen network security monitoring, early warning, and emergency response capabilities to prevent attacks, leaks, and theft in the big data environment. Strengthen the protection of transportation data to prevent infringement of personal privacy and misuse of user information, and other behaviors.
titlelist: Enhance the level of intelligent development in transportation and strengthen the construction of intelligent development in transportation.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Promoting International Cooperation in Production Capacity and Equipment Manufacturing (excerpt) (State Council Document No. [2015] 30) (State Council, May 13, 2015)
content: With a focus on promoting and implementing interconnection of surrounding railways, construction of key regional railway networks in Africa, and high-speed railway projects, we will leverage our comprehensive advantages in railway design, construction, equipment supply, operation and maintenance, and financing to actively carry out comprehensive cooperation. We will actively develop and implement urban rail transit projects and expand international cooperation in urban rail transit vehicles. We will establish assembly, maintenance bases, and research and development centers in key countries where conditions permit. We will accelerate the integration of rail transit equipment enterprises and enhance the international operational capabilities and overall strength of backbone enterprises.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the pace of the railway's going global and expand the international market for rail transportation equipment.

name: Opinions of the State Council on Strengthening Urban Infrastructure Construction (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 36 [2013]) (State Council/September 6, 2013)
content: Construction of public transportation infrastructure. Encourage eligible cities to promote the construction of urban rail transit systems such as subways and light rails based on the principle of 'acting within one's capacity and orderly development', and leverage the backbone role of subways and other forms of public transportation to drive the development of urban public transportation and related industries. By 2015, the total length of newly operated rail transit in the country will reach 1,000 kilometers. Actively develop high-capacity surface public transportation, accelerate the construction of dispatch centers, parking lots, maintenance yards, terminal stations, and docking stations; promote the construction of transfer hubs and supporting facilities such as charging piles, charging stations, and public parking lots, and incorporate them into the simultaneous implementation of urban old city renovation and new city construction plans.
titlelist: Focus on key areas, promote comprehensive improvement of urban infrastructure, and strengthen the construction of urban road transportation infrastructure.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Prioritizing the Development of Public Transportation in Cities (excerpt) (State Council Document No. [2012] 64) (State Council/December 29, 2012)
content: By improving transportation capacity, enhancing service levels, strengthening the competitiveness and attractiveness of public transportation, we aim to build an urban mobility system centered around public transportation while also improving conditions for walking and cycling. We need to develop various forms of high-capacity public transportation vehicles, construct integrated transportation hubs, optimize transfer center functions and layouts, increase station coverage, and increase the proportion of public transportation in urban travel to establish its dominant position in urban transportation. Scientific research should determine the urban public transportation model, and based on the actual development needs of the city, a ground-based public transportation system primarily consisting of buses and electric buses should be planned and constructed, including rapid buses, modern trams, and other high-capacity ground-based public transportation systems. In cities with suitable conditions, the construction of rail transit systems should be orderly promoted. We should improve the level of public transportation vehicle ownership and the average operating speed of buses and electric buses. In large cities, we should strive to achieve full coverage of public transportation stations within a 500-meter radius of the city center, and the proportion of public transportation in motorized travel should reach around 60%.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Decision of the State Council on Accelerating the Cultivation and Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 32 [2010]) (State Council, October 10, 2010)
content: Focus on the development of aviation equipment, with an emphasis on trunk-line aircraft and general aircraft, to expand and strengthen the aviation industry. Actively promote the construction of space infrastructure to facilitate the development of satellite and its application industry. Relying on key projects such as passenger dedicated lines and urban rail transit, vigorously develop rail transit equipment. For the development of marine resources, vigorously develop marine engineering equipment. Strengthen basic supporting capabilities and actively develop intelligent manufacturing equipment with digitization, flexibility, and system integration technologies as the core.
titlelist: Based on the national conditions, strive to achieve rapid and healthy development in key areas, such as high-end equipment manufacturing industry.

name: Equipment Manufacturing Industry Adjustment and Revitalization Plan (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 11 [2009]) (State Council/ May 12, 2009)
content: Nearly 70 railway projects in 17 cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen. The project focuses on the independent development of urban rail transit vehicles, signal systems, train network control systems, braking systems, main and auxiliary inverters, and other electromechanical equipment.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization rely on ten key areas of focus, revitalizing the equipment manufacturing industry, and urban rail transit.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: Standards are the technical support for economic activities and social development, and an important aspect of the fundamental system of a country. Standardization plays a fundamental and leading role in promoting the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity. In order to promote the comprehensive development of railway standardization work, this plan is formulated in accordance with the requirements of the 'Outline of National Standardization Development', 'Outline of Building a Strong Transportation Nation', and railway development plans, combined with the actual needs of railway reform and development.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: Optimization has improved the survey, design, construction quality acceptance, and safety technical requirements of high-speed railways and mixed passenger and freight railways. For the first time in the industry standards, it has unified the main technical standards of heavy-duty railways, urban (suburban) railways, maglev railways, and dedicated railways. It has highlighted the technical and economic aspects in determining key indicators such as railway clearance, design load, train organization, and vehicle selection. It has guided the construction of key railway projects such as the Beijing-Zhangjiakou high-speed railway (19,000 kilometers) and the Haoji railway, effectively promoting the integration of trunk railways, intercity railways, urban (suburban) railways, and urban rail transit. New achievements have been made in key technologies and operational services such as EMUs, AC drive high-power locomotives, high-speed railway train operation control systems, railway digital mobile communication systems, track and bridge components, and key components of the catenary system. It has improved equipment quality and system stability, further enhanced the safety and reliability of technical equipment, continuously optimized the quality of railway transportation services, and improved the travel experience for passengers.
titlelist: The development status and situation requirements indicate that the construction and operation of standard service railways have achieved remarkable results.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: Actively organizing and participating in international standardization activities has enhanced the influence of China's railways in the field of international standardization. China ranks among the top contributors in the International Organization for Standardization Technical Committee for Railway Applications (ISO/TC269) and the International Electrotechnical Commission Technical Committee for Railway Applications (IEC/TC9). China has led the development of 21 ISO and IEC international standards in the railway field and participated in 157 standards, including 12 new ones. China successfully hosted the 56th annual meeting of IEC/TC9. China has also led the completion of 8 standards in the series Implementation of High-Speed Rail for the International Union of Railways (UIC) and is currently working on the development of 18 standards in the series High-Speed Rail Design, incorporating China's key railway technologies and practical experience. China actively serves the Belt and Road Initiative, continuously promotes the translation of railway standards into foreign languages, and has organized the publication of 114 railway equipment manufacturing standards and 70 railway engineering construction standards in foreign languages, achieving comprehensive coverage of important railway equipment manufacturing and engineering construction standards in English. China has published translations of the High-Speed Rail Design Code in English, Russian, Arabic, Thai, and Indonesian, sharing China's experience and wisdom in high-speed rail construction with the international community. China has also published three dictionaries, including the Chinese-Arabic Dictionary of Railway Engineering Construction Standards, providing strong support for technical exchanges between China and foreign countries. China's railway standards have been adopted in various overseas projects such as the Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Railway, the China-Laos Railway, and the China-Thailand Railway, promoting the internationalization of China's railway construction and equipment products.
titlelist: The development status and situation require achieving new achievements in international standardization.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: By 2025, the level of standardization and integration of the railway standard system will significantly improve. The railway standard system will be further optimized and integrated, becoming more systematic, comprehensive, and coordinated. The standards will be more advanced and applicable, with over 200 national and industry railway standards implemented and published. The quality of group and enterprise standards will significantly improve, better meeting the practical needs of railway construction and safe operation. The ability to participate in international standardization activities will continue to strengthen, with an increase in the number of international standards led or participated in. The international influence and contribution will greatly increase, with a conversion rate of over 95% for the application of international standards. The foundation of standardization will continue to be strengthened, with a more sound working system and mechanism, standardized management of standardization technical institutions, and sufficient standardization professionals to meet development needs. The implementation and supervision mechanism of standards will be further improved, resulting in more significant effectiveness.
titlelist: Guiding principles and main objectives, the main objectives for the development of railway standardization work during the 14th Five-Year Plan period.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: By combining railway technological innovation and technological development, we adhere to problem-oriented, goal-oriented, and demand-oriented approaches, deepen research on the railway standard system, and optimize the government-led formulation of standards supply. Building upon the existing comprehensive sub-systems of equipment manufacturing and engineering construction standards, we innovate and enhance the architecture, content, and other aspects to make the railway standard system more adaptable to the requirements of building a strong transportation nation and achieving high-quality railway development. We plan and guide the revision of railway standards. We optimize the sub-systems of equipment technology standards, improve the sub-systems of engineering construction standards, and establish a sound sub-system of transportation service standards. We aim to construct a railway standard system that is more structurally reasonable, covers a more comprehensive range, is more advanced in level, and provides stronger support.
titlelist: Build a new pattern of railway standard system, continuously optimize and improve the railway standard system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: Focus on building a high-standard railway market system and accelerating independent innovation, support the development of group standards and enterprise standards in strategic emerging industries and key common technologies in the railway sector. Encourage social groups to develop group standards that meet market and innovation needs, timely incorporate advanced and applicable technological innovations into standards, and improve the level of standards. Encourage enterprises to focus on cutting-edge areas of scientific and technological innovation, establish enterprise standards with technical requirements higher than national and industry standards, and improve product and service quality. Encourage the transformation of group standards and enterprise standards that lead scientific and technological innovation and promote industrial upgrading into national and industry standards.
titlelist: Building a new pattern of railway standard system, encouraging the innovative development of group standards and enterprise standards.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: Strengthen the revision of standards related to basic safety, mobile equipment, infrastructure, and other areas, and enhance the government-led public welfare standards in safety, basic, general, energy conservation and environmental protection, emergency rescue, etc., to provide technical support for ensuring the quality and safety of railway construction and equipment. Column 1 focuses on the revision of standards in the field of equipment technology. Revise standards such as aerodynamics, high-speed railway perimeter intrusion alarm system, and measurement of environmental noise along the railway. Locomotives and vehicles. Revise standards such as traction calculation for EMUs, key components of EMU running gear and braking system, locomotive and vehicle inverters, locomotive and vehicle operation safety monitoring, locomotive and vehicle energy storage power supply, non-destructive testing of key components, etc. Research on standards such as whole vehicle testing of high-speed EMUs, power concentration EMUs, hybrid locomotives and EMUs, urban (suburban) railway locomotives and vehicles, intercity medium and low-speed maglev vehicles, railway carrying vehicles, locomotive and vehicle fire protection, locomotive and vehicle energy consumption, locomotive and vehicle carbon emissions, etc. Civil engineering. Revise standards such as high-speed railway CRTS III type slab ballastless track concrete track slab, elastic support ballastless track components, bridge erection machines, beam transport vehicles, bridge construction machines, comprehensive inspection vehicles, heavy-duty track vehicles, rail welding vehicles, etc. Research on standards such as roughness spectrum of heavy-duty railway tracks. Communication and signaling. Revise standards such as automatic driving for high-speed trains, comprehensive automation of marshalling yards, railway radio monitoring, etc. Research on standards such as CTCS-4 level train operation control system, new generation railway mobile communication system, railway communication network security, fully electronic computer interlocking system, monitoring system based on Beidou, railway turnout monitoring, etc. Traction power supply. Revise standards such as high-speed railway power supply safety detection and monitoring system, transformers for electrified railway traction power supply system, lightning protection devices, AC switchgear, etc. Research on standards such as current-carrying performance of contact wire. Transportation equipment. Revise standards such as equipment for detecting excessive load on freight cars, ticket sales and inspection equipment, etc.
titlelist: Strengthen the revision of standards in key areas, optimize equipment technology standards.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: The strengthening of standards plays a role in ensuring the basic and bottom line of quality control, safety assurance, and green environmental protection in railway engineering. It promotes the revision of key standards that adapt to different railway characteristics and promotes the integrated application of new generation information technology in railway construction. It incorporates engineering cost standards, providing technical support for ensuring the quality and safety of railway engineering and improving construction investment efficiency. Column 2 focuses on the revision of standards in the field of engineering construction. It revises the standards for land indicators for construction projects, the application of engineering informatization, project management standards, and railway construction risk management standards. It revises specialized geological survey technical standards and test method standards for physical exploration, geological drilling, and geotechnical testing, measurement standards for railway engineering photography, satellite positioning, and measurement standards for high-speed railway and reconstruction railway projects. It researches new technology application standards such as Beidou and airborne lidar. It revises standards for high-speed railway logistics bases, 300 km/h ballasted track and intelligent logistics parks, design standards for passenger and freight co-linear railways and intercity railways, design supporting standards for urban (suburban) railways and maglev railways, design standards for complex structures such as long and deep-buried tunnels and large-span arch bridges, green passenger stations, bridge wind resistance, tunnel operation ventilation, engineering seismic resistance, comprehensive pipelines, and electromechanical equipment monitoring, standards for natural disaster and foreign object intrusion monitoring, and engineering BIM technology application standards. It revises technical standards for safety monitoring during construction of tunnels on the Sichuan-Tibet Railway, technical standards for construction monitoring of adjacent operating lines, identification and assessment of construction hazards and factors, and intelligent embankment construction standards. It revises standards for construction quality control of environmental protection projects, acceptance standards for key parts such as tunnel linings, acceptance standards for construction of special and complex structures such as long and deep-buried tunnels and large-span suspension bridges, and technical specifications for static and dynamic acceptance of high-speed railway projects. It revises technical standards for non-destructive testing of engineering quality, construction quality testing standards for structural concrete, detection procedures for communication bearing networks, computer interlocking, train control systems, and power and traction engineering; researches detection procedures for natural disaster and foreign object intrusion systems. It revises the methods and cost quotas for railway engineering design estimates and cost quotas, railway engineering budget estimates, cost quotas for construction machinery and equipment, material base period prices, specifications for railway engineering quantity lists, and rules for calculating railway engineering quantities, as well as construction cost standards for new technologies and special complex geological conditions in various specialties.
titlelist: Strengthen the revision of standards in key areas, improve the standards for construction projects.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: With a focus on safety supervision and efficient operation, further promote the expansion of transportation services. Revise the transportation organization standards, service quality standards, and operation maintenance standards in the field of transportation services, providing technical support to ensure the safety and efficiency of railway transportation and improve the quality of railway transportation services. Column 3 focuses on the revision of standards in the field of transportation services. Revise standards such as railway passenger transportation vocabulary, freight terminology, technical requirements for oxygen-enriched environment in high-altitude passenger trains, and monitoring of radioactive materials in railway transportation. Transportation organization. Revise standards for railway transportation of dangerous goods, transportation of oversized and overweight goods, cargo loading and reinforcement, cargo handling safety, freight terminology, etc.; study standards for railway electronic tickets, electronic payments, etc. Service quality. Revise standards for evaluating the quality of passenger transportation services, and study standards for evaluating the quality of freight transportation services. Operation and maintenance. Revise standards for technical requirements for railway safety protection facilities, etc.
titlelist: Strengthen the revision of standards in key areas and improve transportation service standards.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: 14. Continuously promote the internationalization of railway standards. Actively participate in the revision of international standards such as ISO, IEC, and UIC, and promote the inclusion of China's railway advantages and characteristic technologies in international standards in the fields of ballastless track systems, train passing systems, high-speed railway design, etc. Carry out publicity on international standardization work through multiple channels, encourage various units in the railway industry to actively send more experts to participate in international standardization work, support enterprises, social organizations, research institutions, etc. to actively participate in various international professional standard organizations, strive to achieve new achievements in international standardization technical institutions and secretariats, actively undertake and participate in more international conferences, further enhance the international influence of China's railways, and strengthen its discourse power. Keep track of the development of international railway technical standards in a timely manner, strengthen research on international standards, conduct in-depth research and analysis on the differences and equivalences between Chinese and foreign standards, and improve the conversion rate of applicable standards. 15. Further enhance the ability to serve the construction of the Belt and Road by railways. Strengthen the management of the translation of railway standards into foreign languages, improve the terminology database for the translation of foreign language versions of standards, research and develop a corpus for the translation of foreign language versions of standards, and enhance the effective supply of foreign language versions of standards. Give full play to the advantages of China's railway standard system and complete system, and explore the establishment of a method system for foreign countries to cite or transform Chinese railway standards in conjunction with overseas engineering contracting, foreign aid projects, etc. Actively promote cooperation and coordination with countries along the Belt and Road in jointly formulating standards, and promote the soft interconnection of standards in various countries along the route.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Standardized Development of Railways (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 47) (National Railway Administration/December 21, 2021)
content: Implement the national development strategy, summarize the experience of railway construction and operation management in our country, optimize design concepts and key technical parameters, and further improve the economic applicability of standards on the basis of ensuring safety. Promote the interactive development of standardization and technological innovation, and enhance the level of standards through technological innovation. Conduct research on safety management standards and strengthen the foundation of railway safety technology management. Carry out research on key technologies for operating high-speed wheel-rail systems with a speed of 400 kilometers per hour, high-speed maglev systems with a speed of 600 kilometers per hour, and high-speed railway freight transportation. Conduct research on technical standards for urban (suburban) railway supporting technologies. Conduct research on the operation risk prevention and control, evacuation and rescue, environmental protection, and autonomous train operation control of the long and steep tunnel group of the Sichuan-Tibet Railway, as well as key technologies for railway safety and disaster prevention in windy and seismic areas. Deploy technology research and development, standard formulation, and other tasks in the fields of 5G, Beidou, artificial intelligence, and other promising applications, and promote breakthroughs in key core technologies of railway standards. Conduct research on key components of high-speed train sets and standards to continuously enhance the advantages of the entire industry chain of high-speed railways and provide support for improving industrial quality. Conduct research on energy-saving and carbon-reducing technologies for railway engineering construction and equipment to promote the green, healthy, and sustainable development of the railway sector.
titlelist: Strengthen the basic research on railway standardization and enhance the scientific research support for standards.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Railway technology innovation is an important component of the national science and technology innovation system and is the driving force behind railway development. In order to continuously promote railway technology innovation, drive high-quality railway development, support the construction of a scientifically and technologically strong country and a strong transportation country, this plan is formulated in accordance with national and industry-related planning and deployment.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Focus on key technologies in the field of equipment, promote the development of high-speed intelligent train sets, advanced transportation and loading equipment, and modern engineering equipment. Accelerate the research and development of key core technologies, promote the high-end, intelligent, and systematic development of technological equipment, and build a modern equipment system.
titlelist: Key tasks, technical equipment

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Develop key technologies that restrict speed and improve energy efficiency in the integration of high-speed train systems, bearing running structures, wheel axle drives, and brake controls. Formulate a standardized system and testing and verification capabilities, construct a self-controlled and leading performance platform for high-speed trains with speeds ranging from 250 to 400 kilometers per hour, and continuously lead in technological advancements. Deepen research on the wheel-rail relationship, pantograph-catenary relationship, aerodynamics, vehicle dynamics, impact dynamics, vibration and noise control, non-ballasted track structure dynamics, energy consumption and recovery, and other fundamental theories of railway. Conduct research on drag reduction and energy-saving, vibration and noise reduction, vehicle-track relationship, fluid-structure interaction, vehicle interoperability, cabin environment quality and coordination, intelligence, and lightweight technologies for trains operating at higher speeds. Enhance the safety, reliability, and comfort of trains operating at high speeds.
titlelist: Key tasks, technological equipment, promoting the research and development of higher speed wheel-rail technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Improve the research and development of intercity and urban (suburban) equipment technology, enhance the technological level of lightweight, intelligent, and green equipment for intercity and urban (suburban) areas. Promote the mature application of 30,000-ton heavy-duty trains and fast freight equipment with speeds of 160 kilometers per hour and above, advance the research, application, and industrialization of 25-40-ton axle load freight equipment, 120 kilometers per hour multimodal transport, and high-speed freight equipment technology. Promote the research and application of standardized, containerized, modular freight equipment, new cold chain, dangerous goods transportation, pack animal transportation, double-deck container transportation, and other railway specialized vehicles, achieving the development of heavy-duty bulk freight, high-speed fast freight, and specialized transportation. Carry out research and development of technology reserves for high-speed maglev systems with speeds of 600 kilometers per hour and low-vacuum tube (tunnel) high-speed trains.
titlelist: Key tasks, technological equipment, strengthening the research and development of advanced transportation equipment technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Carry out the identification of rock mass classification and research on new rock-breaking methods for tunnel boring machines, and develop a new generation of tunnel boring machines and tunnel drilling and blasting construction equipment. Research and develop efficient and high-precision drilling, in-situ testing, geotechnical testing, geophysical exploration, and remote sensing equipment that integrate information technology. Carry out key technology research and development of intelligent excavation, bridge erection, and maintenance robots, promote the research, development, and large-scale application of complete sets of engineering equipment for intelligent, systematic, and configurable railway route survey, construction, testing, monitoring, operation, and rescue in complex environments, and enhance the digitization, integration, and visualization level of engineering construction management. Research key technologies for strengthening and improving the service performance of heavy-duty railway engineering equipment. Develop a new generation of railway intelligent comprehensive detection, monitoring, and unmanned fully automated inspection equipment that can adapt to special environments and operate at a speed of 400 kilometers per hour, accelerate the upgrading and replacement of large-scale maintenance machinery, and promote the research, development, and application of new types of railway cranes and high-speed railway rapid rescue and repair equipment.
titlelist: Key tasks, technological equipment, strengthening research and development of modern engineering equipment technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Conquer the basic theory of bearings based on complex boundary conditions, improve the key core technologies such as bearing design, simulation, materials, manufacturing, testing, and application maintenance for high-speed train bogies, establish a bearing technology and product innovation capability platform for bogies, form a bearing industry chain and scale industrialization capability, and promote the application of products in train operation. Improve the complete set of technologies for high-speed train wheels, axles, and insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) chips, establish an application technology system and standard system throughout the chain, form a complete technology innovation platform, achieve product assessment and promote application in train operation. Research and apply new traction control, brake control, auxiliary power supply control, train network, and operation control systems for new trains. Column 2: Key projects in the field of technical equipment implement the CR450 technology innovation project, establish a full-process test and verification platform for high-speed trains with a speed of 400 kilometers per hour, implement the technical standard system for 400-kilometer-per-hour high-speed railways, carry out the lightweight technology upgrade project for equipment, develop and apply demonstration equipment with unmanned autonomous operation capabilities for construction and maintenance, implement new equipment for high-speed railway box girder transportation, super large gantry crane, variable span cable crane, etc., carry out key core technology research and development for bearings used in high-speed train bogies, establish a product innovation capability platform, develop a new Chinese train control system (CTCS), implement the complete set of technologies for IGBT chips used in high-speed trains, and carry out research and testing on the electromagnetic environmental effects of railway construction.
titlelist: Key tasks, technological equipment, accelerate the key core technology breakthroughs.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: With major projects as the foundation, we will play a crucial role in scientific and technological innovation, enhance the comprehensive strength of survey and design, break through key construction technologies for complex and difficult mountainous projects, overcome the mechanisms and technical challenges of severe environmental disasters, and provide strong support for the high-level, high-standard, and high-quality advancement of national major engineering construction.
titlelist: Key tasks, construction engineering

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Develop remote sensing target recognition technology for special geological and complex meteorological environments, to achieve high efficiency, high precision, and high adaptability in railway survey methods. Research on technologies such as Beidou satellite navigation, airborne radar, low-altitude remote sensing with unmanned aerial vehicles, aerial geophysics, and simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), to promote the application of integrated aerial, space, and ground survey technologies and satellite positioning measurement methods. Develop intelligent route selection technology supported by geographic information system big data (GIS) and cloud computing technology, to achieve automatic generation of multiple solutions and multidimensional intelligent evaluation. Research key technologies for geological survey in complex environments, to improve the anti-interference and refinement levels of engineering survey technology. Increase the research and development efforts for fundamental software in railway survey design, and accelerate testing, verification, and application promotion. Promote the deep integration of railway information modeling technology, to achieve standardization and digitization of information model creation and delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, and promote integration.
titlelist: Key tasks, engineering construction, promoting the integrated application of survey and design technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Conduct research on tunnel construction technology under extremely complex geological conditions such as high stress, high temperature, large deformation of soft rock, and strong seismic activity. Actively promote the application of tunnel prefabrication and assembly construction technology, breakthrough key technologies such as the utilization of engineering materials, corrosion mechanisms and service life of key materials, and seamless integration of high-altitude railway turnouts, and serve major engineering construction projects. Promote research on the design and construction technology of complex and special structural bridges and seamless track on bridges, comprehensively improve the level of railway construction in difficult mountainous areas. Study key technologies for roadbed construction under special climate and complex geological conditions, continuously improve the quality of roadbed engineering construction. Continuously carry out research on ballastless track structure technology to meet safety and comfort requirements. Deepen research on technologies such as deformation control of tracks, bridges, and roadbeds for 400 km/h speed, and optimization of aerodynamic effects in tunnels and ancillary facilities. Further optimize the structural types of heavy-duty railway bridges and tunnels, and establish a series of technical systems for heavy-duty railways in China.
titlelist: Key tasks, engineering construction, strengthening technical research and development in engineering construction.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Deepen the theoretical research on risk control, carry out key technological breakthroughs in disaster prevention and reduction based on risk control theory, develop early identification and intelligent trend recognition technologies for major geological disasters, and comprehensively enhance the level of risk management in railway engineering. Develop infrastructure disaster prevention and control technologies and maintenance capabilities, emergency repair technologies, and improve disaster prevention and repair efficiency. Conduct research on digital monitoring and detection technologies for construction processes under complex environmental conditions, and improve engineering construction safety measures. Improve natural disaster and foreign object intrusion monitoring systems, earthquake monitoring and early warning systems, and perimeter intrusion alarm systems to enhance the level of disaster prevention and reduction technologies in railway engineering. Promote the application of structural health monitoring and long-term performance observation technologies, enhance integrated management, intelligent analysis, and early warning capabilities for safety data, hidden dangers, operational status, and performance rules. Column 3: Key projects in the field of engineering construction. Relying on projects such as the Shanghai-Chongqing-Chengdu along the Yangtze River high-speed railway, carry out technological infrastructure engineering tests for the CR450 scientific and technological innovation project. Establish a technology system for the series development of heavy-duty railways with axle loads of 25-40 tons, and develop intelligent technology, aerospace, and land, sea, and air integrated information technology platforms for surveying, mapping, and route selection based on building information modeling (BIM) technology. Develop a comprehensive platform for obtaining and analyzing complex and diverse geographical and geological information and comprehensive mountain disaster prevention and control technologies in complex and difficult mountainous areas. Develop a deep environmental tunnel disaster evaluation system, develop mechanisms and technologies for the deterioration and control of bridges and tunnels in high-altitude and cold regions, develop underwater tunnel construction technologies in the Yangtze River, coastal areas, and cross-sea deep water complex environments, and develop technologies for the construction of large-span deep water and deep foundation bridges. Develop assembly-type ballastless track systems, research and develop technologies for the design of subgrade structures, construction processes, and structural deformation control under special climate and geological conditions, improve key technologies for the durability of railway infrastructure, and develop intelligent diagnostic and early warning platforms. Develop structural health monitoring and early warning systems for railway stations, large-span bridges, complex slopes, long tunnels, and tracks.
titlelist: Key tasks, engineering construction, deepening the application of engineering disaster prevention and mitigation technologies.
