name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Based on the goal of 'people enjoy their travel, goods flow smoothly,' we carry out technological research and development applications in the fields of passenger transportation, cargo transportation, and transportation organization. We continuously meet the diverse, high-quality, and refined transportation service needs of passengers and cargo owners, achieving convenient passenger transportation, efficient freight logistics, efficient scheduling, and intelligent transportation.
titlelist: Key tasks, transportation services

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Research on innovative design of the Chinese railway customer service system (12306) to improve the architecture, achieve flexible expansion of business functions, and enhance system concurrency processing performance. Conduct research on passenger transportation demand analysis and forecasting techniques to continuously optimize passenger train operation plans. Deepen the research on differentiated service system design techniques, improve the differentiated and spectrum-based passenger transportation product system, and effectively adapt to passengers' multi-level transportation needs. Promote research on intelligent travel services for passengers throughout the entire process, make breakthroughs in biometric recognition technology and contactless payment technology, and deepen research on high-speed rail technology on 5G signals. Promote the construction of integrated comprehensive transportation hubs, conduct research on the construction of passenger intermodal transportation networks and collaborative transportation organization techniques, gradually realize the provision of comprehensive travel plans covering various transportation modes seamlessly to passengers, and build a personalized and precise service system to meet passengers' individual needs.
titlelist: Key tasks, transportation services, promoting technological innovation in passenger transportation services.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Improve the architecture design of the railway freight e-commerce system (95306), optimize integrated freight comprehensive services platform, achieve electronic application and multi-channel information services. Promote the construction of a high-speed rail express service system, form a complete set of technical solutions that match infrastructure, equipment systems, and operational management. Apply key core technologies of multimodal transport, develop intelligent and automated railway freight transportation hub system, improve the efficient logistics network railway freight system covering end users, integrate into the social logistics system, and play a role in backbone support. Promote research on standardization of multimodal transport railway, accelerate the improvement of key and fundamental national and industry standards. Explore key technologies such as full-process tracking and inquiry of freight and guarantee of delivery time limits.
titlelist: Key tasks, transportation services, accelerate the technological upgrade of cargo transportation services.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Carry out key technology research on intelligent integrated dispatching, deepen the research and development of intelligent dispatching centers (CTC) for high-speed railways, multimedia communication and emergency command technologies, and break through the technologies of collaborative train command for multi-level and multi-granularity across the entire network, high-density cross-line transportation scheduling for high-speed trains of different speed levels, etc. Deepen the research on smaller tracking intervals for high-speed railways and promote the comprehensive technology research on mixed transportation of passengers and freight at speeds of 200-250 kilometers per hour. Promote the integrated research on train command and control for regional rail transit systems with railways as the backbone. Research the intelligent compilation system for train operation diagrams under abnormal conditions for high-speed railways. Column 4: Implement key projects in the transportation service field, optimize and upgrade the China Railway Customer Service System (12306), optimize and upgrade the China Railway Freight E-commerce System (95306), promote the application of intelligent integrated dispatching systems and intelligent dispatching center systems, and apply intelligent control and command systems for large marshalling yards.
titlelist: Key tasks, transportation services, deepening research and development of transportation efficiency improvement technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Vigorously promote the deep integration of frontier technologies such as Beidou satellite navigation, 5G, artificial intelligence, big data, Internet of Things, cloud computing, blockchain, etc., with railway technology equipment, engineering construction, and transportation services. Strengthen the research and application of key core technologies for intelligent railways, promote collaborative sharing of big data, promote the development of the digital economy in the railway field, and enhance the level of railway intelligence.
titlelist: Key task, intelligent railway

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Based on the comprehensive application demonstration project of the Beidou Railway Industry, promote the research and application of key technologies such as Beidou satellite navigation system for railway basic space-time coordinates, infrastructure survey and design, structural safety monitoring, train operation control and safety monitoring, and real-time positioning services for freight transportation. Establish an independent and controllable railway Beidou application technology system. Research on 5G integrated technology, promote the application of millimeter wave communication, wireless big data, digital twins, cloud-edge collaboration, and integration of sensing-communication-computation in the field of railway communication signals. Research on the deep application of artificial intelligence and big data technology in core business areas such as railway transportation organization, passenger and freight services, safety assurance, and equipment health management. Conduct ubiquitous application research on Internet of Things technology in railway equipment and facilities, operating environment, public safety, and promote the application research of cloud computing and mobile Internet technology in the field of railway command and dispatch and passenger and freight services. Conduct research on railway computing network, intelligence network, and knowledge graph technology, and promote the application research of Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6), blockchain, and Internet of Things identification network in the railway field. Research and promote the application of robot technology in the field of railway equipment and facilities operation and maintenance.
titlelist: Key task, intelligent railway, promoting deep integration of cutting-edge technology and the railway field.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Translate the following Chinese text to English:'In order to achieve the integration of the entire lifecycle and all business objectives, we will continue to strengthen research on intelligent railway top-level planning and build the architecture of the intelligent railway technology system version 2.0. We will deepen technological innovation in intelligent construction, intelligent equipment, and intelligent operation, and develop digital twin platforms for intelligent construction. We will develop intelligent train sets with self-perception, self-decision-making, and self-adaptive capabilities, and develop full-service travel based on Mobility as a Service (MaaS) + 5G and data-driven precise maintenance intelligent operation service technologies. We will also conduct research and development on intelligent maintenance technologies for heavy-duty railways. Drawing on the experience of intelligent railway technological innovation, we will promote key technological innovation in intelligent intercity transportation, research overall technical solutions for regional rail transit integration, research key technologies applicable to intercity, urban (suburban) railway network, bus-like, and intelligent operation, develop new train operation control system equipment that integrates various modes such as CTCS and Communication-Based Train Control (CBTC), and promote research on collaborative operation technologies for multi-system rail transit networks to meet the needs of multi-network integration and cross-line operation.'
titlelist: Key tasks, intelligent railways, strengthening the research, development, and application of intelligent railway technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Strengthen the acquisition, integration, and collaborative sharing of big data in railway transportation, and build an innovative platform for comprehensive transportation big data application technology to support the research and engineering of technologies such as data collection, processing, analysis, mining, management, decision-making, and integration application in transportation big data. Research the sharing of transportation big data and seamless transportation service technologies among national railways, local railways, dedicated railway lines, highways, water transportation, aviation, urban public transportation, and other transportation modes, enhance the digitalization and seamless connection level of railway transportation services, and support the construction of a comprehensive transportation system for a strong transportation country. Column 5: Key projects in the field of intelligent railways. Relying on the construction of the Chengdu-Chongqing high-speed railway, promote the implementation of the Intelligent Railway 2.0 demonstration application project, complete the research on the 5G private network technology system and key core technologies of railways, develop the Beidou comprehensive application demonstration project for the railway industry, develop the industrial Internet demonstration platform for railway communication and signaling, develop the digital twin platform for intelligent construction, develop the digital twin application demonstration platform for railway communication and signaling systems and traction power supply systems, develop key technologies for intelligent intercity transportation and complete system construction, establish a platform for high-speed heavy-duty autonomous driving technology, conduct research and demonstration applications of intelligent operation and maintenance technology for heavy-duty railway mobile equipment, and develop a seamless travel platform for railway passengers and a one-stop service platform for cargo based on the sharing of multimodal transportation big data.
titlelist: Key tasks, intelligent railways, promoting collaborative sharing of transportation big data.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Adhere to the concept of safe development, improve the integrated proactive safety control technology of the railway system, deepen research on key technologies for equipment maintenance and repair, enhance railway emergency response and rescue capabilities, and establish and improve a comprehensive security technology system integrating personnel defense, physical defense, and technical defense.
titlelist: Key tasks, security guarantee

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Carry out research on the theory of railway infrastructure disaster transformation and the degradation mechanism of safety performance in complex environments, and construct an integrated active safety control technology system based on comprehensive detection and monitoring data for risk prediction, early warning, and prevention and control. Deepen the research on integrated detection and monitoring technology system for power and communication supply, and promote the upgrading and transformation of high-speed comprehensive detection system, high-speed comprehensive inspection system, engineering comprehensive inspection system, power supply detection and monitoring system, etc. Deepen the research on integrated detection and monitoring technology system for railway mobile equipment, promote the development, application, and system integration of on-board monitoring and detection system for railway mobile equipment and trackside monitoring and detection system, and strengthen the research on safety monitoring and real-time tracking technology for the entire process of railway dangerous goods transportation. Strengthen the basic research on railway safety control and construct a railway safety control technology system. Strengthen the basic research on the application of control safety cloud technology, break through a batch of basic key technologies such as design, development, testing, verification, and evaluation and certification of control safety and information security based on cloud architecture, construct an equipment system based on control safety cloud, and support the upgrading of product system. Deepen the basic research on safety technology standards for railway infrastructure and equipment, establish a sound safety standards system for the entire life cycle of railway mobile equipment, and improve the safety, reliability, durability, safety protection, and rapid repair capabilities of key equipment and facilities throughout their life cycle. Integrate the use of high-speed comprehensive video surveillance and intelligent analysis technology to achieve visual and three-dimensional prevention and control of train operation, construction, public security, and natural disaster risks. Continuously promote the construction of railway information system network security and construct a network security protection technology system that meets the characteristics of railway systems and operations.
titlelist: Key tasks, security guarantee, deepening the research and application of proactive safety control system technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Deepen the reform of maintenance and management systems, establish a sound standard system for equipment maintenance and evaluation. Construct a train on-route monitoring and early warning system, as well as a health management technology system. Carry out in-depth research on the safety and reliability of train operation, such as structural safety monitoring, fatigue performance evaluation of key components, and lifespan prediction, in order to extend the service life of equipment. Develop specialized, intensive, precise, intelligent, and integrated maintenance technologies, improve the cloud-based intelligent health management level of infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, and promote the application of unmanned technologies. Deepen theoretical innovation and technological breakthroughs in infrastructure operation and maintenance, optimize performance and operational quality. Promote the development and application of complete sets of technologies for preventive maintenance, rapid maintenance, and green and intelligent maintenance of infrastructure, and enhance the refined, rapid, and intelligent operation and maintenance level of railway infrastructure.
titlelist: Key tasks, safety assurance, promoting the application of equipment and facility operation and maintenance technology engineering.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Build an integrated railway emergency response system that ensures the intrinsic safety, production safety, and emergency rescue of railway transportation, and improve the efficiency and scientificity of emergency response. Develop railway train command and dispatch, emergency plans, and emergency command integration technology for the entire network, and enhance the emergency response capability for emergencies and disasters. Deepen the research on functional evaluation and rapid repair enhancement technology of railway engineering systems in natural disasters and emergencies, conduct optimization research on disaster prevention, evacuation, and rescue systems for large tunnels and tunnel clusters, and improve the on-site emergency repair level of railway infrastructure in special extreme situations. Carry out precise tracing and identification of railway passengers, non-contact rapid security checks and health screenings for high passenger flows, and research and develop technologies for biological safety prevention and control of transport vehicles, and enhance the railway's emergency response capabilities for public health emergencies. Conduct research on auxiliary technologies for railway emergency rescue and enhance comprehensive emergency rescue capabilities. Column 6: Key projects in the field of security. Develop next-generation high-speed comprehensive inspection vehicles, optimize and upgrade power supply detection and monitoring (6C), locomotive safety protection (6A), on-the-way train detection and monitoring systems, develop comprehensive video surveillance and intelligent analysis application systems covering the entire high-speed rail line, develop railway safety cloud platforms, develop intelligent security assurance systems for train operation control information, develop active safety assurance and disaster prevention and rescue systems for high-altitude and harsh geological environments, develop large-scale infrastructure maintenance systems for harsh environments such as plateaus, steep mountains, and seabeds, and construct data and algorithm-driven integrated intelligent operation and maintenance systems for power supply and electrical systems. Establish a railway emergency on-site command and coordinated emergency response platform for major emergencies.
titlelist: Key tasks, security guarantee, and improving the level of security emergency rescue support capabilities.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Implementing the requirements of the national carbon peak and carbon neutrality deployment, fully leveraging the advantages of green development in the railway sector, integrating green technology throughout the entire process of railway technology and equipment, engineering construction, and production operation, focusing on reducing the comprehensive energy consumption of railways, strengthening the research and application of key technologies in ecological protection and restoration, and reducing pollutant emissions, improving regulatory standards, and building a higher-level green and ecological railway.
titlelist: Key tasks, green and low-carbon

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Promote the integration of energy, information, and transportation networks, and conduct research on the architecture of energy internet, core equipment, and derivative technologies. Build an energy-efficient technology system for operation control of multi-mode control systems and multi-model trains, and develop energy supply and traffic system energy efficiency management technologies that match the layout of railway facilities. Carry out research on comprehensive energy-saving forward design technology, internal combustion locomotive emission technology, hybrid power technology, fuel substitution technology, and intelligent operation and maintenance technology. Breakthrough key technologies for flexible traction power supply for long-distance heavy-duty railways. Strengthen key technology research on off-grid power supply, develop multi-source power systems for trains, deepen research on innovative traction power supply technologies such as energy storage devices and fuel cells, and promote the development of hybrid power and low-carbon power sources. Research and promote the application of renewable energy, new energy, clean energy, and intelligent and friendly grid connection technologies in the railway industry, coordinate the development of generation, network, load, and storage, and reduce carbon dioxide and pollutant emissions.
titlelist: Key tasks, green and low-carbon, deepening energy efficiency improvement and research and development of energy supply technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Conduct research on various factors of the entire lifecycle of railways that impact the natural environment and methods of protection. Deepen the research and application of railway infrastructure network ecological planning, green corridor design, and ecological restoration techniques, promoting the coordination of infrastructure construction with ecosystems and adaptation to resource and environmental carrying capacity. Develop comprehensive resource-saving technologies, improve the efficiency of resource utilization, protect the ecological environment, and ensure engineering quality. Conduct research on improving land conservation technology and land-intensive and efficient utilization levels. Deepen research on prefabricated construction and energy-saving and emission-reducing technologies throughout the entire life cycle in areas such as bridges and buildings. Accelerate the renewal and utilization of old and new facilities, and research and promote the recycling technology of railway construction materials, waste materials, and recycled materials from construction waste.
titlelist: Key tasks, green and low-carbon, strengthen research and development of ecological environmental protection and restoration technologies.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Deepen the coordinated governance of railway pollution and carbon reduction, strengthen the supervision and management of energy consumption and emissions, improve the standards for carbon emission verification and accounting reports for railways, promote the research and application of green engineering construction, monitoring and evaluation technologies in railways. Focus on the development of lightweight, green, heavy-duty, and environmentally friendly technologies for mobile equipment, and create green and low-carbon mobile equipment to meet the needs of green travel for the public. Promote the application of new energy-saving materials, technologies, processes, and equipment, and accelerate the elimination of high-consumption and low-efficiency technological equipment. Research and apply new generation ultra-low emission exhaust gas purification, vibration reduction and noise reduction, and electromagnetic radiation protection technologies for high-speed railways. Deepen the research and application of green and low-carbon related technologies in transportation modes such as fully enclosed, container, and pack animal transportation, gradually increasing the proportion of multimodal transport in the total railway transportation volume. Column 7: Key projects in the field of green and low-carbon. Develop an implementation plan for the peak carbon emission action in railways, establish a sound system for measuring, statistics, and monitoring railway energy consumption, build a comprehensive energy-saving solution for the vehicle-line-network-map and the integrated source-load-storage-transportation-network-maintenance system, carry out research and demonstration applications of continuous-phase power supply engineering, develop a multi-source power supply system that coordinates the source-network-storage-vehicle for heavy-duty railways, develop networked traction power supply systems and high-power, long-life, and high-reliability fuel cell power systems, develop power electronic transformers and new locomotives and vehicles based on hybrid electric power, and develop on-board equipment and facilities for the on-the-go treatment of infectious pollutants in railways.
titlelist: Key tasks, green and low-carbon, improving the level of comprehensive pollution prevention and control technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Deeply integrate into the national science and technology innovation system, strengthen communication and connection between departments, industries, regions, and enterprises. Deepen the construction of a technology innovation system that is led by enterprises, guided by the market, and integrates production, education, research, and application. Play a guiding role of the government, promote the synergy of strategic goals, strengthen planning and policy guidance, promote complementary use of high-quality resources, enhance risk control, and promote the sharing of achievements. Coordinate various resources and forces in the railway industry, establish a railway technology innovation consortium, deepen the integration of innovation chains and industrial chains, and enhance the overall innovation efficiency of the industry. Implement the system of revealing the list and appointing the leader for major scientific and technological projects, guide more scientific and technological forces to participate in research and development, and promote breakthroughs in key core technologies. Improve the mechanism for the transfer, transformation, and evaluation of railway technology innovation achievements, and build a platform for the exchange and sharing of technology innovation achievements. Strengthen the tracking of new technology, new equipment research and development, testing, assessment, and other work, and improve relevant systems. Give full play to the enthusiasm and technical advantages of enterprises, research institutes, and associations in standard formulation, encourage the transformation of research results into standards, and gradually form a new pattern of railway standard system construction. Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights in railway technology, optimize the use of research funds, improve the management of research funds, and stimulate the driving force and vitality of railway technology innovation.
titlelist: Innovation system, perfecting institutional mechanisms.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Encourage enterprises to increase investment in innovation research and development, guide research institutes and universities to participate more deeply, and promote the construction of a batch of railway technology innovation platforms with national key laboratories, national technology innovation centers, and national engineering research centers as representatives, which have international advanced level. According to the principles of clear positioning, efficient operation, diversified investment, dynamic adjustment, open sharing, and collaborative development, coordinate and plan the construction of railway innovation bases, further optimize the layout of bases, expand the coverage areas and quantity of bases, give full play to the role of bases as the main force in industry innovation, and improve the industry's scientific and technological innovation base system. Promote the establishment of a national-level third-party platform for testing and certification of new railway products and technologies, and research and construct a national-level comprehensive test base for rail transportation.
titlelist: Innovation system, strengthen platform construction.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Create an environment that respects labor, knowledge, talent, and creativity, and foster a culture that values science. Support the accelerated development of Double First-Class initiatives, promote the development of higher education with enriched content, and strive to cultivate more outstanding talents with innovative spirit and practical abilities. Establish a talent development model that integrates industry and education and promotes cooperation between universities and enterprises, with a focus on cultivating a group of well-grounded and highly skilled applied talents. Leverage the role of innovation bases, strengthen the cultivation of strategic scientific and technological talents, technological leaders, industrial skilled talents, young and reserve scientific and technological talents in the railway industry, and build high-level innovation teams. Explore the establishment of railway industry scientist studios. Enhance the foundation of railway scientific and technological innovation talents, build talent hubs, and encourage innovation and creativity among grassroots professional and technical personnel in the railway industry.
titlelist: Innovative system, cultivating talent foundation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)

Promote the implementation of policies related to greater autonomy for research institutions and personnel, allocation of research funding, and incentives for researchers to stimulate innovation. Open up the railway technology research and development market, widely absorb advanced technology and experience from both domestic and international sources. Strengthen the management of research integrity and create an environment of honesty and trustworthiness in scientific research. Promote the spirit of science and advocate for a culture of innovation. Carry out railway technology education, dissemination, and popularization, promote the integration of railway technology into classrooms, communities, and households, and increase the attention and participation of the whole society in railway technology innovation.
titlelist: Innovation system, optimizing development environment.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Railway Technological Innovation (National Railway Science and Technology Law [2021] No. 45) (National Railway Administration/December 14, 2021)
content: Improve the mechanism for technological innovation and open cooperation in the railway sector, deepen intergovernmental exchanges in railway technology, strengthen international dialogue and communication on railway technology research and development, innovation policies, technical standards, intellectual property rights, etc., and promote the internationalization of Chinese railway technology standards. Construct intelligent detection and monitoring facilities for railways, enabling online monitoring, remote diagnosis, and intelligent maintenance of rolling stock such as EMUs, locomotives, and vehicles, as well as key facilities such as tracks, bridges, tunnels, and major passenger stations. Build intelligent power supply facilities to achieve intelligent fault diagnosis and self-recovery. Develop intelligent high-speed EMUs and conduct research and development on high-speed maglev trains with speeds of up to 600 kilometers per hour and high-speed wheel-rail passenger trains with speeds of up to 400 kilometers per hour. Enhance intelligent construction capabilities and improve the mechanization, informatization, intelligence, and greenization of railway engineering construction. Carry out research and development and application of construction robots, prefabricated construction, and intelligent construction.
titlelist: The main task is to build integrated and efficient smart transportation infrastructure, intelligent railways.

name: Guiding Opinions of the Ministry of Transport on Building a New Development Pattern for Services (excerpt) (Transportation Planning and Development [2021] No. 12) (Ministry of Transport/January 22, 2021)
content: Strengthen the application of fifth-generation mobile communication technology (5G), artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, and satellite technology in the field of transportation. Promote the digital construction and transformation of transportation infrastructure, actively develop smart railways, smart highways, smart waterways, smart ports, smart shipping, smart civil aviation, smart postal services, smart subways, and smart logistics, and improve standards, specifications, and supporting policies. Promote the research and development, as well as pilot demonstrations, of autonomous driving, smart shipping, and high-speed maglev technology. Advance the construction of smart delivery networks for unmanned aerial vehicle bases, underground logistics distribution systems, integrated transportation and information networks, comprehensive transportation big data centers, and key research platforms.
titlelist: Persist in innovation-driven development, enhance circular momentum, and promote the construction of new transportation infrastructure.

name: Notice on Strengthening the Supervision of Urban Rail Transit Vehicle Investment Projects (NDRC Office Industry [2018] No. 323) (National Development and Reform Commission Office/March 9, 2018)
content: The National Development and Reform Commission's Industry Coordination Department organizes the China Urban Rail Transit Association and related units to establish a capacity warning mechanism for urban rail vehicles. It conducts in-depth capacity verification and analysis assessments, timely releases capacity changes and warning information through the national online approval and supervision platform for investment projects, and formulates and improves policy measures to strengthen guidance for relevant regions and enterprises.
titlelist: Strengthen capacity monitoring and early warning, strengthen capacity release and early warning.

name: Notice on Strengthening the Supervision of Urban Rail Transit Vehicle Investment Projects (National Development and Reform Commission Office [2018] No. 323) (National Development and Reform Commission Office, March 9, 2018)
content: The provincial development and reform commission should take effective measures to strictly control the increase in production capacity of urban rail vehicles in the local area. In areas where the utilization rate of urban rail vehicle production capacity is below 80%, no new production capacity for urban rail vehicles shall be added. For enterprises applying for the construction and expansion of urban rail vehicle production capacity projects, the utilization rate of production capacity in the past two years should be higher than 80%.
titlelist: Improve investment project supervision and strictly control the increase in capacity of urban rail vehicles.

name: Notice on Strengthening the Supervision of Urban Rail Transit Vehicle Investment Projects (NDRC Office Industry [2018] No. 323) (National Development and Reform Commission Office/March 9, 2018)
content: The provincial development and reform commission should strengthen the management of investment projects for urban rail vehicles, traction, braking, and signal systems. The investment project for urban rail vehicles should include the development, testing, inspection, manufacturing of the car body, bogie, as well as the development of train network control systems. The investment project for traction systems should include the manufacturing, integration, as well as the development, testing, and inspection of key components such as traction converters, auxiliary converters, and motors. The investment project for braking systems should include the manufacturing, integration, as well as the development, testing, and inspection of subsystems such as brake control units and basic brakes. The investment project for signal systems should include the development, integration, and testing verification of subsystems such as Automatic Train Supervision (ATS), Automatic Train Protection (ATP), Automatic Train Operation (ATO), and Interlocking (CI).
titlelist: Improve investment project supervision and enhance technical requirements for investment projects.

name: Notice on Strengthening the Supervision of Urban Rail Transit Vehicle Investment Projects (National Development and Reform Commission Office [2018] No. 323) (National Development and Reform Commission Office, March 9, 2018)
content: Urban rail equipment manufacturing enterprises should strengthen their independent innovation capabilities, accelerate the mastery of core technologies, develop advanced and applicable urban rail vehicles, establish independent intellectual property rights, and improve the level of autonomy, intelligence, greenness, and service. It is necessary to strengthen cooperation in capital, technology, and other aspects, actively carry out mergers, reorganizations, and strategic collaborations, and continuously enhance market competitiveness.
titlelist: Accelerate industrial structure adjustment and enhance corporate competitiveness.

name: Notice on Strengthening the Supervision of Urban Rail Transit Vehicle Investment Projects (NDRC Office Industry [2018] No. 323) (National Development and Reform Commission Office/March 9, 2018)
content: The China Urban Rail Transit Association and urban rail equipment manufacturing enterprises should actively carry out the revision of standards for urban rail vehicles and other equipment, develop group standards and enterprise standards, and improve the standards and specifications for urban rail equipment. Accelerate the construction of a standardized urban rail equipment system in China, establish technical guidelines for equipment selection such as urban rail vehicles, promote equipment standardization, and provide support for preventing and resolving overcapacity.
titlelist: Promote the standardized development of industries and build China's standard urban rail equipment system.

name: Opinions of the Ministry of Transport on the Pilot Work of Building a First-class Rail Transit Industry and Other Transportation Powerhouse Construction in Qingdao City (Transportation Planning Letter [2021] No. 472) (Comprehensive Planning Department of the Ministry of Transport/October 26, 2021)
content: We will work together with relevant departments, units, and organizations to provide guidance on the pilot work, and strengthen support in related planning, policy formulation, and implementation. We will conduct timely follow-up research, monitoring and evaluation, and exchange experiences. After the completion of the pilot tasks, we will organize assessments, recognition of achievements, and promote publicity.
