name: Opinions of the Ministry of Transport on the Pilot Work of China Railway Rolling Stock Corporation Limited in the Development and Application of Green Intelligent Transportation Equipment and the Construction of a Strong Transportation Country (Transportation Planning Letter [2021] No. 370) (Comprehensive Planning Department of the Ministry of Transport, August 26, 2021)
content: Submit an annual summary of pilot work to our department by the end of December each year. Our department will work together with relevant departments, units, and organizations to provide guidance on pilot work and strengthen support in planning, formulation, and implementation. Conduct timely follow-up research, monitoring and evaluation, and experience sharing. After the completion of the pilot tasks, organize assessments, recognition of achievements, and promotion and publicity work.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Opinions on the Implementation of Urban Rail Transit Equipment Certification (National Certification Alliance [2017] No. 142) (State Administration for Certification and Accreditation Supervision, National Development and Reform Commission/December 6, 2017)
content: The certification agency should carry out certification of urban rail equipment based on officially released national standards, industry standards, group standards, and certification technical specifications, as specified in the certification rules.
titlelist: Unified authentication directory and rules, the certification rules for urban rail equipment in the authentication directory are issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation.

name: Opinions on the Implementation of Urban Rail Transit Equipment Certification (National Certification Alliance [2017] No. 142) (State Administration for Certification and Accreditation Supervision, National Development and Reform Commission/December 6, 2017)
content: The certification mark is composed of the basic certification mark identification information (eight). Certification institutions engaged in urban rail equipment certification within the certification directory can issue certification certificates as required, and timely submit certification information to relevant departments. The Urban Rail Association is responsible for the collection, statistics, and analysis of relevant information.
titlelist: Unified authentication logo, the certification of urban rail equipment in the certification directory should use a unified authentication logo.

name: Opinions on the Implementation of Urban Rail Transit Equipment Certification (National Certification Alliance [2017] No. 142) (State Administration for Certification and Accreditation Supervision, National Development and Reform Commission/December 6, 2017)
content: The testing institution is responsible for the testing process, results, and testing reports. The certified enterprises for urban rail equipment certification bear the main responsibility for product quality. The certification institution and testing institution are legally responsible for the certified product quality.
titlelist: Clearly define the certification mode and responsibility, certification bodies are responsible for the certification conclusion.

name: Notice on the Implementation of Urban Rail Transit Equipment Certification by the National Development and Reform Commission and the State Administration for Market Regulation (NDRC Industry [2016] No. 2029) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation/September 23, 2016)
content: Strengthen communication and exchange with relevant parties in the urban rail equipment industry, establish a platform for exchanging and sharing certification information of urban rail equipment products, and jointly promote the recognition of certification results. Enhance tracking and evaluation of certified product production and usage, and provide timely feedback to relevant departments on issues and suggestions for countermeasures in the certification work.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: The construction of railways in the central and western regions is accelerating, and the basic formation of inter-regional fast channels is taking shape. High-speed railways are gradually forming a network, and intercity railways are starting to develop. The scale of the railway network is continuously expanding, and its capacity for guaranteeing transportation is significantly enhanced. By the end of 2015, the total operating mileage of railways nationwide reached 121,000 kilometers, including 19,000 kilometers of high-speed railways.
titlelist: Planning foundation, current development status, preliminary formation of basic network.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Optimization and improvement of the road network in the eastern region, expansion of road network coverage in the central and western regions, realization of high-speed railway connectivity in the four major regions, enhancement of key material and express freight service capabilities, organic connection and supporting facilities of comprehensive hubs, significant improvement in technological equipment level, establishment of an information service platform, and continuous improvement in overall service level.
titlelist: Planning foundation, current development status, significant improvement in service level.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Relying on the development of high-speed, high-altitude, high-cold, and heavy-load railways, significant achievements have been made in engineering construction, equipment manufacturing, and system integration. The independent development capability and core competitiveness have been continuously enhanced. The overall technical level of China's railways has entered the world's leading ranks, and high-speed railways have become a bright business card for China's international presence.
titlelist: Planning foundation, development status, significant enhancement of innovative capabilities.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: To meet the rapidly growing passenger transportation demand and optimize the expansion of regional development space, in addition to the existing four vertical and four horizontal high-speed railways, it is necessary to increase the construction of high-speed railways that can support passenger flow, meet appropriate standards, and meet development needs. Some sections will utilize railways with a speed of 200 kilometers per hour, forming a high-speed railway network with the eight vertical and eight horizontal main channels as the backbone, regional connecting lines, and intercity railways as supplements. This network will achieve efficient and convenient connections between provincial capital cities and inter-regional areas. The construction standards for high-speed railways will be determined based on local conditions and scientific considerations. The main channels of the high-speed railway will adopt a standard of 250 kilometers per hour or above (which can be appropriately reduced in areas with complex terrain, geology, and climate conditions). Among them, railways passing through densely populated towns, economically developed areas, and major cities can adopt a standard of 350 kilometers per hour. The connecting lines of regional railways will generally adopt a standard of 250 kilometers per hour or below. Intercity railways will generally adopt a standard of 200 kilometers per hour or below.
titlelist: Planning scheme, high-speed railway network

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: (1) Eight Vertical Channels. Coastal Channel. Dalian (Dandong) ~ Qinhuangdao ~ Tianjin ~ Dongying ~ Weifang ~ Qingdao (Yantai) ~ Lianyungang ~ Yancheng ~ Nantong ~ Shanghai ~ Ningbo ~ Fuzhou ~ Xiamen ~ Shenzhen ~ Zhanjiang ~ Beihai (Fangchenggang) high-speed railway (including the Qingdao to Yancheng section using the Qinglian and Lianyan railways, and the Nantong to Shanghai section using the Hutoong railway), connecting the eastern coastal areas, linking the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Liaoning-Zhongnan, Shandong Peninsula, East Longhai, Yangtze River Delta, West Coast of the Taiwan Strait, Pearl River Delta, and Beibu Gulf city clusters. Beijing-Shanghai Channel. Beijing ~ Tianjin ~ Jinan ~ Nanjing ~ Shanghai (Hangzhou) high-speed railway, including Nanjing ~ Hangzhou, Bengbu ~ Hefei ~ Hangzhou high-speed railway, and also through Beijing ~ Tianjin ~ Dongying ~ Weifang ~ Linyi ~ Huai'an ~ Yangzhou ~ Nantong ~ Shanghai high-speed railway, connecting North China, East China, and linking the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta city clusters. Beijing-Hong Kong (Taiwan) Channel. Beijing ~ Hengshui ~ Heze ~ Shangqiu ~ Fuyang ~ Hefei (Huanggang) ~ Jiujiang ~ Nanchang ~ Ganzhou ~ Shenzhen ~ Hong Kong (Kowloon) high-speed railway; another branch is the Hefei ~ Fuzhou ~ Taipei high-speed railway, including Nanchang ~ Fuzhou (Putian) railway. Connecting North China, Central China, East China, South China, and linking the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Middle Reaches, West Coast of the Taiwan Strait, Pearl River Delta city clusters. Beijing-Harbin ~ Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau Channel. Harbin ~ Changchun ~ Shenyang ~ Beijing ~ Shijiazhuang ~ Zhengzhou ~ Wuhan ~ Changsha ~ Guangzhou ~ Shenzhen ~ Hong Kong high-speed railway, including Guangzhou ~ Zhuhai ~ Macau high-speed railway. Connecting Northeast China, North China, Central China, South China, and the Hong Kong-Macau region, linking Harbin-Changchun, Liaoning-Zhongnan, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Central Plains, Yangtze River Middle Reaches, Pearl River Delta city clusters. Hu-Nan Channel. Hohhot ~ Datong ~ Taiyuan ~ Zhengzhou ~ Xiangyang ~ Changde ~ Yiyang ~ Shaoyang ~ Yongzhou ~ Guilin ~ Nanning high-speed railway. Connecting North China, Central Plains, Central China, South China, and linking Hu-Bao-Yu, central Shanxi, Central Plains, Yangtze River Middle Reaches, Beibu Gulf city clusters. Beijing-Kunming Channel. Beijing ~ Shijiazhuang ~ Taiyuan ~ Xi'an ~ Chengdu (Chongqing) ~ Kunming high-speed railway, including Beijing ~ Zhangjiakou ~ Datong ~ Taiyuan high-speed railway. Connecting North China, Northwest China, Southwest China, and linking Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Taiyuan, Guanzhong Plain, Chengdu-Chongqing, Central Yunnan city clusters. Bao (Yin) Hai Channel. Baotou ~ Yan'an ~ Xi'an ~ Chongqing ~ Guiyang ~ Nanning ~ Zhanjiang ~ Haikou (Sanya) high-speed railway, including Yinchuan ~ Xi'an and Hainan Island Ring high-speed railway. Connecting Northwest China, Southwest China, South China, and linking Hu-Bao-Yu, Ningxia along the Yellow River, Guanzhong Plain, Chengdu-Chongqing, Guizhong, Beibu Gulf city clusters. Lan (West) Guang Channel. Lanzhou (Xining) ~ Chengdu (Chongqing) ~ Guiyang ~ Guangzhou high-speed railway. Connecting Northwest China, Southwest China, South China, and linking Lan-Xi, Chengdu-Chongqing, Guizhong, Pearl River Delta city clusters. (2) Eight Horizontal Channels. Suiman Channel. Suifenhe ~ Mudanjiang ~ Harbin ~ Qiqihar ~ Hailar ~ Manzhouli high-speed railway. Connecting Heilongjiang and Eastern Inner Mongolia regions. Beijing-Lanzhou Channel. Beijing ~ Hohhot ~ Yinchuan ~ Lanzhou high-speed railway. Connecting North China, Northwest China, and linking Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Hu-Bao-Yu, Ningxia along the Yellow River, Lan-Xi city clusters. Qingyin Channel. Qingdao ~ Jinan ~ Shijiazhuang ~ Taiyuan ~ Yinchuan high-speed railway (including the Suide to Yinchuan section using the Taizhongyin railway). Connecting East China, North China, Northwest China, and linking Shandong Peninsula, Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Taiyuan, Ningxia along the Yellow River city clusters. Land Bridge Channel. Lianyungang ~ Xuzhou ~ Zhengzhou ~ Xi'an ~ Lanzhou ~ Xining ~ Urumqi high-speed railway. Connecting East China, Central China, Northwest China, and linking East Longhai, Central Plains, Guanzhong Plain, Lan-Xi, North Slope of the Tianshan Mountains city clusters. Along the Yangtze River Channel. Shanghai ~ Nanjing ~ Hefei ~ Wuhan ~ Chongqing ~ Chengdu high-speed railway, including Nanjing ~ Anqing ~ Jiujiang ~ Wuhan ~ Yichang ~ Chongqing, Wanzhou ~ Dazhou ~ Suining ~ Chengdu high-speed railway (including the Chengdu to Suining section using the Dacheng railway), connecting East China, Central China, Southwest China, and linking Yangtze River Delta, Yangtze River Middle Reaches, Chengdu-Chongqing city clusters. Shanghai-Kunming Channel. Shanghai ~ Hangzhou ~ Nanchang ~ Changsha ~ Guiyang ~ Kunming high-speed railway. Connecting East China, Central China, Southwest China, and linking Yangtze River Delta, Yangtze River Middle Reaches, Guizhong, Central Yunnan city clusters. Xia-Chongqing Channel. Xiamen ~ Longyan ~ Ganzhou ~ Changsha ~ Changde ~ Zhangjiajie ~ Qianjiang ~ Chongqing high-speed railway (including the Xiamen to Ganzhou section using the Longxiang railway, Ganzhou to Chongqing section using the Qianzhangchang railway). Connecting West Coast of the Taiwan Strait, Central-South, Southwest China, and linking West Coast of the Taiwan Strait, Yangtze River Middle Reaches, Chengdu-Chongqing city clusters. Guang-Kun Channel. Guangzhou ~ Nanning ~ Kunming high-speed railway. Connecting South China, Southwest China, and linking Pearl River Delta, Beibu Gulf, Central Yunnan city clusters.
titlelist: Planning scheme, high-speed railway network, constructing the main channels of the 'Eight Verticals and Eight Horizontals' high-speed railway.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: On the basis of the Eight Verticals and Eight Horizontals main channels, plans are being made to construct regional high-speed railway connecting lines to further improve the road network and expand coverage. In the eastern region, there are railways such as Beijing to Tangshan, Tianjin to Chengde, Rizhao to Linyi to Heze to Lankao, Shanghai to Huzhou, Nantong to Suzhou to Jiaxing, Hangzhou to Wenzhou, Hefei to Xinyi, Longyan to Meizhou to Longchuan, Meizhou to Shantou, Guangzhou to Shanwei, and others. In the northeastern region, there are railways such as Qiqihar to Ulanhot to Baicheng to Tongliao, Jiamusi to Mudanjiang to Dunhua to Tonghua to Shenyang, the Chifeng and Tongliao to Beijing-Shenyang high-speed railway connecting line, Chaoyang to Panjin, and others. In the central region, there are railways such as Zhengzhou to Fuyang, Zhengzhou to Puyang to Liaocheng to Jinan, Huanggang to Anqing to Huangshan, Badong to Yichang, Xuancheng to Jixi, Nanchang to Jingdezhen to Huangshan, Shimen to Zhangjiajie to Jishou to Huaihua, and others. In the western region, there are railways such as Yuping to Tongren to Jishou, Mianyang to Suining to Neijiang to Zigong, Zhaotong to Liupanshui, Lanzhou to Zhangye, and Guigang to Yulin, and others.
titlelist: Planning scheme, high-speed railway network, expansion of regional railway connections.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: While prioritizing the use of high-speed and conventional railways to operate intercity trains for intercity functions, we plan to construct intercity passenger railway networks that support and lead the development of new urbanization, effectively connect major and medium-sized cities with central towns, and serve commuting functions. Intercity railway networks will be built in urban clusters such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Central Yangtze River Region, Chengdu-Chongqing, Central Plains, and Shandong Peninsula. Intercity railway skeleton networks will be constructed in urban clusters such as the west coast of the Taiwan Strait, Harbin-Changchun, Liaoning-Middle and South, Guanzhong, and Beibu Gulf. Intercity railway backbone corridors will be built in urban clusters such as central Yunnan, central Guizhou, northern slopes of the Tianshan Mountains, Ningxia along the Yellow River, and Hubei-Baotou-Erdos-Yulin.
titlelist: Planning scheme, high-speed railway network, developing intercity passenger railway.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Expand the coverage of the road network in the central and western regions, improve the layout of the network in the eastern region, enhance the quality of the existing road network, promote interconnectivity with surrounding areas, and form a comprehensive, internally and externally connected, and border-to-sea high-speed railway network. Improve the support and guarantee capabilities for poverty alleviation, regional development, opening up to the outside world, national security, and other aspects. By 2025, the scale of the high-speed railway network will reach approximately 131,000 kilometers, and plans will be implemented to upgrade and expand approximately 20,000 kilometers of existing lines.
titlelist: Planning scheme, conventional-speed railway network

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Inter-regional fast and high-capacity channels. Promote the construction of bottleneck sections, critical segments, and key links of the conventional-speed trunk lines. Form inter-regional channels with multiple paths and high capacity for convenience. Combine the construction of new lines with the expansion of existing railways to strengthen the transportation networks for containers, express delivery, and heavy loads. Establish an efficient freight logistics network, improve the overall service efficiency of the road network, and expand effective supply. (1) Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei to Northeast China channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Harbin, Tianjin-Shanhaiguan, Shenyang-Shanhaiguan, Harbin-Dalian, and Jitong. Implement railway expansion projects such as Beijing-Tongzhou and Pingqi. Construct entry and exit channels such as Beijing-Shenyang-Harbin-Suifenhe (Tongjiang) and Beijing-Tongliao-Qiqihar-Manzhouli, connecting Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, central and southern Liaoning, and Harbin-Changchun urban agglomerations.(2) Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei to Yangtze River Delta and West Coast of the Taiwan Strait channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Shanghai, Beijing-Kowloon, Huadong Second Passage, Wangan, Jinwen, and Ganlong. Construct railways such as Fuyang-Luan-Jingdezhen, Quzhou-Ningde, and Xingguo-Yong'an-Quanzhou. Implement railway transformations such as Wangan and Luozhan South section expansion. Build channels such as Beijing-Tianjin-Jinan-Shanghai (Hangzhou, Ningbo) and Beijing-Tianjin-Shangqiu-Nanchang-Fuzhou (Xiamen), connecting Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, central Yangtze River region, and West Coast of the Taiwan Strait urban agglomerations.(3) Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei to Pearl River Delta and Beibu Gulf channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Guangzhou, Beijing-Kowloon, Xianggui, Jiaoliu, and Dazhan. Construct railways such as Longchuan-Shanwei. Implement expansion and transformation projects such as Jiaoliu and Luozhan South section. Build channels such as Beijing-Wuhan-Guangzhou (Nanning) and Beijing-Nanchang-Shenzhen, connecting Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, central China, central Yangtze River region, Pearl River Delta, and Beibu Gulf urban agglomerations.(4) Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei to Northwest China (Tibet) channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Baotou-Lanzhou, Linhe-Haolebaoa, Nanyuanjiang, Beijing-Guangzhou, Shitai, Taiyuan-Zhongwei, Lanzhou-Qinghai, and Qinghai-Tibet. Implement expansion projects such as Qinghai-Tibet Railway Geladandong section and Nanyuanjiang Railway. Construct Liugou-Santanghu-Jiangjunmiao Railway. Build channels such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hohhot-Urumqi-Kashgar and Beijing-Tianjin-Shijiazhuang-Taiyuan-Lanzhou-Xining-Lhasa, connecting Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Lanzhou-Xi urban agglomeration, and Tibet region.(5) Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei to Southwest China channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Guangzhou, Shanghai-Kunming, Nanbei Tongpu, Xikang, Xiangyu, Chengkun, and Neikun. Construct channels such as Beijing-Xi'an (Changsha)-Sichuan, Chongqing, Guizhou, and Yunnan. Connect Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei with the central Yunnan urban agglomeration.(6) Yangtze River Delta to Northwest China channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Shanghai, Luqiao, and Ningxi. Implement expansion projects such as Xiping Railway and Baozhong Railway Pingliang-Zhongwei section. Construct railways such as Sanmenxia-Yuzhou-Jiangsu coastal ports. Build channels such as Yangtze River Delta-Xi'an-Urumqi-Alashankou (Khorgos), connecting Yangtze River Delta, central China, Guanzhong Plain, and Lanzhou-Xi urban agglomeration.(7) Yangtze River Delta to Chengdu-Chongqing channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Shanghai, Ningxi, Ningqi, Tongjiu, Wujiu, Wuxiangyu, and Chengdu-Chongqing. Implement expansion and transformation projects such as Nanjing-Wuhu-Tongling-Jiujiang Railway. Construct Jiujiang-Yueyang-Changde, Qianjiang-Zunyi-Zhaotong-Panzhihua-Dali Railway. Plan and study freight railway along the Yangtze River. Build channels such as Shanghai-Nanjing (Hefei)-Wuhan-Chongqing-Chengdu along the Yangtze River, connecting Yangtze River Delta, central Yangtze River region, and Chengdu-Chongqing urban agglomeration.(8) Yangtze River Delta to Yunnan-Guizhou channel. Utilize railways such as Shanghai-Kunming, Jinwen. Construct railways such as Ningbo (Taizhou)-Jinhua, Wenzhou-Wuyishan-Ji'an, Ganzhou-Chenzhou-Yongzhou-Xingyi. Implement expansion projects such as Hengcha-Ji Railway. Build channels connecting Yangtze River Delta, central Yangtze River region, and Yunnan-Guizhou region.(9) Yangtze River Delta to Pearl River Delta channel. Utilize railways such as Shanghai-Kunming, Beijing-Kowloon, Beijing-Guangzhou. Implement expansion projects such as Gan-Shao Railway. Connect Yangtze River Delta with Pearl River Delta urban agglomeration.(10) Pearl River Delta to Southwest China channel. Utilize railways such as Beijing-Guangzhou, Shanghai-Kunming, Yuqian, Guangmao, and Lizhan. Construct railways such as Liuzhou-Wuzhou-Guangzhou, Shaoguan-Hezhou-Liuzhou-Baise. Implement expansion projects such as Yu-Huai, Qian-Gui, and Nankun railways. Build channels connecting Pearl River Delta with Southwest China region.(11) Shandong Peninsula to Northwest China channel. Utilize railways such as Jiaozhou-Jinan, Shide, Shitai, Taiyuan-Zhongwei, and Lanxin. Construct railways such as Pingliang-Guyuan-Dingxi via Gulang. Build westward connection channels for Shandong Peninsula.(12) Northwest China to Southwest China channel. Utilize railways such as Lanxin, Longhai, Baocheng, Baoxi, Lanyu, Xikang, Xiangyu, Yuqian, Chengkun, and Neikun. Construct railways such as Korla-Golmud, Golmud-Chengdu. Build channels connecting Northwest China (including Hohhot-Baotou-Erdos-Yulin) with Southwest China region. At the same time, utilize railways such as Daqin, Shenshuo, Shuohuang, Zhangtang, Xinhe-Yanzhou-Rizhao, southern Shanxi, and Ningxi. Construct railways such as from western Inner Mongolia to central China, Qingyang-Huangling, Qingyang-Pingliang, Shenmu-Watang. Build major channels for coal transportation, including westward coal transportation, northward coal transportation, and intermodal transportation between sea (river) and rail. Improve the coal transportation system and enhance the capacity of coal transportation channels.
titlelist: Planning scheme, conventional-speed railway network, formation.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Promote the interconnection between China and its neighboring countries, improve port facilities, and strengthen the rear channels of coastal ports. In the northwest direction, plan and construct railways such as Karamay to Tacheng (Bakhtu), Kashgar to Yarkant, Kashgar to Hongqilafu, Altay to Kanas (Ji Ke Pu Lin), Altay to Jimunai, as well as border railways like Mandula, Ulij, and Laoyemiao. In the southwest direction, implement capacity expansion of the Nanning to Pingxiang railway, and plan and construct railways such as Mangshi to Houqiao, Lincang to Qingshuihe, Shigatse to Jilong, Shigatse to Yadong, Jingxi to Longbang, and Fangchenggang to Dongxing. In the northeast direction, implement capacity expansion of the Jining to Erenhot railway, and plan and construct railways such as Yiershi to Arihashat, Hailar to Heishantou, Moerdaoga to Shiwei, Gulin to Luoguhe, Hulin to Jixiang, Mishan to Dangbi Town, Nanping to Maoshan, Kaishantun to Sanfeng, Changbai Mountain to Huishan, and Pangu to Lianyin. In the coastal direction, use cities and important ports such as Dalian, Qinhuangdao, Tianjin, Yantai, Qingdao, Lianyungang, Shanghai, Ningbo-Zhoushan, Fuzhou, Quanzhou, Xiamen, Shantou, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Maoming, Zhanjiang, and Haikou as hubs, establish smooth railway channels and integrated transportation systems for port cities, and construct international transportation corridors connecting the inland areas with sea and rail transport.
titlelist: Planning scheme, conventional-speed railway network, oriented towards the international corridors of the 'Belt and Road'.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Expand the coverage of the road network. Construct Ankang~Enshi~Zhangjiajie, Ganzhou~Chenzhou~Yongzhou~Xingyi, Fuyang~Lu'an~Jingdezhen, Wenzhou~Wuyishan~Ji'an, Xingguo~Yongan~Quanzhou, Qianjiang~Zunyi~Zhaotong~Panzhihua~Dali, Ningde~Nanping, Ruijin~Meizhou, Jianning~Guanzhishan, Shaoguan~Hezhou~Liuzhou~Baise, Huangling~Qingyang~Pingliang~Guyuan~Dingxi, Ejina~Jiuquan, Hanzhong~Bazhong~Nanchong, Guiyang~Xingyi, Huangtong~Baise, Fuling~Liuzhou, Luzhou~Zunyi, Shizong~Wenshan, Lincang~Puer, and other railways. Improve access to Tibet and Xinjiang. Construct the Chengdu-Lhasa Railway Ya'an~Changdu~Linzhi section, the Dali-Lhasa Railway Shangri-La~Bangda section, the Lop Nur~Ruoqiang~Hotan, Chengdu~Golmud, Liugou~Santanghu~Jiangjunmiao, Xining~Yushu~Changdu Railway, and study the construction of the new Tibet Railway Hetian~Shigatse section, forming convenient channels for access to Tibet, Xinjiang, Qinghai, and the Tibetan areas of the four provinces. Promote development and opening up along the border. Construct the Hanjiayuan~Heihe, Sunwu~Xunke~Wuyiling, Hegang~Fujin, Chuangye~Raohe~Dongfanghong, Dongning~Hunchun, and other railways along the northeast border, and the Mangshi~Lincang~Wenshan~Jingxi~Fangchenggang and other railways along the southwest border.
titlelist: Planning scheme, conventional-speed railway network, promoting poverty alleviation and land development railways.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: With a focus on resource-rich areas, major ports, and logistics parks, the plan is to construct development-oriented railways and branch lines such as port-oriented and park-oriented railways. This will create a modern railway transportation system that effectively connects main and branch lines, promoting multimodal transportation and ensuring smooth transportation for the first and last mile of railway transport. After the implementation of the above railway network plan, the long-term railway network will reach a scale of about 200,000 kilometers, including approximately 45,000 kilometers of high-speed railways.
titlelist: Planning scheme, conventional-speed railway network, strengthening railway transportation system.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Optimize the overall transportation network layout, following the principle of passenger inside, freight outside, improve the layout of railway hubs, enhance supporting facilities, and compile a master plan for railway hubs. Innovate institutional mechanisms, coordinate construction and operation, promote synchronized construction and collaborative management, and form a modern comprehensive hub with integrated supporting facilities, convenience, and urban integration. Study and formulate standards and specifications for comprehensive hub construction, operation, and services. Construct comprehensive railway hubs in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Wuhan, Chengdu, Shenyang, Xi'an, Zhengzhou, Tianjin, Nanjing, Shenzhen, Hefei, Guiyang, Chongqing, Hangzhou, Fuzhou, Nanning, Kunming, Urumqi, and other cities.
titlelist: Planning scheme, integrated transportation hub.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: According to the requirements of zero-distance transfer, the planning and construction of the same station should be centered around railway passenger stations and organically connected with other modes of transportation, forming a comprehensive transportation system. In major cities, the convenient connection between railway passenger hubs, airports, and urban rail transit should be strengthened. The station area should be developed in a three-dimensional manner, creating an efficient and convenient comprehensive passenger hub and a station economic zone that integrates urban and industrial development. At the same time, the facilities of the passenger hub and station should be strengthened, including improving the maintenance facilities for high-speed trains, passenger locomotives, and vehicles, as well as the facilities for express parcel distribution and other fast cargo services at the passenger hub (high-speed railway station).
titlelist: Planning scheme, integrated transportation hub, passenger transportation hub.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Reasonably layout railway logistics centers, railway container hubs, and end-to-end distribution service facilities to expand the network of goods distribution services. According to the requirements of seamless connection, improve the one-stop service facilities for multimodal transport, container transportation, postal express transportation, international transportation, and integrated transportation, in order to enhance the hub's distribution capacity and service efficiency. Optimize the layout of freight hub marshalling yards and improve freight locomotive and vehicle facilities. Layout and construct comprehensive maintenance bases, emergency rescue bases, and supporting railway contingency facilities. Guided by the development of hub-type industrial parks, promote the transformation and development of traditional freight stations into urban logistics distribution centers and modern logistics parks.
titlelist: Planning scheme, integrated transportation hub, freight hub

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: With high-speed railway corridors as the foundation, we aim to guide and support the rational layout of cities, industries, and populations along the line. This will promote close regional communication, cooperation, and optimal allocation of resources, accelerate the transfer of industries and upgrade economic transformation, and foster the development of a new form of high-speed railway economy that deeply integrates with the economy. By utilizing comprehensive development of high-speed railway station areas as a carrier, we will develop the station area economy, guide and promote the concentration and scale development of related industries such as modern logistics, trade and finance, e-commerce, tourism, and catering. Efforts will be made to create brand effects and economies of scale. The revenue from comprehensive development will compensate for railway construction and operation.
titlelist: Protective measures, cultivating and strengthening the high-speed rail economy.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: To leverage the comparative advantages and backbone role of railways, we will establish an integrated transportation system that is organically connected with other modes of transportation such as highways, civil aviation, and water transportation. We will consider factors such as fare adjustments, operational system adjustments, financial support, and mobilizing the enthusiasm of local governments to promote coordinated development and enhance comprehensive social benefits. We will strengthen the connection between railway planning and overall urban planning, land use planning, etc., optimize the layout of transportation networks, coordinate the shared transportation corridors, cross-sea and cross-river passages, and other resources with railways and other modes of transportation. We will strengthen the construction of comprehensive passenger transport hubs, enhance the effective connection between railways and urban public transportation, regional (suburban) railways, road passenger transport, airports, etc., and improve the efficiency of hub transfer and distribution. We will promote multimodal transportation involving railways, roads, and waterways, vigorously develop railway container transportation, implement projects such as introducing railways to important ports, road freight stations, and logistics parks, and bridge the first and last mile of transportation to ensure smooth network circulation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, building a comprehensive transportation system.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: Research effective measures to resolve railway debt and gradually improve the debt structure of railway enterprises. Increase efforts to activate existing assets, strengthen land asset evaluation, and implement national policies supporting comprehensive land development for railways. Support railway enterprises in integrating the planning of stations and track land, enhance the comprehensive development of above-ground and underground spaces, and increase the income from incremental assets. Study and issue guidelines to promote the development of the railway transportation industry, adapt to changes in market demand, develop high-speed rail and fast transportation of bulk goods, utilize price mechanisms, vigorously expand the transportation market, comprehensively improve service levels, expand effective supply of products and services, enhance the market competitiveness of railway enterprises, and accelerate the transformation and development into modern logistics enterprises. Tap into potential, reform the management system, leverage market forces, implement diversified business strategies, extend the industrial and service chains, and continuously improve the efficiency and benefits of railway operations. Deepen the reform of railway enterprises, accelerate the establishment of a modern corporate system, promote market-oriented operations, strengthen internal management, and promote cost reduction and efficiency improvement to enhance internal driving force and development vitality, and leverage the key role of the railway corporation in railway construction. Firmly establish a concept of safe development, strengthen safety management, and ensure the continuous safety and stability of railways.
titlelist: Safeguard measures, enhance sustainable development capabilities.

name: Medium and Long-Term Railway Network Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Foundation [2016] No. 1536) (National Development and Reform Commission/July 13, 2016)
content: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:First, adhere to the principle of priority protection, avoidance as the main in the layout of the road network, and strengthen the protection of environmentally sensitive areas along the line. Reasonably design the project route and station location, make use of existing transportation corridors as much as possible, avoid basic farmland protection areas, bypass environmentally sensitive areas such as water sources, nature reserves, scenic spots, as well as key prevention and control areas for soil erosion. Second, carry out proactive planning, with the participation of land and environmental protection departments, to provide strong support for pre-project survey and design, reserved construction land, and other preliminary work. Accelerate the research and formulation of methods to increase arable land for compensation and major project supplementary arable land under national coordination, strictly control the increase in land use, prioritize the use of existing land, strengthen energy-saving and land-saving design of railway construction projects and stations, and efficiently implement comprehensive land development and utilization. Develop advanced and applicable energy-saving and emission reduction technologies, strengthen the research and application of new intelligent, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly technologies and equipment, optimize transportation organization, and improve transportation efficiency. Third, carry out environmental restoration and pollution control, do a good job in terrain, landform, ecological environment restoration, and land reclamation; take comprehensive measures to effectively prevent and control noise and vibration along the railway line; do a good job in water and soil conservation and other ecological protection, strengthen ecological restoration projects, pay attention to landscape restoration and the construction of green railway corridors; vigorously promote the use of environmentally friendly new technologies, promote the recycling and comprehensive utilization of exhaust gas, wastewater, and solid waste. Fourth, strictly abide by environmental protection laws and regulations, and effectively implement the environmental impact assessment system in the planning and construction process of the medium and long-term railway network.
titlelist: Environmental impact assessment and requirements, measures to prevent and mitigate adverse environmental impacts.

name: Guiding Opinions of the Ministry of Transport on Being a Leading Official in Economic and Social Development with the Strategic Layout of the 'Four Comprehensives' (excerpt) (Comprehensive Planning Department of the Ministry of Transport, July 7, 2015)
content: Transportation equipment is the fundamental carrier for providing transportation services and is an important sector driving the development of China's manufacturing industry. Efforts should be made to vigorously promote the rapid development of advanced rail transportation equipment, marine engineering equipment, high-tech ships, energy-saving and new energy vehicles, and other advantageous and strategic industries. Encourage and support transportation companies in promoting the application of safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation equipment and transfer equipment. Actively promote the standardization and specialization of transportation equipment, promote the upgrading and renewal of transportation equipment, and play an active role in promoting the transformation of China's manufacturing industry towards the middle and high-end.
titlelist: Effectively fulfill the important responsibilities of being a pioneer, effectively play a prominent role in promoting economic growth, and accelerate the update and upgrade of transportation equipment.

name: Guiding Opinions of the Ministry of Transport on Being a Leading Official in Economic and Social Development with the Strategic Layout of the 'Four Comprehensives' (excerpt) (Comprehensive Planning Department of the Ministry of Transport, July 7, 2015)
content: Coordinate the overall situation of both the international and domestic markets, as well as the two types of resources. Utilize China's management and technological advantages in transportation infrastructure construction, operation, and equipment manufacturing to actively promote international cooperation in high-speed rail, highways, deep-water ports, large bridges and tunnels, and rail transportation. Concentrate support and cultivate a group of backbone transportation companies with strong international competitiveness and market development capabilities. Develop business cooperation models such as engineering contracting + financing and engineering contracting + financing + operation. Actively promote the internationalization of China's transportation standards, enhance participation in international cooperation, and strengthen the discourse power of international resource integration.
titlelist: Effectively fulfill the important responsibilities of being a pioneer, effectively play an important role in all-round opening up to the outside world, and promote international cooperation in capacity and equipment manufacturing.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, the main theme of implementing scientific development and accelerating the transformation of the economic development mode, the strategy of expanding domestic demand was implemented, and industrialization and urbanization were deepened. Efforts were made to ensure and improve people's livelihoods. The economy will maintain stable and rapid growth, and urban and rural residents' incomes will increase rapidly. Economic factors will flow more frequently, and the demand for travel by the people will be more vigorous. The demand for passenger and freight transportation will continue to grow. At the same time, the upgrading of consumption structure and transportation demand structure will put forward new and higher requirements for transportation safety, convenience, comfort, timeliness, and equality. It is predicted that the total passenger and freight volume of the whole society will reach 47 billion people and 45 billion tons respectively in 2015, and the passenger and freight turnover will reach 3.95 trillion passenger kilometers and 19.45 trillion ton kilometers respectively. As an important national infrastructure, railways are suitable for China's national conditions and the large-scale flow of personnel and materials in urban and rural areas. During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, it is necessary to further improve the railway transportation network, focus on the construction of high-speed railways, intercity trunk lines, coal transportation channels, etc., continuously improve service capacity and quality, give full play to the role of railway backbone, and provide reliable transportation guarantee for maintaining stable and rapid economic development. It is estimated that the railway passenger volume will reach 4 billion people and the passenger turnover will reach about 1.6 trillion passenger kilometers in 2015, while the cargo volume will reach 550 million tons and the cargo turnover will reach about 4.29 trillion ton kilometers.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Since the reform and opening up, urbanization in China has developed rapidly. By 2010, the urbanization rate had reached 47.5%, with a urban population of 670 million. It is estimated that by 2015, the urbanization rate in China will reach 51.5%. At the same time, relying on large cities and focusing on medium and small cities, urban agglomerations with strong radiating effects are gradually forming, promoting the coordinated development of large and medium-sized cities and small towns. With the improvement of urbanization level and the development of urban agglomerations, there is a strong demand for passenger transportation between central cities with population and industrial agglomeration and within urban agglomerations, which puts higher requirements on the carrying capacity of transportation infrastructure. To meet the needs of China's urbanization development, it is necessary to quickly establish a fast railway network that combines high-speed railways, intercity trunk lines, intercity railways, and speed-up lines of existing railways, in order to meet the high-volume, high-density, fast and convenient passenger transportation demand, provide basic guarantee for expanding regional development space, promoting rational industrial layout and healthy development of urban agglomerations, and also provide mass, all-weather, convenient and comfortable basic public services for urban and rural residents.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, the basic construction of a high-speed railway network was completed, high-speed railways were developed, and the construction of intercity trunk lines, coal transportation channels, and western railways was promoted. The layout of the railway network was improved, and efforts were made to accelerate the development of a well-developed and comprehensive railway network.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Build the Four Vertical and Four Horizontal high-speed railways. Connect Beijing to Harbin (Dalian), Beijing to Shanghai, Shanghai to Shenzhen, Beijing to Shenzhen, as well as Xuzhou to Lanzhou, Shanghai to Chengdu, and other Four Vertical and Four Horizontal high-speed railways. Construct rapid railways in an orderly manner. Construct Beijing to Hohhot, Datong to Xi'an, Xi'an to Chengdu, Chengdu via Guiyang to Guangzhou, Hefei to Bengbu, Hefei to Fuzhou, Nanjing to Hangzhou, Jilin to Hunchun, Shenyang to Dandong, Harbin to Qiqihar, Harbin to Jiamusi, Wuhan to Jiujiang, Zhengzhou to Wanzhou, and other rapid railways, further expanding the coverage of the rapid railway network. Plan and construct intercity railways. Plan and construct intercity railways in the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Bohai Sea region, Chang-Zhu-Tan urban agglomeration, Central Plains urban agglomeration, Wuhan metropolitan area, Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone, Guanzhong urban agglomeration, the economic zone on the west coast of the Taiwan Strait, as well as Hubei, Inner Mongolia, and Hebei regions, the Beibu Gulf region, Poyang Lake ecological economic zone, and Dianzhong region. Utilize newly built rapid railways and existing railways within the corridors to operate intercity trains, fully leveraging the role of the road network resources in regional intercity passenger transportation.
titlelist: Develop a well-developed and improved railway network, promote the development of high-speed railways, and basically complete the construction of a fast railway network.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: On the basis of realizing the separation of passenger and freight lines on busy trunk lines, accelerate the construction of inter-provincial trunk lines and the expansion and renovation of existing lines, and strengthen heavy-duty freight channels such as coal transportation. Focus on strengthening the eastern coastal railways, the Beijing-Shanghai, Beijing-Kowloon, and Beijing-Guangzhou corridors, the Datong-Zhanjiang-Haikou corridor, the Baotou-Xi'an-Chongqing-Guiyang-Fangcheng corridor, and the Linhe-Lanzhou-Chengdu-Kunming and other north-south corridor constructions; the Manzhouli-Suifenhe corridor, the Tianjin-Beijing-Hohhot-Hami-Turpan-Kashgar (including the Jining-Tongliao-Changchun railway) corridor, the Qingdao-Taiyuan-Lanzhou-Lhasa corridor, the land bridge and Shanghai-Kunming corridor, the Ningxi and Shanghai-Han-Rong corridor, and the Kunming-Nanning-Guangzhou and other east-west corridor constructions. Strengthen the construction of coal transportation channels. Adhere to the simultaneous construction of new lines and renovation of existing lines, accelerate the construction of coal transportation channels from the Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi, Gansu, and Ningxia regions to the East China and Central China regions, strengthen the coal transportation channels between Inner Mongolia and Northeast China, and accelerate the construction of coal transportation channels in Xinjiang for export. Strengthen the optimization and improvement of the coal transportation system.
titlelist: Develop a well-established and improved railway network, construct high-capacity transportation corridors, and improve inter-regional mainline networks.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Constructing inbound and outbound railways in Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, and other regions, as well as developing border railways for territorial development, and supporting the construction of ports. Improving infrastructure and port logistics systems to promote communication and cooperation between China and neighboring regions. Strengthening land bridge connections. Implementing electrification of the Harbin to Manzhouli railway, electrification transformation of the Harbin to Suifenhe railway, capacity expansion of the Jining to Erenhot railway, and strengthening the Chinese section of the first Eurasian Land Bridge. Studying the construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway (domestic section), implementing electrification of the western section of the Lanzhou-Xinjiang railway, capacity expansion and transformation of the Southern Xinjiang railway, and expanding the second Eurasian Land Bridge. Constructing the Dali to Ruili railway to gradually establish the third continental bridge. Improving regional cooperation channels. In the Northeast Asia region, constructing railways such as the Tongjiang railway bridge, Bayanwula to Zhu'engadabuqi, and Gulin to Luoguhe, and implementing capacity expansion of the Arxan to Ulanhot railway, etc. In the Southeast Asia region, constructing railways from Yuxi to Mengzi to Hekou, planning and constructing the Yuxi to Mohan railway, capacity expansion of the Nanning to Pingxiang railway, etc., gradually forming a multi-channel pattern for communication between China and Southeast Asia.
titlelist: Developing and improving the railway network, strengthening the construction of international channels, and gradually achieving interconnectivity with neighboring countries.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Combine the construction of new lines and the renovation of existing lines, strengthen the construction of hub, passenger and freight supporting facilities, and the construction of integrated transportation systems, enhance the connection with other modes of transportation, and leverage the efficiency and overall advantages of the comprehensive transportation system. Construct passenger and freight transportation hubs and supporting facilities. Optimize and improve the overall plan for railway hubs, and strengthen the connection with urban master plans. Combine the construction of new lines and the renovation of existing lines, construct and renovate railway passenger stations, and build integrated passenger transportation hubs closely connected with other modes of transportation and surrounding land development in provincial capital cities and important central urban areas. Strengthen the construction of marshalling yards and large-scale freight yards and other comprehensive freight facilities, and build a sound integrated passenger and freight hub. Construct modern freight yards and logistics centers with value-added services, construct new or renovated freight stations along the line, enhance the service capabilities of freight storage and handling, promote the transformation of freight stations into modern logistics centers, and promote the development of modern logistics industry. Optimize the division of labor and intensify the operation of regional freight stations and technical stations to meet the needs of emerging industrial parks and industrial structure upgrading. Explore the model of using existing railway resources in central cities to serve urban transportation. Build a container transportation network. Accelerate the construction of container centers and container handling stations in Beijing, Shenyang, Ningbo, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Lanzhou, Urumqi, and other cities; combine the construction of new lines, the renovation of existing lines, and port planning and construction, accelerate the construction of container transportation corridors, and basically establish a railway container transportation network covering the whole country, and vigorously develop container transportation. Strengthen the hinterland channels of ports. Through the construction of new channels, the renovation of existing channels, and the improvement of the port transportation system, establish a well-planned, smooth and convenient hinterland channel for ports, achieve seamless connection between railways and ports, actively develop multimodal transportation such as water-rail and road-rail, and expand service functions. Construct comprehensive supporting facilities. According to the layout of productivity adjustment and the needs of network development, construct cross-regional service-oriented operating facilities such as EMU maintenance bases, infrastructure maintenance bases, high-power locomotive maintenance bases, and dispatching offices. Strengthen the construction of railway lines, production sections, and railway staff apartments and dormitories to improve the working and living conditions of employees.
titlelist: Developing and improving the advanced and complete railway network, strengthening the construction of hubs and supporting facilities, and enhancing transportation efficiency.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Adhere to independent innovation, deepen innovation in key technologies and key areas, improve the railway technology standard system, expand the application of technological innovation achievements, and comprehensively promote the modernization of technological equipment.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Combining the construction of high-speed railways, intercity trunk lines, and coal transportation channels, the focus is on equipping advanced equipment such as EMUs (Electric Multiple Units), high-power locomotives, and heavy-duty trucks to meet the needs of passenger and freight transportation. The proportion of air-conditioned passenger cars and specialized freight cars will continue to be increased, and the locomotive and vehicle structure will be optimized. Large-tonnage rescue trains will be provided. The development of EMU series and different series of locomotives, passenger cars, and freight cars will be promoted to further improve the level of technological equipment modernization.
titlelist: Promote the comprehensive modernization of technological equipment and enhance the modernization level of locomotives and vehicles.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Improve the backbone and intra-bureau transmission network, and build a comprehensive data communication network for the entire railway. Achieve GSM-R wireless network coverage for high-speed railways, intercity railways, and important trunk lines. Establish a sound communication network security monitoring, prediction and early warning, and emergency response mechanism, and build a comprehensive emergency rescue communication network for the entire railway. Promote the construction of integrated video surveillance systems to achieve real-time monitoring of key areas of high-speed railways, intercity railways, and important trunk lines. Equip trains with control systems suitable for different levels of railway operation, promote computer interlocking systems, promote the construction of comprehensive automation systems for marshalling yards, and comprehensively improve the modernization level of signal technology equipment.
titlelist: Promote the comprehensive modernization of technological equipment and improve the modernization level of communication signals.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Strengthen the reinforcement and transformation of existing infrastructure and equipment such as railway bridges and tunnels, improve the ability to resist disasters and ensure transportation safety. Promote the comprehensive application of seamless lines across different sections. Actively develop and apply equipment for de-icing and snow removal on tracks and overhead lines. Establish and improve high-speed rail equipment maintenance and repair facilities, achieve full coverage of large-scale track maintenance machinery operations and inspections. Accelerate the promotion of comprehensive monitoring, data collection, and energy-saving technologies for power supply, achieve automation, remote control, and intelligent operation management of traction power supply systems, and enhance the modernization level of power supply equipment.
titlelist: Comprehensively promote the modernization of technological equipment and strengthen the level of modernization of infrastructure equipment.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Adhere to safety as the top priority, with a focus on the safety of the rapid railway network, especially high-speed railway operations. Strengthen the overall construction of safety infrastructure, establish a sound long-term mechanism for safety production, strictly implement the responsibility system for safety production, continuously improve the level of safety guarantee and management, and achieve continuous safety and stability in railway transportation.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Coordinate and improve the equipment quality of high-speed, express, and conventional railways. Strengthen emergency response and disaster prevention safety. Enhance infrastructure testing, monitoring, and detection, establish a sound high-speed rail maintenance system, and improve equipment maintenance standards. Promote the transformation and upgrading of existing railway lines, strengthen the construction of safety protection facilities on fast trunk lines, and establish a three-dimensional safety barrier along the railway. Further improve the level of locomotive and train operation monitoring and early warning systems, perfect locomotive onboard dynamic detection and monitoring systems, and vehicle dynamic ground detection systems. Establish a sound high-speed rail emergency rescue system, accelerate the construction of modern emergency rescue bases, strengthen emergency drills and evaluation mechanisms, and enhance emergency rescue capabilities. Establish a high-speed rail disaster warning and monitoring system, emergency response plans, and disposal systems, achieve comprehensive monitoring of various disasters such as strong winds, rain and snow, earthquakes, foreign object intrusion, and ground subsidence, and enhance the ability to withstand various disasters. Strengthen the construction of high-speed rail safety protection facilities and equipment, and enhance the ability to prevent various risks.
titlelist: Ensure railway transportation safety, strengthen safety infrastructure and equipment.

name: Railway '12th Five-Year Plan' Development Plan (National Railway Administration/December 19, 2013)
content: Strictly implement the product access system according to regulations, and establish a rigorous quality supervision and guarantee system. Establish and improve a sound safety supervision system, strengthen supervision over design, construction, supervision units, and production manufacturing enterprises, and improve and innovate supervision methods and means. Strengthen the comprehensive management of security prevention and safety environment for high-speed rail and rapid trunk lines, strengthen passenger and luggage security checks and public security management, and fully implement real-name ticketing for high-speed rail. Adhere to the combination of physical defense, technical defense, and personnel defense, and accelerate the construction of a security prevention system and guarantee system. Strengthen research on safety basic theory and safety management, strive to make breakthroughs in major accident disaster mechanisms, safety prediction and prevention, and comprehensive safety analysis. Establish and improve a railway safety regulatory system covering operation management, safety management, equipment maintenance, and emergency disposal. Strengthen transportation safety supervision, inspection, and regulation, and actively promote the reform of the safety supervision system and the improvement of the mechanism. Strictly implement the safety production responsibility system, deepen special governance of safety production, and improve the level of scientific and standardized safety management. Strengthen the construction of the railway public health safety system. Improve safety behavior norms and education and training systems, and strengthen training for key positions in transportation and related management personnel. Strengthen the safety management of practitioners, strictly implement the access system for high-speed rail positions, and ensure dynamic optimization of key positions for high-speed rail operation personnel.
titlelist: Ensure railway transportation safety, strengthen safety management and guarantee system.

content: With a focus on transportation organization, passenger and freight services, and business management, we will promote the construction of information infrastructure and comprehensively enhance the level of railway informatization.

name: Main Technical Policies of Railways (Order No. 34 of the Ministry of Railways in 2013) (Former Ministry of Railways/January 9, 2013)
content: The maximum operating speed of the newly built passenger and freight shared-line railway is 200km/h for passenger trains, 160km/h for express freight trains, and 120km/h for regular freight trains. The minimum tracking interval for double-track railway passenger trains is designed to be 5 minutes. The passenger train formation does not exceed 20 cars. The axle load of 160km/h passenger cars is not more than 16.5t, and for 120km/h passenger cars, it is not more than 18t. The axle load of regular passenger locomotives is not more than 23t, and for freight locomotives, it is recommended to be 25t. The axle load of freight cars is being studied for promotion, with 25t being researched and developed for 27t.
titlelist: The co-linear railway for passenger and freight trains operates with a design speed of 200km/h or below, taking into account the train speed, density, and weight.

Build comprehensive transportation hubs and modern logistics centers that are closely connected with other modes of transportation.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: By constructing passenger dedicated lines, developing intercity passenger rail transit and upgrading existing lines, a rapid passenger transportation network has been initially formed with passenger dedicated lines as the backbone, connecting major cities across the country. The construction includes Beijing-Shanghai, Beijing-Zhengzhou-Wuhan-Guangzhou-Shenzhen, Harbin-Dalian, Tianjin-Qinhuangdao, Shanghai-Hangzhou-Ningbo, Shijiazhuang-Taiyuan, Jinan-Qingdao, Xuzhou-Zhengzhou-Xi'an-Baoji passenger dedicated lines, as well as the Shanghai-Hankou-Chengdu, Ningbo-Xiamen-Shenzhen rapid passenger transportation corridors. The construction also includes intercity rail transit in the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Bohai Economic Rim, and other densely populated urban areas. The main construction projects include Beijing-Tianjin, Shanghai-Nanjing, Nanjing-Hangzhou, Nanjing-Wuhu-Anqing, Guangzhou-Zhuhai, Jiujiang-Nanchang, Qingdao-Yantai-Weihai, Mianyang-Chengdu-Emeishan, Changchun-Jilin, Liuzhou-Nanning intercity rail transit systems, as well as the Shanghai-Hangzhou maglev transportation. Combined with electrification and capacity expansion of existing lines, the existing trunk lines will be upgraded to further expand the coverage of high-speed networks, enabling the maximum speed of passenger trains on the 13,000-kilometer main trunk lines to reach 200 kilometers per hour.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to accelerate the construction of a well-developed railway network and to build a fast passenger transportation network.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: The key focus is on the transportation demand of the top ten coal export regions. By constructing dedicated passenger lines and releasing the capacity of existing freight lines, efforts will be made to accelerate the construction of coal transportation channels and expand the capacity of existing lines, in order to form a powerful, advanced, and well-functioning coal transportation system. The expansion of the Daqin Railway and the construction of supporting transportation systems will be implemented, including the construction of the Qian'an North to Caofeidian, Shuozhou to Zhunge'er, and Kelan to Watang railways. Other projects include the construction of the Datong to Yuanping fourth line, Ningwu to Shuozhou double line, Ningwu to Kelan capacity expansion, Dazhun Railway capacity expansion, and Jigang Railway capacity expansion, with a total capacity of 400 million tons. The Shuohuang Railway will undergo a capacity expansion of 200 million tons and the construction of a supporting transportation system. A new coal transportation channel from west to east will be built, mainly including the construction of the Changzhi to Taian, Xingtai (Handan) to Huanghua, Dongsheng to Wuhai, Zhunge'er to Dongsheng, Zhunge'er to Shenmu, Suzhou to Huai'an, Fuxin to Bayanwula, Chifeng to Baiyinhua, Zhenglanqi to Fengning, Jiayuguan to Ceke, Linhe to Ceke, Ganqimaodao Railway, and other new coal transportation channels. The construction of the Dabaobao-Huixian electrification and the Beijing-Zhangjiakou-Hohhot-Baotou fourth line will form a major transportation corridor for the Beijing-Baotou-Baolan route. The construction of the Baoxi Railway channel, Xi'an to Ankang double line, and Handan-Jinan-Hangzhou-Changsha double line will also be implemented. The capacity expansion of the Houyue line, Xinheyan to Yanzhou daily line, Jiaoliu line, Taijiao line, Xiwen to Changzhi North electrification, and Nantongpu line and Jitong line capacity expansion projects will significantly improve the capacity of existing mainline coal transportation.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to accelerate the construction of a well-developed railway network and strengthen the transportation channels for coal.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Smooth transportation to external ports and important ports, to meet the needs of large-scale import and export at ports and ports. Construct Shanghai-Nantong, Shanghai-Zhenjiang, Huzhou-Zhapu-Pudong, Xiangtang-Meizhou Bay, Longyan-Xiamen, Guangzhou-Zhuhai, Guangzhou Nansha Port, Maoming-Zhanjiang, Dezhou-Longkou-Yantai, Huanghua-Dajiawa Railway, etc., implement the Lijiang-Zhanjiang Line River Lip-Zhanjiang double line, expand the capacity of Guangxi Coastal Railway, duplicate the Jin'ao Line in Dalian Hub, expand the capacity of Shendan Line, and other port railway construction, further improve the port's rear channel. Construct Binzhou Line Hailar-Manzhouli, Binsui Line Mudanjiang-Suifenhe, Lanxin Line Urumqi-Jinghe double line, and Jier Line expansion project, strengthen the capacity of existing port rear channels.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to accelerate the construction of a well-developed railway network and strengthen the construction of port and hinterland access channels.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Strengthen the construction of east, central, and west channels. Continue the construction of the Golmud section of the Qinghai-Tibet Railway, electrify the Lanqing and Golmud sections of the Qinghai-Tibet Railway, and construct the Yichang-Wanzhou and Chongqing-Lichuan railways. Implement the double-track electrification of the Wuhan-Ankang-Chongqing railway, expand the capacity of the Dacheng railway, and electrify the Dacheng-Wan railway, forming a high-capacity channel connecting the Sichuan-Chongqing region, the Jianghan Plain, and the Yangtze River Delta region. Construct the Taiyuan-Zhongwei and Lanzhou-Chongqing railways, as well as the Suining-Chongqing and Chongqing-Huaihua double-track lines, to create convenient channels connecting the northwest to the north China, northwest to southwest, and southwest to southeast coastal areas. Implement the double-track electrification of the Lanzhou-Xinjiang line, the electrification of the Wuwei-Jiayuguan-Urumqi line, the double-track construction of the Turpan-Korla line, and the Kunming-Zhanyi-Liupanshui and Kunming-Guangtong double-track lines of the Guikun railway, to strengthen the capacity of land bridges and the Shanghai-Kunming corridor. Expand the capacity of the Xianggui railway, add a second line to the Nankun and Qianguigui railways, construct the Guiyang-Guangzhou railway, and study the construction of the Nanning-Guangzhou railway. Electrify the Baolan line and enhance the connection between the northwest and north China and northeast China. Expand the coverage of the western road network. Construct the Jinghe-Yili-Horgos, Kuitun-Beitun, Golmud-Dunhuang, Xi'an-Pingliang, Dali-Lijiang-Shangri-La, Qinghai-Tibet Railway extension, Emei-Yibin, Leba-Bazhong, Longchang-Huangtong, Yulin-Hepu, Hepu-Hechun, Yongzhou-Cenxi-Yulin, and Cenxi-Maoming, Tianyang-Debao-Jingxi, Nanchuan-Fuling, Yimin-Yiershi, Ulanhot-Xilinhot, Moerdaoga-Shiwei, Hailar-Heishantou, and Chaidar-Muli railways. Open international channels for southwest and northwest border crossings, and construct the Yuxi-Mengzi-Hekou, Dali-Ruili, Yuxi-Mohan, and Zhongjiwu railways.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to accelerate the construction of a well-developed railway network and continue expanding the western network.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Implement the electrification transformation of the Beijing-Shanghai, Tianjin-Shenyang, Beijing-Kowloon, Wuhan-Kowloon, Shide, Lanyan, Jiaoxin, Xinchang, Fuhuai, Huainan, Shanghai-Hangzhou, Zhejiang-Gan, Xuanhang, Xiaoyong, and Longhai lines, as well as the electrification of the Xuzhou to Lianyungang section of the Longhai line, to achieve the electrification of the main lines in the eastern region of the Beijing-Guangzhou line. Construct the Hainan East Ring, Shaoguan-Ganzhou, Guangzhou-Maoming, Jiujiang-Jingdezhen-Quzhou, Tongling-Jiujiang, Lujiang-Tongling, Fuyang-Lu'an, Jingzhou-Yueyang, Lianyungang-Yancheng, Huaiyin-Yangzhou, Huangdao-Rizhao, Dongdu-Pingyi, Baoding-Bazhou, Yandai Ferry, Northeast Eastern Railway Corridor, Xiuyan-Zhuanghe, Xifeng-Liaoyuan, Changchun-Yantongshan, Jingyu-Songjianghe, Baishanzhen-Quanyang, Yushu-Shulan, Weihe-Yabuli, Gulin-Luoguhe, Hulin-Jixiang, Tongjiang Railway, etc., to further improve the density of the railway network. Construct the Guangzhou-Shenzhen Fourth Line, the Beijing-Shan Railway Beijing-Tianjin section Fourth Line, the Wan-Gan, Ning-Qi, Jinzhou-Qiqihar Railway Double Line, carry out the Xinxiang-Chenjiahe section of the Beijing-Guangzhou line, Jinwen, Yingxia, Waifu, Hengnan, Hebang, Luofu, Loufeng, Yechi, Jincheng, Shenji, Changtu, Tonghuo, Bai'a, Siping-Meihekou-Tonghua, Siping-Taipingchuan, Linkou-Boli-Qitaihe, Linkou-Jidong, and capacity expansion of the Hegang line, as well as the transformation of the Hainan West Ring Line, significantly improving the capacity of existing railway transportation.
titlelist: The key task of railway development is to accelerate the construction of a well-developed railway network and optimize and improve the network in the eastern and central regions.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Construct 18 container logistics centers in Shanghai, Tianjin, Guangzhou, and other cities. Utilize the construction of new lines and the renovation of existing lines to actively promote the construction of double-decker container transportation channels, and some major cities will be the first to achieve double-decker container transportation. Vigorously develop multimodal transport to improve transportation efficiency and quality. Adapt to the economic structural adjustment, foreign trade, and port development needs, meet the requirements of shippers for convenient, safe, and door-to-door transportation, and open up new economic growth points for railways.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to accelerate the construction of a well-developed railway network and to build a container transportation system.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Combining the construction of a fast passenger transport network, a number of large-scale passenger stations such as Beijing South and Shanghai Hongqiao will be newly built or renovated, forming a modern passenger transport center that integrates mainline railways, intercity railways, road transport, urban subways, and bus systems. Construction of network-based and regional marshalling yards such as Wuhan North, Xinfengzhen, Guiyang South, and Chengdu North will be carried out to meet the needs of direct transportation, heavy loading, and centralized traffic operations for freight transportation. Taking the opportunity of container center station construction, the layout of hub freight stations will be integrated to meet the needs of cargo flow distribution in urban radiation areas. The optimization of major hub layouts will achieve coordination of point-to-line capabilities, ensuring smooth and flexible transportation of passengers and goods, maximizing the advantages of railway transportation, and enhancing the radiation function of regional central cities.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to accelerate the construction of a well-developed railway network and strengthen the construction of major hubs.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Adhere to the technical policy of advanced, mature, economical, applicable, and reliable, and follow the requirements of standardization, serialization, modularization, and informatization. Based on localization, introduce advanced technology, collaborate in design and production, build Chinese brands, strengthen the digestion, absorption, and re-innovation of imported technology, enhance independent innovation capabilities, and accelerate the modernization of technological equipment.
titlelist: The key task of railway development is to vigorously promote the modernization of technology and equipment.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Vigorously develop electric traction, with electric locomotives accounting for over 80% of the transportation workload. Achieve domestic production of AC transmission locomotives as soon as possible. Develop supporting inner electric locomotives suitable for speeds of 200 kilometers per hour. Vigorously develop heavy-duty freight locomotives with an axle load of 25 tons. By 2010, the locomotive fleet size will reach around 19,000 units. Based on the research and development of key technologies for high-speed trains with speeds of 200 kilometers per hour and above, combined with the introduction of a small number of train sets, achieve domestic production of high-speed train sets with speeds of 200 kilometers per hour and above as soon as possible. Actively promote the development and research of key technologies for high-speed trains with speeds of 300 kilometers per hour and above, and ultimately establish domestic manufacturing, maintenance, and operation capabilities for high-speed train sets.
