By 2010, the number of train sets will reach around 1,000. Develop new passenger cars that meet different levels of passenger demand and different operating conditions. By 2010, the number of passenger cars will reach around 45,000. Vigorously improve the overall technical level of freight cars, increase freight car speed, load capacity, and safety and reliability. Actively develop new general-purpose freight cars with an axle load of 23 tons and a maximum speed of 120 kilometers per hour, and develop fast freight cars with a speed of 160 kilometers per hour for different purposes. Vigorously develop dedicated freight cars for coal transportation, container transportation, and special cargo transportation needs. By 2010, the number of freight cars will reach 700,000 (including 100,000 company-owned cars).
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to vigorously promote the modernization of technology and equipment, and accelerate the upgrading and replacement of locomotives and vehicles.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Adhere to scientific construction standards, improve the durability and service life of engineering structures. Emphasize the treatment of roadbed foundations to ensure the quality of roadbed engineering. Promote the use of slag-free track structure technology and new types of steel rails, switches, rail sleepers, and connecting fasteners in high-speed railways to achieve maintenance-free and low-maintenance operations. Develop high-strength and new structural bridges, reinforce and renovate existing infrastructure such as existing lines, bridges, and tunnels. For newly built railways with speeds of 160 kilometers per hour and above, promote the laying of seamless tracks across multiple sections. Focus on busy trunk lines and speed-up lines, complete major maintenance coverage of 85,000 kilometers of large-scale track maintenance machinery across the entire railway. Vigorously improve the quality and reliability of traction power supply equipment, develop comprehensive rectification technology for traction power supply systems, and achieve automation, remote control, and intelligent operation management of traction power supply systems. Achieve localization of traction power supply technology and equipment.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to vigorously promote the modernization of technology and equipment, and to enhance the technical level of line infrastructure.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Utilize modern communication technology to construct a comprehensive and orderly transmission system, with fiber optic digital systems and GSM-R as the main components, and coordinate and unify with other information transmission methods. Establish a comprehensive mobile communication technology system for China's railways based on GSM-R. Construct high-speed broadband digital transmission networks and access networks, and develop railway-specific communication and emergency communication. Establish an intelligent and networked dispatch communication system. Gradually build a new generation of centralized train control systems (CTC). Develop a train operation control system (CTCS) based on locomotive signaling, with a focus on implementing train overspeed protection. Basic construction of computer interlocking systems.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to vigorously promote the modernization of technology and equipment, and accelerate the modernization of communication and signal technology.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Adhere to the principles of unified leadership, unified planning, unified standards, unified resources, and unified management, widely utilize the achievements of modern communication and information technology, and build a technologically advanced, structurally reasonable, functionally perfect, scientifically managed, economically applicable, safe and reliable railway information system with Chinese characteristics. Focus on strengthening the informatization construction of the busy eastern region, important railway trunk lines, and newly built passenger dedicated lines in the railway network, gradually realizing intelligent dispatching and command, socialized passenger and freight marketing, and modernized operation management. It plays a significant role in improving transportation efficiency, expanding transportation capacity, optimizing resource allocation, ensuring transportation safety, improving service quality, enhancing management level, and increasing economic benefits.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to vigorously promote the modernization of technology and equipment, and actively promote the informatization of railways.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: To implement the national requirements for accelerating the construction of a resource-saving and environmentally friendly society, vigorously promote the application of various advanced technologies for comprehensive utilization of resources such as fuel-saving, electricity-saving, water-saving, new energy, and renewable energy, actively promote clean production, improve the energy and resource utilization efficiency of railways, and achieve a reduction in transportation costs of more than 20% by the end of the 11th Five-Year Plan. Strengthen environmental protection in railway transportation, focus on improving the railway environment in urban areas, and improve the quality of transportation environment. Strengthen ecological environmental protection, soil and water conservation, and flood impact assessment in railway construction, and conscientiously implement all requirements in accordance with the law. Accelerate the construction of green channels for railways and quickly form an overall greening scale.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to vigorously promote technological equipment modernization and strengthen resource conservation and environmental protection.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Establish a technology innovation system with enterprises as the main body, market-oriented, and the integration of industry, academia, and research. Strengthen original innovation, integrated innovation, and introduction, digestion, absorption, and re-innovation. Adhere to the combination of introducing advanced technology and independent innovation, actively develop core technologies and key technologies with independent intellectual property rights, and form a high-speed railway technology system with independent intellectual property rights in China. Pre-station projects such as railway lines, bridges, tunnels, and culverts solve key technical problems through scientific and technological research and testing, form completely independent technical standards and independent intellectual property rights, and achieve original innovation. Communication, signaling, and traction power supply systems adhere to system integration innovation, forming a technical system integration that meets the requirements of China's high-speed passenger line stations. Operation scheduling and passenger service systems adhere to independent innovation, combining national and road conditions. With Chinese enterprises as the main body, design and develop operation scheduling and passenger service systems that meet the requirements of China's high-speed passenger line operations. Following the overall idea of introducing advanced technology, joint design and production, and building Chinese brands, introduce, digest, absorb, and re-innovate to achieve the modernization of China's locomotive and rolling stock manufacturing industry and the modernization of locomotive and rolling stock equipment.
titlelist: The key tasks of railway development are to vigorously promote the modernization of technology and equipment, and accelerate the construction of the railway innovation system.

name: Railway 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' (Former Ministry of Railways/March 10, 2009)
content: Continue to promote the expansion of connotation and reproduction, further tap the transportation potential of existing lines, strengthen the supporting capacity of point-to-line and infrastructure such as routes, signals, and power supply, accelerate the transformation and expansion of existing lines, optimize transportation organization and allocation of transportation resources, improve the overall transportation capacity of the network, improve the efficiency of locomotive and freight car utilization, and enhance the transportation guarantee capacity for economic and social development. Consolidate and increase the market share of railways in long-distance passenger and bulk freight markets. Adapt to the changing demands of railway passenger and freight transportation, combine the construction of passenger dedicated lines and intercity passenger railways with the speed improvement of existing lines, strengthen transportation management, optimize product structure, improve service facilities, innovate service methods, and continuously improve transportation service levels and efficiency. Optimize and adjust the passenger train operation plan, increase direct express trains, overnight trains, day-return trains, and tourist trains, actively develop new products that meet different passenger needs, and increase the market share of railway passenger transportation. Combine with the construction of high-capacity network corridors, optimize dispatching and transportation organization, reduce intermediate transportation links, increase the number of daily loaded cars, develop heavy-duty transportation and direct transportation, and at the same time improve emergency plans for key material transportation, improve the guarantee capacity for key material transportation, and ensure the transportation of key materials such as coal, oil, grain, and fertilizer that are related to national economy and people's livelihood. Increase the market share of short-distance passenger transportation and high-value-added freight transportation. Strengthen the connection and cooperation with other modes of transportation, and play the backbone role of railways in the integrated logistics chain. Strengthen the development and cultivation of intercity, urban, suburban, and other short-distance passenger transportation markets. Accelerate the development of specialized transportation such as containers and special goods, and quickly form a scale, market-oriented, and specialized operation to improve economic efficiency and service quality.
titlelist: Key tasks for railway development, improving railway service quality.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: The strategic focus of technological development is as follows. Firstly, prioritize the development of energy, water resources, and environmental protection technologies. Resolve major bottlenecks that hinder economic and social development. Secondly, seize the rare opportunity of rapid development in information technology and new materials technology in the coming years. Make independent intellectual property rights in obtaining core technologies for equipment manufacturing and information industries a breakthrough for improving China's industrial competitiveness. Thirdly, prioritize biotechnology as a key industry to catch up with in the future high-tech sector. Strengthen the application of biotechnology in agriculture, industry, population, and health fields. Fourthly, accelerate the development of aerospace and marine technology. Fifthly, strengthen basic science and frontier technology research, especially interdisciplinary research.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: (8) Key research and development of seawater desalination technology, including pre-treatment techniques, nuclear energy coupling, and low-cost desalination methods such as thermal and membrane processes. Also, focus on developing comprehensive utilization techniques for concentrated brine and scalable seawater desalination thermal energy equipment, desalination equipment, and key equipment for multi-unit coupling. (11) Key research and development of efficient utilization of marine resources, including exploration techniques for shallow concealed oil and gas reservoirs and comprehensive techniques to improve the recovery rate of heavy oil fields. Also, focus on developing techniques for the protection and efficient utilization of marine biological resources, as well as direct utilization and comprehensive utilization techniques for seawater chemical resources.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese means man or male.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: Research, develop technologies for ecological and environmental protection, restoration, and emergency response in the near-sea areas, and develop high-precision numerical forecasting technologies for marine dynamic environmental conditions.
titlelist: Key areas and their priority themes, environment... (15) Key development of marine ecology and environmental protection, focusing on the development of marine ecology and environmental monitoring technology and equipment, and strengthening the research of marine ecology and environmental protection technology.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: Emphasize the development of multi-functional, multi-parameter, and long-term operation marine comprehensive development technology to improve the comprehensive technical capabilities of deep-sea operations. Focus on researching and developing natural gas hydrate exploration and development technology, deep-sea metal mineral resource subsea gathering technology, on-site efficient extraction technology, and large-scale marine engineering technology. (19) Marine environment three-dimensional monitoring technology. Marine environment three-dimensional monitoring technology is a technology that synchronously monitors marine environmental elements in the air, onshore stations, water surface, and underwater. Focus on researching marine remote sensing technology, acoustic detection technology, buoy technology, shore-based remote radar technology, and developing marine information processing and application technology. (20) Deep-sea multi-parameter rapid detection technology. Deep-sea multi-parameter rapid detection technology is a technology that synchronously detects and realizes real-time information transmission of multiple parameters of seabed geophysics, geochemistry, and biochemistry. Focus on researching sensor technology under abnormal environmental conditions, sensor automatic calibration technology, seabed information transmission technology, etc. (21) Natural gas hydrate development technology. Natural gas hydrates are hydrocarbon compounds found in deep-sea and underground. Focus on researching the exploration theory and development technology of natural gas hydrates, geophysical and geochemical exploration and evaluation technology of natural gas hydrates, breakthroughs in natural gas hydrate drilling technology and safe mining technology. (22) Deep-sea operation technology. Deep-sea operation technology is the underwater technology that supports deep-sea seabed engineering operations and mineral mining. Focus on researching deep-depth underwater transportation technology, life support system technology, high specific energy power device technology, high-fidelity sampling and remote information transmission technology, deep-sea operation equipment manufacturing technology, and deep-sea space station technology.
titlelist: Cutting-edge technology, marine technology

name: Decision on Accelerating the Cultivation and Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (Excerpt) (State Council [2010] No. 32) (State Council/October 10, 2010)
content: Focus on the development of aviation equipment, with an emphasis on trunk and regional aircraft as well as general aviation aircraft, to expand and strengthen the aviation industry. Actively promote the construction of space infrastructure to facilitate the development of satellite and its applications industry. Relying on key projects such as passenger dedicated lines and urban rail transit, vigorously develop rail transit equipment. In the field of ocean resource development, make great efforts to develop marine engineering equipment. Strengthen basic supporting capabilities and actively develop intelligent manufacturing equipment with digitalization, flexibility, and system integration technologies as the core.
titlelist: Based on the national conditions, strive to achieve rapid and healthy development in key areas, such as high-end equipment manufacturing industry.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: In the next three years, the shipbuilding industry will maintain steady and rapid growth, striving to achieve a shipbuilding output of 50 million tons and a production of marine low-speed diesel engines of 12 million horsepower by 2011.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles and goals, planning objectives, stable growth of ship production.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: In 2011, the completion volume of shipbuilding accounted for over 35% of the world's shipbuilding completion volume, with a market share of high-tech and high value-added vessels reaching 20%, and a market share of marine engineering equipment reaching 10%.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and goals, planning objectives, gradually expanding market share.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: The average loading rate of domestically produced ship equipment for the three main types of ships has reached over 65%. The domestic market satisfaction rate for ship auxiliary equipment such as marine low-speed diesel engines, medium-speed diesel engines, and deck machinery has exceeded 80%.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and goals, planning objectives, significantly enhanced supporting capabilities.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Large-scale shipbuilding enterprise groups have strong international competitiveness in the high-end ship market. Several specialized marine engineering equipment manufacturing bases have initially taken shape. A group of ship equipment production enterprises have developed and grown. The Bohai Bay, Yangtze River Estuary, and Pearl River Estuary have become world-class shipbuilding bases.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text '指导思想、基本原则和目标,规划目标,结构调整取得进展' to English is:Guiding ideology, basic principles and goals, planning objectives, progress in structural adjustment.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: The three main types of ships have been developed, designed, and implemented in a series and standardized manner, forming a group of internationally competitive branded ship types. Breakthroughs have been achieved in the development of high-tech, high-value-added ships and marine engineering equipment.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, basic principles, and goals, planning objectives, significant improvement in research and development level.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: The backbone shipbuilding enterprises have basically established a modern shipbuilding model, with the average construction cycle of the three mainstream ship types shortened to within 10 months. The energy consumption of unit industrial added value has been reduced by 15% over the past three years. The utilization rate of steel has significantly improved.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and goals, planning objectives, significant improvement in quality of development.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Take effective measures to support large shipbuilding enterprises and shipping enterprises in fulfilling contracts on schedule, actively respond to operational risks such as delayed delivery, order cancellations, and vessel abandonment. Guide shipbuilding enterprises to strengthen production management, arrange production plans reasonably, ensure shipbuilding quality and progress, and maintain production continuity.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to stabilize the production of shipbuilding enterprises.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Accelerate the scrapping and renewal of old ships and the elimination of single-hull oil tankers, actively develop specialized vessels such as offshore fishing boats, special-purpose vessels, engineering vessels, and work vessels.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to expand the demand in the shipbuilding market.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Support shipbuilding enterprises in researching and developing new types of self-elevating drilling platforms, deepwater semi-submersible drilling platforms and production platforms, floating production storage and offloading facilities, marine engineering operation vessels and large-scale modules, comprehensive integrated components, and other marine engineering equipment. Encourage research and development of marine engineering power and transmission systems, single-point mooring systems, dynamic positioning systems, deep diving equipment, deck machinery, oil and wastewater treatment, and seawater desalination, as well as other key systems and supporting equipment for marine engineering.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are the development of marine engineering equipment.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Support the implementation of mergers and reorganizations for large shipbuilding enterprise groups and other key shipbuilding enterprises. Promote the formation of strategic alliances between large shipbuilding enterprises and upstream and downstream enterprises, supporting each other and developing together. Guide small and medium-sized shipbuilding enterprises to adjust their business structures, develop intermediate product manufacturing, ship repair, special ship manufacturing, and other businesses, and explore non-ship product markets. Support eligible enterprises in acquiring well-known overseas ship equipment enterprises, research and development institutions, and marketing networks.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to support enterprise mergers and reorganizations.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Develop the Key Project Catalogue for Research and Development in the Shipbuilding Industry to support the optimization and upgrading of three major mainstream ship types. Develop ships that comply with new regulations, standards, and energy-saving and environmental protection requirements. Improve the design and development capabilities of high-tech and high-value-added ships such as large liquefied natural gas ships, large liquefied petroleum gas ships, large automobile transport ships, and scientific research vessels. Accelerate the independent research and development of new marine diesel engines and their key components, deck machinery, cabin equipment, and communication navigation automation equipment. Accelerate research on common basic technologies for modern shipbuilding technology, ship and marine engineering equipment.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to enhance independent innovation capabilities.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Translate the following Chinese text to English:Develop the 'Catalog of Shipbuilding Industry Technological Transformation Projects and Products' to support the construction of high-tech, high-value-added ships and specialized production facilities for ocean engineering equipment. Support the technological transformation of ships and ocean engineering equipment and supporting products that can fill domestic gaps, have significant energy-saving and environmental protection effects, and cannot meet market demand for production capacity.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to strengthen the technological transformation of enterprises.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Encourage shipbuilding enterprises to utilize existing shipbuilding facilities for ship repair business. Strengthen research on ship repair technology and enhance the repair and modification capabilities of large-scale ships, special-purpose ships, and marine engineering equipment. Standardize the development of ship dismantling industry and implement designated locations.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization include actively developing the ship repair industry.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Develop and improve relevant measures to consolidate the competitive advantage of China's shipbuilding industry in the international market for three major mainstream ship types. Expand the international market share of high-tech, high value-added ships and marine engineering equipment. Encourage ship equipment companies to establish overseas marketing networks and after-sales service systems to drive product exports.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to strive to explore international markets.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council [2009] No. 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Each relevant bank should ensure that the shipbuilding enterprises have sufficient working capital loans for the construction of ships and valid contracts. For shipowners who delay taking delivery of the ships, appropriate loan extension support should be provided to the shipbuilding enterprises. Timely payment and repayment guarantees should be issued to shipowners and shipbuilding enterprises with good credit. Strengthen cooperation between banks and enterprises, and implement mortgage financing for ships under construction. Support eligible shipbuilding enterprises in going public and issuing bonds. Accelerate the establishment of a shipbuilding industry investment fund.
titlelist: Policy measures to increase support for production and operation credit financing.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Encourage financial institutions to increase the provision of buyer's credit funds for ship exports, to help stabilize existing export ship orders for large shipbuilding enterprise groups and other key shipbuilding enterprises.
titlelist: Policy measures to increase the provision of buyer's credit for ship exports.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Research and formulate relevant policy measures to encourage major shipping companies to purchase abandoned ocean-going vessels, and encourage financial leasing companies to purchase abandoned export vessels.
titlelist: Policy measures to encourage the purchase of abandoned ships.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Continue to implement the value-added tax refund policy for domestic enterprises selling marine engineering structures to domestic offshore oil and gas extraction enterprises. Increase the investment of budgetary funds and advance the implementation of government and public welfare shipbuilding projects included in the national plan.
titlelist: Policy measures, efforts to expand domestic ship market demand.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Formulate and implement policies and measures to encourage corporate mergers and reorganizations, properly resolve issues such as the placement of surplus personnel, transfer of corporate assets, debt consolidation and disposal, and distribution of financial and tax benefits. Support large shipbuilding enterprise groups in implementing mergers and reorganizations through capital injection, financing, and credit support. Support key shipbuilding enterprises in merging and reorganizing other shipbuilding companies, prioritize the approval of their technological transformation projects, and encourage product structure adjustments.
titlelist: Policy measures, improving policies and measures for corporate mergers and reorganizations.

name: Plan for the Adjustment and Revitalization of the Shipbuilding Industry (State Council Document No. [2009] 21) (State Council/June 9, 2009)
content: Increase investment in research and development of high-tech ships, support the development of high-tech new ships, marine engineering equipment, and key supporting equipment, support research on key common technologies and advanced manufacturing technologies, and accelerate the construction of the shipbuilding industry standard system. Support the technological transformation of ship-related supporting equipment, marine engineering equipment, and specialized facilities and equipment for special-purpose ships. Support the informatization construction and process reengineering of large shipbuilding enterprises after mergers and reorganizations, and support the adjustment and transformation of small and medium-sized shipbuilding enterprises to meet relevant industrial policy requirements. Support the construction of research and development conditions for shipbuilding enterprises and research institutions.
titlelist: Policy measures, increase investment in scientific research and development, and technological transformation.

name: Equipment Manufacturing Industry Adjustment and Revitalization Plan (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 11 [2009]) (State Council/ May 12, 2009)
content: In combination with the implementation of the shipbuilding industry adjustment and revitalization plan, the focus is on improving the level of welding and painting process equipment, achieving the localization of equipment required for the manufacturing of key components such as marine diesel engines, crankshafts, propellers, cabin equipment, and deck machinery.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to seize the nine major industrial key projects, implement equipment autonomy, and develop the shipbuilding industry.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: After three years of effort, China has formulated a top-level plan for the development of intelligent ships. It has initially established a standard system for intelligent ships, made breakthroughs in core technologies such as intelligent perception of navigation situations and automatic berthing and departure, completed the development of related key intelligent equipment systems, and realized pilot demonstrations of typical scenarios such as remote control and autonomous navigation. It has also expanded the demonstration and promotion of typical intelligent ships with one platform + N intelligent applications. It has initially formed comprehensive testing and verification capabilities that combine virtual and real aspects of intelligent ships and integrate land and sea, and has kept pace with the world's advanced level in the development of intelligent ships.
titlelist: Overall strategy, action goals

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Research and formulate China's medium and long-term development plan for intelligent ships. Conduct in-depth analysis of the development trends of intelligent ships, clarify the concept and classification of intelligent ships, research and propose the technological framework for intelligent ships, and develop a roadmap for technological development. Research and formulate guidelines for the construction of intelligent ship specifications and standards system. Strengthen research on supporting infrastructure for intelligent ships and propose an overall layout plan. Carry out a review of relevant laws and regulations for intelligent ships, propose a framework for requirements, and initiate the revision and formulation of urgently needed laws, regulations, and policy documents.
titlelist: Key tasks, comprehensively strengthen top-level design.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Strengthen the overall design of intelligent ship systems, integrate innovative resources from within and outside the industry, and break through the basic common technologies and key core technologies of intelligent ships. Focus on the research and development needs of intelligent perception, intelligent navigation systems, etc., and focus on enhancing the integrated innovation capabilities of multiple disciplines such as ship overall, power, perception, communication, control, and artificial intelligence. Column 1: Key intelligent technologies. Overall design of intelligent systems: Conduct research on system architecture design, application models, information flows, integration frameworks, standard interfaces, etc., and develop comprehensive intelligent management and control systems for the entire ship. Intelligent perception system: Conduct research on shipborne sensing technology and multi-source perception data fusion technology supported by intelligent hardware, and develop perception systems that cover data collection and fusion of navigation environment, ship status, equipment status, cargo status, etc. Network and communication system: Conduct research on ship domain networks, ship-shore interaction, ship-to-ship self-organizing networks, etc., and develop ship domain network systems for information interaction and collaborative control throughout the ship, ship-shore integrated communication systems with low latency, low cost, low power consumption, and lightweight data transmission, and ship-to-ship communication systems. Intelligent navigation system: Conduct research on intelligent navigation technology based on situational awareness, remote control driving technology under ship-shore collaboration, autonomous navigation and collision avoidance technology, etc., and develop intelligent navigation systems.
titlelist: Key task, breakthrough in key intelligent technology.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Around the functional requirements of intelligent ship auxiliary decision-making and autonomous control, the system clarifies the technical requirements of perception and control basic components, focusing on filling the gaps and strengthening comprehensive integration. It promotes the intelligent upgrade of ship navigation, operations, power, and other related equipment, develops new ship equipment with highly integrated information and control, and comprehensively enhances the level of ship intelligence. Column 2 focuses on filling the gaps in basic components and upgrading equipment intelligence. Perception and control basic components: clarify the technical requirements and product spectrum of intelligent ship perception and control basic components, and focus on comprehensive integration and application research. Upgrading existing equipment intelligence: focus on the intelligent upgrade of existing ship equipment systems such as power electromechanical, communication and navigation, berthing and unberthing, cargo handling, and cabin equipment. Development of new intelligent equipment: develop new ship equipment with highly integrated information and control, and conduct application research on new ship power equipment and new ship self-organizing communication equipment.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the intelligent upgrading of ship equipment.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Make full use of the research foundation and technological achievements in related industries, strengthen the application research in network and link security, system hardware and software security, data security, etc., comprehensively enhance the network and information security protection capabilities of intelligent ships, and ensure safety, reliability, and controllability. Column 3: Network and Information Security. Network and link security: Conduct research on anti-interference, anti-blocking, anti-eavesdropping, and other aspects of ship-shore-port, ship-ship, and ship internal networks and data links. System hardware and software security: Conduct research on hardware reinforcement technology for relevant intelligent application systems, as well as security protection research on preventing illegal access, program tampering, and unauthorized manipulation. Ship data security: Focus on the needs of ship intelligent management and control, and carry out research on data encryption, anti-tampering, data recovery, etc.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing network and information security protection capabilities.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Make full use of existing conditions and foundations, break through technologies such as semi-physical environment testing and cross-domain collaborative testing, establish a multi-level comprehensive testing and verification platform covering intelligent devices, intelligent equipment, intelligent systems, and the entire ship, construct a water-based comprehensive test field that meets the requirements of multi-scenario shipboard testing, build a comprehensive testing and verification capability that combines virtual and real, and integrates shore and sea, and create a service system for intelligent ship testing, verification, evaluation, and inspection. Column 4: Testing and Verification. Testing and verification technologies: Conduct research on scenario coordination, high-precision simulators, semi-physical environment testing, cross-domain collaborative testing, etc. Comprehensive testing and verification platform: Focus on research on overall design of test platforms, test basic environment, test scenario library, typical application testing and verification, etc., and develop a comprehensive testing and verification platform that integrates shore and sea. Water-based comprehensive test field: Conduct research on the overall plan of the intelligent ship water-based test field, establish corresponding network communication, high-precision positioning, and stereoscopic perception service networks, and build water-based test basic environments such as traffic control radar, shore-based automatic identification system (AIS) base stations, navigation marks, underwater calibration, electronic fences, and accompanying test ships.
titlelist: Key task, strengthen the construction of testing and verification capabilities.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Actively promote the engineering application of intelligent technology, take the pilot demonstration of new intelligent ships as an example, drive the intelligent transformation and upgrading of operational ships, and continuously expand the application scope of various types of intelligent ships and intelligent system equipment. With technological development as the traction and market demand as the guidance, coordinate the pilot demonstration of various types of intelligent ships in inland, coastal, and ocean areas. Column 6 pilot demonstration. Pilot demonstration of new intelligent ships: carry out pilot demonstrations of intelligent ship integration platforms and application systems such as intelligent navigation, intelligent engine rooms, intelligent hulls, and energy efficiency management, and realize the one platform + N intelligent applications model in three mainstream ship types. Promotion of standardized intelligent system applications: form a product spectrum of the one platform + N intelligent applications model, increase the promotion of applications in inland, coastal, and ocean transportation ships, and promote the intelligent transformation and upgrading of existing operational ships. Pilot application of personalized intelligent systems: carry out pilot applications of personalized intelligent application systems such as auxiliary machinery control, cargo handling, shore support, port firefighting, emergency rescue, and customized services on applicable ship types.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting pilot demonstrations of engineering applications.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Promote ship-shore coordination, promote the construction of shore-based shared cloud service platforms, and achieve information interconnection and interoperability between ships, ship-shore, and ship-port. Focus on the needs of shipping, ports, logistics, and other related industries, and promote intelligent applications in ship navigation, berthing and departure, operation management, cargo handling, and other aspects. Promote the coordinated development of ship design, construction, supporting facilities, operation, inspection, and other related links, gradually build and improve the intelligent ship development ecosystem.
titlelist: Key task: Building a collaborative development ecosystem.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Strengthen the construction of a standardized system for the development, design, manufacturing, supporting, and key component resources of intelligent ships for both military and civilian use. Promote the planning and layout, as well as the joint construction and sharing, of innovation platforms, comprehensive testing and verification platforms, and comprehensive testing sites. Enhance the two-way conversion of military and civilian scientific and technological achievements, promote the widespread application of the Beidou positioning and navigation system in the field of intelligent ships, and facilitate the transformation and application of technologies such as radar, night vision equipment, micro-electromechanical systems, space-based communication systems, and target detection in civilian sectors.
titlelist: Key task: Promote deep integration of military and civilian sectors.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Build an intelligent ship cross-border communication and cooperation platform, gather key enterprises, higher education institutions, research institutes, and supporting suppliers from both inside and outside the industry to carry out technology demand docking, promote reasonable sharing of data resources, and promote practical cooperation and collaborative innovation. Encourage professional enterprises and service organizations in the fields of the Internet, big data, artificial intelligence, etc. to strengthen cooperation with ship and shipping enterprises, provide industry solutions, and promote the best application practices in the industry.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promoting cross-border integration.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Build a variety of high-level talent training platforms, encourage backbone enterprises and scientific research units to rely on major scientific research projects and demonstration application projects, cultivate and introduce a group of leading talents in intelligent ships and outstanding young talents. Strengthen the training of reserve talents, encourage cooperation between enterprises and higher education institutions, optimize discipline and curriculum settings, expand the scale of relevant professional students, and provide intellectual support for the development of intelligent ships.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, accelerate talent cultivation.

name: Intelligent Ship Development Action Plan (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 288) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense/December 27, 2018)
content: Further increase efforts to participate in the work of relevant international organizations, fully utilize intergovernmental bilateral and multilateral cooperation mechanisms, and encourage various forms of international exchanges and cooperation in areas such as intelligent ship technology, industry, and talent development. Build international innovation cooperation mechanisms and platforms, efficiently utilize global innovation resources, accelerate the global allocation of industrial chains, innovation chains, and value chains, and comprehensively enhance the development capabilities of intelligent ships.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen international cooperation.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: After three years of effort, the innovation system and standard system for intelligent ship manufacturing technology have been initially established. The labor intensity of dirty, dangerous, and difficult operations such as cutting, shaping, welding, and painting has been significantly reduced. The number of workers has decreased noticeably. The level of refinement and information integration in shipbuilding enterprise management has significantly improved. 2-3 benchmark enterprises have taken the lead in building several intelligent units, intelligent production lines, and intelligent workshops that are at an internationally advanced level. Backbone enterprises have basically achieved digital shipbuilding, reducing labor hours per gross ton by more than 20% and comprehensive energy consumption per gross ton by 10%. The construction quality and efficiency have reached an international advanced level, laying a solid foundation for the construction of intelligent shipyards. Breakthroughs have been made in a batch of key technologies and intelligent manufacturing equipment. Breakthroughs have been made in five categories of key technologies for intelligent ship manufacturing, including overall, design, process, control, and decision-making. Shortcomings in six types of intelligent manufacturing equipment for shipbuilding have been overcome, including intelligent material cutting for ship body parts, intelligent edge polishing for ship body parts, intelligent welding for small group assembly, intelligent welding for medium group assembly, intelligent spray painting for segmented outer plates, and intelligent processing for pipe fittings. A batch of intelligent manufacturing standards and platforms have been formed. More than 20 shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing standards have been formulated or revised, and more than four trial verification platforms and three public service platforms have been established. A batch of intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, and intelligent workshops have been built. Intelligent manufacturing units have been formed for profile processing, plate processing, segmented sandblasting and rust removal, segmented painting, and VOC treatment. Six types of intelligent production lines for shipbuilding intermediate products have been built, including profile cutting, small group assembly, medium group assembly, flat segmented assembly, pipe processing, and free edge polishing of components. Shipbuilding intelligent workshops have been established for segmented manufacturing, pipe processing, segmented painting, and other processes.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Accelerate the application of technologies such as the Internet of Things, big data, virtual simulation, system collaboration, and artificial intelligence in the construction of intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, and intelligent workshops. Breakthrough a batch of key common technologies in ship intelligent manufacturing, including overall technology, process design, intelligent control, and intelligent decision-making. Develop core supporting software for ship intelligent manufacturing and build an industrial software system for the shipbuilding industry. Column 1 focuses on the research and development of key common technologies in ship intelligent manufacturing. Overall intelligent manufacturing technology: focus on researching and breaking through new models of ship intelligent manufacturing, intelligent manufacturing solutions for ship workshops (such as hull segmentation, pipe processing, segmented coating, etc.), integrated design and control technology for the production line of typical intermediate ship products (profiles, bars, small group assembly, medium group assembly, flat segmentation, and pipe processing), and unified database integration technology. Intelligent process design technology: focus on researching and breaking through process design technologies for intelligent manufacturing of ship components (such as hull component processing and forming technology, small and medium group welding process design technology, hull segmentation outer plate coating process design technology, pipe flange welding process design technology, etc.). Intelligent manufacturing process technology: focus on researching and breaking through technologies such as cutting and forming processes for ship components in intelligent manufacturing, welding processes for complex components, segmented coating processes for ship segments, structural assembly processes for ship hulls, pipe assembly and welding processes, precise installation processes for outfitting components, and shipbuilding process knowledge base. Intelligent control technology for manufacturing processes: focus on researching and breaking through technologies such as unified material coding and management, non-contact (such as laser) online automatic detection, real-time transmission/storage/processing of production site information, workshop operation planning and adaptive adjustment, real-time control of logistics, precision and quality control of shipbuilding, and shipbuilding industry cloud platform technology. Intelligent decision-making technology for key manufacturing processes: focus on researching and breaking through technologies such as visual recognition and automatic positioning of ship structures, adaptive control of welding robots, multi-robot collaborative operation in ship intelligent manufacturing, online calibration and error compensation of intelligent manufacturing equipment, and in-situ detection of ship intelligent manufacturing quality. Industrial software for intelligent manufacturing: focus on the development of three-dimensional design software based on unified models, numerical analysis and visualization simulation software, data-driven process and production logistics simulation software, workshop manufacturing execution systems (MES) and manufacturing operations management (MOM) system software, and big data management and real-time data intelligent processing system software.
titlelist: Key tasks: Tackle the key common technologies and weak equipment in intelligent manufacturing, and break through the key common technologies in intelligent manufacturing of ships.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: In response to the dirty, dangerous, difficult, and repetitive processes such as cutting, forming, welding, and painting of ship components during the shipbuilding process, as well as key processes such as inspection, assembly, logistics, and warehousing, we have developed a batch of specialized intelligent manufacturing equipment for shipbuilding. This is to meet the needs of shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing units and intelligent production line construction, and to achieve engineering application and industrialization, supporting the automation, digitization, and intelligent operation of key shipbuilding processes. Column 2 focuses on the development of intelligent equipment for shipbuilding. Intelligent cutting and forming equipment includes intelligent cutting equipment for profiles, intelligent material handling and polishing equipment for ship components, and intelligent equipment for three-dimensional forming of ribs and curved plates. Intelligent assembly and welding equipment includes intelligent welding equipment for small assemblies, intelligent welding equipment for medium assemblies, intelligent welding equipment for pipe flanges, and high-power laser composite welding equipment. Intelligent painting equipment includes VOC-efficient and energy-saving intelligent treatment devices, intelligent dust-free sandblasting and rust removal devices, and intelligent equipment for painting ship exteriors. Intelligent logistics and warehousing equipment includes equipment for identifying and automatically sorting ship components, as well as AGV carts for transporting ship pallets.
titlelist: Key tasks include conquering the key common technologies and weak equipment in intelligent manufacturing, and developing intelligent weak equipment for key processes.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: The text translates to English as follows:The system construction covers the intermediate product system and the integrity standards for the intermediate product coating of the entire shipbuilding process. Implement a pull-driven engineering planning management, establish production period and quantity standards for intermediate products, establish a work hour management system that adapts to the intelligent shipbuilding new model, and achieve quantified lean management. Construct an enterprise shipbuilding accuracy compensation model and database, promote the use of compensation quantity instead of allowance, extend shipbuilding accuracy control from hull assembly process to cutting and processing process, and extend from hull engineering to outfitting engineering, and promote the manufacturing of the entire process without allowance.
titlelist: Key tasks, solidify the foundation of intelligent ship manufacturing, promote refined and digitized basic management and control.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Transform shipyard enterprise internal network, realize the interconnection of various systems such as ship design, manufacturing, management, and services; accelerate the integration and innovative application of industrial internet identification and resolution, promote real-time collection and transmission of massive and heterogeneous data information in shipbuilding processes such as (design) digital flow, (personnel) work flow, logistics, capital flow, energy consumption, equipment, personnel, etc., form an efficient and reliable shipyard industrial internet network infrastructure, strengthen enterprise network and data security capabilities; make every effort to promote the construction of cloud service platforms for ship design, manufacturing, management, and services, and promote the integration of enterprise information and collaborative operation of the industrial chain. Column 3 focuses on shipyard information infrastructure construction. Shipyard network infrastructure. Utilize fiber optic communication, 4G/5G mobile communication, short-range wireless communication, as well as fieldbus, industrial Ethernet, industrial wireless, and other communication network technologies to construct and transform internal and external networks of enterprises. Strengthen the application of satellite communication and positioning systems to achieve comprehensive collection and transmission of shipyard data. Shipbuilding multi-source data collection system. Establish a real-time data collection system, structured and unstructured data collection system, to provide data foundation for big data technology applications. Focus on solving real-time data collection of shipbuilding progress, quality, equipment status, energy consumption, logistics, personnel positioning, vehicle tracking, equipment monitoring, etc. based on Internet of Things technology. Shipbuilding manufacturing cloud platform. Gradually build a shipbuilding industry cloud platform, form a cloud application cluster covering the industry value chain, break through geographical, organizational, and technological boundaries, integrate and aggregate, open, and share various elements and resources, promote manufacturing resource docking and optimization configuration, connect the information flow, business flow, and capital flow of the industrial chain, promote collaborative innovation and ecological development of the industrial chain, and promote the formation of new manufacturing models such as cloud manufacturing, smart factories, personalized customization, and service-oriented manufacturing.
titlelist: Key tasks, solidify the foundation of intelligent ship manufacturing, and build shipyard information infrastructure.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Docking with the national intelligent manufacturing standard system, focusing on the characteristics of the shipbuilding industry, constructing a shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing standard system. Following the principle of urgent use first, emphasis is placed on promoting the research of intelligent manufacturing standards from six aspects: overall planning, intelligent design, intelligent process, intelligent equipment, intelligent management, and interconnection. This includes the construction of a standard test verification platform (system), conducting full-process test verification of technical specifications and standards, and forming strong standard support. Column 4 focuses on the construction of the shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing standard system. Shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing basic common standards include standards such as terminology, symbols, coding, identification, models, metadata, and data dictionaries, as well as standards for information security, data security, network security, system security, and functional safety. It also includes standards for testing requirements, testing equipment, indicator systems, and evaluation methods. Ship product collaborative design standards include standards for design drawing, data generation, geometric information and attribute information, model naming, and coding principles. It also includes standards for plant collaboration and data collaboration, as well as standards for model definition, model simplification and processing, and model classification and output. Shipbuilding intelligent process design standards include requirements for digital process design integrity and three-dimensional modeling, standards for three-dimensional model design data exchange and data interface, requirements for intelligent processing, assembly, and welding process design of ship components, requirements for product data management for intelligent manufacturing, requirements for construction process simulation, and requirements for the preparation of three-dimensional operation guides for on-site operations. Shipbuilding intelligent process standards include standards for intelligent process testing, process knowledge modeling, design of process knowledge databases, process decision evaluation, process information integration, and other process specifications. It also includes standards for profile processing, plate cold and hot processing, joint welding, straight component welding, ship section welding, pipe fabrication, intelligent coating, coating, and intelligent detection, and other typical operation process specifications. Intelligent equipment standards include plasma cutting machines, intelligent cutting equipment for profiles, CNC forming equipment for plates, and other cutting processing equipment. It also includes standards for the identification and sensing of welding equipment such as CO2 semi-automatic welding machines and assembly intelligent welding equipment, as well as data interface standards and control system standards. Intelligent management standards include standards for the design, process simulation, and information integration application of ship section intelligent workshops, precision control of intermediate product manufacturing, job planning, classification and coding of storage materials, information collection and control, quality control, and integration of workshop MES and ERP/PDM.
titlelist: Key tasks, solidify the foundation of intelligent ship manufacturing, establish a standard system for intelligent ship manufacturing.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Research and establish unified design standards, toolkits, basic resource libraries, and management processes, forming a software system for three-dimensional digital design and process design. Establish an interactive data flow from three-dimensional design to the production site, promote three-dimensional process visualization and simulation for on-site operations, and facilitate model-based design/process/manufacturing collaboration.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the full three-dimensional digital design, promote the construction of a model-based digital design system.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Research and master key technologies such as ship product data organization for intelligent manufacturing, integration of ship production design system data, refined work hour and material quantity management, design process information management, design and material coding mapping, and the correlation between work hour and material quantity and task packages/work orders (WP/WO). Formulate a ship product data management system (PDM) for intelligent manufacturing applications, enhance the level of ship design data management, and accelerate the unified management and integrated application of production design data.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the full three-dimensional digital design, promote the informatization of ship product data management.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Based on a single data source for ships, using three-dimensional visualization technology, establish an integrated three-dimensional digital model that includes design information, drawing review information, process information, operation and maintenance information, etc., to connect the data chain of the ship's entire life cycle. Promote the full-element, full-life cycle design, submission, construction, inspection, management, and operation and maintenance based on an integrated data source, adapt to the data requirements of ship owners' operations, and promote the digital delivery of completed products. Column 5 focuses on promoting the work of full three-dimensional digital design. Coordinate preliminary design, detailed design, and production design. Propose methods for preliminary design and detailed design of three-dimensional models based on a unified database, as well as a three-dimensional model submission mode and three-dimensional drawing review method. Introduce the data specifications and data interface standards for submitting and withdrawing three-dimensional model data, and realize preliminary design, detailed design, and drawing review based on three-dimensional models. Master key technologies such as segment generation for production design, coordination of detailed and production design models for typical ship structures, and coordination of piping and electrical principle design with production design. Achieve seamless integration of detailed design and production design model data, and integrate and coordinate ship detailed design and production design business and systems. Ship intelligent process design. Research and establish model export interface software for multi-type design software, welding process and path automatic planning software, offline programming of welding process based on three-dimensional models, and online programming software system based on laser scanning, supporting intelligent operations such as ship steel cutting, small and medium group welding, and segment painting. Ship intelligent manufacturing process and database application. Around key process links such as profile processing, plate processing, pipe processing assembly and welding, component casting and forging processing, component assembly and welding, and segment painting, establish a three-dimensional design intelligent process database to effectively manage new processes and meet the precise use requirements of ship intelligent manufacturing for processes. Three-dimensional process visualization simulation for on-site operations. Master key technologies such as process visualization design based on three-dimensional models, organization and storage of large-scale product design data, etc., build a ship three-dimensional operation guidance system and a workshop three-dimensional operation guidance platform, create a new mode of ship process guidance based on three-dimensional models, and improve shipbuilding efficiency. Ship product data management system. Break through technologies such as ship production design data organization, integration of ship production design system data, fine management of work hours and material quantities, design process information management, design and material coding mapping, and the correlation between work hours and material quantities with WP/WO, and build a product data management system.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting full 3D digital design, promoting 3D digital delivery.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: The key focus is on the processing, distribution, assembly, welding, and painting processes in shipbuilding. We promote the digital modeling of workshop overall design, process flow, and layout, analyzing and optimizing the process flow and end-to-end data flow of each process, production line, and workshop to adapt to the requirements of intelligent manufacturing. This aims to achieve the organic integration of logistics and information flow. By combining dedicated fixtures and automated, intelligent equipment that match the functions of production stations, we aim to create production stations where personnel, equipment, and information are coordinated. We utilize big data technology to analyze and mine the massive data generated during the production process, achieving continuous optimization and improvement of shipbuilding processes.
titlelist: Key task: Accelerate the construction of intelligent workshops and continuously optimize shipbuilding process.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: With shipbuilding segment manufacturing as the focus, strengthen the digital and network transformation of bottom-level equipment, comprehensively promote the digital and intelligent upgrading and construction of the ship's intermediate product assembly line, and gradually realize the digital and intelligent flow-line batch production of various intermediate products such as parts, small groups, medium groups, flat segments, and pipes.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the construction of intelligent workshops, accelerate the construction of intelligent production lines for intermediate products.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Based on the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform, accelerate the construction of the Intelligent Workshop Manufacturing Execution System (MES), achieve closed-loop management of shipyard workshop planning, scheduling, equipment, production, and efficiency throughout the process, and achieve efficient collaboration and integration with the Enterprise Resource Planning platform.
titlelist: Key task, accelerate the construction of intelligent workshops, and build workshop manufacturing execution systems.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Promote the workshop interconnection platform and intelligent control system construction, forming an intelligent workshop that integrates functions such as planning management, process collaboration, equipment control, resource optimization, quality control, and decision support. Accelerate the application demonstration in key processes such as ship sectioning, pipe processing, and section painting, and establish industry benchmarks.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the construction of intelligent workshops, and promote the demonstration of digital workshop applications.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Based on an integrated data source, fully integrate the Product Data Management System (PDM), Enterprise Resource Planning System (ERP), and Manufacturing Execution System (MES), establish an information channel connecting design, manufacturing, management, and service, and achieve information integration and continuous optimization of key processes such as design, production, and management.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the digitization, integration, and service of shipbuilding; advance the integration of design, production, and management information.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Promote the construction of the industrial internet in the shipbuilding industry, accelerate the promotion and application of systems such as customer relationship management, supply chain management, and remote operation and maintenance services. Gradually establish an information chain between ship owners, design companies, ship inspection agencies, and suppliers, in order to achieve seamless cooperation and effective information integration and management between enterprises, and lay a solid foundation for the development of service-oriented manufacturing.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the digital integration and services of shipbuilding, strengthen the information integration of the shipbuilding industry chain.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Build a big data platform for shipbuilding process, promote the research and innovative application of technologies such as storage, analysis, visualization, pattern recognition, and artificial intelligence decision-making for shipbuilding process big data. Provide technical support for intelligent equipment operation, workshop intelligent control, and enterprise intelligent decision-making, significantly improving the decision-making level and management efficiency of shipyards' production process.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the digitization, integration, and services of shipbuilding; explore shipbuilding big data analysis and decision-making.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Make full use of existing channels, increase support for key technologies research, standard formulation, intelligent manufacturing equipment development, industrial software development, and industry-specific big data center construction in ship intelligent manufacturing.
