Support the construction of intelligent testing and verification platforms, carry out verification of ship intelligent manufacturing processes, equipment, software, key technologies, standards, etc., and encourage their development into industry public service platforms. Encourage shipbuilding enterprises to actively collaborate with equipment manufacturing enterprises, establish innovation consortia, and accelerate the research and development, engineering, and industrialization of intelligent manufacturing equipment. Make full use of relevant policies on the first set of major technological equipment and industrial internet demonstration applications to promote innovative applications of ship intelligent manufacturing equipment.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen support for innovation and demonstration applications.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Encourage policy banks and development financial institutions to increase their financing support for the intelligent transformation of shipbuilding. Encourage commercial financial institutions to provide financing conditions for shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing projects based on controllable risks and commercial sustainability. Encourage the establishment of a shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing development fund to guide social capital participation in the research and development and industrialization promotion of key technologies and equipment for shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial support.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: In order to meet the development needs of intelligent manufacturing in the shipbuilding industry, promote division of labor cooperation and collaborative innovation between shipbuilding enterprises and different companies in the fields of intelligent manufacturing equipment, automation, information technology, etc. Relying on the Shipbuilding Industry Sub-Alliance of the China Intelligent Manufacturing System Solution Provider Alliance, explore the recommendation and working mechanism of system solution providers in the shipbuilding industry, gradually cultivate several shipbuilding industry intelligent manufacturing system solution providers with certain influence at home and abroad, and enhance the innovation and service capabilities of shipbuilding intelligent manufacturing.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, vigorously cultivate system solution providers.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Encourage and support universities, institutes, and enterprises with conditions to establish ship intelligent manufacturing training platforms, and carry out the cultivation of related management and technical talents. Encourage universities to develop ship intelligent manufacturing discipline systems and talent cultivation systems, and establish ship intelligent manufacturing talent demand forecasting and information service platforms. Encourage key enterprises to rely on national major scientific research projects and demonstration application projects to introduce and cultivate high-level leading talents in ship intelligent manufacturing.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the construction of talent teams.

name: Action Plan for Promoting the Intelligent Transformation of Shipbuilding General Assembly Construction (2019-2021) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2018] No. 287) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Defense Science and Technology Bureau/December 27, 2018)
content: Encouraging shipbuilding enterprises, research institutes, and foreign institutions to engage in multi-level, comprehensive, and cross-industry technological exchanges and cooperation in the research and development, standard formulation, and demonstration application of ship intelligent manufacturing technology and equipment. At the same time, actively participating in the research and formulation of relevant international rules and standards, promoting a significant improvement in China's shipbuilding industry's level of intelligent manufacturing.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepening international exchange and cooperation.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: Healthy seawater aquaculture, deep-water anti-wind and wave net cage aquaculture, and factory-scale circulating water aquaculture, new types of fishery aquaculture equipment, large-scale integrated cold chain logistics projects (bases), offshore fishery facility equipment, overseas fishery comprehensive service bases, fishery administration and fishery port infrastructure construction, deep-sea oil and gas exploration and development, merger, reorganization, transformation, and production conversion of marine shipbuilding enterprises.
titlelist: Strengthen support for key areas of the marine economy, and transform and upgrade traditional marine industries.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:The research and manufacturing of deep-sea resource development engineering equipment, yacht equipment manufacturing, marine renewable energy equipment, seawater desalination equipment, marine environmental protection (monitoring, remediation) equipment, the research and industrialization of marine innovative drugs, modern marine traditional Chinese medicine products, new marine biological functional products, marine characteristic enzyme preparations, marine biotechnology products, and marine biological materials; the industrialization and scale demonstration projects of seawater desalination, offshore wind farms, marine renewable energy demonstration projects, and island multi-energy complementary demonstration projects.
titlelist: Strengthen support for key areas of the marine economy, and cultivate and develop emerging marine industries.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:The construction of coastal port infrastructure, port logistics parks, inland dry ports, and intermodal transportation systems; the transformation and upgrading of coastal ports, the construction of specialized berths, deepwater channels, and port logistics systems; the construction of fishing ports, disaster prevention and reduction, and law enforcement infrastructure along the coast; the construction of deepwater port marine structures, submarine cables, optical cables, and underwater pipeline laying; underwater tunnel projects; construction of offshore factories, airports, artificial islands, and other engineering structures; construction of underwater warehouses; and the construction of marine entertainment facilities and landscape engineering.
titlelist: Strengthen support for key areas of the marine economy, and focus on the construction of major marine infrastructure.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: Key support will be provided for the modern maritime service industry, the construction of the Northern International Shipping Core Area in Tianjin, distinctive coastal tourism, high-end cruise and yacht tourism, the development of marine leisure tourism, the construction of ecological petrochemical industrial bases, the construction of the Tianjin Binhai New Area and the Hebei Caofeidian seawater desalination and comprehensive utilization base, the salt chemical industry, high-end marine vessel and equipment manufacturing industry, the construction of shipping finance, a national maritime financing leasing asset platform, and the Northern (Tianjin) Shipping Exchange, the construction of a national marine cultural exhibition and aggregation area, creative industry demonstration zones, and marine ecological restoration and rehabilitation, among others.
titlelist: Strengthen financial support for the development of the marine economy in key areas, including the northern marine economic zone, the coastal areas and waters of the Bohai Bay.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: Key support will be given to the construction of a modern maritime shipping service system centered around Lianyungang, Yancheng Port, Nantong Port, and other major ports along the Yangtze River. This includes the manufacturing of high-end marine vessels and supporting equipment, marine equipment manufacturing, factory-scale circular water aquaculture, coastal agriculture, forestry, and fishery on tidal flats, offshore wind power development, marine pharmaceuticals and bioproducts, seawater utilization industry, marine tourism industry, marine cultural and creative industries, coastal wetland, Huaizhou Bay, Lusi Fishing Ground marine ecological restoration and rehabilitation, and more.
titlelist: Strengthen financial support for the development of the marine economy in key areas, including the eastern marine economic zone, the coastal areas of Jiangsu, and offshore areas.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: Key support will be provided for the construction of the Shanghai International Shipping Center, the development of the International Shipping Development Comprehensive Experimental Zone, and the cruise yacht industry. This includes the design, construction, and production of high-tech vessels such as economic, marine engineering equipment, and large cruise ships, as well as the supporting industries for cruise ship production and services. It also includes comprehensive pollution control and ecological protection in the Yangtze River Estuary and Hangzhou Bay nearshore areas, as well as ecological restoration and rehabilitation in Fengxian, Chongming Island, and Dajinshan Island.
titlelist: Strengthen financial support for the development of the marine economy in key areas, including the eastern marine economic zone, Shanghai's coastal areas, and offshore areas.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: Key support will be given to the construction of the China (Zhejiang) Free Trade Pilot Zone, the Zhoushan River-Sea Intermodal Transportation Center, the Ningbo-Zhoushan Hub Port Bulk Commodity Reserve Processing and Trading Base, and the International Maritime Shipping Service Base. Other areas of focus include the construction of the Zhoushan Green Petrochemical Industry Base, the development of the Deep Ocean and Deep Sea Scientific Research and Development Base, the research and development of deep-sea equipment, deep-water anti-wave net cage aquaculture, marine biotechnology research, the construction of offshore fishery bases, the establishment of pilot zones for fishery transformation and development, and the construction of marine biotechnology industrial bases. Additionally, support will be provided for the research and development of high-tech ships and marine engineering equipment, the research platform for seawater utilization and seawater resource development and utilization projects, the construction of pilot and industrialization bases for product testing, the establishment of the Zhoushan National Tidal Energy Test Field, and the development of marine culture and leisure tourism industry.
titlelist: Strengthen financial support for the development of the marine economy in key areas, including the eastern marine economic zone, Zhejiang coastal areas and waters.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of the Marine Economy (excerpt) (Natural Resources Development [2018] No. 63) (Ministry of Natural Resources, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China / August 29, 2018)
content: Key support will be provided for the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the development of Shenzhen as a global marine center city, and the development of port logistics, coastal tourism, marine information services, and marine public services. This includes deep-sea oil and gas exploration and development, comprehensive processing and utilization, as well as the development and utilization of natural gas hydrates. Other areas of focus include the construction of modern fishing port economic zones, factory-scale circular water aquaculture, deep-water anti-wind and wave net cage aquaculture, deep-sea fishing, marine vessel and marine engineering equipment industries, the construction of shipbuilding supporting bases in Guangzhou and Jiangmen, yacht manufacturing bases in Zhuhai, Dongguan, Zhongshan, marine drugs and bioproducts, offshore wind power, the construction of the Wanshan National Wave Energy Test Field, industrial water use such as seawater as a circulating cooling water, intensive development of coastal petrochemicals, energy, and the ecological restoration of the marine environment in the Pan-Pearl River Delta region.
titlelist: Strengthen financial support for the development of the marine economy in key areas, including the southern marine economic zone, the Pearl River Estuary, and the coastal areas and waters of eastern and western Guangdong.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening Reform and Promoting High-Quality Development of Ship Inspection (Excerpt) (Jiao Hai Fa [2020] No. 84) (Ministry of Transport/September 11, 2020)
content: Focus on the forefront of technology such as next-generation intelligent shipping, new materials, and new energy, strengthen the forward-looking and disruptive technological research that may trigger the transformation of the marine equipment manufacturing industry and shipping industry, and adapt to the needs of industry innovation and development. Conduct research on large-scale liquefied natural gas ships, cruise ships, polar navigation ships, large-scale oil spill recovery ships, and large-scale deep-sea multi-functional rescue ships, as well as related technical regulations. Promote the technological application of the Beidou satellite navigation system.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the innovation of cutting-edge and key technologies.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: By 2020, China's international competitiveness and sustainable development capabilities in the marine engineering equipment manufacturing industry have significantly improved. The industrial system has been further improved, with increasing specialization, serialization, informatization, and intelligentization. The product structure is moving towards the mid-to-high-end market, striving to become an advanced country in the overall assembly and manufacturing of marine engineering equipment.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: The international competitiveness of high-end products such as offshore oil and gas production platforms has significantly improved; significant progress has been made in the research, development, and application of emerging marine engineering equipment such as offshore wind power equipment, marine fishery equipment, deep-sea mineral resource development equipment, and marine electronic information equipment; a number of competitive new industrial demonstration bases have been established in the field of marine engineering equipment.
titlelist: Development goals, significant achievements in structural adjustment.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Basic mastery of the construction technology of deep-sea oil and gas resource development equipment, comprehensive improvement in equipment economy, safety and reliability, environmental friendliness, and intelligence level, forming advantages in certain areas. Breakthroughs have been made in mining equipment for marine mineral resources, natural gas hydrates, etc., as well as in the development of series of detection equipment such as manned/unmanned submersibles capable of reaching depths of 10,000 meters. Integrated information systems for island/anchorage floating platforms, comprehensive experimental ships for offshore operations, and other integrated information basic equipment for ocean sensing and communication have been developed. Key core technologies for the development of equipment for the exploitation of marine renewable resources such as wave energy/tidal energy, temperature difference energy, as well as for the development of equipment for the exploitation of marine chemical resources such as seawater desalination and lithium extraction from seawater have been achieved. The research and development capabilities and technological reserves for polar marine engineering equipment have been significantly enhanced.
titlelist: Development goals, significantly improving research and development design capabilities.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: In the fields of deck machinery, drilling packages, platform lifting systems, oil and gas production modules, liquefied natural gas (LNG) loading and unloading systems, etc., several brands have been formed. In the fields of deepwater mooring systems, dynamic positioning systems, deepwater pipe-laying systems, underwater operation systems, umbilical cables and flexible risers, LNG transportation and re-gasification systems, marine observation/monitoring equipment, underwater carriers, and offshore communication network equipment, design, construction, and application have been achieved, realizing demonstration applications of underwater production systems within 500 meters.
titlelist: Development goals, key system and equipment research and development capabilities significantly enhanced.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Initially form 2-3 marine engineering integrated solution providers and general contractors, and form 4-5 world-class marine engineering equipment assembly and construction enterprises and several specialized subcontractors.
titlelist: Development goals, significant improvement in the strength of excellent and strong enterprises.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Intensify the efforts of adjustment and restructuring. Strengthen industry supervision, raise industry standard requirements, utilize market forces to guide the aggregation of social resources towards enterprises that meet the 'Marine Engineering Equipment (Platform Class) Industry Standard Conditions', and accelerate the transformation and exit of backward enterprises. Encourage and promote the strong alliance, specialized restructuring, mergers and acquisitions, and internal resource integration of marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises (groups), optimize resource allocation, reduce excess low-end production capacity, and enhance the core competitiveness of backbone enterprises. Optimize the layout of the industrial chain. Take the national demonstration base for new industrialization (marine engineering equipment) and enterprises that meet the 'Marine Engineering Equipment (Platform Class) Industry Standard Conditions' as the main carriers, actively extend the industrial service chain, expand the development of the industrial chain with engineering services as the main focus, transform from a development model that solely provides products to a model that provides 'products + services', and gradually expand into service areas such as offshore construction operations. Develop a group of specialized subcontractors with strong international competitiveness in fields such as engineering design, module design and manufacturing, and equipment supply, establish an industrial chain collaboration system, and gradually cultivate the general contracting capability of marine engineering enterprises. Actively develop technical service industries such as research and development experimentation (testing) services, engineering technical services, installation and commissioning services, comprehensive integration services, marine network and information operation services, technology transfer, and scientific and technological consulting, and accelerate the development of financial, insurance, legal, and other related services for the marine engineering equipment manufacturing industry.
titlelist: Key tasks, intensify efforts to adjust the structure.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Innovative business models promote 'delivery'. Encourage cooperation among oil and gas development companies, oilfield service companies, marine engineering equipment manufacturing companies, financial institutions, insurance companies, etc., actively introduce multiple sources of capital, innovate business models, leverage the strengths of all parties, and through fund investment, financing leasing, asset restructuring, equipment operation, and other businesses, establish a mechanism for sharing benefits and sharing risks, and promote the delivery and operation of marine engineering equipment. Strengthen risk control to ensure 'delivery of ships'. Marine engineering equipment manufacturing companies should strengthen and improve the risk control throughout the project process, and reduce the risk factors of default by the companies themselves. Support backbone marine engineering equipment manufacturing companies to coordinate and promote ongoing projects based on specific customer needs, help customers solve difficulties in financing and operational leasing, and create conditions for equipment delivery.
titlelist: Key tasks, multiple measures to reduce 'inventory'

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Vigorously cultivate core advantages and supporting products. Through independent research and development, patent introduction, joint ventures, mergers and acquisitions, and other forms, focus on the development of large-scale mooring systems, deepwater lifting equipment, deployment and towing systems, heave compensation systems, dynamic positioning systems, and other general supporting equipment and systems. Develop key equipment and systems for drilling equipment, such as drilling packages, riser systems, and self-elevating drilling platform lifting systems. Develop key equipment and systems for offshore oil and gas production, such as oil and gas treatment equipment and systems, LNG loading and unloading systems, natural gas liquefaction and LNG re-gasification systems, single point mooring systems, umbilical cables, and flexible risers. Develop key supporting equipment and systems for marine engineering vessels, such as diving support systems, pipe-laying equipment, and geophysical exploration equipment. Accelerate the design and manufacturing of marine observation and monitoring equipment, marine communication and navigation equipment, saturation diving equipment, deep-sea salvage equipment, and others. Strengthen the construction of equipment testing and verification capabilities and demonstration applications. Establish national-level testing and verification platforms, construct and improve infrastructure with stability and durability testing and verification capabilities for core equipment and systems, and establish a mechanism for sharing and co-building. Strengthen communication and cooperation with international testing and verification institutions, oil and gas companies, equipment operators, and network operators. With major engineering demonstration projects as a driving force, strengthen cooperation between marine engineering equipment supporting enterprises and general assembly construction enterprises, promote the application of supporting equipment and system installation on ships, and provide support for industrialization.
titlelist: Key tasks, breakthrough bottlenecks and fill gaps.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Continuously strengthen enterprise management. Innovate and optimize the management model of marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises, strengthen the management of marine engineering projects, optimize the management systems of design, procurement, construction, and commissioning, and improve the operational efficiency of various stages of the projects. Strengthen integrated management, enhance the efficiency of comprehensive decision-making and intelligent management of projects. Establish a sound risk prevention and control system to comprehensively and effectively manage market risks, financial risks, technical risks, and legal risks. Actively promote intelligent manufacturing. In response to the customization and diversification characteristics of marine engineering equipment, combined with the design and construction resources and capabilities of marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises, carry out overall planning and top-level design, and implement step by step. Actively utilize next-generation information and communication technologies, accelerate the integration and development with the Internet, and improve the digitization, networking, and intelligence level of marine engineering equipment manufacturing. Build a three-dimensional design digital model from basic design, detailed design to production design. Apply virtual simulation technology to rationalize the allocation of manufacturing resources. For key processes with high labor consumption and low production efficiency, carry out research and development and promote the application of automated equipment, continuously improve the level of digitization and automation, and gradually establish an intelligent and flexible production system. Strengthen network information security management and establish a comprehensive security guarantee system. Strengthen quality control and standardization construction. Attach great importance to the quality and safety reliability of marine engineering equipment and devices, promote the establishment of a quality management system and technical standard system covering the entire product life cycle. Strengthen precision management in the design and construction stages, apply non-destructive testing, optical scanning, and intelligent identification technologies, strengthen product quality monitoring and on-site monitoring of the production process; develop a remote operation and maintenance platform for real-time monitoring of equipment operating status, research and develop equipment self-diagnosis and fault warning system platforms, and realize post-sales quality tracking management and services. Based on the shipbuilding industry and petroleum equipment standardization system, combined with the development direction of marine engineering products and business, taking into account the dual needs of military and civilian, align with international standards, and accelerate the revision of relevant standards in key areas.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen foundation, create brand.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Strengthen international cooperation. Combine with the national 'Belt and Road' initiative, deepen exchanges and cooperation with countries along the route, encourage qualified domestic backbone marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises and supporting enterprises to establish joint ventures in countries with marine oil and gas resources along the route, get closer to the market, and accelerate equipment manufacturing cooperation. Support qualified enterprises to issue stocks, bonds, engage in venture capital investment, establish research and development centers and experimental bases overseas. Encourage the use of the global marketing network and e-commerce platforms of backbone enterprises to jointly build and share a global marketing and service system. Encourage and attract leading foreign marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises, design enterprises, engineering companies, supporting businesses, etc., to establish global research and development institutions in China. Strengthen technical exchanges and international project cooperation. Encourage domestic advantageous enterprises to participate widely in bidding for marine engineering projects worldwide, and form joint bids with internationally renowned engineering technology enterprises, engineering general contracting enterprises, core system/module design and manufacturing enterprises, etc., to accumulate experience, cultivate talents, and enhance international competitiveness and influence. Encourage Chinese marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises to cooperate with major international marine oil companies, oilfield service enterprises, marine engineering general contractors, engineering design enterprises, core supporting/system providers, classification societies, etc., to strengthen exchanges and learning, and jointly carry out the revision of international standards and specifications. Encourage qualified enterprises and research institutes to cooperate with internationally renowned professional institutions or companies to establish specialized research institutions or companies for marine engineering equipment.
titlelist: Key tasks, comprehensive opening to promote development.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Encourage financial institutions to support high-quality marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises that temporarily encounter repayment difficulties on the basis of legal compliance, controllable risks, and sustainable business; support marine resource development enterprises and marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises that meet the conditions to raise funds and issue various debt financing instruments domestically and overseas; encourage the market-oriented debt-to-equity conversion for high-quality marine engineering equipment enterprises with good development prospects but temporary difficulties.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial support.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration/November 27, 2017)
content: Support domestic oil and gas development enterprises to accelerate the scrapping of old marine engineering equipment, or to transform and reuse old equipment, and to acquire delayed or cancelled products domestically, in order to achieve equipment renewal. Accelerate the development and utilization of marine resources, expedite the commercialization of natural gas hydrate extraction, promote the construction of offshore information infrastructure, implement offshore wind power development projects, support the development of deep-sea fishing and aquaculture, and the construction of marine tourism facilities. Encourage more enterprises to participate in the development of marine resources.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, expanding effective demand for marine engineering equipment.

name: Action Plan for the Sustainable and Healthy Development of the Marine Engineering Equipment Manufacturing Industry (2017-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2017] No. 298) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration / November 27, 2017)
content: Give full play to the role of industry organizations, professional institutions, and relevant think tanks such as the China Deep-sea Offshore Engineering Equipment Technology Industry Alliance, China Association of Shipbuilding Industry, China Society of Naval Architects and Marine Engineers, and China Classification Society. Strengthen industry self-discipline, guide enterprises to operate in a standardized and rational manner, and safeguard industry interests. Research and publish the marine engineering equipment industry prosperity index to guide market expectations. Promote domestic and international exchanges and cooperation, act as a bridge and link, and timely reflect market information and enterprise demands to government departments.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, leverage the role of industry organizations and professional institutions, strengthen industry self-discipline.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Promote the development and construction of key islands. Continue to promote the development and construction of the Zhoushan Islands New Area in Zhejiang, the Pingtan Comprehensive Experimental Zone in Fujian, and the Hengqin Island in Guangdong. The Zhoushan Islands New Area in Zhejiang focuses on developing the port logistics industry, high-end shipbuilding and marine engineering equipment manufacturing industry, marine tourism industry, comprehensive development and utilization of marine resources, modern marine fishing industry, and marine tourism industry. Accelerate the construction of the Zhoushan Free Trade Port Zone and the Green Petrochemical Park, and build a major center for the storage, transportation, processing, and trading of bulk commodities in China, an important open gateway for the eastern region, an important base for modern marine industries, a demonstration zone for the comprehensive protection and development of marine islands, and a pilot zone for coordinated land-sea development. The Pingtan Comprehensive Experimental Zone in Fujian focuses on developing the tourism industry, high-tech industries, marine industries, and modern service industries. Actively promote cross-strait cultural exchanges, connectivity, industrial cooperation, and social integration, and make efforts to build a common home for both sides of the strait. Accelerate the construction of Pingtan International Tourism Island, the high-tech industry base on the west bank of the Taiwan Strait, the gathering area for modern service industries, the demonstration base for marine economy, and the internationally renowned island tourism and leisure destination. Hengqin Island in Guangdong focuses on developing tourism, leisure and health, business and financial services, cultural education, science and technology industries. Build a leading area for cultural and educational openness and an international business service and leisure tourism base, and create a new carrier to promote moderate and diversified development of the Macao economy. Develop nearshore islands in a reasonable manner. With protection as the core, intensively and efficiently utilize the resources of nearshore islands, control the scale and intensity of development in islands and surrounding waters, develop characteristic island ecological economies according to local conditions, support desalination and comprehensive utilization projects for island seawater, encourage the development of renewable energy such as solar energy, wave energy, and tidal energy on islands, and promote green, circular, and low-carbon development. Accelerate the opening-up of islands with conditions on the premise of protecting resources and the environment. Support the development of remote islands. Develop marine fisheries, cruise tourism, and ecological tourism based on the location and development conditions of remote islands and reefs. Strengthen the construction of infrastructure such as ports, terminals, airports, roads, communications, water supply, power supply, sewage treatment, as well as public service facilities such as schools and hospitals on remote islands, and improve living conditions and the residential environment for residents. Establish marine observation and scientific experiment stations. Strictly protect and manage island resources. Protect island ecosystems, maintain ecological balance in islands and surrounding waters, implement ecological restoration for islands with high levels of development and environmental damage. Standardize the construction of new island projects and implement a negative list for industrial access in key islands. Strictly regulate the use of uninhabited islands, establish a list of uninhabited islands that can be developed and utilized, and establish and improve relevant systems for the paid use of uninhabited islands. Encourage coastal provinces to explore and promote the market-oriented transfer of islands for commercial use based on their actual conditions. Strengthen the protection and management of islands with public facilities such as navigation and observation.
titlelist: Optimizing the layout of marine economic development, island development and conservation.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Continue to carry out international deep-sea mineral resource surveys and assessments, actively promote applications for new mining areas. Strengthen environmental investigations and evaluations of international exploration areas, navigational areas, and typical regions. Focus on enhancing deep-sea technological equipment capabilities, implementing the Jiaolong Deep-Sea Exploration project, conducting in-depth surveys and assessments of deep-sea biological resources, and establishing a national deep-sea biological resource repository and service platform. Promote the industrialization of deep-sea mining, deep-sea equipment manufacturing, and deep-sea biological resource utilization. Innovate international marine area management mechanisms, shifting from national-led to nationally-led and widely participated international marine resource surveys and development. Conduct comprehensive examinations and potential assessments of polar environments, and implement the Xuelong Polar Exploration project. Column 1: Xuelong Polar Exploration and Jiaolong Deep-Sea Exploration. Construct new shore-based observation stations for Arctic cooperation, establish new scientific research stations in Antarctica, build advanced icebreakers, enhance Antarctic aviation capabilities, and preliminarily establish a land-sea-air observation platform for polar regions. Develop detection technologies and equipment suitable for polar environments, establish information on polar environments and resource potential, and develop business applications and service platforms. Breakthrough key technologies in the construction of the Dragon Palace No. 1 deep-sea experimental platform, and construct mobile and bottom-sitting deep-sea experimental platforms. Develop a deep-sea detection system that integrates environmental monitoring and activity detection. Promote the construction of a shared platform for the application of deep-sea equipment.
titlelist: Optimize the layout of marine economic development and expand deep-sea and airspace.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Promote the transformation and upgrading of traditional marine industries, accelerate the development of emerging marine industries, improve the scale and level of marine services, promote the development of marine industry clusters, enhance the standardization level of marine industries, and strengthen the international competitiveness of marine industries.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Ocean fishing. Strictly control the intensity of nearshore fishing, implement a policy of negative growth in nearshore fishing production, strictly implement the off-season fishing ban system and fishing access system. Accelerate the adjustment and reform of fishery oil price subsidy policies, actively promote the reduction of fishing capacity through vessel conversion, and reduce domestic fishing production capacity. Promote regional comprehensive development with marine ranching as the main form, construct marine ranching demonstration zones with artificial reefs as carriers and methods such as stock enhancement and bottom seeding, and achieve sustainable development of marine fisheries. Develop offshore fishing, improve processing, distribution, and supply chain, extend the industrial chain, improve the level of offshore fishing facilities and equipment, build overseas comprehensive service bases for fisheries, and encourage the growth and strengthening of offshore fishing enterprises through mergers and acquisitions. Adjust the layout of marine aquaculture reasonably, vigorously develop healthy marine aquaculture, support deep-water wind-resistant net cage aquaculture and factory-scale recirculating aquaculture. Implement seed improvement projects, support breeding research in marine fisheries, and build a modern breeding system for high-quality breeds. Improve the aquatic disease prevention and control system, regulate the production and use of aquaculture feed and drugs, establish a center for aquatic product quality testing, and create demonstration zones for the quality and safety of exported aquatic products. Enhance the deep processing capacity of aquatic products, build cold chain logistics for aquatic product storage and transportation, and develop aquatic product trading markets. Develop water product futures markets in coastal cities where conditions permit, and increase the pricing power of international bulk water products. Vigorously develop diversified recreational fisheries. Strengthen the construction of fishery administration and fishery port infrastructure, promote the integration of fishery port economic zones and fishery town development. Carry out the Internet+ modern fishery action, and improve the informatization level of marine fisheries. Marine oil and gas industry. Establish a coordination mechanism for oil and gas development at sea, continue to promote nearshore oil and gas exploration and development. Support deep-sea and ultra-deep-sea oil and gas exploration and development, and promote the construction of comprehensive guarantee bases for the development and services of marine oil and gas resources. Further increase support for the development of hard-to-recover oil and gas reserves such as heavy oil and low permeability at sea. By 2020, the newly discovered geological reserves of marine oil and gas will grow rapidly, and the production of marine oil and gas will steadily increase. Actively strengthen international cooperation and promote deep-sea and ultra-deep-sea oil and gas cooperation and development. Strengthen the construction of coastal LNG unloading capacity and improve turnover and allocation capabilities. Support social capital to participate in the exploration and development of marine oil and gas resources through equity participation and other forms. Marine shipbuilding industry. Accelerate the adjustment of marine shipbuilding industry capacity, promote enterprise mergers, reorganizations, and transformation, eliminate backward production capacity through market supply and demand. Adjust and optimize the structure of ship products, improve the independent design and construction capabilities of high-tech ships. Cultivate and enhance the capabilities and levels of ship design and development research institutions, guide and support key backbone enterprises to build influential research and development centers in China. Promote the integrated, intelligent, and modular development of key ship equipment, and promote the transformation of the shipbuilding supporting industry from equipment processing and manufacturing to system integration. Encourage capable enterprises to establish overseas sales and service bases. Marine transportation industry. Promote the transformation and upgrading of maritime enterprises, accelerate mergers and acquisitions, and promote large-scale and specialized operations. Optimize the structure of maritime fleets and improve the international competitiveness of container liner transportation. Further optimize the layout of coastal ports, coordinate and coordinate the development scale of various ports, optimize and adjust the development direction and functional positioning of various ports, and strengthen the hub functions of major ports. Establish regional port alliances and promote resource integration and optimization. Strengthen the integration of dedicated terminal resources and prioritize the development of public terminals. Promote the coordinated development of ports and cities, intensively utilize port shorelines, land, sea areas, and other resources. Accelerate the coordinated development of water transportation with railways, highways, and aviation, and promote multimodal transport. Develop a logistics system centered on ports, carry out professional logistics businesses such as cold chain, automobiles, and chemicals, and accelerate the construction of a public service platform for port information. Strengthen the safety responsibility system and enhance emergency response capabilities. Marine salt and chemical industry. Scientifically plan the layout of salt production, accelerate the transformation of salt fields. Focus on the development of marine fine chemicals, strengthen the development of series products and deep processing. Promote the integration of water-electricity-heat-salt field biology-salt-salination to form a number of key marine chemical and salt chemical industry bases. Focus on the development and production of new products such as marine anti-corrosion coatings, marine inorganic functional materials, and marine polymer materials, and build a number of marine new material industrial bases. Actively develop new products in seaweed chemical industry. Promote the adjustment, optimization, and upgrading of the petrochemical industry structure, build safe and green petrochemical bases, and form internationally competitive industrial clusters.
titlelist: Promote the optimization and upgrading of the marine industry, and adjust and optimize traditional marine industries.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Ocean equipment manufacturing industry. To develop deep-sea resources, carry out independent design and manufacturing of key common technologies and engineering equipment, focus on breakthroughs in floating drilling production and storage equipment, liquefied natural gas floating production and storage equipment, floating liquefied natural gas storage and re-gasification equipment, and equipment for drilling platforms in waters deeper than 3600 meters. Enhance the design and construction capabilities of marine engineering equipment and establish overall assembly capabilities. Promote the construction of marine engineering equipment testing bases and offshore test sites to form a major global supply base for high-end marine engineering equipment. Strengthen the development of large-scale offshore wind power equipment with a capacity of 5 MW, 6 MW, and above, break through key technologies for offshore substations and submarine cable transmission, extend the development and manufacturing capabilities of energy storage devices, smart grids, and other offshore wind power supporting industries, and enhance the research and manufacturing capabilities of tidal energy, wave energy, and current energy construction, installation, and power generation equipment. Develop efficient and energy-saving core equipment for large and medium-sized seawater desalination projects and build seawater desalination equipment manufacturing bases. Ocean pharmaceuticals and bioproducts industry. Focus on supporting marine innovative drugs with independent intellectual property rights and broad market prospects, and develop modern marine traditional Chinese medicine products with ethnic characteristics. Develop green, safe, and efficient new marine biological functional products, with a focus on developing marine characteristic enzyme preparations such as pharmaceutical enzymes, tool enzymes, industrial enzymes, and feed enzymes, as well as microecological preparations, feed additives, and efficient biological fertilizers as green agricultural products, marine biotechnology products, and marine functional foods. Develop medical tissue engineering materials from marine biological sources, as well as new functional textile materials, pharmaceutical excipients, biofiber materials, bioseparation materials, bioenvironmental materials, and biopreservative materials from marine organisms. In cities with advantages in marine biotechnology research and development and the development of the biotechnology industry, establish innovative strategic alliances combining industry, academia, and research. Seawater utilization industry. Under the premise of ensuring the health of residents and the safe operation of municipal water supply facilities, promote the entry of desalinated seawater into the municipal water supply network, actively carry out demonstration and promotion of desalination pilot cities, parks, islands, and communities, and implement seawater desalination projects to guarantee people's livelihood in coastal water-deficient cities. Strictly limit freshwater cooling in coastal areas and promote the large-scale application of seawater cooling technology in high-water-consuming industries such as coastal power, chemical, petrochemical, metallurgical, and nuclear power. Support the demonstration of urban use of seawater as a major source of domestic water. Promote the high-value utilization of seawater chemical resources, accelerate the development of series of products such as potassium, bromine, and magnesium extracted from seawater, and carry out demonstration project construction. Marine renewable energy industry. Adapt to local conditions and reasonably layout offshore wind power industry, encourage the construction of offshore wind farms in deep-sea areas, adjust wind power grid connection policies, improve the technical standards system and sea use standards of offshore wind power industry. Accelerate the development and application of marine energy, break through engineering design bottlenecks, and build 2-3 MW tidal energy, hundred-kilowatt to kilowatt-level wave energy, and one 50 kW ocean temperature difference energy demonstration projects. Build demonstration projects for multi-energy complementation on islands. Strengthen the construction of demonstration power stations such as Shandong Marine Energy Test Zone, Zhejiang Tidal Energy and Tidal Energy Demonstration Zone, Guangdong Tidal Energy and Wave Energy Demonstration Zone, and South China Sea Comprehensive Utilization Demonstration Base for Marine Energy.
titlelist: Promote the optimization and upgrading of the marine industry, cultivate and develop emerging marine industries.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Ocean tourism industry. Adapt to the trend of upgrading consumer demand and develop ocean tourism that integrates sightseeing, vacation, leisure, entertainment, and water sports. Promote coastal ecological tourism mainly focused on ecological sightseeing, vacation and wellness, and marine science popularization. Utilize high-quality coastal areas, bays, and islands, strengthen the construction of coastal landscape environment, and plan and construct a batch of island tourist destinations and leisure vacation wellness bases. Coordinate the planning and construction of cruise terminals, implement visa-free or landing visa for international seafarers and international cruise tourists, and promote the construction of China Cruise Tourism Development Experimental Zones in Shanghai, Tianjin, Shenzhen, and Qingdao. Develop the cruise economy and expand cruise routes. Accelerate the development of yacht economy in coastal cities, promote the construction of yacht marinas, and innovate the management mode of yacht entry and exit. Support the development and construction of distinctive marine theme parks in coastal areas. In coastal cities with conditions, build comprehensive marine sports centers and offshore sports industry bases, and develop offshore competitive and leisure sports projects. Shipping service industry. Accelerate the construction and layout of international shipping centers. Encourage the construction of port alliances, enhance the coordinated development capacity of port clusters, and improve service functions. Enrich the Shanghai International Shipping Center Index and develop index derivatives. Support enterprises to participate in the formulation of international shipping standards and promote the construction of shipping transaction information sharing and service platforms. Actively develop various types of shipping service enterprises, steadily promote pilot projects such as wholly foreign-owned ship management companies and controlling joint venture shipping companies in free trade pilot zones, and further explore the demonstration policies of comprehensive experimental zones for international shipping development. Seize the opportunity of developing international shipping centers, attract various large-scale marine-related enterprise headquarters, introduce marine industry organizations, intermediary agencies, higher education institutions, research institutions, etc., build marine service industry clusters, promote the development of marine finance, shipping insurance, ship and shipping brokerage, maritime arbitration, and other formats, and form the core functional area and headquarters economy of the international shipping center. Marine cultural industry. Increase the popularization and promotion of marine awareness and marine science and technology knowledge, combine with the construction of the basic public cultural service system, establish a batch of marine science popularization and education demonstration bases, and promote the dissemination of marine culture. Strictly protect marine cultural heritage, carry out investigations on underwater cultural heritage in key areas and excavations and exhibitions of marine sites and relics, actively promote the special investigation and research on the cultural heritage of the Maritime Silk Road. Promote the construction of national underwater cultural heritage protection bases. Continue to hold activities such as World Ocean Day and National Ocean Publicity Day, China Ocean Economy Expo, World Mazu Culture Forum, China Ocean Culture Festival, Xiamen International Ocean Week, China (Xiangshan) Fishing Festival, etc. Explore marine culture with regional characteristics and develop marine cultural and creative industries. Standardize the construction of a batch of marine characteristic cultural industry platforms, support the development of marine characteristic cultural enterprises and key projects. Relying on relevant regional marine traditional cultural resources, focus on promoting the construction of the marine characteristic cultural industry belt of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road. Marine financial services industry. Accelerate the construction of a multi-level, wide-coverage, and sustainable marine economic financial service system. Give full play to the leading role of policy finance in supporting the marine economy. Encourage various financial institutions to develop marine economic financial services, and provide financing services for the marine real economy under controllable risks and sustainable commercial premises for banking financial institutions with conditions. Encourage financial institutions to explore the development of marine financing products with marine area usage rights, marine product warrants, etc. as collateral. Introduce and cultivate and regulate the development of several marine financing guarantee institutions, accelerate the development of shipping insurance business, and explore the development of marine environmental liability insurance. Strengthen ship and marine engineering equipment financing leasing, explore the development of emerging leasing markets such as high-end marine equipment manufacturing, marine new energy, marine energy conservation and environmental protection. Marine public service industry. Accelerate the deep integration of information technology such as the Internet, cloud computing, big data, and the marine industry, strengthen the construction of marine informatization system, and promote the coordinated utilization and sharing of information resources. Coordinate the planning and integration of marine observation resources, build a global marine three-dimensional observation network in China. Improve the level of special forecasts for marine environment, enrich thematic service products such as marine safety production, environmental protection, and meteorological forecasts. Accelerate the construction of marine consulting and demonstration institutions, improve the service level of marine engineering environmental impact assessment, marine area usage demonstration, marine engineering survey, etc. Promote marine surveying and mapping engineering construction, build a modern marine surveying and mapping benchmark system, and construct a multi-level application service system for marine geographic information. Improve the marine standard measurement service system and build a national marine standard information service platform. Implement real-time monitoring of offshore fishing vessel safety, improve offshore search and rescue emergency services, and actively promote bilateral, multilateral, and regional cooperation in search and rescue activities. Column 2 Global Ocean Three-dimensional Observation Network Project. Coordinate the planning of the national marine observation network layout, promote the construction of a real-time online monitoring system for national marine environment and overseas observation (monitoring) sites, gradually form a global marine three-dimensional observation (monitoring) system, and strengthen observation and research on marine ecology, ocean currents, marine meteorology, etc.
titlelist: Promote the optimization and upgrading of the marine industry, expand and enhance the marine service industry.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Strong competitive advantage in the marine industry cluster and characteristic industrial chain. Column 3 focuses on the cultivation of marine industry clusters. Marine fisheries: support the construction of marine ranches in coastal areas such as Dalian, Weihai, Yantai, and Qingdao, rely on the development of water product processing industry clusters in Dalian, Weihai, Zhoushan, Fujian, Guangxi, and rely on the development of offshore fishing industry clusters in Dalian, Zhoushan, Fuzhou, and Beihai. Marine equipment manufacturing industry: accelerate the development of marine equipment industry, focus on the construction of marine engineering equipment manufacturing industry clusters in the Bohai Sea region, mainly in Dalian, Tianjin, Yantai, and Qingdao, in the Yangtze River Delta region mainly in Shanghai, Suzhou, and Zhejiang, and in the Pearl River Delta region mainly in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Zhuhai. Marine shipbuilding industry: optimize the product structure of the marine shipbuilding industry, support the development of high-end marine vessels, focus on the construction of shipbuilding bases in the Bohai Sea region mainly in Dalian and Qingdao, in the Yangtze River Delta region mainly in Shanghai, Suzhou, and Zhoushan, and in the Pearl River Delta region mainly in Guangzhou. Marine oil and gas industry: based on Tianjin, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangxi, and Hainan, promote the construction of marine oil and gas development bases, and build marine oil and gas resource development belts and industry clusters. Marine pharmaceuticals and bioproducts industry: vigorously develop marine biomedicine, marine bioproducts, and marine biomaterials, and establish marine biotechnology and marine pharmaceutical research centers mainly in Shanghai, Qingdao, Xiamen, and Guangzhou. Marine renewable energy industry: relying on resource advantages and technological capabilities, build Weihai and Qingdao marine energy equipment manufacturing bases, as well as Zhoushan and Wanshan marine energy test sites and demonstration zones. Seawater utilization industry: promote the construction of seawater desalination and comprehensive utilization demonstration bases in Tianjin, Qingdao, Dalian, Tangshan, Zhoushan, and other places. Marine tourism industry: promote the construction of China Cruise Tourism Development Experimental Zones in Shanghai, Tianjin, Shenzhen, and Qingdao, and vigorously develop the cruise industry. Build a China-ASEAN marine tourism cooperation circle. Shipping services industry: promote the construction of international shipping centers in Shanghai, Tianjin, Dalian, and Xiamen, and develop the Beibu Gulf Port in Guangxi into a regional international shipping hub facing ASEAN.
titlelist: Promote the optimization and upgrading of the marine industry, promote the development of industrial clusters, innovate systems and mechanisms, increase support, promote industrial agglomeration, take the lead of the marine economic development demonstration zone, cultivate and strengthen a group of marine industries with distinctive characteristics and prominent regional brand images, and achieve efficient coordination of the industrial chain and core competitiveness.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Accelerate the development of marine resources and the transformation of the marine economy around major needs such as deep water, green, and safety. Industrialize and localize core technologies and key common technologies that urgently need upgrading. In the field of deep-sea key technologies and equipment, focus on breakthroughs in the development of fully submersible vehicles and manned equipment for deep-sea exploration, deep and remote sea nuclear floating platform technology, and the construction of deep-sea space stations. Conduct research and development and application of core technology equipment for deep-sea energy and mineral development. In the field of deep-water oil and gas resource development, break through core key technologies such as deep-water drilling facilities, deep-water platforms, and mooring systems. In the field of seawater aquaculture and marine biotechnology, develop deep and remote sea aquaculture equipment and technology, strengthen research on marine candidate drug formulation technology, and overcome the discovery of lead compounds for marine drugs. In the field of seawater desalination, accelerate the research and application of core components and key equipment such as reverse osmosis membrane materials and elements, and conduct research on key technologies for new seawater desalination. In the field of ship and marine engineering equipment manufacturing, further strengthen the research and development of basic common technologies, core key technologies, and forward-looking leading technologies for green and environmentally friendly ships, high-tech ships, and marine engineering equipment design and construction. Strengthen the development of ship and marine engineering equipment supporting systems and devices.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of the marine economy, strengthen major key technological innovations in the marine sector, promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, enhance the support capacity and international competitiveness of marine scientific and technological innovation, deepen pilot projects for the innovative development of the marine economy, promote innovation in the talent system and mechanism for the marine sector, and support major scientific and technological innovations in the marine field.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Strengthen the position and leading role of enterprises in innovation, support the development of technology-oriented small and medium-sized enterprises in the marine sector, and encourage enterprises to carry out research and development of marine technology and the transformation of achievements. Promote the construction of major marine scientific and technological innovation platforms, promote the optimization and integration of marine scientific and technological resources, and promote collaborative innovation. Accelerate the construction of a market-oriented, finance-driven, and industry-university-research combined marine industry innovation alliance. Vigorously develop marine crowdsourcing platforms, support the cultivation of new entrepreneurship and innovation service organizations, and accelerate the integration of the Internet to create spaces for crowdsourcing, crowdfunding, and crowd support. Continue to promote pilot projects for innovative development of the marine economy, marine high-tech industry demonstration bases, and national science and technology-based marine industry demonstration bases. Build public service platforms for the trading and transformation of marine scientific and technological achievements, support marine universities, research institutes, and key laboratories to open up to society and share research instruments, equipment, and technological achievements. Encourage social capital to invest in national deep-sea biological gene banks, deep-sea mineral sample banks, etc., and provide services for social scientific research and industrial development through enterprise operation.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of the marine economy, strengthen the innovation of key technologies in the marine sector, promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, enhance the support capacity and international competitiveness of marine scientific and technological innovation, deepen the pilot projects for the innovative development of the marine economy, promote the innovation of the talent system and mechanism in the marine sector, and promote the transformation of marine scientific and technological achievements.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Continue to deepen the pilot construction of national marine economic development, focusing on optimizing the spatial development pattern of the marine economy, building a modern marine industry system, strengthening the construction of marine infrastructure, improving the marine public service system, constructing a blue ecological barrier, innovating the system and mechanism of marine comprehensive management, etc. Select a number of regions with conditions to build a batch of marine economic development demonstration zones, further optimize the layout of marine economic development, enhance the comprehensive competitiveness of the marine economy, explore new paths for the protection and development of marine resources, and new models of marine comprehensive management, create important growth poles for the development of the marine economy, summarize replicable and promotable experiences, and provide demonstration and reference for the national marine economic development.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of the marine economy, strengthen the innovation of key technologies in the marine sector, promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, enhance the support capacity and international competitiveness of marine scientific and technological innovation, deepen the pilot projects for the innovative development of the marine economy, promote the innovation of the talent system and mechanism in the marine sector, and deepen the pilot projects for the development of the marine economy.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Accelerate the innovation of the marine talent training mode, closely integrate major projects and key technology research, and guide and promote the organic connection between the marine talent training chain and the industrial chain and innovation chain. Strengthen the training of marine talents at multiple levels, across industries and disciplines, and support the formation of marine science and technology innovation teams by comprehensive universities, ocean universities, and research institutes involved in marine science. Implement policies to support marine research personnel in starting businesses, and establish a sound mechanism for the two-way flow of research personnel. Improve the mechanism for marine science and technology innovation and talent training, guide and encourage marine-related enterprises to establish innovative talent training, recruitment, and equity incentive systems, and support research institutions and researchers in sharing the benefits of technology transfer. Enhance the information service for marine industry talent and promote the rational flow of marine talent resources.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of the marine economy, strengthen the innovation of key technologies in the marine sector, promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, enhance the support capacity and international competitiveness of marine scientific and technological innovation, deepen the pilot projects for the innovative development of the marine economy, and promote the innovation of the talent system and mechanism in the marine sector.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Adhere to the principle of prioritizing conservation, protection, and natural restoration, strengthen the efforts in marine environmental protection and ecological restoration, promote the efficient and sustainable utilization of marine resources and low-carbon development of industries, enhance the capacity for disaster prevention and reduction in the marine environment, and build a marine ecological civilization.
