name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Strengthen marine ecological protection. Establish a red line system for marine ecological protection and implement mandatory protection and strict control. Implement the construction of coastal protection forest system, and increase efforts in the construction and restoration of coastal main forest belts. Accelerate the selection and construction of marine protected areas, aquatic genetic resource protection areas, marine parks, and other marine protected areas. Increase investment in the standardized construction of protected areas and strengthen ecological monitoring of marine protected areas, achieving full coverage of national-level marine protected area management. Accelerate the establishment of a coordinated mechanism for ecosystem protection, restoration, and pollution prevention and control between land and sea, and establish a sound marine ecological environment protection mechanism in the Bohai Sea and Yangtze River Delta regions. Strengthen the protection and restoration of coastal zones and implement the Blue Bay project in coastal cities. Prevent marine ecological damage and biological invasion, and strengthen quarantine and supervision of incoming ships. Improve the system and mechanism for compensating for marine ecological environment, and explore diversified ecological compensation methods. Improve the system for holding accountable and compensating for marine ecological environment protection, strengthen the assessment of marine ecological environment damage, and implement the responsibility for ecological environment damage restoration. Promote the restoration of marine ecosystems. Carry out ecological restoration and biodiversity protection in important habitats such as wetlands, bays, islands, and estuaries. Implement the Southern Red, Northern Willow wetland restoration project and build an ecological security barrier in coastal areas. Implement the Ecological Island and Reef restoration project, select typical islands for vegetation, shoreline, beach, and surrounding waters restoration, and restore damaged island landforms and ecosystems.
titlelist: Strengthen the construction of marine ecological civilization, and enhance the protection and restoration of marine ecology.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Strictly implement the Management Measures for Enclosing and Filling the Sea and the Management Measures for Enclosing and Filling the Sea Plan, and implement restrictive indicators for the enclosed and filled sea area. Guide new construction projects to concentrate within the scope of regional marine planning, improve the management system for enclosing and filling the sea, and strengthen the management of enclosing and filling the sea development. Formulate and introduce policy opinions to strengthen the protection and development management of coastal tidal flats. Strictly implement the planning of marine functional zones, and implement the system of marine functional zoning, marine area ownership management, and compensated use of marine areas in accordance with the law. Implement differentiated marine policies to ensure the needs of construction projects such as major national infrastructure, emerging marine industries, green and low-carbon and circular economy industries, and major people's livelihood projects. In accordance with the Regulations on the Protection and Utilization of Coastlines, implement strict protection, development restrictions, and optimized utilization systems for coastlines, and strictly restrict development and utilization activities that change the natural attributes of coastlines. Coordinate the implementation of comprehensive restoration projects such as beach retreat and restoration, wetland retreat and restoration, shoreline protection and restoration, stock enhancement and release, and artificial reefs. By 2020, the coastline that has been restored and repaired should be no less than 2000 kilometers. Strictly manage uninhabited islands, prohibit island blasting, sand and gravel mining, and logging, and strictly restrict activities that harm the natural ecology of islands and surrounding waters, such as physical dam island projects.
titlelist: Strengthen the construction of marine ecological civilization, intensively and efficiently utilize marine resources.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Accelerate the adjustment of energy consumption structure in the marine industry, encourage the development of low-energy and low-emission marine service and high-tech industries, strengthen the constraints of energy and environmental assessments, implement energy-saving and emission reduction measures in high-energy-consuming industries such as offshore oil and gas, marine chemicals, and marine transportation, and accelerate the elimination of outdated and excess production capacity. Encourage the development of clean energy, and develop renewable energy such as solar energy, offshore wind energy, tidal energy, and wave energy according to local conditions. Continue to carry out demonstration projects for the recycling of marine aquaculture, marine drugs and bioproducts, seawater utilization, marine chemicals, and marine salt industry. Relying on marine industrial parks, promote the establishment of industrial consortia for comprehensive utilization of raw materials and power among enterprises. Encourage the information consultation and technology promotion activities for energy-saving and emission reduction, and low-carbon development in the marine industry.
titlelist: Strengthen the construction of marine ecological civilization and promote low-carbon development of the marine industry.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Surrounding the construction of the '21st Century Maritime Silk Road,' we aim to build international and domestic maritime hubs, strengthen investment cooperation in the marine industry, enhance international cooperation in the field of oceans, establish a sound system to safeguard foreign investment in the marine economy, and expand new opportunities for the development of marine economic cooperation.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Promote the construction of domestic shipping ports. Integrate domestic coastal port resources to build hubs and gateways for the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road economic belt and external opening. Promote the construction of global maritime center cities such as Shenzhen and Shanghai, further enhance their level of external opening and international influence in investment and financing, service trade, business tourism, etc., and become the vanguard and main force of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road. Continue to promote the construction of regional port clusters in the Bohai Sea, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Southeast Coast, Southwest Coast, etc., expand and develop international shipping routes and sea channels, and connect with the global interconnection pattern. Promote the construction of overseas shipping port hubs. Strengthen cooperation between international ports, support large-scale port and shipping enterprises in implementing international development strategies, and participate in overseas port management, channel maintenance, and maritime rescue through acquisitions, equity participation, leasing, and other methods according to market demand, providing commercial services for deep-sea fishing, international shipping, overseas resource development, etc.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of marine economic cooperation and promote the construction of maritime connectivity.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Implement the going global strategy, guiding enterprises involved in the maritime industry to establish overseas production, marketing, and service networks based on market principles. Encourage maritime enterprises and research institutes to engage in joint design and technological exchanges with foreign institutions, establish industrial technology innovation alliances, and promote international cooperation in advanced marine manufacturing industries such as marine engineering construction, marine vessels, and marine engineering equipment manufacturing. Accelerate the development of cooperation in production capacity and technology output in industries such as seawater aquaculture, seawater desalination and comprehensive utilization, and marine energy development and utilization. Support fishing enterprises in establishing offshore fishing and seafood processing logistics bases overseas. Promote international cruise tourism and establish a network of marine tourism cooperation with neighboring countries to facilitate marine tourism. Relying on the construction of overseas port support points, cooperate with neighboring countries to build coastal marine industrial parks, attract domestic maritime enterprises to settle in the parks, mitigate investment risks, improve investment efficiency, optimize industrial chains, enhance supporting capabilities, and promote the development of industrial clusters.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of marine economic cooperation and promote effective integration of the marine industry.

name: National Marine Economy Development Thirteenth Five-Year Plan (excerpt) (Development and Reform Region [2017] No. 861) (National Development and Reform Commission, State Oceanic Administration / May 4, 2017)
content: Accelerate the formation of a unified, open, and orderly modern marine economic market system, and promote the free and orderly flow of marine economic factors. Establish a clear ownership, clear rights and responsibilities, strict protection, and smooth transfer of marine property rights system. Promote the establishment of marine property rights trading service platforms in coastal central cities, carry out mortgage and trading of marine usage rights, explore pilot projects for marine carbon emission trading, and achieve market-oriented allocation of various marine resources and factors. Accelerate the cultivation of the marine technology market, improve the system for the use of intellectual property rights and technology transfer mechanisms. Accelerate the pace of reform of research institutions in the marine sector and strengthen cooperation with social capital. Accelerate the opening up of the marine public service sector, expand the social services functions of marine environmental special forecasts, maritime search and rescue services, marine geographic information services, and major scientific research facilities. Establish a system for the paid use of marine public services and promote the market-oriented application of survey fleets, marine equipment testing bases, deep-sea biological resource sample libraries, and other facilities.
titlelist: Deepen the reform of the marine economic system and improve the modern marine economic market system.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment and Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: By 2020, we will have built a strong and innovative shipbuilding industry with good quality and efficiency, and optimized structure. We strive to become a leading shipbuilding nation and advanced country in marine engineering equipment manufacturing. Our market share will steadily increase. Our international competitive position will further improve, aiming to increase shipbuilding output by 5 percentage points compared to the 12th Five-Year Plan, and achieve a market share of around 35% for marine engineering equipment and 40% for high-tech ships in the international market. Our innovation capability will be at the forefront of the world. Our technological innovation capability will be at the forefront of the shipbuilding industry, and the energy efficiency, environmental friendliness, safety, and intelligence level of ship types will reach international leading levels. The concept/basic design of high-tech ships and marine engineering equipment will reach world advanced levels. We will comprehensively master the core technologies of ship power, deck machinery, cabin equipment, communication and intelligent systems, and the international influence of ship specifications and standards will significantly increase. R&D investment of large-scale enterprises will not be less than 2.5% of sales revenue. Significant progress will be made in structural adjustment. The concentration of the industry will be greatly improved, with the top 10 shipbuilding companies accounting for over 70% of the national total ship completions, forming a group of world-class advanced shipbuilding and marine engineering equipment manufacturing companies with strong core competitiveness. Supporting capabilities will be significantly enhanced, with the average local equipment installation rates of bulk carriers, oil tankers, container ships, high-tech ships, and marine engineering equipment reaching over 80%, 60%, 40%, respectively, making us a major ship equipment manufacturing country in the world. Backbone shipbuilding, marine engineering equipment, and supporting enterprises will establish a global research and development, marketing, and service system. Quality and efficiency will be greatly improved. Backbone shipyards will establish a lean manufacturing system, significantly improving the level of automation, digitization, and intelligence, and building a number of intelligent workshops and production lines. The popularity rates of Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and digital design tools in large and medium-sized enterprises will reach 97%, and the rate of key process flow digitization will reach 90%. The quality and brand reputation of ship and marine products will significantly improve, with shipbuilding efficiency of white-listed companies reaching 15-20 working hours per corrected gross tonnage, and benchmark shipbuilding efficiency reaching international advanced levels, achieving steady improvement in economic benefits.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Focus on key areas such as green and environmentally friendly mainstream ships, high-tech ships, marine engineering equipment, and core supporting equipment. Strengthen the research and development of basic common technologies such as hydrodynamic technology, lightweight structural design technology, and ship engine concept/engineering design technology, as well as the study and revision of relevant international standards and specifications. Increase efforts to tackle key issues in areas such as intelligent ships, deep-sea equipment, polar technology and equipment, strengthen forward-looking layout, enhance the supply of sources, and promote the transformation of scientific and technological innovation towards parallel and leading.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the leading role of scientific and technological innovation, strengthening research in fundamental and cutting-edge technologies.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Surrounding the demand for major technological innovation, accelerate the construction of the innovation center for deep-sea and ocean engineering equipment manufacturing, and establish a number of laboratories and engineering centers with international standards in the fields of intelligent ships, ship power, etc. Promote the construction of platforms such as numerical wave tanks, data resources, and large-scale shared experimental facilities. Encourage the gathering of various resources on these platforms to provide specialized services to society, and establish a resource-rich, innovation-driven, and efficient collaborative double innovation new ecosystem.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the leading role of scientific and technological innovation, constructing high-level innovation centers.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Strengthen the supervision and management of enterprises that meet industry standards, dynamically adjust the white list of the shipbuilding industry, support the strong ones, guide social resources to gather in advantageous backbone enterprises, promote the transformation and restructuring of backward enterprises. Utilize the mechanism of domestic and foreign market pressure to promote cross-industry, cross-regional, and cross-ownership mergers and reorganizations, guide backbone enterprises to actively adapt to changes in demand, and proactively reduce excess production capacity through capacity replacement, urban retreat to suburban areas, transformation, and upgrading.
titlelist: Key tasks, adjusting and optimizing industrial structure, making efforts to resolve overcapacity.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Strengthen internal management of enterprises, benchmark against advanced domestic and foreign companies, improve labor productivity, and continuously reduce costs and increase efficiency. Support and cultivate a group of world-class advanced enterprises and system integration contractors with strong innovation capabilities, specialized manufacturing, and high management levels in the core supporting areas of large mainstream ships, high-tech ships, marine engineering equipment, and ship power. Promote the growth of a group of specialized and distinctive small and medium-sized shipbuilding enterprises in areas such as special-purpose ships, large fishing vessels and deep-sea aquaculture equipment, inland shipbuilding, high-tech ship repair and modification, and intermediate product manufacturing.
titlelist: Key tasks, adjusting and optimizing industrial structure, vigorously supporting strong and competitive enterprises.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment and Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: To adapt to the accelerating trend of the release of the potential for traditional high-end consumption such as domestic cruise ships and yachts, we will speed up the realization of independent design and construction of cruise ships, vigorously develop small and medium-sized yachts and new yacht design and manufacturing. Actively carry out research and application of deep-sea fishery aquaculture equipment, renewable energy development equipment, deep-sea mineral resource development equipment, marine space development and utilization equipment, polar technology and equipment, etc.
titlelist: Key tasks, adjusting and optimizing industrial structure, actively cultivating new sources of economic growth.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Taking intelligent manufacturing as the main direction to strengthen management and reduce costs and increase efficiency in the shipbuilding industry, vigorously promote the application of digital, networked, and intelligent technologies in the design and manufacturing process of ships and supporting equipment. Consolidate the foundation of lean shipbuilding and popularize digital and automated manufacturing. Focus on implementing intelligent manufacturing of intermediate ship products, accelerate the construction of demonstration intelligent workshops and intelligent production lines for ship sectioning, intelligent coating, and intelligent pipe processing. Promote the new model of intelligent manufacturing for ship supporting equipment, carry out demonstrations of intelligent workshops/factories, and comprehensively promote the intelligence of the entire process of ship and supporting equipment design, manufacturing, management, maintenance, inspection, etc.
titlelist: Key tasks, developing advanced and efficient manufacturing models, vigorously promoting intelligent manufacturing.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Accelerate the construction of new foundations for the shipbuilding industry, including automatic control and perception, industrial core software, industrial Internet, industrial cloud, and information technology services for manufacturing. Make full use of methods such as Internet Plus to innovate service models, develop network precision marketing, personalized customization services, intelligent monitoring, inspection, remote diagnosis management, and full lifecycle management services, and achieve a transformation and upgrade from manufacturing to manufacturing plus services. Support ocean engineering equipment, shipbuilding, and supporting enterprises that meet the conditions to shift from equipment providers to providing system integration and general contracting services, and from providing products to providing overall solutions and services. Promote the specialization, scale, and marketization of solution services. Accelerate the development of third-party logistics, inspection, testing, and certification enterprises in the productive services sector.
titlelist: Key tasks, developing advanced and efficient manufacturing models, actively developing 'Internet+' and service-oriented manufacturing.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment and Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Integrate the concept of green sustainability throughout the entire shipbuilding industry chain and the entire lifecycle of products. Focus on promoting ecological product design, clean production processes, efficient energy utilization, and recycling of resources. Strengthen the awareness of conservation in design, actively promote the use of new energy-saving and environmentally friendly materials and processes, support enterprises in technological transformation related to energy conservation, environmental protection, green production, and safety, accelerate the establishment of a green manufacturing system, and establish green and safe shipbuilding technical specifications and standards.
titlelist: Key tasks: develop advanced and efficient manufacturing models, comprehensively promote green manufacturing.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment and Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Strengthen the construction of key technology and product testing and verification capabilities, promote the use of advanced forming and processing methods, significantly improve the performance stability, quality reliability, and environmental adaptability of shipboard medium and high-speed engines, electric propulsion systems, deck machinery, intelligent navigation systems, as well as supporting equipment such as drilling packages, power stations, and mooring positioning systems for offshore platforms, reaching international advanced levels. Cultivate and promote the spirit of excellence in craftsmanship, guide enterprises to establish a business philosophy of quality first and reputation first, organize the tackling of a batch of key common technologies that restrict the improvement of product quality, and promote the quality upgrade of China's shipbuilding industry.
titlelist: Key tasks: Building a well-known Chinese shipbuilding brand and improving product quality.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Following market demand, we aim to build a group of internationally renowned brands in the fields of bulk carriers, oil tankers, container ships, mainstream ship types, self-elevating platforms, semi-submersible drilling/support platforms, marine engineering vessels, and auxiliary vessels. These brands will be characterized by advanced technology, cost-effectiveness, efficient construction, excellent quality, and high credibility. We will also promote the comprehensive expansion of branded products into high-tech ships and deep-sea marine engineering equipment. We will expand the influence of core supporting areas such as ship propulsion and deck machinery. We will establish a brand culture, increase the promotion and publicity efforts of Chinese brands, establish a good image for Chinese shipbuilding brands, and enhance brand added value and soft power.
titlelist: Key task: Building a well-known Chinese shipbuilding brand and promoting brand construction.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Develop and implement Chinese shipbuilding quality standards and Chinese ship repair quality standards. Strengthen supply chain quality management, improve the quality traceability capability of supporting equipment throughout its entire lifecycle, and establish a technical standard specification system that covers the entire lifecycle of products. Utilize information technology to promote the establishment of on-site quality management systems, precision control systems, outsourcing management systems, and cost management systems in shipyards. Enhance the research, development, and application of advanced inspection tools and equipment to improve the efficiency and accuracy of production process quality supervision and inspection.
titlelist: Key tasks: Building a well-known Chinese shipbuilding brand and strengthening manufacturing system management.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Further strengthen the sharing and utilization of research and development, design, testing and verification facilities, production, and supporting resources in the field of shipbuilding. Support the coordinated development of comprehensive testing facilities such as water tanks, marine environments, communication and navigation, and major military-civilian integration industrial projects. Promote the application of Beidou navigation and improve resource allocation efficiency. Establish a collaborative support system for military-civilian products. Accelerate the development of military-civilian universal standards in the shipbuilding industry and promote the unification of military and civilian standards and specifications in several areas.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the deep integration and development of military-civilian integration, and promote the sharing of military-civilian resources.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Combine the construction of the 'Belt and Road' initiative and actively promote international capacity and equipment manufacturing cooperation in shipbuilding and marine engineering equipment. Support oil and gas development enterprises, shipbuilding and marine engineering equipment manufacturing enterprises, and financial institutions in strengthening strategic cooperation, and jointly carry out global oil and gas resource development and operations. Encourage leading shipbuilding enterprises to actively engage in overseas mergers and acquisitions, invest in overseas factories, establish overseas research and development centers, experimental bases, and global marketing and after-sales service systems. Actively participate in the revision of international shipbuilding regulations and improve the depth and breadth of participation in the formulation of international shipbuilding standards.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote comprehensive opening and cooperation, accelerate the pace of going global.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Utilize foreign advantageous resources to carry out collaborative research and development on luxury cruise ships and marine low-speed engines, and encourage overseas enterprises and research institutions to establish global research and development institutions in our country. Encourage shipbuilding enterprises and research institutes to engage in joint design, technological exchange cooperation, and talent cultivation with foreign relevant institutions. Encourage shipbuilding enterprises to attract overseas high-end talents through team introduction, core talent introduction, project introduction, and other methods.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote comprehensive open cooperation, actively introduce global innovative resources.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment and Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Promote the improvement of relevant policies on ship mortgage for vessels under construction; encourage and guide financial institutions to implement differentiated credit policies for the shipbuilding industry based on actual conditions; increase support for direct financing of shipbuilding enterprises, support eligible shipbuilding enterprises in domestic and overseas listing financing, issuance of various debt financing instruments, and optimize financing structure; encourage financial institutions to support mergers and reorganizations in the shipbuilding industry and international capacity cooperation; support financial institutions and shipbuilding enterprises in actively utilizing macro-prudential management policies for cross-border financing to improve the cross-border financing environment of the shipbuilding industry. Encourage and support shipbuilding enterprises to use RMB as the pricing and settlement currency in foreign trade and related investment and financing activities, reduce exchange rate risks, and lower exchange costs.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial support.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Implement the first (set) of major technical equipment insurance compensation mechanisms well, adapt to the needs of industry development, and dynamically adjust the relevant category list; increase support for ship export credit insurance, study and standardize short-term export credit insurance business, and expand the scope of export credit insurance support.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve insurance support policies.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Under the premise of adhering to the dual control of fishing vessel quantity and power, accelerate the renovation and upgrading of fishing vessels; promote the research, development, and application of technological equipment such as artificial islands, offshore floating platforms, marine exploration, and development of marine resources; optimize the layout of cruise ports, improve the requirements for yacht certification, operational regulations, and insurance systems, explore pilot yacht leasing businesses, formulate a national overall plan for cruise tourism development, and accelerate the cultivation and development of the cruise and yacht tourism market; in conjunction with the establishment of emission control zones in China, promote the elimination and upgrading of old ships in inland and coastal areas, improve energy-saving and emission reduction standards for inland ships, encourage the conversion of inland ships from oil to gas, installation of shore power supply facilities and exhaust gas treatment devices, and promote the use of clean energy.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the cultivation of new demands.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment, Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Strengthen the cultivation of high-level research and development talents, high-skilled talents, high-level management talents, and international talents in the shipbuilding industry. Encourage shipbuilding enterprises and universities to jointly establish a professional talent cultivation system, encourage the construction of regional shipbuilding industry skills training centers, support shipbuilding enterprises in optimizing talent cultivation mechanisms, carry out re-education and training for existing employees in new business areas, continuously improve the quality and learning ability of practitioners, and cultivate highly skilled technicians and modern industrial workers with the spirit of excellence. Encourage shipbuilding enterprises to carry out the cultivation of relevant management talents and technical workers in future technological development trends such as intelligent manufacturing.
titlelist: Protective measures, improve the multi-level talent protection system.

name: Action Plan for Deepening Structural Adjustment and Accelerating Transformation and Upgrading of the Shipbuilding Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Equipment [2016] No. 447) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, China Banking Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / January 13, 2017)
content: Give full play to the role of intermediary organizations, professional institutions, and relevant think tanks such as the Shipbuilding Industry Association, Shipbuilding Engineering Society, Import and Export Chamber of Commerce, China Classification Society, and Fishing Vessel and Fishing Equipment Industry Association, strengthen industry self-discipline, safeguard industry rights and interests, promptly reflect enterprise demands to the government, and propose policy suggestions. Enhance the level of industry services, strengthen industry analysis, monitoring, judgment, and early warning, and guide the healthy development of the industry. All regions and departments should unify their thinking, raise their awareness, improve work mechanisms, effectively fulfill their responsibilities, strengthen departmental coordination and vertical linkage, urgently improve supporting policies, form a joint force, and coordinate the advancement of various tasks.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, leveraging the role of intermediary organizations and professional institutions.

name: Opinions on the Full, Accurate, and Comprehensive Implementation of the New Development Concept and the Work of Achieving Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/September 22, 2021)

content: Accelerate the promotion of green development in agriculture and promote carbon sequestration and efficiency in agriculture. Develop implementation plans for carbon peaking in industries and sectors such as energy, steel, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, building materials, transportation, and construction. Revise the guidance catalog for industrial restructuring with a focus on energy conservation and carbon reduction. Conduct a review of the steel and coal capacity reduction efforts to consolidate the achievements. Accelerate the low-carbon technological innovation and digital transformation in the industrial sector. Carry out pilot projects for carbon peaking in designated areas. Speed up the green transformation of commerce, trade, circulation, and information services, and enhance the level of low-carbon development in the service industry.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (Excerpt) (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Implement the project of industrial base reconstruction, accelerate the filling of bottlenecks in basic components and parts, basic software, basic materials, basic processes, and industrial technological foundations. Relying on leading enterprises in the industry, increase efforts in key products and key core technology research and development, and accelerate the industrial breakthrough through engineering and industrialization. Implement major technological equipment research and development projects, improve incentive and risk compensation mechanisms, promote the demonstration application of the first set of equipment, the first batch of materials, and the first version of software. Improve the industrial base support system, establish a number of national manufacturing innovation centers in key areas, improve national quality infrastructure, build production application demonstration platforms and industrial technological basic public service platforms such as standard measurement, certification and accreditation, inspection and testing, and trial verification, and improve industrial basic databases such as technology and processes.
titlelist: Deeply implement the strategy of building a strong manufacturing country and strengthen the construction of industrial basic capabilities.

content: Accelerate the innovation and application of key core technologies, enhance the capability of resource guarantee, and cultivate and strengthen new driving forces for the development of strategic emerging industries such as green environmental protection, aerospace, and marine equipment. name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: In accordance with the development trend of high performance, multifunctionality, and greenization of new materials, we will promote the sustainable development of characteristic resource new materials, strengthen the layout of cutting-edge materials, and optimize the industrialization and application environment of new materials. We will strengthen the construction of new material standard system, improve the application level of new materials, and promote the integration of new materials into the high-end manufacturing supply chain. By 2020, we strive to make several new material varieties enter the global supply chain, and the self-sufficiency rate of major key materials reaches over 70%, initially realizing the strategic transformation of China from a material-rich country to a material-strong country. We will promote the quality and efficiency improvement of the new materials industry. Facing the development needs of industries such as aviation and aerospace, rail transportation, power electronics, and new energy vehicles, we will expand the scale of application of high-strength lightweight alloys, high-performance fibers, special alloys, advanced inorganic non-metallic materials, high-quality special steels, new display materials, power battery materials, and green printing materials, gradually entering the global high-end manufacturing procurement system. We will promote the going global of advantageous new material enterprises, strengthen the supply chain cooperation with well-known domestic and foreign high-end manufacturing enterprises, and carry out all-round cooperation in research and development design, production and trade, and standard formulation. We will increase the added value of new materials, build new material brands, and enhance international competitiveness. We will establish a new material technology maturity evaluation system and study the establishment of a first-batch application insurance compensation mechanism for new materials. We will establish a new material performance testing and evaluation center. We will refine and improve the classification of new material products. We will build a new material standard system based on application. We will strengthen the connection and support between new material product standards and downstream industry design specifications in industries such as next-generation information technology, high-end equipment manufacturing, and energy conservation and environmental protection. We will accelerate the formulation of key new material standards, promote the revision of old standards, strengthen the promotion and application of existing standards, strengthen the pre-research of cutting-edge new material standards, and pre-layout a batch of core standards. We will accelerate the internationalization process of the new material standard system and promote the transformation of domestic standards into international standards. We will promote the sustainable development of characteristic resource new materials. We will promote the high-quality utilization of rare earths, tungsten and molybdenum, vanadium and titanium, lithium, graphite, and other characteristic resources, strengthen the research and development of special processes and technologies, promote the balanced utilization of co-associated mineral resources, and support the establishment of specialized characteristic resource new material recycling and utilization bases and mineral functional material manufacturing bases. In various links of characteristic resource new material mining, smelting and separation, and deep processing, we will promote the intelligent and green production equipment and processes. We will develop new materials such as medical tissue engineering materials and bio-environmental materials from marine biological sources. We will proactively plan the research and development of cutting-edge new materials. We will break through the industrial application technology of graphene, expand the application scope of nanomaterials in optoelectronics, new energy, and biomedicine, develop smart materials, biomimetic materials, metamaterials, low-cost additive manufacturing materials, and new superconducting materials, increase the research and development efforts of materials required in extreme environments such as aerospace, deep sea, and deep earth, and form a number of innovative achievements with broad driving force. We will strengthen the improvement and coordinated application of 10 new materials. We will strengthen the connection between new green building materials standards and public building energy-saving standards, accelerate the formulation of standards for gear steel for rail transportation equipment, carbon/carbon composite structural materials for aerospace, high-temperature alloys, special glass, wide bandgap semiconductors, and chemical products for electronic information, optical functional films, and artificial crystal materials, improve the supporting standards for functional film materials for energy conservation and environmental protection, marine anti-corrosion materials, and do a good job in the layout of additive manufacturing materials, rare earth functional materials, and graphene materials standards, and promote the improvement of new material product quality. We will strengthen the cooperation and support between the upstream and downstream of the new materials industry, carry out collaborative application pilot demonstrations in areas such as aviation aluminum, carbon fiber composite materials, and nuclear power steel, and build collaborative application platforms.
titlelist: Promote breakthrough development in the high-end equipment and new materials industry, lead a new leap in Chinese manufacturing, and enhance the basic support capability of new materials.
