name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: By 2025, the ability of the raw materials industry to ensure and lead the high-quality development of the manufacturing industry will be significantly enhanced. The growth rate of value-added will remain at a reasonable level, and its proportion in the manufacturing industry will be basically stable. The scale of the new materials industry will continue to increase, and its proportion in the raw materials industry will significantly increase. A development pattern of higher quality, better efficiency, optimal layout, greener, and safer industries will be initially formed. The level of high-end supply will continue to improve. The stability, reliability, and applicability of advanced basic materials and high-end products will be significantly enhanced. Some cutting-edge new material varieties will achieve mass production and typical applications. Breakthroughs will be made in key basic materials in strategic areas. The collaborative innovation system will be more efficient and perfect, and the national new materials platform system will be initially established. The innovation capability of the new materials industry will be significantly enhanced, with research and development investment intensity in key industries reaching 1.5% or more, and a number of key core technologies with independent intellectual property rights will be mastered. The level of structural rationalization will continue to improve. The production capacity of key raw material bulk products such as crude steel and cement will only decrease, and the capacity utilization rate will be maintained at a reasonable level. The concentration of key industries will further increase, forming 5 to 10 leading enterprises in the industrial chain with ecological dominance and core competitiveness. The industrial layout will be more coordinated with production factors, forming more than 5 world-class advanced manufacturing clusters in the raw materials field. The intensive level of chemical parks will be significantly improved, forming a number of petrochemical industry bases. The level of green development will be greatly improved. Phase achievements will be made in controlling the total energy consumption and carbon emissions of key industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, and building materials. The comprehensive energy consumption per ton of steel in the steel industry will be reduced by 2%, the energy consumption level of cement products per unit of clinker will be reduced by 3.7%, and the carbon emissions of electrolytic aluminum will be reduced by 5%. The intensity and total amount of pollutant emissions per unit of output in key industries will achieve double reduction, and all industries will achieve stable compliance with emission standards, with new projects meeting ultra-low emission standards. The comprehensive utilization rate of industrial solid waste and other solid waste will be further improved. The effect of industrial digital transformation will be highlighted. More than 20% of enterprises will have a maturity level of level 3 or above in intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and the CNC rate of key processes will exceed 70%. The CNC level of key processes in key areas such as steel will be further improved. The level of digitization, networking, and intelligence in key industries will be significantly improved, and the network security protection capabilities of enterprises will be accelerated. More than 100 intelligent manufacturing demonstration factories and more than 10 industrial Internet platforms will be built. The foundation of system security will be more solid. The ability to ensure strategic resources will be greatly enhanced, forming a basically stable resource guarantee system. The level of key production process technology and equipment autonomy and controllability in key industries will be significantly improved, and the number of breakpoints and bottlenecks in the industrial chain will be significantly reduced. The level of inherent safety in key industries will be greatly improved. The relocation and transformation tasks of hazardous chemical production enterprises in densely populated urban areas will be fully completed. By 2035, it will become a highland for the research, production, and application of world-important raw material products, the competitiveness of the new materials industry will be comprehensively enhanced, the level of green and low-carbon development will be world-leading, and the industrial system will be safe, autonomous, and controllable.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen the support for innovation platform carriers. Encourage leading enterprises to actively participate in the construction and restructuring of national key laboratories, establish national manufacturing innovation centers in key areas, and support the establishment of provincial-level innovation centers. Support the integration of research institutes into the industrial and innovation chains, establish common technology research platforms for industries, and enhance engineering capabilities in green metallurgy, high-end processing, and stable preparation. Support local areas in building national key new material pilot platforms in various forms according to local conditions. Increase the construction of measurement and testing centers, platforms, and alliances for the new materials industry. Continue to organize the construction of national new material production application demonstration and testing evaluation platforms, and promote coordinated progress in product design, research and development, production, system verification, and mass application. Improve the innovation service support system and establish a national shared platform for new material research facilities. Establish a new material data center to enhance the ability to provide data services for industrial development. Optimize and improve the innovation mechanism ecosystem. Support raw material enterprises to increase investment, collaborate with downstream enterprises, universities, and research institutes to carry out basic research and applied innovation in processes, equipment, products, and other aspects. Formulate incentive policies for scientific and technological talents in state-owned enterprises, providing support in performance assessment, research and development investment, total wages, and talent treatment. Select a group of enterprises with a good foundation for innovation to pilot the implementation of policies for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements on par with universities and research institutes, relax restrictions on employee stock ownership, increase the weight of indicators related to the transformation of innovative achievements in performance assessment, and provide preferential treatment to core backbone personnel who have made outstanding contributions. Strengthen international exchanges and cooperation, attract foreign key enterprises and research institutions to invest and establish research and development centers in China, and encourage cooperation between Chinese and foreign institutions in material technology innovation research. Support enterprises in establishing overseas material technology and equipment research and development institutions and carry out international technological innovation cooperation.
titlelist: Promote the high-end transformation of industrial supply and improve the innovation system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen the deep integration of industry, academia, research, and application, promote the optimization of research and development capabilities and resource sharing among research institutes, universities, and enterprises, and overcome mining process technologies such as complex ore deposits and safe and efficient mining in ultra-deep mines. Overcome process equipment technologies such as uniformity control of composition and homogenization and purification of raw materials, improve product performance and stability. Overcome pollution prevention and comprehensive utilization technologies such as mercury-free production of polyvinyl chloride using the calcium carbide method, low-temperature and low-concentration flue gas desulfurization and denitrification, chemical agglomeration-enhanced dust removal of fine particles, and coordinated disposal and resource utilization of solid waste (hazardous waste), improve resource and energy utilization efficiency and achieve ultra-low emission levels. Overcome intelligent manufacturing technologies such as online detection and control, rapid identification and evaluation of material properties, full life cycle management of equipment, fault diagnosis, and predictive maintenance, and improve overall productivity. Organize the promotion of advanced and applicable technologies and roll out the catalog of key advanced and applicable technologies for specific industries. Column 1: Key directions for technological innovation. Petrochemical industry: promote technologies such as high-selectivity catalysis, efficient membrane separation, and inherent safety in hazardous processes, and develop new products such as special metallocene polyolefins, high-end lubricants, high-purity/ultra-high-purity chemicals and industrial specialty gases, and methane coupling to olefins. Advance the engineering of technologies such as clean and efficient utilization of coal, short-process coal-based chemicals, the full industry chain preparation of bio-based materials, low-cost and harmless treatment and resource utilization of phosphogypsum, carbon dioxide capture, storage, and comprehensive utilization. Promote the industrial application of technologies such as new microchannel reactor equipment and continuous flow processes, safe storage and transportation of hazardous chemicals, industrial internet and intelligent manufacturing, and low-global warming potential refrigerant alternatives. Steel industry: promote key common technologies such as efficient and low-cost clean steelmaking, energy conservation, and environmental protection, and advance the engineering of general-purpose and special-purpose equipment and component production technologies such as advanced electric arc furnaces and their manufacturing processes, near-net shape manufacturing, special smelting, and advanced testing. Promote the industrial application of technologies such as backfill mining, low-grade refractory ore beneficiation, sintering flue gas circulation, mechanized raw material yards, efficient desulfurization of blast furnace gas, efficient desulfurization and denitrification, waste heat recovery, medium and low-temperature waste heat utilization, and high-value-added utilization of steel slag. Non-ferrous metal industry: promote new technologies such as mechanical excavation and continuous mining, green and efficient extraction of ion adsorption-type rare earth ores, efficient utilization of associated resources in rare earth polymetallic ores and salt lake lithium resources, material circulation in extraction and separation processes, preparation of ultra-high purity metals and target materials, etc. Advance the engineering of technologies such as high purity and homogenization in metallurgy, short-process preparation of high-performance alloys, precise penetration of high-performance rare earth permanent magnet materials, intelligent unmanned mining, internet of things and cloud services for mine safety management, artificial intelligence for batching and production scheduling, virtual simulation of key processes, intelligent online monitoring and process control for smelting and separation, and machine vision for online quality inspection. Promote the industrial application of technologies such as efficient sorting and pre-selection of low-grade complex ores, efficient comprehensive utilization of tailings and red mud, harmless disposal of hazardous waste containing fluorine and arsenic, and balanced utilization of high-abundance rare earth elements. Building materials industry: promote new technologies such as deep desulfurization and denitrification of cement, chemical agglomeration-enhanced dust removal, and high-efficiency and low-carbon energy conservation. Advance the engineering of technologies such as classification and purification of non-metallic minerals, crystalline protection, particle shape and morphology control, special glass melting and forming technologies, advanced ceramic powder preparation technologies, co-firing technologies for high-temperature solid oxide fuel cell powders and components, molding and sintering technologies, large-size artificial crystal preparation technologies, integrated manufacturing of structural-functional refractory materials, and in-service diagnosis and maintenance. Promote the industrial application of technologies such as fully automated operations in underground mining, three-dimensional simulation of open-pit mining, unmanned blasting, online monitoring of ore, efficient dissociation of graphite, protection of large flakes, fluorine-free purification, intelligent continuous drawing of high-performance fibers such as special glass fibers and basalt fibers, and mining and material deep processing technologies.
titlelist: Promote the high-end transformation of industrial supply and conquer key technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adhere to the principle of giving equal importance to material-driven and demand-driven approaches, focusing on the major needs of national defense construction, addressing shortcomings in people's livelihood, and building a strong manufacturing country. Develop and publish a rolling catalog of key material products, and formulate and release technology roadmaps. Implement actions to address key material shortages, using methods such as announcing the list and appointing leaders and racing horses, to support joint research by material production and application enterprises and research institutions, and carry out collaborative research on wide bandgap semiconductors and display materials, integrated circuit key materials, bio-based materials, carbon-based materials, and biomedical materials. Implement actions to consolidate and enhance bulk basic materials, guide enterprises to optimize production processes, and use new generation information technologies such as industrial internet to enhance the comprehensive competitiveness of advanced manufacturing basic components such as steel for advanced manufacturing, high-strength aluminum alloys, rare and precious metal materials, special engineering plastics, high-performance film materials, new fiber materials, and composite materials. Implement actions to strategically lay out cutting-edge materials, support research institutions and enterprises in grasping the development trend of integrating new material technologies with information technology, nanotechnology, and intelligent technology, and develop superconducting materials, intelligent biomimetics, additive manufacturing materials, etc., to promote the systematic development of new backbone materials and strengthen support and guidance in application areas. Implement the material genetic engineering program and explore pilot applications of new models for material research and development. Implement actions to promote the application of key materials, optimize the compensation mechanism for the first batch of key new material applications, and promote the application of new materials through measures such as the promotion of the first set (batch) and green building materials. Column 2: New Material Innovation and Development Project. Breakthrough in key varieties. Focus on key application areas such as large aircraft, aviation engines, integrated circuits, information and communication, biotechnology, and energy industries, and overcome key materials such as high-temperature alloys, aerospace lightweight alloys, ultra-high-purity rare earth metals and compounds, high-performance special steels, degradable biomaterials, special coatings, photoresists, targets, polishing fluids, industrial gases, biomimetic synthetic rubber, artificial crystals, high-performance functional glass, advanced ceramic materials, special separation membranes, and high-performance rare earth magnetic, catalytic, optical functional, and hydrogen storage materials. Enhance public platforms. Build manufacturing innovation centers for high-end polyolefins, rare metals, powder metallurgy, advanced glass, and advanced ceramics. Construct production and application demonstration platforms for information and communication equipment, energy conservation and environmental protection, and robot equipment materials. Establish regional centers for new material testing and evaluation platforms and new material data centers. By 2025, the capability to ensure key materials will be enhanced, the capacity for public services will be significantly improved, and more than 10 new material platforms will be established.
titlelist: Promote the high-end transformation of industrial supply and breakthrough in key materials.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Develop and strengthen leading enterprises. Adhere to the combination of market orientation and government promotion, remove barriers to cross-regional mergers and reorganizations, eliminate restrictions such as market segmentation and regional blockades, coordinate and solve major issues related to cross-regional mergers and reorganizations of enterprises, support enterprises in accelerating cross-regional and cross-ownership mergers and reorganizations, improve industrial concentration, and engage in international operations. In industries such as petrochemicals, steel, non-ferrous metals, and building materials, cultivate a group of industry-leading enterprises with ecological dominance and core competitiveness, strengthen and expand rare earth enterprise groups, and encourage the integration of rare metal enterprises. Play the leading role of chemical and building materials industry leaders to promote corporate restructuring and reform. Provide capacity replacement support policies for industries such as steel that have completed substantial mergers and reorganizations. Improve industry norms and management, promote the concentration of market factors to advantageous enterprises. Encourage financial institutions to provide comprehensive financial services to raw material enterprises implementing mergers and reorganizations and transformation and upgrading in accordance with the principles of controllable risks and commercial sustainability. Cultivate and strengthen small and medium-sized enterprises. Improve the innovation capabilities and specialization levels of small and medium-sized enterprises in the raw materials industry, encourage leading enterprises to include supporting small and medium-sized enterprises in common industrial chain management, quality management, standard management, cooperative research and development management, etc., establish stable collaborative relationships in supply, production, sales, etc., and achieve integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Focus on cultivating a group of specialized and innovative small giants enterprises and manufacturing industry champions in advanced basic processes and core basic components of the raw materials industry chain.
titlelist: Promote the rationalization of industrial structure and optimize organizational structure.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Expand the domestic demand for high-end materials. Accelerate the upgrading and replacement of traditional materials to meet the needs of new infrastructure construction, high-end equipment, new urbanization, transportation and water conservancy projects, and the people's pursuit of a better life. Remove invisible barriers and unreasonable regulations that restrict the application of materials. Revise and improve design and application standards, expand the domestic market for mature products such as green building materials, promote the application of green building materials and the construction of pilot cities, promote prefabricated buildings and steel structure housing, and tap into the consumption potential of high-performance aluminum and other high-end materials. Actively explore new markets and applications for traditional products, continuously enhance the competitive advantage and efficiency of traditional industries. Strengthen the matching of supply and demand in the raw materials industry, reduce ineffective supply, expand effective supply, improve the adaptability of supply structure to demand structure, and promote the formation of a high-level dynamic balance between demand-driven supply and supply-driven demand. Strengthen the connection and coordination between upstream and downstream industries. Raw material enterprises should strengthen synergistic and symbiotic development with upstream and downstream enterprises, extend their production to component manufacturing, and transform into providing integrated material system solutions. Adopt a cooperation model that involves early-stage R&D and continuous improvement in the later stages, promote business model innovation and format innovation, and facilitate the transformation from production-oriented manufacturing to service-oriented manufacturing. Support industry associations in building platforms for supply-demand connection. Establish and improve upstream and downstream cooperation mechanisms for aviation materials, heavy-duty gas turbine materials, integrated circuit materials, rare earth permanent magnet materials for new energy vehicle drive motors, biomedical materials, and hot-rolled steel for construction. Leverage leading enterprises to drive innovation and application of new materials. Support third-party organizations in organizing and promoting comprehensive application demonstrations of key materials.
titlelist: Promote the rationalization of industrial structure and promote industrial synergy.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Support efficient use of resources, continuously improve the level of key processes and process management, increase the efficiency of resource utilization, and reduce resource and energy consumption from the source. Promote comprehensive utilization of solid waste in the raw materials industry, focusing on tailings, waste rock, fly ash, red mud, smelting slag, electrolytic manganese slag, industrial by-product gypsum, chemical waste residue, waste fibers, and composite materials, etc. Construct a number of industrial resource utilization bases, and in key areas, establish comprehensive utilization projects for tailings, phosphogypsum, electrolytic manganese slag, and zinc-containing secondary resources in the steel and non-ferrous metal industries, as well as demonstration lines for the coordinated disposal of waste in gasification furnaces, cement kilns, and large-scale sintered brick tunnel kilns, to accelerate the achievement of harmless, reduction, and resource-based disposal. Encourage the implementation of slag-based production for phosphogypsum nationwide. Accelerate the treatment and recycling of plastic pollution, and promote the industrialization and application of biodegradable plastics. Develop and improve building material co-production systems that enhance the efficiency of resource utilization. Promote the priority use of unconventional water sources such as recycled water and seawater in the production processes of the raw materials industry to reduce the use of fresh water. Promote the deep treatment and recycling of wastewater in the petrochemical, steel, and other industries, and create a number of demonstration enterprises and parks for industrial wastewater recycling. Encourage regions with conditions to promote the integrated development of petrochemicals, steel, non-ferrous metals, building materials, and electricity industries, establish raw materials industry development parks, and achieve hierarchical utilization of energy resources and industrial circular connection. Improve the mechanism for resource price formation.
titlelist: Accelerate the green development of industries and enhance the level of comprehensive resource utilization.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the construction of digital infrastructure. Encourage enterprises to transform production process conditions and accelerate the deployment of digital tools and equipment such as intelligent sensors, processors, gateways, and instruments, to enhance the real-time perception and data acquisition capabilities of production sites such as ore selection, smelting, chemical reactions, etc. Establish a unified data integration and management platform to achieve centralized management of data throughout the research and development, production, operation, and maintenance processes. Encourage eligible enterprises to upgrade their networks using new generation information technologies such as 5G, and build a ubiquitous perception and interconnected factory operating environment to improve production intelligence. Encourage enterprises to develop advanced process control systems based on data-driven, mechanistic models, empirical models, and simulation models, and optimize the operating parameters of production equipment. Establish real-time monitoring, abnormal condition warning, dynamic scheduling, and intelligent disposal for key links such as raw material feeding, reaction processes, smelting processes, quality control, pollutant emissions, and energy consumption. Construct digital twin models for major production scenarios, process flows, and key core equipment. Encourage the use of robots in positions with high labor intensity, harsh working environments, high safety risks, and high precision requirements. Establish enterprise management and business decision-making systems that integrate customer service, business management, production execution, and process control information. Accelerate the transformation of enterprise management systems. Support enterprises in carrying out pilot demonstrations and hierarchical assessments of the integration of the two industries' management systems. Organize assessments of the degree of integration of the two industries, clarify the development focus and improvement paths for enterprises with different degrees of integration, and guide enterprises to gradually or cross-level improve the level of integration and application of information technology. Support the promotion and replication of advanced practices in the integration of the two industries by leading enterprises, and incorporate supporting enterprises into common management systems such as supply chain collaboration, quality control, and cooperative research and development, to drive the improvement of the intelligence level of upstream and downstream enterprises in the industrial chain and enhance the security of the industrial chain and supply chain. Support small and medium-sized enterprises in accelerating transformation and upgrading, and promote the popularization and application of new generation information technologies in research and development, design, production, manufacturing, business management, and product services, as well as collaborative innovation.
titlelist: Accelerate the digital transformation of industries and speed up the intelligentization of manufacturing processes.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the construction of secondary nodes for the identification and resolution of the industrial internet of things in the raw materials industry, and promote the exploration and application of identification and resolution in supply chain collaboration, product traceability, inventory management, and other aspects. Encourage leading enterprises to create networked collaboration platforms between enterprises, realizing resource sharing and collaborative manufacturing among multiple production bases. Encourage leading enterprises in the industrial chain to create enterprise-level industrial internet platforms, achieve integration of the industrial chain and supply chain, and build industrial internet platforms with characteristics for specific industries and regions, as well as professional technical industrial internet platforms. Encourage enterprises to connect enterprise-side and user-side data based on the platform, guided by downstream customer needs, and restructure product structures and manufacturing processes, realizing a shift from large-scale mass production to large-scale customization. Build cross-industry and cross-domain industrial internet platforms, explore cross-domain integration of the raw materials industry with logistics, urban construction, energy, and other industries. Encourage leading enterprises in the raw materials industry, third-party institutions, and others to lead the creation of specialized and characteristic industrial internet platforms for the raw materials industry, promoting the digital transformation and cloudization of key equipment. Focus on cultivating and promoting a batch of industrial apps and solutions for process management, providing research and development design, software usage, production manufacturing, equipment operation and maintenance, business management, warehousing and logistics, and other services for small and medium-sized enterprises. Accelerate the exploration of the integration and development of the raw materials industry and 5G + industrial internet, create more typical application scenarios, and empower enterprises to improve quality, reduce costs, and increase efficiency.
titlelist: Accelerate the digital transformation of industries and promote the empowerment of the industrial Internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Increase the exploration efforts for scarce mineral resources such as iron ore, copper, and potassium. Actively carry out exploration in the deep parts and periphery of existing mines. Implement tax incentives to encourage the adoption of advanced processes and equipment to reduce solid waste generated by the mining industry. Promote the efficient and intensive utilization of low-grade ores and encourage the comprehensive utilization of complex associated minerals and mine solid waste. When delineating ecological protection red lines and other control lines, fully integrate them with strategic mineral resource areas. Construct high-standard mines as appropriate to strengthen the role of domestic mineral resources as a ballast and enhance basic guarantee capabilities. Optimize the management mechanism for annual mining control indicators and scientifically regulate the scale of rare earths, tungsten, and other mineral resources extraction. Improve the policy on mineral resource equity funds. Expand diversified resource supply channels. Develop urban mines resources and support leading enterprises in establishing large-scale scrap steel and recycling bases and industrial clusters for aluminum, copper, lithium, nickel, cobalt, tungsten, molybdenum, etc., and promote the integrated development of recycling, dismantling, processing, classification, and distribution of recycled metals. Build a mineral resource reserve system that involves both national and corporate participation, combining product reserves with resource reserves. Improve the ore trading market system and establish an open, transparent, fair, and reasonable pricing mechanism. Promote international cooperation in the field of mineral resources, optimize the structure and layout of overseas investments in accordance with the principles of equality, mutual benefit, and win-win cooperation, regulate and orderly participate in overseas resource development, and enhance the global strategic capabilities of mineral resources. Encourage the import of low-carbon petrochemical raw materials such as light hydrocarbons. Strictly implement the import standards for recycled resources and promote the import of high-quality recycled resources. Implement the Strategic Resource Security Project. Implement the planning requirements for strategic mineral resources, carry out domestic exploration actions for strategic mineral resources, and achieve increased exploration and storage. Support the construction of key domestic mines such as iron ore, copper, and rare earths, and select and construct a batch of efficient development and utilization bases for important inorganic non-metallic mineral resources. Construct recycling and utilization projects that comply with industrial policies for recycled resources. Encourage enterprises to carry out overseas resource exploration and development in a standardized manner and construct comprehensive resource bases integrating mining, selection, and metallurgy. By 2025, the resource guarantee capability will be significantly improved, a stable and open resource guarantee system will be established, a number of domestic leading large-scale mineral development enterprises will be formed, and more than 15 efficient development and utilization bases for key non-metallic minerals will be built. The domestic self-sufficiency rate of ferrous metals will be greatly increased, with the scrap steel ratio reaching over 30%, and the proportion of recycled copper and aluminum production reaching 35% and 20% respectively.
titlelist: Ensure the security of the industrial system and enhance the capacity to safeguard resources, and promote the rational development of domestic mineral resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Raw Material Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 212) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Natural Resources/December 29, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Expand the supporting supply channels. content: Support new material enterprises to carry out market-oriented joint reorganization, and form a group of leading enterprises with strong innovation capabilities and international influence. Encourage the development of new models such as mass entrepreneurship, mass innovation, mass support, and mass crowdfunding, and form a group of specialized and excellent new material small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the establishment of industrial alliances between upstream and downstream enterprises, large, medium, and small enterprises, with capital as the link and close integration of production, education, research, and application, to concentrate advantageous resources and accelerate the research, industrialization, and application of new materials. Encourage new material enterprises to establish flexible and standardized corporate systems and decision-making systems, actively carry out independent innovation and introduce digestion, absorption, and re-innovation, form close upstream and downstream relationships, and achieve from specialization to refinement, and from refinement to strength. Strengthen the training of new material talents and the construction of innovative teams, rely on key enterprises, alliances, universities, vocational colleges, public training bases, and public service platforms, cultivate a group of engineering and engineering graduate students through joint research and implementation of major projects, and cultivate a group of industrial workers, technical backbones, and innovation teams. Organize visits by experts and academicians in the new material industry, provide training for professional and technical talents in the new material field, promote international exchanges of new material talents, implement projects to introduce foreign experts in the new material field, and optimize the growth environment for new material talent teams.
titlelist: Key task: Cultivating advantageous enterprises and talent teams.

name: Guidelines for the Development of New Materials Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 454) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance/December 30, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Implement the national regional development strategy, promote the coordinated development of the new materials industry, form a coordinated and orderly new materials industry overall pattern in the eastern, central, western, and northeastern regions, and enhance the level of new materials aggregation in key areas such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and the Yangtze River Economic Belt. Scientifically plan industrial layout, avoid redundant construction, encourage new materials enterprises and research institutions in various regions to leverage regional advantages, rationally allocate industrial chains, innovation chains, and resource chains, and promote the development and growth of regional characteristic new materials industries. Advanced basic materials should fully consider the existing industrial foundation and resource and environmental carrying capacity, and accelerate the adjustment of layout in accordance with the development path of intensification, parkization, and greening. Key strategic materials should be centered around downstream major demands and major engineering projects, accelerate the construction of production and application demonstration platforms, and form a number of key new materials aggregation areas and innovation radiation centers. Cutting-edge new materials should fully rely on research institutes and other innovation institutions, actively develop emerging business models, and build a number of industrial demonstration projects. Consolidate and enhance the strength of existing new materials industrial bases and parks, and promote the formation of several characteristic industrial aggregation areas in key new materials fields that have complete industrial chains, comprehensive supporting facilities, and strong competitiveness.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the characteristic agglomeration and development of the new materials industry.

content: By 2020, the overall layout of the national new materials testing and evaluation platform will be completed, and a preliminary testing and evaluation service network system will be formed. A main center will be established with functions such as overall coordination, resource sharing, and certification services. Several industry centers will be built in the fields of advanced basic materials, key strategic materials, and cutting-edge new materials. Based on the current industrial agglomeration situation, a number of regional centers will be established. The testing and evaluation issues of key new materials will be basically resolved. By 2025, the capabilities of the main center and industry centers will be further enhanced, and the regional centers will basically meet the development needs of local new materials industries, with significantly enhanced radiating and driving effects. The coordinated and supporting new materials testing service system of the main center, industry centers, and regional centers will be basically sound, with greatly improved networked service capabilities and levels of sharing and utilization, and a testing and evaluation system covering the major new materials industrial agglomeration areas and upstream and downstream markets nationwide will be basically formed. content: Responsible for comprehensive testing and evaluation services for new materials, as well as the development and application of key common testing technologies and capabilities. The main center relies on excellent domestic testing and evaluation institutions, and jointly establishes partnerships with internet companies, new materials production enterprises, application units, and relevant social capital to achieve coordinated development through business and capital links with industry centers and regional centers. The main center's construction mainly includes improving key common instruments and equipment for testing, application evaluation, life prediction, failure analysis, metrology, etc. of key new materials, constructing facilities for simulating testing under service conditions and assessment experiments, and enhancing testing and evaluation capabilities. It formulates data collection and sharing mechanisms, establishes databases for new materials' organizational composition, basic performance, service performance, testing methods, evaluation indicators, etc., and carries out data analysis, international mutual recognition, and application research for new materials testing and evaluation. It establishes a standard system for testing and evaluating new material products. It fully utilizes information technology such as the internet to carry out the construction of network systems for e-commerce, business management, training services, etc., and realizes the sharing of new materials testing instruments and equipment, testing needs and services, testing talents and qualifications, etc.

content: The Industry Center is an authoritative testing and evaluation institution in the industry, mainly responsible for the development of testing and evaluation technology for new materials in the industry and external services. Focusing on important industry sectors in advanced basic materials, key strategic materials, and cutting-edge new materials, it relies on backbone testing and evaluation units in the industry, collaborates with other related testing and evaluation service institutions in the same industry, and attracts leading enterprises and social capital to jointly build. The construction of the industry center mainly includes: improving specialized testing capabilities for specific new material varieties in the industry, such as material composition, physical and chemical indicators, material structure, and service performance. Building engineering application assessment devices for downstream key application areas, conducting international comparisons and mutual recognition, and meeting the needs of material application evaluation and failure analysis under service conditions. Building related digital simulation and modeling systems in key new material areas. Establishing an industry new material testing and evaluation certification system. Collaborating with the main center to develop testing and evaluation technology for new materials in the industry and revise related standards.

content: The regional center is established to meet the development needs of the regional new materials industry. It relies on existing testing and evaluation institutions within the region, integrates relevant testing and evaluation resources, and is built as a local new materials testing and evaluation center based on the principles of specialization and intensification. According to the layout of China's new materials industry and the advantages and prospects of local new materials industry development, the regional center will be constructed in an orderly manner in key provinces of the regional new materials industry, such as the Bohai Rim, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Northeast, and Central and Western regions. The construction of the regional center mainly includes the establishment of specialized facilities for reliability testing, accelerated testing, and life evaluation of new materials under special geographical and climatic conditions based on the regional geographical features and natural environment. It also improves the testing and evaluation equipment for major, scarce, and specialized purposes to meet the testing and evaluation needs of key new materials within the region. Furthermore, it establishes a regional testing service capability sharing mechanism to improve the utilization rate of testing instruments and large-scale equipment.
titlelist: Construction and operation, functional positioning and construction content, regional center.

By providing services such as testing and evaluation, certification, consulting, training, and big data, they can obtain operational benefits and achieve sustainable development. category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: To adapt to the rapid development trend of new materials technology and industrial transformation, accelerate the construction of the new materials industry standard system. The new materials industry standard system consists of three standard subsystems: advanced basic materials, key strategic materials, and cutting-edge new materials. The advanced basic materials standard subsystem is an upgrade of the traditional raw materials standard system, including advanced steel materials, advanced non-ferrous metal materials, advanced chemical materials, advanced building materials, advanced textile materials, and other standard subsystems. The key strategic materials standard subsystem focuses on enhancing the guarantee capability of new materials, focusing on major needs in industries such as next-generation information technology and high-end equipment manufacturing, and establishing standards for high-end equipment special alloys, high-performance fibers and composite materials, semiconductor materials and new display materials, new energy materials, and biomedical materials. The cutting-edge new materials standard subsystem focuses on the standard layout of leading industrial technologies such as graphene, additive manufacturing materials, superconducting materials, and extreme environment materials, and plans for future development patterns and paths.

content: Establish and improve the standard system for silicon-based semiconductor materials, improve the standards for 200-300mm silicon wafers and SOI wafers, establish standards for key materials such as photoresist, ultra-high purity specialty electronic gases, and PVD targets, and accelerate the localization of integrated circuit manufacturing materials. Establish standards for third-generation wide bandgap semiconductor materials such as silicon carbide, gallium nitride, and boron nitride, guiding the development of semiconductor devices towards higher efficiency, higher power density, and higher reliability. Conduct research on key technologies for same/different heteroepitaxy on large-size high-aluminum/high-indium composition nitride, silicon, silicon carbide, and nitride semiconductor substrates, and establish common technical standards for third-generation semiconductor epitaxial materials. Conduct research on the testing, evaluation, and related standards of key supporting materials for third-generation semiconductor packaging and testing, such as deep ultraviolet resistant, high moisture resistant, high thermal conductivity, and high refractive index packaging materials, high temperature resistant and high reliability interconnect materials, high thermal conductivity and reliable substrate materials, high insulation strength and high temperature resistant encapsulation materials, and high thermal conductivity and low coefficient of thermal expansion substrate materials. Improve the aerospace electronic standard system, conduct research on radiation-resistant wide bandgap semiconductor device design, and standard research on materials and structures for high temperature resistant and high reliability power devices.

content: Aiming at the forefront of biological science development, focusing on the technological support needs of the biological industry, vigorously promoting the construction of an innovative system for the biological manufacturing industry, conducting key technology research and development in areas such as raw material utilization, biological tool creation, biological processing processes, and equipment, solving basic scientific problems such as biological catalysts, design, synthesis, and optimization control of artificial biology, achieving disruptive technological innovation and application in areas such as artificial life forms, enzyme protein machines, nano-bio devices, genome editing, molecular recognition and biosensing, biomimetic manufacturing, etc., with a focus on achieving key technological and process breakthroughs in the biological conversion of one-carbon compounds such as carbon dioxide, bio-manufacturing of olefins, heterologous synthesis of natural compounds, and large-scale manufacturing of bio-based materials, significantly enhancing the independent innovation capability of the biological manufacturing industry, the technological support capability for industrial development, and the ability to cultivate new business models, laying a solid foundation for the construction of a new industrial system and accelerating the development of innovative industrialization.
titlelist: Promote new development in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and accelerate the construction of the innovation system in the bio-manufacturing industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Biotechnology Industry (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2016] No. 2665) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: With the creation and application of new biotechnological tools as the core, we aim to build a core technological system for the bio-manufacturing of bulk chemical products, chemical polymer materials, and bulk fermentation products, continuously improving the economic viability and market competitiveness of bio-based products. We will establish bio-manufacturing routes for basic chemical products such as organic acids, chemical alcohols, olefins, alkanes, aromatic hydrocarbons, and organic amines, gaining a competitive advantage over petroleum-based routes and achieving large-scale production and application of bio-based methods. We will promote the development and application of bio-manufacturing and polymer modification technologies for chemical polymer materials, such as polyols, hydroxycarboxylic acids, and oleic acids, and drive the large-scale production and demonstration application of bio-based polyesters, bio-based polyurethanes, bio-based nylon, bio-based rubber, microbial polysaccharides, marine biomaterials, etc., realizing the chain, aggregation, and large-scale development of the bio-based materials industry. We will significantly enhance the independent innovation capability and international competitiveness of bulk fermentation products such as amino acids and vitamins, achieving a positive and high-end development of the industry.
titlelist: Promote new developments in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and improve the economic viability and market competitiveness of bio-based products.

name: Notice on Issuing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Energy Conservation (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2012] No. 3) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 27, 2012)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: In industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, chemicals, building materials, machinery, light industry, textiles, and electronic information, we will vigorously promote structural energy conservation. Following the concept of a circular economy, we will optimize industrial structure and spatial layout, promote the integration of industries upstream and downstream, and focus on comprehensive utilization of energy and resources. We will strictly control the rapid growth of high-energy-consuming industries, eliminate outdated processes, equipment, and products, and develop energy-efficient and high-value-added products and equipment. We will greatly improve the energy utilization level of industries, continue to strengthen major energy-saving technological innovation and demonstrations, increase the promotion of advanced and applicable energy-saving technologies, accelerate the formulation of major energy-saving standards, and ensure the achievement of the energy-saving targets for the 12th Five-Year Plan period.

name: Notice on Issuing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Energy Conservation (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2012] No. 3) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 27, 2012)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: With a focus on process optimization and secondary energy recovery, improve the quality of materials and fuels, increase the coal injection ratio and the proportion of pellet usage in blast furnaces, increase the recycling and comprehensive utilization of scrap steel, and reduce the iron-to-steel ratio. Vigorously develop green steel products, effectively control the growth of steel production, eliminate sintering machines below 90 square meters, blast furnaces below 400 cubic meters, converters and electric furnaces below 30 tons, coking chambers with a height less than 4.3 meters (3.8 meters for stamping coke ovens), conventional coke ovens for machine coke with a capacity of 6300 kiloamperes and below, semi-closed direct current electric furnaces for iron alloys below 3000 kiloamperes, and refining electric furnaces. Increase the technological transformation efforts for energy-efficient recovery, conversion, and utilization, and improve the comprehensive utilization level of secondary energy. Promote the comprehensive application of technologies such as dry quenching of coke ovens, dry dedusting of converter gas, dry dedusting of blast furnace gas, coal moisture adjustment, hot charging of continuous casting billets, and negative refining in converters; focus on promoting technologies such as low-temperature waste heat utilization of sintered pellets, online heat treatment of steel, etc.; demonstrate and promote technologies such as waste heat recovery of riser pipes, dehumidification of blast air, utilization of waste plastics and tires in coke ovens; research and promote technologies such as high-temperature heat recovery and utilization of steel slag and iron slag, direct reduction iron production process, etc.; accelerate the application of motor system energy-saving technologies and energy-saving transformers. By 2015, the application ratios of technologies such as negative refining in converters, dehumidification of blast air, waste heat power generation from sintering, and coal moisture adjustment should reach 65%, 20%, 40%, and 50% respectively.
titlelist: Key industry energy-saving approaches and measures, steel industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Energy Conservation (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2012] No. 3) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 27, 2012)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Vigorously develop high value-added industries such as copper and aluminum deep processing products and new materials, accelerate the development of recycling resource processing parks and comprehensive utilization industries for recycled metal resources, strictly control the increase in electrolytic aluminum production capacity, guide the transfer of electrolytic aluminum production to energy-rich western regions, eliminate pre-baked anode cells with a capacity of 100 kiloamperes and below, closed drum roasters, electric furnaces, and reverberatory furnaces for copper refining processes and equipment, as well as sintering machines without supporting acid-making and tail gas absorption systems such as sintering pots, sintering pans, simple blast furnaces, sintering-blast furnaces, and lead refining processes and equipment. Focus on energy-saving in the production processes of electrolytic aluminum, alumina, copper, lead, zinc, magnesium, and other products, comprehensively promote technologies such as waste heat power generation in non-ferrous metal smelting, short process production of copper materials, and efficient beneficiation in metal mines, as well as efficient and energy-saving mining and beneficiation equipment. Key areas of promotion include new structural aluminum electrolytic cells, low-temperature and high-efficiency aluminum electrolysis, electrolytic aluminum liquid alloy forming and processing technologies, and new processes such as direct reduction of lead slag with high lead content in molten state by oxygen bottom blowing. Research and promote flash smelting technology, etc. Column 2: Energy-saving measures and targets for key products in the non-ferrous metal industry. Electrolytic aluminum: Promote new cathode structure aluminum electrolytic cells, new flow guide structure aluminum electrolytic cells, and large-scale aluminum electrolytic cells with high anode current density. By 2015, the popularity rate of new structural aluminum electrolytic cells should reach over 80%. Alumina: Promote efficient and energy-saving production technologies for alumina using low-grade bauxite, Bayer process high-concentration leaching slurry liquid separation technology, and series production technologies for alumina. Copper smelting: Research and promote technologies such as oxygen bottom blowing furnace continuous copper smelting and flash furnace short process copper smelting. Lead-zinc smelting: Accelerate the research and development and promotion of energy-saving technologies for short process continuous lead smelting and direct reduction lead smelting process with high lead slag in molten state. By 2015, the proportion of advanced oxygen bottom blowing (top blowing) processes in total lead smelting capacity should reach 80%. Magnesium smelting: Use clean energy sources such as coke oven gas, semi-coke oven gas, gasifier gas, natural gas, or coal-water slurry as fuel, comprehensively transform backward magnesium smelting production processes, support the research and development and industrialization demonstration of internal resistance heating silicon thermal reduction technology and equipment, and promote thermal storage high-temperature air combustion technology.
titlelist: Key industry energy-saving approaches and measures, non-ferrous metal industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Energy Conservation (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2012] No. 3) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 27, 2012)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: With a focus on increasing the added value of petrochemical products, we will vigorously develop high-end or specialty petrochemical products such as polycarbonate, polyoxymethylene, polybutylene terephthalate, high-strength and high-modulus carbon fiber, high-performance polytetrafluoroethylene, butyl rubber, ethylene-propylene rubber, isoprene rubber, etc. We will strengthen the research and development of renewable resins and the recycling of waste plastics, and strive to increase the new products and new grades of energy-saving and environmentally friendly styrene-butadiene rubber, butadiene rubber, nitrile rubber, and chloroprene rubber. We will actively promote the application of energy-saving styrene-butadiene rubber. We will comprehensively promote technologies such as large-scale ethylene cracking furnaces; focus on promoting technologies and equipment such as preheating of cracking furnace air, optimization of heat transfer processes, optimization of middle section reflux heat recovery ratio, utilization of medium and low temperature waste heat, permeation vaporization membrane separation, deep thermal coupling of gas separation units, efficient heating furnaces, and efficient heat exchangers. We will demonstrate and promote optimization control technologies for turbine compressor units, integrated technologies for gas turbines and cracking furnaces, and advanced control technologies for ethylene cracking furnace temperature and load, as well as optimization operation technologies for C2 hydrogenation reaction processes. Column 3: Energy-saving measures for key products in the petrochemical industry. Ethylene: optimize raw material structure, promote lightweight raw materials, support ethylene production enterprises in energy-saving transformation, and achieve optimal utilization of energy in production systems. By 2015, the comprehensive energy consumption of ethylene will be reduced to 857 kg of standard coal per ton. Aromatics: optimize operating processes and achieve rational utilization of steam energy levels. By reducing the effective load of heating furnaces and improving the thermal efficiency of heating furnaces, the fuel consumption of heating furnaces can be reduced. Promote new and efficient catalysts (adsorbents) to improve the energy utilization efficiency and economic benefits of facilities. Synthetic materials and monomers: Carry out targeted energy-saving technology transformations for production facilities of polyethylene, polypropylene, caprolactam, acrylonitrile, ethylene glycol, etc., reduce the consumption of steam, water, and raw materials, and improve the energy efficiency of facilities. Develop and produce new products and new grades of energy-saving and environmentally friendly synthetic resins, synthetic rubber, and synthetic fibers.
titlelist: Key industry energy-saving approaches and measures, petrochemical industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Energy Conservation (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2012] No. 3) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 27, 2012)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on industries such as synthetic ammonia, caustic soda, soda ash, calcium carbide, and traditional coal chemical industry, and reasonably control their new production capacity. Eliminate small-scale synthetic ammonia units with high energy consumption and heavy pollution, mercury-based caustic soda production units, graphite anode membrane caustic soda production units, and ordinary metal anode membrane caustic soda production units that do not adopt energy-saving measures (such as expanding anodes and modified membranes), as well as calcium carbide furnaces that do not meet the access conditions and sulfuric acid and sulfur production units below 100,000 tons (except for remote areas). Vigorously develop high-end chemicals such as functional membrane materials, advanced energy storage materials, biodegradable materials, environmentally friendly and energy-saving coatings, electronic-grade fluorine-containing fine chemicals, new catalytic materials, and high-performance environmentally friendly water treatment agents. Promote the concentration of production of resource-based products such as fertilizers, methanol, and calcium carbide to the raw material production areas. Organize and implement demonstration projects for modern coal chemical industry such as coal-to-oil, coal-to-olefins, coal-to-natural gas, and coal-to-ethylene glycol, comprehensively evaluate and explore new ways of efficient and clean conversion of coal. Improve the domestic guarantee capacity of new materials and the refinement rate of the chemical industry, with the rate of fine and specialty chemicals reaching 50% by 2015. Promote advanced technologies such as advanced coal gasification, advanced rectification, liquid caustic soda evaporation, flash recovery of ammonia waste liquid, as well as new membrane distance ion membrane electrolyzers, sliding high-pressure chlorine gas compressors, and new calcium carbide furnaces. Focus on promoting technologies such as high-pressure steam recovery in hydrogen chloride synthesis, vacuum distillation, dry ash addition, recovery and utilization of yellow phosphorus smoke, and comprehensive utilization of tail gas from calcium carbide furnaces. Research and promote technologies such as low-voltage ion membrane electrolysis with oxygen cathode, energy-saving ammonium sulfate furnace, and low-temperature waste heat recovery in inorganic chemical production processes. Column 4: Energy-saving measures and targets for key products in the chemical industry. Synthetic ammonia: Optimize the raw material structure, achieve diversification of ammonia production materials, support nitrogen fertilizer companies in energy-saving transformation, accelerate the localization process of complete sets of technologies and equipment for large-scale coal-to-ammonia, and reduce the comprehensive energy consumption of synthetic ammonia to 1350 kg of standard coal per ton by 2015. Caustic soda: Promote the localization of membranes used in ion membrane caustic soda production, support the energy-saving transformation of caustic soda units using new membrane distance ion membrane electrolyzers, and reduce the comprehensive energy consumption of caustic soda (30% using ion membrane technology) to 330 kg of standard coal per ton by 2015. Soda ash: Increase product structure adjustment, increase the proportion of heavy soda ash and dried ammonium chloride production, encourage large and medium-sized enterprises to adopt measures such as combined heat and power, and multi-stage utilization of steam to improve the utilization efficiency of heat energy. By 2015, the comprehensive energy consumption of soda ash should be reduced to 320 kg of standard coal per ton. Calcium carbide: Promote the merger and reorganization of the calcium carbide industry, encourage enterprises to concentrate in resource and energy production areas, promote the rational development of industrial layout structure, accelerate the transformation of internal combustion furnaces, and improve the level of technology and equipment. By 2015, the comprehensive energy consumption of calcium carbide should be reduced to 1050 kg of standard coal per ton. Yellow phosphorus: Strengthen the recovery and utilization of tail gas, promote deep purification, production of high-tech and high-value-added carbon-chemical products, and the use of dry dust removal technology instead of wet dust removal technology. Strengthen research and demonstration projects for the comprehensive utilization of thermal energy and slag of molten phosphorus slag.
titlelist: Key industry energy-saving approaches and measures, chemical industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Energy Conservation (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2012] No. 3) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 27, 2012)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: With cement, flat glass, and new wall materials as the focus, we will vigorously develop cement-based products such as ready-mixed concrete, pre-mixed mortar, and concrete products, as well as energy-saving building materials such as hollow glass, laminated glass, and high-performance fireproof insulation materials, sintered hollow products, and fly ash steam-cured aerated concrete lightweight insulation wall materials. We will phase out outdated process equipment such as cement mechanized shaft kilns with a diameter of 3.0 meters and below, ball mills with a diameter of less than 3.0 meters (except in remote areas of western provinces), and flat glass production lines using the plate-pulling process (including the float glass method). We will carry out technological transformation for cement clinker production lines, cement grinding stations, and ordinary float glass production lines that do not meet comprehensive energy consumption standards. For those that still do not meet the standards after technological transformation, they will be shut down within a specified period. We will promote the comprehensive utilization of waste heat from glass kilns, technologies such as full oxygen combustion and high-temperature pre-decomposition of raw materials, as well as ceramic dry powder production and one-step firing processes. We will focus on promoting technologies and equipment such as cement pure low-temperature waste heat power generation, vertical mills, roller presses, variable frequency speed regulation, and the utilization of combustible waste. We will demonstrate and promote high-solid-gas ratio cement suspension calcination processes, as well as waste heat utilization in sintered brick tunnel kilns and energy-saving frequency conversion of kiln fans. Column 5: Key energy-saving measures and targets for the building materials industry. Cement: vigorously develop ecological cement and deep-processed cement products, and continue to promote pure low-temperature waste heat power generation in cement kilns. Carry out equipment energy-saving transformation with a focus on grinding power saving. By 2015, the proportion of pure low-temperature waste heat power generation in cement kilns will be increased to more than 65%. Flat glass: accelerate the development of deep-processed glass, improve the rate of deep processing of glass, promote raw material optimization, and pure low-temperature waste heat power generation in glass kilns. By 2015, the proportion of pure low-temperature waste heat power generation in glass kilns should reach more than 30%. Building sanitary ceramics: promote thinning of ceramic tiles and lightweight technology for sanitary ware, and increase the utilization rate of large-scale, intelligent, and energy-saving production equipment. Wall materials: promote waste heat power generation technology in sintered brick tunnel kilns using coal gangue and internal combustion technology in sintered bricks, improve the energy efficiency level of wall materials, vigorously develop new types of load-bearing wall materials, and replace solid clay bricks. By 2015, the proportion of new wall materials in production should reach more than 65%.
titlelist: Key industry energy-saving approaches and measures, building materials industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Energy Conservation (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2012] No. 3) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 27, 2012)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on the papermaking, ceramics, daily glass, fermentation, plastic processing, and salt industry, vigorously develop energy-saving products such as ultra-thin ceramics and lightweight glass bottles and cans; eliminate single production lines with an annual output of less than 34,000 tons of non-wood pulp, annual output of less than 51,000 tons of chemical wood pulp paper production lines, single production lines with an annual output of 10,000 tons or less of waste paper as raw material pulp production lines, annual output of less than 30,000 tons of alcohol and monosodium glutamate production lines (excluding alcohol production from waste molasses), and leather production lines with an annual processing capacity of less than 30,000 standard sheets of blue wet skin and an annual processing capacity of less than 50,000 standard sheets of raw skin; eliminate production facilities in the northern sea salt industry with an annual output of less than 300,000 tons and lake salt industry with an annual output of less than 200,000 tons, and single sets of vacuum salt production equipment with an annual production capacity of 100,000 tons or less; strengthen waste heat recovery and utilization in the papermaking, daily glass, salt production, and other industries, and encourage the development of cogeneration of heat and power in the papermaking and fermentation fields. Promote low-energy cooking, efficient waste paper disintegration, and other energy-saving technologies, as well as efficient evaporation and concentration, new fermentation equipment, etc.; focus on promoting rapid drying, large-scale spray towers, sludge dewatering, membrane separation and concentration, strain breeding, and fermentation process control technologies, as well as energy-saving and environmentally friendly glass melting kilns such as oxygen-enriched and full combustion; demonstrate and promote energy-saving technologies such as mechanical steam recompression, comprehensive utilization of secondary energy, and boot-type pressing; research and promote new fermentation technologies, large-tonnage continuous ball mills, and new screwless plastic processing equipment. By 2015, the proportion of membrane separation and concentration technology should reach more than 30%, and the proportion of new chromatographic separation technology should reach more than 60%. Column 7: Energy-saving measures in key areas of the light industry. Papermaking: Use low-energy cooking, closed screening, medium-consistency washing and bleaching technology and equipment for chemical pulping. Optimize the application of steam recovery technology and equipment in chemical mechanical pulping; use dry screening, efficient waste paper disintegration technology and equipment to improve waste paper pulping process and technology; use new dehydration elements and efficient wire washing devices in the paper machine wire section, and demonstrate and promote technologies such as wide pressure zone pressing, composite pressing, and boot-type pressing in the pressing section; use closed drying cylinder covers, bag ventilation, and waste heat recovery devices in the drying section. Adjust the fiber raw material structure of papermaking, and by 2015, the proportion of waste paper pulp should reach 65%. Ceramics: Increase the intensity of product structure adjustment and vigorously develop ultra-thin ceramics; encourage the use of clean fuels such as natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas; improve the automation, continuous operation capacity, and process innovation of key equipment, and promote the improvement of energy efficiency in key processes such as ceramic processing, forming, drying, and firing. Daily glass: Increase research and development investment in lightweight glass technology and vigorously develop lightweight glass bottles and cans; optimize the design of glass furnace structures, increase the application of energy-saving and environmentally friendly glass melting kilns, improve the processing capacity of crushed glass, and increase the amount of crushed glass used. Fermentation: Promote efficient new evaporation equipment in the fermentation and extraction processes, strengthen the application of waste steam recovery and comprehensive utilization technology at the end, support the demonstration application of secondary energy comprehensive utilization technology and equipment such as biogas power generation, steam cascade utilization, and cascade water recycling. Plastic processing: Carry out energy-saving technology research and development for key plastic processing equipment such as injection molding machines, extruders, and auxiliary equipment, promote technologies such as fully closed-loop servo drive, dynamic molding processing, and reasonable comprehensive utilization of waste and old plastics by electromagnetic induction heating, and improve the energy efficiency level of the plastic processing industry. Salt production: Speed up the introduction and digestion of salt and nitrate co-production technology, promote energy-saving technologies such as three-phase flow separation and preheating anti-scaling, cogeneration, and carry out comprehensive energy-saving technology transformation of salt production systems. Household appliances: Strengthen ecological design, adopt energy-saving technologies such as frequency conversion, carry out green manufacturing, and vigorously promote energy-efficient air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, and other products with energy efficiency levels above level 2.
titlelist: Key industry energy-saving approaches and measures, light industry.

Conduct comprehensive demonstrations of carbon reduction, zero carbon, and negative carbon technologies. Support key technological breakthroughs and industrial development in new energy, new materials, new energy vehicles, new energy aircraft, green ships, green agricultural machinery, new energy power, efficient energy storage, carbon capture, utilization and storage, zero carbon industrial process reengineering, carbon sequestration in agriculture, forestry, and fisheries, substitution and reduction of hazardous substances, and resource utilization of industrial wastewater.
