Accelerate innovation in high-end materials, support the construction of production and application demonstration platforms for key materials in aviation, nuclear energy, engines, and other critical areas, promote the verification and promotion of new material applications, and develop high-performance, functional, and differentiated advanced basic material supply capabilities. Accelerate the construction of rare earth functional materials innovation centers and industry testing and evaluation centers, support the development of green mining and smelting separation technologies for rare earths, and accelerate the development of rare earth new materials and high-end application industries. Support the conduct of user satisfaction surveys for key raw material products, and continuously improve the quality of raw material supply with a user-centered approach.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Petrochemical and Chemical Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2016] No. 318) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 18, 2016)
content: Strictly control the excess capacity of industries such as urea, ammonium phosphate, calcium carbide, caustic soda, polyvinyl chloride, soda ash, and yellow phosphorus. Implement equal or reduced replacement for advanced process improvement projects that meet policy requirements. Explore the establishment of a legal and market-oriented mechanism for phasing out outdated capacity, guide enterprises to carry out mergers and acquisitions, and leverage the competitive and forcing mechanisms of market selection and pressure. Fully utilize measures such as safety, environmental protection, energy conservation, and pricing to promote the elimination of outdated and inefficient capacity and create greater market space for advanced capacity. Upgrade existing production facilities through advanced technologies such as clean production, reduce consumption, decrease emissions, and enhance comprehensive competitiveness and sustainable development capabilities. Strengthen application research and development, expand the consumption of traditional products in various fields. Enhance brand awareness, improve product quality, establish a sound brand management system, and create a group of internationally renowned brands with high visibility and reputation. Integrate and optimize production service systems, focus on developing modern productive service industries such as technology services, research and development design, engineering contracting, information services, energy conservation and environmental protection services, and financing leasing, and provide socialized and specialized services to the industry. Traditional chemical industry upgrading and efficiency improvement project. Completely eliminate mercury catalyst acetylene-based polyvinyl chloride production facilities in the chlor-alkali industry, moderately promote the application of acetylene-dichloroethane synthesis technology, accelerate the research and development of mercury-free catalysts, and reduce mercury pollutant emissions. Promote energy-saving technologies such as zero-gap and oxygen cathodes to reduce industry energy consumption. Encourage the development of high-end fine chlorine products and improve the comprehensive utilization level of by-product hydrogen chloride in chlorine-consuming products. Promote the use of all-halogen alkali production technology for soda ash in areas with conditions. Promote the research and development and application of new technologies such as acetylene-based chemical products, oxygen-thermal method for calcium carbide furnaces, high-value utilization of furnace gas, and comprehensive utilization of waste heat in the calcium carbide industry. Increase the promotion of lime nitrogen as a low-toxic green pesticide and fertilizer. Develop and promote advanced clean production technologies for inorganic salts, develop food-grade and electronic-grade fine inorganic salt products, and strengthen the utilization of waste heat from common inorganic salt processes such as high-temperature calcination. Strengthen the research and development and promotion of environmentally friendly coatings, accelerate the development and industrialization of special coatings for high-end fields such as aviation and aerospace, and promote clean production processes for fully enclosed integrated coatings. Strengthen the research and development and promotion of clean production processes for dyes and intermediates, as well as advanced and applicable three-waste treatment technologies, improve dye application technologies and supporting additives, and enhance the value-added services in the dye industry. Develop high-performance tires such as aviation radial tires, green radial tires, and agricultural radial tires, as well as supporting materials such as low rolling resistance fillers, ultra-high-strength and ultra-high-strength steel wire curtain cords, and high-dispersion white carbon black and dispersants. Promote energy-saving processes such as wet rubber refining and nitrogen-filled high-temperature vulcanization, and establish tire testing grounds.
titlelist: Main tasks and major projects, promoting the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Petrochemical and Chemical Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2016] No. 318) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 18, 2016)
content: Surrounding the fields of aviation and aerospace, high-end equipment, electronic information, new energy, automobiles, rail transportation, energy conservation and environmental protection, medical health, and national defense and military industry, we will enhance the industrial technology of engineering plastics to meet the requirements of lightweight, high strength, high temperature resistance, stability, shock absorption, and sealing. We will accelerate the development of high-performance carbon fiber and composite materials, special rubber, graphene, and other high-end products, and strengthen applied research. We will enhance the level of process technology for electronic chemicals supporting the electronic information and new energy industries. We will develop functional membrane materials for water treatment, traditional process transformation, and new energy applications. We will focus on the development of new bio-based plasticizers and biodegradable polymer materials. We will establish a column for the innovation and development of chemical new materials. We will enhance the production technology of engineering plastics such as polyether ether ketone/nitrile, PCT/PBT resin, polysulfide, engineering nylon, and polyimide, and accelerate the development of long-chain nylon, high-temperature resistant nylon, amorphous copolyester (PETG), and high-performance polyoxymethylene modified products. We will promote the industrialization of benzyl-based organosilicon monomers, focusing on the development of high-end fluorosilicone polymers (fluorosilicone resin, fluorosilicone rubber), fluorine-containing functional membrane materials, and high-quality fluorine and silicon fine chemicals (high-purity electronic chemicals, fluorine and silicon surfactants, fluorine and silicon intermediates, etc.), and accelerate the development of low-temperature ozone-depleting substances (ODS) substitutes. We will focus on the development of high-strength and high-modulus carbon fibers, para-aramid fibers, ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fibers, polysulfide fibers, polyimide fibers, and polyethylene terephthalate glycol fibers, and break through the low-cost, continuous, and large-scale production technology of high-strength carbon fibers, and accelerate the industrial breakthrough of high-strength medium-modulus and high-strength high-modulus carbon fibers. We will accelerate the development of fiber-grade polysulfide, bio-based propylene glycol, and polyethylene terephthalate glycol resins and other supporting raw materials. We will focus on the development of high-performance separation membranes for petrochemicals, metallurgy, and biotechnology, improve the performance of ion exchange membranes for the chlor-alkali industry, and reach the world's advanced level in terms of membrane resistance and transmembrane voltage. We will promote the industrialization of fuel cell membranes and industrial-grade high-performance bipolar membranes. We will develop low-cost, high-performance pervaporation and electrodialysis equipment for acid-base recovery and achieve industrial application. We will develop high-end lithium-ion battery separators and flexible packaging films, polyvinyl fluoride (PVF) and polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) backsheet films, and fluorinated proton exchange membranes. We will also develop polarizing films for thin-film transistor-liquid crystal displays (TFT-LCD). For electronic chemicals, we will develop electronic chemicals for integrated circuits, with a focus on the development of 248nm and 193nm photoresists, high-purity reagents and gases for PPT, polyimide, and liquid epoxy packaging materials. We will develop special resins for printed circuit boards, such as special epoxy resins, polyimide resins, and thermosetting polyphenyl ether resins for rigid boards, as well as polyimide films, special polyester films, and conductive coatings for flexible boards. We will develop liquid crystal materials for flat panel displays. We will develop new electrolytes such as lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for new energy batteries and new electrolyte solvents such as fluoroethylene carbonate. For bio-based materials, we will promote the substitution of bio-based plasticizers for phthalate plasticizers. We will accelerate the development of bio-based polymers such as polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA), polycarbonate propylene carbonate (PPC), bio-based diacid diol copolyesters, bio-based polyols and polyurethanes, and bio-based nylons. We will make substantial progress in the low-cost production of cellulose ethanol and downstream bio-based ethylene, achieving partial substitution of petroleum raw materials. For 3D printing materials, we will accelerate the development of photosensitive resins for 3D printing, as well as polyether ether ketone, carbon fiber-reinforced nylon composites (above 200°C), colored flexible plastics, and PC-ABS materials with high temperature resistance and high strength. We will improve the level of 3D printing process technology, including stereolithography (SLA), fused deposition modeling (FDM), selective laser sintering (SLS), three-dimensional printing (3DP), and material jetting.
titlelist: The main tasks and major projects are to develop new materials for the chemical industry.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Petrochemical and Chemical Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order [2016] No. 318) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 18, 2016)
content: Taking into account factors such as resource supply, environmental capacity, security guarantee, and industrial foundation, we will promote the orderly construction of seven major petrochemical industrial bases and major projects, enhance the guarantee capacity of basic products such as olefins and aromatics, and improve the level of refining and petrochemical integration. We will accelerate the upgrading and transformation of existing ethylene units, optimize the raw material structure, achieve economies of scale, increase processing depth, and enhance international competitiveness. We will expedite the construction of aromatics projects to make up for supply shortages. In resource-rich and environmentally suitable areas in the central and western regions, in conjunction with the development of large-scale coal bases, we will steadily carry out key technological engineering and industrial upgrading demonstrations for modern coal chemical industry in accordance with environmental access requirements, focusing on improving resource utilization and environmental protection levels, enhancing unit competitiveness, and promoting clean and efficient utilization of coal resources. We will strengthen the guarantee of basic products in Column 9. We will accelerate the construction of major petrochemical projects for olefins, carry out lightweight transformation of ethylene raw materials, and enhance unit competitiveness. We will carry out demonstrations for upgrading coal-to-olefins, coordinate the use of international and domestic resources, moderately develop methanol-to-olefins and propane dehydrogenation to propylene, increase the proportion of non-petroleum-based products in ethylene and propylene production, and improve guarantee capacity. In accordance with the requirements of the national petrochemical industry layout plan, we will accelerate the development of petrochemical aromatics industry, actively promote the industrialization of coal-to-aromatics technology, and promote diversification of raw material routes. We will promote the construction of integrated industrial bases for aromatics, ethylene glycol, and polyester. We will accelerate the development of organic raw materials such as ethylene glycol, styrene, and acrylonitrile, and improve the guarantee capacity of organic raw materials. We will promote diversification of raw material routes and steadily develop non-petroleum-based ethylene glycol. We will accelerate the promotion of clean production processes, promote green technology transformation of organic raw materials, focus on improving the process routes of products such as propylene oxide, epichlorohydrin, and methyl methacrylate, and intensify efforts to save energy and reduce emissions.
titlelist: The main tasks and major projects, promoting the construction of major projects.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Petrochemical and Chemical Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 318) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/ October 18, 2016)
content: Encourage key enterprises to obtain production technologies for new chemical materials and high-end specialty chemicals through investment, mergers and acquisitions, and restructuring, strengthen technology digestion, and promote domestic industrial upgrading.
titlelist: Main tasks and major projects, expanding international cooperation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Petrochemical and Chemical Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 318) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 18, 2016)
content: Establish key industry alliances in order to promote cooperation between upstream and downstream sectors in the chemical new materials industry. Research and formulate insurance compensation mechanisms to support the first batch application of chemical new materials.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, innovative system mechanisms

name: Development Plan for Nonferrous Metal Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 316) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 19, 2016)
content: With the aim of meeting the needs of key basic materials in high-end fields such as new generation information technology, aerospace, marine engineering and high-tech ships, advanced rail transportation, energy-saving and new energy vehicles, we focus on the development of high-performance lightweight alloy materials, non-ferrous metal electronic materials, non-ferrous metal new energy materials, and rare metal deep processing materials through collaborative innovation and intelligent manufacturing. We aim to improve the uniformity of material quality, reduce costs, and enhance the capacity and level of mid-to-high-end effective supply.

name: Development Plan for Nonferrous Metal Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 316) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 19, 2016)
content: Accelerate the implementation of large-scale aluminum-lithium alloy ingot smelting and casting, high-precision thin plate with high-speed air cushion continuous heat treatment system, large coil heavy high-precision wide magnesium alloy strip manufacturing, titanium alloy profile extrusion processing and online precision straightening, large-scale titanium alloy materials, 3D printing powder and other production line transformations and upgrades in the fields of large aircraft, passenger cars, high-speed rail, ships, and marine engineering. By 2020, stable supply of high-performance lightweight alloy materials for aviation, passenger cars, and freight trains, as well as titanium and aluminum alloy materials for marine engineering and aviation, will be achieved, and international competitiveness will continue to improve. Column 6: Key development areas for lightweight alloy materials. Aluminum alloy materials: aluminum alloy thin plates resistant to damage for aerospace applications, new high-strength and high-toughness aluminum alloy thick plates, extruded materials and forgings, third-generation aluminum-lithium alloy sheets and extruded profiles, high-corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy sheets for land and water transportation, high-strength weldable large complex section aluminum alloy profiles, high-performance aluminum alloy car panels, foam aluminum structural components for automotive collision prevention systems, aluminum alloy precision forgings and aluminum-silicon alloy die castings for automotive engines and internal structural components, high-strength corrosion-resistant aluminum alloy pipes for oil drilling, etc. Magnesium alloy materials: high-strength magnesium alloy large-sized complex castings for aerospace applications, high-strength heat-resistant magnesium alloy large-sized extruded profiles/forgings, magnesium alloy precision die castings for 3C products, large coil low-cost high-formability magnesium alloy sheets and strips, magnesium alloy precision die castings for lightweight automotive structural components, etc. Titanium alloy materials: titanium alloy thin plates/thick plates/rods/forgings for aerospace applications, 3D printed titanium alloy complex structural components and supporting low-cost titanium alloy powders, titanium alloy ultra-wide thick plates/large-diameter thick-walled pipes for ships and marine engineering, superplastic-formed titanium alloy thin plates, medium-strength/high-strength titanium alloy extruded profiles, high-precision titanium coil-welded pipes and supporting large coil low residual stress titanium strips for seawater desalination equipment, high-corrosion-resistant titanium alloy pipes for oil drilling, etc.
titlelist: Vigorously develop high-end materials, high-performance lightweight alloy materials.

name: Development Plan for Nonferrous Metal Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 316) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 19, 2016)
content: Utilizing advanced and reliable technologies, we aim to meet the demands in the field of integrated circuits, functional components, and other areas related to the new generation of information technology industry. We will accelerate the development of large-size silicon single crystal polishing wafers, ultra-large specification high-purity metal targets, substrates and packaging materials for high-power microwave/laser devices, infrared detection and imaging materials, vacuum electronic materials, etc. This will achieve breakthroughs in the research and industrialization of new generation microelectronic optoelectronic functional materials and intelligent sensing materials, and enhance the supply level of high-end non-ferrous metal electronic materials. Column 7: Key development areas for non-ferrous metal electronic materials. Materials for integrated circuits: electronic-grade polysilicon, 12 and 18-inch silicon single crystal polishing wafers, flat alloy targets, rotating targets, and oxide targets, 6-inch germanium wafers, new high-strength and high-conductivity/high-strength and high-elasticity copper alloy strip materials for lead frames, copper-clad laminates, and ultra-thin copper foils for current collectors. New supporting materials: high-performance copper alloy ultra-fine wire materials and ultra-thin strip materials, positive silver electronic paste for photovoltaic solar cells, high-performance silver powder, lead-free solder strips for photovoltaics, various high-performance solder strips, thick film pastes, low-cost metal electronic pastes, electrode pastes for fuel cells. Other materials: ultra-pure rare metals and high-precision deep processing materials, tantalum powder for capacitors, tungsten and molybdenum narrow bands for vacuum electronic devices, high-purity and ultra-high-purity metals, high-performance permanent magnet ferrites with high saturation magnetic flux density, high DC bias characteristics, high permeability, and other properties of soft magnetic materials.
titlelist: Vigorously develop high-end materials, non-ferrous metal electronic materials.

name: Development Plan for Nonferrous Metal Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 316) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 19, 2016)
content: Focus on the development of high-capacity, long-life energy storage battery cathode materials, anode materials, high-performance copper foil and aluminum foil, as well as low-cost, high-quality battery-grade lithium carbonate, ternary precursors, etc., in response to the demand in the field of energy storage and new energy vehicles. Column 8: Key development areas for non-ferrous metal new energy materials. Basic raw materials: battery-grade lithium carbonate, lithium fluoride, cobalt trioxide, ternary hydroxide, etc. Cathode materials: layered high-nickel cathode materials with high specific capacity and long cycle life for lithium-ion batteries, lithium-rich manganese-based solid solution cathode materials, high specific capacity, high energy density, long cycle life lithium-sulfur battery cathode materials. Anode materials: high specific capacity, long cycle life silicon-carbon/alloy anode materials. Other materials: high-strength, high-ductility, low-defect aluminum foil, copper foil, and porous copper foil for lithium-ion batteries, efficient, low-cost core-shell structure fuel cell oxygen reduction catalysts, metal (aluminum, magnesium, etc.) air electrode materials for metal-air batteries.
titlelist: Vigorously develop high-end materials, new energy materials for non-ferrous metals.

name: Development Plan for Nonferrous Metal Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 316) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/October 19, 2016)
content: Focused on the demands in the fields of high-end equipment manufacturing, strategic emerging industries, and national major projects, the key development areas include precision hard alloy and deep processing products, large-sized tungsten-molybdenum plates and foils, nuclear-grade zirconium-hafnium-beryllium materials. Tungsten-molybdenum: ultra-high hardness and high toughness hard alloys, high-end coated hard alloy cutting tools/molds, high-performance refractory metal powders, large and complex tungsten-molybdenum parts. Zirconium-hafnium-beryllium: nuclear-grade sponge zirconium-hafnium and processed materials, functional zirconium-hafnium ceramics; high-performance beryllium materials, wide-width high-precision beryllium-copper alloy strips, beryllium-aluminum alloys. titlelist: Vigorously develop high-end materials, rare metal materials.

content: Combining the needs of high-end equipment manufacturing in marine engineering, nuclear power, and other industries, we will vigorously develop high-performance corrosion-resistant copper alloys, large-diameter corrosion-resistant copper alloy pipes, low-expansion, high-fatigue-resistant copper alloys, nickel-based high-temperature corrosion-resistant alloys, carbonyl nickel, carbonyl nickel-iron powder, magnesium-based hydrogen storage materials, gold nano-catalysts, and powder materials to meet domestic demand.
titlelist: Vigorously develop high-end materials, other metal functional materials.

name: Release of the 'Catalog of Technologies and Products Encouraged for Promotion and Application in the Building Materials Industry (2016-2017 Edition)' (No. 15 of 2016) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/March 29, 2016)
content: The technology has been used to transform two float glass production lines, achieving mass production with stable product quality. The TCO glass produced is used in photovoltaic building integrated projects, with a photovoltaic conversion efficiency exceeding 7%. The technology for monitoring the stripes on the float glass utilizes optical principles, computer digital image technology, and dynamic acquisition methods. It magnifies and displays the end face of the float glass product on a computer monitor, allowing clear observation of the uniform and non-uniform characteristic stripes generated during the melting and forming process of the float glass. By using application software, the relationship between the stripe image information and the flow process inside the forming kiln is established, and the collected stripe images are analyzed to determine the range of glass flow faults inside the kiln, and make automatic adjustments.

The performance of the pre-hydrated bentonite waterproof blanket produced by this technology is comparable to that of organic anti-seepage materials such as SBS. It reduces pollution. 17 Alkali-resistant, wear-resistant, fast-repair refractory materials. This product has plasticity or vibration pouring dual construction characteristics by controlling the amount of water added. The binder and accelerator are added during on-site construction, and it has the characteristics of high strength, early demolding, no baking, and strong resistance to alkali erosion. It can be widely used in industrial kiln overhaul (reconstruction), medium repair, and minor repair.

content: This product is formed in one piece, requires no maintenance, and has a wide range of applications. This product has been tested on high-speed trains and has good damping, heat insulation, and flame retardant effects, meeting the requirements. It is formed in one piece and has excellent properties such as high tensile strength, good compression rebound performance, oil resistance, high temperature resistance, flame retardancy, and superior sealing performance, reaching ST-2 level. name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Strengthen the unified planning of exploration, development, and utilization of rare earth resources by the country. Based on the resource situation and market demand, regulate the total amount of mining and production reasonably to ensure national economic security and long-term development needs. By 2020, the annual mining volume of rare earths should be controlled within 140,000 tons. Crack down severely on illegal and irregular practices in rare earth production, protecting while developing, and developing while protecting. Strictly enforce the market access system, with no additional mining rights granted except for the six large rare earth enterprise groups. Continue to support key resource areas such as Baotou in Inner Mongolia, Liangshan in Sichuan, Ganzhou in Jiangxi, and Longyan in Fujian to improve mining area resource protection and monitoring facilities, and strengthen technological transformation of rare earth mining and selection projects. Strengthen the reserve and protection of identified large and medium-sized mineral deposit resources, aligning with the National Mineral Resource Plan (2016-2020) to designate a batch of national planned mining areas, implementing unified planning, scale development, key supervision, and promoting the protection and rational utilization of high-quality resources.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen resource and ecological protection, promote sustainable development, and enhance rare earth resource management.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Strictly implement national and local pollutant emission standards, rigorously review environmental impact assessments for construction projects and enterprises, and resolutely eliminate outdated production capacity. Promote the use of new mining technologies and processes, implement a guarantee deposit system and economic responsibility for geological environmental protection and restoration in rare earth mines, strengthen the treatment and disposal of tailings ponds, and implement a production wastewater discharge permit system. Promote new technologies for pollution prevention and control in the integrated extraction and smelting of ion-type rare earth ores, and promote clean production in the industry. Establish a mechanism for green development of rare earths, implement industry norms, and comprehensively implement mandatory clean production audits in the rare earth industry.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen resource and ecological protection, promote sustainable development, and enhance resource and ecological protection.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: The rare earth elements are classified into three categories: strategic, critical, and general, based on their scarcity and development status. Element classification management is implemented to match the value of the elements with economic benefits. Strengthening the reserve of strategic and critical products and improving the rare earth reserve system. Enhancing the management of the entire industry chain, including mining, production, and circulation of medium and heavy rare earth elements, and firmly cracking down on illegal production, smuggling, and tax evasion related to rare earths.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen resource and ecological protection, promote sustainable development, manage rare earth elements according to their functions.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Give full play to the core leading role of scientific and technological innovation, improve the rare earth innovation system with enterprises as the main body, market-oriented, and the combination of government-industry-university-research-application, promote the construction of national and industry innovation centers and service platforms. Targeting strategic emerging industries and other national strategies and future industrial development high points, carry out original innovation, integrated innovation, and introduce digestion and absorption for re-innovation, achieve breakthroughs in the key application areas of rare earth functional materials such as next-generation information technology and industrial robots, and cultivate advanced enterprises with strong innovation capabilities; carry out research on efficient separation and extraction of rare earth metal resources, low-cost green smelting and separation, high-end product preparation, and recycling of waste rare earth metals, and research on key equipment.
titlelist: Key tasks, support innovation system and capacity building, cultivate new drivers of industry, improve industry innovation system.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Strengthen the analysis and strategic research on rare earth patents, research on intellectual property protection mechanisms, and establish an industrial-oriented rare earth technology core patent and patent pool. Support the development of projects with independent intellectual property rights and encourage companies to apply for foreign patents. Utilize the important role of rare earth enterprises, research institutes, universities, academic groups, and industry organizations in standard setting, improve the domestic rare earth standard system, strictly enforce mandatory standards, and establish a rare earth standardization information platform to serve industry management.
titlelist: Key tasks, support innovation system and capacity building, cultivate new driving forces in the industry, strengthen intellectual property and standard system construction.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Explore the intrinsic characteristics of rare earth elements, explore new functions of rare earth materials, and expand new applications. Aim at the forefront of international new materials, carry out research on new materials such as rare earth magnetism, catalysis, and optical functions based on material genetic engineering, and break through a batch of rare earth new materials and key technologies for green preparation that are urgently needed by the country and leading future development.
titlelist: Key tasks, support innovation system and capacity building, cultivate new driving forces in the industry, and promote research on the functional mechanisms of rare earths.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Continue to implement the strategy of large conglomerates, further promote the intensive production of rare earth mining, smelting and separation, and comprehensive utilization of resources. Include all aspects of mining, smelting and separation, and comprehensive utilization of resources under the management of six conglomerates, realizing centralized production, management, and process reengineering of rare earths. Improve inter-group collaboration mechanisms, strengthen industry self-discipline, maintain market order, maintain supply-demand balance, and assume social responsibilities. Support the conglomerates in expanding their application industries and enhancing core competitiveness. Support the construction of China Rare Metal Valley in Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, and promote the transformation and upgrading of key rare earth resource industries in Baotou, Inner Mongolia, Longyan, Fujian, and Liangshan, Sichuan, extending the industrial chain and increasing product added value.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote intensive and high-end development, adjust and optimize the structure, promote the intensive development of rare earths.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Accelerate the development of high-performance rare earth materials such as magnetic, hydrogen storage, crystal, luminescent, and high-frequency materials. Enhance the guarantee capability of rare earth key materials and components. Cultivate the application of rare earth in fields such as aviation and aerospace, rail transportation, marine engineering, industrial robots, high-end CNC machine tools, and medical devices. Harness the supporting role of rare earth materials in the digitalization, intelligence, and networking construction of future social development.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote intensive and high-end development, adjust and optimize the structure, promote high-value applications of rare earth materials.

name: Rare Earth Industry Development Plan (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 319) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/September 29, 2016)
content: Extend the industrial chain downstream, promote the integrated development of rare earth magnetic materials - permanent magnet motors, rare earth luminescent materials - LED display devices, rare earth catalytic materials - industrial kiln denitrification functional devices, rare earth alloy materials - automotive and aerospace components, and other deep processing and application industries of rare earths. Form a raw material supply system that is compatible with the demand of terminal applications, and achieve coordinated development of the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain. Guided by the demand for terminal applications such as industrial robots, energy conservation and environmental protection, and new energy vehicles, encourage downstream enterprises to participate in the research and development of new rare earth materials, strengthen the close connection between rare earths and application industries, develop rare earth functional components and parts with independent intellectual property rights, and improve the research and development and production level of rare earth functional materials and components, and realize the optimization and upgrading of the entire rare earth industry chain.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote intensive and high-end development, adjust and optimize the structure, achieve coordinated development of upstream and downstream industries.

name: The Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (2016 Edition) and Management Measures for the Announcement of Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 30, 2016)
content: The production scale of mixed rare earth mining enterprises should not be less than 20,000 tons per year (calculated in terms of oxides, the same below); the production scale of fluorocarbon cerium mining enterprises should not be less than 5,000 tons per year; the production scale of ion-type rare earth mining enterprises should not be less than 500 tons per year. It is prohibited to mine single monazite. The production scale of independent smelting and separation enterprises using mixed rare earth ore should not be less than 8,000 tons per year; the production scale of independent smelting and separation enterprises using fluorocarbon cerium ore should not be less than 5,000 tons per year; the production scale of independent smelting and separation enterprises using ion-type rare earth ore should not be less than 3,000 tons per year; the production scale of smelting and separation projects of comprehensive recycling and utilization of rare earth resources enterprises should not be less than 3,000 tons per year. The minimum capital ratio of the above fixed asset investment projects shall not be less than 20%.
titlelist: Production scale, technology, and equipment, production scale.

name: The Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (2016 Edition) and Management Measures for the Announcement of Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 30, 2016)
content: Rare earth mining, smelting, and separation enterprises should adopt clean production processes that are low in pollution, emissions, and energy consumption, and are economically efficient. The mature technologies listed in the National Key Industry Clean Production Technology Guideline Catalog should be promoted and used. The Industrial Structure Adjustment Guideline Catalog and the Elimination Catalog of High Energy-consuming and Outdated Mechanical and Electrical Equipment (Products) should not be used. Outdated processes, technologies, equipment, and products that should be eliminated are specified in the regulations. For the development of mixed rare earth ore and fluorocarbon cerium ore, complete waste treatment facilities, dedicated waste rock yards, and tailings ponds should be established. For the development of ion-type rare earth ore, production processes suitable for resource and environmental protection requirements, such as in-situ leaching, should be used, and outdated production processes such as heap leaching and vat leaching that are prohibited by the country should be prohibited. Projects using the ammonia saponification rare earth smelting and separation process must have complete ammonia comprehensive recycling facilities that are in normal operation, and all emission indicators must meet the Rare Earth Pollutant Emission Standards (GB26451-2011). Rare earth smelting and separation projects should adopt clean and efficient extraction and separation processes and should not use outdated production processes prohibited by the country.
titlelist: Production scale, technology, and equipment, technology and equipment.

name: The Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (2016 Edition) and Management Measures for the Announcement of Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 30, 2016)
content: The rare earth smelting and separation project should adopt advanced processes and equipment, have sound energy-saving measures, and the energy consumption must meet the requirements of the Energy Consumption Limit for Rare Earth Smelting and Processing Enterprises (GB29435-2012). General equipment such as motors, pumps, and transformers should meet the corresponding energy efficiency standard requirements, and should be subject to supervision and inspection by energy-saving supervision agencies in accordance with the Energy Conservation Law.

name: The Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (2016 Edition) and Management Measures for the Announcement of Rare Earth Industry Standard Conditions (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 30, 2016)
content: The mining loss rate and impoverishment rate of mixed rare earth ore and fluorocarbon cerium ore shall not exceed 10%. The beneficiation recovery rate of general ore shall reach over 75% (including the following). The beneficiation recovery rate of low-grade and difficult-to-select rare earth ore shall reach over 65%. The water recycling rate for production shall be over 85%. The comprehensive recovery rate of ion-type rare earth ore shall be over 75%, and the water recycling rate for production shall be over 90%. For the smelting and separation projects of mixed rare earth ore and fluorocarbon cerium ore, the total rare earth recovery rate from rare earth concentrate to mixed rare earth shall be greater than 92%, and from mixed rare earth to single or enriched rare earth compound, the total rare earth recovery rate shall be greater than 96%. For the smelting and separation projects of ion-type rare earth ore, from mixed rare earth to single or enriched rare earth compound, the total rare earth recovery rate shall be greater than 94%. The total rare earth recovery rate from mixed rare earth to single or enriched rare earth compound in the smelting and separation projects of comprehensive rare earth resource recycling and utilization enterprises shall be implemented according to the above standards.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Semiconductor Lighting Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 772) (Ministry of Science and Technology/July 11, 2012)
content: In recent years, semiconductor lighting technology has developed rapidly, moving towards higher light efficiency, better light quality, lower cost, more functionality, more reliable performance, and wider application. Currently, the international level of high-power white LED (light-emitting diode) industrialization has exceeded 130lm/W (lumens per watt). It has been reported that laboratory LED efficiency exceeds 200lm/W. Although the technological and application innovations of LEDs have far exceeded expectations, there is still a huge development space compared to the theoretical efficiency of 400lm/W. Along with the rapid technological development of semiconductor lighting, new applications continue to emerge. Currently, the competition focuses mainly on GaN-based LED epitaxial materials and chips, high-efficiency and high-brightness high-power LED devices, LED functional lighting products, intelligent lighting systems and solutions, innovative lighting applications, and the development of related major equipment. OLED (organic light-emitting diode), as a soft planar light source, has also developed rapidly in recent years and can complement LED light sources. It has been reported that laboratory white OLED efficiency has reached 128lm/W. The research and development of related organic light-emitting materials, production equipment, and new types of lamps are also on the rise. Currently, there are already a small number of OLED lighting products on the market.
titlelist: The situation and demand, rapid development of semiconductor lighting technology and applications.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Semiconductor Lighting Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 772) (Ministry of Science and Technology/July 11, 2012)
content: In recent years, many developed countries/regions have arranged special funds, established special programs, and formulated strict plans to phase out incandescent lamps, vigorously supporting domestic and regional semiconductor lighting technology innovation and industrial development. The global industry presents a tripartite competition among the United States, Japan, and Europe, with South Korea, mainland China, and Taiwan rising up. The semiconductor lighting industry has become the direction for the strategic transfer of international large enterprises, with the speed of industry integration accelerating and business models continuously innovating. Targeting emerging application markets, international large consumer electronics companies have begun to develop from the back end of the industry chain to the front end. Integrated circuit manufacturers, represented by Taiwan, have also accelerated their layout in the field of semiconductor lighting. The competition for patents, standards, and talents has reached a white-hot stage, and the industry development is showing an explosive growth trend, reaching a critical moment to seize the commanding heights of the industry.
titlelist: Situations and demands, explosive growth in the semiconductor lighting industry.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Semiconductor Lighting Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 772) (Ministry of Science and Technology/July 11, 2012)
content: Under the continuous support of national research and development investment and the drive of market demand, China's semiconductor lighting technology innovation capability has been rapidly improved. The technological innovation gap between the upstream of the industrial chain and the international level has gradually narrowed, and downstream lighting applications are expected to achieve leapfrog development through system integration technology innovation. Some industrialized technologies are approaching the international advanced level, with the luminous efficiency of power-type white LED packaging exceeding 110lm/W, close to the international advanced level. The industries of indicators, displays, and large-sized backlight sources are beginning to take shape, and the industrial chain is becoming more complete. The energy-saving effect of functional lighting has already emerged. Standard formulation and testing capabilities have made significant progress, with 22 national standards and industry standards already formulated and published.
titlelist: The situation and demand provide China's semiconductor lighting technology and industry with opportunities for leapfrog development.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Semiconductor Lighting Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 772) (Ministry of Science and Technology/July 11, 2012)
content: The semiconductor lighting industry has the characteristics of low resource consumption, high driving coefficient, strong job creation ability, and good comprehensive benefits. During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, with people's pursuit of higher lighting quality, more energy-saving and environmentally friendly lighting, and the rapid development of the semiconductor lighting application market, there are still many technical problems that need to be solved urgently. It is urgent to carry out high-reliability and low-cost industrialization key technology research and development for different application fields, and seize the commanding heights of the next generation of core technologies. With the acceleration of urbanization, the consumption of lighting products will further increase, and the pressure of energy saving and emission reduction is increasing, urgently requiring the large-scale application of semiconductor lighting energy-saving products. Along with the pressure of transformation and upgrading of traditional industries such as information display, digital home appliances, automobiles, equipment, and raw materials, there is an urgent need for the application of new semiconductor lighting technologies and products. In addition, with the increasing employment pressure in China, it is urgent to give full play to the technical and labor-intensive characteristics of the semiconductor lighting industry and create more employment opportunities.
titlelist: Situations and demands, the development demand for semiconductor lighting in China is evident.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Semiconductor Lighting Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 772) (Ministry of Science and Technology/July 11, 2012)
content: By 2015, the key technological breakthroughs in the entire innovation chain from basic research, cutting-edge technology, application technology to demonstration applications will be achieved. The key production equipment and important raw materials will be localized. The focus will be on developing new, healthy and environmentally friendly semiconductor lighting standardized and standardized products, achieving large-scale demonstration applications. An internationally advanced public research, testing, and service platform will be established. The policy and service environment for scientific and technological innovation and industrial development will be improved. A number of pilot demonstration cities and characteristic industrialization bases will be built, nurturing leading enterprises with well-known brands and forming a semiconductor lighting industry with international competitiveness.
titlelist: Development goals, overall goals

name: Several Opinions on Accelerating the Innovative Development of the Graphene Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Original [2015] No. 435) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 20, 2015)
content: By 2018, the industrial system of graphene materials, including preparation, application development, and terminal applications, will be established with positive interactions. Product standards and technical specifications will be substantially improved, and over a hundred practical technologies and samples will be developed. This will promote a number of industrial demonstration projects and achieve stable production of graphene materials, leading to industrial applications in some industrial products and consumer goods. By 2020, a well-established graphene industry system will be formed, with standardized, serialized, and low-cost graphene materials. Several innovative platforms with graphene characteristics will be established, and a number of core application technologies will be mastered, enabling large-scale applications in various fields. Several graphene enterprises with core competitiveness will be formed, and a new industrial demonstration base with graphene as its feature will be built.
titlelist: Build the graphene industry into a leading industry, overall goal.

name: Several Opinions on Accelerating the Innovative Development of the Graphene Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Original [2015] No. 435) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 20, 2015)
content: Guided by key technologies for large-scale preparation of graphene materials and the preparation of various functional materials based on graphene, we encourage backbone enterprises to collaborate with relevant universities and research institutes to jointly develop material scale-up preparation technologies, promote the synchronous development of key processes and core equipment, enhance industrialization level, achieve effective control over key parameters such as graphene layers, dimensions, and surface functional groups, improve the process stability, performance consistency, and product qualification rate of large-scale preparation of graphene materials, and effectively reduce costs.
titlelist: Promote key technological innovation in industrial development, and break through the common key technologies for large-scale preparation of graphene materials.

name: Several Opinions on Accelerating the Innovative Development of the Graphene Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Original [2015] No. 435) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 20, 2015)
content: Encourage enterprises to collaborate with universities, research institutes, intellectual property institutions, etc., to jointly develop the construction of a protection system for key technologies and intellectual property rights in the graphene industry, and enhance the quantity and quality of patents. titlelist: Promote key technological innovation for industrial development and strengthen the construction of intellectual property rights system.

content: Actively utilize graphene materials to enhance the comprehensive performance and cost-effectiveness of traditional products. Promote the application of graphene materials in new products. titlelist: Promote the demonstration of the first batch of industrial applications and innovate key technologies for the industrial application of graphene materials.

content: Accelerate the production of graphene materials towards large-scale, flexible, intelligent, and green development. Newly built graphene material production lines should, in principle, be located in chemical industrial parks, meeting the environmental access requirements and environmental impact assessment requirements of the parks. The scale of the powder production line should not be less than 10 tons per year, and the film production line should be able to continuously and automatically transfer films. Encourage the organic combination of graphene powder preparation and the development of natural graphite resources.
