content: Optimize the spatial layout of new infrastructure, coordinate and plan the scientific allocation of data centers and other new infrastructure, and avoid low-level redundant construction. Optimize the energy structure of new infrastructure, adopt direct current power supply, distributed energy storage, photovoltaic + energy storage and other models, explore diversified energy supply, and increase the proportion of non-fossil energy consumption. Benchmarking international advanced levels, accelerate the improvement of equipment energy efficiency standards for communication, computing, storage, transmission, etc., enhance access thresholds, and eliminate outdated equipment and technologies. Strengthen the energy management of new infrastructure, include all data centers with an annual comprehensive energy consumption exceeding 10,000 tons of standard coal into the key energy-consuming unit energy consumption online monitoring system, and carry out energy measurement audits. Promote the green upgrading and transformation of existing facilities, actively promote the use of efficient refrigeration, advanced ventilation, waste heat utilization, intelligent energy control, and other technologies to improve facility energy efficiency.
titlelist: Key tasks, energy-saving and carbon reduction efficiency action, strengthening energy-saving and carbon reduction in new infrastructure.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Industry is one of the main sectors that generate carbon emissions, and it has an important impact on achieving carbon peak nationwide. The industrial sector needs to accelerate green and low-carbon transformation and strive to be the first to achieve carbon peak in order to achieve high-quality development.
titlelist: Key task, Carbon Peak Action in the industrial sector.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Optimize industrial structure, accelerate the elimination of outdated production capacity, vigorously develop strategic emerging industries, and accelerate the green and low-carbon transformation of traditional industries. Promote the low-carbonization of industrial energy consumption, promote the clean and efficient use of fossil energy, increase the proportion of renewable energy application, strengthen demand-side management of electricity, and improve the level of industrial electrification. Implement the Green Manufacturing Project, promote green design, improve the green manufacturing system, and build green factories and green industrial parks. Promote the integration of digitization, intelligence, and greenization in the industrial field. Develop and strengthen technological transformation in key industries and areas.
titlelist: Key tasks, industrial sector carbon peak action, promoting green and low-carbon development in the industrial sector.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing a Good Job in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deepen the supply-side structural reform of the steel industry, strictly implement capacity replacement, prohibit the addition of capacity, promote inventory optimization, and eliminate outdated capacity. Promote cross-regional and cross-ownership mergers and reorganizations of steel enterprises to increase industry concentration. Optimize the layout of productive forces, with a focus on the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and surrounding areas, and continue to reduce steel production capacity. Promote structural optimization and clean energy substitution in the steel industry, vigorously promote non-blast furnace ironmaking technology demonstrations, improve the level of scrap steel recycling and utilization, and promote the use of all-scrap steel electric furnace technology. Promote advanced and applicable technologies, tap into the potential for energy saving and carbon reduction, encourage steel-toughened co-production, explore pilot demonstrations of integrated hydrogen metallurgy and carbon dioxide capture and utilization, and promote the development of low-grade waste heat for heating.
titlelist: Key tasks, carbon peak action in the industrial sector, promoting carbon peak in the steel industry.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Consolidate and resolve the achievements in reducing excess capacity in the electrolytic aluminum industry, strictly implement capacity replacement, and strictly control the increase in capacity. Promote the substitution of clean energy, increase the proportion of hydropower, wind power, solar power, and other applications. Accelerate the development of the renewable non-ferrous metal industry, improve the recycling, sorting, and processing network of discarded non-ferrous metal resources, and increase the output of recycled non-ferrous metals. Accelerate the promotion and application of advanced and applicable green low-carbon technologies, improve the level of waste heat recovery in the production process of non-ferrous metals, and promote a continuous decrease in energy consumption per unit of product.
titlelist: Key tasks, carbon peak action in the industrial sector, promoting carbon peak in the non-ferrous metal industry.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen capacity replacement supervision, accelerate the elimination of inefficient capacity, strictly prohibit the addition of cement clinker and flat glass production capacity, and guide the transformation of the building materials industry towards lightweight, intensive, and product-oriented development. Promote staggered production of cement as a regular practice, and reasonably shorten the operation time of cement clinker equipment. Utilize renewable energy such as wind and solar power according to local conditions, gradually increase the proportion of electricity and natural gas applications. Encourage building materials companies to use fly ash, industrial waste, tailings, and other materials as raw materials or cement admixtures. Accelerate the promotion and application of green building materials certification, and strengthen the research and application of low-carbon building materials such as new types of cementitious materials, low-carbon concrete, and wood-bamboo building materials. Promote energy-saving technology and equipment, establish energy management systems, and achieve energy conservation and efficiency improvement.
titlelist: Key tasks, carbon peak action in the industrial sector, promoting carbon peak in the building materials industry.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Optimize production capacity and layout, increase efforts to eliminate backward production capacity, effectively resolve structural overcapacity contradictions. Strictly control project access, reasonably arrange construction schedules, strictly control the increase in refining and traditional coal chemical production capacity, and develop modern coal chemical industry in a stable and orderly manner. Guide enterprises to transform their energy use methods, encourage the use of electricity, natural gas, and other alternatives to coal. Adjust the raw material structure, control the increase in coal consumption for raw materials, expand the import sources of hydrogen-rich raw materials, and promote the lightweighting of petrochemical and chemical raw materials. Optimize product structure, promote the coordinated development of petrochemical and chemical industry with coal mining, metallurgy, building materials, chemical fiber, and other industries, and strengthen the efficient utilization of by-product gases such as refinery dry gas and liquefied gas. Encourage enterprises to upgrade energy-saving and promote the cascade utilization of energy and the recycling of materials. By 2025, the domestic crude oil processing capacity will be controlled within 1 billion tons, and the utilization rate of major product capacity will be increased to 80%.
titlelist: Key tasks, carbon peak action in the industrial sector, promoting the carbon peak in the petrochemical industry.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing a Good Job in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the promotion of green and low-carbon development in urban and rural construction. Both urban renewal and rural revitalization need to implement green and low-carbon requirements.
titlelist: Key Task: Carbon Peak Action for Urban and Rural Construction

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the development of urban clusters, scientifically determine the scale of construction, and control the rapid growth of newly added construction land. Advocate the concept of green and low-carbon planning and design, enhance the climate resilience of urban and rural areas, and build sponge cities. Promote green and low-carbon building materials and construction methods, accelerate the development of new building industrialization, vigorously develop prefabricated buildings, promote steel structure housing, promote the recycling of building materials, and strengthen green design and construction management. Strengthen the green and low-carbon construction of county towns. Promote the establishment of a green and low-carbon-oriented urban and rural planning and construction management mechanism, formulate building demolition management measures, and eliminate large-scale demolition and construction. Build green towns and green communities.
titlelist: Key tasks, urban and rural construction carbon peak action, promoting the green and low-carbon transformation of urban and rural construction.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the updating of building energy-saving standards, municipal infrastructure, and other standards, and increase the requirements for energy-saving and carbon reduction. Strengthen the research and development and promotion of energy-saving and low-carbon technologies applicable to different climate zones and building types, and promote the large-scale development of ultra-low energy consumption buildings and low-carbon buildings. Speed up the energy-saving renovation of residential and public buildings, and continue to promote the energy-saving and carbon reduction renovation of old heating networks and other municipal infrastructure. Improve the level of intelligent operation and management of urban buildings and infrastructure, accelerate the promotion of heat metering and charging, and contract energy management, and gradually implement energy consumption quotas for public buildings. By 2025, green building standards will be fully implemented in newly constructed urban buildings.
titlelist: Key tasks, urban and rural construction carbon peak action, accelerate the improvement of building energy efficiency levels.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deepen the application of renewable energy in buildings, promote the integration of photovoltaic power generation and buildings. Actively promote clean heating in severely cold and cold regions, promote combined heat and power for centralized heating, accelerate the large-scale application of industrial waste heat for heating, actively and prudently carry out nuclear heating demonstrations, and promote clean and low-carbon heating such as heat pumps, biomass energy, geothermal energy, and solar energy according to local conditions. Guide scientific heating in regions with hot summers and cold winters, and adopt clean and efficient heating methods according to local conditions. Improve the level of electrification in building terminals, and construct photovoltaic power generation, energy storage, direct current distribution, and flexible power consumption buildings. By 2025, the substitution rate of renewable energy in urban buildings will reach 8%, and the rooftop photovoltaic coverage rate of newly built public institutions and factory buildings will strive to reach 50%.
titlelist: Key tasks, urban and rural construction carbon peak action, accelerate the optimization of building energy structure.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing a Good Job in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the construction of green rural houses and accelerate energy-saving renovations for rural houses. Continuously promote clean heating in rural areas and choose appropriate heating methods according to local conditions. Develop energy-saving and low-carbon agricultural greenhouses. Promote energy-saving and environmentally friendly stoves, electric agricultural vehicles, energy-saving and environmentally friendly agricultural machinery and fishing boats. Accelerate the application of renewable energy such as biomass and solar energy in agricultural production and rural life. Strengthen the construction of rural power grids and improve the electrification level of rural energy use.
titlelist: Key tasks, urban and rural construction carbon peak action, promoting rural construction and low-carbon transformation of energy use.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing a Good Job in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the formation of green and low-carbon transportation methods to ensure that carbon emissions in the transportation sector remain within a reasonable range.
titlelist: Key task: Green and low-carbon transportation action.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing a Good Job in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Actively expand the application of new energy and clean energy such as electricity, hydrogen, natural gas, and advanced biofuels in the transportation sector. Promote the use of new energy vehicles, gradually reduce the proportion of traditional fuel vehicles in new vehicle production, sales, and vehicle stock, promote the electrification of urban public service vehicles, and promote the use of electric power, hydrogen fuel, and liquefied natural gas for heavy-duty freight vehicles. Improve the electrification level of the railway system. Accelerate the renovation of old ships, develop electric and liquefied natural gas-powered ships, promote the use of shore power for ships in port, and carry out demonstration applications of green and intelligent ships along the coast and inland rivers according to local conditions. Improve the electrification and intelligence level of airport operations and develop new energy aircraft. By 2030, the proportion of newly added new energy and clean energy-powered vehicles should reach about 40%, and the carbon emission intensity per unit of turnover for operating vehicles should decrease by about 9.5% compared to 2020. The comprehensive energy consumption per unit of turnover for national railways should decrease by 10% compared to 2020. Strive to reach the peak of petroleum consumption in land transportation before 2030.
titlelist: Key tasks, green and low-carbon actions in transportation, promoting the low-carbon transformation of transportation tools and equipment.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing a Good Job in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Integrate the green and low-carbon concept throughout the entire process of transportation infrastructure planning, construction, operation, and maintenance, in order to reduce energy consumption and carbon emissions throughout the life cycle. Carry out green transformation and improvement of transportation infrastructure, coordinate the use of comprehensive transportation corridors, land, airspace, and other resources, increase the integration of shoreline, anchorages, and other resources, and improve utilization efficiency. Promote the orderly construction of charging stations, supporting power grids, refueling (gas) stations, hydrogen refueling stations, and other infrastructure to enhance the level of urban public transportation infrastructure. By 2030, strive to achieve comprehensive electrification of civilian transport airport vehicles and equipment.
titlelist: Key tasks, green and low-carbon transportation actions, accelerate the construction of green transportation infrastructure.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing a Good Job in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Seize the source of resource utilization, vigorously develop a circular economy, comprehensively improve resource utilization efficiency, and fully leverage the synergistic effect of reducing resource consumption and carbon reduction.
titlelist: Key task: Circular economy supports carbon reduction action.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: With the goal of improving resource output and recycling rate, optimizing the spatial layout of industrial parks, and carrying out circular transformation in the parks. Promote circular production and industrial combination in park enterprises, organize enterprises to implement clean production transformation, promote comprehensive utilization of waste, cascade utilization of energy, and recycling of water resources. Promote the utilization of industrial waste heat, waste gas, waste liquid, and waste residue, and actively promote centralized gas and heat supply. Build infrastructure and public service sharing platforms, strengthen material flow management in industrial parks. By 2030, all key industrial parks at or above the provincial level will implement circular transformation.
titlelist: Key tasks: Circular economy supports carbon reduction actions and promotes the development of industrial park circularization.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Improve the comprehensive development and utilization level of mineral resources and the comprehensive utilization rate, with a focus on major solid wastes such as coal gangue, fly ash, tailings, associated minerals, smelting slag, industrial by-product gypsum, construction waste, and crop straw. Support large-scale, industrialized, and high-value utilization, and encourage the application of these wastes as substitutes for primary non-metallic minerals, sand, and gravel resources. While ensuring safety and environmental protection, explore the application of phosphogypsum in soil improvement, underground filling, road construction, etc. Promote the resource utilization of construction waste and promote the on-site regeneration of discarded pavement materials. Accelerate the high-value utilization of crop straw, improve the collection, storage, and transportation system, and strictly control burning. Accelerate the demonstration construction of comprehensive utilization of major solid wastes. By 2025, the annual utilization of major solid wastes will reach about 4 billion tons; by 2030, the annual utilization will reach about 4.5 billion tons.
titlelist: Key tasks, circular economy supports carbon reduction actions, strengthen comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Improve the recycling network for waste materials, promote the Internet + recycling model, and achieve full collection of renewable resources. Strengthen the standardized management of comprehensive utilization of renewable resources and promote the development of industry clusters. Construct modern urban mineral bases at a high level to promote standardized, large-scale, and clean utilization of renewable resources. Promote the recycling of retired power batteries, photovoltaic modules, wind turbine blades, and other emerging industry waste. Promote the high-quality development of the remanufacturing industry for automotive parts, engineering machinery, office equipment, and other products. Strengthen the promotion and application of recycled products and remanufactured products. By 2025, the recycling volume of nine main renewable resources, including scrap steel, scrap copper, scrap aluminum, scrap lead, scrap zinc, waste paper, waste plastic, waste rubber, and waste glass, will reach 450 million tons, and by 2030, it will reach 510 million tons.
titlelist: Key tasks, circular economy supporting carbon reduction actions, and improving the system of resource recycling.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Fully, Accurately, and Comprehensively Implementing the New Development Concept and Doing Well in Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality Work (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Party, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Solidly promote the classification of household waste, accelerate the establishment of a comprehensive household waste collection and disposal system covering the entire society, and fully realize the classification of waste disposal, collection, transportation, and treatment. Strengthen the governance of the entire chain of plastic pollution, rectify excessive packaging, and promote waste reduction at the source. Promote the incineration treatment of household waste, reduce the proportion of landfilling, and explore resource utilization technologies suitable for the characteristics of kitchen waste in China. Promote the utilization of wastewater resources. By 2025, the urban household waste classification system will be basically sound, and the proportion of resource utilization of household waste will be increased to about 60%. By 2030, urban household waste classification will achieve full coverage, and the proportion of resource utilization of household waste will be increased to 65%.
titlelist: Key task: Circular economy supports carbon reduction efforts, vigorously promotes the reduction and resource utilization of household waste.

name: Comprehensive Work Plan for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 33) (State Council/December 28, 2021)
content: Guide industrial enterprises to gather in industrial parks, promote overall optimization of energy systems and comprehensive pollution control in industrial parks, and encourage industrial enterprises and parks to prioritize the use of renewable energy. Focus on provincial-level and above industrial parks, promote the joint construction and sharing of public infrastructure such as heating, power supply, sewage treatment, and recycled water use. Carry out systematic treatment of sewage treatment plants with abnormal influent concentrations in designated areas, strengthen the centralized storage and disposal of general solid waste and hazardous waste, and promote the centralized management of volatile organic compounds, electroplating wastewater, and characteristic pollutants. By 2025, a number of energy-saving and environmentally friendly demonstration parks will be built. (Responsibilities are assigned to the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, etc.)
titlelist: Implementation of key projects for energy conservation and emission reduction, and upgrading projects for energy conservation and environmental protection in the park.

name: Comprehensive Work Plan for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 33) (State Council/December 28, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of green railways, green highways, green ports, green waterways, and green airports, and orderly advance the construction of infrastructure such as electric charging and swapping, refueling (gas), hydrogenation, and shore power for ports and airports. Increase the proportion of new energy vehicles used in urban public transportation, taxis, logistics, and sanitation vehicles. Accelerate the transformation of bulk cargo and long-distance cargo transportation from road to rail and water, vigorously develop multimodal transportation such as rail-water, road-rail, and road-water. Fully implement the China VI emission standards for automobiles and the China IV emission standards for non-road mobile diesel machinery, and basically phase out vehicles that meet the China III or lower emission standards. Implement the clean diesel engine action, encourage the renewal and replacement of heavy-duty diesel trucks. Implement the vehicle emission inspection and maintenance system, strengthen the management of vehicle emission recalls. Strengthen the promotion and application of clean energy power for ships, and promote the transformation of shore power facilities for ships. Improve the level of railway electrification, promote low-energy transportation equipment, and implement China I emission standards for railway internal combustion locomotives. Vigorously develop intelligent transportation and actively use big data to optimize transportation organization models. Accelerate the construction of green warehousing and encourage the construction of green logistics parks. Accelerate the promotion and application of standardized logistics turnover boxes. Promote green packaging for express delivery comprehensively and guide e-commerce and postal express delivery companies to purchase and use express packaging products that have obtained green certification. By 2025, the sales volume of new energy vehicles will account for about 20% of the total sales volume of new vehicles, and the proportion of railway and waterway freight volume will further increase. (Led by the Ministry of Transport and the National Development and Reform Commission, with the participation of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Commerce, the State Administration for Market Regulation, the National Energy Administration, the National Railway Administration, the Civil Aviation Administration of China, the State Post Bureau, and China State Railway Group Co., Ltd., according to their respective responsibilities.)
titlelist: Implement key projects for energy conservation and emission reduction, transportation and logistics energy conservation and emission reduction projects.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 2016)
content: Grasp the global energy transformation and development trends, as well as the requirements for green transformation and development of industries in our country. Focus on ecological civilization construction and addressing climate change. Emphasize green and low-carbon technological innovation and application, guide green consumption, promote green products, significantly increase the proportion of new energy vehicles and new energy applications, comprehensively promote the construction of an efficient energy-saving, advanced environmental protection, and resource recycling industrial system. Drive the green and low-carbon industries such as new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy conservation and environmental protection to become pillar industries. By 2020, the output value scale will exceed 10 trillion yuan.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 2016)
content: Strengthen technological innovation, improve the industrial chain, optimize supporting environment, implement and improve support policies, enhance the industrialization level of pure electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, and promote the industrialization of fuel cell vehicles. By 2020, achieve an annual production and sales of over 2 million vehicles, with a cumulative production and sales of over 5 million vehicles, maintaining overall technological level in sync with international standards, and forming a group of new energy vehicle manufacturers and key component enterprises with international competitiveness. Enhance the overall quality and performance of electric vehicles. Accelerate the innovation and application of electric vehicle system integration technology, focusing on research on vehicle safety and reliability, and lightweight design. Improve the technological level, supporting capacity, and overall performance of key components. Accelerate the formulation and application of electric vehicle safety standards. Speed up the innovation and application of intelligent technology for electric vehicles, and develop intelligent autonomous driving vehicles. Conduct research and development on energy storage application technology for electric vehicle power systems, implement distributed new energy and electric vehicle joint application demonstrations, and promote the integration development of electric vehicles with smart grids, new energy, energy storage, and intelligent driving. Establish joint innovation platforms for electric vehicles and cross-industry, cross-domain technology innovation strategic alliances, and promote collaborative innovation of major key technologies for electric vehicles. Improve the production access policies for electric vehicles and study the implementation of a new energy vehicle credit management system. By 2020, electric vehicles strive to have market competitiveness for commercial promotion. Build a globally competitive power battery industry chain. Vigorously promote power battery technology research and development, focus on breakthroughs in battery grouping and system integration technology, proactively develop next-generation power batteries and new system power batteries, and achieve breakthroughs in battery material technology. Accelerate the innovation of production, control, and testing equipment for high-performance and high-reliability power batteries, and enhance the engineering and industrialization capabilities of power batteries. Cultivate and develop a group of power battery enterprises and key material leading enterprises with sustainable innovation capabilities. Promote the hierarchical utilization of power batteries and establish a power battery recycling and utilization system with upstream and downstream enterprises. By 2020, the technological level of power batteries will be synchronized with international standards, and the production capacity will remain globally leading. Innovate production, control, and testing equipment, and promote the engineering and technical capabilities of the entire industry chain. Conduct research and development on new technologies in the fields of fuel cells, solid-state lithium-ion batteries, metal-air batteries, lithium-sulfur batteries, etc. Column 14: Power battery enhancement project for new energy vehicles. Improve the power battery research and development system, accelerate the construction of power battery innovation centers, and break through technical bottlenecks such as high safety, long life, and high energy density lithium-ion batteries. Build several technology innovation centers in key battery materials, key production equipment, and other fields, and make breakthroughs in high-capacity positive and negative electrode materials, high safety separators, and functional electrolyte technologies. Increase efforts to promote the research and development and industrialization of fuel cell vehicles. Strengthen the research on fuel cell basic materials and process mechanisms, promote the development of high-performance and low-cost fuel cell materials and key components of the system. Accelerate the improvement of fuel cell stack system reliability and engineering level, and improve relevant technical standards. Promote the development of on-board hydrogen storage systems, hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and refueling technologies, and advance the construction of hydrogen refueling stations. By 2020, achieve mass production and large-scale demonstration applications of fuel cell vehicles. Accelerate the construction of standardized and convenient infrastructure systems. According to the principle of suitable and moderately advanced according to local conditions, prioritize the construction of public service area charging infrastructure in urban development, actively promote the construction of charging piles in residential areas and parking spaces of units. Improve charging facility standards and promote interconnection of charging infrastructure. Accelerate the development of new types of charging and swapping technologies and equipment, such as high-power density, high conversion efficiency, high applicability, wireless charging, and mobile charging. Strengthen research on key technologies such as testing and certification, safety protection, and bidirectional interaction with the power grid. Promote the Internet + charging infrastructure and improve the intelligence level of charging services. Encourage innovation in business models for charging service companies and enhance their capacity for sustainable development. By 2020, establish a charging infrastructure system that meets the needs of electric vehicles.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, build a new model of sustainable development, and achieve the large-scale application of new energy vehicles.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of National Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 2016)
content: Adapt to the requirements of building a resource-saving and environmentally friendly society, establish the concept of energy conservation as the foundation, comprehensively promote energy conservation, enhance the application level of high-efficiency energy-saving equipment technology and products, promote the integration and demonstration application of energy-saving technologies, support the development of the energy-saving service industry, and promote the rapid development of the high-efficiency energy-saving industry. By 2020, the output value of the high-efficiency energy-saving industry should strive to reach 3 trillion yuan. Vigorously improve the technology and application level of high-efficiency energy-saving equipment. Encourage the development of high-efficiency energy-saving equipment (products) and key components, increase demonstration and promotion efforts, and accelerate the reduction of comprehensive costs. Formulate or revise mandatory energy efficiency and energy consumption limit standards, and accelerate the application of energy-saving scientific and technological achievements. Publish a catalog of energy-saving products and technology promotion, improve government procurement policies for energy-saving products, and promote the increase in market share of energy-saving products. Improve the energy efficiency labeling system and energy-saving product certification system, implement energy efficiency leaders in industries such as industry, construction, transportation, and consumer goods, and promote a leap in energy efficiency for energy-using enterprises and product manufacturers. Promote the integration and demonstration application of energy-saving technologies. Carry out pilot projects for energy-saving technology system integration in key areas and industries such as demonstration parks, integrate waste heat, waste pressure, and waste gas resources of high-energy-consuming enterprises, encourage the use of waste heat for heating, utilize waste energy and low-temperature waste heat for power generation. Encourage key energy-consuming units and energy-consuming equipment to be equipped with intelligent energy measurement and remote diagnostic equipment, and strengthen system automatic monitoring and intelligent analysis capabilities through information network technology to promote the improvement of comprehensive energy efficiency. Promote the optimization of process industrial system technology, promote the construction of energy management centers in industrial enterprises, encourage the use of solar collectors in the low-temperature heating section, and achieve comprehensive optimization of production processes and energy supply. Promote the industrialization of near-zero consumption building technologies for fossil energy, and vigorously promote the application of energy-saving doors and windows, green energy-saving building materials, and other products. Encourage the comprehensive integration of wind power, solar power generation, and enterprise energy supply and management systems, and promote the local consumption of renewable energy. Develop and strengthen the energy-saving service industry. Support the rapid development of contract energy management, franchise operations, and other formats, promote innovation in energy-saving service business models, and promote the promotion of comprehensive energy-saving service solutions. Support energy-saving service companies to achieve scale, branding, and networked operations through mergers, alliances, and reorganizations. Build a green financing platform, promote the issuance of green bonds, and support the financing of energy-saving service companies. Develop relevant standards to improve the standardization level of energy-saving services. Formulate management measures for energy-saving service institutions and establish a sound third-party evaluation mechanism for energy-saving. Establish a performance registration and service platform for energy-saving service companies, key energy-consuming units, and third-party evaluation institutions to create an honest and trustworthy market environment. Column 16: Development of energy-saving technology and equipment. Organize the implementation of key common energy-saving technology improvement projects and energy-saving equipment manufacturing projects. Encourage the development of high-performance building insulation materials, photovoltaic integrated building glass curtain walls, compact household air source heat pump devices, high-power semiconductor lighting chips and devices, advanced and efficient gas turbine power generation equipment, clean and efficient coal utilization technology and equipment, shallow geothermal energy utilization devices, and heat storage high-temperature air combustion devices, and other high-efficiency energy-saving equipment (products) and their key components. Implement comprehensive energy-saving and environmental improvement projects for coal-fired boilers, comprehensive energy efficiency improvement projects for heating pipe network systems, and energy efficiency improvement projects for motor drive systems, promote energy-saving and ultra-low emission transformation of coal-fired power plants, energy-saving of motor systems, energy system optimization, and waste heat and waste pressure utilization, and demonstrate the large-scale application of key energy-saving technologies and products. Organize the implementation of energy-saving demonstration projects in cities, parks, and enterprises, and promote the integrated demonstration application of high-efficiency energy-saving technologies.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, and build a new model of sustainable development, vigorously develop efficient energy-saving industries.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 2016)
content: Vigorously promote the implementation of action plans for the prevention and control of water, air, and soil pollution, promote overall linkage between regional and watershed pollution prevention and control, deeply promote the reduction of major pollutants in land and sea, promote the development of environmental protection equipment industry, enhance the monitoring and control technology and equipment capabilities for major pollutants, strengthen the promotion and integration of advanced and applicable environmental protection technology and equipment, actively promote the application of advanced environmental protection products, promote the development of environmental service industry, and comprehensively improve the level of development of the environmental protection industry. By 2020, the output value of advanced environmental protection industries will strive to exceed 2 trillion yuan. Enhance the technical and equipment capabilities for pollution prevention and control. Focus on breakthroughs in industrial wastewater, smog, pesticide residues in soil, and heavy metal pollution in water and soil, and accelerate the formation of production capabilities for complete sets of equipment, core components, and supporting materials. Construct a number of demonstration bases for the industrialization of major environmental protection technologies that are technologically advanced, well-equipped, and standardized, and form a sound development pattern of the industry with backbone enterprises as the core and small and medium-sized enterprises specializing in new and emerging fields growing rapidly. Support the research and development of hazardous waste prevention and control technologies and improve the level of hazardous waste treatment and disposal. Support the optimization and integration of environmental protection industry resources and actively expand the international market. Strengthen the promotion and integration of advanced and applicable environmental protection technology and equipment. Regularly update the Catalog of Major Environmental Protection Technologies and Equipment Encouraged by the State, strengthen supply-demand connection, and strengthen the application of advanced and applicable environmental protection equipment in key areas such as metallurgy, chemical industry, building materials, and food. Accelerate the deep integration of environmental protection industry with new generation information technology and advanced manufacturing technology, strengthen the manufacturing capacity of advanced environmental protection equipment, and improve the level of comprehensive integration. Support the establishment of an environmental protection technology innovation alliance that combines production, education, research, and application, and accelerate research and application of integrated innovation. Actively promote the application of advanced environmental protection products. Promote the application of environmental materials and agents such as ion exchange resins, biofilter media and fillers, efficient activated carbon, circulating cooling water treatment agents, bactericides and algaecides, water treatment disinfectants, solid waste treatment solidifiers and stabilizers. Expand the scope of government procurement of environmental protection products and continuously increase the proportion of environmental protection product procurement. Implement the system of environmental protection product leaders, improve environmental protection product standards, actively promote the application of advanced environmental protection products, and organize the implementation of demonstration projects for advanced environmental protection equipment technological progress and model innovation. Enhance comprehensive environmental service capabilities. Based on the big data of pollutants in various industries, promote the establishment of environmental protection equipment and service demand information platform, technology innovation and transformation trading platform, and environmental protection equipment bidding information platform, and improve the level of informatization of environmental service information. Promote the application of satellite and Internet of Things technology in environmental monitoring, build a platform for pollution emission, basic data on environmental quality, and monitoring and disposal information, improve the intelligence level of environmental supervision, and deepen the pilot work of environmental service industry. Develop environmental restoration services, promote contract-based environmental services, and promote the overall solution of environmental protection services. Carry out pilot projects for third-party governance of environmental pollution and pilot projects for comprehensive governance and hosting services, and explore the third-party governance model in key areas such as urban sewage and garbage treatment and centralized treatment of industrial park pollution. Promote the creation of demonstration enterprises for green design, and support enterprises in carrying out green design. Create demonstration areas for comprehensive application of related technologies. Column 17: Comprehensive Innovation Demonstration Project for Green and Low-carbon Technologies. Connect with green and low-carbon pilot demonstration projects, and in regions with conditions, take the comprehensive application of green and low-carbon technologies as the core, with the Internet as the link, and build comprehensive application facilities for new energy, new energy vehicles and smart transportation systems, low-carbon communities, carbon capture and rich carbon agriculture, green intelligent factories, etc. Take the lead in implementing relevant reform measures to promote the integration and innovation of green and low-carbon technologies, new generation information technology, urbanization construction, and production and life, and carry out extensive international cooperation.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, build a new model of sustainable development, and accelerate the development of advanced environmental protection industries.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 2016)
content: Establish a resource concept of conservation, intensification, and circular utilization, vigorously promote the comprehensive utilization of associated minerals and tailings, the development of urban minerals, the recycling of agricultural and forestry waste, and the recycling of new varieties of waste. Develop the remanufacturing industry, improve the infrastructure for resource recycling, enhance policy support, and promote the development and growth of the resource recycling industry. By 2020, strive to replace 1.3 billion tons of primary resources annually and achieve a scale of 3 trillion yuan in the resource recycling industry. Vigorously promote the comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste and tailings. Promote the comprehensive utilization of industrial waste such as metallurgical slag, chemical slag, red mud, and phosphogypsum, promote the application of advanced and applicable technologies and equipment, and strengthen the recycling of strategic precious metals in industrial solid waste. Research and develop deep processing and comprehensive utilization technologies for tailings, promote the recovery of associated valuable elements and the development of high-tech tailings products, and improve the economic efficiency of tailings comprehensive utilization. Research and develop key technologies and equipment for the joint selection and metallurgy of complex multi-metal tailings, key technologies for clean and harmless comprehensive utilization, and a set of equipment with an annual processing capacity of 100,000 tons for efficient concentration and preparation of tailings, transportation, and filling. Develop optimization and upgrading technologies for low-grade titanium slag, and improve the comprehensive utilization rate of vanadium-titanium magnetite resources. Promote the development of urban minerals and the utilization of low-value waste. Improve the level of technology and equipment for the recycling and utilization of waste electrical and electronic products, and scrapped automobiles, promote the processing and utilization of non-ferrous metals and waste plastics in a centralized and scaled manner. Accelerate the construction of resource-based and harmless treatment systems for urban kitchen waste, construction waste, and waste textiles, coordinate the role of various solid waste treatment facilities, and create a base for the coordinated treatment of low-value urban waste. Implement preferential policies related to land, finance, and taxation. Improve the infrastructure for the recycling and utilization of renewable resources, and support the upgrading and transformation of existing recycling and distribution sites for renewable resources. Strengthen the recycling and utilization of agricultural and forestry waste. Basically achieve the utilization of agricultural and forestry waste such as livestock and poultry manure, film residue, crop straw, and forestry residues. Promote the technology of straw composting and returning to the field, support the industrialization of new technologies such as straw substitution for wood, fiber raw materials, clean pulping, biomass energy, and commercial organic fertilizer. Encourage the use of various agricultural and forestry waste such as livestock and poultry manure and straw to implement rural household biogas and centralized biogas projects according to local conditions. Promote the use of standard plastic film, guide the recycling of waste and the use of degradable film. Encourage the construction of biomass cogeneration projects using forestry waste to produce heat, electricity, oil, medicine, etc. Actively develop ultra-low emission incineration technology for agricultural and forestry waste. Actively carry out the recycling of new varieties of waste. Carry out demonstrations of the recycling and utilization system of new varieties of waste, promote the recycling and utilization of new types of waste such as waste solar cells, waste power batteries, waste carbon fiber materials, and waste energy-saving lamps, promote the efficient enrichment and clean recycling of precious metals, and the cascade utilization of electric vehicle power batteries. Support the research and development and application of carbon capture, utilization, and storage technologies, and develop the carbon cycle industry. Vigorously promote the comprehensive utilization of seawater resources. Accelerate the research and industrialization of seawater desalination and utilization technologies, improve the reliability, advancedness, and supporting capacity of core materials and key equipment. Promote the construction of a concentrated development base for seawater desalination equipment manufacturing. Carry out demonstration projects for the utilization of seawater resources, and promote the general contracting and services of large-scale seawater desalination projects. Carry out pilot demonstrations of seawater desalination, encourage the production of bottled water from seawater desalination, and promote the entry of seawater desalination water into the municipal water supply network in accordance with the law. Promote the large-scale application of seawater cooling technology in water-intensive industries along the coast. Accelerate the extraction of potassium, bromine, magnesium, and other products from seawater to achieve high-value utilization. Develop the remanufacturing industry. Strengthen the research and development of non-destructive testing, green and efficient cleaning, and automated surface and volume restoration technologies for remanufacturing of mechanical products, and accelerate industrial application. Organize the implementation of demonstration projects for the application of remanufacturing technology processes, promote the application of mature surface engineering equipment such as nanoelectroplating technology equipment and arc spraying, and carry out remanufacturing of high-value components such as engines and shield machines. Establish a traceability and product tracking information system for remanufactured old parts to promote the standardized development of the remanufacturing industry. Improve the industrial system for resource recycling. Promote the application of Internet of Things electronic supervision technology in the disposal of hazardous waste, electronic waste, etc., support the establishment of online and offline integrated recycling networks by renewable resource companies. Coordinate the domestic and international utilization of renewable resources, strengthen the connection between the recycling of municipal solid waste and the recycling of renewable resources. Establish a third-party service system for resource recycling, encourage the provision of integrated solutions and specialized services for waste management, recycling, regeneration processing, and recycling. Fully implement the extended producer responsibility system, and encourage the use of recycled products and raw materials. Establish a sound standard system covering solid waste, hazardous waste, recycled products, and pollutant control. Column 18: Demonstration projects for the resource recycling substitution system. Implement actions to lead circular development, promote the recycling and utilization of new types of waste such as solar photovoltaic cells, precious metal separation and extraction from waste electronic products, electric vehicle power batteries, waste LCDs, etc., and carry out demonstrations of waste recycling and utilization systems based on the Internet + model. Promote the coordinated disposal of low-value urban waste and the accelerated development of comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste. Establish a system for the recycling of old parts with the after-sales service system as the core, and promote the application of remanufactured products in commercial trade logistics, financial insurance, maintenance and sales, and coal and petroleum mining enterprises. Encourage professional remanufacturing service companies to provide integrated solutions and specialized services.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, build a new model of sustainable development, and deepen the promotion of resource recycling.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: The level of industrial technology has significantly improved. The ability of enterprises to innovate in technology and integrate and transform scientific and technological achievements has greatly increased. Key core technologies such as energy efficiency and hierarchical utilization, pollution prevention and control, safe disposal, resource recycling, etc. have achieved breakthroughs in research and development. The quality and performance of equipment and products have significantly improved, and a large number of major equipment and products with intellectual property rights and international competitiveness have been formed. Some key common technologies have reached the international advanced level. Domestic equipment and products basically meet market demand. Through the introduction, digestion, absorption, and re-innovation, efforts have been made to improve the technological level of products, promote the widespread application of energy-saving and environmentally friendly key materials, as well as important equipment and products in various fields such as industry, agriculture, services, and residents' lives, and provide strong technical support for achieving energy-saving and environmental protection goals. Energy-consuming units widely adopt new energy-saving service mechanisms such as energy-saving doctors diagnosis, contract energy management, and energy management engineer system to improve energy management. The operation of urban sewage, waste treatment, desulfurization, and denitrification facilities has basically achieved specialization, marketization, and socialization, and comprehensive environmental services have been vigorously developed. Construct a number of technically advanced, well-matched, and standardized energy-saving and environmental protection industry demonstration bases, and form a development pattern of the energy-saving and environmental protection industry with large backbone enterprises as the leader and supporting a large number of small and medium-sized enterprises. The role of radiation and driving force has been fully exerted. Improve incentive and restraint mechanisms, establish a unified, open, fair competition, and standardized market order. The annual growth rate of the energy-saving and environmental protection industry's output value is above 15%. By 2015, the total output value will reach 4.5 trillion yuan, becoming a new pillar industry of the national economy. By promoting energy-saving and environmental protection products, it effectively stimulates consumer demand. By enhancing engineering and technical capabilities, it drives the growth of social investment in energy-saving and environmental protection, and provides strong support for the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries and the acceleration of economic development.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Currently, it is necessary to focus on key areas with wide market application, great potential for energy conservation and emission reduction, and significant demand-driven effects. We should accelerate the research and development, promotion, and industrialization of relevant technological equipment to comprehensively enhance the level of development in the energy conservation and environmental protection industry.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Promote efficient boilers. Develop a group of efficient boiler manufacturing bases and cultivate a group of large-scale backbone production enterprises for efficient boilers. Focus on improving the technological level of boiler automation control, optimization of main and auxiliary machine matching, adaptation to fuel varieties, deep recovery of low-temperature flue gas waste heat, and efficient combustion of small coal-fired boilers. Increase the promotion of efficient boiler applications. Expand the application of efficient motors. Promote the accelerated development of the efficient motor industry and establish 15-20 industrial bases for efficient motors and their control systems. Vigorously develop efficient motor products such as three-phase asynchronous motors and rare earth permanent magnet coreless motors, improve the technological level of efficient motor design, matching, key materials, equipment, as well as high-voltage frequency conversion, reactive power compensation, and other control systems. Develop thermal storage combustion technology and equipment. Construct a group of manufacturing bases with efficient combustion, heat transfer, and cooling technologies as characteristics, and accelerate the industrial demonstration and large-scale application of major technologies and equipment. The key is to comprehensively adopt energy-saving technologies such as optimized furnace structure, preheating utilization, and enhanced radiation heat transfer to improve the combustion efficiency of heating furnaces. Strive for breakthroughs in the combination of premixing and thermal storage, research and development of thermal storage materials, and miniaturization of thermal storage combustioners. Accelerate the technological breakthroughs and demonstration and promotion of new energy vehicles. Accelerate the implementation of the energy-saving and new energy vehicle technology innovation project, vigorously strengthen the innovation of power battery technology, focus on solving the safety, reliability, and lightweight issues of power battery systems, strengthen the research and development and industrialization of drive motors, core materials, electronic controls, and other key components, accelerate the improvement of supporting industries and charging facilities, and demonstrate and promote pure electric vehicles, plug-in hybrid vehicles, and air-powered vehicles. Promote the industrialization of semiconductor lighting. Integrate existing resources, improve industrial concentration, cultivate 10-15 leading enterprises with core technologies, intellectual property rights, and well-known brands, build a group of industrial agglomeration areas with complete industrial chains, and achieve localization of key production equipment and important raw materials. Accelerate the research and development of core materials, equipment, and key technologies, and focus on solving major technical problems such as heat dissipation, modularization, and standardization.
titlelist: Focus on key areas, promote comprehensive improvement in the development level of energy-saving and environmental protection industries, accelerate the upgrading and replacement of energy-saving technology and equipment, and promote energy-saving and efficiency improvement in key areas.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Improve the level of remanufacturing technology equipment. Enhance the innovation capability of the remanufacturing industry and promote the application of remanufacturing technologies such as nano-electroplating and laser cladding. Research and develop remanufacturing technology equipment such as non-destructive disassembly, surface pretreatment, and fatigue residual life assessment of components. Focus on supporting the establishment of 10-15 national-level remanufacturing industry clusters and a number of major demonstration projects, significantly increasing the application rate of equipment based on surface engineering technology. Build demonstration bases for urban minerals. Promote the clean recycling, large-scale utilization, and industrial development of recycled resources. Promote technologies such as large-scale crushing and shearing of scrap steel, crushing and sorting of scrapped cars and waste electrical appliances. Improve the level of equipment for fine separation and purification of rare and precious metals, modification of plastics, efficient sorting of mixed waste plastics, and comprehensive recycling and utilization of waste batteries. Support the construction of 50 urban mineral demonstration bases, accelerate the construction of a recycling system for renewable resources, and develop processing and utilization capacity of over 80 million tons of recycled resources. Deepen comprehensive utilization of waste. Promote the construction of demonstration bases for comprehensive resource utilization, encourage industrial clustering, and cultivate leading enterprises. Actively develop key common technologies and complete sets of equipment for the high-value utilization of valuable elements extracted from tailings and the production of ultrafine fibers from coal gangue. Develop large-scale, refined, and complete sets of technology and equipment for the production of new building materials from industrial waste. Increase research and development of recycling technologies for waste batteries and fluorescent lamps. Support the comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste and improve the technological content and added value of products from comprehensive resource utilization. Promote the comprehensive utilization of straw in major grain and cotton producing areas. Accelerate the construction of harmless treatment and resource utilization facilities for kitchen waste. Promote innovation in seawater desalination technology. Cultivate a number of seawater desalination industry bases that integrate research and development, incubation, production, integration, testing, and engineering technical services. Demonstrate and promote membrane, thermal, and hybrid seawater desalination technologies, as well as the co-production of electricity and water desalination model. Improve key components and system integration technologies such as membrane modules, high-pressure pumps, and energy recovery devices.
titlelist: Focus on key areas, promote comprehensive improvement in the development level of energy-saving and environmental protection industries, develop technology and equipment for resource recycling, and improve resource output efficiency.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Develop the energy-saving service industry. Implement financial incentives, tax benefits, and accounting systems to support key energy-consuming units in implementing energy-saving renovations through contract energy management, conducting energy audits and energy-saving doctor diagnoses, and creating a one-stop comprehensive service platform for contract energy management. The number, scale, and efficiency of specialized energy-saving service companies will grow rapidly. Actively explore market-oriented energy-saving mechanisms such as energy trading. Expand the environmental protection service industry. In key areas such as urban sewage treatment, solid waste treatment, flue gas desulfurization and denitrification, and industrial pollution control, encourage the development of environmental protection service general contracting and environmental governance franchise models that include system design, complete equipment, engineering construction, commissioning and operation, and maintenance management. The proportion of specialized and socialized services in the industry will significantly increase. Accelerate the development of emerging environmental protection services such as ecological environment restoration, environmental risk and damage assessment, pollutant discharge rights trading, green certification, and environmental pollution liability insurance. Cultivate the remanufacturing service industry. Support specialized companies in providing personalized remanufacturing services for high-value and vulnerable parts of equipment in industrial and mining enterprises using technologies such as surface repair and laser, and establish information management systems for remanufacturing old parts recycling, product marketing, and traceability. Promote the construction of a reverse logistics trading platform for waste materials.
titlelist: Focus on key areas, promote comprehensive improvement in the development level of energy conservation and environmental protection industries, innovate development models, and strengthen the energy conservation and environmental protection service industry.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Leverage the guiding and driving role of fiscal funds, adopt methods such as subsidies, rewards, and interest rate reductions to promote energy-saving transformations of key energy-consuming equipment such as boilers and heat exchange equipment in enterprises. comprehensively promote energy-saving key projects such as motor system energy-saving, energy system optimization, waste heat and waste pressure utilization, oil conservation and substitution, energy-saving in transportation, green lighting, energy-saving in circulation and retail sectors, and improve the energy-saving capabilities of traditional industries. Accelerate the promotion and application of energy-saving technology and equipment. Carry out energy-saving transformations in data centers to reduce energy consumption in data centers, supercomputing centers, and large-scale computer cooling.
titlelist: Give full play to the leading role of the government, guide the investment of social funds into energy-saving and environmental protection projects, and strengthen energy-saving technology transformation.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Guide enterprises and local governments to increase investment, promote the circular transformation of industrial parks (development zones), promote the exchange and utilization of various types of waste in park construction, promote the hierarchical utilization of energy, classify and utilize water, and promote the construction of public service platforms and other infrastructure, to achieve effective combination and circular linkage of projects, enterprises, and industries within the park, and create an upgraded version of the park. Promote a number of national and provincial-level development zones to improve the output rate of main resources, land output rate, and resource recycling rate, and basically achieve zero emissions.
titlelist: Give full play to the leading role of the government, guide the investment of social funds in energy conservation and environmental protection projects, and promote the transformation of industrial parks towards circular economy.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: By 2015, the newly added green building area will exceed 1 billion square meters, and the proportion of two-star and above green buildings in newly constructed urban buildings will exceed 20%. Green ecological cities (districts) will be built. Energy-saving standards for new buildings will be improved, and government investment in buildings, affordable housing, and large-scale public buildings will be the first to implement green building standards. Heating in new buildings will be metered per household. Heating metering and energy-saving renovations will be promoted in existing residential buildings. Heating pipeline network renovations will be implemented for 20,000 kilometers. 2,000 energy-saving public institutions will be established at all levels of government and in the education, science, culture, and health systems. Energy-saving renovations will be completed for 60 million square meters of office buildings in public institutions, driving investment in green building construction and related industries. Green building materials will be vigorously developed, and the use of bulk cement, ready-mixed concrete, and pre-mixed mortar will be promoted to promote industrialization in the construction sector. The large-scale application of new energy sources and renewable energy in buildings, such as solar power generation, will be actively promoted to expand the domestic market demand for the new energy industry.
titlelist: Give full play to the leading role of the government, guide the investment of social funds into energy conservation and environmental protection projects, and carry out green building initiatives.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Continue to implement and study the adjustment of energy-saving product benefit policies, implement the leader in energy efficiency plan, and promote the consumption of ultra-efficient energy-saving products in the market. Strengthen the implementation of energy efficiency labeling and energy-saving product certification systems, and guide consumers to purchase high-efficiency energy-saving products. Continue to adopt subsidy methods to promote high-efficiency energy-saving lighting, high-efficiency motors, and other products. Study and improve peak and off-peak electricity pricing and seasonal electricity pricing policies, and use reasonable price differentials to guide the public to change their lifestyles and promote the application of energy-saving products. Expand the scope of the demonstration and promotion of new energy vehicles in the public service sector in cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou, with the proportion of new energy vehicles in newly added or updated buses reaching over 60%, and promote the purchase of new energy vehicles and new energy taxis and logistics vehicles by individuals. By 2015, the energy efficiency level of terminal energy-consuming products will increase by more than 15%, and the market share of high-efficiency energy-saving products will increase to over 50%.
titlelist: Promote energy-saving and environmentally friendly products, expand market consumption demand, and expand the market consumption of energy-saving products.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Research policies and measures to expand the consumption of environmentally friendly products, improve the certification system for environmental and eco-label products, promote products such as fume purifiers, car exhaust purifiers, indoor air purifiers, household kitchen waste processors, concentrated laundry detergent, etc., to meet consumer demands. Relax market controls on liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and increase usage among rural residents. Carry out the exchange old for new program for remanufacturing, providing a certain percentage of subsidies to consumers who return old parts and purchase remanufactured pilot products, with a focus on promoting remanufactured engines, electric motors, etc. Implement relevant support policies to promote the comprehensive utilization of resources such as fly ash, coal gangue, construction waste, and straw.
