titlelist: Promote energy-saving and environmentally friendly products, expand market consumption demand, and drive the consumption of environmental and recycled products.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Strengthen the dominant position of enterprises in technological innovation, encourage enterprises to increase research and development investment, and support enterprises in taking the lead in undertaking national energy-saving and environmental protection scientific and technological programs. Priority should be given to the establishment of energy-saving and environmental protection technology research centers and laboratories in key national construction enterprises. Develop a number of industry technology innovation strategic alliances and other platforms led by key enterprises, with close integration of industry, academia, research, and application. Support the construction of regional energy-saving and environmental protection science and technology service platforms.
titlelist: Strengthen technological innovation, improve the market competitiveness of energy-saving and environmental protection industries, and support the construction of enterprise technological innovation capabilities.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Give full play to the role of national major science and technology projects, special funds for science and technology plans, etc., increase efforts to tackle key common technologies in energy conservation and environmental protection, accelerate breakthroughs in energy efficiency and hierarchical utilization, pollution prevention and control, safe disposal, resource recycling and utilization, carbon dioxide heat pumps, low-grade waste heat utilization, modular heating boiler technology and equipment. Aim at the future technological development high ground, and deploy carbon capture, utilization, and storage technology and equipment in advance.
titlelist: Strengthen technological innovation, improve the market competitiveness of energy-saving and environmental protection industries, and accelerate the mastery of major key core technologies.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Choose regions with a good foundation for the development of energy-saving and environmental protection industries, and establish a number of demonstration bases for energy-saving and environmental protection industries that have industry clustering, prominent advantages, organic integration of industry, academia, research, and application, and significant leading and demonstration roles. Support the production, manufacturing, and promotion of complete sets of equipment and supporting equipment, key common technologies, and advanced manufacturing technologies. Strengthen intellectual property protection, promote the construction of intellectual property investment and financing mechanisms, encourage the establishment of public service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises, and introduce supportive policies to support technological innovation and industrial development of small and medium-sized energy-saving and environmental protection enterprises. Select a batch of technologically advanced and economically applicable energy-saving and environmental protection equipment and expand their promotion and application.
titlelist: Strengthen technological innovation, improve the market competitiveness of energy-saving and environmental protection industries, and promote the industrialization of scientific and technological achievements.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Accelerate the revision of energy-saving and environmental protection standards, gradually improve the energy efficiency standards for end-use products and the energy consumption limits for key industry units. Improve the environmental quality standards and pollutant emission standards system according to the needs of improving environmental quality. Increase pollutant emission control requirements, expand the monitoring of pollutants, strengthen total control and control of toxic and harmful pollutant emissions, fully leverage the role of standards in promoting industrial development, and promote the upgrading and transformation of traditional industries. Improve energy-saving and environmental protection laws and regulations, promote the accelerated formulation of energy-saving evaluation and examination laws for fixed asset investment projects, and formulate management measures for the promotion of energy-saving technologies. Strictly enforce energy-saving and environmental protection laws, seriously investigate and deal with various illegal activities, ensure the connection between administrative law enforcement and criminal justice, and increase the punishment for environmental pollution crimes in accordance with the law. Implement the responsibility system for law enforcement accountability seriously. Strengthen supervision and inspection of the implementation of energy-saving and environmental protection standards, certification marks, policy measures, etc. Accelerate the establishment of energy-saving and emission reduction monitoring and evaluation systems and technical service platforms.
titlelist: Strengthen constraints and incentives, create a favorable market and policy environment, and improve regulations and standards.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Vigorously develop green credit, increase support for energy-saving and environmental protection projects in accordance with the principles of controllable risks and sustainable business. Actively innovate financial products and services, explore the inclusion of franchise rights and other assets into the scope of loan collateral according to existing policy regulations. Support green credit and financial innovation, establish a green bank rating system. Support financing guarantee institutions to increase their guarantee efforts for energy-saving and environmental protection enterprises that comply with industrial policies, have good qualifications, and follow standardized management. Support eligible energy-saving and environmental protection enterprises to issue corporate bonds, small and medium-sized enterprise collective bonds, commercial papers, medium-term notes, and other debt financing instruments. Conduct a pilot program for non-public issuance of corporate bonds for energy-saving and environmental protection enterprises with good qualifications. Steadily develop carbon trading. Encourage and guide private investment and foreign investment in the field of energy-saving and environmental protection.
titlelist: Strengthen constraints and incentives, create a favorable market and policy environment, and expand investment and financing channels.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Accelerate the formulation and implementation of grid connection and pricing policies that encourage the generation of electricity from waste heat, excess pressure, and excess energy, as well as the development of cogeneration and renewable energy. Improve the peak and off-peak electricity pricing policy, expand its application, and gradually increase the price difference between peak and off-peak periods. Impose punitive electricity prices on enterprises and products that exceed the energy consumption (electricity consumption) limit. Strictly implement the electricity pricing policy for desulfurization and denitrification in coal-fired power plants, as well as the tiered pricing policy for residential electricity consumption, and promote tiered pricing for residential water and gas consumption. Deepen the market-oriented reform of municipal public utilities, improve the pricing and fee management methods for heating measurement, and improve the policies for sewage treatment fees and garbage disposal fees by including sludge treatment costs in sewage treatment costs and implementing a system for charging sewage treatment fees to self-supplied water users. Improve the collection methods for garbage disposal fees, reasonably determine the charging carriers and standards, and improve the collection rate and the efficiency of fund utilization. Key projects supported by the state in energy conservation and environmental protection, such as urban sewage and garbage treatment facilities, urban mineral demonstration bases, and centralized resource utilization centers, should be given priority protection in the annual land use planning. Strictly implement and continuously improve existing tax incentives for energy conservation, water conservation, environmental protection, and comprehensive utilization of resources.
titlelist: Strengthen constraints and incentives, create a favorable market and policy environment, and improve pricing, fees, and land policies.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Establish the leader system for energy efficiency of major terminal energy products, and clarify the implementation deadline. Promote energy-saving power generation scheduling. Strengthen demand-side management of electricity and carry out comprehensive urban pilot projects. Study and formulate a mandatory catalog for the recovery of products and packaging, establish an extended producer responsibility system, and promote producers to fulfill their responsibilities for the recovery and disposal of waste products. Adopt methods such as government construction of networks and enterprise construction of facilities to encourage the market-oriented construction and operation of urban sewage and waste treatment facilities. Deepen the pilot program for paid use and trading of pollutant discharge rights, establish and improve the policy system for paid use and trading of pollutant discharge rights, and study and formulate policies for the initial and trading prices of pollutant discharge rights. Carry out pilot programs for carbon emission trading. Improve the polluter pays system, perfect the compensation system for mineral resources, and accelerate the establishment of an ecological compensation mechanism.
titlelist: Strengthen constraints and incentives, create a favorable market and policy environment, and implement market-oriented mechanisms.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: Encourage eligible enterprises to undertake various environmental protection projects and service projects overseas. In accordance with the needs of recipient countries and China's aid capacity, increase assistance in the fields of environmental protection, clean energy, and climate change, and support cooperation in related technologies, products, and services. Cultivate and construct a number of national science and technology innovation bases for trade. Encourage energy-saving and environmental protection enterprises to participate in various bilateral or international energy-saving and environmental protection forums, exhibitions, and trade and investment promotion activities, fully utilize relevant platforms for communication and promotion, carry out international cooperation, and enhance the ability to 'go global'. Guide foreign investment towards the energy-saving and environmental protection industry, enrich foreign investment methods, expand foreign investment channels, and continuously improve the soft environment for foreign investment. Continue to support the introduction of advanced energy-saving and environmental protection core technologies and equipment. The policies supporting the development of the energy-saving and environmental protection industry are equally applicable to eligible foreign-invested enterprises.
titlelist: Strengthen constraints and incentives, create a favorable market and policy environment, support the going out and bringing in of the energy-saving and environmental protection industry.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
content: While carrying out the top-level design and overall deployment of ecological civilization construction, we should summarize effective practices and successful experiences and carry out the construction of ecological civilization pilot zones. Based on different regional characteristics, we will select 100 representative areas nationwide to carry out the construction of ecological civilization pilot zones, exploring a model of ecological civilization construction that suits China's national conditions. We will steadily expand the scope of comprehensive demonstration of fiscal policies for energy conservation and emission reduction, integrate fiscal policies related to energy conservation, emission reduction, and new energy development in conjunction with the construction of new urbanization, select some cities as platforms, tap the potential of domestic demand in industrial low-carbonization, clean transportation, green building, intensive services, major pollutant reduction, and scale utilization of renewable energy, systematically promote energy conservation and emission reduction, drive economic transformation and upgrading, and accumulate experience in cross-regional and cross-basin energy conservation and emission reduction through exploration. Through pilot projects, we will promote investment in energy conservation, environmental protection, and circular economy, comprehensively promote resource conservation and environmental protection, give full play to the driving and radiation effects of typical cases, and form comprehensive capabilities in energy conservation, emission reduction, and ecological civilization.
titlelist: Strengthen constraints and incentives, create a favorable market and policy environment, and carry out ecological civilization pilot projects.

name: Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industry (State Council [2013] No. 30) (State Council, August 1, 2013)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Strengthen the education on the concept of ecological civilization and the national conditions of resources and environment, and incorporate energy conservation and environmental protection, as well as ecological civilization, into the propaganda and education system of socialist core values, basic education, higher education, and vocational education. Strengthen public opinion supervision and guidance, promote advanced examples, expose negative cases, popularize knowledge and methods of energy conservation and environmental protection, advocate a new trend of green consumption, and promote a civilized, economical, green, and low-carbon production mode, consumption pattern, and lifestyle. All regions and departments should deepen their understanding of the importance of accelerating the development of the energy conservation and environmental protection industry, strengthen organizational leadership and coordination, clarify division of tasks, implement work responsibilities, carry out solid work, ensure that all tasks and measures are implemented, and strive to achieve results as soon as possible. (This text has been edited for brevity).
titlelist: Strengthen constraints and incentives, create a favorable market and policy environment, and enhance energy conservation and environmental protection publicity and education.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green Development (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 178) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: By 2025, significant progress will be made in the green and low-carbon transformation of the industrial industry structure and production methods. Green and low-carbon technologies and equipment will be widely applied, energy and resource utilization efficiency will be greatly improved, and the level of green manufacturing will be comprehensively enhanced, laying a solid foundation for achieving carbon peak in the industrial sector by 2030. Carbon intensity will continue to decrease, with a reduction of 18% in CO2 emissions per unit of industrial value added. Key industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, and building materials will achieve phased results in controlling total carbon emissions. Pollutant intensity will significantly decrease, with continuous strengthening of source control capabilities for harmful substances, significant improvement in clean production levels, and a 10% reduction in pollutant emissions intensity for key industries. Energy efficiency will steadily improve, with a 13.5% reduction in energy consumption per unit of value added by industrial enterprises above a certain scale, and key industrial products such as crude steel, cement, and ethylene reaching world advanced levels in terms of energy consumption per unit. Resource utilization levels will significantly improve, with continuous improvement in resource output rates for key industries, a comprehensive utilization rate of industrial solid waste reaching 57%, and the recovery and utilization of major renewable resources reaching 480 million tons. Water consumption per unit of industrial value added will be reduced by 16%. The green manufacturing system will become increasingly perfect, with the basic establishment of green manufacturing systems in key industries and regions, the improvement of industrial green and low-carbon standard systems, the promotion of tens of thousands of green products, and the output value of the green and environmental protection industry reaching 11 trillion yuan. A number of standard and technical public service platforms will be established and constructed.
titlelist: Overall plan, main objectives

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green Development (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 178) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Accelerate the adjustment of industrial structure, resolutely curb the blind development of two high projects, promote the phased-out of backward production capacity in accordance with laws and regulations, develop strategic emerging industries and high-tech industries, continuously optimize the industrial layout in key areas and river basins, and comprehensively promote the green and low-carbon transformation of industries. Promote the green and low-carbon development of traditional industries. Accelerate the green upgrading and transformation of industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, building materials, textiles, light industry, and machinery, and promote the relocation and transformation of hazardous chemical production enterprises in densely populated urban areas. Implement the dual control targets for energy consumption and control requirements for carbon emissions, and promote the reduction, intensification, and green development of heavy and chemical industries. For two high projects that have saturated the market, the energy efficiency level of the main products should meet the advanced energy consumption limit or international advanced level. Strictly implement the capacity replacement policy for industries such as steel, cement, flat glass, and electrolytic aluminum, and strictly control the increase in capacity in industries such as urea, ammonium phosphate, calcium carbide, caustic soda, and yellow phosphorus. New projects should implement capacity replacement of equal or reduced amount. Strengthen the constraints of environmental protection, energy consumption, water consumption, and other factors, and promote the phased-out of backward production capacity in accordance with laws and regulations. Strengthen the development of strategic emerging industries in green environmental protection. Focus on creating a new engine for industrial development with low energy and resource consumption, less environmental pollution, high added value, and strong market demand. Accelerate the development of strategic emerging industries such as new energy, new materials, new energy vehicles, green intelligent ships, green environmental protection, high-end equipment, and energy electronics, and promote the green and low-carbon development of the entire economy and society. Promote the integrated, clustered, and ecological development of strategic emerging industries in the green manufacturing field, develop a group of leading backbone enterprises, cultivate a group of specialized and innovative hidden champions enterprises and manufacturing industry champions. Optimize the layout of key areas for green and low-carbon development. Under the strict protection of the ecological environment, enhance the green supply capacity of energy resources in energy-rich regions, promote the increase in the proportion of clean energy utilization and the level of resource recycling in key development areas, guide the development of characteristic industries and ecological industries suitable for resource and environmental conditions in ecologically fragile areas, and encourage the transformation of ecological advantages into industrial advantages in regions with abundant ecological product resources. Accelerate the construction of green and low-carbon development highlands with a focus on regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, actively promote the Yangtze River Economic Belt as the main battlefield for China's ecological priority and green development, and solidly promote the ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin. Column 2: Key regional green transformation and upgrading projects. Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region. Promote the coordinated development of regional resource utilization, and construct large-scale projects such as tailings and waste stone production of sand and gravel aggregates. Strengthen the efficient utilization of unconventional water such as wastewater, seawater, and recycled water in water-intensive industries. Encourage leading enterprises to carry out green partner supplier management and integrate and optimize the regional green industrial chain. Yangtze River Delta. Promote the joint protection and governance of the ecological environment, coordinate the adjustment of regional industrial structure, promote the green upgrading and transformation of traditional industries, industrial transfer, cross-regional coordination of industrial chains, and high-efficiency aggregation of industries, promote the optimization allocation of energy and resource in the region, and build a high-level demonstration zone for integrated ecological and green development in the Yangtze River Delta. Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Promote the green transformation of traditional industries such as refining, papermaking, and building materials in the Greater Bay Area, implement the clean production partner program in the Greater Bay Area, and increase the recycling and utilization of renewable resources. Promote the construction of green development demonstration zones, conduct evaluations of green and low-carbon development, and strengthen exchanges and cooperation in green and low-carbon technologies. Yangtze River Economic Belt. Strengthen the improvement and pollution control of chemical industrial parks, prohibit the construction and expansion of chemical projects within 1 kilometer of the Yangtze River and its tributaries, and carry out water-saving and pollution reduction in industries along the river. Strengthen the comprehensive utilization of resources such as phosphogypsum, smelting slag, fly ash, scrap metal, waste plastics, and waste tires in the middle and upper reaches of the Yangtze River. Yellow River Basin. According to the principle of production based on water resources, strictly control the blind expansion of industries such as coal chemical, non-ferrous metals, and steel. Guide the coupling development of new coal chemical industry with petrochemicals, steel, building materials, and other industries. Promote the recycling of water resources in industries such as steel and coal chemical, and fully utilize municipal sewage and recycled water.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the transformation of the industrial structure towards high-end development.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green Development (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 178) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Adhering to the principles of total control, scientific allocation, comprehensive conservation, and circular utilization, strengthen the efficient utilization of resources in the production process, reduce industrial solid waste and wastewater generation, strengthen the comprehensive utilization of industrial resources, promote the green circular linkage between production and living systems, and greatly improve resource utilization efficiency. Promote the efficient and coordinated utilization of primary resources. Coordinate the two major sources of international and domestic resources, strengthen the optimized allocation of resources across regions and industries, comprehensively and reasonably develop mineral resources such as iron ore, phosphate ore, and non-ferrous metals, and strengthen the development of associated mineral resources such as vanadium and titanium resources in vanadium-titanium magnetite and fluorine resources in phosphate ore. Strengthen the matching of raw materials supply and demand structure among steel, non-ferrous metals, building materials, and chemical enterprises, promote effective and coordinated supply, strengthen the circular linkage between enterprises, industrial parks, and industrial clusters, and improve the level of resource utilization. Promote the high-value recycling of renewable resources. Cultivate leading backbone enterprises for the recycling of waste steel, waste non-ferrous metals, waste plastics, waste tires, waste paper, waste electrical and electronic products, waste power batteries, waste oil, and waste textiles, promote the aggregation of resource elements to advantageous enterprises, rely on the technical equipment of advantageous enterprises, and promote the high-value utilization of renewable resources. Coordinate the use of domestic and international resources, rely on information technology such as the Internet, blockchain, and big data, and build a dual-track supply chain for renewable resources both domestically and internationally. Encourage the construction of industrial parks for high-value utilization of renewable resources, promote the clustering of enterprises, the circulation of resources, and the development of high-end industries. Coordinate the comprehensive utilization of emerging solid waste such as retired photovoltaic, wind power generation equipment, and marine engineering equipment. Actively promote remanufactured products and vigorously develop high-end intelligent remanufacturing. Promote the large-scale comprehensive utilization of industrial solid waste. Promote the large-scale comprehensive utilization of bulk industrial solid waste such as tailings, fly ash, coal gangue, smelting slag, industrial by-product gypsum, red mud, and chemical slag. Promote the coordinated disposal of solid waste such as steel furnaces, cement kilns, and chemical plants. Based on the comprehensive utilization base of industrial resources, explore the development model of industrial solid waste comprehensive utilization based on regional characteristics in concentrated solid waste generation areas, coal-producing areas, and basic raw material industry agglomeration areas. Encourage qualified parks and enterprises to strengthen resource coupling and recycling, create zero waste parks and zero waste enterprises. Implement the evaluation of comprehensive utilization of industrial solid waste resources, promote the use through evaluation, and promote the first realization of the full use of newly added industrial solid waste and the orderly reduction of existing industrial solid waste in areas with conditions. Column 4: Promotion of efficient resource utilization engineering. Recycling of renewable resources. Construct a number of large-scale integrated green sorting, processing, and distribution centers for waste steel, waste non-ferrous metals, waste paper, etc. Increase the proportion of strategic metal resources such as recycled copper, aluminum, cobalt, and lithium, and promote the comprehensive recovery of various valuable components. Implement plastic pollution control requirements, implement industry norms for comprehensive utilization of waste plastics, and encourage chemical recycling of waste plastics. By 2025, strive to achieve recycling and utilization of 320 million tons of waste steel, 60 million tons of waste paper, and 20 million tons of waste non-ferrous metals, among which the production of recycled copper, aluminum, and lead will reach 4 million tons, 11.5 million tons, and 2.9 million tons, respectively. Comprehensive utilization of industrial solid waste. Promote the large-scale application of bulk industrial solid waste in the production of building materials, infrastructure construction, and filling of underground goafs. Extract valuable elements from solid waste and produce fiber materials, white carbon black, microcrystalline glass, ultrafine fillers, energy-saving building materials, etc. By 2025, the comprehensive utilization rates of smelting slag (excluding red mud) and industrial by-product gypsum will reach 73% respectively. Recycling and utilization of waste power batteries. Improve the regulations and systems for the recycling and utilization of power batteries, explore and promote new business models such as Internet + recycling, strengthen traceability management, encourage upstream and downstream enterprises in the industrial chain to jointly build and use recycling channels, and build a number of centralized recycling service outlets. Promote the large-scale and hierarchical application of waste power batteries in energy storage, backup power, charging and swapping, and build a number of hierarchical utilization and recycling projects. By 2025, a relatively complete system for the recycling and utilization of power batteries will be established. High-end intelligent remanufacturing. Revise the management measures for the identification of remanufactured products, establish a product qualification assessment system combining voluntary certification and self-declaration, and standardize the development of the remanufacturing industry. Promote the remanufacturing of high-tech and high-value-added products from overseas in national free trade pilot zones. Cultivate industry benchmarks. Select and release a list of recycling and utilization enterprises that meet industry norms, build 50 industrial resource utilization bases, and cultivate a group of leaders in industrial resource utilization. Promote the extension of producer responsibility for electrical and electronic products, automobiles, etc., and strengthen demonstration and guidance. Promote the efficient use of water resources. According to the principle of water-based production, strengthen quota management for water-intensive industries, and carry out water efficiency benchmarking. Promote the integrated optimization of water systems for enterprises and industrial parks, achieve serial water use, segmented water quality use, multiple water use, and cascade utilization. Encourage key industries to increase the utilization of municipal sewage, recycled water, seawater, rainwater, mine water, and other unconventional water in coastal areas, and reduce the use of fresh water. Promote enterprises to establish sound water management systems, establish smart water management platforms, and achieve efficient use of water resources. Carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial wastewater recycling, and guide key industries and key areas to strengthen the reuse of industrial wastewater after treatment. Column 5: Industrial water-saving and efficiency enhancement projects. Optimize water intake structure. Guide enterprises and industrial parks to cooperate with municipal authorities to increase the use of municipal domestic sewage and recycled water. Encourage coastal areas to directly use seawater as circulating cooling water and build seawater desalination facilities. Encourage the construction of rainwater collection, storage, and comprehensive utilization facilities. Encourage the graded treatment and segmented utilization of coal mine water in energy bases such as Ningdong, Mengxi, northern Shaanxi, and western Shanxi. Strengthen process management. Encourage enterprises or parks with annual water consumption exceeding 100,000 cubic meters to establish water management positions and regularly receive training in water-saving technologies, standards, and management norms. Carry out industrial water-saving diagnosis and cultivate a group of professional third-party industrial water-saving and water treatment service organizations. Build a smart water management cloud platform in key industries. Increase wastewater recycling. Promote the integrated regeneration and reuse of refinery wastewater, joint regeneration and reuse of steel wastewater and municipal wastewater, deep treatment of coking wastewater by electromagnetic strong oxidation, deep treatment and reuse of coal chemical concentrated brine wastewater, deep treatment and reuse of textile printing and dyeing wastewater, and biological treatment and reuse of organic wastewater from food fermentation. Create pilot projects for efficient and circular utilization of wastewater in areas with severe water shortages. Build a number of demonstration enterprises and parks for wastewater recycling. Conduct water-saving evaluations. Strengthen the revision of industrial water-saving standards, carry out water efficiency benchmarking, and establish industrial water-saving models. By 2025, select 50 water efficiency leaders enterprises in water-intensive industries such as steel, refining, coal chemical, papermaking, food, and textile printing and dyeing, and create water-saving benchmarks.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the transformation of resource utilization towards circularity.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green Development (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 178) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: The concept of system pollution reduction combining source reduction, process control, and end-of-pipe efficient treatment is strengthened. Green design is vigorously promoted to lead incremental enterprises to create cleaner production methods from a higher starting point, and to promote continuous implementation of clean production technology transformation in existing enterprises, guiding enterprises to actively improve their clean production levels. The promotion mechanism for green design is improved. The life cycle concept is strengthened, and industrial product green design is comprehensively implemented in all aspects and processes. In industries with significant ecological and environmental impacts, wide product coverage, and high industrial relevance, green design demonstration enterprises are established to explore green design paths for the industry, driving the green collaborative improvement of the industrial chain and supply chain. A green design platform based on technologies such as big data and cloud computing is constructed, and the key technology supply for green design and green manufacturing collaboration is strengthened, with increased application of green design. Focus is placed on industrial products with prominent green attributes and high consumption, and green design evaluation standards are formulated, and the standard acceptance mechanism is improved. Enterprises are guided to conduct green design evaluations through self-declaration or voluntary certification. The use of harmful substances at the source is reduced. Strict implementation of control requirements for the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic products, automobiles, ships, and other products, reducing the use of lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, polybrominated biphenyls, polybrominated diphenyl ethers, and other substances. Research and formulate management measures for the use of harmful substances in road motor vehicles, update the catalog of products under control for electrical and electronic products, establish and revise mandatory standards for the content of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic products and automobiles, compile a list of harmful substances in ships, and develop inspection guidelines, continuously promoting the alignment of control requirements for hazardous substances with international standards. Strengthen mandatory standards. Promote the widespread use of coatings, inks, adhesives, cleaning agents, and other products with low (or no) volatile organic compound content. Promote the establishment of a departmental collaborative regulatory mechanism, establish a database of hazardous substances covering the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain, fully leverage the role of e-commerce platforms, and innovate the implementation of big data regulation. Reduce pollution emissions from production processes. For key industries and process links with large pollutant emissions, research and promote process pollution reduction technologies and equipment, and carry out application demonstrations. Focus on key areas such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and its surrounding areas, the Fenwei Plain, and the Yangtze River Delta region, increase the efforts to transform key industries with regard to nitrogen oxides, volatile organic compounds, and achieve coordinated control of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and ozone. Focus on key river basins such as the Yangtze River and the Yellow River, as well as industrial clusters related to heavy metal industries, implement projects to improve the level of clean production, and reduce the emissions of pollutants such as chemical oxygen demand, ammonia nitrogen, and heavy metals. Strictly comply with international environmental conventions and relevant standards, promote the reduction of persistent organic pollutants, toxic and hazardous chemicals, and other new pollutants in key industries. Formulate a list of outdated production processes and equipment for industrial solid waste causing severe environmental pollution to be phased out within a specified period. Upgrade and improve end-of-pipe treatment facilities. Promote the use of advanced and applicable environmental protection governance equipment in key industries, and promote the formation of stable and efficient governance capabilities. In the field of air pollution prevention and control, focus on key industries with large flue gas emissions, complex composition, and difficult governance, and carry out application demonstrations for the coordinated control of multiple pollutants. Deepen the ultra-low emission transformation in the steel industry, and steadily implement ultra-low emission transformations in industries such as cement and coking. Accelerate the recovery and treatment of volatile organic compounds (VOCs), and encourage the selection of low-consumption and high-efficiency combined processes for governance. In the field of water pollution prevention and control, focus on difficult wastewater treatment such as heavy metals, high salinity, and high organic matter, and carry out demonstrations of deep and efficient treatment to gradually improve the level of wastewater treatment in industries such as printing and dyeing, papermaking, chemical raw materials and pharmaceuticals, coal chemical industry, and non-ferrous metals. Column 6: Key industries clean production transformation projects. Steel industry: Implement technologies and equipment upgrades such as coke oven gas desulfurization, high proportion sintering, coke negative pressure distillation, and full-process optimization by 2025, complete the ultra-low emission transformation of 530 million tons of steel production capacity and clean production transformation of 460 million tons of coking production capacity. Petrochemical industry: Implement process technology upgrades such as efficient catalysis, process intensification, and efficient distillation, as well as equipment upgrades such as waste salt incineration and refining, high-temperature decomposition of waste sulfuric acid, advanced oxidation, micro-reaction, and coal gasification. Non-ferrous metals industry: Implement technologies and equipment upgrades such as efficient alumina dissolution and red mud reduction, short-process smelting and continuous smelting in the copper smelting industry, efficient and clean electrolysis and oxygen pressure leaching in the zinc smelting industry, and vertical reduction magnesium refining in the magnesium smelting industry. By 2025, complete the clean production transformation of about 4,000 non-ferrous metal furnaces. Building materials industry: Implement technologies and complete equipment upgrades such as ultra-low emission of desulfurization, denitrification, and dust removal in the cement industry, and integrated process technologies and equipment for dust removal, desulfurization, and waste heat utilization (power generation) in the glass industry. Textile industry: Implement technologies and equipment upgrades such as low bath ratio dyeing, non-polyvinyl alcohol sizing and weaving, green pulping of regenerated cellulose fibers, supercritical carbon dioxide fluid dyeing, flat dyeing of knitted fabrics, and low-water continuous dyeing of polyester fabrics. Light industry: Implement technologies and equipment upgrades such as short-process, low-water consumption release paper for synthetic leather manufacturing, closed-loop circulation of leather ash and chrome tanning waste liquid, bio-tanning, efficient production of strains for bulk fermentation products, and green extraction and refining. Machinery industry: Continuously promote green optimization and upgrading of basic manufacturing processes, implement green process material preparation, clean casting, precision forging, green heat treatment, advanced welding, low-carbon and pollution reduction surface engineering, and efficient cutting processes and technologies.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the transformation of the production process towards cleanliness.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green Development (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 178) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Increase the supply of green and low-carbon products. Build a green product supply system in the industrial sector, from basic raw materials to end consumer products, and encourage enterprises to use green design methods and tools to develop and promote a batch of high-performance, high-quality, lightweight, and low-carbon environmental-friendly products. Create green consumption scenarios and expand the consumption of new energy vehicles, photovoltaic products, green consumer electronics, green building materials, and other green products. Advocate for a green lifestyle and continue to promote energy-saving, water-saving, efficient, and safe green smart home appliances. Promote the establishment of a green and low-carbon product sales zone on e-commerce platforms, establish sales incentive and constraint mechanisms, and support new forms of consumption as production such as green credits. Vigorously develop green environmental protection equipment. Research and develop energy-saving equipment in industries such as efficient heating, energy-saving power, and waste heat and pressure recovery, as well as low-energy consumption, modular, and intelligent industrial wastewater, flue gas, and solid waste treatment equipment. Accelerate the promotion and application of rural energy-saving and environmental protection equipment such as biomass gasification and power generation, biogas utilization, and agricultural film pollution control. Develop integrated molding equipment for new wall materials, copper and aluminum waste crushing and sorting equipment, and comprehensive utilization equipment for retired power batteries. Develop remanufacturing equipment for engineering machinery, heavy-duty machine tools, internal combustion engines, etc. Innovate green service supply models. Build key industry platforms for carbon peak and carbon neutrality, providing low-carbon planning, low-carbon solution design, low-carbon technology verification, carbon emissions, and carbon footprint accounting services to enterprises and industrial parks. Establish a basic database for carbon emissions of key industrial products and improve the measurement, collection, monitoring, and analysis system for carbon emissions data. Promote service models such as contract energy management, contract water management, and third-party governance of environmental pollution. Actively cultivate specialized green service institutions such as green manufacturing system solution providers, third-party evaluators, and urban environmental service providers, providing services such as green diagnosis, research and development design, integrated application, operation management, evaluation certification, and training, and actively participate in the formulation of international standards for green services and service trade rules. Column 7: Supply of green products and energy-saving and environmental protection equipment. Green products: vigorously develop and promote new energy vehicles, promote the use of alternative fuel vehicles such as methanol vehicles. Continue to promote energy-efficient lighting, energy-saving air conditioning, energy-saving refrigerators, water-saving washing machines, and other green smart home appliances through methods such as trade-in. Encourage the use of coatings and cleaning agents with low volatile organic compound content, and accelerate the development of new building materials such as biomass, wood, and gypsum. Increase the proportion of recycled materials consumption. By 2025, develop and promote 10,000 types of green products. Green environmental protection equipment: focus on the development of pollution control robots, machine vision-based intelligent garbage sorting technology equipment, dry anaerobic organic waste treatment technology equipment, efficient and low-consumption difficult-to-treat wastewater resource utilization technology equipment, multi-pollutant collaborative deep treatment technology equipment for non-electric field flue gas, efficient continuous volatile organic compound adsorption-desorption, heat storage-type thermal oxidation/catalytic combustion technology equipment. New energy equipment: develop large-sized and efficient photovoltaic modules, high-power offshore wind power equipment, hydrogen fuel gas turbines, ultra-high-pressure hydrogen compressors, efficient hydrogen fuel cells, integrated commercial small reactors, and other new energy equipment. Promote the intelligent innovation and upgrading of photovoltaics and characteristic applications in the industry.
titlelist: The main tasks are to guide the transformation of product supply towards greenification, increase the supply of green and low-carbon products and green environmental protection equipment, guide green consumption, create new demand, cultivate new models, build a new engine for green growth, and provide solid support for the green and low-carbon transformation in various sectors of the economy and society.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green Development (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 178) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Drive the transformation of production methods through digitalization, adopt new generation information technologies such as industrial internet, big data, and 5G to enhance the level of energy, resource, and environmental management, deepen the digital application of production and manufacturing processes, and empower green manufacturing. Establish a green and low-carbon basic data platform. Accelerate the formulation of green and low-carbon basic data standards covering energy, resources, carbon emissions, and pollutant emissions. Establish product lifecycle green and low-carbon basic data platforms in different industries, coordinate green and low-carbon basic data with industrial big data resources, establish data sharing mechanisms, and promote data aggregation, sharing, and application. Based on platform data, carry out carbon footprint, water footprint, and environmental impact analysis and evaluation. Promote the integration of digitalization, intelligence, and green development. Deepen the digital application in product research and development design, production and manufacturing, application and service, and recycling and utilization, accelerate the application of artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, cloud computing, digital twins, blockchain, and other information technologies in the field of green manufacturing, and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of green transformation and development. Promote the intelligent perception and control systems of key process equipment in the manufacturing process, multi-objective optimization of processes, and optimization of management decisions, and realize the collection, monitoring, intelligent analysis, and fine management of information such as material flow and energy flow in the production process. Build a digital twin system for the entire product lifecycle, and use data to drive the improvement of the industry's green and low-carbon technology innovation, green manufacturing, and operation and maintenance service levels. Promote the encapsulation of green technologies into software and promote the innovative application of mature green manufacturing technologies. Implement Industrial Internet + Green Manufacturing. Encourage enterprises and industrial parks to carry out system construction for energy and resource information management and control, online monitoring of pollutant emissions, and underground pipe network leakage detection, and achieve dynamic monitoring, precise control, and optimized management. Strengthen the intelligent collection, management, and application of data throughout the lifecycle of renewable resources. Promote the digital transformation and cloud-based utilization of major energy-consuming equipment and processes. Support the use of Internet of Things, big data, and other information technologies for information collection, data analysis, flow monitoring, and financial management, and promote the new model of Industrial Internet + Recycling and Utilization of Renewable Resources.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the digital transformation of production methods.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green Development (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 178) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Accelerate breakthroughs in key common technology research. Implement a batch of energy-saving and carbon reduction research projects targeting basic components and parts, basic processes, key basic materials, etc. Concentrate advantageous resources to carry out research on carbon reduction, zero carbon, and negative carbon technologies, carbon capture, utilization, and storage technologies, zero carbon industrial process reengineering technologies, complex and difficult-to-use solid waste harmless utilization technologies, new energy-saving and new energy materials technologies, and high-efficiency energy storage materials technologies, etc., to form a batch of original scientific and technological achievements. Carry out research and development of common technologies such as clean and efficient utilization of fossil energy, graded utilization of renewable resources, high-end intelligent equipment remanufacturing technologies, and efficient energy-saving and environmental protection equipment technologies, and strengthen the supply of green and low-carbon technologies. Strengthen basic research and frontier technology layout. Strengthen the layout of basic theories, basic methods, and frontier disruptive technologies, and promote research on frontier green and low-carbon technologies such as carbon neutrality, carbon dioxide removal, and low-cost utilization. Carry out basic research on new pollution control technologies and equipment such as intelligent photovoltaics, perovskite solar cells, green hydrogen development and utilization, carbon monoxide fermentation for alcohol production, carbon dioxide negative emission technologies, as well as ozone pollution, persistent organic pollutants, microplastics, and free-state pollutants, and steadily promote integrated innovation of technologies such as aggregation and microwave dust removal. Promote the widespread application of advanced and applicable technologies. Regularly compile and release catalogs of green technologies, equipment, and products such as low-carbon, energy-saving, water-saving, clean production, and comprehensive utilization of resources, select a batch of process equipment technologies with advanced level, good economic performance, great promotion potential, and urgent market demand, and encourage enterprises to strengthen equipment renewal and large-scale application of new products. Focus on promoting process equipment technologies such as fully waste steel electric arc furnace short process steelmaking, high-selectivity catalysis, efficient waste heat recovery and utilization, ultra-low emission and simultaneous control of multiple pollutants, low-nitrogen combustion in heating furnaces, dry granulation dedusting, deep treatment and reuse of industrial wastewater, efficient extraction and separation, and efficient membrane separation. Organize the formulation of major technology promotion plans and supply-demand matching guidelines. Optimize and improve the insurance compensation mechanism for the first set of major technological equipment, the first batch of key new materials, and support the application of green and low-carbon technology equipment and green materials that meet the conditions. Encourage localities and industries to explore new mechanisms for promoting green and low-carbon technology. Column 8: Promotion and application of green and low-carbon technology engineering. Carbon reduction technology. Promote the application of technologies such as low-carbon metallurgy, clean steelmaking, green hydrogen refining, new low-carbon cementitious materials, carbon dioxide-coupled methanol production, efficient and low-carbon aluminum electrolysis, high-parameter gas power generation, carbon dioxide enhanced oil recovery, and ultra-low nitrogen porous media flameless combustion. Pollution reduction technology. Promote the application of technologies such as ion exchange desulfurization and denitrification, circulating cooling water treatment with phosphorus-free water treatment agents, nanoceramic membrane wastewater treatment, coordinated disposal of industrial kilns, in-situ thermal desorption soil remediation, low-temperature vacuum drying of sludge, and catalytic oxidation of high-salt wastewater. Energy-saving technology. Promote the application of technologies such as integrated casting and rolling without head-end rolling, medium and low-temperature waste heat utilization, clean and efficient coal-water slurry gasification, high-calorific value solid waste fuel substitution, microgrid energy storage, indirect condensation evaporation (data centers), and special carbon electrodes for ferroalloy smelting. Water-saving technology. Promote the application of technologies such as water-saving in circulating cooling water through air cooling, membrane desalination of high-salinity water, low-temperature multi-effect seawater desalination with residual energy, advanced catalytic oxidation and deep treatment and reuse of coking wastewater, alkaline condensate water treatment and reuse through evaporative crystallization, and MBR+reverse osmosis for dyeing and printing wastewater reuse. Resource-efficient utilization technology. Promote the application of technologies such as non-incineration cementitious materials from solid waste, green concrete production from solid waste, efficient steam grinding of steel slag, harmless production of environmental protection bricks from red mud, production of high-strength gypsum powder and its products from industrial by-product gypsum, low-value waste plastic pyrolysis, and fine automatic dismantling of retired power batteries. Stimulate the innovation vitality of various market entities. Market-oriented, encourage the research and development of green and low-carbon technologies, implement green technology innovation research actions, cultivate and build a batch of manufacturing innovation centers, industrial innovation centers, engineering research centers, and technology innovation centers in the field of green and low-carbon, and focus on solving key common technology problems across industries and fields. Strengthen the position of enterprises as the main body of innovation, support enterprises in integrating the strength of scientific research institutes, universities, industrial parks, etc., to establish market-oriented operation of green technology innovation consortia. Accelerate the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, support the establishment of green technology innovation project incubators and innovation and entrepreneurship bases. Accelerate the industrialization breakthrough of green and low-carbon technology engineering, give full play to the leading role of large enterprises, and cultivate new green competitive advantages in the manufacturing industry. Support the growth of innovative small and medium-sized enterprises as important sources of innovation.
titlelist: The main tasks are to build a green and low-carbon technology system, promote the rapid large-scale application and iterative upgrading of new technologies, accelerate the deployment of cutting-edge technology research, improve the industrial technology innovation system, and strengthen the support of scientific and technological innovation for the industrial green and low-carbon transformation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: By 2025, the collaborative mechanism for promoting green development in the industry will be basically mature. The green financial standard system that meets the characteristics and needs of the industry will be further improved. The mechanism for green information disclosure by industrial enterprises will be more sound. The collaborative platform for production and finance will be further optimized. The financial products and services supporting the green development of the industry will be more abundant. Various factors and resources will continue to gather in the green and low-carbon fields. Efforts will be made to ensure that industrial enterprises supported by financial focus become benchmarks for carbon emission reduction, effectively supporting the achievement of peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality goals, and ensuring that the industry and finance share the achievements of green development and the people share a beautiful life of harmonious coexistence between industrial civilization and ecological civilization.
titlelist: Overall requirements, overall objectives

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Accelerate the research and development of green core technologies, build an innovation center for green manufacturing in the manufacturing industry, strengthen the research and development of common technologies in the fields of low carbon, energy saving, water conservation, environmental protection, clean production, and comprehensive utilization of resources. Carry out comprehensive demonstrations of carbon reduction, zero carbon, and negative carbon technologies. Support key technological breakthroughs and industrial development in new energy, new materials, new energy vehicles, new energy aircraft, green ships, green agricultural machinery, new energy power, efficient energy storage, carbon capture, utilization and storage, zero carbon industrial process transformation, carbon sequestration in agriculture, forestry, and fisheries, substitution and reduction of hazardous substances, and resource utilization of industrial wastewater. Accelerate the integration and innovation of electronic information technology and clean energy industry, promote breakthroughs in the new energy storage battery industry, and guide the high-quality development of the intelligent photovoltaic industry. Support the research and development innovation of green and low-carbon equipment, instruments and control systems, and improve the level of equipment and intelligent supply in the fields of land greening, ecological restoration, sponge cities, and beautiful rural construction.
titlelist: The key direction of industrial green development is to strengthen the innovation and application of green and low-carbon technologies.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Promote green manufacturing, shared manufacturing, and intelligent manufacturing comprehensively, and support enterprises in creating green factories. Accelerate the green transformation of industries such as steel, petrochemicals, chemicals, non-ferrous metals, building materials, light industry, and textiles. Guide enterprises to increase the use of renewable energy, strengthen demand-side management of electricity, and promote the substitution of fossil fuels with electric power, hydrogen energy, and biomass energy. Encourage enterprises to use unconventional water sources such as seawater, wastewater, and rainwater, carry out water-saving and pollution reduction technology transformations, and create a group of water-saving benchmark enterprises. Encourage enterprises to adopt advanced clean production technologies and efficient end-of-pipe treatment equipment, promote the resource utilization and harmless treatment of water, air, and solid pollutants. Accelerate the coordinated disposal of municipal solid waste in cement kilns and improve the level of coordinated disposal of urban waste in industrial kilns. Carry out comprehensive and intelligent green transformation of enterprises, and build green data centers. Support the construction of energy and water resource management centers to enhance the level of management informatization.
titlelist: Key directions for green development in the industry, accelerate the green transformation and upgrading of industrial enterprises.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Relying on advantages such as national new industrialization industry demonstration bases, we will create a number of green industrial parks and advanced manufacturing clusters, support the construction and sharing of public facilities, optimize energy consumption structure, carry out cascaded utilization of energy, promote resource recycling and centralized safe disposal of pollutants, and encourage the construction of intelligent microgrids. We will promote the integrated optimization of water systems among enterprises in the parks, achieve interconnected water use, differentiated water quality use, multiple uses of water, and cascaded utilization, and build a number of benchmark industrial water-saving parks. We will promote the advanced and applicable process technology and equipment for comprehensive utilization of industrial resources, and build a number of comprehensive utilization bases for industrial resources. We will carry out the construction of demonstration parks for demand-side management of electricity in the industrial sector. We will encourage steel, non-ferrous, building materials, chemical and other enterprises to actively participate in mine restoration, accelerate the revitalization of abandoned mines, industrial sites, and other stranded assets, enrich the cultural, tourism, education, popular science, and innovation functions of the industry, and improve the ecological circular value chain.
titlelist: The key direction of green development in the industry, supporting the green development of industrial parks and advanced manufacturing clusters.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Promote the coordinated development of green industry chains and green supply chains, guide enterprises to build a green supply chain management system supported by data, shared networks, and intelligent collaboration, and improve resource utilization efficiency and the level of greenization of the supply chain. Encourage companies to implement green procurement, develop green manufacturing processes, promote green packaging, carry out green transportation, and properly handle the recycling of waste products. Create a number of green supply chains in key industries such as automobiles, household appliances, and machinery, and develop and promote a green product spectrum that is easy to package, easy to transport, easy to disassemble, easy to reconstruct, and easy to recycle.
titlelist: Key directions for the green development of industry, building a sound green supply chain.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Vigorously develop specialized energy-saving and environmental protection services, including energy measurement, monitoring, diagnosis, evaluation, technological transformation, consulting, as well as integrated services for industrial water conservation and water treatment systems, third-party environmental pollution control, and comprehensive environmental governance. Focus on the production, consumption, turnover, renewal, recycling, and reuse of products in industries such as automobiles, textiles, and household appliances, and vigorously develop recycling and reuse based on the Internet+ and Smart+ concepts, as well as new models of sharing services. Cultivate a group of green manufacturing service providers to provide green product design and manufacturing, integrated and digitally enhanced green improvement in factories, and system solutions for greening other industries.
titlelist: The key direction of industrial green development is to cultivate a green manufacturing service system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Encourage enterprises to carry out green product design based on the concept of the entire life cycle, and expand the effective supply of high-quality green products. Establish incentive and constraint mechanisms for the sale of green and low-carbon products on e-commerce platforms, and expand consumption of new energy vehicles, photovoltaic and solar thermal products, green consumer electronics, and green building materials. Accelerate the development of facility and equipment industries for ice and snow sports, marine leisure, and rural economy. Promote technological breakthroughs in ultra-high-definition video, new display technologies, and expand digital green consumption scenarios. Develop traditional craftsmanship with cultural heritage significance and resource activation benefits, promote biomass products with low environmental impact, low resource consumption, and easy recyclability, and support pilot demonstrations of value realization mechanisms for ecological products such as Miao embroidery and mulberry silk.
titlelist: The key direction of industrial green development is to promote the upgrading of consumption of green and low-carbon products.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Guided by carbon neutrality, we will establish key industry targets and roadmaps for achieving peak carbon emissions, and support industries such as intelligent photovoltaics and new energy vehicles to play a leading role in demonstration. We will encourage the construction of Sino-foreign cooperation green industrial parks in eligible areas, and promote the domestic transformation and implementation of green technological innovations. We will jointly build a green Belt and Road, strengthen the coordinated control of the coal and electricity industries, and promote the optimization and upgrading of industrial capacity. We will establish green comprehensive service platforms and common technology platforms, and promote the internationalization of China's new green technology equipment and standards.
titlelist: Key directions for the green development of industry, promoting international cooperation on green and low-carbon initiatives.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Build an industrial carbon accounting method, algorithm, and database system, promote the application of carbon accounting information in the financial system, and strengthen the integration of carbon accounting and finance. Encourage the use of digital technology to conduct carbon accounting, and take the lead in accounting for key industries undergoing green transformation, green industrial parks, and advanced manufacturing clusters. Standardize and unify green finance standards, improve evaluation and certification standards for green bonds, and establish a sound green finance standard system to support the green development of industries. Promote the integration of domestic and international green finance standards, enhance the mutual connectivity of markets, strengthen the domestic application of international mature experiences, and promote the international dissemination of beneficial domestic experiences, attracting foreign capital to participate in China's industrial green development.
titlelist: The main task is to establish a sound carbon accounting and green finance standard system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Organize the selection of products, technological equipment, solutions, enterprises, projects, and industrial parks that meet the requirements of green development, and establish a guiding catalog and project library for industrial green development. Explore the establishment of an information platform for greenhouse gas emissions of industrial enterprises, and encourage enterprises to proactively disclose relevant information based on mature experiences. Promote mandatory disclosure of environmental information for high-energy-consuming, highly polluting enterprises, and related listed companies, and support credit rating agencies in incorporating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors into corporate credit ratings. Improve the classification of industrial green development in the Green Bond Support Project Catalog to provide support for the construction of industrial enterprise information service platforms and project libraries.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the information sharing mechanism for green industrial development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Take the national production and financing cooperation platform as an important carrier to support the green development of the industry, and establish a special zone for 'industrial green development'. Promote the establishment of a cross-department, multi-dimensional, high-value green data docking mechanism, integrate 'non-financial' data such as enterprise emission information, connect with the unified registration and publicity system for movable property financing, and ensure the security of financing transactions. Explore the construction of a platform ecosystem that is directly connected, algorithmically self-built, model optimized, intelligently connected, and funds directly accessible, promote the accurate connection of financial resources to meet the financing needs of enterprises, and improve the quality and effectiveness of platform services.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the construction of the production and financing cooperation platform.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Utilize various monetary policy tools to guide financial institutions to expand green credit issuance and reasonably reduce the comprehensive financing costs for enterprises. Encourage banking and financial institutions to improve credit management policies, optimize credit approval processes, and guide the allocation of credit resources through adjustments in internal fund transfer pricing, actively develop green credit and energy efficiency credit, promote the green transformation of 'two high' projects, and provide key support for industrial green development projects. Study and orderly expand the scale of green bond issuance, encourage eligible enterprises to issue medium- to long-term green bonds. Support eligible green enterprises in IPO financing and refinancing, and reduce financing costs. Relying on the evaluation of scientific and technological innovation attributes, study and establish a mechanism to cultivate and guide green scientific and technological innovation enterprises, and support 'hard technology' enterprises to list on the science and technology innovation board. Encourage the promotion of the 'Green Investment Principles for the Belt and Road' (GIP), further develop cross-border green investment and financing, and support low-carbon investment under the Belt and Road Initiative.
titlelist: Main task: Increase support for green financing.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Support the cautious and prudent promotion of real estate investment trust funds (REITs) in the infrastructure sector in green and low-carbon parks. Encourage financial institutions to develop financial products for the green transformation of key industries such as steel, petrochemicals, the production and application of green building materials and new energy vehicles, the electrification of old ships, and the promotion of green products. Utilize a package of financial tools such as merger and acquisition loans and asset management to support orderly capacity transfer, relocation of hazardous chemical production enterprises, and the construction of advanced manufacturing clusters. Actively explore the development of specialized government-backed green financing guarantee businesses to promote synergy between investment, credit, and guarantee services. Encourage financial institutions to develop climate-friendly financial products, support the establishment of a carbon futures market by the Guangzhou Futures Exchange, and regulate the development of carbon financial services.
titlelist: The main task is to innovate green financial products and services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Encourage insurance institutions to combine the level of green development and changes in environmental risks of enterprises, scientifically determine insurance rates, and improve the efficiency of insurance claims and service levels.
