Strengthen the innovation of green insurance products and services, encourage enterprises to purchase insurance for environmental technology equipment, green technology insurance, and insurance for quality and safety responsibilities of green low-carbon products. Utilize the compensation mechanism of insurance for the first set of major technological equipment, the first batch of materials, and the first edition of software to accelerate the market application of new products. Encourage the investment of insurance funds in green enterprises and projects.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the level of green insurance services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Strengthen and optimize the existing green industry development funds, encourage national-level funds such as the National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund, the National Manufacturing Industry Transformation and Upgrading Fund, and the National Small and Medium-sized Enterprise Development Fund to increase investment in key areas of industrial green development. Encourage the establishment of industrial green development funds by social capital to promote the rational layout of green industries. Guide angel investments, venture capital, and private equity investment funds to invest in key areas such as green core technology research and development.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the development of green funds.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Encourage financial institutions to accelerate the application of financial technology, conduct green digital profiling and automated assessment of industrial enterprises and projects, and enhance personalized service capabilities. Based on the digital map of the industrial chain and the roadmap for carbon peaking in key industries, innovate and develop supply chain finance, with leading enterprises in the industrial chain with significant green and low-carbon benefits, manufacturing champions, and specialized and innovative small giants as the core, strengthen financial services for upstream and downstream small and micro enterprises. Continuously explore new scenarios and applications of new technologies in the financial field, carry out carbon accounting and carbon footprint certification business, and provide financial solutions based on behavioral data, such as usage-based insurance (UBI).
titlelist: The main task is to leverage financial technology to promote green finance.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the People's Bank of China, the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission will establish a regular consultation mechanism to jointly promote the improvement of supporting policies and measures for industrial green development. Localities should improve their work mechanisms and policy guarantee systems, study and propose implementation plans for their respective regions, and ensure that policy measures are implemented. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology should work together with relevant departments to strengthen overall coordination, summarize and promote innovative practices, and commend and incentivize localities, financial institutions, and enterprises that have achieved significant results.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve work mechanisms.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, together with relevant departments, will improve the information sharing mechanism to facilitate financial institutions in obtaining the Industrial Green Development Guide and project information, helping them accurately grasp the key directions of industrial green development and enhance their service capabilities. Encourage the development of third-party institutions for industrial green and low-carbon research and evaluation, implement comprehensive evaluation of industrial resource utilization, and support financial institutions in better carrying out green financial services. Promote the construction of related professional disciplines and industrial colleges, strengthen the training of interdisciplinary and compound talents, and strengthen the talent guarantee for promoting industrial green development through industry-finance cooperation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen capacity building.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Production-Finance Cooperation to Promote Green Industrial Development (MIIT-Liancai [2021] No. 159) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission/September 3, 2021)
content: Adhere to the concept of considering the big picture, long-term interests, overall situation, and comprehensive accounts, promote the idea of sustainable development in the whole society, and enhance the recognition of industrial green development by localities, enterprises, and the public. Advocate low-carbonism and frugality, shape and guide the new trend of green consumption. Carry out popular science propaganda on green industry, green products, and green finance, create a favorable atmosphere for the development of green finance, and continuously explore new ways to support industrial green development through finance.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, gathering consensus for development

name: 13th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industries (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, former Ministry of Environmental Protection/December 2016)
content: Accelerate the application of renewable energy such as wind energy, solar energy, and biomass energy in agricultural production and rural life, and promote clean heating in rural areas in an orderly manner. Promote the use of electric vehicles for agriculture, energy-saving and environmentally friendly agricultural machinery and fishing boats, develop energy-saving agricultural greenhouses, promote energy-saving renovation of rural houses and the construction of green rural houses. Strengthen the prevention and control of agricultural non-point source pollution, promote the reduction and efficiency improvement of pesticides and fertilizers, comprehensive utilization of straw, and accelerate the recycling and treatment of agricultural film and pesticide packaging waste. Deepen the pollution control of large-scale livestock and poultry farms, and promote the resource utilization of livestock and poultry manure in the whole county. Improve the rural living environment, enhance the capacity for rural sewage and garbage treatment, and basically eliminate large-scale rural black and odorous water bodies. By 2025, the rural sewage treatment rate will reach 40%, the comprehensive utilization rate of straw will stabilize at over 86%, the utilization rates of major crop fertilizers and pesticides will both reach over 43%, the comprehensive utilization rate of livestock and poultry manure will exceed 80%, and the coverage rates of green prevention and control and integrated prevention and control will reach 55% and 45% respectively. The total ammonia emissions from large-scale livestock and poultry farms in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and surrounding areas will be reduced by 5%. (Led by the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the National Energy Administration, and the National Rural Revitalization Bureau, with responsibilities divided among the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Water Resources, and the State Administration for Market Regulation).

name: 13th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industries (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, former Ministry of Environmental Protection/December 2016)
content: Accelerate the energy-saving renovation of existing building envelopes, heating, cooling, lighting, and other facilities and equipment in public institutions, and encourage the adoption of energy management models such as energy cost management contracts. Take the lead in phasing out old vehicles and procuring and using energy-saving and new energy vehicles. New and existing parking lots should be equipped with electric vehicle charging facilities or reserved installation conditions for charging facilities. Implement energy consumption quota management and comprehensively promote the creation of energy-saving government agencies. By 2025, create 2,000 energy-saving public institution demonstration units and select 200 energy efficiency leaders among public institutions. (Responsibilities are divided among the State Administration Bureau, the Central Management Bureau, etc.).
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 13th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industries (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, former Ministry of Environmental Protection/December 2016)
content: Continue to advance the autumn and winter campaign to prevent and control air pollution in key areas, and increase efforts to adjust the structure of key industries and control pollution. Focus on key areas for air pollution prevention and control, such as the Pearl River Delta region and the Chengdu-Chongqing region, and promote the coordinated reduction of volatile organic compounds and nitrogen oxides, as well as strengthen the coordinated control of fine particulate matter and ozone. Continue to fight the battle for the protection and restoration of the Yangtze River, solidly promote urban sewage and garbage treatment, as well as industrial, agricultural, ship, and tailings pond pollution control projects. By 2025, the overall water quality of the Yangtze River Basin should remain excellent, and the water quality of the main stream should reach Class II stability. Focus on the ecological protection and control of the Yellow River, implement deep water-saving and water control actions, strengthen pollution control in important tributaries, and carry out investigations and rectification of sewage outlets into the river. By 2025, the water quality of the upper and middle reaches of the Yellow River (above Huayuankou) should reach Class II. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Ecology and Environment, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and Ministry of Water Resources, with responsibilities divided among the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, National Energy Administration, etc.)
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 13th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industries (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, former Ministry of Environmental Protection/December 2016)
content: Promote the substitution of raw and auxiliary materials and products at the source, and implement comprehensive pollution control measures. Focus on industries such as industrial coating, packaging printing, etc., and promote the use of coatings, inks, adhesives, and cleaning agents with low volatile organic compound content. Deepen the control of volatile organic compound pollution in industries such as petrochemicals, and comprehensively improve the collection rate of exhaust gases, the simultaneous operation rate of control facilities, and the removal rate. Carry out transformation of easily volatile organic liquid storage tanks, promote the use of fully submerged liquid floating roofs and high-efficiency dual-sealing technology for floating roof tanks, and separately collect and treat high-concentration exhaust gases from wastewater systems. Strengthen the recovery and treatment of oil vapors in oil tankers and crude oil and finished oil terminals. By 2025, the proportion of solvent-based industrial coatings and inks will be reduced by 20 percentage points and 10 percentage points respectively, and the usage of solvent-based adhesives will be reduced by 20%. (Responsibilities will be divided among the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, etc.).
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 13th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Industries (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, former Ministry of Environmental Protection/December 2016)
content: Accelerate the construction of an environmental infrastructure system that integrates sewage, garbage, solid waste, hazardous waste, and medical waste treatment and disposal facilities, as well as monitoring and regulatory capabilities. Promote the formation of an environmental infrastructure network that extends from cities to towns and rural areas. Advance the construction and renovation of urban sewage pipe networks, implement mixed and separated pipe network transformations, update and repair old and damaged pipe networks, accelerate the closure of treatment capacity gaps, and promote the utilization of sewage resources and the harmless disposal of sludge. Construct a household waste treatment system that includes separate collection, transportation, and processing. By 2025, add and renovate 80,000 kilometers of sewage collection pipe networks, add 20 million cubic meters per day of sewage treatment capacity, achieve a 90% harmless disposal rate for urban sludge, achieve a daily incineration capacity of around 800,000 tons for urban household waste, and have the incineration capacity for urban household waste account for about 65% of the total capacity. (Responsibilities are divided among the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, etc.)
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: National Environmental Protection Thirteenth Five-Year Plan Outline for Scientific and Technological Development (excerpt) (Environmental Science and Technology [2016] No. 160) (Ministry of Environmental Protection/November 14, 2016)
content: Air pollution monitoring technology. Based on the characteristics and formation mechanism of atmospheric fine particulate matter, the development of multi-parameter and portable online analysis systems for atmospheric fine particulate matter, to achieve integrated rapid measurement of mass concentration, particle size distribution, and chemical composition of atmospheric fine particulate matter. Develop three-dimensional distribution monitoring technology for gaseous precursors of atmospheric fine particulate matter, form a complete set of precursor distribution monitoring technology and equipment, and develop sampling and monitoring technology and equipment for low-concentration gaseous pollutants and particles in flue gas. For the monitoring and prediction of pollutants such as heavy metals and volatile organic compounds in gases, develop new types of heavy metal online monitoring instruments and supporting equipment suitable for air and waste gas, with the ability to synchronize monitor multiple elements, high sensitivity, and stable performance. Develop new devices for industrial waste gas sample collection and pretreatment, online monitoring equipment for volatile organic compounds in the atmosphere, odor gas pretreatment technology and online monitoring equipment, and multi-component gas online and portable analyzers. Comprehensive control technology for fixed source air pollution. In response to the urgent need to reduce emissions from fixed sources, develop advanced and efficient technologies and equipment for joint control of multiple pollutants in flue gas, resource recovery-oriented pollution control, and new types of air pollution control. Breakthroughs in core technologies and key equipment for the coordinated control of multiple pollutants, the recovery and high-value utilization of pollutants, and the control of unconventional pollutants, focusing on fine particulate matter, sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, heavy metals, dioxins, volatile organic compounds, odor, carbon dioxide emissions, and agricultural ammonia emissions in key industries such as steel, thermal power, industrial boilers, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, chemicals, surface coating, and building materials. Develop key technologies and equipment for monitoring and controlling different types of dust pollution in response to severe wind and construction dust pollution in China. Develop key technologies and equipment for monitoring and controlling cooking fume pollution in the catering service industry in China. Comprehensive control technology for mobile source air pollution. In response to stricter requirements for mobile source emission control, develop key technologies and new materials for controlling evaporative emissions of volatile organic compounds, electronic control software and hardware for onboard diagnostic systems, precision fuel injection control technology, various emission control sensor technologies, and key technologies and equipment for mobile source environmental regulation and compliance. Breakthroughs in advanced diesel vehicle exhaust aftertreatment technologies suitable for diesel quality in China, such as particulate matter capture technology and selective catalytic reduction, as well as exhaust aftertreatment technologies suitable for gasoline quality in China, such as efficient gasoline vehicle particulate filters. Develop mobile source emission monitoring technologies for conventional pollutants, non-CO2 greenhouse gases, and key precursor compounds, as well as unconventional pollutant identification and monitoring technologies. Establish a series of integrated control key technologies for mobile sources from oil inspection to emission control.
titlelist: Strengthen key technology innovation research and development, support environmental protection and efficient governance, key technologies for atmospheric environment monitoring and comprehensive prevention and control of atmospheric compound pollution.

name: National Environmental Protection Thirteenth Five-Year Plan Outline for Scientific and Technological Development (excerpt) (Environmental Science and Technology [2016] No. 160) (Ministry of Environmental Protection/November 14, 2016)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Soil and groundwater pollution monitoring technology. In response to soil and groundwater pollution issues, we have developed high-precision, multi-functional sample collection and specialized monitoring instruments for soil and groundwater pollution. We have also established soil and groundwater environmental monitoring methods based on sensors, remote sensing technology, and biomarkers, and strengthened the application of satellite remote sensing technology. We have developed miniaturized on-site monitoring equipment for heavy metals in soil. We have conducted research on long-term monitoring methods after the remediation of contaminated sites. We have also developed technologies for the restoration and risk control of agricultural land and mining area soil and groundwater. In response to the significant demand for the restoration and risk control of agricultural land and mining area soil and groundwater, we have made breakthroughs in risk control, safe utilization, and restoration technologies for mildly polluted agricultural land soil environments, as well as comprehensive treatment and restoration technologies for heavily polluted agricultural land soil that are green, sustainable, energy-efficient, and low-consumption. We have developed integrated green restoration technologies for the reclamation, prevention and control, and pollution restoration of typical mining area soil pollution. We have also developed comprehensive utilization and bioremediation technologies for oilfield-contaminated soils of different pollution levels, as well as restoration technologies for the storage and utilization of mine dewatering water underground, and conducted engineering demonstrations. We have developed key technologies and equipment for the prevention and control of soil and groundwater pollution in shale gas development. We have developed soil remediation technologies for contaminated sites. In response to heavy metal and volatile/semi-volatile organic compound pollution in heavily polluted industries such as non-ferrous metal smelting, petroleum processing, chemical industry, coking, electroplating, and leather, we have developed key and common restoration technologies for soils with different pollution levels and complex pollution, and conducted engineering demonstrations of comprehensive treatment process combinations. We have developed restoration technologies and equipment for the resource utilization, enhanced degradation, and desorption purification of contaminated soils, as well as secondary pollution prevention and control technologies and equipment during the soil remediation process. We have developed green and environmentally friendly restoration materials and technologies, including slow-release oxidation/reduction materials, efficient solidification/stabilization materials, capacity/infiltration enhancement and bioremediation strengthening materials, as well as emergency rapid soil remediation technologies. We have conducted research on the environmental footprint assessment of the entire restoration process and the evaluation system for contaminated site restoration. Groundwater remediation technology for contaminated sites. In response to the technical requirements for the remediation of high-risk groundwater pollution in contaminated sites, we have made breakthroughs in multi-layer extraction, in-situ directional infusion, and composite efficient purification technologies for high-risk heavy metals and organic pollutants in groundwater. We have developed movable and modular soil and groundwater remediation equipment. We have also developed environmentally functional materials such as green and efficient nanomaterials and transformative biomaterials for the treatment of groundwater pollution. We have researched pollution source control technology, pollution pathway blocking technology, surface water and groundwater collaborative control technology for groundwater source pollution, as well as emergency remediation technology and equipment for groundwater pollution, to achieve engineering of restoration technology and standardization of equipment and materials.
titlelist: Strengthen key technology innovation research and development, support environmental protection and efficient governance, key technologies for soil and groundwater environmental protection and restoration.

name: National Environmental Protection Thirteenth Five-Year Plan Outline for Scientific and Technological Development (excerpt) (Environmental Science and Technology [2016] No. 160) (Ministry of Environmental Protection/November 14, 2016)
content: Ecological system monitoring technology. In response to issues such as the imperfect ecological monitoring technology, establish a comprehensive monitoring and evaluation method, standards, and norms for national ecological systems and biodiversity. Develop integrated ecological system and biodiversity monitoring technology and alien species monitoring technology, and construct a comprehensive monitoring system for atmospheric, hydrological, soil, and biogeosphere ecological environments. Develop data collectors and wireless sensors based on ecological elements and ecosystem service functions, and construct an ecological security monitoring support platform. Ecological system protection and restoration technology. In response to the major demand for constructing an ecological system protection and restoration technology system that is in line with China's national conditions, focus on breakthroughs in key common technologies such as biodiversity restoration in ecologically vulnerable areas, comprehensive regulation and restoration of priority areas for biodiversity protection, protection and restoration of key habitats in nature reserves, and construction of ecological corridors. Breakthroughs should be made in key technologies for improving regional ecological carrying capacity, and key regional demonstrations should be conducted. Develop and integrate natural and artificial assisted restoration and reconstruction of different degraded ecosystem types and disaster sites, optimize the allocation of species in communities, and key common technologies such as ecological system structure adjustment, service enhancement, and adaptive management.
titlelist: Strengthen key technology innovation research and development, support environmental protection and efficient governance, key technologies for ecosystem monitoring, protection, and restoration.

name: National Environmental Protection Thirteenth Five-Year Plan Outline for Scientific and Technological Development (excerpt) (Environmental Science and Technology [2016] No. 160) (Ministry of Environmental Protection/November 14, 2016)
content: Remote sensing monitoring and early warning technology for water and atmospheric environment. In response to the need for timely monitoring of water and atmospheric environmental quality, research is conducted on identification and extraction techniques for water pollution based on hyperspectral imaging. Automation technology and equipment for ecological monitoring of dam projects are developed, and remote sensing monitoring and early warning technology for urban black and odorous water bodies, water ecology in river basins, non-point source pollution, and water safety in drinking water sources are studied. Quantitative remote sensing inversion technology for atmospheric aerosols and trace gases based on hyperspectral imaging is developed, and research is conducted on remote sensing monitoring and early warning technology for regional haze, pollution gases, greenhouse gases, and other atmospheric environmental factors. Integrated monitoring technology for environmental emergency and risk management. In response to the technological needs of environmental emergency and risk monitoring, breakthroughs are made in new red tide monitoring and early warning technology, and research is conducted on remote sensing application technology for environmental regulation, such as emergency response to natural disasters and sudden environmental events, environmental impact assessment of construction projects, and environmental assessment of planning. Data preprocessing and environmental index inversion technology for multi-source data collaboration are developed, and unmanned aerial vehicle environmental regulation and sky-ground collaborative environmental monitoring are carried out. Key technology research for early warning. Development of environmental risk source management technology and equipment for enterprise environmental risk sources, integrating Internet of Things, Internet, big data, cloud computing, and mobile terminals for connection management between government departments, enterprises, and the public.
titlelist: Strengthen key technology innovation research and development, support environmental protection and efficient governance, and integrate environmental monitoring and early warning technology.

name: National Environmental Protection Thirteenth Five-Year Plan Outline for Scientific and Technological Development (excerpt) (Environmental Science and Technology [2016] No. 160) (Ministry of Environmental Protection/November 14, 2016)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Monitoring technology for noise pollution sources. In response to the difficulties in identifying and continuously monitoring noise pollution sources, as well as the challenges in data quality control due to the non-reproducibility of noise, an integrated handheld monitoring device for noise monitoring has been developed. Through research on the time-domain and frequency-domain information of noise pollution sources and algorithm optimization, key technologies for automatic identification of noise pollution sources have been breakthrough, and continuous online monitoring devices capable of automatically identifying target noise sources, background noise, and other noise sources have been developed. Technology for the prevention and control of noise pollution sources. Further research on noise source control technologies, especially for important noise sources and vibration pollution sources, including sound source tracking and positioning technologies for complex noise sources, noise reduction technologies for low-frequency noise propagated through air and structures, etc. Continued development of new sound-absorbing, sound-insulating materials, as well as low-noise road surfaces and vehicles.
titlelist: Strengthen key technology innovation research and development, support environmental protection and efficient governance, identification of noise pollution sources, prevention and control technology and equipment.

name: New Action Plan for Pollution Control (excerpt) (State Council Document [2022] No. 15) (State Council General Office/ May 4, 2022)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strengthen the technological research and development of new pollution control methods in the national science and technology plan, conduct key research on the assessment and control of toxic and hazardous chemicals in the environment; enhance research on new theories and technologies related to new pollutants, and improve innovation capabilities; strengthen research on the ecological and environmental hazards of antibiotics, microplastics, etc. Integrate existing resources, reorganize the national key laboratories in the field of environment, and carry out research on new pollutants.
titlelist: Take action, strengthen capacity building, consolidate the foundation of new pollutant control, and increase the support of science and technology.

name: New Action Plan for Pollution Control (excerpt) (State Council Document [2022] No. 15) (State Council General Office/ May 4, 2022)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage social capital to enter the field of new pollutant treatment, and guide financial institutions to increase their credit support for new pollutant treatment. New pollutant treatment is eligible for tax incentives according to regulations.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, broaden channels for capital investment.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Ban the Ten Small enterprises. Conduct a comprehensive investigation of small industrial enterprises with low equipment levels and poor environmental facilities. By the end of 2016, in accordance with the requirements of water pollution prevention and control laws and regulations, all small-scale production projects that seriously pollute the water environment, such as small-scale papermaking, tanning, printing and dyeing, dyes, coking, sulfur refining, arsenic refining, oil refining, electroplating, and pesticides, which do not comply with national industrial policies, should be banned. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Land and Resources, the National Energy Administration, and local people's governments responsible for implementation. The implementation is the responsibility of local people's governments at all levels and is not listed below). Special rectification of the top ten key industries. Develop special governance plans for industries such as papermaking, coking, nitrogen fertilizer, non-ferrous metals, printing and dyeing, agricultural and sideline food processing, raw material medicine manufacturing, tanning, pesticides, and electroplating, and implement clean transformation. For newly built, rebuilt, and expanded projects in the above industries, the emission of major pollutants should be exchanged with an equivalent or reduced amount. By the end of 2017, the papermaking industry strives to complete the transformation of chlorine-free bleaching of pulp or adopt other low-pollution pulping technologies. Steel companies complete the transformation of dry quenching technology in coke ovens. The nitrogen fertilizer industry completes the technological transformation of urea production through hydrolysis and analysis of process condensate. The printing and dyeing industry implements low-discharge dyeing and finishing process transformation. The pharmaceutical industry (antibiotics, vitamins) implements green enzymatic production technology transformation. The tanning industry implements chromium reduction and closed-loop recycling technology transformation. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, etc.). Concentrated treatment of industrial agglomeration area water pollution. Strengthen the pollution control of industrial agglomeration areas such as economic and technological development zones, high-tech industrial development zones, and export processing zones. Industrial wastewater in the agglomeration area must undergo pretreatment to meet the requirements of centralized treatment before entering the sewage treatment facilities. For newly built or upgraded industrial agglomeration areas, pollution control facilities such as centralized sewage and garbage treatment should be planned and constructed simultaneously. By the end of 2017, sewage treatment facilities should be built in industrial agglomeration areas according to regulations, and automatic online monitoring devices should be installed. The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other regions should complete this one year in advance. Those who fail to complete it on time will have their approval and approval of construction projects that increase water pollutant emissions suspended, and their park qualifications will be revoked in accordance with relevant regulations. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Commerce, etc.).
titlelist: Comprehensively control pollutant emissions, and vigorously tackle industrial pollution prevention and control.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Prevention and control of pollution from livestock and poultry farming. Scientifically delineate prohibited areas for livestock and poultry farming. By the end of 2017, livestock and poultry farms (communities) and professional households within the prohibited areas should be closed or relocated in accordance with the law. The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other regions should complete this one year ahead of schedule. Existing large-scale livestock and poultry farms (communities) should construct supporting facilities for the storage, treatment, and utilization of manure and wastewater according to pollution prevention and control needs. In areas with intensive free-range farming, separate collection and centralized treatment and utilization of livestock and poultry manure and wastewater should be implemented. Starting from 2016, newly built, renovated, and expanded large-scale livestock and poultry farms (communities) should implement rainwater and sewage separation and resource utilization of manure and wastewater. (Led by the Ministry of Agriculture, with participation from the Ministry of Environmental Protection).Control agricultural non-point source pollution. Develop and implement a comprehensive plan for the prevention and control of agricultural non-point source pollution nationwide. Promote the pilot experience of using low-toxicity and low-residue pesticides and carry out green prevention and control of crop diseases and pests. Implement soil testing and formula fertilization, promote precision fertilization technology and machinery. Improve standards and specifications for high-standard farmland construction, land development and consolidation, and clarify environmental protection requirements. Newly built high-standard farmland should meet relevant environmental protection requirements. In sensitive areas and large and medium-sized irrigation areas, existing ditches, ponds, and wells should be used to configure aquatic plant communities, grids, and permeable dams, and facilities such as ecological ditches, sewage purification ponds, and surface runoff storage ponds should be constructed to purify farmland drainage and surface runoff. By 2020, the coverage rate of soil testing and formula fertilization technology should reach over 90%, the utilization rate of chemical fertilizers should be increased to over 40%, and the coverage rate of integrated prevention and control of crop diseases and pests should reach over 40%. The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other regions should complete this one year ahead of schedule. (Led by the Ministry of Agriculture, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Water Resources, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, etc.).Adjust the structure and layout of planting industry. Implement land reduction and water reduction in water-deficient areas. Priority should be given to planting crops with low fertilizer and pesticide requirements and outstanding environmental benefits in areas where groundwater is easily polluted. In provinces (regions) such as Gansu, Xinjiang (including the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps), Hebei, Shandong, and Henan, where surface water overexploitation and groundwater over-extraction are serious and agricultural water use accounts for a large proportion, the planting area of water-intensive crops should be appropriately reduced and drought-resistant crops and economic forests should be planted instead. By the end of 2018, comprehensive management should be implemented for an irrigation area of 33 million mu, reducing water volume by more than 3.7 billion cubic meters. (Led by the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Water Resources, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Land and Resources, etc.).Accelerate comprehensive rural environmental improvement. Based on the county-level administrative regions, implement unified planning, construction, and management of rural sewage treatment. In areas with conditions, actively extend urban sewage treatment facilities and services to rural areas. Deepen the reward for treatment policy, implement rural clean-up projects, carry out river dredging, and promote comprehensive rural environmental improvement. By 2020, 130,000 administrative villages should complete comprehensive environmental improvement. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture, etc.).
titlelist: Comprehensively control pollutant emissions and promote pollution prevention and control in agriculture and rural areas.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Eliminate outdated production capacity in accordance with the law. Since 2015, localities should formulate and implement annual plans for the elimination of outdated production capacity based on the Catalogue for the Elimination of Outdated Production Processes, Equipment, and Products in certain industrial sectors, the Guiding Catalogue for Industrial Structure Adjustment, and relevant industry pollutant emission standards. These plans should be developed in conjunction with water quality improvement requirements and industrial development situations, and submitted to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Environmental Protection for record. Areas that fail to complete the elimination tasks should suspend the approval and approval of new projects in related industries. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with the participation of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Environmental Protection, etc.). Strict environmental access. Based on the water quality targets of river basins and the requirements of the main functional zones, regional environmental access conditions should be clarified, functional zoning should be refined, and differentiated environmental access policies should be implemented. Establish a monitoring and evaluation system for water resources and water environment carrying capacity, implement carrying capacity monitoring and early warning, and implement water pollutant reduction plans in areas that have exceeded their carrying capacity, accelerating the adjustment of development plans and industrial structure. By 2020, complete the current status evaluation of water resources and water environment carrying capacity at the city and county levels. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with the participation of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Water Resources, the State Oceanic Administration, etc.).
titlelist: Promote the transformation and upgrading of the economic structure, and adjust the industrial structure.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strengthen industrial water recycling. Promote comprehensive utilization of mine water, prioritize the use of mine water for supplementary water in coal mining areas, production and ecological water in surrounding areas, and strengthen the recycling of coal washing wastewater. Encourage deep treatment and reuse of wastewater from water-intensive industries such as steel, textile printing and dyeing, papermaking, petroleum and petrochemical, chemical, and leather. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with participation from the Ministry of Water Resources, the National Energy Administration, etc.). Promote the use of recycled water. Focus on cities in water-scarce and heavily polluted areas, improve recycled water utilization facilities, and prioritize the use of recycled water for industrial production, urban greening, road cleaning, vehicle washing, construction, and ecological landscapes. Promote sewage treatment and utilization in highway service areas. Steel, thermal power, chemical, pulp and paper, printing and dyeing projects that have the conditions for using recycled water but are not fully utilized shall not be granted new water extraction permits. Starting from 2018, newly built public buildings with a single building area exceeding 20,000 square meters, concentrated affordable housing newly built in Beijing with an area exceeding 20,000 square meters, Tianjin with an area exceeding 50,000 square meters, and Hebei Province with an area exceeding 100,000 square meters, should install building water reuse facilities. Actively promote the installation of building water reuse facilities in other newly built houses. By 2020, the water reuse rate in water-scarce cities should exceed 20%, and in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, it should exceed 30%. (Led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Environmental Protection, the Ministry of Transport, the Ministry of Water Resources, etc.). Promote seawater utilization. In coastal areas, promote the direct use of seawater as industrial water for circulation cooling in industries such as electricity, chemical, and petrochemical. In cities with conditions, accelerate the use of desalinated seawater as a supplementary water source for domestic use. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission, with participation from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Water Resources, the State Oceanic Administration, etc.).
titlelist: Promote the transformation and upgrading of the economic structure, and advance sustainable development.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Establish a water consumption efficiency evaluation system, including the water consumption index of 10,000 yuan of domestic gross domestic product (GDP), and incorporate the completion of water-saving targets into the performance assessment of local governments. Include unconventional water sources such as reclaimed water, rainwater, and slightly saline water in the unified allocation of water resources. By 2020, the water consumption per 10,000 yuan of national GDP and the water consumption per 10,000 yuan of industrial value-added should decrease by more than 35% and 30% respectively compared to 2013 (led by the Ministry of Water Resources, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, etc.). Focus on industrial water conservation. Develop a national catalog of water-saving technologies, processes, products, and equipment to encourage and eliminate water use. Improve water consumption quotas for water-intensive industries. Conduct water-saving diagnosis, water balance testing, and water efficiency evaluation, and strictly manage water consumption quotas. By 2020, water-intensive industries such as electricity, steel, textiles, papermaking, petroleum and petrochemicals, chemicals, and food fermentation should meet advanced quota standards (led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Water Resources, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, General Administration of Quality Supervision, etc.). Strengthen urban water conservation. Prohibit the production and sale of products and equipment that do not meet water-saving standards. Public buildings must use water-saving appliances, and water taps and toilet tanks that do not meet water-saving standards must be phased out within a certain period. Encourage residents to use water-saving appliances. Update and renovate water supply pipes that have been in use for more than 50 years and have outdated materials. By 2017, the national public water supply network leakage rate should be controlled within 12%; by 2020, it should be controlled within 10%. Actively promote low-impact development and construction models and build rainwater collection and utilization facilities that combine retention, infiltration, storage, use, and discharge. Newly built urban areas should have a permeable area of over 40%. By 2020, all water-deficient cities at the prefecture level and above should meet the requirements of national water-saving cities. The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, the Pearl River Delta, and other regions should complete this one year ahead of schedule (led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Water Resources, General Administration of Quality Supervision, etc.). Develop agricultural water conservation. Promote water-saving irrigation technologies such as canal seepage prevention, pipeline water delivery, sprinkler irrigation, and micro-irrigation, and improve irrigation water metering facilities. In regions such as Northeast China, Northwest China, and the Huang-Huai-Hai region, promote large-scale and efficient water-saving irrigation and popularize water-saving and drought-resistant agricultural technologies. By 2020, the construction and renovation tasks of large-scale irrigation areas and key medium-sized irrigation areas should be basically completed, and the area of water-saving irrigation projects nationwide should reach about 700 million mu, with an irrigation water use efficiency coefficient of above 0.55 (led by the Ministry of Water Resources and the Ministry of Agriculture, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, etc.).
titlelist: Focus on conserving and protecting water resources, and improving water use efficiency.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Improve the assessment and evaluation system for water resources protection. Strengthen the supervision and management of water functional zones, strictly determine the pollution capacity of water areas. (Led by the Ministry of Water Resources, with the participation of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Environmental Protection, etc.). Strengthen the management of water volume scheduling for rivers and lakes. Improve water volume scheduling plans. Take measures such as joint scheduling of gates and dams, ecological water replenishment, etc., to reasonably arrange the discharge volume and discharge period of gates and dams, maintain the basic ecological water demand of rivers and lakes, and focus on guaranteeing ecological base flow during the dry season. Increase the construction of water conservancy projects and give full play to the role of control water conservancy projects in improving water quality. (Led by the Ministry of Water Resources, with the participation of the Ministry of Environmental Protection). Scientifically determine ecological flow. Conduct pilot projects in the Yellow River, Huai River, and other river basins to determine ecological flow (water level) in stages, as an important reference for basin water volume scheduling. (Led by the Ministry of Water Resources, with the participation of the Ministry of Environmental Protection).
titlelist: Focus on conserving and protecting water resources, scientifically protecting water resources.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Integrate technological resources, accelerate the development of key industries such as deep treatment of industrial wastewater, low-cost and high-standard treatment of domestic sewage, seawater desalination, desalination of industrial high-salt wastewater, treatment of trace toxic pollutants in drinking water, remediation of groundwater pollution, emergency response to hazardous chemical accidents and water oil spills, etc., through relevant national science and technology plans (special projects, funds), etc. Conduct research on water environment benchmarks such as organic matter and heavy metals, the impact of water pollution on human health, risk assessment of new pollutants, assessment of water environment damage, and high-quality recycled water as a source of drinking water. Strengthen international exchanges and cooperation in the fields of water ecology protection, prevention and control of agricultural non-point source pollution, water environment monitoring and early warning, and water treatment technology and equipment. (Led by the Ministry of Science and Technology, with the participation of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Land and Resources, the Ministry of Environmental Protection, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Water Resources, the Ministry of Agriculture, the National Health and Family Planning Commission, etc.)
titlelist: Strengthen technological support, focus on research and development of cutting-edge technology.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Standardize the environmental protection industry market. Conduct a comprehensive review of laws, regulations, and provisions related to the access and operation of the environmental protection market, and abolish regulations and practices that hinder the formation of a unified national environmental protection market and fair competition. Improve the bidding and tendering management methods and technical standards in the fields of environmental protection engineering design, construction, and operation. Promote the industrialization of advanced and applicable water-saving, pollution control, remediation technologies, and equipment. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission, with participation from the Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, State Oceanic Administration, etc.). Accelerate the development of the environmental protection service industry. Clarify the responsibilities and obligations of regulatory departments, polluting enterprises, and environmental protection service companies, and improve mechanisms for risk sharing and performance guarantee. Encourage the development of environmental protection service general contracting models, government and social capital cooperation models, including system design, complete equipment, engineering construction, commissioning and operation, and maintenance management. Focus on sewage, waste treatment, and industrial parks, and promote third-party governance of environmental pollution. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Finance, with participation from the Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, etc.).
titlelist: Strengthen technological support and vigorously develop the environmental protection industry.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Accelerate water price reform. County-level and above cities should fully implement a residential tiered water pricing system by the end of 2015, and eligible administrative towns should also actively promote it. By the end of 2020, a progressive pricing system for non-residential water use exceeding quotas and plans should be fully implemented. Promote comprehensive reform of agricultural water prices. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission, with the participation of the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture, etc.). Improve the charging policies. Revise the methods for collecting urban sewage treatment fees, pollutant discharge fees, and water resource fees, and reasonably increase the collection standards to ensure full collection. The charging standard for urban sewage treatment fees should not be lower than the cost of sewage and sludge treatment and disposal. The collection standard for groundwater resource fees should be higher than that for surface water, and the collection standard for overexploited areas should be higher than that for non-overexploited areas. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Finance, with the participation of the Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, etc.). Improve tax policies. Implement tax preferential policies for environmental protection, energy conservation, water conservation, and comprehensive utilization of resources in accordance with the law. Large-scale environmental protection equipment that domestic enterprises import for national development support, as well as key components and raw materials that are necessary for import, should be exempt from import duties. Accelerate the legislation of environmental protection taxes and the reform of resource taxes and fees. Consider including some high-energy-consuming and highly polluting products in the scope of consumption tax. (Led by the Ministry of Finance and the State Taxation Administration, with the participation of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, General Administration of Customs, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, etc.).
titlelist: Give full play to the role of market mechanisms and streamline prices and taxes.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Establish a sound system for leading in water conservation and environmental protection. Encourage advanced enterprises in energy conservation and emission reduction, industrial clusters, and other areas to achieve higher standards in water efficiency and pollutant discharge intensity. Support the development of clean production, water conservation, and pollution control demonstrations. (Led by the National Development and Reform Commission, with participation from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, etc.). Implement green credit. Actively leverage the role of policy banks and other financial institutions in water environmental protection, with a focus on supporting circular economy, sewage treatment, water resource conservation, water ecological environment protection, clean and renewable energy utilization, and other areas. Strictly limit loans to environmentally non-compliant enterprises. Strengthen the construction of the environmental credit system, establish mechanisms for rewarding trustworthiness and punishing untrustworthiness, and enhance cooperation and coordination among environmental protection, banking, securities, insurance, and other sectors. By the end of 2017, establish a graded enterprise environmental credit evaluation system. Encourage high-risk industries such as heavy metals, petrochemicals, and hazardous chemical transportation to purchase environmental pollution liability insurance. (Led by the People's Bank of China, with participation from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Water Resources, China Banking Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission, China Insurance Regulatory Commission, etc.). Implement cross-border water environmental compensation. Explore the use of horizontal funding subsidies, paired assistance, industrial transfer, and other methods. Establish a mechanism for cross-border water environmental compensation and carry out compensation pilot projects. Deepen the pilot projects for paid use and trading of pollutant discharge rights. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Water Resources, etc.).
titlelist: Give full play to the role of market mechanisms and establish incentive mechanisms.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Improve laws and regulations. Accelerate the revision of laws and regulations on water pollution prevention and control, marine environmental protection, pollutant discharge permits, and chemical environmental management. Research and formulate laws and regulations on environmental quality target management, environmental functional zoning, water conservation and recycling, drinking water source protection, pollution liability insurance, supervision and management of water functional zones, groundwater management, environmental monitoring, ecological flow guarantee, and prevention and control of ship and land-based pollution. Local areas can study and draft local regulations on water pollution prevention and control based on their actual conditions. (Led by the Legislative Affairs Office, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture, National Health and Family Planning Commission, China Insurance Regulatory Commission, State Oceanic Administration, etc.). Improve the standard system. Revise standards for groundwater, surface water, and marine environmental quality, as well as emission standards for urban sewage treatment, sludge treatment and disposal, agricultural drainage, and other pollutants. Establish special emission limits for key industries' water pollutants, policies on pollution prevention and control technologies, and indicators for clean production evaluation. Local areas can establish water pollutant emission standards stricter than national standards. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, etc.).
titlelist: Strict environmental law enforcement and supervision, improve regulations and standards.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Clearly define the water quality protection objectives for various types of water bodies and conduct a comprehensive inspection of compliance. For areas that do not meet the water quality requirements, a compliance plan should be developed to implement pollution control measures for each wastewater discharge unit within the watershed. The plan should specify prevention and control measures as well as the deadline for compliance, and it should be submitted to the higher-level people's government for record-keeping. Starting from 2016, regular public announcements should be made. For areas where water quality does not meet the standards, targeted supervision and necessary measures such as regional restrictions on approvals should be implemented (led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection with the participation of the Ministry of Water Resources).
titlelist: Strengthen water environmental management effectively and enhance the management of environmental quality goals.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Issue pollution discharge permits in accordance with the law. By the end of 2015, complete the issuance of pollution discharge permits for key national-controlled pollution sources and pilot areas for the compensated use and trading of pollution rights. Other pollution sources should be completed by the end of 2017. (Responsibility of the Ministry of Environmental Protection). Strengthen permit management. With the goal of improving water quality and preventing environmental risks, include the types, concentrations, total amounts, and discharge destinations of pollutants in the scope of permit management. Prohibit unauthorized discharge of pollutants or discharge that does not comply with permit regulations. Strengthen supervision of marine pollution and study the establishment of a system for marine pollution discharge permits. By the end of 2017, complete the construction of a national platform for pollution discharge permit management information. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the Oceanic Administration).
titlelist: Strengthen water environmental management in a practical manner and comprehensively implement pollutant discharge permits.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: From the water source to the tap, the entire process is regulated to ensure the safety of drinking water. Local governments at all levels and water supply units should regularly monitor, test, and evaluate the drinking water safety status of water sources, water treatment plants, and tap water quality within their administrative areas. Starting from 2016, cities at the prefecture level and above should publicly disclose this information on a quarterly basis. Starting from 2018, all cities at the county level and above should also publicly disclose their drinking water safety status information. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, National Health and Family Planning Commission, etc.). Strengthen the protection of drinking water sources. Carry out standardized construction of drinking water sources, and legally clean up illegal buildings and sewage outlets within drinking water source protection areas. Cities at the prefecture level and above that rely on a single water source for water supply should basically complete the construction of backup water sources or emergency water sources by the end of 2020, with eligible areas able to do so earlier. Strengthen the protection and water quality testing of rural drinking water sources. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, National Health and Family Planning Commission, etc.). Prevent and control groundwater pollution. Regularly investigate and evaluate the environmental conditions of centralized groundwater-based drinking water source recharge areas and other regions. Petrochemical production, storage, and sales enterprises, industrial parks, mining areas, and landfill sites should undergo necessary anti-seepage treatment. Underground oil tanks at gas stations should be replaced with double-layer tanks or equipped with anti-seepage pits by the end of 2017. Abandoned mines, wells, and water intake wells should be sealed and backfilled. Publish a list of underground water pollution sites in regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei that pose significant environmental risks and seriously affect public health, and carry out pilot projects for restoration. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Commerce, etc.).
titlelist: Make every effort to ensure the safety of the aquatic ecological environment and guarantee the safety of drinking water sources.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Compile and implement plans for the prevention and control of water pollution in seven key river basins. Study and establish a management system for functional zoning of water ecology in river basins. Take targeted measures to control pollutants such as chemical oxygen demand, ammonia nitrogen, total phosphorus, heavy metals, and other pollutants that affect human health, and increase efforts to rectify the situation. Rivers flowing into eutrophic lakes and reservoirs should implement total nitrogen discharge control. By 2020, the overall water quality of the Yangtze River and Pearl River should reach a good level, while the Songhua River, Yellow River, Huai River, and Liao River should further improve from mild pollution levels. The pollution level of the Hai River should be alleviated. The water quality in the Three Gorges Reservoir area should be maintained at a good level, and water diversion projects such as the South-to-North Water Diversion and the Luan River Diversion to Tianjin should ensure water quality safety. The eutrophication levels of Taihu Lake, Chaohu Lake, and Dianchi Lake should improve. The pollution levels of Baiyangdian, Wuliangsuhai, Hulun Lake, Aibi Lake, and other lakes should be reduced. In areas with small environmental capacity and fragile ecological environment and high environmental risks, special emission limits for water pollutants should be implemented. Local governments can expand the scope of implementation of special emission limits according to the needs of water environmental quality improvement. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with the participation of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, etc.). Strengthen the protection of good water bodies. Conduct ecological and environmental safety assessments and develop and implement ecological environmental protection plans for rivers and lakes whose water quality at the source and current state meets or exceeds Class III standards. This should be completed by the end of 2017 for the Dongjiang River, Luan River, Qiandao Lake, Nansihu Lake, and other river basins. Maintain stable water quality in rivers in Zhejiang and Fujian provinces, as well as in rivers in Southwest and Northwest China, and in transboundary water bodies. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with the participation of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Water Resources, State Forestry Administration, etc.).
titlelist: Make every effort to ensure the safety of the aquatic ecological environment and deepen the prevention and control of pollution in key river basins.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Implement pollution prevention and control measures in coastal areas. Focus on addressing pollution in the mouths of the Yellow River, Yangtze River, Minjiang River, Pearl River, Liaodong Bay, Bohai Bay, Jiaozhou Bay, Hangzhou Bay, Beibu Gulf, and other estuaries and bays. Implement total nitrogen emission control in coastal cities at the prefecture level and above. Study and establish a total pollution control system for key marine areas. Regulate the setting of marine outfall points and fully clean up illegal or improperly set outfall points into the sea by the end of 2017. By 2020, coastal provinces (regions, cities) should eliminate water bodies that are worse than Class V in rivers flowing into the sea. Raise the threshold for access to marine-related projects. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection and the State Oceanic Administration, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture, etc.). Promote healthy aquaculture. Designate restricted aquaculture areas in key rivers, lakes, and nearshore waters. Implement standardized transformation of aquaculture ponds and nearshore aquaculture net cages, and encourage eligible fishing enterprises to engage in offshore and intensive aquaculture. Actively promote the use of artificial compound feed and gradually reduce the use of fresh fish and miscellaneous fish feed. Strengthen the management of inputs for aquaculture, regulate the use of antibiotics and other chemical drugs in accordance with the law, and carry out special rectification. By 2015, the area of marine aquaculture should be controlled at around 2.2 million hectares. (Led by the Ministry of Agriculture). Strictly control the pollution of environmental hormone-like chemicals. By the end of 2017, complete an investigation into the production and use of environmental hormone-like chemicals, monitor and assess the risks in water source areas, agricultural product planting areas, and concentrated aquaculture areas, and implement measures such as elimination, restriction, and substitution of environmental hormone-like chemicals. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with participation from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Agriculture, etc.).
titlelist: Make every effort to ensure the safety of the aquatic ecological environment and strengthen the protection of nearshore marine areas.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strengthen the protection of river and lake water ecology, scientifically delineate ecological protection red lines. Prohibit encroachment on natural wetlands and other water source conservation areas, and restore those that have already been encroached upon within a specified time frame. Strengthen the construction and protection of water source conservation forests, carry out wetland protection and restoration, and increase efforts in returning farmland to forests, grasslands, and wetlands. Enhance the ecological construction of riverfronts (lakesides) by establishing vegetation buffer zones and isolation zones on both sides of the river channel. Increase the protection of natural reserves for aquatic wildlife and aquatic genetic resources, carry out on-site and translocation protection of rare and endangered aquatic organisms and important aquatic genetic resources, and improve aquatic biodiversity. By the end of 2017, formulate and implement seven major biodiversity conservation plans for key river basins. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection and the Forestry Bureau, with participation from the Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture, etc.). Protect marine ecology. Increase the protection of coastal wetlands, estuaries, and bays, such as mangroves, coral reefs, and seagrass beds, as well as important fishing areas such as spawning grounds, feeding grounds, wintering grounds, and migration channels, implement stock enhancement and release, and construct artificial fish reefs. Conduct research on marine ecological compensation and compensation, and implement marine ecological protection.
