Strictly implement the plan for controlling land reclamation, strictly manage and supervise land reclamation, and prohibit land reclamation in key bays, marine nature reserves' core and buffer zones, key protection zones and reserved zones of marine special protection areas, key estuarine areas, important coastal wetland areas, important sandy shorelines and sand source protection areas, special protected islands, and important fishing areas. Strictly limit land reclamation in ecologically fragile and sensitive areas with poor self-purification capacity. Seriously investigate and punish illegal land reclamation activities and hold relevant personnel accountable. Include the protection of natural coastlines in the performance assessment of coastal local governments. By 2020, the national natural coastline retention rate should not be less than 35% (excluding island coastlines). (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection and the State Oceanic Administration, with participation from the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry Bureau, etc.).
titlelist: Make every effort to ensure the safety of the aquatic ecological environment and protect water and wetland ecosystems.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Taking into account factors such as water environmental quality and compliance, the country annually publishes a list of the top 10 cities with the worst and best water conditions, as well as the water environmental conditions of each province (region, municipality). For cities with poor water conditions that still fail to meet the requirements after rectification, their honorary titles such as Environmental Protection Model City, Ecological Civilization Construction Demonstration Zone, Water-saving City, Garden City, and Sanitary City will be revoked and announced to the public. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with the participation of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, National Health and Family Planning Commission, State Oceanic Administration, etc.). The people's governments of each province (region, municipality) should regularly publish the water environmental quality of each prefecture-level city (prefecture, league) within their administrative area. Key polluting units designated by the country should publicly disclose, in accordance with the law, the names of the main pollutants they generate, emission methods, emission concentrations and total amounts, excessive emission situations, as well as the construction and operation of pollution prevention and control facilities, and actively accept supervision. Research and release information on the environmental friendliness index of industrial agglomeration areas, intensity of pollutant emissions in key industries, and urban environmental friendliness index. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with the participation of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, etc.).
titlelist: Strengthen public participation and social supervision, and disclose environmental information in accordance with the law.

name: Action Plan for Water Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2015] No. 17) (State Council/April 2, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Establish the behavior code of water conservation and cleanliness, everyone is responsible. Carry out strong publicity and education, incorporate water resources, water environment protection, and water knowledge into the national education system, and enhance the public's understanding of the objective laws of economic and social development and environmental protection. Rely on social practice bases such as water conservation education in primary and secondary schools, soil and water conservation education, and environmental education to carry out environmental protection social practice activities. Support non-governmental environmental protection organizations and volunteers in their work. Advocate a new trend of green consumption, carry out mass creation activities for environmental protection communities, schools, families, etc., promote water conservation, encourage the purchase and use of water-saving products and environmentally friendly products. (Led by the Ministry of Environmental Protection, with the participation of the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Water Resources, etc.). China is currently in a stage of rapid development of new industrialization, informatization, urbanization, and agricultural modernization, and the task of water pollution prevention and control is arduous. All regions and relevant departments must effectively handle the relationship between economic and social development and the construction of ecological civilization. In accordance with the requirements of local performance of territorial responsibilities, departments strengthening industry management, clarify the law enforcement and responsibility subjects, fulfill their duties, highlight key points, comprehensively rectify, strive for practical results, and implement the spirit of leaving marks on iron and stones and leaving footprints on stones. Implement the law and regulations rigorously to ensure the timely realization of the national water environment governance and protection goals, and contribute to the realization of the Two Centenary Goals and the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.
titlelist: Strengthen public participation and social supervision, and build a pattern of nationwide action.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strengthen urban traffic management. Optimize urban functions and layout planning, promote intelligent traffic management, and alleviate urban traffic congestion. Implement a priority strategy for public transportation, increase the proportion of public transportation trips, and strengthen the construction of pedestrian and bicycle transportation systems. According to urban development plans, reasonably control the number of motor vehicles. Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and other major cities should strictly limit the number of motor vehicles. By encouraging green travel and increasing usage costs, reduce the intensity of motor vehicle use. Improve fuel quality. Accelerate the upgrading and transformation of petroleum refining enterprises, strive to supply nationally compliant fourth-stage standard gasoline for motor vehicles by the end of 2013, nationally compliant fourth-stage standard diesel for motor vehicles by the end of 2014, and nationally compliant fifth-stage standard gasoline and diesel for motor vehicles in key cities in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other regions by the end of 2015. By the end of 2017, supply nationally compliant fifth-stage standard gasoline and diesel for motor vehicles nationwide. Strengthen supervision and inspection of fuel quality, and crack down on illegal production and sale of substandard fuel. Accelerate the elimination of yellow-label vehicles and old vehicles. Gradually eliminate yellow-label vehicles and old vehicles by designating restricted areas and providing economic compensation. By 2015, eliminate yellow-label vehicles registered for operation before the end of 2005, and basically eliminate 5 million yellow-label vehicles in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other regions. By 2017, basically eliminate yellow-label vehicles nationwide. Strengthen motor vehicle environmental management. Environmental protection, industry and information technology, quality inspection, industry and commerce, and other departments jointly strengthen environmental supervision of new production vehicles, and crack down on illegal production and sale of vehicles that do not meet environmental standards. Strengthen annual inspection of in-use motor vehicles, and do not issue environmental compliance marks or allow them to be driven on the road for vehicles that do not meet standards. Accelerate the construction of the urea supply system for diesel vehicles. Study the reduction of mandatory scrapping age for buses and taxis. Encourage taxis to replace high-efficiency exhaust purification devices annually. Control pollution from non-road mobile machinery such as construction machinery and ships. Accelerate the upgrading and replacement of low-speed vehicles. Continuously improve energy-saving and environmental protection requirements for low-speed vehicles (three-wheeled vehicles, low-speed trucks), reduce pollution emissions, and promote the upgrading and replacement of related industries and product technologies. Starting from 2017, newly produced low-speed trucks will be subject to the same energy-saving and emission standards as light-duty trucks. Promote new energy vehicles vigorously. The public transportation, sanitation, and other industries, as well as government agencies, should take the lead in using new energy vehicles and encourage individuals to purchase them through measures such as direct registration and financial subsidies. The proportion of new energy and clean fuel vehicles among newly added or updated public transportation vehicles in cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou should exceed 60% annually.
titlelist: Strengthen comprehensive governance efforts, reduce emissions of multiple pollutants, and enhance the prevention and control of mobile source pollution.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Revise the admission criteria for high-energy-consuming, highly polluting, and resource-intensive industries, and clarify indicators such as resource and energy conservation and pollutant emissions. In areas where conditions permit, a catalog of industrial admission that aligns with local functional positioning and meets national requirements should be developed. Strictly control the increase in production capacity in industries with high energy consumption and high pollution, and implement capacity replacement in new, renovated, and expanded projects with an equal or reduced amount of capacity.
titlelist: Adjust and optimize the industrial structure, promote industrial transformation and upgrading, and strictly control the increase in production capacity in the 'two high' industries.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strengthen environmental protection, energy consumption, and safety law enforcement penalties, and establish a mechanism to promote the exit of excess capacity in the 'two high' industries through energy-saving and environmental protection standards. Develop supportive policies in finance, land, and finance to support the exit and transformation of enterprises in the 'two high' industries with excess capacity. Give full play to the leading role of strong and competitive enterprises in industry development, promote the compression of excess capacity through cross-regional and cross-ownership mergers and reorganizations. Strictly prohibit the approval of new capacity projects in industries with severe excess capacity.
titlelist: Adjust and optimize the industrial structure, promote industrial transformation and upgrading, and reduce excess production capacity.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Conduct clean production audits on key industries such as steel, cement, chemicals, petrochemicals, and non-ferrous metal smelting. For key areas and weak links in energy conservation and emission reduction, adopt advanced and applicable technologies, processes, and equipment to implement clean production technology transformation. By 2017, the emission intensity of key industries should be reduced by more than 30% compared to 2012. Promote innovation in non-organic solvent-based coatings, pesticides, and other products to reduce the emission of volatile organic compounds during production and use. Actively develop new varieties of slow-release fertilizers to reduce ammonia emissions during fertilizer application.
titlelist: Accelerate the technological transformation of enterprises, enhance the ability of scientific and technological innovation, and comprehensively promote clean production.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage the development of industrial clusters, implement the circular transformation of industrial parks, promote the cascade utilization of energy, the recycling of water resources, the exchange and utilization of waste, and the efficient use of land, promote enterprise-based circular production, park-based circular development, and industry-based circular combination, and build a circular industrial system. Promote the coordinated disposal of waste in cement kilns, blast furnaces, and other industrial furnaces. Vigorously develop the remanufacturing of mechanical and electrical products and promote the development of the resource recycling industry. By 2017, the energy consumption per unit of industrial value-added should be reduced by about 20% compared to 2012, and circular transformation should be implemented in over 50% of national-level parks and over 30% of provincial-level parks. The proportion of major non-ferrous metals and steel in circular recycling should reach about 40%.
titlelist: Accelerate the technological transformation of enterprises, enhance the ability of scientific and technological innovation, and vigorously develop the circular economy.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Efforts should be made to effectively transform the policy requirements for air pollution control into market demands for energy conservation and environmental protection industries, promoting the innovative development and industrial application of major environmental protection technologies, equipment, and products. Expanding the domestic consumer market, actively supporting new formats and models, cultivating a group of large-scale energy-saving and environmental protection enterprises with international competitiveness, significantly increasing the output value of air pollution control equipment, products, and services industries, and effectively promoting the development of strategic emerging industries such as energy conservation, environmental protection, and new energy. Encouraging foreign investment in the energy conservation and environmental protection industry.
titlelist: Accelerate the technological transformation of enterprises, enhance the ability of scientific and technological innovation, and vigorously cultivate the energy-saving and environmental protection industry.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Increase the supply of natural gas, coal-to-gas, and coalbed methane. By 2015, the added capacity for natural gas transmission pipelines will be over 150 billion cubic meters, covering regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta. Optimize the use of natural gas, with priority given to guaranteeing residents' livelihoods or replacing coal. Encourage the development of efficient utilization projects such as distributed natural gas energy, while limiting the development of natural gas chemical projects. Develop natural gas peak-shaving power plants in an orderly manner, with no new natural gas power generation projects being built in principle. Formulate a development plan for coal-to-gas, accelerating the industrialization and scaling of coal-to-gas while meeting the strictest environmental protection requirements and ensuring water resource supply. Actively and orderly develop hydropower, exploit and utilize geothermal energy, wind energy, solar energy, and biomass energy, and promote the safe and efficient development of nuclear power. By 2017, the installed capacity of operating nuclear power units will reach 50 million kilowatts, and the proportion of non-fossil energy consumption will increase to 13%. Accelerate the replacement of existing industrial coal-fired facilities with natural gas in the urban built-up areas of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, Yangtze River Delta urban agglomeration, and Pearl River Delta region. By 2017, the natural gas replacement transformation tasks for coal-fired boilers, industrial kilns, and self-owned coal-fired power plants will be basically completed.
titlelist: Accelerate the adjustment of the energy structure, increase the supply of clean energy, and expedite the substitution and utilization of clean energy.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Increase the proportion of coal washing, and new coal mines should simultaneously construct coal washing facilities. Existing coal mines should accelerate construction and renovation. By 2017, the rate of raw coal selection should reach over 70%. Prohibit the import of low-quality coal with high ash and sulfur content, and develop coal quality management measures. Restrict the import of high-sulfur petroleum coke. Expand the scope of urban areas where high-pollution fuels are prohibited, gradually extending from urban built-up areas to the suburbs. Combine urban areas, villages, urban-rural junctions, and shantytown renovations. Through policy compensation and the implementation of peak-valley electricity prices, seasonal electricity prices, tiered electricity prices, and peak-shaving electricity prices, gradually promote the use of natural gas or electricity as a substitute for coal. Encourage the construction of clean coal distribution centers in rural areas of the northern region and promote the use of clean coal and briquettes.
titlelist: Accelerate the adjustment of the energy structure, increase the supply of clean energy, and promote the clean utilization of coal.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strictly implement the energy-saving evaluation and review system. The energy consumption of newly built high-energy-consuming projects should reach the domestic advanced level per unit of product (output), and the energy-using equipment should meet the first-level energy efficiency standards. In regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta, the energy consumption of newly built high-energy-consuming projects should reach the international advanced level per unit of product (output). Actively develop green buildings, and government-invested public buildings, affordable housing, etc., should take the lead in implementing green building standards. Newly built buildings should strictly comply with mandatory energy-saving standards and promote the use of technologies and equipment such as solar hot water systems, ground source heat pumps, air source heat pumps, photovoltaic building integration, and heat-electricity-cooling tri-generation. Promote heating metering reform and accelerate the metering and energy-saving transformation of existing residential buildings in northern heating areas. Newly built buildings and existing buildings that have completed heating metering transformation should gradually implement heating metering charges. Accelerate the construction and transformation of heat supply networks.
titlelist: Accelerate the adjustment of the energy structure, increase the supply of clean energy, and improve energy efficiency.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Raise the threshold for energy conservation and environmental protection access, improve the access conditions for key industries, publish a list of enterprises that meet the access conditions, and implement dynamic management. Strictly implement the total control of pollutant emissions, and make compliance with the total control requirements for sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, particulate matter, and volatile organic compound emissions a prerequisite for the approval of construction project environmental impact assessments. The Three Zones and Ten Groups including the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta region, the Pearl River Delta region, as well as the central part of Liaoning, Shandong, Wuhan and its surrounding areas, Changsha-Zhuzhou-Xiangtan, Chengdu-Chongqing, the west coast of the Taiwan Strait, the central and northern parts of Shanxi, the Guanzhong region of Shaanxi, Gansu-Ningxia, and the Urumqi urban agglomeration. In these 47 cities, new construction projects for thermal power, steel, petrochemical, cement, non-ferrous metals, and chemical enterprises, as well as coal-fired boilers, must comply with special emission limits for air pollutants. Each region may expand the scope of implementation of special emission limits according to the needs of improving environmental quality. Projects that have not passed energy and environmental impact assessments shall not be approved, approved, or filed by relevant departments, shall not be provided with land, shall not be approved for construction, shall not be issued production permits, safety production permits, or pollutant discharge permits, and financial institutions shall not provide any form of new credit support. Relevant units shall not provide electricity or water supply.
titlelist: Strict energy conservation and environmental protection access, optimize industrial spatial layout, strengthen energy conservation and environmental protection indicators constraints.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Scientifically formulate and strictly implement urban planning, strengthen urban spatial control requirements and green space control requirements, regulate the establishment and layout of various industrial parks, new cities, and new areas, prohibit arbitrary adjustments and modifications to urban planning, and form a spatial pattern conducive to the diffusion of air pollutants in cities and regions. Conduct pilot work on urban environmental master planning. Combine efforts to resolve excess capacity, energy conservation and emission reduction, and enterprise mergers and reorganizations, and orderly promote the environmental relocation and transformation of heavily polluting enterprises such as steel, petrochemical, chemical, non-ferrous metal smelting, cement, and flat glass located in the main urban areas of cities, to be basically completed by 2017.
titlelist: Strict energy conservation and environmental protection access, optimize industrial spatial layout, optimize spatial pattern.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: In accordance with the principles of whoever pollutes, takes responsibility; whoever emits more, bears more burden; energy conservation and emission reduction bring benefits and receive compensation, actively promote a new mechanism for energy conservation and emission reduction that combines incentives and constraints. Establish enterprise consumption quotas for water, electricity, and other resource products by industry and region. Establish a leader system for enterprises, providing incentives to advanced enterprises that achieve higher standards of energy efficiency and pollution intensity. Fully implement preferential financial and tax policies for contract energy management, improve support policies for the development of environmental services industry, and promote integrated investment, construction, and operation of pollution control facilities through franchising. Improve green credit and green securities policies, and incorporate enterprise environmental information into the credit system. Strictly restrict loans and financing for environmentally non-compliant enterprises. Promote pilot projects for the paid use and trading of emission rights.
titlelist: Play the role of market mechanisms, improve environmental economic policies, and utilize the regulatory function of market mechanisms.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: According to the cost of denitrification and the adjustment of electricity sales prices, improve the denitrification electricity price policy. Existing thermal power units that adopt new technologies for dust removal facility renovation should be given price policy support. Implement a tiered electricity price. Promote the reform of the natural gas price formation mechanism and rationalize the price relationship between natural gas and alternative energy sources. Reasonably determine the price of finished oil based on the principles of reasonable compensation cost, high quality and high price, and polluter pays. Improve the subsidy policy for the reform of the price of finished oil for some disadvantaged groups and public welfare industries. Increase the collection of pollution fees and collect all that should be collected. Timely increase the pollution discharge fee standards and include volatile organic compounds in the scope of pollution discharge fee collection. Study the inclusion of some products from the two high industries in the scope of consumption tax collection. Improve the export tax rebate policy for products from the two high industries and the tax policy for comprehensive utilization of resources. Actively promote the reform of resource taxes, such as coal, based on value. Enterprises that comply with tax laws and regulations, use special equipment or construct environmental protection projects, and high-tech enterprises can enjoy preferential corporate income tax treatment.
titlelist: Play the role of market mechanisms, improve environmental economic policies, and perfect price and tax policies.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote innovative law enforcement mechanisms such as joint law enforcement, regional law enforcement, and cross-sector law enforcement. Clearly define priorities, increase efforts, and severely crack down on environmental violations. Enterprises that engage in illegal discharge and repeated offenses should be shut down in accordance with the law. Those suspected of environmental crimes should be held criminally responsible in accordance with the law. Implement law enforcement responsibilities, and supervisory authorities should hold relevant departments and personnel accountable for acts of supervision failure, weak law enforcement, and favoritism.
titlelist: Strengthen the legal system, strictly supervise and manage in accordance with the law, and increase the intensity of environmental law enforcement.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The country publishes a monthly list of the 10 cities with the worst air quality and the 10 cities with the best air quality. Each province (region, city) should publish the ranking of air quality for cities at the prefecture level and above within their administrative area. Cities at the prefecture level and above should timely release air quality monitoring information through local major media. Environmental protection departments at all levels and enterprises should proactively disclose environmental information such as environmental impact assessments of new projects, pollutant emissions from enterprises, and the operation of pollution control facilities, and accept social supervision. Construction projects involving the interests of the masses should fully listen to public opinions. A mandatory system for the disclosure of environmental information of heavily polluting industries and enterprises should be established.
titlelist: Establish a sound legal system, strictly supervise and manage in accordance with the law, and implement environmental information disclosure.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The environmental protection department needs to strengthen cooperation with the meteorological department and establish a monitoring and early warning system for heavy pollution weather. By 2014, the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta regions should complete the construction of regional, provincial, and municipal-level heavy pollution weather monitoring and early warning systems. Other provinces (regions, cities), sub-provincial cities, and provincial capitals should complete this by the end of 2015. It is necessary to conduct trend analysis of heavy pollution weather processes, improve consultation and judgment mechanisms, enhance the accuracy of monitoring and early warning, and timely release monitoring and early warning information.
titlelist: Establish a monitoring and early warning emergency system to effectively respond to severe pollution weather, and establish a monitoring and early warning system.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Cities that do not meet the prescribed air quality standards should develop and improve emergency plans for severe pollution weather and make them public. Responsibilities should be assigned, emergency organizations and their responsibilities, warning and response procedures, emergency response and protection measures, etc. should be clearly defined. Measures to be taken in response to different levels of pollution should include production restrictions and shutdowns for enterprises, control of motor vehicles and dust, suspension of classes in primary and secondary schools, and feasible meteorological interventions. Emergency drills for severe pollution weather should be conducted. The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and other regions should establish and improve a regional, provincial, and municipal joint emergency response system for severe pollution weather. The emergency plans of each province (region, city) in the region should be submitted to the Ministry of Environmental Protection for record before the end of 2013.
titlelist: Establish a monitoring and early warning emergency system, properly respond to severe pollution weather, and develop and improve emergency response plans.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Include the emergency response to severe pollution weather into the local people's government emergency management system, and implement the system where the main government officials are responsible. Based on the warning level of severe pollution weather, promptly initiate emergency plans and guide the public to take necessary hygiene precautions.
titlelist: Establish a monitoring and early warning emergency system, properly respond to severe pollution weather, and take timely emergency measures.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Relevant departments should closely cooperate, coordinate efforts, and act in unison to form a strong synergy in the prevention and control of air pollution. The Ministry of Environmental Protection should strengthen guidance, coordination, and supervision, while relevant departments should formulate policies in investment, finance, taxation, finance, pricing, trade, technology, and other areas that are conducive to the prevention and control of air pollution. They should also carry out their respective work in accordance with the law.
titlelist: Clarify the responsibilities of government, enterprises, and society, mobilize the participation of the entire population in environmental protection, and strengthen coordination and collaboration among departments.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Enterprises are the main body responsible for air pollution control. They should strengthen internal management, increase investment, adopt advanced production processes and control technologies, ensure compliance with environmental standards, and even achieve 'zero emissions'. They should also consciously fulfill their social responsibility for environmental protection and accept social supervision.
titlelist: Clarify the responsibilities of government, enterprises, and society, mobilize the participation of the entire population in environmental protection, and strengthen corporate governance.

name: Action Plan for Air Pollution Prevention and Control (State Council [2013] No. 37) (State Council/September 13, 2013)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Environmental governance is the responsibility of everyone. We should actively carry out various forms of publicity and education, popularize scientific knowledge on the prevention and control of air pollution. We need to strengthen the training of professionals in atmospheric environmental management. We should advocate for civilized, economical, and green consumption patterns and lifestyles, guide the public to start from themselves, from small things around them, and establish a code of conduct of breathing together, striving together in the whole society, and jointly improve air quality. China is still in the primary stage of socialism, and the task of preventing and controlling air pollution is arduous. We must have confidence, implement comprehensive governance, highlight key points, and gradually advance. The focus should be on implementation and practical results. All regions, relevant departments, and enterprises should closely integrate with reality, vigorously implement the action plan, and ensure that the goal of improving air quality is achieved as scheduled.
titlelist: Clarify the responsibilities of government, enterprises, and society, mobilize the participation of the entire population in environmental protection, and widely mobilize social participation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: By 2020, the industry's innovation capability has significantly improved, with new breakthroughs in key core technologies, and the innovation-driven industry development system has been basically established. The effective supply capacity of advanced environmental protection technology and equipment has significantly increased, and market share has greatly improved. The main technological equipment has basically reached the international advanced level, and international competitiveness has significantly enhanced. The industrial structure continues to optimize, supporting a group of standardized enterprises with demonstrative and leading roles in each key area, cultivating ten billion-scale leading enterprises, creating thousands of specialized, refined, distinctive, and new small and medium-sized enterprises, and forming several industrial clusters with strong driving effects and distinctive characteristics. The output value of the environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry reaches 1 trillion yuan.
titlelist: Overall thinking and objectives, work objectives.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage enterprises to focus on urgent and difficult issues in environmental pollution and the increasing demand for environmental protection standards. The goal is to break through key common technologies, rely on industry key common technologies, and connect through the industrial chain to cultivate and establish technology innovation centers and industry technology innovation alliances. Guide enterprises to collaborate in innovation along the industrial chain, promote the formation of collaborative innovation communities, achieve precise research and development, overcome a batch of key core technologies and equipment for pollution control, as well as materials and pharmaceuticals. Strengthen the construction of application promotion platforms, improve industrialization mechanisms, encourage the transformation of innovative achievements, promote precise connection between equipment and governance projects, and accelerate the application in the green transformation of traditional manufacturing industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, chemicals, and building materials.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the collaborative innovation and development of technology research and development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Explore and promote the modular design and standardized manufacturing of non-standard products, promote the application of the Internet of Things, robotics, automation equipment, and information management software in the production process, improve the level of intelligent manufacturing and information management in the environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry, and achieve lean management of the production process. Increase the application of green design, green processes, and green supply chains in the field of environmental protection equipment manufacturing, carry out benchmarking of energy efficiency, water efficiency, and pollutant emissions in the production process, create green demonstration factories, and improve the overall level of green manufacturing in the industry.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the transformation and development of intelligent and green production.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Optimize the structure of environmental protection equipment products, expand product segmentation areas, gradually develop a complete set of series products with independent intellectual property rights for different industries. Focus on developing a batch of intelligent and energy-saving advanced and efficient environmental protection equipment, taking into account the cost and operational efficiency of environmental governance. Create a batch of customized products based on user governance needs and operating environment. Strengthen the brand construction of environmental protection equipment products, establish a brand cultivation management system, promote socialized quality testing services, improve product quality levels, enhance the market recognition of independent brands, cultivate a batch of internationally renowned independent brands, and increase brand added value and international competitiveness.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the diversification and branding of products to enhance development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage leading environmental protection equipment companies to develop into comprehensive service providers integrating system design, equipment manufacturing, engineering construction, commissioning and maintenance, and operation management. Encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to develop in the direction of product specialization, deepening research and development, specialized services, and innovative business models, forming a cluster led by leading enterprises, supported by small and medium-sized enterprises, and coordinated development of the industrial chain. Guide the integration of environmental protection equipment manufacturing with the Internet and service industry, actively explore new models and formats, and accelerate the improvement of manufacturing enterprises' service capabilities and investment and financing capabilities. Encourage traditional manufacturing enterprises to expand into the environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry using their own technological advantages, extending the depth and breadth of the industrial chain.
titlelist: The main task is to guide the differentiated, clustered, and integrated development of the industry.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage environmental protection equipment enterprises to strengthen cooperation, adopt complementary advantages and strong alliances, actively expand foreign markets, participate in overseas environmental protection project construction and operation through technology introduction, cooperative research and development, direct investment, etc., and guide the transformation of the environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry from mainly exporting individual machines to providing complete sets of equipment and services as the main international equipment general contracting and engineering general contracting. Encourage environmental protection equipment enterprises to join forces with infrastructure construction enterprises and actively participate in environmental infrastructure construction projects in the Belt and Road initiative and international capacity cooperation. Make full use of bilateral and multilateral cooperation mechanisms and exchange platforms, strengthen information, technology, and project exchanges and cooperation with foreign enterprises, promote international recognition of environmental protection technology equipment patents, standards, etc., and achieve international integration.
titlelist: The main task is to encourage the internationalization and open development of enterprises.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The text translates to:Key research and development focuses on the combined removal of PM2.5 and ozone precursors, as well as trend-setting and forward-looking technologies and equipment for the treatment of sulfur trioxide (SO3), heavy metals, and dioxins. Key components such as pulse high-voltage power supplies for dust removal are being developed, and purification and disposal technologies and equipment for waste gases from waste incineration flue gas, mobile source exhaust gas, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are being promoted. The application and demonstration of ultra-low emission technologies for coal-fired power plants, as well as collaborative control of multiple pollutants in non-electric industries such as steel, coking, non-ferrous metals, building materials, and chemicals, and control technologies and equipment for volatile organic compounds in key areas are being advanced.
titlelist: Key areas, equipment for air pollution prevention and control.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Focus on the research and development of anaerobic ammonia oxidation technology equipment, electrolytic catalytic oxidation, supercritical oxidation equipment, and advanced membrane treatment technology and components that are bio-enhanced and low-energy and high-efficiency. Conduct basic research on the treatment technology equipment for trace toxic pollutants in drinking water. Emphasize the promotion of low-cost, high-standard, low-energy, and high-efficiency sewage treatment equipment, zero-emission treatment and comprehensive utilization technology for high-salinity wastewater in coal-fired power plants, coal chemical industry, and other industries, as well as deep denitrification, phosphorus removal, and safe and efficient disinfection technology equipment. Promote the restoration of black and odorous water bodies, rural sewage treatment, upgrading of urban and industrial park sewage plants, and application demonstrations of high-concentration and difficult-to-degrade sewage treatment in industrial and livestock farming, leachate treatment from garbage, and other fields.
titlelist: Key areas, equipment for water pollution prevention and control.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Key research and development of soil bioremediation, enhanced soil vapor extraction (SVE), heavy metal electrokinetic separation, and other technological equipment. Emphasis on promoting thermal desorption, chemical flushing, oxidation-reduction, and other technological equipment. Study the impact of polluted sites such as petroleum, chemical, smelting, and mining on human living environment and ecological safety, and carry out demonstrations of remediation and restoration of agricultural soil pollution, industrial land pollution, and mining area soil pollution.
titlelist: Key areas, soil pollution remediation equipment

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Key research and development of technical equipment for wet separation of construction waste, pollution control and restoration of contaminated bottom sludge, efficient anaerobic digestion of waste, efficient desulfurization of incineration flue gas, efficient adsorption of dioxins and heavy metals in incineration flue gas, and resource utilization of incineration fly ash. Key promotion of complete sets of technical equipment for coordinated harmless disposal in cement kilns, anaerobic pyrolysis of organic solid waste, advanced and efficient waste incineration technology equipment, safe disposal technology equipment for incineration slag and fly ash, harmless treatment technology equipment for by-products of coal-fired power plants, denitrification catalysts, waste filter bag, low energy consumption sludge dewatering and deep drying technology equipment, treatment of leachate and concentrated liquid of waste, biogas production of natural gas, and regeneration technology equipment for deactivated catalysts. Application demonstrations are carried out in key areas such as the stability of technical equipment and prevention of secondary pollution in the field of municipal solid waste and hazardous waste incineration treatment, as well as the treatment and disposal of sludge in urban sewage treatment plants and industrial wastewater treatment facilities.
titlelist: Key areas, solid waste treatment and disposal equipment.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Focus on the research and development of intelligent comprehensive utilization technology equipment based on the Internet of Things and big data, and develop and promote comprehensive utilization equipment that integrates with end-of-pollution treatment. In the field of bulk industrial solid waste such as tailings, red mud, coal gangue, fly ash, industrial by-product gypsum, and smelting slag, research and promote high-value, large-scale, and intensive utilization technology equipment. In the field of recycling resources such as waste electronic appliances, scrapped cars, scrap metal, and waste tires, research and develop key technology equipment for intelligent dismantling, fine sorting, and comprehensive utilization, and promote the application of large-scale complete sets of environmentally friendly equipment. Accelerate the research and development of modification and transformation technologies for waste plastics and waste rubber, as well as harmless, resourceful, and complete sets of treatment and utilization technology equipment for waste textiles, waste denitration catalysts, waste power batteries, and waste solar panels. Promote the application of five materialization utilization technology equipment in the field of agricultural waste such as straw, including feed, base material, fertilizer, raw material, and fuel utilization.
titlelist: Key areas, equipment for comprehensive utilization of resources

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Key research and development of emergency technical equipment for hazardous chemical accidents, leakage prevention and emergency management of hazardous chemicals (cyanides) in shipping. Emphasis on promoting mobile emergency treatment technology equipment for hazardous waste, emergency disposal technology equipment for water oil spills, etc. Conduct application demonstrations of emergency disposal technology equipment for hazardous chemical accidents, blue-green algae blooms, etc.
titlelist: Key areas, equipment for emergency treatment of environmental pollution.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Key research and development areas include cluster analysis of water quality in pollution sources, toxicity monitoring of water quality, continuous monitoring and early warning of multiple parameters of air pollution in petrochemical and chemical industrial parks, biological monitoring and simultaneous monitoring of multiple target substances, as well as emergency environmental monitoring and other technical equipment. Key promotion areas include on-site rapid monitoring of pollutants, continuous monitoring of multiple parameters and multiple pollutants such as volatile organic compounds, ammonia, heavy metals, and sulfur trioxide (SO3), regional and grid-based environmental monitoring technologies such as vehicle-mounted, aircraft-mounted, and satellite-based equipment, as well as rapid detection and diagnosis of heavy metals and persistent organic pollutants in farmland soil and other technical equipment.
titlelist: Key areas, specialized instruments and meters for environmental monitoring.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Key research and development of new efficient water treatment materials and agents, ultra-clean filtration, high-efficiency gas-solid separation materials, solidification and removal of heavy metals and persistent organic pollutants in soil, microbial remediation, ecological restoration, environmentally friendly nanomaterials and agents. Key promotion of efficient, low-resistance, long-life dust removal filter materials, corrosion-resistant lining plates for desulfurization, soil heavy metal passivation materials and agents, catalysts for volatile organic compound treatment, deodorants for garbage, in-situ passivation, fixation, biological barrier materials and agents, etc.
titlelist: Key areas, specialized materials and agents for environmental pollution prevention and control.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Fully utilize existing funding channels such as green manufacturing, industrial transformation and upgrading, energy conservation and emission reduction, and technological transformation, and leverage the preferential tax policies for energy-saving and water-saving environmental protection equipment and the insurance compensation mechanism for the first set of major technological equipment to support the industrialization demonstration and promotion of advanced environmental protection technology equipment. Actively promote financial products such as green credit, green bonds, financing leasing, intellectual property pledge loans, and credit insurance policy pledge loans, and increase support for the environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry. Encourage social capital to establish industry funds based on market principles and invest in the environmental protection equipment manufacturing industry.
titlelist: Enhance financial and taxation support measures

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Environmental Protection Equipment Manufacturing Industry (MIIT Jie [2017] No. 250) (MIIT/October 17, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Utilize the advantages of industry associations, research institutes, and consulting firms that are familiar with the industry and close to enterprises, actively carry out policy promotion, technology exchange, standard formulation, operation monitoring, industry self-discipline, and other work, serve as a bridge and link between the government, industry, and enterprises, and promote the sustainable and healthy development of the industry.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, fully leveraging the role of intermediary organizations.

name: Implementation Plan for Groundwater Pollution Prevention and Control (Huan Tu Rang [2019] No. 25) (Ministry of Ecology and Environment, Ministry of Natural Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs / March 28, 2019)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Continue to carry out investigations and assessments of the groundwater environment, strengthen the supervision of groundwater environment, develop and implement policies and technical engineering measures for the prevention and control of groundwater pollution, promote coordinated control of surface water, groundwater, and soil pollution, comprehensively utilize legal, economic, technical, and necessary administrative means, carry out prevention and control of groundwater pollution and ecological protection work, prioritize prevention, adhere to the combination of prevention and control, and promote continuous improvement of the national groundwater environment quality.
titlelist: Overall requirements, basic principles, prevention as the main focus, comprehensive measures.

name: Implementation Plan for Groundwater Pollution Prevention and Control (Huan Tu Rang [2019] No. 25) (Ministry of Ecology and Environment, Ministry of Natural Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs / March 28, 2019)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: With a focus on controlling dual sources (centralized underground water sources for drinking water and underground water pollution sources), ensuring the environmental safety of underground water sources for drinking water, and strict control of underground water pollution sources. Through comprehensive analysis of hydrogeological conditions and characteristics of underground water pollution, classification guidance is provided to develop corresponding prevention and control measures, effectively improving the level of prevention and control of underground water pollution.
titlelist: Overall requirements, basic principles, highlighting key points, and classification guidance.

name: Implementation Plan for Groundwater Pollution Prevention and Control (Huan Tu Soil [2019] No. 25) (Ministry of Ecology and Environment, Ministry of Natural Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs / March 28, 2019)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Focus on the weak security guarantee of groundwater as a drinking water source, the presence of multiple pollution sources and high environmental risks, the inadequate regulatory standard system, the imperfect environmental monitoring system, and insufficient protection. Combine these issues with the characteristics of key regions and industries to strengthen the construction of the groundwater pollution risk prevention and control system.
titlelist: Overall requirements, basic principles, problem orientation, risk prevention and control.

name: Implementation Plan for Groundwater Pollution Prevention and Control (Huan Tu Soil [2019] No. 25) (Ministry of Ecology and Environment, Ministry of Natural Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs / March 28, 2019)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: By 2020, a preliminary regulatory standard system for the prevention and control of groundwater pollution and a national groundwater environmental monitoring system will be established. The proportion of extremely poor groundwater quality nationwide will be controlled at around 15%. Typical sources of groundwater pollution will be initially monitored, and the trend of groundwater pollution exacerbation will be initially curbed. By 2025, a regulatory standard system for the prevention and control of groundwater pollution and a national groundwater environmental monitoring system will be established. The overall proportion of urban centralized groundwater drinking water sources at the prefecture level and above reaching or surpassing Class III water quality will be around 85%. Typical sources of groundwater pollution will be effectively monitored, and the trend of groundwater pollution exacerbation will be effectively curbed. content: Advocate that public institutions at all levels reduce air conditioning usage by one hour during peak electricity consumption periods, and close doors and windows when using air conditioning. category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: By 2025, the circular production mode will be fully implemented, green design and clean production will be widely promoted, the ability of comprehensive resource utilization will be significantly improved, and the resource recycling industrial system will be basically established. The recycling network for waste materials will be further improved, the capacity for recycling renewable resources will be further enhanced, and a resource recycling system covering the whole society will be basically established. The efficiency of resource utilization will be greatly improved, the proportion of renewable resources replacing primary resources will be further increased, and the supporting role of the circular economy in resource security will be further highlighted. By 2025, the main resource output rate will increase by about 20% compared to 2020, the energy consumption per unit of GDP and water consumption will be reduced by about 13.5% and 16% respectively compared to 2020. The comprehensive utilization rate of crop straw will be maintained at over 86%, the comprehensive utilization rate of bulk solid waste will reach 60%, the comprehensive utilization rate of construction waste will reach 60%, the utilization of waste paper will reach 60 million tons, the utilization of waste steel will reach 320 million tons, and the production of recycled non-ferrous metals will reach 20 million tons, including 4 million tons of recycled copper, 11.5 million tons of recycled aluminum, and 2.9 million tons of recycled lead.
