name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote the large-scale, standardized, and clean utilization of renewable resources, and promote the development of the renewable resource industry cluster to build a modern urban mineral base at a high level. Implement standardized management of the recycling and utilization of waste steel, waste non-ferrous metals, waste plastics, waste paper, waste tires, waste mobile phones, waste power batteries, and other renewable resources, improve the level of industry standardization, and promote the aggregation of resources to advantageous enterprises. Strengthen the standardized management and environmental supervision of enterprises engaged in the dismantling and utilization of waste electrical and electronic products, scrapped motor vehicles, scrapped ships, waste lead-acid batteries, etc., increase efforts to rectify illegal and non-compliant enterprises, and create a fair market competition environment. Accelerate the establishment of a system for promoting the use of recycled raw materials, expand the application channels of recycled raw materials in the market, and strengthen the guarantee capacity of renewable resources for strategic mineral resources supply.
titlelist: Key tasks, building a system for the recycling of waste materials, constructing a resource recycling society, and improving the level of processing and utilization of recycled resources.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote the level of remanufacturing in automobile parts, engineering machinery, machine tools, office equipment, and other industries. Drive the development of the remanufacturing industry in emerging fields such as shield tunneling machines, aerospace engines, and industrial robots. Promote the application of non-destructive testing, additive manufacturing, flexible processing, and other common key technologies in remanufacturing. Cultivate specialized enterprises for the recycling of remanufactured old parts. Support the construction of a trading platform for remanufactured products. Encourage companies to use remanufactured products in their after-sales service systems and fulfill their disclosure obligations. Promote the integration of remanufacturing technology and equipment digitization, providing customized remanufacturing services for large-scale electromechanical equipment. Support the exploration of bonded maintenance and remanufacturing of aviation, CNC machine tools, communication equipment, and other industries in the pilot free trade zones, under the premise of information sharing and risk control by regulatory authorities. Strengthen the evaluation and promotion of remanufactured products.
titlelist: Key tasks: Build a system for the recycling of waste materials, construct a resource recycling society, and promote the high-quality development of the remanufacturing industry.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote the efficient utilization of agricultural and forestry waste such as crop straw, livestock and poultry manure, forestry waste, and by-products of agricultural product processing. Strengthen the comprehensive utilization of crop straw, prioritize agricultural use, increase the efforts of returning straw to the fields, and enhance the conservation function of arable land. Encourage the industrial utilization of straw outside the fields, develop new materials and products, and increase the added value of straw in feed, fuel, raw materials, etc. Strengthen the construction of facilities for the treatment of livestock and poultry manure, encourage integrated farming, and promote the on-site and nearby utilization of organic fertilizers in agriculture. Encourage the use of small-sized fuelwood and the three leftovers of forestry (residuals from logging, processing, and manufacturing) for the production of composite panels, edible mushroom cultivation, and energy utilization, and promote the resource utilization of by-products from agricultural product processing.
titlelist: Key tasks: Deepen the development of circular economy in agriculture, establish a circular agricultural production mode, and strengthen the utilization of agricultural and forestry waste resources.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Guide large-scale planters, farmer cooperatives, family farms, agricultural supplies enterprises, and waste recycling enterprises to actively participate in recycling. Support the construction of recycling facilities in rural towns, and improve the recycling system for waste agricultural materials such as agricultural film, fertilizer and pesticide packaging, irrigation equipment, agricultural machinery, and fishing nets. Construct regional centralized disposal and utilization facilities for waste agricultural materials, and improve the level of large-scale and resource utilization.
titlelist: Key tasks: Deepen the development of circular economy in agriculture, establish a circular agricultural production mode, and strengthen the recycling and utilization of waste agricultural materials.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote the integration of planting and breeding, agriculture and animal husbandry, and the construction of breeding farms with organic agricultural field construction, and promote the coordinated development model of livestock, poultry, fish, grain, vegetables, fruits, and tea. Build a number of ecological farms and ecological circular agricultural industry clusters, and explore sustainable operation mechanisms. Promote the development and utilization of biomass energy in rural areas, and give full play to the comprehensive benefits of clean energy supply and rural ecological environment governance. Construct a forestry circular economy industrial chain and promote the three-dimensional development model of industry on, between, and under the forest. Promote the circular linkage of planting, breeding, agricultural product processing, biomass energy, and tourism and health care, and encourage the integrated development of primary, secondary, and tertiary industries.
titlelist: Key tasks, deepen the development of circular economy in agriculture, establish a circular agricultural production mode, and promote the development of circular agriculture.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Construct 50 demonstration cities for the utilization of construction waste resources. Promote the reduction of construction waste at the source, establish a management system for the classification of construction waste, and standardize the construction, operation, and management of construction waste disposal, transfer, and resource utilization sites. Improve policies for the recycling and utilization of construction waste and certification standards for recycled products, promote the resource utilization of construction waste such as construction debris, construction slurry, demolition waste, engineering waste, and renovation waste, and increase the market scale of recycled products. Cultivate leading enterprises in the construction waste resource utilization industry, accelerate the development, application, and integration of new technologies, processes, and equipment for the resource utilization of construction waste. Key technologies and equipment innovation for the circular economy. Implement key special projects for key technologies and equipment in the circular economy. Breakthrough a batch of green and circular key common technologies and major equipment in areas such as eco-design of typical products, clean production in key industries, comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste, high-quality recycling of regenerated resources, and remanufacturing of high-end equipment. In regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta, carry out integrated demonstration of green technology systems for the circular economy, and promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements through the integration of government, industry, academia, research, and application. High-quality development of the remanufacturing industry. Combined with industrial intelligent transformation and digital transformation, vigorously promote the remanufacturing of industrial equipment, expand the application scope of remanufactured machine tools, industrial motors, and industrial robots. Support enterprises in the fields of tunnel excavation, coal mining, oil extraction, etc., to widely use remanufactured products and services. Promote the use of remanufactured automotive parts, remanufactured office equipment, and remanufactured products in the after-sales market, insurance, trade, logistics, leasing, and other fields. Expand the scale of the remanufacturing industry, guide the formation of around 10 remanufacturing industry clusters, cultivate a group of leading remanufacturing enterprises, and achieve an industrial output value of 200 billion yuan in the remanufacturing industry.
titlelist: Key Projects and Actions, Demonstration Project for the Utilization of Construction Waste Resources

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Utilize internet information technology, encourage diverse participation, and build an integrated online and offline network for the recycling of waste electrical and electronic products. Continue to carry out pilot projects for the extension of producer responsibility for electrical and electronic products. Support electrical and electronic product manufacturers in establishing recycling systems through independent, collaborative, or delegated methods, and guide and regulate the sharing of information between production companies, recycling companies, and e-commerce platforms. Guide the flow of waste electrical and electronic products to standardized dismantling enterprises. Ensure the security of personal privacy information throughout the entire process of recycling and utilizing electronic products such as mobile phones and computers. Strengthen technological innovation, encourage the promotion and application of new technologies, new processes, and new equipment, support the improvement and transformation of process equipment in standardized dismantling enterprises, promote intelligent and refined dismantling, and promote high-value utilization. Promote the management of the entire life cycle of automobiles. Research and formulate a comprehensive life cycle management plan for automobile use, build an information exchange system covering automobile manufacturers, dealers, repair companies, recycling and dismantling companies, etc., and strengthen the interconnection and sharing of information such as automobile production, import, sales, registration, maintenance, second-hand car transactions, scrapping, and the flow of key components. Establish a system for identifying certified parts, remanufactured parts, and reused appearance parts, and an information query system. Carry out pilot projects for the extension of producer responsibility for automotive products. Select certain regions to pilot the comprehensive life cycle management of automobile use, and promote it nationwide when conditions are ripe. Special action to control plastic pollution throughout the entire chain. Scientifically and reasonably promote the reduction of plastic at the source, strictly prohibit the production of environmentally and health-hazardous products such as ultra-thin agricultural films and daily products containing plastic microbeads, and encourage the public to reduce the use of disposable plastic products. Thoroughly evaluate the resource and environmental impacts of various types of plastic alternatives throughout their life cycle. Promote degradable plastics according to local conditions, improve the standard system, enhance inspection and testing capabilities, and standardize application and disposal. Promote the application of standard films, and improve the level of recycling and utilization of waste agricultural films. Strengthen the classification, recycling, and reuse of plastic waste, accelerate the construction of waste incineration facilities for household waste, and reduce the amount of plastic waste landfilled. Carry out special actions to clean up plastic waste in rivers, lakes, and coastlines, and implement special actions to clean up marine debris. Strengthen policy interpretation and guidance, and create a good social atmosphere. Green transformation of express packaging. Strengthen the green governance of express packaging, promote cooperation between e-commerce and manufacturers, and achieve direct delivery of key categories of express items in their original packaging. Encourage packaging manufacturers, e-commerce platforms, express delivery companies, and other upstream and downstream enterprises to establish industry alliances, support the establishment of a qualified supplier system for express packaging products, and promote the voluntary reduction of packaging by production companies. Implement a green certification system for express packaging products. Carry out pilot projects for the large-scale application of recyclable express packaging, significantly increase the proportion of reusable transit bags (boxes), and promote the standardized application of green and circular standardized turnover boxes. Encourage e-commerce platforms, express delivery companies, commercial institutions, convenience stores, property service companies, etc., to establish agreement-based recycling points for recyclable express packaging and provide specialized recycling facilities for recyclable express packaging. By 2025, the basic elimination of secondary packaging for e-commerce parcels will be achieved, and the scale of application of recyclable express packaging will reach 10 million. Action for the recycling of waste power batteries. Strengthen the construction of a traceability management platform for new energy vehicle power batteries, and improve the traceability management system for the recycling and utilization of new energy vehicle power batteries. Promote new energy vehicle manufacturers and waste power battery reuse companies to establish standardized recycling service outlets through self-construction, joint construction, authorization, etc. Promote the standardized and hierarchical utilization of power batteries, and improve the technical level of residual energy detection, residual value evaluation, recombination utilization, and safety management. Strengthen the promotion and application of advanced technology and equipment for the recycling and hierarchical utilization of waste power batteries. Improve the standard system for the recycling and utilization of power batteries. Cultivate backbone enterprises for the comprehensive utilization of waste power batteries and promote the development of the waste power battery recycling industry.
titlelist: Key Projects and Actions, Improvement Action for the Recycling and Utilization of Waste Electrical and Electronic Products

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (National Development and Reform Commission [2021] No. 969) (Development and Reform Commission/July 1, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strengthen the legal and regulatory standards for a sound circular economy. Promote the revision of the Circular Economy Promotion Law to further clarify the rights and obligations of relevant entities. Study and revise the Regulations on the Management of Recycling and Disposal of Waste Electrical and Electronic Products, improve supporting policies, and better leverage the role of the market. Encourage localities to formulate local regulations to promote the development of the circular economy. Improve the circular economy standard system, establish sound standards and specifications for green design, clean production, remanufacturing, recycled materials, green packaging, waste utilization in construction materials, etc., and deepen the pilot work of national circular economy standardization. Improve the circular economy statistical evaluation system. Study and improve the circular economy statistical system, gradually establish a statistical system including important resource consumption and recycling volume, optimize statistical accounting methods, and enhance the support capability of statistical data for circular economy work. Improve the evaluation index system for circular economy development, establish a sound evaluation system for circular economy, and encourage third-party evaluations. Strengthen financial and taxation policy support. Coordinate existing funding channels, strengthen support for major circular economy projects, key projects, and capacity building. Increase government green procurement efforts and actively purchase recycled resource products. Implement tax incentives for comprehensive utilization of resources, expand the scope of income tax preferential catalog for environmental protection, energy conservation, and water conservation enterprises. Encourage financial institutions to increase investment and financing for major projects in the circular economy field. Strengthen innovation in green financial products and increase support for circular economy-related enterprises and projects through green credit, green bonds, green funds, and green insurance. Strengthen industry supervision. Strengthen standardized management of enterprises engaged in the recycling and utilization of scrapped motor vehicles, waste electrical and electronic products, and used batteries, crack down on illegal modification, assembly, dismantling, and disposal activities, and increase investigation and punishment. Strengthen market supervision, crack down on the production and sale of plastic products that are explicitly prohibited by the state, and strictly investigate and penalize acts of false labeling and mislabeling of degradable plastics. Strengthen environmental protection in the recycling, utilization, and disposal of waste materials and other links.

name: Circular Development Leading Action (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Circular [2017] No. 751) (Fourteen Departments including the Development and Reform Commission/May 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote the comprehensive utilization of associated minerals and tailings. Conduct pilot demonstrations of comprehensive development and utilization of metallic mineral resources in areas with large reserves and associated iron ore, bauxite, copper ore, lead-zinc ore, gold ore, tungsten-tin ore, and other mineral deposits. Continue to promote the comprehensive utilization of associated non-metallic mineral resources such as coal mines, kaolin, alumina clay, and phosphate mines. Promote the efficient separation and extraction of valuable metals from tailings and their high-value and efficient utilization, and carry out the overall recovery and utilization of multiple elements from tailings. Support the production of building materials and road engineering materials using tailings and waste rock. Encourage the backfilling of tailings and the reclamation of tailings ponds in depleted mining areas. Promote the comprehensive utilization of bulk industrial solid waste. Focus on promoting the comprehensive utilization of industrial waste such as metallurgical slag, chemical slag, red mud, phosphogypsum, and electrolytic manganese slag, and cultivate a group of backbone enterprises. Further strengthen the comprehensive utilization of steel slag, mine slag, coal gangue, fly ash, and desulfurization gypsum. Implement the Action Plan for the Promotion and Application of New Wall Materials. Focus on promoting the recovery and utilization of strategic rare and precious metals from industrial solid waste. Build industrial solid waste comprehensive utilization industrial bases. Vigorously promote the coordinated utilization of various types of industrial solid waste. Strengthen the resource utilization of agricultural and forestry waste. Carry out pilot projects for the resource utilization of agricultural waste. Promote the fertilizerization, feed utilization, fuel utilization, basic material utilization, and raw material utilization of crop straw. Encourage the production of boards, paper, activated carbon, particles, liquid fuel biomass energy, and other products using forestry residues. Support the construction of facilities for the collection, storage, transportation, and utilization of manure in large-scale breeding farms. Support the construction of facilities for the treatment of dead livestock and poultry, aquatic organisms, and slaughter waste, and promote the development of various biogas projects and organic fertilizer facilities according to local conditions. Support the promotion of integrated agriculture and animal husbandry in counties with large-scale farming and breeding, and promote the demonstration of large-scale, specialized biogas production in these counties. Promote the replacement of chemical fertilizers with organic fertilizers in the production of fruits, vegetables, and tea. Promote the comprehensive utilization of by-products from agricultural and forestry processing. Promote the recycling and utilization of waste agricultural films, irrigation equipment, pesticide and veterinary vaccine containers, fishing gear, and fishing boats. By 2020, the comprehensive utilization rate of crop straw should reach 85%, and the comprehensive utilization rate of forestry residues should reach 60%.
titlelist: Promote the development of the resource recycling industry and promote the recycling of industrial waste.

name: Circular Development Leading Action (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Circular [2017] No. 751) (Fourteen Departments including the Development and Reform Commission/May 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Improve the recycling system for renewable resources. Promote traditional sales companies, e-commerce platforms, logistics companies, and others to utilize sales and distribution networks to establish reverse logistics recycling systems. Support renewable resource companies in utilizing internet and Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to establish integrated online and offline recycling networks. Encourage collaboration between renewable resource companies and various types of waste-producing enterprises to establish recycling models that suit the characteristics of the industries. Promote the adoption of recycling machines, recycling supermarkets, and other recycling methods based on local conditions. Strengthen the connection between the household waste classification and recycling system and the recycling of renewable resources. Enhance the level of development and utilization of urban minerals. Promote the improvement and efficiency of existing national urban minerals demonstration bases, guide standardized waste electrical and electronic dismantling enterprises and scrapped automobile dismantling enterprises outside the parks (bases) to develop within the parks, and promote agglomeration and scaled development. Introduce guidelines to promote the upgrading of the utilization level of renewable resources, and improve the technological equipment and high-value utilization level of enterprises. Promote the implementation of standardized conditions for the renewable resources industry and guide the standardized development of the renewable resources industry. Carry out major demonstration projects for national resource recycling and cultivate backbone enterprises. Conduct demonstrations of the recycling and utilization of new types of waste. Promote the recycling and utilization of new types of waste such as solar photovoltaic modules, power batteries, carbon fiber materials, bio-based fibers, composite materials, and energy-saving lamps. Promote the utilization of waste textiles, establish a hierarchical utilization mechanism for waste textiles, set up clothing collection boxes in charitable organizations, communities, schools, shopping malls, and other places, establish multiple recycling channels, promote the recycling and resource utilization of waste uniforms such as military and police uniforms, work uniforms, and school uniforms, and encourage clothing brands to recycle their own waste clothing. Promote the establishment of a recycling and utilization system for waste bamboo and wood products such as waste wooden furniture and wooden packaging. Starting with the express delivery industry, carry out pilot projects for standardization and classified recycling of packaging materials in the logistics industry, promote the use of degradable tapes, environmentally friendly fillers, recyclable paper, and environmentally friendly ink for packaging materials, encourage companies to recycle packaging boxes and bags, and improve the recycling rate.
titlelist: Promote the development of the resource recycling industry and enhance the quality and upgrade of recycling and utilization of renewable resources.

name: Circular Development Leading Action (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission Circular [2017] No. 751) (Fourteen Departments including the Development and Reform Commission/May 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The text translates to:Focusing on city clusters such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Chengdu-Chongqing, and Harbin-Changchun, we will coordinate the planning and construction of industrial solid waste, recycling resources, and the resource utilization and harmless disposal facilities for municipal solid waste within the region. We will also establish cross-administrative regional industrial bases for resource recycling. We will establish an information platform for the coordinated disposal of waste across administrative regions to promote the coordinated utilization and disposal of waste. We will promote the cross-administrative flow of scrapped vehicles dismantling and hazardous waste treatment, and achieve mutual recognition of qualifications, policy coordination, and system coordination.
titlelist: Strengthen the development of the resource recycling industry and build a regional resource recycling system.

name: Implementation Plan for the Recycling of Industrial Wastewater (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Letter [2021] No. 213) (MIIT and other six ministries/December 24, 2021)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote scale-above water enterprises to accelerate the upgrading and transformation of existing digital control platforms, utilize new generation information technologies such as big data, cloud computing, and the internet, establish an intelligent management platform for industrial wastewater recycling, and develop capabilities in perception, monitoring, early warning, and emergency response, in order to enhance the digital management, networked collaboration, and intelligent control level of wastewater recycling. Strengthen the control of total water consumption and intensity in the industry, comprehensively implement planning and major project layout, water resource demonstration for new construction, expansion, and renovation projects, strictly control new water withdrawals for key water-consuming industries that have the conditions for wastewater recycling but have not effectively utilized them. Carry out special actions for the treatment of water pollution in industrial parks in the Yangtze River Economic Belt, promote the collection, centralized treatment, and compliant discharge of industrial wastewater in the parks.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote comprehensive measures, and improve the management level of wastewater recycling.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: By 2020, a sound management system, advanced technological equipment, prominent industrial contributions, strong resilience against risks, and a healthy and orderly development of the renewable resources industry system will be basically established. The amount of recycled and utilized renewable resources will reach 350 million tons. A relatively complete set of standards and specifications will be established, and new breakthroughs will be made in key core technologies for industrial development. A number of market-competitive demonstration enterprises will be cultivated, further strengthening the renewable resources industry.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Integrate the concept of greenization into every link and process of the recycling industry chain, from collection, sorting, transportation, to processing, recycling, remanufacturing, and waste disposal. Strictly adhere to environmental, safety, hygiene, labor protection, and quality standards. Promote the improvement of environmental protection systems in comprehensive utilization enterprises of recycled resources, strengthen the construction and operation management of environmental protection facilities, promote clean production, achieve standard emissions, prevent secondary pollution, and ensure ecological and environmental safety.
titlelist: The main tasks are green development and ensuring ecological environmental safety.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Combining the construction of the 'Belt and Road' initiative, the coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, we will scientifically plan and coordinate the spatial layout of industrial belts and industrial parks. We encourage the establishment of circular economy alliances among enterprises and industries, which integrate material flow, information flow, capital flow, and product chains. We aim to extend the recycling resource industry chain, enhance the added value of recycled resource products, and achieve cross-enterprise, cross-industry, cross-sector, and cross-regional resource recycling.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote circular development and advance the combination of industrial cycles.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strengthen the dominant position of enterprises in technological innovation, encourage enterprises to increase research and development investment, strengthen the close integration between enterprises and higher education institutions and research institutes, encourage and support the establishment of industry-university-research collaboration alliances, and jointly carry out key common technology research. Accumulate a batch of core technology intellectual property rights and accelerate the transformation and application of technological achievements. Based on the Internet of Things and big data, focus on key areas, aim at future technological development high points, build a number of demonstration bases for the recycling resources industry with industrial agglomeration, prominent advantages, organic integration of industry, academia, research, and application, and significant leading and demonstration roles, and enhance the technological innovation capability of complete equipment manufacturing.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote coordinated development and enhance industrial innovation capabilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Improve the efficiency of resource utilization, promote the transition to high-value utilization, and ensure the quality and safety of recycled products. Increase the added value of recycled products, avoid low-level utilization and circular but uneconomical practices. Revise and improve the relevant standard system for recycled resource products, and encourage the use of certified recycled resource products. Implement the mortgage of newly manufactured products through remanufacturing and carry out remanufacturing projects. Focus on strengthening the deep processing of recycled resources and increasing product added value.
titlelist: The main tasks are high-value development and promoting product structure upgrading.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote the large-scale and refined development of the utilization of waste electrical and electronic products, automobiles, electrical appliances, batteries, and other recycled resources. Carry out classification guidance and management based on the characteristics of recycled resources in different industries and varieties, such as industry standard conditions and extended producer responsibility systems. Relying on the service outlets of telecommunications operators, explore the establishment of new models for recycling and utilization of waste mobile phones, batteries, chargers, and other communication products. Relying on the Internet Plus model, establish an integrated online and offline recycling mode, continuously improving the recycling rate of key varieties, especially low-value recycled resources.
titlelist: The main tasks are specialized development and improving resource utilization efficiency.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage the development of enterprises that comprehensively utilize renewable resources. Encourage the improvement of industry concentration through methods such as mergers, reorganizations, and joint ventures. In key areas such as waste non-ferrous metals, waste plastics, and the utilization of discarded electrical and electronic products, rely on technological innovation to achieve scale development. Promote the effective connection of the recycling system for renewable resources, the national urban mineral demonstration base, and the industrial chain of resource recycling bases, establish a favorable environment for the industry's sustainable development, explore commercial models that comply with the laws of industrial development, and cultivate leading enterprises in the field of renewable resources.
titlelist: The main task is to achieve cluster development and realize the clustering of industries.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Based on the steel production capacity and scrap steel resources in various regions, a reasonable plan should be made for the layout of scrap steel processing and distribution enterprises to ensure regional market stability and resource supply. Continuously strengthen the standardized management of the scrap steel processing industry, improve the scrap steel product standard system, promote the improvement of industrial policies and tax policies for scrap steel utilization, and encourage steel companies to use more scrap steel. Encourage deep cooperation between scrap steel supply enterprises and steel utilization enterprises, promote the effective connection of the scrap steel recycling-processing-utilization industrial chain, and form a replicable industrial innovation model. By 2020, guide the standardized development of scrap steel processing enterprises, and achieve a scrap steel consumption of 150 million tons.
titlelist: Key areas, scrap steel

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Promote the construction of a waste non-ferrous metal recycling and utilization system, with leading enterprises and pilot demonstration enterprises as the main body, and utilize information technology to enhance the intelligence level of waste non-ferrous metal trading. Guide enterprises to enter industrial parks, promote clean production, achieve centralized production and centralized wastewater treatment to prevent secondary pollution. By 2020, the scale of waste non-ferrous metal utilization will reach 18 million tons, including 4.4 million tons of recycled copper, 9 million tons of recycled aluminum, 2.5 million tons of recycled lead, and 2.1 million tons of recycled zinc.
titlelist: Key areas, waste non-ferrous metals.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Vigorously promote the construction of the waste plastic recycling and utilization system, and support the diversified and high-value utilization of different quality waste plastics. Focus on varieties with large resource volume and high recycling rate, encourage the demonstration of key varieties of waste plastic recycling, promote the scale-up of advanced production lines for waste plastic crushing, sorting, modification, and granulation, and cultivate a group of leading enterprises. Actively promote the resource utilization of low-quality waste plastics that are easily environmentally polluted, encourage pollution-free energy utilization of plastic waste from household garbage, and gradually reduce landfilling of waste plastics. By 2020, the scale of waste plastic recycling and utilization in China will reach 23 million tons.
titlelist: Key areas, plastic waste

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of the Renewable Resources Industry (MIIT Joint Letter [2016] No. 440) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Science and Technology/December 21, 2016)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Accelerate the standardized construction of waste paper sorting and processing centers, establish large-scale waste paper storage and logistics trading centers in key areas, and effectively reduce the flow cost of waste paper between regions. Improve the automation level and standardization of waste paper sorting and processing, promote the technology and equipment for automatic waste paper sorting, and increase the utilization rate and value-added utilization level of waste paper recycling. content: Give full play to the role of the inter-ministerial joint conference system and local coordination mechanism for the development of energy-saving and new energy vehicle industries, strengthen departmental coordination and vertical linkage, formulate annual work plans and division of departmental tasks, strengthen the coordination of new energy vehicles with energy, transportation, information and communication industries in policy planning, standards and regulations, and actively implement the major tasks and key work determined in the planning. name: China's Energy Development in the New Era (Excerpt) (State Council Information Office/December 21, 2020)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Implement major scientific and technological projects and engineering, achieve breakthroughs in key technologies in the energy field. Focus on the industrialization goals of national strategic industries, implement major projects in oil and gas technology, focus on breakthroughs in new theories of oil and gas geology and key technologies for efficient exploration and development, and carry out technological research on the economic and efficient development of unconventional resources such as shale oil, shale gas, and natural gas hydrates. Implement major projects in nuclear power technology, focus on key core technology research and development related to third-generation pressurized water reactors and fourth-generation high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, and continue to promote independent innovation in nuclear power. Deploy research in key common technologies, including new energy vehicles, smart grid technology and equipment, intelligent mining technology and equipment for coal mines, clean and efficient utilization of coal and new energy-saving technologies, and renewable energy and hydrogen energy technologies. Focus on the physical and chemical basic research of efficient and clean utilization and transformation of energy, and promote breakthroughs in application technology driven by basic research to support national strategic tasks.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and carry out collaborative scientific and technological innovation in major energy fields.

name: China's Energy Development in the New Era (Excerpt) (State Council Information Office/December 21, 2020)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Currently, the world is at the intersection of a new technological revolution and an industrial revolution. Breakthroughs in new technologies are accelerating industrial transformation and promoting the emergence of new energy models and formats. Efforts are being made to promote the deep integration of energy technology with modern information, materials, and advanced manufacturing technology, relying on the Internet+ smart energy construction to explore new models of energy production and consumption. The innovation and upgrading of intelligent photovoltaics are being accelerated, promoting the integration of photovoltaic power generation with agriculture, fisheries, animal husbandry, construction, and other industries, expanding new applications for complementary use of photovoltaic power generation, and forming new models for the extensive development and utilization of new energy. The technological equipment of the hydrogen energy industry chain, such as green hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and application, is being developed rapidly, promoting the development of the hydrogen fuel cell technology chain and the hydrogen fuel cell vehicle industry chain. Energy storage applications are being supported in various stages and scenarios of the energy sector, with a focus on promoting the complementary development of energy storage and renewable energy. Support is being provided for the construction of new energy microgrids to form integrated local clean energy supply systems for generation, storage, and use. New models of comprehensive energy services are being promoted to achieve multi-energy complementarity and synergistic efficiency at the end of the energy chain. With the guidance and driving force of pilot demonstration projects, various new energy technologies, models, and formats continue to emerge, forming a fusion effect for innovative energy development.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and support the development of new technologies, new models, and new formats.

content: Steadily increase the consumption of automobiles, household appliances, and other major consumer goods; remove unreasonable restrictions on the trading of used cars; increase the construction of facilities such as parking lots, charging stations, and battery swapping stations; accelerate the establishment of a power battery recycling and utilization system. (Responsibilities are divided among the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Transport, the Ministry of Commerce, the National Energy Administration, etc., and will be continuously promoted within the year).
titlelist: Adhere to the strategic focus of expanding domestic demand, fully tap the potential of the domestic market, stabilize and expand consumption.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The main strategic direction for the development of new energy vehicles and the transformation of the automotive industry is to focus on pure electric drive. Currently, the key focus is on promoting the industrialization of pure electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, popularizing non-plug-in hybrid electric vehicles and energy-saving internal combustion engine vehicles, and improving the overall technological level of China's automotive industry.
titlelist: Technology roadmap and main objectives, technology roadmap.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: By 2015, the cumulative production and sales of pure electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles strive to reach 500,000 units. By 2020, the production capacity of pure electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles will reach 2 million units, with cumulative production and sales exceeding 5 million units. The fuel cell vehicle and hydrogen energy industry for vehicles will develop synchronously with international standards.
titlelist: Technology roadmap and main objectives, main objectives, significant progress achieved in industrialization.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: By 2015, the average fuel consumption of passenger cars produced that year will be reduced to 6.9 liters per 100 kilometers, and the fuel consumption of energy-saving passenger cars will be reduced to below 5.9 liters per 100 kilometers. By 2020, the average fuel consumption of passenger cars produced that year will be reduced to 5.0 liters per 100 kilometers, and the fuel consumption of energy-saving passenger cars will be reduced to below 4.5 liters per 100 kilometers. The fuel consumption of new commercial vehicles will approach international advanced levels.
titlelist: Technology roadmap and main objectives, main objectives, significant improvement in fuel economy.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)

titlelist: Technology roadmap and main objectives, main objectives, significant improvement in technical level.

titlelist: Technology roadmap and main objectives, main objectives, significantly enhanced supporting capabilities.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Vigorously promote technological innovation in power battery, with a focus on conducting research on the safety and reliability of power battery systems, lightweight design, and accelerating the development of key materials such as positive and negative electrodes, separators, electrolytes, as well as their production, control, and testing equipment. Develop new supercapacitors and their combination systems with batteries, promote the standardization and serialization of power batteries and related components and assemblies. Take the lead in deploying advanced technologies in the field of power batteries, focusing on research on high specific energy power battery new materials, new systems, new structures, new processes, and concentrate efforts to break through key common technologies that support long-term development. Strengthen the research and development of key components for new energy vehicles, with a focus on supporting the development of drive motor systems and core materials, electric air conditioning, electric power steering, electric brakes, and other electrification accessories. Conduct research on core technologies for fuel cell stacks, engines, and their key materials. Grasp the development trends of new energy vehicles worldwide and increase research efforts on other types of new energy vehicle technologies. By 2015, the maximum speed of pure electric passenger vehicles and plug-in hybrid passenger vehicles shall not be less than 100 kilometers per hour, and the comprehensive driving range in pure electric mode shall not be less than 150 kilometers and 50 kilometers, respectively. The specific energy of power battery modules shall reach 150 watt-hours per kilogram or above, the cost shall be reduced to below 2 yuan per watt-hour, and the stable cycle life shall reach 2000 times or more than 10 years. The power density of the electric drive system shall reach 2.5 kilowatts per kilogram or above, and the cost shall be reduced to below 200 yuan per kilowatt. By 2020, the specific energy of power battery modules shall reach 300 watt-hours per kilogram or above, and the cost shall be reduced to below 1.5 yuan per watt-hour.
titlelist: The main tasks include implementing the energy-saving and new energy vehicle technology innovation project, and strengthening research on key core technologies of new energy vehicles.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)

Focus on hybrid power technology research, develop dedicated hybrid power engines and electromechanical coupling devices, support the development of high-efficiency internal combustion engine technologies such as high-pressure common rail for diesel engines, direct injection for gasoline engines, homogeneous combustion, and turbocharging, as well as advanced electronic control technologies. Support the development of six-speed and above mechanical transmissions, dual-clutch automatic transmissions, and automatic control mechanical transmissions for commercial vehicles. Breakthroughs in low-resistance components, lightweight materials, and laser welding technology to significantly improve the technological level of small-displacement engines. Conduct research on high-efficiency control of pollutant emissions such as nitrogen oxides.
titlelist: The main tasks include implementing the energy-saving and new energy vehicle technology innovation project, and increasing the research and development efforts in energy-saving vehicle technology.

Construct several engineering platforms with international advanced levels, and develop industrial technology innovation alliances led by enterprises with active participation from research institutions and higher education institutions. titlelist: The main task is to implement the energy-saving and new energy vehicle technology innovation project, and accelerate the establishment of an energy-saving and new energy vehicle research and development system.

content: Actively promote the large-scale production of power batteries, accelerate the cultivation and development of a group of power battery production enterprises with sustainable innovation capabilities, strive to form 2-3 leading enterprises with an annual production and sales scale exceeding 10 billion watt-hours and key material research and production capabilities, and form 2-3 backbone production enterprises in the fields of positive and negative electrodes, separators, electrolytes, and other key materials.

content: Expand the scope of promoting and demonstrating new energy vehicles in the public service sector in large and medium-sized cities. Explore commercially viable market promotion models, coordinate the development of charging facilities, and establish effective mechanisms to drive technological progress and industrial development through pilot projects. Explore various commercial models such as leasing of new energy vehicles and battery, as well as charging and swapping services, and cultivate a group of high-quality new energy vehicle service enterprises. Continue to carry out demonstrations of fuel cell vehicles, improve the reliability and durability of fuel cell systems, and promote the development of hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and refueling technologies.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the promotion and pilot demonstration, and solidly promote the pilot demonstration of new energy vehicles.

content: Developing alternative fuel vehicles is a necessary supplement to reduce fuel consumption for automobiles. Actively conducting research and development and application of alternative fuel manufacturing technologies for vehicles, encouraging the development of alternative fuel vehicles in resource-rich areas such as natural gas (including liquefied natural gas) and biofuels. Exploring other avenues for the application of alternative fuel vehicle technologies to promote diversified development of automotive energy.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the promotion, application, and pilot demonstration, and to develop alternative fuel vehicles according to local conditions.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The vigorous development of professional services and value-added services that contribute to the expansion of the energy-saving and new energy vehicle market is beneficial. This includes establishing marketing and after-sales service systems for new energy vehicle financial credit, insurance, leasing, logistics, used car transactions, and the recycling and utilization of power batteries. When implementing measures such as restricted driving, license plate quota auctions, and vehicle purchase quota indicators, they should take into account the differences of new energy vehicles.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, create a favorable environment for industrial development.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)

Strengthen the construction of related disciplines such as electrochemistry, new materials, automotive electronics, vehicle engineering, and mechatronics, and cultivate talents in technology research, product development, business management, intellectual property rights, and technology application. Promote talent introduction work in accordance with the requirements of the National Medium- and Long-Term Talent Development Plan (2010-2020), and encourage enterprises, universities, and research institutions to introduce outstanding talents from abroad. Attach importance to the development of vocational education and job skills training, and increase the intensity of training for engineering and technical personnel and professional skilled talents.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen talent team guarantee.

name: Energy Conservation and New Energy Vehicle Industry Development Plan (2012-2020) (State Council Document [2012] No. 22) (State Council/June 28, 2012)

content: Support automobile companies, universities, and research institutions to carry out international collaborative research in the fields of energy-saving and new energy vehicles, provide global research and development outsourcing services, establish research and development institutions overseas, conduct joint research and submit patent applications abroad. Actively create conditions for various forms of technological exchange and cooperation, learn from and draw on advanced technologies and experiences from abroad. Improve policies such as export credit and insurance to support the export of new energy vehicle products, technologies, and services. Support companies in cultivating international brands through methods such as registering trademarks overseas and overseas acquisitions. Fully leverage the role of various bilateral and multilateral cooperation mechanisms, strengthen international exchanges and coordination in technical standards, policies, and regulations, and collaborate to explore and promote new commercialization models for new energy vehicles.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (State Council Document [2015] No. 73) (State Council General Office/September 29, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: By 2020, we will have basically established a moderately advanced, interconnected, and intelligent charging infrastructure system to meet the charging needs of over 5 million electric vehicles. We will also establish comprehensive standards, regulations, and market supervision systems to create a unified, open, and orderly charging service market. Furthermore, we aim to develop a sustainable Internet + charging infrastructure industrial ecosystem, achieve breakthroughs in technology and business innovation, and cultivate a group of charging service enterprises with international competitiveness.
titlelist: Overall requirements, work objectives.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (State Council Document [2015] No. 73) (State Council General Office/September 29, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Each region should incorporate relevant content of the special planning for charging infrastructure into urban and rural planning, improve the layout of independently occupied charging infrastructure, clarify the construction ratio or reserved construction and installation requirements of charging facilities in various types of buildings' parking lots and public parking lots. The main body should be dedicated charging facilities built in residential parking spaces, unit parking lots, bus and taxi stations, with public charging facilities built in public buildings' parking lots, public parking lots, temporary parking spaces, etc., as auxiliary, and intercity fast charging stations built in independently occupied urban fast charging stations, battery swapping stations, and highway service areas as supplements, forming an electric vehicle charging infrastructure system. In principle, newly built residential parking spaces should have 100% construction of charging facilities or reserved construction and installation conditions. The proportion of parking spaces with charging facilities or reserved construction and installation conditions in large public buildings' parking lots and public parking lots should not be less than 10%. At least one public charging station should be built for every 2,000 electric vehicles. The construction of integrated mechanical and three-dimensional parking and charging facilities with small footprint, low cost, and quick results should be encouraged.
titlelist: Intensify construction efforts, strengthen specialized planning, design, and guidance.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (State Council Document [2015] No. 73) (State Council General Office/September 29, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage companies such as charging service providers and property service providers to participate in the construction, operation, and management of charging facilities in residential areas. Carry out unified parking space renovations, directly handle the procedures for electricity connection, and appropriately charge users fees in accordance with relevant laws and regulations. For users with designated parking spaces, prioritize the installation of charging facilities in the parking spaces. For users without designated parking spaces, encourage the construction of public charging spaces in residential areas and establish a time-sharing mechanism for charging spaces to create conditions for users to charge their vehicles.
titlelist: Intensify construction efforts and build charging facilities in residential areas for users.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (State Council Document [2015] No. 73) (State Council General Office/September 29, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Government agencies, public institutions, and enterprises and institutions that meet the conditions should combine their electric vehicle equipment renewal plans and the demand for employees to purchase and use electric vehicles. They should utilize internal parking resources to plan and construct dedicated parking spaces and charging facilities for electric vehicles. Local authorities can include the construction of charging facilities by relevant units in the scope of energy conservation and emission reduction assessment and incentives.
titlelist: Intensify construction efforts, establish internal charging facilities within the construction units.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (State Council Document [2015] No. 73) (State Council General Office/September 29, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: For fixed-point and fixed-line operations such as public transportation, sanitation, and airport commuting, electric vehicles in the public service sector should prioritize the construction of charging facilities in parking lots and stations according to the operational needs of the routes. Along the way, it is reasonable to construct independent fast-charging stations and battery swapping stations. For public service electric vehicles that operate in non-fixed-point and non-fixed-line operations such as taxis, logistics, rentals, and police patrols, the potential of building charging facilities in internal parking lots and stations should be fully explored, combined with urban public charging facilities to achieve efficient complementarity.
titlelist: Intensify construction efforts and build charging facilities in the public service sector.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (State Council Document [2015] No. 73) (State Council General Office/September 29, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The construction of public charging facilities should gradually expand from the city center to the outskirts, and from priority development areas to general areas. Priority should be given to equipping large shopping malls, supermarkets, sports venues, and other buildings with parking lots, as well as constructing public charging facilities in transportation hubs and park-and-ride (P+R) public parking lots. Encouragement should be given to equipping gas stations with public fast charging facilities where conditions permit, and appropriately constructing independent public fast charging stations. Units and individuals with the necessary conditions are encouraged to open their charging facilities to the general public.
titlelist: Intensify construction efforts and build urban public charging facilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (State Council Document [2015] No. 73) (State Council General Office/September 29, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Make full use of parking spaces at highway service areas to build intercity fast charging stations. Prioritize the construction of intercity fast charging networks in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta regions. Power grid enterprises are responsible for the construction, operation, and maintenance of the supporting grid connection projects from the boundary point of the ownership of charging infrastructure to the power grid, and shall not charge any grid connection fees. The corresponding assets shall be fully included in the effective assets, and the costs shall be accounted for in accordance with the actual costs and recovered through the electricity transmission and distribution price.

Encourage charging service companies to innovate and establish commercial cooperation models for charging infrastructure through cooperation with vehicle manufacturers, crowdfunding, and other methods. Adopt online and offline integration methods to provide value-added services such as intelligent charging and discharging, e-commerce, and advertising, and enhance the sustainable development capabilities of charging service companies.
titlelist: Improve service system, innovate charging service business model.

name: Long-term Development Plan for the Automobile Industry (MIIT Joint Announcement [2017] No. 53) (MIIT, NDRC, MOST/April 6, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Since entering the new century, China's automobile industry has developed rapidly, forming a complete and well-matched industrial system. The research and development capabilities of complete vehicles have significantly improved, energy conservation and emission reduction have achieved remarkable results, and the quality level has steadily improved. Chinese brands have grown rapidly, and their international development capabilities have gradually increased. Especially in recent years, certain competitive advantages have been formed in the commercial vehicle and sports utility vehicle markets. The development of new energy vehicles has made significant progress, transitioning from the nurturing period to the growth period. In 2016, China's automobile production and sales exceeded 28 million vehicles, ranking first in the world for 8 consecutive years. Chinese brand automobile sales accounted for about 50% of the market share, and market recognition has greatly improved. The automobile industry continues to grow and strengthen, continuously enhancing its position and role in the national economy, and making outstanding contributions to promoting economic growth, promoting social employment, and improving people's well-being. For several consecutive years, the automobile-related industry's tax revenue accounted for more than 10% of the national tax revenue, the number of employees accounted for more than 10% of the national urban employment, and the automobile sales accounted for more than 10% of the national retail sales of goods. At the same time, the problem of China's automobile industry being large but not strong is still prominent, manifested in insufficient mastery of key core technologies, shortcomings in the industrial chain, the need for improvement in the innovation system, slow progress in international brand building, urgent need to enhance corporate strength, risks of overcapacity, and the need to improve the safety performance of commercial vehicles. The problems of energy, environmental protection, and transportation brought about by the huge number of automobiles are increasingly prominent.
titlelist: Development status and facing situation, China's automobile industry has made remarkable achievements.

name: Long-term Development Plan for the Automobile Industry (MIIT Joint Announcement [2017] No. 53) (MIIT, NDRC, MOST/April 6, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: New energy vehicles and intelligent connected vehicles are expected to become breakthroughs for seizing opportunities and surpassing development. Currently, China's new energy vehicle technology has greatly improved, the industry scale has rapidly expanded, and the industrial chain is becoming more perfect. The information technology industry's strength in the development of intelligent and connected vehicles continues to enhance, and the internet industry has certain advantages globally. The international discourse power of technology and standards in the field of information and communication has greatly increased, and the Beidou satellite navigation system is about to achieve global networking. The market demand, with huge potential and rich levels, provides continuous driving force and upward space for industrial development. With the acceleration of new industrialization and urbanization, as well as the development of emerging automobile markets overseas, China's automobile production will continue to maintain steady growth. It is estimated that the production will reach around 30 million vehicles in 2020 and around 35 million vehicles in 2025. The aftermarket scale of maintenance, finance and insurance, and used cars will rapidly expand. At the same time, differentiated and diversified consumer demands will drive enterprises to innovate and develop in multiple dimensions such as technology, products, services, and standards, seizing the development opportunities in emerging fields. The implementation of the strategy of building a manufacturing powerhouse and the construction of the Belt and Road provide important support and development opportunities for industrial development. The promotion and implementation of intelligent manufacturing will effectively promote industrial transformation and upgrading, gradually solidify the common technological foundation of industrial strength, and the Belt and Road construction will make overseas development channels more accessible, facilitating market development along the route. The mechanism for the automobile industry to collaborate with other advantageous industries in global layout and international development will accelerate its formation. To build a strong automobile country, we must seize the current rare strategic opportunities, actively respond to challenges, strengthen overall planning, enhance innovation-driven development, promote cross-border integration, improve institutional mechanisms, and promote structural adjustment and transformation and upgrading.
titlelist: Development status and facing situation, building a strong automobile country has a good foundation and favorable conditions.

name: Long-term Development Plan for the Automobile Industry (MIIT Joint Announcement [2017] No. 53) (MIIT, NDRC, MOST/April 6, 2017)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Strive to enter the ranks of the world's automotive powers after ten years of continuous efforts. Significant breakthroughs have been made in key technologies. The industrial innovation system continues to improve, and the innovation capabilities of enterprises have significantly enhanced. Energy-saving technologies such as power systems, efficient transmission systems, and automotive electronics have reached international advanced levels, while key core technologies such as power batteries and drive motors are at the forefront internationally. By 2020, several new energy vehicle companies will be cultivated to enter the top ten in the world, and intelligent connected vehicles will develop synchronously with international standards. By 2025, the influence and market share of backbone new energy vehicle companies will further increase globally, and intelligent connected vehicles will be at the forefront worldwide. The entire industry chain will achieve safety and controllability. Breakthroughs will be made in the weak links of the industrial chain, such as advanced automotive electronics like vehicle sensors and onboard chips, lightweight new materials, and high-end manufacturing equipment. Competitive component suppliers with international competitiveness will be cultivated, forming a complete industrial system from components to complete vehicles. By 2020, several automotive component enterprise groups with a scale exceeding 100 billion will be formed, possessing strong international competitive advantages in some key core technology areas. The quality of Chinese brand automobile products will significantly improve, and brand recognition, product reputation, and international influence will significantly enhance. By 2035, a hydrogen energy industry system will be formed, creating a diverse hydrogen energy application ecosystem covering transportation, energy storage, industry, and other fields. The proportion of renewable energy hydrogen in end-use energy consumption will significantly increase, playing an important supporting role in the green transformation and development of energy.
