name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The charging infrastructure is in its early stages both domestically and internationally. Due to factors such as urban planning, land use, building and distribution network renovations, installation conditions in residential areas, and investment and operation models, there are multiple stakeholders and difficulties in promoting its development. There is a high level of uncertainty surrounding electric vehicles and their charging technology. The electric vehicle industry is still in its early stages of development, and key technologies such as batteries and charging are rapidly evolving. Different technical solutions have significant differences in charging requirements, which increases the difficulty of infrastructure construction and management, increases investment and operational risks, and affects the enthusiasm of social capital participation. The development of charging infrastructure is not coordinated with the development of electric vehicles. In the process of developing the electric vehicle industry, there is a common problem of focusing on vehicles rather than charging infrastructure, resulting in a lack of charging stations where there are vehicles and a lack of vehicles where there are charging stations. On one hand, in some areas, the growth of electric vehicles is fast, but the scale of charging infrastructure construction is insufficient. On the other hand, due to low acceptance of electric vehicles by users and local protectionism, the overall growth of electric vehicles is lower than expected. In addition, some charging infrastructure layouts are unreasonable, and the facilities have poor universality, resulting in low utilization rates of charging infrastructure. The construction of charging infrastructure is difficult. It requires planning, land use, electricity, and other prerequisites, involving multiple regulatory authorities and related companies. The construction of charging infrastructure in social parking lots faces difficulties in coordination due to numerous dispersed stakeholders. In the private passenger car sector, many parking spaces are not suitable for installation, and for those who are suitable, there are issues of lack of support from homeowner associations and non-cooperation from property service companies. Furthermore, the construction of charging infrastructure also involves the transformation of public power grids, user-side power facilities, and road pipelines, which increases the difficulty of construction. Mature commercial models for charging services have not yet been formed. In some cities, progress has been made in exploring commercial models through measures such as implementing fuel surcharges, peak and off-peak electricity prices, and charging service fees in specific areas such as public transportation and taxis. However, these models are not yet ready for large-scale promotion and application. In the public charging service sector for the general public, commercial model exploration is still in its early stages. Due to the low number of electric vehicles, low utilization rates of facilities, and incomplete pricing mechanisms, charging service companies generally operate at a loss. The standardization system for charging infrastructure needs to be improved. Technical standards for charging infrastructure equipment interfaces, communication protocols, and other aspects need urgent improvement. Some issued technical standards are not strictly enforced, resulting in incompatibility between different brands of electric vehicles and charging infrastructure from different manufacturers, greatly reducing charging convenience. The construction standards for charging infrastructure projects need further improvement. The communication protocols and settlement systems between charging infrastructure and charging service platforms are not unified, and the service capabilities and quality of charging service platforms fail to meet user needs. Supportive policies need to be strengthened. Some local governments do not pay enough attention to the development of charging infrastructure and lack supportive policies. Charging infrastructure is not adequately considered in urban construction and related planning. Long-term land use policies for charging infrastructure need further clarification and refinement. The financial and tax support policies for charging infrastructure do not match the policies supporting electric vehicles, which results in insufficient attractiveness to social capital and inadequate coordination and promotion in places such as residential areas and social parking lots where installation is difficult.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: According to the growth trend of electric vehicles in China's specialized vehicles such as public transportation, taxis, sanitation and logistics, as well as government and private passenger cars, and in combination with the requirements and planning goals of the national new energy vehicle promotion and application policies, it is estimated that by 2020, the total number of electric vehicles in the country will exceed 5 million, including over 200,000 electric buses, over 300,000 electric taxis, over 200,000 electric sanitation and logistics vehicles, and over 4.3 million electric government and private passenger cars. According to the charging infrastructure requirements of electric vehicles in various application areas, it is estimated that from 2015 to 2020, 3,848 new bus charging and swapping stations, 2,462 taxi charging and swapping stations, 2,438 sanitation and logistics vehicle charging stations, 4.3 million dedicated charging piles for government and private car users, 2,397 urban public charging stations, 500,000 decentralized public charging piles, and 842 intercity fast charging stations will need to be built. In Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Liaoning, Shandong, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Guangdong, Hainan, and other regions with a good foundation for the development of electric vehicles, heavy haze control tasks, and superior application conditions, it is estimated that by 2020, the scale of electric vehicle promotion will reach 2.66 million vehicles, requiring the construction of 7,400 charging and swapping stations and 2.5 million charging piles. In demonstration and promotion areas such as Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Jiangxi, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Chongqing, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan, Shaanxi, and Gansu, it is estimated that by 2020, the scale of electric vehicle promotion will reach 2.23 million vehicles, requiring the construction of 4,300 charging and swapping stations and 2.2 million charging piles. In active promotion areas that have not yet been included in the national new energy vehicle promotion and application scope, such as Guangxi, Tibet, Qinghai, Ningxia, and Xinjiang, it is estimated that by 2020, the scale of electric vehicle promotion will reach 110,000 vehicles, requiring the construction of 400 charging and swapping stations and 100,000 charging piles.

content: According to the predicted results based on demand, the construction goals for charging infrastructure are determined in accordance with the principle of moderate advancement. By 2020, there will be more than 12,000 new centralized charging and swapping stations and over 4.8 million decentralized charging piles to meet the charging needs of 5 million electric vehicles nationwide. Priority will be given to the construction of charging infrastructure in public service areas such as public transportation, taxis, sanitation, and logistics. There will be over 3,850 new charging and swapping stations for buses, 2,500 for taxis, and 2,450 for sanitation and logistics vehicles. Efforts will be made to promote the combination of government and private passenger vehicles with the construction of charging piles in residential areas and parking spaces of institutions, with over 4.3 million dedicated charging piles added to meet basic charging needs. Facilities that meet the conditions are encouraged to be open to the public. Public charging infrastructure will be reasonably distributed in social parking lots, and in accordance with the principle of moderate advancement, over 2,400 urban public charging stations and 500,000 decentralized public charging piles will be added to meet temporary charging needs. Combined with the backbone highway network, a four vertical and four horizontal intercity fast charging network will be built, with over 800 intercity fast charging stations added to meet intercity travel needs. name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)

In cities promoting the use of new energy vehicles, the ratio of public charging piles to electric vehicles should not be lower than 1:7, and the radius of public charging services in the core areas of cities should be less than 0.9 kilometers. In other cities, the ratio of public charging piles to electric vehicles should strive to reach 1:12, and the radius of public charging services in the core areas of cities should strive to be less than 2 kilometers. The intercity fast charging network in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta regions, which are key areas for haze prevention and control, will be built first, achieving interconnection between major cities.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The main body of the dedicated charging infrastructure is built with user residential parking spaces, internal parking lots in units, dedicated stations for public transportation and taxis, etc. The public charging infrastructure is supplemented by parking lots built in urban public buildings, social public parking lots, and temporary parking spaces on roadsides. Inter-city fast charging stations are built in independently occupied urban areas, battery swapping stations, and service areas on highways. The construction of a moderately advanced, well-planned, and fully functional charging infrastructure system is accelerated with the support of a smart charging service platform.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the construction of charging infrastructure system.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: For public service electric vehicles operating on fixed routes such as buses, sanitation, airport commuting, etc., charging infrastructure should be prioritized in conjunction with the construction of parking stations based on route operation needs. A certain number of independently occupied fast charging stations and battery swapping stations can be built according to actual demand. For public service electric vehicles operating on non-fixed routes such as taxis, logistics, rentals, public security patrols, etc., the potential of internal parking stations in relevant units for building charging infrastructure should be fully tapped. Simultaneously, the construction of urban public charging infrastructure should be promoted, and the convenience of vehicle use should be improved through efficient complementarity between internal dedicated facilities and public facilities.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the construction of charging infrastructure system, and focus on advancing the construction of charging infrastructure in the public service sector.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: For users with fixed parking spaces, priority should be given to combining the construction of charging piles with parking spaces. For users without fixed parking spaces, enterprises are encouraged to build a certain proportion of public charging spaces, establish a time-sharing sharing mechanism for charging spaces, and create conditions for charging for users through the construction and transformation of integrated mechanical and three-dimensional parking and charging facilities. Guide charging service providers, property service providers, and other related enterprises to participate in the construction and operation of charging infrastructure in residential areas, encourage enterprises to carry out unified parking space transformation and directly handle installation and power connection procedures, allow enterprises to charge users appropriately without violating relevant regulations, and establish a market-oriented mechanism that reflects the responsibilities, rights, and interests of all parties, effectively solving the last mile problem faced by charging infrastructure construction in residential areas.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the construction of charging infrastructure system, accelerate the construction of charging infrastructure at residential areas for users.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Government agencies, public institutions, and enterprises and institutions that meet the conditions should combine their electric vehicle equipment renewal plans and the demand for employees to purchase and use electric vehicles. They should utilize the internal parking resources of the units to plan dedicated parking spaces for electric vehicles and build charging piles. Local areas can include the construction of charging infrastructure by relevant units in the scope of energy conservation and emission reduction assessment and rewards.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the construction of charging infrastructure system, actively carry out the construction of charging infrastructure in internal parking lots of units.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Priority should be given to the construction of parking lots in conjunction with large shopping malls, sports venues, and other buildings, as well as the development of urban public charging infrastructure in transportation hubs and park-and-ride (P+R) facilities. Encouragement should be given to the construction of public fast-charging facilities at gas stations that meet the requirements, and the appropriate construction of independent public fast-charging stations. The layout of public charging infrastructure should follow the principle of gradually advancing from the city center to the outskirts and from priority development areas to general areas, gradually increasing the density of public charging infrastructure. Units and individuals with the necessary conditions should be encouraged to open their charging infrastructure to the public. In line with actual needs, the integration of mechanical and three-dimensional parking and charging facilities should be promoted, which have a small footprint, low cost, and quick results, in order to improve land utilization efficiency.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the construction of charging infrastructure system and accelerate the construction of urban public charging networks.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Relying on parking spaces at highway service areas, construct an intercity fast charging network. Prioritize the construction of intercity fast charging networks in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta regions, and achieve interconnection between regions. Promote the construction of intercity fast charging networks in the Yangtze River Midstream Urban Agglomeration, Central Plains Urban Agglomeration, Chengdu-Chongqing Urban Agglomeration, and Harbin-Changchun Urban Agglomeration at the appropriate time. By the end of 2020, initially establish an intercity fast charging network covering most major cities to meet the intercity and interprovincial travel needs of electric vehicles.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the construction of charging infrastructure system, vigorously promote the construction of intercity fast charging network.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: The construction of the smart charging service platform should be considered in sync with the construction of charging infrastructure. It should integrate technologies such as the Internet, Internet of Things, intelligent transportation, and big data. Through Internet + charging infrastructure, it actively promotes the energy and information interaction between electric vehicles and smart grids, and enhances the intelligence level of charging services. It encourages the provision of charging navigation, status inquiry, charging reservation, and fee settlement services based on user needs, expanding value-added services, and improving user experience and operational efficiency.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the construction of charging infrastructure system and simultaneously build a smart charging service platform.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Each region should include the construction and renovation projects of charging infrastructure in the local distribution network special plan, and coordinate with other relevant plans. Support should be provided in terms of land guarantee and corridor access, effectively achieving facility construction, grid priority. According to the demand for charging infrastructure in various types of buildings, the electricity design standards for various types of buildings should be reasonably increased, and the revision of relevant standards and specifications should be strengthened. Power grid enterprises should strengthen the construction and renovation of charging infrastructure in the supporting distribution network, ensure barrier-free access to charging infrastructure, ensure unimpeded power supply, and meet the operational needs of charging and swapping facilities.
titlelist: Key tasks: strengthen the supporting power grid guarantee capability, strengthen the construction of supporting power grids.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Electric grid enterprises should provide convenient conditions for the access of charging infrastructure to the grid, open up green channels, optimize processes, simplify procedures, improve efficiency, and complete tasks within a specified time. The supporting grid connection projects from the boundary point of the ownership of the charging infrastructure to the grid are the responsibility of the electric grid enterprises for construction, operation, and maintenance. They are not allowed to charge grid connection fees. The corresponding assets are fully included in the effective assets, and the corresponding costs are accurately calculated as permitted costs and included in the grid transmission and distribution price recovery.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthening the supporting power grid guarantee capability and improving power supply services.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Accelerate the revision and implementation of standards for charging interfaces and communication protocols, actively promote the revision of standards for interoperability testing of charging interfaces and data exchange between service platforms, carry out the transformation of existing charging infrastructure, accelerate the realization of unified charging standards, and achieve compatibility and interoperability between charging equipment from different manufacturers and electric vehicles of different brands. Further improve the standards and management specifications for the construction of charging infrastructure-related projects, as well as operation standards and management specifications for measurement, billing, and settlement. Further research on safety technical measures such as fire protection for the installation of electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and timely revise and improve relevant standards; improve standards for charging and swapping equipment, electric vehicle batteries, and clarify fire safety requirements. Accelerate the establishment of a road traffic signage system and related specifications for charging infrastructure.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the improvement of standards and technological innovation, and expedite the promotion of charging standardization work.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Give full play to the role of enterprises as the main force in innovation, accelerate the research and development of new charging and swapping technologies and equipment such as high power density, high conversion efficiency, high applicability, wireless charging, and mobile charging. Strengthen key technologies such as testing and certification, safety protection, bidirectional interaction with the power grid, battery cascading utilization, unmanned self-service, and coordinated control of charging stations. Relying on demonstration projects, actively explore technical solutions for the integration of charging infrastructure with smart grids, distributed renewable energy, and intelligent transportation.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the improvement of standards and technological innovation, actively support the research and application of key technologies.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Each region should effectively integrate various public resources such as public transportation, taxi stations, and social public parking lots. Through government and social capital cooperation (PPP) and other methods, market entities should be cultivated, and social capital should be introduced to construct and operate public service charging infrastructure, urban public charging networks, and intelligent service platforms. Accelerate the establishment of market mechanisms for the construction and operation of charging infrastructure in private residential areas and internal parking lots of units. Build a unified, open, and competitively orderly charging service market.
titlelist: Key tasks, explore sustainable business models, actively introduce social capital.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Encourage the exploration of the development mode that combines large-scale charging and swapping stations with commercial real estate, and guide commercial places such as shopping malls, supermarkets, cinemas, and convenience stores to provide auxiliary charging services for users. Encourage innovation in business cooperation models between charging service companies and vehicle manufacturers in sales and after-sales services. Make full use of financing leasing, pledge of franchise rights, and other financing models, learn from contract energy management and other business models, and promote business model innovation. Vigorously promote the commercial models and service innovation related to Internet + charging infrastructure, introduce crowdfunding, and combine online and offline emerging business models, actively expand value-added services such as intelligent charging and discharging, e-commerce, and advertising, attract more social resources to participate, and improve the sustainable development capabilities of enterprises.
titlelist: Key tasks, explore sustainable business models, and encourage the expansion of various business models.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Each region should combine the needs of promoting and applying new energy vehicles, and follow the principles of adapting to local conditions and being moderately ahead. Focus on the key and difficult points of developing charging infrastructure in different levels and fields, actively carry out construction and operation model demonstrations in areas such as urban and county charging infrastructure system construction, residential and unit supporting charging facilities, and intercity fast charging network construction. Through demonstration projects, streamline the management mechanism of charging infrastructure construction and operation, explore systematic support policies and feasible business models, accelerate the overall process of charging infrastructure construction, and improve development quality, speed, and efficiency. Actively explore the application of new technologies such as unmanned self-service, wireless charging, mobile charging, and smart grid in demonstration projects.
titlelist: Key tasks, carry out relevant demonstration work, carry out demonstration of construction and operation models.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Each region should incorporate the relevant content of the special planning for charging infrastructure into urban and rural planning, improve the layout of independently occupied charging infrastructure, and specify the construction ratio or reservation requirements for charging facilities in parking lots of various types of buildings and social public parking lots. In principle, newly built residential areas should have 100% construction of charging infrastructure or reserved installation conditions for parking spaces. The proportion of parking spaces in large public buildings and social public parking lots that are equipped with charging infrastructure or reserved installation conditions should not be less than 10%. At least one public charging station should be built for every 2,000 electric vehicles. Relevant departments and local governments should incorporate intercity fast charging networks into relevant highway planning and specify the requirements for building charging infrastructure in highway service areas.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.

Following the land supply model for gas stations, priority should be given to arranging land supply based on the availability of state-owned construction land. For newly constructed projects that require the construction of charging infrastructure, the accessory requirements can be included in the land supply conditions. The holder of the land use right is allowed to cooperate with other market entities to invest in and operate the charging infrastructure as required. It is encouraged to build charging infrastructure in existing buildings such as parking lots, bus stations, social public parking lots, and highway service areas. Local governments should coordinate with relevant units to provide support in terms of land use.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase support for land use.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.

According to the law and regulations, fire design review, fire acceptance, and random inspections should be conducted on the establishment of charging infrastructure, and fire supervision and inspection should be strengthened. The industry regulatory authorities should urge the units or individuals operating and using charging infrastructure to strengthen daily fire safety inspections and management of charging infrastructure and its establishment, and promptly eliminate safety hazards.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen security management.

name: Guidelines for the Development of Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (2015-2020) (Energy Reform [2015] No. 1454) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development/ October 9, 2015)
category: 节能环保 translates to energy conservation and environmental protection in English.
content: Develop a nationwide unified private user residential charging infrastructure construction and management demonstration text. The real estate administrative departments, street offices, and neighborhood committees in various regions should actively strengthen guidance and supervision of the homeowners' committees, and guide homeowners to support the construction of charging infrastructure. The homeowners' general meeting and homeowners' committee should fulfill their autonomous management responsibilities in accordance with the law, clarify the process of constructing and managing charging infrastructure within the property service area based on the demonstration text and their own actual situation, and incorporate relevant content into the property service contract. The real estate administrative departments in various regions should establish corresponding punishment measures for property service companies that refuse to cooperate or obstruct the construction of charging infrastructure, and deduct the credit information scores of the relevant companies and responsible persons.

Promote pledge financing methods such as equity, project income rights, and franchise rights, accelerate the establishment of a multi-level guarantee system including fiscal investment and social capital input, actively promote the establishment of financing guarantee funds, and broaden the financing channels for charging infrastructure investment and operation enterprises and equipment manufacturers. Encourage the use of social capital to establish special funds for the development of charging infrastructure, issue bonds for charging infrastructure enterprises, and explore the use of basic pension insurance funds to support the construction of charging infrastructure.

Increase the openness of national scientific and technological plans, initiate a batch of major scientific and technological cooperation projects, study the establishment of global scientific research funds, and implement scientist exchange programs. Support the establishment of international scientific and technological organizations in China and the appointment of foreign scientists in Chinese scientific and technological academic organizations.
titlelist: Persist in innovation-driven development to comprehensively shape new advantages in development, and improve the system and mechanism for scientific and technological innovation.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on the needs of industrial transformation and upgrading and consumer upgrading, expand the effective supply of the service industry, improve service efficiency and quality, and build a new system of high-quality, efficient, structurally optimized, and competitive service industry. The first section promotes the integrated development of productive service industries. Guided by the high-quality development of service manufacturing, promote the specialization and high-end extension of productive service industries. Focus on improving industrial innovation capabilities, accelerate the development of research and development design, industrial design, business consulting, inspection and testing certification, and other services. Focus on improving factor allocation efficiency, promote innovative development of supply chain finance, information data, human resources, and other services. Focus on enhancing the advantages of the entire industry chain and improving the development level of modern logistics, procurement and distribution, production control, operation management, after-sales service, and other areas. Promote the deep integration of modern service industries with advanced manufacturing and modern agriculture, deepen business connections, chain extensions, and technological penetration, support the development of new specialized service institutions such as intelligent manufacturing system solutions and process reengineering. Cultivate service enterprises with international competitiveness. The second section accelerates the quality development of life service industries. Guided by improving convenience and enhancing service experience, promote the high-quality and diversified upgrading of life service industries. Accelerate the development of health, elderly care, childcare, culture, tourism, sports, property management, and other service industries, strengthen the supply of public welfare and basic service industries, and expand the coverage of various services throughout the life cycle. Continuously promote the improvement and expansion of housekeeping services, integrate with smart communities, elderly care, and childcare. Encourage innovation in commercial and trade circulation formats and models, promote digital and intelligent transformation and cross-border integration, and meet consumer needs through online and offline channels. Accelerate the improvement of standards for elderly care, housekeeping, and other services, improve the certification and accreditation system for life service industries, and promote the professional and trustworthy development of life service industries. The third section deepens the reform and opening up of the service sector. Expand the opening of the service industry to the domestic and foreign markets, further relax market access, comprehensively clean up unreasonable restrictions, and encourage social forces to expand diversified and multi-level service supply. Improve the policy system supporting the development of the service industry, innovate policies on land, finance, taxation, and pricing to adapt to the needs of new formats, new models, and industrial integration development in the service industry. Improve the service quality standard system, strengthen the implementation and promotion of standards. Accelerate the formulation of key service sector regulatory catalogs, processes, and standards, and build an efficient and coordinated service industry regulatory system. Improve the system for evaluating professional titles in the service sector, and encourage practitioners to participate in vocational skills training and assessment. Deepen comprehensive reforms and expand opening up in the service industry.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of a modern industrial system, consolidate and strengthen the foundation of the real economy, and promote the prosperous development of the service industry.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Coordinate and promote the construction of traditional infrastructure and new infrastructure, and build a modern infrastructure system that is comprehensive, efficient, practical, intelligent, green, safe, and reliable. The first section focuses on accelerating the construction of new infrastructure. Focus on strengthening digital transformation, intelligent upgrading, and integrated innovation support, and layout the construction of new infrastructure such as information infrastructure, integrated infrastructure, and innovative infrastructure. Build a high-speed ubiquitous, integrated, interconnected, safe, and efficient information infrastructure, enhance data sensing, transmission, storage, and computing capabilities. Accelerate the large-scale deployment of 5G networks, increase the user penetration rate to 56%, and promote the upgrade and expansion of gigabit fiber optic networks. Proactively plan for the reserve of 6G network technology. Expand the interconnection nodes of the backbone network, establish a batch of international communication entry and exit points, and comprehensively promote the commercial deployment of Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6). Implement the improvement project for the basic network of small and medium-sized cities in the central and western regions. Promote the comprehensive development of the Internet of Things and create IoT access capabilities that support fixed-mobile convergence and wide-narrow integration. Accelerate the construction of a national integrated big data center system, strengthen the coordination of computing power and intelligent scheduling, build several national hub nodes and big data center clusters, and construct E-level and 10E-level supercomputing centers. Actively and steadily develop the industrial Internet and connected vehicles. Build a globally covered and efficiently operated communication, navigation, and remote sensing space infrastructure system, and construct commercial space launch centers. Accelerate the digital transformation of traditional infrastructure such as transportation, energy, and municipal facilities, and strengthen the construction of ubiquitous perception, terminal networking, and intelligent scheduling systems. Play the leading role of the market, open up diversified investment channels, and build a new infrastructure standard system. The second section focuses on accelerating the construction of a strong transportation country. Build a modern comprehensive transportation system, promote the integrated development of various transportation modes, and improve network effects and operational efficiency. Improve the comprehensive transportation corridors, strengthen the construction of strategic backbone channels for entering Xinjiang and Tibet, the central and western regions, and along the Yangtze River, the coast, and the border, and orderly promote the upgrade and expansion of capacity-constrained channels, and strengthen interconnection with neighboring countries. Build a fast network, basically connect the Eight Verticals and Eight Horizontals high-speed railways, improve the quality of the national expressway network, and accelerate the construction of world-class port clusters and airport clusters. Improve the trunk network, accelerate the construction of conventional-speed railways and electrification transformation of existing railways, optimize the layout of railway passenger and freight transportation, promote the upgrade and connectivity of bottleneck sections of national and provincial roads, promote the expansion and upgrade of high-grade inland waterways, steadily build branch airports, general aviation airports, and cargo airports, and actively develop general aviation. Strengthen the construction of postal facilities and implement the entering villages, entering factories, and going global express delivery project. Promote the integration of transportation in urban agglomerations, accelerate the construction of intercity railways and urban (suburban) railways, build a high-speed ring road system, and orderly promote the development of urban rail transit. Improve transportation accessibility, promote regional railway construction, accelerate the construction of border-to-border roads, continue to promote the construction of Four Good Rural Roads, and improve road safety facilities. Build a multi-level and integrated comprehensive transportation hub system, optimize the layout of hub stations, promote intensive and comprehensive development, improve the integrated transportation system, develop passenger intermodal transportation and multimodal freight transportation, and promote full-service one-stop and one-form services. Promote the construction of the China-Europe freight train assembly center. Deepen the reform of railway enterprises, comprehensively deepen the reform of the air traffic control system, and promote the reform of the highway toll system and maintenance system. The third section focuses on building a modern energy system. Promote energy revolution, build a clean, low-carbon, safe, and efficient energy system, and improve energy supply security. Accelerate the development of non-fossil energy, adhere to the combination of centralized and distributed energy, vigorously expand the scale of wind power and photovoltaic power generation, accelerate the development of distributed energy in the eastern and central regions, orderly develop offshore wind power, accelerate the construction of the Southwest hydropower base, safely and steadily promote coastal nuclear power construction, and build a number of multi-energy complementary clean energy bases, with the proportion of non-fossil energy in total energy consumption increasing to about 20%. Promote the concentration of coal production in resource-rich areas, reasonably control the scale of coal-fired power construction and the pace of development, and promote the substitution of electricity for coal. Gradually open up the market access for oil and gas exploration and development, accelerate the utilization of deep-sea, deep-layer, and unconventional oil and gas resources, and promote oil and gas reserves and production. Develop and utilize geothermal energy according to local conditions. Improve the utilization rate of ultra-high voltage transmission channels. Accelerate the intelligent transformation of power grid infrastructure and the construction of smart microgrids, improve the complementary and intelligent regulation capabilities of the power system, strengthen the connection between power generation, grid, load, and storage, enhance the absorption and storage capacity of clean energy, enhance the transmission and distribution capacity to remote areas, promote the flexible transformation of coal-fired power plants, accelerate the construction of pumped storage power stations, and scale up the application of new energy storage technologies. Improve the cross-regional transportation channels and integrated transportation system of coal, accelerate the construction of natural gas trunk pipelines, and improve the oil and gas interconnection network. The fourth section focuses on strengthening water conservancy infrastructure construction. Based on the overall basin and balanced allocation of water resources, strengthen the governance and protection of river systems across administrative regions and the construction of key projects, coordinate and support the coordination of large, medium, small, and micro water conservancy facilities, and improve the optimization of water resources allocation and the defense against drought and flood capabilities. Adhere to water conservation as a priority, improve the water resources allocation system, construct backbone projects for water resources allocation, and strengthen the construction of key water sources and urban emergency backup water source projects. Implement flood control and upgrading projects, solve weak links in flood control, accelerate the construction of flood control and control hub projects, small and medium-sized river management, and dangerous and risky reservoir reinforcement, comprehensively promote the construction of embankments and flood storage areas. Strengthen the protection and restoration of water conservation areas, increase efforts to protect and comprehensively manage key rivers and lakes, and restore the water ecological system with clear water and green banks.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of a modern industrial system, consolidate and strengthen the foundation of the real economy, and build a modern infrastructure system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Relying on a strong domestic market, connecting the production, distribution, circulation, and consumption sectors, and achieving a higher level of dynamic balance between demand-driven supply and supply-driven demand, promoting a virtuous cycle of the national economy. The first section is to enhance the adaptability of the supply system. Deepen the supply-side structural reform, improve the ability of supply to adapt and lead to the creation of new demand. Adapt to personalized, differentiated, and quality consumer demand, promote innovation in production models and industrial organizational methods, continuously expand the supply of high-quality consumer goods and mid-to-high-end products, and education, medical care, elderly care, and other service supplies, improve product service quality and customer satisfaction, and promote supply-demand coordination. Optimize and upgrade the supply structure, promote the coordinated development of agriculture, manufacturing, services, energy resources, and other industries. Improve the industrial supporting system, accelerate the marketization of competitive links in natural monopoly industries, and achieve effective connection between upstream and downstream, production and supply, and sales. Improve the long-term mechanism for resolving excess capacity through marketization and the rule of law, and improve laws, regulations, and supporting policies for enterprise mergers and reorganizations. Establish and improve a hierarchical quality system, accelerate the upgrading and iteration of standards, and the application of international standards. Carry out the Made in China brand creation campaign, protect the development of time-honored Chinese brands, and enhance the influence and competitiveness of independent brands, taking the lead in the fields of cosmetics, clothing, home textiles, electronic products, and other consumer goods. Cultivate a group of high-end brands. The second section is to promote the smooth flow of resource factors. Remove the obstacles that restrict the reasonable flow of factors, correct the imbalance and mismatch of resource factors, and smooth the national economic cycle from the source. Improve the ability of financial services to the real economy, improve the long-term funding supply system for the real economy, innovate financial products and services that directly serve the real economy, and enhance the financing function of multi-level capital markets. Implement a long-term mechanism for the stable and healthy development of the real estate market, and promote the balanced development of the real estate industry and the real economy. Effectively improve the skills of workers, improve the quality of employment and income levels, and form a virtuous cycle of human capital improvement and industrial transformation and upgrading. Improve the mechanism for the free flow of urban and rural factors, build a regional industrial gradient transfer pattern, and promote positive interaction between urban and rural areas. The third section is to strengthen the support role of the circulation system. Deepen the reform of the circulation system, smooth the channels of commodity and service circulation, improve circulation efficiency, and reduce transaction costs for the whole society. Accelerate the construction of a unified domestic market, optimize the market environment in line with international advanced rules and best practices, promote the coordination and unification of standards, rules, and policies in different regions and industries, and effectively eliminate local protectionism, industry monopolies, and market segmentation. Build a modern logistics system, accelerate the development of cold chain logistics, coordinate the construction of logistics hub facilities, backbone routes, regional distribution centers, and end distribution nodes, improve the facilities of national logistics hubs and backbone cold chain logistics bases, improve the three-level logistics distribution system in counties and towns, develop high-speed rail express and other railway fast freight products, strengthen the construction of international air cargo transportation capacity, and enhance international maritime competitiveness. Optimize international logistics channels, accelerate the formation of a connected, safe, and efficient logistics network. Improve the modern commercial circulation system, cultivate a group of modern circulation enterprises with global competitiveness, support the transformation and upgrading of convenience stores, farmers' markets, and other commercial circulation facilities, develop contactless transaction services, strengthen the standardization and green development of commercial circulation. Accelerate the establishment of an emergency logistics system with sufficient reserves, rapid response, and strong shock resistance. The fourth section is to improve the policy system to promote domestic circulation. Maintain a reasonable level of fiscal expenditure and deficit ratio, improve policies for reducing taxes and fees, build a tax system that is conducive to expanding enterprise investment, increasing research and development investment, adjusting income distribution, and reducing consumer burdens. Maintain reasonable and abundant liquidity, ensure that the growth rate of money supply and social financing scale matches the nominal economic growth rate, innovate structural policy tools, guide financial institutions to increase support for key areas and weak links, and regulate the development of consumer credit. Promote the transformation of industrial policies to be inclusive and functional, strengthen the fundamental position of competition policies, support technological innovation and structural upgrading. Improve income distribution, social security, and public service systems that are compatible with the level of economic development.
titlelist: Form a strong domestic market and build a new development pattern, smooth the domestic circulation.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Based on the domestic circulation, we will promote the construction of a strong domestic market and a strong trading nation, form a powerful gravitational field for global resource elements, promote the coordinated development of domestic and foreign demand, imports and exports, and foreign investment and overseas investment, and accelerate the cultivation of new advantages in international cooperation and competition. The first section promotes the coordinated development of imports and exports. Improve the integrated regulation system of domestic and foreign trade, promote the connection of laws and regulations, regulatory systems, business qualifications, quality standards, inspection and quarantine, certification and accreditation, etc., and promote the same line, same standard, and same quality. Reduce import tariffs and institutional costs, expand imports of high-quality consumer goods, advanced technology, important equipment, energy resources, etc., and promote diversified import sources. Improve export policies, optimize the quality and structure of export commodities, and steadily increase the added value of exports. Optimize the layout of international markets, guide enterprises to deepen traditional export markets, expand emerging markets, expand trade with neighboring countries, and stabilize international market share. Promote the transformation and upgrading of processing trade, deepen the construction of foreign trade transformation and upgrading bases, customs special supervision areas, trade promotion platforms, and international marketing service networks, accelerate the development of new models such as cross-border e-commerce and market procurement trade, encourage the construction of overseas warehouses, and ensure the smooth operation of the foreign trade industry chain and supply chain. Innovate and develop trade in services, promote the construction of pilot open platforms for innovative development of trade in services, and improve the level of trade digitalization. Implement the integration of trade and investment. Hold exhibitions such as the China International Import Expo, China Import and Export Fair, and China International Trade in Services Fair. The second section aims to improve the level of international two-way investment. Adhere to the principle of both attracting foreign investment and encouraging domestic companies to invest overseas, make efficient use of global resource elements and market space through high-level two-way investment, improve the guarantee mechanism for industrial chain and supply chain, and promote the improvement of industrial competitiveness. Attract and utilize foreign investment to a greater extent, orderly promote the opening of telecommunications, the Internet, education, culture, medical care, and other related fields. Fully optimize foreign investment services, strengthen the promotion and protection of foreign investment, give full play to the demonstration effect of major foreign investment projects, support foreign investment in high-end manufacturing, high-tech, traditional manufacturing transformation and upgrading, modern services, and investment in central and western regions, support foreign-funded enterprises in establishing research and development centers and participating in national science and technology programs. Encourage reinvestment of profits by foreign-funded enterprises. Adhere to the main role of enterprises, innovate overseas investment methods, optimize overseas investment structure and layout, and enhance risk prevention capabilities and returns. Improve overseas production service networks and distribution systems, accelerate the international development of productive service industries such as finance, consulting, accounting, and law, and promote the internationalization of Chinese products, services, technology, brands, and standards. Support enterprises in integrating into the global industrial chain and supply chain, and improve their ability and level of multinational operation. Guide enterprises to strengthen compliance management and prevent and resolve various risks such as overseas political, economic, and security risks. Promote the construction of multilateral and bilateral investment cooperation mechanisms, improve policies and service systems to promote and guarantee overseas investment, and promote legislation on overseas investment.
titlelist: Form a strong domestic market and build a new development pattern, promoting domestic and international dual circulation.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deepen the implementation of the strategy to expand domestic demand, enhance the fundamental role of consumption in economic development, and the key role of investment in optimizing the supply structure, and build a strong domestic market with strong consumer and investment demand. Section 1: Comprehensive promotion of consumption. In line with the trend of upgrading residents' consumption, combine the expansion of consumption with the improvement of people's quality of life, promote the development of consumption towards green, healthy, and safe development, and steadily improve residents' consumption levels. Enhance traditional consumption, accelerate the transformation from purchase management to use management of consumer goods such as automobiles, improve the mandatory scrapping system and the recycling and disposal system for durable consumer goods such as old household appliances and consumer electronics, and promote the healthy development of housing consumption. Cultivate new types of consumption, develop information consumption, digital consumption, and green consumption, encourage the development of new models and formats such as customized, experiential, intelligent, and fashionable consumption. Develop service consumption, relax market access in the service consumption field, promote the improvement and expansion of consumption in education and training, medical health, elderly care and childcare, culture, tourism, and sports, and accelerate the integration of online and offline development. Appropriately increase public consumption and improve the efficiency of public service expenditure. Expand holiday consumption, improve the holiday system, and fully implement the paid vacation system. Cultivate and build international consumption center cities, and create a number of regional consumption centers. Improve the integration of urban and rural consumption networks, expand the coverage of e-commerce in rural areas, improve the consumption environment in counties, and promote the upgrading of rural consumption levels. Improve the policy of downtown duty-free shops, and plan and build a number of downtown duty-free shops with Chinese characteristics. Take measures to increase residents' income and reduce their burdens, continuously expand the middle-income group, and continuously unleash consumption potential. Strengthen the protection of consumer rights and interests, improve quality standards and post-evaluation systems, improve systems such as the recall of defective products, monitoring of product injuries, and product quality guarantees, improve diversified consumer rights protection mechanisms and dispute resolution mechanisms. Section 2: Expand investment space. Optimize the investment structure, improve investment efficiency, and maintain reasonable investment growth. Accelerate the filling of shortfalls in infrastructure, municipal engineering, agriculture and rural areas, public safety, ecological environment protection, public health, material reserves, disaster prevention and reduction, and people's livelihood security, promote enterprise equipment renewal and technological transformation, and expand investment in strategic emerging industries. Promote the construction of new types of infrastructure, new urbanization, transportation and water conservancy, and other major projects that promote consumption, benefit people's livelihood, adjust structure, and increase momentum. Implement major projects related to national strategies, such as the Sichuan-Tibet Railway, the Western Land-Sea New Passage, the national water network, the development of hydropower in the lower reaches of the Yarlung Zangbo River, interstellar exploration, the industrialization of the Beidou Navigation System, and promote the construction of major projects such as major scientific research facilities, major ecological system protection and restoration, public health emergency support, major water diversion and flood control, power transmission and gas supply, and transportation along the border, along the river, and along the coast, which have a strong foundation, increased functionality, and long-term benefits. Deepen the reform of the investment and financing system, give full play to the role of government investment, stimulate the vitality of private investment, and form a market-oriented investment-driven growth mechanism. Improve project planning, reserve, and promotion mechanisms, increase the guarantee of funds, land, and other factors, and accelerate the implementation and effectiveness of investment projects. Promote government and social capital cooperation (PPP) in an orderly manner, promote the healthy development of real estate investment trusts (REITs) in the infrastructure field, effectively revitalize existing assets, and form a virtuous cycle of existing assets and new investments.
titlelist: Form a strong domestic market and build a new development pattern, accelerate the cultivation of a complete domestic demand system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Persist in giving equal importance to regulation and development, promote the unity of development and standardized management, build a digital rule system, and create an open, healthy, and secure digital ecosystem. The first section is to establish sound rules for the data element market. Coordinate the development and utilization of data, privacy protection, and public security, accelerate the establishment of basic systems and standard specifications for data resource property rights, transaction circulation, cross-border transmission, and security protection. Establish a sound mechanism for data property rights transactions and industry self-discipline, cultivate standardized data trading platforms and market entities, develop market operation systems such as data asset assessment, registration and settlement, transaction matching, and dispute arbitration. Strengthen the protection of data involving national interests, trade secrets, and personal privacy, accelerate the basic legislation in the fields of data security and personal information protection, and strengthen the security protection of data resources throughout their lifecycle. Improve the system of classified and graded protection of data applicable to the big data environment. Strengthen data security assessment and promote the orderly flow of data across borders. The second section is to create a standardized and orderly policy environment. Build a policy and regulatory system that is compatible with the development of the digital economy. Improve the management standards for the sharing economy, platform economy, and new individual economy, clean up unreasonable administrative permits, qualification matters, and support the innovative development and enhanced international competitiveness of platform enterprises. Strengthen the regulation of the internet platform economy in accordance with the law and regulations, clarify the positioning and regulatory rules of platform enterprises, improve the legal norms for monopoly determination, and crack down on monopolistic and unfair competition practices. Explore the establishment of regulatory frameworks for unmanned driving, online medical care, financial technology, intelligent distribution, etc., and improve relevant laws, regulations, and ethical review rules. Improve the statistical monitoring system for the digital economy. The third section is to strengthen network security protection. Improve national laws, regulations, and institutional standards for network security, and strengthen the security guarantee for important data resources, important networks, and information systems in key areas. Establish and improve the protection system for critical information infrastructure, enhance security protection and maintenance capabilities for political security. Strengthen network security risk assessment and review. Strengthen the construction of network security infrastructure, enhance cross-domain sharing of network security information and work coordination, enhance the ability to discover network security threats, monitor and warn, emergency command, and trace attacks. Strengthen the research and development of key network security technologies, accelerate the innovation of artificial intelligence security technologies, and enhance the comprehensive competitiveness of the network security industry. Strengthen network security publicity, education, and talent training. The fourth section is to promote the construction of a community with a shared future in cyberspace. Promote international exchanges and cooperation in cyberspace, promote the formulation of international rules for the digital and cyberspace based on the United Nations as the main channel and the United Nations Charter as the basic principle. Promote the establishment of a multilateral, democratic, and transparent global internet governance system, establish a more fair and reasonable governance mechanism for network infrastructure and resources. Actively participate in the formulation of international rules and digital technology standards for data security, digital currency, and digital taxation. Promote the construction of a global network security cooperation mechanism, build an international coordination and cooperation mechanism for protecting data elements, handling network security incidents, and combating cybercrime. Provide digital assistance such as technology, equipment, and services to underdeveloped countries, so that all countries can share the dividends of the digital age. Actively promote cultural exchanges and mutual learning in cyberspace.
titlelist: Accelerate digital development, build a digital China, and create a good digital ecosystem.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Looking ahead to 2035, China will basically achieve socialist modernization. Economic strength, technological strength, and comprehensive national power will greatly increase. The total economic output and per capita income of urban and rural residents will reach new heights. Key core technologies will achieve major breakthroughs, propelling China into the forefront of innovative countries. China will basically achieve new industrialization, informatization, urbanization, and agricultural modernization, and build a modern economic system. China will basically achieve modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity, ensuring that the rights of the people to equal participation and equal development are fully protected. China will basically establish a rule of law country, rule of law government, and rule of law society. China will become a strong cultural country, strong education country, strong talent country, strong sports country, and a healthy China. The national quality and social civilization will reach new heights, and the national cultural soft power will significantly increase. A green production and lifestyle will be widely adopted, with carbon emissions peaking and then gradually decreasing. The ecological environment will fundamentally improve, and the goal of building a beautiful China will be basically achieved. A new pattern of opening up will be formed, and China's participation in international economic cooperation and competition will significantly increase. The gross domestic product will reach the level of moderately developed countries, and the middle-income group will significantly expand. Basic public services will be equalized, and the development gap between urban and rural areas and the gap in living standards of residents will significantly narrow. The construction of a safe China will reach a higher level, and the modernization of national defense and the military will be basically achieved. People's lives will be better, and substantial progress will be made in comprehensive human development and common prosperity for all.
titlelist: Promote the overall development of individuals and enhance the quality of the population, build a high-quality education system, comprehensively promote the construction of a healthy China, actively respond to the national strategy of population aging, enhance people's well-being, improve the level of co-construction, co-governance, and sharing, improve the national public service system, implement the employment priority strategy, optimize the income distribution structure, improve the multi-level social security system, protect the basic rights and interests of women, minors, and disabled persons, and construct a new pattern of grassroots social governance. Coordinate development and security, build a higher level of a safe China, strengthen the national security system and capacity building, enhance national economic security, and comprehensively improve the capacity of public security guarantee, maintain social stability and security. Accelerate national defense and military modernization, achieve the unity of a prosperous country and a strong military, improve the quality and efficiency of national defense and military modernization, promote the synchronous improvement of national defense capabilities and economic strength. Strengthen the construction of socialist democracy and the rule of law, improve the supervision system of the Party and the state, promote socialist democracy, comprehensively advance the rule of law, and improve the supervision system of the Party and the state. Adhere to the principle of one country, two systems, promote the reunification of the motherland, maintain the long-term prosperity and stability of Hong Kong and Macao, promote peaceful development of cross-strait relations and reunification of the motherland. Strengthen planning and implementation, ensure the centralized and unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, improve the unified planning system, and perfect the planning implementation mechanism. Vision for 2035.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Promote the optimization of the innovation system based on national strategic needs, and accelerate the construction of a strategic scientific and technological force led by national laboratories. Focus on major innovation areas such as quantum information, photonics and micro-nanoelectronics, network communication, artificial intelligence, biomedicine, and modern energy systems to establish a number of national laboratories, restructure national key laboratories, and form a well-structured and efficient laboratory system. Optimize and enhance innovation bases such as national engineering research centers and national technology innovation centers. Promote the optimization of the allocation of scientific research forces and resource sharing among research institutes, universities, and enterprise research forces. Provide digital assistance such as technology, equipment, and services to underdeveloped countries, so that all countries can share the dividends of the digital age. Actively promote cultural exchanges and mutual learning in cyberspace. The sixth part is to comprehensively deepen reforms and build a high-level socialist market economy system. Adhere to and improve the basic socialist economic system, give full play to the decisive role of the market in resource allocation, and better leverage the role of the government to promote the better integration of an effective market and an active government.
titlelist: Enhancing the quality of the nation and promoting comprehensive human development, accelerating the pace of digital society construction to adapt to the new trend of comprehensive integration of digital technology into social communication and daily life, promoting public services and social operations, and promoting the construction of a community with a shared future in cyberspace.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Establish a sound legal environment, policy environment, and market environment that support the development of private enterprises, and protect the property rights and rights of entrepreneurs of private enterprises equally under the law. Ensure that private enterprises have equal access to resources, participate in competition openly, fairly, and justly, and receive equal legal protection. Further relax market access for private enterprises and eliminate various barriers in areas such as bidding and tendering. Innovate financial policy tools to support private enterprises, improve the financing and credit support system, treat credit ratings and bond issuance of private enterprises equally, and reduce comprehensive financing costs. Improve the policy system to promote the development of small and micro enterprises and individual businesses, increase tax and fee incentives, and provide stronger credit support. Build a close and transparent relationship between government and business, and establish standardized channels of communication between government and enterprises. Establish a long-term mechanism to prevent and resolve the issue of overdue payments to small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Enhancing the quality of the people and promoting their comprehensive development, steadfastly consolidating and developing the public-owned economy, unwaveringly stimulating the vitality of various market entities, and unwaveringly encouraging, supporting, and guiding the development of the non-public-owned economy, optimizing the development environment for private enterprises.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
