content: Encourage reform and innovation in private enterprises, enhance their operational capabilities and management levels. Guide eligible private enterprises to establish modern corporate systems. Support private enterprises in conducting basic research and technological innovation, participating in key core technology research and development, and major national scientific and technological projects. Improve the mechanism for private enterprises to participate in the implementation of major national strategies. Promote the lawful and compliant operation of private enterprises, encourage them to actively fulfill social responsibilities, and participate in social welfare and charitable causes. Promote the spirit of entrepreneurship and implement a program to promote the healthy growth of young private entrepreneurs.
titlelist: Promote the overall development of individuals and enhance the quality of the nation, unwaveringly stimulate the vitality of various market entities, unwaveringly consolidate and develop the public ownership economy, unwaveringly encourage, support, and guide the non-public ownership economy, and promote the high-quality development of private enterprises.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Implement the action of constructing a high-standard market system, improve the basic institutional framework of the market system, adhere to equal access, fair regulation, open and orderly, and integrity and law-abiding principles, and form an efficient and standardized, fair and competitive domestic unified market.
titlelist: Improving the quality of the nation and promoting comprehensive human development, constructing a high-standard market system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Persist in encouraging competition and opposing monopolies, improve the competition policy framework, and establish a comprehensive competition policy implementation mechanism covering the pre-, during, and post-stages. Coordinate efforts to conduct reviews of new additions and clean up existing practices, strengthen the rigid constraints of the fair competition review system, improve the detailed rules for fair competition review, and continuously eliminate regulations and practices that hinder the unified national market and fair competition. Improve the market competition assessment system, establish a mechanism for complaint reporting and handling responses. Strengthen the enforcement and judicial efforts against anti-monopoly and unfair competition, and prevent the disorderly expansion of capital. Promote market-oriented reforms in sectors such as energy, railways, telecommunications, and public utilities, open up access to competitive businesses, further introduce market competition mechanisms, and strengthen regulation of natural monopoly businesses.
titlelist: Enhancing the quality of the nation and promoting comprehensive human development, constructing a high-standard market system, and strengthening the foundation of competition policy.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Establish and improve the legal and regulatory framework for credit, and develop a directory of public credit information and a list of measures for punishing dishonesty, while enhancing the mechanism for repairing the credit of dishonest entities. Promote the system of credit commitments. Strengthen the collection, sharing, disclosure, and application of credit information, and promote credit products and services that benefit the people and facilitate business. Establish a mechanism for the integration and sharing of public credit information and financial information. Cultivate internationally competitive enterprise credit agencies and credit rating agencies, strengthen credit supervision, and promote the healthy development of the credit service market. Strengthen the management of credit information security and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of credit subjects. Establish and improve the system for holding the government accountable for dishonesty.
titlelist: Improving the quality of the nation and promoting comprehensive human development, constructing a high-standard market system, and establishing a sound social credit system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Better play the fundamental and important role of finance in national governance, enhance the ability of financial services to support the real economy, and improve the fiscal, tax, and financial systems in line with the requirements of high-quality development.
titlelist: Enhancing the quality of the nation and promoting comprehensive human development, establishing a modern financial and taxation system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deepen the reform of streamlining administration, delegating power, combining decentralization with regulation, and optimizing services. Fully implement the system of government lists of powers and responsibilities, and continuously improve the market-oriented, rule of law-based, and internationalized business environment. Implement a nationwide unified market access negative list system, remove implicit barriers to market access outside the list, and further relax access restrictions, with a focus on the service industry. Streamline administrative licensing matters, reduce the consolidation of qualification licenses, eliminate unnecessary filing registrations and annual inspections, and standardize inspections related to enterprises. Fully implement the reform of separating permits from licenses and reducing licenses after obtaining permits, and comprehensively reform the approval system for construction projects. Reform the production permit system, simplify the approval procedures for industrial products, and implement a list-based management system for business-related operating permits. Establish a convenient, efficient, and orderly system for market entities to exit, simplify the procedures for ordinary cancellation, and establish sound systems for corporate bankruptcy and personal bankruptcy. Innovate government service methods and promote the convenience of approval services. Deepen the construction of a single window for international trade. Improve the evaluation system for the business environment.
titlelist: Enhancing the quality of the people and promoting their comprehensive development, improving the government's economic governance capacity, and building a first-class business environment.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Continuously strengthen the basic position of agriculture, deepen the structural reform of agricultural supply-side, emphasize quality orientation, and promote the revitalization of rural industries.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the comprehensive promotion of agricultural and rural development, advance the revitalization of rural areas, and improve the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen the foundation of food production capacity and ensure the supply security of important agricultural products such as grain, cotton, oil, sugar, meat, and milk. Adhere to the strictest farmland protection system, strengthen the protection and improvement of both the quantity and quality of farmland, and strictly adhere to the red line of 1.8 billion mu of farmland. Control the non-agriculturalization of farmland and prevent the non-foodification of farmland, regulate the balance between occupation and compensation of farmland, and strictly prohibit occupation of water fields to compensate for dry fields. Focus on the construction of grain production functional zones and important agricultural product production protection zones, establish a national food security industrial belt, implement high-standard farmland construction projects, and build 1.075 billion mu of concentrated and contiguous high-standard farmland. Implement black soil protection projects, strengthen the protection and fertility restoration of black soil in the northeast. Promote water-saving transformation and refined management of large and medium-sized irrigation areas, construct backbone projects for water-saving irrigation, and simultaneously promote comprehensive water price reform. Strengthen the research and application of large and medium-sized, intelligent, and compound agricultural machinery, and increase the mechanization rate of crop cultivation and harvesting to 75%. Strengthen the protection and utilization of germplasm resources and the construction of seed banks to ensure seed source security. Strengthen the research and development of agricultural fine varieties, promote the industrial application of biotechnology breeding in an orderly manner, and cultivate leading seed companies with international competitiveness. Improve the agricultural science and technology innovation system, innovate the ways of agricultural technology promotion and extension services, and build smart agriculture. Strengthen animal epidemic prevention and control of crop diseases and pests, and enhance agricultural meteorological services.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the development of agriculture and rural areas, comprehensively promote rural revitalization, improve the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and enhance the comprehensive production capacity of agriculture.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Optimize the layout of agricultural production and build advantageous agricultural product industrial belts and characteristic agricultural product advantage zones. Promote the overall planning of grain, economic crops, and livestock, and coordinate the development of agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry, and fisheries. Optimize the structure of planting industry, vigorously develop modern animal husbandry, and promote the ecological and healthy breeding of aquatic products. Actively develop facility agriculture and develop forestry and fruit industry according to local conditions. Deepen the promotion of high-quality grain project. Promote the green transformation of agriculture, strengthen the protection and governance of production areas, develop water-saving agriculture and dryland farming, implement the reduction of pesticides and fertilizers, control agricultural film pollution, improve the recycling rate of agricultural film, promote the comprehensive utilization of straw and the resource utilization of livestock and poultry manure. Improve the green agriculture standard system, strengthen the certification management of green food, organic agricultural products, and geographical indication agricultural products. Strengthen the quality and safety supervision of agricultural products throughout the process and improve the traceability system. Establish modern agricultural industrial parks and agricultural modernization demonstration areas.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the development of agriculture and rural areas, comprehensively promote rural revitalization, improve the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and deepen agricultural structural adjustments.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Developing the county's economy, promoting the integrated development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries in rural areas, extending the agricultural industry chain, and developing modern rural industries with distinctive features to enrich the rural population. Promoting the integration of crop and livestock farming and restructuring the industrial chain, improving the development level of agricultural processing industry and agricultural production services, and strengthening the characteristic industries such as leisure agriculture, rural tourism, and homestay economy. Strengthening the construction of agricultural product storage and preservation facilities and cold chain logistics, establishing platforms and intelligent standard factories for rural property rights trading, commercial circulation, inspection, testing, and certification, and guiding the concentrated development of the secondary and tertiary industries in rural areas. Improving the mechanism of interest connection, allowing farmers to share more of the added value of the industry through resource-to-asset, funds-to-equity, and farmers-to-shareholders.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the comprehensive development of agriculture and rural areas, promote the revitalization of rural areas, improve the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and enrich the economic structure of rural areas.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Coordinate the planning and construction of urban and rural areas in the county, taking into account land use, industrial development, residential construction, improvement of living environment, ecological protection, disaster prevention and reduction, and the inheritance of historical and cultural heritage. Scientifically formulate the layout plan for villages in the county, promote village construction in a targeted and classified manner, regulate comprehensive land improvement throughout the region, protect traditional villages, ethnic villages, and rural landscapes, and strictly prohibit arbitrary merging of villages to create large communities or demolishing and rebuilding against the will of farmers. Optimize the layout of rural living spaces, strictly protect agricultural production spaces and rural ecological spaces, and scientifically delineate areas for suitable, restricted, and prohibited animal husbandry. Encourage areas with conditions to develop practical village plans.
titlelist: Adhere to the priority development of agriculture and rural areas, comprehensively promote rural revitalization, implement rural construction actions, and strengthen the planning guidance for rural construction.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the integrated development of urban and rural areas with the county as the basic unit, strengthen the comprehensive service capacity of county towns and the function of townships in serving farmers. Improve the unified planning, construction, and management mechanism of urban and rural infrastructure, promote the extension of municipal public facilities to suburban villages and larger central towns, improve rural infrastructure such as water, electricity, roads, gas, postal communication, radio and television, and logistics, and enhance the quality of rural housing construction. Promote the standardization and convergence of basic public services in urban and rural areas, increase the supply of rural education, healthcare, elderly care, culture, and other services, promote the exchange and rotation of teachers and doctors within the county, and encourage social forces to establish public welfare undertakings in rural areas. Improve the scientific and cultural quality of farmers and promote the revitalization of rural talents.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the comprehensive development of agriculture and rural areas, promote the revitalization of rural areas, implement rural construction actions, and improve the level of rural infrastructure and public services.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Carry out actions to improve the rural living environment, steadily addressing issues such as garbage surrounding villages and rural black and odorous water bodies. Highlight environmental problems. Promote on-site classification and resource utilization of rural household waste, with a focus on town government offices and central villages, gradually advancing the treatment of rural domestic sewage. Support the targeted promotion of the rural toilet revolution. Advance comprehensive treatment of rural water systems. Conduct thorough village cleaning and greening actions, achieving cleanliness and tidiness in public spaces, courtyard houses, and the surrounding areas of villages.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the comprehensive development of agriculture and rural areas, promote the revitalization of rural areas, implement rural construction actions, and improve the living environment in rural areas.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Establish and improve a policy system for equal exchange and two-way flow of urban and rural factors, promote the flow of factors to rural areas, and enhance the vitality of agricultural and rural development.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the comprehensive promotion of agricultural and rural development, and improve the institutional mechanisms for integrated urban-rural development.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Establish a comprehensive assistance mechanism for low-income populations in rural areas and underdeveloped regions, maintain overall stability in major assistance policies and financial inputs, and continue to promote the development of poverty-stricken areas.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the development of agriculture and rural areas, comprehensively promote rural revitalization, and achieve effective connection between consolidating and expanding the achievements of poverty alleviation and rural revitalization.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strictly implement the requirements of removing the hat without removing responsibility, removing the hat without removing policies, removing the hat without removing assistance, and removing the hat without removing supervision, and establish and improve the long-term mechanism for consolidating and expanding the achievements in poverty alleviation. Improve the dynamic monitoring and targeted assistance mechanism to prevent poverty relapse, implement regular monitoring of populations prone to relapse into poverty, establish and improve rapid detection and response mechanisms, and timely include them in the scope of assistance policies through hierarchical classification. Improve the rural social security and assistance system, and establish a long-term assistance mechanism for low-income populations in rural areas. Continue to implement the policy of linking the increase or decrease of construction land in urban and rural areas in poverty-stricken areas, adjust and improve the policy of inter-provincial transactions. Strengthen the management and supervision of poverty alleviation project funds and assets, and promote the sustainable development of characteristic industries. Promote the work-for-relief approach to drive local employment for low-income populations. Provide follow-up assistance for poverty alleviation relocation, and strengthen the construction of new urbanization in large-scale relocation and resettlement areas.
titlelist: Adhere to the priority development of agriculture and rural areas, comprehensively promote rural revitalization, achieve effective connection between consolidating and expanding the achievements of poverty alleviation and rural revitalization, and consolidate and enhance the achievements of poverty alleviation.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Persist in giving priority to the existing population while driving growth, coordinate the reform of the household registration system and achieve full coverage of basic public services for permanent residents in urban areas. Improve the supporting policy system for the urbanization of agricultural migrant populations and accelerate the comprehensive integration of agricultural migrant populations into cities.
titlelist: Improve the strategy of new urbanization to enhance the quality of urbanization development and accelerate the urbanization of the rural population.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: To promote the development of urban agglomerations as the main focus, comprehensively form a strategic pattern of two horizontal and three vertical urbanization. Optimize and enhance urban agglomerations such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Chengdu-Chongqing, and the middle reaches of the Yangtze River, and develop and strengthen urban agglomerations such as Shandong Peninsula, Guangdong-Fujian-Zhejiang coastal areas, Central Plains, Guanzhong Plain, and Beibu Gulf. Cultivate and develop urban agglomerations such as Harbin-Changchun, Liaoning-Middle and South, Central Shanxi, Guizhou-Middle, Yunnan-Middle, Hohhot-Baotou-Wuhai-Yulin, Lanzhou-Xining, Ningxia along the Yellow River, and the northern slope of the Tianshan Mountains. Establish and improve mechanisms for integrated and coordinated development of urban agglomerations, cost sharing, and benefit sharing, and coordinate the layout of infrastructure, division of labor in industries, sharing of public services, and ecological construction and environmental governance. Optimize the internal spatial structure of urban agglomerations, build ecological and security barriers, and form a network-type urban agglomeration with multiple centers, levels, and nodes.
titlelist: Improve the quality of urbanization development by enhancing the strategy of new urbanization, improving the spatial layout of urbanization, and promoting the integrated development of urban clusters.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Relying on central cities with strong driving capabilities, improve the level of coordinated development within a 1-hour commuting circle and cultivate a number of highly urbanized modern metropolitan areas. Use intercity railways and urban (suburban) railways as the backbone, open up various dead-end roads and bottleneck roads, promote effective connection between urban and suburban transportation and the integration of four networks of rail transportation, and improve the connectivity of infrastructure in metropolitan areas. Encourage mutual recognition of social security and household registration points in metropolitan areas, sharing of education and medical resources, and promote the universal exchange of technology innovation vouchers, as well as cooperation and joint construction of industrial parks and research platforms. Encourage metropolitan areas with conditions to establish a unified planning committee to achieve unified planning and implementation, and explore the promotion of unified management of land, population, and other aspects.
titlelist: Improve the quality of urbanization development by enhancing the strategy of new urbanization, improving the spatial layout of urbanization, and constructing modern metropolitan areas.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: Taking into account the diverse needs of the economy, livelihood, ecology, and security, transforming the development and construction methods of super-large and mega cities, strengthening risk prevention and control in the governance of super-large and mega cities, and promoting high-quality and sustainable development. Orderly dispersal. Resolve the functions and facilities of general manufacturing industries, regional logistics bases, professional markets, as well as excessive concentration of public service resources such as medical and higher education, and reasonably reduce development intensity and population density. Enhance global resource allocation, technological innovation, and high-end industry leadership, taking the lead in forming an industrial structure with modern service industry as the main body and advanced manufacturing industry as the support, and improving comprehensive capabilities and international competitiveness. Adhere to the integration of industry and city, improve the functions of suburban new towns, and achieve multi-center and cluster-based development.
titlelist: Improve the quality of urbanization development by enhancing the strategy of new urbanization, perfecting the spatial layout of urbanization, and optimizing and enhancing the functions of central urban areas in super large and mega cities.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Make full use of the advantage of relatively low comprehensive cost, actively undertake the transfer and dispersal of industries from super large and mega cities, and consolidate the foundation for the development of the real economy. Based on distinctive resources and industrial foundation, establish differentiated positioning for the manufacturing industry, promote the scale and cluster development of the manufacturing industry, and construct advanced manufacturing bases, commercial and trade logistics centers, and regional professional service centers according to local conditions. Optimize the layout and functions of municipal public facilities, support the layout of tertiary hospitals and higher education institutions in large and medium-sized cities, increase the supply of cultural and sports resources, create modern and fashionable consumption scenes, and improve the quality of urban life.
titlelist: Improve the quality of urbanization development by enhancing the strategy of new urbanization, improving the spatial layout of urbanization, and enhancing the livability and suitability for business in large and medium-sized cities.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the development of weak areas and strengths in county towns, promote the upgrading and expansion of facilities such as public services, environmental sanitation, municipal utilities, and industrial supporting facilities, and enhance comprehensive carrying capacity and governance capabilities. Support the construction of county towns in the eastern region with better infrastructure, with a focus on supporting the construction of county towns in the central and western regions and in areas undergoing urbanization in the northeast, and provide reasonable support for the construction of county towns in major agricultural production areas and key ecological functional areas. Improve the investment and financing mechanism for the construction of county towns, better leverage fiscal funds, and guide financial and social capital to increase investment. Steadily and orderly promote the establishment of cities in large towns with a permanent population of over 200,000 in counties and townships that meet the conditions. Develop small towns according to their location, resource endowment, and development foundation, and promote the standardized and healthy development of characteristic small towns.
titlelist: Improve the quality of urbanization development by enhancing the strategy of new urbanization, improving the spatial layout of urbanization, and promoting urbanization construction with county towns as important carriers.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the transformation of urban development mode, coordinate urban planning, construction and management, implement urban renewal actions, and promote the optimization of urban spatial structure and quality improvement.
titlelist: Improve the strategy of new urbanization to enhance the quality of urban development, and comprehensively improve the quality of cities.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: According to the carrying capacity of resources and the environment, the city's scale and spatial structure should be determined reasonably, and urban construction, industrial development, ecological conservation, infrastructure, and public services should be coordinated. Promote a development model that is functionally diverse, three-dimensional, and oriented towards public transportation, and coordinate the use of above-ground and underground spaces, increase green nodes and public open spaces, and promote the construction of residential blocks. Implement urban design and architectural control, implement applicable, economical, green, and aesthetically pleasing architectural guidelines for the new era, and strengthen control over the construction of high-rise buildings. Accelerate urban renewal, transform and upgrade the functions of old residential areas, old factory areas, old neighborhoods, and urban villages, promote the renovation of old buildings, and actively expand the construction of parking lots and charging stations.
titlelist: Improve the strategy of new urbanization to enhance the quality of urbanization development, comprehensively improve the quality of cities, and transform the development mode of cities.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: In accordance with the new concepts and trends of urban development, we will carry out pilot demonstrations of urban modernization and build livable, innovative, intelligent, green, humanistic, and resilient cities. We will enhance the level of urban intelligence, implement digital management of urban buildings, public spaces, underground pipelines, and other one map systems, and centrally manage urban operations. We will scientifically plan and layout urban green belts, green corridors, green wedges, and greenways, promote ecological restoration and improvement projects, prioritize the development of urban public transportation, and build slow transportation networks such as bicycle lanes and pedestrian walkways. We will promote intelligent construction, popularize green building materials, prefabricated buildings, and steel structure residences, and build low-carbon cities. We will protect and continue the urban context, eliminate large-scale demolition and construction, and let the city retain memories and residents remember their hometown. We will establish a comprehensive urban flood control and drainage system that combines source reduction, storage and discharge, drainage and risk prevention, and emergency response to exceed standards, and promote significant progress in urban waterlogging control. We will enhance the ability of public facilities to cope with storms, droughts, and geological disasters, and improve the emergency shelter functions of public facilities and buildings. We will strengthen the construction of barrier-free environments. We will expand the channels for urban construction funding and establish financing mechanisms with matching terms, diverse channels, and financial sustainability.
titlelist: Improve the strategy of new urbanization to enhance the quality of urbanization development, comprehensively improve the quality of cities, and promote the construction of new cities.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adhere to the positioning that houses are for living, not for speculation, and accelerate the establishment of a multi-subject supply, multi-channel guarantee, and a housing system that combines renting and purchasing, so that all people have a place to live and achieve a balance between work and residence. Adhere to the principle of adapting measures to local conditions and implementing multiple strategies, strengthen the main responsibility of city governments, stabilize land prices, housing prices, and expectations. Establish a mechanism for linking housing and land, strengthen the regulation of real estate finance, play a role in regulating housing taxation, support reasonable self-occupancy demand, and curb investment and speculative demand. Accelerate the cultivation and development of the housing rental market, effectively activate the stock of housing resources, vigorously and orderly expand the supply of rental housing in cities, improve long-term rental housing policies, and gradually ensure that rental and purchased housing have equal rights in enjoying public services. Accelerate the construction of housing rental regulations, strengthen the supervision of the rental market, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of tenants and landlords. Effectively increase the supply of affordable housing, improve the basic system and support policies for housing security. Focus on cities with large population inflows and high housing prices, expand the supply of affordable rental housing, and focus on solving housing problems for disadvantaged groups and new urban residents. Set aside separate plans for rental housing land, explore the use of collectively owned construction land and idle land owned by enterprises and institutions to build rental housing, and support the conversion of non-residential buildings into affordable rental housing. Improve the mechanism for the distribution of land transfer income and increase financial, tax, and financial support. Develop shared ownership housing according to local conditions. Handle the relationship between basic security and non-basic security, improve housing security methods, and establish policies for the target population, admission thresholds, and exit management. Reform and improve the housing provident fund system, improve the mechanisms for depositing, using, managing, and operating the fund.
titlelist: Improve the quality of new urbanization strategy, comprehensively enhance the quality of urban development, improve the housing market system and housing security system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Improve the mechanism for integrating Hong Kong and Macau into the overall national development, promoting complementary advantages and coordinated development with the mainland. Support Hong Kong and Macau's participation and contribution to the comprehensive opening-up and modernization of the national economic system, and build a functional platform for jointly constructing the Belt and Road Initiative. Deepen economic and trade cooperation, as well as scientific and technological innovation cooperation between the mainland and Hong Kong and Macau, and deepen and expand the interconnection of financial markets between the mainland and Hong Kong and Macau. Promote the high-quality development of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, deepen cooperation between Guangdong, Hong Kong, and Macau, and promote cooperation in the Pan-Pearl River Delta region, and advance the construction of major cooperative platforms such as Shenzhen Qianhai, Zhuhai Hengqin, Guangzhou Nansha, and Shenzhen-Hong Kong cooperation in the Heung Yee Kuk area. Strengthen exchanges and cooperation between the mainland and Hong Kong and Macau in various fields, improve policies and measures to facilitate the development, living, and residence of Hong Kong and Macau residents in the mainland, strengthen education on the Constitution and the Basic Law, and enhance the national consciousness and patriotism of Hong Kong and Macau compatriots. Support Hong Kong and Macau in conducting exchanges and cooperation with countries and regions around the world.
titlelist: Adhere to the principle of 'one country, two systems' to promote the reunification of the motherland, maintain long-term prosperity and stability in Hong Kong and Macau, and support Hong Kong and Macau in better integrating into the overall development of the country.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adhere to the One China principle and the 1992 Consensus, take the well-being of compatriots on both sides of the Taiwan Strait as the starting point, promote peaceful development and integrated development of cross-strait relations, and remain highly vigilant and resolutely curb separatist activities advocating Taiwan independence.
titlelist: Adhere to the principle of 'one country, two systems' to promote the reunification of the motherland, and advance peaceful development and reunification of cross-strait relations.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Improve the system and policies to ensure the well-being of Taiwan compatriots and their equal treatment on the mainland, continuously introduce and implement policies and measures that benefit Taiwan and its people, allow Taiwan compatriots to share development opportunities, and participate in the mainland's economic and social development process. Support Taiwan businesses and enterprises in participating in the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative and the national regional coordinated development strategy. Promote financial cooperation between the two sides of the strait, support eligible Taiwan-funded enterprises to go public on the mainland. Promote the construction of cross-strait industrial cooperation zones, Pingtan Comprehensive Experimental Zone, and Kunshan Deepening Cross-Strait Industrial Cooperation Pilot Zone, and other cross-strait cooperation platforms. Support Fujian in exploring new paths for integrated development across the strait, and accelerate the construction of demonstration zones for integrated development across the strait. Strengthen cross-strait industrial cooperation, create a common market for both sides of the strait, and enhance the economy of the Chinese nation.
titlelist: Adhere to the principle of 'one country, two systems' to promote national reunification, advance peaceful development of cross-strait relations and national reunification, and deepen the integrated development between the two sides of the strait.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Actively promote cross-strait exchanges, cooperation, and personnel exchanges, deepen mutual understanding, enhance mutual trust and recognition. Promote cultural, educational, medical, and health exchanges and cooperation between the two sides, promote social security and sharing of public resources, support equalization, universalization, and convenience of basic public services in adjacent or similarly situated areas on both sides, promote the common inheritance and innovative development of excellent traditional Chinese culture among compatriots on both sides. Strengthen grassroots and youth exchanges between the two sides, encourage Taiwanese youth to pursue dreams, build dreams, and achieve dreams on the mainland. Unite with the broad masses of Taiwanese compatriots to jointly oppose Taiwan independence separatist activities, safeguard and promote the peaceful development of cross-strait relations, and devote efforts to the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.
titlelist: Adhere to the principle of 'one country, two systems' to promote national reunification, advance peaceful development of cross-strait relations and national reunification, and strengthen cultural exchanges between the two sides of the strait.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the establishment and improvement of a national planning system that is guided by national development plans, based on spatial planning, supported by special planning and regional planning, and composed jointly by national, provincial, municipal, and county-level planning. This system should have accurate positioning, clear boundaries, complementary functions, and unified connections.
titlelist: Strengthen planning implementation guarantee, and improve the unified planning system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (March 2021)

content: To better play the role of national development planning and strategic guidance, strengthen the support of spatial planning, special planning, and regional planning for the implementation of this plan. Develop and implement national-level spatial planning in accordance with the land space development and protection requirements and key tasks determined by this plan, to provide spatial guarantee for the implementation of major strategic tasks. Focus on the strategic priorities and main tasks determined by this plan, develop and implement a number of national-level key special planning in areas such as technological innovation, digital economy, green ecology, and people's livelihood security, and clarify the timetable and roadmap for implementing development tasks. Develop and implement a number of national-level regional planning implementation plans based on the regional development strategic tasks determined by this plan. Strengthen the implementation of local planning for the development strategies, main objectives, key tasks, and major engineering projects proposed in this plan.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: To implement the new development concept and adapt to the new normal of leading economic development, it is necessary to focus on promoting supply-side structural reform while moderately expanding total demand, so as to meet the growing, upgrading, and personalized material, cultural, and ecological needs of the people. Structural adjustment must be promoted through reform, with greater emphasis on market-oriented reforms in key areas and key links, adjustments to various distorted policies and institutional arrangements, improvement of a fair competition and survival of the fittest market environment and mechanism, maximization of microeconomic vitality, optimization of factor allocation, promotion of industrial structure upgrading, expansion of effective and high-end supply, enhancement of supply structure adaptability and flexibility, and improvement of total factor productivity. The goal is to improve the quality and efficiency of the supply system, implement policy pillars that ensure stable macro policies, accurate industrial policies, active micro policies, practical reform policies, and social safety net policies. Efforts should be made to reduce overcapacity, inventory, leverage, costs, and weaknesses, accelerate the cultivation of new development drivers, transform and enhance traditional comparative advantages, consolidate the foundation of the real economy, and promote overall improvement in social productivity. The second part is about implementing the innovation-driven development strategy. The focus of development should be on innovation, with scientific and technological innovation as the core and talent development as the support. It is necessary to promote the organic integration of scientific and technological innovation with mass entrepreneurship and innovation, and shape a more innovative-driven and leading development that leverages first-mover advantages.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: Give full play to the leading role of technological innovation in comprehensive innovation, strengthen basic research, enhance original innovation, integrated innovation, and introduce digestion and absorption for re-innovation, and strive to enhance independent innovation capabilities, providing sustained power for economic and social development.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concept, strengthening the leading role of scientific and technological innovation.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Clarify the functional positioning of various types of innovation entities and build an integrated innovation network involving government, industry, academia, research, and application. Strengthen the status and leading role of enterprises in innovation, encourage them to conduct fundamental and cutting-edge innovation research, implement the Top 100 Innovative Enterprises project, cultivate internationally competitive leading innovative enterprises, and support the development of technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the integration of science and education, involve universities, vocational colleges, and research institutes in the construction of the national innovation system, support the formation of interdisciplinary and comprehensive research teams in high-level universities and research institutes. Leverage the advantages of the new national system under market economic conditions in major key projects. Implement national technological innovation projects, establish industry technology innovation alliances, develop market-oriented research and development institutions, and promote cross-disciplinary and cross-industry collaborative innovation.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, strengthen the leading role of scientific and technological innovation, optimize the innovation organization system.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: Aiming at the forefront of international science and technology, guided by national goals and strategic needs, we will establish a number of high-level national laboratories. We will accelerate the construction of major national scientific and technological infrastructure in fields such as energy, life sciences, earth systems and environment, materials, particle physics and nuclear physics, space and astronomy, engineering technology, and some interdisciplinary fields. We will establish a comprehensive national science center based on existing advanced facilities. We will also establish a number of national technology innovation centers relying on enterprises, universities, and research institutes, and support the construction of enterprise technology centers. We will promote the opening of research infrastructure and innovation resources in universities and research institutes.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development philosophy, strengthen the leading role of scientific and technological innovation, and enhance the basic capacity for innovation.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Guide the gathering and flow of innovative elements, and build cross-regional innovation networks. Give full play to the role of central cities with a high concentration of universities and research institutes, national independent innovation demonstration zones, and national high-tech industrial development zones, and form a group of innovative provinces, cities, and regional innovation centers with strong driving force. Systematically promote comprehensive innovation and reform experiments. Support Beijing and Shanghai in building globally influential science and technology innovation centers.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concept, strengthen the leading role of scientific and technological innovation, and build a regional innovation highland.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote professional space, online platforms, and internal crowdsourcing within enterprises to enhance the sharing of innovative resources. Popularize crowdsourcing in research and development, manufacturing operations, knowledge content, and lifestyle services to encourage public participation in online production and distribution division of labor. Develop public assistance, sharing assistance, and mutual assistance. Improve regulatory systems to standardize the development of physical crowdfunding, equity crowdfunding, and online lending.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, main goals, and development concept are to deeply promote mass entrepreneurship and innovation, integrating them into various fields and aspects of development. Encouraging all types of entities to develop new technologies and innovations, comprehensively advancing mass entrepreneurship, mass participation, mass support, and mass funding, and leveraging the Internet to expand market resources and connect social needs with entrepreneurship and innovation.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Break through the institutional barriers that restrict innovation and the transformation of achievements, optimize the supply of innovation policies, and establish a system and mechanism that promotes the vigorous emergence of innovation, efficient transformation of innovative achievements, and full realization of innovative value.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development philosophy, constructing a system and mechanism that encourages innovation.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Implement actions to transform scientific and technological achievements, fully decentralize the disposal rights, usage rights, and income rights of innovative achievements, increase the proportion of income sharing for researchers' achievements transformation, support researchers in part-time and off-the-job transformation of scientific and technological achievements. Establish a comprehensive process of scientific and technological innovation financing from experimental research, pilot testing to production, and promote the capitalization and industrialization of scientific and technological achievements. Implement a distribution policy oriented towards increasing knowledge value, strengthen equity, stock options, and dividend incentives for innovative talents.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, constructing a system and mechanism that encourages innovation, improving the mechanism for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements and the distribution of benefits.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Create a market competition environment that encourages innovation, clean up institutional regulations and industry standards that hinder innovation, accelerate legislation in weak areas and fields of innovation, and strengthen the enforcement and supervision of industrial technology policies and standards. Increase financial investment in science and technology, with a focus on supporting basic frontier research, social welfare, and key technologies of common interest. Implement policies that allow for the deduction of research and development expenses and expand the scope of accelerated depreciation of fixed assets, strengthen support for the first purchase and order of innovative products, and incentivize companies to increase research and development investment. Strengthen financial support and vigorously develop venture capital. Better leverage the role of entrepreneurs, accommodate the challenges of innovation to traditional interest patterns, and protect the property rights and innovation benefits of entrepreneurs in accordance with the law.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, constructing a system and mechanism that encourages innovation, constructing a comprehensive innovation support policy system.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Establish and improve the mechanism for talent mobility, enhance social horizontal and vertical mobility, and promote orderly and free movement of talents between different types of organizations and regions. Improve incentive policies such as salary, medical benefits, professional title evaluation, and pension security to encourage talents to move to the grassroots, central and western regions, and remote and difficult areas. Carry out talent exchanges and paired support between the eastern coastal areas and the central and western regions, as well as the old industrial bases in the northeast, and continue to implement talent training projects supported by eastern cities for the western regions.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, implementing the strategy of prioritizing talent development, promoting the optimization of talent allocation.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Improve the talent evaluation and incentive mechanism, as well as the service guarantee system, to create a social environment conducive to everyone's development and the emergence of young talents. Play a guiding role in government investment, encourage the development and introduction of talent resources. Improve performance and contribution-oriented talent evaluation standards. Ensure that talents participate in the distribution of benefits based on knowledge, skills, management, and other innovative factors, and return the value of talents with market value. Strengthen material and spiritual incentives for talents and encourage them to promote the spirit of dedication. Create a social atmosphere that values professionalism and vigorously promote the spirit of craftsmanship in the new era. Implement more proactive, open, and effective talent introduction policies, improve the permanent residency system for foreigners, and relax the conditions for technical and skilled talents to obtain permanent residency rights. Accelerate the improvement of efficient and convenient services for overseas talents to work, enter and exit, and reside in China. Expand the scale of studying in China, optimize the structure of international students, and improve support mechanisms for their education. Train and recommend outstanding talents for positions in international organizations, improve supporting policies, and facilitate their return to serve in China.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development philosophy, implementing the strategy of prioritizing talent development, and creating a favorable environment for talent development.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: Adhere to demand-driven and supply-side innovation, improve the quality and efficiency of supply, activate and release effective demand, form a high-efficiency cycle of positive interaction between consumption and investment, and coordinated progress between demand upgrading and supply upgrading, enhancing the development of new momentum.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, expanding new space for development momentum.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adapt to the accelerated upgrading of consumption, release the potential of consumption by improving the consumption environment, better meet and create consumer demand through supply improvement and innovation, and continuously enhance the basic role of consumption in driving the economy. Enhance consumption capacity, improve public consumption expectations, tap into rural consumption potential, and focus on expanding resident consumption. Focus on expanding service consumption to drive the upgrading of consumption structure, support new types of consumption such as information, green, fashion, and quality, and steadily promote bulk consumption such as housing, automobiles, and health and elderly care. Promote the development of new consumption models such as online and offline integration. Implement the project to improve the quality of consumer goods, strengthen consumer rights protection, fully leverage the role of consumer associations, and create a trustworthy and convenient consumption environment. Actively guide the return of overseas consumption. Relying on important tourist destination cities, optimize the layout of duty-free shops, and cultivate the development of international consumption centers.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, expanding new space for development momentum, promoting consumption upgrading.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on expanding effective investment around effective demand, optimizing supply structure, improving investment efficiency, and leveraging the key role of investment in stabilizing growth and adjusting structure. Better play the role of the main force of social investment, create a relaxed and fair investment and business environment, encourage private capital and corporate investment, and stimulate the vitality and potential of private capital. Fully leverage the leverage effect of government investment, increase investment in public goods and services, increase investment in human capital, increase investment that is conducive to upgrading the supply structure, filling the gaps in well-being, coordinating urban and rural areas, and enhancing development momentum, and initiate the implementation of a number of comprehensive, strategic, and fundamental major investment projects.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, expanding new space for development momentum, and expanding effective investment.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adapt to changes in international market demand, accelerate the transformation of foreign trade development mode, optimize trade structure, and leverage exports to promote growth. Accelerate the cultivation of new advantages in foreign economic affairs with technology, standards, brands, quality, and services as the core, promote the export of high-end equipment, and increase the technological content and added value of export products. Expand service exports, improve the service system for after-sales maintenance and repair, and promote the coordinated development of onshore and offshore service outsourcing. Increase support for exports from small and medium-sized enterprises. The third aspect is to build a new development system. Play the guiding role of economic system reform, correctly handle the relationship between government and the market, make breakthrough progress in key areas and crucial reforms, and form a system and mechanism that is conducive to leading the new normal of economic development.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, expanding new space for development momentum, cultivating new advantages in exports.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: Strengthen the supervision of state-owned assets, improve capital returns, and prevent the loss of state-owned assets. Restructure and establish state-owned capital investment and operation companies to improve the allocation and operational efficiency of state-owned capital, and create an effective platform for the restructuring and adjustment of state-owned capital flow and layout. Establish a reasonable mechanism for the flow of state-owned capital, promote strategic adjustments in the layout of state-owned capital, and guide more state-owned capital to invest in important industries and key areas related to national security and the national economy. Establish a list of regulatory powers and responsibilities for state-owned asset contributors, steadily promote the centralized and unified supervision of operational state-owned assets, and establish a budget management system for state-owned capital operations that covers all state-owned enterprises and is managed at different levels. Conduct a comprehensive audit of the performance of state-owned enterprise state-owned capital and corporate leaders' economic responsibilities.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, adhere to and improve the basic economic system, improve various state-owned asset management systems.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Support cross-shareholding and integration among state-owned capital, collective capital, non-public capital, and other forms of capital. Promote diversification of equity in the public sector economy. Steadily promote the development of mixed-ownership economy in state-owned enterprises and carry out pilot demonstrations of mixed-ownership reform. Introduce non-state-owned capital to participate in the reform of state-owned enterprises and encourage the development of mixed-ownership enterprises controlled by non-public capital. Encourage state-owned capital to invest in non-state-owned enterprises in various ways.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concept, adhere to and improve the basic economic system, actively and steadily develop the mixed ownership economy.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adhere to the principles of equal rights, equal opportunities, and equal rules to better stimulate the vitality and creativity of the non-public sector of the economy. Abolish unreasonable regulations on various forms of non-public ownership, eliminate various hidden barriers, ensure equal use of production factors in accordance with the law, fair participation in market competition, equal legal protection, and joint fulfillment of social responsibilities. Encourage private enterprises to enter more fields in accordance with the law.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, adhere to and improve the basic economic system, support the development of the non-public sector of the economy.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: Accelerate the formation of a unified, open, and orderly market system, establish mechanisms to ensure fair competition, break regional divisions and industry monopolies, focus on removing market barriers, and promote the free and orderly flow and equal exchange of goods and factors.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concept, and improve the modern market system.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: Accelerate the establishment of a unified construction land market for urban and rural areas. Under the premise of compliance with planning, use control, and legal acquisition, promote the equal entry, rights, and prices of rural collective-operated construction land and state-owned construction land. Improve the collective land expropriation system, reduce the scope of expropriation, standardize the expropriation procedures, and improve the protection mechanism for the rights and interests of farmers whose land is expropriated. Carry out pilot projects for financing and mortgage of residential land, moderate circulation, and voluntary compensated withdrawal. Improve the market-oriented allocation system for industrial land. Coordinate the labor market and implement an equal employment system. Strengthen the construction of various technology trading platforms, improve technology market trading rules, and encourage the development of technology intermediary service agencies.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, improve the modern market system, improve the factor market system.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Clear and abolish various regulations and practices that hinder the unified market and fair competition. Improve competition policy, perfect market competition rules, and implement a fair competition review system. Relax market access and improve market exit mechanisms. Establish a sound market supervision and anti-monopoly law enforcement system with unified standards, clear rights and responsibilities, fairness, efficiency, and legal guarantees. Strictly enforce mandatory standards for product quality, safety production, energy consumption, and environmental damage, and establish sound rules and regulatory measures for market entities' behavior. Improve social supervision mechanisms and facilitate complaint reporting channels. Strengthen internet transaction regulation. Crack down on counterfeiting and selling fake products.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development philosophy, to improve the modern market system and safeguard fair competition.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: Optimize the structure of fiscal expenditure, correct unsustainable expenditure policies, adjust ineffective and inefficient expenditure, and withdraw redundant and misaligned expenditure. Establish a mechanism linking treasury management with the allocation of transfer payments. Innovate fiscal expenditure methods, guide social capital to participate in the provision of public goods, maintain fiscal expenditure at a reasonable level, and control fiscal deficits and government debt within manageable limits to ensure fiscal sustainability.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concept are to accelerate the reform of the fiscal and taxation system, focusing on resolving the division of powers and expenditure responsibilities between the central and local governments, improving the local tax system, enhancing local development capabilities, and perfecting the mechanism for sustainable fiscal development.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)

content: A sound financial institution system with reasonable division of labor and mutual complementarity between commercial finance, development finance, policy finance, and cooperative finance. Construct a multi-level, wide-coverage, and diverse banking institution system, expand private capital's entry into the banking industry, develop inclusive finance and multi-format small and micro financial organizations. Regulate the development of internet finance. Steadily promote comprehensive operations of financial institutions. Promote the transparency of private financing, regulate the development of small-scale loan and financing guarantee institutions, etc. Improve the management level and service quality of financial institutions.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, accelerate financial system reform, enrich the financial institution system.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Actively cultivate an open, transparent, and healthy capital market, increase the proportion of direct financing, and reduce leverage. Create conditions for implementing a stock issuance registration system, develop a multi-level equity financing market, deepen the reform of the Growth Enterprise Market (GEM) and the New Third Board, regulate the development of regional equity markets, and establish sound transfer and exit mechanisms. Improve the bond issuance registration system and the infrastructure of the bond market, accelerate the interconnection of the bond market. Develop financial services that meet innovation needs, prudently promote bond product innovation, promote financing methods combining high-yield bonds and stocks, and vigorously develop financing leasing services. Improve the interest rate and exchange rate market determination mechanism, better play the role of the government bond yield curve as a pricing benchmark. Promote the development of interbank lending, repurchase, bills, foreign exchange, gold, and other markets. Actively and prudently promote innovation in futures and other derivative markets. Accelerate the development of the insurance and reinsurance market, and explore the establishment of an insurance asset trading mechanism. Establish a safe and efficient financial infrastructure and implement the National Treasury Project.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, accelerate financial system reform, and improve the financial market system.

content: Improve the macroeconomic regulation system, innovate macroeconomic regulation methods, enhance the coordination of macroeconomic policies, pay more attention to expanding employment, stabilizing prices, adjusting structure, improving efficiency, preventing and controlling risks, and protecting the environment. Also, pay more attention to guiding market behavior and social expectations, and create a stable macroeconomic environment for structural reform.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, main objectives, and development concepts, innovate and improve macroeconomic regulation.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Persist in maintaining overall balance and optimizing structure, regarding keeping the economy operating within a reasonable range and improving quality and efficiency as the basic requirements and policy orientation of macroeconomic regulation. Strengthen targeted regulation and timely regulation based on range regulation, adopt precise control measures, and make timely pre-adjustments and fine-tuning. Maintain a stable policy stance, improve communication with the market, and enhance predictability and transparency. Better leverage fiscal policy to support targeted regulation. Establish a system for enterprises to publicly declare and supervise their product and service standards, support enterprises in improving their online quality testing and control, and product quality traceability throughout the entire lifecycle. We will establish special funds for industrial restructuring awards and subsidies, accelerate the exit of excess capacity in industries such as steel and coal through mergers and reorganizations, debt restructuring, bankruptcy liquidation, and asset revitalization. We will dispose of exiting enterprises in a classified, orderly, proactive, and prudent manner, and properly handle personnel placement and other related work.

Reduce the burden of value-added tax and turnover tax, clean up and standardize funds related to enterprises, eliminate unreasonable charges related to enterprises, and reduce the tax burden on enterprises. Improve the linkage mechanism of international and domestic energy prices and coal-electricity prices, and reduce enterprise energy costs. Improve the level of logistics organization and management, regulate highway toll collection behavior, and reduce enterprise logistics costs. Encourage and guide enterprises to innovate management, improve processes, and save energy and materials.

content: Accelerate the reform of the market-oriented system and mechanism, actively promote structural adjustment, increase support, enhance the development vitality, endogenous power, and overall competitiveness of old industrial bases such as the Northeast region.
