Carry out and actively encourage entrepreneurship and innovation, support the construction of technology and industrial innovation centers, attract various innovative elements such as talents, and make innovation a strong driving force for the development of the Northeast region. Accelerate the development of modern large-scale agriculture, promote the quality and efficiency improvement of traditional advantageous industries, build demonstration zones for industrial transformation and upgrading, and promote the construction of advanced equipment manufacturing bases and major technological equipment strategic bases. Support the transformation and development of resource-based cities, organize and implement major livelihood projects such as the renovation of old urban areas and the treatment of subsidence areas. Accelerate the construction of a high-speed railway network and power transmission channels. Deepen the reform of state-owned assets and state-owned enterprises, and accelerate the resolution of issues such as factory collective ownership. Support the central region in accelerating the construction of a modern three-dimensional transportation system and modern logistics system that connects the north and south, and the east and west, and cultivate and strengthen the growth poles of urban agglomerations along the Yangtze River and metropolitan areas. Actively undertake industrial transfers in an orderly manner, accelerate the development of modern agriculture and advanced manufacturing, support the transformation and development of the energy industry, build a number of strategic emerging industry and high-tech industry bases, and cultivate a number of industrial clusters. Strengthen water environmental protection and governance, promote the construction of the Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake ecological economic zones, and the Han River and Huai River ecological economic belts. Accelerate the construction of the Zhengzhou Airport Economic Comprehensive Experimental Zone. Support the development of an open inland economy.
titlelist: Build modern infrastructure networks to expand infrastructure construction space, accelerate the improvement of safe, efficient, intelligent, green, and interconnected modern foundations, and implement the overall strategy for regional development, promoting the rise of the central region.

content: Promote the protection of water resources and the treatment of water pollution in the entire river basin, so that the water quality of the Yangtze River main stream reaches or exceeds Class III level. Basically achieve full collection and treatment of sewage and garbage in towns along the main and tributary rivers. Properly handle the relationship between rivers and lakes, enhance water storage capacity, and strengthen ecological protection. Coordinate the planning of industrial and port shorelines along the river, cross-river passage shorelines, and intake and discharge port shorelines. Promote joint operation of reservoirs in the upper and middle reaches of the Yangtze River. Strengthen the treatment of phosphate mining and phosphate chemical pollution in the basin. Implement major ecological restoration projects such as the construction of the Yangtze River protection forest system, and enhance ecological functions such as water conservation and soil conservation. Strengthen the prevention and control of geological hazards in the Yangtze River basin. Strengthen the protection and restoration of key ecological functional areas in the basin. Establish the Yangtze River wetland protection fund. Innovate the mechanism for cross-regional ecological protection and environmental governance, and establish mechanisms for ecological protection and compensation. Build the Three Gorges Ecological Economic Cooperation Zone.
titlelist: Build a modern infrastructure network to expand the space for infrastructure construction, accelerate the improvement of safe, efficient, intelligent, green, and interconnected modern infrastructure, promote the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and construct a green ecological corridor along the river.

name: Outline of the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China (excerpt) (March 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Relying on the golden waterway of the Yangtze River, we will coordinate the development of various transportation modes. We will construct a 12.5-meter deepwater channel below Nanjing, carry out the renovation of the Yichang to Anqing waterway, promote the construction of a new waterway for the Three Gorges hub, and improve the comprehensive transportation system of the Three Gorges. We will optimize the port layout, accelerate the construction of the Wuhan and Chongqing Yangtze River shipping centers, as well as the regional shipping and logistics center in Nanjing. We will strengthen the construction of the integrated transportation system, vigorously develop the intermodal transportation between the river and sea, and the water and rail transportation, and establish a Zhoushan river-sea intermodal service center. We will promote the standardization of ship types on the Yangtze River and improve the intelligent safety guarantee system. We will accelerate the construction of high-speed railways and high-grade highways. We will strengthen the functions of aviation hubs and improve the layout of feeder airports. We will construct main oil and gas pipelines along the river and promote pipeline interconnection.
titlelist: Build modern infrastructure networks to expand infrastructure construction space, accelerate the improvement of safe, efficient, intelligent, green, and interconnected modern infrastructure, promote the development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, and construct a high-quality comprehensive three-dimensional transportation corridor.

Establish a water efficiency labeling system and promote water-saving technologies and products. Accelerate the utilization of unconventional water resources and implement projects for utilizing rainwater and recycled water resources. Control the total water consumption within 670 billion cubic meters.

content: Support the participation of Hong Kong and Macau in the country's two-way opening-up and the construction of the Belt and Road Initiative, and encourage Mainland China and Hong Kong and Macau enterprises to leverage their respective advantages and cooperate in various ways to go global. Increase the opening-up of Mainland China to Hong Kong and Macau, and promote the upgrading of arrangements for closer economic and trade relations between Mainland China and Hong Kong and Macau. Deepen financial cooperation between Mainland China and Hong Kong, and accelerate the interconnection of the two markets. Support the construction of a high-quality living circle in the Greater Bay Area, and accelerate the construction of cooperation platforms such as Qianhai, Nansha, and Hengqin in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau region. Support Hong Kong and Macau in playing an important role in regional cooperation in the Pan-Pearl River Delta, and promote the construction of major cooperation platforms in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area and cross-provincial regions.

titlelist: Building a modern infrastructure network to expand the space for infrastructure construction, accelerating the improvement of safe, efficient, intelligent, green, and interconnected modern foundations, promoting peaceful development of cross-strait relations and the process of national reunification.

content: By 2025, a green, low-carbon, and circular economic system will be initially formed, with a significant improvement in energy efficiency in key industries. Energy consumption per unit of GDP will decrease by 13.5% compared to 2020, and carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP will decrease by 18% compared to 2020. The proportion of non-fossil energy consumption will reach around 20%. Forest coverage will reach 24.1%, with a forest stock volume of 18 billion cubic meters, laying a solid foundation for achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality. By 2030, significant progress will be made in the comprehensive green transformation of economic and social development, and energy efficiency in key energy-consuming industries will reach international advanced levels. Energy consumption per unit of GDP will decrease significantly, and carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP will decrease by over 65% compared to 2005. Optimize the functions of government service platforms at all levels to facilitate online services for the elderly. Support communities and institutions in providing digital skills training for the elderly population and maintain necessary offline service channels. Establish a comprehensive supervision system for smart elderly care services and promote the healthy development of the smart elderly care market.
titlelist: Priority Action, Expansion of Smart Elderly Care Services

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Central Cyberspace Administration and Informationization Committee/December 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Establish and improve the policy system for the development of a digital China. Relevant departments should refine the planning and policies in areas such as digital economy, technological innovation, digital government, and digital society, in accordance with the development framework, main directions, and major tasks determined by the plan, and ensure their alignment with this plan. Encourage and guide the capital market to strengthen support for core technologies and strategic emerging industries, and build an investment and financing system involving industrial funds and social capital in a market-oriented manner. Innovate the ways of financial support, increase the coordination of existing national science and technology plans, and support the research and development of key core technologies and major technological experiments and verifications. Explore the recognition of cloud service usage, intelligent devices, and digital transformation investments as eligible collateral and research and development inputs. Optimize the system of intellectual property pledge financing and increase financing support for small and micro internet finance enterprises with stable operations and good credit. Coordinate efforts to protect intellectual property rights, conduct anti-monopoly measures, and ensure fair competition in the information field, and promote the independent and orderly flow and efficient allocation of innovative elements.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Governance of Science and Technology Ethics (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on March 20, 2022)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Science and technology activities should adhere to the development ideology centered on the people, which is conducive to promoting economic development, social progress, improvement of people's livelihoods, and ecological environment protection. It continuously enhances people's sense of gain, happiness, and security, and promotes peaceful development and sustainable development of human society.
titlelist: Clarify the principles of technology ethics and enhance human well-being.

content: Technological activities should avoid causing harm or potential threats to human life safety, physical health, mental and psychological well-being to the greatest extent possible. They should respect human dignity and personal privacy, and ensure the right to information and choice for participants in technological activities. The use of experimental animals should comply with requirements such as 'reduction, replacement, and optimization'.
titlelist: Clarify the principles of technology ethics, respect the right to life.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Governance of Science and Technology Ethics (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on March 20, 2022)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Technological activities should respect differences in religious beliefs, cultural traditions, and other aspects, and treat different social groups fairly, justly, and inclusively, in order to prevent discrimination and prejudice.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Governance of Science and Technology Ethics (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on March 20, 2022)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Technological activities should encourage the reasonable participation of stakeholders and the general public, and establish a disclosure mechanism for technological activities involving significant and sensitive ethical issues. When disclosing relevant information about technological activities, transparency should be increased to ensure objectivity and truthfulness.
titlelist: Clarify the principles of technology ethics and maintain openness and transparency.

content: Promote the establishment of the Chinese Society for Science and Technology Ethics, improve the social organizational system for science and technology ethics governance, and strengthen academic research support. Relevant scientific societies, associations, research institutes, and other science and technology-related social organizations should organize and mobilize scientific and technological personnel to actively participate in science and technology ethics governance, promote industry self-discipline, strengthen cooperation with universities, research institutions, medical and health institutions, enterprises, etc., carry out popularization of science and technology ethics knowledge, and enhance public awareness of science and technology ethics.
titlelist: Establish a sound system for the governance of scientific and technological ethics, and leverage the role of scientific and technological social organizations.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Governance of Science and Technology Ethics (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on March 20, 2022)

content: Technology personnel should actively learn about technology ethics, enhance their awareness of technology ethics, consciously practice the principles of technology ethics, adhere to the bottom line of technology ethics, and report and resist behaviors that violate the requirements of technology ethics. The project leader should strictly conduct research within the scope approved by the technology ethics review, strengthen ethical management of team members and the entire research process of the project, and the publication, dissemination, and application of research results involving sensitive issues of technology ethics should comply with relevant regulations and be rigorous and cautious.
titlelist: Establish a sound system for the governance of scientific and technological ethics, and guide scientific and technological personnel to consciously abide by ethical requirements in science and technology.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Governance of Science and Technology Ethics (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on March 20, 2022)

content: Support relevant institutions, think tanks, social organizations, and scientific and technological personnel to carry out theoretical exploration of science and technology ethics, strengthen forward-looking research on ethical issues in scientific and technological innovation, actively promote and participate in international discussions and rule-making on major issues in science and technology ethics.
titlelist: Strengthen the governance system to ensure the ethics of science and technology, and enhance the theoretical research on the ethics of science and technology.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Governance of Science and Technology Ethics (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on March 20, 2022)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: The relevant departments should promote the improvement of the monitoring and early warning mechanism for ethical risks in higher education institutions, research institutions, medical and health institutions, social organizations, and enterprises. They should track the latest developments in emerging technologies, strengthen the assessment of potential conflicts, social risks, and ethical challenges brought about by technological innovation, and propose corresponding strategies.
titlelist: Strengthen technology ethics review and supervision, monitor and warn against technology ethics risks.

content: Integrate technology ethics training into the onboarding training for technology personnel, as well as activities such as undertaking research tasks and participating in academic exchanges and seminars. Guide technology personnel to consciously abide by the requirements of technology ethics and engage in responsible research and innovation. Industry regulatory authorities, local governments, and relevant organizations should regularly provide training for members of technology ethics (review) committees to enhance their performance capabilities and improve the quality and efficiency of technology ethics review.
titlelist: Deepen the promotion of science and technology ethics education and publicity, and promote the institutionalization of science and technology ethics training.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: By 2025, the digital economy will enter a comprehensive expansion phase. The value added of the core industries in the digital economy will account for 10% of GDP. The ability to lead development through digital innovation will significantly improve, and the level of intelligence will be noticeably enhanced. The integration of digital technology and the real economy will achieve significant results. The governance system of the digital economy will be further improved, and the competitiveness and influence of China's digital economy will steadily increase. - The preliminary establishment of the data factor market system. The data resource system will be basically completed, and the use of data resources will promote the synergy of the entire value chain of research and development, production, circulation, services, and consumption. The effectiveness of market-oriented construction of data factors will be evident, and orderly data rights, pricing, and transactions will be carried out. Explorations will be made to establish an income distribution mechanism that is compatible with the value and contribution of data factors, stimulating the innovation vitality of market entities. - Industrial digital transformation will reach a new level. The digital transformation of agriculture will progress rapidly, and the digitization, networking, and intelligence of manufacturing will deepen. The integrated development of productive services will accelerate and popularize, while the diversification of lifestyle services will significantly accelerate. The supporting service system for industrial digital transformation will be basically complete, promoting green development in the process of digital transformation. - The level of digital industrialization will significantly improve. The independent innovation capability of digital technology will be significantly enhanced, and the quality of digital products and services will be greatly improved. The core competitiveness of the industry will be significantly enhanced, and global leading advantages will be formed in some fields. New industries, new formats, and new models will continue to emerge and widely spread, significantly enhancing the driving force for improving the quality and efficiency of the real economy. - Digital public services will be more inclusive and equitable. Digital infrastructure will be widely integrated into production and life, further highlighting its support for government services, public services, social welfare, and social governance. The digital business environment will be further optimized, the level of e-government services will be further improved, and the networked, digitalized, and intelligent convenience service system for enterprises will be continuously improved, accelerating the bridging of the digital divide. - The governance system of the digital economy will be further improved. A coordinated and unified framework and rules system for the governance of the digital economy will be basically established, and cross-departmental and cross-regional collaborative regulatory mechanisms will be basically sound. The government's digital supervision capability will be significantly enhanced, and the level of industry and market supervision will be greatly improved. A governance pattern for the digital economy led by the government, with diverse participation and legal guarantees, will be basically formed, and the level of governance will be significantly improved. The legal and regulatory system that is compatible with the development of the digital economy will be further improved, and the security system of the digital economy will be further strengthened. Looking ahead to 2035, the digital economy will move towards a period of prosperity and maturity, striving to form a unified, fair, orderly, mature, and complete modern market system for the digital economy. The foundation of digital economic development and the level of industrial system development will be at the forefront of the world.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Build a comprehensive digital information infrastructure that is high-speed, ubiquitous, integrated with the earth and sky, converged with cloud and network, intelligent and agile, green and low-carbon, and safe and controllable. Promote the expansion of backbone networks in an orderly manner, coordinate the construction of gigabit fiber optic networks and 5G network infrastructure, promote the commercial deployment and large-scale application of 5G, proactively plan for the reserve of sixth-generation mobile communication (6G) network technology, increase support for 6G technology research and development, and actively participate in promoting international standardization work for 6G. Actively and steadily promote the evolution and upgrade of spatial information infrastructure, accelerate the layout of satellite communication networks, and promote the construction of satellite internet. Improve the coverage level of the Internet of Things in industrial manufacturing, agricultural production, public services, emergency management, and other fields, and enhance the integration of fixed and mobile, and the combination of wide and narrowband IoT access capabilities.
titlelist: Optimize and upgrade digital infrastructure, accelerate the construction of information network infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the construction of a national integrated big data center system that synergizes computing power, algorithms, data, and application resources. Establish national integrated computing power network hubs in regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Circle, Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia. Build data center clusters and optimize the layout of data center construction based on application and industrial development needs. Speed up the implementation of the East Data, West Computing project, promote the coordinated development of cloud and network, enhance the cross-network and cross-regional data exchange capabilities of data centers, strengthen edge computing capabilities for specific scenarios, and enhance computing power coordination and intelligent scheduling. Continuously promote the construction of green digital centers based on the principles of green, low-carbon, intensive, and efficient. Accelerate the energy-saving transformation of data centers and continuously improve the utilization of renewable energy in data centers. Promote the orderly development of intelligent computing centers, create a new type of intelligent infrastructure that integrates intelligent computing power, general algorithms, and development platforms, and provide systematic artificial intelligence services for key emerging areas such as government services, smart cities, intelligent manufacturing, autonomous driving, and language intelligence.
titlelist: Optimize and upgrade digital infrastructure, promote the coordinated development of cloud and network integration.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Steadily build intelligent and efficient integrated infrastructure, enhance the level of infrastructure networking, intelligence, service, and collaboration. Efficiently layout artificial intelligence infrastructure, enhance the industry's empowerment capabilities to support the development of 'intelligence +'. Promote the intelligent transformation of agricultural, forestry, animal husbandry, and fishery infrastructure and production equipment, advance the application of technologies such as machine vision and machine learning. Construct reliable, flexible, and secure industrial Internet infrastructure, support ubiquitous connectivity, elastic supply, and efficient allocation of manufacturing resources. Accelerate the digital transformation of infrastructure in energy, transportation, water conservancy, logistics, environmental protection, and other fields. Promote the construction of new urban infrastructure, enhance the intelligence level of municipal public facilities and buildings. Build advanced and inclusive, intelligent collaborative digital integration facilities for life services. In the process of intelligent upgrading of infrastructure, fully meet the special needs of the elderly and other groups, and create a new type of digital life characterized by smart sharing and harmonious governance.
titlelist: Optimize and upgrade digital infrastructure, promote intelligent upgrading of infrastructure in an orderly manner.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Support market entities to carry out data collection in accordance with the law, focusing on data annotation, cleaning, de-identification, aggregation, analysis, and other processes, enhancing data resource processing capabilities, and cultivating and expanding the data service industry. Promote the construction of a data resource standard system, improve data management level and data quality, explore sharing, exchange, collaboration, and openness for business applications. Accelerate the compatibility and unification of communication protocols in various fields, break through technical and protocol barriers, strive to achieve interoperability, and form a complete and smooth data chain. Promote data classification and hierarchical management, strengthen data security risk assessment, monitoring, early warning, and emergency response. Deepen the orderly sharing of government data across levels, regions, and departments. Establish and improve the national public data resource system, coordinate the development and utilization of public data resources, promote the secure and orderly opening of basic public data, build a unified national public data open platform and development and utilization portal, enhance the level of public data openness, and unleash the dividend of data.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of data elements and strengthen the supply of high-quality data elements.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the establishment of market rules for data elements, cultivate market entities, improve governance systems, and promote the circulation of data elements. Encourage market entities to explore data asset pricing mechanisms, promote the formation of data asset catalogs, and gradually improve data pricing systems. Regulate data transaction management, cultivate standardized data trading platforms and market entities, establish a sound market operation system for data asset evaluation, registration and settlement, transaction matching, dispute arbitration, etc., and enhance data transaction efficiency. Crack down on illegal data trading and create a safe and orderly market environment.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of data elements and accelerate the market-oriented circulation of data elements.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adapt to the characteristics of different types of data, guided by practical application needs, and explore the establishment of diverse mechanisms for data development and utilization. Encourage market forces to explore the value of commercial data, promote the productization and service-oriented development of data value, vigorously develop professional and personalized data services, promote deep integration of data, technology, and scenarios, and meet the data needs of various fields. Encourage key industries to innovate data development and utilization models, and ensure data security and protect user privacy, mobilizing industry associations, research institutes, enterprises, and other parties to participate in the development of data value. For government data and public data with economic and social value that allow processing and utilization, encourage more social forces to engage in value-added development and utilization through data openness, authorized development, and authorized applications. Combined with the construction of new smart cities, accelerate the integration of urban data and the cultivation of industrial ecology, and enhance the level of urban data operation and development utilization.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of data elements and innovate the mechanism for developing and utilizing data elements.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)

content: Guide enterprises to strengthen digital thinking, enhance employees' digital skills and data management capabilities, comprehensively and systematically promote the digital transformation of business functions such as research and development, design, production, processing, operation management, and sales services. Support large enterprises with conditions to build integrated digital platforms, comprehensively integrate internal information systems, strengthen end-to-end data connectivity, accelerate business collaboration along the entire value chain, form data-driven intelligent decision-making capabilities, and improve overall operational efficiency and upstream and downstream synergy in the industrial chain. Implement special actions to empower digitalization for small and medium-sized enterprises, support them in starting from urgent needs in digital transformation, accelerate the promotion of online marketing, remote collaboration, digital office, intelligent production lines, and other applications, and extend and expand digital transformation from specific areas to the entire business and process. Encourage and support internet platforms, industry leaders, and other enterprises to leverage their own advantages, open up digital resources and capabilities, and help traditional enterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises achieve digital transformation. Promote inclusive cloud and data intelligence services, promote enterprises to move to the cloud and platforms, reduce technological and financial barriers, and accelerate enterprise digital transformation.
titlelist: Vigorously promote the digital transformation of industries and accelerate the digital transformation and upgrading of enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)

Deepen the digital transformation of the industrial sector, accelerate the digital transformation of the entire life cycle of research and development, design, production, manufacturing, operation management, and market services, and accelerate the cultivation of a group of specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises and manufacturing champions. Implement smart manufacturing projects, vigorously promote equipment digitalization, carry out pilot demonstration projects for smart manufacturing, and improve the national smart manufacturing standard system. Cultivate and promote new models such as personalized customization and networked collaboration. Vigorously develop digital commerce, comprehensively accelerate the digital transformation of service industries such as commerce, logistics, and finance, optimize management systems and service models, and improve the quality and efficiency of the service industry. Promote the deep application of digital technology in the field of whole-process engineering consulting, leading the transformation and upgrading of consulting services and engineering construction models. Accelerate the promotion and application of smart energy construction, promote the intelligent upgrading of energy production, transportation, consumption, and other links, and promote the low-carbon transformation of the energy industry. Accelerate the construction and application of the national spatial basic information platform. Promote the integration and application of industrial internet, cultivate integrated development models such as supply chain finance and service-oriented manufacturing, and promote the integration and development of industries through digital technology.
titlelist: Vigorously promote the digital transformation of industries, comprehensively deepen the digital transformation of key industries.

Around the common transformation needs, promote the landing and scale development of shared manufacturing platforms in industrial clusters. Explore the development of virtual industrial parks and industrial clusters that transcend physical boundaries, accelerate the virtual aggregation of industrial resources, platform-based operations, and networked collaboration, and build a new ecosystem of digitalization combining virtual and real. Relying on key regions such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the Chengdu-Chongqing region, coordinate the promotion of digital infrastructure construction, explore the establishment of new mechanisms for cross-regional and cross-platform collaboration in various industrial clusters, promote the integration and sharing of innovative elements, and build a regional digital development ecosystem that promotes innovation collaboration, complementary advantages, and supply-demand linkage, and enhance the collaborative supporting capabilities of industrial chain and supply chain.
titlelist: Vigorously promote the digital transformation of industries, and promote the digital transformation of industrial parks and industrial clusters.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)

content: Establish a dual-driven service ecosystem of market-oriented services and public services, supported by multiple factors such as technology, capital, talent, and data, to solve the difficulties faced by enterprises in not knowing how to transform, not being able to transform, and not daring to transform. Cultivate and promote a number of digital solutions targeting key industries and enterprise transformation needs. Focus on transformation consulting, standard formulation, testing and evaluation, and cultivate a number of third-party specialized service organizations to enhance the scale and vitality of the digital transformation service market. Support universities, leading enterprises, industry associations, etc., to strengthen collaboration, build comprehensive testing and verification environments, and enhance the supply of industry-specific solutions. Establish a digital transformation promotion center to connect and gather various resources, provide public services for digital transformation, create a regional industrial digital innovation complex, and drive the digital transformation of traditional industries.
titlelist: Vigorously promote the digital transformation of industries and cultivate the supporting service ecosystem for transformation.

We encourage the development of new research and development institutions, innovative joint ventures, and other new innovation entities, and create a diversified, networked, and market-oriented innovation ecosystem. We support the development of open-source communities, platforms, and projects with independent core technologies, promote the co-construction and sharing of innovative resources, and promote the open evolution of innovation models.
titlelist: Accelerate the promotion of digital industrialization and enhance key technological innovation capabilities.

Deepen the integration innovation and application of new generation information technology, accelerate the innovation of platform-based, customized, and lightweight service models, and create new advantages in emerging digital industries. Coordinate the industrialization and large-scale application of information technology software and hardware products, accelerate integration, adaptation, and iterative optimization, promote the growth and strengthening of the software industry, and enhance the innovation and supply capability of key software and hardware technologies.
titlelist: Accelerate the promotion of digital industrialization and enhance the competitiveness of core industries.

Deepen the application of the sharing economy in the field of life services, expand new spaces for resource sharing in innovation, production, supply chains, and other areas. Improve the system of diverse value transmission and contribution distribution, and orderly guide the development of diversified social, short video, knowledge sharing, and other new employment and entrepreneurship platforms.
titlelist: Accelerate the promotion of digital industrialization, accelerate the cultivation of new formats and models.

Encourage the development of new collaborative platforms such as open-source communities and developer platforms, cultivate a digital industry innovation ecosystem that promotes open collaboration among large, medium, and small enterprises and social developers, and drive the rapid growth of innovative enterprises. Promote the construction of industrial innovation service platforms as a whole in parks, industries, and regions, strengthen the aggregation of advantageous resources such as technology research and development, standard revision, testing and evaluation, application training, and entrepreneurship incubation, and enhance the level of support for industrial innovation services.
titlelist: Accelerate the promotion of digital industrialization and create a prosperous and orderly ecosystem for industrial innovation.

content: Comprehensively enhance the functionality of the national integrated government service platform, accelerate the standardization, regularization, and facilitation of government services, continuously improve the digitization and intelligence level of government services, and achieve the one-stop handling of high-frequency service matters for the convenience of enterprises and the public. Establish and improve the coordination mechanism for the sharing of government data, accelerate the mutual trust and recognition of digital identity unified authentication, electronic licenses, electronic signatures, electronic documents, etc., promote the electronic invoicing reform, and promote the sharing of government data, process optimization, and business collaboration. Promote the overall linkage of online and offline government services, fully online processes, and deep expansion to the grassroots level, and improve the level of service convenience and sharing. Carry out deep integration and innovation of government data with business and services, enhance the ability to predict transactional needs based on big data, and create proactive and multi-level innovative service scenarios. Focus on public health, social security, emergency management, and other fields, deepen the application of digital technology, and achieve rapid response and coordinated disposal of major public emergencies.
titlelist: Continuously improve the level of digitization of public services, enhance the efficiency of 'Internet + government services'.

content: Accelerate the digital supply and networked services of public service resources in the fields of cultural education, medical health, exhibition tourism, sports and fitness, and promote the sharing and reuse of high-quality resources. Make full use of new digital technologies to strengthen the connection between supply and demand in areas such as employment, elderly care, child welfare, childcare, and household services, and further optimize resource allocation. Develop smart radio and television networks, accelerate the integration and upgrading of national cable television networks. Carry out pilot projects for universal telecommunications services, and improve the level of network coverage in rural and remote areas. Strengthen remote services for revolutionary old areas, ethnic areas, border areas, and poverty-stricken areas, expand education, medical care, social security, and targeted assistance services, and help achieve equalization of basic public services. Strengthen the construction of information accessibility and enhance the digital social service capabilities for special groups. Promote deep integration of social services and digital platforms, explore cross-sector cooperation in multiple fields, and promote the integration of medical care and elderly care, culture and education, sports and medicine, and culture and tourism.
titlelist: Continuously improve the level of digitization of public services, and enhance the level of digital inclusiveness in social services.

Deepen the construction of new smart cities, promote the integration and sharing of urban data and business collaboration, enhance the comprehensive management service capabilities of cities, improve the urban information model platform and operation management service platform, and build digital twin cities according to local conditions. Accelerate the extension and coverage of urban intelligent facilities to rural areas, improve the supply of information services in rural areas, promote the two-way free flow of urban and rural factors, allocate public resources reasonably, and form a pattern of integrated development of digital urban and rural areas with the city leading the countryside and joint construction and sharing. By 2030, the installed capacity of pumped storage power stations will reach approximately 120 million kilowatts, and provincial-level power grids will have a peak load response capacity of over 5%.
titlelist: Key tasks, energy green low-carbon transformation action, accelerate the construction of a new power system.

content: Areas where carbon emissions have already stabilized need to consolidate the achievements in emission reduction and further reduce carbon emissions on the basis of achieving carbon peaking. Regions with a heavy industrial structure and a coal-dominated energy structure, as well as resource-based regions, should prioritize energy conservation and carbon reduction, vigorously optimize and adjust the industrial and energy structure, gradually decouple carbon emissions growth from economic growth, and strive to achieve carbon peaking in sync with the rest of the country.
titlelist: Key tasks, each region should implement a step-by-step and orderly carbon peak action, scientifically and reasonably determine the orderly peak target.

The central and western regions, as well as the northeastern region, should focus on optimizing energy structure, orderly promoting the concentration of high-energy-consuming industries in clean energy advantage areas in accordance with industrial policies and dual control requirements for energy consumption, and actively cultivating green development momentum.

Encourage social capital to establish green and low-carbon industry investment funds in a market-oriented manner.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Based on the national conditions and looking towards the future, we will build an industrial internet ecosystem that is compatible with the development of our country's economy. We aim to make our country's level of industrial internet development at the forefront internationally, striving to achieve and even lead. By 2025, we will have basically formed a foundation of infrastructure and industrial systems with international competitiveness. The industrial internet network infrastructure will be established in various regions and industries. The industrial internet identification and resolution system will be continuously improved and scaled up. We will establish 3-5 industrial internet platforms that reach international standards. The industrial system will be relatively sound, with mastery of key core technologies and significantly enhanced supply capabilities, forming a group of internationally competitive leading enterprises. We will establish a relatively complete and reliable industrial internet security system. New technologies, new models, and new formats will be widely promoted and applied, pushing forward the integration of the two industries to a new level. In the initial stage from 2018 to 2020, we will initially build a low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage industrial internet network infrastructure. We will initially construct an industrial internet identification and resolution system and initially form a platform system for industrial internet development with different focuses and collaborative aggregation. We will also establish an initial industrial internet security system. By 2035, we will have built internationally leading industrial internet network infrastructure and platforms, formed internationally advanced technology and industrial systems, comprehensively and deeply applied industrial internet, and developed innovative capabilities in advantageous industries. The security capabilities will be comprehensively enhanced, and key areas will achieve international leadership. By the middle of this century, the industrial internet network infrastructure will comprehensively support economic and social development. The innovation and development capabilities, technological and industrial systems, and integrated applications of the industrial internet will reach international advanced levels. Our comprehensive strength will enter the forefront of the world.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the transformation, upgrading, speed increase, and cost reduction of the internet. In response to the low latency, high reliability, and wide coverage network needs of enterprises, vigorously promote the construction of internal and external networks for industrial enterprises. Accelerate the construction and transformation of broadband network infrastructure, expand network coverage, and optimize and upgrade the national backbone network. Promote the IP (Internet Protocol), flat, and flexible technical transformation and construction deployment of internal networks of industrial enterprises. Promote the application of new intelligent gateways and fully deploy IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6). Continue to promote the construction of dedicated lines for connecting small and medium-sized enterprises. Based on the completion of the network speed increase and cost reduction tasks determined in the 2017 government work report, further improve network speed and reduce tariff levels, especially significantly reduce the tariff levels for internet access of small and medium-sized enterprises. Strengthen resource openness and support the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Increase the guarantee of key resources such as radio spectrum. Promote the construction of identification resolution systems. Strengthen the top-level design of the industrial internet identification resolution system, formulate an overall architecture, clarify development goals, roadmaps, and timetables. Establish a national management agency for industrial internet identification resolution, build an identification resolution service system, support the construction of various levels of identification resolution nodes and public recursive resolution nodes, use identification to achieve precise connection between global supply chain systems and enterprise production systems, as well as cross-enterprise, cross-regional, and cross-industry product lifecycle management, and promote the integration and sharing of information resources. Column 1: Industrial Internet Infrastructure Upgrade and Transformation Project. Organize the construction and upgrade of internal networks of industrial enterprises, external networks of industrial enterprises, and identification resolution systems for the industrial internet. Support the transformation of internal networks of industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Passive Optical Network (PON), and industrial wireless, and upgrade and transform the external networks of industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), and new cellular mobile communication technologies. Conduct network technology experiments for industrial internet applications in 5G research and coordinate the deployment of 5G in industrial enterprises. Carry out the construction of the industrial internet identification resolution system and establish and improve various levels of identification resolution nodes. By 2020, basically complete the upgrade and transformation of the next-generation internet and supporting management capabilities for advanced manufacturing, achieve the application of wireless network technologies such as Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) and Wireless Industrial Automation/Process (WIA-PA/FA) in key areas and industries; initially establish supporting systems such as industrial internet identification resolution registration and filing, and form more than 10 public identification resolution service nodes with a registration volume of over 2 billion. By 2025, deploy industrial internet network technologies such as industrial wireless, Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), and IPv6 in large-scale industrial enterprises; achieve universal coverage of 5G networks and low-power wide-area networks for industrial internet access; establish a fully functional industrial internet identification resolution system, form more than 20 public identification resolution service nodes, and have a registration volume of over 3 billion.
titlelist: Main task, solidify network foundation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the construction of industrial internet platforms. Break through key technological bottlenecks such as data integration, platform management, development tools, microservice frameworks, and modeling analysis, and form a technical system and industrial system that effectively support the development of industrial internet platforms. Carry out experimental verification in terms of adaptability, reliability, and security of industrial internet platforms, and promote continuous improvement of platform functions. Form a multi-level and systematic platform development system through classification, synchronous promotion, and dynamic adjustment. Relying on industrial internet platforms to create multi-level public platforms that serve mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Enhance platform operation capabilities. Strengthen the resource aggregation capabilities of industrial internet platforms, effectively integrate data resources such as product design, production processes, equipment operations, and operation management, and gather and share manufacturing resources such as design capabilities, production capabilities, software resources, and knowledge models. Carry out application innovation for different industries and scenarios, providing users with various applications including equipment health maintenance, production management optimization, collaborative design and manufacturing, and manufacturing resource leasing, and enhance service capabilities. Continuously explore business model innovation, expand platform profit space through resource rental, service provision, industry-finance cooperation, etc., and achieve long-term sustainable operation. The networking platform carries out R&D design, production manufacturing, operation management, and other businesses, and the basic and supporting role of industrial internet platforms in industrial transformation and upgrading is initially evident. Column 2: Construction and promotion of industrial internet platform engineering. Start from both the supply and demand sides of industrial internet platforms, and carry out construction and promotion in four aspects: First, cultivate industrial internet platforms. Through enterprise-led, market selection, and dynamic adjustment, form cross-industry, cross-domain platforms, realize interconnection and interoperability of multiple platforms, undertake functions such as resource aggregation and sharing, technology standard testing and verification, and provide services such as industrial data circulation, business resource management, and industrial operation monitoring. Promote leading enterprises to actively develop enterprise-level platforms and develop various solutions that meet the needs of enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent development. Establish and improve the technical system of industrial internet platforms. Second, conduct trial and verification of industrial internet platforms. Support industry alliances, cooperation between enterprises and research institutions to jointly build test and verification platforms, and carry out technology verification and testing evaluation. Third, migrate millions of enterprises to the cloud. Encourage the landing of industrial internet platforms in industrial agglomeration areas, and promote local governments to encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to migrate their business systems to the cloud through financial and tax support, government procurement of services, and other means. Fourth, cultivate millions of industrial apps. Support software companies, industrial enterprises, research institutes, etc., to cooperate and cultivate a batch of industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios. By 2020, the industrial internet platform system will initially take shape, supporting the construction of about 10 cross-industry, cross-domain platforms, and building a batch of enterprise-level platforms that support enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent transformation. Cultivate 300,000 industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios, and promote the application of industrial internet in 300,000 enterprises. By 2025, key industries will achieve networked manufacturing, the industrial internet platform system will be basically improved, 3-5 industrial internet platforms with international competitiveness will be formed, millions of industrial apps will be cultivated, millions of enterprises will migrate to the cloud, and a new ecosystem of manufacturing industry will be formed through the iterative development and mutual promotion of platform construction and platform utilization.
titlelist: The main task is to build a platform system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Increase the efforts in key common technology research. Conduct research on new network interconnection technologies such as time-sensitive networks, deterministic networks, and low-power industrial wireless networks, and accelerate the application research of 5G, software-defined networks, and other technologies in the industrial internet. Promote the research on key technologies and secure and reliable mechanisms for industrial internet identification resolution, information management, and heterogeneous identification interoperability. Accelerate the research on core technologies such as IPv6. Promote the application research and exploration of emerging frontier technologies such as edge computing, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, virtual reality, and blockchain in the industrial internet. Build an industrial internet standard system. Establish a national industrial internet standard coordination and promotion group, an overall group, and an expert advisory group to coordinate the construction of the industrial internet standard system, optimize the promotion mechanism, and accelerate the establishment of a unified, comprehensive, and open industrial internet standard system. Develop a series of general standards, basic common standards, application standards, and security standards. Organize standard development and test verification projects, and promote the development and promotion of standard content test verification, test verification environment construction, simulation and testing tool development. By 2025, basically establish a standard system covering key technologies, products, management, and applications of the industrial internet, and widely apply it in enterprises. Column 3: Standard development and test verification projects. Carry out the development of industrial internet standards based on the standardization needs and the construction of the standard system for the industrial internet. Develop general standards such as general requirements, system architecture, and testing and evaluation; develop basic common standards such as network and digital interconnection interfaces, identification resolution, industrial internet platforms, and security; develop industry application guidelines, specific technical standards, and management specifications for key industries such as automotive, aerospace, petrochemical, machinery manufacturing, light industry and home appliances, and information electronics. Organize the test verification of relevant standards and promote the development of supporting simulation and testing tools. By 2020, initially establish an industrial internet standard system, formulate more than 20 general and key basic common standards, formulate more than 20 key industry standards, and promote the application of standards in key enterprises and industries. Enhance product and solution supply capabilities. Accelerate the research and industrialization of information communication, data integration and analysis, and focus on breakthroughs in key software and hardware products and solutions such as high-performance networks, intelligent modules, intelligent networking equipment, and industrial software. Focus on improving the integration and innovation level of data analysis algorithms with industrial knowledge, mechanisms, and experience, and develop a batch of industrial data analysis software and systems for different industrial scenarios, as well as industrial intelligence software and solutions with deep learning and other artificial intelligence technologies. Create integrated solutions for the industrial internet closely aligned with the characteristics of key sectors and traditional industries in response to the needs of transformation and upgrading. Guide telecommunications operators, internet companies, and industrial enterprises to actively transform and enhance their capabilities in industrial internet operation services such as network operation, identification resolution, and security, and develop innovative productive services such as industrial e-commerce, supply chain, and related financial information. Column 4: Key technology industrialization projects. Promote research and application of emerging frontier technologies such as new network interconnection and identification resolution in the industrial internet, establish technology test verification systems, and support technology and product test verification. Focus on key industrial links of the industrial internet and actively promote the industrialization of key technologies. Accelerate the industrialization of key network equipment for the industrial internet, develop key technologies and products such as IPv6, industrial passive optical networks, time-sensitive networks, industrial wireless, low-power wide area networks, software-defined networks, and identification resolution. Develop and promote key intelligent networked equipment, focus on key areas such as numerical control machine tools, industrial robots, and large-scale power equipment, achieve integrated innovation of intelligent control, intelligent sensing, industrial-grade chips, and network communication modules, and develop a series of new intelligent equipment with networking, computing, and optimization functions. Develop industrial big data analysis software, focus on key areas, develop industrial big data analysis application software for application scenarios such as production process optimization, quality analysis, predictive maintenance of equipment, and intelligent scheduling, and achieve industrial deployment. By 2020, make breakthroughs in a batch of key technologies, establish more than 5 technology test verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment with advanced domestic levels, and have active innovation in intelligent networked products, achieve quick access to functions such as industrial big data cleaning, management, and analysis, promote the application of technology and products in key enterprises and industries, and achieve initial industrialization of key technologies for the industrial internet. By 2025, master key core technologies, have technology test verification systems effectively support industrial internet technology research and experiments, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment that reaches international advanced levels, achieve large-scale commercial deployment of intelligent networked products and industrial big data analysis application software, and form a relatively sound industrial internet industry system.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen industrial support.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the innovation and application level of industrial Internet in large enterprises. Accelerate the application of industrial Internet in industrial sites, strengthen the networking and data collection capabilities of equipment in complex production processes, and achieve end-to-end integration of data resources at all levels of the enterprise. Carry out data integration applications based on the industrial Internet platform, form the ability of process optimization, workflow optimization, equipment maintenance, and accident risk warning based on data analysis and feedback, and realize intelligent decision-making and deep optimization of enterprise production and operation management. Encourage enterprises to integrate resources through the industrial Internet platform, build a collaborative manufacturing system that effectively organizes design, production, and supply chain resources, carry out large-scale customization that accurately matches user individual needs with product design and production, and promote the transformation of services towards quality traceability, equipment health management, and value-added services. Accelerate the popularization of industrial Internet applications in small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the deployment and application of low-cost, modular industrial Internet equipment and systems in small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance their digital and networked capabilities. Encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to fully utilize the cloud-based research and development design, production management, and operation optimization software of the industrial Internet platform, realize the migration of business systems to the cloud, and reduce the cost of digital and intelligent transformation. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises to open up professional knowledge, design creativity, and manufacturing capabilities, and carry out innovative applications such as supply-demand matching, integrated supply chain, industrial e-commerce, and crowdsourcing and crowdfunding based on the industrial Internet platform to improve the efficiency of social manufacturing resource allocation. Focus on intelligent home, wearable devices, and other fields, integrate advanced technologies such as 5G, deep learning, and big data, and meet typical needs such as high-precision positioning, intelligent human-computer interaction, and secure and reliable operation and maintenance. In terms of identification resolution and integration applications, implement innovative applications that integrate industrial Internet identification resolution systems with industrial enterprise information systems, support enterprises in exploring key product traceability based on identification services, multi-source heterogeneous data sharing, and lifecycle management applications. Column 5: Industrial Internet Integration and Innovation Application Engineering. Guided by pioneering applications, organize innovative application demonstrations and gradually explore the implementation path and application models of the industrial Internet. In terms of intelligent production applications, encourage large industrial enterprises to achieve wide interconnection between various production equipment and information systems internally, as well as the integration and intercommunication of related industrial data, and develop applications such as quality optimization, intelligent scheduling, and supply chain optimization based on this. In terms of remote service applications, carry out networked services for high-value intelligent equipment, realize remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and other remote service applications, and explore the development of remote services for comprehensive support in the defense industry. In terms of networked collaborative manufacturing applications, in response to the intelligent development needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, carry out innovative applications such as collaborative design, crowdsourcing, and cloud manufacturing, and realize online access to various industrial software and modular design and manufacturing resources. In terms of intelligent Internet of Things product applications, by 2020, initially form influential pilot application models of the industrial Internet, and establish around 150 application pilots. By 2025, expand the scope of industrial Internet applications, comprehensively promote them in key areas and key traditional industries, and achieve significant overall improvement in enterprise efficiency.
titlelist: The main task is to promote integrated applications.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Enhance security protection capabilities. Strengthen research on the industrial internet security system, combining technology and management, and establish a multi-layered security system for the industrial internet that covers equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security. Increase support for technology research and development and the transformation of achievements, with a focus on breakthroughs in core technologies such as identification and resolution system security, industrial internet platform security, industrial control system security, and industrial big data security. Promote the development of security products such as attack protection, vulnerability discovery, intrusion detection, situational awareness, security auditing, and trusted chips, establishing technical support capabilities that match the development of the industrial internet. Build a security assessment and certification system for industrial internet devices, networks, and platforms, conducting security capability assessments and certifications through third-party organizations such as industry alliances, leading to continuous improvement in the security protection capabilities of the industrial internet. Establish a data security protection system. Establish a comprehensive data security management system for the entire industrial internet industry chain, clarifying the data security protection responsibilities and specific requirements of relevant entities, and strengthening the security protection capabilities of data collection, storage, processing, transfer, deletion, and other processes. Establish a classification and management system for industrial data, formulating a mechanism for managing the flow of industrial internet data, specifying requirements for data retention and data leakage reporting, and strengthening supervision and inspection of industrial internet data security. Promote the construction of security technology means. Urge relevant enterprises in the industrial internet to fulfill their responsibilities as the main body of network security, guide enterprises to increase security investment, strengthen the construction of security protection and monitoring and disposal technology means, carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial internet security, and enhance security protection capabilities. Actively leverage the guiding role of relevant industry alliances, integrate industry resources, encourage alliance units to innovate service models, provide security operation and maintenance, security consulting, and other services, and enhance the overall security assurance service capabilities of the industry. Fully leverage the role of national professional institutions and social forces, enhance the national-level industrial internet security technology support capabilities, and focus on improving the capabilities of hazard investigation, attack detection, emergency response, and attack traceability. Implement and promote projects. Column 7: Enhancing Security Assurance Capability Project. Promote the improvement of national-level industrial internet security technology capabilities. Build industrial internet security monitoring, early warning, and protection and disposal platforms, industrial internet security core technology research and development platforms, industrial internet security testing and evaluation platforms, industrial internet test fields, etc. Guide enterprises to enhance their own industrial internet security protection capabilities. In key areas with good foundations such as automobiles, electronics, aerospace, energy, and urgent security needs such as the defense industry, establish industrial internet security management and technology systems, carry out pilot demonstrations and industry applications of security products and solutions. By 2020, based on the distribution of important industrial internet platforms and systems, organize targeted inspections and assessments; initially establish industrial internet security monitoring, early warning, and protection and disposal platforms; cultivate and form 3-5 industrial internet security enterprises with core competitiveness, and select a batch of innovative and practical network security pilot demonstrations. By 2025, form a series of standards covering industrial internet equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security, establish a sound industrial internet security certification system; comprehensively promote the application of industrial internet security products and services; significantly enhance the network security protection capabilities of industrial internet-related enterprises; and basically establish a national-level industrial internet security technology support system.
titlelist: Main task, strengthen security guarantee.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)

content: Improve the international development capabilities of enterprises. Encourage domestic and foreign enterprises to collaborate on technical research and product development in weak areas such as big data analysis, industrial data modeling, key software systems, and chips. Establish international cooperation mechanisms in industrial internet technology, products, platforms, and services, and promote the introduction and export of industrial internet platforms, integrated solutions, and more. Encourage close collaboration among domestic and foreign enterprises across different sectors and the entire industry chain. Strengthen multilateral dialogue and cooperation. Establish multi-level communication and dialogue mechanisms among governments, industry alliances, and enterprises to exchange and cooperate on major issues related to the latest development of industrial internet, global infrastructure construction, data flow, security, policies, and regulations. Enhance collaboration with international organizations to jointly formulate industrial internet standards and international rules, and build a multilateral, democratic, and transparent international governance system for the industrial internet.
titlelist: The main task is to promote openness and cooperation.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)

content: Strengthen the role of fiscal funds in guiding, and increase support for the development of industrial Internet through funds for industrial transformation and upgrading, with a focus on supporting the construction of network systems, platform systems, and security systems. Explore support methods such as first purchase and preferential purchase to promote the large-scale application of innovative products and services in the industrial Internet. Encourage eligible regions to support the development of local industrial Internet clusters by establishing special funds for industrial Internet and establishing risk compensation funds. Implement relevant tax incentives to promote accelerated depreciation of fixed assets, additional deductions for enterprise research and development expenses, preferential income tax for software and integrated circuit industry enterprises, and tax incentives for small and micro enterprises, and encourage relevant enterprises to accelerate the development and application of the industrial Internet.
titlelist: Ensure support and increase financial and tax support.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)

content: Support the expansion of the proportion of direct financing, support industrial internet companies that meet the conditions to carry out equity financing in domestic and foreign capital markets at all levels, actively promote the application of project income bonds, convertible bonds, corporate bonds, and company bonds in the field of industrial internet, and guide various types of investment funds to tilt towards the field of industrial internet. Increase support for targeted credit, improve the mechanism for banks to connect with enterprises, and provide loan services for technological, business, and application innovations in the field of industrial internet; encourage banking and financial institutions to innovate credit products, explore and develop pledge loan businesses such as data assets under the premise of legal compliance, controllable risks, and commercial sustainability. Extend the scope of financial services for the industrial chain, encourage eligible enterprise groups to establish financial companies to provide financial management services for industrial internet companies under the group, strengthen centralized management of funds, improve the efficiency of fund utilization, and reduce the cost of funds. Expand targeted insurance services, support insurance companies in developing corresponding insurance products based on the needs of the industrial internet.
titlelist: Guarantee support, innovate financial service methods.
