content: Improve and strengthen agricultural support policies, continue to promote the development of poverty-stricken areas, and promote agricultural harvest and farmers' income increase. Strengthen the stable production and supply of important agricultural products such as grain. Stabilize the sown area of grain, optimize the grain structure, strengthen field management for late-sown wheat, and promote increased production of soybeans and oil crops. Appropriately raise the minimum purchase price of rice and wheat. Ensure the supply and price stability of fertilizers and other agricultural materials, provide agricultural input subsidies to grain farmers again, increase support for major production areas, and ensure that farmers have reasonable income from grain cultivation and major production areas have inherent motivation for grain production. Firmly adhere to the red line of 1.8 billion mu of arable land, designate permanent basic farmland, effectively curb the non-agriculturalization of cultivated land and prevent non-foodization. Strengthen the transformation of low and medium-yield fields, establish 100 million mu of high-standard farmland, and build or transform a batch of large and medium-sized irrigation areas. Increase the protection of black soil and comprehensive utilization of saline-alkali land. Support the development of water-saving agriculture and dryland farming in the Yellow River Basin. Launch the third national soil survey. Accelerate the revitalization of the seed industry, strengthen agricultural scientific and technological research and development, and promote application, and improve the level of agricultural machinery and equipment. Enhance the capacity for prevention and control of agricultural meteorological disasters and prevention and control of animal and plant diseases. Strengthen the regulation of pig production capacity, ensure the production and supply of livestock, poultry, aquatic products, vegetables, and accelerate the development of modern facility-based agriculture. Support the production of cotton, sugarcane, and other crops. It is the responsibility of all regions to ensure national food security, and regions that import grain should stabilize grain production. All parties should work together to fill the rice bag and enrich the vegetable basket, and firmly hold the rice bowls of more than 1.4 billion Chinese people in their own hands. Consolidate and expand the achievements of poverty alleviation. Improve and implement the monitoring and assistance mechanism to prevent a return to poverty, and ensure that there is no large-scale return to poverty. Support the development of characteristic industries in poverty-stricken areas, strengthen labor cooperation and vocational skills training, and promote continuous income increase for people who have been lifted out of poverty. Strengthen assistance measures for key counties in national rural revitalization, provide follow-up support for relocation, deepen cooperation between eastern and western regions, targeted assistance, and support from social forces, vigorously implement the thousands of enterprises revitalizing thousands of villages action, and enhance the self-development capacity of poverty-stricken areas. Solidly and steadily promote rural reform and development. Carry out the second round of extending the land contract period for another 30 years in pilot counties. Deepen reforms in supply and marketing cooperatives, collective property rights, collective forest rights, state-owned forest areas and farms, and state farms. Actively develop new rural collective economy. Strengthen rural financial services and accelerate the development of rural industries. Strengthen county-level economy. Strictly regulate village mergers and protect traditional villages and rural landscapes. Launch rural construction actions, strengthen planning guidance, strengthen infrastructure construction such as water, electricity, roads, telecommunications, and postal services, and promote rural toilet and sewage and garbage treatment according to local conditions. Carry out civilized village and town construction. Strengthen the governance of wage arrears for migrant workers, support the employment and entrepreneurship of migrant workers, and provide more channels for rural residents to increase their income through employment.
titlelist: Billion yuan, vigorously promote agricultural production, and promote comprehensive rural revitalization.

Expand the coverage of export credit insurance for small and medium-sized foreign trade enterprises, strengthen export credit support, optimize foreign exchange services, accelerate export tax refund progress, and help stabilize orders and production for foreign trade enterprises. Accelerate the development of new forms and models of foreign trade, give full play to the role of cross-border e-commerce, and support the construction of a number of overseas warehouses. Actively expand the import of high-quality products and services. Innovate the development of trade in services and digital trade, and promote the implementation of a negative list for cross-border trade in services. Deepen customs facilitation reform, accelerate the construction of an international logistics system, and help reduce costs and improve efficiency in foreign trade. Actively utilize foreign investment. Implement the negative list for foreign investment access, and implement national treatment for foreign-funded enterprises. Expand the scope of encouraging foreign investment and support foreign investment in high-end manufacturing, research and development, modern services, and investment in central and western regions and the northeast. Optimize services to promote foreign investment and accelerate the implementation of major projects. Solidly promote the construction of pilot free trade zones and the Hainan Free Trade Port, promote reform and innovation in development zones, improve the development level of comprehensive bonded zones, and establish comprehensive pilot zones for opening up the service industry. China's open market will undoubtedly provide more opportunities for enterprises from all countries to develop in China. Build the Belt and Road initiative with high quality. Adhere to consultation, joint construction, and shared benefits, consolidate the foundation of cooperation in connectivity, and steadily expand cooperation in new areas. Promote the construction of the new land-sea corridor in the western region. Carry out foreign investment cooperation in an orderly manner and effectively prevent overseas risks. Deepen multilateral and bilateral economic and trade cooperation. The Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership has formed the world's largest free trade zone. We should support enterprises in making good use of preferential tariffs, rules of origin accumulation, and expand trade and investment cooperation. Promote the signing of high-standard free trade agreements with more countries and regions. Firmly uphold the multilateral trading system and actively participate in the reform of the World Trade Organization. China is willing to strengthen mutually beneficial cooperation with countries around the world to achieve win-win outcomes for all.
titlelist: Billion yuan, expanding high-level opening up to promote stable development of foreign trade and foreign investment.

Enhance coordinated control of multiple air pollutants and regional governance, increase efforts to control pollution in important rivers, lakes, and bays, and continue to promote soil pollution prevention and control. Strengthen the treatment of solid waste and new pollutants, promote waste classification and reduction, and resource utilization. Improve support policies for energy conservation, water conservation, and recycling of waste materials and other environmental protection industries. content: Drive the continuous transformation of old and new driving forces. Use informatization to enhance traditional driving forces, promote capacity reduction, inventory reduction, deleveraging, cost reduction, and fill in the gaps, improve the quality and efficiency of the supply system. Use informatization to cultivate new driving forces, accelerate various types of innovation based on the Internet, build a new modern industrial system, and promote new development with new driving forces. content: Build an independent and advanced technological system. Formulate the implementation outline of the strategy for building a cyber strong nation, and use systematic thinking to construct a new generation of network technology system, cloud computing system, security technology system, and high-end manufacturing equipment technology system. Collaborate on key software and hardware devices such as high-end chips, core components, optical communication devices, operating systems, database systems, key network equipment, high-end servers, and security protection products, to build a cyber strong nation that is strategically clear, technologically advanced, industry-leading, and secure and reliable. Coordinate the development of network security and informatization in the fields of economy, politics, culture, society, and ecological civilization, and enhance independent innovation capabilities. Strengthen the strategic layout of frontier technologies. Based on the national conditions, face the world's technological frontier, major national needs, and the main areas of the national economy, adhere to strategic orientation, frontier orientation, and security orientation, and focus on breakthroughs in basic technology, general technology, and asymmetric technology in the field of informatization, and proactively layout frontier and disruptive technologies. Strengthen the basic research and frontier layout of new technologies such as quantum communication, future networks, brain-like computing, artificial intelligence, holographic display, virtual reality, cognitive analysis of big data, new non-volatile storage, unmanned driving vehicles, blockchain, and gene editing, and build a leading advantage in the new arena. Accelerate the construction of emerging intelligent terminal industrial systems and policy environments such as smart wearables, advanced robots, and smart cars. Encourage enterprises to carry out fundamental and cutting-edge innovation research. Column 1: Core technology surpassing project. Formulate the implementation outline of the cyber strong nation project. List the detailed inventory and plan for the development of core technologies, implement a number of major projects, accelerate the transformation of scientific and technological innovation achievements into real productivity, and form a systematic layout in a step-by-step manner. Overcome key core technologies in high-end general chips, integrated circuit equipment, basic software, broadband mobile communication, etc., and form several strategic leading technologies and products. Promote breakthroughs in integrated circuit innovation. Increase investment in chip design and research and development deployment for new computing, 5G, intelligent manufacturing, industrial Internet, and the Internet of Things, promote the construction of 32/28nm, 16/14nm process production lines, accelerate the research and development of 10/7nm process technology, vigorously develop chip-level packaging, wafer-level packaging, silicon through-hole, and 3D packaging research and industrialization processes, and break through electronic design automation (EDA) software. Enhance the core competitiveness of cloud computing and network equipment. Focus on breakthroughs in core devices such as high-end processors, storage chips, I/O chips, as well as key technologies such as computing resource virtualization, software-defined networking, and ultra-high-speed remote intelligent optical transmission. Promote the development and industrialization of high-end servers, intelligent terminal devices, storage devices, network and communication equipment, industrial control equipment, and security protection equipment. Improve the level of independent research and development of basic software and key application software. Promote the research and development of cloud operating systems, intelligent terminal operating systems, embedded operating systems, and related application software. Develop industrial control operating systems and industry application software covering the entire life cycle for key industrial sectors. Promote innovation and development of intelligent hardware, new sensors, etc. Improve the level of intelligent hardware technology in fields such as wearable devices, smart homes, and smart vehicles. Accelerate the research and application of high-precision, low-power, and high-reliability sensors. Establish a reporting system for major projects and key technology introductions in the field of national information. Coordinate the management of major projects, major scientific and technological breakthroughs, and major technology introductions in the information field. Promote collaborative innovation in the industry. Coordinate and promote the coordinated development of basic research, technological innovation, industrial development, market application, standard formulation, and network security, strengthen the integration and coordination of the innovation chain, the coordination and interaction of the industrial chain, and the efficient connection of the value chain, and open up channels for the application and transformation of technological innovation achievements. Guide and support the deep integration of industry, academia, research, and application, promote leading enterprises and research institutions to establish open-source technology research and development teams, support the development of technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises, and build collaborative innovation clusters of industry, academia, research, and application. Accelerate the formulation of standards and patent layouts related to new generation information technology. Explore and improve capital collaboration mechanisms, establish investment companies for core technology research and development, give full play to the advantages of leading enterprises, drive the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance the synergistic interaction between upstream technology research and development and downstream promotion and application. Deepen the deployment of secure and reliable applications, accelerate the construction of an open and independent industrial ecosystem, cultivate a large number of leading enterprises, and consolidate the industrial foundation. Column 2: Innovation project for the information industry system. Build an advanced, secure, and controllable core technology and product system. Enhance systematic innovation capabilities in the three major areas of cloud computing and big data, next-generation information networks, and intelligent terminals and hardware. Improve the ecological environment for the development of core technologies. Enhance the compatibility between underlying chips, core components, basic software, and application software, comprehensively layout the intellectual property rights of core technologies, and leverage the positive role of the capital market in the technology industry. Innovate incentive mechanisms for breakthroughs in core technologies. Explore a market-oriented mechanism for tackling key core technologies. Strengthen the coordination of industry, academia, research, and application, coordinate the use of national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.) and major scientific infrastructure in the information field, support key core technology research and development and major technology experimental verification as required, and strengthen the supply of key common technology research and development. Support the innovation and development of open-source communities. Encourage Chinese enterprises to actively participate in international open-source organizations for major core technologies, evolve from participants to important contributors, strive to be initiators in advantageous technology areas, and actively safeguard the rights and interests of relevant standards and patents in international open-source organizations. Cultivate enterprises for core technology innovation. Cultivate a group of innovative enterprises with outstanding core technology capabilities, strong integrated innovation capabilities, and leading the development of important industries, and strive to have a group of enterprises enter the global top 500.

content: Promote the deep integration of informatization and industrialization. Support the compatibility, interoperability, and interoperability testing and verification of key technologies, networks, platforms, and application environments, promote the integration and application of industrial software and hardware with industrial big data platforms, industrial networks, industrial information security systems, and intelligent equipment. Actively promote the double innovation of manufacturing enterprises, as well as the construction and innovation of industrial cloud, industrial big data, industrial e-commerce, and other service platforms, comprehensively enhance the industry's system solution capabilities. Organize the implementation of enterprise management capability improvement projects, accelerate the formulation and application promotion of standards for the integration management system of informatization and industrialization. Build a batch of double innovation service platforms for manufacturing small and medium-sized enterprises by internet companies and basic telecommunications companies, encourage large manufacturing enterprises to open various resources gathered on double innovation platforms, develop online services such as professional consulting, talent training, inspection and testing, and investment and financing. Cultivate a batch of double innovation platforms for manufacturing enterprises. Support the improvement of enterprise management capabilities. Strengthen the formulation and application promotion of standards for the integration management system of informatization and industrialization, promote business process reengineering and organizational transformation. Relying on the China Integration Service Platform for Informatization and Industrialization, carry out comprehensive self-assessment, self-diagnosis, and self-benchmarking of enterprises, and build a national data map for the integrated development of informatization and industrialization. Strengthen core technology research and development and industrialization. Promote the implementation of national key research and development programs, accelerate the construction of new infrastructure and platform facilities such as automatic control and sensing technology, core industrial software and hardware, industrial internet, and industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms. Support the construction of information-physical system monitoring and verification platforms, and build reference models and comprehensive technical standards systems. Organize pilot demonstrations of industry system solutions and cultivate a group of system solution providers. Improve the level of industrial information system security. Carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial enterprise information security guarantee, support the construction of key common technology platforms such as system simulation testing and evaluation, promote the industrialization of core technologies such as access control, traceability, business information and privacy protection. Establish a national industrial information security guarantee center to enhance the monitoring, evaluation, verification, and emergency response capabilities of industrial information security. Promote agricultural informatization. Implement the Internet Plus Modern Agriculture action plan, focus on building modern agricultural industrial systems, production systems, and operation systems. Promote the integration of information technology with agricultural production management, operation management, market circulation, and resource environment. Promote the online and data-based development of industries and fields such as planting, animal husbandry, veterinary medicine, fisheries, seeds, agricultural machinery, agricultural reclamation, agricultural product processing, animal and plant inspection and quarantine, rural collective asset management, agricultural resource and environmental protection, rural sewage, rural energy, as well as water conservancy facilities, water resources, water-saving irrigation, and drinking water security. Accelerate the improvement of agricultural informatization, comprehensively strengthen the construction of rural informatization capabilities, and establish a spatial and intelligent new rural statistical information comprehensive service system. Focus on the development of precision agriculture and smart agriculture, improve the level of agricultural production intelligence, networked management, data-based management, and online services, promote agricultural transformation and upgrading, and continuously increase farmers' income, providing strong innovative power for accelerating the modernization of agriculture. Promote the application of agricultural demonstration and Beidou navigation technology in agricultural production. Column 8: Agricultural and rural informatization project. Develop smart agriculture. Promote the application of intelligent sensors, satellite navigation, remote sensing, spatial geographic information, and other technologies to enhance the accurate monitoring capabilities of agricultural production environments. Organize the implementation of regional trials for agricultural Internet of Things, carry out pilot projects for the application of Internet of Things technologies in areas such as field crop cultivation, facility agriculture, and large-scale breeding of livestock and aquatic products. Promote precision agriculture machinery. Develop agricultural e-commerce. Promote the application and promotion of internet technologies in various aspects of agricultural production, processing, and circulation, promote the construction of modern rural market systems, and cultivate diversified rural e-commerce market entities. In conjunction with the construction of modern agricultural circulation systems, carry out pilot demonstrations of agricultural e-commerce and support the application of agricultural e-commerce platforms. Promote the application of agricultural and rural big data. Integrate and build national agricultural big data centers and national agricultural clouds. Build a public service platform for agriculture going global, carry out global agricultural data survey and analysis system construction, and establish an agricultural industry chain information monitoring and analysis early warning system. Establish a national platform for quality and safety supervision and traceability management of agricultural products, continuously expand the coverage of information-based supervision and traceability. Establish a platform for the supervision of rural collective assets, promote the institutionalization, standardization, and informatization of rural collective asset financial management, comprehensively enhance the informatization capabilities and levels of agricultural government affairs information. Enhance the comprehensive service capabilities of agricultural information. Vigorously promote information access to villages and households, expand the 12316 comprehensive information services for agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. Promote the informatization construction of rural communities, carry out mobile phone application skills training for farmers, enhance farmers' information application capabilities, promote equalization of urban and rural information services, and narrow the urban-rural digital divide. Establish a water conservancy big data analysis and application service project, enhance the support and guarantee service capabilities of water conservancy facilities and water resources for agricultural production and rural development. Carry out the construction of agricultural information economy demonstration zones and improve the modern agricultural information service system. Enhance the support capabilities for the development of agricultural informatization. Promote the intelligent construction of agricultural information infrastructure guided by application. Promote the leapfrog development of agricultural information technology innovation capabilities, build a collaborative innovation system for agricultural information technology that combines government, industry, academia, research, and application, effectively support the development of the agricultural information industry. Develop e-commerce. Regulate the competition in the e-commerce market in all aspects, accelerate the innovation of e-commerce models and market service methods, and promote the upgrading of e-commerce technology levels. Support the development of new e-commerce models such as mobile e-commerce, community e-commerce, rural e-commerce, and cross-border e-commerce, promote the improvement of e-commerce quality.
titlelist: Major tasks and key projects, building an integrated and innovative information-based economic system.

Accelerate the comprehensive evolution and upgrade of network infrastructure to IPv6, enhance the rapid distribution capability of content delivery networks for IPv6 content. Accelerate the development of IPv6 terminals and application systems, promote the support of IPv6 by smart terminals, and achieve end-to-end support for IPv6 in 4G networks. Accelerate the commercialization of mobile internet based on IPv6, actively guide commercial websites, government, and public enterprise websites to migrate to IPv6. Proactively layout the future network. Layout the architecture of the future network, accelerate the construction of new network facilities such as industrial internet, energy internet, and space internet, and promote the compatible development of the future network with existing networks. Accelerate the construction of the future network technology system, establish a national-level network testbed, and promote key breakthroughs and testing verification of core technologies of the future network. Strengthen the security of the future network and actively prevent future network security risks.

name: Notice on Issuing the '13th Five-Year' National Informatization Plan (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 15, 2016)

content: Action goals: By 2018, the original innovation capabilities of cloud computing and the Internet of Things will be significantly enhanced, and the power usage effectiveness (PUE) value of newly built large-scale cloud computing data centers will not exceed 1.5. By 2020, a cloud computing and Internet of Things industry system with international competitiveness will be formed, and the PUE value of newly built large-scale cloud computing data centers will not exceed 1.4. Coordinate the planning and layout of national data center construction. Optimize the layout of large and super-large data centers, and eliminate blind construction of data centers and related parks. Accelerate the promotion of energy-saving design and renovation of existing data centers, and orderly promote the construction of green data centers. Enhance the independent innovation capability of cloud computing. Cultivate and develop a group of cloud computing backbone enterprises with international competitiveness, give full play to the role of enterprise innovation, enhance the original innovation capability of cloud computing technology, and achieve breakthroughs as soon as possible in key technologies and core software and hardware such as large-scale resource management and scheduling, operation monitoring and security guarantee, and big data mining and analysis on cloud computing platforms. Encourage backbone Internet companies to open platform resources, strengthen the construction of industry cloud service platforms, support the migration of government and industry information systems to cloud platforms, build a national scientific research information infrastructure based on cloud computing, and create the China Science and Technology Cloud. Actively promote the development of the Internet of Things. Promote the planning and layout of Internet of Things sensing facilities, and develop open-loop applications of the Internet of Things. Implement major application demonstration projects for the Internet of Things, promote regional pilot projects for the Internet of Things applications, establish city-level Internet of Things access management and data aggregation platforms, and deepen the application of the Internet of Things in urban infrastructure, production and operation, and other links.
titlelist: Priority action, application of infrastructure construction action.

name: Notice on Issuing the '13th Five-Year' National Informatization Plan (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 15, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Action goals: By 2017, 80 national pilot cities for information benefiting the people will initially achieve cross-regional, cross-level, and cross-departmental one application, one window acceptance, one network access for government services, forming a convenient, fast, fair, inclusive, high-quality, and efficient government service information system. By 2020, the one application, one window, one network goal will be achieved nationwide, with significantly optimized service processes, more diverse service models, smoother service channels, and significantly improved satisfaction of the people in handling affairs. Construct a unified government service information system. Relying on a unified data sharing and exchange platform, promote interconnection, information sharing, and business coordination among various departmental business systems, forming a service model of comprehensive front desk acceptance, classified approval in the back, and unified window delivery. Expand self-service, community agency, postal express, and other service channels, construct a cross-regional, cross-level, online and offline integrated government service system, realize one-window acceptance, one-platform sharing, and one-stop service. Establish an electronic license system and a shared recognition mechanism. Following the principle of combining decentralization and centralization, build a natural person electronic license database, promote the connection and integration of the certification system, business handling system, and electronic license database, realize the one-time generation and multi-party reuse of relevant information, and manage and share it in one database. Research and formulate electronic license standard specifications, establish a cross-regional electronic license recognition and sharing mechanism, promote cross-level, cross-regional, and cross-departmental electronic license recognition and sharing, and gradually realize business handling in different places nationwide. Establish and improve a unified identity authentication system. Using the citizen's identity number as the unique identifier, explore the use of biometric and network identity recognition technologies, connect and integrate user authentication from different channels such as physical government service halls, government websites, mobile clients, self-service terminals, and service hotlines, form a unified identity authentication system for the masses based on the citizen's identity number, and realize one-time authentication, multi-point interconnection, and seamless switching for the masses to handle affairs through multiple channels. Build a one-stop convenience service network. Streamline and integrate online service resources in the fields of education, medical and health care, social assistance, social welfare, community services, marriage registration, labor and employment, housing provident fund, social security, family planning, housing security, legal services, rule of law promotion, public safety, and other areas of people's livelihood services, connect various online service channels, build a one-stop convenience service network, and realize one-time authentication and one-network access.
titlelist: Priority action, 'Internet+Government Affairs Service' action.

name: Notice on Issuing the '13th Five-Year' National Informatization Plan (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 15, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Action goals: By 2018, the dynamic monitoring network and regulatory system for natural resources and ecological environment will be basically established, and significant progress will be made in the construction of the energy internet. By 2020, energy utilization efficiency will be significantly improved, and the level of green production and lifestyle will be greatly enhanced. Promote the development of Internet + Smart Energy. Explore the construction of a multi-energy complementary, distributed and coordinated, open and shared energy internet, and build a clean, low-carbon, efficient and safe modern energy system. Promote the development of green energy networks, build an energy consumption ecological system, develop smart energy use at the user end, promote the development of the sharing economy and free trade of energy. Implement the national energy management and supervision informatization project, establish a public service platform for monitoring and management of regional energy production based on the internet, and build an online monitoring system for energy consumption in key energy-consuming units. Strengthen the dynamic monitoring and supervision of natural resources. Implement the natural resources monitoring and supervision information project, establish a 24/7 natural resources monitoring technical system, and build a three-dimensional monitoring system for various resources such as land, ocean, energy, mineral resources, water, forests, grasslands, and atmosphere. Strengthen the construction of basic data for land and resources, build a basic platform for real estate registration information management and a rural land circulation management information platform, establish a vertically linked, horizontally coordinated, and interconnected natural resources information sharing service platform, and provide effective support for resource supervision and optimization of land and space development. Promote the informatization construction of surveying and mapping geographic information, strengthen the overall construction and management of national satellite navigation positioning reference stations, and build a public service platform for geographic information. Innovate in the prevention and control of regional environmental pollution and management. Implement the construction project of ecological environment monitoring network, establish a 24/7, multi-level intelligent multi-source perception system for pollutant emissions and monitoring. Support the use of Internet of Things, cloud computing, big data, remote sensing, data fusion and other technologies to carry out analysis of atmospheric, water and soil environments, and establish a list of pollution sources. Carry out pilot projects for environmental carrying capacity assessment, strengthen environmental pollution prediction and early warning, and establish a decision support system for environmental pollution source management and pollutant reduction. Promote the informatization construction of environmental monitoring in key regions and areas such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Economic Belt, and ecological forests, and improve the ability of regional basin environmental pollution prevention and control and governance. Vigorously develop green and smart industries. Use new generation information technology to improve the level of environmental protection technology and equipment and enhance environmental service capabilities. Explore the cultivation of online trading markets for energy rights, water rights, carbon emissions rights, and pollutant discharge rights. Promote the Internet + recycling and utilization of renewable resources, industrial waste resource utilization, establish a standardized and orderly recycling and utilization system, enhance the coupling degree of forward and reverse logistics, and promote the integration of waste collection and transportation systems with recycling systems. Demonstration projects will be carried out in the fields of solid waste classification and recycling in urban and rural areas, online trading of major types of recycled resources, remanufacturing, and industrial symbiosis platforms. Encourage the elimination and retirement of old and high-energy-consuming equipment, and the application of green and energy-saving new technologies, encourage enterprises to research and develop and apply energy-saving servers, and reduce equipment energy consumption.
titlelist: Priority Action, Beautiful China Informationization Special Action

name: Notice on Issuing the '13th Five-Year' National Informatization Plan (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 15, 2016)

content: Action goals: By 2018, establish a network poverty alleviation information service system, with pilot areas achieving basic network coverage, information coverage, and service coverage. By 2020, complete network coverage for 832 impoverished counties and 128,000 impoverished villages, with e-commerce services accessible in towns and villages. Help impoverished areas improve cultural quality, physical fitness, and employment skills through online education, online culture, internet healthcare, etc. Implement network coverage projects. Accelerate internet construction and application in impoverished areas, encourage telecom enterprises to actively assume social responsibilities, and ensure that broadband access reaches villages in line with poverty alleviation efforts. Accelerate the promotion of network coverage in impoverished areas, implement speed increase and fee reduction measures, and explore preferential network tariffs for impoverished households. Accelerate the research, development, and production application of secure and reliable mobile terminals, promote the development of ethnic language voice and video technology and software, and reduce language barriers for ethnic minorities in using mobile terminals and accessing information services. Implement e-commerce poverty alleviation projects. Encourage e-commerce enterprises to promote customized online sales of specialty agricultural products in rural areas, promote the development of rural industries in impoverished areas, organize well-known e-commerce platforms to establish poverty alleviation channels for impoverished areas, and establish online exhibitions for high-quality products from impoverished counties. Relying on existing national rural tourism e-commerce platforms, develop Internet + tourism poverty alleviation, promote online rural tourism trunk project, and special actions for the construction of one village, one product industries. Support the construction of payment service networks in remote and extremely impoverished areas. Accelerate the construction and improvement of product quality management, credit, and logistics service systems in impoverished areas. Implement network poverty alleviation and intelligence projects. Fully utilize information technology to promote distance education and facilitate the sharing of high-quality educational resources between urban and rural areas. Strengthen vocational education and skills training for personnel at county, township, and village levels, and enrich their knowledge of network specialties. Support university student village officials, three supports and one assistance personnel, and other grassroots service project participants and university students returning to their hometowns to carry out online entrepreneurship and innovation, and improve the employment and entrepreneurship capabilities of impoverished area residents. Implement poverty alleviation information service projects. Gradually integrate agricultural information platforms at all levels below the provincial level into a one-stop system, establish a network poverty alleviation information service system, fully utilize the national concentrated poverty alleviation and development information system and social poverty alleviation information service platform, promote cross-departmental sharing of poverty alleviation and development information, and ensure that poverty alleviation services are accessible anytime and anywhere, and poverty alleviation resources are allocated according to individual needs. Implement network public welfare projects. Accelerate the development and use of network poverty alleviation mobile applications (APPs), promote national poverty alleviation and development policies, enrich information content services, popularize agricultural technology knowledge, and cover applications in industries such as social networking, business, transportation, healthcare, education, and legal aid. Relying on the China Internet Development Foundation, China Poverty Alleviation Volunteer Service Promotion Association, and other organizations, establish a network public welfare poverty alleviation alliance, mobilize internet companies and netizens to participate in network poverty alleviation actions. Build a network system for guaranteeing people's livelihood in impoverished areas, construct a comprehensive information platform for social assistance, and provide personalized and targeted social assistance services.
titlelist: Priority Action, Internet Poverty Alleviation Action

name: Notice on Issuing the '13th Five-Year' National Informatization Plan (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 15, 2016)

content: Action goals: By 2018, establish a major information economy cooperation channel with countries in Central and Eastern Europe, Southeast Asia, the Arab region, and other relevant countries, promoting mutual recognition of regulations, interconnection of facilities, mutual trust among enterprises, and integration of industries. By 2020, basically form a major information economy cooperation channel covering key directions of countries and regions along the Belt and Road, with a significant expansion of the scope and areas of information economy cooperation. Construct an online Silk Road Economic Cooperation Experimental Zone. Fully leverage the enthusiasm of localities, encourage domestic cities to engage in point-to-point cooperation with key cities along the Belt and Road, respectively establishing online Silk Road Economic Cooperation Experimental Zones, and promote deep cooperation between the two sides in information infrastructure, smart cities, e-commerce, telemedicine, and Internet Plus fields. Support the establishment of international industry alliances. Fully leverage the enthusiasm of enterprises, support Chinese internet companies, research institutes, foreign internet companies, and related institutions to initiate the establishment of international industry alliances, forming the soft power of the online Silk Road, accelerating the cooperation process between Chinese internet companies and overseas enterprises, promoting the establishment of a cross-border internet industry investment and financing platform, leading the research and formulation of relevant norms in the field of information economy, and transforming the comparative advantages of China's internet industry into the dominant advantages of the global information economy. Encourage and support international expansion of enterprises. Encourage internet companies to jointly build e-commerce trading platforms, logistics information service platforms, online payment service platforms, and other forms, constructing a new type of international cooperation platform for information economy, expanding the international market for platform design, talent cultivation, creative promotion, and supply chain services in various information technology services, driving the improvement and efficiency enhancement of international commodity circulation and transportation logistics.

name: Notice on Issuing the '13th Five-Year' National Informatization Plan (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 15, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Action goals: By 2018, the convenience of medical and health services facilitated by information technology will be greatly improved, and a basic remote medical service system will be formed. By 2020, new health information services based on sensing technology and products will gradually become popular, and information technology will play a significant role in achieving universal access to basic medical and health services. Build efficient and convenient smart health and medical services for the convenience and benefit of the people. Implement the National Electronic Health Information Service Plan, improve internet health consultation, appointment triage, in-clinic settlement, mobile payment, and access to test results and follow-up tracking services based on new information technology. Prioritize appointments for scheduled patients and referred patients, and fully implement appointment scheduling in different time slots. Promote a comprehensive population health information service system. Build a unified and authoritative population health information platform that is interconnected, strengthen the integration, sharing, and coordination of application information systems for public health, family planning, medical services, medical insurance, drug supply, and comprehensive management, and basically achieve standardized electronic health records and fully functional health cards for urban and rural residents. Implement the Healthy China Cloud Service Plan, build an integrated platform for health and medical services, provide remote consultations, remote imaging, pathology results, and electrocardiogram diagnostic services, and improve the mechanism for mutual recognition and sharing of examination and test results. Use the internet to enhance emergency response capabilities for major diseases and public health emergencies, and establish a health communication and remote education video system that covers medical and health institutions nationwide. Improve the global public health risk monitoring and early warning decision-making system, establish an international travel health network, and provide travel health and safety services for inbound and outbound personnel. Promote and regulate the application of health and medical big data. Promote the application of health and medical clinical and research big data, strengthen research in key areas such as rare diseases, promote the application of gene chips and sequencing technology in the diagnosis of genetic diseases, early diagnosis of cancer, and disease prevention and detection, and promote the development of precision medical technology. Promote the application of public health big data and comprehensively enhance the monitoring, evaluation, and decision-making management capabilities of public health. Promote the application of artificial intelligence, 3D bioprinting, medical robots, wearable devices, and related microsensors in disease prevention, health emergencies, health care, and daily nursing, and promote the transformation from medical treatment to health services.
titlelist: Priority Action, Healthy China Information Service Action

content: Comprehensively utilize various policy tools to guide financial institutions to expand credit support for information technology enterprises. Encourage venture capital investment, equity investment funds, and other funds to actively invest in information technology development. Carry out pilot programs for internet finance innovation in an orderly manner, and support the development of small and micro enterprises. Promote innovative pilot programs that combine industry and finance, and explore financing services that combine equity and debt. Deepen the reform of the Growth Enterprise Market (GEM) and support eligible innovative and growth-oriented internet companies to raise funds through initial public offerings (IPOs). Study the institutional policies for overseas-listed companies with special equity structures to list domestically. Encourage financial institutions to strengthen product and service innovation, and increase financial support for key areas, major projects, and weak links in the field of information technology, under controllable risks. Actively develop new services such as intellectual property pledge financing and credit insurance policy financing to support eligible information and communication technology (ICT) enterprises in issuing corporate bonds and non-financial corporate debt financing instruments to raise funds. In key areas with strategic significance and long investment cycles, actively explore government and social capital cooperation (PPP) models, establish a database of major information technology projects under the PPP model, clarify risk responsibilities and profit boundaries. Strengthen performance evaluation and promote the sustainable operation of major information technology projects.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: The scale of industries continues to grow, becoming a new driving force for economic and social development. The proportion of value added by strategic emerging industries to the domestic gross domestic product (GDP) has reached 15%, forming five new pillars with a value scale of 10 trillion yuan, including the new generation of information technology, high-end manufacturing, biotechnology, green and low-carbon industries, and digital creativity. In addition, a large number of cross-border integration growth points have been formed in broader fields, creating over 1 million new jobs on average each year. Innovation capability and competitiveness have significantly improved, creating a new global highland for industrial development. Key core technologies have been conquered, with the annual growth rate of invention patents exceeding 15%. A number of major industrial technological innovation platforms have been established, and the industrial innovation capability has reached the forefront of the world, forming a leading advantage in several important fields and significantly improving product quality. The accessibility of new products and services in the fields of energy conservation, environmental protection, new energy, and biotechnology has greatly improved. Intellectual property protection has become more stringent, and policies and regulations to incentivize innovation have become more sound. The industrial structure has been further optimized, forming a new industrial system. A group of industry leaders with strong original capabilities, international influence, and brand reputation have emerged, and dynamic and pioneering small and medium-sized enterprises continue to emerge. The proportion of high-end manufacturing and knowledge-intensive service industries has significantly increased, supporting the industry's move towards a medium-high-end level. Several strategic emerging industries with global influence have become sources of development strategies and centers of technological innovation, creating over 100 distinctive and highly innovative emerging industry clusters. By 2030, the development of strategic emerging industries will become the dominant force driving the sustained and healthy development of China's economy. China will become an important manufacturing and innovation center for strategic emerging industries in the world, and a group of innovative leading enterprises with global influence and dominance will be formed.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of strategic emerging industries, create new engines for economic and social development, and achieve development goals.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: With innovation, growth, and leadership as the core, we adhere to the path of innovation-driven development, promote the growth and development of a number of emerging fields to become pillar industries, and continuously lead the development of high-end industries and high-quality economic and social development. Based on development needs and industrial foundations, we will significantly increase the technological content of industries, accelerate the development and growth of the five major areas of the network economy, high-end manufacturing, bio-economy, green and low-carbon, and digital creativity, and achieve a leap towards an innovative economy. Focusing on the new trends and directions of the global new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, we will proactively layout strategic industries in aerospace, ocean, information networks, biotechnology, and nuclear technology, and create new advantages for future development. Following the basic laws of strategic emerging industry development, we will highlight advantages and characteristics, create a number of strategic emerging industry development sources, agglomeration areas, and characteristic industry clusters, and form a new pattern of regional growth. Seizing the strategic opportunity of promoting the Belt and Road construction, we will use a more open vision to efficiently utilize global innovation resources and enhance the internationalization level of strategic emerging industries. We will accelerate the reform of key areas and key links, continuously improve policies and measures conducive to the convergence of technology, capital, and talent, create a fair and competitive market environment, comprehensively create an ecological environment that adapts to the vigorous emergence of new technologies and new formats, and accelerate the formation of new driving forces for economic and social development.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of strategic emerging industries, create new engines for economic and social development, overall deployment.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deepen the Broadband China strategy, accelerate the construction of high-speed, mobile, secure, and ubiquitous new generation information infrastructure. Vigorously promote the construction of high-speed fiber optic networks. Carry out pilot projects for the large-scale application of new intelligent network technologies, and upgrade the national backbone network towards high-speed transmission, flexible scheduling, and intelligent adaptation. Fully achieve the transition to all-optical networks, accelerate the coverage of optical networks in urban areas, provide access services of over 1000 gigabits per second (1000Mbps), and enable flexible selection of bandwidth of over 100Mbps for households in large and medium-sized cities. Collaborate with multiple parties to improve the coverage rate of rural fiber optic broadband, achieve fiber optic connectivity in over 98% of administrative villages, provide access services of over 100Mbps in areas with conditions, and enable flexible selection of bandwidth of over 50Mbps for over half of rural households. Promote the development of integrated infrastructure for the convergence of the three networks. Promote the evolution, upgrade, and application of Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6), and promote backbone enterprises to no longer use private addresses for new network addresses. Accelerate the construction of a new generation of wireless broadband networks. Accelerate the construction of fourth-generation mobile communication (4G) networks, achieve deep coverage in urban areas and densely populated administrative villages, and achieve wide-area continuous coverage. Promote free high-speed wireless LAN in hot public areas. Vigorously promote the joint research and development, testing, and pre-commercial trial of fifth-generation mobile communication (5G). Optimize the allocation of national spectrum resources, improve spectrum utilization efficiency, and ensure the supply of frequency resources. Reasonably plan and utilize satellite frequencies and orbital resources, accelerate the deployment of space Internet, develop new communication satellites and application terminals, explore the construction of an integrated space-ground information network, and research new high-altitude coverage methods such as stratospheric communication. Accelerate the construction of the next-generation broadcasting and television network. Promote the intelligent collaborative coverage of wired, wireless, and satellite broadcasting and television networks, build a broadcasting and television convergence transmission coverage network that integrates space and ground, interconnects, has broadband interaction, intelligent collaboration, and is manageable and controllable. Accelerate the construction of national cable television network infrastructure and upgrade and transform it to bidirectional and intelligent, promote the integration and interconnection of national cable television networks. Promote the research and industrialization of next-generation terrestrial digital broadcasting and television transmission technologies, strengthen the integration and innovation of terrestrial wireless broadcasting and television with the Internet, and create a mobile, interactive, and convenient new format for terrestrial wireless broadcasting and television. Column 1: Broadband Rural Demonstration Project. Carry out pilot projects for universal telecommunications services, promote the convergence of the three networks, accelerate the construction of optical fiber and satellite communication in administrative villages, extend the coverage of fiber-to-the-home networks and fourth-generation mobile communication (4G) networks to natural villages and households as needed, strengthen coverage of islands, remote areas, mountainous areas, etc. using satellite, mobile communication, and other technological innovations, accelerate the popularization of information applications such as e-commerce, distance education, telemedicine, smart agriculture, and e-government, and support poverty alleviation efforts. Coordinate the development of application infrastructure. Make full use of existing facilities, coordinate the planning and layout of large and super-large data centers in suitable areas nationwide, and promote the construction of green data centers in an orderly manner. Promote the intensive deployment of the Internet of Things based on various existing communication networks. Continuously strengthen the construction of emergency communication capabilities. Strengthen international cooperation. Strengthen international interconnection and cooperation in information network infrastructure. Strengthen the construction of overseas submarine cables, land cables, business nodes, data centers, satellite communication facilities, etc., and optimize the layout of international communication networks. Accelerate the construction of the China-Arab States' Silk Road, China-ASEAN Information Harbor, and other online routes.
titlelist: Promote the leapfrog development of the information technology industry, expand new space for the network economy, and build the infrastructure for a strong cyber nation.

content: Promote the integrated development of the new generation of information technology and various sectors of the economy and society, and cultivate the Internet Plus ecosystem. Deepen the integration and application of the Internet in the production field. Deepen the integration and development of manufacturing and the Internet, promote substantial breakthroughs in Made in China + Internet, develop information technology services for the manufacturing industry, build new foundations for core industrial software and hardware, industrial cloud, intelligent service platforms, and vigorously promote new formats and models such as intelligent manufacturing, networked collaboration, personalized customization, and service extension. Accelerate the development of the industrial Internet, build the architecture of the industrial Internet system, and carry out innovative applications of the industrial Internet. Promote the deep integration of mobile Internet, cloud computing, Internet of Things, and other technologies with agriculture, energy, finance, commerce, logistics, and express delivery, support the research and development of industry application software and system integration oriented towards network collaboration, promote the transformation of manufacturing industry to production service-oriented, and the extension of productive service industry to the high-end of the value chain. Expand the Internet Plus applications in the fields of life and public services. Accelerate the innovation of industry management system, promote the intelligence of medical, education, social security, employment, transportation, tourism, and other services. Expand the application of new smart city models, promote innovation in public service models based on the Internet, promote the construction of information service public platforms based on cloud computing, and enhance the supply capacity of public products. Accelerate the implementation of Internet Plus government services and gradually realize one application, one window, and one network for government services. Promote innovation in new forms of Internet Plus. Encourage the use of information network technology to promote changes in production, management, and marketing models, reshape industrial chains, supply chains, and value chains, and accelerate the formation of new production and circulation exchange models. Promote the development of the sharing economy through institutional and mechanism innovation, establish regulatory methods that are conducive to the development of the sharing economy, promote the standardized development of platform enterprises in the fields of transportation, tourism, elderly care, human resources, and daily consumer goods consumption, and create a culture of sharing economy. Column 2: Internet Plus Project. Deeply promote 11 key actions including Internet Plus entrepreneurship and innovation, collaborative manufacturing, modern agriculture, smart energy, inclusive finance, benefitting the people's services, efficient logistics, e-commerce, convenient transportation, green ecology, and artificial intelligence, and build a cross-domain integration and innovation support service platform for the Internet. Promote business model and commercial model innovation based on cloud computing, and promote the construction of public and industry cloud platforms. Strengthen research on the architecture of the Internet of Things network and organize major application demonstrations of the Internet of Things. Accelerate the deployment of the next generation of the Internet for commercial use, and build a technology test and management service platform for the industrial Internet. Create a national demonstration zone for the information economy.
titlelist: Promote the leapfrog development of the information technology industry, expand new space for the internet economy, and advance the Internet Plus action.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: In response to the development trends of networking, intelligence, integration, and other aspects, we will focus on cultivating and establishing an application-driven and open-compatible core technology independent ecosystem. We will comprehensively review and accelerate the research and development and industrialization of new technologies in key areas of information technology, and promote breakthrough progress in the transformation and upgrading of the electronic information industry. We will enhance the supply capacity of core hardware. We will improve the design level of key chips and develop chips for new applications. We will accelerate the industrialization of 16/14-nanometer processes and the construction of memory production lines, improve the level of packaging and testing technology, and intensify the layout in chip-related fields in the post-Moore's Law era. We will achieve breakthroughs and scale applications in the localization of active matrix organic light-emitting diodes (AMOLED), ultra-high-definition (4K/8K) quantum dot liquid crystal displays, flexible displays, and other technologies. We will promote the research and development and industrialization of key technologies in areas such as intelligent sensors, power electronics, printed electronics, semiconductor lighting, and inertial navigation, and enhance the supply guarantee capacity of new chip components, optoelectronic communication devices, and specialized electronic materials. We will implement the Integrated Circuit Development Project. We will launch the major productivity layout planning project for integrated circuits, implement a number of projects with strong driving roles, and promote rapid improvement in industrial capacity. We will accelerate the construction of advanced manufacturing processes, memory, and special processes, improve the design and development capabilities and application levels of key products such as secure and reliable CPUs, analog-to-digital/digital-to-analog conversion chips, and digital signal processing chips, and promote the rapid development of packaging and testing, key equipment, materials, and other industries. We will support the improvement of service levels for contract manufacturers and third-party IP core companies, support collaborative innovation between design companies and manufacturing companies, and promote the improvement of industrial concentration in key areas. We will promote collaborative innovation in the semiconductor display industry chain. We will vigorously develop basic software and high-end information technology services. We will establish a secure and reliable basic software product system for key industries, support the development of open-source communities, strengthen the research and development and application of operating systems in fields such as cloud computing, the Internet of Things, industrial Internet, and smart hardware, accelerate the development of database systems for big data applications and middleware for industry-specific applications, support the development of general-purpose software such as office software for network collaboration optimization. We will strengthen the capacity building of information technology core software and hardware systems, promote domestic enterprises to develop towards the high-end in all aspects of system integration, standardize service delivery, ensure service quality, encourage exploration of service new formats driven by cutting-edge technology, and promote backbone enterprises to accelerate the research and development and promotion of industry solutions in emerging fields. We will vigorously develop high-end software outsourcing business based on new generation information technology. We will accelerate the development of high-end integrated products. We will promote the research and development and industrialization of information technology products such as green computing, trusted computing, data and network security, accelerate the innovation and application of high-performance secure servers, storage devices and industrial control products, new generation smartphones, complete sets of equipment for next-generation network devices and data centers, advanced smart TVs and smart home systems, and information security products, and develop professional terminals, equipment, and integrated innovation systems for applications in industries such as finance, transportation, and healthcare. We will greatly improve product quality and cultivate a number of internationally influential brands.
titlelist: Promote the leapfrog development of the information technology industry, expand new space for the network economy, and strengthen the core information technology industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Cultivate the artificial intelligence industry ecosystem, promote the widespread application of artificial intelligence in key areas of the economy and society, and build an internationally leading technical system. Accelerate the construction of the artificial intelligence support system. Promote basic theoretical and technological research such as brain-like research, accelerate the research and industrialization of application technologies based on artificial intelligence, such as computer vision and audiovisual, biometric recognition, new human-computer interaction, and intelligent decision-making control, and support the development of basic software and hardware in the field of artificial intelligence. Accelerate the construction of artificial intelligence massive training resource libraries and basic resource service public platforms for video, maps, and industry application data, and build new computing clusters to support large-scale deep learning. Encourage leading companies or institutions to provide artificial intelligence research and development tools, as well as entrepreneurship consulting, talent training, and other entrepreneurial innovation services. Promote the application of artificial intelligence technology in various fields. Carry out pilot demonstrations in important areas such as manufacturing, education, environmental protection, transportation, commerce, health care, network security, and social governance, and promote the large-scale application of artificial intelligence. Develop diversified, personalized, and customized intelligent hardware and intelligent systems, with a focus on the research and industrialization of smart homes, smart cars, smart agriculture, smart security, smart health, smart robots, and smart wearable devices. Encourage all industries to strengthen integration with artificial intelligence and gradually achieve intelligent upgrading. Utilize artificial intelligence to innovate urban management and build new smart cities. Promote the application of professional service robots and household service robots, and cultivate new high-end service industries. Column 5: Artificial Intelligence Innovation Project. Promote basic theoretical research and core technology development, achieve industrialization of neuromorphic chips, intelligent robots, and intelligent application systems, and embed new artificial intelligence technologies into various fields. Build an artificial intelligence public service platform and open research and development service platform for backbone enterprises to the society. Establish and improve the double innovation support service system for artificial intelligence.
titlelist: Promote the leapfrog development of the information technology industry, expand new space for the network economy, and develop artificial intelligence.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deepen the reform of the telecommunications system. Promote the integration of the three networks comprehensively, further open up competitive businesses in the basic telecommunications field, relax market access restrictions for integrated products and services, and promote the pilot work of mixed ownership in state-owned telecommunications enterprises. Break down industry barriers, promote full integration in technology, standards, regulation, and other aspects across various industries and fields, and allow all types of entities to participate in market competition on an equal basis in accordance with the law. Strengthen the construction of relevant laws and regulations. Adjust existing regulations and policy provisions that are not suitable for the development requirements in light of the new characteristics of the integration of the internet and various industries. Implement relevant regulations on strengthening network information protection and information disclosure, and accelerate the formulation of laws and regulations on network security, e-commerce, and other areas.
titlelist: Promote the leapfrog development of the information technology industry, expand new space for the network economy, and improve the management methods of the network economy.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)

content: Adhering to the development trend of intelligent, green, service-oriented, and internationalized manufacturing, we will accelerate the breakthrough of key technologies and core components, promote the engineering application and industrialization of major equipment and systems, promote the coordinated development of the industrial chain, shape a new image of Chinese manufacturing, and drive the comprehensive improvement of the manufacturing industry. We strive to achieve a scale of over 12 trillion yuan in the output value of high-end equipment and new materials industries by 2020.
