name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on improving the performance and quality of core equipment and components for intelligent manufacturing, building an intelligent manufacturing system, strengthening basic support, actively carrying out demonstration applications, forming several internationally renowned brands, and promoting intelligent manufacturing equipment to a new level. Vigorously develop intelligent manufacturing systems. Accelerate the deep integration of new generation information technology and manufacturing technology, carry out top-level design of information-physical systems (CPS) that integrate computation, communication, and control, explore the construction of intelligent manufacturing systems that have the characteristics of self-perception, intelligent optimization, and precise control throughout the entire production process and product lifecycle, promote the construction of robot automation production lines, digital workshops, and intelligent factories with independent intellectual property rights, provide overall solutions for key industries, and promote the intelligent transformation of traditional manufacturing industries. Build testing and verification platforms, improve the intelligent manufacturing standard system. Promote key technologies and equipment for intelligent manufacturing to a new level. Build an industrial robot industry system, comprehensively break through key technologies and core components such as high-precision reducers, high-performance controllers, and precision measurement, and focus on the development of high-precision, high-reliability mid-to-high-end industrial robots. Accelerate the research and industrialization of high-end CNC machine tools and intelligent machining centers, break through major functional components such as multi-axis, multi-channel, high-precision CNC systems, and servo motors, and develop and promote high-end CNC machine tools, basic manufacturing equipment, and integrated manufacturing systems that are precise, high-speed, efficient, flexible, and have network communication capabilities. Breakthroughs in intelligent sensing and control equipment, intelligent detection and assembly equipment, intelligent logistics and warehousing equipment, and intelligent agricultural machinery equipment, carry out research and development and promote the application of the first set of equipment, and improve quality and reliability. Build an additive manufacturing industry chain. Breakthroughs in special materials for additive manufacturing such as titanium alloys, high-strength alloy steels, high-temperature alloys, and high-temperature and high-strength engineering plastics. Build an additive manufacturing process technology research and development platform to improve process technology level. Develop and promote mainstream additive manufacturing process equipment driven by lasers, electron beams, ion beams, and other energy sources. Accelerate the development of supporting core devices and embedded software systems such as high-power fiber lasers, scanning mirrors, dynamic focusing mirrors, and high-performance electron guns, enhance the ability of software and hardware collaborative innovation, and establish an additive manufacturing standard system. Promote the application of additive manufacturing technology in aerospace, medical equipment, transportation equipment, cultural creativity, personalized manufacturing, and other fields, and accelerate the development of the additive manufacturing service industry. Column 6 focuses on the application demonstration project of intelligent factories. In the discrete manufacturing fields such as machinery, aviation, aerospace, automobiles, ships, light industry, clothing, and electronic information, carry out integrated innovation and application demonstrations of intelligent workshops/factories, promote pilot applications such as digital design, equipment intelligence upgrading, process optimization, lean production, visual management, quality control and traceability, and intelligent logistics, and promote the intelligent integration of the entire business process. In the process manufacturing fields such as petrochemicals, steel, non-ferrous metals, building materials, textiles, food, and pharmaceuticals, carry out integrated innovation and application demonstrations of intelligent factories, and improve the intelligence level of enterprises in resource allocation, process optimization, process control, industrial chain management, quality control and traceability, energy saving and emission reduction, and safety production.
titlelist: Promote breakthrough development in the high-end equipment and new materials industry, lead a new leap in Chinese manufacturing, and create a high-end brand in intelligent manufacturing.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen independent innovation, promote the industrialization and serialization of civil aviation products, enhance the construction of industrial supporting facilities and safety operation guarantee capabilities, improve product safety, environmental friendliness, economy, and comfort, and comprehensively construct an aviation industry system covering aviation engines, aircraft, industrial supporting facilities, and safety operation. By 2020, the certification and delivery of civil large aircraft and new regional aircraft will be completed, major breakthroughs will be achieved in aviation engine development, and the industrial supporting and demonstration operation systems will be basically established. Accelerate the independent development of aviation engines. Relying on major projects for aviation engines and gas turbines, breakthroughs will be made in key technologies of large bypass ratio large turbofan engines to support the development of domestically produced trunk aircraft. Develop 1000 kW-level turboshaft engines and 5000 kW-level turboprop engines to meet the power requirements of domestically produced serialized helicopters and medium-sized transport aircraft. Develop piston engines that use heavy oil and turbine engines that use aviation biofuels to promote the commercial application of small engines. Promote the industrialization of civil aircraft. Accelerate the implementation of major projects for large aircraft, complete the development of large passenger aircraft, initiate the development of wide-body passenger aircraft, and make breakthroughs in core technologies. Accelerate the development and series improvement of new regional aircraft, carry out demonstration operations and design optimization of new aircraft models for domestic and foreign pioneer users, and improve the adaptability and competitiveness of aircraft routes. Vigorously develop civil helicopters, multi-purpose aircraft, special-purpose aircraft, and industrial-grade unmanned aerial vehicles that have high market demand. Improve the construction of industrial supporting systems. Improve the level of independent manufacturing of aviation materials and basic components, and master core technologies for processing and manufacturing aluminum-lithium alloys, composite materials, and others. Develop highly reliable, long-life, environmentally adaptable, standardized, and low-cost aviation equipment and systems to achieve airworthiness certification. Accelerate the construction of major infrastructure for aviation research and testing, increase investment in measurement testing and verification conditions such as structural strength, flight control, electromagnetic compatibility, and environmental testing, and strengthen flight test condition construction. Make breakthroughs in a batch of airworthiness critical technologies, strengthen airworthiness certification conditions and capabilities, accelerate the improvement of airworthiness certification policies for various types of aircraft, and establish an airworthiness certification system with well-established organizational structure, sufficient human resources, sound regulatory system, advanced hardware facilities, and strong international cooperation capabilities. Accelerate the construction of a batch of specialized digital demonstration factories to significantly improve the manufacturing quality stability and production efficiency of aviation products. Actively promote the construction of international risk cooperation partnerships and establish a well-functioning aviation industry supporting system. Develop new aviation operation services. Implement various policy measures to promote the development of general aviation industry, vigorously cultivate the general aviation market, and promote the coordinated development of general aviation manufacturing and operation services. Promote the development of aviation leasing. Utilize Internet technology to establish an advanced aviation operation system and promote service model innovation. Strengthen flight training and cultivate aviation culture. Develop integrated, universal, and intelligent communication, navigation, and control systems, develop technical systems and equipment for comprehensive risk management and the integrated use of multiple airspace, and establish a safety operation support system. Column 7: New Generation Civil Aircraft Innovation Project. Supported by major projects and civil aircraft research, breakthroughs will be made in a batch of core technologies, systems, components, and materials, system integration capabilities will be improved, and the focus will be on the development of serialized single-aisle narrow-body and dual-aisle wide-body large aircraft, serialized new turboprop/turbofan regional aircraft, and advanced general aviation aircraft. Efforts will be made to carry out demonstration operations and market promotion of new civil aircraft, and establish a product support and customer service system with market competitiveness. C919 and MA700 will obtain airworthiness certification and be delivered to users, and ARJ21 will achieve mass production and delivery. A batch of key general aviation aircraft will be developed and put into market application.
titlelist: Promote breakthrough development in high-end equipment and new materials industries, lead a new leap in China's manufacturing industry, and achieve new breakthroughs in the aviation industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Build a national civil space infrastructure that is autonomous, open, secure, and reliable, and accelerate the integration of satellite applications and infrastructure development. By 2020, the basic construction of a fully functional national civil space infrastructure will be completed, meeting the major business needs in various fields of our country, achieving basic independent guarantee for space information applications, and forming a relatively complete satellite and application industry chain. Accelerate the construction of satellite and application infrastructure. Build a remote sensing satellite system composed of constellations and thematic satellites, forming a global data acquisition capability with high, medium, and low resolution, reasonable configuration, and multi-layer observation of space, air, and ground. Strengthen the construction of ground systems, gather high-precision, all-element, systematic earth observation information, and build a big data earth. Create a domestically-produced high-resolution commercial remote sensing satellite operation service platform. Develop three satellite series for fixed communication broadcasting, mobile communication broadcasting, and data relay, forming a satellite communication broadcasting system covering major regions worldwide. Implement the national major science and technology project for the second-generation satellite navigation system, accelerate the construction of satellite navigation space systems and ground systems, build the Beidou global satellite navigation system, and form a high-precision global service capability. Promote the construction of remote sensing satellites and other projects through government and social capital cooperation (PPP) models. Improve satellite performance and technological level. Master satellite application platform technologies with long lifespan, high stability, high positioning accuracy, large carrying capacity, and strong agility, and break through effective payload technologies such as high resolution, high precision, high reliability, and comprehensive detection. Prioritize the development of remote sensing satellite data processing technology and business application technology. Enhance the performance of broadband communication satellites, mobile multimedia broadcasting satellites, etc. Strengthen the construction of satellite platform spectrum, and promote the development of small and micro satellites in an orderly manner. Promote comprehensive satellite applications. Coordinate military and civilian space infrastructure, improve satellite data sharing mechanisms, strengthen satellite popularization, regionalization, and internationalization applications, accelerate the integration of satellite remote sensing, communication, and navigation applications, innovate satellite+ application models using new technologies such as the Internet of Things and mobile Internet. Carry out comprehensive application demonstrations in typical regions for disaster prevention and reduction, emergency response, and the ocean. Carry out comprehensive satellite applications demonstrations for government business management and social service needs in modern agriculture, new urbanization, smart cities, smart oceans, remote areas, etc. Based on the overall strategic development of the country's regions, promote the deep development of Internet + space-based information application, and create a new industrial chain and business model for space information consumption. Promote the development of commercial satellites and the commercialization of satellite applications. Actively layout overseas markets and establish the Belt and Road space information corridor. Column 8: Space Information Intelligent Perception Project. Accelerate the construction of a national space infrastructure with remote sensing, communication, and navigation satellites as the core, strengthen cross-domain resource sharing and information integration service capabilities, actively promote comprehensive space information applications, provide timely and accurate space information services for dynamic monitoring and early warning of resources and the environment, disaster prevention and reduction, and emergency command, strengthen the construction of comprehensive information service capabilities for global provision, and vigorously expand international markets.
titlelist: Promote breakthrough development in high-end equipment and new materials industries, leading the new leap in Chinese manufacturing, and expand and strengthen the satellite and application industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the intelligent, green, lightweight, serialized, standardized, and platform-based development of the rail transit equipment industry. Accelerate the application of new technologies, new processes, and new materials. Develop advanced and reliable series of products, improve the relevant technical standards system, construct a modern rail transit equipment industry innovation system, and create a complete industrial chain layout covering trunk railways, intercity railways, urban (suburban) railways, and urban rail transit. Build a rail transit equipment industry chain with international competitiveness. Form a series of products including China's standard new high-speed train, energy-saving permanent magnet motor-driven high-speed train, 30-ton axle load heavy-duty electric locomotives and vehicles, and large-scale track maintenance machinery. Promote the research and development and industrialization of new types of trains such as the 500 km/h wheel-rail test train and the 600 km/h maglev system, and build a complete industrial chain. Strengthen the comprehensive capacity building of product quality inspection, testing, and certification. Accelerate the pace of going global and enhance international competitiveness. Promote the research and development and industrialization of new urban rail transit equipment. For the complex transportation needs of large cities, promote the equipment for suburban railways (connecting seamlessly with urban rail transit) with speeds of 120-160 km/h, develop and apply technologies such as straddle-type monorails and automatic guided rapid transit systems based on different technical routes, and build a design, manufacturing, testing, and detection technology platform for medium-low-speed maglev systems with speeds of 200 km/h and below. Establish and improve product certification systems, establish new urban rail transit vehicle technical standards and specifications, and lead international technical standards. Breakthrough in key components and green intelligent integration technology of the industry. Further develop key systems and components such as train traction and braking systems, train network control systems, communication signal systems, electric drive systems, intelligent systems, coupler and buffer systems, energy storage and energy-saving systems, high-speed wheelsets, high-performance bogies, gearboxes, bearings, and lightweight vehicle bodies, forming a complete industrial chain for rail transit equipment. Strengthen the research and development and industrialization of technologies such as permanent magnet motor drive, fully automatic operation, and wireless integrated carrying based on the fourth-generation mobile communication. Optimize and improve the high-speed railway train control system and intercity railway train control technical standards system.
titlelist: Promote breakthrough development in the high-end equipment and new materials industry, leading a new leap in China's manufacturing industry, and strengthen the leading position of rail transit equipment.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)

content: Promote the development and diversification of marine engineering equipment in deep-sea and polar regions, achieve an upgrade in the structure of main equipment, break through key new types of equipment, enhance design capabilities and the level of supporting systems, and form a complete industrial system covering scientific research and development, overall assembly and construction, equipment supply, and technical services. Focus on the development of main marine engineering equipment. Accelerate the development and series production of main marine engineering equipment such as geophysical survey vessels, deepwater semi-submersible platforms, drilling ships, floating production storage and offloading facilities, marine survey ships, semi-submersible transport ships, lifting and laying pipe ships, and multi-functional marine engineering ships, and build a service system with world-leading design and construction capabilities. Accelerate the development of new marine engineering equipment. Breakthroughs in the research, design, and construction technologies of floating drilling production storage and offloading facilities, floating liquefied natural gas storage and regasification facilities, deep-draft column platforms, tension leg platforms, polar drilling platforms, and offshore test sites, establish a large-scale production manufacturing process system, and achieve product performance and reliability at an internationally advanced level. Strengthen the research, development, and industrialization of key supporting systems and equipment. Combine industry, academia, and research to improve the design and manufacturing level of key supporting equipment such as lifting and locking systems, deepwater mooring systems, dynamic positioning systems, automatic control systems, underwater drilling systems, and flexible riser deep-sea observation systems, vigorously develop high-performance engines for marine engineering, and enhance specialized supporting capabilities. Column 9: Innovation and development of marine engineering equipment. Promote the research and development of new equipment such as large floating structures, deep-sea drilling platforms with a water depth of over 3600 meters, and marine polar survey and observation equipment, achieve the engineering and industrialization of scientific research results, and promote the coordinated development of overall assembly and supporting industries. Improve the standard system for marine engineering equipment.
titlelist: Promote breakthrough development in the high-end equipment and new materials industry, lead a new leap in China's manufacturing, and enhance the international competitiveness of marine engineering equipment.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: In response to the trend of high-performance, multifunctional, and green development of new materials, we will promote the sustainable development of characteristic resource new materials, strengthen the layout of cutting-edge materials, and optimize the industrialization and application environment of new materials. We will strengthen the construction of the new material standard system, improve the application level of new materials, and promote the integration of new materials into the high-end manufacturing supply chain. By 2020, we strive to make several new material varieties enter the global supply chain, and the self-sufficiency rate of major key materials reaches more than 70%, initially realizing the strategic transformation of China from a material-rich country to a material-strong country. We will promote the quality and efficiency improvement of the new materials industry. Facing the development needs of industries such as aviation, aerospace, rail transportation, power electronics, and new energy vehicles, we will expand the scale of application of high-strength lightweight alloys, high-performance fibers, special alloys, advanced inorganic non-metallic materials, high-quality special steels, new display materials, power battery materials, and green printing materials, gradually entering the global high-end manufacturing procurement system. We will promote the going global of advantageous new material enterprises, strengthen supply chain cooperation with well-known domestic and foreign high-end manufacturing enterprises, and carry out all-round cooperation in research and development design, production and trade, and standard formulation. We will increase the added value of new materials, build new material brands, and enhance international competitiveness. We will establish a new material technology maturity evaluation system and study the establishment of a first-batch application insurance compensation mechanism for new materials. We will establish a new material performance testing and evaluation center. We will refine and improve the classification of new material products. We will build a new material standard system based on applications. We will strengthen the connection and coordination between new material product standards and downstream industry design specifications in industries such as next-generation information technology, high-end equipment manufacturing, and energy conservation and environmental protection. We will accelerate the formulation of key new material standards, promote the revision of old standards, strengthen the promotion and application of existing standards, strengthen the pre-research of cutting-edge new material standards, and pre-layout a batch of core standards. We will accelerate the internationalization of the new material standard system and promote the transformation of domestic standards into international standards. We will promote the sustainable development of characteristic resource new materials. We will promote the high-quality utilization of rare earths, tungsten and molybdenum, vanadium and titanium, lithium, graphite, and other characteristic resources, strengthen the research and development of special processes and technologies, promote the balanced utilization of co-associated mineral resources, and support the establishment of specialized characteristic resource new material recycling and utilization bases and mineral functional material manufacturing bases. In the various links of characteristic resource new material mining, smelting and separation, and deep processing, we will promote the intelligent and green production equipment and processes. We will develop new materials such as medical tissue engineering materials and bio-environmental materials from marine biological sources. We will proactively plan and layout the research and development of cutting-edge new materials. We will break through the industrial application technology of graphene, expand the application scope of nanomaterials in fields such as optics, electronics, new energy, and biomedicine, develop smart materials, biomimetic materials, metamaterials, low-cost additive manufacturing materials, and new superconducting materials, increase research and development efforts for materials required in extreme environments such as aerospace, deep sea, and deep earth, and form a number of innovative achievements with broad driving force. We will strengthen the improvement and coordinated application of 10 new materials. We will strengthen the connection between new green building materials standards and public building energy-saving standards, accelerate the formulation of standards for gear steel for rail transportation equipment, carbon/carbon composite structural materials for aerospace, high-temperature alloys, special glass, wide-bandgap semiconductors, and chemical products for electronic information, optical functional films, and artificial crystal materials, improve the supporting standards for functional film materials for energy conservation and environmental protection, and marine anti-corrosion materials, and lay out additive manufacturing materials, rare earth functional materials, and graphene materials standards, promote the improvement of new material product quality. We will strengthen the cooperation and coordination between the upstream and downstream of the new materials industry, carry out collaborative application pilot demonstrations in areas such as aviation aluminum, carbon fiber composite materials, and nuclear power steel, and build collaborative application platforms.
titlelist: Promote breakthrough development in the high-end equipment and new materials industry, lead a new leap in Chinese manufacturing, and enhance the basic support capability of new materials.

content: Grasp the new trend of deep development in life sciences, extensive application of new biotechnologies, and integration of innovation. Seize the opportunity of rapid development in genetic technology to promote the development of precision medicine and personalized medicine in the medical field. Accelerate the transformation of agricultural breeding towards efficient and precise breeding. Expand into new areas of marine biological resources, promote the substitution of bioprocesses and products in a wider range of fields. Use new development models to promote the large-scale application of bioenergy. Cultivate high-quality specialized bio-service industries. Accelerate the development of the bioeconomy as an important new form of economy after the information economy, providing new support for building a healthy and beautiful China. By 2020, the scale of the bio-industry will reach 8-10 trillion yuan, forming a group of new biotechnology enterprises and bioeconomic clusters with strong international competitiveness.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the development of innovative drugs and biologics with significant clinical demand, promote the green and intelligent production technology of pharmaceuticals, strengthen scientific and efficient regulation and policy support, promote the internationalization of the industry, and accelerate the construction of a strong biopharmaceutical country. Promote the leapfrog upgrade of the biopharmaceutical industry. Accelerate the research and application of technologies such as gene sequencing, large-scale cell culture, targeted and sustained drug release, and green intelligent production, to support the high-end development of the industry. Develop new antibodies, vaccines, gene therapy, cell therapy, and other biologics and formulations, promote innovation in chemical drugs and high-end formulation development, accelerate the research and development of characteristic innovative traditional Chinese medicine, and achieve original innovation in the prevention and treatment of major diseases. Support the scale development of biosimilars, carry out research and production of a large variety of patent-expired drugs, accelerate the upgrading of pharmaceutical equipment, improve the automation, digitization, and intelligence level of pharmaceuticals, further promote the standardized development of traditional Chinese medicine products, promote the integration of industrial standards with international standards, and accelerate internationalization. Develop innovative marine drugs, develop modern marine traditional Chinese medicine products with ethnic characteristics, promote the industrialization of reagent raw materials and intermediates, and form a cluster of marine biopharmaceutical industries. Column 11: New Drug Development and Industrialization Engineering. Focus on the construction of a sustainable biopharmaceutical industry system, with a focus on emerging drugs such as antibody drugs, recombinant protein drugs, and new vaccines, promote the research and development, industrialization, and quality improvement of new drugs for major diseases, common diseases, rare diseases, and children's diseases that are clinically scarce, integrate various elements to form a set of advanced product standards and industrial technology systems with international advanced level, enhance the supporting capacity of key raw materials and equipment, and support the continuous innovation and development of biotechnology drugs. Innovate the regulatory approach for biopharmaceuticals. Establish a more scientific and efficient drug evaluation and approval system, accelerate the pilot implementation of the drug marketing authorization holder system, accelerate the evaluation of generic drug quality and efficacy consistency, and explore the pilot implementation of the clinical trial recognition system for new medical technologies. Improve the drug procurement mechanism and comprehensively promote the reform of the pricing and industry regulation mechanisms in the pharmaceutical sector.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and build a new system for the biopharmaceutical industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deepen the integration of biomedical engineering technology and information technology, accelerate industry regulation reform, actively develop new medical devices, construct new diagnosis and treatment models such as mobile healthcare and remote healthcare, promote the development of smart healthcare industry, promote the application of high-performance medical devices, advance the research and development of new instruments and reagents that adapt to the development of life science and enhance the overall competitiveness of China's biomedical engineering industry. Develop intelligent and mobile new medical equipment. Develop intelligent medical devices and their software and supporting reagents, comprehensive remote healthcare service platforms and terminal devices, develop mobile healthcare services, establish relevant data standards, promote interoperability, and initially establish a modern intelligent healthcare service system deeply integrated with information technology and biotechnology. Develop high-performance medical equipment and core components. Develop high-quality medical imaging equipment, advanced radiation therapy equipment, high-throughput and low-cost gene sequencers, gene editing equipment, rehabilitation medical devices, and other medical equipment to significantly improve the stability and reliability of medical devices. Utilize new technologies such as additive manufacturing to accelerate the innovation and industrialization of organ repair and replacement materials and implantable medical devices. Accelerate the development of new products such as in vitro diagnostic instruments, equipment, and reagents, promote the development of new technologies such as high-specificity molecular diagnostics and biochips, and support rapid and accurate diagnosis and screening of diseases such as tumors, genetic diseases, and rare diseases. Column 12: Biotechnology Benefit Project. Promote the construction of networked gene technology application demonstration centers, carry out birth defect gene screening, early tumor screening, and drug guidance demonstrations. Develop and apply new biotechnology to promote the standardization and standardization of new personalized biotreatment. Develop intelligent and high-performance medical equipment, support the joint construction of third-party imaging centers by enterprises, medical institutions, research institutions, etc., carry out collaborative diagnosis and treatment and training, and pilot the establishment of residents' health imaging archives. Carry out regional comprehensive application demonstrations to replace more than 50% of traditional petrochemical plastic products with bio-based plastic products and packaging materials. Build biomass centralized gas and heat supply demonstration projects in urban areas or around enterprises, and explore diversified and win-win market-oriented development models.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and enhance the development level of biomedical engineering.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: With the goal of high efficiency, product safety, resource conservation, and environmental friendliness, we aim to create new varieties of biotechnology agriculture, develop new products for animal and plant nutrition and green plant protection, construct a new system for modern agriculture, and establish a group of internationally competitive biotechnology breeding enterprises. This will provide new approaches and support for accelerating the transformation of agricultural development methods. We will also establish an independent innovation system for biotechnology seed industry. Key core technology innovations and breeding applications such as gene editing, molecular design, and cell mutation will be carried out to develop and promote a batch of high-quality, high-yield, nutritious, safe, resource-efficient, and standardized agricultural animal and plant varieties. We will actively promote the industrialization of new varieties bred through biotechnology and establish a group of biotechnology breeding innovation platforms led by enterprises. We will create integrated modern biotechnology seed industry enterprises with core competitiveness, and accelerate the industrialization and market promotion of new agricultural animal and plant varieties. We will develop new technologies for animal and plant quarantine and strengthen the construction of platforms for introducing and quarantining high-quality animal and plant varieties from abroad. We will also develop a batch of new agricultural biological preparations and major products. We will vigorously develop new technologies and products for the prevention and control of animal and plant diseases and pests, establish a green pesticide and veterinary drug creation technology system based on disease and pest genomics information, and create a batch of new animal vaccines, biological veterinary drugs, and new plant pesticides. This will achieve large-scale production and application and promote the green transformation of agricultural production. We will create new green biotechnology feed and efficient biological fertilizer products that can replace antibiotics. We will explore marine biological resources in depth, develop new green, safe, and efficient marine biological functional products, and explore new ways of comprehensive utilization. We will promote key technological innovations such as food synthetic biotechnology, efficient conversion of food biotechnology, and gut microbiome genomics, as well as the creation of precision nutrition food.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and expedite the industrialization of biotechnology in agriculture.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the development of new technologies such as microbial genomics engineering, enzyme molecular machines, and cell factories to enhance the economic viability of industrial biotechnology products. Promote the application of biomanufacturing technology in fields such as chemical engineering, materials, and energy, gradually replacing traditional chemical processing methods with clean bio-processing methods, and gradually replacing fossil resources with renewable resources. Continuously improve the economic viability and scale of development of biomanufacturing products. Develop a new biotool creation and application technology system to achieve the biological production and application of basic chemical products such as organic acids, chemical alcohols, olefins, alkanes, and organic amines. Promote the industrial chain, aggregation, and scale development of bio-based materials such as bio-based polyesters, bio-based polyurethanes, bio-based nylon, bio-based rubber, and microbial polysaccharides. Enhance the independent innovation capability and development level of bulk fermentation products such as amino acids and vitamins. Establish an ecological, safe, green, low-carbon, and circular development bioprocess system. Develop an efficient industrial biocatalytic conversion technology system to enhance the application level of green bioprocesses. Establish biocatalytic synthesis routes for steroidal drugs, chiral compounds, rare sugar alcohols, etc., to achieve green and large-scale production of pharmaceutical and chemical intermediates. Promote the comprehensive entry and demonstration application of green bioprocesses in agriculture, chemical industry, food, medicine, light textile, metallurgy, energy, and other fields, significantly reducing resource consumption, energy consumption, and pollutant emissions.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the innovative development of biotechnology services through specialized division of labor, construct a new specialized service model for new technologies, and continuously create new growth points in the bioeconomy. Enhance the specialized service capabilities of biotechnology for consumers. Develop specialized diagnostic and treatment institutions, cultivate standardized new technology diagnostic and treatment service institutions such as liquid biopsy and genetic diagnosis. Develop health examination and consultation, mobile healthcare, and other health management services, promote the construction of a shared platform for bio big data and medical and health big data, pilot the establishment of resident health image archives, encourage the construction of an intelligent diagnosis and treatment ecosystem combining online and offline, and promote the specialized development of medical laboratory testing, imaging diagnosis, and other services. Column 13: Construction project for the innovation and development platform of the bioindustry. Relying on and integrating existing resources, construct a number of innovative basic platforms, support the construction of gene banks, stem cell banks, traditional Chinese medicine standard libraries, high-level biosafety laboratories, protein component libraries, etc. Accelerate the construction of a number of transformation and application platforms, promote the construction of antibody screening platforms, medical imaging information databases, crop molecular breeding platforms, and other carriers. Actively develop a number of testing service platforms, promote the construction of generic drug consistency evaluation technology platforms, innovative platforms for the quality and safety testing of biological drugs, platforms for the safety and quality testing of agricultural products, and public service platforms for the inspection, testing, and monitoring of biomass energy, etc., and improve relevant standards. Improve the level of support of biotechnology services for industries. Develop drug research and development and production services that meet international standards, and encourage pharmaceutical companies to strengthen cooperation with contract research and development and contract manufacturing enterprises. Promote the application and transformation of emerging technologies such as gene testing and diagnosis in various fields, and support bioinformatics service institutions in improving their technical level. Provide public services such as testing, evaluation, and certification for pharmaceuticals, medical devices, seed industry, bioenergy, and other bio products, accelerate the listing process of products, and improve product quality. Encourage the expansion and application of biotechnology in areas such as water pollution control, air pollution treatment, degradation of toxic and harmful substances, and waste resource utilization, actively guide cross-regional and cross-industry cooperation or mergers of bio-environmental protection technology enterprises, and achieve growth and strength. Construct a specialized innovation and entrepreneurship platform for biotechnology, reduce the cost of innovation and entrepreneurship in the bioindustry, support the establishment of various virtual research and development enterprises by personnel, and unleash innovation potential.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and foster new forms of bio-services.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on developing the next generation of biomass liquid and gas fuels, develop high-performance biomass energy conversion system solutions, expand the application space of bioenergy, strive for comprehensive large-scale application in power generation, gas supply, heating, and fuel fields, and achieve world advanced level in bioenergy utilization technology and core equipment technology, forming a relatively mature commercial market. Promote the clean application of biomass energy. Focus on promoting key technologies and equipment research and development such as high-life, low-power consumption biomass fuel forming equipment, biomass heating boilers, and distributed biomass cogeneration, promote the substitution of biomass formed fuel for centralized coal-fired heating, and biomass cogeneration. According to the principle of adapting measures to local conditions and producing and consuming locally, demonstrate and construct centralized large-scale bio-gas application projects, break through key technological bottlenecks such as large-scale biomass centralized gas supply raw material processing and efficient anaerobic fermentation of biogas. Explore the establishment of a diversified, collaborative, and win-win market-oriented development model, encourage the comprehensive utilization of multiple products, and provide clean and high-quality energy for production and life. Promote the industrialization of advanced bio-liquid fuels. Focus on breaking through the technological bottlenecks of efficient and low-cost biomass liquid fuel raw material processing and preparation, and construct demonstration projects for the production of tens of thousands of tons of biomass prepared liquid fuels and the comprehensive utilization of multiple products. Improve the raw material supply system and promote the orderly development of biodiesel. Promote the research and industrialization of cutting-edge technologies such as oil algae biodiesel and bio-aviation fuels.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and innovate the development model for bioenergy.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)

content: Grasping the global energy transformation and development trends, as well as the requirements for green transformation and development of industries in our country, focusing on ecological civilization construction and addressing climate change, with an emphasis on innovation and application of green and low-carbon technologies, guiding green consumption, promoting green products, significantly increasing the proportion of new energy vehicles and new energy applications, comprehensively advancing the construction of efficient energy-saving, advanced environmental protection, and resource recycling industrial systems, promoting green and low-carbon industries such as new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy conservation and environmental protection to become pillar industries. By 2020, the output value scale will exceed 10 trillion yuan.
