name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen technological innovation, improve the industrial chain, optimize supporting environment, implement and improve support policies, enhance the industrialization level of pure electric vehicles and plug-in hybrid electric vehicles, and promote the industrialization of fuel cell vehicles. By 2020, achieve an annual production and sales of over 2 million vehicles, with a cumulative production and sales of over 5 million vehicles, maintaining overall technological level in sync with international standards, and forming a group of new energy vehicle manufacturers and key component enterprises with international competitiveness. Enhance the overall quality and performance of electric vehicles. Accelerate the innovation and application of electric vehicle system integration technology, focusing on research on vehicle safety and reliability, and lightweight design. Improve the technological level, supporting capacity, and overall performance of key components. Accelerate the formulation and application of electric vehicle safety standards. Accelerate the application of intelligent technology in electric vehicles and develop intelligent autonomous driving vehicles. Conduct research and development on energy storage application technology for electric vehicle power systems, implement distributed new energy and electric vehicle joint application demonstrations, and promote the integration development of electric vehicles with smart grids, new energy, energy storage, and intelligent driving. Establish joint innovation platforms for electric vehicles and cross-industry, cross-domain technology innovation strategic alliances, and promote collaborative innovation of major key technologies for electric vehicles. Improve the production access policies for electric vehicles and study the implementation of a new energy vehicle credit management system. By 2020, electric vehicles strive to have market competitiveness for commercial promotion. Build a globally competitive power battery industry chain. Vigorously promote power battery technology research and development, focus on breakthroughs in battery grouping and system integration technology, proactively develop next-generation power batteries and new system power batteries, and achieve breakthroughs in battery material technology. Accelerate the innovation of production, control, and testing equipment for high-performance and high-reliability power batteries, and enhance the engineering and industrialization capabilities of power batteries. Cultivate and develop a group of power battery enterprises and key material leading enterprises with sustainable innovation capabilities. Promote the hierarchical utilization of power batteries and establish a power battery recycling and utilization system with upstream and downstream enterprises. By 2020, the technological level of power batteries will be synchronized with international standards, and the production capacity will remain globally leading. Column 14: New Energy Vehicle Power Battery Enhancement Project. Improve the power battery research and development system, accelerate the construction of power battery innovation centers, and break through technical bottlenecks such as high safety, long life, and high energy density lithium-ion batteries. Build several technology innovation centers in key battery materials, key production equipment, and other fields, and break through high-capacity positive and negative electrode materials, high safety separators, and functional electrolyte technologies. Increase innovation in production, control, and testing equipment, and promote the construction of the entire industry chain engineering technology capability. Conduct research and development on new technologies in the fields of fuel cells, solid-state lithium-ion batteries, metal-air batteries, lithium-sulfur batteries, etc. Systematically promote the research and development and industrialization of fuel cell vehicles. Strengthen the research on fuel cell basic materials and process mechanisms, promote the research and development of high-performance and low-cost fuel cell materials and key components of the system. Accelerate the improvement of fuel cell stack system reliability and engineering level, and improve relevant technical standards. Promote the development of on-board hydrogen storage systems, hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and refueling technologies, and promote the construction of hydrogen refueling stations. By 2020, achieve mass production and large-scale demonstration applications of fuel cell vehicles. Accelerate the construction of standardized and convenient infrastructure systems. According to the principle of suitable for local conditions and moderately advanced, prioritize the construction of public service area charging infrastructure in urban development, actively promote the construction of charging piles in residential areas and parking spaces of units. Improve charging facility standards and promote interconnection of charging infrastructure. Accelerate the development of new charging and swapping technologies and equipment such as high power density, high conversion efficiency, high applicability, wireless charging, and mobile charging. Strengthen research on key technologies such as testing and certification, safety protection, and bidirectional interaction with the power grid. Promote the Internet + charging infrastructure and improve the intelligence level of charging services. Encourage innovation in business models of charging service companies and enhance their sustainable development capabilities. By 2020, establish a charging infrastructure system that meets the needs of electric vehicles.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, build a new model of sustainable development, and achieve the large-scale application of new energy vehicles.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the development of advanced nuclear power, efficient photovoltaic and solar thermal power, large-scale wind power, efficient energy storage, and distributed energy, etc., accelerate the improvement of the economic viability of new energy products, accelerate the construction of a power system mechanism, a new type of power grid, and an innovative support system that are suitable for the high proportion of new energy development, promote multi-energy complementarity and synergistic optimization, and lead the energy production and consumption revolution. By 2020, the proportion of nuclear power, wind power, solar power, biomass energy, etc. in total energy consumption will reach more than 8%, and the industrial output value will exceed 1.5 trillion yuan, creating a world-leading new energy industry. Promote the safe and efficient development of nuclear power. Adopt the highest international safety standards, adhere to cooperative innovation, focus on the development of large-scale advanced pressurized water reactors, high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, fast reactors, and post-processing technology and equipment, improve the supporting capacity of key components, and accelerate the construction of demonstration projects. Improve the recycling and safe disposal capacity of nuclear waste. Integrate industry resources, form systematic service capabilities, and promote the accelerated going global of nuclear power. By 2020, the installed capacity of nuclear power will reach 58 million kilowatts, and the capacity under construction will reach 30 million kilowatts, forming an internationally advanced nuclear power industry chain development capability integrating technology development, design, equipment manufacturing, and operation services. Promote the high-quality and efficient development and utilization of wind power. Vigorously develop smart grid technology, develop and explore system peak shaving capabilities, significantly improve wind power consumption capacity. Accelerate the development of high tower long blades, smart blades, dedicated technologies for distributed and offshore wind power, focus on the development of wind turbines with a capacity of over 5 megawatts, intelligent development and operation of wind farms, offshore wind farm construction, wind and heat utilization, and other key technologies and equipment. Establish a public service platform for wind power technology testing and industrial monitoring. By 2020, the installed capacity of wind power will exceed 210 million kilowatts, and the wind power price will be basically equivalent to that of coal-fired power, and the innovative capacity of wind power equipment technology will reach an international advanced level. Promote the diversified and large-scale development of solar energy. Break through the technological bottlenecks of advanced crystalline silicon cells and key equipment, improve the efficiency of thin-film solar cells, strengthen the research and development of new efficient and low-cost solar cell technologies such as perovskite, dye-sensitized, and organic solar cells, vigorously develop solar energy integration application technologies, promote the industrialization of new technologies and materials for efficient and low-cost solar energy utilization, establish a public service platform for testing and industrial monitoring of solar photovoltaic and solar thermal products, and significantly enhance innovation and development capabilities. Coordinate the electricity market and external transmission channels, orderly promote the development of photovoltaic and solar thermal power generation in the western region, accelerate the development of distributed photovoltaics in the central and eastern regions, and promote the comprehensive development and utilization of various forms of solar energy. Accelerate the implementation of the leading runner program for photovoltaics, form the system integration and supporting capabilities of solar thermal power plants, promote the application of advanced solar energy technology products, and rapidly reduce the cost of electricity generation, leading the global solar energy industry. By 2020, the installed capacity of solar power generation will exceed 110 million kilowatts, and efforts will be made to achieve grid parity for users. Among them, the installed capacity of distributed photovoltaic power generation, photovoltaic power plants, and solar thermal power generation will reach 60 million kilowatts, 45 million kilowatts, and 5 million kilowatts, respectively. Actively promote the comprehensive utilization of various forms of new energy. Break through the technological bottlenecks of wind-solar complementarity, advanced fuel cells, efficient energy storage, and ocean energy generation, accelerate the development of biomass gas supply and heating, biomass and coal coupling power generation, geothermal heating, air energy heating, bio-liquid fuel, ocean energy heating and cooling, etc., carry out multi-field applications and regional demonstrations of bio-natural gas, promote the industrialization of multi-product co-production and supply technologies for new energy. Accelerate the development of distributed energy with integrated energy storage and microgrid applications, vigorously promote the integrated optimization demonstration project of multi-energy complementarity, and establish a sound technical innovation, infrastructure, operation mode, and policy support system for the comprehensive development and utilization of new energy. Vigorously develop Internet Plus smart energy. Accelerate the research and development of key technologies such as distributed energy, energy storage, and smart microgrids, build an intelligent power operation monitoring and management technology platform, construct an energy internet with renewable energy as the main body, coordinated development of source-grid-load-storage-use, develop energy production big data prediction, scheduling, and operation and maintenance technologies, establish a public service network for monitoring, management, and scheduling of energy production and operation, promote the integration of upstream and downstream information in the energy industry chain and intelligent production and consumption. Promote the development of green energy networks that integrate energy storage facilities, the Internet of Things, and smart power consumption facilities, as well as carbon trading, Internet finance, and other derivative services, promote intelligent energy use at the user end, the development of energy sharing economy and energy free trade, cultivate new businesses and new formats based on smart energy, and build a new energy consumption ecosystem and industrial system. Accelerate the formation of an institutional environment that adapts to the high proportion of new energy development. In order to achieve a significant increase in the proportion of renewable energy and a near-zero abandonment rate of wind and solar power, improve the dispatch mechanism and operation management methods, establish a power grid operation management system that adapts to the large-scale development of new energy electricity, improve national standards and clean energy pricing mechanisms for wind power, solar power, biomass energy, etc., and establish a priority mechanism for the consumption of new energy. Establish a dynamic adjustment mechanism for renewable energy generation subsidies and supporting management systems. Include distributed new energy in power and heating planning as well as the national new round of distribution network transformation plan, promote coordinated development of source-grid-use, realize direct supply and barrier-free access of distributed new energy. Column 15 New Energy High Proportion Development Project. In order to achieve flexible and friendly grid connection and full absorption of new energy, accelerate the construction of safe and efficient transmission networks, reliable and flexible active distribution networks, and microgrids with various distributed power sources widely connected and interactive, demonstrate and apply large-scale intelligent energy storage systems and flexible DC transmission projects, establish an intelligent supply-demand interactive power system that meets the diversified load access requirements of distributed power sources, electric vehicles, energy storage, etc., and build a new power grid system that adapts to the high proportion of new energy development. Select suitable areas for the comprehensive development of distributed photovoltaics, decentralized wind power, biomass gas supply and heating, geothermal energy, ocean energy, etc., integrate large-capacity energy storage and microgrid technologies, build a comprehensive utilization system for distributed energy, and lead the transformation of energy supply methods.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy conservation and environmental protection industries, build a new model for sustainable development, and promote the development of the new energy industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Adapt to the requirements of building a resource-saving and environmentally friendly society, establish the concept of energy conservation as the foundation, comprehensively promote energy conservation, enhance the application level of high-efficiency energy-saving equipment technology and products, promote the integration and demonstration application of energy-saving technologies, support the development of the energy-saving service industry, and promote the rapid development of the high-efficiency energy-saving industry. By 2020, the output value of the high-efficiency energy-saving industry should strive to reach 3 trillion yuan. Vigorously improve the technology and application level of high-efficiency energy-saving equipment. Encourage the development of high-efficiency energy-saving equipment (products) and key components, increase demonstration and promotion efforts, and accelerate the reduction of comprehensive costs. Formulate or revise mandatory energy efficiency and energy consumption limit standards, and accelerate the application of energy-saving scientific and technological achievements. Publish a catalog of energy-saving products and technology promotion, improve government procurement policies for energy-saving products, and promote the increase in market share of energy-saving products. Improve the energy efficiency labeling system and energy-saving product certification system, implement the energy efficiency leader system in industries such as industry, construction, transportation, and consumer goods, and promote a leap in energy efficiency for energy-using enterprises and product manufacturers. Promote the integration and demonstration application of energy-saving technologies. Carry out pilot projects for the integration of energy-saving technology systems in key areas and industries such as demonstration parks, integrate the waste heat, waste pressure, and waste gas resources of high-energy-consuming enterprises, encourage the use of waste heat for heating, utilize waste energy and low-temperature waste heat for power generation. Encourage key energy-consuming units and energy-consuming equipment to be equipped with intelligent energy metering and remote diagnostic equipment, strengthen system automatic monitoring and intelligent analysis capabilities through information network technology, and promote the improvement of comprehensive energy efficiency. Promote the optimization of process industrial system technology, promote the construction of energy management centers in industrial enterprises, encourage the use of solar collectors in the low-temperature heating section, and achieve comprehensive optimization of production processes and energy supply. Promote the industrialization of near-zero consumption building technologies for fossil energy, and vigorously promote the application of energy-saving doors and windows, green energy-saving building materials, and other products. Encourage the comprehensive integration of wind power, solar power generation, and enterprise energy supply and management systems, and promote the local consumption of renewable energy. Develop and strengthen the energy-saving service industry. Support the rapid development of contract energy management, franchise operations, and other formats, promote innovation in energy-saving service business models, and promote the promotion of comprehensive energy-saving solutions. Support energy-saving service companies to achieve scale, branding, and networked operations through mergers, alliances, and reorganizations. Build a green financing platform, promote the issuance of green bonds, and support the financing of energy-saving service companies. Develop relevant standards and improve the standardization level of energy-saving services. Formulate management measures for energy-saving service institutions and establish a sound third-party evaluation mechanism for energy-saving. Establish a performance registration and service platform for energy-saving service companies, key energy-consuming units, and third-party evaluation institutions to create an honest and trustworthy market environment. Column 16: Development of energy-saving technology and equipment. Organize the implementation of key common energy-saving technology improvement projects and energy-saving equipment manufacturing projects. Encourage the development of high-performance building insulation materials, photovoltaic integrated building glass curtain walls, compact household air-source heat pump devices, high-power semiconductor lighting chips and devices, advanced and efficient gas turbine power generation equipment, clean and efficient coal utilization technology and equipment, shallow geothermal energy utilization devices, and heat storage high-temperature air combustion devices, and other high-efficiency energy-saving equipment (products) and their key components. Implement comprehensive energy-saving and environmental improvement projects for coal-fired boilers, comprehensive energy efficiency improvement projects for heating pipe network systems, and energy efficiency improvement projects for motor drive systems, promote energy-saving and ultra-low emission transformation of coal-fired power plants, energy-saving of motor systems, energy system optimization, and waste heat and waste pressure utilization, and demonstrate the large-scale application of key energy-saving technologies and products. Organize the implementation of energy-saving demonstration projects in cities, parks, and enterprises, and promote the integrated demonstration application of high-efficiency energy-saving technologies.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, build a new model of sustainable development, and vigorously develop efficient energy-saving industries.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Vigorously promote the implementation of action plans for the prevention and control of water, air, and soil pollution, promote overall linkage between regional and watershed pollution prevention and control, deeply promote the reduction of major pollutants in land and sea, promote the development of environmental protection equipment industry, enhance the monitoring and control technology and equipment capabilities for major pollutants, strengthen the promotion and integration of advanced and applicable environmental protection technology and equipment, actively promote the application of advanced environmental protection products, promote the development of environmental service industry, and comprehensively improve the level of development of the environmental protection industry. By 2020, the output value of advanced environmental protection industries will strive to exceed 2 trillion yuan. Enhance the technical and equipment capabilities for pollution prevention and control. Focus on the prevention and control of water, air, and soil pollution, concentrate on breakthroughs in key treatment technologies for industrial wastewater, smog, pesticide residues in soil, and heavy metal pollution in water and soil, and accelerate the formation of production capabilities for complete sets of equipment, core components, and supporting materials. Construct a number of demonstration bases for the industrialization of major environmental protection technologies that are technologically advanced, well-equipped, and standardized, and form a sound development pattern of the industry with backbone enterprises as the core and small and medium-sized enterprises specializing in new and high technologies growing rapidly. Support the research and development of hazardous waste prevention and control technologies and improve the level of hazardous waste treatment and disposal. Support the optimization and integration of environmental protection industry resources and actively expand the international market. Strengthen the promotion and integration of advanced and applicable environmental protection technology and equipment. Regularly update the Catalog of Major Environmental Protection Technologies and Equipment Encouraged by the State, strengthen supply-demand connection, and strengthen the application of advanced and applicable environmental protection equipment in key areas such as metallurgy, chemical industry, building materials, and food. Accelerate the deep integration of environmental protection industry with new generation information technology and advanced manufacturing technology, strengthen the manufacturing capacity of advanced environmental protection equipment, and improve the level of comprehensive integration. Support the establishment of an environmental protection technology innovation alliance that combines production, education, research, and application, and accelerate research and application of integrated innovation in technology. Actively promote the application of advanced environmental protection products. Vigorously promote the application of environmental protection materials and agents such as ion exchange resins, biofilter media and fillers, efficient activated carbon, circulating cooling water treatment agents, bactericides and algaecides, water treatment disinfectants, solid waste treatment solidifiers and stabilizers. Expand the scope of government procurement of environmental protection products and continuously increase the proportion of environmental protection product procurement. Implement the system of leading environmental protection products, improve environmental protection product standards, actively promote the application of advanced environmental protection products, and organize the implementation of demonstration projects for technological progress and model innovation of advanced environmental protection equipment. Enhance comprehensive environmental service capabilities. Based on the big data of pollutants in various industries, promote the establishment of an information platform for environmental protection equipment and service demand, a platform for technological innovation and transformation transactions, and a platform for bidding information for environmental protection equipment, and improve the level of informationization of environmental protection services. Promote the application of satellite and Internet of Things technologies in environmental monitoring, build a platform for pollution emission, basic data on environmental quality, and monitoring and disposal information, improve the intelligence level of environmental supervision, and deepen the pilot work of environmental service industry. Develop environmental restoration services, promote contract-based environmental services, and promote the overall solution of environmental protection services. Carry out pilot projects for third-party governance of environmental pollution and pilot projects for comprehensive governance and hosting services, and explore the third-party governance model in key areas such as urban sewage and garbage treatment and centralized treatment of industrial park pollution. Promote the creation of demonstration enterprises for green design, and support enterprises in carrying out green design. Column 17: Comprehensive Innovation Demonstration Project for Green and Low-carbon Technologies. Connect with green and low-carbon pilot demonstration projects, and in regions with conditions, focus on the comprehensive application of green and low-carbon technologies, with the Internet as the link, build comprehensive application facilities for new energy, new energy vehicles and intelligent transportation systems, low-carbon communities, carbon capture and rich carbon agriculture, green intelligent factories, etc., take the lead in implementing relevant reform measures, promote the integration and innovation of green and low-carbon technologies, new generation information technology, urbanization construction, production, and life, carry out extensive international cooperation, and create demonstration areas for the comprehensive application of relevant technologies.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, build a new model of sustainable development, and accelerate the development of advanced environmental protection industries.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Establish a resource concept of conservation, intensification, and circular utilization, vigorously promote the comprehensive utilization of associated minerals and tailings, the development of urban minerals, the recycling of agricultural and forestry waste, and the recycling of new varieties of waste. Develop the remanufacturing industry, improve the infrastructure for resource recycling, enhance policy support, and promote the development and growth of the resource recycling industry. By 2020, strive to replace 1.3 billion tons of primary resources annually and achieve a scale of 3 trillion yuan in the resource recycling industry. Vigorously promote the comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste and tailings. Promote the comprehensive utilization of industrial waste such as metallurgical slag, chemical slag, red mud, and phosphogypsum, promote the application of advanced and applicable technologies and equipment, and strengthen the recycling of strategic precious metals in industrial solid waste. Research and develop deep processing and comprehensive utilization technologies for tailings, promote the recovery of associated valuable elements and the development of high-tech tailings products, and improve the economic efficiency of tailings comprehensive utilization. Research and develop key technologies and equipment for the joint selection and metallurgy of complex polymetallic tailings, key technologies for clean and harmless comprehensive utilization, and technologies for the efficient concentration, preparation, transportation, and filling of tailings with an annual processing capacity of 10-50 million tons. Develop optimization and upgrading technologies for low-grade titanium slag to improve the comprehensive utilization rate of vanadium-titanium magnetite resources. Promote the development of urban minerals and the utilization of low-value waste. Improve the level of technology and equipment for the dismantling and utilization of waste electrical and electronic products and scrapped vehicles, promote the processing and utilization of non-ferrous metals and waste plastics in a centralized and scaled manner. Accelerate the construction of resource-based and harmless treatment systems for urban kitchen waste, construction waste, and waste textiles, coordinate the role of various solid waste treatment facilities, and create urban collaborative treatment bases for low-value waste. Implement preferential policies related to land, finance, and taxation. Improve the infrastructure for the recycling and utilization of renewable resources, and support the upgrading and transformation of existing recycling and distribution sites for renewable resources. Strengthen the recycling and utilization of agricultural and forestry waste. Basically achieve the utilization of agricultural and forestry waste such as livestock and poultry manure, film remnants, crop straw, and forestry residues. Promote the technology of straw composting and returning to the field, support the industrialization of new technologies such as straw substitution for wood, fiber raw materials, clean pulping, biomass energy, and commercial organic fertilizer. Encourage the use of livestock and poultry manure, straw, and other agricultural and forestry waste to implement rural household biogas and centralized biogas projects according to local conditions. Promote the use of standard plastic film, guide the recycling of waste and the use of degradable film. Encourage the construction of biomass cogeneration projects using forestry waste to produce heat, electricity, oil, medicine, etc. Actively develop ultra-low emission incineration technology for agricultural and forestry waste. Actively carry out the recycling of new varieties of waste. Carry out demonstrations of the recycling and utilization system for new varieties of waste, promote the recycling and utilization of new types of waste such as waste solar cells, waste power batteries, waste carbon fiber materials, and waste energy-saving lamps, promote the efficient enrichment and clean recycling of precious metals, and the cascade utilization of electric vehicle power batteries. Support the research and development and application of carbon capture, utilization, and storage technologies, and develop the carbon cycle industry. Vigorously promote the comprehensive utilization of seawater resources. Accelerate the research and industrialization of seawater desalination and utilization technologies, improve the reliability, advancedness, and supporting capacity of core materials and key equipment. Promote the construction of a concentrated development base for seawater desalination equipment manufacturing. Carry out demonstration projects for the utilization of seawater resources, and promote the general contracting and services of large-scale seawater desalination projects. Carry out pilot demonstrations of seawater desalination, encourage the production of bottled seawater desalination water, and promote the use of seawater desalination water to enter the municipal water supply network in accordance with the law. Promote the large-scale application of seawater cooling technology in water-intensive industries along the coast. Extract potassium, bromine, magnesium, and other products from seawater to achieve high-value utilization. Develop the remanufacturing industry. Strengthen the research and development of non-destructive testing, green and efficient cleaning, and automated surface and volume restoration technologies for remanufacturing machinery products, and accelerate industrial application. Organize the implementation of demonstration projects for the application of remanufacturing technology processes, promote the application of mature surface engineering equipment such as nanoelectroplating technology equipment and arc spraying, and carry out the remanufacturing of high-value components such as engines and shield machines. Establish a traceability and product tracking information system for remanufactured parts to promote the standardized development of the remanufacturing industry. Improve the industrial system for resource recycling. Promote the application of Internet of Things electronic supervision technology in the disposal of hazardous waste, electronic waste, etc., support recycling enterprises in establishing integrated online and offline recycling networks. Coordinate domestic and foreign utilization of recycled resources, strengthen the connection between municipal solid waste classification and recycling and the recycling of recycled resources. Establish a third-party service system for resource recycling, encourage the provision of integrated solutions and specialized services for waste management, recycling, reprocessing, and recycling through contract management. Fully implement the extended producer responsibility system, encourage the use of recycled products and raw materials. Establish a sound standard system covering solid waste, hazardous waste, recycled products, and pollutant control. Column 18: Demonstration projects for the resource recycling substitution system. Implement actions to lead circular development, promote the recycling and utilization of new types of waste such as solar photovoltaic cells, precious metal separation and extraction from waste electronic products, electric vehicle power batteries, waste LCDs, etc., and carry out demonstrations of waste recycling and utilization systems based on the Internet + model. Promote the coordinated disposal of low-value waste in cities and the accelerated development of comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste. Establish a system for the recycling of used parts with the after-sales service system as the core, and promote the application of remanufactured products in sectors such as trade logistics, finance and insurance, repair and sales, and coal and petroleum mining enterprises. Encourage specialized remanufacturing service companies to provide integrated solutions and specialized services.
titlelist: Promote the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, new energy, and energy-saving and environmental protection industries, build a new model of sustainable development, and deepen the promotion of resource recycling.

Encourage companies to use digital creation, network collaboration, and other means to improve production efficiency. Enhance the level of communication service technology equipment. Improve the technical and service standard system of the digital cultural and creative industry, promote the widespread application of standards in fields such as mobile animation and film and television media, and establish standards for the digital protection and inheritance of cultural relics, smart museums, and ultra-high-definition content production and transmission. name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)

content: By using new methods such as nationwide creativity and collaborative creation, we aim to explore excellent cultural resources, stimulate cultural creativity, adapt to the characteristics of internet communication, and create high-quality, diverse, and personalized digital creative content products. We promote the creative transformation of excellent cultural resources. We encourage the digitization and development of cultural resources such as artworks, cultural relics, and intangible cultural heritage. By relying on local cultural characteristics, we aim to create digital creative content products with distinct regional and ethnic features. We strengthen the integration of modern design and traditional craftsmanship to promote innovative integration. We improve the digitization and intelligence level of libraries, art galleries, cultural centers, and experience centers, enhance the construction of smart museums and smart cultural heritage sites, and innovate interactive experience applications. We encourage the creation of high-quality contemporary digital creative content. We strengthen the support of high-tech for cultural product creation, improve the originality of digital creative content products, accelerate the digitization process in industries such as publishing, film and television production, performing arts and entertainment, artworks, and cultural exhibitions, and enhance the cultural taste and market value of animation, games, digital music, online literature, online videos, and online performances. We encourage creative development models that involve multiple industries, improve the integration and conversion efficiency between different content forms, strive to create digital creative brands with global influence, and support the internationalization of Chinese culture. This is part of the Column 20 Digital Content Innovation and Development Project. By relying on advanced digital technology, we promote the implementation of the cultural creative product support plan and the Internet Plus Chinese Civilization Action Plan, support the promotion of a batch of digital cultural heritage masterpieces, create a batch of excellent digital cultural creative products, build a digital cultural resource platform, realize intelligent retrieval, development, utilization, promotion, and popularization of cultural creative resources, expand communication channels, and guide the formation of an industry chain.
titlelist: Promote the vigorous development of the digital creative industry, create leading new consumption, enrich digital cultural creative content and forms.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)

content: Promote the application of digital cultural creativity and innovative design in various fields, cultivate more new products, new services, and new formats of multi-directional interactive integration, and form a boundaryless pattern of creative economy penetration. Accelerate the integration and development of key areas. Promote the application of digital creativity in e-commerce and social networks, develop new marketing models such as virtual reality shopping, social e-commerce, and fan economy. Promote the application of digital creativity in the field of education, enhance the level of creative learning content, strengthen the development of digital cultural education products and the deep utilization of public information resources, and promote the creative transformation of educational services. Enhance the cultural connotation and digital level of tourism product development and tourism service design, promote innovative development of new models such as virtual tourism display. Tap into the potential of creative rural development, improve the level of creative leisure agriculture, promote the development of geographical indication agricultural products and rural culture, and promote rural tourism development and the construction of new rural areas through creative homestays. Promote the application of digital creativity in fields such as healthcare, exhibition display, geographic information, and public management. Build a digital creativity project resource library and docking service platform, innovate the use of various forms of online and offline promotion methods, carry out extensive exhibition activities, and encourage industry associations and research institutions to actively engage in cross-disciplinary exchanges and cooperation. Promote the construction of a digital creativity ecosystem. Establish a digital creativity intellectual property protection system that covers laws and regulations, administrative measures, and technical standards, increase efforts to combat piracy and infringement in the field of digital creativity, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of rights holders. Actively research and solve the risk issues in the promotion and application of virtual reality, online games, and other fields, effectively protect users' physical and mental health. Improve the management regulations of the digital creativity-related industries, further relax market access conditions, simplify approval procedures, strengthen mid-term and post-event supervision, and promote integrated development.
titlelist: Promote the vigorous development of the digital creative industry, create leading new consumption, and promote the integrated development of related industries.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Significantly enhance the ability to access space. Breakthrough key technologies such as large thrust engines, large diameter rocket body design, manufacturing, and advanced control, and develop heavy-duty launch vehicles to ensure the implementation of future major space missions. Develop a fast, inexpensive, and reusable small payload transportation system for space travel. Advance the deployment of space vehicles with high spatial positioning accuracy and autonomous navigation and flight technologies. Accelerate the development of new spacecraft. Strengthen the research and development of key technologies such as ultra-high resolution, ultra-high precision space-time reference, ultra-high-speed secure communication, high-performance on-board processing, high-power power supply, and new materials, and develop new application satellites. Establish an advanced manned space science experiment platform and life support system. Develop lightweight and miniaturized technologies for space vehicles and promote the standardized and orderly development of micro, nano, and pico satellites. Deploy and launch new experimental satellites. Accelerate the development of new space vehicles for future missions, such as near-space vehicles and reusable spacecraft. Accelerate breakthroughs in key technologies and major product development in the aviation field. Advance research on key technologies for new engines such as hydrogen fuel, all-electric, and hybrid power, and enhance the independent development capability of the future aviation industry. Accelerate the development of strategic aviation equipment such as multi-purpose drones and new configuration aircraft. Proactively plan for supersonic business jets, new concept and configuration overall aerodynamic technologies, advanced high-reliability electromechanical technologies, new generation aviation electronic systems, aviation new materials, and new composite material processing technologies. Develop new generation deep-sea, remote sea, and polar technical equipment and systems. Establish deep-sea regional research bases, develop key technologies and equipment such as marine remote sensing and navigation, underwater acoustics detection, deep-sea sensors, unmanned and manned deep diving, deep-sea space stations, deep-sea observation systems, integrated communication and positioning for air-sea-bed, and new marine observation satellites. Vigorously develop equipment and systems for the exploration and utilization of deep-sea and offshore oil and gas mineral resources, renewable energy, and biological resources, research and develop large-scale floating structures at sea, support the research and development and industrial application of key technologies for the utilization of marine resources, and cultivate new growth points in the marine economy. Vigorously develop equipment and systems for the exploration and utilization of polar resources, and develop equipment such as polar robots and nuclear-powered icebreakers.
titlelist: Advance layout strategic industries, cultivate new advantages for future development, in the aerospace and marine sectors.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)

content: Build a new network system for the future. Focus on improving the scalability, security, manageability, mobility, and content delivery capabilities of the current network architecture. Conduct research on new network architectures, technical systems, and security systems, and carry out experimental network construction. Research and build a new type of network that integrates ubiquity, green bandwidth, and intelligent security. Strengthen the research and development of key technologies and products. Develop technologies and products such as Internet of Things search engines, E-level high-performance computing, and edge computing for the Internet of Things. Conduct research and development in cutting-edge technologies such as deep learning, cognitive computing, virtual reality, and natural human-computer interaction to enhance the intelligence and personalization of information services. Lay out the research and development of technologies such as terahertz communication and visible light communication, and continue to promote the application of quantum key technologies. Promote revolutionary upgrades and replacements of electronic devices. Strengthen the research and development of cutting-edge technologies and devices in areas such as low-power, high-performance new principle silicon-based devices, silicon-based optoelectronics, hybrid optoelectronics, and microwave optoelectronics. Form a batch of specialized key manufacturing equipment to enhance the support capability of optical network communication components. Coordinate the layout of key technologies for quantum chips, quantum programming, quantum software, as well as the preparation of related materials and devices, and promote the physical implementation of quantum computers and the application of quantum simulation. Strengthen the research and development of new principle components such as brain-like chips, superconducting chips, graphene storage, non-volatile storage, and memristors, and promote the development and application of microelectronics technology in the post-Moore's Law era, achieving leapfrog development in the industry.
titlelist: Advance layout strategic industries, cultivate new advantages for future development, in the field of information networks.

Accelerate the research and development of somatic cell reprogramming science and technology, and develop new technologies for obtaining functional cells. Improve the in vitro and in vivo production technology platforms and bases for cells, tissues, and organs. Standardize the laws, regulations, and standards system in the field of stem cells and regeneration, improve the evaluation and transformation mechanism of intellectual property rights, and continuously deepen the clinical application of stem cells and regenerative technology. Develop tumor immunotherapy techniques. Promote the research and application of gene editing technology. Establish a gene editing technology system with independent intellectual property rights, and develop new gene therapy technologies for major genetic diseases, infectious diseases, malignant tumors, etc. Establish related animal resource platforms, clinical research, and translational application bases to promote the clinical transformation and industrial development based on gene editing research. Strengthen the research and application of synthetic biology technology. Breakthrough key technologies such as genome chemical synthesis, biological system design and reconstruction, and artificial biological regulation, and research and promote the clinical application and industrialization of artificial biology and artificial biological devices. Promote disruptive technological innovations in areas such as biotechnology, ecological conservation, and energy production, build new models for basic raw material supply, material transformation synthesis, and livelihood services, and cultivate the synthetic biology industry chain.
titlelist: Advance layout strategic industries, cultivate new advantages for future development, in the field of biotechnology.

Develop non-power nuclear technologies. Support the development of new types of radiation sources such as ions and neutrons, research and develop high-resolution radiation detectors and multidimensional dynamic imaging devices, develop precision treatment equipment, medical radioactive isotopes, neutron radiography, radiation modification, and other new technologies and products, and continue to promote the application of nuclear technology in industries, agriculture, healthcare, environmental protection, resource exploration, public safety, and other fields.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)

content: Deepen the mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Build platforms for mass entrepreneurship, crowdsourcing, crowd support, and crowdfunding, relying on the resources of double innovation gathered in regions, research institutes, and innovative enterprises. Support the construction of double innovation demonstration bases and the development of specialized mass entrepreneurship spaces. Utilize the internet to create open and shared innovation mechanisms and platforms, promoting collaborative innovation among enterprises, research institutions, universities, and makers. Focus on improving the legal and policy system to promote double innovation. Continuously strengthen the promotion of double innovation, organize the National Double Innovation Week, and create a favorable atmosphere for society to pay attention to, understand, and support double innovation. Strengthen the construction of the public innovation system. Implement major scientific and technological projects and major engineering projects, strengthen disruptive technology research and development, and industrialization. Innovate the implementation methods of major projects and explore the organizational management mechanism that separates project decision-making, execution, evaluation, and supervision. Build industry-technology innovation alliances led by enterprises and combining government, industry, academia, and research, support the construction of key technology research and development platforms, and establish a number of industrial innovation centers in key industries through new mechanisms. Coordinate and deploy the construction of national major scientific and technological infrastructure and other innovation platforms based on the needs of innovation development in key areas, and strengthen the openness and sharing of facilities and platforms. Optimize the layout of scientific research bases and build a number of national technology innovation centers to support and lead the development of strategic emerging industries. Strengthen the construction of public service platforms such as relevant metrology testing, inspection and testing, certification and accreditation, knowledge and data centers. Establish a strategic emerging industry metrology and technological innovation alliance and strengthen certification and accreditation innovation. Implement and improve the standardization development plan for strategic emerging industries, improve the standard system, and support the application of new technology standards in key areas. Support the building of innovation capabilities in enterprises. Implement national technology innovation projects, strengthen the construction of enterprise technology centers, promote the Top 100 Innovative Enterprises project, cultivate a group of innovative leading enterprises with international influence, and lead and promote the improvement of innovation capabilities in upstream and downstream industries. Increase support for innovation in science and technology-oriented small and medium-sized enterprises, implement tax preferential policies such as the deduction of research and development expenses, and guide enterprises to increase research and development investment. Improve the system of technology transfer and transformation. Implement relevant laws, regulations, and policies, and organize actions to promote the transfer and transformation of scientific and technological achievements. Implement reform measures related to the transfer and transformation of scientific and technological achievements, increase the proportion of income sharing for scientific researchers in the transformation of achievements, and accelerate the establishment of performance evaluation and annual reporting systems for the transfer and transformation of scientific and technological achievements. Guide eligible universities and research institutes to establish specialized and market-oriented technology transfer organizations, strengthen the release of scientific and technological achievements in strategic emerging industries, and explore the establishment of a time-limited transformation system for scientific and technological achievements using fiscal funds in related fields of strategic emerging industries.
titlelist: Improve the system, mechanisms, and policy framework, create a new development ecosystem, and build an industrial innovation system.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen the protection and rights enforcement of intellectual property. Actively promote the revision of patent law and copyright law. Track the development of new technologies, new formats, and new models to enhance research on intellectual property protection rules in areas such as the internet, e-commerce, and big data. Improve relevant laws and regulations on the protection of intellectual property in business models, trade secrets, and utility model design patents. Enhance the mechanism for rapid protection of intellectual property rights and establish a number of rapid rights protection centers. Include intentional infringement of intellectual property rights in social credit records, improve the administrative enforcement mechanism for intellectual property rights infringement, strictly crack down on intellectual property rights crimes in accordance with the law, strengthen customs enforcement of intellectual property rights, and promote an increase in the statutory compensation limit for intellectual property rights infringement. Strengthen the layout and application of intellectual property rights. Vigorously promote the standardization management of intellectual property rights and enhance the management capabilities of innovation entities in intellectual property rights. Implement projects for the layout of intellectual property rights industries and regions, and establish intellectual property rights layout design centers in strategic emerging industry clusters and leading enterprises. Build an intellectual property rights operation service system, promote the construction of a national public service platform for intellectual property rights operation, cultivate a number of specialized and branded intellectual property rights service agencies, encourage the development and application of high-end retrieval and analysis tools, and guide the construction of intellectual property rights alliances. Focus on strategic emerging industries, encourage innovative intellectual property rights financial products, develop new products such as intellectual property rights investment, loans, insurance, and bonds, and explore the securitization of intellectual property rights. Encourage enterprises to comprehensively use patents, copyrights, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights to build their own brands. Improve the development mechanism of intellectual property rights. Implement the strategic emerging industry intellectual property rights strategic promotion plan, deploy the intellectual property rights service chain around strategic emerging industry clusters, establish a management system for intellectual property rights clusters, and promote the formation of a number of intellectual property rights advantage clusters. Strengthen patent analysis and trend monitoring in strategic emerging industries. Establish a system for analyzing and evaluating intellectual property rights in major economic and technological activities, and encourage enterprises to establish mechanisms for analyzing and evaluating intellectual property rights. Improve the overseas intellectual property rights service system, research and release overseas intellectual property rights environment information, track and research international intellectual property rights trends in key industrial sectors, guide the establishment of a mechanism for submitting overseas intellectual property rights case information, strengthen research on major intellectual property rights cases, establish an overseas intellectual property rights risk warning mechanism, and support enterprises in conducting overseas mergers and acquisitions and rights protection actions related to intellectual property rights.
titlelist: Improve the system, mechanisms, and policy framework, create a new development ecosystem, and strengthen the protection and utilization of intellectual property rights.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)

content: Increase the proportion of direct financing for enterprises. Actively support eligible strategic emerging industry enterprises to go public or list for financing, study and introduce a pilot program for companies listed on the National Equities Exchange and Quotations System to transfer to the Growth Enterprise Market, and establish a cooperation mechanism between the National Equities Exchange and Quotations System and regional equity markets. Explore and promote the development of over-the-counter securities trading markets and inter-institutional private placement quotation and service systems, and support the development of strategic emerging industry start-ups. Vigorously develop venture capital and angel investment, improve tax support policies for venture capital enterprises and angel investors investing in seed-stage and early-stage technology-based enterprises, and enrich merger and acquisition financing and venture capital investment methods. Actively support eligible strategic emerging industry enterprises to issue bonds for financing, expand the scale of credit-enhanced collective bonds for small and micro enterprises and collective notes for small and medium-sized enterprises, encourage the exploration and development of high-yield bonds and convertible bonds, and steadily promote the development of non-financial corporate debt financing instruments. Encourage insurance companies, social insurance funds, and other institutional investors to participate in strategic emerging industry venture capital and equity investment funds in a legal and compliant manner. Promote pilot projects for the integration of investment and financing. Strengthen financial product and service innovation. Guide financial institutions to actively improve credit management and loan review systems that adapt to the characteristics of strategic emerging industries. Explore the establishment of an information service platform for investment and financing in strategic emerging industries to promote the integration of banks and enterprises. Encourage the establishment of systems for the identification, evaluation, pledge, and transfer of intangible assets in the fields of digital creativity, software, etc., and actively promote financial product innovation such as intellectual property pledge financing, equity pledge financing, supply chain financing, and technology insurance. Guide policy-oriented and development-oriented financial institutions to increase support for strategic emerging industries. Promote the development of financing leasing and financial leasing companies that serve industries such as aircraft, marine engineering equipment, and robots. Accelerate the establishment of a national financing guarantee fund to support financing guarantee work for strategic emerging industry projects. Innovate support methods for fiscal and tax policies. Play the guiding role of fiscal funds, innovate ways to attract social investment, and strongly support the development of strategic emerging industries. Give full play to the role of the National Emerging Industry Venture Capital Guidance Fund in serving entrepreneurship and innovation, improve management rules, do a good job in risk prevention and control, carry out investment operations efficiently, and drive social capital to establish a number of venture capital funds, increasing investment in strategic emerging industries. Encourage regions with conditions to establish development funds for strategic emerging industries, and guide social capital to establish a number of investment funds for strategic emerging industries and international investment funds. Actively use government and social capital cooperation (PPP) models to guide social capital participation in major project construction. Improve government procurement policies, increase support for double innovation as well as cloud computing, big data, circular economy, and promote demonstration applications such as smart cities, information accessibility, urban mines, and intelligent equipment. Further improve subsidies for renewable energy generation such as photovoltaics, wind power, and biomass. Adjust and improve policies for promoting the use of new energy vehicles. content: Establish a sound legal environment for protecting innovation, accelerate the legislative process in weak areas and sectors, amend regulations and documents that are not in line with the orientation of innovation, abolish institutional provisions that restrict innovation, and build a comprehensive and supportive legal guarantee system. Study and draft regulations for standardizing and managing government research institutions, non-enterprise units in the field of science and technology, etc., and reasonably adjust and regulate the rights and obligations of various entities in the field of scientific and technological innovation. Promote legislation on the sharing of scientific and technological resources, study and draft regulations on the protection and sharing of scientific data, and strengthen the obligation of open sharing of scientific and technological resources formed by financial support. Study and formulate regulations and systems for standardizing and managing scientific research activities, improve the norms for the participation of scientific communities, enterprises, and the general public in the management of scientific and technological innovation.
