category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote maker culture in schools, establish innovative entrepreneurship courses, organize branded maker activities, encourage students to be hands-on, practice, and start businesses. Support employees of enterprises to participate in process improvement and product design, encourage all beneficial micro-innovations, micro-entrepreneurship, small inventions, and small improvements, and transform creative ideas and innovative concepts into tangible entrepreneurial activities.
titlelist: The strategic tasks are closely focused on the core key of enhancing economic competitiveness, the urgent needs of social development, and the major challenges of national security. Differentiated strategies and asymmetric paths are adopted to strengthen the task deployment in key areas and key links. This will promote innovation and entrepreneurship, stimulate the construction of a creative and entrepreneurial society, improve innovation and entrepreneurship carriers, develop a maker economy, and create a vibrant situation of mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Everyone is encouraged to innovate.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ May 20, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Establish a sound legal environment for protecting innovation. Accelerate the legislative process in weak areas and sectors of innovation, amend regulations and documents that are not in line with the direction of innovation, abolish institutional provisions that restrict innovation, and build a comprehensive and refined legal guarantee system. Cultivate an open and fair market environment. Accelerate the breakthrough of industry monopolies and market segmentation. Strengthen the guiding role of demand-side innovation policies, establish a government procurement system that complies with international rules, utilize policy measures such as first-order subscription, inclusive finance and taxation, and insurance to reduce enterprise innovation costs and expand the market space for innovative products and services. Promote the market-oriented reform of the mechanism for determining factor prices, strengthen rigid constraints in energy resources, ecological environment, and other aspects, increase the weight of innovation factors such as technology and talent in product prices, and enable innovators to gain greater competitive advantages. Create a culture that advocates innovation. Promote the inspiring stories and noble spirit of patriotism and dedication among science and technology workers, and foster a culture of encouraging creativity and pursuing excellence throughout society, promoting innovation as an important content of national spirit. Advocate academic culture that encourages diverse opinions and respects the individuality of scientists, enhance the confidence in innovation to take the lead, dare to question boldly. Emphasize the value of trial and error in scientific research, establish a fault-tolerant and error-correcting mechanism that encourages innovation and tolerates failure. Create a relaxed atmosphere for scientific research and guarantee the academic freedom of scientific and technological personnel. Strengthen the construction of scientific research integrity, guide science and technology workers to abide by academic ethics and fulfill social responsibilities. Strengthen scientific education, enrich the content and forms of science education and teaching, and stimulate the interest of young people in science and technology. Enhance the popularization of science and technology, improve the scientific literacy of the whole population, and shape a spirit of scientific rationality throughout society.
titlelist: Strategic security, cultivating a friendly social environment for innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: By 2025, the circular production mode will be fully implemented, green design and clean production will be widely promoted, the ability of comprehensive resource utilization will be significantly improved, and the resource recycling industrial system will be basically established. The recycling network for waste materials will be further improved, the capacity for recycling renewable resources will be further enhanced, and a resource recycling system covering the whole society will be basically established. The efficiency of resource utilization will be greatly improved, the proportion of renewable resources replacing primary resources will be further increased, and the supporting role of the circular economy in resource security will be further highlighted. By 2025, the main resource output rate will increase by about 20% compared to 2020, the energy consumption per unit of GDP and water consumption will decrease by about 13.5% and 16% respectively compared to 2020. The comprehensive utilization rate of crop straw will be maintained at over 86%, the comprehensive utilization rate of bulk solid waste will reach 60%, the comprehensive utilization rate of construction waste will reach 60%, the utilization of waste paper will reach 60 million tons, the utilization of waste steel will reach 320 million tons, and the production of recycled non-ferrous metals will reach 20 million tons, including 4 million tons of recycled copper, 11.5 million tons of recycled aluminum, and 2.9 million tons of recycled lead. The output value of the resource recycling industry will reach 5 trillion yuan.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Establish sound policies and mechanisms for green product design, guiding enterprises to use environmentally friendly materials in the production process, such as non-toxic, harmless, low-toxicity, low (or zero) volatile organic compounds (VOCs) content. Promote product design schemes that are easy to disassemble, classify, and recycle, and increase the proportion of recycled materials. Promote the reduction of packaging and packaging printing. Accelerate the improvement of technical specifications for green design evaluation of key products, encourage industry associations to publish green design guidelines, and promote green design cases.
titlelist: Key tasks: building a resource recycling industrial system, improving resource utilization efficiency, promoting green design of key products.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Implement mandatory clean production audits in the double super and double high energy-consuming industries in accordance with the law, and guide other industries to voluntarily conduct audits. Further regulate the behavior of clean production audits and improve the quality of clean production audits. Promote the formulation of clean production transformation and improvement plans for key industries such as petrochemical, chemical, coking, cement, non-ferrous, electroplating, printing and dyeing, packaging and printing, etc. Accelerate clean production technology innovation, achievement transformation, and standard system construction. Establish and improve differentiated reward and punishment mechanisms, and explore pilot demonstration work for regional, industrial parks, and industry-wide clean production audits.
titlelist: Key tasks: building a resource recycling industrial system, improving resource utilization efficiency, and strengthening clean production in key industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote circular production and industrial integration, promote comprehensive utilization of waste, cascade utilization of energy, and recycling of water resources, promote the resource utilization of industrial excess pressure, waste water, waste gas, and waste liquid, achieve green, low-carbon, and circular development, and actively promote centralized gas and heat supply. Encourage the park to promote the construction of green factories, achieve intensive factory buildings, harmless raw materials, clean production, waste resource utilization, low-carbon energy, and green building materials. Develop guidelines for the circular development of the park, promote typical models of circular economy development in key industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, metallurgy, petrochemicals, equipment manufacturing, and light industry. Encourage the creation of national ecological industrial demonstration parks.
titlelist: Key tasks: building a resource recycling industrial system, improving resource utilization efficiency, promoting the circular development of industrial parks.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen the comprehensive utilization of low-grade ore, associated ore, difficult-to-select and smelt ore, tailings, etc., and promote the efficient extraction and utilization of valuable components. Further expand the comprehensive utilization channels of bulk solid waste such as fly ash, coal gangue, metallurgical slag, industrial by-product gypsum, and construction waste, and increase the scale of utilization in ecological restoration, green mining, green building materials, transportation engineering, and other fields. Strengthen the research and development of large-scale utilization technologies for complex and difficult-to-use industrial solid waste such as red mud, phosphogypsum, electrolytic manganese slag, and steel slag. Promote the use of mine water for replenishing water sources in mining areas and for production and ecological water use in surrounding areas. Strengthen the comprehensive utilization of dredged soil and sand in waterways.
titlelist: Key tasks: building a resource recycling industrial system, improving resource utilization efficiency, strengthening comprehensive resource utilization.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Improve policy mechanisms and standard specifications, promote the coordinated disposal of facilities in accordance with the management of urban environmental infrastructure, and ensure the continuous and stable operation of facilities. Determine the payment standards for the coordinated disposal of urban solid waste through market-oriented approaches, and orderly promote the coordinated disposal of medical waste, hazardous waste, and household waste in cement kilns and smelting furnaces. Coordinate the emergency disposal of medical waste in incinerators for household waste. Promote the coordinated disposal of low-value organic waste such as kitchen waste, garden waste, and sewage sludge.
titlelist: Key tasks: Building a resource recycling industrial system, improving resource utilization efficiency, and promoting coordinated disposal of urban waste.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Include the facilities related to the recycling of waste materials in the overall land use planning, ensuring land requirements, and reasonably layout and construct a recycling network system. Coordinate the integration of waste material recycling points and household waste classification points to achieve the integration of the two networks. Relax restrictions on the entry of waste material recycling vehicles into cities and residential areas, and regulate their management to ensure reasonable road rights. Actively promote the Internet + Recycling model to achieve online and offline collaboration, improve the integration capacity of standardized recycling companies with individual operators, and further improve the convenience of residents' disposal of waste materials. Standardize the operation order of the waste material recycling industry and improve the overall image and management level of the industry. Adapt to local conditions and improve the rural recycling network, promote the integrated development of urban and rural waste material recycling and disposal systems. Support the sales and service network of supply and marketing cooperatives to carry out waste material recycling.
titlelist: Key tasks: Construct a system for the recycling of waste materials, build a resource recycling society, and improve the network for the collection of waste materials.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the large-scale, standardized, and clean utilization of renewable resources, and promote the development of the renewable resource industry cluster to build a modern urban mineral base at a high level. Implement standardized management of the recycling and utilization industry of waste steel, waste non-ferrous metals, waste plastics, waste paper, waste tires, waste mobile phones, waste power batteries, and other renewable resources, improve the level of industry standardization, and promote the aggregation of resources to advantageous enterprises. Strengthen the standardized management and environmental supervision of enterprises engaged in the dismantling and utilization of waste electrical and electronic products, scrapped motor vehicles, scrapped ships, waste lead-acid batteries, etc., increase efforts to rectify illegal and irregular enterprises, and create a fair market competition environment. Accelerate the establishment of a system for promoting the use of recycled raw materials, expand the application channels of recycled raw materials in the market, and strengthen the ability of renewable resources to guarantee the supply of strategic mineral resources.
titlelist: Key tasks, building a system for the recycling of waste materials, constructing a resource recycling society, and improving the level of processing and utilization of recycled resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the level of remanufacturing in automobile parts, engineering machinery, machine tools, office equipment, and other industries. Drive the development of the remanufacturing industry in emerging fields such as shield tunneling machines, aerospace engines, and industrial robots. Promote the application of non-destructive testing, additive manufacturing, flexible processing, and other common key technologies in remanufacturing. Cultivate specialized enterprises for the recycling of remanufactured old parts. Support the construction of a trading platform for remanufactured products. Encourage enterprises to use remanufactured products in their after-sales service systems and fulfill their disclosure obligations. Promote the integration of remanufacturing technology and equipment digitization, providing customized remanufacturing services for large-scale electromechanical equipment. Under the premise of information sharing and risk control by regulatory authorities, support the exploration of bonded maintenance and remanufacturing re-export business in free trade zones for aviation, CNC machine tools, communication equipment, and other industries. Strengthen the evaluation and promotion of remanufactured products.
titlelist: Key tasks: Build a system for the recycling of waste materials, construct a resource recycling society, and promote the high-quality development of the remanufacturing industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the efficient utilization of agricultural and forestry waste such as crop straw, livestock and poultry manure, forestry waste, and by-products of agricultural product processing. Strengthen the comprehensive utilization of agricultural and crop straw, prioritize agricultural use, increase the efforts of returning straw to the fields, and enhance the function of soil conservation. Encourage the industrial utilization of straw outside the fields, develop new materials and products, and increase the added value of straw as feed, fuel, and raw materials. Strengthen the construction of facilities for the treatment of livestock and poultry manure, encourage the integration of planting and breeding, and promote the on-site and nearby utilization of organic fertilizers in agriculture. Encourage the use of small-sized fuelwood and the three leftovers of forestry (residuals from logging, wood processing, and manufacturing) for the production of composite panels, cultivation of edible fungi, and energy utilization, and promote the resource utilization of by-products from agricultural product processing.
titlelist: Key tasks: Deepen the development of circular economy in agriculture, establish a circular agricultural production mode, and strengthen the utilization of agricultural and forestry waste resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Guide large-scale planters, farmer cooperatives, family farms, agricultural material enterprises, and waste material recycling enterprises to actively participate in recycling. Support the construction of recycling facilities in rural towns, and improve the recycling system for waste agricultural materials such as agricultural film, fertilizer and pesticide packaging, irrigation equipment, agricultural machinery, and fishing nets. Construct regional centralized disposal and utilization facilities for waste agricultural materials, and improve the level of large-scale and resource utilization.
titlelist: Key tasks: Deepen the development of circular economy in agriculture, establish a circular agricultural production mode, and strengthen the recycling and utilization of waste agricultural materials.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Promote the integration of planting and breeding, agriculture and animal husbandry, and the construction of breeding farms with organic agricultural field construction, and promote the coordinated development model of livestock, poultry, fish, grain, vegetables, fruits, and tea. Build a number of ecological farms and ecological circular agricultural industry clusters, and explore sustainable operation mechanisms. Promote the development and utilization of biomass energy in rural areas, and give full play to the comprehensive benefits of clean energy supply and rural ecological environment governance. Construct a forestry circular economy industrial chain and promote the three-dimensional development model of industry on, between, and under the forest. Promote the circular linkage of planting, breeding, agricultural product processing, biomass energy, and tourism and health care, and encourage the integrated development of primary, secondary, and tertiary industries.
titlelist: Key tasks, deepen the development of circular economy in agriculture, establish a circular agricultural production mode, and promote the development of circular agriculture.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Develop a list of circular development parks in various regions, and formulate circular transformation plans for each park based on the principle of one park, one strategy. Organize park enterprises to implement clean production transformation. Actively utilize waste heat and pressure resources, promote the application of combined heat and power, distributed energy, and integrated photovoltaic energy storage systems, and promote the cascade utilization of energy. Construct centralized collection, treatment, and reuse facilities for park sewage, strengthen sewage treatment and recycling. Strengthen the circular linkage of park industries and promote the comprehensive utilization of waste resources by enterprises. Build a public information service platform for the park and strengthen the management of material flows. All provincial-level and above parks that meet the conditions should complete circular transformation by the end of 2025.
titlelist: Key projects and actions, park circular development project.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on key varieties such as fly ash, coal gangue, metallurgical slag, industrial by-product gypsum, tailings, associated minerals, agricultural crop straw, and forestry residues. Promote advanced technologies and equipment for the comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste, implement key projects with demonstrative effects, vigorously promote the use of products from comprehensive resource utilization, and establish 50 bulk solid waste comprehensive utilization bases and 50 industrial resource comprehensive utilization bases.
titlelist: Key Projects and Actions, Demonstration Project for Comprehensive Utilization of Bulk Solid Waste

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Construct 50 demonstration cities for the utilization of construction waste resources. Promote the reduction of construction waste at the source, establish a management system for the classification of construction waste, and standardize the construction, operation, and management of sites for the disposal, transfer, and utilization of construction waste. Improve policies for the recycling and utilization of construction waste and the certification standards for recycled products, promote the utilization of construction waste such as construction soil, construction slurry, demolition waste, engineering waste, and renovation waste, and increase the market scale of recycled products. Cultivate leading enterprises in the construction waste resource utilization industry, accelerate the development, application, and integration of new technologies, processes, and equipment for the utilization of construction waste resources.
titlelist: Key Projects and Actions, Demonstration Project for the Utilization of Construction Waste Resources

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Deeply implement the key special project of circular economy technology and equipment. Focus on areas such as eco-design of typical products, clean production in key industries, comprehensive utilization of bulk solid waste, high-quality recycling of renewable resources, and remanufacturing of high-end equipment. Breakthrough a batch of green and circular key common technologies and major equipment. In regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta, carry out integrated demonstration of green technology system for circular economy, and promote the formation of an integrated model for the transformation of scientific and technological achievements among government, industry, academia, research, and application.
titlelist: Key Projects and Actions, Circular Economy Key Technology and Equipment Innovation Project

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: By combining industrial intelligent transformation and digitalization, we will vigorously promote the remanufacturing of industrial equipment and expand the application scope of remanufactured machine tools, industrial motors, and industrial robots. We will support enterprises in the fields of tunnel excavation, coal mining, and oil extraction to widely use remanufactured products and services. We will promote the use of remanufactured automotive parts and remanufactured office equipment in the fields of after-sales maintenance, insurance, trade, logistics, and leasing, further increasing the proportion of remanufactured products in the after-sales market. We will expand the scale of the remanufacturing industry, guide the formation of around 10 remanufacturing industry clusters, cultivate a group of leading remanufacturing enterprises, and achieve an industrial output value of 200 billion yuan in the remanufacturing industry.
titlelist: Key Projects and Actions, Action Plan for High-Quality Development of the Remanufacturing Industry

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Utilizing internet information technology, encouraging diverse participation, and constructing an integrated online and offline network for the recycling of discarded electrical and electronic products, continuing to carry out pilot projects for the extension of producer responsibility for electrical and electronic products. Supporting electrical and electronic product manufacturers in establishing recycling systems through independent, collaborative, or delegated recycling methods, guiding and regulating the sharing of information between production enterprises, recycling enterprises, and e-commerce platforms. Guiding the flow of discarded electrical and electronic products into standardized dismantling enterprises. Ensuring the security of personal privacy information throughout the entire process of recycling and utilizing electronic products such as mobile phones and computers. Strengthening technological innovation, encouraging the promotion and application of new technologies, new processes, and new equipment, supporting the improvement and transformation of process equipment in standardized dismantling enterprises, promoting intelligent and refined dismantling, and promoting high-value utilization.
titlelist: Key Projects and Actions, Improvement Action for the Recycling and Utilization of Waste Electrical and Electronic Products

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Research and develop a comprehensive lifecycle management plan for automobile use, and establish an information exchange system covering automobile production enterprises, dealers, maintenance enterprises, and recycling and dismantling enterprises. Strengthen the interconnection and sharing of information on automobile production, import, sales, registration, maintenance, used car transactions, scrapping, and the flow of key components. Establish a system for identifying certified parts, remanufactured parts, and reused exterior parts, as well as an information query system. Carry out pilot projects to extend the responsibility of automobile producers. Select certain regions to pilot comprehensive lifecycle management of automobile use, and promote it nationwide when conditions are ripe.
titlelist: Key projects and actions, promoting the implementation of full lifecycle management for automobile use.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen the green governance of express packaging, promote cooperation between e-commerce and manufacturers, and achieve direct delivery of original packaging for key categories of parcels. Encourage packaging production, e-commerce, express delivery, and other upstream and downstream enterprises to establish industrial alliances, support the establishment of a qualified supplier system for express packaging products, and promote production enterprises to consciously reduce packaging. Implement a green product certification system for express packaging. Carry out pilot projects for the large-scale application of recyclable express packaging, significantly increase the proportion of reusable transit bags (boxes). Increase the promotion and application of standardized reusable turnover boxes for green and circular sharing. Encourage e-commerce and express delivery companies to cooperate with commercial institutions, convenience stores, property service companies, etc., to establish agreement-based recycling points for recyclable express packaging and set up specialized recycling facilities for recyclable express packaging. By 2025, e-commerce parcels will basically no longer require secondary packaging, and the scale of application for recyclable express packaging will reach 10 million.
titlelist: Key projects and actions, promoting the green transformation of express packaging.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Strengthen the construction of the new energy vehicle power battery traceability management platform, improve the traceability management system for the recycling and utilization of new energy vehicle power batteries. Promote new energy vehicle manufacturers and used power battery recycling companies to establish standardized recycling service outlets through self-construction, joint construction, authorization, and other methods. Promote the standardized and hierarchical utilization of power batteries, improve the technical level of residual energy detection, residual value assessment, recombination utilization, and safety management. Strengthen the promotion and application of advanced equipment for the recycling and hierarchical utilization of used power batteries. Improve the standard system for the recycling and utilization of power batteries. Cultivate backbone enterprises for the comprehensive utilization of used power batteries and promote the development of the recycling industry for used power batteries.
titlelist: Key projects and actions, action for the recycling of used power batteries.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Circular Economy (NDRC/July 1, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Coordinate existing funding channels, strengthen support for major projects, key projects, and capacity building in the circular economy. Increase government's efforts in green procurement, actively purchasing products made from recycled resources. Implement tax incentives for comprehensive utilization of resources, expand the scope of preferential income tax policies for enterprises in environmental protection, energy conservation, and water conservation. Encourage financial institutions to increase investment and financing in major projects in the circular economy. Enhance innovation in green financial products, and increase support for enterprises and projects related to the circular economy through green credit, green bonds, green funds, and green insurance.
titlelist: Policy protection, strengthening financial and taxation policy support.

name: Guiding Opinions on Expanding Investment and Cultivating and Strengthening New Growth Points and Growth Poles in Strategic Emerging Industries (NDRC, MOST, MIIT, MOF/September 8, 2020)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Increase investment in 5G construction, accelerate the pace of commercial development of 5G, prioritize the opening of base station construction to government agencies at all levels, enterprises and institutions, and public institutions, and study and promote the inclusion of 5G base stations in commercial buildings and residential construction standards. Accelerate the core technology research and development of basic materials, key chips, high-end components, new display devices, key software, etc., vigorously promote key projects and major construction projects, and actively expand reasonable and effective investment. Steadily promote the integration and innovation of industrial Internet, artificial intelligence, Internet of Things, connected vehicles, big data, cloud computing, blockchain, and other technologies. Accelerate the construction of new urban infrastructure based on informatization, digitization, and intelligence. Focus on emerging directions with great growth potential such as smart broadcasting, media integration, 5G broadcasting, smart water conservancy, smart ports, smart logistics, smart municipal administration, smart communities, smart home services, smart tourism, online consumption, online education, and medical health. Implement special actions to empower digitalization of small and medium-sized enterprises, promote the cloud and data intelligence of small and micro enterprises, and cultivate a number of pillar industries. Implement the strategy of digital rural development, accelerate the improvement of rural Internet infrastructure shortcomings, strengthen the construction of digital rural industrial systems, encourage the development of information products and applications that meet the production and living needs of farmers, and develop new formats and models of rural Internet. Implement the Internet+ project for the sale of agricultural products from villages to cities, promote the construction of agricultural and rural big data centers and the entire industry chain big data of important agricultural products, and accelerate the digital transformation of the entire agricultural industry chain. (Responsibility departments: National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Water Resources, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, State Administration of Radio and Television, China Railway Group, etc., responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Focus on key industries and accelerate the improvement and efficiency of the new generation information technology industry.

name: Guiding Opinions on Expanding Investment and Cultivating and Strengthening New Growth Points and Growth Poles in Strategic Emerging Industries (NDRC, MOST, MIIT, MOF/September 8, 2020)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Accelerate the implementation of major projects and initiatives in the fields of innovative vaccines, in vitro diagnostics and test reagents, and antibody drugs, and encourage the upgrading and replacement of vaccine varieties and processes. Systematically plan the construction of a national biosafety risk prevention and control system, increase investment in biosafety and emergency response, strengthen the construction of national innovation platforms for the inspection and certification of biological products, support the construction of genetic cell and genetic breeding technology research centers, synthetic biology technology innovation centers, and biopharmaceutical technology innovation centers, and promote the healthy development of biotechnology. Reform and improve the evaluation and approval mechanism for traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the research and development and industrial development of new traditional Chinese medicines. Implement biotechnology projects to benefit the people and create a market for independently innovative drugs, medical equipment, and other products. (Responsible departments: National Development and Reform Commission, National Health Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, State Drug Administration, etc., according to their respective responsibilities).
titlelist: Focus on key industries and accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry.

name: Guiding Opinions on Expanding Investment and Cultivating and Strengthening New Growth Points and Growth Poles in Strategic Emerging Industries (NDRC, MOST, MIIT, MOF/September 8, 2020)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Key support will be provided for the production of high-end equipment, including industrial robots, construction, medical and other special-purpose robots, high-end instruments and meters, rail transportation equipment, high-grade five-axis CNC machine tools, energy-saving asynchronous traction motors, high-end medical equipment and pharmaceutical equipment, aerospace equipment, marine engineering equipment, and high-tech ships. Pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing and intelligent construction will be implemented. Research and development and promotion of urban municipal infrastructure operation and maintenance, agricultural production special sensors, intelligent equipment, automation systems, and management platforms will be carried out. A number of innovation centers, demonstration bases, and pilot counties will be established. Leading enterprises will be encouraged to build Internet+ collaborative manufacturing demonstration factories and establish high-standard industrial Internet platforms. (Responsible departments: National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, China Railway Group, etc., according to their respective responsibilities).
titlelist: Focus on key industries and accelerate the development of high-end equipment manufacturing to fill the gaps.

name: Guiding Opinions on Expanding Investment and Cultivating and Strengthening New Growth Points and Growth Poles in Strategic Emerging Industries (NDRC, MOST, MIIT, MOF/September 8, 2020)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on ensuring the stability of the industrial chain and supply chain in key areas such as large aircraft, microelectronics manufacturing, and deep-sea mining, and accelerate breakthroughs in areas such as photoresist, high-purity target materials, high-temperature alloys, high-performance fiber materials, high-strength and high-conductivity heat-resistant materials, corrosion-resistant materials, large-size silicon wafers, and electronic packaging materials. Implement the action plan for innovative development of new materials, improve the technological level of special resources such as rare earths, vanadium and titanium, tungsten and molybdenum, lithium, rubidium and cesium, graphite, in mining, smelting, and deep processing, and accelerate the application of graphene, nanomaterials, etc. in the fields of optoelectronics, aviation equipment, new energy, and biomedicine. (Responsible departments: National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, etc., according to their respective responsibilities).
titlelist: Focus on key industries and accelerate the development of strengths and weaknesses in the new materials industry.

content: Develop a digital transformation action plan for the manufacturing industry. Develop a roadmap for digital transformation in key industry sectors. Build an assessment and evaluation system for digital transformation in the manufacturing industry, and develop a series of implementation guidelines and tools to promote digital transformation in key industry sectors such as raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, green manufacturing, and safety production. Build a digital transformation capability system for manufacturing enterprises. Organize pilot demonstrations of the integration of next-generation information technology and the manufacturing industry, with a focus on enhancing new capabilities such as integrated management, data interoperability, software development, intelligent applications, and security protection, and guiding enterprises to develop new models such as digital management, platform-based design, intelligent manufacturing, networked collaboration, personalized customization, and extended services. Column 2: Key areas of digital transformation in focus. Focus on addressing pain points in key industries such as inefficient equipment maintenance, opaque production processes, fragmented downstream demand, and intensified environmental pressures in the steel industry. Use process optimization as a starting point to accelerate digital transformation in the direction of intelligent equipment maintenance, transparent production processes, coordinated supply chain, and clean environmental management. In the petrochemical industry, focus on pain points such as opaque equipment management, difficult knowledge transfer, low level of upstream and downstream collaboration in the industrial chain, and high pressure on safety production. Use intelligent equipment control as a starting point to carry out digital transformation in areas such as equipment health management, intelligent refining and production, supply chain collaboration, and safety monitoring. In the coal industry, focus on pain points such as environmental pollution, high production risks, and difficult equipment management. Use safety production as a starting point to promote digital transformation in the direction of intelligent, unmanned, and green production by focusing on production, management, logistics, and maintenance. In the aerospace industry, focus on pain points such as disparate data sources, poor model adaptability, weak management adjustment capabilities, and poor fault prediction capabilities. Use networked collaboration as a starting point to carry out digital transformation in areas such as integrating research and development resources, restructuring production paradigms, transforming management models, and improving maintenance efficiency. In the shipbuilding industry, focus on optimizing and improving the quality and efficiency of the entire chain from ship design, research and development, production, management to services. Use networked collaboration and extended services as starting points to carry out digital transformation in areas such as collaborative design, intelligent manufacturing, lean management, online financing, and product services. In the automotive industry, focus on pain points such as long design cycles, personalized downstream demand, and inefficient after-sales service. Use mass customization production as a starting point to accelerate digital transformation in the direction of collaborative research and development, flexible production, coordinated production and supply, and manufacturing services. In the construction machinery industry, focus on pain points such as low efficiency in resource allocation, difficulties in equipment maintenance, and incomplete financial ecosystem. Use equipment health management as a starting point to accelerate digital transformation in the direction of intelligent equipment maintenance, lean management, and manufacturing services. In the home appliance industry, focus on pain points such as low level of intelligent production, low efficiency of supply chain collaboration, and slowing industry revenue growth. Use personalized customization as a starting point to accelerate digital transformation in the direction of flexible production methods, platform-based management, and product service ecosystem. In the electronics industry, focus on pain points such as long production cycles for new products, insufficient equipment management accuracy, and labor-intensive processes. Use intelligent equipment as a starting point to carry out digital transformation in areas such as equipment health management, intelligent production, product quality testing, and supply chain collaboration.
titlelist: Key Projects, Manufacturing Industry Digital Transformation Action

content: Laying the technological foundation and advantageous direction for our country in the new round of international competition in information technology. Quantum communication research focuses on the key technologies and complete equipment for quantum communication in a multi-user network, taking the lead in breaking through quantum secure communication technology, constructing a long-distance fiber optic quantum communication network, conducting research on satellite-ground quantum communication systems, constructing a complete space-ground integrated wide-area quantum communication network system, and seamlessly connecting with classical communication networks. content: Support key little giant enterprises to promote the following work: First, increase innovation investment, accelerate the industrial application of technological achievements, promote the filling of short boards and strengthening of long boards in the ten major industrial sectors with clear strategies for the development of the four bases or manufacturing power. Second, collaborate with industry-leading enterprises and cooperate with the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain to support the supplementation, extension, and consolidation of the industrial chain, and enhance the stability and competitiveness of the industrial chain and supply chain. Third, promote digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation, migrate business systems to the cloud, and promote quality improvement and brand creation through industrial design. In addition, support enterprises to accelerate their listing process, strengthen international cooperation, and further enhance development potential and international competitiveness. Support public service demonstration platforms to provide technical innovation, listing guidance, transformation and application of innovative achievements, digitalization and intelligent transformation, intellectual property application, cloud computing, and industrial design services for national-level specialized and new little giant enterprises. Among them, point-to-point services should be provided for key little giant enterprises.
titlelist: Implementation content, support content

name: Notice on Supporting the High-Quality Development of Specialized, Refined, Unique, and New Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 23, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Finance organize compliance audits and provide audit opinions. Among them, for the key 'Little Giant' enterprises recommended by local governments, a unified standard that is quantifiable and assessable is used to determine the best ones. The provincial-level departments responsible for small and medium-sized enterprises, together with the financial departments, will modify and improve the implementation plan based on the compliance audit opinions. The improved 'Implementation Plan' (record version) will be submitted to the two departments according to the procedure, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, together with the Ministry of Finance, will approve it (including the list of key 'Little Giant' enterprises and the list of public service demonstration platforms).
titlelist: Organize and implement, review and approve the plan.

name: Notice on Supporting the High-Quality Development of Specialized, Refined, Unique, and New Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 23, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: The provincial-level departments responsible for small and medium-sized enterprises, together with the financial departments, will organize the preparation and submission of the Implementation Plan, implement the responsibility for declaration, verify the declaration materials, and keep them on file for future reference. They will also provide regular tracking guidance, on-site supervision, service satisfaction evaluation, and supervision and management. They will timely summarize experiences and practices, as well as identify difficulties and problems, and report relevant information to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with a copy to the Ministry of Finance. During the process of preparing the Implementation Plan, each province should strictly review and conduct initial verification, and keep relevant supporting materials on file. They should also provide policy interpretation and explanation. No institution or unit shall make participation in fee-based training or interpretation classes a prerequisite for enterprise declaration.
titlelist: Other requirements, strengthen organizational coordination.

name: Notice on Supporting the High-Quality Development of Specialized, Refined, Unique, and New Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 23, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: The management of incentive funds is subject to the Measures for the Administration of Special Funds for the Development of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises. Provincial financial departments and small and medium-sized enterprise authorities should strengthen the management of relevant incentive funds according to their respective responsibilities and improve the efficiency of fund utilization. The incentive funds obtained by public service demonstration platforms must be used for the service of specialized and innovative small giant enterprises, and must not be used to balance the local financial budget or for the construction of the demonstration platform itself, work expenses, etc. If such problems are found during inspections and assessments, the relevant incentive funds may be deducted accordingly. The incentive funds obtained by key small giant enterprises should be autonomously arranged by the enterprises based on the development goals of specialization, expertise, and innovation. If it is found during inspections and assessments that financial funds have been obtained through false reporting or misappropriation, relevant regulations such as the Regulations on the Punishment of Financial Illegal Acts shall be followed for handling.
titlelist: Other requirements, strengthen financial management.

name: Notice on Supporting the High-Quality Development of Specialized, Refined, Unique, and New Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/January 23, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: According to the regulations on budget transparency and the current situation, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology actively discloses the progress of relevant work and publishes the list of key little giant enterprises and public service demonstration platforms, as well as the annual assessment results. The Ministry of Finance actively discloses the allocation of transfer payments to each province. Provincial departments in charge of small and medium-sized enterprises and finance departments should proactively disclose the progress of relevant work and the use of fund management according to their respective responsibilities. The first batch of Implementation Plans (submitted version) from each province should be submitted before March 31, 2021; the second and third batches of Implementation Plans (submitted version) should be submitted before July 15, 2021 and July 15, 2022, respectively (with three copies of stamped hard copies and scanned PDF electronic versions). Contact information: Industry Policy Department, Economic Construction Department, Ministry of Finance. Entrepreneurship and Innovation Service Department, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises Bureau, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. Attachment: Implementation Plan (Template) for the Xth batch of support for specialized and innovative little giant enterprises in XX province. Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, January 23, 2021.
titlelist: Other requirements, ensure information disclosure.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (Excerpt) (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Focus on the new generation of information technology, biotechnology, new energy, new materials, high-end equipment, new energy vehicles, green environmental protection, as well as strategic emerging industries such as aerospace, marine equipment, etc. Accelerate the innovation and application of key core technologies, enhance the capacity of element guarantee, and cultivate and strengthen new driving forces for industrial development. Promote the integration and innovation of biotechnology and information technology, accelerate the development of biopharmaceuticals, biological breeding, biological materials, bioenergy, and expand and strengthen the bioeconomy.
titlelist: Accelerate the development of a modern industrial system, consolidate and strengthen the foundation of the real economy, develop and strengthen strategic emerging industries, and build new pillars for the industrial system.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (Excerpt) (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Continuously strengthen the basic position of agriculture, deepen the structural reform of agricultural supply-side, emphasize quality orientation, and promote the revitalization of rural industries.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the comprehensive promotion of agricultural and rural development, advance the revitalization of rural areas, and improve the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (Excerpt) (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Consolidate the foundation of food production capacity and ensure the supply security of important agricultural products such as grain, cotton, oil, sugar, meat, and milk. Adhere to the strictest farmland protection system, strengthen the protection and improvement of both the quantity and quality of farmland, strictly adhere to the red line of 1.8 billion mu of farmland, curb the non-agriculturalization of farmland, prevent non-foodization, regulate the balance between occupation and compensation of farmland, and strictly prohibit occupying high-quality farmland to compensate for inferior or converting paddy fields to dry land. Focus on the construction of national food security industrial belts in grain production functional zones and important agricultural product production protection zones, implement high-standard farmland construction projects, and establish 1.075 billion mu of concentrated and contiguous high-standard farmland. Implement black soil protection projects, strengthen the protection and fertility restoration of black soil in Northeast China. Promote large and medium-sized irrigation district water-saving transformation and refined management, construct backbone projects for water-saving irrigation, and simultaneously promote comprehensive water price reform. Strengthen the research and application of large and medium-sized, intelligent, and compound agricultural machinery, and increase the mechanization rate of crop cultivation and harvesting to 75%. Strengthen the protection and utilization of germplasm resources and the construction of seed banks to ensure seed source security. Strengthen the research and development of superior agricultural varieties, promote the industrial application of biotechnology breeding in an orderly manner, and cultivate leading seed companies with international competitiveness. Improve the agricultural science and technology innovation system, innovate agricultural technology extension service methods, and build smart agriculture. Strengthen animal epidemic prevention and control of crop pests and diseases, and enhance agricultural meteorological services.
titlelist: Persist in prioritizing the development of agriculture and rural areas, comprehensively promote rural revitalization, improve the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and enhance the comprehensive production capacity of agriculture.

name: Outline of the Fourteenth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 (Excerpt) (March 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Persist in giving equal importance to both Chinese and Western medicine and promote their complementary advantages, vigorously develop the traditional Chinese medicine industry. Improve the traditional Chinese medicine service system and leverage the unique advantages of traditional Chinese medicine in disease prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation. Strengthen the integration of Chinese and Western medicine, and promote the development of ethnic minority medicine. Strengthen the sorting and excavation of the essence of classical medical books, establish a scientific and technological support platform for traditional Chinese medicine, reform and improve the evaluation and approval mechanism for Chinese medicine, promote the research, development, protection, and industrial development of new Chinese medicines. Strengthen the supervision of the quality of Chinese medicine and promote the improvement of its quality. Strengthen the training of talents with expertise in traditional Chinese medicine, enhance the inheritance and innovative development of traditional Chinese medicine culture, and promote the internationalization of traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Enhancing the quality of the nation and promoting comprehensive human development, comprehensively advancing the construction of a healthy China, and promoting the inheritance and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Healthy China 2030 Planning Outline (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ October 25, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Implement the project of cultivating the advantages of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) in clinical practice, strengthen the research on TCM prevention and treatment of diseases with advantages, enhance the integration of TCM and Western medicine, and improve the clinical efficacy in treating major difficult and critical illnesses. Vigorously develop non-pharmaceutical therapies of TCM, so that they can play a unique role in the prevention and treatment of common diseases, prevalent diseases, and chronic diseases. Develop TCM characteristic rehabilitation services. Improve the TCM medical and healthcare service system that covers both urban and rural areas. Establish TCM comprehensive service areas such as TCM clinics and national medicine halls in township health centers and community health service centers, promote appropriate techniques, and ensure that all primary healthcare institutions can provide TCM services. Promote the development of ethnic medicine. By 2030, TCM will fully play a leading role in disease prevention, a collaborative role in the treatment of major diseases, and a core role in disease rehabilitation.
titlelist: Optimize health services, fully leverage the unique advantages of traditional Chinese medicine, and enhance the capacity of traditional Chinese medicine services.

name: Healthy China 2030 Planning Outline (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ October 25, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Implement the Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Health Project for Preventive Care, combining the advantages of TCM with health management, and exploring an integrated TCM health security model that incorporates health culture, health management, and health insurance. Encourage the establishment of standardized TCM health preservation institutions by social forces, and accelerate the development of health preservation services. Expand the service scope of TCM hospitals to provide preventive care services such as TCM health consultation and assessment, intervention and regulation, and follow-up management for the public. Encourage TCM medical institutions and TCM practitioners to provide technical support such as health consultation and regulation to TCM health preservation institutions. Carry out the TCM and Traditional Chinese Medicine Tour in China campaign, vigorously disseminate TCM knowledge and easily accessible health preservation techniques, strengthen the protection and inheritance of TCM intangible cultural heritage, and achieve creative transformation and innovative development of TCM health preservation culture.
titlelist: Optimize health services, fully leverage the unique advantages of traditional Chinese medicine, and develop traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and preventive treatment services.

name: Healthy China 2030 Planning Outline (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ October 25, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Implement the project of inheriting and innovating traditional Chinese medicine, emphasizing the study and exploration of classical medical books, and comprehensively inheriting and systematically inheriting the academic theories, schools, and doctrines of various generations. Continuously promote the academic thoughts and clinical experience of contemporary famous old Chinese medicine experts. Explore folk diagnosis and treatment techniques and herbal medicine, and promote the inheritance and development of traditional Chinese medicine culture. Establish a system for protecting traditional Chinese medicine knowledge and formulate a list of protected traditional knowledge. Integrate modern scientific and technological achievements, explore traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions, strengthen the prevention and treatment techniques and new drug research and development for major difficult diseases, chronic diseases, and other traditional Chinese medicine. Continuously promote the development of traditional Chinese medicine theory and practice. Develop traditional Chinese medicine health services, accelerate the creation of multinational companies and internationally renowned Chinese brands that provide full industry chain services, and promote the internationalization of traditional Chinese medicine. Protect important Chinese medicinal resources and biodiversity, conduct a general survey and dynamic monitoring of Chinese medicinal resources. Establish breeding bases for bulk, authentic, and endangered medicinal materials, provide dynamic monitoring information for the Chinese herbal medicine market, and promote the green development of the Chinese herbal medicine planting industry.
titlelist: Optimize health services, fully leverage the unique advantages of traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the inheritance and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Healthy China 2030 Planning Outline (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ October 25, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Consolidate and improve the national essential medicine system, promote basic medicine guarantee for special populations. Improve the existing policy of free treatment drugs, increase the supply of free drugs for AIDS prevention and treatment and other special drugs. Ensure medication for children. Improve the policy for guaranteeing medication for rare diseases. Establish a comprehensive clinical evaluation system with basic medicines as the focus. Improve the drug pricing mechanism based on the principles of government regulation and market adjustment. Strengthen the connection between pricing, medical insurance, and procurement policies, adhere to classified management, strengthen price regulation for drugs with insufficient market competition and high-value medical consumables, establish a drug price information monitoring and information disclosure system, and formulate and improve policies on payment standards for medical insurance drugs.
titlelist: Improve health security, improve the drug supply security system, improve national drug policies.

name: Healthy China 2030 Planning Outline (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ October 25, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Improve the collaborative innovation system of government, industry, academia, research, and application, and promote pharmaceutical innovation and transformation and upgrading. Strengthen the capacity building of innovative drugs, traditional Chinese medicine, new formulations, and high-end medical devices, and promote the generic listing of patented drugs for the treatment of major diseases after their patents expire. Vigorously develop new varieties of biopharmaceuticals, chemical drugs, high-quality traditional Chinese medicine, high-performance medical devices, new auxiliary materials and packaging materials, and pharmaceutical equipment, promote the industrialization of major drugs, accelerate the transformation and upgrading of medical devices, and enhance the international competitiveness of medical diagnostic and therapeutic equipment and medical materials with independent intellectual property rights. Accelerate the development of the rehabilitation aids industry and enhance independent innovation capabilities. Improve the quality standard system, enhance quality control technology, implement green and intelligent transformation and upgrading, and by 2030, fully align the quality standards of drugs and medical devices with international standards.
titlelist: Develop the health industry, promote the development of the pharmaceutical industry, and strengthen pharmaceutical technology innovation.

name: Healthy China 2030 Planning Outline (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ October 25, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Develop professional pharmaceutical industrial parks, support the formation of industry alliances or consortia, build an innovative, green, low-carbon, intelligent, and efficient advanced manufacturing system, improve industrial concentration, and enhance the supply capacity of high-end products. Vigorously develop medical and health service trade, promote the internationalization of pharmaceutical companies and international industrial cooperation, and enhance international competitiveness. By 2030, the international market share of new drugs and diagnostic equipment with independent intellectual property rights will significantly increase, the localization rate of high-end medical equipment market will significantly improve, achieving high-speed development and moving towards the middle and high-end in the pharmaceutical industry, and entering the ranks of world pharmaceutical powers. Promote the transformation and upgrading of the pharmaceutical distribution industry, reduce distribution links, improve market concentration, and form a group of multinational large-scale pharmaceutical distribution enterprises.
titlelist: Develop the health industry, promote the development of the pharmaceutical industry, and enhance the level of industrial development.

name: Healthy China 2030 Planning Outline (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ October 25, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Launch and implement major scientific and technological projects and major engineering projects in the fields of brain science and brain-like research, health security, etc., and promote national major scientific and technological projects, key special projects of national key research and development programs, and other scientific and technological plans. Develop cutting-edge medical technologies such as omics technology, stem cells and regenerative medicine, new vaccines, and biologics, strengthen key technological breakthroughs in chronic disease prevention and control, precision medicine, and smart healthcare, and focus on deploying tasks such as innovative drug development, localization of medical devices, and modernization of traditional Chinese medicine. Significantly enhance the scientific and technological support capabilities for the prevention and treatment of major diseases and the development of the health industry. Strive to have the influence of scientific papers and the total number of international patents enter the forefront by 2030, further increasing the contribution rate of scientific and technological innovation to the growth of the pharmaceutical industry and the rate of achievement transformation.
titlelist: Strengthen support and guarantee, promote health technology innovation, and advance medical and technological progress.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
content: Grasp the new trend of deep development in life sciences, extensive application of new biotechnologies, and integration of innovation. Seize the opportunity of rapid development in genetic technology to promote the development of precision medicine and personalized medicine in the medical field. Accelerate the transformation of agricultural breeding towards efficient and precise breeding. Expand into new areas of marine biological resources, promote the substitution of biotechnology and products in a wider range of fields. Use new development models to promote the large-scale application of bioenergy. Cultivate high-quality specialized bio-service industries. Accelerate the development of the bioeconomy as an important new form of economy after the information economy, providing new support for building a healthy and beautiful China. By 2020, the scale of the bio-industry will reach 8-10 trillion yuan, forming a group of new biotechnology enterprises and bioeconomic clusters with strong international competitiveness.
