name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
content: Accelerate the development of innovative drugs and biologics with significant clinical demand, promote the green and intelligent production technology of pharmaceuticals, strengthen scientific and efficient regulation and policy support, promote the internationalization of the industry, and accelerate the construction of a strong biopharmaceutical country. Promote the leapfrog upgrade of the biopharmaceutical industry. Accelerate the research and application of technologies such as gene sequencing, large-scale cell culture, targeted and sustained drug release, and green intelligent production to support the high-end development of the industry. Develop new antibodies, vaccines, gene therapy, cell therapy, and other biologics and formulations, promote innovation in chemical drugs and high-end formulation development, accelerate the research and development of characteristic innovative traditional Chinese medicine, and achieve original innovation in the prevention and treatment of major diseases. Support the scale development of biosimilars, carry out research and production of a large variety of drugs whose patents have expired, accelerate the upgrading of pharmaceutical equipment, improve the automation, digitization, and intelligence level of pharmaceuticals, further promote the standardized development of traditional Chinese medicine products, promote the integration of industrial standards with international standards, and accelerate internationalization. Develop innovative marine drugs, develop modern marine traditional Chinese medicine products with ethnic characteristics, promote the industrialization of reagent raw materials and intermediates, and form a cluster of marine biopharmaceutical industries. Develop industrial technology systems that are in line with international advanced levels, enhance the supporting capabilities of key raw materials and equipment, support the continuous innovation and development of biotechnological drugs. Column 11: New Drug Development and Industrialization Engineering. Focus on building a sustainable biopharmaceutical industry system, with a focus on emerging drugs such as antibody drugs, recombinant protein drugs, and new vaccines, promote the research and development, industrialization, and quality improvement of new drugs for major diseases, common diseases, rare diseases, and children's diseases that are clinically scarce, integrate various elements to form a batch of advanced product standards. Innovate the regulatory methods for biopharmaceuticals. Establish a more scientific and efficient drug evaluation and approval system, accelerate the pilot implementation of the drug marketing authorization holder system, accelerate the evaluation of generic drug quality and efficacy consistency, and explore the pilot implementation of the clinical experimental research accreditation system for new medical technologies. Improve the drug procurement mechanism and comprehensively promote reforms in medical pricing and industry regulation mechanisms.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and build a new system for the biopharmaceutical industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
content: Deepen the integration of biomedical engineering technology and information technology, accelerate industry regulation reform, actively develop new medical devices, establish new diagnostic and treatment models such as mobile healthcare and remote healthcare, promote the development of smart healthcare industry, promote the application of high-performance medical devices, advance the research and development of new instruments and reagents that adapt to the development of life science and enhance the overall competitiveness of China's biomedical engineering industry. Develop intelligent and mobile new medical equipment. Develop intelligent medical devices and their software and supporting reagents, comprehensive remote healthcare service platforms and terminal devices, develop mobile healthcare services, establish relevant data standards, promote interoperability, and initially establish a modern intelligent healthcare service system deeply integrated with information technology and biotechnology. Develop high-performance medical equipment and core components. Develop high-quality medical imaging equipment, advanced radiation therapy equipment, high-throughput and low-cost gene sequencers, gene editing equipment, rehabilitation medical devices, and other medical equipment to significantly improve the stability and reliability of medical devices. Utilize new technologies such as additive manufacturing to accelerate the innovation and industrialization of organ repair and replacement materials and implantable medical devices. Accelerate the development of new products such as in vitro diagnostic instruments, equipment, and reagents, promote the development of new technologies such as highly specific molecular diagnostics and biochips, and support rapid and accurate diagnosis and screening of diseases such as tumors, genetic diseases, and rare diseases. Column 12: Biotechnology Benefit Project. Promote the construction of networked gene technology application demonstration centers, carry out application demonstrations such as screening for birth defects, early screening for tumors, and drug guidance. Develop and apply new biotechnology therapies, promote the standardization and standardization of new personalized biotechnology therapies. Develop intelligent and high-performance medical equipment, support the joint construction of third-party imaging centers by enterprises, medical institutions, research institutions, etc., carry out collaborative diagnosis and treatment and training, and pilot the establishment of residents' health imaging archives. Carry out regional comprehensive application demonstrations to replace more than 50% of traditional petrochemical plastic products with bio-based plastic products and packaging materials. Build biomass centralized gas and heat supply demonstration projects in urban areas or around enterprises, and explore diversified and win-win market-oriented development models.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and enhance the development level of biomedical engineering.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 67) (State Council/November 29, 2016)
content: With the goal of high efficiency, product safety, resource conservation, and environmental friendliness, we aim to create new varieties of biotechnology agriculture, develop new products for animal and plant nutrition and green plant protection, construct a modern agricultural system, and establish a group of internationally competitive biotechnology breeding enterprises. This will provide new approaches and support for accelerating the transformation of agricultural development methods. We will also build an independent innovation system for biotechnology seed industry. Key core technology innovations and breeding applications such as gene editing, molecular design, and cell mutation will be carried out. We will develop and promote a batch of high-quality, high-yield, nutritious, safe, resource-efficient, and standardized agricultural animal and plant varieties. We will actively promote the industrialization of biotechnology breeding of new varieties, establish a group of biotechnology breeding innovation platforms led by enterprises, and create integrated modern biotechnology seed industry enterprises with core competitiveness. This will accelerate the industrialization and market promotion of new animal and plant varieties. We will develop new technologies for animal and plant quarantine and strengthen the construction of platforms for introducing and quarantining high-quality animal and plant varieties from abroad. We will develop a batch of new agricultural biological preparations and major products. We will vigorously develop new technologies and products for the prevention and control of animal and plant diseases and pests, establish a green pesticide and veterinary drug creation technology system based on disease and pest genomics information, and create a batch of new animal vaccines, biological veterinary drugs, and new plant pesticides. This will achieve large-scale production and application and promote the green transformation of agricultural production. We will create new green biotechnology feed and efficient biological fertilizer products that can replace antibiotics. We will explore marine biological resources in depth, develop new green, safe, and efficient marine functional products, and open up new avenues for comprehensive utilization. We will promote key technological innovations such as food synthetic biotechnology, efficient food biotransformation technology, and gut microbiome genomics, as well as the creation of precision nutrition food.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and expedite the industrialization of biotechnology in agriculture.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
content: Accelerate the development of new technologies such as microbial genomics engineering, enzyme molecular machines, and cell factories to enhance the economic viability of industrial biotechnology products. Promote the application of biomanufacturing technology in fields such as chemical engineering, materials, and energy, gradually replacing traditional chemical processing methods with clean bio-processing methods, and gradually replacing fossil resources with renewable resources. Continuously improve the economic viability and scale of development of biomanufacturing products. Develop a new biotool creation and application technology system to achieve the biological production and application of basic chemical products such as organic acids, chemical alcohols, olefins, alkanes, and organic amines. Promote the industrial chain, aggregation, and scale development of bio-based materials such as bio-based polyesters, bio-based polyurethanes, bio-based nylon, bio-based rubber, and microbial polysaccharides. Enhance the independent innovation capability and development level of bulk fermentation products such as amino acids and vitamins. Establish an ecological, safe, green, low-carbon, and circular development bioprocess system. Develop an efficient industrial biocatalytic conversion technology system to enhance the application level of green bioprocesses. Establish biocatalytic synthesis routes for steroidal drugs, chiral compounds, rare sugar alcohols, etc., to achieve green and large-scale production of pharmaceutical and chemical intermediates. Promote the comprehensive entry and demonstration application of green bioprocesses in agriculture, chemical industry, food, medicine, light textile, metallurgy, energy, and other fields, significantly reducing resource consumption, energy consumption, and pollutant emissions.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of Strategic Emerging Industries (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 67, November 29, 2016)
content: Promote the innovative development of biotechnology services through specialized division of labor, establish a new specialized service model for new technologies, and continuously create new growth points in the bioeconomy. Enhance the specialized service capabilities of biotechnology for consumers. Develop specialized diagnostic and treatment institutions, cultivate standardized new technology diagnostic and treatment service institutions such as liquid biopsy and genetic diagnosis. Develop health examination and consultation, mobile healthcare, and other health management services, promote the construction of a shared platform for bio big data and medical and health big data, pilot the establishment of resident health image archives, encourage the construction of an intelligent diagnosis and treatment ecosystem combining online and offline, and promote the specialized development of medical laboratory testing, imaging diagnosis, and other services. Column 13: Construction project for the innovation and development platform of the bioindustry. Relying on and integrating existing resources, construct a number of innovative basic platforms, support the construction of gene banks, stem cell banks, traditional Chinese medicine standard libraries, high-level biosafety laboratories, protein component libraries, etc. Accelerate the construction of a number of transformation and application platforms, promote the construction of antibody screening platforms, medical imaging information databases, crop molecular breeding platforms, and other carriers. Actively develop a number of testing service platforms, promote the construction of generic drug consistency evaluation technology platforms, innovative platforms for the quality and safety testing of biological drugs, platforms for the safety and quality testing of agricultural products, and public service platforms for the inspection, testing, and monitoring of biomass energy, etc., and improve relevant standards. Improve the level of support of biotechnology services for industries. Develop drug research and development and production services that meet international standards, and encourage pharmaceutical companies to strengthen cooperation with contract research and development and contract manufacturing enterprises. Promote the application and transformation of emerging technologies such as gene testing and diagnosis in various fields, and support bioinformatics service institutions in improving their technical level. Provide public services such as testing, evaluation, and certification for pharmaceuticals, medical devices, seed industry, bioenergy, and other bio products, accelerate the listing process of products, and improve product quality. Encourage the expansion and application of biotechnology in areas such as water pollution control, air pollution treatment, degradation of toxic and harmful substances, and waste resource utilization, actively guide cross-regional and cross-industry cooperation or mergers of bio-environmental protection technology enterprises, and achieve growth and strength. Build a specialized innovation and entrepreneurship platform for biotechnology, reduce the cost of innovation and entrepreneurship in the bioindustry, support various individuals in starting virtual research and development enterprises, and unleash innovation potential.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and foster new forms of bio-services.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (excerpt) (State Council Document No. [2016] 43) (State Council, August 8, 2016)

content: With the goal of accelerating agricultural modernization, ensuring national food security, and increasing farmers' income, we will thoroughly implement the strategies of storing grain in the ground and storing grain in technology, and proactively deploy research on cutting-edge and common key agricultural technologies. We will focus on developing the national seed industry, based on animal and plant genomics, and cultivate key technologies for independent intellectual property rights in breeding. We will also develop technologies for improving farmland quality and comprehensive land management to ensure national food security from the source. With the goal of developing high-tech agricultural industries and supporting agricultural transformation and upgrading, we will focus on developing key technologies and products in agricultural biomanufacturing, intelligent agricultural production, intelligent agricultural machinery and equipment, and facility agriculture. We will accelerate the transformation of agricultural development methods by improving resource utilization, land output, and labor productivity. We will break through key technologies in water-saving agriculture, circular agriculture, agricultural pollution control and restoration, saline-alkali land transformation, and agricultural and forestry disaster prevention and reduction to achieve green agricultural development. By 2020, we strive to establish a modern agricultural technology system led by information technology, guided by biotechnology, and characterized by intelligent production and sustainable development, supporting agriculture to embark on a modern path of high efficiency, product safety, resource conservation, and environmental friendliness. Column 4: Modern Agricultural Technology.

name: Opinions on Deepening the Reform of the Drug and Medical Device Review and Approval System to Encourage Innovation in Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (Document No. [2017] 42 of the Ministry) (issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on October 8, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: After the institution with clinical trial conditions registers and files on the designated website of the food and drug regulatory department, it can accept the commission of drug and medical device registration applicants to conduct clinical trials. The main researchers of clinical trials should have senior professional titles and have participated in more than three clinical trials. Registration applicants can hire a third party to evaluate and certify whether the clinical trial institution meets the requirements. Encourage social forces to invest in the establishment of clinical trial institutions. The management regulations for clinical trial institutions are formulated by the State Food and Drug Administration in conjunction with the National Health Commission.
titlelist: Reform the management of clinical trials, and implement record management for the qualification recognition of clinical trial institutions.

name: Opinions on Deepening the Reform of the Drug and Medical Device Review and Approval System to Encourage Innovation in Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (Document No. [2017] 42 of the Ministry) (issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on October 8, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Support medical institutions, medical research institutions, and pharmaceutical universities to conduct clinical trials, and incorporate the evaluation of clinical trial conditions and capabilities into the evaluation of medical institutions. Establish a separate evaluation and assessment system for medical institutions conducting clinical trials, where beds used solely for clinical trials are not counted towards the total number of beds in the medical institution, and evaluation indicators such as bed efficiency, turnover rate, and utilization rate are not specified. Encourage medical institutions to establish dedicated clinical trial departments and equip them with professional clinical trial researchers. Improve the distribution and incentive mechanism for performance-based salaries to ensure the income level of clinical trial researchers. Encourage clinical doctors to participate in drug and medical device technological innovation activities, and treat clinical trial researchers equally with clinical doctors in terms of job promotion and professional title advancement. Allow overseas companies and research institutions to conduct clinical trials of new drugs in China in accordance with the law.
titlelist: Reform clinical trial management, support clinical trial institutions and personnel in conducting clinical trials.

name: Opinions on Deepening the Reform of the Drug and Medical Device Review and Approval System to Encourage Innovation in Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (Document No. [2017] 42 of the Ministry) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China General Office, State Council General Office/ October 8, 2017)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Clinical trials should comply with ethical standards, ensuring that participants are informed of sufficient trial information before voluntary participation, understand and sign informed consent forms, and protect the safety, health, and rights of participants. Clinical trial institutions should establish ethics committees responsible for reviewing clinical trial protocols, assessing and supervising the qualifications of clinical trial researchers, monitoring the progress of clinical trials, and accepting inspections from regulatory authorities. Regional ethics committees may be established as needed to guide the ethical review work of clinical trial institutions, and they may be entrusted by institutions or applicants without the necessary ethical review conditions to conduct ethical reviews of clinical trial protocols and supervise the progress of clinical trials. Departments such as health and family planning, traditional Chinese medicine management, and food and drug regulation should strengthen the management guidance and business supervision of ethics committees.
titlelist: Reform clinical trial management, improve ethics committee mechanisms.

content: Highlighting the problem of heavy reliance on imported high-end medical equipment and low localization of core components in China, the focus is on strengthening the development of major products such as digital diagnostic equipment, in vitro diagnostic products, and high-value consumables. content: Seize the strategic opportunities of integrating biotechnology and information technology, with a focus on malignant tumors, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, metabolic diseases, rare diseases, etc. Key technologies to be tackled include next-generation gene sequencing technology, tumor immunotherapy, stem cells and regenerative medicine, and biomedical big data analysis. Develop small clinical sequencers for DNA sequence analysis, develop next-generation sequencing-related technologies such as nanopore sequencing, and research new related reagents, calibration, and quality control technologies for sequencers or sequencing technologies. Tumor immunotherapy. Focus on researching gene-engineered T cell technologies such as chimeric antigen receptor-modified T cells (CAR-T) and T cell receptor-modified T cells (TCR-T), select specific and moderately affinity recognition receptors to improve their safety, research universal production technologies, study new gene-modified tumor cell vaccine technologies, enhance immune cell response, reduce immune escape, and ultimately achieve specific immune response to tumor cells. Carry out in-depth research and transformation development in the application of stem cells, biomaterials, tissue engineering, bioartificial organs, and the relationship between stem cells and disease occurrence, obtain key technologies that can regulate stem cell proliferation, differentiation, and function, use the differentiation characteristics of stem cells in vivo and in vitro, combine with intelligent biomaterials, tissue engineering, and embryonic engineering to achieve the regeneration of neural, liver, kidney, reproductive system, and other tissue organs, and accelerate clinical applications. Integrate multi-level data with life omics data, clinical information, and health data as the core, develop rapid analysis systems for different levels of data, develop large-scale personal multi-omics information management, annotation, visualization, and application systems, construct large-scale knowledge base systems that support precision medicine, develop a series of tools to support precision medicine and smart healthcare. Research methods for evaluating the efficacy of complex disease subtypes based on genotype or molecular feature spectra, develop disease efficacy evaluation and prognosis monitoring products based on molecular imaging, establish a technical system for personalized evaluation, treatment, screening, drug resistance identification, and detection of drug efficacy and safety on a large scale, develop personalized treatment methods and formulations, develop personalized drug clinical application plans and companion diagnostic methods and reagent kits, based on clarifying the personalized characteristics of existing drugs such as efficacy, toxicity, and drug resistance, prescribe drugs according to the type and achieve individualized precision treatment.

content: Aiming at the forefront of biological science development, focusing on the technological support needs of the biological industry, vigorously promoting the construction of an innovative system for the biological manufacturing industry, conducting key technology research and development in areas such as raw material utilization, biological tool creation, biological processing processes, and equipment, solving basic scientific problems such as biological catalysts, design, synthesis, and optimization control of artificial biology, achieving disruptive technological innovation and application in areas such as artificial life forms, enzyme protein machines, nano-bio devices, genome editing, molecular recognition and biosensing, biomimetic manufacturing, etc., with a focus on the biological conversion of one-carbon compounds such as carbon dioxide, bio-manufacturing of olefins, heterologous synthesis of natural compounds, and large-scale manufacturing of bio-based materials, achieving key technological and process breakthroughs, significantly enhancing the independent innovation capability of the biological manufacturing industry, the technological support capability for industrial development, and the ability to cultivate new business models, laying a solid foundation for the construction of a new industrial system and accelerating the development of innovative industrialization.
titlelist: Promote new development in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and accelerate the construction of the innovation system in the bio-manufacturing industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Biotechnology Industry (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2016] No. 2665) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2016)
content: With the creation and application of new biotechnological tools as the core, we aim to build a core technological system for the bio-manufacturing of bulk chemical products, chemical polymer materials, and bulk fermentation products, continuously improving the economic viability and market competitiveness of bio-based products. We will establish bio-manufacturing routes for basic chemical products such as organic acids, chemical alcohols, olefins, alkanes, aromatic hydrocarbons, and organic amines, gaining a competitive advantage over petroleum-based routes and achieving large-scale production and application of bio-based methods. We will promote the development and application of bio-manufacturing and polymer modification technologies for chemical polymer materials, such as polyols, hydroxycarboxylic acids, and oleic acids, and drive the large-scale production and demonstration application of bio-based polyesters, bio-based polyurethanes, bio-based nylon, bio-based rubber, microbial polysaccharides, marine biomaterials, etc., realizing the chain, aggregation, and large-scale development of the bio-based materials industry. We will significantly enhance the independent innovation capability and international competitiveness of bulk fermentation products such as amino acids and vitamins, achieving a benign and high-end development of the industry.
titlelist: Promote new developments in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and improve the economic viability and market competitiveness of bio-based products.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Biotechnology Industry (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2016] No. 2665) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2016)
content: With the discovery and engineering application of biocatalysts as the core, we aim to construct an efficient industrial biocatalysis and conversion technology system, significantly improving the catalytic efficiency and industrial application properties of industrial enzymes and proteins, and significantly reducing production costs. We aim to establish biocatalytic synthesis routes for steroid hormones, non-natural amino acids, chiral compounds, special amino acids, rare sugar alcohols, glycopeptides, and other compounds, promote large-scale production and application demonstrations, achieve safe, clean, and sustainable production of chemical raw materials, food additives, pesticide intermediates, and bioemulsifiers, and break through key technologies and equipment in green bioprocesses such as biobased synthesis, biobased textiles, biobased mining, and biobased papermaking. We aim to promote the comprehensive integration and demonstration application of green bioprocesses in the fields of chemical industry, medicine, agriculture, light industry, energy, and ecological environment, significantly reduce material and energy consumption, industrial solid waste generation, and environmental pollutant emissions, and initially establish an ecological, safe, low-carbon, and circular development bioprocess system.
titlelist: Promote new developments in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and advance the greenification of bio-manufacturing processes.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11 of 2016) (State Council General Office/ March 4, 2016)
content: By 2020, the innovative capability of the pharmaceutical industry has significantly improved, and the supply guarantee capability has been significantly enhanced. Over 90% of major patented drugs have been successfully replicated and launched on the market. The shortage of clinical drugs and the tense supply situation have been effectively alleviated. The industry has achieved green development, safety, and efficiency, with a significant improvement in quality management. The industrial organizational structure has been further optimized, the system and mechanism have been gradually improved, and the market environment has significantly improved. The scale of the pharmaceutical industry has further expanded, with the annual growth rate of main business income exceeding 10%, and the growth rate of industrial added value consistently ranking among the top in all industries.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11 of 2016) (State Council General Office/ March 4, 2016)
content: Promote the improvement of innovation capabilities. Increase the intensity of scientific and technological system reform, improve the collaborative innovation system of medicine among government, industry, academia, and research institutions. Strengthen the construction of innovative capabilities in original research drugs, first generic drugs, traditional Chinese medicine, new formulations, high-end medical devices, and other areas. Optimize the allocation of scientific and technological resources and build scientifically efficient science and technology innovation bases with reasonable layouts. Utilize information technologies such as databases, computer screening, and the internet to establish public service platforms for pharmaceutical product technology research and development, industrialization, safety evaluation, and clinical evaluation. Actively develop maker spaces, vigorously promote mass innovation and entrepreneurship, and cultivate innovative small and medium-sized enterprises with distinctive technologies and high-end talents, promoting the transformation of research and development outsourcing companies towards full-process innovation, and improving the research and development capabilities of new pharmaceutical products. Promote the industrialization of major drugs. Continue to promote the development of new drugs, accelerate the development of chemical drug preparation technologies such as chiral synthesis, enzyme catalysis, and crystallization control, promote the research and development and engineering of large-scale cell culture and purification, antibody conjugation, serum-free and protein-free culture medium, and other biotechnologies, and enhance the level of new formulation technologies such as sustained release, controlled release, and targeted delivery. Based on the demand for clinical medication, focus on the development of targeted, highly selective, and new mechanism of action therapeutic drugs in the fields of tumors, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, diabetes, neurodegenerative diseases, mental disorders, high-prevalence immune diseases, major infectious diseases, rare diseases, etc., and focus on the generic production of foreign patented drugs with great market potential and urgent clinical needs. Accelerate the research and development and industrialization of new biopharmaceuticals such as antibodies, proteins, and peptides. Improve the vaccine supply system and actively develop urgently needed varieties and new adjuvants such as hand, foot, and mouth disease vaccines, new polio vaccines, and cervical cancer vaccines. Develop new varieties, dosage forms, and specifications that conform to the physiological characteristics of children to meet the needs of pediatric medication. Carry out the designated production of essential drugs that are clinically necessary, require small quantities, and have short supply in the market, strengthen their production capacity building and regular reserves, and meet the basic medication needs of the public. Accelerate the transformation and upgrading of medical devices. Focus on the development of key components such as digital detectors, superconducting magnets, and high-heat capacity X-ray tubes, as well as technologies such as precise surgical positioning and navigation, data acquisition, processing and analysis, and three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting. Develop nuclear medicine imaging equipment such as PET-CT and PET-MRI, superconducting magnetic resonance imaging systems (MRI), multi-slice spiral CT, color ultrasound diagnosis, image-guided radiation therapy, proton/heavy ion tumor therapy, medical robots, health monitoring, remote medical care, and other high-performance diagnostic and therapeutic equipment. Promote the industrialization of in vitro diagnostic equipment and supporting reagents such as fully automated biochemical analyzers, chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzers, high-throughput gene sequencers, and five-category blood cell analyzers. Develop high-end interventional products such as heart valves, pacemakers, fully biodegradable vascular stents, artificial joints and spines, and cochlear implants, as well as high-end products in the field of rehabilitation aids. Actively explore the research and development of medical devices based on traditional Chinese medicine theories. Promote the modernization of traditional Chinese medicine. Conduct research on technical standards for traditional Chinese medicine, ethnic medicine, and their clinical applications, strengthen the formulation of technical standards for the cultivation (breeding) of Chinese medicinal materials, establish a system of standards for authentic Chinese medicinal materials, and strengthen the protection of geographical indication products in the field of traditional Chinese medicine. Carry out the breeding of high-quality Chinese medicinal materials and the promotion of modern cultivation (breeding) and production technologies, and build standardized cultivation (breeding) and large-scale integrated processing bases in suitable areas. Accelerate the establishment of a dynamic monitoring system for Chinese medicinal resources and conduct ecological and environmental impact assessments of the utilization of wild Chinese medicinal resources. Strengthen the construction of traceability systems for Chinese medicinal materials, production, circulation, and use, and improve the quality and safety of Chinese medicine products. Develop modern Chinese medicine extraction and purification technologies, research and develop formulation technologies that conform to the characteristics of Chinese medicine such as mucosal administration, and promote the application of technologies such as quality control, automation, and online monitoring in the production of Chinese medicine. In the field of advantageous treatment with traditional Chinese medicine, promote the secondary development and application of classic prescriptions, and develop a batch of Chinese medicine products with definite efficacy, high safety, clear active ingredients, and clear mechanisms of action. Strengthen the research on ethnic medicine theories, promote the development of Tibetan medicine, Uighur medicine, Mongolian medicine, Dai medicine, and other ethnic medicine systems, improve the formulation level of ethnic medicine medical institutions, and develop new varieties with resource characteristics and therapeutic advantages.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen technological innovation and enhance core competitiveness.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11 of 2016) (State Council General Office/ March 4, 2016)
content: Strict production quality management. Fully implement and strictly enforce the new version of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) for pharmaceutical production, improve the quality management system throughout the entire life cycle and industry chain, implement comprehensive, all-process, and all-round quality management, and establish a sound drug safety traceability system. Strictly control production environment standards such as temperature control and cleanliness, strengthen document management of management standards and work standards, establish quality management systems such as quality risk prevention and control, supplier audits, continuous stability inspections, and quality authorized personnel. Strengthen the awareness of the first person responsible for quality and safety in pharmaceutical companies and implement the main responsibility for quality. Strengthen quality and safety training, strict environmental, occupational health and safety (EHS) management, and improve employee quality. Standardize production and operation behaviors, focus on solving problems such as heavy certification and light implementation, heavy hardware and light software, strengthen the supervision of basic drug quality, and urge pharmaceutical production companies to comprehensively improve their quality management level. Improve quality control technology. Establish scientific and effective quality standards and control methods, promote the application of advanced quality control technologies, improve product design, optimize process routes, improve the whole-process quality control system from raw materials to finished products, and effectively improve drug quality. Accelerate the development and application of control technologies such as chemical impurities, dissolution performance, solvent residues, and drug crystal forms, and improve product purity and stability. Strengthen the research on biological activity, equivalence, and utilization of biological drug properties, enhance the control ability of biological process variability such as fermentation and cell culture, and focus on improving the safety and effectiveness of biological products such as vaccines. Increase the research efforts on traditional Chinese medicine, ethnic medicine, and other traditional medicine products, improve the stability of auxiliary solvent quality, and reduce the incidence of adverse reactions. Improve the quality standard system. Improve the national drug standard system with the Chinese Pharmacopoeia as the core, implement action plans to improve drug and medical device standards, promote the upgrading of quality standards for basic drugs, high-risk drugs, pharmaceutical excipients, packaging materials, and basic, universal, and high-risk medical devices, improve the technical specifications and quality control standards for Chinese medicine and ethnic medicine materials and products, improve the scientificity, rationality, and operability of standards, and strengthen the authority and seriousness of standards. Further improve the drug quality evaluation system, establish drug impurity databases, quality evaluation methods, and testing platforms. Improve the consistency evaluation methods and technical specifications for generic drugs, carry out third-party testing and evaluation, and improve the quality of generic drugs. Focus on the evaluation of the consistency of basic drug quality and efficacy, and comprehensively improve the quality of basic drugs. Carry out risk assessment of harmful residues in traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the safety evaluation of traditional Chinese medicine injections, and maintain the quality and safety of traditional Chinese medicine products. Accelerate the improvement of public technical service platforms such as metrology, standards, inspection and testing, certification and accreditation, encourage the construction of third-party quality reliability evaluation platforms, promote enterprises to increase investment, and improve product reliability. Implement green transformation and upgrading. Use modern biotechnology to improve traditional production processes, vigorously promote biotechnology such as genetic engineering and biocatalysis, actively use biotechnology fermentation methods to produce pharmaceutical active substances. Develop clean production technologies such as biotransformation, efficient extraction and purification, and application of high-yield and low-consumption strains, strengthen pollution prevention and control of bulk fermentation raw materials. Accelerate the promotion and application of non-toxic and harmless raw materials, strengthen the management of new chemical substances outsourced by research and development outsourcing companies, and promote the governance of environmental pollution sources. Build green factories and circular economy parks, promote mutual supply of raw materials and resource sharing, strengthen the recycling of by-products, harmless treatment of waste, and comprehensive management of pollutants. Strictly manage resource utilization, implement energy system optimization projects, promote energy-saving, water-saving, and land-saving technologies and equipment, eliminate outdated process equipment, strengthen the management of high-value medical consumables recycling and utilization, and improve the efficiency of energy and resource utilization and the level of clean production. Strengthen environmental risk control, investigate and control environmental safety hazards, and prevent sudden environmental incidents.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate quality upgrading and promote green and safe development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11 of 2016) (State Council General Office/ March 4, 2016)
content: Adjust the industrial organizational structure. Increase the intensity of enterprise organizational structure adjustment, promote cross-industry and cross-sector mergers and reorganizations, support the strong alliance of pharmaceutical and chemical, medical equipment and supplies, Chinese medicinal materials and traditional Chinese medicine, raw materials and preparations, production and distribution enterprises, and form an integrated upstream and downstream enterprise group, truly solving the problems of small, scattered, and disorderly. Promote the concentration of basic drug production to advantageous enterprises, improve the level of production intensification, and ensure product quality and stable supply. Take industry-leading enterprises as the mainstay, unite innovative enterprises, research institutes, and other units with similar products and technologies, and form industrial alliances or consortia through forms of cooperation such as capital injection and technical equity participation. Give full play to the advantages of backbone enterprises in terms of capital, technology, etc., strengthen the effective integration of production factors and business process reengineering, strengthen new product research and development, market marketing, and brand building; give full play to the characteristics of small and medium-sized enterprises being close to the market and having flexible mechanisms, develop high-quality pharmaceutical intermediates, auxiliary materials, packaging materials, and other supporting products, and form a division of labor and cooperation, mutually beneficial industrial organizational structure among large, medium, and small enterprises. Promote regional coordinated development. Give full play to the advantages of regional resource elements and build a new pattern of coordinated development in the eastern, central, and western regions. Utilize the advantages of funds, technology, talents, etc. in the eastern coastal areas to build internationally advanced research and development centers and headquarters bases, develop biopharmaceuticals, pharmaceutical preparations, and medical equipment with high added value and low resource consumption, and guide the orderly transfer of products lacking comparative advantages. Give full play to the location advantages of the central region as a bridge between the east and the west, actively undertake industrial transfers from the eastern region based on resource and environmental carrying capacity, rely on central cities to carry out high-end pharmaceutical product research and industrialization, and develop labor-intensive medical equipment products such as medical consumables according to local conditions. Utilize the medicinal resources and border location advantages of the western and northeastern regions, build traditional Chinese medicine and ethnic medicine production bases, and export bases for special pharmaceutical products to neighboring countries. Guide the development of industrial agglomeration. Promote the scale, intensification, and park-like development of the pharmaceutical industry, create a number of industrial agglomeration areas with standardized management, environmental friendliness, prominent characteristics, and high industrial relevance. Guide advantageous enterprises to carry out large-scale and standardized planting (breeding) in regions suitable for the growth of medicinal materials according to the Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) for the production and quality management of Chinese medicinal materials, and build large-scale Chinese medicine production and processing bases in areas with abundant Chinese medicinal resources, and build ethnic medicine production bases in areas with ethnic minority settlements. Combine the adjustment of the layout and transfer of chemical raw materials with the strong environmental carrying capacity, complete supporting facilities, and convenient supply of raw materials in chemical and pharmaceutical industrial parks, and build high-level chemical raw materials production bases, and build formulation export processing bases that meet international standards in coastal and border areas. In central cities with talent and technological advantages, utilize the radiation effects of industries such as electronics, information, and equipment to build high-end medical equipment research and industrialization bases. Guide the coordinated use of local advantages in medical, traditional Chinese medicine, and ecological tourism resources in areas with conditions, play the role of the tourism market, develop and construct a batch of medical and health tourism demonstration bases integrating elderly care, medical care, rehabilitation, and tourism, and further improve the comprehensive system of social elderly care, medical care, rehabilitation, and tourism services.
titlelist: The main tasks are to optimize the industrial structure and enhance the level of intensive development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11 of 2016) (State Council General Office/ March 4, 2016)
content: Establish a sound healthcare service system. Accelerate the reform of compensation mechanisms for public hospitals, establish a scientific and reasonable assessment and reward system, combine the implementation of policies such as separating medicine from healthcare and eliminating drug markups, strengthen the management of diagnosis and treatment behavior, prevent over-treatment and other irregular practices, and control medical expenses. Medical institutions should prescribe medications using generic names and actively provide prescriptions to patients, ensuring patients' right to choose medication. Promote the sharing of equipment among medical institutions of various ownership types, promote mutual recognition of inspection results between medical institutions, reduce duplicate inspections, and alleviate the burden on patients. Improve the development environment for medical institutions organized by social forces, treat all medical institutions equally in terms of market access, designated social insurance, key specialty construction, professional title evaluation, academic status, and level assessment, and accelerate the formation of a diversified healthcare service pattern, expanding patients' choice. Promote doctors' multi-practice, enhance the service capabilities of primary healthcare institutions, and accelerate the implementation of hierarchical diagnosis and treatment. Improve pricing and medical insurance policies. Implement coordinated reforms in healthcare, medical insurance, and pharmaceuticals, fully leverage the role of market mechanisms, and let actual drug transaction prices be mainly determined by market competition. Strengthen the connection between pricing, medical insurance, and bidding procurement policies, scientifically formulate medical insurance payment standards, strengthen comprehensive supervision of pharmaceutical expenses and pricing behavior, improve the drug price monitoring system, and promote price information transparency. Actively and steadily promote the reform of medical service prices, establish a price adjustment mechanism based on changes in cost and income structure, gradually rationalize the price relationship of medical services, and effectively reflect the technical and labor value of medical personnel. According to the principles of total control, structural adjustment, both increases and decreases, and gradual implementation, adjust medical service prices reasonably, and the resulting expenses after adjustment should be included in the scope of medical insurance payment according to regulations, ensuring that the burden on the masses does not increase. Actively promote the reform of medical insurance payment methods, strengthen the budget for the income and expenditure of medical insurance funds, and implement a composite payment method combining payment by disease category, per capita, and other methods. According to the capacity of the medical insurance fund, timely include drugs, medical devices, and diagnostic and treatment procedures that meet the conditions, have reasonable prices, and have independent intellectual property rights into the scope of medical insurance payment according to the prescribed procedures. Improve major illness protection policies, comprehensively carry out medical assistance for severe and major diseases, vigorously develop commercial health insurance, and meet the diverse needs of society for health protection and pharmaceutical products.
titlelist: The main task is to closely connect with healthcare reform and create a favorable market environment.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11, 2016) (State Council General Office, March 4, 2016)
content: Optimize the structure of product exports. Accelerate the development of emerging international pharmaceutical markets and adjust the structure of product exports. Utilize the international competitive advantage of chemical raw materials to promote the export of processed products of advantageous varieties such as vitamins, penicillin, erythromycin, cephalosporins, etc. Implement the internationalization strategy of formulations, accelerate the export of generic drugs, recombinant protein drugs, antibody drugs, vaccines, and other formulated products, improve the export capacity of raw materials and formulation combinations, and cultivate well-known Chinese pharmaceutical brands. Establish and improve overseas sales and service systems, promote the export of medical equipment such as PET-CT, X-ray machines, electrocardiographs, and ultrasound, and gradually increase the added value of exports. Strengthen the international cultural exchange of traditional Chinese medicine, enhance international awareness, enhance the discourse power in the international standard formulation of traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the export of natural medicines, traditional Chinese patent medicines, and other products. Promote international registration and certification. Introduce and cultivate international pharmaceutical registration talents familiar with overseas laws, regulations, and market environments to improve international registration capabilities. Systematically carry out international market product registration, promote international clinical research and registration of domestically patented original drugs, and accelerate international registration and certification of branded generic drugs. Actively carry out international comparisons related to medical devices. Improve process routes, quality testing and analysis methods in accordance with international standards, improve environmental, occupational health, and safety (EHS) management systems, and establish and implement systems for filing raw materials and excipients. Accelerate international certification of production quality systems such as Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), promote the construction of production lines that comply with international quality standards, improve the international production and management level, and accelerate the internationalization of testing and certification processes. Encourage companies to apply for foreign patents and form effective overseas patent layouts. Accelerate international cooperation. Implement the Belt and Road strategy, focus on global resource allocation, and accelerate the pace of going global. Use various forms of cooperation to promote overseas mergers and acquisitions, equity investments, and venture capital investments by pharmaceutical advantage enterprises, establish overseas research and development centers, production bases, sales networks, and service systems, obtain new products, key technologies, production licenses, and sales channels, accelerate integration into the international market, and create a group of well-known brands with international influence. Encourage companies to actively participate in international cooperation in the field of public health, continuously expand and consolidate the international market. Improve the investment environment, strengthen the construction of supporting systems, increase efforts to attract foreign investment, and encourage companies in special customs supervision areas to undertake outsourcing business in the biopharmaceutical industry. Promote multinational companies to establish high-level pharmaceutical research and development centers, production centers, and procurement centers in China, accelerate the extension of industrial cooperation from processing and manufacturing to research and development, design, marketing, brand cultivation, and other high value-added links, and improve international cooperation levels.
titlelist: The main task is to deepen foreign cooperation and expand international development space.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11 of 2016) (State Council General Office/ March 4, 2016)
content: Build intelligent demonstration factories. Promote the intelligentization of pharmaceutical production processes and carry out demonstrations of intelligent factories and digital workshops. Accelerate the application of technologies such as human-machine intelligent interaction and industrial robots in pharmaceutical production processes, and promote manufacturing process simulation optimization, real-time feedback of status information, and adaptive control. Apply technologies such as big data, cloud computing, the Internet, and additive manufacturing to construct new production models such as dynamic perception of pharmaceutical product consumer demand, crowdsourced design, and personalized customization. Accelerate the digitization and intelligentization of medical device products, focusing on the development of wearable, portable, and other mobile medical and assistive device products, and promote the application of new technologies such as bio three-dimensional (3D) printing and data chips in implantable intervention products. Promote the intelligent upgrading of pharmaceutical production equipment, accelerate the research and industrialization of core technical equipment such as industrial control systems and intelligent sensing components, and support the construction of intelligent factories in the pharmaceutical industry. Carry out intelligent medical services. Give full play to the leading role of high-quality medical resources, encourage social forces to participate, integrate online and offline resources, and standardize the management of medical Internet of Things and health medical application programs (APPs). Actively carry out convenient services such as online health consultation, appointment scheduling, waiting reminder, pricing and payment, and medical report inquiry. Strengthen the integration of regional medical and health service resources, encourage medical service institutions to establish medical and health information service platforms, and actively carry out Internet-based medical and health information services. Guide medical institutions to use information technology and intelligent technology equipment to provide remote medical services such as telepathology diagnosis, imaging diagnosis, expert consultation, monitoring guidance, and surgical guidance for grassroots, remote, and underdeveloped areas.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate emerging industries and promote intelligent development of the industry.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (State Council Document No. 11, 2016) (State Council General Office, March 4, 2016)
content: Innovative fiscal funding support methods are used to support projects with strong public service characteristics, such as application demonstrations and the construction of public service platforms. This support is provided through incentive guidance, capital injection, application demonstration subsidies, and other means. Industrial investment and venture capital funds are utilized and guided to support projects with profit-making and competitive aspects, such as innovative product research and development and industrialization construction. Backbone enterprises and industry alliances with innovative development capabilities are supported, and upstream and downstream resources in the industrial chain are integrated. Exploring cooperation between medical device manufacturers and financial leasing companies to provide installment payment services for the purchase of large medical equipment by various types of medical institutions. Researching and formulating a key product catalog of domestically scarce and breakthrough-needed raw materials, implementing lower provisional tax rates for raw materials that have clear chemical structures, comply with tariff classification rules, and meet regulatory requirements. Establishing incentive mechanisms for research and development units and user units in the innovation, value-added services, and demonstration application stages of pharmaceutical products. Supporting eligible innovative pharmaceutical production companies in financing through IPOs, issuing bonds, mergers, and reorganizations.
titlelist: Strengthen policy guarantees and organizational implementation, and enhance financial support.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Accelerate the improvement of the relevant standard working mechanism led by the government, driven by enterprises, and involving social participation. Continue to implement the National Action Plan for Improving Drug Standards. Strengthen the construction of drug standard system, improve the standard management system and measures, and enhance the fine management of the entire process of standard revision. Improve the medical device standard system, establish a cosmetics standard system, and strengthen the overall coordination of national standards, industry standards, group standards, and enterprise standards. Actively participate in the coordination of international standards, and enhance the consistency with international standards. Strengthen the informatization construction of standards and improve the level of public standard services.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing standard management capability.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Aiming at the international technological forefront, with the China National Institutes for Food and Drug Control as the leader, the key laboratory of the National Medical Products Administration as the backbone, and provincial-level inspection and testing institutions as the support, we will improve the scientific and authoritative inspection and testing system for pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and cosmetics. We will accelerate the construction of the national key laboratory for the evaluation and testing of innovative vaccines and biotechnology products, and incorporate it into the national laboratory system. We will continue to strengthen the construction of medical device inspection and testing institutions, accelerate the construction of laboratories for the inspection and evaluation of prohibited and restricted substances in cosmetics, and fill in the gaps in inspection and testing capabilities. Provincial-level inspection and testing institutions should strengthen their business guidance to municipal and county-level inspection and testing institutions and carry out capacity building.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing inspection and testing capabilities.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Consolidate and enhance the batch issuance capacity of the National Institutes for Food and Drug Control in China for biological products (vaccines), promote the capacity building of provincial drug inspection and testing institutions for batch issuance, and designate provincial drug inspection and testing institutions that meet the requirements as national batch issuance institutions for biological products (vaccines) in accordance with laws and regulations.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing the capacity for batch issuance of biological products (vaccines).

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Strengthen the construction of the adverse reaction (event) monitoring system for drugs, medical devices, and cosmetics, as well as the capacity building of drug adverse reaction monitoring institutions at the provincial, municipal, and county levels. Develop quality management standards for drug vigilance, improve information systems, enhance information sharing, and promote the data linkage and application of suspected adverse reaction monitoring systems for preventive vaccination with disease control institutions.
titlelist: Key task: Building a national drug surveillance system.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Integrate risk information related to the evaluation and approval of cosmetic technology, supervision sampling, on-site inspections, adverse reaction monitoring, complaint reporting, public opinion monitoring, law enforcement inspections, etc., to establish a unified and improved risk monitoring system and form a coordinated and interconnected working mechanism. Promote the construction of high-throughput screening platforms for cosmetic safety risk substances, rapid testing technology, network monitoring, and other capabilities, gradually achieving timely monitoring, accurate assessment, scientific early warning, and effective disposal of cosmetic safety risks.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing the risk monitoring capability of cosmetics.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Improve the emergency response plans for drug safety incidents at all levels of the people's government, and strengthen the emergency management mechanism. Strengthen the unified command and coordination of inspection, testing, system verification, evaluation and approval, monitoring and evaluation in response to major public health emergencies. Enhance the construction of the National Medical Products Administration's safety emergency drill center, carry out regular emergency drills for drug safety, and improve the emergency response capabilities of drug regulatory agencies at all levels. Establish a national emergency call mechanism for reference material samples, effectively maintain emergency inspection equipment and facilities, and strengthen the research and development of key emergency technologies.
titlelist: Key task: Improve the emergency management system.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Develop unified drug information traceability standards, implement drug coding management, and enforce the responsibility of drug marketing authorization holders for traceability. Build a national drug traceability collaborative platform, integrate traceability information from drug production, distribution, and use, starting with vaccines, blood products, and special drugs, gradually achieving traceability of drug sources and destinations. Gradually implement unique identification for medical devices, strengthen connections with medical management, and medical insurance management. Harness the role of traceability data in risk prevention and control, product recalls, emergency response, and enhance the level of regulatory precision.
titlelist: Key task: Improve the informatization traceability system.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Strengthen the application of big data in the regulation of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and cosmetics, and enhance the capabilities of data collection, correlation, risk assessment, and information sharing throughout the entire lifecycle from the laboratory to end users. Strengthen the construction and application of variety archives for pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and cosmetics, and enhance the development and utilization of relevant data by government departments, industry organizations, enterprises, third-party platforms, and others. Research and explore key common technologies and applications based on big data, and promote the digitalization upgrade of regulation and industry.
titlelist: Key task: Promote digital management throughout the entire lifecycle.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Innovate and improve funding guarantee policies that are suitable for the characteristics of drug regulatory work, and arrange regulatory funds reasonably. Establish a dynamic adjustment system for fees charged by evaluation and approval enterprises. Include technical support services such as evaluation, inspection, testing, monitoring and evaluation, and standard management in the scope of government purchasing services, optimize the structure of fund expenditure, and enhance the efficiency of purchasing services. Support local drug regulatory work through special transfer payments.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthening policy protection.

name: Implementation Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Drug Regulatory Capacity in an All-round Manner (State Council Document No. [2021] 16) (State Council General Office, April 27, 2021)
content: Scientifically determine the number of technical institution personnel responsible for functions such as evaluation, inspection, testing, monitoring and evaluation, and standard management. Establish the position of chief scientist and introduce senior professionals with international regulatory experience and familiarity with the actual situation of Chinese industries. Innovate and improve human resources policies, strengthen policy support in areas such as open recruitment, job positions, professional title evaluation, and salary and benefits guarantee, and break through the bottleneck of talent development. Reasonably determine the total amount of performance-based salaries for relevant technical support institutions, and give priority to personnel in high-risk regulatory positions such as on-site supervision when distributing performance-based salaries, better reflecting the technical labor value of the staff.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, optimize personnel management.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: Establish a cross-departmental mechanism for sharing information on drug production and use, strengthen drug supply guarantee and information monitoring, timely grasp and release information on drug supply and demand, and guide enterprises in research and development, registration, and production. Demand-oriented, encourage the production of generic drugs that are clinically necessary, have definite efficacy, and are in short supply, encourage the production of generic drugs needed for the prevention and treatment of major infectious diseases and rare diseases, drugs needed for the handling of public health emergencies, drugs for children, and drugs that have not yet applied for registration one year before the expiration of their patents. The list of encouraged generic drugs shall be formulated by the National Health Commission, the National Medical Products Administration, and relevant departments, and regularly published on platforms such as the National Drug Supply Guarantee Comprehensive Management Information Platform, and shall be dynamically adjusted. Newly approved drugs or generic drugs that have passed quality and efficacy consistency evaluation shall be included in the China Marketed Drug Catalog, and the content of the Marketed Drug Catalog shall be dynamically updated and publicly available in real time.
titlelist: Promote the research and development of generic drugs, and establish a list of drugs that encourage generic production.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office, March 21, 2018)
content: The key common technology research of chemical drugs and biological drugs in the encouraged generic drug catalog will be included in the relevant national scientific and technological plans. The mechanism of collaborative innovation between industry, academia, research, and medical use will be improved, and a generic drug technology research alliance will be established. Enterprises will play a leading role, while hospitals, research institutions, and universities will provide basic support. The research and development of pharmaceutical raw materials, packaging materials, and formulations will be strengthened, and the organic connection between the drug research and development chain and the industrial chain will be promoted. International advanced technology will be actively introduced and digested and absorbed to further improve.
titlelist: Promote the research and development of generic drugs, strengthen the technical breakthroughs in generic drug production.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: In accordance with the principle of encouraging the creation of new drugs and the development of generic drugs, we will study and improve the intellectual property protection system for drugs that is suitable for our country's economic and social development level and industrial development stage, in order to fully balance the interests of drug patent holders and the general public. We will implement a project to improve patent quality, cultivate more core intellectual property rights, original intellectual property rights, and high-value intellectual property rights in the field of pharmaceuticals. We will strengthen anti-monopoly law enforcement in the field of intellectual property, while fully protecting drug innovation, preventing the abuse of intellectual property rights, and promoting the market entry of generic drugs. We will establish and improve a patent early warning mechanism in the field of pharmaceuticals to reduce the risk of patent infringement for generic drug companies.
titlelist: Promote the research and development of generic drugs, improve the protection of pharmaceutical intellectual property rights.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: Organize the revision of quality standards for medicinal raw materials and packaging materials. Promote enterprises to strengthen the research and development of medicinal raw materials and packaging materials, and utilize new materials, new processes, and new technologies to improve the quality level. Through measures such as improving self-innovation capabilities and actively introducing advanced foreign technologies, promote technological upgrades, breakthrough key technologies such as purification and quality control, eliminate outdated technologies and production capacity, change the situation of partial dependence on imported medicinal raw materials and packaging materials, and meet the quality requirements of formulations. Strengthen the quality supervision of medicinal raw materials and packaging materials, and regularly publish inspection and sampling information on manufacturers.
titlelist: Improve the quality and efficacy of generic drugs, and enhance the quality of pharmaceutical raw materials and packaging materials.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: Greatly enhance the level of pharmaceutical equipment and intelligent manufacturing, improve the research and manufacturing capabilities and equipment performance of key equipment, promote the application of new technologies, optimize and improve process production management, strengthen comprehensive quality control, improve the level of key process control, and promote the resolution of bottlenecks that restrict product quality. Promote the informatization construction of drug production quality control, and realize real-time online monitoring of the production process. Improve the management system for enterprise production process changes.
titlelist: Improve the quality and efficacy of generic drugs, and enhance the level of process manufacturing.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: The centralized procurement organization for pharmaceuticals should compile a procurement catalog based on the generic names of drugs to promote equal competition between generic drugs and original drugs with the same quality and efficacy. For newly approved generic drugs, relevant departments should promptly compile procurement codes for public medical and health institutions. If the corresponding generic name drugs are already listed in the drug procurement catalog, the centralized procurement organization should promptly initiate the procurement process. If the corresponding generic name drugs are not listed in the drug procurement catalog, the centralized procurement organization should promptly evaluate and actively include them in the drug procurement catalog from the date of approval. Drugs subject to compulsory licensing of patents by the state shall be unconditionally included in the drug procurement catalogs of various regions.
titlelist: Improve support policies and promptly include them in the procurement catalog.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
