content: Include generic drugs that have the same quality and efficacy as the original research drugs in the list of interchangeable drugs with the original research drugs. This information should be indicated in the package insert and labels, and relevant information should be promptly disclosed to the public, facilitating the selection of drugs by medical personnel and patients. The health department and other relevant departments should strengthen pharmaceutical management, formulate policies and incentives to encourage the use of generic drugs, and increase supervision of clinical drug use. Strictly implement the requirement to prescribe drugs by their generic names. Except in special circumstances, brand names should not appear on prescriptions, as specifically regulated by the health department. Implement prescription review system, strengthen assessment of rational drug use in medical institutions, publicly disclose prescriptions of doctors who prescribe drugs irrationally, and establish a system for interviews. Strengthen the role of pharmacists in prescription review and drug dispensing. When providing medication to patients with AIDS or tuberculosis according to regulations, priority should be given to the procurement and use of generic drugs.
titlelist: Improve support policies to promote the use of generic drugs as substitutes.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: Accelerate the formulation of payment standards for medical insurance drugs, and pay generic drugs that are consistent with the quality and efficacy of original drugs according to the same standards. Establish and improve the dynamic adjustment mechanism for the basic medical insurance drug catalog, and promptly include eligible drugs in the catalog. For drugs in the basic medical insurance drug catalog, they shall not be limited by brand name or manufacturer, and the medical insurance information system shall be updated in a timely manner to ensure that approved generic drugs are included in the scope of medical insurance payment. Through the incentive and constraint mechanism of medical insurance payment, encourage medical institutions to use generic drugs.
titlelist: Improve supportive policies and leverage the incentive role of basic medical insurance.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: Implement tax preferential policies, and deduct the research and development expenses incurred by generic drug companies in the development of new technologies, new products, and new processes before corporate income tax in accordance with relevant regulations. Generic drug companies that have been identified as high-tech enterprises shall be subject to a reduced corporate income tax rate of 15%. The National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and other departments should increase support and promote technological transformation in generic drug companies. Encourage local governments to issue policies that support the transformation and upgrading of the generic drug industry based on local conditions, and further increase support. Continue to promote drug price reform, improve the mechanism for market-based drug pricing, and coordinate with reform policies on drug procurement and medical insurance payment. Adhere to classified drug procurement, highlight the clinical value of drugs, fully consider drug costs, and establish a purchasing price that is scientifically reasonable and encourages companies to improve drug quality. Strengthen drug price monitoring and early warning, and strictly crack down on illegal activities such as price monopolies in raw materials for drugs in accordance with the law.
titlelist: Improve support policies, implement tax incentives policies and price policies.

name: Opinions on Reforming and Improving the Policy for Supply Guarantee and Use of Generic Drugs (State Council Document No. [2018] 20) (State Council General Office/March 21, 2018)
content: In conjunction with the promotion of the major initiative of the Belt and Road construction, strengthen exchanges with relevant international organizations and countries, and accelerate the internationalization of drug research and development, registration, and market sales. Support enterprises in conducting international capacity cooperation and establish cross-border research and development cooperation platforms. Actively introduce advanced management experience and key technological processes, and encourage overseas companies to establish research and development centers and production bases in our country.
titlelist: Improve support policies and promote the internationalization of the generic drug industry.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Establish a professional curriculum system for traditional Chinese medicine with traditional Chinese medicine courses as the main focus, with Chinese medicine preceding Western medicine, and add courses on Chinese medicine for epidemic diseases. Support traditional Chinese medicine colleges and universities in selecting and cultivating outstanding students who have a deep foundation in traditional Chinese medicine culture and a passion for Chinese medicine. Strengthen the cultivation of Chinese medicine thinking and clinical skills, and make it a major component of student academic evaluation. Strengthen support for traditional Chinese medicine colleges and disciplines in the construction of Double First-Class universities. Establish approximately 100 first-class undergraduate programs in traditional Chinese medicine. Promote the construction of high-level professional groups in vocational colleges for traditional Chinese medicine. Strengthen the clinical teaching function of traditional Chinese medicine in affiliated hospitals of universities. (Responsibilities are held by the Ministry of Education, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, with the leading unit listed first, and so on).
titlelist: Consolidate the foundation of traditional Chinese medicine talents and improve the overall level of traditional Chinese medicine education.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Increase the multi-level apprenticeship education program, expand the scope and number of apprentices, and integrate apprenticeship education throughout the entire process of clinical practice teaching. Persist in promoting projects such as the inheritance of academic experience from renowned traditional Chinese medicine experts, training of outstanding traditional Chinese medicine clinical talents, and the establishment of inheritance studios. Performance-based salary distribution should be appropriately biased towards traditional Chinese medicine doctors who undertake apprenticeship tasks. In the national inheritance of academic experience from renowned traditional Chinese medicine experts, support qualified inheritors to apply for a traditional Chinese medicine degree examination with equivalent qualifications by using medical ancient texts instead of foreign languages, following the procedures (responsibilities of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Education, National Health Commission, and provincial governments).
titlelist: Strengthen the foundation of traditional Chinese medicine talents and persist in developing the education of traditional Chinese medicine inheritance.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Respect the research and development laws of traditional Chinese medicine, improve the classification and application requirements for the registration of traditional Chinese medicine. Optimize the evaluation and approval process for new drugs of traditional Chinese medicine that have human experience, and establish a management mechanism that exempts non-clinical safety studies and some clinical trials for eligible innovative traditional Chinese medicines, improved traditional Chinese medicines, ancient classic prescriptions, and drugs with the same name and formula, in accordance with the law and regulations. Make full use of modern techniques such as data science to establish an evidence-based system for the registration evaluation of traditional Chinese medicine, combining traditional Chinese medicine theory, human experience, and clinical trials, and actively explore the establishment of a real-world research evidence system for traditional Chinese medicine. Optimize the registration and approval process for complex formulations of traditional Chinese medicine based on ancient classic prescriptions. Improve the technical research and guidance principles for quality control throughout the entire process of new drugs of traditional Chinese medicine. (Responsibility of the National Medical Products Administration, National Health Commission, and State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Enhancing the vitality of the traditional Chinese medicine industry and improving the classification and registration management of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Encourage regions with conditions, capabilities, and willingness to take the lead, flexibly utilize local planning, land, pricing, insurance, and financing support policies, encourage and guide social investment, improve the competitiveness of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) clinical services, and create highlands for TCM health services, disciplines, and industry clusters. Include eligible TCM clinics in the construction of medical consortiums. Encourage eligible TCM clinics to form teams to provide family doctor contract services and charge service fees according to regulations. Encourage street communities to provide medical facilities free of charge for TCM clinics that provide family doctor services. (Responsibilities of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, the National Health Commission, and provincial-level governments).
titlelist: Enhance the development momentum of traditional Chinese medicine and increase social investment from multiple sources.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Actively support eligible traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) companies in their efforts to raise funds through initial public offerings (IPOs) and issue corporate credit bonds. Encourage social capital to establish TCM industry investment funds and increase long-term investment in the TCM industry. Encourage governments at all levels to support financing guarantee institutions in accordance with laws and regulations, and increase their guarantee support for bank loans to small and medium-sized enterprises in the TCM field. Support credit service agencies in enhancing their ability to collect and process credit information in the TCM industry, and encourage financial institutions to innovate financial products to support the development of TCM characteristics. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, the People's Bank of China, the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, the China Securities Regulatory Commission, and provincial-level governments).
titlelist: Enhance the development momentum of traditional Chinese medicine and strengthen support for financing channels.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: The organic, team-based, effective integrated Chinese and Western medicine model is gradually being promoted in general hospitals, infectious disease hospitals, specialized hospitals, and others. The allocation of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) physicians in clinical departments is strengthened, and integrated Chinese and Western medicine teams are established to carry out joint diagnosis and treatment. The principle of use TCM when appropriate, use Western medicine when necessary is followed, gradually establishing a multidisciplinary diagnosis and treatment system of Chinese and Western medicine. Collaboration between departments, hospitals, and medical consortiums in Chinese and Western medicine is encouraged. The effectiveness of integrated Chinese and Western medicine work is included in hospital grading and performance assessment. Clinical physicians in hospitals receive training in TCM knowledge to equip them with routine TCM diagnosis and treatment capabilities in their respective departments. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission and the State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Improve the system of integrating traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine, and innovate the model of integrated medical care combining traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of integrated Chinese and Western medicine disciplines (specialties). Carry out joint research on major difficult diseases, infectious diseases, chronic diseases, and other Chinese and Western medicine. Gradually establish evaluation standards for the clinical efficacy of integrated Chinese and Western medicine, and select and compile a catalog of advantageous diseases. Carry out pilot demonstrations, striving to develop around 100 integrated Chinese and Western medicine diagnosis and treatment plans within 5 years (Ministry of Science and Technology, National Health Commission, and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine are responsible).
titlelist: Improve the system of integrating traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine, and enhance the level of clinical research on the integration of traditional Chinese medicine and Western medicine.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Provincial and committee (bureau) jointly establish a number of national medical centers and regional medical centers in the field of traditional Chinese medicine (including integration of Chinese and Western medicine). Accelerate the construction of traditional Chinese medicine inheritance and innovation centers with strong clinical capabilities, rich traditional Chinese medicine culture, and optimized functional layout. Promote the expansion and balanced distribution of high-quality traditional Chinese medicine resources at the provincial and municipal levels, and build traditional Chinese medicine hospitals and departments with distinctive advantages in treating specific diseases. Rely on high-level traditional Chinese medicine hospitals to establish national traditional Chinese medicine epidemic prevention and control bases, create a number of emergency medical rescue bases, and strengthen the construction of infectious disease departments, respiratory disease departments, fever clinics, convertible infectious disease areas, convertible intensive care units, etc. Build flagship hospitals, flagship departments, and flagship primary healthcare institutions for collaborative Chinese and Western medicine. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, National Health Commission, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and provincial governments).
titlelist: Implement major projects for the development of traditional Chinese medicine, and strengthen the construction of the Chinese medicine healthcare service system.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of third-level biosafety laboratories in key areas of traditional Chinese medicine in an orderly manner. Establish national key laboratories focusing on key areas such as traditional Chinese medicine theory, traditional Chinese medicine resources, traditional Chinese medicine innovation, and evaluation of the efficacy of traditional Chinese medicine. Strengthen the construction of national science and technology innovation bases that serve the development of technical equipment in traditional Chinese medicine and the transformation and application of achievements. Establish 10-20 national clinical medical research centers for traditional Chinese medicine, focusing on advantageous diseases and characteristic therapies in traditional Chinese medicine. Construct a number of research support platforms for traditional Chinese medicine to respond to public health emergencies. (Responsibilities of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Science and Technology, National Health Commission, and Chinese Academy of Sciences).
titlelist: Implement major projects for the development of traditional Chinese medicine, and strengthen the construction of research platforms for traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Establish a health technology assessment system for traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) medical services based primarily on clinical value and technical labor value, and optimize the pricing policy for TCM medical services. Implement a dynamic adjustment mechanism for medical service prices, conduct price evaluation annually, and promptly adjust prices that meet the conditions for adjustment, taking into full consideration the characteristics of TCM medical services. Improve the tiered pricing policy, with a focus on including TCM medical service projects that have significant therapeutic effects, are widely accepted by patients, have prominent advantages, reflect labor value, and have a long history of application in the scope of price adjustment. TCM decoctions and TCM preparations used by medical institutions shall be priced independently, and those that meet the conditions shall be included in the scope of medical insurance payment as stipulated (responsibility of the National Healthcare Security Administration, National Health Commission, and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Improve the development efficiency of traditional Chinese medicine and perfect the pricing policy for traditional Chinese medicine services.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Strongly support the inclusion of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) medical services with advantages in efficacy and cost into the scope of basic medical insurance payment. Consider factors such as effectiveness and economy comprehensively, and reasonably determine the classification of the directory according to regulations. Explore payment methods for TCM that are in line with its characteristics, release a list of TCM advantage diseases, and encourage the implementation of the same effectiveness and price for both TCM and Western medicine for the same disease. General TCM diagnosis and treatment projects continue to be paid on a project basis. Encourage commercial insurance companies to launch TCM characteristic health insurance products and establish an information docking mechanism between insurance companies and TCM institutions. Support insurance companies and TCM institutions to cooperate in carrying out health management services. Strengthen the supervision of TCM services and expenses included in the scope of basic medical insurance payment. (Responsibilities of the National Healthcare Security Administration, National Health Commission, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Improve the development efficiency of traditional Chinese medicine, and establish sound management measures for traditional Chinese medicine medical insurance.

name: Several Policy Measures to Accelerate the Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Council Document [2021] No. 3) (State Council General Office/January 22, 2021)
content: Formulate guidelines for the examination of invention patents in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, further improve the quality of patent examination in the field of traditional Chinese medicine, and promote international patent applications for traditional Chinese medicine technology. Improve the protection system for trade secrets of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen appropriate confidentiality, enhance the commercial value of confidential information, and strengthen international protection. Under the geographical indication protection mechanism, ensure the protection and use of authentic medicinal materials. Explore the inclusion of traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces with unique processing methods in the scope of traditional Chinese medicine variety protection. (The State Administration for Market Regulation, the National Intellectual Property Administration, the State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and the National Medical Products Administration are responsible respectively).
titlelist: Create a favorable environment for the development of traditional Chinese medicine and strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Leverage the overall advantages of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) and integrative medicine, establish a TCM healthcare system with national TCM medical centers and regional TCM healthcare centers as the leading institutions, TCM departments in various levels and types of medical institutions as the backbone, and primary healthcare institutions as the foundation. This system should integrate preventive care, disease treatment, and rehabilitation, providing TCM services that cover the entire population and lifespan. Adhering to the development laws of TCM, standardize the establishment of TCM hospital departments, revise the standards for setting up and constructing TCM hospitals, improve evaluation and performance assessment systems, strengthen the hospital management model and service functions centered around TCM services, and establish a modern hospital management system that reflects the characteristics of TCM. Vigorously develop TCM clinics, outpatient departments, and specialized TCM hospitals, and encourage chain operations. Enterprises providing TCM health preservation services should register their business scope as TCM health preservation services (non-medical) in a standardized manner. By 2022, strive to achieve full coverage of county-level TCM medical institutions and aim to have TCM clinics and TCM physicians in all community health service centers and township health clinics.
titlelist: Strengthen the Chinese medicine service system and enhance the construction of Chinese medicine service institutions.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Expand the scale of targeted free training for TCM (Traditional Chinese Medicine) medical students in rural areas, actively recruit TCM doctors in the special post plan for general practitioners, encourage the implementation of the county management, township utilization policy for TCM personnel, encourage retired TCM doctors to provide services at the grassroots level, and relax the promotion criteria for TCM doctors serving long-term at the grassroots level. Improve the training mechanism for TCM knowledge and skills for general practitioners and rural doctors. Support TCM hospitals in leading the formation of medical consortia. TCM hospitals at all levels should strengthen guidance for TCM services at the grassroots level.
titlelist: Establish a sound Chinese medicine service system and strengthen the foundation of primary-level Chinese medicine service.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Implement the Internet Plus Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Health Services initiative, establish a basic database with a focus on TCM electronic medical records and electronic prescriptions, encourage the development of internet-based TCM hospitals based on medical institutions, develop TCM intelligent auxiliary diagnosis and treatment systems, and promote integrated online and offline services and remote medical services. Utilize existing resources to establish national and provincial TCM data centers. Accelerate the establishment of a comprehensive statistical system for TCM at the national level. Improve the comprehensive regulatory information system for TCM, comprehensively utilize methods such as random inspections, targeted monitoring, and punishment for illegal and dishonest behavior, to achieve precise and efficient regulation.
titlelist: Build a sound traditional Chinese medicine service system, with information technology supporting the construction of the service system.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Strengthen the construction of specialized departments in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), optimize and enhance the specialties of orthopedics, proctology, pediatrics, dermatology, gynecology, acupuncture, massage, as well as cardiovascular diseases, kidney diseases, peripheral vascular diseases, and other specialized diseases. Timely summarize and develop diagnosis and treatment plans, consolidate and expand advantages, and promote distinctive development. Accelerate the construction of evidence-based medicine centers for TCM, select 50 TCM treatment advantages, 100 suitable techniques, and 100 unique Chinese medicine varieties within about 3 years, and promptly release them to the society. Focus on cancer, cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, infectious diseases, Alzheimer's disease, and antibiotic resistance issues, and carry out collaborative efforts between TCM and Western medicine. By 2022, form and promote around 50 integrated diagnosis and treatment plans combining TCM and Western medicine. Establish comprehensive hospitals and specialized hospitals, implement a system of TCM consultation in multi-disciplinary consultations, and incorporate TCM into the multi-disciplinary consultation system. Establish effective mechanisms to better utilize TCM in the prevention and control of new and emerging infectious diseases such as influenza and in public health emergency response.
titlelist: Give full play to the unique role of traditional Chinese medicine in safeguarding and promoting people's health, and highlight the advantages of traditional Chinese medicine in disease treatment.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Combine the implementation of the Healthy China Action and promote the upgrading of the Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Health Project for Preventive Treatment. Enrich the content of TCM preventive treatment in the national basic public health service projects, encourage family doctors to provide TCM preventive treatment contract services, and promote 20 TCM preventive treatment intervention programs among key populations and chronic disease patients by 2022. Vigorously popularize TCM health knowledge and health preservation methods such as Tai Chi and Qigong (such as the Eight Section Brocade), and promote health work and lifestyle that embody the concept of TCM preventive treatment.
titlelist: Give full play to the unique role of traditional Chinese medicine in safeguarding and promoting people's health, and strengthen the role of traditional Chinese medicine in disease prevention.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Promote the integration of traditional Chinese medicine, traditional Chinese sports, and modern rehabilitation technology, and develop Chinese characteristic rehabilitation medicine. Implement the project to enhance the rehabilitation service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine. Relying on existing resources, establish a number of traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation centers, strengthen the construction of rehabilitation departments in traditional Chinese medicine hospitals, and promote the use of traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation techniques in other hospitals. Develop and promote a number of traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation programs for chronic diseases such as cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, diabetes, disabilities, etc., and promote the research and development of traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation equipment. Carry out training vigorously and promote the integration of traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation techniques into communities, households, and institutions.
titlelist: Give full play to the unique role of traditional Chinese medicine in safeguarding and promoting people's health, and enhance the rehabilitation capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Strengthen the research and utilization of classical texts, compile the Chinese Medical Collection, establish a directory of traditional Chinese medicine classics, techniques, and formula names, establish a national digital library of ancient Chinese medical books and traditional knowledge, and research and formulate regulations for the protection of traditional Chinese medicine knowledge. Accelerate the promotion of living heritage, improve the academic inheritance system, strengthen the inheritance of academic experience of renowned senior Chinese medicine practitioners and traditional skills of experienced pharmaceutical workers, and achieve digital and visual recording. Collect and select folk prescriptions, secret formulas, and techniques of traditional Chinese medicine, establish mechanisms for cooperation, development, and benefit sharing. Promote the development of Chinese medicine museums, implement actions to promote the dissemination of Chinese medicine culture, integrate Chinese medicine culture into national education, further enrich the cultural education of Chinese medicine in primary and secondary schools, and make Chinese medicine a cultural consciousness for the masses to promote health.
titlelist: Promote the inheritance and open innovation development of traditional Chinese medicine, and explore and inherit the essence and quintessence of traditional Chinese medicine treasures.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Integrate traditional Chinese medicine into the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind and the international cooperation of the Belt and Road Initiative, and implement special projects for international cooperation in traditional Chinese medicine. Promote the establishment of international standards for traditional Chinese medicine, and actively participate in the formulation of international rules for traditional medicine. Promote the overseas dissemination of traditional Chinese medicine culture. Vigorously develop trade in traditional Chinese medicine services. Encourage social forces to establish a number of high-quality overseas centers, international cooperation bases, and service export bases for traditional Chinese medicine. Research and promote the steady development of international transactions on existing Chinese herbal medicine trading platforms. Build a highland for traditional Chinese medicine in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Strengthen exchanges and cooperation in traditional Chinese medicine with Taiwan, and promote the integrated development of traditional Chinese medicine across the Taiwan Strait.
titlelist: Promote the inheritance and open innovation development of traditional Chinese medicine, and promote the open development of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Guided by clinical value, with a focus on providing services and distinctive services based on the advantages of traditional Chinese medicine, efforts will be made to increase policy support and improve the mechanism for determining medical service prices. When adjusting medical service prices, particular attention will be given to considering the value of medical personnel's technical labor in services such as traditional Chinese medicine. A payment method for medical insurance that aligns with the characteristics of traditional Chinese medicine will be established. The coding system for traditional Chinese medicine diseases and syndromes will be improved to align with international disease classifications. Selected disease types with obvious advantages in traditional Chinese medicine, clear treatment pathways, and clear costs will be implemented with payment based on disease types, and reasonable payment standards will be determined. By implementing payment per capita for certain chronic diseases and improving relevant technical specifications, grassroots medical and health institutions will be encouraged and guided to provide appropriate traditional Chinese medicine services. Qualified traditional Chinese medicine medical institutions will be promptly included in designated medical institutions for medical insurance. Appropriate traditional Chinese medicine medical service projects and Chinese herbal medicines will be included in the scope of medical insurance according to regulations. Commercial insurance institutions will be encouraged to develop insurance products related to preventive treatment in traditional Chinese medicine. The work related to the markup of Chinese herbal medicine pieces will be studied for cancellation.
titlelist: Reform and improve the management system and mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine, improve the pricing and medical insurance policies for traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Opinions of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the State Council on Promoting the Inheritance, Innovation, and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (October 20, 2019)
content: Establish a sustainable and stable diversified investment mechanism for the development of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), and coordinate and allocate funds for the development of TCM in health investment, while increasing support. Increase investment in the development of TCM, improve the conditions of TCM hospitals, and expand the supply of high-quality services. Effectively ensure the implementation of investment responsibilities in public TCM hospitals. Encourage local governments to establish government-guided, social capital participation, and market-oriented TCM development funds. Guide commercial insurance institutions to invest in the TCM service industry.
titlelist: Reform and improve the management system and mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine, and improve the mechanism for ensuring investment.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Comprehensively establish a network of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) medical institutions, with TCM hospitals as the main body and integrated hospitals as well as other types of hospitals having TCM departments as the backbone. This network should also include primary healthcare institutions as the foundation, TCM outpatient departments and clinics as supplements, and cover both urban and rural areas. Local governments at or above the county level should reasonably allocate TCM medical resources in regional health planning. In principle, one municipal TCM hospital and one county-level TCM hospital should be established in each prefecture-level region and county-level region. TCM departments should also be set up in comprehensive hospitals, maternal and child health institutions, and other non-TCM medical institutions. TCM clinics and TCM comprehensive service areas such as TCM halls should be established in township health centers and community health service centers, and efforts should be made to strengthen the allocation of TCM equipment and personnel. The construction of rehabilitation departments in TCM hospitals should be strengthened, and TCM departments should be set up in rehabilitation hospitals to enhance the deployment of TCM rehabilitation professionals.
titlelist: Key tasks: effectively improve the medical service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine, and perfect the network of traditional Chinese medicine medical services covering urban and rural areas.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Implement the project of cultivating the advantages of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) in clinical practice, strengthen the construction of influential provincial or municipal TCM hospitals with strong scientific research capabilities within the region. Establish a coordination mechanism for TCM participation in emergency response networks and emergency treatment of public health incidents, and improve the emergency treatment and prevention capabilities of TCM for major infectious diseases. Continuously implement the project to enhance the service capabilities of TCM at the grassroots level, improve the diagnosis and treatment capabilities of TCM specialty diseases in county-level TCM hospitals and primary healthcare institutions, and enhance the comprehensive service capabilities of TCM. Establish a monitoring and information management system for TCM in chronic disease management, promote the integration of TCM content into community health management models, carry out TCM health interventions for high-risk populations, and improve the level of TCM health management at the grassroots level. Vigorously develop non-pharmacological TCM therapies and fully leverage their unique role in the prevention and treatment of common diseases, prevalent diseases, and chronic diseases. Establish a comprehensive network and working mechanism for the prevention and treatment of chronic diseases, with collaboration between TCM hospitals, primary healthcare institutions, and disease prevention and control institutions, and accelerate the establishment of a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment order for acute and chronic diseases.
titlelist: Key tasks: effectively improve the medical service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine, and enhance the disease prevention and treatment capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Utilize modern science and technology to promote the integration, complementary advantages, and collaborative innovation of Chinese and Western medicine resources. Strengthen the construction of innovative research platforms for the integration of Chinese and Western medicine, enhance clinical collaboration between Chinese and Western medicine, carry out joint research on major difficult diseases, and develop unique Chinese and Western medicine combination diagnosis and treatment plans to improve the clinical efficacy of major difficult diseases and critical illnesses. Explore the establishment and improvement of the national mechanism and model for collaborative work between Chinese and Western medicine in tackling major difficult diseases, and enhance the service capabilities of Chinese and Western medicine integration. Actively create conditions for the construction of integrated Chinese and Western medicine hospitals. Improve policies and measures for the training of talents in Chinese and Western medicine integration, establish a more comprehensive system for Western medicine practitioners to learn traditional Chinese medicine, encourage Western medicine practitioners to leave their positions to study traditional Chinese medicine, and strengthen the training of high-level talents in Chinese and Western medicine integration.
titlelist: Key tasks: effectively improve the medical service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine and promote the integration of traditional Chinese and Western medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Include the development of ethnic medicine in the economic and social development plans of ethnic regions and autonomous areas, strengthen the construction of ethnic medical institutions, support the establishment of ethnic medical hospitals in eligible autonomous areas, encourage the establishment of ethnic medicine departments in various medical and health institutions in ethnic regions, and encourage the establishment of ethnic medical hospitals and clinics by social forces. Strengthen the inheritance protection, theoretical research, and rescue and compilation of literature in ethnic medicine. Promote the construction of ethnic medicine standards, improve the quality of ethnic medicine, increase development and promotion efforts, and promote the development of the ethnic medicine industry.
titlelist: Key tasks, effectively improving the medical service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine, promoting the development of ethnic medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Reform the qualifications, scope of practice, and management system for TCM medical practitioners. Implement classified management based on professional skills exploration. For those who establish TCM clinics, a record management system will be implemented in accordance with the law. Reform the qualification admission system for traditional medical practitioners with inherited knowledge and expertise, allowing TCM professionals who have obtained a certificate to practice as rural doctors to open TCM clinics in towns and villages. Encourage the establishment of chain TCM medical institutions by social forces. There are no restrictions on the layout of medical institution settings and regional health development plans for TCM outpatient departments and clinics that only provide traditional Chinese medicine services by social capital. Support qualified TCM professionals, especially renowned TCM doctors, in opening TCM outpatient departments and clinics. Encourage pharmaceutical companies to establish TCM clinics. Ensure that privately-run and government-run TCM medical institutions enjoy equal rights in terms of admission and practice.
titlelist: Key tasks: effectively improve the medical service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine and relax the access requirements for traditional Chinese medicine services.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Vigorously develop new medical service models such as telemedicine, mobile healthcare, and smart healthcare in traditional Chinese medicine. Build a healthcare information sharing service system that integrates medical imaging, laboratory reports, and other health records. Gradually establish a cross-hospital standard system for sharing and exchanging traditional Chinese medicine medical data. Explore the application of internet-based traditional Chinese medicine medical services such as extending medical advice and electronic prescriptions. Utilize information technologies such as mobile internet to provide convenient services such as online appointment scheduling, waiting reminders, pricing and payment, diagnosis and treatment report inquiries, and medicine delivery.
titlelist: Key tasks: effectively improve the medical service capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine and promote the 'Internet+' integration of traditional Chinese medicine and medical services.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Research and formulate policy measures to promote the development of traditional Chinese medicine health preservation services, support social forces in establishing traditional Chinese medicine health preservation institutions, and achieve group development or chain operation. Implement the Traditional Chinese Medicine Health Project to prevent and treat diseases, strengthen the construction of preventive and treatment departments in traditional Chinese medicine hospitals, provide preventive and treatment services such as traditional Chinese medicine health consultation, intervention and regulation, and follow-up management for the public, and explore a traditional Chinese medicine health guarantee model that integrates health culture, health management, and health insurance. Encourage traditional Chinese medicine hospitals and traditional Chinese medicine practitioners to provide technical support such as health consultation, regulation, and medicinal diet for traditional Chinese medicine health preservation institutions.
titlelist: Key tasks: vigorously develop traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and healthcare services, accelerate the construction of the traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and healthcare service system.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Encourage traditional Chinese medicine medical institutions and health preservation institutions to enter government agencies, schools, enterprises, communities, rural areas, and households, promoting the popularization of knowledge on traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and easy-to-master therapeutic techniques and methods such as Tui Na massage. Encourage traditional Chinese medicine institutions to fully utilize modern scientific and technological advancements such as biology, bionics, and artificial intelligence to develop a range of health food, health products, and health equipment. Accelerate the construction of the technology system and industrial system for preventing diseases with traditional Chinese medicine. Promote the integration of the concept of preventing diseases with traditional Chinese medicine into health work and lifestyle.
titlelist: Key tasks: vigorously develop traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and healthcare services, enhance the capacity of traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and healthcare services.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Promote the integrated development of traditional Chinese medicine and elderly care, and facilitate the entry of TCM medical resources into elderly care institutions, communities, and households. Support the collaboration between elderly care institutions and TCM medical institutions, establish fast-track green channels for medical consultations, and encourage TCM medical institutions to provide home visits, health check-ups, and health consultation services for the elderly. Encourage TCM doctors to provide health consultation and conditioning services in elderly care institutions. Encourage social capital to establish nursing homes and recuperation centers with a focus on TCM health care for the elderly, explore the establishment of TCM medicine and health care combined institutions, and build a number of demonstration bases for the integration of medical and elderly care.
titlelist: Key tasks: vigorously develop traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and healthcare services, and develop traditional Chinese medicine health and elderly care services.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Promote the organic integration of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) health services and the tourism industry, develop TCM health tourism with a focus on the dissemination and experience of TCM culture, integrating TCM medical care, rehabilitation, health preservation, cultural dissemination, business exhibitions, TCM material scientific research, and tourism. Develop TCM health tourism products and routes with regional characteristics, establish a number of national TCM health tourism demonstration bases and TCM health tourism complexes. Strengthen the development and production of TCM cultural tourism products. Establish a standardized system for TCM health tourism, promote standardization and specialization of TCM health tourism services. Hold the China TCM Health Tourism Year and support the organization of international TCM health tourism exhibitions, conferences, and forums.
titlelist: Key tasks: vigorously develop traditional Chinese medicine health preservation and healthcare services, and promote the development of traditional Chinese medicine health tourism services.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Implement the project of inheriting traditional Chinese medicine, comprehensively and systematically inheriting the academic theories, schools, and doctrines of various generations, comprehensively and systematically inheriting the academic thoughts and clinical experience of contemporary famous old Chinese medicine experts, summarizing the basic clinical diagnosis and treatment rules of advantageous diseases in traditional Chinese medicine. Include the compilation of ancient Chinese medical literature in the national project of compiling Chinese classics, conduct a comprehensive survey of ancient Chinese medical literature resources, rescue endangered and precious ancient Chinese medical literature, promote the digitization of ancient Chinese medical literature, compile and publish the Chinese Medical Collection, and strengthen the reproduction and repatriation of overseas ancient Chinese medical literature.
titlelist: Key tasks, solidly promote the inheritance of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the inheritance of traditional Chinese medicine theories and methods.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Establish a database, directory, and system for the protection of traditional Chinese medicine knowledge. Strengthen the screening of clinical diagnosis and treatment techniques, health preservation techniques, and rehabilitation techniques in traditional Chinese medicine, and improve the directory of medical techniques and operational standards. Enhance the inheritance and application of traditional pharmaceutical, identification, processing techniques, and the experience of veteran herbalists. Conduct investigations, excavation, organization, research evaluation, and promotion of folk characteristic diagnosis and treatment techniques in traditional Chinese medicine. Strengthen the protection of century-old famous brands in traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Key tasks, solidly promote the inheritance of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the protection of traditional Chinese medicine knowledge and the exploration of techniques.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Establish a system for the inheritance and education of traditional Chinese medicine practitioners, fully integrating the inheritance education into university education, post-graduation education, and continuing education. Encourage medical institutions to develop inheritance education, achieving normalization and institutionalization of inheritance education. Establish a management system for traditional Chinese medicine practitioners. Strengthen the inheritance work of renowned traditional Chinese medicine experts. Establish facilities to attract and encourage renowned traditional Chinese medicine experts and long-term grassroots service traditional Chinese medicine experts through the apprenticeship model. Cultivate multi-level backbone talents in traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Key tasks, solidly promote the inheritance of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the education of traditional Chinese medicine apprenticeship.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Establish a collaborative innovation system and mechanism for traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) with national and provincial TCM research institutions as the core, higher education institutions, medical institutions, and enterprises as the main bodies, and TCM scientific research bases (platforms) as the support. This system should involve multiple disciplines and departments, and improve the scientific and technological layout in the field of TCM. Coordinate the use of relevant scientific and technological plans (special projects, funds, etc.) to support TCM-related scientific and technological innovation work, promote the improvement of TCM scientific and technological innovation capabilities, accelerate the formation of independent intellectual property rights, and promote the intellectual property, commercialization, and industrialization of innovative achievements in TCM.
titlelist: Key tasks, focus on promoting innovation in traditional Chinese medicine, and improve the collaborative innovation system of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: By using modern scientific and technological methods as well as traditional Chinese medicine research methods, we aim to deepen the study of the basic theories of Chinese medicine, the methods of syndrome differentiation and treatment, and conduct research on the specificity of acupoints, the mechanism of acupuncture treatment, the theory of medicinal properties of Chinese herbs, the compatibility theory of herbal formulas, the material basis and mechanism of action of compound Chinese medicine, etc. We aim to establish a clear and rational theoretical framework. We will strengthen collaborative research on major difficult diseases and the prevention and treatment of major infectious diseases, as well as research on the prevention and treatment of common diseases, prevalent diseases, and chronic diseases using traditional Chinese medicine. We aim to develop a number of significant products and technological achievements for the prevention and treatment of major diseases and the maintenance of health. By integrating modern scientific and technological means, we will develop a number of diagnostic and therapeutic instruments and equipment based on traditional Chinese medicine theories. We will explore new models for the development of new drugs that are suitable for the characteristics of Chinese medicine and promote the creation of major new drugs. We will encourage the development of new Chinese medicines based on classical prescriptions, Chinese medicine preparations in medical institutions, etc. We will search for new candidate drugs in Chinese medicine resources targeting new drug targets for diseases.
titlelist: Key tasks, focus on promoting innovation in traditional Chinese medicine, and strengthen scientific research in traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Implement the project for the conservation of wild Chinese medicinal resources, improve the system for the classification and protection of Chinese medicinal resources, establish protected areas for endangered wild medicinal plants and animals, as well as cultivation bases for wild Chinese medicinal resources and endangered and scarce medicinal plants. Strengthen the protection and breeding research of rare and endangered wild medicinal plants and animals. Establish a national gene bank for medicinal plants and animals. Establish a system for the investigation of Chinese medicinal resources combining surveys and dynamic monitoring. Further improve the reserve of Chinese medicinal materials and medicinal slices in the national medical reserve. Encourage investment from social forces to establish Chinese medicinal science and technology parks, museums, and botanical gardens as conservation bases. Explore the construction of ecological and economic demonstration zones for the cultivation of Chinese medicinal materials in desertification areas.
titlelist: Key tasks, comprehensively enhance the development level of the traditional Chinese medicine industry, strengthen the protection and utilization of traditional Chinese medicine resources.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Promote the digitization, networking, and intelligent construction of the traditional Chinese medicine industry, strengthen technology integration and process innovation, improve the level of traditional Chinese medicine equipment manufacturing, accelerate the standardization and modernization of traditional Chinese medicine production processes, enhance the application of intellectual property rights in the traditional Chinese medicine industry, and gradually form large-scale traditional Chinese medicine enterprise groups and industrial clusters. With the support of the modernization of traditional Chinese medicine science and technology industrial base, implement the action plan for entrepreneurs in the traditional Chinese medicine health industry, and promote the integration and development of the first, second, and third industries of traditional Chinese medicine. Carry out post-market evaluation of traditional Chinese patent medicines, increase efforts in secondary development of traditional Chinese patent medicines, conduct large-scale and standardized clinical trials, and cultivate a group of internationally competitive famous traditional Chinese medicines. Develop a batch of traditional Chinese medicine manufacturing machinery and equipment, improve the technological level and scale efficiency of the traditional Chinese medicine manufacturing industry. Promote the implementation of the action plan for standardization of traditional Chinese medicine, and build a high-quality product standard system for the entire chain of the traditional Chinese medicine industry. Implement the green manufacturing project of traditional Chinese medicine, form a diverse emerging green industry system, gradually reduce the use of heavy metals and their compounds, strictly implement the Water Pollutant Discharge Standard for Pharmaceutical Industry of Traditional Chinese Medicine (GB21906-2008), and establish a green manufacturing system for traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Key tasks, comprehensively improving the development level of the traditional Chinese medicine industry, promoting the transformation and upgrading of the traditional Chinese medicine industry.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Develop a plan for the construction of the traditional Chinese medicine circulation system, and establish a number of standardized, intensive, large-scale, and traceable initial processing and warehousing logistics centers for authentic medicinal materials, closely connected with production enterprise supplier management and quality traceability systems. Promote the development of e-commerce for traditional Chinese medicinal materials. Utilize big data to strengthen the collection of information on traditional Chinese medicine production, monitor and analyze price dynamics, and provide forecasting and early warning. Implement the traditional Chinese medicine quality assurance project, establish a quality management and traceability system for the entire process of traditional Chinese medicine production and circulation, and strengthen the construction of third-party testing platforms.
titlelist: Key tasks, comprehensively improve the development level of the traditional Chinese medicine industry, and build a modern traditional Chinese medicine circulation system.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Vigorously promote the concept of great doctors with sincerity, strengthen the construction of professional ethics, and form a good industry atmosphere. Implement the project to enhance the cultural literacy of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the protection of cultural relics and intangible cultural heritage of traditional Chinese medicine, and promote more non-pharmaceutical traditional Chinese medical diagnostic and treatment techniques to be included in the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage List and the national-level Intangible Cultural Heritage List, allowing more ancient Chinese medical classics to be included in the Memory of the World Register. Promote the international dissemination of traditional Chinese medicine culture, showcase the unique charm of Chinese culture, and enhance our country's cultural soft power.
titlelist: Key task: vigorously promote the culture of traditional Chinese medicine and foster the prosperous development of traditional Chinese medicine culture.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Promote the integration and development of traditional Chinese medicine and the cultural industry, and explore the inclusion of traditional Chinese medicine culture in the development plan of the cultural industry. Create a batch of creative products and cultural masterpieces that carry traditional Chinese medicine culture. Facilitate the effective integration of traditional Chinese medicine with radio, film and television, news publishing, digital publishing, animation and gaming, tourism and catering, sports and performing arts, and develop new cultural products and services. Cultivate a group of well-known brands and enterprises to enhance the level of integration and development between traditional Chinese medicine and the cultural industry.
titlelist: Key task: vigorously promote traditional Chinese medicine culture and develop the traditional Chinese medicine cultural industry.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Deepen exchanges and cooperation with governments of various countries, the World Health Organization, the International Organization for Standardization, etc., actively participate in the research and formulation of international rules and standards, and create an international environment conducive to the overseas development of traditional Chinese medicine. Implement projects for the overseas development of traditional Chinese medicine, promote the international acceptance of traditional Chinese medicine technologies, drugs, standards, and services, based on the principles of government support, private operation, local service, and mutual benefit. Explore the establishment of a number of overseas centers for traditional Chinese medicine. Support traditional Chinese medicine institutions to fully participate in global cooperation and competition in various fields of traditional Chinese medicine, and play the role of traditional Chinese medicine social organizations. Further increase the content of traditional Chinese medicine services in foreign medical aid. Promote multi-level international education exchanges and cooperation in traditional Chinese medicine, attract more overseas students to China for academic education, non-academic education, short-term training, and clinical internships, and make traditional Chinese medicine a shining business card for cultural exchanges and people-to-people connectivity between China and foreign countries.
titlelist: Key tasks, actively promoting the overseas development of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthening the international exchange and cooperation of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Include international trade of traditional Chinese medicine in the overall strategy for foreign trade development, establish a policy support system, break through legal, policy barriers, and technological barriers that restrict the development of traditional Chinese medicine in foreign trade, strengthen international protection of intellectual property rights in traditional Chinese medicine, and expand international market access for traditional Chinese medicine service trade. Support traditional Chinese medicine institutions in participating in the Belt and Road Initiative, expand foreign investment and trade in traditional Chinese medicine. Provide comprehensive public resource guarantees for the development of traditional Chinese medicine service trade. Encourage traditional Chinese medicine institutions to establish traditional Chinese medicine hospitals, chain clinics, and traditional Chinese medicine health care institutions overseas. Support the development of overseas resources for Chinese herbal medicine and strengthen the quality management of overseas production and circulation of Chinese herbal medicine. Encourage traditional Chinese medicine enterprises to go global, accelerate the development of multinational companies and well-known international brands that provide services throughout the entire industry chain. Actively develop inbound Chinese medicine health tourism, undertake outsourcing of Chinese medicine medical services, and strengthen overall promotion and promotion of traditional Chinese medicine service trade to the outside world.
titlelist: Key tasks, actively promoting the overseas development of traditional Chinese medicine, expanding international trade in traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: To ensure the quality and safety of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) services, we will implement the TCM standardization project, with a focus on developing, promoting, and applying TCM clinical diagnosis and treatment guidelines, technical operation specifications, and efficacy evaluation standards. We will systematically develop standards for TCM preventive treatment, medicinal diet production, and TCM health products. We will improve the TCM quality standard system, strengthen TCM quality management, and focus on standardizing TCM processing, identification, formulations, granules, and authentic medicinal materials. We will accelerate the digitalization of TCM standards and the construction of TCM specimen standards. We will also expedite the transformation of domestic standards into international standards. We will strengthen the supervision system for TCM and establish an information data platform for TCM supervision. We will promote TCM certification management and leverage the supervision role of social forces.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improving the standard system of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Implement the government's investment policy in the traditional Chinese medicine industry. Reform the pricing mechanism of traditional Chinese medicine, reasonably determine the fees and prices for traditional Chinese medical services, reduce the inflated prices of Chinese patent medicines, and eliminate the mechanism of using medicine to compensate for medical expenses. Continue to implement the policy of adding a markup to traditional Chinese medicine decoctions. Further increase the number of Chinese patent medicine varieties in the national essential drug list and continuously improve the quality of Chinese patent medicines in the national essential drug list. Local governments at all levels should consider the development needs of traditional Chinese medicine in overall land use planning and urban-rural planning, and expand the supply of land for traditional Chinese medical services, health preservation and elderly care services in traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Enhance support for traditional Chinese medicine policies and strengthen protective measures.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: Establish a sound system for the cultivation of talents in traditional Chinese medicine, which includes the integration of education in universities, post-graduate education, continuing education, and apprenticeship education. Focus on cultivating leading talents in key disciplines of traditional Chinese medicine, key specialties, and clinical research in traditional Chinese medicine. Strengthen the cultivation of general practitioners, grassroots talents in traditional Chinese medicine, as well as talents in ethnic medicine and integrated traditional Chinese and Western medicine. Provide training in traditional Chinese medicine knowledge and skills for clinical physicians and rural doctors. Establish a series of professional skills for traditional Chinese medicine practitioners and reasonably set up positions for traditional Chinese medicine health service skills. Deepen the reform of traditional Chinese medicine education, establish a certification system for traditional Chinese medicine professionals, explore talent cultivation models that adapt to the classification and management of traditional Chinese medicine practitioners, strengthen the construction of key disciplines in traditional Chinese medicine, encourage ethnic regions and higher education institutions with conditions to establish ethnic medicine programs, and carry out postgraduate education in ethnic medicine, and build a group of world-class prestigious traditional Chinese medicine schools and disciplines. Improve the system for selecting and commending national masters of traditional Chinese medicine and perfect the evaluation mechanism for traditional Chinese medicine talents. Establish mechanisms to attract and retain talents in grassroots traditional Chinese medicine and provide long-term incentives and guarantees.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the construction of the Chinese medicine talent team.

name: Outline of the Development Strategy and Planning for Traditional Chinese Medicine (2016-2030) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2016] No. 15) (State Council/February 22, 2016)
content: According to the work deployment of health and medical big data application, strengthen the application of traditional Chinese medicine big data in the Healthy China Cloud Service Plan. Strengthen the construction of information infrastructure in traditional Chinese medicine hospitals and improve the information systems of traditional Chinese medicine hospitals. Establish a network verification mechanism for the authenticity and effectiveness of patient prescriptions, achieve vertical and horizontal integration with population health information. Improve the construction of traditional Chinese medicine information statistics system and establish a national comprehensive statistical network reporting system for traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote the informatization construction of traditional Chinese medicine
