content: Improve the quality of key products. Continuously carry out consistency evaluation of generic drugs, steadily promote consistency evaluation of oral solid preparations and injections, and increase the coverage of evaluated varieties. Urge enterprises to strictly manage quality and ensure that the quality of evaluated varieties remains stable and meets the requirements. Take improving the stability and controllability of traditional Chinese medicine as the core goal, improve the control level of the manufacturing process of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the supervision of the entire production and circulation process, and systematically promote the improvement of the quality of traditional Chinese medicine. Improve the standard system and quality specifications of pharmaceutical excipients and packaging materials, and promote the effective fulfillment of requirements such as consistency evaluation of generic drugs and internationalization of formulations. Accelerate the quality upgrade of medical devices and improve the stability and reliability of products. Strengthen the construction of quality brands and develop a batch of branded products in segmented fields. Strengthen the main responsibility of enterprises for quality. Strengthen the quality awareness of enterprises, promote enterprises to strengthen the construction of quality systems under the holder system of marketing authorization, and implement the main responsibility for the quality of the entire life cycle of products. Strengthen self-management of enterprises, strictly implement research and development, production, and operation quality management standards, improve quality measurement and risk assessment systems, accelerate the establishment of systems such as post-marketing research, product traceability, and monitoring reports of adverse reactions (events), and ensure controllable quality throughout the process. Improve the quality supervision system. Strengthen the construction of regulatory laws and regulations, accelerate the formulation and revision of supporting regulations and rules in accordance with the Drug Administration Law, Vaccine Administration Law, and Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Medical Devices. Continuously implement the action plan to improve drug and medical device standards, enhance the overall level of national drug standards and medical device standards, and promote international coordination of standards. Accelerate the formulation of medical device standards for artificial intelligence medical devices, new biomaterials, and new molecular diagnostic reagents. Strengthen the inspection and verification of high-risk varieties such as vaccines, newly launched products, and products selected in national centralized procurement, promote digital intelligent supervision, and further ensure the safety of public medication. Column 4: Product Quality Upgrade Project.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system and continuously improve the quality and safety level.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Continue to implement incentive policies to stimulate the enthusiasm of enterprises to carry out consistency evaluation of generic drugs, gradually eliminate quality differences of the same variety; support enterprises to carry out consistency evaluation of essential drugs, small variety drugs, etc.; encourage eligible enterprises to take the lead in carrying out consistency evaluation of other dosage forms of products, apart from oral solid preparations and injections.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of the pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system, continuously improve the quality and safety level, and enhance the quality of generic drugs.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Guide the construction of standardized and large-scale production bases for traditional Chinese medicinal materials, strengthen the construction of traceability systems for traditional Chinese medicinal materials, gradually solve the problem of inconsistent quality of traditional Chinese medicinal materials, and improve the quality of traditional Chinese medicine from the source. Strengthen the application of new formulation technology, quality evaluation technology, and quality control methods in the research and development and production of new traditional Chinese medicines, and further improve the quality of traditional Chinese medicine products. Promote enterprises to continue conducting post-market research on products, improve the level of quality control, strengthen safety and efficacy evaluation, and systematically improve the quality of traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of the pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system, continuously improve the quality and safety level, and implement the Chinese medicine quality improvement project.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Promote the implementation of the main responsibility of enterprises for drug and medical device vigilance. Based on the national adverse drug reaction monitoring system, actively explore the implementation of proactive monitoring work, establish a convenient reporting and user-friendly national drug and medical device vigilance information system, and strengthen data sharing and feedback, risk warning and identification.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system, continuously improve the quality and safety level, and construct a drug and medical device alert system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Encourage enterprises to actively participate in the evaluation of the China Quality Award, Quality Benchmark, and other quality honors. Support industry associations in conducting the selection of pharmaceutical enterprise management awards, and leverage the leading role of excellent quality enterprises to promote self-regulation and self-management within the industry.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system, continuously improve quality and safety levels, and cultivate quality benchmark enterprises.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Empower pharmaceutical research and development with new generation information technology. Explore the application of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data, and other technologies in the field of research and development, improve the efficiency of discovering new targets and new drugs through mining and analysis of biological data, and simulation calculations. Strengthen the application of information technology in experimental animal model construction, drug design, pharmacology and efficacy research, clinical trials, data analysis, etc., to shorten the research and development cycle and reduce research and development costs. Promote the development, application, integration, and sharing of health and medical big data, explore the establishment of a unified clinical big data platform, and provide strong support for innovative drug research and clinical research. Promote the deep integration of information technology and production and operation. Develop and release the Pharmaceutical Industry Intelligent Manufacturing White Paper and guide enterprises to apply digital technology in various aspects such as factory design, production and manufacturing, logistics and warehousing, and business management, to improve lean management and quality control levels. Encourage eligible enterprises to build smart factories, carry out innovative applications of 5G + Industrial Internet, and lead the digital transformation of the entire industry. Implement the Industrial Internet + Safety Production action plan, strengthen the application of information technology in enterprise safety management, enhance the perception, monitoring, early warning, disposal, and evaluation capabilities of safety production, and improve the level of intrinsic safety. Actively develop new models and new formats. Adapt to the rapid development trend of smart healthcare and internet hospitals, explore the interconnection of prescription information between medical institutions and drug retailing, promote the construction of a digital management system covering disease diagnosis and treatment, drug distribution, medical institution charges, and medical insurance settlement, realize deep integration online and offline, and form a new ecology of Internet + Medicine with the participation of medical institutions, pharmaceutical production and operation enterprises, insurance companies, information technology service providers, etc.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capabilities system and promote the digital transformation of the industry.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Build a green industrial system. Establish and improve the standard evaluation system for green factories, green parks, and green supply chains in the pharmaceutical industry, and cultivate a group of excellent enterprises and parks. In regions with sufficient resources and environmental carrying capacity, construct a group of high-standard concentrated production bases for raw materials. Strictly implement environmental protection, safety, and energy-saving access standards, benchmarking international leading levels, carry out clean production audits and evaluations, promote the green and low-carbon transformation of production processes by enterprises, and eliminate process technologies and production facilities with high volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions, severe environmental pollution, and high safety risks. Improve the level of green manufacturing. Strengthen environmental risk assessment during drug research and development, and develop low environmental risk products. Carry out green technological innovation, adopt new technologies and equipment to transform traditional production processes, develop and apply green chemical technologies such as continuous synthesis and biotransformation, and strengthen the automation and closed-loop transformation of production processes. Promote enterprises to implement the concept of green development, formulate overall pollution control strategies, strengthen comprehensive measures such as source prevention, process control, and end treatment, and ensure the stable and compliant discharge of three wastes. Implement carbon emission reduction actions in the pharmaceutical industry. Implement the national strategy for peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality, formulate and implement action plans for carbon emission reduction in key areas of the pharmaceutical industry, clarify carbon dioxide emission intensity control targets, and improve the comprehensive utilization efficiency of resources in the entire industry. Support enterprises in developing and applying energy-saving technologies and equipment, improve energy utilization efficiency, and reduce carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gas emissions. Encourage pharmaceutical parks to implement centralized heating or use renewable and clean energy, and accelerate the elimination of self-supplied coal-fired boilers by enterprises. Column 5: Green and low-carbon engineering in the pharmaceutical industry.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system and promote the green and low-carbon development of the entire industry chain.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Revise the Pharmaceutical Industry EHS Guidelines to guide enterprises in establishing effective EHS management systems, eliminating environmental, occupational health, and safety hazards, and minimizing environmental pollution, occupational diseases, and safety accident risks. Encourage enterprises to conduct supplier EHS audits and create a green supply chain.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system, promote the green and low-carbon development of the entire industry chain, and enhance the overall industry's level of environment, occupational health and safety (EHS) management.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: In regions with independent geographical space and strong environmental carrying capacity, relying on existing pharmaceutical and chemical industrial parks, we will carry out the construction of concentrated production bases for raw materials, achieve shared public systems, comprehensive resource utilization, centralized pollution control, and industrial agglomeration development. This will provide space for the transfer and agglomeration development of the raw materials pharmaceutical industry, and improve the level of green production of raw materials pharmaceuticals.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system, promote the green and low-carbon development of the entire industry chain, and build a centralized production base for raw materials.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Focus on preventing production safety risks, enhancing intrinsic safety, personnel skills, and the level of safety informatization. Strengthen the safety supervision of chemical pharmaceutical production enterprises. All enterprises involved in major hazard sources and key-regulated hazardous chemical processes shall be included in the key control scope of the hazardous chemical safety risk monitoring and early warning system. For other enterprises using hazardous chemicals, strengthen safety risk identification and assessment to improve the level of safety production. Enhance the capacity building of biosafety prevention and control in the stages of drug research and development, production, etc., promote key sector enterprises to establish biosafety management systems, conduct biosafety risk assessments for critical stages, develop and apply advanced technology and equipment, and strengthen biosafety management at different levels.
titlelist: Promote the upgrading of pharmaceutical manufacturing capacity system and enhance the ability to control safety risks.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Adhere to open development and win-win cooperation, actively respond to the new situation of reshaping the global pharmaceutical innovation chain, industrial chain, and supply chain, deepen international cooperation in the industry, accelerate the cultivation of new competitive advantages, and integrate into the global innovation network and industrial system at a higher level.

content: Based on the context provided, the translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Based on the large domestic pharmaceutical market, we aim to attract global innovative drugs and medical devices to be registered in our country first, thereby reducing the time difference between the domestic and international launch of innovative products. We support domestic clinical research institutions to actively participate in and organize international multicenter clinical trials, in order to enhance the internationalization level of clinical research. We encourage multinational companies to establish research and development centers and innovative drug production bases in China. We guide domestic enterprises to introduce advanced foreign technologies through cooperation, technology licensing, and other means, in order to improve innovation efficiency and narrow the gap with international advanced levels. We leverage the advantages of the Hainan Free Trade Port policy to facilitate the provision of urgently needed clinical drugs and medical devices that are already on the market abroad but not yet in the domestic market.
titlelist: Create new international competitive advantages, attract global pharmaceutical innovation elements to gather domestically.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Support enterprises to carry out simultaneous registration of innovative drugs at home and abroad, conduct global multicenter clinical research targeting developed countries' markets, and realize the value of innovative drugs in a broader space. Seize the international market opportunities for biosimilar drugs, encourage vaccine manufacturers to carry out international certification, produce and export vaccines in accordance with international vaccine procurement requirements. Increase the number of generic drug registrations in developed countries, and increase the proportion of high-value-added products such as first generic drugs and complex formulations. Accelerate the global layout of the industrial chain, encourage enterprises to improve their international market operation capabilities, strengthen investment cooperation with countries participating in the Belt and Road Initiative, and actively explore emerging pharmaceutical markets.
titlelist: Create new international competitive advantages, promote domestic pharmaceutical companies to enter the international market at a higher level.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Strengthen international pharmaceutical policy cooperation, actively participate in international regulatory coordination mechanisms, play an important role in the development of relevant guidelines by the International Council for Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Pharmaceuticals for Human Use (ICH), actively promote joining the Pharmaceutical Inspection Cooperation Scheme (PIC/S), and promote the convergence of domestic and foreign regulations, mutual recognition of standards, and mutual trust in quality. By promoting cooperation and mutual recognition in drug regulation with key regions, create conditions for pharmaceutical products to enter the international market more conveniently. Strengthen communication and cooperation with the International Regulatory Cooperation for Herbal Medicines (IRCH) and play a leading role in global Chinese medicine standards. Promote communication and cooperation between domestic and foreign industry organizations in trade promotion, information exchange, industry self-discipline, and addressing frictions, and establish a public service platform for international pharmaceutical cooperation.
titlelist: Create new international competitive advantages, and consolidate the foundation of international medical cooperation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Pharmaceutical Industry (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 217) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, National Medical Insurance Administration, National Medical Products Administration, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 22, 2021)
content: Implement support policies such as the deduction of research and development expenses, the simplified collection of value-added tax for anti-cancer drugs and rare disease drugs. Guide financial institutions to innovate financial products, optimize supply chain financial services, support eligible enterprises in issuing corporate credit bonds, guide early-stage investment to support technological innovation in the pharmaceutical industry, and broaden financing channels for pharmaceutical companies. Encourage the development of specialized pharmaceutical venture capital funds and equity investment funds by social capital to provide financing support for enterprise innovation and development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, enhance the level of financial support.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Looking ahead to 2035, China's scientific, efficient, and authoritative drug regulatory system will be further improved, and its drug regulatory capabilities will reach international advanced levels. The ability to manage drug safety risks will be significantly enhanced, and a comprehensive regulatory, standard, and institutional system covering the entire life cycle of drugs will be established. The efficiency of drug evaluation and approval will be further improved, and the technical support capabilities for drug regulation will reach international advanced levels. The safety, efficacy, and accessibility of drugs will be significantly improved, effectively promoting the prevention of major infectious diseases and the treatment of difficult and rare diseases. The high-quality development of the pharmaceutical industry will make significant progress, with the industrial level significantly improved. The innovative research and development capabilities of drugs will reach international advanced levels, and excellent leading industrial clusters will be basically formed. Traditional Chinese medicine inheritance and innovative development will enter a new stage, basically achieving a leap from a major pharmaceutical country to a pharmaceutical powerhouse.
titlelist: Overall principles and development goals, 2035 long-term vision goals.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: The national drug sampling selects 130 to 150 varieties each year, and on the basis of completing the inspection tasks, conducts targeted exploratory research on key varieties. Local drug sampling completes annual full coverage sampling of the production process of nationally organized drug centralized procurement selected varieties, national essential drug formulation varieties, and varieties that have passed the generic drug quality and efficacy consistency evaluation, for the holders of drug marketing licenses (drug manufacturers) within the administrative region. It also increases the sampling efforts for products in the medical insurance catalog, imported chemical drugs, pediatric drugs, and traditional Chinese medicine decoctions. Every year, it conducts full coverage inspections of vaccine and blood product manufacturers.
titlelist: The main tasks include implementing comprehensive supervision of drug safety throughout the entire process and conducting risk assessment of drug safety.

content: The country selects approximately 50 varieties each year that have high safety risks, large daily consumption, and high social attention for random inspections. Local inspections focus on covering key regulated products and local specialty products. At least once a year, a comprehensive inspection of all items in the production quality management standards is organized for sterile and implantable medical device manufacturers in the jurisdiction. The supervision and inspection of high-value consumables for medical devices selected through centralized procurement by the national organization are strengthened.
titlelist: The main tasks include implementing comprehensive supervision of drug safety throughout the entire process and conducting risk assessments for medical device safety.

content: The national cosmetics supervision random sampling quantity reaches 1%-2% (16,000-32,000 batches) of the total registered and recorded amount each year. Continuous risk monitoring is carried out for high-risk varieties such as freckle whitening and children's cosmetics (with no less than 2,000 batches monitored annually). Provincial drug regulatory authorities conduct comprehensive supervision and inspection of children's cosmetics manufacturers and cosmetics e-commerce platform operators within their jurisdiction every year.
titlelist: The main tasks include implementing comprehensive supervision of drug safety throughout the entire process and conducting risk assessment for cosmetic safety.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Continue to carry out the National Drug Standard Improvement Action Plan. Compile the 2025 edition of the Pharmacopoeia of the People's Republic of China. Strengthen international coordination of standards, take the lead in the development of international standards for traditional Chinese medicine, achieve international advanced levels in chemical drug standards, keep biological product standards synchronized with international levels, and closely follow international standards for pharmaceutical excipients and packaging materials. Strengthen the construction of the technical support system for drug standards and enhance the research capabilities of drug standards. Optimize the medical device standard system, encourage the formulation of recommended standards in emerging technology fields, expedite the synchronization of projects with international standards, and improve consistency between domestic and international standards. Improve the technical support system for cosmetic standards and establish a mechanism for revising standards. Column 2: National Drug Standard Improvement Action Plan.
titlelist: The main tasks are to support the upgrading and development of industries and to continue promoting the construction of a standard system.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)

titlelist: The main tasks include supporting the upgrading and development of industries and implementing the Action Plan for improving drug standards.

content: Revise and formulate 500 medical device standards, with a focus on strengthening the research and formulation of mandatory standards for general medical devices, those related to personal health and safety, and recommended standards to promote high-quality development of the industry.
titlelist: The main task is to support the upgrading and development of industries, and the action plan to improve medical device standards.

Integrate existing national standards and technical specifications for cosmetics to form a unified national standard system for cosmetics.
titlelist: The main task is to support the upgrading and development of industries, and to implement the Action Plan for the improvement of cosmetic standards.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)

Include products and companies selected in the medical insurance catalog and centralized procurement as key regulatory targets. Support the sharing of information and data in the medical, pharmaceutical, and medical insurance fields, and promote the establishment of a 'Three-Linkage' big data system.
titlelist: The main tasks are to improve the drug safety governance system and coordinate the three-linkage policy.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Promote innovation in vaccines, innovative drugs, high-end medical devices, and other areas in accordance with the law and regulations. Strengthen the coordination between the layout of the pharmaceutical industry and the regulatory framework. Various regions should construct key industrial parks, demonstration bases, and key innovation projects, and simultaneously deploy corresponding regulatory capabilities.
titlelist: The main tasks are to improve the drug safety governance system and coordinate drug safety with industry support policies.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Establish a national collaborative mechanism for pharmaceutical and medical device innovation, and strengthen guidance for the research and development of innovative drugs. Further improve the ethical review mechanism to protect the rights and interests of trial participants and enhance the efficiency of ethical review. Optimize the expert advisory committee system, closely monitor the development of international cutting-edge technologies, and improve the technical evaluation capabilities for innovative products. Improve the evaluation communication mechanism, expand communication methods and channels, and strengthen technical guidance and services for applicants. Timely analyze and evaluate changes in medical device risks, improve the dynamic adjustment mechanism for medical device classification, and establish a comprehensive medical device naming database. content: Establish a sound national drug surveillance system and implement the primary responsibility of the drug marketing authorization holder for surveillance. Conduct research on medical device surveillance and explore a medical device surveillance system. Enhance the monitoring and evaluation capabilities of adverse drug reactions at all levels, explore the unified management of county-level drug adverse reaction monitoring institutions by provincial drug regulatory authorities, and establish a unified drug surveillance system and medical device adverse event monitoring system based on the adverse reaction monitoring system. Implement the quality management standards for drug surveillance, promote the establishment of monitoring checkpoints for drug adverse reactions and medical device adverse events, strengthen the analysis, judgment, and disposal of drug adverse reaction clustering events, and continue to advance the research and application of post-marketing drug safety monitoring and evaluation technologies. content: Integrate risk information such as cosmetics evaluation and approval, supervision sampling, on-site inspection, adverse reaction monitoring, complaint reporting, public opinion monitoring, law enforcement inspection, etc., to establish a unified and comprehensive risk monitoring system. Strengthen the construction of high-throughput screening platforms for cosmetics safety risk substances, rapid testing technology, network monitoring, and promote the construction of national evaluation bases for monitoring adverse reactions to cosmetics. Gradually achieve timely monitoring, accurate assessment, scientific early warning, and effective disposal of cosmetics safety risks. Column five: Improve the national drug adverse reaction monitoring system.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the construction of technical support capabilities and enhance the monitoring ability of cosmetic risks.

content: Strengthen the key technologies and platform construction for drug and medical device inspection and testing. With the China National Institute for Food and Drug Control as the leader, the key laboratory of the National Medical Products Administration as the backbone, and provincial-level inspection and testing institutions as the support, improve the scientific and authoritative inspection and testing system for drugs, medical devices, and cosmetics. National-level inspection institutions should focus on international cutting-edge technologies and strengthen the construction of inspection capabilities in key professional areas. Local inspection institutions at all levels should address daily and emergency inspection needs, fill in capability gaps, and strive to have the ability to conduct comprehensive inspections in response to sudden public health emergencies. In order to meet the needs of drug-related evaluation, approval, and supervision, promote the establishment of a rational layout and prominent inspection and testing system for pharmaceutical excipients and packaging materials. This is part of the Column Six Inspection and Testing Capability Enhancement Project.
