content: The China National Institutes for Food and Drug Control (NIFDC) benchmark international cutting-edge technologies and have the capability to issue batch certificates for all vaccine varieties. Accelerate the construction of national key laboratories for drug regulation and carry out research on the evaluation and testing of innovative vaccines and biotechnology products. Promote the establishment of provincial drug inspection institutions in the provinces where vaccine manufacturers are located and in provinces with high vaccine usage as national vaccine batch certification agencies.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the construction of technical support capabilities and enhance the capacity for vaccine inspection and testing.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Establish a molecular biology gene bank for traditional Chinese medicine and ethnic medicine, as well as a national digital platform for traditional Chinese medicine specimens. Establish one national-level and 8-10 regional technology platforms for the detection and safety evaluation of exogenous contaminants in traditional Chinese medicine, and construct a monitoring system for exogenous harmful residues in traditional Chinese medicine. Further enhance the detection capabilities of Tibetan medicine, Mongolian medicine, Uighur medicine, and other ethnic medicines.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the construction of technical support capacity and improve the inspection capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine and ethnic medicine.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: The provincial drug regulatory department urges relevant agencies to carry out capacity building in accordance with the guiding principles for the construction of drug, medical device, and cosmetic inspection and testing institutions. Provincial inspection and testing institutions should strengthen their guidance on the business of municipal and county-level inspection and testing institutions.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the construction of technical support capabilities and enhance the capabilities of inspection and testing institutions.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: With the support of the National Institute for Food and Drug Control Senior Training Academy, we will strengthen the construction of a professional education and training system. We will fully utilize internet technology to integrate existing resources and further expand the accessibility of education and training.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the construction of professional talent teams and enhance the capacity for professional education and training.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Regulatory personnel shall receive professional training for no less than 40 hours per year. Newly hired personnel shall receive standardized training for no less than 90 hours. Responsible officials at various levels of local governments shall undergo hierarchical training. All levels of full-time and part-time inspectors shall complete pre-job qualification training and pass the assessment according to the teaching outline.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the construction of professional talent teams and increase the intensity of education and training.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Improve the professional qualification system for practicing pharmacists, standardize continuing education, and continue to implement the project to enhance the abilities and qualifications of practicing pharmacists. Improve the national management information system for practicing pharmacists.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the construction of professional talent teams and to strengthen the construction of practicing pharmacists teams.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Implement the main responsibility of the holder of the drug marketing authorization for traceability. Improve the information traceability system for drugs, establish a national drug traceability collaborative service and regulatory system, promote the interconnection and sharing of drug traceability information, and achieve traceability of the entire process of key categories of drugs and traceability of their destinations. Gradually implement unique identification for medical devices, improve the unique identification database for medical devices, and strengthen the application of linkage in post-marketing supervision, medical management, and medical insurance management.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the intelligent supervision system and capacity building, and to establish a sound drug information traceability system.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine/December 30, 2021)
content: Strengthen the construction and application of national archives for drug, medical device, and cosmetic varieties. Strengthen the collection, analysis, application, and evaluation of national drug regulatory big data. Enhance the development and utilization of relevant data by government departments, industry organizations, pharmaceutical companies, third-party platforms, etc. Research and explore key common technologies and applications based on big data to serve regulatory cases, promote government transparency, ensure grassroots law enforcement, prevent and control drug risks, and promote the digital upgrade of regulation and industry.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the intelligent supervision system and capacity building, and promote the digital management of the entire life cycle of pharmaceuticals.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: The provincial drug regulatory department establishes and improves the basic database of drug, medical device production and operation, and cosmetic registration (filing) persons, as well as production enterprises within the administrative region, and updates it dynamically. It also establishes the credit records of drug marketing authorization holders, medical device registration (filing) persons, and production enterprises within the administrative region.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the intelligent supervision system and capacity building, and to improve the basic databases for pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and cosmetics.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Strengthen the unified command and coordination of emergency research and development, inspection and testing, system verification, evaluation and approval, monitoring and evaluation of pharmaceuticals and medical devices needed for prevention and control. Improve the mechanism for assisting in emergency research and development of pharmaceuticals and medical devices, and establish special green channels for vaccines, therapeutic drugs, and medical devices needed for prevention and control, with immediate reporting and review. Strengthen the supervision and inspection of the quality and safety of pharmaceuticals and medical devices needed for prevention and control, and relevant departments should ensure reserves and supplies.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the emergency system and capacity building, and to continue to do a good job in the normalized prevention and control of the novel coronavirus pneumonia epidemic.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Strengthen the construction of national pharmaceutical safety emergency response capabilities, enhance the awareness of all-staff emergency, and make emergency management a key focus of education and training for pharmaceutical regulatory officials. Establish a case library for pharmaceutical safety emergency drills, strengthen training and practical drills for emergency response capabilities at all levels, and improve emergency response capabilities. Ten projects for enhancing emergency response capabilities.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the emergency system and capacity building, and to cultivate and enhance emergency response capabilities.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: The departments responsible for drug supervision at the national, provincial, municipal, and county levels should conduct emergency drills at least once every three years and organize drill evaluations.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the emergency system and capacity building, enhance the national drug safety emergency response capability, and carry out regular drug safety emergency drills.

name: National Drug Safety and Promotion of High-Quality Development Plan for the 14th Five-Year Plan (State Drug Administration Comprehensive [2021] No. 64) (State Drug Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Healthcare Security Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / December 30, 2021)
content: Improve the funding guarantee mechanism for drug supervision. Establish a dynamic adjustment system for fees charged by drug evaluation and approval enterprises. Gradually include technical support services such as evaluation, inspection, testing, monitoring and evaluation, and standard management in the scope of government purchasing services. Continue to support the construction of infrastructure and equipment for drug safety supervision. Innovate and improve human resource policies, optimize and strengthen policy support in areas such as public recruitment, job positions, professional title evaluation and appointment, and salary and benefits guarantee, and remove bottlenecks in talent career development. Reasonably determine the total amount of performance-based salaries for relevant technical support institutions, and encourage localities to tilt towards personnel in high-risk regulatory positions such as vaccine factory supervision when distributing performance-based salaries.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, innovative and improved support and protection mechanisms.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: By 2020, the pharmaceutical industry will experience stable growth in scale and efficiency, significant enhancement in innovation capabilities, comprehensive improvement in product quality, a more complete supply guarantee system, a noticeable acceleration in internationalization, and a substantial increase in overall industry quality.- Scale: The main business revenue will maintain a medium to high-speed growth, with an average annual growth rate exceeding 10%, and the proportion of the pharmaceutical industry in the industrial economy will significantly increase.- Technological Innovation: Research and development investment by enterprises will continue to increase. By 2020, the research and development intensity of the entire industry's large-scale enterprises will reach 2% or more. The quality of innovation will significantly improve, with an increased proportion of new drug registrations compared to overall drug registrations. A number of high-quality innovative achievements will be industrialized, and breakthroughs will be made in international drug registrations.- Product Quality: Standards for pharmaceuticals and medical devices will be improved, and quality management regulations will be effectively implemented at all stages. Product quality and safety assurance will be strengthened. The evaluation of the consistency of quality and efficacy of generic drugs in oral solid preparations will be basically completed. Over 100 formulation enterprises will achieve international advanced level Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification.- Green Development: By 2020, compared to 2015, energy consumption per unit of industrial value-added by large-scale enterprises will decrease by 18%, carbon dioxide emissions per unit of industrial value-added will decrease by 22%, water consumption per unit of industrial value-added will decrease by 23%, volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions will decrease by over 10%, and the level of green production of chemical raw materials will significantly improve.- Intelligent Manufacturing: By 2020, the automation and informatization level of the pharmaceutical production process will significantly improve. Key processes in large enterprises will be automated, and the utilization rate of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) will reach over 30%. A number of intelligent manufacturing demonstration workshops will be established.- Supply Guarantee: The capacity to ensure the supply of essential drugs and commonly used low-priced drugs will be strengthened. The shortage of clinical drugs will be significantly improved. Generic versions of patented drugs urgently needed in clinical practice will be put on the market. The national pharmaceutical reserve system will be further improved, and the emergency research and development and production capacity to respond to public health emergencies will be significantly enhanced.- Organizational Structure: The pace of industry restructuring and integration will accelerate, and the concentration will continue to increase. By 2020, the top 100 enterprises will account for an increased proportion of the main business revenue by 10 percentage points, and large enterprises will further strengthen their leading role in industry development.- Internationalization: Pharmaceutical exports will maintain stable growth, and the proportion of export delivery value to sales revenue will strive to reach 10%. The export structure will significantly improve, with an increased proportion of formulations and medical device exports. Overseas investment will expand, international technological cooperation will deepen, and the ability for international development will significantly increase.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, main objectives.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Improve the collaborative innovation system between government, industry, academia, research, and application. Utilize the guiding and promoting role of the government to create a policy environment that encourages innovation. Strengthen the position of enterprises in technological innovation, leverage the role of leading companies in integrating scientific and technological resources, and support the development of research and development-oriented small enterprises that possess key technologies. Promote collaboration between enterprises and universities, research institutes, and medical institutions, establish investment, benefit, and risk-sharing mechanisms that align with the characteristics of new drug development, and accelerate the industrialization of research and development achievements. Mobilize the enthusiasm of medical institutions in pharmaceutical innovation, improve the level of clinical research on new drugs, and promote the transformation and application of scientific and technological achievements. Promote innovation and upgrading. Guide enterprises to improve the quality of innovation, cultivate major products to meet important needs, solve key problems, and enhance the level of industrialization technology. Shift the focus of chemical drug development from imitation to independent innovation. Conduct research on key varieties of compound, effective parts, and effective components of traditional Chinese medicine for diseases where traditional Chinese medicine has advantages, and develop modern Chinese medicine with stable and controllable quality and outstanding clinical advantages. Improve the research and preparation level of biotechnological drugs such as antibody drugs and tumor immunotherapy drugs, and accelerate the localization of urgently needed biosimilar drugs and combination vaccines. Strengthen the development of core technologies and key components of medical devices, and enhance integrated innovation capabilities and manufacturing levels. Breakthrough generic key technologies, promote the industrialization of major innovations and clinically urgently needed products. Strengthen research and development support. Support the construction of preclinical drug efficacy evaluation platforms, standardize the construction and management of drug and medical device clinical trial bases (GCP bases), optimize the layout of national-level science and technology innovation bases, coordinate the construction of national clinical medical research centers, improve the quality of clinical research, meet the needs of new product development and post-market quality evaluation of drugs and medical devices, and promote the transformation and application of scientific and technological achievements. Support the construction of small enterprise service platforms such as entrepreneurship incubation and open laboratories, and support the development of research and development-oriented small enterprises. Strengthen the construction of public data and resource platforms for pharmaceutical research and development, improve the level of openness and sharing, and enhance professional service capabilities. Leverage financial innovation to promote technological innovation, guide social capital to establish venture capital funds and equity investment funds in the pharmaceutical field, and support the implementation of early-stage research and development projects and the growth of innovative enterprises. Column 1: Enhancing Innovation Capability Project.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance industrial innovation capabilities.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Establish an innovation center for the pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturing industry, integrating resources from the government and society, research institutes and corporate R&D capabilities, clinical research resources from medical institutions, and industrialization capabilities of enterprises. Cooperate on common key technological issues related to industrial development, achieve 10-15 key technological breakthroughs, enhance the innovation capacity of the entire industry chain, and promote innovation-driven development.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance industrial innovation capabilities and to construct an innovation center for the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Support the construction of innovation and entrepreneurship service platforms such as incubators, open laboratories, and technology transfer centers, and support innovation activities of small and micro enterprises.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance industrial innovation capabilities and to construct a service platform for innovation and entrepreneurship for small and micro enterprises.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Guide social capital to establish more than 50 pharmaceutical industry venture capital funds, with a total scale of over 10 billion yuan, to provide investment and financing support for pharmaceutical technology innovation projects.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance industrial innovation capabilities and implement the pharmaceutical industry venture capital plan.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Support the construction and integration of disease clinical information databases, biological sample libraries, compound libraries, traditional Chinese medicine chemical component libraries, drug impurity standard libraries, and drug packaging additive databases, to achieve open sharing of data and resources, and provide services for the pharmaceutical industry's research and development.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance industrial innovation capabilities and to build pharmaceutical research and development data and public resource platforms.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Strengthen the construction of the quality system. Strengthen the main responsibility of enterprises for quality, promote strict implementation of GMP requirements by enterprises, adopt advanced quality management methods and quality control technologies, implement the concept of quality originating from design (QbD), establish a quality management system covering the entire product life cycle and a quality traceability system covering the entire industry chain, and improve the level of quality management throughout the process. Guide enterprises to improve pharmaceutical service capabilities and strengthen monitoring of adverse reactions and adverse events. Support eligible enterprises in establishing production quality systems that are in line with international advanced levels. Promote quality improvement in key areas. Enhance the quality level of essential drugs comprehensively, implement requirements for the consistency evaluation of generic drug quality and efficacy, and complete the consistency evaluation task for national essential oral solid preparations. Improve the quality standard system for traditional Chinese medicine, enhance the quality control level of the entire industry chain of traditional Chinese medicine, and improve the uniformity and controllability of product quality. Implement the national action plan to improve medical device standards, benchmark against international standards, formulate technical requirements for in-use medical device inspections, promote enterprises to improve product design, manufacturing processes, and quality control, and enhance the stability and reliability of medical equipment. Strengthen the construction of the standard system for pharmaceutical excipients and packaging materials and containers directly in contact with drugs, increase the number of varieties included in national standards, encourage enterprises to improve standardized production capabilities, and enhance the level of quality control. Promote enterprises to establish and improve measurement management systems to promote quality and efficiency improvement. Strengthen the construction of quality brands. Guide enterprises to enhance brand awareness, protect and inherit traditional Chinese medicine brands, encourage the development of over-the-counter drugs (OTC drugs) and well-known medical device brands, cultivate a large variety of generic drugs, form a batch of generic drugs with sales exceeding 2 billion yuan, change the situation of homogeneous product development and low market concentration, and promote the improvement of quality and safety levels and industrial upgrading. Column 2: Product quality upgrade project.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the quality and safety level.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Fully implement the task of evaluating the quality and therapeutic consistency of oral solid preparations of essential medicines, support the technological transformation and quality improvement of a wide range of generic drugs, and support the development and application of new pharmaceutical excipients.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the quality and safety level, and implement the plan for upgrading the quality of generic chemical drugs.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Carry out a nationwide survey of traditional Chinese medicine resources, establish a dynamic monitoring and technical service network for traditional Chinese medicine resources, establish a germplasm resource protection system for traditional Chinese medicine, protect medicinal germplasm resources and biodiversity, and guide enterprises in building standardized planting and breeding bases for traditional Chinese medicinal materials.
titlelist: The main tasks are to improve the quality and safety level, and to develop a sustainable utilization plan for Chinese herbal resources.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Implement the project of revitalizing and developing traditional Chinese medicine, support the improvement of quality of key products such as Chinese herbal medicine slices, essential Chinese medicines, and Chinese medicine injections; formulate and enhance production quality control standards and product standards for a wide range of traditional Chinese medicines, and establish a traceability system for the entire process of Chinese herbal medicine.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the quality and safety level, Chinese medicine quality improvement plan.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: The main focus is on immunization planning and key vaccine varieties, developing combination and multivalent vaccines, upgrading the technology and optimizing the production process of existing vaccines, improving the control of key quality control points in the production process, establishing a sound cold chain traceability system for distribution, and ensuring the quality and safety of vaccines.
titlelist: Main tasks: improving quality and safety levels, vaccine quality improvement plan.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Promote the upgrading of quality standards for fundamental, universal, and high-risk medical devices, support medical device companies in improving their technological level, carry out clinical quality verification of products, and enhance stability and reliability.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the quality and safety level, and implement the Medical Device Quality Improvement Plan.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Promote the interconnection and sharing of information systems for drug production statistics, bidding and procurement, clinical use of drugs, and medical insurance payment among various departments, in order to provide support for ensuring drug supply. Establish a drug shortage warning system to monitor the production and supply of key varieties, predict drug supply shortages, and timely release warning information.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance the ability to ensure supply and to construct the information system for pharmaceutical production and supply.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Select production enterprises with strong comprehensive strength, high quality management level, and centralized approval for small variety drug production. Establish 3-5 concentrated production bases for small variety drugs nationwide to enhance the supply guarantee capability for a batch of small variety drugs.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance supply guarantee capability and to construct centralized production bases for small-scale pharmaceuticals.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: In response to newly emerging and sudden infectious diseases, as well as other emergency needs that pose a threat to national public health security, we will rely on eligible enterprises and research institutions to establish a military-civilian integrated base for rapid development and production of drugs and vaccines, in order to meet the needs of disease prevention and control.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance supply guarantee capabilities, develop emergency drugs, and construct industrialization bases.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Improve the level of clean production in the industry. Strictly enforce mandatory clean production audits and encourage voluntary clean production audits. Guide enterprises to transform their management concepts from end-of-pipe treatment of pollutants to overall pollution control strategies. Develop and apply technology for comprehensive pollution control throughout the production process, adopt a circular production mode, eliminate outdated processes, standardize production and fine operations, reduce the generation of pollutants, and improve the level of comprehensive resource utilization. Construct green factories and green industrial parks. Aim for intensive factory buildings, clean production, waste resource utilization, and low-carbon energy, and create a batch of low-emission green factories. Actively pilot clean production in pharmaceutical industrial parks, construct high-standard parks, achieve upstream-downstream coordination, shared public systems, comprehensive resource utilization, and centralized treatment of pollutants, and continuously and stably meet national and local standards or control requirements in controlling the emissions of volatile organic compounds (VOCs) and treating wastewater. Improve the overall industry's Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) management level. Develop EHS standards and guidelines for the pharmaceutical industry, guide enterprises to establish EHS management systems, improve and enhance EHS-related hardware and software, minimize environmental pollution, safety accidents, and occupational diseases, and cultivate a corporate culture that fulfills social responsibilities, prioritizes people, and promotes sustainable development. Guide enterprises to conduct supplier EHS audits and build a green supply chain. Column 4: Pharmaceutical Green Development Project.
titlelist: The main task is to promote green transformation and upgrading.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: With a focus on chemical raw materials, develop and apply clean production processes such as the substitution of toxic and hazardous materials, biocatalysis and biosynthesis, and solvent-free separation. Improve the control level of volatile organic compound emissions and the treatment level of fermentation residues and other waste. Promote the application of ecological production technology for traditional Chinese medicinal materials, strengthen the management of production inputs, and improve the comprehensive utilization level of non-medicinal parts of traditional Chinese medicinal materials and industrial waste from traditional Chinese medicine production.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote green transformation and upgrading, and to develop and apply green production technologies.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Support the construction of a batch of low-energy consumption, low-emission green demonstration factories in accordance with international advanced standards, and promote enterprises to carry out clean production and energy-saving and emission reduction technological transformation.
titlelist: The main tasks include promoting green transformation and upgrading, as well as the construction of green factory demonstration projects.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Choose suitable areas with strong environmental carrying capacity and environmental governance capabilities, and construct 3-5 chemical raw material pharmaceutical circular economy parks to promote the development of pharmaceutical production clusters.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote green transformation and upgrading, and to construct green chemical raw material pharmaceutical parks.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Use innovative research and development methods in information technology. Support companies in establishing research and development platforms based on information integration, conducting computer-aided drug design, simulation screening, drug efficacy evaluation, structural analysis, and comparative studies to enhance the level and efficiency of drug development. Utilize Process Analytical Technology (PAT) to optimize pharmaceutical processes and quality control, achieve technical integration and product quality consistency from research and development to production. Improve the digital design level of pharmaceutical engineering projects, establish a digital management platform from design to operation and maintenance, and realize the full lifecycle management of engineering projects. Enhance the automation and informatization level of the production process. Improve the automation, digitization, and intelligence level of pharmaceutical equipment, enhance information upload and control, and network connectivity. Utilize information technology such as Industrial Internet, Internet of Things, big data, and cloud computing to extensively acquire and explore data and information from the production process, providing support for automatic optimization and decision-making in the production process. Promote the application of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in the production process, integrate and integrate data and information from various links, achieve automatic control of the production process, and create intelligent production workshops. Apply information technology to improve quality management. Establish a real-time monitoring system for production quality information, achieve automatic collection, management, and traceability of quality data, ensuring the authenticity and integrity of data. Develop intelligent control systems based on process analysis technology, establish a quality deviation warning system, maximize constraints, standardize, and reduce employee operations, promote strict implementation of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and effectively ensure product quality stability. Column 5: Pharmaceutical Intelligent Manufacturing Engineering.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the deep integration of the two industries.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Support the development of a batch of management information systems that are in line with the characteristics of the pharmaceutical industry and are applied in research and development, production, and quality management. The key areas include automated batch control technology, manufacturing execution systems (MES), process analysis technology (PAT), process knowledge management systems (PKS), and intelligent management systems that have the ability to analyze, learn, make decisions, and execute operations around key process units.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the deep integration of the two industries and develop and apply pharmaceutical management information systems.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Support the construction of more than 20 intelligent production demonstration workshops for raw materials and preparations, comprehensively applying various information technology, equipment, and management systems to achieve process automation and intelligence; support the construction of more than 5 drug production workshops that apply continuous manufacturing technology, exploring the transformation of drug production from batch production to continuous production.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the deep integration of the two industries and the construction of intelligent pharmaceutical production workshops.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Support the construction of more than 10 automated production demonstration workshops specifically designed for the characteristics of decentralized manufacturing of medical devices, aiming to change the current situation where most medical devices are manually assembled and tested. Improve the level of mechanical assembly, achieve automated material distribution, quality testing, and customized production, and systematically enhance the stability and reliability of medical devices.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the deep integration of the two industries and the construction of automated production workshops for medical devices.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Promote industry restructuring and integration. By raising standards such as registration, quality, energy conservation, environmental protection, and safety production, strictly controlling market access, and forming a market-driven mechanism, promote enterprise restructuring and the exit of backward enterprises. Support the alliance of strong enterprises and cultivate large-scale enterprises with international competitiveness. Promote the integration of large pharmaceutical companies with small and medium-sized innovative and entrepreneurial enterprises, promote the integration of new products, new technologies, and existing production capacity. Implement a pilot system for listing permit holders, develop specialized contract manufacturing businesses, and focus on resolving overcapacity. Cultivate and support the listing of small and medium-sized enterprises, promote the standardization of corporate governance structures, and transform operating mechanisms. Encourage the development of mergers and acquisitions funds by social capital, and broaden the financing channels for corporate mergers and reorganizations. Guide the development of industrial clusters. Based on the needs of industry development and in combination with the resource endowment and environmental carrying capacity of various regions, scientifically plan industrial cluster areas. Implement the coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei and the Yangtze River Economic Belt strategies, and guide the cross-regional integration of industrial resources. Strengthen the construction of specialized infrastructure, service platforms, and human resources conditions in industrial cluster areas, study and formulate special support policies that are in line with industry characteristics, enhance the carrying capacity and service capabilities of industrial parks, optimize development space, and improve development levels.
titlelist: The main task is to optimize the industrial organizational structure.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Optimize the export structure and promote export growth. Consolidate the international competitive position of chemical raw materials and increase the proportion of exports of processed products with higher value-added, as well as the number of varieties that meet advanced GMP requirements. Based on the advantages of the raw materials pharmaceutical industry, implement an internationalization strategy for formulations, comprehensively improve the scale, proportion, and added value of our country's formulation exports, and focus on expanding markets in developed countries and emerging pharmaceutical markets. Expand the scale of medical equipment exports, leverage the foundation of China's electronic information and equipment manufacturing industries, cultivate the competitiveness of medical equipment products, establish overseas technical service networks, and vigorously develop international markets. Strengthen international technological cooperation. Optimize the investment environment, deepen cooperation with foreign pharmaceutical companies, promote the organic integration of investment attraction, technology introduction, and talent introduction, and achieve win-win cooperation. Support enterprises in establishing cross-border R&D cooperation platforms, fully utilize international resources, and explore global innovative achievements. Encourage international clinical research on new drugs, achieve the internationalization of innovative drugs and participate in international competition. Lead the formulation of international standards for traditional Chinese medicine and create conditions for the internationalization of traditional Chinese medicine. Promote international production capacity cooperation. Implement the requirements of the Belt and Road construction, encourage enterprises to utilize manufacturing advantages to carry out acquisitions, mergers, and investment in suitable regions. Promote international cooperation in the production capacity of chemical raw materials, and encourage enterprises to establish production bases for scarce Chinese medicinal materials overseas. Introduce and cultivate international talents, improve the international operational capabilities of R&D registration, production quality, and market sales. Encourage foreign companies to establish R&D and production bases in China and conduct international multicenter clinical trials for new drugs. Column 6: International Competitiveness Enhancement Project.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the level of international development.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Supporting enterprises in acquiring or investing in the construction of overseas chemical raw materials, pharmaceutical preparations, and traditional Chinese medicine production bases, promoting international cooperation in production capacity, fully utilizing overseas environmental resources, and better serving the local market.
titlelist: The main tasks are to improve the level of international development and to construct overseas production bases.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Support international talent and technology exchange, introduce and export advanced products.
titlelist: The main tasks are to improve the level of international development and promote international technology exchange and cooperation.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Vigorously promote Internet + Medicine and develop smart medical products. Develop and apply mobile medical products with cloud services and artificial intelligence capabilities, wearable devices, and various types of mobile internet-based health management software (APP) to achieve remote monitoring and consultation through remote medical systems. Strengthen the development and utilization of health and medical big data, develop electronic health records, electronic medical records, electronic prescriptions, and other databases to achieve interconnection and sharing of data resources, guide disease diagnosis and treatment, drug evaluation, and new drug development, and develop medical decision support systems based on big data. Cultivate new health consumer demands. Promote the development and application of household, elderly care, and rehabilitation medical equipment to meet the needs of an aging population. Develop large health products, support pharmaceutical companies to extend into functional foods, special medical purpose formula foods, cosmetics, as well as health, prevention, and disease prevention fields. Support the development of new medical technologies such as gene sequencing, tumor immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, drug companion diagnostics, improve industry access policies, strengthen clinical application management, promote the adaptation of various technologies to clinical needs, and keep pace with international development. Promote the development of productive service industries and service-oriented manufacturing. Vigorously develop new productive service industries such as contract production, contract research and development, pharmaceutical e-commerce, biotechnology services, and third-party maintenance of medical devices, promote further specialization of division of labor, improve efficiency, and reduce costs. Encourage the construction of several high-standard drug production bases mainly engaged in contract production around biotechnology drugs and pharmaceutical preparations. Encourage medical device and pharmaceutical equipment companies to provide product extension services, transition from providing products to providing overall solutions, and establish third-party inspection centers, imaging centers, dialysis centers, pathology centers, etc.
titlelist: The main task is to expand into new fields and develop new business formats.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Grasp the direction of industrial technological progress, target major market demands, vigorously develop new varieties of biopharmaceuticals, chemical drugs, high-quality traditional Chinese medicine, high-performance medical devices, new auxiliary materials and packaging materials, and pharmaceutical equipment, accelerate the development and application of new technologies in various fields, and promote product, technology, and quality upgrades.
