name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Key development of antibody drugs targeting tumors, immune system diseases, cardiovascular diseases, and infectious diseases, such as PCSK9 inhibitors for treating hypercholesterolemia, PD-1/PD-L1 immunotherapy drugs for tumors, and RANKL for treating osteoporosis, which have outstanding clinical value. Accelerate the research and development of novel antibodies such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, and antibody fusion proteins. Promote the production of biosimilar drugs with high clinical demand. The focus is on products targeting TNF-α, CD20, VEGF, Her2, EGFR, and other targets. Improve patient access to medication.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, biopharmaceuticals, antibody drugs.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Focus on the development of new products for diseases such as diabetes, viral infections, and tumors, with low immunogenicity, good stability, strong targeting, long-lasting effects, and high bioavailability. According to the treatment needs of diabetes in our country, enhance the industrialization level of long-acting insulin and premixed insulin, and accelerate the development of new varieties such as glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) analogs. Promote the industrialization of products with significant demand, such as recombinant human albumin and gene recombinant coagulation factors. Establish a quality control system that aligns with international standards and actively explore the international market.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, biopharmaceuticals, recombinant protein drugs.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Key focus on developing vaccines for major infectious diseases such as highly pathogenic influenza, malaria, dengue fever, tuberculosis, AIDS, Ebola, Zika, and Middle East respiratory syndrome, to enhance the emergency research and industrialization capabilities of vaccines. Accelerate the development and industrialization of urgently needed clinical products such as the 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine, cervical cancer vaccine, and respiratory syncytial virus vaccine. Develop therapeutic vaccines for tumors, immune system diseases, and infectious diseases, as well as new adjuvants and new cell matrices for vaccines. Develop new types of vaccines such as combination multivalent vaccines, genetic engineering vaccines, viral vector vaccines, and nucleic acid vaccines, to upgrade some of the immunization program vaccines.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, biopharmaceuticals, vaccines.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Key development areas include RNA interference drugs, gene therapy drugs, as well as cell therapy products such as stem cells and immune cells, including CAR-T cell therapy products. 5. Industrialization technology. Key development areas include large-scale, high-expression antibody production technology, novel antibody preparation technologies such as antibody-drug conjugates and bispecific antibodies, long-acting protein formulation technology, large-scale cell-based influenza vaccine production technology, cell therapy product preparation technology, large-scale expression and purification technology for recombinant human albumin, and analysis and detection technology for trace impurities. Quality control technology in line with international advanced levels will be established for key development products. The production level of important raw and auxiliary materials for production, such as serum-free and protein-free culture media, protein separation and purification media, stabilizers, and protectants, will be improved. (II) Chemical drugs. 1. New chemical drugs. Keeping up with the international trends in pharmaceutical technology development, research and development of major new drugs for diseases, with a focus on innovative drugs for malignant tumors, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, diabetes, mental disorders, neurodegenerative diseases, autoimmune diseases, drug-resistant bacterial infections, viral infections, etc., especially new drugs targeting new targets and mechanisms of action. Based on disease segmentation and the trend of precision medicine, the development of new drugs, new compound formulations, and diagnostic companion products for specific disease subgroups in China will be promoted. 2. Generic drugs. Accelerating the development of generic drugs for drugs urgently needed in clinical practice and drugs with expired patents to improve patient accessibility. Improving the quality of generic drugs, with a focus on improving the production technology and quality control level of oral solid preparations in combination with the evaluation of consistency in quality and efficacy of generic drugs. 3. High-end formulations. Key development areas include new injectable drug delivery systems such as liposomes, lipid microspheres, and nanoparticles, as well as oral controlled-release drug delivery systems such as immediate-release, sustained-release, and multiparticulate systems, transdermal and mucosal drug delivery systems, formulations suitable for special populations such as children, etc., to promote high-end formulations to meet international advanced quality standards. 4. Clinically scarce drugs. Strengthening the development of drugs for rare diseases, pediatric use, and other clinically scarce drugs, and accelerating the development of replacement products for clinically necessary but highly side-effect drugs.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, including biopharmaceuticals, nucleic acid drugs, and cell therapy products.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Following the trend of international medical technology development, we are conducting research and development of new drugs for major diseases, with a focus on the development of innovative drugs for malignant tumors, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, diabetes, mental disorders, neurodegenerative diseases, autoimmune diseases, drug-resistant bacterial infections, viral infections, and other diseases, especially those that target new targets and new mechanisms of action. According to the trend of disease segmentation and precision medicine, we are developing new drugs, new compound formulations, and diagnostic companion products for specific disease subgroups in our country.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, chemical medicine, chemical new drugs.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Accelerate the development of generic drugs for urgently needed clinical use and for drugs with expired patents, improving the accessibility of medication for patients. Enhance the quality of generic drugs, with a focus on improving the production technology and quality control of oral solid dosage forms in conjunction with the evaluation of consistency in quality and efficacy of generic drugs.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, chemical medicine, chemical generic drugs.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Key development of new injection drug delivery systems such as liposomes, lipid microspheres, and nanomaterials; oral controlled-release drug delivery systems such as immediate release, sustained release, and multiple particle systems; transdermal and mucosal drug delivery systems; dosage forms suitable for special populations such as children, etc., to promote high-end formulations to reach international advanced quality standards.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, chemical medicine, high-end formulations.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Strengthen the development of drugs for rare diseases, pediatric drugs, and other clinically scarce drugs, and accelerate the development of replacement products for drugs that are clinically necessary but have significant side effects. 5. Industrialization technology. Focus on the development of new technologies such as crystal control of active pharmaceutical ingredients, enzyme synthesis, chiral synthesis, microreaction continuous synthesis, carbon fiber adsorption, molecular distillation, etc. Harmless treatment and resource utilization technology for solid waste such as fermentation residue, improve the level of clean production of active pharmaceutical ingredients; develop high-end formulation industrialization technology, improve oral solid formulation process technology and quality control level.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, chemical medicine, and clinically scarce drugs.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: In order to target cardiovascular diseases, autoimmune diseases, gynecological and pediatric diseases, digestive diseases, and other advantageous traditional Chinese medicine diseases, we will explore classical prescriptions, develop compound formulas, effective components, and effective parts of new Chinese medicine drugs, and accelerate the research and industrialization of innovative Chinese medicine drugs with precise therapeutic effects and high clinical value. For the varieties that have already been marketed, we will use modern scientific and technological methods to further explore their clinical value, identify advantageous treatment areas, and develop new indications. We will carry out re-evaluation of the efficacy, safety, formulation process, and quality control of drugs after they are marketed, and achieve breakthroughs in the international registration of new drugs.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, traditional Chinese medicine, and Chinese patent medicine.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Focus on the development of artificial breeding techniques for endangered and scarce medicinal materials, promote the cultivation and breeding of wild variants of musk, agarwood, cordyceps, and other products; improve the standardized production and processing techniques of bulk authentic medicinal materials, and enhance the quality of traditional Chinese medicine from the source.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, Chinese medicine, Chinese medicinal materials, and Chinese herbal medicine.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Promote the construction of the national germplasm resource bank for traditional Chinese medicine, conduct systematic research and evaluation on the safety and effectiveness of traditional Chinese medicine, improve key technologies such as production, processing, and formulation of traditional Chinese medicine, enhance product quality, and cultivate distinctive varieties.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, Chinese medicine, ethnic medicine.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Focus on the development of large-scale and efficient separation and preparation technologies for traditional Chinese medicine ingredients. Develop new formulation technologies that are in line with the characteristics of traditional Chinese medicine, such as sustained-release, transdermal and mucosal administration, physical modification, and taste masking. Improve the quality control level of the production process and enhance inspection and testing technologies and standards.
titlelist: Promoting the development of key areas, Chinese medicine, industrialization technology.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Focus on the development of high-field superconducting magnetic resonance (MR) and specialized MR imaging systems. High-end CT equipment, multimodal fusion molecular imaging devices such as PET-CT and PET-MRI, high-end color Doppler ultrasound and intravascular ultrasound, digital subtraction angiography (DSA), high-definition electronic endoscopy, etc. Improve the production level of core components, including CT tubes, MR superconducting magnets and RF coils, PET crystal detectors, ultrasound single crystal probes, two-dimensional array probes, X-ray flat panel detectors, endoscope three-chip camera systems, etc.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, medical equipment, medical imaging equipment.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Key development areas include high-throughput biochemical analyzers, immune analyzers, blood cell analyzers, fully automated laboratory testing and analysis pipelines (TLA), and related reagents. Other molecular diagnostic instruments such as single-molecule gene sequencers and new instant testing devices (POCT) are also being emphasized. Integration and innovation of in vitro diagnostic equipment, testing reagents, information management software, and data analysis systems are being strengthened. The establishment of testing reagent standards, the development of traceable reference materials, and the development of new reagents are being accelerated.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, medical devices, and in vitro diagnostic products.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Focus on the development of high-energy linear accelerators and image-guided radiation therapy devices, orthopedic and laparoscopic surgical robots, blood dialysis equipment and consumables, artificial liver blood purification equipment and consumables, ophthalmic laser treatment systems, high-end therapeutic ventilators, mobile ICU emergency systems, defibrillators, and traditional Chinese medicine treatment equipment.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, medical equipment, treatment devices.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Key development areas include fully biodegradable coronary stents, heart valves, degradable occluders, reusable interventional treatment catheters, artificial joints and spines, 3D printed orthopedic implants, tissue organ induction regeneration and repair materials, pacemakers, implantable left ventricular assist devices, brain pacemakers, cochlear implants, dental implants, ophthalmic artificial lenses, functional dressings, degradable hemostatic materials, and medical adhesives.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, including medical devices, implantable interventional products, and medical materials.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Develop applications for health and medical big data, with a focus on the development of remote medical systems, wearable physiological information monitoring devices, and home, elderly care, and rehabilitation devices with cloud services and artificial intelligence capabilities. These devices can provide health consultation, online appointment triage, follow-up on medical cases, and query of test results, among other applications, for a health management information system. Develop new core components for wearable medical devices, such as electrocardiogram sensors, flexible display devices, and high-performance batteries.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, medical devices, and mobile medical products.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Develop a series of pharmaceutical excipients based on function-related indicators, segment product specifications, improve quality levels, meet the needs of generic drug quality and consistency evaluation, and focus on the development of cellulose and its derivatives, high-quality starch and soluble starch, polyvinyl pyrrolidone, polyethylene glycol, phospholipids, adsorbents for injection, and new material capsules. Develop series of products for high-end formulations that can provide specific functions. Focus on the development of propylene glycol ethylene glycol copolymers, polylactic acid and other injection control materials. Functional synthetic phospholipids such as PEGylated phospholipids and phospholipids for antibody modification, as well as targeted derivatives of hyaluronic acid sodium and chitosan.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, pharmaceutical excipients and packaging systems, pharmaceutical excipients and functional materials.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Accelerate the upgrading of packaging system products, develop new materials with high application security and good quality performance, gradually eliminate varieties with high quality and safety risks, focus on accelerating the transition from low-boron silicon glass bottles to neutral boron silicon glass bottles for injection packaging, develop new materials such as cyclic olefin polymers and styrene thermoplastic elastomers for use in injectors, infusion bags, blood bags, etc., high barrier materials for moisture-sensitive and oxidizable drugs, improve the quality level of pharmaceutical-grade polypropylene, polyethylene, and halogenated butyl rubber. Develop new packaging systems and drug delivery devices, provide specific functions, meet formulation technology requirements, improve patient compliance, ensure medication safety, and focus on the development of specialized delivery devices for aerosols and powder mists, new injectors such as self-administered injectors, pre-filled syringes, and automatic mixing devices, multi-chamber bags and infusion packaging with the function of removing insoluble particles, intelligent packaging systems with memory and quality monitoring functions, child-safe packaging and elderly-friendly packaging for commonly used medications in households, etc.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, pharmaceutical excipients and packaging systems, packaging systems and drug delivery devices.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Key development of new formulation processes and equipment such as sustained release, transdermal absorption, and powder aerosol; large-scale bioreactors and associated systems; protein efficient separation and purification equipment; flexible sterile formulation production lines; continuous solid dosage form production equipment; advanced powder engineering equipment; foreign object optical detection equipment; high-speed intelligent packaging production lines; industrial robots suitable for special positions.
titlelist: Promote the development of key areas, pharmaceutical equipment, high-end equipment.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Improve the integration, continuity, automation, informatization, and intelligence level of pharmaceutical equipment. Develop systematic and complete equipment, providing overall solutions. Strengthen the application of online detection, online monitoring, in-place cleaning and disinfection, high containment, and isolation technologies, improve the equipment's self-diagnosis, self-adaptation, and network communication capabilities, and enhance the equipment's openness and compliance. Expand the application of industrial Ethernet technology, digital signal processing technology, and programmable controllers to create conditions for process control, optimized operations, and intelligent management.
titlelist: Promoting the development of key areas, pharmaceutical equipment, equipment technology.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Strengthen the coordination of industrial policies with quality and safety supervision, price regulation, centralized procurement, clinical use, medical insurance payment, fiscal finance, foreign trade, and other policies, to form a policy synergy, enhance the level of industry governance, and promote the healthy and rapid development of the pharmaceutical industry. Improve market access policies, while raising industry access standards and curbing low-level redundant construction from the source, deepen the reform of streamlining administration, delegating power, combining decentralization with regulation, and optimizing services. Establish a mechanism for phasing out outdated products to promote the optimization of existing stock and the enhancement of incremental growth. Improve innovation incentive policies to facilitate the accelerated entry of new products into the market, create conditions for the development of emerging technologies and new business models, and accelerate the cultivation of new industry growth points. Strengthen anti-monopoly, anti-unfair competition law enforcement, intellectual property protection, and price behavior regulation, eliminate local protectionism and market segmentation, increase efforts to crack down on counterfeiting, false advertising, and other illegal activities, correct improper practices in pharmaceutical purchasing and sales and medical services, and create a favorable business environment.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen policy coordination and support

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Continue to implement national science and technology programs such as the Major New Drug Creation national major special project and industrialization special project, to support pharmaceutical innovation and transformation and upgrading. Implement policies such as the deduction of research and development expenses, preferential tax treatment for high-tech enterprises, and accelerated depreciation of fixed assets. Improve and implement government procurement policies that support innovation, promote the research and development and large-scale application of innovative products. Expand enterprise financing channels, reduce financing costs, encourage the development of pharmaceutical venture capital funds and equity investment funds, implement and improve export credit and export credit insurance policies, and support eligible enterprises to raise funds through domestic and overseas listings and the issuance of various debt financing instruments.
titlelist: Enhance financial and taxation support measures

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Establish a market-oriented drug pricing mechanism, strengthen the coordination between pricing policies and policies on medical insurance, procurement, and medication use. While restraining excessive drug prices, avoid excessively low prices that may affect supply security and quality safety. Improve the policy for categorized drug procurement, scientifically set bidding and procurement evaluation criteria, improve quality evaluation methods, and promote survival of the fittest. Standardize and promote transparent procurement of high-value medical consumables, improve policies for the allocation of large medical equipment and management of medical service price items, and promote the timely entry of new medical devices into clinical use in accordance with regulations. Scientifically and reasonably formulate and adjust the payment standards for basic medical insurance drugs, promote reform of the payment methods for medical insurance, and promote rational use of medications. Based on the capacity of the medical insurance fund, include eligible innovative drugs in the medical insurance catalog according to regulations. Vigorously develop commercial health insurance to meet diverse and multi-level health security needs.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve pricing, procurement, and medical insurance policies.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Strengthen the construction of the pharmaceutical distribution network, and form a pharmaceutical distribution network that closely connects industrial enterprises and various levels of distribution enterprises, coordinating national and regional channels. Develop third-party pharmaceutical logistics, improve the drug distribution capacity in rural and remote areas, and achieve effective coverage of drug distribution at the grassroots level. Guide pharmaceutical distribution enterprises to develop modern pharmaceutical logistics, implement supply chain management using information technology, integrate upstream and downstream resources, create a whole industry chain service model, and improve the efficiency of the entire supply chain. Encourage standardized direct chain operation of retail pharmacies, expand business scope and service content, fully leverage the role of practicing pharmacists in pharmaceutical services, and meet consumers' diverse and multi-level health needs.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the pharmaceutical distribution system.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Implement the pharmaceutical talent training plan, coordinate the use of various educational resources, improve the talent training mechanism, and focus on new drug research and development, new medical device development, clinical use of drugs, quality management, pharmaceutical internationalization, etc. Focus on cultivating innovative leading talents, compound management talents, and applied technical talents to consolidate the intellectual foundation for industrial development. Strengthen the construction of pharmaceutical-related disciplines in universities, guide cooperation between enterprises and higher education institutions, research institutes, and medical institutions, jointly cultivate high-level talents and practical talents, and establish pharmaceutical application technology and practical training bases. Improve the talent incentive mechanism, implement policies and regulations related to the distribution of benefits from the transfer and transformation of scientific and technological achievements, and stimulate the enthusiasm of scientific and technological personnel for innovation and entrepreneurship. Relying on major projects, key laboratories, industrial technological innovation platforms, and major talent introduction plans, attract overseas high-level pharmaceutical talents to return to China for innovation and entrepreneurship. Encourage various forms of specialized training to cultivate great craftsmen and outstanding engineers for frontline production.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the construction of pharmaceutical talent team.

name: Guidelines for the Development Planning of the Pharmaceutical Industry (excerpt) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, former National Health and Family Planning Commission, former State Food and Drug Administration / October 26, 2016)
content: Strengthen the organizational construction of the pharmaceutical industry, play the role of industry organizations as a bridge between enterprises and the government, actively participate in policy-making, timely reflect industry demands, carry out industry self-discipline, regulate corporate behavior, and maintain a fair competition environment. Support industry organizations in undertaking government functions, expanding service functions, conducting industry statistics, testing and certification, information consulting, education and training, international exchanges, and other work. Support the establishment of the China Pharmaceutical Federation, integrate resources, better play a role in serving industry development, collecting and releasing information, safeguarding corporate rights and interests, and communicating and cooperating with government departments. Support industry organizations in promoting the implementation of the Code of Ethics for Chinese Pharmaceutical Enterprises.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, leveraging the role of industry organizations.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Biotechnology Innovation (excerpt) (Guo Ke Fa She [2017] No. 103) (Ministry of Science and Technology/April 24, 2017)
content: Focusing closely on the strategic needs of people's health and the cultivation of emerging industries, the future development of medicine is represented by the research and development of major products such as innovative drugs and medical devices, as well as precision, individualized, substitutable, or renewable medicine. The key breakthroughs are in new vaccines, antibody preparation, immunotherapy, and other key technologies, aiming to seize the strategic high ground in the biopharmaceutical industry and strive to transform China's biopharmaceutical industry from catching up to keeping pace and leading in some areas by 2020. Column 4: Biopharmaceuticals. Modern biological treatment technologies such as immunotherapy and gene therapy. Strengthen original research related to biological treatment, such as immune checkpoint inhibitors, gene therapy, and immunocellular therapy, and break through key technologies such as immune cell acquisition and storage, immune cell genetic engineering modification, biopharmaceutical target screening, and the development of new gene therapy vectors, to enhance the industrial development and international competitiveness of biological treatment in China. Stem cells, biomedical materials, and regenerative medicine. Focus on strengthening the basic and translational research of stem cells, enhancing the cross-fusion of stem cells, biomedical materials, and tissue engineering, guiding the technological upgrading of China's biomedical materials industry and the standardized clinical application of new treatment methods such as cell therapy; develop new generation vascular stents, nerve repair conduits, artificial bone tissue repair materials, and other products to promote the application and transformation of tissue engineering products and bioprinting products; explore the artificial construction of tissues and organs such as valves, liver, and kidneys to promote the leapfrog development of related industries. Molecular typing and precision medicine for major diseases. Focus on the development of next-generation life omics technologies such as gene sequencing, clinical application technologies, bio big data cloud computing technologies, and biomedical analysis technologies; systematically identify and optimize candidate biomarkers, establish disease typing standards and technical methods, build large-scale national health cohorts and specific disease cohorts, establish a biomedical big data sharing platform; develop precise prevention, diagnosis, and treatment plans and clinical decision-making systems for major diseases, and improve the level of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of major diseases. Development of new vaccines, antibodies, and other major biological products. Focus on breakthroughs in key technologies and bottlenecks such as vaccine molecular design, multi-valent design, engineered cell construction, antibody engineering optimization, new drug delivery systems and formulations, large-scale separation and preparation, and efficacy evaluation, to accelerate the research and development of new vaccines, antibodies, blood products, and other major biological products. Drug design and new drug development. Based on potential drug targets discovered in modern life sciences, combined with next-generation computer and artificial intelligence technologies, as well as structural biology research achievements, carry out research on computer-aided drug molecular design technology, develop innovative drugs based on new structures and targets, and strengthen the research and development of classical prescriptions of traditional Chinese medicine, advantageous compound formulas of traditional Chinese medicine, and active ingredients. Biomedical engineering and medical devices. Focus on breakthroughs in new imaging technologies, new sensing technologies, microfluidics, optoelectronics, imaging navigation and robotics, single-cell sequencing, and molecular diagnostics, break through the development of core components of high-end large-scale medical devices and equipment, improve the product evaluation system and capability support platform, and accelerate the development of medical imaging equipment, medical robots, new implantable devices, new biomedical materials, in vitro diagnostic technologies and products, home medical monitoring and health equipment, wearable devices, primary care-appropriate diagnostic and treatment equipment, mobile medical products, and so on.
titlelist: Key tasks, supporting the development of key areas, biopharmaceuticals.

name: Notice on the Special Project for the Construction of the Biomedical Contract Research and Production Service Platform (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2018] No. 633) (National Development and Reform Commission Office, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Office, National Health Commission Office, State Drug Administration Office / May 31, 2018)
content: To meet the increasing demand in the field of biomedicine for high-level research and development and production services, and to promote the continuous improvement of efficient research and development and advanced manufacturing service levels for advantageous enterprises, expand service areas, improve service systems, and build a group of comprehensive and strong professional contract research and production service enterprises with international competitiveness, providing strong support for deepening the implementation of the reform of the drug evaluation and approval system.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the advantage of the enterprise.

name: Notice on the Special Project for Organizing the Implementation of the Construction of a Biomedical Contract Research and Production Service Platform (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2018] No. 633) (National Development and Reform Commission Office, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Office, National Health Commission Office, State Drug Administration Office / May 31, 2018)
content: Guide contract research and production service enterprises to focus on the key areas that urgently need improvement in China's pharmaceutical research and production chain, break through a batch of common technologies, reduce research and production costs, significantly improve the efficiency of the development of the biopharmaceutical industry, and accelerate alignment with international advanced levels.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance innovation capability.

name: Notice on the Special Project for the Construction of the Organizational Implementation of the Biomedical Contract Research and Production Service Platform (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2018] No. 633) (National Development and Reform Commission Office, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Office, National Health Commission Office, State Drug Administration Office / May 31, 2018)
content: Promote the radiating effect of contract research and development and production services in the biopharmaceutical industry, stimulate innovation and entrepreneurship, encourage the continuous gathering of talents, funds, and other factors, strengthen cooperation and linkage among various links in the industrial chain, enhance the level of coordinated division of labor in the region, build a favorable industrial development ecosystem, and accelerate the formation of a group of biopharmaceutical industry clusters with international influence.
titlelist: The main task is to promote cluster development.

name: Notice on the Special Project for the Construction of the Organizational Implementation of the Biomedical Contract Research and Production Service Platform (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2018] No. 633) (National Development and Reform Commission Office, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Office, National Health Commission Office, State Drug Administration Office / May 31, 2018)
content: Key support will be given to advantageous enterprises with strong industry influence, high-standard quality assurance systems, and sound public service mechanisms. These enterprises will establish contract research and development service platforms in specific fields such as pharmaceutical research, preclinical safety evaluation, and new drug clinical research. Priority will be given to comprehensive integrated contract research and development service platforms that can provide multi-link and international services.
titlelist: Key supported direction: Contract research and development services in the field of biopharmaceuticals.

name: Notice on the Special Project for the Construction of the Organizational Implementation of the Biomedical Contract Research and Production Service Platform (excerpt) (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2018] No. 633) (National Development and Reform Commission Office, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Office, National Health Commission Office, State Drug Administration Office / May 31, 2018)
content: Key support is given to the development and industrialization of innovative drug production processes. The construction of contract manufacturing service platforms for the scale-up production of marketed drugs is also prioritized. Preference is given to the establishment of scale-up and specialized contract manufacturing service platforms that have mastered the core technologies of drug production, quality systems, environmental health and safety (EHS) systems that are in line with international standards, and sound public service mechanisms.
titlelist: Key supported direction: contract manufacturing services for biopharmaceuticals.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/ October 29, 2021)
content: By 2025, we will develop a batch of high value-added and high-growth varieties, break through a batch of green and low-carbon technology equipment, cultivate a group of internationally competitive leading enterprises, and build a group of industrial clusters and production bases with global influence. The innovation and development of the pharmaceutical industry and the level of advanced manufacturing will be significantly improved, the capacity for green and low-carbon development will be noticeably enhanced, and the supply system will be significantly strengthened, providing strong support for the development of the pharmaceutical industry and forging distinctive advantages in international competition and cooperation.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/No. 1523 [2021]/October 29, 2021)
content: Adhering to the trend of technological innovation in the production of raw materials for pharmaceuticals, we will accelerate the development and application of advanced technologies such as synthetic biotechnology, continuous flow microreactors, continuous crystallization, and crystal control, and utilize modern technology to transform traditional production processes. We will promote the digitalization and intelligent transformation and upgrading of key enterprises, improving production efficiency and quality control. Focusing on the key common technologies in the production of raw materials for pharmaceuticals, we will support the development of a number of public service platforms with strong externalities.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the innovation and upgrading of production technology.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Strengthen the layout of forward-looking research and develop green and low-carbon production technologies for raw materials. Promote the green transformation of bulk raw materials, continuously reduce unit product energy consumption and emission levels. Strengthen the utilization of by-products in the production process of raw materials, promote the treatment and transformation of volatile organic compounds (VOCs), and improve the comprehensive disposal level of solid waste, high-salt wastewater, organic waste liquid, etc. Promote the popularization and application of advanced energy-saving equipment, accelerate the transformation and upgrading of high-energy-consuming process modules such as refrigeration and fermentation, and achieve cascade utilization of energy.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the green and low-carbon transformation of industries.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Closely track the trends in the structural changes of clinical drug use, vigorously develop characteristic raw materials and innovative raw materials, and increase the proportion of new products and high value-added products. Promote the scale and intensive development of raw material drug production, encourage advantageous enterprises to grow stronger, and enhance industrial concentration. Guide the development of new business formats such as specialized contract research and development and production services in the field of raw materials. Strictly implement policies such as the Guidance Catalog for Industrial Structural Adjustment, and strictly implement environmental protection, energy consumption, safety, and other standards, accelerate the elimination of outdated products, technologies, and equipment.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the optimization and adjustment of industrial structure.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: In response to changes in the external environment of industrial development, we will implement regional ecological and environmental zoning and control plans, ecological and environmental access lists, and other requirements to promote the establishment of new active pharmaceutical ingredient projects in suitable areas and compliant chemical (pharmaceutical) industrial parks. We will also guide existing active pharmaceutical ingredient enterprises to optimize and adjust their layouts between regions. Taking into account factors such as raw materials, markets, and technology, we will focus on developing areas with a good foundation, prominent location advantages, and abundant resource elements to build a world-class industrial cluster and production base. We will further enhance the park's capacity to guarantee public infrastructure and promote the transformation of three wastes disposal from decentralized management by enterprises to centralized disposal in the park.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the concentrated and clustered development of industries.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Facing the cutting-edge technology field of raw pharmaceutical production, guiding backbone enterprises to deploy innovation chains with the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain and research institutes, accelerating the development of high-end production equipment such as nucleic acid reaction instruments and specialized consumables such as high-end membrane materials, breaking through the bottleneck constraints of industrial development, and improving the level of independent supporting capabilities of the industrial chain. Strengthen the sharing of advanced technologies in the petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical, and other industries, and enhance the level of industrial integration and innovation.
titlelist: The main task is to promote breakthroughs in major equipment research and development.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Leverage the advantages of our country's industrial system and scale, promote business synergy among pharmaceutical intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and formulation companies, and enhance the stability of the supply chain. Promote cross-sector resource sharing and cooperation, strengthen collaboration between biotechnology, fine chemicals, hazardous waste disposal, pharmaceutical equipment companies, and active pharmaceutical ingredient companies, and improve the modernization level of the industrial chain. Encourage the integrated development of active pharmaceutical ingredients and formulations, and guide active pharmaceutical ingredient companies to develop formulations based on advantageous varieties.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the division of labor and cooperation in related industries.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Strengthen standard leadership and improve the level of green and high-end development of the industry. Improve the evaluation index system for clean production of raw materials, and guide enterprises to carry out green manufacturing pilot demonstrations. Improve the environmental, occupational health, and safety management system of the raw materials industry, and build an internationally advanced green supply chain. Research and improve the energy efficiency standards of high-energy-consuming equipment in the production of raw materials, and establish and improve mechanisms for calculating and evaluating carbon emissions in the industry.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the construction of the industrial standard system.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Optimize the export structure of raw materials for pharmaceuticals, increase the proportion of high value-added product exports, and deeply integrate into the global value chain. Guide high-quality enterprises to strengthen international registration of raw materials for pharmaceuticals and quality system certification, better adapting to international market demands. Improve the supply of production factors, establish international pharmaceutical industry cooperation parks, and achieve open innovation, open cooperation, and open win-win outcomes.
titlelist: The main task is to promote high-level open cooperation in the industry.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Relying on existing support channels, promote the industrialization of major innovative achievements in the field of raw materials for pharmaceuticals and the promotion and application of green and low-carbon technology equipment. Innovate the use of funds by using market-oriented industrial investment funds to support the development of backbone enterprises and the construction of industry key common technology platforms. Encourage advantageous enterprises to utilize diversified investment and financing channels such as listing and issuing bonds to enhance the support capacity for industrial innovation and development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, expanding financing channels for industries.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: The National Development and Reform Commission, together with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and relevant departments, will strengthen the organization and coordination of the implementation of the plan, implement the major project of high-quality development of raw materials for pharmaceuticals, timely entrust relevant agencies to evaluate the implementation situation, and promptly coordinate and solve problems in the implementation process. Development and Reform Commissions at all levels and competent departments of industry and information technology should take into account factors such as industrial foundation, market demand, and environmental capacity, scientifically plan and fully demonstrate, and orderly promote the high-quality development of the local raw materials pharmaceutical industry. Attachment: Major Project of High-Quality Development of Raw Materials for Pharmaceuticals.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational coordination and management.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2021] No. 1523) (October 29, 2021)
content: Key areas of development include synthetic biotechnology, screening and preparation of biocatalysts (enzymes), continuous flow microreactors, continuous crystallization and crystal control, chiral synthesis, solid-phase synthesis, efficient separation and purification, control of trace impurities in pharmaceuticals, and process analysis.

content: Key development technologies include enzyme catalysis, electrochemical reactions, photochemical synthesis, etc. Other technologies include the substitution or reuse of precious metal catalysts, substitution of toxic and harmful materials, substitution of composite culture media for fermentation, advanced oxidation of wastewater, membrane bioreactors, treatment of high-concentration and difficult-to-degrade wastewater, treatment of volatile organic compound emissions, and resource utilization and harmless treatment and evaluation of waste liquids and residues.

content: Develop advanced international equipment such as microchannel reactors, peptide synthesizers, nucleic acid synthesizers, novel crystallizers, high-density isolation units, fluidized bed dryers, ultrafine powder airflow pulverizers, wet grinding homogenizers, membrane separation systems, and fully automated synthesis reactors.

content: Develop and apply high-efficiency energy-saving equipment for high-energy-consuming processes such as compressed air, refrigeration, water treatment, distillation, fermentation, and waste treatment, in order to improve the level of heat cycle utilization and reduce energy consumption. Focus on the application of environmental protection technologies, and develop new three waste treatment equipment such as solvent continuous recovery, catalytic oxidation, sludge reduction, waste liquid desalination, microbial residue treatment, and heat storage incineration.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the High-Quality Development of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients Industry (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/No. 1523 [2021]/October 29, 2021)
content: Develop high-end membrane materials and components such as nanofiltration, ultrafiltration, microfiltration, reverse osmosis, etc. High-performance sensors such as online carbon dioxide, glucose, ammonia nitrogen, cyanide ion probes. New types of filtration consumables such as diatomaceous earth filter cartridges, activated carbon filter cartridges, precious metal removal filter cartridges, etc. as well as new chromatographic packing materials and resins.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Emphasize the importance of evaluating the clinical value of new Chinese medicine drugs based on the characteristics of traditional Chinese medicine clinical treatment and practical assessment, and focus on meeting unmet clinical needs. Establish technical guidelines for the evaluation of clinical value of new Chinese medicine drugs. Establish efficacy evaluation standards that are in line with the clinical positioning of Chinese medicine, reflecting its characteristics and advantages. Encourage patient-centered efficacy evaluation. Explore the use of real-world evidence to support the registration and market launch of new Chinese medicine drugs.
titlelist: Promote the adherence to tradition and innovation in Chinese medicine, and adhere to the guidance of clinical value.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Explore the introduction of new tools, new methods, new technologies, and new standards for the evaluation of traditional Chinese medicine efficacy. Promote the development of standardized research capabilities and systems for multi-regional clinical trials, and enhance the overall quality of clinical research on traditional Chinese medicine. Utilize medical institutions as incubators for the inheritance, innovation, and development of traditional Chinese medicine preparations, and encourage the transformation of medical institution preparations into new traditional Chinese medicines. Support the development of new traditional Chinese medicines through various methods such as combining disease patterns, specialized medicines for specific diseases, or traditional Chinese medicines based on syndrome differentiation.
titlelist: Promote the adherence and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine, promote the innovative development of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Develop technical requirements for the research of improved traditional Chinese medicine, support the use of new technologies and processes that are in line with the characteristics of the product, and improve the existing market varieties of traditional Chinese medicine by reflecting the clinical advantages and characteristics of new dosage forms. Support the development of drugs with the same name and same formula, and promote quality competition among existing market varieties of traditional Chinese medicine. Optimize the technical requirements for changes in existing market varieties of traditional Chinese medicine.
titlelist: Promote the adherence to tradition and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine, and encourage secondary development.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Guide the holders of pharmaceutical marketing authorizations to actively conduct post-marketing research and evaluation of traditional Chinese medicines. Establish safety evaluation methods and standards that are in line with the characteristics of traditional Chinese medicines, and establish a classification and grading evaluation strategy for the safety of traditional Chinese medicines guided by traditional Chinese medicine clinical practices. Increase research on the technical standards for evaluating the safety of new traditional Chinese medicines derived from ancient classic prescriptions, prescriptions from renowned senior traditional Chinese medicine practitioners, and formulations from medical institutions that have been used by humans. Based on the composition of the medicine, human experience, preparation process, dosage and administration, and therapeutic characteristics, conduct corresponding non-clinical and clinical safety studies during the clinical trial period or after marketing.
titlelist: Promote the adherence to tradition and innovation in traditional Chinese medicine, and strengthen research on the safety of traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Revise the production quality management specifications for Chinese medicinal materials (GAP), develop guidelines for the implementation of production quality management specifications for Chinese medicinal materials, guide and promote standardized cultivation and breeding of Chinese medicinal materials, promote processing at the origin of Chinese medicinal materials, and encourage Chinese herbal medicine enterprises to extend their quality assurance system to the cultivation and processing stages, strengthening the quality control of Chinese medicinal materials and Chinese herbal medicine slices from the source. Strengthen and standardize the quality management of Chinese medicinal materials and Chinese herbal medicine slices used for new drug development, and clarify the technical requirements for quality control research. Protect wild medicinal resources and strictly limit the use of endangered wild animals and plants as medicinal materials. Strengthen the evaluation of resources for new Chinese medicines to ensure the stable source and sustainable utilization of Chinese medicinal materials.
titlelist: Strengthen the quality and safety supervision of traditional Chinese medicine, and enhance the management of the quality of traditional Chinese medicine from the source.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Revise the Regulations on the Protection of Traditional Chinese Medicine Varieties, organically connect the system of protecting traditional Chinese medicine varieties with the patent protection system, and incorporate it into the registration and management of the entire life cycle of traditional Chinese medicine, to play a protective role in traditional Chinese medicine varieties such as innovative traditional Chinese medicines, improved traditional Chinese medicines, and compound formulations of ancient classic prescriptions. Support the registration and declaration of relevant patent information by holders or applicants of drug marketing authorizations in accordance with relevant regulations.
titlelist: Strengthen the quality and safety supervision of traditional Chinese medicine, and increase the protection of traditional Chinese medicine varieties.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Increase the publicity efforts for the reform of the evaluation and approval of traditional Chinese medicine, strengthen the interpretation of important policies and major measures, respond promptly to social concerns, reasonably guide expectations from all parties, and promote the formation of a new pattern of collective participation in the inheritance and innovation of traditional Chinese medicine throughout society.
titlelist: Emphasize multi-party coordination and linkage, and create a good social atmosphere.

name: Implementation Opinions on Promoting the Inheritance and Innovative Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine (State Drug Administration, Drug Note [2020] No. 27) (National Medical Products Administration/December 21, 2020)
content: Accelerate the construction of supporting regulations and systems for the Drug Administration Law and the Traditional Chinese Medicine Law, and improve the regulatory system for the entire life cycle of traditional Chinese medicine. Strengthen the management of traditional Chinese medicine standards, optimize the formation mechanism of national drug standards, and continuously improve the national drug standard system with the Chinese Pharmacopoeia as the core. Establish and improve a quality standard, technical specifications, and evaluation system for traditional Chinese medicine that is clinically oriented and in line with the characteristics of traditional Chinese medicine, comprehensively and objectively reflecting the quality of traditional Chinese medicine. Research and improve the requirements and testing methods for harmful substances such as pesticide residues, heavy metals, and mycotoxins in Chinese medicinal materials. Develop and implement national standards for the processing of traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces. Strengthen the supervision and implementation of local medicinal material standards and provincial-level processing standards for decoction pieces.
titlelist: Promote the modernization of the traditional Chinese medicine regulatory system and regulatory capabilities, and improve the regulatory standards and system for traditional Chinese medicine.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Strengthen the standardized management of high-value medical consumables, clarify the scope of governance, and prioritize the governance of high-value medical consumables with relatively high unit prices and resource consumption ratios. Develop rules for a unique identification system for medical devices. Gradually unify the classification and coding of high-value medical consumables for national medical insurance, and explore the application of standardized coding for registration, procurement, and use of high-value medical consumables. Establish a price monitoring and centralized procurement management platform for high-value medical consumables, strengthen statistical analysis, and ensure interoperability with the medical insurance payment review platform. Establish a mechanism for sharing and coordinating price information of high-value medical consumables among departments, and strengthen the monitoring of purchasing and selling prices.
titlelist: Improve the price formation mechanism, reduce the excessively high prices of high-value medical consumables, and establish a unified coding system and information platform.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Establish a basic medical insurance access system for high-value medical consumables, implement catalog management for high-value medical consumables, improve the dynamic adjustment mechanism of the catalog, timely supplement necessary new technological products, and withdraw products that are no longer suitable for clinical use. Gradually implement price negotiations for high-value medical consumables' medical insurance access, achieving quantity for price exchange. Establish a reporting system for high-value medical consumable product companies, where companies must submit relevant reports on prices, market sales, health economic evaluations, adverse event monitoring, etc., according to specified requirements for products intended to be included in medical insurance, as necessary basis for medical insurance access review. Establish a management system and standard system for the evaluation of high-value medical consumables' medical insurance.
titlelist: Improve the price formation mechanism, reduce the excessively high prices of high-value medical consumables, and implement dynamic adjustments to the medical insurance access and catalog.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Explore centralized procurement of high-value medical consumables based on principles such as volume-based purchasing, price linkage, and promoting market competition. All public medical institutions must conduct open and transparent transactions on the procurement platform when purchasing high-value medical consumables. For high-value medical consumables with large clinical usage, high procurement amounts, mature clinical use, and multiple manufacturers, explore centralized procurement by category and encourage joint volume negotiation procurement by medical institutions. Actively explore cross-provincial alliance procurement. For high-value medical consumables that have already passed medical insurance access and have clear medical insurance payment standards and relatively stable prices, implement direct online procurement. Strengthen supervision of the actual procurement volume of high-value medical consumables by medical institutions.
titlelist: Improve the price formation mechanism, reduce the excessively high prices of high-value medical consumables, and improve the method of centralized procurement.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Cancel the markup on medical consumables in public medical institutions, and achieve 'zero difference rate' sales of medical consumables in all public medical institutions by the end of 2019. The sales price of high-value medical consumables shall be based on the procurement price. The reasonable income reduction of public medical institutions due to the cancellation of the markup on medical consumables shall be properly resolved mainly through adjusting medical service prices, appropriate financial subsidies, and ensuring smooth connection with medical insurance payments. Public medical institutions should reduce costs through centralized procurement, strengthening cost accounting, and regulating rational use, in order to achieve a stable and healthy operation.
titlelist: Improve the pricing mechanism, reduce the excessively high prices of high-value medical consumables, and eliminate the markup on medical consumables.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Taking into account factors such as the payment capacity of the medical insurance fund, the patient's ability to bear the cost, the situation of centralized procurement, and the actual market transaction prices of high-value medical consumables, fully considering the normal operation of public medical institutions, we will study and formulate medical insurance payment policies. Scientifically establish payment standards for high-value medical consumables under medical insurance and establish a dynamic adjustment mechanism. For those that have passed the medical insurance access negotiation, the payment standards will be determined based on the negotiated price. For high-value medical consumables of the same category and similar function, explore the establishment of unified medical insurance payment standards. The medical insurance fund and patients will separately pay for high-value medical consumables according to the medical insurance payment standards, guiding medical institutions to actively reduce procurement prices.
titlelist: Improve the pricing mechanism, reduce the excessively high prices of high-value medical consumables, and formulate medical insurance payment policies.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Establish a high-value medical consumables internal admission selection mechanism, strictly prohibit departments from procuring on their own. Clarify the responsibilities of the high-value medical consumables management department and ensure their implementation. Improve the internal evaluation mechanism and abnormal use warning mechanism for high-value medical consumables, and conduct monitoring and analysis of the usage of high-value medical consumables by medical staff for single-brand use and the quantity of high-value medical consumables used in each surgery. Promptly interview relevant medical staff in case of abnormal usage, and link the monitoring and analysis results to their performance assessment.
titlelist: Standardize medical service behaviors, strictly control the unreasonable use of high-value medical consumables, and improve self-management of medical institutions.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Incorporate the usage of high-value medical consumables into the contracted medical institutions' medical insurance service agreements, strengthen the management of medical insurance doctors. For those who violate the medical insurance service agreements, handle them through interviews, warnings, public criticism, orders for rectification within a specified period, suspension or termination of agreements, and other methods. Improve the construction of the medical insurance intelligent audit information system, strengthen the big data analysis of high-value medical consumables, focus on monitoring and auditing medical institutions and medical personnel with high frequency and high costs of using high-value medical consumables, regularly report and publicly disclose the information to the society. Establish a blacklist system for contracted medical institutions and medical personnel, and improve the credit evaluation system for contracted medical institutions under medical insurance.
