name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Strictly regulate the pre-market registration and approval process for high-value medical consumables, strengthen the effective connection between the management of new product medical insurance and registration approval. Improve the technical requirements for medical device registration and promote the gradual alignment of high-value medical consumables standards with international standards. Timely disclose relevant approval information and strengthen social supervision. Establish a product information traceability system and a lifelong responsibility system for product quality of manufacturing enterprises. Strengthen the quality management of high-value medical consumables throughout their lifecycle and improve policies for research and development, approval, and standardized application. Encourage innovation and development of high-value medical consumables, support research and development and production of medical consumables, accelerate the registration and approval of high-tech and high-value medical consumables, and promote fair market competition. Increase the inspection and supervision of production enterprises through random inspections, on-site inspections, and inspections during the production process. Establish a system for reporting the rate of defective medical consumables in medical institutions and carry out monitoring and re-evaluation of adverse events of medical devices in accordance with the Measures for Monitoring and Re-evaluation of Adverse Events of Medical Devices.
titlelist: Establish a sound supervision and management mechanism, strictly investigate and punish illegal and irregular behaviors, and improve quality management.

name: Reform Plan for the Governance of High-Value Medical Consumables (State Council Document [2019] No. 37) (State Council General Office/July 19, 2019)
content: Promote the scale, specialization, and informatization of the circulation of high-value medical consumables. Public medical institutions should establish a mechanism for selecting the distribution of high-value medical consumables to promote fair market competition. Standardize the management of purchase and sales contracts, and medical institutions should strictly follow the contracts to complete the payment collection. Encourage local areas to reduce the circulation links of high-value medical consumables through methods such as two-ticket system according to their actual situations, and promote transparency in purchasing and sales activities. Incorporate the integrity operation and professional practice of high-value medical consumables-related enterprises and their practitioners into the credit management system, strengthen the recording, publicizing, and early warning of dishonest behaviors, and enhance performance management.
titlelist: Strengthen supervision and management mechanisms, seriously investigate and deal with illegal and irregular behaviors, and enhance circulation management.

titlelist: Improve supporting policies, promote the healthy development of the industry, and increase financial investment.

content: According to the principles of overall control, structural adjustment, both increases and decreases, and gradual implementation, as well as the paths of creating space, adjusting structure, and ensuring connection, the medical service prices should be adjusted reasonably. The focus should be on increasing the prices of medical services that reflect the value of technical labor, and coordinating with insurance and pricing policies. Establish a dynamic adjustment mechanism for medical service prices, gradually straighten out comparative price relationships, promote an increase in the proportion of medical service income in total medical income, and create favorable conditions for regulating the prices of high-value medical consumables.
titlelist: Improve supporting policies, promote the healthy development of the industry, and make reasonable adjustments to medical service prices.

titlelist: Adhere to the three-linkage of medical treatment, strengthen organizational implementation, enhance publicity, and guide reasonably.

content: Compile a key product and technology catalog for medical equipment, focusing on the forefront of people's health and medical health technology. Support industry organizations, research institutions, and national medical centers in developing and publishing technology innovation roadmaps. Strengthen collaboration between materials, components, and complete machines to accelerate the development of basic components and components, basic software, basic materials, and basic processes that restrict the industry's development. Column 1: Industrial basic research action. Focus on advanced basic materials. Focus on the research of hollow fiber membranes for extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) and dialysis membranes for blood purification equipment. Research high-precision and high-surface-quality titanium, nickel-titanium, titanium-niobium, tantalum-based alloy wires, rods, and tubes, etc. Research oxygen-free copper and molybdenum-titanium-zirconium alloys for electronic computerized tomography (CT), as well as vacuum high-temperature bearings and large-capacity rotating target discs for CT tubes. Research high thermal conductivity circuit board materials for positron emission tomography (PET), scintillators for CT/PET detectors, and efficient filtering materials for protective equipment. Research absorbable and degradable materials, high-risk contrast guide wires, large arterial stents, lumen stents, coronary stents, orthopedic implant materials, heart valve materials, and lead-free piezoelectric materials, etc., to promote a batch of basic materials to reach international advanced levels. Focus on core components. Develop simulation chips for medical X-ray detectors, analog-to-digital conversion chips, system-level chips for wearable devices, and medical AI chips, etc. Develop high-precision current sensors, high-temperature and high-precision temperature sensors, high-precision high-voltage voltage sensors, high-precision magnetic field sensors, and high-speed optical components for 3D vision systems. Develop flexible electrocardiogram (ECG)/electroencephalogram (EEG)/electromyogram (EMG)/blood glucose and pressure sensors for wearable devices. Develop flexible connectors and biometric chromatographic sensors, etc. Focus on key components. Develop proportional valves for ventilators, vacuum pumps and miniature solenoid valves for dialysis equipment, and miniature proportional valves for high-flow nasal oxygen therapy devices. Develop high-power CT tubes and high-resolution X-ray photon counting detectors. Develop high-field magnetic resonance magnets, low-temperature coils, and multi-nuclear spectrometers. Develop advanced color ultrasound probes. Develop grid-controlled triode electron guns, high-power magnetrons, high-power multi-beam klystrons, and high-turn-ratio solid-state modulators for radiotherapy. Develop six-degree-of-freedom treatment beds, etc. Develop reducers, precision motors, and optical lenses for medical robots. Develop photomultiplier tubes for real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) detection systems. Develop light-conducting endoscope fibers and high-resolution flexible fiber optic imaging bundles, etc. Focus on supporting diagnostic and testing equipment. Strengthen the development of supporting reagents for diagnostic and testing equipment, improve product sensitivity, precision, long-term stability, and batch production controllability, and ensure continuous improvement and iterative development of diagnostic and testing equipment. Focus on basic processes. Improve and optimize the manufacturing processes of advanced basic materials, key components, and complete machine products, strengthen quality and safety control, and enhance product performance, reliability, stability, and batch production capabilities.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: New digital X-ray imaging system. The key breakthroughs in core components and key technologies such as dynamic flat panel detectors, bringing the digital X-ray machine technology to the international advanced level and effectively reducing the overall cost; actively developing new scintillation crystal preparation technology for detector, developing X-ray machines based on photon counting detectors for vascular angiography, striving to reach the international advanced level in low-dose imaging based on photon counting. New ultrasound imaging system. The focus is on developing high-performance color Doppler ultrasound, such as digital beamforming, high frame rate color flow imaging, contrast harmonic imaging, real-time 3D imaging, etc., with image resolution and low-speed microvascular resolution reaching the level of high-end mainstream products abroad; developing multimodal specialized ultrasound equipment, portable/handheld ultrasound equipment; overcoming key technologies of high-density single crystal transducers, developing new ultrasound probes; developing new elastography imaging, ultrasound brain imaging, and other cutting-edge technologies and innovative products. Computerized tomography (CT) system. The focus is on developing spiral CT with independent intellectual property rights of 256 rows or more, with key technical indicators such as spatial resolution and temporal resolution reaching the level of similar international products, and breakthroughs in CT tube, detector, slip ring processing technology, and image processing technology. New superconducting magnetic resonance imaging system. The focus is on developing high-field (not less than 3T) superconducting and specialized superconducting magnetic resonance imaging systems that are comparable to mainstream foreign products, with technical indicators such as channel number, gradient field strength, and switching rate reaching the international advanced level of similar products; breakthroughs in zero liquid helium evaporative magnet system, digital spectrometer with 64 channels or more, high-temperature superconducting RF coil, RF amplifier, gradient amplifier, and new clinical application imaging sequences and other key components and core technologies. Nuclear medicine imaging system. The focus is on developing whole-body PET-CT/MRI, SPECT/SPECT-CT, and other nuclear medicine imaging systems with high sensitivity, high resolution, and full digitalization that are comparable to mainstream foreign products. The key breakthroughs are in fully digital modular PET detectors, high registration accuracy PET-CT on the same gantry, image processing, and algorithms. Multimodal molecular optical imaging system. The focus is on developing cutting-edge molecular medical imaging products such as non-fluorescence confocal microscopy imaging system, micro-focus CT, high-sensitivity fluorescence molecular imaging system, etc., breaking through the fusion and integration of PET, CT, autofluorescence/excitation fluorescence imaging, magnetic resonance imaging, and γ-ray isotope imaging in multimodal molecular imaging, and reaching the international advanced level in the engineering of multimodal imaging technology. Super-resolution microscopy imaging system. The focus is on breakthroughs in real-time data processing and image reconstruction of microscopic imaging, digital pathological analysis, fast and high-sensitivity weak light detection, overcoming the design and manufacturing bottlenecks of large numerical aperture objectives, large array CMOS detectors, optical reconstruction microscopic imaging signal processors, and developing ultra-high-resolution pathological analysis systems, high-speed structured illumination microscopy (SIM), STORM/SIM fusion microscopy, two-photon/STED fusion microscopy, and other super-resolution microscopy imaging systems, with key indicators reaching the international advanced level, providing technical support for the next generation of digital pathological analysis. Composite endoscope imaging system. The focus is on breakthroughs in key technologies for real-time imaging of three-dimensional ring scanning, high-magnification fluorescence imaging, optical coherence tomography imaging, etc., overcoming the design and manufacturing bottlenecks of ultrasound-electronic composite endoscopic probes, fluorescence microscopic endoscopic probes, and developing high-end endoscopic imaging systems such as ultrasound, confocal, and optical coherence tomography, reaching the international advanced or leading level, and realizing applications in medical fields such as digestion, respiration, and urology, promoting early diagnosis and treatment of major tumor diseases such as lung cancer and gastric cancer.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote major product research and development, break through core component bottlenecks, medical imaging.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Intelligent on-site rapid detection system. Key development of integrated drying chemical analyzer, automated immune rapid detection instrument, handheld sequencer, portable nucleic acid detection instrument, and supporting testing reagents and quality control products; research on high-sensitivity on-site rapid detection technology for non-invasive sample collection and supporting reagents. Conduct research on non-invasive blood glucose detection instrument, wearable extracorporeal detection technology and equipment. New molecular diagnostic system. Key development of on-site rapid extraction/detection integrated platform for nucleic acids, new gene sequencer, fully automated nucleic acid detection system with on-site testing, quantitative digital PCR systems, etc. Medical multimodal flow cytometer. Development of multi-color fluorescence, flow cytometer for quantitative flow microspheres, flow cytometer for intracellular component detection, flow cytometer for flow molecular phenotyping analysis and immune phenotyping analysis, and supporting reagents. New medical mass spectrometer. Development of matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization and other soft ionization methods-based time-of-flight, quadrupole or tandem high-precision mass spectrometers. Development of commonly used internal reference standards for isotopes and establishment of commonly used mass spectrometry data analysis libraries. Fully automated microbial analysis system. Key development of non-cultured microbial automated analysis system, automated blood culture system, microbial automated identification and drug sensitivity analysis system, microbial clinical sample automated pretreatment system, and other fully automated microbial analysis equipment. Rapid pathological diagnosis system. Key development of intelligent rapid pathological diagnosis system, pathology micro-CT based on phase-contrast energy spectrum. Key breakthroughs in automated technology for routine staining, immunohistochemistry, and in situ FISH of pathological sections, intelligent image analysis technology for pathological slides, and nanoscale rapid histological X-ray stereoscopic imaging technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote major product research and development, break through core component bottlenecks, and focus on in vitro diagnostics.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Intelligent perception interactive surgical robot. The key development of an intelligent medical robot system with internationally advanced levels of high-precision surgical planning, navigation, and positioning, including minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery for abdominal treatment, intelligent surgical robot systems for orthopedics, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, neurology, dentistry, ophthalmology, etc. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as rapid image registration, high-precision positioning, intelligent human-machine interaction, and multi-degree-of-freedom precise control. Composite guided radiation therapy system. The key development of a high-precision radiation therapy system for different types of tumors coexisting, with breakthroughs in multi-mode high-definition navigation, simultaneous treatment of multiple target areas with one positioning, high-precision positioning and dose guidance, miniaturization/high stability radiation source, adaptive TPS, and other technologies. Implantable active treatment devices. The key development of implantable cardiac pacemakers with automated pacing function and low power consumption, high-performance and low-cost domestically produced cochlear implants, implantable spinal cord stimulators, artificial retinas, and other products. Blood purification and dialysis machines and consumables. The key development of high-quality, low-cost blood dialysis machines, blood dialysis filtration machines, dialyzers/filters/perfusion devices. Key solutions to stability, batch production process, and core component issues of domestically produced blood dialysis equipment and dialyzers/perfusion devices.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote major product research and development, break through core component bottlenecks, advanced treatment category.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Orthopedic repair and implant materials and instruments. Key development of internationally leading load-bearing bone-inducing repair materials, absorbable bone fixation products, high wear-resistant, long-lasting new artificial hip, artificial knee, and artificial intervertebral disc products. Oral implant repair materials and systems. Key development of highly biocompatible oral implant repair bodies, digital precise tooth preparation devices, and oral three-dimensional imaging surgical navigation systems. Key breakthroughs in key technologies such as all-ceramic dentures, zirconia ceramic blocks, nano-crystalline powder preparation, and three-dimensional imaging-guided implantation. New cardiovascular and cerebrovascular interventional instruments. Key development of a new generation of fully degradable vascular stents, small-diameter artificial blood vessels, new artificial heart valve systems, intelligent ablation devices, and catheters. Key breakthroughs in technologies such as controllable degradation and drug release of vascular stents, anticoagulation and anti-thrombosis of small-diameter artificial blood vessels, decalcification of heart valves, anticoagulation, and anti-proliferation. Central nervous system repair and regeneration materials. Key development of internationally leading central nervous system repair materials and products that promote central nervous system regeneration in spinal cord and brain nerve repair, and research and development of implantation catheters and auxiliary surgical systems for central nervous system regeneration.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote major product research and development, break through core component bottlenecks, biomedical materials.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Health perception products. Focus on developing intelligent human physiological information perception products, real-time monitoring of human behavior, health status detection, and monitoring of health perception products. Rehabilitation care products. Focus on developing intelligent rehabilitation robots, intelligent walking assistance systems, multimodal rehabilitation wheelchairs, exoskeleton robot systems, etc. Key breakthroughs in human motion intention recognition, human-machine interaction, exoskeleton flexible control, optimization of rehabilitation exercise patterns for different adaptation conditions, and other key technologies. Traditional Chinese medicine medical devices. Focus on developing pulse diagnosis, tongue diagnosis, as well as acupuncture, moxibustion, traditional Chinese medicine rehabilitation, and other traditional Chinese medicine equipment. Key breakthroughs in pulse signal acquisition and analysis, human acupoint auxiliary positioning, traditional Chinese medicine intelligent health identification, and other technologies.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote major product research and development, break through core component bottlenecks, health equipment category.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: One is to focus on clinical needs such as early diagnosis, accurate diagnosis, minimally invasive treatment, precision treatment, specialized diagnosis and treatment, critical care, remote services, and decision support. We will conduct integrated research on new diagnostic and treatment technologies, strengthen equipment configuration standards, clinical application norms, diagnosis and treatment pathways, training tools, etc., to promote collaborative innovation and accelerate the clinical application of domestically innovative products. We will establish clinical technology training bases to provide a platform for the improvement, dissemination, and promotion of new technologies.The second is to focus on clinical needs such as smart healthcare, mobile healthcare, remote healthcare, and hierarchical diagnosis and treatment. We will accelerate the integration of medical device services with new technologies such as cloud computing and big data. We will focus on the standardization research of clinical service products such as medical imaging cloud, radiotherapy planning system cloud, surgical planning cloud, third-party medical testing, remote diagnosis, mobile services, intelligent follow-up, clinical decision support, and digital hospitals. We will develop intelligent prediction, early warning, and prognosis systems for diseases, as well as management information systems for chronic diseases such as cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, and cancer, to promote the development of new service models for digital diagnosis and treatment equipment.
titlelist: Key tasks, focusing on application demand orientation, strengthening demonstration and popularization, and integrating solutions.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Aiming at the forefront of global technology and top-level standards, attracting and gathering top research institutions, leading talents, and first-class innovation teams from around the world, laying out and constructing a world-class major technological infrastructure cluster and innovation cluster for medical devices, and building an internationally leading technology innovation center in the field of medical devices.
titlelist: Key tasks, optimize the layout of platform bases, promote the enhancement of innovation capabilities, technology innovation center.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Strengthen the construction of common technical platforms for medical devices, with a focus on building 15-20 technology research and development platforms for medical imaging, digital diagnosis and treatment, physical therapy, in vitro diagnostics, biomedical materials, personalized design and manufacturing, electromagnetic compatibility, etc.
titlelist: Key tasks, optimize the layout of platform bases, promote the enhancement of innovation capabilities, and common technology platforms.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Column 6: Key Development Directions for Base Construction. National-level Medical Device Science and Technology Industrial Base. In the fields of medical imaging, biomedical materials, radiation therapy, medical robotics, in vitro diagnostics, mobile telemedicine, medical artificial intelligence, and smart healthcare, select several industrial parks with good industrial foundations and local government attention. Strengthen policy guidance, gather innovative elements such as technology, finance, and talent, with the goal of creating a technological and industrial highland. Encourage policy experimentation, create several closely coordinated areas integrating government, industry, academia, research, and application, with concentrated resources and coordinated policy support, combining research and development with the transformation of achievements in the medical device industry, leading and promoting the development of the medical device industry.
titlelist: Key tasks include gathering innovative entrepreneurial elements to support the development of industrial clusters, gathering innovative elements to improve the industrial chain, promote industrial synergy, strengthen the construction of medical device innovation clusters and industrialization bases, and focus on advancing the construction of 8-10 national-level medical device technology industrial bases.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Strengthen support for major strategic products, key technologies, and core components; encourage collaborative innovation among industry, academia, research, and healthcare institutions, and improve the innovation and entrepreneurship platform in the field of medical devices; carry out the evaluation and approval of relevant medical device products in accordance with the Special Approval Procedure for Innovative Medical Devices and the Priority Approval Procedure for Medical Devices; improve policies and regulations for the clinical application of innovative medical device products, enhance application demonstration and promotion, and shorten the market cultivation period for innovative medical device products; strengthen intellectual property protection and support the development of innovative medical device products.
titlelist: Policy measures, strengthening innovation incentives and guidance.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Research and improve tax support policies that encourage innovation. Expand financing channels and encourage social capital to establish medical device industry investment funds, optimize investment and financing environment, and guide social capital to gather in the medical device field. Support eligible medical device companies to issue bonds and list on domestic and overseas capital markets for financing. Carry out pilot work on insurance compensation mechanism for the first set of major technical equipment to promote cooperation between innovative medical device companies and financial leasing companies, and promote the application of innovative medical devices. Achieve international mergers and acquisitions and integration of high-end medical devices through financial support, and implement and improve export credit and export credit insurance policies.
titlelist: Policy measures, improving financial and taxation support.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Strengthen support for the industrialization of key enterprises, innovative enterprises, and core component enterprises, improve product reliability, promote industrial upgrading, and perfect the industrial chain; support domestic and cross-border mergers and acquisitions, support the growth and strengthening of medical device enterprises, and participate in international competition; relax market access for medical services, encourage medical device enterprises to extend into the health and wellness services industry, promote the development of new formats, new business models, and third-party service networks; guide local governments to strengthen the cultivation of the medical device industry; strengthen production quality supervision and environmental protection inspections, and regulate market competition order.
titlelist: Policy measures to accelerate the cultivation and expansion of industries.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Medical imaging equipment. Including multi-energy multi-slice spiral computed tomography (CT), permanent magnet magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or high-field superconducting magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), magnetoencephalography (MEG), and functional near-infrared spectroscopy imaging (fNIRS), positron emission tomography (PET), high-performance ultrasound imaging (USI), and integrated multimodal hybrid imaging equipment; high-performance electronic endoscopy/laparoscopy (ES) (such as gastroscopy, laryngoscopy, bronchoscopy, laparoscopy, arthroscopy, etc.) and its ultrasound, optical coherence, fluorescence, confocal, and other composite modal imaging systems; high-performance digital radiography (DR), digital subtraction angiography (DSA), and specialized digital radiography for gastrointestinal, breast, bladder, oral, and other specialties; portable, portable, mobile, and vehicle-mounted multi-functional medical imaging systems and their supporting equipment. The core components include high-field superconducting magnets, superconducting RF array surface coils, low-temperature refrigerators for MRI, high-heat-capacity X-ray tubes, fast multi-slice CT detectors, amorphous silicon/oxide flat-panel X-ray detectors, magnetically compatible all-digital solid-state PET detectors, high-density array ultrasound probes, low-dose detectors, and other core components and key technologies. Medical imaging services. Including remote image diagnosis, mobile image diagnosis and treatment, third-party medical imaging centers, and other related supporting equipment and technologies.
titlelist: Medical engineering industry, specializing in imaging equipment and services.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Tumor treatment equipment. This includes electronic linear accelerators with advanced features such as real-time motion tracking, image guidance, conformal therapy, and intensity modulation, as well as radiation therapy systems with proton/heavy ion cyclotrons and their high-precision treatment planning systems; tumor thermal therapy, ablation, and cryotherapy equipment such as magnetic induction, high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU), radiofrequency, microwave, argon-helium knife, and their treatment monitoring systems; boron neutron capture therapy systems and their targeted drugs. Surgical treatment equipment. This includes intraoperative positioning, intraoperative imaging, intraoperative monitoring, image-guided navigation equipment, and their information systems; digital, integrated surgical, interventional, intraoperative, and minimally invasive treatment equipment, as well as their information systems; abdominal, thoracic, urological, orthopedic, interventional, and other surgical assistive robots and their accompanying minimally invasive surgical instruments; high-performance lasers, ultrasound, plasma, high-frequency, and other new surgical instruments, as well as digital anesthesia machine workstations with functions such as anesthesia depth monitoring and control. Rehabilitation treatment equipment. This includes implantable neurostimulators, multi-chamber cardiac pacemakers, implantable defibrillators, artificial electronic cochlea; sound and photodynamic therapy and their sensitizers; ultrafast electromagnetic pulses, ultra-high static electric fields, high-power lasers, electromagnetic fields, electromagnetic waves, ultrasound, optics, mechanics, and other rehabilitation therapy equipment; rehabilitation training and treatment robots with real-time 3D muscle strength assessment, gait analysis, balance assessment control, limb coordination, functional electrical stimulation (FES), biofeedback, motion monitoring, sensory testing, and other functions; rehabilitation training and assessment systems for muscle function training, behavior, psychology, and cognitive intervention. Specialized treatment equipment. This includes ophthalmic excimer laser therapy devices, urological laser therapy devices, endoscopic laser therapy devices, oral treatment equipment; image fusion-based cardiac conduction three-dimensional mapping and radiofrequency ablation therapy systems; traditional Chinese medicine treatment equipment based on traditional medical principles. Life support equipment. This includes high-performance ventilators with new ventilation modes, artificial heart-lung machines, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation systems, and cardiac function assist devices; continuous blood purification systems, hemodialysis machines, peritoneal dialysis machines, artificial liver treatment devices, blood perfusion, plasma adsorption, plasma exchange equipment, and consumables; intensive care systems, automated defibrillators, cardiopulmonary resuscitation devices. Rehabilitation treatment services. This includes supporting equipment and technologies related to third-party tumor radiation therapy centers, community blood purification centers, community chronic disease treatment centers, community rehabilitation therapy centers, and community rehabilitation training centers.
titlelist: Medical engineering industry, focusing on therapeutic equipment and services.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Medical Device Technological Innovation (excerpt) (State Science and Technology Office [2017] No. 44) (Ministry of Science and Technology Office/ May 26, 2017)
content: Medical examination and testing instruments. Including electrocardiogram, electroencephalogram, electromyogram, evoked potential, eye electromyogram and other electrophysiological signal detection and analysis instruments, new types of vascular function, heart function, lung function, and cardiopulmonary function testing and analysis instruments, continuous dynamic electrocardiogram, electroencephalogram, blood pressure, blood glucose, hemoglobin and other detection and analysis instruments, low physiological and low psychological load respiratory sleep monitoring and analysis instruments, multi-functional and multi-parameter physiological parameter monitor; Doppler blood flow imaging instrument, ultrasound bone density testing and analysis instrument, ophthalmic optical coherence tomography (OCT) and other specialized diagnostic equipment; non-invasive/minimally invasive intracranial pressure monitoring instrument, non-invasive/minimally invasive blood glucose testing instrument, non-invasive in vivo biochemical analysis device; health information terminals, general examination devices, life information monitoring devices, and related information systems and cloud platforms based on Internet of Things, wearable technology, sensor networks, mobile communication, global positioning, etc.; major chronic disease screening and diagnostic equipment for lung cancer, gastric cancer, liver cancer, colorectal cancer, breast cancer, cervical cancer, etc. In vitro diagnostic testing instruments. Including high-precision, high-throughput (fast), fully automated biochemical, electrolyte, blood gas, urine, body fluid, feces, vaginal secretions, hemoglobin, glycated hemoglobin, specific proteins, blood cells, microorganisms, metabolism, nutrition, blood coagulation and other detection and analysis instruments (including dry type) and their disease diagnosis and screening information systems; fully automated, high-throughput, high-sensitivity enzyme-linked photometry, electrochemistry, chemiluminescence, electrochemiluminescence, fluorescence, time-resolved fluorescence, homogeneous time-resolved fluorescence and other methods of immune analysis systems, instruments related to tissue/cell detection and analysis, immunohistochemistry automated staining instruments and their supporting reagents; medical mass spectrometry analyzers, medical chromatography analyzers, trace spectrophotometers, automated blood typing analyzers, flow cytometers, confocal scanners, on-site rapid multi-parameter biochemical analyzers (POCT), microbial culture instruments; mercury-free thermometers, various types of in vitro diagnostic reagents, test strips, and their supporting equipment and consumables. Molecular diagnostic testing instruments. Including real-time fluorescence quantitative PCR instruments, fluorescence in situ hybridization instruments, high-throughput gene sequencers, constant temperature chip nucleic acid real-time detection systems, biochip readers, biochip hybridization instruments, biochip washers, super-resolution molecular imaging systems, rapid fully automated nucleic acid extractors; molecular biology information analysis and processing systems. Medical examination and testing services. Including third-party in vitro diagnostic centers, health examination centers, health records and information collection centers, molecular diagnostic information centers, health cabins, and other supporting equipment and technologies related to services.
titlelist: Medical engineering industry, using inspection and testing instruments and services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: By 2030, research and development of common key technologies and core components of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices will achieve breakthroughs. A batch of refined, integrated, digitalized, and intelligent products that meet clinical needs and market demands will be developed and applied. Integration with modern technologies such as microelectronics, information technology, materials technology, new generation manufacturing technology, sensing technology, and biotechnology will be strengthened, significantly improving the performance, quality, and technological content of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices. Furthermore, the construction of the traditional Chinese medicine medical device technology innovation platform system will be further strengthened, the standard system for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices will be basically improved, and a multidisciplinary research and development talent and innovation team that understands both traditional Chinese medicine and modern science and technology will be cultivated. The innovative role and capabilities of traditional Chinese medicine medical device manufacturing enterprises will be significantly enhanced, improving industrial competitiveness and industrialization level.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: With the goal of expanding the scope of clinical services and meeting clinical needs, we integrate emerging technologies such as microelectronics, high-reliability component technology, sensing technology, cloud computing, big data, Internet of Things, mobile healthcare, and artificial intelligence technology to develop a series of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) prevention, detection, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation, and monitoring equipment. By applying artificial intelligence technology and utilizing TCM big data, we promote the integration of TCM medical devices with the Internet and mobile terminals, and develop mobile, wearable, and intelligent Internet+ TCM medical devices and auxiliary systems. Focusing on challenges such as flexible control, human-machine coupling, multi-information fusion and processing, we aim to make breakthroughs in non-invasive detection, acquisition and analysis of TCM diagnostic information, auxiliary positioning of acupoints, intelligent identification of TCM health, and clinical evaluation of TCM medical devices. Key research areas include new intelligent pulse diagnosis devices, tongue diagnosis devices, infrared thermal imaging detection devices, moxibustion therapy devices, laser treatment devices, meridian detection and treatment devices, precise assessment devices for TCM treatment of characteristic diseases, visualization devices for TCM efficacy, TCM rehabilitation appliances, and sleep promotion devices. We also develop TCM detection and monitoring devices that are easy to operate and suitable for home or personal use. In response to the needs of elderly rehabilitation and care, we develop TCM intelligent rehabilitation appliances for elderly patients, TCM medical service robots, and related auxiliary devices. We strengthen research analysis and development utilization of diagnostic and treatment big data generated from the application of TCM medical devices, establish standards and specifications for digital TCM diagnostic and treatment information, and study the establishment of technologies, methods, platforms, and related tools for the collection, storage, management, and utilization of diagnostic and treatment big data, in order to enhance the level of TCM medical devices.
titlelist: Strengthen the innovation and development of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and strengthen the research and development of traditional Chinese medicine medical device products.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: With the goal of improving the performance, quality, and technological content of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) medical devices, modern multidisciplinary technological achievements are utilized to enhance the optimization and iterative upgrading of TCM medical devices that have extensive clinical applications and high market demand. This aims to promote increasing variety, improving quality, and creating brands, and guide the development of TCM medical devices towards refinement, digitization, and intelligence. For TCM diagnostic equipment such as the four diagnostic methods instrument, the focus is on improving the authenticity, reliability, accuracy, and precision of TCM data collection. For TCM traditional treatment equipment such as acupuncture, massage, bone injury, external application, and fumigation, as well as comprehensive nursing equipment, the focus is on enhancing their clinical efficacy. For existing TCM rehabilitation devices and elderly care equipment, the focus is on introducing technologies such as flexible traction, intelligent virtual training, emotion perception, and human motion intention recognition to improve product performance and rehabilitation effectiveness.
titlelist: Strengthen the innovation and development of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and accelerate the upgrading and transformation of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: Based on the existing classification of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) testing, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation, and health status identification, research is conducted on the basic standards of TCM medical device terminology, technical requirements, diagnosis and treatment information, etc. The research focuses on TCM medical device classification standards, providing support for the standardization of TCM medical device management.
titlelist: Establishing a comprehensive standard system for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and conducting basic standard research on traditional Chinese medicine medical devices.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: Conduct research on the methodology of clinical evaluation of traditional Chinese medical devices that aligns with the theories and clinical application characteristics of traditional Chinese medicine. Focus on standardizing the medical health data collected by traditional Chinese medicine testing and diagnostic equipment, achieve standardized data interpretation, and develop clinical diagnostic guidelines based on the data. Conduct key technological research in areas such as application, evaluation, monitoring, and improvement, and establish technical specifications, improve the standard system, and enhance the quality of technical standards. Research and formulate operating standards for traditional Chinese medical devices to improve the standardization level of their application.
titlelist: Establishing a comprehensive standard system for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and researching the technical standards for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: Facing the innovation and market demand of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, in accordance with the relevant requirements of the laws and regulations on the supervision and management of medical devices, research is conducted on the management standards related to the quality and safety, registration, approval, supervision, and operational technology of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, in order to improve the standard system of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices.
titlelist: Establishing a comprehensive standard system for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and researching the management standards for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: Combining the demand of the Chinese traditional medicine medical device market, we encourage collaborative establishment of joint laboratories by academic, research, and industrial units to carry out research and development of Chinese traditional medicine medical devices that align with the theories of Chinese traditional medicine in terms of diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation, and other functions. We aim to build a number of platforms for academic, research, and industrial use, with enterprises as the main body, to strengthen interdisciplinary integration and the construction of innovative teams that combine medical research and enterprise. This will provide support for the development of Chinese traditional medicine medical devices, solidify the research foundation of Chinese traditional medicine medical devices, and focus on enhancing the innovation capability of China's Chinese traditional medicine medical device industry. We also encourage regions with industrial foundations and technological advantages to establish research and development and industrialization bases for Chinese traditional medicine medical devices.
titlelist: Promote the construction and international development of the innovative platform for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and accelerate the construction of interdisciplinary platforms for industry, academia, research, and application.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: Adhere to the combination of inheritance and innovation, actively learn from and utilize modern science and technology, achieve original innovation, integrated innovation, as well as introduce, digest, and absorb for re-innovation. Accelerate the development of the traditional Chinese medicine medical device industry chain, promote the transformation and upgrading of the medical device industry, gradually promote the cross-border integration of industry, technology, and finance, optimize the combination of innovation chain, industry chain, and service chain, and make the field of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices present a development trend of integration, multi-subject, and integration. Innovation and entrepreneurship are highly active, and new products and new formats continue to emerge.
titlelist: Promote the construction and international development of the innovative platform for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and promote the integrated development of the industrial chain.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: Strengthen cooperation and communication with international standardization organizations, actively develop international standards for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and enhance the international influence and market competitiveness of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices. According to the needs of countries along the Belt and Road, strengthen international scientific and technological cooperation and research on traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, actively explore new models of international cooperation, and promote the application of traditional Chinese medicine medical device products in countries along the Belt and Road through technological innovation.
titlelist: Promote the construction and international development of the innovative platform for traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and promote the international development of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: Establish a coordination and consultation mechanism between the Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) management department and relevant management departments such as science and technology, industry and information technology, health and drug regulation. Research and formulate policy measures that can reflect the characteristics of TCM medical devices and promote innovative development in TCM medical devices. Coordinate with relevant science and technology programs (special projects, funds, etc.) to provide support, and address major issues that hinder technological innovation in TCM medical devices. Guide the development of branded TCM medical devices and cultivate a group of innovative TCM medical device manufacturing enterprises.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen communication and coordination, improve relevant support policies.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Technological Innovation in Traditional Chinese Medicine Medical Devices (National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission/ August 30, 2018)
content: The various levels of traditional Chinese medicine management departments should strengthen their attention and support for technological innovation in traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, increase investment in basic research, encourage various scientific research forces and social capital to participate in the research and development of traditional Chinese medicine medical devices, and encourage companies to support basic research. Support companies as the main innovators to carry out pre-market research and development and clinical evaluation of traditional Chinese medicine medical device projects that have completed preliminary research, and accelerate the integration and development of the industry chain from the perspectives of technology, demand, and market. Encourage companies to collaborate with medical institutions and research institutions in scientific research cooperation, talent cultivation, and infrastructure construction to achieve the sharing of scientific and technological resources.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, encourage enterprise innovation, and establish a diversified input mechanism.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Plan for the Construction of Public Health Prevention, Control, and Treatment Capacity (excerpt) (Development and Reform Society [2020] No. 735) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Health Commission, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine / May 9, 2020)
content: Construction goal: To meet the needs of urbanization in the county town, to plan and layout in advance moderately, and to focus on improving the infrastructure of one county-level hospital (including the county traditional Chinese medicine hospital), fully exerting the leading role of the county-level hospital, radiating and driving the overall improvement of medical service capacity in the county, and building a solid first line of defense for epidemic treatment. Construction content: First, improve the business premises conditions of the fever clinic, emergency department, inpatient department, medical technology department, etc. of the county-level hospital, update and replace medical equipment, improve logistics support facilities such as parking, medical waste, and sewage treatment, and enhance the hospital's diagnosis and treatment environment. Second, enhance the infectious disease testing and treatment capabilities of the county-level hospital, focus on strengthening the construction of the infectious disease department and relatively independent infectious disease wards, improve the configuration of inspection and testing instruments and equipment, and improve the level of rapid testing and treatment. Third, construct convertible wards, expand the intensive care unit (ICU, including related specialized intensive care units) beds, generally set up intensive care beds at 2-5% of the authorized beds, which can be used as general beds during normal times, and configure necessary medical equipment such as ventilators according to different scales and functions. They can be immediately converted in the event of a major epidemic. Construction requirements: Taking into account factors such as urbanization, transportation conditions, population size, and the public service needs of relocated poverty alleviation populations, refer to the Comprehensive Hospital Construction Standards and Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital Construction Standards to reasonably determine the construction scale. The construction of infectious disease treatment capacity in county-level hospitals should achieve a combination of peacetime and wartime and give equal importance to both Chinese and Western medicine. They should have the ability to quickly open infectious disease beds when an epidemic occurs. In principle, counties with a population of less than 300,000 should open no fewer than 20 beds, counties with a population of 300,000 to 500,000 should open no fewer than 50 beds, counties with a population of 500,000 to 1 million should open no fewer than 80 beds, and counties with a population of over 1 million should open no fewer than 100 beds. Localities should coordinate the construction of primary healthcare institutions such as township health centers, community health service centers, and village clinics, and form a joint force for medical treatment and epidemic prevention and control within the county.
titlelist: Construction task, comprehensively enhance the treatment capabilities of county-level hospitals.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 13, 2017)
content: Support the development of surgical robot operating systems and promote the application of surgical robots in clinical medicine. By 2020, breakthroughs will be made in key technologies such as intelligent service robot environment perception, natural interaction, autonomous learning, and human-machine collaboration. Prototype production of robots for medical rehabilitation, elderly and disabled assistance, fire rescue, and other purposes will be completed, with technology and functionality verification achieved, and more than 20 application demonstrations realized.
titlelist: Cultivating intelligent products, intelligent service robots.

name: Promotion of the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry Three-Year Action Plan (2018-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 13, 2017)
content: Promote the standardization and normalization of medical imaging data collection, support the research and development of medical imaging-assisted diagnosis technologies in typical disease areas such as brain, lung, eye, bone, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, and breast, and accelerate the productization and clinical application of medical imaging-assisted diagnosis systems. By 2020, the detection rate of advanced multimodal medical imaging-assisted diagnosis systems for the above-mentioned typical diseases in China will exceed 95%, with a false negative rate of less than 1% and a false positive rate of less than 5%.
titlelist: Cultivating intelligent products, medical imaging assisted diagnosis system.

name: Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/January 4, 2021)
content: Agricultural modernization, with seeds as the foundation. Strengthen the protection, development, and utilization of agricultural germplasm resources, accelerate the investigation and collection of germplasm resources for the third time in crops, livestock, and poultry, and strengthen the construction of national crop, livestock, and marine fishery genetic resources banks. Provide long-term and stable support for fundamental breeding research and key breeding projects. Accelerate the implementation of major scientific and technological projects in agricultural biotechnology. Thoroughly implement joint research on high-quality crop and livestock breeds. Implement a new round of genetic improvement plans for livestock and poultry and modern seed industry enhancement projects. Respect science, strengthen supervision, and promote the industrial application of biological breeding in an orderly manner. Strengthen intellectual property protection in the breeding field. Support leading seed companies in establishing a sound commercial breeding system, accelerate the construction of a silicon valley for seed breeding, strengthen the construction of seed production bases and high-quality breeding systems, research and develop major varieties, and promote the integrated development of breeding and propagation.
titlelist: Accelerate the advancement of agricultural modernization and win the battle of seed industry transformation.

name: Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/January 4, 2021)
content: Implement the continuation, supporting, and modernization of large and medium-sized irrigation areas. By 2025, complete the reinforcement of all existing dangerous reservoirs. Adhere to agricultural science and technology self-reliance and self-strengthening, improve the stable support mechanism for basic research in the field of agricultural science and technology, deepen institutional reform, and establish a number of innovative base platforms. Carry out in-depth actions to support rural revitalization with science and technology. Support universities in providing intellectual services for rural revitalization. Strengthen the construction of the socialized service system for agricultural science and technology, and promote the system of sending science and technology officers. Build a national tropical agricultural science center. Improve the independent research and development capability of agricultural machinery and equipment, support the research, development, and manufacturing of high-end intelligent agricultural machinery equipment in hilly and mountainous areas, increase the subsidy for equipment purchase, and carry out subsidies for agricultural machinery operations. Strengthen the construction of animal epidemic prevention and crop pest and disease control systems, and enhance prevention and control capabilities.
titlelist: Accelerate the advancement of agricultural modernization, strengthen the support of modern agricultural science and technology, and material equipment.

name: Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Fully Advancing Rural Revitalization and Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/January 4, 2021)
content: Relying on the advantages of rural characteristics and resources, we will build a complete agricultural industry chain, keeping the main body of the industry chain in the county town and allowing farmers to share more of the value-added income of the industry. We will accelerate the establishment of a modern agricultural industry chain standard system, promote the production of new agricultural management entities according to standards, and cultivate standard leaders in agricultural leading enterprises. Based on the county's layout of characteristic agricultural product production and initial and deep processing, we will build modern agricultural industrial parks, strong agricultural towns, and advantageous characteristic industry clusters. We will promote the construction of public welfare agricultural product markets and backbone networks for agricultural product circulation. We will develop leisure agriculture and rural tourism boutique routes and improve supporting facilities. We will promote the integration and development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries in rural areas, and the construction of demonstration parks for integrated development of agriculture, industry, and services and science and technology demonstration parks. Taking the demonstration area for agricultural modernization as an important starting point for promoting agricultural modernization, we will establish an index system, strengthen resource integration and policy integration, and carry out the creation at the county (city, district) level. By 2025, we aim to create around 500 demonstration areas, forming a pattern of promoting agricultural modernization in stages. We will create demonstration zones for modern forestry industry. We will organize the thousands of enterprises prospering thousands of villages campaign. We will steadily promote the statistical accounting of agriculture and related industries that reflects the value of the entire industry chain.
titlelist: Accelerate the advancement of agricultural modernization and build a modern rural industrial system.

name: Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/January 4, 2021)
content: Implement the national black soil conservation project and promote conservation tillage. Improve the fallow rotation system for farmland. Continuously promote the reduction and efficiency improvement of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, and promote green pest control products and technologies for crops. Strengthen the utilization of livestock and poultry manure resources. Fully implement comprehensive utilization of straw and recycling of agricultural film and pesticide packaging materials, and strengthen the research and promotion of degradable agricultural film. Construct a number of demonstration counties for comprehensive management of agricultural non-point source pollution in the Yangtze River Economic Belt and the Yellow River Basin. Support the construction of national agricultural green development pilot zones. Strengthen the supervision of agricultural product quality and food safety, develop green agricultural products, organic agricultural products, and geographical indication agricultural products, and pilot the system of edible agricultural product qualification certificates, and promote the creation of national agricultural product quality and safety counties. Strengthen the conservation of aquatic biological resources, promote the construction of fishery law enforcement capacity with the Yangtze River as the focus, ensure the effective implementation of the ten-year fishing ban, and do a good job in the resettlement and guarantee of fishermen who have stopped fishing. Develop water-saving agriculture and dryland farming. Promote comprehensive management of desertification, rocky desertification, soil erosion on sloping farmland, soil pollution prevention and control, and protection and overexploitation control of groundwater in key areas. Implement water system connectivity and comprehensive improvement of rural water systems, and strengthen river and lake management. Consolidate the achievements of returning farmland to forests and grasslands, and improve policies in an orderly manner. Implement forest tenure system. Scientifically carry out large-scale national land greening actions. Improve grassland ecological protection subsidies and incentives, comprehensively promote grazing prohibition, rotational grazing, and rest grazing on grasslands, strengthen grassland rodent control, and steadily restore grassland ecological environment.
titlelist: Accelerate the advancement of agricultural modernization and promote the green development of agriculture.

name: Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on comprehensively promoting rural revitalization and accelerating agricultural and rural modernization (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/January 4, 2021)
content: Highlight and focus on the two types of operating entities, namely family farms and farmer cooperatives, and encourage the development of various forms of moderate-scale operations. Implement a family farm cultivation plan to transform large-scale agricultural operations into vibrant family farms. Promote the improvement of farmer cooperatives and increase support for well-regulated ones. Develop and strengthen specialized socialized service organizations in agriculture, introducing advanced varieties, inputs, technologies, and equipment to small-scale farmers. Support the construction of regional agricultural comprehensive service centers for market entities. Support the innovative development and expansion of leading agricultural industrialization enterprises. Deepen the comprehensive reform of supply and marketing cooperatives, carry out pilot projects for integrated cooperation in production, supply and marketing, and credit, and improve comprehensive platforms for serving farmers' production and livelihoods. Cultivate high-quality farmers, organize participation in skills assessment and education, and establish specialized skills competitions for farmers. Attract talents from various fields in cities to start businesses and innovate in rural areas, and participate in rural revitalization and modern agricultural construction.
titlelist: Accelerate the advancement of agricultural modernization and promote the construction of a modern agricultural management system.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document No. 25 of 2021) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Deepen the promotion of agricultural scientific and technological innovation, improve and perfect the management mechanism, promote the cultivation of superior varieties, improve product quality, build brands, and standardize production, continuously improving the level of development in agriculture, animal husbandry, and fisheries.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Carry out key core technology research in agriculture. Improve the stable support mechanism for basic research in agricultural science and technology, strengthen the construction of agricultural basic theory, scientific research infrastructure, positioning observation system, and resource and ecological monitoring system. Focus on key areas of basic frontier research, accelerate breakthroughs in major theories and tools. Focus on key areas such as biological breeding, farmland quality, smart agriculture, agricultural machinery and equipment, and agricultural green inputs, accelerate the research and innovation of key core technologies and products. Accelerate research on the meteorological environment causes, transmission mechanisms, and pathogenic mechanisms of animal diseases and crop pests and diseases, and enhance the ability to prevent and control major agricultural risks and ensure industrial safety. Strengthen the construction of agricultural strategic scientific and technological forces. Strengthen the construction of the national modern agricultural industry technology system. Deepen the reform of the agricultural science and technology system, promote the integrated allocation of key areas projects, bases, talents, and funds. Strengthen the construction of high-level agricultural research universities, cultivate and strengthen a group of leading agricultural enterprises, and optimize the construction of local agricultural research institutions and innovation teams. Implement the national agricultural research outstanding talent training program. Build a national tropical agricultural science center. Promote deep integration of science and technology with industry. Strengthen the construction of the national agricultural science and technology innovation alliance, support agricultural enterprises in leading the construction of agricultural science and technology innovation consortium or new research and development institutions, and accelerate the construction of national modern agricultural industry science and technology innovation. Carry out actions to support rural revitalization with science and technology, strengthen the construction of the agricultural science and technology social service system, improve the agricultural science and technology promotion service cloud platform, implement the system of sending science and technology representatives, and strengthen the construction of public welfare agricultural technology promotion institutions.
titlelist: Promote innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and strengthen the support of modern agricultural science and technology.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Strengthen the protection of germplasm resources. Fully complete the general survey of crop germplasm resources, livestock and poultry genetic resources, and aquaculture germplasm resources, understand the resources thoroughly, and salvage rare, endangered, unique resources and local characteristic varieties. Initiate precise identification and evaluation of agricultural germplasm resources, promote the creation and application of excellent germplasm resources, and establish a DNA molecular fingerprint library, feature library, and agricultural germplasm resources database. Strengthen the construction of national crop, forestry, livestock and poultry, marine and freshwater fisheries, and microbial germplasm resource banks. Carry out breeding innovation and breakthroughs. Focus on key crops and livestock and poultry, initiate and implement key core technologies for agricultural germplasm resources. Accelerate the implementation of major scientific and technological projects in agricultural biotechnology, and promote the industrial application of biological breeding in an orderly manner. Carry out joint research and development in the seed industry and implement a new round of genetic improvement plans for livestock and poultry and modern seed industry enhancement projects. Strengthen the construction of seed industry bases. Promote the construction of national and provincial seed breeding bases, and accelerate the construction of the Southern Breeding Silicon Valley. Layout and construct large-scale forage breeding bases in the northern farming and animal husbandry areas. Accelerate the construction of high-standard farmland in seed industry bases. Continue to implement incentive policies for seed production counties. Establish a number of national core breeding farms and improve the conditions for breeding and biosafety protection facilities. Promote the construction of national aquatic seed breeding bases. Strengthen seed industry market supervision. Strictly manage varieties, improve the approval standards for major crop varieties, and establish a variety identity card system. Strengthen intellectual property protection in the breeding field, enhance administrative and judicial coordination protection mechanisms, and crack down on illegal and criminal activities such as counterfeiting, inferior quality, and trademark infringement. Improve the supervision system and technical standards for seedlings of livestock, poultry, and aquaculture, and strengthen the supervision of genetic materials for livestock and poultry.
titlelist: Promote innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and promote the revitalization of the seed industry.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Strengthen the research and development of weak links in agricultural machinery and equipment. Strengthen the research and development and application of large and medium-sized, intelligent, and composite agricultural machinery, and build first-class enterprises and well-known brands in agricultural machinery and equipment. Promote the research and development of advanced agricultural machinery and equipment for weak links in the cultivation, management, harvesting, transportation, and storage of grain crops and strategic economic crops. Accelerate the research and development and manufacturing of efficient specialized agricultural machinery suitable for hilly and mountainous agricultural production. Overcome key core technologies, key materials, and important components that restrict the improvement of the overall performance of agricultural machinery. Strengthen the research and development of green and intelligent livestock and aquaculture equipment. Promote the comprehensive development of agricultural mechanization. Improve the whole process mechanization production system for crops, and accelerate the integration of varieties, cultivation, and equipment. Increase support for intelligent, high-end, and safe agricultural machinery and equipment, highlight the selection of excellent machinery and the elimination of inferior ones, support the exploration of integrated research, development, manufacturing, and application, and enhance the level of agricultural machinery and equipment in China and international competitiveness. Promote the integration of machinery and equipment with breeding processes, and improve the mechanization level of major livestock and aquaculture species, key processes, large-scale breeding farms, and facility agriculture. Promote the application of green and environmentally friendly agricultural machinery. Strengthen the construction of supporting facilities such as farm roads, storage sheds, and drying towers, and develop new models of agricultural machinery services such as full-process mechanization + comprehensive farming. Column 3: Enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture.
titlelist: Promote innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and improve the research, development, and application capabilities of agricultural machinery and equipment.
