name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Newly establish a batch of major agricultural science and technology facilities, key laboratories, and agricultural science observation experimental stations in the fields of biological breeding, biosafety, resource environment, intelligent agricultural machinery, deep processing of agricultural products, and the development of green inputs.
titlelist: Promoting innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and building the capacity for agricultural scientific and technological innovation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Construct long-term and mid-term repositories for national crop germplasm resources, improve the level of national breeding and seed production bases in Hainan, Gansu, Sichuan, and other regions, and establish regional breeding and seed production bases for crops such as soybeans in Heilongjiang. Establish new or expand existing national repositories for livestock, poultry, and aquatic product germplasm resources, breeding farms (zones), and gene banks, and promote the construction of national core breeding farms for livestock and poultry. Expand and upgrade two molecular breeding innovation service platforms.
titlelist: Promoting innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, modern seed industry.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Stably implement the agricultural machinery purchase subsidy policy, create 300 demonstration counties for fully mechanized crop production, establish 300 demonstration counties for facility agriculture and large-scale breeding fully mechanization, promote deep tillage and mechanization transformation of terraced fields in hilly and mountainous areas. Strengthen the capacity building of agricultural machinery for planting, harvesting, and drying services.
titlelist: Promoting innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, agricultural mechanization.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Establish approximately 300 demonstration counties for family farms and around 1500 demonstration family farms. Carry out four-level joint creation of national, provincial, municipal, and county-level farmer cooperative demonstration societies, and expand the scope of pilot projects for improving the quality of farmer cooperatives throughout the entire county.
titlelist: Promote innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and cultivate and enhance the action of new agricultural management entities.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for Advancing Agricultural and Rural Modernization (excerpt) (State Council Document [2021] No. 25) (State Council/November 12, 2021)
content: Develop a batch of core germplasm resources and new varieties of water-saving, fertilizer-saving, and pesticide-saving with independent intellectual property rights. Construct 800 green standardized agricultural product production bases and 500 standardized demonstration sites for livestock and poultry farming. Create more than 300 national-level regional public brands for agricultural products, more than 500 enterprise brands, and more than 1000 agricultural product brands.
titlelist: Promoting innovation-driven development to enhance the quality, efficiency, and competitiveness of agriculture, and the action to improve the 'Three Products and One Standard' in agricultural production.

name: Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on the Key Tasks of Comprehensive Rural Revitalization in 2022 (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/January 4, 2022)
content: Comprehensively implement the action plan for revitalizing the seed industry. Accelerate the progress of the national agricultural germplasm resources survey and collection, and strengthen precise identification and evaluation. Promote the construction of national major innovation platforms in the seed industry. Initiate major agricultural biotechnology breeding projects. Speed up the implementation of key core agricultural technologies, implement systems such as revealing the list and appointing the leader and interactions between departments and provinces, and carry out pilot projects for long-term research and development projects. Strengthen the construction of modern agricultural industry technology systems. Carry out pilot projects for subsidies after the development and promotion of major varieties. Implement the Seed Law, establish a substantial derived variety system, strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights in the seed industry, and strictly crack down on illegal activities such as counterfeiting and infringement according to the law.
titlelist: Strengthen the basic support of modern agriculture and vigorously promote key core technologies such as germplasm resources in agricultural research and development.

name: Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on the Key Tasks of Comprehensive Rural Revitalization in 2022 (excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/January 4, 2022)
content: Comprehensively combing through weaknesses and shortcomings, strengthening the engineering collaboration of agricultural machinery and equipment, accelerating the research, development, and manufacturing of high-power machinery, small-scale machinery for hilly and mountainous areas, and intelligent machinery for facility horticulture, and including them in the national key research and development plan for long-term stable support. Implementing subsidies for the purchase and application of agricultural machinery, optimizing the subsidy payment methods. Improving the performance evaluation mechanism of agricultural machinery, promoting the subsidy of machinery with phased-in and phased-out policies, prioritizing support for grain drying, crawler operations, strip intercropping of corn and soybeans, rapeseed harvesting, and promoting large-scale intelligent agricultural machinery. Promoting the upgrade of emission standards for newly produced agricultural machinery. Carrying out pilot projects for the integrated promotion and application of research, development, and manufacturing of agricultural machinery.
titlelist: Strengthen the foundation of modern agriculture and enhance the level of research, development, and application of agricultural machinery and equipment.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Bioeconomy (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2021] No. 1850) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2021)
content: Improve the production capacity and quality of important agricultural products such as grain. Under the premise of respecting science, strict supervision, compliance with laws and regulations, and ensuring safety, promote the industrial application of biotechnology and other fields in an orderly manner, and guarantee the supply of important agricultural products such as grain, meat, eggs, milk, and oilseeds. Promote the orderly development of biotechnology such as whole-genome selection, systems biology, synthetic biology, and artificial intelligence, focus on improving the ability of breeding, production and processing, and promotion and application of superior varieties, and accelerate the construction of a commercial breeding innovation system. Actively promote the research and development of high-yielding and high-quality maize and soybean crops, carry out research on high-quality breeds of pigs, broiler chickens, dairy cows, and other poultry and aquatic products, and promote scientific breeding. Develop synthetic biology technology and explore the development of new types of food such as artificial proteins to achieve iterative upgrading of the food industry and reduce the environmental resource pressure brought by traditional farming. Improve agricultural production efficiency. Develop green agriculture and produce agricultural products such as biological preparations from agricultural waste, natural agricultural biopharmaceuticals, precision multi-target biological pesticides, and soil improvement products. Promote the integration of cutting-edge biotechnology in the field of agriculture, promote the creation and industrialization of technologies such as feed antibiotics substitutes, woody feed, animal genetic engineering vaccines, biological veterinary drugs, plant immune regulators, efficient testing reagents, efficient carbon sequestration and nitrogen fixation products, and improve land and resource utilization efficiency. Develop enzyme preparations, microbial preparations, fermented feed, and amino acid feed, and solve major problems in the breeding field such as feed safety, lack of raw materials, and environmental pollution. Column 3: Modern Seed Industry Enhancement Project.
titlelist: Cultivate and strengthen the pillar industries of the bioeconomy, and promote the development of the bio-agricultural industry.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Bioeconomy (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2021] No. 1850) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2021)
content: By focusing on the national long-term and mid-term repositories (resource gardens) for crop germplasm resources, as well as repositories and conservation areas for livestock and poultry genetic resources, and aquatic germplasm resource repositories and resource fields, we aim to build a germplasm resource protection system with international advanced level. This system will support research institutes, universities, and enterprises in collecting, preserving, identifying, evaluating, and utilizing germplasm resources, providing high-quality resource materials for scientific research and breeding.
titlelist: Promote the development of the bio-based economy, support the growth of the bio-agricultural industry, and protect genetic resources.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Bioeconomy (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2021] No. 1850) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2021)
content: The text translates to:Focusing on innovative service platforms and identification platforms for molecular breeding of crops, innovative platforms for livestock and poultry breeding, and joint breeding platforms for aquaculture, we will develop original breeding technologies, support the construction of a batch of integrated breeding and propagation enterprises, and strive to build a basic research and commercial breeding system with international standards. We will improve research and innovation conditions, promote deep integration of production and research, and facilitate efficient allocation of innovative elements.
titlelist: Develop and strengthen the pillar industries of the bioeconomy, promote the development of the bio-agricultural industry, and promote breeding innovation.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Bioeconomy (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2021] No. 1850) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2021)
content: The key focus is on establishing national-level crop breeding and regional breeding bases, as well as seed stations for livestock and breeding bases for aquaculture. Efforts are being made to create national production bases for high-quality crops, livestock, and aquaculture breeds, effectively ensuring the supply of high-quality breeds and comprehensively improving the coverage rate of high-quality breeds.
titlelist: Promote the development of the bio-based economy pillar industry, drive the development of the bio-agricultural industry, and promote the breeding of superior varieties.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Bioeconomy (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2021] No. 1850) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2021)
content: The main technologies involved in biological breeding include the discovery, isolation, and cloning of important functional genes in agricultural organisms, molecular marker-assisted breeding technology, genetic engineering (transgenic) breeding technology, molecular design breeding technology, plant virus-free tissue culture and rapid propagation technology, cell engineering breeding technology, animal embryo engineering technology, animal cloning technology, animal and plant bioreactor technology, chromosome manipulation technology, plant haploid, double haploid, and polyploid induction breeding technology, germplasm resource irradiation mutation breeding technology, space breeding technology, as well as genome editing technology, big data analysis and optimization breeding management technology, etc. These technologies form the basis for key products, including new varieties and combinations of grain, cotton, and oil crops with superior quality, high yield, disease and pest resistance, and drought and salt tolerance, as well as new varieties and seedlings of fruits, vegetables, flowers, special economic crops, forestry and landscaping tree species, energy plant varieties and seedlings, forage grass varieties, excellent livestock and poultry varieties, semen and embryos of breeding animals, animal and plant bioreactors and products, new varieties of aquatic products and large-scale healthy aquaculture, new materials for biological breeding, and artificially scaled breeding of new varieties of animals and plants with important economic and medicinal value.
titlelist: 物农业产业,物育种 translates to Physical agriculture industry, physical breeding in English.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Bioeconomy (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2021] No. 1850) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2021)
content: Biological pesticides. This includes living microorganisms such as bacteria, fungi, and viruses, processed formulations of microbial metabolites, and plant-based pesticides. It is supported by modern microbial technology, recombinant DNA technology, and fermentation engineering. This includes large-scale isolation and identification of microorganisms and their resource utilization technology, functional gene isolation, cloning, expression, and recombinant technology of animals, plants, and microorganisms, gene transfer and bioencapsulation technology, antibiotic combination biosynthesis technology, large-scale production technology of plant-based pesticides, oligosaccharide molecular structure modification and transformation technology, and processing and production technology of new broad-spectrum long-lasting biological pesticide formulations. Key products include safe, efficient, and novel microbial insecticides such as Bacillus thuringiensis (BT), Beauveria bassiana, Metarhizium anisopliae, and insect viruses, microbial metabolite formulations such as agricultural antibiotics, Bacillus subtilis formulations for antibacterial and disease prevention, microbial ecology and oligosaccharide formulations, insect pheromones and other biochemical formulations, and plant-based insecticides and antibacterial fungicides.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text '物农业产业,物农药' to English is 'Physical agriculture industry, physical pesticides'.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Bioeconomy (excerpt) (NDRC High-Tech [2021] No. 1850) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 20, 2021)
content: Key products and technical services. Including the screening and fermentation process of microbial fertilizer production bacteria, symbiotic nitrogen-fixing microorganisms, application of new technologies for agricultural biogas production and comprehensive utilization, crop straw returning technology, slow-release technology and equipment for biological fertilizers, microbial degradation technology for synthetic organic substances and hazardous waste, symbiotic nitrogen-fixing microorganism inoculants such as rhizobia, organic material ripening agents, biological organic fertilizers, compound microbial fertilizer products, etc.
titlelist: 物农业产业,物肥料 translates to Physical agriculture industry, physical fertilizers in English.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan National Agricultural and Rural Science and Technology Development Plan (excerpt) (Agricultural Science and Education Development [2021] No. 13) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/December 24, 2021)
content: Strengthen the innovation and utilization of germplasm resources, carry out innovation in biological breeding technology system, cultivate breakthrough new varieties, achieve localization of core technologies and strategic varieties of germplasm resources, and promote the revitalization of the seed industry. Germplasm collection and identification. Focus on major food crops, cotton, oil and sugar crops, important tropical crops, important livestock and aquaculture animals, high-end vegetables, important flowers, potatoes, edible fungi, etc., strengthen the survey, collection, preservation, and evaluation of germplasm resources, improve the living library, specimen library, cell library, and gene library of major crops and wild plants, livestock and aquaculture, agricultural microorganisms, etc., and form a national agricultural germplasm resource preservation system. Breakthrough key technologies in multi-omics big data analysis, develop high-throughput germplasm resource genomics-metabolomics-phenomics-environmentomics coupled intelligent identification technology. Germplasm resource innovation. In response to the major demand for precise design of agricultural biological varieties, carry out research on the formation and evolution of germplasm resources, explore key genes and regulatory elements controlling complex traits such as high yield and quality, drought and salt tolerance, resource conservation, environmental intelligence response, growth period regulation, quality and health, as well as resistance to diseases, pests, and weeds, clarify their functions and regulatory networks, reveal the molecular mechanisms of complex traits such as high yield, high quality, and green efficiency in agricultural organisms, and create high-quality and stable germplasm products. Modern biological breeding. Overcome the bottleneck of efficient genetic transformation of major agricultural animals and plants, establish a new efficient genetic transformation technology that does not depend on the receptor genotype and multi-gene stacking; integrate agricultural genetics, genomics, metabolomics, and phenomics data, develop new technologies such as polyploid breeding, rapid domestication, and cross-border improvement, and achieve precise improvement of specialized traits. Accelerate the breeding of new green varieties suitable for mechanized operations and efficient resource utilization, cultivate breakthrough agricultural new varieties with high yield, high efficiency, and high quality. Respect science, strengthen regulation, and promote the industrial application of biological breeding in an orderly manner. Carry out precise identification of agricultural germplasm resources and gene mining, and construct DNA molecular fingerprint maps of germplasm resources. Column 2: Seed industry revitalization actions. 01. Promote the protection and utilization of germplasm resources, and complete the third national survey and collection of crop germplasm resources, and initiate and complete the third national survey of livestock and poultry genetic resources and the first national survey of aquaculture germplasm resources. Coordinate the construction of a batch of crop germplasm resource banks (nurseries), livestock and aquaculture germplasm resource conservation sites (areas), and germplasm resource introduction, transit, and isolation libraries, spectral libraries, feature libraries, and germplasm resource databases. 02. Seed industry innovation and research. Strengthen basic and frontier research in the seed industry, initiate and implement key core technologies for agricultural germplasm resources, implement major projects in agricultural breeding, promote joint breeding research, increase the promotion and application of seed industry scientific and technological achievements, and promote the construction of innovation bases such as the Southern Silicon Valley. Implement major projects such as large-scale phenotypic identification platforms and molecular breeding platforms, and support leading seed industry enterprises in carrying out breeding innovation.
titlelist: Strengthen agricultural and rural scientific and technological innovation, break through major scientific and technological issues in key areas of agriculture and rural areas, and promote innovation in germplasm and biological seed industry.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan National Agricultural and Rural Science and Technology Development Plan (excerpt) (Agricultural Science and Education Development [2021] No. 13) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/December 24, 2021)
content: Strengthen the key technological innovation of high-efficiency cultivation of crops and healthy breeding of livestock, poultry, and aquatic products, focus on technological research and development, product creation, and engineering integration application, enhance the adaptability of technology supply for green agricultural development, scientifically improve land output rate, labor productivity, and resource utilization rate, effectively support food security, effective supply of important agricultural products, and the improvement of industrial quality and efficiency. Efficient cultivation of crops. With high yield, high efficiency, ecological, and safety as the core, research on high-yield and efficient cultivation theory of crops that synergistically coordinate yield, quality, and resource utilization, develop streamlined, scaled, precise and intelligent, and efficient technologies for the entire process of crop production, and construct a green standardized production technology system. Aggregate and integrate resource elements to support the construction of a national food security industrial belt. Focus on improving yield levels, developing reserve arable land, and developing saline-alkali land, implement soybean technology self-strengthening actions, and support the improvement of soybean oilseed production capacity. Accelerate the integration and large-scale demonstration application of simplified, mechanized, scaled, and standardized technologies for horticultural crop intelligent standardized production, tropical crops, and large-scale economic crop green and high-quality production. Efficient and healthy breeding of livestock and poultry. Conduct research on the physiological regulation mechanisms and laws of livestock and poultry feed utilization, growth and development, reproduction, and health, develop automatic monitoring technologies for the physiological states and health conditions of animal growth and development, estrus, and pregnancy, develop efficient feed utilization and emission reduction technologies, and develop new feed resources. Break through the bottleneck of physiological synchronization in animal herds, establish a pipeline-style industrial production technology for livestock and poultry batches, innovate environmental control, greenhouse gas, and ammonia reduction technologies for livestock and poultry breeding, research on good breed evaluation, precise supply of feed nutrients, and scaled healthy breeding technologies. Improve the quality and efficiency of fishery production. Research on green and healthy breeding models for land-based factory farming, freshwater pond farming, deep-sea and offshore farming, rice-fish integrated farming, large water surface ecological fishery, and saline-alkali water farming. Conduct research on breeding and genetic improvement technologies for aquaculture seedlings, develop high-quality, efficient, multi-resistant, and safe new aquatic varieties. Research on efficient utilization of aquaculture feed, promote the replacement of live and miscellaneous fish with compound feed. Develop and promote key technologies for efficient and specific vaccines and disease control for aquaculture. Carry out research and development of key technologies and equipment for high-quality fishing, mechanization, and sustainable development of deep-sea and ocean fisheries. Precise control of water and fertilizer. Conduct research on agricultural microbiomics, reveal the mechanisms of microbial nitrogen fixation and plant interactions, efficient nutrient utilization, etc., develop demonstration technologies for efficient water-saving irrigation, soil testing and formula fertilization, and other modern water-saving and fertilization technologies, focus on the research and development of new technologies, methods, and products such as low-energy consumption sprinkler irrigation for field crops, precise ground irrigation, fully biodegradable mulch film for moisture retention, combined leaching of soil nutrients, and plant nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium nutrition diagnosis, and establish a technology system for drought and flood protection, efficient water-saving irrigation, and slow-release fertilizer in dryland areas. Creation of green inputs. Develop targeted delivery and intelligent controlled release systems for agricultural nanomaterials, create new green agricultural inputs such as efficient, safe, and low-residue pesticides, green veterinary drugs, intelligent fertilizers, functional feeds, and fully biodegradable mulch films, and improve the level of production process technology. Conduct research on biomimetic synthesis materials and heavy metal component control in feed, develop and create large molecular materials such as functional polysaccharides, nucleic acids, active peptides, antigens and antibodies, insecticidal and antibacterial proteins, and biological enzymes. Develop new types of probiotics, antimicrobial peptides, and water quality improvers as alternative products. Integrate and promote green pest and disease control and fertilizer reduction and efficiency enhancement technologies, and promote the use of traditional Chinese medicine in animal husbandry. Agricultural non-point source pollution control. Conduct research on the emission and riverine changes of agricultural non-point source pollution at the watershed scale, break through the typical sources of non-point source pollution in watershed water bodies, identify key source areas of agricultural non-point source pollution in watersheds, and estimate pollution loads, create assessment models for agricultural non-point source pollution in watersheds and visualized decision-making platforms for prevention and control. Develop intelligent online monitoring equipment for watershed water quality and quantity, develop key technologies and equipment for coordinated prevention and control of multiple sources in planting, breeding, and rural life, and integrate and promote regional agricultural non-point source pollution prevention and control technology models. Comprehensive utilization of agricultural waste. Research on collaborative treatment technologies, equipment, and models for agricultural waste such as rural breeding, planting, and processing, construct a comprehensive utilization technology model system for on-site reduction, on-site treatment, and on-site disposal of agricultural waste, and integrate and establish agricultural waste utilization models adapted to different regional characteristics. Develop key technologies for the treatment and utilization of livestock and poultry manure and return to farmland, develop key technologies for the comprehensive utilization of straw through multiple pathways such as fertilizer, feed, fuel, base material, and raw material, develop important products and key technologies such as high-strength mulch film, mulch film recovery and picking equipment, and mulch film resource utilization, and develop environmental health risk assessment and control technologies for the comprehensive utilization of agricultural waste. Construction of ecological circular agriculture. Conduct innovative research on integrated cultivation and breeding models, increase research and development of intercropping, crop rotation, and fallow cultivation techniques and models such as soybean and corn intercropping, focus on innovative technologies and models such as integrated three-dimensional cultivation in paddy fields, three-dimensional cultivation under forests, and comprehensive utilization of saline-alkali land for fisheries and agriculture. Construct a low-carbon, circular, intelligent, and integrated technology system for green agricultural development, accelerate the research and development of cost-saving and efficient, ecological circulation, and other products and technology models, increase the supply of green and high-quality agricultural products and ecological products, and construct typical regional quality improvement and efficiency enhancement technology systems and cultivation and breeding development models. Construct a number of ecological farms. Fisheries resources and environment. Research on technologies such as ecological environment restoration, resource conservation, aquatic wildlife protection, and aquatic habitat restoration. Scientifically evaluate the effectiveness of the Yangtze River fishing ban on the protection of aquatic resources, study the establishment of the Yellow River aquatic biological integrity index, and conduct research on the restoration of the Yellow River estuary habitat. Carry out pilot projects for the protection and habitat restoration of important fisheries resources in offshore waters. Develop equipment and facilities for the construction of marine ranch habitats and study the impact of wind power on marine organisms. Develop key technologies for optimizing the construction of aquatic biological chains, optimizing variety structure, constructing ecological barriers, and maintaining biological hierarchy.
titlelist: Strengthen agricultural and rural scientific and technological innovation, break through major scientific and technological issues in key areas of agriculture and rural areas, and promote efficient farming and green production.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan National Agricultural and Rural Science and Technology Development Plan (excerpt) (Agricultural Science and Education Development [2021] No. 13) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/December 24, 2021)
content: Based on the requirements of full process, comprehensive, high quality, and high efficiency of agricultural mechanization, we focus on the three core functions of perception, decision-making (control), and execution. We carry out research and development of major crops, special economic crops, livestock and aquaculture equipment, and key components to support and lead the automation and intelligence of modern agricultural production. We aim to break through core technologies and components, accelerate the breakthrough of core components such as high-power energy-saving and efficient agricultural diesel engines, lightweight engines for paddy field machinery, hydraulic continuously variable transmissions, and power shift transmissions. We optimize the performance of key operational components such as tillage equipment, imitation cutting platforms, flexible threshing drums, high-speed sowing devices, high-performance knotting machines, and pesticide machinery nozzles. We also develop key common technologies such as efficient and precise sowing, low-loss harvesting, efficient cleaning and sorting, automatic leveling, and film recycling. We focus on weak links in agricultural machinery and equipment, carry out research on rice mechanized planting, low-pressure harvesting of regenerated rice, precision machine sowing for rice/wheat rotation, mechanical harvesting of corn grains/fresh corn, special machinery for soybean-corn strip intercropping, precision sowing of potatoes, efficient planting and efficient harvesting of soybeans, rapeseed, peanuts, and sugarcane, cotton picking, efficient utilization of straw, agricultural film recycling, and livestock and poultry manure application. We develop general-purpose power chassis, lightweight agricultural machinery and equipment, and high-adaptability special machinery for hilly and mountainous areas. We conduct research on the mechanization of natural rubber, fruits, vegetables, tea, Chinese medicinal materials, miscellaneous grains and beans, and high-quality forage, focusing on the development of equipment for rubber tapping, shaping and pruning of fruit trees/tea trees, fruit bagging, harvesting and transportation, and specialty crop harvesting. We conduct research on green and healthy breeding technologies for small and medium-scale livestock and poultry, and develop and apply precision feeding, intelligent environmental control, animal behavior monitoring, seedling counting, vaccine injection, cleaning and disinfection, grading and capture, seaweed production, and aquaculture cycle purification technologies and equipment. We enhance the level of equipment intelligence, develop special sensors for intelligent agricultural machinery and equipment, research on agricultural machinery information acquisition, intelligent decision-making, precision operations, agricultural machinery navigation, efficient scheduling, intelligent diagnosis, traceability analysis, and collaborative operations, and promote intelligent control, satellite positioning, agricultural Internet of Things, big data, agricultural machinery automatic driving, agricultural sensing, and other technologies. We integrate and apply agricultural machinery and equipment, research on precision planting and transplanting, fertilization and pesticide application, grafting and pruning, feeding management, harvesting and drying, and other agricultural robots and intelligent operation equipment that are compatible with agronomy. We develop intelligent new agricultural machinery testing and identification technologies and control equipment. We accelerate the application of key technologies in facility-based and factory-based agriculture, develop equipment for vegetable factory seedling precision sowing, precise seedling extraction, efficient transplanting, harvesting and transportation, and research solar energy interception technology for greenhouses and energy-saving regulation methods for LED light environments in plant factories. We develop integrated intelligent control technologies and devices for horticultural facilities and promote the efficient utilization of light, heat, and nutrient elements for vegetable production and quality formation. We integrate and demonstrate efficient utilization technology models for facility horticultural resources. We accelerate the research and application of light and temperature environmental regulation for greenhouse crops, as well as the development and construction of new greenhouse structures. We initiate the implementation of the action plan to address the shortcomings of agricultural machinery and equipment. We establish a special research project for addressing the weaknesses and shortcomings of agricultural machinery and equipment, establish a national-level innovation center for agricultural machinery and equipment, establish a research and development center for weak links in agricultural mechanization, and establish four-in-one full-process mechanization demonstration and application bases for different crops and production areas.
titlelist: Strengthen agricultural and rural scientific and technological innovation, break through major scientific and technological issues in key areas of agriculture and rural areas, agricultural machinery and equipment and intelligence.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan National Agricultural and Rural Science and Technology Development Plan (excerpt) (Agricultural Science and Education Development [2021] No. 13) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/December 24, 2021)
content: Focus on promoting innovation in post-harvest loss reduction and processing technology and equipment for bulk agricultural products, achieving diversified development, multi-level utilization, and value-added in agricultural products, and researching and developing intelligent processing technology and equipment for agricultural products. Value-added processing and comprehensive utilization of agricultural products. Research and develop post-harvest loss reduction process technologies such as initial processing, intelligent screening and storage, and rapid drying for agricultural products. Integrated research and development of key technologies such as automated harvesting (slaughtering), rapid pre-cooling, efficient commercial processing, intelligent warehousing logistics, green preservation, and cold chain coupling for agricultural products. Research and develop intelligent initial processing technologies such as peeling and shelling, sorting and grading, cleaning and cutting, crushing and mixing, energy-saving drying, integrating automatic measurement, precise control, and intelligent operation. Breakthroughs in deep processing and comprehensive utilization processing technologies such as high-efficiency separation and extraction, high-performance mixing and homogenization, high-capacity packaging and sealing, new non-thermal processing, and new sterilization methods. Multi-functional and diversified processed products. Explore the potential functional value of processing by-products of grains and oils, fruits and vegetables, livestock and poultry, and aquatic products. Research and develop food or food ingredients such as rice bran oil, germ oil, dietary fiber, polysaccharides and polypeptides, organic calcium, and develop new materials and products such as feed, fertilizer, base materials, pectin, essential oils, and pigments. Research and development of intelligent processing equipment. Develop a full range of intelligent post-harvest initial processing technology and equipment for specialty crops, including weed removal, peeling and shelling, grading and sorting, and packaging. Carry out equipment innovation and application in digitalization of important processes, unmanned operation of key positions, and intelligent production control. Utilize new technologies such as intelligent manufacturing, biotechnology synthesis, and 3D printing to integrate a batch of high-tech and widely applicable processing equipment. Accelerate the research and application of rapid testing instruments and equipment for agricultural product physical and chemical properties, functional components, etc.
titlelist: Strengthen agricultural and rural scientific and technological innovation, break through major scientific and technological issues in key areas of agriculture and rural areas, agricultural product processing technology and equipment.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan National Agricultural and Rural Science and Technology Development Plan (excerpt) (Agricultural Science and Education Development [2021] No. 13) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/December 24, 2021)
content: Focus on supporting original basic research and applied basic research in agriculture from 0 to 1, encourage exploration and research in unexplored areas, master more universal, irreplaceable, and independently controllable core patents, and provide support for the innovation of agricultural science and technology. Theoretical laws. Conduct research on the formation and evolution of germplasm resources, explore the laws of agricultural biological germplasm resource diversity and directional evolution. Conduct research on the formation laws of important agronomic traits, explore the laws of the formation of complex traits such as high yield, high quality, green, and efficient in agriculture. Conduct research on the mechanisms of major agricultural pest and disease disasters, explore the laws and trends of occurrence. Mechanisms. Conduct research on biological and non-biological stress, reveal the regulatory mechanisms of agricultural biological response to stress signals and adaptation to diverse environments. Conduct research on agricultural microbiomics, reveal the mechanisms of microbial nitrogen fixation and plant interaction, efficient nutrient utilization, and microbial-host-environment interactions. Conduct basic research on smart agriculture, reveal the mechanisms of soil-crop-environment-machine system interaction. Methods and tools. Conduct original research on gene editing technology and develop new gene editing tools. Research on genetic transformation technology independent of receptor genotypes and construct a universal transformation system suitable for major varieties. Breakthrough in synthetic biology, construct efficient cell factories and artificial synthetic biological systems. Research on new whole-genome selection models and establish whole-genome selection platforms suitable for different animal and plant species. Conduct research on basic algorithms of artificial intelligence, breakthrough core algorithms for mining and analyzing biological big data.
titlelist: Strengthen agricultural and rural scientific and technological innovation, optimize the layout of agricultural scientific and technological development, basic and applied basic research.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan National Agricultural and Rural Science and Technology Development Plan (excerpt) (Agricultural Science and Education Development [2021] No. 13) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/December 24, 2021)
content: Aiming at the forefront of world science, focusing on key areas that have a driving effect on agricultural development, have a certain research foundation, and can be quickly transformed into real productivity, strengthening the layout of scientific and technological research, and accelerating the formation of new advantages. Agricultural big data technology. Developing modeling and analysis tools for massive data, conducting research on digital simulation and process modeling analysis of animals and plants based on agricultural big data, data intelligent analysis, and knowledge model design, with a focus on breakthroughs in data mining for animal and plant breeding, assessment of local environmental quality and pollution attribution analysis, and monitoring and early warning of market operation data. Developing real-time mobile intelligent monitoring and collection technologies for grain crop planting and yield, pig population, and fresh agricultural product market prices. Constructing core technologies such as an unstructured database system, agricultural data warehouse, agricultural knowledge computing engine, and agricultural visual interactive service engine applicable to the agricultural field. Establishing a database for rural construction and sustainable development, and constructing a smart rural big data cloud platform. Researching technologies such as optimizing and improving the spatial pattern and quality of rural areas, intelligent monitoring of living environments, and digital rural areas. Researching and formulating technical standards and specifications for smart rural construction. Smart agriculture technology. Researching technologies such as animal and plant life information perception and regulation, high spatiotemporal remote sensing reporting and intelligent control, high-throughput acquisition and intelligent analysis of animal and plant phenotypic groups, and agricultural ecological environment monitoring. Developing intelligent breeding technology, automated sowing and seedling technology, dynamic monitoring technology for farmland quality, new biological imaging technology, machine vision and digital interaction technology, intelligent coordination technology for large-scale vegetable production, and agricultural robots. Developing automated yield measurement technology for wheat, rice, and corn harvesting processes. Accelerating the research and application of technologies combining agriculture with the Internet+, Internet of Things+, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain. Column 7: Smart Agriculture Technology Innovation Project. 01: Research on intelligent information acquisition and perception technology. Researching the perception and cognitive mechanisms of animal and plant life information, conducting research on agricultural sensors, smart electronic tags, agricultural remote sensing data analysis, agricultural sensor perception, and rapid agricultural testing. 02: Research on agricultural intelligent control technology and equipment. Researching the complex control of agricultural machinery field operations, conducting research on dynamic path planning, remote monitoring, intelligent networking, and multi-machine collaboration, and researching agricultural intelligent sensing and control, conducting research on precision navigation and positioning, precision operation equipment, agricultural cultivation automation robots, livestock and poultry growth trend inspection robots, precise and rapid harvesting robots for agricultural products, and livestock and poultry safety and epidemic prevention robots. Future food manufacturing. Researching the cultivation and manufacturing technologies of nutrition-based foods such as cell-cultured meat, synthetic egg cream, and functional recombinant proteins, promoting the high-value utilization of agricultural product resources, component interaction and quality control, exploration of new food resources, food big data, foodomics, functional foods, molecular food creation, and monitoring and evaluation of food hazards.
titlelist: Strengthen agricultural and rural scientific and technological innovation, optimize the layout of agricultural scientific and technological development, and integrate cutting-edge and cross-disciplinary technologies.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan National Agricultural and Rural Science and Technology Development Plan (excerpt) (Agricultural Science and Education Development [2021] No. 13) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/December 24, 2021)
content: Build a collection and preservation system for germplasm resources such as crops, livestock, aquaculture, and agricultural microorganisms. Establish a number of basic resource collection and preservation repositories, and construct a dynamic monitoring system for data and information related to agricultural production, including water, soil, air, phenology, inputs, and biological disasters. Promote the construction of agricultural science observation and experimental stations and field observation research stations. Accelerate the establishment of agricultural big data centers and sub-centers, and expedite the construction of an agricultural big data system to strengthen the foundation of agricultural industry and technological innovation. Enhance the collection and preservation of germplasm resources. Accelerate the construction of germplasm resource repositories and the Southern Breeding Silicon Valley, and improve the quantity and quality of germplasm resource preservation. Conduct systematic surveys, collection, and organization of samples and DNA information, as well as evaluation and identification of traits and functions. Promote the construction of national repositories for livestock and poultry germplasm resources, freshwater fishery biological germplasm resources, and agricultural microorganism germplasm resources. Facilitate the completion and operation of new repositories for national crop germplasm resources, strengthen the monitoring of stored germplasm resources, and establish an agricultural germplasm resource big data platform. Environmental monitoring. Conduct dynamic monitoring of environmental factors such as spatial and temporal patterns, production systems, and evolutionary laws in the planting, breeding, and fishing industries. Systematically collect data and information on water, soil, air, phenology, and inputs in typical production areas, and construct an environmental evolution database. Carry out systematic environmental monitoring for the industrial application of biological breeding, and analyze the evolutionary laws of major pest and weed occurrences, as well as changes in biodiversity. Monitoring of biological disasters. Conduct dynamic monitoring of crop diseases, pests, weeds, rodents, livestock and poultry diseases, and aquaculture diseases caused by factors such as climate change, cultivation systems, and inputs. Systematically organize data on disaster-causing factors, occurrences, and adaptive changes, and construct a database to deeply explore the interrelationships between factors. Monitoring of the quality and application of agricultural inputs. Establish long-term fixed monitoring points for fertilizer quality and long-term fixed monitoring points for fertilizer application by different scale farmers and major crops. Conduct dynamic monitoring and establish databases on the quality of major fertilizer varieties and the application of major crops in China.
titlelist: Strengthen agricultural and rural scientific and technological innovation, optimize the layout of agricultural scientific and technological development, and focus on long-term foundational work in agricultural science and technology.

Focus on precision leveling of farmland, precision seeding, precision fertilization, and precision pesticide application, develop intelligent machinery and equipment, and improve the level of precision operation technology. Accelerate the innovation and development of large-scale high-end intelligent agricultural machinery equipment, promote the informatization and intelligentization of livestock, poultry, and aquaculture equipment, and promote the demonstration application of smart agriculture.

content: Accelerate the promotion and application of green and intelligent agricultural machinery equipment and cost-saving and efficiency-increasing agricultural mechanization technologies, promote energy-saving and emission reduction in agricultural machinery, and assist in the implementation of agricultural carbon peaking and carbon neutrality. Support the upgrading of non-road mobile machinery emission standards from National III to National IV, implement stricter emission standards for agricultural machinery, develop compound and efficient agricultural machinery and electric agricultural machinery equipment according to local conditions, and reduce exhaust emissions. Demonstrate and promote agricultural mechanization technologies for crop rotation, water conservation, energy saving, fertilizer reduction, and pesticide reduction, accelerate the promotion and application of mechanical equipment such as deep side dressing, precision spraying, water-saving irrigation, and high-performance no-tillage seeding, and reduce the use of seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and water resources. Increase research and development and promotion efforts for efficient mechanical equipment applicable to the recycling and utilization of agricultural waste such as returning manure to fields, returning straw to fields, and collecting and recycling residual film, and support the recycling of agricultural waste through circular utilization. Cultivate and expand new agricultural machinery service organizations, provide efficient and convenient agricultural machinery operation services, improve operation efficiency, and reduce energy consumption. Fully implement the policy of scrapping and updating subsidies for agricultural machinery, accelerate the elimination of old agricultural machinery with high energy consumption, large operation losses, and low safety performance, and promote safe production, energy saving and emission reduction, and structural adjustment of agricultural machinery.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Expansion and Strengthening of Leading Agricultural Industrialization Enterprises (Excerpt) (Nong Chan Fa [2021] No. 5) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/October 22, 2021)
content: By using the National Agricultural Science and Technology Innovation Alliance, the National Modern Agricultural Industry Technology Innovation Center, the National Modern Agricultural Industry Technology System, and the National Agricultural Product Processing Technology Research and Development System as the main platforms, we aim to create a platform that integrates and combines the advantageous resources of government, industry, academia, research, and application. This platform will provide technical support for the innovative development of leading enterprises. We support the construction of a systematic, organized, and task-oriented innovation consortium, led by leading enterprises, supported by universities and research institutes, and coordinated by various innovative entities. We encourage technology-leading enterprises to participate in key core technology research, undertake major national science and technology projects, and participate in cross-disciplinary, large-scale collaboration, and high-intensity innovation base and platform construction. We support leading enterprises, research institutions, and equipment manufacturing companies to jointly tackle common technologies and process equipment, improve the technological level and material and equipment conditions for rural industrial development. We guide leading seed companies to increase the protection and utilization of germplasm resources, strengthen key core technologies for key germplasm sources and agricultural biotechnology research and development capabilities, establish and improve commercial breeding systems, and cultivate new varieties and strains.
titlelist: Clarify the direction, achieve high-quality development of leading enterprises, and improve the innovation and development capabilities of leading enterprises.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Expansion and Strengthening of Leading Agricultural Industrialization Enterprises (Excerpt) (Nong Chan Fa [2021] No. 5) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/October 22, 2021)
content: Focused on building national strategic technological capabilities, in areas where there are technological constraints or weaknesses that hinder national food security, effective supply of important agricultural products, and the development of agricultural and rural modernization, we will guide a group of leading agricultural technology enterprises with strong integrated innovation capabilities, strong industry driving capabilities, and strong market development capabilities. These enterprises will leverage their advantages in meeting market demands, integrated innovation, and organizational platforms to carry out research and development of common key technologies in the agricultural industry, technology transfer and industrialization, and sharing of scientific and technological resources, in order to enhance the innovation drive of these leading enterprises. We will leverage the role of enterprises as proposers in joint tackling of key issues, increase the guiding role of leading enterprises in technology research and development direction, route selection, factor prices, and allocation of various innovative elements, encourage and guide leading enterprises to increase their own investment in research and development, and promote enterprises to become the main body of technological innovation decision-making, research and development investment, scientific research organization, and achievement transformation, thereby enhancing the leading position of these enterprises in innovation.
titlelist: Accurate positioning, building a team of leading enterprises, and strengthening a group of technology-leading enterprises with independent innovation capabilities.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Expansion and Strengthening of Leading Agricultural Industrialization Enterprises (Excerpt) (Nong Chan Fa [2021] No. 5) (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs/October 22, 2021)
content: Accelerate the development of new technologies such as microbial genomics engineering, enzyme molecular machines, and cell factories to enhance the economic viability of industrial biotechnology products. Promote the penetration and application of biomanufacturing technologies in fields such as chemical industry, materials, and energy, gradually replacing traditional chemical processing methods with clean bioprocessing methods, and gradually replacing fossil resources with renewable resources. Continuously improve the economic viability and scale of development of biomanufacturing products. Develop a new biotool creation and application technology system to achieve the biological production and application of basic chemical products such as organic acids, chemical alcohols, olefins, alkanes, and organic amines, and promote the industrial chain, aggregation, and scale development of biobased materials such as biobased polyesters, biobased polyurethanes, biobased nylons, biobased rubber, and microbial polysaccharides. Enhance the independent innovation capability and development level of bulk fermentation products such as amino acids and vitamins. Establish an ecological, safe, green, low-carbon, and circular development bioprocess system. Develop an efficient industrial biocatalytic conversion technology system to enhance the application level of green bioprocesses. Establish biocatalytic synthesis routes for steroidal drugs, chiral compounds, rare sugar alcohols, etc., to achieve green and large-scale production of pharmaceutical and chemical intermediates. Promote the comprehensive entry and demonstration application of green bioprocesses in agriculture, chemical industry, food, medicine, light textile, metallurgy, energy, and other fields, significantly reducing material consumption, energy consumption, and pollutant emissions.
titlelist: Accelerate the pace of innovation and development in the biotechnology industry, cultivate new driving forces for the bioeconomy, and promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing.
