name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Carry out research on the bio-manufacturing of major chemical products, the development of new bioenergy, the bioconversion of organic waste and gaseous carbon oxides, and the bio-process substitution in heavily-polluting industries. Break through key technological bottlenecks in raw material conversion and utilization, bioprocess efficiency, and bio-manufacturing costs. Expand new sources of industrial raw materials and develop new green manufacturing processes, forming a new path for green development in the industrial and energy economy led by biotechnology.
titlelist: Develop advanced and efficient biotechnology, build a modern industrial technology system with international competitiveness, and green bio-manufacturing technology.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Focus on the integration, exploration, and utilization of strategic biological resources, promote the systematic integration and in-depth utilization research of human genetic resources, establish a national strategic biological resource repository and information service platform, expand resource reserves, strengthen development and sharing, grasp the initiative in utilization and development, and provide resource guarantee for the sustainable development of the biological industry.
titlelist: Develop advanced and efficient biotechnology, construct a modern industrial technology system with international competitiveness, and utilize biorenewable resources.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Support environmental protection and pollution control. Relying on biomanufacturing technology, achieve biotechnological substitution of chemical raw materials and processes, develop high-performance bio-environmental materials and bio-preparations, promote the deep integration of important industrial products such as chemicals, pharmaceuticals, materials, and light industry with biotechnology, and transform towards a green, low-carbon, non-toxic, and sustainable development model. Utilize functional microorganisms, enzyme preparations, and other biotechnologies to promote denitrification and phosphorus removal in water bodies, heavy metal soil remediation, solid waste utilization and disposal, improve the comprehensive utilization level of straw, develop the bio-environmental industry chain for pollution monitoring, biodegradation and bioremediation, and bioresource recycling, and help win the battle against pollution in the atmosphere, water, soil, and other areas. Actively develop bioenergy. Develop biomass power generation in an orderly manner and promote the transformation and upgrading towards combined heat and power generation. Carry out research and development and cultivation of new biomass energy technologies, promote the integrated development of biofuels and bio-based chemicals, and establish biomass combustion blending standards. Optimize and improve high-temperature anaerobic fermentation strains, improve the level of biomass anaerobic treatment processes and the development of complete sets of anaerobic fermentation equipment, accelerate the research and development of key technologies such as biogas, cellulose ethanol, and algae-based biofuels, and the manufacturing of equipment. Actively promote the substitution and application of advanced biofuels in key areas such as municipal and transportation, and promote the transformation of fossil energy to green, low-carbon, and renewable energy. Promote the demonstration and application of bioaviation fuels. Column 4: Demonstration projects for the bioenergy and environmental protection industry.
titlelist: Develop and strengthen the pillar industries of the bioeconomy, promote the development of bioenergy and bio-environmental protection industries.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Promote and apply high-yielding, high-resistant, and fast-growing new varieties of oil crops and energy forests through targeted breeding. Develop bioenergy bases according to local conditions, strengthen innovation in thermochemical technology, and promote the efficient and low-cost application of bioenergy. Carry out demonstrations of cellulose ethanol, biodiesel, and biogas industries in areas with concentrated organic waste in urban and rural areas, and improve important links such as biomass raw material collection and organic fertilizer production and use to increase the scale of biofuel production. Construct industrial parks mainly based on biomass cogeneration, biomass briquettes, and other renewable energy sources. Support counties with conditions to replace coal with biomass energy for clean heating, steadily develop urban domestic waste incineration cogeneration, and promote biogas, biomass briquettes, and other clean heating methods using biomass energy. Conduct pilot projects for the promotion of biodiesel in areas with suitable conditions.
titlelist: Promote the development of the bio-based economy pillar industry, drive the development of bio-energy and bio-environmental protection industries, and focus on the bio-energy sector.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Promote the application of biodegradable materials, with a focus on demonstrating applications in daily products, agricultural films, packaging materials, textile materials, and other fields. This aims to reduce production costs, improve product performance, and actively explore the market for bio-based materials. Additionally, promote the development of bamboo-wrapped composite material technology and demonstrate its application in infrastructure construction such as urban comprehensive pipe corridors.
titlelist: Promote the development of the bio-based economy pillar industry, advance the development of bioenergy and bio-environmental protection industries, and the field of bio-environmental protection.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Improve the innovation and development capabilities of the bio-manufacturing industry, promote the large-scale production and application of bio-based materials, bio-based chemicals, and new fermentation products, promote the application demonstration of green bioprocesses in industries such as chemical engineering, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and food, by 2020, the output value of the modern bio-manufacturing industry will exceed 1 trillion yuan, the proportion of bio-based products in the total chemical production will reach 25%, compared with the traditional route, energy consumption and pollutant emissions will be reduced by 30%, making significant contributions to the green and sustainable development of China's economy and society.
titlelist: Promote new development in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Aiming at the forefront of biological science development, focusing on the technological support needs of the biological industry, vigorously promoting the construction of an innovative system for the biological manufacturing industry, conducting key technology research and development in areas such as raw material utilization, biological tool creation, biological processing processes, and equipment, solving basic scientific problems such as biological catalysts, design, synthesis, and optimization control of artificial biology, achieving disruptive technological innovation and application in areas such as artificial life forms, enzyme protein machines, nano-bio devices, genome editing, molecular recognition and biosensing, biomimetic manufacturing, etc., with a focus on the biological conversion of one-carbon compounds such as carbon dioxide, bio-manufacturing of olefins, heterologous synthesis of natural compounds, and large-scale manufacturing of bio-based materials, achieving key technological and process breakthroughs, significantly enhancing the independent innovation capability of the biological manufacturing industry, the technological support capability for industrial development, and the ability to cultivate new business models, laying a solid foundation for the construction of a new industrial system and accelerating the development of innovative industrialization.
titlelist: Promote new development in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and accelerate the construction of the innovation system in the bio-manufacturing industry.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: With the creation and application of new biotechnological tools as the core, we aim to build a core technological system for the bio-manufacturing of bulk chemical products, chemical polymer materials, and bulk fermentation products, continuously improving the economic viability and market competitiveness of bio-based products. We will establish bio-manufacturing routes for basic chemical products such as organic acids, chemical alcohols, olefins, alkanes, aromatic hydrocarbons, and organic amines, gaining a competitive advantage over petroleum-based routes and achieving large-scale production and application of bio-based methods. We will promote the development and application of bio-manufacturing and polymer modification technologies for chemical polymer materials such as polyols, hydroxycarboxylic acids, and oleic acids, driving the large-scale production and demonstration application of bio-based polyesters, bio-based polyurethanes, bio-based nylon, bio-based rubber, microbial polysaccharides, marine biomaterials, and other products, realizing the chain, agglomeration, and large-scale development of the bio-based materials industry. We will significantly enhance the independent innovation capability and international competitiveness of bulk fermentation products such as amino acids and vitamins, achieving a positive and high-end development of the industry.
titlelist: Promote new developments in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and improve the economic viability and market competitiveness of bio-based products.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: With the discovery and engineering application of biocatalysts as the core, we aim to construct an efficient industrial biocatalysis and conversion technology system, significantly improving the catalytic efficiency and industrial application properties of industrial enzymes and proteins, and significantly reducing production costs. We will establish biocatalytic synthesis routes for steroid hormones, non-natural amino acids, chiral compounds, special amino acids, rare sugar alcohols, glycopeptides, and other compounds, promote large-scale production and application demonstrations, achieve safe, clean, and sustainable production of chemical raw materials, food additives, pesticide intermediates, and bioemulsifiers, among other chemical intermediates. We will also break through key technologies and equipment in green bioprocesses such as biobased synthesis, biobased textiles, biobased mining, and biobased papermaking, promote the comprehensive integration and demonstration application of green bioprocesses in fields such as chemical industry, medicine, agriculture, light industry, energy, and ecological environment, significantly reduce resource and energy consumption, industrial solid waste generation, and environmental pollutant emissions, and initially establish an ecological, safe, low-carbon, and circular development bioprocess system.
titlelist: Promote new developments in key areas, promote the large-scale application of bio-manufacturing, and promote the greening of bio-manufacturing processes.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: In response to the strategic demand for coordinated development of the economy and the environment in our country, guided by the concept of green development, we aim to break through key technological bottlenecks in the conversion and utilization of raw materials, the cost of bio-manufacturing, and the efficiency of bioprocesses. By 2020, we strive to establish a key technological system and industrial demonstration of green bio-manufacturing for major chemical products in our country, achieve the greening of raw materials, processes, and products, and lay the industrial foundation for a green and low-carbon bio-economy. Column 5: Biochemical Engineering. Next-generation industrial fermentation technology. Establish targeted modification technology for industrial strains, high-throughput screening technology, fermentation genomics analysis technology, artificial construction technology for biosynthetic pathways, intelligent fermentation control technology, and product separation and purification technology. Develop a theoretical system for large-scale cultivation of animal and plant cells, and form a new generation of fermentation technologies for bulk chemicals, fine chemicals, nutritional chemicals, and natural product biosynthesis, breaking the monopoly of foreign patents and comprehensively improving the technological level and international competitiveness of China's fermentation industry. Bio-manufacturing of major chemicals. Carry out basic research, key technological innovation, and industrial application demonstrations of biologically synthesized materials, renewable chemicals, bio-based synthetic materials, and natural products. Focus on breakthroughs in key technologies such as the conversion and utilization of biomass raw materials, the synthesis of biopolymers and bio-based chemicals, and the biosynthesis of natural products, and establish efficient and low-cost chemical bio-synthesis routes. Enzyme engineering and green processes for industrial biocatalysis. Develop next-generation enzyme preparations, break through key technologies such as efficient biocatalytic conversion of chemical products, and establish green biological processes such as biological bleaching, biological degumming, and biological tanning. Form green bioprocess routes for chiral chemicals, pharmaceutical intermediates, and agrochemicals, and promote the green transformation and upgrading of China's chemical industry. Biological conversion of one-carbon gases and one-carbon biochemicals. Establish technical routes for the biosynthesis of high-value fine chemicals from one-carbon gases such as carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide, as well as biofuels such as ethanol and aviation fuel, creating a new industrial chain with significantly reduced carbon footprint from the source. Break through key technologies for the bioconversion of one-carbon raw materials such as methanol and formic acid into multi-carbon chemicals, and promote the green upgrading of the one-carbon chemical industry. Core technology and equipment for biochemical engineering. Carry out research and development of fermentation equipment systems such as strain screening, bioprocesses, process monitoring, and biopurification, and develop new technology and instrument equipment such as high-throughput screening technology, single-cell analysis equipment, novel bioreactor sensors, and micro-bioreactors. Establish a core technology and equipment system for China's next-generation biochemical engineering technology and industry, and improve the localization level of related equipment.
titlelist: Key tasks, supporting the development of key areas, bio-chemical industry.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Polymer materials such as bioplastics, biofibers, and biorubbers derived from biomass. This includes polylactic acid (PLA), polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA), polytrimethylene terephthalate (PTT), polybutylene succinate (PBS), polyamino acids, polytetrahydrofuran, polyorganic acid composites and products, polyol fibers, starch-based plastics, bio-based polyesters, bio-based polyurethanes, biomass fibers, new carbon adsorbent materials, chitosan fibers, seaweed fibers, pectin materials, protein fibers, non-staple food modified starch-based biodegradable materials, microbial polysaccharide materials, bio-based material additives, etc. Bio-based material polymerization technology, high-density, high-viscosity microbial fermentation process technology, phase separation technology for bio-polymers, efficient separation and extraction technology for bio-polymers, bio-based three-dimensional composite materials and their forming and processing technology, modification technology, biomass fiber bio-degumming technology, clean production technology for bio-based materials.
titlelist: Manufacturing industry, materials for manufacturing

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Large-scale and fine chemicals and their derivatives produced by biological methods or biomass raw materials. This includes bioethylene, isoprene, acrylic acid, ethanol, ethylene glycol, propylene glycol, isopropanol, 3-hydroxypropionic acid, acrylic acid, butanol, isobutanol, butanediol, butanetriol, polyols, acetic acid, lactic acid, propionic acid, butyric acid, succinic acid, long-chain dicarboxylic acids, long-chain fatty acids, malic acid, itaconic acid, citric acid, citric acid esters, isosorbide, chiral compounds, steroidal compounds, chemical intermediates, additives, straw sugars, oligosaccharides, rare sugars, non-natural amino acids, etc. Non-food raw material conversion technology, biomass refining technology, biomass gasification technology, chemical product fermentation technology, biocatalysis technology, whole-cell catalytic conversion technology, biomass fractionation technology, enzymatic hydrolysis technology, biochemo-combination synthesis technology, bio-synthesis process control technology, etc.
titlelist: Manufacturing industry of goods, chemical products

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Industrial enzyme preparations. Including enzymes for textiles, enzymes for papermaking, enzymes for detergents, enzymes for tanning, enzymes for chemicals, enzymes for energy, enzymes for food, etc. Special and specialized enzyme preparations for clinical diagnosis, dietary supplementation, etc. New fermentation products such as amino acids, vitamins, microbial preparations, biological pigments, biological preservatives, biological flocculants, microbial polysaccharides, biological oils and fats, plant chemicals, sugar alcohols, nucleosides, functional peptides, pyruvic acid, etc. Biological process equipment such as automatic fermentation tanks with control systems, special cell culture reactors, bioprocessing reactors, biosensors, and dedicated separation equipment for biomacromolecules. Fermentation process optimization technology and equipment. Including high-density fermentation, solid-state fermentation, gas fermentation, clean fermentation, enzyme preparation evaluation, biotextiles, biobleaching, biotanning, biodegumming, bioprospecting, biometallurgy, membrane separation, supercritical fluid extraction, high-throughput screening, bioprocessing, bioextraction, biopurification, etc. technologies and equipment.
titlelist: Manufacturing industry of goods, special fermentation products, and bioprocess equipment.

name: The 13th Five-Year National Science and Technology Innovation Plan (State Council Document No. 43 of 2016) (State Council, August 8, 2016)
content: Based on modern biotechnology, marine functional food and bioproducts are obtained from marine organisms. This includes natural carotenoids such as astaxanthin, lutein, and zeaxanthin, natural pigments, polyunsaturated fatty acids such as docosahexaenoic acid and eicosapentaenoic acid, marine enzymes such as proteases, lipases, and cellulases, marine functional proteins, peptides, and oligosaccharides as feed additives, marine biofertilizers, marine biocides, algae regulators, and marine microorganism vaccines. Techniques for the extraction, purification, and synthesis of marine bioactive substances, green preparation techniques for chitosan and its derivatives, large-scale cultivation and refining of macroalgae, development of seaweed energy technology, exploration and utilization techniques for marine medicinal biological resources and active products, high-tech creation of marine agricultural biopharmaceuticals, large-scale cultivation and reactor technology for marine organisms, and efficient expression and purification technology for marine agricultural biopharmaceuticals.
titlelist: Manufacturing industry, foreign bioactive substances and biological products.

name: White Paper on China's Energy Development in the New Era (Excerpt) (State Council Information Office/December 21, 2020)
content: Safe and orderly development of nuclear power. China regards nuclear safety as the lifeline of nuclear power development, adheres to the principle of simultaneous development and safety, implements the policy of safe and orderly development of nuclear power, strengthens the management and supervision of the entire lifecycle of nuclear power including planning, site selection, design, construction, operation, and decommissioning, and insists on using the most advanced technology and the strictest standards for nuclear power development. We will improve the multi-level nuclear energy and nuclear safety regulatory standards system, strengthen the construction of nuclear emergency plans, laws, systems, and mechanisms, and form an effective national nuclear emergency response capability system to deal with nuclear accidents. We will strengthen nuclear security and nuclear material control, strictly fulfill international obligations on nuclear security and non-proliferation, and maintain a good record of nuclear security. So far, the overall safety of operating nuclear power units in China has been good, and no international nuclear event classification level 2 or higher incidents or accidents have occurred.
titlelist: Build a diversified and clean energy supply system, with priority given to the development of non-fossil energy.

name: White Paper on China's Energy Development in the New Era (Excerpt) (State Council Information Office/December 21, 2020)
content: Implement major scientific and technological projects and engineering, achieve breakthroughs in key technologies in the energy field. Focus on the industrialization goals of national strategic industries, implement major projects in oil and gas technology, focus on breakthroughs in new theories of oil and gas geology and key technologies for efficient exploration and development, and carry out technological research on the economic and efficient development of unconventional resources such as shale oil, shale gas, and natural gas hydrates. Implement major projects in nuclear power technology, focus on key core technology research and development related to third-generation pressurized water reactors and fourth-generation high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, and continue to promote independent innovation in nuclear power. Deploy research in key common technologies, including new energy vehicles, smart grid technology and equipment, intelligent mining technology and equipment for coal mines, clean and efficient utilization of coal and new energy-saving technologies, and renewable energy and hydrogen energy technologies. Focus on the physical and chemical basic research of efficient and clean utilization and transformation of energy, and promote breakthroughs in application technology driven by basic research to support national strategic tasks.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and carry out collaborative technological innovation in major areas of energy.

name: White Paper on China's Energy Development in the New Era (Excerpt) (State Council Information Office/December 21, 2020)
content: Under the trend of global energy green and low-carbon transformation and development, it is necessary to accelerate the upgrading and replacement of traditional energy technology and equipment, strengthen independent innovation of emerging energy technology and equipment, and significantly improve the level of clean and low-carbon energy technology. Relying on major equipment manufacturing and demonstration projects, we should promote key energy equipment technology research, experimental demonstration, and application promotion. Improve the energy equipment measurement, standards, testing, and certification system, and enhance the research and development, design, manufacturing, and complete set capabilities of major energy equipment. Focusing on the three directions of energy security supply, clean energy development, and clean and efficient utilization of fossil energy, we should focus on breaking through the key technologies, materials, and components of energy equipment manufacturing, and promote technological innovation throughout the industry chain. Carry out major energy demonstration projects for advanced energy technology equipment, and improve the technological level of equipment in areas such as clean and intelligent coal mining and washing, deepwater and unconventional oil and gas exploration and development, oil and gas storage and transportation, clean and efficient coal-fired power generation, advanced nuclear power, renewable energy power generation, gas turbines, energy storage, advanced power grids, and coal deep processing.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and rely on major energy projects to enhance the level of energy technology and equipment.

name: White Paper on China's Energy Development in the New Era (Excerpt) (State Council Information Office/December 21, 2020)
content: Currently, the world is at the intersection of a new technological revolution and an industrial revolution. Breakthroughs in new technologies are accelerating industrial transformation and promoting the emergence of new energy models and formats. Efforts are being made to promote the deep integration of energy technology with modern information, materials, and advanced manufacturing technology, relying on the Internet Plus smart energy construction, and exploring new models of energy production and consumption. The innovation and upgrading of intelligent photovoltaics are being accelerated, promoting the integration of photovoltaic power generation with agriculture, fisheries, animal husbandry, construction, and other industries, expanding new applications for complementary use of photovoltaic power generation, and forming new models for the extensive development and utilization of new energy. The technological equipment of the hydrogen energy industry chain, such as green hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and application, is being developed rapidly, promoting the development of the hydrogen fuel cell technology chain and the hydrogen fuel cell vehicle industry chain. Energy storage applications are being supported in various stages and scenarios of the energy industry, with a focus on promoting the complementary development of energy storage and renewable energy. Support is being provided for the construction of new energy microgrids, forming integrated local clean energy supply systems for generation, storage, and utilization. New models of comprehensive energy services are being promoted to achieve multi-energy complementarity and synergistic efficiency at the end-use level. With the guidance and driving force of pilot demonstration projects, various new energy technologies, models, and formats continue to emerge, forming a fusion effect for innovative energy development.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and support the development of new technologies, new models, and new formats.

name: Energy Development Strategic Action Plan (2014-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2014] No. 31) (State Council General Office/June 7, 2014)
content: Actively develop clean energy such as natural gas, nuclear power, and renewable energy, reduce the proportion of coal consumption, and promote the continuous optimization of the energy structure.
titlelist: The main task is to optimize the energy structure.

name: Energy Development Strategic Action Plan (2014-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2014] No. 31) (State Council General Office/June 7, 2014)
content: Under the premise of adopting the highest international safety standards and ensuring safety, timely initiate new nuclear power projects in the eastern coastal areas, and study and demonstrate the feasibility of inland nuclear power construction. Adhere to the approach of introducing, digesting, absorbing, and innovating, with a focus on advancing the research and development of AP1000, CAP1400, high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, fast reactors, and post-processing technologies. Accelerate the domestic independent technology engineering verification, with a focus on constructing large-scale advanced pressurized water reactors and high-temperature gas-cooled reactors as major demonstration projects. Actively promote fundamental research on nuclear power, research and development of nuclear safety technologies, and engineering construction, while improving the nuclear fuel cycle system. Actively promote the internationalization of nuclear power. Strengthen nuclear power popularization and nuclear safety knowledge promotion. By 2020, the installed capacity of nuclear power will reach 58 million kilowatts, with a capacity under construction exceeding 30 million kilowatts.
titlelist: The main task is to optimize the energy structure and promote the safe development of nuclear power.

name: Energy Development Strategic Action Plan (2014-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2014] No. 31) (State Council General Office/June 7, 2014)
content: According to the principles of innovative mechanisms, solid foundation, advanced deployment, and key breakthroughs, we will strengthen independent technological innovation, encourage the introduction, digestion, absorption, and re-innovation, create an upgraded version of energy technology innovation, and build a strong country in energy technology.
titlelist: The main task is to promote energy technology innovation.

name: Energy Development Strategic Action Plan (2014-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2014] No. 31) (State Council General Office/June 7, 2014)
content: Accelerate the implementation of major national science and technology projects for the development of large-scale oil and gas fields and coalbed methane. Strengthen the national science and technology major projects for large-scale advanced pressurized water reactors and high-temperature gas-cooled reactors. Strengthen technological research and strive for significant breakthroughs in core technologies such as shale gas, deep-sea oil and gas, natural gas hydrates, and next-generation nuclear power.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote energy technology innovation and to focus on major scientific and technological projects.

name: Energy Development Strategic Action Plan (2014-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2014] No. 31) (State Council General Office/June 7, 2014)
content: Relying on major energy projects such as offshore oil and gas exploration and development, unconventional oil and gas exploration, efficient and clean utilization of coal, advanced nuclear power, renewable energy development, and smart grids, accelerate the transformation of scientific and technological achievements and the manufacturing of energy equipment. Construct innovative platforms, support the going global of advanced energy technology and equipment, and form an internationally competitive energy equipment industry system.
titlelist: The main task is to promote energy technology innovation and drive independent innovation through major projects.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Modern Energy System (Excerpt) (NDRC Energy [2022] No. 210) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/January 29, 2022)
content: Actively promote the safe and orderly development of nuclear power. While ensuring safety, actively and orderly promote the construction of coastal nuclear power projects, maintain a steady construction pace, and reasonably plan the layout of new coastal nuclear power projects. Carry out demonstrations of comprehensive utilization of nuclear energy, actively promote advanced reactor types such as high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, fast reactors, modular small reactors, and offshore floating reactors, and promote the comprehensive utilization of nuclear energy in areas such as clean heating, industrial heating, and seawater desalination. Effectively protect the resources of nuclear power plant sites. By 2025, the installed capacity of nuclear power operation will reach about 70 million kilowatts.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Modern Energy System (Excerpt) (NDRC Energy [2022] No. 210) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/January 29, 2022)
content: Forge the long board of energy innovation advantages. Consolidate the technological and equipment advantages in the non-fossil energy field, continuously improve the technological level and economic viability of wind power, solar power, biomass energy, geothermal energy, ocean energy, and other development and utilization, carry out optimization research on third-generation nuclear power technology, strengthen the technological innovation and application of high-proportion renewable energy systems. Based on the development foundation and advantages of green and low-carbon technologies, accelerate the promotion of new power systems, new generation advanced nuclear energy, and other technological breakthroughs. Improve the technological level of clean and efficient utilization of fossil energy, strengthen research on intelligent and green coal mining, flexible and efficient coal-fired power generation, modern coal chemical industry, and ecological environment protection technologies, implement efficient exploration and development of onshore conventional oil and gas, and tackle key refining technologies. Column 5: Technological Innovation Demonstration Projects. Advanced nuclear energy technology. Optimization and upgrading demonstration application of key technologies for third-generation nuclear power, technological research and demonstration application of modular small reactors, (ultra) high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, low-temperature heating reactors, fast reactors, molten salt reactors, offshore floating nuclear power platforms, etc. Support the research and development and application of new technologies such as new fuels and new materials. Support the early-stage research and development of controlled nuclear fusion and actively carry out international cooperation.

content: - Actively and orderly develop nuclear power while ensuring safety. name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for Technological Innovation in the Energy Sector (excerpt) (National Energy Administration of China, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 29, 2021)
content: Carrying out research on the optimization of key technologies for the improvement of nuclear power technology and equipment level and project economics, supporting the establishment of standardized models and model lineages; strengthening strategic and forward-looking nuclear energy technology innovation, conducting key core technology research on new generation advanced nuclear energy systems such as small modular reactors, (ultra) high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, and molten salt reactors; conducting research on key technologies such as radioactive waste disposal, long-term operation of nuclear power plants, and life extension, promoting sustainable development of the entire nuclear energy industry chain.
titlelist: Key task, safe and efficient nuclear energy technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for Technological Innovation in the Energy Sector (excerpt) (National Energy Administration of China, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 29, 2021)
content: (1) Optimization and upgrading of third-generation nuclear power technology models. [Demonstration and testing] Carry out research on key technologies such as equipment, processes, layout, and construction involved in the engineering construction and operation of third-generation nuclear power, further improving unit safety, economy, site adaptability, and equipment reliability, supporting the establishment of standardized models and model lineages of third-generation nuclear power with complete independent intellectual property rights. [Application and promotion] Conduct research and development on model adaptability in accordance with international market requirements, supporting design review, certification, and accreditation; continue to optimize nuclear power plant design and research on advanced technologies, assisting in the large-scale development and international market promotion and application of independent third-generation nuclear power.(2) Comprehensive utilization of nuclear energy technology. [Demonstration and testing] Carry out research on key technologies such as optimization of nuclear heating (cooling) schemes, safety design principles, core equipment for nuclear seawater desalination and low-temperature flash evaporation, and nuclear hydrogen production processes, study the complementary forms of nuclear energy with wind power, photovoltaics, energy storage, hydrogen energy, etc., optimize and improve comprehensive energy system schemes and operation technologies centered around nuclear power plants, promote the cascade utilization of nuclear energy, and improve the efficiency of comprehensive nuclear energy utilization.
titlelist: Key tasks, safe and efficient nuclear energy technology, nuclear power optimization and upgrading technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for Technological Innovation in the Energy Sector (excerpt) (National Energy Administration of China, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 29, 2021)
content: (3) Small-scale intelligent modular reactor technology. [Demonstration experiment] Carry out research on small-scale intelligent modular reactor technology, as well as advanced heat exchange, monitoring, materials, software systems, and safety-related key technologies. Breakthrough core technology equipment, complete the integrated and intelligent design of advanced modular small-scale reactor typical projects, and meet the engineering application conditions in various scenarios such as industrial parks, islands, bases, and mining areas. Timely carry out demonstration of small modular reactor nuclear energy comprehensive utilization engineering.(4) Small-scale heating reactor technology. [Demonstration experiment] Conduct research on key technologies such as heating reactor system design, fuel components, and experimental verification. Breakthrough key equipment technologies, achieve standardization of small-scale heating reactor design, equipment, construction, and supporting systems, and timely carry out commercial demonstration of small-scale heating reactors.(5) Floating reactor technology. [Focused research] Conduct research on key technologies such as overall technical solutions for floating reactor devices, develop key equipment that meets marine conditions and miniaturization requirements, and improve the standard specification system for offshore floating reactors.(6) Mobile reactor technology. [Focused research] Conduct research on lightweight and intelligent nuclear power supply device design and key technologies, break through key common technologies of mobile reactors, carry out overall design of models such as air-cooled micro-reactors, mini pressurized water reactors, and heat pipe reactors, and develop key nuclear-grade equipment. Complete relevant experimental verification and form advanced nuclear power supply device solutions with mobility capability.
titlelist: Key tasks, safe and efficient nuclear energy technology, small modular reactor technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for Technological Innovation in the Energy Sector (excerpt) (National Energy Administration of China, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 29, 2021)
content: (7) High-temperature gas-cooled reactor technology. [Focused research] Carry out optimization and transformation of key equipment such as the main helium fan electromagnetic bearing in high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, and break through the multi-module coordinated control technology; develop key equipment for ultra-high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, research and develop multi-generation application technology for high-temperature reactors, including heat-electricity-hydrogen production, and form a multi-purpose application technology scheme for ultra-high-temperature gas-cooled reactors. (8) Thorium-based molten salt reactor technology. [Focused research] Construct a 20MWe small modular thorium-based molten salt research reactor and scientific facilities, explore the existence form and transformation law of actinide elements and fission products in fuel salt, off-gas salt, and post-treatment fuel salt, establish standards for material failure assessment and life prediction of molten salt reactors, and complete the research and verification of the coupling technology between thorium-based molten salt reactors and power generation systems.
titlelist: Key tasks, safe and efficient nuclear energy technology, next-generation nuclear power technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for Technological Innovation in the Energy Sector (excerpt) (National Energy Administration of China, Ministry of Science and Technology/November 29, 2021)
content: (9) Key technologies for the disposal of radioactive waste. [Focused research] Conduct comprehensive research on the treatment of radioactive waste, develop and improve key waste treatment technologies such as plasma melting and steam reforming; establish an optimized technical system for comprehensive waste treatment and long-term waste treatment plans for nuclear power units, and construct disposal sites for low and intermediate-level radioactive waste. (10) Long-term operation and life extension technologies for nuclear power units. [Focused research] Conduct research on strategies for long-term safe and reliable operation of nuclear power plants, break through key technologies such as intelligent renovation, complete equipment replacement, multifunctional remote control, and online monitoring of aging (faults) under complex and harsh conditions of nuclear power plants. Develop intelligent specialized equipment for positioning, cutting, welding, and metal dust collection, and construct three-dimensional simulation models and a full life cycle big data system; study the feasibility and implementation path of long-term operation after key equipment replacement in nuclear power plants. [Demonstration experiments] Conduct fundamental and applied research on aging and life management of nuclear power units, including structural integrity testing and evaluation, fast neutron irradiation damage evaluation of key component materials, prediction of degradation behavior of important nickel-based alloy components and main pipeline materials in the primary circuit, intelligent health management and monitoring of nuclear facilities, and mitigation of irradiation embrittlement and thermal annealing aging. Establish technical systems for the extension of operating licenses and aging management guidelines. (11) Key supporting technologies for major infrastructure in nuclear power scientific and technological innovation. [Focused research] Accelerate the experimental verification of advanced theoretical research results in reactor thermal-hydraulics, severe accident mechanisms, and other areas, and support the construction and upgrading of high-level platforms and research facilities. Column 3 Key demonstrations of safe and efficient nuclear energy technologies. 01 Demonstration of nuclear power optimization and upgrading technologies. (1) Conduct demonstrations of optimized and upgraded third-generation nuclear power models with complete independent intellectual property rights; (2) Conduct demonstrations of comprehensive utilization of existing nuclear power units for heating and other purposes. 02 Demonstration of small modular reactor technologies. (3) Conduct demonstrations of comprehensive utilization projects for small nuclear reactors; (4) Conduct commercial demonstrations of small reactor heating. 03 Demonstration of sustainable support technologies throughout the entire industry chain. (5) Conduct demonstrations and feasibility studies on the extension of operating licenses for nuclear power units approaching the end of their service life.
titlelist: Key tasks, safe and efficient nuclear energy technology, sustainable support technology throughout the entire industry chain.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Improve the safety performance of operating nuclear power plants. Evaluate the effectiveness of safety improvement measures after the Fukushima nuclear accident in Japan, and continue to promote safety improvements in nuclear power plants to enhance their ability to respond to extreme natural disasters and other external events. Strengthen the operation and maintenance of emergency equipment allocated for safety improvements after the Fukushima nuclear accident in Japan to ensure their availability in emergency situations. Take various measures such as conversion and connection to improve the compatibility of mobile emergency equipment interfaces between nuclear power groups. Strengthen the management of aging and lifespan of nuclear power plants. Conduct safety assessments for the renewal of operating licenses for certain nuclear power units in accordance with the law. Strengthen drills, conduct peer reviews, improve the quality of severe accident management guidelines, and enhance the ability to respond to severe accidents. Develop a Maintenance Rules Policy Statement to improve the effectiveness of maintenance activities. Strengthen radiation protection management in nuclear power plants and reduce personnel exposure doses. Establish a human factor management system in nuclear power plants and improve the regular psychological health assessment system for key positions such as operators. Gradually improve the basic data for probabilistic safety analysis, promote the exchange of probabilistic safety analysis techniques in the industry, and select nuclear power plants with conditions to carry out pilot applications of probabilistic safety analysis in technical specification revisions and in-service inspections. Ensure the quality and safety of nuclear power plants under construction. Further implement the management responsibility of operating units for construction quality, strengthen the management of nuclear power engineering general contracting units and subcontracting units at all levels, strengthen the supervision and inspection of the supply quality of important safety equipment, bulk objects, and bulk materials, and strengthen the supervision and management of conventional industrial safety. Improve the construction event reporting system and processing procedures, and properly handle construction events in nuclear power plants. Carry out commissioning and initial core tests of new models such as AP1000, Hualong One, EPR, and high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, with a focus on non-active system commissioning and verification to improve the quality of commissioning. Strengthen the feedback and sharing of commissioning experience of new models and establish a rapid experience feedback mechanism. Maintain a high level of safety for newly built nuclear power plants. Scientifically select nuclear power plant sites, conduct safety evaluations of site characteristics, protect selected nuclear power plant sites, and conduct site re-evaluations if necessary. Learn from the experience and lessons of the Fukushima nuclear accident in Japan, revise the Safety Regulations for Nuclear Power Plant Design, and incorporate safety improvement measures into the standard design of new units to improve the safety level of unit design. Eliminate a large amount of radioactive material release from the design of newly built nuclear power units.
titlelist: Key tasks, continuous improvement, maintaining a high level of safety in nuclear power plants.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Improve the safety level of research reactors. Enhance the requirements for research reactor safety management, promote the classification management of research reactors, improve safety regulations for research reactor site safety evaluation, design, operation, long-term shutdown, and periodic safety reviews. Develop regulations and safety assessment principles for small modular reactors, molten salt reactors, high-temperature reactors, floating reactors, and accelerator-driven subcritical clean nuclear energy systems. Carry out safety improvements for research reactors, conduct comprehensive evaluation and inspection before restarting long-term shutdown research reactors to ensure compliance with operational requirements. Conduct periodic safety reviews for research reactors such as the 49-2 reactor, high-flux engineering test reactor, Minjiang test reactor, and pulse reactor, and implement safety improvements based on review conclusions. Track aging effects and carry out safety improvements or upgrades for aging systems and equipment in research reactors. Strengthen the sharing of information on operational events in research reactors. Improve the safety level of nuclear fuel cycle facilities. Based on seismic zoning adjustments, continue to conduct safety identification, assessment, and reinforcement for early-built nuclear fuel cycle facilities. Conduct research on safety classification of nuclear fuel cycle facility items, conduct in-depth analysis of accidents in nuclear fuel cycle facilities, improve prevention, monitoring, and mitigation measures for risks such as criticality, fire, explosion, and leakage, and increase emergency support interfaces for chemical accidents and firefighting in nuclear fuel cycle facilities. Improve the safety of uranium hexafluoride sealing systems, enhance the online monitoring system for hydrogen fluoride and operating procedures for uranium hexafluoride. Strengthen the safety of material handling and promote the reutilization and stabilization of depleted uranium hexafluoride. Strengthen personal internal radiation dose management and reduce the occupational radiation levels of personnel in nuclear fuel cycle facilities. Promote the safety storage and disposal of spent fuel. Develop and publish plans for the disposal of spent fuel in nuclear power plants, promote the storage and disposal of spent fuel. Legally clarify the safety assessment requirements for dry storage facilities for spent fuel near nuclear power plants, and accelerate the construction of off-site storage capacity for spent fuel. Strengthen the integration of research, industry, and academia in spent fuel reprocessing, establish guarantee mechanisms, optimize operation management, actively promote the site selection and construction of large-scale commercial reprocessing plants, and alleviate the pressure of in-reactor storage of spent fuel in nuclear power plants. Ensure the safety of radioactive material transportation. Promote the combined transport of radioactive materials by road and rail, improve the design capability and manufacturing quality of transport containers for spent fuel and uranium hexafluoride. Standardize the periodic safety performance evaluation of in-service Class I radioactive material transport containers, and strengthen the safety supervision of radioactive material transportation activities. Establish an online real-time monitoring system for the transport of Class I radioactive materials such as spent fuel. Improve the safety protection level of radioactive material transport devices and strengthen safety assurance measures during transportation.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen control, reduce risks of research reactors and nuclear fuel cycle facilities.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Accelerate the decommissioning and waste management of early-stage nuclear facilities. Speed up the decommissioning process of key units such as early-stage reactors, nuclear fuel cycle facilities, research facilities, and waste treatment facilities, and complete a batch of nuclear facility decommissioning projects. Accelerate the construction of radioactive waste treatment capabilities, basically complete the solidification treatment of historical legacy low and intermediate-level liquid waste, dispose of a batch of low and intermediate-level solid waste, and explore innovative disposal methods for low and intermediate-level solid waste in the front end of nuclear fuel cycle. Promote the disposal of radioactive solid waste from nuclear power. Issue and implement the Planning for Low and Intermediate-Level Radioactive Solid Waste Disposal Sites, carry out the selection and construction of five low and intermediate-level solid waste disposal sites, establish a reasonable layout for the disposal of low and intermediate-level solid waste, and promote the transportation and disposal of nuclear power waste. Construct demonstration projects for the centralized treatment of radioactive waste at the Qinshan and Daya Bay nuclear power bases, promote the application of incineration of combustible radioactive solid waste and smelting of radioactive contaminated metals, and advance the reduction and clean control of radioactive waste from nuclear power plants. Accelerate research on high-level waste disposal. Start construction of underground laboratories for geological disposal of high-level waste. Promote the selection and site investigation of geological disposal sites for high-level waste, conduct research on engineering barriers, disposal process technology, disposal chemistry, safety evaluation, etc., and complete the screening of 2-3 key candidate sites for geological disposal facilities. Clarify the safety goals and principles for geological disposal of high-level waste, and study the technical safety criteria for site selection of high-level waste geological disposal in China.
titlelist: Key tasks, overall coordination, accelerate the decommissioning of early-stage nuclear facilities and the disposal of radioactive waste.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Strengthen the management of uranium mining and metallurgical emissions and radiation protection. Optimize the three wastes treatment technology and wastewater discharge management in uranium mining and metallurgy production. Implement monitoring responsibilities for uranium mining and metallurgical enterprises, and strengthen the monitoring of effluents and surrounding environments. Strengthen ventilation in underground uranium mines, improve dust and radon reduction measures, carry out safety improvements such as underground fire suppression systems, and enhance the safety of uranium mines and in-service mine shafts. Enhance the optimization management of radiation protection in uranium mining and metallurgy, standardize measures for managing occupational exposure doses, and continuously reduce individual occupational exposure doses in uranium mining and metallurgy. Promote the safety improvement and decommissioning of uranium mining and metallurgical facilities. Conduct annual evaluations of tailings pond conditions, monitor the safety status of uranium mine tailings dams, and carry out safety improvements for tailings ponds with identified safety hazards. Advance the decommissioning and remediation of hard rock uranium mines, and basically complete the decommissioning and environmental restoration of uranium mining and metallurgical facilities closed before 2010. Fully complete the decommissioning and remediation of uranium geological exploration facilities located in sensitive areas. Safely close uranium mining and metallurgical facilities shut down during the 12th Five-Year Plan period, maintain the normal operation of environmental protection facilities, and initiate decommissioning and remediation. Further clarify the long-term guardianship responsibilities of the decommissioned uranium mining and metallurgical facilities in accordance with the law, establish a long-term guardianship mechanism, and ensure long-term guardianship resources. Develop a decommissioning plan for in-situ uranium mines and promptly carry out environmental remediation during decommissioning. Strengthen the management of radiation environments in associated radioactive mineral mining. Complete the current status investigation of associated radioactive minerals and radiation status survey, and promote the classification management of associated radioactive mineral resources. Conduct radiation safety supervision and research on radiation environmental standards for the development and utilization of associated radioactive minerals such as zirconium and zirconium oxide, oil shale, and rare earths. Urge mining and utilization enterprises of associated radioactive minerals to strengthen monitoring of surrounding radiation environments and effluents. Study the control of artificially induced natural radiation levels.
titlelist: Key tasks, comprehensive rectification, ensuring the safety of uranium mining and associated radioactive mineral radiation environment.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Strengthen the supervision of nuclear safety equipment. Update the catalog of civilian nuclear safety equipment in a timely manner and dynamically adjust the focus of supervision on nuclear safety equipment. Optimize the approval process for nuclear safety equipment permits, clarify the conditions for nuclear safety equipment permits according to equipment categories, establish quantitative evaluation indicators, and dynamically manage certified units. Develop and improve the management requirements for nuclear safety equipment identification and manufacturing activities, establish independent verification methods for nuclear safety equipment, and continuously improve the technical capability verification system for in-service inspection and non-destructive testing of nuclear power plants. Enforce the law strictly, seriously investigate and punish violations and fraudulent behavior, promptly disclose and report the results of penalties to the society and the industry, and establish a system for holding individuals accountable for life. Strengthen process supervision and strictly evaluate major non-compliance with safety. Strengthen experience feedback and improve the reliability database of key component materials. Strengthen the supervision and inspection of imported civilian nuclear safety equipment in accordance with the law. Implement the quality responsibility of enterprises for nuclear safety equipment. Strengthen the management of supervision and construction of nuclear safety equipment by operating units, and enhance factory acceptance. Certified units of civilian nuclear safety equipment continuously improve the level of nuclear safety culture and the effectiveness of the quality assurance system, establish a system for key processes and key positions, and improve equipment quality and reliability.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen management, improve the quality and reliability of nuclear safety equipment.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Improve the level of security for nuclear facilities. Carry out physical protection system upgrades for nuclear power plant entrance and exit controls, monitoring video systems, low-altitude flying objects, and sea surface detection. Enhance the level of cybersecurity for nuclear power plants, assess and analyze network threats, allocate tools reasonably, and establish and strengthen the ability to prevent network attacks, data manipulation, or tampering. Conduct research on perimeter walls, video surveillance systems, and control zone wire fences for research reactors. Construct fences for nuclear fuel cycle facilities and upgrade existing confidential technical defense or monitoring systems. Enhance the physical protection capability of key radioactive waste treatment facilities and overall improve the level of physical protection. Improve the level of security for the utilization of nuclear technology. Issue Requirements for the Security and Prevention System of Urban Radioactive Waste Repositories, upgrade and transform the security systems of national centralized storage facilities for radioactive sources and provincial-level urban radioactive waste repositories. Complete the clearance of waste and old radioactive source repositories in certain areas of urban radioactive waste repositories. Maintain the international nuclear non-proliferation regime. Continuously improve the nuclear import and export control system, strengthen the export control of dual-use nuclear items, and actively combat nuclear smuggling activities. Enhance information sharing, improve border nuclear radiation detection and disposal capabilities, and strengthen the detection of radioactive materials at entry and exit ports. Promote the cooperative model for reducing highly enriched uranium, research and promote the use of highly enriched uranium micro-reactors. Assist relevant countries in the transformation of highly enriched uranium micro-reactors and promote the use of low-enriched uranium.
titlelist: Key tasks, combining prevention and control, enhancing nuclear security level.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Carry out major projects such as technological upgrades and engineering renovations, eliminate safety hazards, continuously improve the safety level of nuclear power plants, research reactors, nuclear fuel cycles, and other nuclear facilities, and ensure nuclear safety. Column 1: Nuclear Safety Improvement Project.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
content: Establish a policy system for nuclear safety and prevention and control of radioactive pollution. Develop a national strategy for radioactive waste management. Implement the system of funds for the disposal of spent fuel from nuclear power plants in accordance with the law. Develop policies for the clean control and minimization of radioactive waste, and optimize the management policies for radioactive isotopes and radiation devices. Explore the formulation of policies for facility operation and decommissioning costs during the approval and establishment phase of research reactors. Study the establishment of a nuclear insurance catastrophe liability reserve system, adjust the maximum compensation limit for third-party damages in nuclear accidents, and explore the participation of commercial insurance in the national nuclear emergency response mechanism. Promote pilot projects for radiation safety liability insurance for high-risk radiation sources, and promote the establishment of liability insurance in the field of radioactive well logging and industrial mobile testing for sources of radiation of Class III and above. Study the establishment of a compensation system for occupational health damage.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen policy support, and promote key tasks.

name: Thirteenth Five-Year Plan and 2025 Vision Goals for Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution (Ministry of Environmental Protection, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / March 23, 2017)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.

Improve the government-led public communication system and promote the construction of public communication capabilities. Incorporate basic knowledge of nuclear safety into the education and training system, promote the dissemination of nuclear and radiation knowledge in communities, primary and secondary schools, and cadres training classrooms. Relying on enterprises, establish 10 national-level popular science and education bases for nuclear and radiation safety, strengthen the functions of network platforms and new media promotion, and enhance communication and exchange with the media. Improve information disclosure plans and guidelines, strengthen the construction of information disclosure platforms, and ensure that enterprises disclose information in accordance with the law at different stages. Actively disclose information such as permit approval, supervision and law enforcement, environmental monitoring, and accident events. Strengthen the interpretation of publicly available information. Safeguard the public's right to participate in accordance with the law during the construction process of nuclear facilities.

Share China's good practices and promote the establishment of a fair, cooperative, and win-win international nuclear security system. Strengthen international compliance, promote the transformation of compliance achievements, and enhance bilateral and multilateral international exchanges and cooperation in nuclear security.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepen international cooperation, and learn from advanced experiences.

content: Support the construction and facility operation of the national nuclear and radiation safety regulatory technology research and development base, the national radiation environment monitoring network, and the capacity building of regional nuclear and radiation safety supervision stations.
