name: Energy Technology Innovation 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration/December 30, 2016)
content: In the field of advanced nuclear energy technology, we have completed the construction of an independently developed third-generation pressurized water reactor demonstration project. We have also mastered the key technologies of large-scale advanced pressurized water reactors, high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, fast reactors, and modular small reactors. Breakthroughs have been made in the research of thorium-based molten salt reactors. We are conducting in-depth research and development on advanced nuclear fuel technology, advanced post-treatment technology for spent fuel and radioactive waste, and establishing a technical system suitable for the life extension verification of large-scale pressurized water nuclear power plants in China.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, development goals.

name: Energy Technology Innovation '13th Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration/December 30, 2016)
content: Accelerate the continuous improvement and innovation of advanced nuclear reactor types with independent intellectual property rights, promote the application of advanced third-generation pressurized water reactors with independent intellectual property rights, accelerate the construction and industrialization of technical demonstration projects for high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, fast reactors, and modular small reactors, and actively conduct research on new reactor types such as micro-reactors and thorium-based molten salt reactors. Carry out research and development of advanced nuclear fuel elements, promote the technology of spent fuel treatment, develop independent technologies for large-scale nuclear fuel reprocessing plants, break through technologies for preventing and mitigating severe accidents, minimizing waste, and cleaning equipment and pipelines. Actively promote research and development of technologies related to life extension of in-service nuclear power units, develop advanced monitoring/detection technologies, key equipment aging assessment technologies, and mitigation/repair technologies. This plan deploys 8 focused research projects, 4 demonstration test projects, and 6 application promotion projects in the fields of safe advanced civilian reactors, advanced nuclear fuel, nuclear power plant construction, operation, and life extension.
titlelist: Key task, advanced nuclear power technology with a focus on safety.

name: Energy Technology Innovation 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration/December 30, 2016)
content: 1) Concentrated research category. G40) Ultra-high temperature gas-cooled reactor technology research. Research objective: Through the research of key technologies, key equipment and materials, as well as performance testing, to demonstrate the feasibility of achieving 950℃ high-temperature operation and nuclear hydrogen production in the HTR-10. Research content: Based on the 10MW high-temperature gas-cooled experimental reactor, research on ultra-high temperature operation and nuclear hydrogen production at 950℃, including reactor physics and thermal design, safety and accident analysis, analysis of internal components materials and structures, high-temperature performance testing of fuel elements, etc. Conduct research on key technologies and performance testing of intermediate heat exchangers, as well as research on iodine-sulfur cycle water decomposition and high-temperature steam electrolysis hydrogen production technology. Duration: 2016-2022. G41) Fast neutron reactor operation and control technology research. Research objective: Through the research of key technologies and key equipment, enhance China's fast reactor operation and control capabilities, and master the technical methods of maintenance, repair, overhaul, and troubleshooting. Research content: Optimize the operation mode of the Chinese experimental fast reactor, clarify the technical requirements and control methods under various operation modes; research on sodium-cooled fast reactor power plant operation simulation and online diagnosis technology, in-service inspection technology for sodium-related equipment, key equipment aging management technology, and integrated operation and maintenance control technology. Duration: 2016-2020. G42) Lead-based alloy-cooled reactor technology research. Research objective: Complete the overall design and comprehensive demonstration test of the lead-based alloy-cooled reactor, laying the foundation for the engineering application of an independent intellectual property lead-based alloy-cooled reactor. Research content: Breakthroughs in key technologies such as lead-based alloy-cooled reactor design, testing, fuel material, etc., master fuel preparation process and in-pile irradiation data, carry out overall design and main equipment development of lead-based alloy-cooled reactor, cooling heat transfer and corrosion characteristics, cooling system process technology, system and equipment testing and verification, power plant instrumentation and control system development and operation and maintenance, etc. Duration: 2016-2021. G43) 5-10MW manufacturing-type modular reactor based on highly safe fuel. Research objective: Master the technology of all-ceramic microencapsulated fuel and cladding materials, break through the industrialized manufacturing technology of 5-10MW manufacturing-type reactor nuclear power units, and demonstrate the feasibility of manufacturing-type small modular reactor nuclear power units and their distributed applications. Research content: Develop manufacturing process, flow, and equipment for silicon carbide matrix coated particle fuel blocks, carry out fuel and material irradiation, performance testing and verification under normal operating conditions and severe accidents, as well as safety licensing; carry out design, safety analysis, licensing, application development of 5-10MW manufacturing-type modular reactor, intelligent control and safety system design, development and verification, advanced and efficient compact supercritical carbon dioxide Brayton cycle energy conversion system development and demonstration, independent operation power plant system integration and supporting equipment development, digitized and intelligent factory manufacturing and assembly process and equipment design and development. Duration: 2016-2021. G44) Key technology research on thorium-based molten salt reactor nuclear energy system. Research objective: Master the key technologies of thorium-based molten salt reactor, achieve industrialization of key materials and equipment, complete the construction of the world's first thorium-based molten salt simulation reactor and 2MW thorium-based molten salt experimental reactor, and achieve an overall technical level leading internationally. Research content: Conduct research on key scientific and technological issues such as thorium-uranium fuel cycle mode, molten salt reactor design and safety standards, molten salt circuit design; master the preparation and processing technology of key materials such as nickel-based high-temperature alloys, high-density graphite, and fuel molten salt; develop key equipment such as molten salt circuit instruments and equipment, molten salt reactor main equipment and instrumentation and control systems; breakthroughs in key technologies such as high-temperature dry separation of actinide elements, light isotope centrifugal extraction separation, molten salt high-temperature hydrogen production and molten salt energy storage. Duration: 2016-2020. 2) Demonstration and test category. S34) CFR600 fast reactor demonstration project. Research objective: Complete the research and development of key technologies and key equipment for the demonstration fast reactor, complete the standard design of CFR600, and finalize the design of the fast reactor MOX fuel. Research content: Conduct research on key process technologies of CFR600 demonstration fast reactor, determine the overall technical scheme and major process parameters; manufacture prototypes of key equipment such as mechanical sodium pumps, steam generators, control rod drive mechanisms, and carry out design work of the demonstration fast reactor; develop MOX fuel blocks, in-pile irradiation and inspection of CN15-15 and fuel samples, as well as research and design of industrial-scale MOX production line. Duration: 2016-2025. S35) Modular small reactor demonstration project. Research objective: Construct a demonstration project for modular small reactors and low-temperature heating reactors. Research content: Conduct research on modular construction technology, operation technology, regulatory standards and safety review technology of modular reactors, develop main equipment such as pressure vessels, steam generators, control rod drive mechanisms, small shield pumps/wet winding pumps, and conduct research on installation and commissioning technology. Duration: 2016-2020. 3) Application and promotion category. T23) Application and promotion of independent third-generation large-scale advanced pressurized water reactor nuclear power technology. Research objective: Carry out research related to the application and promotion of the Hualong One and CAP1400, and initially form batch production and scale-up capabilities. Research content: Based on the demonstration projects, carry out research on the batch production and scale-up application of the Hualong One and CAP1400, further improve the localization rate of equipment, research batch production technology, carry out independent nuclear power software verification and certification standards and specifications research, and initially establish an independent industrialization system for third-generation large-scale advanced pressurized water reactors. Duration: 2017-2025. T24) 600MW high-temperature gas-cooled reactor nuclear power plant. Research objective: Achieve commercial-scale deployment of a 600MW high-temperature gas-cooled reactor nuclear power plant (HTR-PM600). Research content: Conduct overall design and analysis research on the 600MW high-temperature gas-cooled reactor, research key technologies for large-scale production of spherical fuel elements, research on coordinated control technology for multi-module high-temperature gas-cooled reactors; conduct research on high-temperature gas-cooled reactor cogeneration technology, including steam supply technology, heat exchanger technology, energy distribution and balance technology for power generation/steam supply; carry out research on the localization of nuclear-grade graphite. Duration: 2016-2025.
titlelist: Key tasks, advanced nuclear power technology with a focus on safety, advanced civilian reactors with a focus on safety.

name: Energy Technology Innovation '13th Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration/December 30, 2016)
content: 1) Concentrated research category. G45) Research on new generation advanced nuclear fuel technology. Research objectives: Develop new zirconium alloy cladding materials with better performance than M5 and ZIRLO alloys, as well as long-life and high safety fuel elements; Research on accident-tolerant fuel (ATF) elements that can mitigate severe accident consequences, develop pilot rods/pilot components that can withstand in-reactor tests, and breakthrough key technologies for advanced nuclear fuels such as annular fuels with better performance. Research content: Based on the current main pressurized water reactor types in China, develop next-generation advanced pressurized water reactor fuels such as CF4 and the second-generation STEP-14 series, as well as domestically produced N45 and optimized CZ advanced zirconium alloy cladding materials. Conduct research and development on key technologies such as component and assembly design, manufacturing processes, out-of-pile performance testing, in-pile irradiation testing, and post-irradiation examination. Actively conduct research on advanced cladding and core block materials for ATF elements, complete the feasibility verification and preliminary design of the first-generation ATF fuel, and initiate out-of-pile performance testing and in-pile irradiation testing in a timely manner. Based on the feedback from the first-generation ATF fuel, actively optimize and innovate the selection and key technology research of the second-generation ATF fuel. Duration: 2016-2025. G46) Minimization technology for radioactive waste in nuclear power plants. Research objectives: Complete research on advanced radioactive solid waste treatment technology and waste liquid purification technology in nuclear power plants, achieve a significant improvement in decontamination efficiency. Research content: Research on advanced radioactive waste treatment technology and core equipment in nuclear power plants, conduct research on high-integrity container packaging technology, radioactive resin wet oxidation technology, PVC efficient degradation technology, low-level radioactive waste oil treatment technology, decontamination technology for radioactive contaminated pipelines and containers, plasma melting volume reduction technology, etc. Conduct research on waste liquid purification and tritium removal technology, overcome the separation technology of nuclides, boron, and weak electrolytes in radioactive waste liquid, and achieve boron recovery and reuse. Conduct research and development on easily decontaminated and easily disposed of new radiation shielding materials and new super adsorbent materials; conduct research on decontamination and dismantling of materials in decommissioned nuclear facilities. Duration: 2016-2023. 2) Application and promotion category. T25) Application and promotion of independent CF and STEP series advanced nuclear fuel. Research objectives: Master the mass production technology of independent CF and STEP series fuel assemblies, N36 and CZ zirconium alloy fuel cladding, establish a domestic supply system for fuel assembly raw materials, and gradually realize the use of independent brand fuel in the Hualong One export project, domestic second-generation and second-generation pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants, and the Hualong One project under construction. Master the mass production technology of independent brand fuel assemblies, and initially establish an industrialization system for independent brand fuel assemblies. Research content: Conduct research on the scale application of CF series assemblies; actively conduct in-pile irradiation tests and application research on STEP series fuel assemblies; adapt or establish production lines for domestic fuel assemblies based on mature independent brand fuels. Duration: 2016-2020.
titlelist: Key tasks, advanced nuclear power technology with a focus on safety, advanced nuclear fuel.

name: Energy Technology Innovation 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration/December 30, 2016)
content: 1) Concentrated research category. G47) Research on operation and maintenance technology of nuclear power plants. Research objectives: Targeting third-generation, fourth-generation, small-scale reactors, and other nuclear power technologies, with the goal of ensuring the safe, economical, and efficient operation of nuclear reactors, and conducting research on online inspection and replacement of key equipment in nuclear power plants. Research content: Through research on intelligent radiation protection monitoring, intelligent inspection, intelligent equipment management, etc., to build the basic infrastructure for intelligent operation of nuclear power plants; research on advanced non-destructive testing methods, high-precision in-service testing technology; development of intelligent maintenance robots for nuclear power plants, research on simulation technology, operation support technology, development of human factor data collection and analysis systems, and research on key technologies for intelligent operation of nuclear power plants; research on intelligent inspection technologies such as radiation dose monitoring and positioning, automatic meter reading, etc.; research on intelligent equipment management such as asset management technology throughout the equipment lifecycle. Duration: 2016-2020.2) Demonstration and testing category. S36) Demonstration and application of key technologies for life extension of nuclear power plants. Research objectives: Solve the key supporting technologies involved in the scope definition and screening, aging management review, time-limited aging analysis, etc. of life extension of nuclear power plants in China, and complete the life extension demonstration work of the demonstration unit at Daya Bay Nuclear Power Plant. Research content: Conduct research on the service behavior and mechanism of nuclear materials under long-term operation, develop new prediction models or evaluation technologies; conduct research on the application of technologies such as safety shell strain monitoring, component fatigue and damage detection, reactor pressure vessel detection and evaluation; develop advanced technologies such as advanced welding, cathodic protection for structural corrosion mitigation, pipeline corrosion mitigation, special repair under radiation water environment, identification of nuclear-grade cable environment, pre-leakage assessment, evaluation of prestress loss in safety shell reinforcement, and conduct application verification; develop life extension management platform for nuclear power plants; conduct research on the document system and management guidelines for life extension of nuclear power plants, and form an independent technical document system and standards for life extension of nuclear power plants in China. Duration: 2016-2020. S37) Demonstration of intelligent design and construction technology for nuclear power plants. Research objectives: Promote the digitization, networking, and intelligence of nuclear power engineering, and demonstrate the application in the Fangchenggang Nuclear Power Plant's Hualong One reactor. Research content: Establish a business logic network between ten-thousand-level business units in the full business process of nuclear power plant design and construction, and build a unified business process platform for nuclear power engineering; develop nuclear power data sources and data flow models, realize intelligent cross-disciplinary, cross-domain, and cross-stage business collaboration and information exchange, seamless connection of design, procurement, construction, and commissioning processes, and achieve comprehensive collaboration of nuclear power business and management. Duration: 2016-2020.3) Application and promotion category. T26) Application and promotion of independent advanced nuclear power monitoring and detection equipment. Research objectives: Achieve the application and promotion of independent nuclear power monitoring and detection equipment in domestic and international markets, and form a domestic nuclear power equipment production system. Research content: Conduct research on the application and promotion of safety-grade sensors and their online rapid fault diagnosis devices, remote expert analysis platforms for alarm events, LBB leakage monitoring systems for main steam pipelines, online monitoring and diagnostic systems for current, online detection of fuel damage, poolside inspection equipment, large-scale application of metal component monitoring technology; conduct research on the large-scale application of maintenance equipment and key device; establish supply system for advanced nuclear power detection, maintenance equipment, and key equipment; conduct research on the batch production technology of independent third-generation nuclear core measurement system signal processing equipment. Duration: 2016-2020. T27) Application and promotion of digital instrument and control platform technology for nuclear power plants. Research objectives: Achieve the application and promotion of safety-grade digital instrument and control systems in domestic and export nuclear power plants, such as Hualong One and AP1000. Research content: For third-generation nuclear power plant models, fully verify the adaptability and system communication feasibility of non-safety-grade NicSys2000 platform and safety-grade NicSys8000 platform, ACP system's SpeedyHold platform, safety-grade protection system FirmSys platform, non-safety-grade control system HOLLiAS-MACS platform, as well as FirmSim and HOLLiAS-MACS simulation platforms; conduct advanced design scheme verification for OPS remote arrangement, POP large screen display, arc-shaped disk table, NC-VDU bracket display, etc. Duration: 2016-2020. T28) Nuclear accident emergency technology and equipment. Research objectives: Provide technology and equipment for nuclear power plants to respond to severe accidents through technology application and promotion, including the completion of standardized design and promotion of emergency treatment equipment for radioactive wastewater with a processing capacity of 5m3/h. Research content: Application and promotion of emergency treatment technology and process for radioactive wastewater in nuclear accidents, emergency high-capacity battery energy storage system for nuclear power plants, non-active emergency high-level cooling water source system for nuclear power plants, large-capacity 1E-grade emergency diesel generator set for nuclear power plants, emergency feasibility evaluation methods for site selection stage of nuclear power plants, design methods for emergency command centers of nuclear power plants, and advanced real-time evaluation technology for post-accident consequences of nuclear accidents. Duration: 2016-2020.
titlelist: Key tasks, advanced nuclear power technology for safety, construction, operation, and longevity.

name: Energy Technology Innovation '13th Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration/December 30, 2016)
content: 1) Concentrated research category. G58) Controllable nuclear fusion frontier technology research. Research objectives: Master key technologies of magnetic confinement nuclear fusion, and initially establish a nuclear fusion industrial development system. In terms of inertial confinement fusion, obtain key technology and parameter verification results based on the overall technical route of the Z-FFR experimental reactor. Research content: Conduct detailed engineering design of the Chinese fusion engineering experimental reactor, and carry out verification experiments related to CFETR physics on the EAST and HL-2M tokamak devices, combining with existing physics design databases; Conduct pre-research on key fusion reactor technologies, develop tritium technology, fusion materials, and other fusion reactor technologies not covered by ITER. In terms of inertial confinement fusion, obtain key technology and parameter verification results based on the solution of the overall technical route of the Z-FFR experimental reactor, provide core technical support for the formulation, design, and development of the Z-FFR experimental reactor, and focus on key technology research such as local and overall ignition targets, repetitive drivers, subcritical coatings, and materials. Start and end time: 2016-2020.
titlelist: Key tasks, strategic energy technology, controllable nuclear fusion.

name: Energy Technology Innovation '13th Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration/December 30, 2016)
content: 1) Concentrated research category. G62) Stabilization preparation technology for heat transfer tube materials in nuclear power steam generators. Research objectives: Master the key technologies for preparing heat transfer tube materials of 690, achieve stable production of high-quality heat transfer tubes, and gradually increase the finished product rate to over 85%. Research content: Combining the existing 690 heat transfer tube production line in China, research the influence of alloy microelements such as Si and Mn on the alloy strengthening mechanism and corrosion performance, research on large-capacity 690 alloy pure homogenization smelting technology, research on cold-hot deformation and uniformity control technology of 690 alloy, key influencing factors of mechanical stability of 690 alloy heat transfer tubes, and factors affecting the signal-to-noise ratio of 690 tubes. Start and end time: 2016-2020. G63) Key technology research on insulation materials for nuclear power. Research objectives: Develop a series of insulation materials for large-capacity steam turbine generators for nuclear power, including high-strength laminated products, long-life main insulation mica composite products, high-hardness water-soluble silicon steel plate paint, and key materials for radiation-resistant cables. Form a series of independent intellectual property rights for the manufacturing technology of insulation materials for nuclear power and apply the project products to nuclear power units. Research content: Develop high-temperature resistant modified epoxy resin with a long-term heat resistance index of ≥180℃, break through the method of preparing stator slot wedge laminated insulation composite materials using complementary compounding technology of reinforcing materials; develop high-strength epoxy resin with a long-term heat resistance index of ≥155℃, research the method of preparing F-class epoxy glass mat laminated insulation composite materials using glass mat impregnation technology and vacuum molding technology; develop peroxide bisphenol A epoxy resin with characteristics of resistance to tracking and arc resistance and good applicability; synthesize completely water-soluble resin with high hardness (8H) and flexibility (Grade 1); formulate silicon steel plate paint with high filler content; research a new series of mica composite materials suitable for VPI process and multi-rubber molding process. Develop various nuclear-grade cable materials resistant to irradiation, long life cross-linked polyolefin, ethylene-propylene rubber, etc. Start and end time: 2016-2020. G64) Research on key technologies for nuclear-grade SiCf/SiC composite materials. Research objectives: Develop nuclear-grade SiCf/SiC composite materials. Research content: Develop SiCf/SiC composite materials with low porosity, high strength, and high thermal conductivity using PIP technology to meet the performance requirements for nuclear-grade applications; research non-destructive testing and performance evaluation technology for SiCf/SiC composite materials, composite material connection technology and component preparation technology, and component preparation technology for nuclear-grade SiCf/SiC composite materials; research the preparation process, microstructure, and relationship between properties of nuclear-grade SiCf/SiC composite materials, and establish evaluation methods/standards for composite material performance. Start and end time: 2016-2020.
titlelist: Key tasks, energy basic materials technology, nuclear-grade materials.

name: Electric Power Development '13th Five-Year Plan' (2016-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/December 22, 2016)
content: Other key independent innovations in the field of electric power. Actively develop new coal-based power generation technologies, break through the efficiency bottleneck of conventional coal-fired power generation, promote the research and development and application of fuel cell power generation technologies, and develop solid oxide and molten carbonate fuel cell stacks and power generation system integration technologies. Breakthroughs in the design and manufacturing technologies of high-temperature components, master large-scale preparation technologies for high-performance composite materials, establish micro, small, and medium-sized gas turbine test platforms, and heavy-duty gas turbine power generation test stations. Explore the application of electromechanical-type tri-generation demonstration systems for electric heating, cooling, and power supply. Improve the level of independent development of large-scale advanced pressurized water reactor nuclear power technology, promote the optimization and upgrading of high-temperature gas-cooled reactor technology, and carry out research and development of advanced nuclear energy technologies such as small intelligent reactors, commercial fast reactors, and molten salt reactors. Strengthen major technological breakthroughs in million-kilowatt-level hydroelectric generator units, large-capacity high-head pumped storage units, etc. Accelerate the research and development and application of high-efficiency solar power generation technologies, large-capacity wind power generation technologies, and other renewable energy power generation technologies.
titlelist: Key tasks, intensify efforts to tackle key issues, strengthen independent innovation.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Since the first commercial nuclear power plant was put into operation in the mid-1950s, nuclear power development has gone through 50 years. According to data released by the International Atomic Energy Agency in October 2005, there are a total of 442 operating nuclear power units worldwide, including: pressurized water reactors accounting for 60%, boiling water reactors accounting for 21%, heavy water reactors accounting for 9%, and other types such as graphite reactors accounting for 10%. These nuclear power units have accumulated more than 10,000 reactor-years of operation. The total installed capacity of nuclear power worldwide is.
titlelist: The current status of nuclear power development and the position of nuclear power in the world's energy structure.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: The diversification of primary energy is an important guarantee for national energy security strategy. Practice has proven that nuclear energy is a safe, clean, and reliable source of energy. China has a low per capita energy resource ownership rate, and the distribution is also uneven. In order to ensure the long-term stable supply of energy in our country, nuclear energy will become an indispensable alternative energy source. Developing nuclear power can improve China's energy supply structure and contribute to safeguarding national energy security and economic security.
titlelist: The important significance of developing nuclear power is beneficial for ensuring national energy security.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: In our country, coal is the primary source of energy. For a long time, coal-fired power generation has accounted for over 80% of the total electricity generation. The extensive development of coal-fired power plants has put tremendous pressure on coal production, transportation, and environmental protection. With the continuous growth of electricity demand due to economic development, the environmental impact of coal-fired power generation has become increasingly significant, and the national air quality is not optimistic. In 2004, coal-fired power plants emitted approximately 12 million tons of sulfur dioxide, accounting for 53.2% of the total national emissions. In 2005, our coal consumption for power generation reached 1.075 billion tons, and if the current coal-to-electricity ratio is maintained, the demand for coal in 2010 and 2020 will exceed 1.7 billion tons and 2 billion tons respectively. The task of reducing pollutant emissions and improving environmental quality in the power industry is extremely challenging. Nuclear power is a mature and clean energy source. Compared to thermal power, nuclear power does not emit sulfur dioxide, smoke, nitrogen oxides, and carbon dioxide. Replacing some coal-fired power generation with nuclear power can not only reduce the total amount of coal mining, transportation, and combustion but also provide an effective way to reduce pollutant emissions in the power industry and mitigate the greenhouse effect on Earth.
titlelist: The important significance of developing nuclear power is beneficial for adjusting the energy structure and improving the atmospheric environment.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: The nuclear power industry belongs to the high-tech industry, with high technological content in the design and manufacturing of nuclear power equipment, strict quality requirements, high industrial relevance, and involvement in dozens of upstream and downstream industries. Accelerating the independent construction of nuclear power is conducive to the promotion and application of high-tech, the promotion of technological innovation, and will play an important role in improving the overall process, materials, and processing level of China's manufacturing industry.
titlelist: The important significance of developing nuclear power is to improve the level of equipment manufacturing industry and promote technological progress.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Through international bidding, we will select partners and introduce the design and equipment manufacturing technology for a new generation of million-kilowatt pressurized water reactor nuclear power plant projects. We will organize domestic efforts to digest, absorb, innovate, and achieve self-reliance, catching up with the advanced level of pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants worldwide. During the 11th Five-Year Plan period, through the construction of two independent nuclear power projects, we will comprehensively master advanced pressurized water reactor nuclear power technology, cultivate domestic capabilities, and strive to quickly develop the ability to build Chinese brand nuclear power plants on a large scale. At the same time, in order to ensure continuous progress in nuclear power construction, before fully digesting and mastering third-generation nuclear power technology, we will still independently construct pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants of appropriate scale based on existing second-generation improved nuclear power technology through design improvements and research and development.
titlelist: The key content and implementation of planning, the technological roadmap for nuclear power development.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: At the end of the 'Fifteenth Five-Year Plan' and the beginning of the 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan', we fully utilized the existing technology of Qinshan Phase II and Ling'ao Phase I, and made improvements to construct Qinshan Phase II expansion and Ling'ao Phase II nuclear power projects, enabling domestic enterprises to have the capability of independently designing second-generation improved 600,000-kilowatt and million-kilowatt pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants. During the 'Eleventh Five-Year Plan' period, through international cooperation, we introduced new generation advanced nuclear power technology and constructed Zhejiang Sanmen Phase I and Shandong Haiyang Phase I nuclear power projects. Based on digestion and absorption, we further optimized and improved to enhance the safety and economy of nuclear power. The engineering design work can start with joint design between domestic and foreign entities and gradually transition to independent completion by domestic enterprises, forming the design capability for China's advanced pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants and batch construction. In order to increase the proportion of nuclear power as soon as possible, Guangdong Taishan adopted the approach of introducing foreign technology and equipment to construct third-generation nuclear power units. Using the digested and absorbed second-generation improved technology, construction of nuclear power plants such as Liaoning Hongyanhe began.
titlelist: The key focus of planning and implementation is the localization of nuclear power design.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: The main equipment manufacturing for nuclear power is led by the three major domestic equipment manufacturers, while also leveraging the professional advantages of other related enterprises, gradually implementing technological transformation and industrial upgrading, and jointly establishing a relatively complete nuclear power equipment manufacturing system. During the Eleventh Five-Year Plan period, the goal is to achieve an annual production capacity of nuclear power complete sets of equipment of no less than 2 million kilowatts, and after 2010, to achieve an annual production capacity of 4 million kilowatts. The technical introduction work related to the production of key nuclear power equipment should be carried out in accordance with the overall national deployment, combined with the construction of independent projects, organizing unified bidding, coordinating domestic forces, taking effective measures, and doing a good job of digestion and absorption. For key equipment that cannot currently be produced in China, work should be carried out in accordance with the principles of taking ourselves as the mainstay, introducing technology, and achieving localization. For the technologies that have been introduced, the digestion and absorption process should be accelerated and transformed into production capacity of equipment manufacturing enterprises as soon as possible. In terms of equipment procurement methods, for equipment for which domestic manufacturers have basically mastered the manufacturing technology, bidding and procurement should be conducted among domestic manufacturers as a principle. For a small number of non-key equipment that has not mastered the manufacturing technology and has sufficient and stable supply in the international market, after demonstration and determination, bidding and procurement can be conducted externally. For some key equipment, market-for-technology methods should be used, or technology should be introduced from abroad, or joint ventures and cooperation with foreign manufacturers should be established to provide equipment. Under the unified organization of the National Leading Group for Nuclear Power Localization, domestic manufacturing enterprises should coordinate and cooperate, introduce competition, improve efficiency, rely on the expansion of Qinshan Phase II and Ling'ao Phase II, Hongyanhe in Liaoning, Sanmen in Zhejiang, and Haiyang in Shandong, and continuously increase the proportion of equipment manufacturing localization, maximize the mastery of manufacturing technology, and strive to achieve strategic upgrading of the nuclear power equipment manufacturing industry.
titlelist: The key focus of planning and implementation is the localization of nuclear power equipment manufacturing.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: After years of effort, our country has reserved a certain scale of nuclear power plant site resources. In addition to the completed and under-construction projects, there are more than 50 million kilowatts of pre-worked sites in coastal areas, as shown in Table 3. In addition, since 2004, site selection work for nuclear power plants has been carried out in Guangdong (Tianwei site), Zhejiang (West Zhejiang area), Hubei, Jiangxi, Hunan, and other areas, further increasing the reserve of nuclear power plant sites. From the perspective of site conditions, by 2020, the capacity of nuclear power plant sites listed in Table 3 can meet the target of operating 40 million kilowatts and constructing 18 million kilowatts. Considering China's energy resources and production layout, from now until 2020, the newly commissioned 23 million kilowatts of nuclear power plants will mainly be selected from the aforementioned coastal provinces, and consideration will be given to starting the construction of a nuclear power plant in coastal provinces (regions) such as Shandong, Fujian, and Guangxi where there is currently no nuclear power. In addition to coastal sites, inland provinces (regions, cities) such as Hubei, Jiangxi, Hunan, Jilin, Anhui, Henan, Chongqing, Sichuan, and Gansu have also carried out preliminary work on nuclear power plant sites to varying degrees. These sites should be strictly reviewed and approved in accordance with the requirements of nuclear power plant sites and in accordance with the development plan of nuclear power, and work should be carried out gradually according to the requirements of nuclear power development.
titlelist: The key content and implementation of planning, selection and protection of nuclear power plant sites.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Adhere to the technical route of closed fuel cycle for nuclear energy, adhere to the principle of combining domestic and foreign resources, develop domestic resources reasonably, actively utilize foreign resources, moderately advance the development of the nuclear fuel industry, and establish a natural uranium resource security system that includes domestic production, overseas development, and international uranium trade.
titlelist: The key content and implementation of planning, nuclear fuel security capability.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Simultaneously with the construction of nuclear power projects, a low and intermediate-level radioactive waste disposal site is being built to meet the increasing demand for the treatment of low and intermediate-level radioactive waste resulting from the development of nuclear power. By 2020, an underground laboratory for the final disposal of high-level radioactive waste will be completed, and the planning for the final disposal site of high-level radioactive waste will be finished.
titlelist: The key content and implementation of planning, radioactive waste disposal.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: According to a rough estimate of the scale of nuclear power construction and production that will commence within the next 15 years, the total demand for construction funds is approximately 450 billion RMB. Among them, the demand for project capital within the next 15 years is 90 billion RMB, with an average annual investment of over 5.4 billion RMB from the company's own funds. In addition, there is a significant demand for funding for nuclear fuel support, including exploration and reserves of natural uranium resources, as well as spent fuel reprocessing. In principle, funds will be raised through the company's own capital, with commercial loans provided by banks.
titlelist: The key contents and implementation of planning, investment estimation.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Establish a national nuclear power technology company, responsible for the unified introduction of technology, digestion and absorption, and innovation, to achieve technology sharing among domestic enterprises; integrate the localization of nuclear power with the major medium and long-term planning of science and technology, and coordinate the advanced nuclear power engineering design and equipment development work; include nuclear power equipment manufacturing and key technologies in the national major equipment localization plan, and form a complete set of equipment capabilities. For key equipment, including large-scale castings and forgings, concentrate efforts and make breakthroughs.
titlelist: Enhance equipment research and development efforts and strengthen safeguard measures and policies.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: According to the ideas of socialization, marketization, and specialization, the focus is on the development, design, construction, commissioning, operation, maintenance, personnel training, safety protection, and other aspects of nuclear power plants. Corresponding scientific research and supporting conditions are carried out to establish and improve the specialized operation and technical service system of nuclear power, comprehensively improve the safety and stable operation level of nuclear power plants, and create conditions for more enterprises to invest in the construction of nuclear power plants. The large-scale development of nuclear power in our country requires a large number of professionals related to nuclear power. The development of nuclear power is not only a national strategy but also provides broad market space and opportunities for related industries and professionals to display their talents. In order to achieve the goal of nuclear power development by 2020, the state, enterprises, and research institutes of higher education should seize the opportunity to strengthen the training of various talents in scientific research, design, fuel, manufacturing, operation, and maintenance, as well as in professional fields such as nuclear power design, nuclear engineering technology, nuclear reactor engineering, nuclear and radiation safety, and operation management. They should improve treatment and do a good job in talent reserve. The focus is on setting up nuclear power majors at Tsinghua University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and Xi'an Jiao Tong University, compiling and revising nuclear power textbooks, and cultivating nuclear power talents.
titlelist: Guarantee measures and policies, strengthen the construction of operation and technical service system, accelerate the training of nuclear power talents.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Promote the development of nuclear power in a prudent manner. Implement the requirements of the special action plan for the 'Year of Nuclear Power Safety Management Enhancement', further enhance the level of nuclear power safety management, ensure the safe and stable operation of operating nuclear power units, and ensure the safety and quality control of nuclear power projects under construction. Based on comprehensive demonstration and evaluation, start the construction of a batch of advanced third-generation pressurized water reactor nuclear power projects in coastal areas. Further improve the management system for the development of nuclear power projects and protect nuclear power plant site resources. Continue to promote the resolution of the issue of restricted development of nuclear power in certain regions and promote the full development of nuclear power. Continue to implement major scientific and technological projects for nuclear power, build a shared system for the testing platform of nuclear power technology equipment, accelerate the approval of major projects for small modular reactors, and actively promote the comprehensive utilization of nuclear energy.
titlelist: Accelerate the green development of energy, promote harmonious coexistence between humans and nature, and strengthen the clean energy industry.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Actively promote the construction of nuclear power projects that have already started. The plan is to complete the construction of Sanmen Unit 1, Haiyang Unit 1, Taishan Unit 1, Tianwan Unit 3, and Yangjiang Unit 5 within the year, with a total of approximately 6 million kilowatts of newly installed nuclear power capacity. Actively promote the approval and construction of projects that meet the conditions, with plans to start construction on 6 to 8 units within the year. Solidly promote the preliminary feasibility study of a batch of coastal nuclear power projects with mature site conditions and a good public foundation.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Safely develop nuclear power. Actively promote the construction of nuclear power projects that meet the conditions and organize approval for construction according to procedures. Start the approval and preparation for subsequent coastal nuclear power projects in an orderly manner, and promote the protection and demonstration work of nuclear power plant sites. Continue to implement major nuclear power technology projects and promote the construction of high-temperature gas-cooled reactor demonstration projects. Steadily promote the preliminary work of small reactor demonstration projects and actively explore the comprehensive utilization of nuclear energy.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the large-scale development of non-fossil energy.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Ensure the safety of nuclear power construction and operation. Organize the Year of Nuclear Power Safety Management Enhancement activity, implement a one-year special rectification action for nuclear power safety, identify safety loopholes, and eliminate hidden safety hazards. Strengthen the assessment and management of emergency, firefighting, and operating personnel at nuclear power plants, enhance the exchange and feedback of construction and operation experience in nuclear power plants, comprehensively improve nuclear accident emergency management and response capabilities, and ensure the safety and controllability of operating and under-construction units. Strengthen nuclear power popular science promotion.
titlelist: Key task: Strengthen production and construction safety management.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Strengthen key technology research and development. In the fields of nuclear power, new energy, shale gas, coalbed methane, gas turbines, high-temperature materials, and offshore oil and gas exploration, promote breakthroughs in independent core technologies. In the fields of solar thermal utilization, large-capacity energy storage for distributed energy systems, promote the industrialization and popularization of applied technologies. Focus on promoting the sustainable development of renewable energy, advanced nuclear power, key materials, and high-end equipment, research and establish a national energy research and development institution, and establish and improve relevant management mechanisms.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Promote the 'going global' strategy for nuclear power. Advance the construction of the Karachi project in Pakistan and carry out follow-up cooperation. Promote the implementation of the UK nuclear power project and advance the review of the Hualong One UK generic design. Coordinate and do a good job in my participation in the restructuring of France's Areva. Strengthen nuclear power technology cooperation with Russia, the United States, and other countries. Steadily advance cooperation on nuclear power projects in Argentina, Turkey, Romania, and other countries.
titlelist: Key task: Expanding international cooperation in energy.

name: Medium- to Long-Term Development Plan for Nuclear Power (2005-2020) (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/October 2007)
content: Actively promote the construction of nuclear power projects that have already started. The plan is to complete the construction of Sanmen Unit 1, Fuqing Unit 4, Yangjiang Unit 4, Haiyang Unit 1, and Taishan Unit 1 within the year, adding a total installed capacity of 6.41 million kilowatts. name: Twelfth Five-Year Plan and 2020 Vision for Nuclear Safety and Prevention of Radioactive Pollution (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: Our country's nuclear power plants adopt international standards and are designed, constructed, and operated according to the concept of defense in depth, with a high level of safety. As of December 2011, the 15 nuclear power units operating in mainland China have performed well in terms of safety, with no incidents or accidents classified as level 2 or above on the International Nuclear Event Scale, and emissions of gaseous and liquid effluents are far below the national standard limits. The quality assurance system of the 26 nuclear power units under construction is operating effectively, and the engineering and construction technology level is synchronized with international standards. The major scientific projects of large advanced pressurized water reactors and high-temperature gas-cooled reactors are progressing in an orderly manner. The results of the comprehensive safety inspection of nuclear facilities implemented in 2011 show that the operating and under-construction nuclear power units in our country basically meet the requirements of our current nuclear safety regulations and the latest standards of the International Atomic Energy Agency, and safety and quality are guaranteed. Safety improvement activities for research reactors are ongoing, and existing research reactors are in a safe operating or safe shutdown state. Nuclear fuel production, processing, storage, and post-treatment facilities maintain safe operation, with no critical accidents or transportation safety accidents affecting the environment or public health. The nuclear material control system is effective. The entire process control of radiation sources is implemented, and the special rectification work for preventing stuck sources in irradiation devices has achieved results, gradually improving the level of safety management. The annual occurrence rate of radiation accidents involving radiation sources has decreased from 6.2 per ten thousand sources in the 1990s to 2.5 per ten thousand sources during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan period. The design, manufacturing, installation, and non-destructive testing activities of nuclear safety equipment are fully incorporated into nuclear safety supervision, and the quality and reliability of equipment continue to improve.
titlelist: The current situation and prospects have made positive progress in nuclear safety and prevention of radioactive pollution, and the level of nuclear safety continues to improve.

name: Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: In recent years, the country has continuously increased its efforts in preventing and controlling radioactive pollution, steadily advancing the decommissioning of early nuclear facilities and the management of historical radioactive waste. The decommissioning of several micro-reactors and radiochemical laboratories has been completed. A number of facilities for the treatment of medium and low-level radioactive waste have been built. Two disposal sites for medium and low-level radioactive waste are now operational, and construction has begun on another disposal site. Projects for the decommissioning and environmental remediation of uranium mining geological exploration and metallurgical facilities have been completed, reducing the risk of tailings dam failures and controlling pollution, resulting in improved environmental quality. Timely recovery of waste radioactive sources has been achieved, and a number of old irradiation devices have been decommissioned. The national centralized storage facility for radioactive waste sources and temporary storage facilities in various provinces (regions, cities) have been basically completed. The national radiation environmental quality is good, and radiation levels are within the range of natural background fluctuations; the average radiation dose for workers is much lower than the national limit.
titlelist: The current situation and prospects have made positive progress in nuclear safety and prevention and control of radioactive pollution, and the prevention and control of radioactive pollution is steadily advancing.

name: Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: The development of nuclear safety science and technology lacks an overall plan. Existing resources are scattered, talent is scarce, and research and development capabilities are insufficient. The revision of regulations and standards lacks technological support, and there is still a significant overall gap between basic scientific research and applied technology research and the international advanced level. This has hindered the further improvement of China's nuclear safety level.
titlelist: The current situation and prospects face challenges in nuclear safety and prevention of radioactive pollution, and there is a need to strengthen scientific and technological research and development.

content: The emergency management system for nuclear accidents needs further improvement, and the responsibilities of nuclear power group companies in emergency response work need to be further refined. There is a lack of effective emergency support mechanisms within and between nuclear power group companies, and there is insufficient reserve and allocation capacity for emergency resources. The emergency command, response, monitoring, and technical support capabilities of local governments still need to be enhanced. The feasibility of nuclear accident emergency plans still needs to be improved.
titlelist: The current situation and prospects face challenges in nuclear safety and prevention of radioactive pollution, and the emergency response system needs to be improved.

name: Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: According to the conclusions and improvement requirements of comprehensive safety inspections of nuclear facilities, safety improvements will be implemented for research reactors and nuclear fuel cycle facilities with safety hazards. For those that cannot meet safety standards, restricted operation or gradual shutdown will be implemented. The classification directory for research reactors will be completed, and management requirements will be clarified for implementing classified management. The management mode of research reactor licenses and regular safety review methods will be improved. Safety assurance and management methods for research reactors in shutdown states will be determined. Serious accident management will be implemented for large research reactors. Probabilistic safety analysis and aging assessment of research reactors will be conducted. The compilation of technical regulations and technical evaluation principles for new reactor types such as fast neutron breeder reactors, as well as their underlying technical documents, will be completed. The transfer of some spent fuel components from research reactors to centralized storage facilities will be completed. Column 3 focuses on enhancing the safety level of research reactors.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen rectification, eliminate safety hazards in research reactors and nuclear fuel cycle facilities.

content: The safety important structures, systems, and equipment of nuclear fuel cycle facilities are classified and managed. Strengthen the research on the process and safety of nuclear fuel cycle facilities, and continuously improve the inherent safety level. Establish a feedback system for operating experience of nuclear fuel cycle facilities and strengthen the management of nuclear critical safety risks. Standardize and improve the safety management of early nuclear facilities, and resolve historical legacy issues as soon as possible. According to the direction, scale, and speed of nuclear power development, carry out top-level design for the development of nuclear fuel cycle, strengthen the construction and operation management of supporting facilities such as three wastes treatment, and enhance effluent and environmental monitoring. Column 4 focuses on improving the safety level of nuclear fuel cycle facilities.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen rectification, eliminate safety hazards in research reactors and nuclear fuel cycle facilities, and provide reliable power supply, mobile power supply, mobile pumps, fire trucks, and emergency water sources for research reactors.

name: Twelfth Five-Year Plan and 2020 Vision for Nuclear Safety and Prevention of Radioactive Pollution (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: Improve the regulatory requirements and management system for nuclear safety equipment, further clarify the safety responsibilities of operating units, engineering general contracting units, and holders of nuclear safety equipment licenses. Strengthen the qualification management of nuclear safety equipment design, manufacturing, installation, and non-destructive testing units, raise the entry threshold, and establish a sound quality evaluation system for certified units. Strengthen the evaluation and supervision of nuclear safety equipment design verification and identification tests, and formulate management systems for nuclear safety equipment verification and identification. Strengthen the management and supervision of the manufacturing process of nuclear safety equipment, and improve the on-site supervision system. Improve the registration and inspection system for imported nuclear safety equipment, and strengthen the supervision of imported nuclear safety equipment. Strengthen the supervision and personnel qualification management of special process personnel such as welders, welding operators, and non-destructive testing personnel in nuclear safety equipment. Carry out effective aging and life management of in-service equipment to ensure that the equipment meets safety requirements throughout its service life. Establish an independent non-destructive testing capability verification system separate from operating units and inspection units.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen quality assurance, improve equipment reliability.

name: Nuclear safety and prevention and control of radioactive pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: Encourage enterprises to carry out nuclear safety technology innovation, strengthen the development and use of new technologies and processes, and continuously improve facility safety levels. Support the basic capacity building of nuclear safety technology research units, fully integrate and utilize existing scientific research resources and major special project channels, and establish a number of nuclear safety-related technology research and development platforms on this basis. Carry out targeted research and development of nuclear safety technology, concentrate efforts to break through key technologies that restrict development in nuclear safety, and enhance the overall level of nuclear safety in our country. Actively promote major special project safety technology scientific research and application in large pressurized water reactors, high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, and spent fuel reprocessing. Focus on research in areas such as reactor safety, prevention and mitigation of severe accidents, nuclear power plant site safety, measures to prevent and mitigate aircraft impact on nuclear power plants, reliability of nuclear safety equipment, safety of nuclear fuel cycle facilities, safety of nuclear technology utilization, transportation and physical protection of radioactive materials, nuclear emergency and counter-terrorism, evaluation of radiation environmental impact and radiation exposure control, radioactive waste management, and safety of nuclear facility decommissioning. name: Nuclear safety and prevention and control of radioactive pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: To achieve planning goals, promote technological upgrades and progress in the use of nuclear energy and nuclear technology, further eliminate safety hazards, and improve nuclear safety levels, key projects such as safety improvements, pollution control, technological innovation, emergency preparedness, and regulatory capacity building are planned to be implemented. name: Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Further enhance the independence, authority, and effectiveness of nuclear safety regulatory agencies. Clarify and strengthen the responsibilities of the competent authorities and nuclear power industry regulatory departments in nuclear safety management. Increase the management efforts of the nuclear industry regulatory departments, including research institutes and universities. Improve emergency mechanisms by closely integrating emergency management with daily supervision, fully leveraging the functional roles of relevant nuclear departments and the professional technical advantages of nuclear enterprise groups, and specifying the responsibilities of nuclear-related entities. Increase investment in research expenses and incorporate them into the national science and technology development management system. The industry regulatory departments will take nuclear safety requirements as an important basis for formulating relevant industrial and sectoral development decisions to ensure the coordination and unity of development and safety. Improve the coordination mechanism between nuclear safety regulatory agencies and industry regulatory departments in formulating industry development strategies, plans, project preliminary approvals, and safety supervision. Establish a natural disaster warning and emergency coordination mechanism between industry regulatory departments, nuclear safety regulatory agencies, and meteorological, oceanic, seismic, and other departments. Optimize the international cooperation system for nuclear safety, achieve coordination and unity between international and domestic work, and further strengthen and deepen exchanges and cooperation with international organizations in the field of nuclear safety.

Carry out professional certification in the field of nuclear safety-related majors, strengthen the construction of nuclear safety-related majors in universities, further enhance the connection between universities and industries and enterprises, and accelerate the training of urgently needed professional talents. name: Nuclear safety and prevention and control of radioactive pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: Closely track the international trends in nuclear safety development, learn from advanced foreign experiences in nuclear safety management and supervision, and promote the continuous improvement of China's nuclear safety management level. Strengthen international cooperation in areas such as collaborative research, information sharing, experience feedback, training exchanges, peer assessments, emergency response, and assistance. Enhance the introduction and cooperative development of nuclear safety technologies. Actively participate in the research and formulation of unified international nuclear safety standards, and refer to the implementation of the International Atomic Energy Agency's Nuclear Safety Action Plan. Actively engage in bilateral, multilateral, and regional nuclear safety exchanges and cooperation. Actively fulfill relevant international conventions such as the Convention on Nuclear Safety and the Joint Convention on the Safety of Spent Fuel Management and on the Safety of Radioactive Waste Management.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen international cooperation, learn from advanced experiences.

name: Nuclear safety and prevention and control of radioactive pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)

Increase public participation in the processes of nuclear facility site selection, construction, operation, and decommissioning. Establish a long-term mechanism for nuclear safety education and publicity to meet the public's demand for relevant information on nuclear safety, enhance the public's understanding and confidence in the safe use of nuclear energy and technology. Improve the public relations response system for nuclear safety emergencies, promptly and authoritatively release relevant information, clarify doubts, eliminate the misleading of false information, and maintain social stability.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepen public participation, and enhance social confidence.

name: Nuclear Safety and Prevention and Control of Radioactive Pollution 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' and 2020 Vision Goals (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense / August 4, 2015)
content: Give full play to the role of government guidance, establish an effective funding guarantee mechanism, increase financial investment in nuclear safety and radioactive pollution prevention and control, and promote the implementation of planned projects. Implement relevant tax preferential policies, establish a diversified investment mechanism, and actively expand financing channels. Improve the fund management and control model for nuclear safety management, and clearly define the sources of funds, contribution methods, approval processes, and fund utilization for costs that need to be shared by the government and enterprises, such as nuclear emergency response, nuclear insurance and compensation, prevention and control of radioactive pollution in civil nuclear facilities, and construction of public welfare nuclear safety infrastructure. Strictly examine the flow of funds to ensure the adequate collection and use of funds.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial investment, and implement funding security.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Action Plan for Peak Carbon Emissions by 2030 (excerpt) (State Council [2021] No. 23) (State Council/October 24, 2021)
content: Promote the large-scale development and high-quality development of wind power and solar power, adhere to the combination of centralized and distributed generation, and accelerate the construction of wind power and photovoltaic power bases. Accelerate the innovation and upgrading of the intelligent photovoltaic industry and promote its characteristic applications. Innovate the photovoltaic + model and promote the diversified layout of photovoltaic power generation. Emphasize both onshore and offshore development, promote the coordinated and rapid development of wind power, improve the offshore wind power industry chain, and encourage the construction of offshore wind power bases. Actively develop solar thermal power generation, and promote the establishment of comprehensive renewable energy power bases that integrate solar thermal power generation with photovoltaic power generation and wind power through complementary regulation. Develop biomass power generation, biomass clean heating, and biogas according to local conditions. Explore and deepen the development and utilization of geothermal energy, as well as new marine energy sources such as wave energy, tidal energy, and temperature difference energy. Further improve the guarantee mechanism for the consumption of renewable energy electricity. By 2030, the total installed capacity of wind power and solar power will reach more than 1.2 billion kilowatts.
