name: Forwarding Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of New Energy in the New Era by the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration (excerpt) (State Council Letter [2022] No. 39) (State Council General Office/ May 14, 2022)
content: Intensify efforts to plan and construct a new energy supply and consumption system based on large-scale wind and solar power bases, supported by clean, efficient, advanced, and energy-saving coal-fired power plants in their vicinity, and carried by stable, safe, and reliable ultra-high voltage transmission lines. Strengthen coordination and guidance in land pre-examination, site selection, environmental protection, and other aspects to improve approval efficiency. In accordance with the requirements of promoting the optimization of coal and new energy combinations, encourage coal-fired power companies to engage in substantive joint ventures with new energy companies.
titlelist: Innovate the development and utilization model of new energy, accelerate the construction of large-scale wind and solar power bases with a focus on deserts, Gobi, and barren areas.

name: Forwarding Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of New Energy in the New Era by the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration (excerpt) (State Council Letter [2022] No. 39) (State Council General Office/ May 14, 2022)
content: Encourage local governments to increase support for farmers to utilize their own building roofs for household photovoltaic construction, and actively promote the development of decentralized wind power in rural areas. Coordinate the rural energy revolution with the development of rural collective economy, cultivate new market entities such as rural energy cooperatives, encourage village collectives to legally utilize existing collective land through mechanisms such as stock pricing and profit sharing, and participate in new energy project development. Encourage financial institutions to provide innovative products and services for farmers to invest in new energy projects.
titlelist: Innovate the development and utilization model of new energy, promote the integrated development of new energy development and utilization with rural revitalization.

name: Forwarding Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of New Energy in the New Era by the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration (excerpt) (State Council Letter [2022] No. 39) (State Council General Office/ May 14, 2022)
content: In industrial enterprises and industrial parks with the necessary conditions, accelerate the development of distributed photovoltaic, decentralized wind power, and other new energy projects, support the construction of industrial green microgrids and integrated projects of generation, grid, load, and storage, promote the efficient utilization of multiple energy sources, carry out pilot projects for direct supply of new energy electricity, and increase the proportion of new energy electricity in terminal energy consumption. Promote the deep integration of solar energy and buildings. Improve the application technology system of integrated photovoltaic and building, and strengthen the consumer group of photovoltaic power producers. By 2025, the coverage rate of photovoltaic on the roofs of newly constructed public buildings should strive to reach 50%; encourage the installation of photovoltaic or solar thermal utilization facilities on existing public buildings and other structures.
titlelist: Innovate the development and utilization model of new energy, promote the application of new energy in the industrial and construction sectors.

name: Forwarding Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of New Energy in the New Era by the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration (excerpt) (State Council Letter [2022] No. 39) (State Council General Office/ May 14, 2022)
content: Establish an integrated platform for industry, academia, and research, construct national-level new energy laboratories and research and development platforms, increase investment in basic theoretical research, and proactively develop cutting-edge and disruptive technologies. Implement mechanisms such as open competition for leadership and horse racing to promote systematic research by enterprises, research institutes, universities, and other institutions on issues such as the increasing proportion of new energy in the power system and the security, stability, and reliability of the system, and propose solutions. Increase support for intelligent manufacturing and digital upgrading of industries. Develop and implement action plans for the development of intelligent photovoltaic industries, and enhance the level of intelligence and informatization throughout the entire product life cycle. Promote breakthroughs in key technologies such as high-efficiency solar cells and advanced wind power equipment, and accelerate the upgrading of key basic materials, equipment, and components. Promote the development of technologies for the recycling and disposal of decommissioned wind turbines and photovoltaic components, as well as related new industrial chains, to achieve a closed-loop and green development throughout the entire life cycle.
titlelist: Support and guide the healthy and orderly development of the new energy industry, promote technological innovation and industrial upgrading.

name: Forwarding Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of New Energy in the New Era by the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration (excerpt) (State Council Letter [2022] No. 39) (State Council General Office/ May 14, 2022)
content: Strengthen international cooperation on intellectual property rights in the new energy industry, promote the attainment of world advanced levels in measurement, testing, and research capabilities, actively participate in the formulation and revision of international standards and qualification assessment procedures in areas such as wind power, photovoltaics, ocean energy, hydrogen energy, energy storage, smart energy, and electric vehicles, improve the mutual recognition level of measurement and qualification assessment results, and enhance the international recognition and influence of China's standardization and testing certification institutions.
titlelist: Support and guide the healthy and orderly development of the new energy industry, and improve the internationalization level of the new energy industry.

name: Forwarding Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of New Energy in the New Era by the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration (excerpt) (State Council Letter [2022] No. 39) (State Council General Office/ May 14, 2022)
content: Establish a collaborative mechanism among relevant departments such as natural resources, ecological environment, and energy management. Based on the requirements of land spatial planning and land use control, fully utilize unused areas such as deserts, Gobi, and wastelands to layout and construct large-scale wind and solar power bases. Include the spatial information of new energy projects in the One Map of land spatial planning according to regulations, strictly implement the requirements for ecological environment zoning and control, and coordinate the allocation of land, forests, and grass for the construction of large-scale wind and solar power bases. Local governments should strictly collect land use taxes and fees in accordance with the law, and must not exceed the legally prescribed collection fees.
titlelist: Ensure reasonable space demand for the development of new energy, and improve the regulatory rules for land use of new energy projects.

name: Forwarding Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Development of New Energy in the New Era by the National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration (excerpt) (State Council Letter [2022] No. 39) (State Council General Office/ May 14, 2022)
content: Newly established new energy projects must strictly adhere to land use standards and must not exceed the controlled standards. Encouragement should be given to promote the application of land-saving technologies and land-saving models, and the level of land conservation and intensification must reach the advanced level in the domestic industry. The layout of nearshore wind farms should be optimized and adjusted, and the development of deep-sea wind power projects should be encouraged. The setting of landing cable corridors should be standardized to minimize the occupation and impact on the coastline. The integrated development of 'wind, light, and fish' should be encouraged to effectively improve the utilization efficiency of offshore resources for wind power and photovoltaic projects.
titlelist: Ensure reasonable space demand for the development of new energy and improve the efficiency of land and spatial resource utilization.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Establishment of a Sound Green, Low-Carbon, and Circular Development Economic System (excerpt) (State Council [2021] No. 4) (State Council/February 2, 2021)
content: Persist in prioritizing energy conservation, improve the dual control system for total energy consumption and intensity. Increase the proportion of renewable energy utilization, vigorously promote the development of wind power and photovoltaic power generation, and develop hydropower, geothermal energy, ocean energy, hydrogen energy, biomass energy, and solar thermal power generation according to local conditions. Accelerate the research, development, and promotion of large-capacity energy storage technology, and enhance the grid's collection and transmission capacity. Increase the supply of clean energy in rural areas and promote the development of biomass energy in rural areas. Promote the clean and efficient development and utilization of coal, and continue to increase the proportion of large-capacity, high-parameter, low-pollution coal-fired generating units in the installed capacity of coal-fired power plants. Actively develop centralized heating through clean cogeneration in county towns in northern regions and steadily promote the coupling of biomass for heating. Strictly control the capacity of newly added coal-fired power plants. Improve energy transmission and distribution efficiency. Implement urban and rural distribution network construction and intelligent upgrading plans, and promote the upgrading and transformation of rural power grids. Accelerate the construction and interconnection of natural gas infrastructure. Carry out experiments and demonstrations of carbon dioxide capture, utilization, and storage.
titlelist: Accelerate the green upgrading of infrastructure and promote the green and low-carbon transformation of the energy system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Establishment of a Sound Green, Low-Carbon, and Circular Development Economic System (excerpt) (State Council [2021] No. 4) (State Council/February 2, 2021)
content: Comprehensively coordinate and promote wind power development. Following the principles of overall planning, coordinated development, simultaneous advancement on land and at sea, and efficient utilization, wind power development and the construction of large-scale wind power bases will be promoted in an orderly manner, while ensuring the connection between wind power development, power transmission, and market absorption. Actively develop dispersed wind energy resources in the central and eastern regions. Actively and steadily develop offshore wind power. Prioritize the development of cost-competitive wind power projects and implement market-based competition to allocate wind power projects. Promote the development of the wind power manufacturing industry through the scale utilization of wind power, continuously enhance the innovation capability and international competitiveness of the wind power manufacturing industry, and gradually improve the industry service system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Establishment of a Sound Green, Low-Carbon, and Circular Development Economic System (excerpt) (State Council [2021] No. 4) (State Council/February 2, 2021)
content: Implement major scientific and technological projects and engineering, achieve breakthroughs in key technologies in the energy field. Focus on the industrialization goals of national strategic industries, implement major projects in oil and gas technology, focus on breakthroughs in new theories of oil and gas geology and key technologies for efficient exploration and development, and carry out technological research on the economic and efficient development of unconventional resources such as shale oil, shale gas, and natural gas hydrates. Implement major projects in nuclear power technology, focus on key core technology research and development related to third-generation pressurized water reactors and fourth-generation high-temperature gas-cooled reactors, and continue to promote independent innovation in nuclear power. Deploy research on major common key technologies, including new energy vehicles, smart grid technology and equipment, intelligent mining technology and equipment for coal mines, clean and efficient utilization of coal, advanced energy-saving technologies, and renewable energy and hydrogen energy technologies. Focus on the physical and chemical basic research of efficient and clean utilization and transformation of energy, and promote breakthroughs in application technologies driven by basic research, in order to support national strategic tasks.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and carry out collaborative scientific and technological innovation in major energy fields.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Establishment of a Sound Green, Low-Carbon, and Circular Development Economic System (excerpt) (State Council [2021] No. 4) (State Council/February 2, 2021)
content: Relying on major equipment manufacturing and major demonstration projects, promote key energy equipment technology research, experimental demonstration, and application promotion. Improve the measurement, standardization, testing, and certification system for energy equipment, and enhance the research and development, design, manufacturing, and complete set capabilities of major energy equipment. Focus on breakthroughs in key technologies, materials, and components in energy equipment manufacturing, and promote technological innovation across the entire industry chain, with a focus on energy security supply, clean energy development, and clean and efficient utilization of fossil energy. Carry out major energy demonstration project construction for advanced energy technology equipment, and enhance the technological level of equipment in areas such as clean and intelligent coal mining and washing, deepwater and unconventional oil and gas exploration and development, oil and gas storage and transportation, clean and efficient coal-fired power generation, advanced nuclear power, renewable energy power generation, gas turbines, energy storage, advanced power grids, and coal deep processing.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of technological innovation as the primary driving force, relying on major energy projects to enhance the level of energy technology and equipment. In the global trend of green and low-carbon transformation of energy, accelerate the upgrading and replacement of traditional energy technology and equipment, strengthen independent innovation of emerging energy technology and equipment, and significantly improve the level of clean and low-carbon energy technology.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Establishment of a Sound Green, Low-carbon, and Circular Development Economic System (excerpt) (State Council [2021] No. 4) (State Council/February 2, 2021)
content: Currently, the world is at the intersection of a new technological revolution and an industrial revolution. Breakthroughs in new technologies are accelerating industrial transformation and promoting the emergence of new energy models and formats. Efforts are being made to promote the deep integration of energy technology with modern information, materials, and advanced manufacturing technology, relying on the Internet Plus smart energy construction, and exploring new models of energy production and consumption. The innovation and upgrading of intelligent photovoltaics are being accelerated, promoting the integration of photovoltaic power generation with agriculture, fisheries, animal husbandry, construction, and other industries, expanding new applications for complementary use of photovoltaic power generation, and forming new models for the extensive development and utilization of new energy. The technological equipment of the hydrogen energy industry chain, such as green hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and application, is being developed rapidly, promoting the development of the hydrogen fuel cell technology chain and the hydrogen fuel cell vehicle industry chain. Energy storage applications are being supported in various stages and scenarios of the energy industry, with a focus on promoting the complementary development of energy storage and renewable energy. Support is being provided for the construction of new energy microgrids, forming integrated local clean energy supply systems for generation, storage, and utilization. New models of comprehensive energy services are being promoted to achieve multi-energy complementarity and synergistic efficiency at the end-use level. With the guidance and driving force of pilot demonstration projects, various new energy technologies, models, and formats continue to emerge, forming a fusion effect for innovative energy development.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and support the development of new technologies, new models, and new formats.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Modern Energy System (Development and Reform Commission Energy [2022] No. 210) (Excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/January 29, 2022)
content: Accelerate the development of wind power and solar power generation. Promote the large-scale development and high-quality development of wind power and solar power generation comprehensively, prioritize local development and utilization, accelerate the construction of dispersed wind power and distributed photovoltaic in load centers and surrounding areas, and promote the application of low wind speed wind power technology. In areas with good wind and solar resources, superior construction conditions, continuous development conditions, and compliance with regional ecological and environmental protection requirements, promote the centralized development of wind power and photovoltaic power generation in an orderly manner, accelerate the construction of large-scale wind power and photovoltaic base projects focusing on deserts, Gobi, and barren areas, and actively promote the construction of multi-energy complementary clean energy bases in the upper reaches of the Yellow River, Xinjiang, and northern Hebei. Actively promote the development and utilization of photovoltaics on the roofs of industrial parks, economic development zones, etc., and promote the integration of photovoltaic power generation and building applications. Carry out demonstrations of hydrogen production through wind power and photovoltaic power generation. Encourage the construction of offshore wind power bases and promote the layout of offshore wind power in deep-water and far-offshore areas. Actively develop solar thermal power generation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Renewable Energy Development (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 10, 2016)
content: According to the principles of comprehensive planning, coordinated development, simultaneous advancement on land and sea, and efficient utilization, strict coordination between development and market absorption is emphasized. Efforts are made to promote on-site development and efficient utilization of wind power, actively support the development of dispersed wind energy resources in the central and eastern regions, and orderly advance the construction of large-scale wind power bases under the premise of guaranteed market absorption and transmission conditions. Active and prudent development and construction of offshore wind power are carried out, and the industrial service system is improved. By the end of 2020, the installed capacity of wind power connected to the grid nationwide will be ensured to reach over 210 million kilowatts.
titlelist: The main task is to comprehensively coordinate and promote the development of wind power.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Renewable Energy Development (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 10, 2016)
content: Strengthen the exploration of wind energy resources in the central, eastern, and southern regions. Improve the technology of low wind speed wind turbines and the level of micro-siting, and carry out environmental protection, soil and water conservation, and vegetation restoration work. Promote the comprehensive development and utilization of wind energy resources in the central, eastern, and southern regions. Combine with the layout of the power grid and the transformation and upgrading of rural power grids, improve the technical standards and grid connection service system of distributed wind power, consider construction conditions such as resources, land, transportation, and installation, and promote the construction of distributed wind power based on the principle of suitable to local conditions and nearby access. By 2020, the installed capacity of onshore wind power in the central, eastern, and southern regions will reach 70 million kilowatts, and the installed capacity of wind power in Jiangsu Province, Henan Province, Hubei Province, Hunan Province, Sichuan Province, Guizhou Province, and other regions will all exceed 5 million kilowatts.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Renewable Energy Development (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 10, 2016)
content: Based on fully tapping into the local wind power consumption capacity and leveraging the ultra-high voltage inter-provincial transmission channels that have been under construction and clearly planned in the Three North regions, and in accordance with the principle of multiple energy complementarity and coordinated operation, various types of power sources such as wind, solar, water, and biomass are coordinated to maximize the transmission of renewable energy and expand the allocation range of wind energy resources, promoting wind power consumption. On the basis of solving the existing wind curtailment problem and in combination with the trend of power supply and demand changes, the scale of wind power development in the Three North regions will be gradually expanded to promote the large-scale development and efficient utilization of wind power in the Three North regions. By 2020, the installed capacity of wind power in the Three North regions will be ensured to be over 135 million kilowatts, with an additional local consumption capacity of approximately 35 million kilowatts. In addition, the capacity of wind power consumption through inter-provincial and inter-regional transmission channels will be utilized, reaching 40 million kilowatts (including existing projects).
titlelist: The main task is to comprehensively coordinate and promote the development of wind power, and orderly construct the Three-North large-scale wind power base.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Renewable Energy Development (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 10, 2016)
content: Carry out offshore wind energy resource survey and evaluation, improve the development plans for offshore wind power in coastal provinces (regions, cities). Accelerate the progress of ongoing offshore wind power projects, actively promote the construction of subsequent offshore wind power projects, encourage coastal provinces (regions, cities) and major development companies to build offshore wind power demonstration projects, and promote the industrialization of offshore wind power. Improve the management policies for offshore wind power development and construction, strengthen coordination among departments, standardize and streamline project approval procedures, and improve offshore wind power pricing policies. Improve the supporting industry service system for offshore wind power, strengthen offshore wind power technical standards, regulations, equipment testing and certification, and information monitoring work, and develop manufacturing and construction capabilities that cover the entire industry chain. By 2020, start the construction of 10 million kilowatts of offshore wind power, and ensure the completion of 5 million kilowatts.
titlelist: The main task is to comprehensively coordinate and promote the development of wind power, actively and steadily promote the development of offshore wind power.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Renewable Energy Development (excerpt) (National Development and Reform Commission/December 10, 2016)
content: Strengthen the planning and construction of the power grid, reinforce and expand important transmission sections, wind power collection stations, and hub substations in a targeted manner, improve the main grid structure, and reduce the problem of wind curtailment and power limitation caused by insufficient transmission capacity or substation capacity in local power grids. Fully tap into the potential of peak load regulation in the power system, enhance the operational flexibility of conventional coal-fired units and heating units, encourage the enhancement of peak load regulation capability of coal-fired units through technological transformation, and resolve the operational conflicts between wind power and thermal power during the winter heating period. In conjunction with power system reform, cancel or reduce coal-fired power generation plans, promote the participation of gas-fired units and self-owned coal-fired power plants in peak load regulation. Optimize wind power dispatch and operation management, establish auxiliary service markets, strengthen demand-side management and user response system construction, improve wind power generation forecasting accuracy, and increase assessment efforts. Leave sufficient space for wind power generation in the generation plan, reasonably arrange the scale of conventional power sources and generation plans, incorporate wind power into power balance and startup combinations, and encourage renewable energy units such as wind power to gradually improve the system's ability to accommodate wind power through participation in market auxiliary services and real-time electricity price competition.
titlelist: The main task is to comprehensively coordinate and promote the development of wind power, effectively improve the wind power consumption capacity.

Fully complete the investigation of hydropower resources in Tibet and organize the release of the re-examination results of hydropower resources in Sichuan. Increase the evaluation of low wind speed wind energy resources in the central and eastern regions and complex terrain areas in the south, as well as offshore wind energy resources. Timely release the results of various renewable energy resource surveys, and guide and optimize project investment layout.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Wind power has become an important part of China's newly installed power capacity. During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, China's newly installed wind power capacity led the world for five consecutive years, with a cumulative increase of 98 million kilowatts, accounting for 18% of the total newly installed capacity in the same period, and its proportion in the power structure has been increasing year by year. Wind power development and construction in the central, eastern, and southern regions have achieved positive results. By the end of 2015, the grid-connected wind power capacity in the country reached 129 million kilowatts, with an annual power generation of 186.3 billion kilowatt-hours, accounting for 3.3% of the total national power generation, an increase of 2.1 percentage points compared to 2010. Wind power has become the third largest power source in China after coal and hydropower. The industrial technology level has significantly improved. The entire wind power industry chain has basically achieved localization, and the concentration of the industry has continued to increase, with multiple companies ranking among the top 10 globally. The technology level and reliability of wind power equipment have continuously improved, basically reaching the world's advanced level, while meeting the domestic market, it has also been exported to 28 countries and regions. The adaptability to special environments such as high altitude, low temperature, and freezing of wind turbines has significantly improved, and the technical and economic viability of low wind speed wind power generation has been significantly enhanced, greatly increasing the potential for wind power development in China. The industry management and policy system has gradually improved. During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, China has basically established a relatively complete industry management and policy system to promote the development of the wind power industry. It has issued management regulations and technical requirements for key links such as wind power project development, construction, grid connection, operation management, and information supervision, simplified the management process of wind power development and construction, improved the wind power technical standard system, carried out certification for wind power equipment and key components, established a wind power industry information monitoring and evaluation system, and basically formed a standardized, fair, and improved policy environment for the wind power industry, ensuring the sustainable and healthy development of the wind power industry.
titlelist: Development foundation and situation, domestic situation, development foundation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Overall target: By the end of 2020, the cumulative grid-connected wind power installed capacity should reach at least 210 million kilowatts, with offshore wind power reaching at least 5 million kilowatts. The annual wind power generation should reach 420 billion kilowatt-hours, accounting for approximately 6% of the total national power generation. Integration and utilization target: By 2020, effective solutions should be implemented to address wind curtailment issues, and the Three North regions should fully meet the requirements for minimum guaranteed hours of wind power purchase and utilization. Industrial development target: The manufacturing level and research and development capabilities of wind power equipment should continue to improve, with 3-5 equipment manufacturing companies reaching international advanced levels and significantly increasing market share.
titlelist: Development goals and construction layout, development goals.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: According to the principle of accessing nearby and local consumption, we will leverage the widespread distribution and flexible application of wind energy resources, and accelerate the large-scale development of onshore wind energy resources in the central, eastern, and southern regions while ensuring environmental protection, soil and water conservation, and vegetation restoration. Taking into account factors such as resource availability, land, transportation, and construction conditions, we will promote the development and construction of decentralized wind power projects that connect to low-voltage distribution networks, and promote the integration of wind power with other distributed energy sources. By 2020, the newly installed capacity of onshore wind power in the central, eastern, and southern regions will exceed 42 million kilowatts, and the cumulative installed capacity will reach over 70 million kilowatts. In order to achieve the target of non-fossil energy proportion, relevant provinces (regions, cities) should develop local wind power development plans that are not lower than the determined development goals (see column 1). On the basis of ensuring consumption, provinces (regions, cities) are encouraged to further expand the scale of wind power development and actively accept wind power from other regions with lower wind power penetration and good operational conditions.
titlelist: Development goals and construction layout, accelerate the development of onshore wind energy resources in the central and southern regions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Provinces (regions, cities) with a relatively low proportion of wind power and good operational conditions should orderly increase the scale of wind power development and on-site consumption. By 2020, in the Three North regions, on the basis of basically solving the problem of wind curtailment, the newly added grid-connected wind power installed capacity will be about 35 million kilowatts, and the cumulative grid-connected capacity will reach about 135 million kilowatts by promoting on-site consumption and utilizing existing transmission channels for external delivery. Before the wind power utilization hours in relevant provinces (regions, cities) reach the minimum guaranteed purchase hours, the scale of grid connection should not exceed the development goals determined by the plan (see column 2).
titlelist: Development goals and construction layout, orderly promote the on-site consumption and utilization of wind power in the 'Three-North' regions where the problem of wind curtailment is severe in the provinces (regions), and focus on solving the consumption problem of existing wind power projects during the '13th Five-Year Plan' period.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Key efforts will be made to promote the construction of offshore wind power in provinces such as Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong. By 2020, the construction scale of offshore wind power in these four provinces will all reach over one million kilowatts. Active promotion will be given to the construction of offshore wind power in provinces (cities) such as Tianjin, Hebei, Shanghai, and Hainan. Exploratory progress will be made in offshore wind power projects in provinces (regions) such as Liaoning, Shandong, and Guangxi. By 2020, the national construction scale of offshore wind power will reach 10 million kilowatts, striving to achieve a cumulative grid-connected capacity of over 5 million kilowatts.
titlelist: Development goals and construction layout, actively and steadily promote the construction of offshore wind power.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Continuously improve independent innovation capabilities, strengthen the construction of the industrial service system, promote industrial technological progress, enhance the quality of wind power development, and comprehensively build a wind power technology research and development and equipment manufacturing system with world advanced level. Promote independent innovation in industrial technology. Strengthen the application of intelligent manufacturing technologies such as big data and 3D printing, comprehensively improve the performance and intelligence level of wind turbines. Breakthrough in the design and manufacturing technology of 10 MW capacity wind turbines and key components. Master the load reduction optimization, intelligent diagnosis, and fault self-recovery technology of wind turbines, master the intelligent operation and maintenance technology of wind farms based on the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and big data analysis, and master the collaborative control technology of wind farms with multiple units and wind farm clusters. Breakthrough in the key technologies for the design and construction of offshore wind farms, master the integrated design technology for offshore wind turbines, and carry out application demonstrations. Encourage enterprises to use new technologies to reduce operating and management costs, improve the operational efficiency of existing assets, and enhance market competitiveness. Strengthen the construction of public technology platforms. Build a national public service platform for wind resources, providing high-resolution wind resource data. Build offshore test wind farms to provide test sites and field test conditions for the development and optimization of new types of turbines. Build a ground test platform for the transmission chain of 10 MW wind turbines to provide testing and certification guarantees for the development and performance optimization of new types of turbines, and effectively improve the service level of public technology platforms. Promote the construction of the industrial service system. Optimize the consulting service industry and encourage the improvement of consulting service quality through market competition. Actively develop specialized services such as operation and maintenance, technical transformation, and electricity trading, and do well in market management and rule construction. Innovate operation models and management methods, and fully share industry service resources. Establish a national wind power technology training and talent development base to provide skills training and qualification assessment for wind power practitioners, and jointly carry out talent development with enterprises, universities, and research institutions to improve the industrial service system.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote independent technological innovation and the construction of industrial systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Implement the overall requirements of streamlining administration and delegating power, continue to improve the management system of the wind power industry, and establish a policy system and management mechanism to ensure the sustainable and healthy development of the wind power industry. Strengthen government management and coordination. Accelerate the establishment of a coordinated operation mechanism among government departments such as energy, land, forestry, environmental protection, and ocean, clarify the responsibilities of government departments and approval procedures, and provide a good market environment for the healthy and orderly development of wind power projects. Improve the management methods for distributed wind power projects and introduce management methods for the replacement of retired wind turbines. Improve policies for offshore wind power industry. Conduct surveys and evaluations of offshore wind energy resources, and improve the development plans for offshore wind power in coastal provinces (regions, cities). Accelerate the progress of offshore wind power projects and encourage coastal provinces (regions, cities) and major development enterprises to build offshore wind power demonstration projects. Standardize and streamline project approval procedures, and improve offshore wind power pricing policies. Strengthen the formulation of standards and regulations, equipment testing and certification, and information monitoring, and form a mature equipment manufacturing and construction technical standard system that covers the entire industry chain. Fully realize the informatization management of the industry. In accordance with the requirements of streamlining administration and delegating power at the national level, improve the mid-term and post-event supervision of wind power construction and operation, and strengthen the supervision of wind power projects, equipment quality, and operation. Apply big data, Internet + and other information technologies to establish a sound wind power lifecycle information monitoring system, and fully realize the informatization management of the wind power industry.
titlelist: Key task: Improve the management system of the wind power industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Give full play to the decisive role of the market in resource allocation, accelerate the transformation of government functions, establish a fair and orderly market competition environment, and promote the healthy development of industries. Strengthen government supervision. Regulate the behavior of local governments, rectify improper administrative interventions such as 'exchanging resources for industries.' Standardize the investment and development order of wind power projects, eliminate enterprises' illegal buying and selling of approval documents, unauthorized changes to investment entities, etc., establish a system for recording enterprises' misconduct and negative lists, and form a market elimination mechanism. Build a fair, just, and transparent bidding and procurement market environment, eliminate unfair related transactions, and promptly correct behaviors that violate the principle of fairness and disrupt market order. Strengthen quality supervision. Establish a quality supervision and management mechanism that covers the entire process of design, production, and operation. Give full play to the role of industry associations, improve the comprehensive evaluation system for the operation quality of wind turbines, and regularly evaluate the overall performance of wind turbines. Implement reporting, analysis, evaluation, and common fault warning systems for major accidents in wind farms, and regularly publish negative lists of wind turbine operation quality. Give full play to the market's regulatory role, effectively integrate resources, encourage mergers and reorganizations of wind power equipment manufacturing enterprises, and increase market concentration. Improve the standard testing and certification system. Further improve the wind power standard system, formulate and revise testing and evaluation standards for wind turbines, wind farms, and auxiliary operation and maintenance equipment, and improve standards for key components of wind turbines, construction equipment, engineering technology, wind farm operation, maintenance, and safety. Strengthen the construction of testing and certification capabilities, carry out certification for wind turbine projects, and promote the connection between testing and certification results and the credit building system.
titlelist: Key task: Establish a market competition mechanism of survival of the fittest.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Closely integrate with the Belt and Road initiative and international multilateral and bilateral cooperation mechanisms, seize the window of opportunity for the global wind power industry development and deep cooperation in the international market, and promote the internationalization of China's wind power industry in an orderly manner. Steadily explore the international wind power market. Give full play to the competitive advantages of China's wind power equipment and development enterprises, deeply connect with international demand, steadily explore emerging markets such as North Africa, Central Asia, Eastern Europe, and South America, consolidate and deepen traditional markets such as North America, Australia, and Europe, encourage various forms of trade, investment, park construction, and technology cooperation, and promote the overall internationalization of enterprises in the wind power industry field, including consulting, design, general contracting, equipment, and operation. Enhance financing, credit insurance, and other service guarantees, and form a number of wind power equipment backbone enterprises with international competitiveness and market development capabilities. Strengthen international brand building. Adhere to market orientation and commercial operation principles, strengthen quality credit, establish and improve wind power product export norms, including quality monitoring and safety production systems, overseas investment project investment norm management systems, etc. Strictly control the quality of exported wind power equipment, promote the construction of international brands by development enterprises and equipment manufacturing enterprises, and shape a good market image of excellent quality and satisfactory service of China's wind power equipment. Actively participate in the construction of international standard systems. Encourage domestic wind power design, construction, operation, and testing certification institutions to actively participate in the formulation and revision of international standards. Encourage technical exchanges and cooperation with overseas enterprises and relevant institutions, enhance the exchange and mutual recognition of technical standards, and promote the international recognition of China's wind power certification. Actively use international multilateral recognition mechanisms, deeply participate in the formulation, implementation, and evaluation of renewable energy certification mutual recognition system qualification assessment standards and rules, and enhance China's discourse power in the field of international certification, accreditation, and testing. Actively promote international technological cooperation. On the basis of established government bilateral cooperation relations, further deepen technological cooperation, establish new types of government-to-government and civil-to-civil bilateral and multilateral partnership relations. Encourage international cooperation in national wind power public laboratories, establish mutual trust and sharing in the construction of large-scale public wind power databases, etc. Encourage domestic enterprises to establish overseas R&D branches, conduct basic scientific research in collaboration with foreign institutions, and support the establishment of international cooperation projects for wind power technology among enterprises. Do a good job in intellectual property rights in international wind power technology cooperation.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen international cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Actively promote the integration of the wind power industry and the financial system, enhance the industry's risk prevention and control level, and encourage companies to reduce development costs. Improve the insurance service system and enhance the risk prevention and control level of the wind power industry. Establish and improve the wind power insurance basic database and industry information sharing platform, formulate standards and specifications for risk rating of wind power equipment and wind farms, regularly release industry risk assessment reports, and promote differentiated insurance premium rates for wind power equipment and wind farms. Establish an insurance product system that covers the entire process of wind power equipment and projects. Innovate insurance service models and encourage wind power equipment manufacturers to jointly purchase insurance. Encourage insurance companies to provide insurance services through co-insurance bodies and establish priority payment funds, and explore the establishment of professional mutual insurance organizations for wind power equipment quality. Promote insurance companies to actively adopt evaluation results from third-party professional institutions and promote the use of letters of guarantee instead of quality assurance deposits throughout the industry. Innovate financing models and reduce financing costs. Encourage companies to actively use low-cost funds through diversified financial means to reduce financing costs. Include wind power projects in the encouraged catalog for national infrastructure construction. Encourage financial institutions to issue green bonds, encourage policy banks to support the wind power industry through lower interest rates, and encourage commercial banks to promote project financing models. Encourage wind power companies to use financial tools such as public offerings, green bonds, asset securitization, financing leasing, and supply chain finance, and explore emerging financing models based on the Internet and big data. Actively participate in the carbon trading market and increase the economic benefits of wind power projects. Fully recognize the positive role of the carbon trading market in the clean energy industry such as wind power, attach importance to carbon asset management work, and actively carry out project registration and carbon emission reduction trading in accordance with regulations. Improve the construction of the green certificate trading platform, promote the implementation of green electricity certificate trading, and coordinate with the national carbon trading market.
titlelist: Key task: Leveraging the support role of finance in the wind power industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: In several regions including Inner Mongolia and Xinjiang, innovative practices in planning and construction, dispatching and operation, policy mechanisms, etc., are being carried out to promote the construction of demonstration provinces (regions) for the consumption of new energy, with wind power as the main focus. Clear utilization goals for wind power and other new energy sources are being formulated, and demonstrations for high proportion of wind power consumption are being conducted, with the aim of increasing the proportion of new energy consumption in the demonstration provinces (regions). Efforts are being made to promote the substitution of electricity, strengthen the construction and transformation of urban and rural power grids, and improve the consumption capacity of clean energy such as wind power, in order to promote the establishment of a modern energy system with clean energy as the main source in the demonstration provinces (regions).
titlelist: Innovative development methods, carrying out a demonstration of high proportion of wind power consumption within the province.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: In the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei surrounding region, innovative mechanisms for coordinated wind power consumption are being developed, in conjunction with efforts to prevent and control air pollution and achieve the target of renewable energy consumption in the electricity sector. Research is being conducted to enhance the regional power grid's capacity to accommodate large-scale wind power integration. Flexible mechanisms for cross-provincial and cross-regional wind power trading and settlement, as well as shared auxiliary services, are being studied. Coordinated peak-shaving resources at the receiving end are being utilized for wind power integration, promoting the orderly development and integration of wind power in areas such as Zhangjiakou, Chengde, Ulanqab, Chifeng, Xilingol, and Baotou, and improving the level and proportion of wind power consumption in the region.
titlelist: Innovative development methods promote the coordinated consumption of regional wind power.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: In regions such as Sichuan, Yunnan, and Guizhou, the seasonal and time-based complementary characteristics of wind power and hydropower are utilized to promote the comprehensive and complementary utilization of renewable energy such as wind power and hydropower. The aim is to explore the ways of complementary consumption of wind and water, and achieve coordinated operation between wind and water. By utilizing the transmission channels of hydropower, efforts are focused on promoting the planning and construction of wind (solar) and water joint operation bases in areas and basins such as Liangshan Prefecture, Yalong River, Jinsha River, Lancang River, Wujiang River, and Beipan River, in order to optimize wind power and hydropower bundling and transmission. In conjunction with the market-oriented reform of the electricity market, the pricing mechanisms for peak and off-peak electricity prices, as well as time-of-use electricity prices, will be improved to encourage wind power and hydropower to participate in the market-based bidding for electricity transmission.
titlelist: Innovative development methods, promoting the complementary utilization of renewable energy such as wind power and hydropower.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: In the northern region, there is a strong promotion of wind power for clean heating, with coordinated planning and construction of electric heat storage heating facilities and thermal power pipe networks, prioritizing the resolution of existing wind power consumption needs. Adaptation is promoted for a green integrated heating system that combines wind power with geothermal and low-temperature heat sources according to local conditions. New on-site consumption demonstrations are carried out, such as wind power hydrogen production and wind power desalination of seawater. Combined with reforms in transmission and distribution pricing and electricity sales, active exploration is conducted into suitable market resource organization forms, profit models, and operational management models for distributed wind power. The distributed development and application of wind power is promoted, exploring the utilization of wind power resources in the form of microgrids and advancing the construction of new energy microgrids that complement wind and solar power storage.
titlelist: Innovative development methods, expanding the on-site utilization methods of wind power.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: In accordance with the requirements of streamlining administration and delegating power, encourage the market-oriented allocation of wind energy resources. Lift the annual construction scale indicators for onshore wind power in areas with good wind power development and no power restriction issues, and lift the annual construction scale indicators for offshore wind power in areas that have completed offshore wind power planning. Adjust the wind power development plan in a rolling manner based on the implementation of the plan, operation, and consumption conditions.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the management mechanism for annual development plans.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: Combining the market-oriented reform of the electricity sector, gradually changing the current wind power pricing model based on regional benchmark electricity prices. Encouraging wind power to participate in market competition, establishing a price mechanism based on market bidding and fixed subsidies, promoting technological progress and cost reduction in wind power. Initiating the implementation of renewable energy generation quotas assessment and green power certificate trading system in a timely manner, gradually establishing a market-oriented subsidy mechanism.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, innovative pricing, and subsidy mechanisms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Thirteenth Five-Year Plan for Wind Power Development (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 314) (National Energy Administration/November 16, 2016)
content: 1. In 2020, the annual electricity generation of wind power in the country will reach 420 billion kilowatt-hours, accounting for approximately 6% of the total national electricity generation. This will provide important support for achieving the goal of non-fossil energy accounting for 15% of primary energy consumption.
titlelist: Planning implementation effect, environmental and social benefits.

name: Notice on Matters Related to the Development and Construction of Wind Power and Photovoltaic Power Generation in 2021 (excerpt) (National Energy Administration New Energy [2021] No. 25) (National Energy Administration/ May 11, 2021)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Establish multiple guarantee mechanisms for grid connection, including guarantee grid connection and market-oriented grid connection. Each province (region, city) shall complete the necessary new grid connection projects to meet the annual minimum consumption responsibility weight for non-hydropower. Guarantee grid connection shall be implemented by power grid enterprises, and the scale of guarantee grid connection in 2021 shall not be less than 90 million kilowatts. The scale of guarantee grid connection can be exchanged between provinces, and if the responsibility weight for non-hydropower consumption is implemented through inter-provincial power trading, the guarantee grid connection scale of the receiving province shall be correspondingly reduced and increased to the sending province after consultation and long-term agreement signed by the sending and receiving provinces and power grid enterprises. The guarantee grid connection projects shall be uniformly organized and allocated by the provincial energy authorities through competitive allocation. For projects that still have the intention to connect to the grid outside the scope of guarantee grid connection, they can be connected to the grid by power grid enterprises after fulfilling the grid connection conditions through self-construction, joint construction and sharing, or purchasing services through market-oriented means. The grid connection conditions mainly include supporting flexible adjustment capabilities such as pumped storage, thermal storage solar power generation, peak load regulation of thermal power, new energy storage, and adjustable load.

name: Notice on Matters Related to the Development and Construction of Wind Power and Photovoltaic Power Generation in 2021 (excerpt) (National Energy Administration New Energy [2021] No. 25) (National Energy Administration/ May 11, 2021)
content: By the end of 2020, wind power projects that have been approved and are within the validity period of approval, as well as grid-connected projects for cost-competitive wind and photovoltaic power in 2019 and 2020, and competitive photovoltaic projects, will be directly included in the scope of guaranteed grid-connected projects in each province (region, city). All existing projects should be completed and put into operation within the specified time limit. For projects that exceed the approval (filing) validity period and have not been constructed for a long time, the provincial-level energy authorities should promptly organize clearance. For projects that do not meet the construction conditions, they should be abolished in a timely manner. The guaranteed grid-connected scale in each province in 2021 will mainly be used to arrange existing projects. For provinces (regions, cities) where existing projects cannot meet the minimum consumption responsibility weight for non-hydropower this year and there is still room for guaranteed grid connection, the provincial-level energy authorities should promptly organize competitive allocation according to the remaining guaranteed grid-connected scale, determine the newly added projects to be grid-connected in 2021, accelerate approval (filing), actively promote construction, and ensure early completion and operation.

name: Notice on Matters Related to the Construction of Wind Power and Photovoltaic Power Generation Projects in 2020 (excerpt) (National Energy Administration New Energy [2020] No. 17) (National Energy Administration/March 5, 2020)
content: Encourage provinces (regions, cities) to innovate development methods and actively promote the participation of distributed wind power in the market-oriented trading pilot of distributed power generation. Provincial energy authorities and dispatched agencies should coordinate with power grid enterprises to simplify the application process for connecting distributed wind power projects to the grid, develop grid connection plans and provide consultation services, and promptly disclose information on the capacity of distribution networks that can be accessed. At the same time, actively implement the project approval commitment system, establish a multi-department linkage mechanism, and build a one-stop service system, innovating management models such as project package approval. Relevant standardized management organizations should accelerate the research and formulation of technical specifications for distributed wind power equipment, grid operation, and other aspects, and promptly release relevant technical standards.
