name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: The national policies and management regulations regarding distributed power generation are applicable to decentralized wind power projects. For decentralized wind power projects connected at the voltage level of 110 kV (66 kV in the northeast region), the system design and management for connection shall follow the practices of centralized wind farms.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Encourage the integrated development of decentralized wind power projects with various forms of energy such as solar energy, natural gas, biomass energy, geothermal energy, and ocean energy, in order to improve the utilization level of regional renewable energy. Deeply integrate with projects that improve people's livelihoods, such as ecological tourism, beautiful countryside, and characteristic towns, to promote county-level economic development. Effectively integrate with smart cities, smart parks, smart communities, etc., to provide energy support for the construction of future urban (community) forms. Fully integrate with island resource development and utilization to promote the development of the marine economy and expand development space.
titlelist: Planning guidance, comprehensively expanding application areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: After the support documents for the door, according to the relevant regulations of the local government, submit the project application to the corresponding project approval authority. Please report. Relevant departments in various regions should simplify the workflow and reduce the upfront costs of decentralized wind power projects based on their characteristics.
titlelist: Project construction and management, decentralized wind power project development enterprises are responsible for functions such as obtaining land, planning, and environmental protection for the project.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: If construction does not commence within two years after project approval, it will be handled in accordance with the Measures for the Administration of Approval and Filing of Enterprise Investment Projects (Order No. 2 of the National Development and Reform Commission). The pouring of the foundation for the first wind turbine unit marks the start of the project.
titlelist: Project construction and management, development enterprises should carry out construction in accordance with the requirements of the approved documents.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Distributed wind power projects are not allowed to occupy permanent basic farmland. For occupying other types of land, construction land approval procedures should be carried out in accordance with the law. With the consent of the original land owner and user, construction land use rights can be obtained through agreements or other means.
titlelist: Project construction and management, under the premise of meeting national environmental protection, safety production, and other related requirements, the development company can use its own construction land (such as park land) or rent land from other units to develop distributed wind power projects.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: The self-consumed portion of electricity does not qualify for subsidies from the National Renewable Energy Development Fund. The electricity generated and fed into the grid will be purchased by the grid company at the local benchmark wind power grid price. The grid company will bear the benchmark grid price for coal-fired units, while the difference between the local benchmark wind power grid price and the benchmark grid price for coal-fired units will be subsidized by the National Renewable Energy Development Fund. Distributed wind power projects that are not constructed in strict accordance with technical requirements will not be eligible for subsidies from the government.
titlelist: During the application and approval process for decentralized wind power projects, project construction and management can choose one of the following modes: 'self-use and surplus electricity grid connection' or 'full grid connection'.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: The decentralized wind power projects connected to the public grid, the access system engineering, and the public grid transformation caused by the connection are invested and constructed by the grid enterprise. The access system engineering within the user scope of the decentralized wind power projects connected to the user side is invested and constructed by the project owner, and the public grid transformation caused by the connection is invested and constructed by the grid enterprise.
titlelist: Grid connection: Grid enterprises should provide convenient conditions for the grid connection of distributed wind power projects with voltage levels of 35 kV and below, which are included in the special planning, and open a green channel for the construction of grid connection system projects.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Establish a one-stop grid connection service window for distributed wind power projects by municipal or county-level power grid enterprises, simplify the grid connection process, provide corresponding grid connection services, and promptly disclose information on the available capacity for distribution grid connection to the public.
titlelist: Grid connection, grid enterprises should improve the access, connection, and operation services of distributed wind power projects with voltage levels of 35 kV and below.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: At the last wind turbine of the grid, the electricity metering point should, in principle, be as close as possible to the property boundary. In complex technical conditions, it can be determined through negotiation between the development company and the local power grid company. The electricity meter provided by the power grid company should clearly distinguish the total generated electricity of the project, the self-consumption electricity, and the electricity fed into the grid.
titlelist: In the process of accepting grid connection applications, formulating access system plans, signing contracts and agreements, and conducting grid connection debugging, the power grid enterprise does not charge any fees. The boundary point between distributed wind power and the power grid is the wind power unit's collector line closest to the electricity grid.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Through market mechanisms, cultivate specialized service capabilities in the areas of project planning, engineering construction, evaluation certification, operation and maintenance, etc., to meet the diverse technical needs of participants in decentralized wind power projects.
titlelist: Operation management, perfecting the industrial technology service system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Encourage the application of intelligent operation and management technologies in decentralized wind power projects to achieve unmanned operation mode; encourage development companies to entrust third-party professional institutions to provide operation and maintenance services.
titlelist: Operation management, exploring new specialized operation and maintenance business models.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Develop standards for assessing the remaining service life of wind turbines. Within 1-2 years before reaching the designed service life of the wind turbines during grid-connected operation, conduct a comprehensive evaluation of the turbine's condition, operating conditions, and remaining service life. Based on the standard requirements, either extend the service life of the turbine or dismantle it.
titlelist: Operation management, improving the retirement management of decentralized wind power project units.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Encourage various types of enterprises, social organizations, rural collective economic organizations, and individuals to participate in the investment of distributed wind power projects, and achieve diversification of investment entities.
titlelist: Innovation in financial and investment development models, innovative investment and financing mechanisms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Under the premise of voluntary participation by farmers, the compensation fees for land expropriation and the fees for renting agricultural land can be used as assets for equity participation projects, forming collective equity. This equity can be quantified and distributed to members of rural collective economic organizations, establishing a fair, just, and transparent system for distributing project benefits. Different levels of rural collective economic organizations at the village, township, and county levels can hold equity, with their members being the beneficiaries of collective equity, promoting shared development. Encouragement is given for social capital to participate in decentralized wind power project investment and construction led by local governments through various means such as mixed ownership, establishment of funds, and formation of consortia, using the PPP cooperation model.
titlelist: Encourage the legal and compliant use of financing leasing to provide integrated financing leasing services for distributed wind power projects, while ensuring that local government implicit debt is not increased. Encourage the integration of various funds, insurance, trusts, and other industrial capital to explore the establishment of investment funds for distributed wind power projects. Encourage guarantee agencies to provide credit guarantees for small and medium-sized enterprises and individuals in the construction of distributed wind power projects, support the integration of distributed wind power into households and communities (villages and industrial parks, etc.), and actively promote business model innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Development and Construction of Distributed Wind Power Projects (National Energy Administration [2018] No. 30) (National Energy Administration, April 3, 2018)
content: Distributed wind power projects sell electricity directly to nearby power users within the distribution network. The market-oriented trading scope, trading methods, trading prices, transmission and distribution prices, rights and obligations of trading entities, etc., shall be implemented in accordance with the relevant regulations on market-oriented trading of distributed generation.
titlelist: Encourage the legal and compliant use of financing leasing to provide integrated financing leasing services for distributed wind power projects, while ensuring that it does not increase the implicit debt of local governments. Encourage the combination of various funds, insurance, trusts, and other industrial capital to explore the establishment of investment funds for distributed wind power projects. Encourage guarantee agencies to provide credit guarantees for small and medium-sized enterprises and individuals in the construction of distributed wind power projects, and support the integration of distributed wind power into households and communities (villages and industrial parks, etc.). Encourage pilot projects for market-oriented transactions of distributed wind power electricity in the project's location, and allow for the separation...

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Energy Work in 2018 (Excerpt) (National Energy Administration Planning [2018] No. 22) (National Energy Administration/February 26, 2018)
content: Strengthen the monitoring and early warning mechanism for investment in wind power and photovoltaic power generation, and control the construction scale in areas with serious wind and solar curtailment. Ensure a double reduction in the amount and rate of wind and solar curtailment. Construct key wind power base projects in an orderly manner and promote the construction of distributed wind power, low wind speed wind power, and offshore wind power projects. Actively promote the construction of wind power grid parity demonstration projects and study the development roadmap for wind power grid parity. Improve market mechanisms, continue to implement and optimize the photovoltaic leader program, and initiate the construction of demonstration and verification platforms for photovoltaic grid parity. Steadily promote the construction of solar thermal power demonstration projects.
titlelist: Accelerate the green development of energy, promote harmonious coexistence between humans and nature, and strengthen the steady development of the clean energy industry, including wind power and solar power generation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Energy Work in 2018 (Excerpt) (National Energy Administration Plan [2018] No. 22) (National Energy Administration/February 26, 2018)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Steady progress is being made in the construction of wind power projects, with plans to start construction of new projects with a scale of approximately 25 million kilowatts within the year. The newly added installed capacity is about 20 million kilowatts. The preliminary work of wind power projects in some areas is being solidly promoted, with a project scale of about 20 million kilowatts. Active and prudent efforts are being made to promote offshore wind power construction, explore and promote the construction of offshore wind power demonstration projects in the deep sea areas of Shanghai, and accelerate the development of distributed wind power.
titlelist: Major energy project, non-fossil energy sustainable development project wind power

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Energy Work in 2017 (excerpt) (National Energy Administration Plan [2017] No. 46) (National Energy Administration/February 10, 2017)
content: Optimize the deployment of wind power construction, with the focus of new capacity mainly in the central and southern regions. Strictly control the addition of grid-connected projects in areas with severe wind curtailment, and issue warnings for the wind power industry in 2017. Suspend the allocation of new wind power capacity in provinces with a wind curtailment rate exceeding 20%. Promote the planned construction of wind power bases in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Jinsha River Valley, and the Yalong River Valley, which have complementary wind and hydropower resources. Accelerate the development and utilization of offshore wind power.

name: Opinions on the Full, Accurate, and Comprehensive Implementation of the New Development Concept and the Work of Achieving Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/September 22, 2021)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: By 2025, a preliminary formation of a green, low-carbon, and circular economic system will be achieved, with a significant improvement in energy efficiency in key industries. Energy consumption per unit of GDP will decrease by 13.5% compared to 2020, and carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP will decrease by 18% compared to 2020. The proportion of non-fossil energy consumption will reach around 20%, and forest coverage will reach 24.1%, with a forest stock volume of 18 billion cubic meters, laying a solid foundation for achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality. By 2030, significant progress will be made in the comprehensive green transformation of economic and social development, and energy efficiency in key energy-consuming industries will reach international advanced levels. Energy consumption per unit of GDP will decrease significantly, carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP will decrease by over 65% compared to 2005, the proportion of non-fossil energy consumption will reach around 25%, and the total installed capacity of wind and solar power generation will exceed 1.2 billion kilowatts. Forest coverage will reach around 25%, with a forest stock volume of 19 billion cubic meters. Carbon emissions will peak and achieve a steady decline. By 2060, a comprehensive establishment of a green, low-carbon, and circular economic system, as well as a clean, low-carbon, safe, and efficient energy system, will be achieved. Energy efficiency will reach international advanced levels, and the proportion of non-fossil energy consumption will exceed 80%. Carbon neutrality goals will be successfully achieved, and fruitful results will be obtained in the construction of an ecological civilization, creating a new realm of harmonious coexistence between humans and nature.The text also mentions actively developing non-fossil energy sources, promoting renewable energy such as wind, solar, biomass, ocean, and geothermal energy, and increasing the proportion of non-fossil energy consumption. It emphasizes both centralized and distributed energy development, prioritizing the local development and utilization of wind and solar energy. It also mentions developing hydropower according to local conditions, promoting nuclear power in a safe and orderly manner, utilizing biomass energy reasonably, and advancing the scale application of pumped storage and new energy storage. The text also highlights the need to promote the full chain development of hydrogen energy for production, storage, transmission, and utilization. It calls for the construction of a new power system dominated by new energy sources, improving the grid's ability to accommodate and regulate a high proportion of renewable energy.Furthermore, the text emphasizes the optimization of energy structure in the construction sector, promoting the application of renewable energy in buildings, electrification, and decarbonization of energy use in buildings. It mentions the promotion of rooftop solar power in buildings and significantly increasing the electrification rate of building heating, domestic hot water, and cooking. In northern urban areas, it calls for the accelerated promotion of combined heat and power for centralized heating, the scaled development of industrial waste heat heating, and the active and prudent promotion of nuclear waste heat heating. It also suggests promoting clean and low-carbon heating methods such as heat pumps, gas, biomass energy, and geothermal energy according to local conditions.The text also emphasizes the strengthening of basic research and the layout of cutting-edge technologies. It calls for the development of action plans and roadmaps for carbon peak and carbon neutrality supported by science and technology. It encourages research and development in low-carbon, zero-carbon, and carbon-negative technologies, energy storage materials, new technologies, and new equipment. It also highlights the need for research on the causes and impacts of climate change, carbon sinks in ecosystems, and the advancement of low-carbon frontier technologies such as high-efficiency solar cells, renewable energy hydrogen production, controlled nuclear fusion, and zero-carbon industrial process transformation. The cultivation of energy-saving, carbon-reducing, and new energy technologies is also emphasized, along with the establishment of national key laboratories, national technology innovation centers, and major scientific and technological innovation platforms. The construction of talent systems for carbon peak and carbon neutrality is mentioned, and higher education institutions are encouraged to offer majors related to carbon peak and carbon neutrality.

Improve the energy equipment measurement, standards, testing, and certification system, and enhance the research and development, design, manufacturing, and complete set capabilities of major energy equipment. Focusing on the three major directions of energy security supply, clean energy development, and clean and efficient utilization of fossil energy, efforts should be made to break through the key technologies, materials, and components in energy equipment manufacturing, and promote technological innovation throughout the industry chain. Carry out major energy demonstration projects for advanced energy technology equipment, and improve the technological level of equipment in areas such as clean and intelligent coal mining and washing, deepwater and unconventional oil and gas exploration and development, oil and gas storage and transportation, clean and efficient coal-fired power generation, advanced nuclear power, renewable energy generation, gas turbines, energy storage, advanced power grids, and deep processing of coal.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and rely on major energy projects to enhance the level of energy technology and equipment.

name: Opinions on the Full, Accurate, and Comprehensive Implementation of the New Development Concept and the Work of Achieving Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality (Excerpt) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/September 22, 2021)
content: Currently, the world is at the intersection of a new technological revolution and an industrial revolution. Breakthroughs in new technologies are accelerating industrial transformation and promoting the emergence of new energy models and formats. Efforts are being made to promote the deep integration of energy technology with modern information, materials, and advanced manufacturing technology, relying on the Internet Plus smart energy construction, and exploring new models of energy production and consumption. The innovation and upgrading of intelligent photovoltaics are being accelerated, promoting the integration of photovoltaic power generation with agriculture, fisheries, animal husbandry, construction, and other industries, expanding new applications for complementary use of photovoltaic power generation, and forming new models for the extensive development and utilization of new energy. The technological equipment of the hydrogen energy industry chain, such as green hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and application, is being developed rapidly, promoting the development of the hydrogen fuel cell technology chain and the hydrogen fuel cell vehicle industry chain. Energy storage applications are being supported in various stages and scenarios of the energy industry, with a focus on promoting the complementary development of energy storage and renewable energy. Support is being provided for the construction of new energy microgrids, forming integrated local clean energy supply systems for generation, storage, and utilization. New models of comprehensive energy services are being promoted to achieve multi-energy complementarity and synergistic efficiency at the end-use level. With the guidance and driving force of pilot demonstration projects, various new energy technologies, models, and formats continue to emerge, forming a fusion effect for innovative energy development.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and support the development of new technologies, new models, and new formats.

name: Several Opinions on Further Deepening the Reform of the Power System (excerpt) (Zhongfa [2015] No. 9) (Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, State Council/ March 15, 2015)
content: Actively carry out various pilot projects for distributed power generation. Open up the construction of distributed power generation on the user side, support enterprises, institutions, communities, and households to invest in and construct various types of distributed power generation such as solar energy, wind energy, biomass energy, and gas-based combined heat and power generation according to their respective conditions, and allow access to distribution networks and end-use power systems of various voltage levels. Encourage specialized energy service companies to cooperate with users or construct distributed power generation through the contract energy management model.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Energy Development Strategic Action Plan (2014-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2014] No. 31) (State Council General Office/June 7, 2014)
content: According to the overall requirements of integrated urban-rural development and new urbanization, we will adhere to the combination of centralized and decentralized energy supply, construct urban-rural energy facilities according to local conditions, promote the transformation of urban-rural energy use, and improve the level and efficiency of urban-rural energy use. We will implement the action plan for new towns, new energy, and new lifestyles. We will scientifically formulate urban planning, optimize urban spatial layout, promote the deep integration of informatization, low-carbonization, and urbanization, and build low-carbon smart towns. We will formulate comprehensive energy plans for towns, vigorously develop distributed energy, scientifically develop combined heat and power generation, encourage the development of combined heat, power, and cooling supply in areas with conditions, and develop wind energy, solar energy, biomass energy, and geothermal energy for heating. We will accelerate the development of solar power generation. We will promote the construction of photovoltaic bases in an orderly manner, and simultaneously ensure the utilization and construction of transmission channels for on-site consumption. We will accelerate the construction of distributed photovoltaic power generation demonstration zones and steadily implement solar thermal power generation demonstration projects. We will strengthen solar power generation grid connection services. We will encourage the construction of distributed photovoltaic power generation on the roofs of large public buildings, public facilities, industrial parks, etc. By 2020, the installed capacity of photovoltaics will reach about 100 million kilowatts, and the electricity price of photovoltaic power generation will be equivalent to that of the grid.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Energy Development Strategic Action Plan (2014-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Document [2014] No. 31) (State Council General Office/June 7, 2014)
content: According to the principles of innovative mechanisms, solid foundation, advanced deployment, and key breakthroughs, we will strengthen independent technological innovation. We encourage the introduction, digestion, absorption, and re-innovation, to create an upgraded version of energy technology innovation and build a strong country in energy technology.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Taking the expansion of the domestic market, improvement of technological level, and acceleration of industrial transformation and upgrading as the fundamental way and basic foundation for promoting the sustained and healthy development of the photovoltaic industry, we will establish a photovoltaic product production, sales, and service system that adapts to the domestic market, and form a regulatory, policy, standard system, and market environment conducive to the sustained and healthy development of the industry. From 2013 to 2015, the annual average increase in photovoltaic installed capacity will be around 10 million kilowatts, and the total installed capacity will reach over 35 million kilowatts by 2015. We will accelerate enterprise mergers and reorganizations, eliminate production enterprises with poor product quality and outdated technology, and cultivate a group of leading enterprises with strong technological research and development capabilities and market competitiveness. We will accelerate technological innovation and industrial upgrading, improve self-sufficiency in raw materials such as polycrystalline silicon and the manufacturing technology level of photovoltaic cells, significantly reduce the cost of photovoltaic power generation, and enhance the competitiveness of the photovoltaic industry. We will maintain a reasonable share of photovoltaic products in the international market and achieve new progress in foreign trade and investment cooperation.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: According to the overall idea of reasonable layout, nearby access, local consumption, and orderly promotion, and based on the local development of the electricity market and the adjustment of energy structure, various types of photovoltaic power station construction should be promoted in an orderly manner, under the premise of implementing market consumption conditions. Encouragement should be given to the construction of photovoltaic power stations using existing power grid facilities in a complementary manner. Coordination should be made between the planning and construction of photovoltaic power stations and supporting power grids to ensure timely grid connection and efficient utilization of photovoltaic power generation.
titlelist: Actively explore the photovoltaic application market and promote the construction of photovoltaic power plants in an orderly manner.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Actively and properly respond to international trade frictions, and promote the establishment of a fair and reasonable international trade order. Strengthen dialogue and consultation, promote global industrial cooperation, and regulate the import and export order of photovoltaic products. Encourage photovoltaic companies to innovate international trade methods, optimize the distribution of manufacturing bases, and engage in investment and production cooperation overseas. Encourage companies to implement the 'bringing in' and 'going out' strategies, gather global innovative resources, and promote the international development of photovoltaic companies.
titlelist: Actively develop the photovoltaic application market, consolidate and expand the international market.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Strictly control the expansion of production capacity for monocrystalline silicon, photovoltaic cells, and module projects. Photovoltaic manufacturing companies should have advanced technology and strong independent research and development capabilities. New photovoltaic manufacturing projects should meet the following requirements: monocrystalline silicon photovoltaic cell conversion efficiency not less than 20%, polycrystalline silicon photovoltaic cell conversion efficiency not less than 18%, thin-film photovoltaic cell conversion efficiency not less than 12%, and the comprehensive electricity consumption of polycrystalline silicon production should not exceed 100 kilowatt-hours per kilogram. Accelerate the elimination of high energy-consuming, imperfect material recycling, and environmentally non-compliant polycrystalline silicon production capacity. Strictly control the construction of polycrystalline silicon projects in areas with net electricity input.
titlelist: Accelerate industrial structure adjustment and technological progress, and restrain the blind expansion of photovoltaic capacity.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: By utilizing the mechanism of 'market pressure', encourage enterprise mergers and reorganizations. Strengthen policy guidance and promotion, establish a sound long-term mechanism for eliminating outdated production capacity, and accelerate the closure and elimination of outdated photovoltaic capacity. Focus on supporting the development of polysilicon and photovoltaic cell manufacturing enterprises with high technological levels and strong market competitiveness, cultivate a group of polysilicon manufacturing enterprises with low comprehensive energy consumption, minimal material consumption, and international competitiveness, as well as photovoltaic cell manufacturing enterprises with strong technological research and development capabilities, independent intellectual property rights, and brand advantages. Guide the concentration of polysilicon production capacity to energy resource-rich areas in the central and western regions, encourage cooperation or reorganization between polysilicon manufacturing enterprises and advanced chemical enterprises, reduce comprehensive electricity consumption, and improve the comprehensive utilization rate of by-products.
titlelist: Accelerate industrial restructuring and technological progress, and expedite the merger and reorganization of enterprises.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: By implementing the New Energy Integration Application Project, we support the research and industrialization of high-efficiency crystalline silicon cells, new thin-film cells, electronic-grade polysilicon, closed-loop silicon tetrachloride recycling devices, high-end cutting machines, fully automatic screen printing machines, flat-panel coating processes, and high-purity key materials. We aim to improve the technology and equipment level of photovoltaic inverters, tracking systems, power forecasting, centralized monitoring, and smart grids, as well as enhance the system integration technology capabilities of photovoltaic power generation. We support companies in developing new processes for silicon material production and new products and technologies in the photovoltaic industry. We also support key enterprises in constructing research and testing platforms for photovoltaic power generation projects. Additionally, we support universities and companies in cultivating professionals in the photovoltaic industry.
titlelist: Accelerate industrial restructuring and technological progress, accelerate the improvement of technology and equipment levels.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Encourage enterprises to strengthen international R&D cooperation and engage in joint research and development of cutting-edge and common technologies in the photovoltaic industry. Encourage eligible domestic photovoltaic companies and bases to establish strategic cooperation relationships with foreign research institutions and industrial clusters. Support relevant research institutes and enterprises in establishing mechanisms for international talent introduction and cultivation, with a focus on cultivating highly innovative high-end professional and comprehensive management talents. Actively participate in the formulation of international standards for the photovoltaic industry, increase the overseas promotion of independent intellectual property rights standards, and promote international mutual recognition of testing and certification.
titlelist: Accelerate industrial restructuring and technological progress, actively carry out international cooperation.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: According to the needs of the photovoltaic industry development, formulate and implement the photovoltaic industry development plan. Each region can formulate and implement relevant plans and implementation plans based on the national photovoltaic industry development plan and the development needs of the local area. Strengthen the connection and coordination between national planning and local planning, manufacturing industry and power generation application, photovoltaic power generation and supporting grid construction. Strengthen photovoltaic power generation planning and annual implementation guidance. Improve the management system for the construction of photovoltaic power stations and distributed photovoltaic power generation projects, and promote the orderly development of photovoltaic power generation.
titlelist: Standardize the development order of industries, strengthen planning and industry policy guidance.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Establish and improve the standard system for photovoltaic materials, cells and modules, systems and components, and improve the standard system for photovoltaic power generation systems and related grid technologies. Develop and improve the standard system for building photovoltaic applications suitable for different climate zones and building types, and consider the application of photovoltaic power generation in urban planning, architectural design, and renovation of old buildings. Strengthen the construction of testing and certification platforms for silicon materials and wafers, photovoltaic cells and modules, inverters and control equipment, and improve the testing and certification system for photovoltaic products, and timely release a catalog of photovoltaic products that meet the standards. Carry out solar resource observation and evaluation and establish a solar energy information database.
titlelist: Standardize the development order of industries and promote the construction of standardization system and testing and certification system.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Electric grid enterprises should strengthen the construction and transformation of the grid to adapt to photovoltaic power generation, ensuring that supporting grids and photovoltaic power generation projects are built and put into operation synchronously. Actively develop microgrids and smart grid technologies that integrate advanced energy storage technology and information technology, and improve the grid system's capacity to accommodate photovoltaic power generation. The grid connection project and the public grid transformation caused by the connection of photovoltaic power generation projects connected to the public grid are invested and constructed by electric grid enterprises. The public grid transformation caused by the connection of distributed photovoltaic power generation on the user side is invested and constructed by electric grid enterprises.
titlelist: Improve grid management and services, strengthen supporting grid construction.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Each power grid enterprise should provide grid connection services for photovoltaic power generation, optimize system scheduling and operation, prioritize the operation of photovoltaic power generation, ensure timely grid connection of photovoltaic power generation projects, and fully purchase the generated electricity. Simplify the grid connection methods and management procedures for distributed photovoltaic power generation, publish the grid connection service process for distributed photovoltaic power generation, and establish a simple and efficient grid connection service system. Exempt distributed photovoltaic power generation projects from system standby capacity fees and related service fees. Strengthen the supervision of grid connection and operation of photovoltaic power generation.
titlelist: Improve grid management and services, improve grid operation services for photovoltaic power generation.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Open up the construction of distributed power sources on the user side, and support and encourage enterprises, institutions, communities, and households to install and use photovoltaic power generation systems. Encourage specialized energy service companies to cooperate with users, invest in the construction and operation of photovoltaic power generation and related facilities for user power supply. Implement record management for distributed photovoltaic power generation projects, exempting them from the requirement of a power generation business license for distributed photovoltaic power generation applications. For distributed photovoltaic power generation projects that do not require national financial subsidies, if they meet the conditions for grid connection operation, they can be freely developed on a larger scale. The entire electricity generated by distributed photovoltaic power generation is included in the statistics of the total electricity generation and consumption of the whole society, and serves as a performance assessment indicator for local governments and power grid enterprises. Self-generated and self-used electricity is not included in the scope of tiered electricity pricing, but is included in the energy-saving statistics of local governments and users.
titlelist: Improve support policies and strongly support the application of photovoltaics on the user side.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Implement a policy of subsidizing distributed photovoltaic power generation based on electricity consumption. Based on resource conditions and construction costs, establish benchmark on-grid electricity prices for photovoltaic power plants in different regions, and discover prices and subsidy standards through bidding and other competitive methods. Adjust the on-grid electricity prices for photovoltaic power plants and the subsidy standards for distributed photovoltaic power generation reasonably based on factors such as changes in the cost of photovoltaic power generation. The implementation period for on-grid electricity prices and subsidies is generally 20 years. Adjust the surcharge standards for renewable energy electricity prices and expand the scale of the renewable energy development fund according to the needs of photovoltaic power generation development. Coordinate the scale of photovoltaic power generation with the scale of the national renewable energy development fund.
titlelist: Improve support policies, improve electricity pricing and subsidy policies.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: Financial institutions should continue to implement a maintaining stability while ensuring progress credit policy, supporting enterprises with independent intellectual property rights, advanced technology, and great development potential to improve and strengthen themselves. Credit support should be provided to photovoltaic manufacturing enterprises that have a market, orders, profitability, and credibility. Based on the characteristics of the photovoltaic industry and the capital turnover cycle of enterprises, flexible credit policies should be adopted in accordance with the principles of controllable risks, commercial sustainability, and credit access standards. This will support high-quality enterprises in normal production and operation, as well as projects with competitive advantages such as technological innovation, mergers and acquisitions, and overseas investment. Innovative financial products and services should be developed to support small and medium-sized enterprises and households in building and using distributed photovoltaic power generation systems. Funding for blindly expanding capacity projects and backward capacity project construction should be strictly prohibited, and credit support should not be provided to photovoltaic manufacturing projects that are prohibited by the state or do not comply with industrial policies.
titlelist: Improve supportive policies, improve financial supportive policies.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: For the construction of photovoltaic power generation projects on unused land such as the Gobi Desert, appropriate preferential treatment should be given in terms of land planning and scheduling. If there is no need for land conversion, it is not necessary to occupy the annual land planning quota. Explore the use of leasing state-owned unused land as a way to reduce the upfront investment cost of the project. For photovoltaic power generation projects that use unused land, after obtaining the necessary land approval procedures in accordance with the law, land allocation can be adopted. Improve the construction management of photovoltaic power generation projects and simplify procedures.
titlelist: Improve support policies, improve land support policies and construction management.

name: Several Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of the Photovoltaic Industry (State Council [2013] No. 24) (State Council/July 4, 2013)
content: The relevant departments should, according to the requirements of this opinion, urgently formulate relevant supporting documents based on their respective responsibilities, improve supporting policies such as photovoltaic power generation prices, taxation, financial credit, and construction land, and ensure the implementation of various tasks and measures. Provincial-level governments should strengthen the management of local photovoltaic industry development, formulate specific implementation plans based on actual conditions, implement policies, and guide the orderly and coordinated development of the local photovoltaic industry. Improve industry organizations, give full play to the role of industry organizations in strengthening industry self-discipline, promoting advanced technology and management experience, conducting statistical monitoring, and formulating standards. Strengthen industry services, establish a photovoltaic industry monitoring system, timely release industry information, build a communication platform between banks and enterprises, and guide the healthy development of the industry.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese means man or male.

content: Actively develop new generation nuclear energy technology and advanced reactors, and promote the development of the nuclear energy industry. Accelerate the promotion and application of solar thermal utilization technology, and explore diversified solar photovoltaic and solar thermal power generation markets. Promote the scale development of wind power technology and equipment, and accelerate the construction of an intelligent grid system to adapt to the development of new energy. Develop and utilize biomass energy according to local conditions.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Gazette No. 9, 2006) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: Energy plays a particularly important strategic role in the national economy. Currently, China faces sharp contradictions in energy supply and demand, with an unreasonable structure and low energy utilization efficiency. The consumption of primary energy is mainly coal, resulting in serious environmental pollution due to the large consumption of fossil fuels. In the next 15 years, meeting the continuously growing energy demand and achieving clean and efficient energy utilization pose significant challenges for energy technology development. The development approach includes: (1) adhering to energy conservation as a priority to reduce energy consumption. Tackle key energy-saving technologies in major energy-consuming sectors, actively develop building energy-saving technologies, and greatly improve the efficiency of primary energy utilization and end-use energy efficiency. (2) Promote energy structure diversification and increase energy supply. While improving the levels of oil and gas development and utilization, as well as hydropower technology, vigorously develop nuclear energy technology and achieve independent development capabilities in nuclear power system technology. Breakthroughs and large-scale applications should be achieved in renewable energy technologies such as wind energy, solar energy, and biomass energy. (3) Promote the clean and efficient utilization of coal and reduce environmental pollution. Vigorously develop clean, efficient, safe coal development and utilization technologies, and strive to reach international advanced levels. (4) Strengthen the digestion, absorption, and re-innovation of energy equipment introduction technologies. Tackle core technologies in the manufacturing of advanced coal-fired power generation and nuclear power equipment. (5) Improve the technological capabilities of optimizing energy regional allocation. Focus on the development of safe and reliable advanced power transmission and distribution technologies to achieve high-capacity, long-distance, and high-efficiency power transmission and distribution. (6) Low-cost large-scale development and utilization of renewable energy. Focus on the research and development of large-scale wind power generation equipment, the construction of coastal and onshore wind farms, and the technology and equipment for the development of wind energy resources in the western region. Also, focus on cost-effective solar photovoltaic cells and utilization technologies, solar thermal power generation technology, solar energy building integration technology, and the development and utilization technologies of biomass energy and geothermal energy. (7) High-efficiency energy materials technology. Focus on the research of materials and key technologies related to solar cells, fuel cells, high-capacity hydrogen storage materials, high-efficiency secondary battery materials and key technologies, and supercapacitor key materials and preparation technologies. Develop efficient energy conversion and energy storage material systems.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Gazette No. 9, 2006) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: Accelerate the development of wind power and solar power generation. Promote the large-scale development and high-quality development of wind power and solar power generation comprehensively, prioritize local development and utilization, accelerate the construction of dispersed wind power and distributed photovoltaic in load centers and surrounding areas, and promote the application of low wind speed wind power technology. In areas with good wind and solar resources, superior construction conditions, continuous development conditions, and compliance with regional ecological and environmental protection requirements, promote the centralized development of wind power and photovoltaic power generation in an orderly manner, accelerate the construction of large-scale wind power and photovoltaic base projects focusing on deserts, Gobi, and barren areas, and actively promote the construction of multi-energy complementary clean energy bases in the upper reaches of the Yellow River, Xinjiang, and northern Hebei. Actively promote the development and utilization of photovoltaics on the roofs of industrial parks, economic development zones, etc., and promote the integration of photovoltaic power generation and building applications. Carry out demonstrations of hydrogen production through wind power and photovoltaic power generation. Encourage the construction of offshore wind power bases and promote the layout of offshore wind power in deep-water and far-offshore areas. Actively develop solar thermal power generation.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Gazette No. 9, 2006) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: Forge the long board of energy innovation advantages. Consolidate the technological and equipment advantages in the non-fossil energy field, continuously improve the technological level and economic viability of wind power, solar power, biomass energy, geothermal energy, ocean energy, and other development and utilization, carry out optimization research on third-generation nuclear power technology, strengthen the technological innovation and application of high-proportion renewable energy systems. Based on the development foundation and advantages of green and low-carbon technologies, accelerate the promotion of new power systems, new generation advanced nuclear energy, and other technological breakthroughs. Improve the technological level of clean and efficient utilization of fossil energy, strengthen research on intelligent and green coal mining, flexible and efficient coal-fired power generation, modern coal chemical industry, and ecological environment protection technology, implement efficient exploration and development of onshore conventional oil and gas, and tackle key refining technologies. Column 5: Technological innovation demonstration projects. Advanced renewable energy generation and comprehensive utilization technology. Deep-sea offshore wind power development, efficient photovoltaic cells, building-integrated photovoltaics (BIPV), advanced biomass fuels, geothermal energy, large-scale variable-speed pumped storage and seawater energy storage, large-scale development and utilization of ocean energy, and other technology research and demonstration applications, new energy ecological environment protection technology.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Gazette No. 9, 2006) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: - Construction of a new type of power system that leads the gradual increase in the proportion of new energy sources. Breakthroughs are made in key technological equipment such as advanced renewable energy generation and comprehensive utilization, a new generation of power grids that can accommodate large-scale and high-proportion integration of renewable energy sources, new types of high-capacity energy storage, hydrogen energy, and fuel cells. These advancements further enhance the optimization of resource allocation capabilities in the power system and improve the guarantee capacity of renewable energy supply.- Promote the digital and intelligent upgrade of the energy industry. Deep integration of advanced information technology and the energy industry, promoting the orderly advancement of digitalization and intelligent upgrade in the fields of electricity, coal, oil, and gas. name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Gazette No. 9, 2006) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: Focus on the large-scale and high-proportion development and utilization of renewable energy, research and develop more efficient, economical, and reliable advanced power generation and comprehensive utilization technologies for hydropower, wind power, solar power, biomass energy, geothermal energy, and ocean energy, supporting the high-quality development and utilization of the renewable energy industry; overcome key technologies in efficient hydrogen production, storage, transportation, refueling, and fuel cells, and promote the integrated development of hydrogen energy and renewable energy.
titlelist: Key task: advanced renewable energy generation and comprehensive utilization technology.

name: Outline of the National Medium- and Long-Term Science and Technology Development Plan (2006-2020) (excerpt) (State Council Gazette No. 9, 2006) (State Council/February 9, 2006)
content: (5) New photovoltaic system and key component technologies. [Focused research] Develop high-power medium-voltage all-DC photovoltaic power generation system technology and high-power DC boost converter to achieve DC converter voltage levels of 30 kilovolts and above; Breakthrough in large-scale photovoltaic high-efficiency DC electrolysis system technology and ten-thousand-ampere-level high-efficiency DC electrolysis converter; Conduct research on nearshore floating photovoltaic system technology and high-reliability component and part technologies. (6) Efficient perovskite cell preparation and industrial production technology. [Demonstration test] Develop mass production process equipment for perovskite cells based on solution and physical methods, develop high-reliability component interconnection and packaging technology, and research and develop large-area, high-efficiency, high-stability, environmentally friendly perovskite cells; Conduct research on the preparation and industrial production technology of efficient stacked cells such as crystalline silicon/perovskite and perovskite/perovskite. (7) Efficient and low-cost photovoltaic cell technology. [Demonstration test] Carry out research on new crystalline silicon cell low-cost, high-quality industrial manufacturing technologies such as tunnel oxide passivation contact (TOPCon), heterojunction (HJT), and back electrode contact (IBC); Breakthrough in low-cost large-scale application technologies such as silicon particle material preparation, continuous pulling of crystals, N-type and gallium-doped P-type silicon rod preparation, and ultra-thin silicon wafer cutting. Conduct research on the combination of efficient photovoltaic cells and building materials, develop photovoltaic cell modules with high fire resistance, high structural strength, modularity, and lightweight, and achieve large-scale application of photovoltaic building integration. (8) Photovoltaic module recycling and reuse technology. [Demonstration test] Develop low-cost, environmentally friendly dismantling and efficient separation technology equipment for crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules based on physical and chemical methods, develop environmentally friendly treatment technologies and experimental platforms for new materials and new structural components, and efficiently recycle and reuse high-value components such as silver and copper in decommissioned photovoltaic modules. (9) Solar thermal power generation and comprehensive utilization technology. [Focused research] Conduct research on thermochemical conversion and thermochemical energy storage materials, explore the complementary technologies of solar thermal chemical conversion and other renewable energy sources; Develop medium-temperature solar-driven thermochemical fuel conversion reaction technology and develop megawatt-scale solar thermal chemical power generation devices. [Application promotion] Develop integrated systems of solar thermal power generation and other new energy sources, explore the peak shaving characteristics of solar thermal power generation, and promote the application of solar thermal power generation in peak shaving, integrated energy, and other scenarios. Research on large-size, low-loss, ultra-thin wafer cutting technology. Promote automated production lines and logistics lines, fully automatic integrated testing equipment, and silicon wafer coding and reading equipment, and establish a silicon wafer traceability system. Crystalline silicon cells: promote the application of automation in processes such as automatic fluffing, automatic loading and unloading, automatic wire guiding, automatic chip insertion, double-sided double testing, online defect analysis, etc., to improve the automation transmission and intelligent perception capabilities between processes. Continuously improve the conversion efficiency of p-type crystalline silicon cells, and carry out research and industrialization of high-efficiency cells such as n-type TOPCon, HJT, and IBC. Research, develop, and promote automated equipment for module production, and strengthen the formulation and implementation of unified standards for module dimensions.
