Promote the integration of photovoltaic products with consumer electronics, outdoor products, transportation vehicles, aerospace, etc., and develop a variety of mobile energy products. Intelligent photovoltaic key devices: With the goal of meeting the development of intelligent photovoltaic power stations, develop key components such as intelligent inverters, controllers, combiner boxes, energy storage systems, tracking systems, and accelerate breakthroughs in key components required by intelligent power station such as efficient power and electronic devices, and enhance performance in power conversion, remote control, data acquisition, online analysis, and environmental adaptability. Intelligent photovoltaic system support tools: Develop intelligent photovoltaic design systems, photovoltaic construction management systems, photovoltaic power generation monitoring and operation systems, mobile operation and maintenance systems, and photovoltaic power generation project management platforms with independent intellectual property rights, in order to meet the needs of the full life cycle management of intelligent photovoltaic power stations. Develop intelligent cleaning robots, intelligent inspection drones, and other intelligent operation and maintenance products. Intelligent household photovoltaic systems: Develop intelligent and digital household photovoltaic products and systems, achieve plug-and-play, safety, reliability, and convenience of use, and promote the development of the household photovoltaic market. Develop millisecond-level data detection technology, local rapid power adjustment technology, and intelligent home energy management systems to increase self-consumption rate, optimize household electricity usage, and promote energy conservation and carbon reduction. Intelligent design: Support the application of drones, Beidou navigation, robots, etc. in the surveying and construction of photovoltaic systems, and complete 2D/3D modeling in the cloud. Encourage the development of intelligent photovoltaic design systems, comprehensively integrate geographic information data, regional irradiation conditions, product performance prices, and building load-bearing factors, and digitally model and compare different components, inverters, electrical schemes, and bracket methods. Intelligent integration: Develop photovoltaic construction management systems and accelerate their application in procurement, construction process management, quality testing, power station testing, acceptance, etc., to achieve real-time monitoring of project progress, cost and quality control, inventory management, personnel allocation, and construction problem warning. Promote the application of intelligent mechanical equipment in the construction of intelligent photovoltaic power stations. Intelligent operation and maintenance: Promote the application of intelligent photovoltaic power generation monitoring systems, operation and maintenance systems, and project management systems, establish intelligent regional centralized operation and maintenance centers and mobile operation and maintenance platforms, realize unmanned/low manpower, centralized and remote management, support the use of intelligent robots, drones, and other technologies to replace manual operation and maintenance management, reduce operation and maintenance costs, and improve service efficiency. Develop intelligent energy storage systems. Breakthrough key technologies for intelligent energy storage, stabilize photovoltaic power generation fluctuations, track power generation plan output and time shift, and enhance support for new power systems. Promote the integration and development of photovoltaic power stations with pumped storage, electrochemical storage, flywheel storage, etc., and build a batch of photovoltaic energy storage projects on the power supply side to ensure efficient utilization of photovoltaic power generation. Expand the coupling of intelligent photovoltaic technologies. Develop intelligent photovoltaic DC systems and conduct research on photovoltaic energy storage DC coupling system technology, expand the application of DC loads such as photovoltaic DC buildings, solar street lights, and DC air conditioners. Support pilot demonstration projects such as intelligent photovoltaic hydrogen production, and accelerate research on the coupling technology of hydrogen production systems and photovoltaics.
titlelist: The main task is to support the development of intelligent photovoltaic products in the new power system.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Innovation and Development Action Plan (2021-2025) (MIIT Joint Electronic [2021] No. 226) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration/December 31, 2021)
content: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry. Encourage the construction of photovoltaic application projects in industrial parks, new industrialization industry demonstration bases, etc., formulate specific evaluation methods for the proportion of renewable energy, construct industrial buildings that meet the installation requirements of photovoltaic power generation systems, and promote the green development of industrial parks and other areas. Encourage the construction of industrial green microgrids, realize the integrated application of photovoltaics in factory buildings, distributed wind power, diversified energy storage, efficient heat pumps, waste heat and pressure utilization, and intelligent energy management systems, and promote the efficient and complementary use of multiple energies. Intelligent Photovoltaic Transportation. Accelerate the promotion and application of integrated development projects such as photovoltaics + transportation, promote the construction of photovoltaic power stations and charging piles in the transportation field. Adhere to the principles of full demonstration, suitability, and pilot first, encourage the application of photovoltaic power generation in areas such as highway service areas (parking lots), gas stations, highway slopes, highway tunnels, public transportation and freight yards, port terminals, navigation aids and navigation facilities, docked ships, and island workstations. Explore the integration and application of photovoltaics and new energy vehicles. Intelligent Photovoltaic Buildings. In urban and rural areas with conditions, coordinate the promotion of intelligent photovoltaic systems on residential roofs, and encourage the promotion of solar roof systems in newly constructed government-invested public buildings. Carry out regional-level photovoltaic distributed application demonstrations with intelligent photovoltaic systems as the core and new technologies such as energy storage and building power demand response as carriers. Improve the level of intelligent photovoltaic application in buildings. Actively carry out the construction demonstration of photovoltaic + storage + direct current distribution + flexible power consumption buildings. Intelligent Photovoltaic Agriculture. Accelerate the green, low-carbon, and circular development of agriculture, promote the installation of solar panels on agricultural facility roofs in areas with conditions, carry out agricultural production under the panels, organically combine photovoltaic power generation with agricultural facilities, and carry out in-depth innovation in areas such as crop and livestock farming, supplementary lighting for crops, regulation of light uniformity and transmittance, intelligent operation and maintenance, and efficient component development. Encourage the exploration of emerging models of photovoltaic agriculture, promote green agricultural development, and increase farmers' income. Intelligent Photovoltaic Rural Areas. Continue to carry out the construction of village-level power stations and rural household power stations, give priority to supporting the construction of village-level photovoltaic assistance power stations in poverty-stricken areas, strengthen the collective economy of villages, and effectively connect the consolidation and expansion of poverty alleviation achievements with rural revitalization. Encourage the application of advanced intelligent photovoltaic products and systems, and give priority to ensuring product quality and system performance. Improve the national photovoltaic poverty alleviation information monitoring system, expand the monitoring scope, and enhance operation and maintenance service capabilities. Based on the village-level power station model and regional distribution characteristics, integrate various photovoltaic + comprehensive applications according to local conditions, and innovate photovoltaic power generation models. Intelligent Photovoltaic Power Stations. Encourage the use of advanced photovoltaic products based on intelligent photovoltaics in the construction of various types and scenarios of photovoltaic power generation bases, encourage the construction of intelligent photovoltaic power stations according to local conditions, such as combining desert, Gobi, desert, barren hills, barren land, coastal tidal flats, abandoned land such as coal mining subsidence areas and mine soil dumping sites, and oil and gas mining areas, and encourage the application of intelligent photovoltaics in distributed photovoltaic development pilots in entire counties (cities, districts) to promote the organic integration of photovoltaic power generation with other industries. Intelligent Photovoltaic Communication. In areas with abundant solar resources, actively explore and develop advanced and cost-effective intelligent photovoltaic products and solutions for different application scenarios of data centers, 5G, and other new types of infrastructure, support the demonstration application of intelligent photovoltaics in the information and communication field, promote the intelligent transformation and green upgrading of network facilities, and promote energy-saving and innovative levels in the information and communication industry. Intelligent Photovoltaic Innovation Applications. Innovate intelligent photovoltaic market application scenarios, support market-oriented institutions to hold innovation and entrepreneurship competitions in compliance with laws and regulations, expand various forms of photovoltaic + comprehensive applications, strengthen the integration and development of intelligent photovoltaics with related industries in emerging fields, achieve product innovation, technological innovation, and business model innovation, and promote the process of carbon peak and carbon neutrality in various fields.
titlelist: The main task is to assist in achieving carbon peaking and carbon neutrality in various fields.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Innovation and Development Action Plan (2021-2025) (MIIT Joint Electronic [2021] No. 226) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration/December 31, 2021)
content: Improve the technical standard system. Revise and implement the Comprehensive Standardization Technical System for Solar Photovoltaic Industry and accelerate the research and top-level design of the intelligent photovoltaic standard system. Conduct research on the combination of photovoltaics with transportation, construction, agriculture, energy, rural areas, and other fields, and promote the research on photovoltaic power generation specifications applicable to new power systems and power systems based on photovoltaics as the main power source. Improve the layout of intellectual property rights. Enhance the awareness of intellectual property protection for intelligent photovoltaic enterprises and improve management systems. Carry out domestic and international intellectual property layout and pilot projects for the application of intellectual property rights. Support research institutions and industry organizations to comprehensively sort out the current situation of intellectual property rights layout in the photovoltaic field, explore the construction of patent pools, and conduct patent analysis and early warning focusing on key technologies and processes of intelligent photovoltaics. Deepen international exchanges and cooperation. Strengthen bringing in and cooperate with advanced international institutions and enterprises in the field of intelligent photovoltaics in technology, talents, capital, standards, and other aspects. Deepen going out and implement the Belt and Road initiative, encourage the export of high-value-added intelligent photovoltaic products, support enterprises in building intelligent photovoltaic factories overseas, and develop intelligent photovoltaic power station projects, and contribute Chinese solutions to the promotion and application of advanced intelligent photovoltaic models such as photovoltaic desertification control and photovoltaic poverty alleviation.
titlelist: The main task is to optimize the environment for industrial development.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Innovation and Development Action Plan (2021-2025) (MIIT Joint Electronic [2021] No. 226) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration/December 31, 2021)
content: Build technology innovation platforms. Carry out research and development of key common technologies for intelligent photovoltaics, establish national-level intelligent photovoltaic technology innovation platforms, accelerate the research and development reserve of new solar cell technologies, strengthen fundamental and theoretical research on intelligent photovoltaics, achieve the sharing of scientific research achievements, accelerate the transformation of scientific research achievements, provide technical research and development services to the outside, and enhance the core competitiveness of the intelligent photovoltaic industry. Build industry service and verification platforms. Support capable and qualified enterprises and institutions to establish industrial technology basic public service platforms, provide services such as intellectual property training and transactions, scientific and technological achievement evaluation, market strategy research, price monitoring, supply chain coordination, and low-carbon development evaluation. Support the construction of a batch of photovoltaic energy storage, photovoltaic hydrogen production, photovoltaic direct current, and other system verification platforms, and strengthen cross-sector and cross-domain collaboration. Build double innovation incubation platforms. Support the construction of entrepreneurial support platforms such as crowdsourcing, crowdfunding, and crowd support in the field of intelligent photovoltaics, promote the establishment of a batch of intelligent photovoltaic industry ecological incubators and accelerators in eligible areas, explore industrial development and innovation in business application models, and encourage providing support in terms of funding, technology, market application, and promotion for start-up companies.
titlelist: The main task is to build a public service platform.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Innovation and Development Action Plan (2021-2025) (MIIT Joint Electronic [2021] No. 226) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration/December 31, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of talent echelons. Combine introduction and cultivation to form a group of high-level leading talents in the field of intelligent photovoltaics who can drive the intelligent transformation of enterprises, as well as a group of management talents who are familiar with technology and skilled in integrating business resources. Accelerate the training of composite talents who have expertise in photovoltaics as well as fields such as construction, transportation, and agriculture. Increase efforts in talent cultivation. Deepen the integration of industry and education, promote the optimization of disciplines in higher education institutions, and support the establishment of national innovation platforms for the integration of photovoltaic industry and education. Encourage the establishment of comprehensive training and practical bases for intelligent photovoltaic talents in collaboration with enterprises, and support relevant companies in providing domestic and international on-the-job education and training for their employees. Guide the rational flow of talents. Instruct relevant research institutions and associations to organize talent exchange and docking activities, and publish photovoltaic talent white papers. Support the establishment of an intelligent photovoltaic talent information platform to provide talent information services. Guide companies to recruit talents through compliant channels, ensure the normal flow of talents, reduce personnel turnover losses, and enhance the sense of belonging of talents in the photovoltaic industry.
titlelist: Main task: Strengthening the cultivation of photovoltaic talents.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Innovation and Development Action Plan (2021-2025) (MIIT Joint Electronic [2021] No. 226) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration/December 31, 2021)
content: Continuously deepen the coordination mechanism for the development of the intelligent photovoltaic industry, jointly research and solve major problems that arise in the industry's development. Each department should determine annual work goals based on their own functions and responsibilities, strengthen the connection with relevant policies and plans, promote the linkage of action plans with departments such as natural resources, ecological environment, finance, taxation, finance, trade, and securities supervision, and ensure the implementation of various tasks and measures. Strengthen cooperation between the central and local governments, deepen the mechanism for local coordination work, and encourage local governments to introduce supporting policies.
titlelist: Organize and implement, strengthen organizational coordination and policy coordination.

content: In every aspect of our work, we actively promote intelligent manufacturing, enhance the level of inherent safety, reduce operating costs, shorten product production cycles, improve production efficiency, reduce product defect rates, and increase energy utilization efficiency.
titlelist: Intelligent manufacturing and green manufacturing encourage enterprises to integrate automation, informatization, and intelligence into design, production, management, and services.

name: Photovoltaic Manufacturing Industry Standard Conditions (2021 Edition) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/March 11, 2021)
content: Referring to the requirements of green manufacturing in the photovoltaic industry, we will establish green factories, produce environmentally friendly designed products, create green supply chains, and carry out evaluations of green design products, green factories, and green supply chains. We encourage companies to prioritize the use of green and clean electricity in the production process, and they can meet the requirements of green manufacturing by purchasing green electricity certificates and other means.
titlelist: Intelligent manufacturing and green manufacturing, encourage enterprises to participate in the revision of green manufacturing related standards in the photovoltaic industry.

name: Photovoltaic Manufacturing Industry Standard Conditions (2021 Edition) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/March 11, 2021)
content: Battery and component manufacturing companies should be equipped with AAA-grade solar simulators, high and low temperature environmental test chambers, and other key testing equipment. Inverter manufacturing companies should be equipped with environmental testing and grid testing equipment, among other key testing equipment. It is encouraged for companies to establish laboratories with CNAS accreditation qualifications.
titlelist: Quality management, photovoltaic manufacturing enterprises should establish a sound quality management system and equip quality inspection institutions and dedicated inspectors.

content: Support the mechanization and automation of various processes in the production, harvesting, transportation, crushing, sorting, cleaning, and packaging of polycrystalline silicon. Implement automatic detection and monitoring of toxic and hazardous substance emissions and hazardous sources, and comprehensively monitor safety production. Establish an online emergency command system for polycrystalline silicon production. Improve the automation level of ingot furnaces, monocrystalline furnaces, etc., research on automatic control systems for crystal growth, and promote equipment such as automatic spraying, automatic chamfering, wire cutting, squaring, automatic loading and unloading of grinding surfaces, and automatic detection. Encourage the application of wire cutting, automatic wafer insertion, automatic adhesive bonding, fully automatic silicon wafer cleaning, automatic sorting machines, and automatic adhesive removal equipment. Enhance the automation transmission and assembly line operation capabilities between processes. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology).
titlelist: Accelerate industrial technological innovation, enhance the level of intelligent manufacturing, and promote the intelligent upgrading of photovoltaic basic materials production.

content: Promote the use of equipment such as automatic fluffing, automatic loading and unloading, automatic wire guiding, and automatic chip insertion in battery production to enhance intelligent perception and connection capabilities. Encourage the use of component production equipment such as automatic string welding machines, automatic string laying machines, intelligent laminating machines, automatic welding machines, automatic edge trimming machines, automatic framing machines, automatic gluing machines, automatic corner grinding machines, and automatic sealing machines for double-glass components. Research and apply equipment such as automatic stack welding machines, automatic junction box welding, automatic laying of the second layer of EVA/backsheet, automatic packaging, and automatic analysis of EL images. Promote mechanization, automation, and intelligence in the testing, packaging, transportation, and on-site installation of inverters, and establish a complete record and quality traceability mechanism for the entire machine and its components to improve inverter manufacturing efficiency and product reliability. Develop intelligent inverter products and improve the level of power plant monitoring and operation and maintenance. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology).
titlelist: Accelerate industrial technological innovation, enhance the level of intelligent manufacturing, and accelerate the intelligent manufacturing of advanced solar cells and components.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Encourage companies to adopt information management systems such as ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), MES (Manufacturing Execution System), PLC (Programmable Logic Controller), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), SRM (Supply Chain Management System), PLM (Product Lifecycle Management System), CRM (Customer Relationship Management System), etc., to achieve fully digitized management of production processes including product design, process development, material supply, resource scheduling, environmental monitoring, equipment management, quality control, and inventory management. Building upon automated assembly lines, further realize centralized monitoring and intelligent management of production lines, including automatic data acquisition, development of industrial coding systems, real-time quality monitoring, analysis, and processing. Accelerate process improvement and intelligent upgrading through information monitoring, scheduling, data analysis, and support. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology).
titlelist: Accelerate industrial technological innovation, enhance the level of intelligent manufacturing, and improve the level of information management throughout the life cycle of photovoltaic products.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Encourage the development of intelligent photovoltaic components with functions such as optimizing the elimination of shadow shading power loss, mismatch loss, eliminating hot spots, intelligent control shutdown, and real-time monitoring of operation. Develop key components such as intelligent inverters, controllers, combiner boxes, energy storage systems, tracking systems, and efficient power electronic devices suitable for intelligent photovoltaic systems, integrating power transformation, remote control, data collection, online analysis, and environmental adaptability. Develop plug-and-play, detachable, safe, reliable, and user-friendly household intelligent photovoltaic products and systems to standardize the household photovoltaic market. Promote the integration of advanced photovoltaic products with consumer electronics, outdoor products, transportation vehicles, aerospace, and military defense, and encourage the development of diverse mobile products such as solar charging packs, backpacks, clothing, solar-powered drones, and rapid installation power stations. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Promote the deep integration of the two industries, develop intelligent photovoltaic integrated operation and maintenance, and enhance the supply capacity of intelligent photovoltaic terminal products.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Utilize new generation information technologies such as the Internet, big data, artificial intelligence, and 5G communication to promote intelligent control and management of the entire process of photovoltaic system, from surveying, design, integration to operation and maintenance. Support the application of drones in the surveying of photovoltaic system construction, and complete 2D/3D modeling in the cloud. Encourage the development of intelligent photovoltaic design systems that take into account factors such as surveying geographic information data, roof load capacity, local irradiation conditions, and product prices, and compare simulation schemes for different components, inverters, electrical schemes, and bracket methods. Develop intelligent photovoltaic construction management systems to promote their application in procurement, construction processes, quality testing, power station testing, acceptance, etc., and achieve real-time monitoring of project progress, cost control, inventory management, personnel allocation, and construction problem warnings. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with relevant departments responsible according to their duties). Aim to improve the efficiency of photovoltaic systems and reduce operation and maintenance costs, and support the development of intelligent cleaning robots for photovoltaic power plants, intelligent inspection drones, and other products. Apply information technology methods to develop intelligent photovoltaic power generation monitoring systems with functions such as data collection, centralized remote monitoring, fault detection, recording, alarm, analysis, and processing. Support the promotion of intelligent photovoltaic power generation monitoring systems, establish intelligent regional centralized operation and maintenance centers and mobile operation and maintenance platforms, and achieve centralized management and remote management. Apply big data analysis and processing technologies to automatically generate operation and maintenance suggestions and electronic work tickets, and achieve unmanned duty, fewer personnel on duty for remote systems. Support the use of intelligent robots, drones, and other technologies to replace manual operation and maintenance management. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with relevant departments responsible according to their duties).
titlelist: Promote the deep integration of the two industries, develop intelligent photovoltaic integrated operation and maintenance, and promote the intelligent integration and operation of photovoltaic systems.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Deeply implement the 'Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry' and the 'Industrial Green Development Plan (2016-2020)', encourage the construction of photovoltaic application projects in industrial parks, new industrialization demonstration bases, etc., formulate specific evaluation methods for the proportion of renewable energy, increase the proportion of clean energy use, and promote the green development of industrial parks and other areas. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Promote the demonstration of application in characteristic industries, actively promote green development, and carry out demonstration of application in intelligent photovoltaic industrial parks.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: In towns with suitable conditions, such as government buildings, public buildings, commercial buildings, industrial buildings, and facility buildings, the approach of 'government guidance, voluntary participation by enterprises, financial support, and social involvement' is adopted. Various commercial models, such as leasing rooftops to social capital and managing energy-saving service contracts through EMC, are introduced to construct independent 'on-site absorption' distributed building rooftop photovoltaic power stations and integrated building photovoltaic power stations, promoting the development of distributed photovoltaic applications. Demonstrative projects for 'urban-level distributed building photovoltaic power stations' are actively carried out at the city, county, and development zone levels, organized and guided by the government as public construction projects, to achieve intelligent photovoltaic building big data online monitoring and management (led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, with relevant departments responsible according to their duties). In towns and rural areas with excellent sunlight resources and good conditions for grid connection and absorption, combined with channels such as new urbanization construction, old town transformation, new rural construction, and relocation, efforts are made to promote the intelligent photovoltaic application on residential rooftops, forming several photovoltaic towns and new villages. The application of 'photovoltaic replacing coal heating' technology is actively promoted in small buildings and independent farmhouses in rural areas with suitable conditions (led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, with relevant departments responsible according to their duties).
titlelist: Promote the demonstration of application in characteristic industries, actively promote green development, and carry out demonstration of intelligent photovoltaic building and urban applications.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Promote the demonstration construction of photovoltaic power stations and charging piles in the transportation sector. Encourage the application of photovoltaic power generation in highway noise barriers, highway traffic signs, solar street lights, highway service areas (parking lots), bus stations, port terminals, navigation aids and facilities, offshore work vessels, and island work sites. Explore the integration and application of photovoltaics and new energy vehicles. (Led by the Ministry of Transport, relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Promote the demonstration of application in characteristic industries, actively promote green development, and carry out demonstration of intelligent photovoltaic transportation applications.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Support the integrated development of photovoltaics and agriculture, carry out three-dimensional economic development, and implement the installation of solar panels on the roofs of agricultural facilities and agricultural production under the sheds in places where conditions permit. Integrate photovoltaic power generation with agricultural facilities, and carry out in-depth innovation in areas such as farming and breeding, supplementary lighting for crops, regulation of light uniformity and transmittance, intelligent operation and maintenance, and efficient component development. Encourage exploration of new commercial models for photovoltaic agriculture, promote green agricultural development, and increase farmers' income. (Led by the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Promote the demonstration of application in characteristic industries, actively promote green development, and carry out demonstration of intelligent photovoltaic agricultural applications.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Under the premise of meeting the requirements of the 'leader' program for photovoltaics, priority support will be given to advanced photovoltaic products based on smart photovoltaics. Encouragement will be given to the integration of smart photovoltaics in the construction of 'leader' bases, and active promotion will be carried out in large-scale photovoltaic power plants and distributed applications. Various methods, such as the comprehensive utilization of barren mountains and wastelands, coastal tidal flats, and land reclamation in coal mining subsidence areas, will be encouraged to adaptively carry out the construction of smart photovoltaic power plants, promoting the organic integration of photovoltaic power generation with other industries. (Led by the National Energy Administration, relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Promote the application demonstration of characteristic industries, actively promote green development, and carry out the application demonstration of intelligent photovoltaic power stations.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Based on the Comprehensive Standardization Technology System for Solar Photovoltaic Industry, accelerate the research on the intelligent photovoltaic standard system. Focus on the development of standards for intelligent photovoltaic components, junction boxes, inverters, controllers, tracking systems, household photovoltaic systems, and testing methods. Strengthen the standards for interconnection and interoperability of photovoltaic product production and management systems, standards for intelligent manufacturing factories/digital workshops, standards for key intelligent manufacturing equipment, standards for intelligent manufacturing equipment fault information data dictionaries, standards for manufacturing process online detection, traceability, and data collection, and other intelligent production and evaluation standards. Strengthen the research on intelligent operation and maintenance standards for photovoltaic systems, including intelligent cleaning, intelligent inspection, intelligent fault diagnosis, etc. Develop design and evaluation specifications for intelligent operation and maintenance platforms, standardize communication interfaces, data formats, transmission protocols, etc., for photovoltaic system operation and maintenance platforms. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Improve the technical standard system, accelerate the construction of public service platforms, and establish a sound intelligent photovoltaic technology standard system.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Surrounding the development needs of the intelligent photovoltaic industry, promote the integration of industry, academia, research, and application, establish a technology innovation platform, and carry out a batch of key and cutting-edge technology research and development; support capable and qualified enterprises and institutions to build national-level intelligent photovoltaic testing and certification public service platforms, and provide testing, certification, and rating services for various aspects of intelligent photovoltaics, providing a basis for power station system design and equipment selection; support the construction of a batch of public service platforms by local areas, industrial parks, leading enterprises, etc., to carry out scientific and professional services such as technology research and development, product design, financial and tax policies, and strategic research; support the construction of entrepreneurship support platforms such as crowdsourcing, crowdfunding, and crowd support in the field of intelligent photovoltaics, promote the establishment of a batch of intelligent photovoltaic industry ecological incubators and accelerators, and encourage the provision of funding, technology, market application, and promotion support for start-up companies. (Relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Improve the technical standard system, accelerate the construction of public service platforms, and speed up the construction of intelligent photovoltaic public service platforms.

name: Intelligent Photovoltaic Industry Development Action Plan (2018-2020) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2018] No. 68) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, National Energy Administration, State Council Poverty Alleviation Office / April 11, 2018)
content: Carry out diversified intelligent photovoltaic pilot demonstrations, cultivate a group of national intelligent photovoltaic demonstration enterprises, and support the construction of several industry-specific intelligent photovoltaic projects. Guide photovoltaic enterprises to participate in pilot demonstration construction together with software development, information management, system integration, internet, big data, and other enterprises. Encourage photovoltaic enterprises to explore replicable and scalable intelligent photovoltaic construction models with enterprises in the fields of information, transportation, construction, agriculture, energy, poverty alleviation, and other areas. Relevant departments should timely evaluate the progress and effectiveness of work implementation in various regions, summarize advanced experiences, and promote them nationwide. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Strengthen comprehensive policy guarantees, coordinate and promote the healthy development of industries, and promote the pilot application of intelligent photovoltaics.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Continue to expand the scale of solar energy utilization, constantly increase the proportion of solar energy in the energy structure, improve the level of solar energy technology, and reduce the cost of solar energy utilization. Improve the technological innovation and diversified application system of solar energy utilization, and provide a good market environment for the healthy development of the industry.
titlelist: Guidelines and objectives, development goals.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: The cost of photovoltaic power generation continues to decrease. By 2020, the price of photovoltaic power generation will decrease by more than 50% compared to 2015, achieving the goal of grid parity on the demand side. The cost of solar thermal power generation is less than 0.8 yuan/kWh. Solar heating and industrial heating have market competitiveness.
titlelist: Guidelines and objectives, development goals, cost goals.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: The conversion efficiency of advanced crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells has reached over 23%, and the industrial conversion efficiency of thin-film photovoltaic cells has significantly improved. Several new types of photovoltaic cells have achieved preliminary industrialization. The efficiency of photovoltaic power generation systems has significantly increased, achieving intelligent operation and maintenance. The efficiency of solar thermal power generation has greatly improved, forming a complete industry chain integration capability.
titlelist: Guiding principles and objectives, development goals, technological advancement goals.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: According to the overall idea of innovation-driven, industrial upgrading, cost reduction, market expansion, and system improvement, vigorously promote the diversified application of photovoltaic power generation, actively promote the industrialization of solar thermal power generation, and accelerate the popularization of diversified solar thermal utilization.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese means man or male.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Continue to carry out the construction of distributed photovoltaic application demonstration zones, and by 2020, build 100 distributed photovoltaic application demonstration zones. Install photovoltaic power generation on 80% of newly built roofs and 50% of existing roofs within the demonstration zones. In industrial parks, economic development zones, large-scale industrial and mining enterprises, as well as public buildings such as shopping malls, schools, and hospitals that have development conditions, adopt the approach of government guidance, voluntary participation of enterprises, financial support, and social participation to plan and implement rooftop photovoltaic projects. In rural areas and small towns with excellent solar resources and good grid connection and absorption conditions, promote rooftop photovoltaic projects for residential buildings. Combine the planning and construction of rooftop photovoltaic projects with the construction of new urbanization, the transformation of old towns, the construction of new rural areas, and relocation projects to form several photovoltaic towns and new villages.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the application of distributed photovoltaics and 'photovoltaics+' (integration of photovoltaics with other industries), vigorously promote rooftop distributed photovoltaic power generation.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Encourage the comprehensive utilization of barren mountains, wastelands, coastal mudflats, subsidence areas, and other abandoned lands through methods such as facility agriculture, fishery farming, etc. Develop various PV+ application projects according to local conditions, promote the organic integration of photovoltaic power generation with other industries, and explore new ways to increase land value through photovoltaic power generation. Encourage the integration of photovoltaic agriculture development models that enhance agricultural efficiency, and promote the construction of photovoltaic power stations in conjunction with modern and efficient agricultural facilities. In areas with good conditions for aquaculture, encourage the construction of fishery-photovoltaic integrated power stations on pond surfaces. Under the premise of complying with forestry management standards, reasonably layout forest-photovoltaic complementary power stations in suitable forest land, shrub forests, and sparse forests. Combine with traditional Chinese medicine planting, vegetation protection, ecological management projects, and reasonably allocate photovoltaic power stations.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the application of distributed photovoltaics and 'photovoltaic+' to expand the comprehensive utilization of 'photovoltaic+' projects.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Combine the reform of the power system with the market-oriented trading of distributed photovoltaic power generation, encourage the construction of photovoltaic power generation projects close to power loads, and connect them to the medium and low voltage distribution grid to achieve nearby power consumption. All types of distribution network enterprises should provide services for the operation of distributed photovoltaic power generation connected to the grid, prioritize the consumption of distributed photovoltaic power generation, establish a technical support system for distributed power generation grid operation, and organize distributed power trading. Promote the market-oriented electricity sales model of distributed photovoltaic power generation projects to power users, and reasonably determine the transmission and distribution prices paid to grid enterprises based on the principle of promoting nearby consumption of distributed photovoltaic power.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting distributed photovoltaics and photovoltaic + applications, innovating distributed photovoltaic application models.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: According to the layout idea of complementary advantages, coordinated development, expanded consumption, and improved efficiency, in the Three North region, the existing and planned ultra-high voltage power transmission channels are utilized. Following the principles of prioritizing existing stock and optimizing incremental development, solar power generation bases are constructed in an orderly manner to increase the proportion of renewable energy in the power transmission channels and effectively expand the scope of solar power consumption in the Three North region. In areas with abundant solar resources and land resources such as Qinghai and Inner Mongolia, the construction of solar power generation bases that complement other renewable energy sources is studied, demonstrated, and phased. In areas with abundant hydropower resources such as the Jinsha River, Yalong River, and Lancang River in the southwest, large-scale wind-solar-hydro complementary power generation bases are studied and phased based on hydropower bases and power transmission channels. Column 3 focuses on the layout of solar power generation bases in power transmission channels. Main provinces (regions) and main areas of power transmission channels. Hami-Zhengzhou UHVDC transmission project in Hami, Xinjiang (completed). Zhundong-Wannan UHVDC transmission project in Zhundong, Xinjiang (under construction). Ximeng-Taizhou UHVDC transmission project in Ximeng, Inner Mongolia (under construction). Ximeng-Shandong UHVAC transmission project in Ximeng, Inner Mongolia (under construction). Shanghai Temple-Shandong UHVDC transmission project in Mongolian West (under construction). Mongolian West-Tianjin South UHVAC transmission project in Mongolian West (under construction). Zhalute-Shandong UHVDC transmission project in Northeast China (under construction). Alashan region studies and demonstrates power transmission channels mainly for delivering renewable energy. Jiuquan-Hunan UHVDC transmission project in Jiuquan, Gansu (under construction). Ningdong-Zhejiang UHVDC transmission project in Ningxia (under construction). Shanxi-Jiangsu UHVDC transmission project in northern Shanxi (under construction). Qinghai Haixi Prefecture studies and demonstrates power transmission channels mainly for delivering renewable energy. Hainan Prefecture studies and demonstrates power transmission channels mainly for delivering renewable energy.
titlelist: Key tasks: optimize the layout of photovoltaic power plants and innovate construction methods, combining the construction of power transmission channels to establish solar power generation bases.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: The goal is to primarily address the issue of poverty-stricken households without labor capacity through targeted poverty alleviation programs. By adapting to local conditions and promoting various forms of photovoltaic poverty alleviation projects in stages, it aims to cover 2.8 million registered poverty-stricken households without labor capacity, with an average annual increase of 3,000 yuan in cash income per household. It ensures that key equipment for photovoltaic poverty alleviation meets advanced technical standards and is reliable in quality. It encourages the establishment of specialized platform companies to unify the operation and monitoring of photovoltaic poverty alleviation projects, ensuring their long-term quality, stable performance, and lasting benefits.
titlelist: Key tasks, carry out photovoltaic poverty alleviation in various ways, innovate photovoltaic poverty alleviation models.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: In areas with limited land resources in the central and eastern parts of the Middle East, the photovoltaic poverty alleviation model prioritizes the use of village-level power stations (including household systems). The individual household system is about 5 kilowatts, and the individual village-level power station generally does not exceed 300 kilowatts. Village-level poverty alleviation power stations are given priority in the scale of photovoltaic power generation construction and enjoy national renewable energy electricity price subsidies. The connection between rural power grid transformation and distributed photovoltaic poverty alleviation projects is well coordinated to ensure that the electricity generated by photovoltaic poverty alleviation projects is connected and consumed locally. Establish a construction and post-operation supervision and management system for village-level poverty alleviation power stations, and incorporate relevant information into the national photovoltaic poverty alleviation information management system for monitoring. Encourage the construction of unified operation monitoring and management platforms in various regions to ensure the long-term reliable operation of power stations and stable income for impoverished households.
titlelist: Key tasks, carry out various forms of photovoltaic poverty alleviation, vigorously promote distributed photovoltaic poverty alleviation.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Encourage regions to combine modern agriculture and specialty agricultural industries to develop photovoltaic poverty alleviation. Encourage local governments to use the PPP model, with government investment and financing entities partnering with commercial investment enterprises to jointly build photovoltaic agriculture projects. The project assets are jointly owned by the government investment and financing entities and commercial investment enterprises, and the profits are distributed according to the share ratio. The government investment and financing entities should quantitatively allocate shares to eligible impoverished villages and households, allowing representatives of poverty alleviation beneficiaries to participate in project investment and operation, and distribute asset income to impoverished villages and households on a monthly (or quarterly) basis. Priority should be given to using labor from registered impoverished households in photovoltaic agriculture projects, and they should play a leading role in the development of local specialty agriculture.
titlelist: Key tasks, carry out various forms of photovoltaic poverty alleviation, and encourage the construction of photovoltaic agricultural projects.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Gradually promote the industrialization and commercialization of solar thermal power generation, leveraging its advantages such as thermal storage and controllable output, to achieve friendly development between the grid and power sources and enhance the grid's capacity to accommodate renewable energy. In renewable energy-rich areas such as Qinghai, Xinjiang, and Gansu, make advance preparations for the layout of solar thermal power generation, explore the use of solar thermal power generation for peak load regulation, and study the establishment of large-scale hybrid renewable energy power bases that integrate solar thermal power generation with photovoltaic power generation, wind power, pumped storage, and other complementary uses, with controllable and adjustable power generation. These bases will provide the grid with clean, safe, and stable electricity, promoting the high proportionate application of renewable energy.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the industrialization of solar thermal power generation and leverage the role of solar thermal power generation in peak load regulation.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Drawing on the experience of solar thermal power generation projects abroad and combining it with the implementation of solar thermal power generation demonstration projects in China, we will develop standards for the design, equipment, construction, and operation of solar thermal power generation. We will establish and improve the supporting system for engineering design, testing and certification, and quality management. We will accelerate the construction of the policy and management system for the solar thermal power generation industry and study and formulate management methods for solar thermal power generation projects to ensure the healthy and orderly development of the solar thermal power generation industry.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the industrialization of solar thermal power generation and establish a comprehensive service system for the solar thermal power generation industry.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Driven by market demand and relying on projects such as small town construction and shantytown renovation, further promote the large-scale application of solar water heating. Increase the promotion of solar water heating systems in areas with suitable solar resources. Support rural and small town residents in installing and using solar water heaters, promote solar public bath projects in rural areas, and expand the application scale of solar water heaters in rural areas. Increase the mandatory promotion of solar water heating systems in public buildings, affordable housing, and low-rent housing projects in large and medium-sized cities. Promote the coordinated planning, design, and application of solar water heating systems in newly built, renovated, and expanded residential buildings in cities.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the use of solar heating according to local conditions, and further promote the application of solar hot water.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: In the context of energy conservation and emission reduction in the industrial sector, in the construction of new industrial areas (economic development zones) and the transformation of traditional industrial areas, active promotion of the integration of solar heating and conventional energy is being carried out to promote the clean transformation of the industrial energy structure. In industries with high heat demand such as printing and dyeing, ceramics, food processing, agricultural greenhouses, and farms, which are compatible with solar thermal utilization systems, solar heating is fully utilized as the basic heat source for conventional energy systems to provide industrial heat, promoting the cascade utilization of industrial heating. In conjunction with new energy demonstration cities, new energy utilization industrial parks, and green energy demonstration counties (districts), a number of solar heating systems for industrial and agricultural production will be built, with a total collector area of 20 million square meters.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote solar heating according to local conditions, and advance solar heating in the industrial and agricultural sectors.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Construct interconnected new energy microgrid demonstration projects in regions with high penetration rates of distributed renewable energy or with conditions for multi-energy complementarity. Through the comprehensive application of energy storage technology, distributed natural gas power generation, intelligent control, and information technology, explore new commercial operation models and formats for electricity production and consumption, promote more dynamic development of electricity marketization and innovation, establish a sound technical system and management system for new energy microgrids, gradually increase the penetration rate of renewable energy, and explore the construction of a 100% renewable energy multi-energy complementary microgrid.
titlelist: Key tasks, carry out demonstrations of new energy microgrid applications, and construct interconnected microgrid demonstration projects.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: By enhancing energy electronic technology in conjunction with microgrid energy management and energy storage technology, it is highly integrated into the generation, transmission, distribution, and utilization of electricity. In remote areas, islands, border outposts, and other areas where the power grid is not covered or the power supply capacity is insufficient, abundant renewable resources are fully utilized to achieve comprehensive and complementary use of multiple energy sources. This includes the construction of intelligent off-grid new energy microgrid demonstration projects, replacing diesel generators, reducing power supply costs, protecting the ecological environment, and improving regional energy structure.
titlelist: Key tasks: Carry out demonstrations of new energy microgrid applications and demonstrations of off-grid microgrids.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: In accordance with the requirements of power system reform, expand the application space of new energy microgrids. Use new energy microgrids as carriers to act as independent electricity retailers, explore the model of distributed photovoltaic supply within microgrids, as well as direct power transactions between microgrids and local new energy generation projects. Support microgrids in purchasing electricity directly from renewable energy power companies nearby, and explore the realization of microgrids with 100% consumption of new energy electricity.
titlelist: Key tasks: Carry out demonstrations of new energy microgrid applications and explore microgrid electricity trading models.

name: Development of Solar Energy 'Thirteenth Five-Year Plan' (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2016] No. 354) (National Energy Administration/December 8, 2016)
content: Relying on national key laboratories, national engineering centers, and other institutions, we promote the establishment of three national-level photovoltaic technology innovation platforms: public technology innovation, product testing, and empirical research. These platforms aim to create a comprehensive innovation support platform that is internationally leading and serves the entire industry. The public technology innovation platform focuses on forward-looking research and technological breakthroughs in areas such as new types of solar cells, new photovoltaic systems and components, and high penetration of photovoltaic grid connection. The product testing platform focuses on building product and system testing platforms for various links in the photovoltaic industry chain. The empirical research platform focuses on conducting empirical research on photovoltaic systems and components under different regions, climates, and grid conditions, and establishing a national public monitoring and evaluation center for photovoltaic power generation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: In the process of planning and implementation, it is necessary to timely conduct solar power generation planning evaluations and make necessary revisions and adjustments to the plans based on the development situation. Solar power generation development during the Twelfth Five-Year Plan period: 1. Planning foundation and background: (1) Development foundation: International development status. Solar power generation is an emerging renewable energy technology, and the main applications currently in industrialization are solar photovoltaic power generation and solar thermal power generation. Solar photovoltaic power generation has the characteristics of modular battery components, convenient installation and maintenance, and flexible usage, making it the most widely used technology for solar power generation. Solar thermal power generation heats the medium through concentrated heat collection systems and then uses traditional steam power generation equipment to generate electricity. In recent years, there has been an increase in industrial demonstration projects. In the past 10 years, the global annual production of solar photovoltaic cells has increased by about 6 times, with an average annual growth rate of over 50%. In 2010, the global annual production of solar photovoltaic cells reached 16 million kilowatts, of which China's annual production was 10 million kilowatts. Grid-connected photovoltaic power plants and distributed grid-connected photovoltaic power generation systems integrated with buildings are the main utilization methods for photovoltaic power generation. By 2010, the global installed capacity of photovoltaic power generation exceeded 40 million kilowatts, with the main markets in Germany, Spain, Japan, and Italy. Germany added 7 million kilowatts of installed capacity in 2010. With the improvement of the scale, conversion efficiency, and technological level of solar photovoltaic power generation, the cost of the entire industry chain has rapidly decreased. The price of solar photovoltaic cell components has dropped from $4.5 per watt in 2000 to below $1.5 per watt in 2010, significantly improving the economic viability of solar photovoltaic power generation. Solar thermal power generation, also known as solar thermal power generation, has not yet achieved large-scale development, but after a long period of experimental operation, it has begun to enter commercial applications on a large scale. Currently, several solar thermal power plants have been built or are under construction in countries such as the United States, Spain, Germany, France, the United Arab Emirates, and India. By the end of 2010, the total installed capacity of grid-connected solar thermal power plants worldwide reached 1.1 million kilowatts, with a total installed capacity of about 12 million kilowatts for projects under construction. Development trends: The economic viability of solar power generation technology has significantly improved. Currently, solar power generation is still in the early stages of development, and in the next 5-10 years, the solar power generation industry will enter a period of rapid growth. With the improvement of solar power generation technology, the market application scale will gradually expand, the cost of solar power generation will continue to decrease, and market competitiveness will significantly improve. Solar power generation is expected to accelerate its entry into the stage of large-scale development. Diversified development of solar power generation technology: Photovoltaic power generation and solar thermal power generation have different technical characteristics. Crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells, thin-film photovoltaic cell technology, and tower, trough, and dish solar thermal power generation technologies each have their own technical advantages. Solar power generation will present a diversified technological route and development trend. Effective market competition will promote technological progress and cost reduction in solar power generation, and form a pattern of complementary and coordinated development of various solar power generation technologies. Solar power generation gradually becomes an important part of the power system: With the significant improvement in the economic viability of solar power generation technology, solar power generation has begun to enter a stage of large-scale development. In the new installed capacity of the European Union in 2010, solar power generation surpassed wind power for the first time and became the renewable energy with the most new installed capacity in the European Union. With the technological progress and scale expansion of the global solar power generation industry, solar power generation will soon become an important renewable energy source after hydropower and wind power, and an important part of the power system. Development experience: Long-term goals guide development. Developed countries or economies such as the European Union and the United States have identified solar power generation as an important area of renewable energy and have set development goals for 2020 and beyond. According to the renewable energy action plans issued by the European Union and its member states, the total installed capacity of solar power generation in the European Union will exceed 90 million kilowatts by 2020, with Germany's photovoltaic power generation capacity reaching 51 million kilowatts and Spain's solar thermal power generation reaching 10 million kilowatts. The European Union has launched the Desertec initiative, planning to build large-scale solar power plants in the Sahara Desert and transmit electricity to the power load centers in Europe. Legal and policy guarantees: Germany, Spain, the United States, and other countries have enacted specific laws to support the development of renewable energy. European Union countries generally support the development of solar power generation and other renewable energy electricity through preferential grid electricity pricing policies. The United States supports the development of solar power generation through policies such as tax exemptions and initial investment subsidies, and various countries have clearly stated the requirement for renewable energy power generation facilities to have priority access to the grid.
