Combining the advantages of Xinjiang's solar energy resources with other renewable energy sources such as hydropower and wind power, and the overall development layout of accelerating the transformation of energy resources in Xinjiang, the construction of large-scale grid-connected solar power plants in southern and eastern Xinjiang will be promoted, with priority given to the construction of solar power plant projects in Bazhou, Hotan, Turpan, and Hami. Combining the abundant solar energy resources and wind power development and layout in Gansu, the construction of solar power plants in the Hexi Corridor will be promoted with the aim of increasing local power supply, and projects such as wind-solar complementary and hydro-solar complementary will be encouraged. Taking advantage of the wind energy resources and solar energy resources in Inner Mongolia, with the aim of meeting local power supply needs, a number of solar power plants will be constructed in areas such as Alxa League, Bayannur, Baotou, Ordos, Hohhot, and other areas with good conditions for the Inner Mongolia East Power Grid, in conjunction with wind power development. In the Zhongwei, Wuzhong, and Shizuishan areas of Ningxia, and the Yulin and Yan'an areas of Shaanxi, the construction of grid-connected solar power plants will be promoted in conjunction with the optimization of energy structure. In the Lhasa, Shigatse, and Shannan areas of Tibet, a number of solar power plants will be constructed in conjunction with local electricity demand. In the Chuxiong and Dali areas of Yunnan, a number of solar power plants will be constructed in conjunction with local hydropower and wind power development. In the northern part of Hebei, the northern part of Shanxi, the Sichuan plateau region, the northwestern part of Liaoning, the western part of Jilin, the western part of Heilongjiang, and some areas of Shandong, the construction of solar power plants will be steadily promoted, and on the basis of ensuring feasible resource and construction conditions, some solar photovoltaic power plant projects will be coordinated and arranged.
titlelist: Key task, orderly promote the construction of solar power plants.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: According to the principles of adaptation to local conditions, mutual complementarity, flexible configuration, and economic efficiency, in areas with abundant renewable energy resources and diversified utilization conditions, combined with smart grid technology, the focus is on solving local power supply issues. The construction of new energy microgrid projects aims to establish a new power supply and consumption model that fully utilizes new energy generation. During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, 30 new energy microgrid demonstration projects were constructed. Support is provided for the construction of new energy microgrid demonstration projects in remote towns in western provinces such as Tibet, Qinghai, and Xinjiang, as well as offshore islands with concentrated populations in Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, and other provinces. The construction is based on the demand for power supply reliability and stability. Investment subsidies are used to support the construction of decentralized power supply projects for dispersed users in remote areas. The promotion of independent photovoltaic power stations and household photovoltaic power generation systems is encouraged in remote areas of provinces such as Tibet, Qinghai, Xinjiang, and Yunnan, as well as sparsely populated offshore islands in eastern regions, to solve the electricity needs of populations in areas where the grid cannot reach.
titlelist: Key task: Construction of a new energy microgrid demonstration project.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Choose cities with high ecological and environmental protection requirements, relatively good economic conditions, and abundant renewable energy resources. Adopt a unified planning, standardized design, and orderly construction approach to support the comprehensive demonstration and application of new energy technologies such as solar energy in urban areas and various industrial parks. Replace traditional energy utilization methods such as coal combustion to form a regional advantage in new energy utilization. Focus on promoting the application of new energy technologies such as solar thermal utilization and distributed photovoltaic power generation in public institutions, schools, hospitals, hotels, and residential areas. Support the demonstration and application of advanced and diverse new energy technologies such as solar energy in the construction and renovation processes of various industrial parks to meet the energy needs of power, heating, cooling, etc. in the parks. Promote the application of new energy in large and medium-sized cities through policy support and market mechanisms. During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, construct 100 new energy demonstration cities and 1000 new energy demonstration parks.
titlelist: Key task: Creating a new energy demonstration city.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: Establish a multi-level technology innovation system that is market-oriented, with enterprises as the main body, and integrates industry, academia, and research. Integrate the technical capabilities of solar power research institutes and universities, establish a national-level solar power generation laboratory, and focus on research in solar power basic theory, cutting-edge technology, key technology, and common technology. Relying on existing research institutions and enterprises with a good foundation in technological innovation, support the construction of a national solar photovoltaic power generation and solar thermal power generation engineering technology center, and focus on the research and development of solar photovoltaic power generation and solar thermal power generation application technology. Strengthen the construction of testing and certification capabilities for solar photovoltaic power generation and solar thermal power generation equipment and products, and establish an advanced level testing and experimental research base for new products. Encourage local governments and enterprises to jointly develop innovative platforms for solar power generation technology research and development, and create regional clusters of solar power generation technology with industrial advantages. Support cooperation between domestic research institutions with strong innovation capabilities and internationally advanced research institutions, jointly establish solar power generation technology research and development centers, and focus on joint research and development of common technologies such as technology for integrated application systems and grid operation in solar power generation, promoting the overall progress of solar power generation technology and its application in China.
titlelist: Key task: Improve the innovation system for solar power generation technology.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration, Document No. [2012] 194) (National Energy Administration, July 7, 2012)
content: Improve the research and development capabilities of solar power generation technology and key equipment manufacturing capabilities, consolidate the sustained competitive advantage of photovoltaic power generation manufacturing worldwide. Enhance the theoretical research capabilities and system utilization level of photovoltaic power generation comprehensively. Develop and manufacture advanced solar photovoltaic cell components that are efficient, reliable, low-cost, clean, environmentally friendly, and adaptable to different operating environments, and improve the equipment and integration technology level of the entire industry chain. Breakthrough key component design and manufacturing technologies for solar thermal power generation, such as solar concentrators and vacuum tubes, relying on the advantages of integrated control and engineering thermophysics and other related cutting-edge disciplines in our country, to form a complete integrated industrial chain for key equipment in solar thermal power generation. Improve the testing and detection methods for photovoltaic cell component equipment, establish a comprehensive quality control system, and improve the performance and quality of photovoltaic cell components.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing the sustained competitiveness of solar power generation products.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration, Document No. [2012] 194) (National Energy Administration, July 7, 2012)
content: Based on the scale development of the solar power generation industry, gradually transform the current industry system focused on component sales into an industry system centered around engineering construction and lifecycle management. Relying on existing conditions, establish an industry service system that supports the comprehensive development of the solar power generation industry, guided by the national energy development strategy, led by professional technical institutions, and oriented towards market demand. Improve the standard system in areas such as solar resource evaluation, solar power plant planning and design, construction and installation, and operation and maintenance. Establish and improve the construction and operation service system for solar power generation, enhance the specialized service capabilities in site selection, planning, design, construction and installation, and maintenance of solar power plants. Improve the statistical information of the solar power generation industry and form a monitoring system for solar power generation information.
titlelist: Key task: Establishing and improving the solar power generation industry system.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration, Document No. [2012] 194) (National Energy Administration, July 7, 2012)
content: Actively expand the domestic market for photovoltaic products, and achieve a shift from excessive reliance on external demand to a balanced emphasis on both domestic and external demand. Actively promote the optimization of the photovoltaic industry structure, encourage companies to merge and reorganize according to market laws, eliminate outdated production capacity, enhance enterprise risk resistance, improve industry concentration, strengthen key technological research and development in the photovoltaic industry, establish photovoltaic manufacturing technology research and development centers, support companies in improving their technological innovation capabilities, develop industrial core competitiveness based on independent technology, and transform the development of China's photovoltaic industry from scale and efficiency-oriented to technology and efficiency-oriented. Standardize the bidding and tendering activities and market order for the procurement of photovoltaic cells by enterprises, and create a market environment conducive to the healthy development of the photovoltaic manufacturing industry.
titlelist: Key task: Promoting the healthy development of the photovoltaic manufacturing industry.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration, Document No. [2012] 194) (National Energy Administration, July 7, 2012)
content: Promote global technology research and development cooperation, encourage domestic enterprises to cooperate with foreign enterprises in the research of cutting-edge and common technologies related to solar power generation, focus on the research and development of solar power generation application technologies, as well as research and development of grid operation and control technologies related to solar power generation. Collaborate with major research institutions and companies in Europe and the United States to carry out solar power generation system integration design, solar energy resource assessment, and solar power generation forecasting technology research. Strengthen international talent exchange and cooperation, exchange talents with countries strong in solar power generation technology and application, support research institutes and enterprises in establishing mechanisms for international talent training and introduction, and focus on cultivating high-end professional and comprehensive management talents in the field of solar power generation. Encourage domestic enterprises to actively participate in foreign solar power generation project construction, and form solar power generation enterprise groups with international advanced technology and management level.
titlelist: Key tasks, actively carry out international cooperation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: Continue to improve the market competition mechanism to promote the large-scale development of solar power generation, promote the continuous reduction of solar power generation costs, establish and improve a national subsidy mechanism for solar power generation based on market competition, and gradually reduce the amount of national subsidies per unit of electricity. Establish a management mechanism for non-discriminatory and barrier-free integration of distributed photovoltaic power generation into the grid, with self-use as the main focus, and promote the entry of distributed photovoltaic power generation into public facilities and households.
titlelist: Plan implementation, guarantee measures, and improve market mechanisms to promote the development of solar power generation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration, Document No. [2012] 194) (National Energy Administration, July 7, 2012)
content: Implement user-side distributed photovoltaic power generation systems. Innovate the operation mode and establish a distributed power generation operation system supported by smart grids, promoting the pilot demonstration of new energy microgrids. Mobilize the enthusiasm of local governments, power grid companies, and power users to form a comprehensive pattern for promoting the development of distributed energy. Actively promote the operation and technical service system construction of new energy microgrids and off-grid solar power generation, and optimize the allocation of funds and technical resources through market means.
titlelist: Plan implementation, guarantee measures, establish a power operation mechanism adapted to solar power generation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: According to the national solar power generation plan, coordinate the development plans and phased development and construction plans for solar power generation in various regions. Strengthen the construction management of large-scale grid-connected solar power plants, strictly manage the technical aspects of project preparation, project approval, completion acceptance, and operation supervision, coordinate the construction and grid operation management of solar power plants, and promote the orderly and healthy development of the solar power generation industry.
titlelist: Planning and implementation, guarantee measures, strengthening the planning and project management of solar power generation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: Improve the establishment of standards for key products such as solar photovoltaic modules and inverters, and form a product testing and certification system that is in line with international standards. Standardize the procedures and regulations for the design, construction, and operation of large-scale solar power plants. Establish an information monitoring and evaluation system for solar power generation and strengthen the technical supervision throughout the entire process of solar power generation.
titlelist: Plan implementation, guarantee measures, and improve the standard system for solar power generation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: Research and formulate development policies for the photovoltaic manufacturing industry, strictly enforce admission standards, and standardize market access mechanisms. Further strengthen investment management, control capacity expansion, and optimize industrial layout. Increase investment to support key enterprises in mastering core technologies and enhancing core competitiveness. Strengthen the evaluation and certification management of photovoltaic product quality, and prevent inferior photovoltaic products from entering the market. Strengthen market supervision of the photovoltaic industry and prevent disorderly competition and other behaviors that disrupt market order.
titlelist: Planning and implementation, guarantee measures, strengthening the management of the photovoltaic manufacturing industry.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: The energy regulatory departments of each provincial government shall, in accordance with national planning requirements, carry out the formulation and implementation of local plans, and earnestly implement the development goals and key tasks determined by the national planning. The local solar power development plan should be confirmed by the national energy regulatory department before being announced and implemented, to ensure the organic connection of plans at all levels.
titlelist: Planning and implementation, implementation mechanism, strengthening planning coordination and management.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration, Document No. [2012] 194) (National Energy Administration, July 7, 2012)
content: Strengthen the information statistics work of the solar power generation industry, establish an industry monitoring system, timely grasp the implementation of the plan, and carry out mid-term evaluation work. Based on the mid-term evaluation results, make rolling adjustments to the plan in accordance with the principles favorable to the development of the solar power generation industry.
titlelist: Planning and implementation, implementation mechanism, establishment of a rolling adjustment mechanism.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Entrust the centralized management unit of technology to carry out post-evaluation of solar power station projects. Focus on post-evaluation of large-scale centralized solar power generation projects. Power grid enterprises should strengthen the monitoring of grid-connected operation of solar power generation projects and take effective technical measures to ensure the normal grid-connected operation of solar power generation.
titlelist: Planning and implementation, implementation mechanism, strengthening operation monitoring and assessment.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, the newly added installed capacity of solar photovoltaic power plants was approximately 10 million kilowatts, the installed capacity of solar thermal power generation was 1 million kilowatts, the distributed photovoltaic power generation system was approximately 10 million kilowatts. The investment in photovoltaic power plants is estimated at an average of 10,000 yuan per kilowatt, and the distributed photovoltaic system is estimated at 15,000 yuan per kilowatt. The total investment demand is approximately 250 billion yuan.
titlelist: Investment estimation and analysis of environmental and social impacts, investment estimation.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Development Plan for Solar Power Generation during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (excerpt) (National Energy Administration [2012] No. 194) (National Energy Administration/July 7, 2012)
content: With the increasing requirements for environmental protection and the accelerated progress of solar power generation technology, the early investment, high energy consumption, and high pollution Siemens process for producing polycrystalline silicon are gradually being phased out. The waste liquid and waste gas such as silicon tetrachloride and hydrogen chloride have been recycled and harmless through improved Siemens process or silane process. Photovoltaic cells made of crystalline silicon can achieve environmentally friendly large-scale production by increasing added value. The construction of photovoltaic power plants mainly affects the natural and ecological environment through surface damage, dust, and noise. The environmental impact during the construction period will disappear with the completion of the project. Solar power plants do not emit any pollutants during operation, and they consume minimal industrial water. The production of domestic sewage and waste is also minimal, resulting in minimal environmental impact. Solar thermal power plant projects require water consumption, but the use of air cooling technology can minimize water usage. The construction of solar power plants is concentrated in unused land in the western regions. By selecting suitable locations, various environmental protection areas can be avoided, which not only has no adverse impact on the natural environment and production and life but also to some extent reduces surface water evaporation, which is beneficial for sand control and ecological environment protection. The solar power generation industry involves a wide range of fields and has a long industrial chain, which can drive the development of related industries. It is estimated that by 2015, the number of people employed in the solar power generation industry could reach 500,000. By developing the solar power generation industry, advantageous industrial clusters and concentrated areas for development and utilization can be formed in several regions, which will effectively promote the economic development and transformation of these regions and promote their sustainable development.
titlelist: Investment estimation and analysis of environmental and social impacts, analysis of environmental and social impacts.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: Our country's research and development of large-scale polycrystalline silicon production processes with independent intellectual property rights is still in its early stages. There is still a significant gap between production costs, product quality, comprehensive utilization, and international advanced levels. The development of key supporting materials for solar cells in our country is also relatively backward. Some key supporting materials, such as silver paste, silver-aluminum paste materials, TPT backsheet materials, EVA encapsulation materials, etc., still rely heavily on imports. It is necessary to accelerate technological research and development, improve quality, achieve localization of key supporting materials, and further reduce the production costs of solar cells.
titlelist: Problems and needs, solar silicon materials and key supporting materials.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: In terms of high-efficiency crystalline silicon cells, developed countries have achieved commercialization efficiency of over 20%, while China is still in a blank state. In the field of thin-film cells, there is a gap between amorphous silicon/microcrystalline silicon tandem cells and internationally industrialized cadmium telluride thin-film and copper indium gallium selenide thin-film cells, as there are no commercial production lines in China yet. The new types of cells, such as thin-film silicon/crystalline silicon heterojunction cells, high-concentration photovoltaic cells, and flexible cells, have not yet mastered the pilot and production technologies that have been industrialized internationally. Dye-sensitized cells also need to be developed into practical products. There is also a certain gap between China and the international level in the research of cutting-edge technologies such as full-spectrum cells and black silicon cells.
titlelist: Problems and needs, solar cells

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: There is a considerable gap between the performance of key production equipment for crystalline silicon solar cells and the international advanced level, and the degree of automation of complete production lines is low. The key equipment and production lines for thin-film solar cells mainly rely on imports. There is a lack of domestically integrated solutions for the entire production line.
titlelist: Problems and needs, production equipment

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: There is a certain gap between the design integration, key equipment, power prediction, and grid connection technology of large-scale grid-connected photovoltaic power plants, photovoltaic microgrids, regional building photovoltaic systems, and photovoltaic DC grid connection systems and advanced foreign technology. There is also a lack of experience in comprehensive utilization.
titlelist: Problems and needs, photovoltaic system

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Currently, our country does not have any commercially operated solar thermal power plants. There is a lack of system design capabilities and integration technologies, and high-temperature concentration, heat absorption, and heat storage technologies are not mature. Regional solar building heating technology, medium-temperature solar technology, and industrial energy-saving applications are still blank areas in our country.
titlelist: Problems and needs, solar thermal utilization

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Our country needs further improvement in standard battery measurement, battery and component testing, etc. The capabilities of system simulation and testing are just beginning, and research testing on large inverters and outdoor empirical research testing demonstration bases are still blank.
titlelist: Problems and needs, testing and platform

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, there will be comprehensive breakthroughs in photovoltaic technology, promoting the large-scale application of solar power generation. The efficiency of crystalline silicon cells will be above 20%, while silicon-based thin-film cells will have an efficiency of over 10%. Cadmium telluride, copper indium gallium selenide thin-film cells will achieve commercial applications. The installation cost will be 12,000 to 13,000 yuan/kW, and grid-connected photovoltaic systems for end-users will achieve grid parity. The grid-connected photovoltaic system for public power grids will have an electricity price lower than 0.8 yuan/kWh. Key components and design integration technologies for various photovoltaic microgrid systems will be mastered, and demonstration applications will be realized. Solar thermal power generation will have the design capability and complete equipment supply capacity to establish 100 MW-level solar thermal power plants. The installation cost for non-thermal storage power plants will be 16,000 yuan/kW, while those with 8-hour thermal storage will be 22,000 yuan/kW, with an electricity price lower than 0.9 yuan/kWh. Breakthroughs will be made in the application technology of medium-temperature solar thermal energy in industrial energy conservation and long-term thermal storage technology for solar building heating, and demonstration applications will be carried out. A preliminary national standard system for solar power generation and a technology product testing platform will be established, forming a complete industrial chain technology service system for solar energy technology research and development, equipment manufacturing, system integration, engineering construction, operation, and maintenance. (1) The production cost of polycrystalline silicon materials will be reduced by 30%, and the localization rate of supporting materials will reach 50%. (2) The complete set of equipment for crystalline silicon solar cells will be localized, and the integrated turnkey engineering capability with independent intellectual property rights for crystalline silicon will be achieved. (3) The average efficiency of monocrystalline silicon cell industrialization will exceed 20%, and the average efficiency of amorphous silicon thin-film cell industrialization with independent intellectual property rights will exceed 10%. (4) Breakthroughs will be made in the key technologies and equipment for grid-connected photovoltaic power plants with a capacity of 100 MW, grid-connected photovoltaic systems for eco-residential areas with multiple access points at a capacity of 100 MW, 10 MW-level photovoltaic microgrid systems, and regional building photovoltaic systems. (5) Breakthroughs will be made in the key technologies and equipment for 100 MW-level solar thermal power generation, and core product production lines, testing platforms, and demonstration systems will be established. Station design, optimization, and operation technologies will be mastered through system integration. (6) Breakthroughs will be made in seasonal thermal storage heating technology and equipment for regional buildings. (7) Solar medium-temperature utilization technology will be improved, and industrial applications will be demonstrated. (8) Breakthroughs will be made in distributed solar power generation technology. (9) An experimental research and demonstration base for solar energy utilization will be established. (10) Progress will be made in innovative research on grid-connected photovoltaic DC power generation, solar thermal power generation, and complementary power generation with fossil fuels.
titlelist: Guiding ideology and objectives, planning goals.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guo Ke Fa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: In the photovoltaic industry chain, silicon materials mainly involve the purification of polycrystalline silicon for solar cells and downstream processes such as silicon wafers, monocrystalline and polycrystalline ingots. Developing clean production technologies for high-efficiency, energy-saving, and low-cost polycrystalline silicon materials, as well as key supporting material preparation technologies for solar cells, will help reduce the production cost of photovoltaic cells and achieve environmentally friendly silicon material production. Relevant content includes: improved Siemens method, silane method, physical and chemical metallurgy method for polycrystalline silicon material production technology, key supporting material preparation technologies such as silver paste, silver-aluminum paste, TPT backsheet material, EVA encapsulation material, TCO glass substrate for thin-film cells, etc.
titlelist: Key direction, materials direction

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: The improvement of solar power generation efficiency and the reduction of production costs will directly affect the cost of electricity generation. Monocrystalline silicon cells are being improved in three directions: high efficiency, thinning, and low cost. Low-energy, low-cost thin-film solar cell technology is striving towards high efficiency, stability, and long lifespan. Relevant content includes: industrial manufacturing technology for low-cost ultra-thin monocrystalline silicon cells with an efficiency of over 20%, industrial manufacturing technology for thin-film cells with an efficiency of over 10%, high-concentration photovoltaic cells and key power generation technologies, pilot manufacturing technology for flexible substrate silicon-based thin-film solar cells, pilot manufacturing technology for non-vacuum deposition flexible CIGS thin-film solar cells, cutting-edge preparation technologies for new types of solar cells such as quantum dot cells, thermophotovoltaic cells, silicon sphere cells, polycrystalline silicon thin-film cells, organic cells, etc., and high-temperature direct-pass vacuum tube and trough-type concentrated solar heat collection experimental platform.
titlelist: Key direction, device direction

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: The complete set of key technologies and equipment for the breakthrough in the large-scale utilization of photovoltaics, the construction of various forms of photovoltaic power generation demonstration projects, can effectively promote the large-scale application of photovoltaic power generation technology in our country; carry out key equipment and system integration technology research on solar thermal utilization, relying on the construction of large-scale demonstration projects, can promote the development of solar thermal utilization technology and industry. The relevant content includes: 100MW-level grid-connected photovoltaic power station system and equipment technology, 100MW-level urban multi-point access ecological residential area photovoltaic system technology, 10MW-level photovoltaic microgrid system and equipment technology, regional high-density photovoltaic building grid-connected system and equipment technology, 10MW-level sub-high-parameter solar thermal power generation technology, key technology for silicon-based high-reliability photovoltaic building integration, large-scale multi-energy complementary photovoltaic grid-connected system technology, photovoltaic DC grid-connected power generation technology, distributed solar thermal power generation technology, solar thermal storage technology, application technology of solar medium-temperature heat in industrial energy conservation, etc.
titlelist: Key direction, system direction

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Solar photovoltaic production equipment is the foundation that runs through the entire industry chain. Currently, there is an urgent need to break through the bottleneck of core equipment in certain links of the industry chain and improve the performance of key production equipment and the automation level of complete production lines. Relevant content includes: integrated technology for complete sets of equipment for crystalline silicon solar cells, with an efficiency of over 10% and an annual production capacity of 40MW; manufacturing technology for silicon-based thin-film solar cells with an efficiency of over 10% and an annual production capacity of 30MW; manufacturing technology for cadmium telluride thin-film solar cells with an efficiency of over 8% and an annual production capacity of 5MW; manufacturing technology for dye-sensitized solar cells with an efficiency of over 8% and an annual production capacity of 5MW; pilot manufacturing technology for thin-film silicon/crystalline silicon heterojunction cells; manufacturing equipment technology for high-reliability silicon-based BIPV series components, etc.
titlelist: Key direction, equipment direction

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: (1) Master the key technologies and equipment for solar energy materials, devices, system core technology, and industrial production lines. (2) Breakthrough key technologies and equipment for large-scale utilization of solar power generation systems. (3) Establish national key laboratories, engineering centers, and industrialization bases. (4) Improve the testing technology and certification standards for solar energy products and systems. (5) Integrate new technologies and equipment for demonstration of solar energy development and utilization.
titlelist: Key tasks, key tasks

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, the field of solar energy technology was divided into four research directions and five key tasks. A total of 19 research contents were identified, including 2 in the materials direction, 8 in the device direction, 9 in the system direction, and the remaining distributed in the equipment direction.
titlelist: Key tasks, task decomposition

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: (1) Key technology research on efficient and energy-saving large-scale clean production of polycrystalline silicon materials. Enhance and improve Siemens' large-scale low-cost clean production technology, break through the scale production of silane process, and explore low-cost new process technologies such as physical and chemical metallurgy methods. (2) Research on key supporting material preparation technology for solar cells. Breakthroughs in key supporting material preparation technologies for solar cells, such as silver paste, silver-aluminum paste, TPT backsheet materials, EVA encapsulation materials, and TCO glass substrates for thin-film cells.
titlelist: Key tasks, task decomposition, material direction

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: (1) Pilot and cutting-edge technology research on new types of solar cells. Construct a pilot demonstration line for thin-film silicon/crystalline silicon heterojunction solar cells with an annual production capacity of 2MW, achieving a pilot efficiency of 18.5%; construct a pilot demonstration line for roll-to-roll manufacturing of flexible silicon thin-film solar cells with an annual production capacity of 1MW, achieving a stable cell efficiency of 10%; master the technology of high-concentration solar cells and applications, and construct a pilot line with an annual production capacity of 5MW, with cell efficiency exceeding 35%. (2) Key technology research and demonstration production line for the industrialization of low-cost crystalline silicon cells with an efficiency of over 20%. Achieve an average efficiency of 20% for monocrystalline silicon cells and 19% for polycrystalline silicon cells in industrialization, and realize domestic production of major new technology equipment; reduce the cost of crystalline silicon cells to 7 yuan/W and reduce the thickness of silicon wafers to 160 micrometers; promote large-scale industrialization of high-efficiency battery technology nationwide and achieve an annual production capacity of 100MW. (3) Research and development of complete manufacturing process technology for large-scale copper indium gallium selenide (sulfur) thin-film solar cells. Break through the key equipment design and manufacturing bottlenecks in the production line of large-scale copper indium gallium selenide (sulfur) thin-film solar cells, develop internationally advanced complete process technology, construct a roll-to-roll flexible substrate CIGS thin-film solar cell production line with an annual production capacity of 5MW, MW-level flexible copper indium gallium selenide sulfur thin-film solar cell production line, electrochemical deposition CIGS thin-film solar cell demonstration production line, coating-heat treatment CIGS solar cell demonstration production line, and collector tube CIGS thin-film solar cell demonstration production line, and form batch production. (4) Research and development of complete manufacturing process technology for large-scale thin-film solar cells with an efficiency of over 10%. Develop key equipment for an annual production capacity of 40MW silicon-based thin-film solar cell production line and an annual production capacity of 30MW cadmium telluride thin-film solar cell production line with independent intellectual property rights, complete the research and development of complete process technology for silicon-based thin-film solar cells and cadmium telluride thin-film solar cells, achieve an efficiency of over 10% for industrialized components, and reduce production costs to below 5 yuan/W. (5) Research and development of complete manufacturing technology for an annual production capacity of 5MW dye-sensitized solar cell components with an efficiency of 8%. Master the batch production process and synthesis technology of key materials such as dye sensitizers, electrolytes, and photoanodes, develop key equipment for batch production of materials for dye-sensitized solar cells; solve key technologies and production process equipment for MW-level dye-sensitized solar cells, master large-area battery industrial production technology, and construct a dye-sensitized solar cell production line with an annual production capacity of 5MW. (6) Research and development of complete manufacturing process technology for large-scale thin-film solar cells with an efficiency of over 10% using amorphous/microcrystalline silicon layering. Research on technologies such as high-efficiency amorphous silicon materials, silicon thin-film materials, and ZnO transparent conductive thin-film preparation, construct an annual production capacity of 50MW silicon amorphous/microcrystalline silicon layering thin-film solar cell production line, with stable module efficiency of over 10% and cost below 5 yuan/W. (7) Research and demonstration of complete manufacturing process technology for high-concentration solar cells. Master the manufacturing process technology of GaInP/GaInAs/Ge triple-junction solar cells, construct a pilot production line for concentrated multi-junction solar cells with an annual production capacity of over 5MW, as well as a reliability testing platform and outdoor testing platform for concentrated solar cells; master the design technology of 1200x concentrated photovoltaic systems, and develop high-power CPV grid-connected inverters. (8) Research and demonstration of solar trough collector power generation technology. Focus on the commercialization of trough concentration heat collection technology, break through key processes such as high-temperature vacuum heat collection tubes and high-precision concentrator molding, batch production technology, and key equipment, and establish a MW-level trough concentration heat collection integrated experimental demonstration system.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Special Plan for the Development of Solar Power Technology during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Guokefa Ji [2012] No. 198) (Ministry of Science and Technology/March 27, 2012)
content: (1) Research and development of large-scale photovoltaic grid-connected system design integration technology. Aimed at the technical research of 100MW-level large-scale grid-connected photovoltaic power plants, mastering the unit design integration and engineering technology, as well as key equipment for 100MW-level grid-connected photovoltaic power plants, regional high-density multi-access point building photovoltaic, dual-mode building photovoltaic system integration technology, and key equipment. Safety grid connection and power quality regulation technology, power prediction and ecological environment monitoring technology in high-altitude areas, and establishment of empirical research demonstration bases. (2) Research and demonstration of high stability photovoltaic microgrid system technology. Breakthrough in stability technology for photovoltaic multi-energy complementary microgrids, mastering system integration and engineering technology, stability control technology, and power quality regulation technology. Completion of microgrid energy management system, power quality regulation system, and microgrid-type photovoltaic power plant automated online measurement and control system. Construction of 10MW-level solar/water complementary microgrid system, multi-MW-level multi-energy complementary microgrid system, and 100MW-level multi-point access regional photovoltaic demonstration system. (3) Research and development of high-power photovoltaic control/inverter key technology suitable for microgrid operation. Breakthrough in key technologies of self-synchronized voltage source inverters and efficient photovoltaic charging controllers, mastering the technology of stable parallel operation of self-synchronized voltage source inverters and efficient intelligent photovoltaic charging technology combined with maximum power tracking. Completion of product research on self-synchronized voltage source inverters and efficient photovoltaic charging controllers, with batch production capabilities. Proposal of improved self-synchronized voltage source grid-connected inverter droop controller implementation method, and completion of industrial research on self-synchronized voltage source inverters and efficient photovoltaic charging controllers. (4) Research and demonstration of 10MW-level solar tower thermal power generation technology. Aimed at high-parameter, high-efficiency, and stable output solar thermal power generation technology, breakthrough in key technologies and equipment for high-parameter molten salt absorption-heat storage tower power generation, and establishment of a 10MW demonstration molten salt tower power plant. (5) Research and demonstration of large-scale multi-energy complementary photovoltaic grid-connected system technology. Aimed at the complementary grid-connected power generation applications of large-scale photovoltaic power plants with large-scale wind farms, hydroelectric power stations, and solar thermal power stations, breakthrough in design integration and grid-connected technology of complementary power generation systems, various power prediction technologies, joint control technologies, and energy optimization management technologies. Establishment of various complementary power generation system demonstrations. (6) Key technology and demonstration of silicon-based high-reliability photovoltaic building integration (BIPV). Aimed at solar photovoltaic building integration components and application technology, breakthrough in key process technology for manufacturing equipment and production lines of silicon-based high-reliability BIPV components, completion of industrial manufacturing of BIPV components, and formation of scale application standards and specifications. (7) Distributed solar thermal power generation technology. Aimed at 100kW-level distributed solar thermal power generation technology research, breakthrough in design and manufacturing technology of major distributed power generation equipment such as organic Rankine cycle, dish Stirling, single-screw expander, and solar thermal semiconductor power generation technology, and conducting empirical tests and demonstrations. (8) Research and large-scale application of solar thermal energy storage technology. Mastering the design, preparation, heat loss suppression of low-temperature range (20-95°C) and high-temperature range (above 450°C) thermal storage materials, regional centralized heating system integration, energy transmission and distribution management technology, and forming demonstrations of distributed and large-capacity centralized solar thermal energy storage and heating systems. (9) Medium-temperature solar energy technology and industrial applications. Aimed at practical and industrial technology research for medium-temperature solar thermal utilization, breakthrough in technology and equipment for medium-temperature collectors, medium-temperature thermal storage, solar air conditioning, and system integration, and establishment of medium-temperature solar energy system applications in the fields of industry, agriculture, and production. During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, innovative exploratory research is also needed in new technologies and systems such as photovoltaic DC grid-connected power generation.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: During the 11th Five-Year Plan period, China's solar cell production developed rapidly with an average annual growth rate exceeding 100%. From 2007 to 2010, it maintained the world's top position in production for four consecutive years. In 2010, the solar cell production reached approximately 10GW, accounting for 50% of the global total production. Over 90% of China's solar cell products are exported, with the export value reaching 20.2 billion US dollars in 2010.
titlelist: Review of the development during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan period: an overview of China's photovoltaic industry. The industry has rapidly expanded in scale, and its market share remains among the top in the world.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: During the 11th Five-Year Plan period, the annual production of polycrystalline silicon in China increased from a few hundred tons to 45,000 tons. The self-sufficiency rate of raw materials in the photovoltaic industry has increased from almost zero to around 50%, and a production value scale of several billion yuan has been formed. Domestic polycrystalline silicon backbone enterprises have mastered the key technology of large-scale production using the improved Siemens method, and the stability of large-scale production has gradually improved.
titlelist: Review of the 11th Five-Year Plan development, an overview of China's photovoltaic industry, mastering key material production technology, and gradually solidifying the industrial foundation.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: At the end of the 11th Five-Year Plan, China's crystalline silicon solar cells accounted for over 95% of the total production of solar cells. The quality of solar cell products has been improving year by year, especially in terms of conversion efficiency. The performance of products from key enterprises has grown rapidly, with monocrystalline silicon solar cells achieving a conversion efficiency of 17-19%, polycrystalline silicon solar cells achieving a conversion efficiency of 15-17%, and new types of cells such as thin film achieving a conversion efficiency of approximately 6-8%.
titlelist: Review of the development during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan period: an overview of China's photovoltaic industry, mainstream product technology in sync with the world, and steady improvement in product quality.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The photovoltaic industry has achieved significant energy saving and emission reduction results, and the comprehensive utilization level of by-products has steadily improved, with an overall substantial increase in resource utilization efficiency. In 2006, the average consumption level per kilogram of polycrystalline silicon produced was: industrial silicon 1.8-2.0 kilograms, liquid chlorine 1.8 kilograms, comprehensive electricity consumption 300-350 kilowatt-hours. By 2010, these levels had decreased to: industrial silicon 1.3-1.4 kilograms, liquid chlorine 1.0 kilogram, comprehensive electricity consumption 160-180 kilowatt-hours. Some key enterprises have reached 130-150 kilowatt-hours per kilogram. The amount of polycrystalline silicon used to produce crystalline silicon solar cells decreased from 11 grams/watt in 2006 to 7-8 grams/watt in 2010.
titlelist: Review of the 11th Five-Year Plan development, an overview of China's photovoltaic industry, significant energy-saving and emission reduction effects, and a substantial increase in resource utilization efficiency.

We have also launched two batches of photovoltaic power plant franchise bidding projects with a total capacity of 290 megawatts (MW). content: During the 11th Five-Year Plan period, China's photovoltaic industry broke through development bottlenecks such as materials, markets, and talent, and the industry scale rapidly expanded, forming a basically complete upstream and downstream industrial chain. name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The global crisis of conventional energy supply shortage is becoming increasingly severe. The extensive development and utilization of fossil energy has become one of the main causes of environmental pollution and deterioration of the human living environment. The search for emerging energy sources has become a hot topic worldwide. Among various new energy sources, solar photovoltaic power generation has the advantages of being pollution-free, sustainable, abundant, widely distributed, and versatile in application. It has received high attention from countries around the world. China's photovoltaic industry has a good development foundation in terms of manufacturing level, industrial system, and technological research and development. The domestic and international market prospects are generally optimistic. As long as we seize the development opportunities, accelerate transformation and upgrading, we will surely usher in a broader development space in the future.
titlelist: The '12th Five-Year Plan' faces challenges, and China's photovoltaic industry faces vast development opportunities.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: From a global perspective, photovoltaic power generation still needs some time to become competitive in terms of price. The recent growth in demand for solar cells mainly comes from government policies and subsidies for the photovoltaic industry in various countries. The continued growth of the market will also promote the expansion of the industry and the reduction of product costs, thereby facilitating the healthy development of the photovoltaic industry. Currently, the domestic policy system supporting the application of photovoltaics and the long-term interactive mechanism promoting the sustainable development of photovoltaic power generation are still being established. Most solar cell products are exported to overseas markets, and the development of the industry is greatly affected by financial crises and changes in overseas markets. The high dependence on external markets is not conducive to sustained and healthy development.
titlelist: 'The 12th Five-Year Plan' faces a situation where the photovoltaic industry, policies, and market urgently need to strengthen interaction.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: In recent years, there has been a turbulent situation in global economic development, with some countries adjusting their new energy policies. Subsidies have been reduced one after another, which has had a significant impact on the development of China's photovoltaic industry. At the same time, there have been several trade disputes related to the photovoltaic industry in countries such as Europe and the United States, and similar disputes are likely to continue to occur in the future. The main reasons are as follows: First, China has a clear cost advantage in solar cells, which puts pressure on foreign products. Second, the domestic photovoltaic market has not yet been launched on a large scale, and the products are mainly exported, which may raise concerns about dumping. Third, China's relevant standard system is not yet perfect, and there are issues of uneven product quality levels.
titlelist: 'The 12th Five-Year Plan' is facing a situation, facing severe challenges from international economic turbulence and trade protection.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The global photovoltaic industry has been experiencing rapid technological advancements: the conversion efficiency of crystalline silicon cells has increased by an average of one percentage point per year; the level of thin-film cell technology continues to improve; emerging technologies such as nanomaterial cells are developing rapidly; and solar cell production and testing equipment are constantly being upgraded. However, the domestic photovoltaic industry still lags behind in many aspects, facing increasing international competitive pressure: key technologies for polycrystalline silicon are still behind international advanced levels, high-end equipment for crystalline silicon cell production still needs to be imported, and the process and equipment level of thin-film cells are significantly behind.
titlelist: The '12th Five-Year Plan' faces a situation where new technologies and new processes are rapidly evolving, and international competition is intensifying.

In addition to large-scale grid-connected photovoltaic power stations, photovoltaic power generation systems combined with buildings, small-scale photovoltaic systems, and off-grid photovoltaic systems will also rise rapidly. The cost of solar cells and photovoltaic systems continues to decrease and approaches the cost of conventional power generation, which will still be the theme of the development of the photovoltaic industry. From silicon materials to components and supporting parts, they will all face market pressure for rapid price reduction. Solar cells will continue to develop towards high efficiency and low cost.
titlelist: The '12th Five-Year Plan' faces challenges, with continuous expansion of market applications, and cost reduction remains the main theme of the industry.

titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, development goals, photovoltaic power generation cost goals.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Develop clean, safe, low-energy consumption, high-purity, and large-scale polycrystalline silicon production technology, improve the comprehensive utilization rate of by-products, and narrow the gap with international advanced production levels. Achieve innovative development in solar cell production technology, encourage large-scale production, and enhance the core competitiveness of the photovoltaic industry. Promote energy conservation and emission reduction in the industry. Pay close attention to the progress of clean and environmentally friendly new photovoltaic cell and material technologies, and strengthen technological research and development.
titlelist: The main tasks of the 12th Five-Year Plan are to promote technological progress and achieve transformation and upgrading.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: With the goal of improving product quality and photovoltaic conversion efficiency, reducing production energy consumption, supporting the research and industrialization of key production equipment for polycrystalline silicon, silicon ingots/wafers, solar cells and modules, and thin-film solar cells, and promoting the application of localized equipment. Promote technical cooperation and communication between equipment companies and photovoltaic product companies.
titlelist: The main tasks of the 12th Five-Year Plan are to improve the research and development and application level of domestic equipment and integrated technology.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Strongly support the research and industrialization of low-cost, high conversion efficiency, and long-life crystalline silicon solar cells, aiming to reduce the cost of battery products and the final cost of electricity generation, and strive to achieve grid parity as soon as possible. Promote technological progress and industrialization of silicon-based thin-film, copper indium gallium tin thin-film, and other types of batteries, and improve the conversion efficiency of thin-film batteries.
titlelist: The main tasks of the 12th Five-Year Plan are to improve the performance of solar cells and continuously reduce product costs.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Actively promote the formulation and implementation of internet electricity pricing policies, and strengthen the research and development and application of photovoltaic products in industries such as agriculture, transportation, and construction. Support the establishment of a number of distributed photovoltaic power stations, off-grid application systems, photovoltaic building integrated (BIPV) systems, small-scale photovoltaic systems, and photovoltaic-based multi-energy complementary systems. Encourage the construction and application of large-scale grid-connected photovoltaic power stations, and promote the improvement of technical systems and management mechanisms that adapt to the characteristics of photovoltaic power generation.
titlelist: The main tasks of the 12th Five-Year Plan are to promote the application of photovoltaic products and expand the photovoltaic power generation market.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Establish and improve supporting service systems such as standards, patents, testing, and certification, strengthen the management and services of the photovoltaic industry, and support industry self-discipline and collaboration. Actively participate in the formulation of international standards, establish and improve a photovoltaic national/industry standard system that is in line with China's national conditions, including product standards for polycrystalline silicon materials, cells/modules, standards for photovoltaic production equipment, and acceptance standards for photovoltaic systems, etc. Accelerate the construction of domestic certification, testing, and other public service platforms.
titlelist: The main task of the 12th Five-Year Plan is to improve the construction of the supporting service system for the photovoltaic industry.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Support low-energy, low-cost solar-grade polysilicon production technology. Based on existing foundations, through further research, system improvements, and enhancements, support the development of stable electronic-grade polysilicon production technology and establish a thousand-ton electronic-grade polysilicon production line. Breakthroughs in large-scale purification with high efficiency and energy savings, efficient hydrogen recovery and purification, efficient chemical vapor deposition, comprehensive utilization of polysilicon by-products, and other equipment and process technologies. Construct a tens of thousands of tons high-purity polysilicon production line with comprehensive energy consumption less than 120 kWh/kg.
titlelist: The key focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is high-purity polycrystalline silicon.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Support efficient, low-cost, large-size ingot casting technology, with a focus on developing quasi-monocrystalline ingot casting technology. Breakthroughs in key technologies for slicing below 150-160 micrometers, such as diamond wire cutting technology, to improve silicon wafer quality and yield per unit of silicon material, and reduce silicon material cutting losses.
titlelist: The key development focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan, silicon ingots/silicon wafers.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Vigorously develop the research and industrialization of high conversion efficiency and long-life crystalline silicon solar cell technology. Focus on supporting the preparation technology of low reflectivity velvet surface, selective emitter technology, and subsequent electrode alignment technology, plasma passivation technology, low-temperature electrode technology, and research and application of full back contact technology. Pay attention to key technologies for complete sets of new types of solar cells such as thin film silicon/crystalline silicon heterojunction.
titlelist: The key focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is the development of crystalline silicon solar cells.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Focus on the development of stacked and multi-junction thin-film batteries combining amorphous and microcrystalline phases. Reduce the light-induced degradation of thin-film batteries and encourage companies to research and develop large-area, high-efficiency silicon thin-film batteries of 5.5 generations and above. Develop continuous roll-to-roll production processes for flexible silicon-based thin-film solar cells. Keep up with the industrialization process of copper indium gallium selenide and organic thin-film batteries, and develop and master low-cost, non-vacuum copper indium gallium tin thin-film battery preparation technology, magnetron sputtering battery preparation technology, vacuum co-evaporation battery preparation technology, and key processes for large-scale manufacturing.
titlelist: The focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is thin-film batteries.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Focus on the development of industrialized production technology for high-concentration photovoltaic compound solar cells, with a concentration ratio of over 500 times. The efficiency of the industrially produced cells exceeds 35% under non-concentrated conditions and exceeds 40% under concentrated conditions. The conversion efficiency of the substrate-stripping high-concentration photovoltaic cells exceeds 25% under non-concentrated conditions. Breakthroughs in high-concentration solar cell substrate glass technology, high-efficiency high-concentration compound solar cell technology, high-concentration photovoltaic cell testing and analysis, stability control technology, etc., and timely development of supporting equipment such as Fresnel lenses and parabolic mirrors.
titlelist: The focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is on the development of high-efficiency concentrated photovoltaic solar cells.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Double-glazed BIPV modules, hollow glass modules, etc. installed on the roofs of buildings, agricultural greenhouses, and curtain walls, solve the problems of light transmission and heat insulation of BIPV modules, and design aesthetically pleasing, practical BIPV modules that can be directly used as building materials and components. Expand the application scope of building-attached photovoltaic (BAPV) modules.
titlelist: The key focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is the development of BIPV components, with a particular emphasis on the production technology of BIPV components that can be directly integrated with buildings, as well as those used in factories.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Supporting production equipment for polycrystalline silicon, such as restoration and hydrogenation equipment, large-size, low-energy consumption, fully automatic monocrystalline furnaces, ton-level polycrystalline silicon ingot furnaces, large-size, ultra-thin silicon wafer multi-wire cutting machines, silicon wafer automatic sorting machines, and other key production equipment. Supporting multi-slot velvet cleaning equipment, fully automatic flat-panel plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), laser etching machines, dry etching machines, ion implantation machines, fully automatic printing machines, rapid sintering furnaces, and other crystalline silicon solar cell production line equipment and PECVD and other thin-film solar cell production equipment. Promoting low-energy consumption, high efficiency, automation, and integration of production processes in photovoltaic production equipment.
titlelist: The focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is on the development of specialized equipment for photovoltaic production.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Localization of glass, ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA) adhesive, backboard, electronic slurry, wire cutting fluid, etc.
titlelist: The key development focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is to achieve supporting auxiliary materials such as crucibles, high-purity graphite, high-purity quartz sand, carbon-carbon composite materials.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: 'Taiwan, including the testing of polycrystalline silicon, battery cells and modules, thin-film batteries, and the acceptance of photovoltaic system engineering. Support the development of industry-wide research on common issues on relevant service platforms, the formulation and promotion of industry standards, and the research and development of key common technologies.'
titlelist: The focus of the 12th Five-Year Plan is to support the construction of national-level photovoltaic application system testing, certification, and other public services for capable enterprises and institutions.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Promote the formulation and implementation of detailed rules for the implementation of internet electricity prices, continue to implement support measures such as the Golden Sun Project, encourage communication and cooperation between photovoltaic enterprises and the power system, and accelerate the launch of the domestic photovoltaic market. Adhere to the combination of grid-connected power generation and off-grid applications, with the goal of going to rural areas, enriching the people, supporting border areas, and reclaiming wasteland, support the application of small-scale photovoltaic systems, off-grid application systems, and photovoltaic power generation systems combined with buildings, and develop diversified photovoltaic products. Actively expand the domestic photovoltaic market through reasonable electricity price standards, moderate financial subsidies, and active financial support.
titlelist: Policy measures, actively cultivating diverse markets, promoting the healthy development of industries.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Support the transformation and upgrading of photovoltaic enterprises, support backbone enterprises that possess independent technology through technological transformation and other means, and consolidate and improve their core competitiveness. Increase support for technological innovation in the photovoltaic industry, focusing on supporting the research and industrialization of projects related to energy-saving and consumption reduction of polycrystalline silicon, comprehensive utilization of by-products, high-efficiency and high-quality solar cell technologies, and low-cost new process technologies. Strengthen the integration of industry, academia, and research, support the research and development of key common technologies, and comprehensively improve the technological level of localized photovoltaic equipment. Increase efforts in talent cultivation, support the establishment of enterprise technology research and development centers and post-doctoral research stations.
titlelist: Policy measures to support enterprises' independent innovation and enhance the core competitiveness of industries.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Establish and improve the photovoltaic industry organization, promote self-discipline management within the industry, enhance industry communication and collaboration, reflect the industry's development vision, and create a domestic photovoltaic industry cooperation and innovation platform. Fully leverage market mechanisms, with industry organizations as the link, enterprises as the main body, and market orientation, to enhance the industry's ability to respond to international competition and market risks. Strengthen international exchanges and cooperation, optimize the industrial development environment, improve export risk protection mechanisms, encourage enterprises to actively seek overseas funding, and consolidate and expand international markets.
titlelist: Policy measures, strengthen industry organization construction, actively participate in international competition.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Build a new type of power system with gradually increasing proportion of new energy, and promote the optimization of clean power resource allocation on a large scale. Greatly enhance the comprehensive regulation capacity of the power system, accelerate the construction of flexible regulation power sources, guide self-owned power plants, traditional high-energy-consuming industrial loads, interruptible loads in commercial and industrial sectors, electric vehicle charging networks, virtual power plants, and other participants in system regulation, construct a strong and intelligent power grid, and improve the level of power grid security. Actively develop new energy + energy storage, integrated generation-transmission-load-storage, and multi-energy complementarity, and support the rational allocation of energy storage systems for distributed new energy. Formulate a long-term development plan for the next round of pumped storage power stations and improve policies and mechanisms to promote the development of pumped storage. Accelerate the demonstration and promotion of new energy storage applications. Deepen the reform of the power system and accelerate the construction of a unified national electricity market system. By 2025, the installed capacity of new energy storage will reach over 30 million kilowatts. By 2030, the installed capacity of pumped storage power stations will reach approximately 120 million kilowatts, and provincial-level power grids will have a peak load response capacity of over 5%.
