titlelist: Key tasks, energy green low-carbon transformation action, accelerate the construction of a new power system.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Optimize the spatial layout of new infrastructure, coordinate and plan the scientific allocation of data centers and other new infrastructure, and avoid low-level redundant construction. Optimize the energy structure of new infrastructure, adopt direct current power supply, distributed energy storage, photovoltaic + energy storage and other models, explore diversified energy supply, and increase the proportion of non-fossil energy consumption. Benchmarking international advanced levels, accelerate the improvement of equipment energy efficiency standards for communication, computing, storage, transmission, etc., enhance access thresholds, and eliminate outdated equipment and technologies. Strengthen the energy management of new infrastructure, include all data centers with an annual comprehensive energy consumption exceeding 10,000 tons of standard coal into the key energy-consuming unit energy consumption online monitoring system, and carry out energy measurement audits. Promote the green upgrading and transformation of existing facilities, actively promote the use of efficient refrigeration, advanced ventilation, waste heat utilization, intelligent energy control, and other technologies to improve facility energy efficiency.
titlelist: Key tasks, energy-saving and carbon reduction efficiency action, strengthening energy-saving and carbon reduction in new infrastructure.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Deepen the application of renewable energy in buildings, promote the integration of photovoltaic power generation and construction. Actively promote clean heating in severely cold and cold regions, promote combined heat and power for centralized heating, accelerate the large-scale application of industrial waste heat for heating, actively and prudently carry out nuclear heating demonstrations, and promote clean and low-carbon heating methods such as heat pumps, biomass energy, geothermal energy, and solar energy according to local conditions. Guide scientific heating in hot summers and cold winters regions, and adopt clean and efficient heating methods according to local conditions. Improve the level of electrification in building terminals, and construct solar-energy storage-direct-current-flexible buildings that integrate photovoltaic power generation, energy storage, direct current distribution, and flexible power consumption. By 2025, the substitution rate of renewable energy in urban buildings will reach 8%, and the rooftop photovoltaic coverage rate of newly built public institutions and factory buildings will strive to reach 50%.
titlelist: Key tasks, urban and rural construction carbon peak action, accelerate the optimization of building energy structure.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Implement a batch of forward-looking and strategic national major frontier science and technology projects, and make breakthrough progress in the research and development of low-carbon, zero-carbon, and carbon-negative technology equipment. Focus on key areas such as green and intelligent development and clean and low-carbon utilization of fossil energy, large-scale utilization of renewable energy, new power systems, energy conservation, hydrogen energy, energy storage, power batteries, carbon dioxide capture, utilization, and storage, and deepen applied basic research. Actively develop advanced nuclear power technology and strengthen research on frontier disruptive technologies such as controlled nuclear fusion.
titlelist: Key tasks, green low-carbon technology innovation action, strengthening applied basic research.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Under the trend of global energy green and low-carbon transformation and development, it is necessary to accelerate the upgrading and replacement of traditional energy technology and equipment, strengthen the independent innovation of emerging energy technology and equipment, and significantly improve the level of clean and low-carbon energy technology. Relying on major equipment manufacturing and demonstration projects, we should promote key energy equipment technology research, experimental demonstration, and application promotion. Improve the energy equipment measurement, standards, testing, and certification system, and enhance the research and development, design, manufacturing, and complete set capabilities of major energy equipment. Focusing on the three major directions of energy security supply, clean energy development, and clean and efficient utilization of fossil energy, we should focus on breakthroughs in key technologies, materials, and components in energy equipment manufacturing, and promote technological innovation throughout the industry chain. Carry out major energy demonstration projects for advanced energy technology equipment, and improve the technological level of equipment in areas such as clean and intelligent coal mining and washing, deepwater and unconventional oil and gas exploration and development, oil and gas storage and transportation, clean and efficient coal-fired power generation, advanced nuclear power, renewable energy power generation, gas turbines, energy storage, advanced power grids, and deep processing of coal.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and rely on major energy projects to enhance the level of energy technology and equipment.

name: Solar Photovoltaic Industry '12th Five-Year Plan' for Development (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Currently, the world is at the intersection of a new technological revolution and an industrial revolution. Breakthroughs in new technologies are accelerating industrial transformation and promoting the emergence of new energy models and formats. Efforts are being made to promote the deep integration of energy technology with modern information, materials, and advanced manufacturing technology, relying on the Internet Plus smart energy construction, and exploring new models of energy production and consumption. The innovation and upgrading of intelligent photovoltaics are being accelerated, promoting the integration of photovoltaic power generation with agriculture, fisheries, animal husbandry, construction, and other industries, expanding new applications for complementary use of photovoltaic power generation, and forming new models for the extensive development and utilization of new energy. The technological equipment of the hydrogen energy industry chain, such as green hydrogen production, storage, transportation, and application, is being developed rapidly, promoting the development of the hydrogen fuel cell technology chain and the hydrogen fuel cell vehicle industry chain. Energy storage applications are being supported in various stages and scenarios of the energy industry, with a focus on promoting the complementary development of energy storage and renewable energy. Support is being provided for the construction of new energy microgrids, forming integrated local clean energy supply systems for generation, storage, and utilization. The promotion of new models of comprehensive energy services aims to achieve multiple complementary and synergistic high-efficiency energy at the terminal. With the guidance and driving force of pilot demonstration projects, various new energy technologies, models, and formats continue to emerge, forming a fusion effect for innovative energy development.
titlelist: Give full play to the role of science and technology innovation as the primary driving force, and support the development of new technologies, new models, and new formats.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-Driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: Promote the development of the entire value chain of power batteries. Encourage companies to improve their capabilities in securing key resources such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and platinum. Establish a sound modular standard system for power batteries, accelerate breakthroughs in key manufacturing equipment, and improve process levels and production efficiency. Improve the recycling, cascading utilization, and reutilization system of power batteries, and encourage the joint construction and sharing of recycling channels. Establish and improve management systems for power battery transportation, storage, maintenance, safety inspection, retirement and withdrawal, and recycling, and strengthen supervision throughout the lifecycle. Construct a battery traceability management platform to achieve full lifecycle traceability of power batteries. Support the innovative application of power battery products in energy storage, backup power, charging and swapping, and strengthen technological research and development in residual energy detection, residual value assessment, recombination utilization, and safety management. Optimize the layout of the recycling industry, promote the efficient extraction of valuable elements from scrapped power batteries, and promote the industrial resourceization, high value, and green development. Column 3: Construct an efficient recycling system for power batteries. Based on the sustainable development of new energy vehicles, implement an extended producer responsibility system and strengthen the management of power batteries for new energy vehicles.
titlelist: Building a new industrial ecosystem, promoting innovation and application of key systems.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: Promote efficient synergy between new energy vehicles and renewable energy. Promote the sharing and integration of information between new energy vehicles and meteorological and renewable energy power prediction and forecasting systems, coordinate the utilization of energy from new energy vehicles with wind power and photovoltaic power generation, and increase the proportion of renewable energy applications. Encourage the construction of multi-functional integrated stations for generation, storage, and charging/discharging (distributed photovoltaic power generation-energy storage system-charging/discharging). Support the commercial demonstration operation of fuel cell vehicles in areas with conditions.
titlelist: Promote the integrated development of industries, promote the integrated development of new energy vehicles and energy.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: Accelerate the large-scale application of new energy storage technologies. Vigorously promote the development of energy storage on the power supply side, reasonably allocate storage capacity, improve the output characteristics of new energy power stations, and support the rational allocation of distributed energy storage systems for new energy. Optimize the layout of energy storage on the grid side, and utilize energy storage for multiple purposes such as accommodating new energy, peak shaving and valley filling, enhancing grid stability, and emergency power supply. Actively support the diversified development of energy storage on the user side, improve the reliability of user power supply, and encourage the participation of user-side energy storage such as electric vehicles and uninterruptible power supplies in system peak regulation and frequency modulation. Expand the application scenarios of energy storage, promote the diversified application of technologies such as electrochemical energy storage, cascade power station energy storage, compressed air energy storage, and flywheel energy storage, and explore new models and formats of energy storage aggregation and shared utilization.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: Strengthen the research and development of advanced technologies such as energy storage and hydrogen energy. Carry out concentrated research on key technologies for new energy storage, accelerate the achievement of independent core technologies for energy storage, promote the continuous reduction of energy storage costs and the large-scale application of energy storage, improve energy storage technology standards and management systems, and enhance the level of safe operation. Proactively deploy a batch of hydrogen energy projects, focus on tackling core technologies such as renewable energy hydrogen production, hydrogen energy storage and transportation, application, and fuel cells, strive to achieve breakthroughs in key technologies for the entire hydrogen energy industry chain, and promote the development and demonstration application of hydrogen energy technology. Strengthen research on cutting-edge technologies and accelerate the promotion and application of pollution reduction and carbon reduction technologies. Column 5 technology innovation demonstration projects. New power system technologies. Research and demonstration applications of new energy generation grid connection and active support, large-capacity offshore wind power friendly transmission, flexible direct current, direct current distribution network, flexible transformation of coal-fired power units, vehicle-to-grid (V2G), virtual power plants, microgrids, and other technologies. Safe and efficient energy storage. Research and demonstration applications of electrochemical energy storage, cascade power station energy storage, flywheel energy storage, compressed air energy storage, and thermal energy storage and cooling, as well as research and demonstration applications of new energy storage security prevention technologies. Research and diversified demonstration applications of key technologies for efficient renewable energy hydrogen production, storage and transportation, application, and fuel cells. Demonstration applications of hydrogen energy in scenarios such as renewable energy consumption and grid peak shaving. Demonstration of interconnected heterogeneous energy sources such as hydrogen energy, electricity, and heat energy.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: Accelerate the research and development of strategic and forward-looking core technologies for the power grid, supporting the construction of an advanced grid that is compatible with large-scale renewable energy and distributed power generation, enabling two-way interaction between power generation, transmission, and consumption, and promoting intelligent and efficient grid operation. Breakthroughs in key technologies and core equipment for energy storage, such as energy-type and power-type storage systems, to meet the diverse energy storage needs in different application scenarios of the energy system.
titlelist: Key tasks, new power system and its supporting technologies.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: (6) Integrated design and operation technology for source-grid-load-storage and multi-energy complementary integration. [Demonstration experiment] Conduct research on integrated design and planning of source-grid-load-storage and wind-solar-fire (storage), wind-solar-water (storage), wind-solar-storage, and master high-voltage crossing and sub-synchronous oscillation suppression technology at the station level; study the optimal strategy for energy storage charging and discharging and aggregation control theory, establish an integrated solution for smart energy systems at the industrial park level, and form a scalable smart adjustable resource; research on bidirectional interaction and control strategies between electric vehicles and the power grid, construct an electric vehicle load aggregation system, and achieve the integrated development of electric vehicles and the power grid; develop key technologies such as multi-terminal flexible DC transmission suitable for the collection and transmission of new energy, dynamic capacity increase of transmission lines, etc., and achieve wide-area coordination and control of source-grid-load-storage for flexible adjustment, safe and stable, and economically efficient operation.
titlelist: Key tasks, new power system and its supporting technologies, advanced grid technologies that can adapt to large-scale and high-proportion integration of new energy sources.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: (8) Energy-type/capacity-type energy storage technology equipment and system integration technology. [Focused research] Conduct research on large-capacity long-duration energy storage devices and system integration for applications such as peak shaving and valley filling of the power grid and centralized integration of renewable energy; develop long-life, low-cost, and high-safety lithium-ion batteries; breakthroughs in balancing and energy management technology for lead-carbon battery dedicated modules; research on key materials for high-power flow batteries, stack design, and integrated design of system modules; develop new generation high-performance energy storage technologies such as sodium-ion batteries, liquid metal batteries, sodium-sulfur batteries, solid-state lithium-ion batteries, energy storage lithium-sulfur batteries, and water-based batteries; develop energy storage technologies such as thermal storage, hydrogen storage, and mechanical energy storage. [Demonstration and testing] Carry out design and demonstration of GWh-level lithium-ion batteries, large-scale compressed air energy storage power stations, and high-power flow battery energy storage power station systems. (9) Power-type/backup-type energy storage technology equipment and system integration technology. [Focused research] Conduct research on long-life high-power energy storage devices and system integration for applications such as enhancing power regulation of the power grid, smoothing intermittent renewable energy power fluctuations, and capacity backup; conduct research on electromagnetic energy storage technologies such as superconductors and dielectric capacitors; develop various power-type energy storage devices such as electrochemical supercapacitors and high-rate lithium-ion batteries; develop key technologies for high-power flywheel materials and high-speed bearings, breakthroughs in key technologies for integrating high-power flywheels with high-inertia synchronous phase-shifting cameras, and 50MW-level flywheel-based high-inertia synchronous phase-shifting camera technology. [Demonstration and testing] Promote the design and application demonstration of 10MW-level supercapacitors, high-power lithium-ion batteries, and megawatt-level flywheel energy storage systems. (10) Common key technologies for energy storage batteries. [Focused research] Carry out experimental verification and simulation research on predicting long calendar life based on short-term test data of energy storage battery cells and modules, achieve more than 25 years of cycle life and rapid monitoring and evaluation of health status of energy storage batteries; conduct research on low-cost repairable and regenerative new energy storage battery technologies, develop residual value assessment of retired batteries, automated disassembly of individual batteries, and material sorting technologies, achieve battery repair, cascaded utilization, recycling, and regeneration; promote research on intelligent sensing technology for energy storage cells and systems; promote research on safety testing, early warning, and protection of energy storage battery throughout its lifecycle; carry out key technology research on power battery design and manufacturing suitable for cascaded utilization based on forward design, as well as key technologies such as scenario analysis, rapid sorting, system integration, and operation and maintenance. [Demonstration and testing] Develop key technologies such as safety warning for electrochemical energy storage systems, multi-level protection structure and materials, demonstrate the overall safety design, energy intelligent management and operation and maintenance of large-scale lithium battery energy storage power stations, and advanced cooling and fire protection technologies. (11) Key technologies for large-scale variable-speed pumped storage and seawater pumped storage. [Demonstration and testing] Develop key equipment such as water pumps and turbines for large-scale variable-speed pumped storage units, generators, AC excitation systems, relay protection systems, computer monitoring systems, and speed control systems, develop high-voltage switchgear equipment such as export circuit breakers for generators, and establish variable-speed pumped storage technology system. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as power generation scheduling for seawater pumped storage power plants in response to severe weather at sea, reservoir and groundwater seepage prevention, generator adhesion and corrosion resistance, and protection against sea waves for water intake and tailwater systems, and carry out engineering demonstrations in a timely manner. (12) Coordinated aggregation technology for distributed energy storage and distributed power sources. [Focused research] Conduct research on coordinated aggregation of distributed energy storage systems, propose aggregation methods for multi-point layout energy storage systems, master the series of theories and complete technologies for peak shaving, frequency regulation, and emergency control of multi-point layout energy storage systems, achieve large-scale aggregation of distributed energy storage and energy storage power stations in a wide-area layout; conduct research on key technologies for renewable energy development and intelligent microgrid on islands. [Application and promotion] Breakthroughs in coordinated control of distributed energy storage and distributed power sources and regional energy allocation management technologies, improve the acceptance of distributed photovoltaics by distribution networks; develop a distributed energy storage multi-market trading platform based on blockchain technology, promote the application of shared energy storage technologies based on blockchain. Column 2 Key demonstrations of new power systems and supporting technologies. 01 Demonstration of advanced grid technologies for large-scale and high-proportion integration of new energy sources. Conduct demonstrations of active support technologies for new energy direct current transmission bases without conventional power sources; conduct demonstrations of new efficient large-capacity photovoltaic grid integration technologies; conduct demonstrations of integrated design and operation of generation, grid, and load storage; conduct demonstrations of integrated design and operation technologies for wind-solar-fire (storage), wind-solar-water (storage), and wind-solar-storage; conduct demonstrations of interaction between electric vehicles and the grid (V2G); conduct demonstrations of flexible DC transmission projects for deep-sea offshore wind power bases. 02 Demonstration of energy storage technologies. Conduct design and demonstration of large-scale compressed air energy storage power station systems; conduct design and demonstration of large-scale high-security high-performance flow battery energy storage power station systems; conduct demonstrations of high-inertia rotating standby energy storage technology applications; conduct engineering demonstrations of large-scale lithium battery energy storage power stations; conduct demonstrations of variable-speed pumped storage and export circuit breaker; conduct demonstrations of seawater pumped storage engineering.
titlelist: Key tasks, new power system and its supporting technologies, energy storage technology.

name: Outline of the National Innovation-driven Development Strategy (excerpt) (State Council/General Office [2020] No. 39/November 2, 2020)
content: Accelerate the construction of renewable energy storage and regulation facilities, strengthen the support of diversified and intelligent grid infrastructure, and enhance the adaptability of the new power system to a high proportion of renewable energy. Strengthen the direct utilization of renewable energy generation terminals, expand the scale of diversified non-electric utilization of renewable energy, promote the large-scale utilization of renewable energy for hydrogen production, promote the comprehensive utilization of renewable energy in rural areas, and take multiple measures to improve the utilization level of renewable energy.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: By 2025, the transformation of new energy storage from the initial stage of commercialization to large-scale development will be achieved. The innovative capacity of new energy storage technologies will significantly improve, with a substantial increase in the level of independent and controllable core technology equipment. Significant progress will be made in terms of high safety, low cost, high reliability, and long lifespan. The standard system will be basically improved, the industrial system will become increasingly complete, and the market environment and business models will be basically mature. The installed capacity will reach over 30 million kilowatts. New energy storage will play a significant role in promoting the carbon peak and carbon neutrality process in the energy field. By 2030, comprehensive market-oriented development of new energy storage will be achieved. The core technology equipment of new energy storage will be independently controllable, and technological innovation and industrial level will rank among the top in the world. The standard system, market mechanisms, and business models will be mature and sound. Deep integration and development with various links of the power system will be achieved, and the installed capacity will basically meet the corresponding needs of the new power system. New energy storage will become one of the key supports for carbon peak and carbon neutrality in the energy field.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Combine the actual needs of the system and layout a batch of system-friendly new energy power station projects with energy storage configurations. Through energy storage coordination and optimization, ensure the efficient consumption and utilization of new energy, and provide capacity support and certain peak shaving capabilities for the power system. Fully leverage the role of large-scale new energy storage, promote the complementary development of multiple energies, plan and construct large-scale clean energy bases for cross-regional transmission, and improve the utilization rate of outbound channels and the proportion of renewable energy in channel electricity. Explore the use of retired thermal power units' existing sites and transmission and transformation facilities to build energy storage or wind and solar energy storage facilities.
titlelist: Strengthen planning guidance, encourage diversified development of energy storage, and vigorously promote the construction of energy storage projects on the power supply side.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Encourage the exploration of new scenarios for the integrated development of energy storage around distributed new energy, microgrids, big data centers, 5G base stations, charging facilities, industrial parks, and other end users. Encourage the aggregated utilization of uninterruptible power supplies, electric vehicles, and user-side energy storage facilities, relying on technologies such as big data, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and blockchain, combined with comprehensive innovation in institutional mechanisms, to explore various business models such as smart energy and virtual power plants.
titlelist: Strengthen planning guidance, encourage diversified development of energy storage, actively support the diversified development of user-side energy storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Carry out forward-looking, systematic, and strategic research and development of key energy storage technologies, mobilize various forces such as enterprises, universities, and research institutes through the method of 'announcing the list and appointing the leader,' promote the breakthroughs in theoretical knowledge and key materials, units, modules, and systems of energy storage, accelerate the achievement of independent core technologies, and strengthen the research on the safety of electrochemical energy storage. Adhere to the diversification of energy storage technologies, promote the continuous reduction of costs and commercial-scale application of relatively mature new energy storage technologies such as lithium-ion batteries, enable compressed air and flow batteries to enter the initial stage of commercial development, accelerate the scale-up testing and demonstration of technologies such as flywheel energy storage and sodium-ion batteries, and explore the research and demonstration applications of hydrogen storage, thermal storage, and other innovative energy storage technologies based on demand.
titlelist: Promote technological progress, strengthen the energy storage industry system, and enhance technological innovation capabilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Improve the construction of the energy storage technology discipline and deepen the interdisciplinary training of talents, creating a number of integrated innovation platforms for energy storage technology in industry and academia. Support the establishment of national key laboratories and engineering research and development centers for energy storage. Encourage local governments, enterprises, financial institutions, and technology organizations to jointly establish new energy storage development funds and innovation alliances, optimize the allocation of innovation resources, and promote business model innovation.
titlelist: Promote technological progress, strengthen the energy storage industry system, and enhance the integration of industry, academia, research, and application.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Encourage the demonstration of energy storage technology applications and the first major technology equipment demonstration. Strengthen the analysis and evaluation of major demonstration projects for new energy storage, providing scientific data support for the practical application effects of new technologies, new products, and new solutions, and providing scientific basis for the formulation of national industrial policies and technical standards.
titlelist: Promote technological progress, strengthen the energy storage industry system, and accelerate the transformation of innovative achievements.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: By guiding the improvement of the independent and controllable level of core energy storage technology and equipment through major project construction, we emphasize the synergy between upstream and downstream sectors. We rely on backbone enterprises with independent intellectual property rights and core competitiveness to actively promote the development of the entire industry chain from production, construction, operation to recycling. We support the internationalization of China's new energy storage technologies and standards. We support the establishment of a number of national energy storage high-tech industrialization bases by combining resource endowments, technological advantages, industrial foundations, and human resources.
titlelist: Promote technological progress, strengthen the energy storage industry system, and enhance the competitiveness of the energy storage industry.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Research and establish the access conditions, trading mechanisms, and technical standards for energy storage to participate in various electricity markets, including long-term transactions, spot markets, and ancillary services. Accelerate the integration of energy storage into and allow its participation in all types of electricity markets. Adapt to local conditions and establish a sound compensation mechanism for electricity ancillary services based on performance. Deepen the market mechanism for electricity ancillary services and encourage energy storage to participate as an independent market entity in the ancillary services market. Encourage the exploration and construction of shared energy storage.
titlelist: Improve policy mechanisms, create a healthy market environment, and clarify the independent market status of new energy storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Establish a capacity-based pricing mechanism for independent energy storage stations on the power grid, gradually promoting the participation of energy storage stations in the electricity market; research and explore the inclusion of cost recovery for grid-replacement energy storage facilities in transmission and distribution pricing. Improve peak and off-peak pricing policies to create greater space for the development of user-side energy storage.
titlelist: Improve policy mechanisms, create a healthy market environment, and establish a sound pricing mechanism for new energy storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: For new energy generation projects that implement new energy storage through supporting construction or sharing models, their system value and technological level should be dynamically evaluated. Appropriate preferences can be given in terms of competitive allocation, project approval (filing), grid connection timing, system scheduling and operation arrangements, guarantee of utilization hours, and assessment of compensation for power auxiliary services.
titlelist: Improve policy mechanisms, create a healthy market environment, and establish an incentive mechanism for 'new energy + energy storage' projects.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Based on the demand of the power system and with the goal of maximizing the operational benefits and functions of energy storage, it is necessary to establish and improve the policies for installing energy storage facilities in various regions. Grid companies should actively optimize the scheduling and operation mechanisms, research and formulate scheduling and operation regulations and standards for different types of energy storage facilities, clarify the ownership, functional positioning, and operation methods of scheduling, and fully utilize the functions and benefits of energy storage as a flexible resource.
titlelist: Standardize industry management, improve construction and operation levels, and perfect energy storage construction and operation requirements.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Clarify the management functions of local government departments related to the new energy storage industry, coordinate and optimize the process of energy storage registration, and issue management regulations. Urge power grid enterprises to clarify the grid connection process in accordance with the principle of simplifying procedures and improving efficiency, issue timely opinions on grid connection access, be responsible for the construction of grid connection projects, provide grid connection debugging and acceptance services, and encourage the provision of one-stop services for user-side energy storage.
titlelist: Standardize industry management, improve construction and operation levels, clarify energy storage filing and grid connection processes.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: According to the development and safe operation requirements of energy storage, the energy storage standardization information platform should be utilized to coordinate research and improve the top-level design of the energy storage standard system construction. Revision of energy storage standards for different application scenarios should be carried out, and a sound technical standard system for the entire energy storage industry chain should be established. The coordination and connection between current energy and power system standards and energy storage applications should be strengthened. Efforts should be made to improve the new energy storage detection and certification system. The establishment of safety standards and management systems for energy storage equipment manufacturing, construction and installation, and operation monitoring should be promoted.
titlelist: Standardize industry management, improve construction and operation levels, and establish sound energy storage technology standards and management systems.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Encourage various regions to introduce relevant reform measures, carry out reform pilots, and, based on in-depth exploration of energy storage technology routes and innovative business models, study the establishment of reasonable energy storage cost allocation and diversion mechanisms. Accelerate the development of new energy storage technologies and key regional pilot demonstrations, timely summarize replicable practices and successful experiences, and lay a solid foundation for the large-scale and high-quality development of energy storage.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational leadership, enhance supervision and guarantee work, and encourage localities to take the lead and try first.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of New Energy Storage (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/July 15, 2021)
content: Urge relevant departments of local governments to clarify the main responsibilities of each link in the new energy storage industry chain and strengthen fire safety management. Clarify the standards for the grid operation of new energy storage, strengthen online monitoring of component and system operation status, and effectively improve the level of safe operation.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational leadership, enhance supervision and guarantee work, strengthen security risk prevention.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Strengthening the coordination and interaction among various links of the power supply network, fully tapping into the flexibility of system regulation capacity and demand-side resources, is conducive to the coordinated development and scientific allocation of various resources, improving the operational efficiency of the system and the comprehensive benefits of power development, and building a diversified and intelligent energy security system.
titlelist: 重要意义,有利于提升电力发展质量和效益 translates to Significant importance, beneficial for improving the quality and efficiency of power development in English.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Prioritizing the use of clean energy resources, fully utilizing the regulating capabilities of conventional power plants, appropriately deploying energy storage facilities, and mobilizing the enthusiasm of demand-side flexible response, are beneficial for accelerating energy transition and promoting the coordinated and sustainable development of the energy sector and the ecological environment.
titlelist: Significant importance, beneficial for the comprehensive promotion of ecological civilization construction.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Exploiting the coordinated and mutually beneficial role of cross-regional source-network-load-storage coordination, expanding the scale of power resource allocation is conducive to promoting the formation of a new pattern of development in the western region, improving the environmental quality in the eastern region, and increasing the proportion of consumption of renewable energy.
titlelist: 重要意义,有利于促进区域协调发展 translates to Significant importance, beneficial for promoting regional coordinated development in English.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Relying on the construction of regional (provincial) level power auxiliary services, medium and long-term market systems, and spot markets, fair and non-discriminatory introduction of market entities such as power generation, load side, and independent energy storage, fully liberalize market-oriented transactions, guide various market entities to flexibly adjust and interact in multiple directions through price signals, promote the establishment of market transaction mechanisms for market-oriented trading users to participate in and bear auxiliary services, cultivate user load management capabilities, and improve user-side peak load regulation enthusiasm. Relying on modern information and communication technologies such as 5G and intelligentization, strengthen unified dispatching of the entire network, study and establish a flexible and efficient interaction between power generation, grid, load, and storage in power operation and market systems, give full play to the regulatory role of regional power grids, and implement market mechanisms for the participation of power sources, power users, energy storage, and virtual power plants.
titlelist: Promote the integration of source, grid, load, and storage, enhance the capacity of guarantee and utilization efficiency, regional (provincial) level integration of source, grid, load, and storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Carry out integrated construction of source-network-load-energy storage in key cities, sort out important loads in cities, study strengthening schemes for local power grids, and propose plans for ensuring power supply and configuring emergency power sources. Combine clean heating and clean energy consumption work to carry out demonstration of integrated source-network-load-energy storage at the city (county) level, and study integrated operation plans for combined heat and power units, new energy power plants, and flexible operation of electric heating loads.
titlelist: Promote the integration of source-network-load-storage, enhance the capacity for guarantee and utilization efficiency, and implement source-network-load-storage integration at the city (county) level.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: With modern information communication, big data, artificial intelligence, and energy storage as the basis, the Internet+ new model is used to mobilize the load-side regulation and response capabilities. In urban commercial areas, complexes, and residential areas, distributed generation and electric vehicles (user storage) are combined with flexible charging and discharging, relying on photovoltaic power generation, grid-connected microgrids, and charging infrastructure, to promote the integrated construction of source-network-load-storage in park (residential area) level. In areas with high industrial loads and good conditions for new energy, support is provided for the development and construction of distributed power sources and their nearby access and consumption, combined with the work of incremental distribution networks, to promote the construction of green power supply parks with integrated source-network-load-storage. Research is conducted on comprehensive optimization schemes for source-network-load-storage, aiming to improve system balance capabilities.
titlelist: Promote the integration of source, network, load, and storage, enhance the capacity of guarantee and utilization efficiency, and achieve the integration of source, network, load, and storage at the park (residential area) level.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: For existing new energy projects, the necessity and feasibility of increasing energy storage facilities should be studied and demonstrated, taking into account the characteristics of new energy and the space for consumption in end systems. For incremental wind and solar energy storage integration, the scale of supporting energy storage should be optimized, fully utilizing the peak shaving and frequency regulation functions of supporting energy storage, minimizing the comprehensive generation cost of wind and solar energy storage, and enhancing overall competitiveness.
titlelist: Promote multi-energy complementarity, improve the level of renewable energy consumption, and integrate wind and solar energy storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: For existing hydropower projects, it is necessary to study and demonstrate the priority use of hydropower regulation capabilities to accommodate nearby wind and solar power based on the characteristics of hydropower output, new energy characteristics, and the absorption capacity of the receiving system. It is also necessary to explore the feasibility and necessity of increasing energy storage facilities according to local conditions, and encourage the optimization of output characteristics through the construction of leading power stations to achieve nearby bundling. For the integration of incremental wind, solar, and hydropower, it is important to strictly control the scale of small and medium-sized hydropower construction in accordance with national and local environmental protection policies, ecological red lines, and water resource utilization policies. The focus should be on large and medium-sized hydropower projects, which can effectively gather and optimize the supporting energy storage capacity for the transmission of new energy.
titlelist: Promote the integration of multiple complementary energies, enhance the level of renewable energy consumption, and integrate wind and solar power with water storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: For existing coal-fired power projects, priority should be given to improving their regulation capacity through flexible transformation. This should be done in combination with the conditions for developing new energy in the nearby area and the characteristics of power output, as well as the capacity of the receiving system. Efforts should be made to expand the scale of new energy electricity generation through nearby bundling. For new transmission projects in incremental development bases, based on the transmission capacity of the power grid, the regional complementarity advantages of new energy should be reasonably utilized. Priority should be given to collecting new energy electricity from nearby areas and optimizing the scale of supporting energy storage. Without affecting the supply of electricity (heat), existing coal-fired power projects that have been included in the national power development plan should be fully utilized, and the demand for new coal-fired power should be strictly controlled. The proportion of renewable energy in the transmission channel should be no less than 50% in principle, and priority should be given to planning and constructing channels with a higher proportion. The implementation of national and local environmental protection policies, ecological red lines, and water resource utilization policies should be ensured. Planning environmental impact assessments and water resource demonstration review opinions should be obtained in accordance with regulations. For incremental local development and consumption projects, priority should be given to utilizing new energy electricity based on a comprehensive evaluation of local resource conditions and consumption capacity.
titlelist: Promote the integration of multiple complementary energies, enhance the level of renewable energy consumption, and integrate wind and solar power with energy storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Based on the foundation of power system safety and stability, and guided by market consumption, in accordance with the principle of subordinating local interests to overall interests, the national energy regulatory department plays a coordinating role, strengthens the integration of generation, grid, load, and storage, and the planning of complementary projects for multiple energy sources, and connects them with national and local power development plans, renewable energy plans, etc., to promote the orderly implementation of projects. Based on the organization's evaluation and demonstration and fully soliciting the opinions of the dispatched agencies of the National Energy Administration, energy regulatory departments at the transmission and distribution ends, and power companies, according to the principle of piloting first and gradually promoting, through the formulation of national power development plans, annual fine-tuning, and midterm rolling adjustments, projects that meet the conditions are given priority inclusion in the national power development plan.
titlelist: Improve policy measures and strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Each investment entity should strengthen the coordination and integration of power generation, transmission, load, and storage, actively participate in relevant planning and research, jointly promote preliminary work for projects, and achieve integrated planning. Coordinate the construction progress of various power projects to ensure simultaneous construction and operation, and promote integrated implementation. The agency dispatched by the National Energy Administration is responsible for leading the establishment of integrated coordination and operation mechanisms for power generation, transmission, load, and storage, as well as multi-energy complementary projects in the respective regions, and sharing of interests. Furthermore, it will further deepen the construction of market mechanisms such as the electricity ancillary services market and medium- to long-term transactions, leverage synergistic benefits, fully tap into the adjustment capabilities of conventional power sources, energy storage, and user loads, enhance the level of renewable energy consumption, and achieve integrated operation regulation and management standards for projects.
titlelist: Improve policy measures and establish coordination mechanisms.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Adhere to bottom-line thinking, coordinate development and security, effectively prevent and resolve various security risks in the process of promoting relevant projects, through the rational allocation of different power source types, research on the safety governance mechanism of the power system's generation, transmission, load, and storage links, explore new means of power system security governance, ensure the safe consumption of new energy, and build a strong security barrier for China's comprehensive realization of green and low-carbon transformation.
titlelist: Improve policy measures and maintain the bottom line of safety.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: The new energy generation projects in the integrated storage and multi-energy complementary projects of the Yunnan Power Grid should implement the national renewable energy generation project management policies and be coordinated and arranged in the national and local renewable energy planning implementation plans. Encourage regions with the necessary conditions to organize and promote relevant project construction, support participation in inter-provincial and inter-regional electricity market transactions, incremental distribution reform, and market-oriented transactions for distributed generation.
titlelist: Improve policy measures, improve support policies.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Integrated Development of Power Generation, Grid, Load, and Energy Storage, and the Complementary Development of Multiple Energy Sources (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration/February 25, 2021)
content: Lower the entry threshold and create an investment environment with equal rights, equal opportunities, and equal rules. Based on the relevant investment policies and management measures for power projects, encourage various types of investment entities such as social capital to invest in various types of power sources, energy storage, and incremental distribution network projects, or establish consortiums through capital cooperation and participate in project investment, development, and construction.
titlelist: Improve policy measures and encourage social investment.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: By 2021, a government-guided and multi-party participation mechanism for energy storage standardization will be established, promoting the establishment of a relatively systematic energy storage standard system, and strengthening the revision of key technical standards for energy storage and the internationalization of energy storage standards.
titlelist: Overall requirements, work objectives.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: The National Energy Administration, together with the Ministry of Emergency Management, the State Administration for Market Regulation (Standardization Committee), and others, will establish a coordination mechanism for energy storage standardization. This mechanism will guide the construction of energy storage standardization and coordinate the resolution of major issues in energy storage standardization work. It will strengthen the construction of the organizational system for energy storage standardization technology, promote the coordination of relevant industry standardization management organizations, and facilitate communication and collaboration among organizations involved in energy storage standardization technology.
titlelist: Key task: Establishing a standardized coordination mechanism for energy storage.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: Track the development of energy storage technology and industry, establish a standard system that covers energy storage systems, equipment, and their applications, and supports their mutual development and coordination in the energy system. Actively promote the formulation of key energy storage standards and encourage research on standards for emerging energy storage technologies and applications.
titlelist: Key task: Establishing an energy storage standard system.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: Promote the effective combination of energy storage technology innovation and standard formulation, encourage the application, verification, and formulation of standards in energy storage engineering demonstration projects, and transform successful engineering application experiences into standards. Carry out pilot demonstrations of energy storage standardization, promote the use of standardized methods by enterprises to organize energy storage engineering applications, and play a supporting and leading role of standardization in the energy storage industry.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the standardization and demonstration of energy storage.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: Actively undertake the task of revising international standards for energy storage technology and substantially participate in the international standardization work in the field of energy storage technology. Further enhance the conversion rate of international energy storage standards based on international standard research and validation. Promote the internationalization of energy storage standards through bilateral and multilateral energy international cooperation.
titlelist: Key task: Promoting the internationalization of energy storage standards.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: The National Energy Administration, in conjunction with relevant departments, organizes regular joint meetings on energy storage standardization with the storage-related standardization management agencies, standardization technical organizations, and academic associations every year. These meetings aim to research and address major issues related to energy storage standards and coordinate the implementation of energy storage standardization work plans.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational coordination.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: Establish a storage energy standard information platform to share the dynamic information of storage energy standardization work. Relevant standardization technical organizations, according to their respective responsibilities, regularly share the results of standard revision and work information on the platform.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen information sharing.

name: Implementation Plan for Strengthening Energy Storage Standardization Work (Guoneng Zongtong Technology [2020] No. 3) (National Energy Administration/January 9, 2020)
content: Give full play to the platform role of relevant standardization management organizations, standardization technical organizations, and academic associations. Strengthen the promotion of energy storage standards and promote the implementation of key energy storage standards. Actively carry out technical exchanges on energy storage standards, promote the implementation of energy storage standards and technological progress. Organize special seminars to address hot and difficult issues in the field of energy storage.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen technical exchanges.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Concentrate on tackling a batch of energy storage technologies and materials that are of critical core significance. Strengthen the research and development of fundamental and common technologies, focusing on the overall goals of low cost, long lifespan, high safety, and high energy density. Conduct research on energy storage principles, key materials, units, modules, systems, and recycling technologies, as well as develop testing, analysis, and simulation of energy storage materials and devices. Key areas of focus include variable-speed pumped storage technology, large-scale new compressed air energy storage technology, various new material preparation technologies for electrochemical energy storage, high-temperature superconducting magnetic energy storage technology, phase change thermal energy storage materials and high-temperature thermal energy storage technology, energy storage system integration technology, and energy management technology. Demonstrate and test a batch of energy storage technologies and equipment with industrialization potential. Develop energy storage technologies and equipment suitable for different application scenarios and demands, including long-duration large-capacity, short-duration large-capacity, distributed, and high-power applications. Vigorously develop energy storage system integration and intelligent control technology to achieve coordinated and optimized operation of energy storage and modern power systems. Key areas of focus include 10MW/100MWh-level supercritical compressed air energy storage systems, 10MW/1000MJ-level flywheel energy storage array units, 100MW-level lithium-ion battery energy storage systems, large-capacity novel molten salt thermal storage devices, and supercapacitor energy quality regulation systems for smart grids and distributed power generation. Promote the application and popularization of energy storage technologies and products with independent intellectual property rights. Strengthen guidance and support, promote the integration of industry, academia, research, and application, and accelerate technology transfer. Encourage energy storage product manufacturers to adopt advanced manufacturing technologies and concepts to improve quality and efficiency. Encourage innovative investment and financing models to reduce costs and encourage participation in foreign application markets to drive the improvement of domestic equipment manufacturing levels. Key areas of focus include 100MW-level all-vanadium flow battery energy storage stations and high-performance lead-carbon capacitor battery energy storage systems. Improve energy storage product standards and certification systems. Establish a standard system that is in line with international standards and covers various application stages such as energy storage planning and design, equipment and testing, construction and acceptance, grid connection and testing, operation and maintenance, and continuously improve it with technological development and market demand. Improve energy storage product performance, safety, and other testing and certification standards, establish national-level energy storage testing and certification institutions, and strengthen and improve the quality supervision of the entire life cycle of energy storage products. Establish and improve the system for recalling defective products.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the research and development demonstration of energy storage technology equipment.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: Encourage the reasonable configuration of energy storage systems in renewable energy power stations. Research and determine the requirements for different types of energy storage systems, including connection methods, grid adaptability, operation control, network protection, information exchange, and security measures. For energy storage systems that meet the requirements, the power grid should allow their connection and incorporate them into grid dispatch management. Promote the coordinated operation of energy storage systems and renewable energy. Encourage energy storage systems and renewable energy power stations to participate in grid operation optimization as a collective entity, accept grid operation dispatch, achieve smooth power output fluctuations, enhance power absorption capacity, and provide ancillary services to the grid. Grid companies should treat the collective entity as a special power plant, sign grid dispatch agreements and power purchase contracts under government guidance, and grant the collective entity corresponding rights and responsibilities. Research and establish compensation mechanisms for energy storage on the side of renewable energy power stations. Study and quantitatively evaluate the value of energy storage facilities in renewable energy power stations and explore reasonable compensation methods. Support the application of various energy storage technologies to promote the integration of renewable energy. Support the development of various forms of energy storage and utilization, such as energy storage, heat storage, and hydrogen production, in areas with prominent issues in renewable energy integration. Promote the construction of pilot demonstration projects for wind power heat storage, wind power hydrogen production, and other technologies.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the application demonstration of energy storage to enhance the utilization level of renewable energy.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Support the direct connection of energy storage systems to the power grid. Research the technical requirements for the capacity range, voltage level, grid compatibility, operation control, network protection, information exchange, and security of energy storage system integration into the grid. Encourage power grid companies and other enterprises to integrate energy storage systems into the grid, whether centralized or distributed, in accordance with relevant national or industry standards, and conduct research and application demonstrations of operation optimization technologies. Support various entities to invest, construct, and operate energy storage systems that connect to the grid based on market principles. Encourage the use of retired or decommissioned power plant infrastructure to build energy storage systems. Establish and improve mechanisms for energy storage participation in ancillary service markets. Referencing relevant policies and mechanisms for thermal power plants providing ancillary services, allow energy storage systems to participate in ancillary service transactions either in conjunction with generating units or as independent entities. Gradually optimize the electricity market development and form a market mechanism based on voluntary transactions, where payment is based on performance and those who benefit pay. Explore the establishment of rules and mechanisms for energy storage capacity charges and participation in capacity markets. In conjunction with power system reforms, refer to policies related to pumped storage and explore the establishment of rules for energy storage capacity charges and participation in capacity markets, providing capacity compensation for large-scale energy storage systems that meet the requirements.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the application demonstration of energy storage to enhance the flexibility and stability of the power system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: Encourage the construction of distributed energy storage systems on the user side. Research and formulate admission policies and technical standards for user-side energy storage, and guide and regulate the construction and operation of user-side distributed energy storage systems. Support electricity retailers with distribution network operating rights and eligible residential users to install energy storage, increase the proportion of locally consumed distributed energy, participate in demand response, and reduce energy costs, and encourage exploration of relevant business models. Improve support policies for user-side energy storage systems. In conjunction with power system reform, allow energy storage to participate in electricity trading through market-based approaches. Support user-side energy storage facilities of a certain scale to collaborate with power generation companies or participate as independent entities in ancillary services such as frequency regulation and peak shaving. Support the installation of energy storage in microgrids and off-grid areas. Encourage the use of multiple energy storage technologies to improve the reliability and quality of power supply in microgrids; actively explore new technologies and models for energy storage-enabled microgrids to participate in electricity trading and optimize grid operations. Encourage the development of economically viable energy storage systems to address or optimize electricity supply for populations without access to power.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the application demonstration of energy storage to enhance the level of intelligent energy utilization.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: Improve the informatization and management level of energy storage systems. While ensuring network information security, promote the deep integration of energy storage infrastructure and information technology, and support the research and application of energy information technology. Gradually realize the energy interconnection and management of energy storage, improve the utilization efficiency of energy storage resources, and give full play to the diversified role of energy storage systems in the energy interconnection. Encourage the complementary use of various energy storage technologies and the interaction of multiple energy sources in the energy interconnection. Encourage the rational allocation of energy storage systems in large-scale integrated energy bases to achieve the complementary use of wind, solar, hydro, and energy storage. Support the construction of open and shared distributed energy storage big data platforms and energy service platforms. Encourage different levels of end users such as households, parks, and regions to complementarily utilize various types of energy and energy storage resources, and achieve multi-energy synergy and comprehensive utilization of energy. Expand the energy storage application of dispersed battery resources such as electric vehicles. Actively carry out intelligent charging and discharging services for electric vehicles, and explore the energy interconnection and energy storage application of dispersed battery resources such as electric vehicle power batteries, communication base station batteries, and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS). Improve the supervision of the entire life cycle of power batteries and conduct research on the energy storage utilization of retired power batteries.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting diversified application of energy storage to support the demonstration of energy internet applications.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: The National Development and Reform Commission, together with the National Energy Administration, the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and other relevant departments, will coordinate and solve major issues, establish and improve support policies, effectively promote the implementation of various measures, and form a development situation that combines government, industry, academia, research, and application. Relying on industry strength to build a national-level energy storage technology innovation platform; fully leveraging the role of professional associations and research institutes to guide industry innovation direction. Establish an energy storage professional advisory committee to provide support for government decision-making. Promote the establishment of a national-level industry alliance, strengthen industry research, and establish information channels. Encourage provincial-level governments to support energy storage in accordance with relevant policies already introduced, such as smart grids, microgrids, multi-energy complementarity, Internet Plus smart energy, electric vehicle charging facilities, recycling of used power batteries, distribution network construction, and electricity spot market. Develop supporting policies, provide financial support, and carry out pilot demonstration projects based on actual conditions. Eligible energy storage companies can enjoy relevant tax incentives according to regulations. Include energy storage in special funds for smart grids, energy equipment manufacturing, and other key support areas. Conduct comprehensive regional pilot demonstrations of technology and policy mechanisms in areas with conditions, and encourage demonstration provinces of clean energy to develop energy storage according to local conditions. Energy and related competent authorities at all levels should study and formulate implementation plans suitable for local conditions, organize scientifically, and prevent blind construction and redundant investment, and pragmatically and orderly promote the development of energy storage technology and industry.
