Energy regulatory agencies dispatched by the National Energy Administration actively participate in relevant mechanism research according to their responsibilities, strengthen safety and market supervision, and urge the implementation of relevant policies and major demonstration projects.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: Establish and improve relevant laws and regulations to ensure the healthy and orderly development of the energy storage industry. Strengthen the coordination between power system reform and the development of energy storage market mechanisms, and develop energy storage application pricing mechanisms in conjunction with power market construction research. Actively carry out policy trials for innovative applications of energy storage, remove policy barriers in areas such as equipment access, entity identity, data exchange, and transaction mechanisms, and study and formulate relevant policies and regulations in finance, insurance, and other areas that adapt to the development characteristics of new energy storage models. Strengthen the management and protection of intellectual property rights for energy storage technologies, products, and models. Strengthen the construction of policies, regulations, and standards for energy storage safety and environmental protection, and study the establishment of an extended producer responsibility system for energy storage products. Encourage the development of standardized, universal, and easily disassembled structural designs for energy storage systems, and negotiate the opening of energy storage control system interfaces and communication protocols that facilitate recycling and reuse of relevant information.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve policies and regulations.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: Surrounding the major needs of promoting the consumption of renewable energy, developing distributed power and microgrids, enhancing the flexibility of the power system, and accelerating the construction of an energy internet, a number of significant energy storage pilot demonstration projects with leading roles will be established. The construction and operation of pilot demonstration projects will be tracked, and a sound institutional mechanism will be established to promote the sustainable development of the industry. Encouragement and support will be given to national-level renewable energy demonstration zones, as well as other regions, departments, and enterprises that meet the conditions, to carry out various types of energy storage technology application pilot demonstrations in accordance with local conditions. In terms of technological innovation, operation models, development formats, and institutional mechanisms, in-depth exploration, pioneering trials, and summarizing and accumulating successful experiences that can be promoted will be conducted.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, pilot demonstration

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: Combine power system reform, study and promote policies to enable energy storage to participate in electricity market transactions and receive reasonable compensation, and establish energy storage service compensation mechanisms that are compatible with market-oriented operation services. Promote pilot projects for energy storage to participate in compensation mechanisms for power auxiliary services, and establish compatible energy storage capacity electricity fee mechanisms. Establish and improve compensation regulatory mechanisms and severely punish violations.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, establish compensation mechanisms.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of Energy Storage Technology and Industry (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Energy Administration/September 22, 2017)
content: Relying on the industry to establish an energy storage information public platform, strengthen information docking, sharing, and transaction services. Innovate talent introduction and cultivation mechanisms, introduce a group of leading talents, cultivate a group of professional talents, and form an intellectual support system for the energy storage industry. Strengthen publicity, expand the demonstration and driving effects, and attract more social resources to participate in energy storage technology research and industrial innovation development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, solidify the foundation for development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: The energy internet is a new form of energy industry development, and the related technologies, models, and formats are all in the exploratory development stage. In order to promote the healthy and orderly development of the energy internet, it will be promoted in two stages in the near and medium term. The pilot demonstration will be carried out in the early stage, and the subsequent promotion and application will be carried out to ensure effectiveness. From 2016 to 2018, efforts will be made to promote pilot demonstration projects of the energy internet: the construction of a batch of pilot demonstration projects of different types and scales. Overcome a batch of major key technologies and core equipment, and make the energy internet technology reach the international advanced level. Preliminary establishment of the energy internet market mechanism and market system. Preliminary establishment of the energy internet technology standard system and the formation of a batch of key technical specifications and standards. Foster a batch of emerging business formats such as energy finance and third-party comprehensive energy services. Cultivate a batch of competitive emerging market entities. Explore a batch of sustainable and replicable development models. Accumulate a batch of important reform pilot experience. From 2019 to 2025, efforts will be made to promote diversified and large-scale development of the energy internet: preliminary establishment of the energy internet industry system, becoming an important driving force for economic growth. Establish a relatively complete energy internet market mechanism and market system. Form a relatively complete technology and standard system and promote internationalization, leading the development of the world's energy internet. Form an open and shared energy internet ecological environment, significantly improve energy comprehensive efficiency, significantly increase the proportion of renewable energy, make positive progress in the clean and efficient use of fossil energy, greatly increase public participation, and provide strong support for energy production and consumption revolution.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Strengthen the construction of energy internet infrastructure, build an intelligent system for energy production and consumption, a multi-energy collaborative comprehensive energy network, and information and communication infrastructure that coordinates with the energy system. Create an open and shared energy internet ecosystem, establish a new energy market trading system and commercial operation platform, develop distributed energy, energy storage, and electric vehicle applications, smart energy use and value-added services, green energy flexible trading, energy big data services, and other new models and formats. Promote key technology research and development, core equipment development, and standard system construction for energy internet, and promote the international application and cooperation of energy internet technology, standards, and models.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Encourage the construction of intelligent wind farms, intelligent photovoltaic power stations, and other facilities, as well as internet-based smart operation cloud platforms, to achieve the intelligent production of renewable energy. Encourage the construction of comprehensive energy utilization infrastructure on the user side, such as combined cooling, heating, and power supply, heat pumps, and the utilization of industrial waste heat and excess pressure, to promote the coordinated development of distributed renewable energy and distributed natural gas energy, and improve the comprehensive utilization level of distributed renewable energy. Promote the coordinated production of renewable energy and fossil energy, and promote the clean substitution of inefficient fossil energy such as scattered coal burning. Construct access facilities and support systems for the participation of renewable energy in the market, including measurement, trading, and settlement.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the construction of intelligent energy production and consumption infrastructure, promote the intelligent production of renewable energy.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Encourage the intelligent transformation of the entire chain of coal, oil, and gas extraction, processing, and utilization, to achieve green, clean, and efficient production of fossil energy. Encourage the construction of supporting facilities for fossil energy, such as electric heating and thermal storage, to enhance energy flexibility and achieve efficient and deep peak shaving through the development of distributed natural gas energy. Accelerate the network transformation of the monitoring, management, and dispatching system for fossil energy production, and build a market-oriented production planning and decision-making platform and intelligent information management system. Improve the monitoring system for pollutant emissions from fossil energy and promote efficient matching of supply and demand and efficient operation of fossil energy through internet means.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the construction of intelligent energy production and consumption infrastructure, and advance the clean, efficient, and intelligent production of fossil energy.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Develop various types of large-capacity, low-cost, high-efficiency, and long-life energy storage products and systems, including energy storage for electricity, heat, cold, and clean fuel storage. Promote the deployment of appropriate-scale energy storage stations in centralized new energy power generation bases to achieve coordinated and optimized operation of energy storage systems with new energy and the power grid. Promote the construction of distributed energy storage devices in community, building, and household applications, enabling the hybrid configuration, efficient management, and friendly grid connection of energy storage devices.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the construction of intelligent energy production and consumption infrastructure, promote the coordinated development of centralized and distributed energy storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Encourage the construction of smart homes, smart buildings, smart communities, and smart factories with intelligent terminals and flexible energy trading as their main features, supporting the construction of smart cities. Strengthen demand-side management of electricity, popularize intelligent energy monitoring and diagnostic technologies, accelerate the construction of energy management centers for industrial enterprises, and build internet-based information service platforms. Construct a micro-balance system characterized by multi-energy integration, open sharing, two-way communication, and intelligent control, where various energy-consuming terminals can flexibly integrate. Build access facilities and information service platforms for energy markets, involving energy-consuming entities at different levels such as households, parks, and regions.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote the construction of intelligent energy production and consumption infrastructure, accelerate the intelligentization of energy consumption.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Build a comprehensive energy network based on smart grids, interconnected with various types of networks such as district heating networks, natural gas networks, and transportation networks. This network enables the coordinated conversion of multiple forms of energy, as well as the coordinated operation of centralized and distributed energy. Strengthen overall planning, prioritize the layout in new urban areas, new industrial parks, and key areas with severe air pollution, to ensure a rational and efficient structure and operation of the comprehensive energy network. Construct a highly flexible and resilient energy network to ensure flexible and controllable energy transmission, as well as safety and stability. Build comprehensive energy microgrids that accommodate a high proportion of renewable energy, promote flexible and interactive energy consumption behavior, and support distributed energy trading.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen the construction of a synergistic comprehensive energy network, and promote the construction of infrastructure for comprehensive energy networks.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Promote the standardization and modular construction of interface facilities for different energy networks, support the plug-and-play and bidirectional transmission of various energy production and consumption facilities, significantly enhance the acceptance capacity of renewable energy, distributed energy, and diversified loads. Promote the construction of infrastructure that enables flexible conversion, efficient storage, and intelligent coordination of various forms of energy such as electricity, cooling, heating, gas, and hydrogen. Construct infrastructure that enables the collaborative control of smart networks covering electricity grids, gas networks, heating networks, etc.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen the construction of a comprehensive energy network with multiple capabilities, promote the construction of energy access transformation and coordinated control facilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Developing advanced measurement systems and supporting equipment for the smart terminals of the energy internet, to achieve real-time metering, information exchange, and active control of energy consumption such as electricity, heat, and refrigeration. Enriching the implementation functions of the advanced measurement system for smart terminals, promoting remote automatic collection and reading of water, gas, heat, and electricity, and achieving multi-meter integration. Standardizing the networking structure and information interface of the advanced measurement system for smart terminals, to achieve secure, reliable, and fast bidirectional communication with users.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote deep integration of energy and information communication infrastructure, and promote the popular application of smart terminals and access facilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Optimize the layout of components such as sensors, information, communication, and control in the energy network, and achieve efficient configuration with various facilities in the energy network. Promote the connection and deep integration of information infrastructure between the energy network and the Internet of Things. Collaboratively construct the infrastructure of energy networks such as power grids, gas networks, and heating networks, as well as their information architecture and storage units, to achieve shared reuse of infrastructure and avoid duplication of construction. Promote the project of bringing power optical fibers to households and improve the information communication system of energy interconnection. On the basis of fully utilizing existing information and communication infrastructure, promote the construction of energy internet information and communication infrastructure such as power communication networks.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote deep integration of energy and information communication infrastructure, strengthen the construction of information and communication facilities supporting the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Promote the efficient integration of information systems and physical systems in various functional aspects such as measurement, calculation, and control, to achieve real-time perception and information feedback of the energy internet. Construct an intelligent control system that integrates information systems and physical systems, characterized by centralized control, distributed autonomy, and remote collaboration, to achieve rapid response and precise control of the energy internet.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote deep integration of energy and information communication infrastructure, advance efficient integration and intelligent control of information systems and physical systems.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Strengthen the construction of the security infrastructure of the energy information communication system, and scientifically configure security strategies based on the importance of information, communication methods, and service objects. Relying on advanced technologies such as encryption, identity authentication, and encrypted communication, establish an information communication security system for the transmission, storage, and distribution of information among users, data, devices, and networks under the energy internet, ensuring the secure and reliable operation of the energy internet. Enhance the monitoring, early warning, and emergency response capabilities for network and information security incidents in the energy internet.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote deep integration of energy and information communication infrastructure, strengthen the construction of information communication security guarantee capabilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Fully utilize the rapid iterative innovation capability in the field of the Internet, establish open interfaces, network protocols, and application support platforms for energy systems that are interconnected and interoperable in various application and service scenarios, and support the rapid and convenient access of massive and diverse forms of energy supply and utilization devices. Starting from local areas, promote the hierarchical and regional interconnection of energy networks and the global management of energy resources, and support end users in achieving equal participation and energy sharing based on Internet platforms.
titlelist: Key tasks: Create an open and shared ecological system for the energy internet, and build an open and shared system for the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Establish a multi-party participation, equal and open, fully competitive energy market trading system, restoring the attributes of energy commodities. Cultivate new market entities such as electricity retailers, comprehensive energy operators, and third-party value-added service providers. Gradually build a diversified trading system with energy, ancillary services, new energy quotas, and virtual energy currency as underlying assets. Hierarchically construct wholesale energy trading markets and retail trading markets, and build energy trading e-commerce platforms based on the Internet, encouraging competition between trading platforms to achieve anytime, anywhere, flexible and equal sharing and trading of energy. Establish an Internet-based micro-balanced market trading system, encouraging individuals, households, distributed energy, and other small and micro users to flexibly and autonomously participate in the energy market.
titlelist: Key tasks: Creating an open and shared ecosystem for the energy internet, and building a market trading system for the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Build a value circulation system for energy and energy derivatives, supporting the capitalization and securitization of energy resources, equipment, services, and applications. Provide a platform for various forms of business model innovation based on Internet Plus, including B2B, B2C, C2B, C2C, O2O, etc. Promote information sharing and business integration across industries in the energy sector, cultivate new business models such as energy cloud services and virtual energy currency. Encourage flexible investment and financing methods such as crowdfunding and public-private partnerships for distributed energy, promoting local collection and efficient utilization of energy. Carry out financial leasing business for energy internet infrastructure, establish a circulation market for leased assets and second-hand equipment, and develop new business models such as after-sales leaseback and profit sharing. Provide differentiated energy products and value-added services for new businesses such as flexible energy use, auxiliary services, energy efficiency management, and energy-saving services.
titlelist: Key tasks: Create an open and shared energy internet ecosystem, promote business model innovation in the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: In order to support the construction of the national Belt and Road initiative, establish a sound and open energy internet international cooperation mechanism, strengthen interconnection with neighboring countries' energy infrastructure, and promote the advanced technology, equipment, standards, and models of domestic energy internet to go global.
titlelist: Key tasks: Create an open and shared energy internet ecological system, establish an international cooperation mechanism for the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Encourage the integration of various types of distributed energy storage devices, such as energy storage, heat storage, cold storage, clean fuel storage, etc., in community, building, and home application scenarios, as well as other dispersed, redundant, and performance-limited energy storage batteries, uninterruptible power supplies, electric vehicle charging and discharging stations, and other energy storage facilities in society. Establish a database of energy storage facilities and control and operate existing distributed energy storage devices through the Internet. Promote the hierarchical utilization of waste power batteries from electric vehicles in energy storage systems such as energy storage power stations. Build an energy storage cloud platform to achieve modular design, standardized access, hierarchical utilization, and networked management of energy storage devices, and support the free and flexible trading of energy. Promote value-added services such as energy leasing, emergency backup, peak shaving, and frequency regulation provided by energy storage.
titlelist: Key tasks: develop new models for energy storage and electric vehicle applications, develop networked management and operation models for energy storage.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Encourage the operation of charging and swapping facilities, electric vehicle companies, etc., integrate various data from the power grid, vehicle companies, transportation, meteorology, safety, etc., and build a new energy vehicle operation cloud platform based on the elements of the power grid, energy storage, and distributed electricity. Promote the two-way interaction of energy and information between electric vehicles and smart grids, apply battery energy information and internet technology, and explore new operating models such as wireless charging, mobile charging, and intelligent guidance for charging and discharging. Actively carry out intelligent charging and discharging services for electric vehicles, and explore new models such as electric vehicles participating in energy direct trading and power demand response through internet platforms.
titlelist: Key tasks include developing new models for energy storage and electric vehicle applications, as well as developing intelligent charging and discharging models for vehicle-grid coordination.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Make full use of renewable energy resources such as wind energy and solar energy in urban areas, scenic spots, highways, etc. Construct appropriate infrastructure such as new energy charging and discharging stations according to local conditions, and provide services such as electric vehicle charging, discharging, and battery swapping. Achieve the coordinated and optimized operation of electric vehicles and new energy.
titlelist: Key tasks: Developing new models for energy storage and electric vehicle applications, and developing new models for the operation of new energy + electric vehicles.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Improve the construction of an Internet-based smart energy trading platform. Construct an energy comprehensive service center for smart homes, smart buildings, smart communities, and smart factories, realizing intelligent customization, proactive push, and resource optimization combination of various energy sources. Encourage enterprises and residential users to conduct local autonomous transactions with distributed resources, power load resources, and energy storage resources through micro-balance markets. Guide energy production and consumption behavior through real-time transactions, and achieve integrated distributed energy production and consumption.
titlelist: Key tasks: developing new smart energy consumption models and cultivating new smart energy consumption models on the user side.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Gradually cultivate new market entities such as virtual power plants and load aggregators to increase the supply of flexible resources. Encourage users to independently provide flexible energy services such as energy response, frequency regulation, and peak shaving, and conduct dynamic and real-time transactions through internet platforms. Further improve relevant market mechanisms and accommodate various channels for users to participate in flexible resource market transactions, including direct and indirect methods. Establish a reasonable pricing mechanism for compensating flexible resources to ensure that investments in flexible resources receive reasonable returns.
titlelist: Key tasks: develop new smart energy utilization models, construct new user-driven energy service models.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Encourage the provision of more differentiated energy products and service solutions. Build a user energy efficiency monitoring platform and achieve data interconnection and sharing, providing personalized energy efficiency management and energy-saving services. Based on internet platforms, provide value-added services such as energy management and transaction delegation for user terminal facilities. Expand third-party credit evaluation, encourage energy companies or professional data service companies to expand independent energy big data information services.
titlelist: Key tasks: developing new models for intelligent energy use and expanding new models for value-added services in intelligent energy use.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Build an internet-based green energy flexible trading platform that supports direct transactions between green low-carbon energy sources such as wind power, solar power, hydropower, and electricity users. Explore the environmental benefits of green energy and create corresponding energy derivatives, providing differentiated green energy packages for different user groups. Cultivate new formats of green energy production, consumption, and trading such as third-party operation and maintenance, and peer-to-peer energy services.
titlelist: Key tasks include cultivating a flexible trading market model for green energy and building an internet-based flexible trading platform for green energy.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Establish a distributed real-time subsidy settlement mechanism for renewable energy based on an internet platform, realizing real-time linkage between subsidy calculation, certification, settlement, and renewable energy production transactions. Further explore the inclusion of large-scale wind farms, solar power plants, and other facilities into the scope of real-time subsidies based on an internet platform.
titlelist: Key tasks: Cultivate a flexible trading market model for green energy and establish a real-time subsidy mechanism for renewable energy.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Explore the establishment of a green certificate generation and certification mechanism that is linked in real-time to green energy production and trading. Promote the integration of the green certificate trading system with the existing emission rights trading system, and through reasonable mechanisms, make green certificate trading a beneficial supplement to carbon emission rights trading. Promote the establishment of a mandatory quota system for green energy production and achieve green certificate trading and settlement based on internet platforms. Promote the securitization and financialization of green certificates.
titlelist: Key tasks include cultivating a flexible trading market model for green energy and developing a certificate trading system for green energy.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Implement the national big data strategy in the energy sector, actively expand the scope of energy big data collection, gradually covering the fields of electricity, coal, oil, gas, as well as meteorology, economy, transportation, and other areas. Achieve the integrated fusion of multi-sector energy big data. Establish a national energy big data center and gradually achieve data integration and sharing with relevant market entities. Based on security and fairness, with effective supervision as a prerequisite, break down the data barriers between government departments and enterprises, promote the integration of various data resources, and improve the timeliness and accuracy of energy statistics, analysis, forecasting, and other business operations.
titlelist: Key tasks: develop energy big data service applications, achieve the integration and secure sharing of energy big data.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Promote innovation and entrepreneurship based on energy big data, and develop new business applications and value-added services for energy production, distribution, consumption, and other processes. Encourage energy production, service companies, and third-party enterprises to invest in and build energy big data operation platforms for wind power, photovoltaics, and other energy sources, providing specialized services for energy resource assessment, site optimization, and other businesses. Encourage the development of information mining and intelligent prediction services based on energy big data, enabling precise scheduling, fault diagnosis, and condition maintenance of energy equipment. Encourage the development of specialized services related to greenhouse gas emissions based on energy big data. Encourage the provision of energy big data information services for energy end-users, enabling real-time perception and dynamic analysis of energy consumption behavior, and achieving remote, friendly, and interactive intelligent energy control.
titlelist: Key tasks: developing energy big data service applications, innovating the business service system of energy big data.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Develop and provide new equipment with functions such as energy aggregation, flexible distribution, precise control, and non-discriminatory access, to provide hardware support for the bottom-up autonomous networking and decentralized networked collaborative control of energy internet facilities. Support the research and development and application of key technologies, products, and equipment such as direct current grids, advanced energy storage, energy conversion, and demand-side management. Promote clean alternative technologies such as port gasification and shore power. Strengthen international cooperation in the research and development of energy internet technology equipment.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote key technology research and development for the energy internet, support the development of core equipment for the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Research low-cost, high-performance integrated communication technology. Research information coding, encryption, verification, and communication technology that is secure and reliable for various types of information such as vector measurement, electricity pricing, control, and services in information-physical systems. Research key technologies such as efficient scheduling management and collaborative control for the efficient integration of energy flow and information flow in information-physical systems. Research key technologies for unified modeling and secure analysis of information-energy coupling.
titlelist: Key tasks, promote key technology research and development of energy internet, support key technology research and development of cyber-physical systems.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Research on modeling, analysis, and optimization techniques for multi-energy fusion systems. Research on centralized and distributed collaborative computing, control, scheduling, and self-healing techniques. Develop an energy e-commerce platform that supports multiple trading entities, multiple energy commodities, and complex transaction types. Research on real-time transactions that support distributed and concurrent interactive responses, internet virtual energy currency authentication, pricing, circulation, trading, and settlement of internet virtual energy currency. Explore software-defined energy network technologies.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting key technology research and development for the energy internet, supporting key technology research and development for system operation and trading.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Research and establish a standard system for the energy internet. Prioritize the development of general standards for the energy internet, as well as cross-industry public standards and important technical standards that are coordinated with smart cities and initiatives such as Made in China 2025. These standards include energy conversion standards, equipment standards, information exchange standards, security and protection standards, energy trading standards, measurement and collection standards, and regulatory standards for the energy internet. Promote the establishment of an international standardization technical committee for the energy internet and strive to make core standards become international standards.
titlelist: Key tasks: to build an internationally leading standard system for energy internet and to formulate general technical standards for energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Establish a comprehensive, advanced, and industry-wide product testing and quality certification platform. Establish a national energy internet quality certification platform and a mechanism for sharing testing data. Establish a national energy internet product testing and quality certification platform and network. Encourage the construction of energy internet enterprise and product databases, and regularly release testing data. Establish sound testing methods and evaluation systems to guide the healthy development of the industry.
titlelist: Key tasks: Establish an internationally leading standard system for the energy internet and establish a quality certification system for the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Under the mechanism of the inter-ministerial joint conference for the implementation of the Internet Plus initiative, the National Energy Administration, together with the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and other relevant departments, has established a special coordination mechanism for the Internet Plus smart energy, to coordinate and solve major issues, summarize and promote successful experiences and effective practices in a timely manner, and effectively promote the implementation of the initiative. Strengthen the construction of the energy internet technology innovation platform, relying on enterprises, research institutions, and universities to establish a national energy internet technology innovation center and key laboratories. Establish a cross-disciplinary and cross-industry professional advisory committee for the energy internet, providing important support for government decision-making. The competent departments of local development and reform (energy), industry and information technology should, based on local conditions, take the lead in studying and formulating action plans for the implementation of the energy internet that are suitable for the local situation, plan comprehensively, organize scientifically, and prevent blind construction and redundant investment, pragmatically and orderly promote the energy internet initiative.
titlelist: Organize and implement, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Establish and improve relevant laws and regulations to ensure the healthy and orderly development of the energy internet. The ongoing process of revising energy laws, electricity laws, and other related laws and regulations should adapt to the development needs of the new models and formats of the energy internet. Strengthen the coordination between power and oil and gas system reforms, other resource and environmental price reforms, as well as market mechanisms such as carbon trading and energy rights trading, and the development of the energy internet. Actively carry out pilot policies for innovation in the energy internet, remove policy barriers in terms of regional quotas, local protection, interconnection, data sharing, and trading mechanisms, and study and formulate relevant policies and regulations on pricing, taxation, insurance, and other aspects that adapt to the characteristics of the development of the new models and formats of the energy internet. Strengthen the management and protection of intellectual property rights in energy internet technologies, products, and models. Strengthen the construction of policies, regulations, and standards for information security in the energy internet.
titlelist: Organize and implement, improve policies and regulations.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
category: '新能源' translates to 'new energy' in English.
content: Encouraging regions, departments, and enterprises with the necessary conditions to carry out various types of energy internet application pilot demonstrations based on local conditions and industries, in order to achieve comprehensive and deep integration of modern internet technology and energy systems. titlelist: Organize and implement, carry out pilot demonstrations.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Carry out pilot reforms for the hierarchical utilization of public energy data, and research and formulate norms for the management and trading of energy data usage. Starting from the needs of national security, system security, and user information security, promote the hierarchical classification of energy information. Strengthen the security supervision of the entire process of energy big data collection, transmission, storage, processing, and sharing. Enhance the co-construction and sharing of information infrastructure for the energy internet, establish an information public service network and database that spans the entire energy industry chain, and strengthen the energy information connection, sharing, and trading services between upstream and downstream enterprises. Encourage cooperation between internet companies and energy enterprises to explore the commercial value of energy big data and promote the application innovation of the energy internet.
titlelist: Organize and implement, share data resources.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: Promote the establishment of the Energy Internet Innovation Industry Alliance, cooperate with relevant government departments to strictly manage the access of Energy Internet products, and carry out work related to standards, testing, and certification. Introduce and cultivate a group of leading, compound, and professional talents to form an intellectual support system for the construction of the Energy Internet. Innovate talent cultivation models and establish a sound multi-level, interdisciplinary talent cultivation system for the Energy Internet. Explore the establishment of Energy Internet-related majors or training programs in universities and vigorously cultivate cross-disciplinary compound talents.
titlelist: Organize and implement, strengthen the foundation of innovation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Development of 'Internet+' Smart Energy (NDRC Energy [2016] No. 392) (National Development and Reform Commission, National Energy Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2016)
content: All relevant departments, enterprises, and news media should strengthen the promotion of energy internet policies, mechanisms, development trends, advanced technologies, demonstration projects, emerging industries, and other aspects through various forms. This will enable the comprehensive understanding of the energy internet by all sectors of society, expand the demonstration effect, attract more social capital to participate in the research, construction, and innovative development of the energy internet, and create a wide-ranging, active, and sustainable development atmosphere for the energy internet. This will provide a favorable public opinion environment for the emergence and development of new technologies, new business models, and new industries in the energy internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Digital Economy (State Council [2021] No. 29) (State Council/December 12, 2021)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: By 2025, the digital economy will enter a comprehensive expansion phase, with the added value of core digital industries accounting for 10% of GDP. The ability to lead development through digital innovation will significantly increase, and the level of intelligence will be noticeably enhanced. The integration of digital technology and the real economy will achieve significant results, and the governance system of the digital economy will be further improved. China's competitiveness and influence in the digital economy will steadily increase. - The preliminary establishment of the data factor market system. The data resource system will be basically completed, and the use of data resources will promote the synergy of the entire value chain of research and development, production, circulation, services, and consumption. The effectiveness of market-oriented construction of data factors will be evident, and orderly data rights, pricing, and transactions will be carried out. Explorations will be made to establish an income distribution mechanism that is in line with the value and contribution of data factors, stimulating the innovation vitality of market entities. - Industrial digital transformation will reach a new level. The digital transformation of agriculture will progress rapidly, and the digitization, networking, and intelligence of manufacturing will deepen. The integration and development of productive service industries will accelerate and become more widespread, while the diversification of lifestyle service industries will significantly accelerate. The supporting service system for industrial digital transformation will be basically complete, promoting green development in the process of digital transformation. - The level of digital industrialization will significantly increase. The independent innovation capability of digital technology will be significantly enhanced, and the quality of digital products and services will be greatly improved. The core competitiveness of industries will be significantly enhanced, and global leading advantages will be formed in some fields. New industries, new formats, and new models will continue to emerge and become widely popular, significantly enhancing the upgrading and efficiency of the real economy. - Digital public services will be more inclusive and equitable. Digital infrastructure will be widely integrated into production and life, further highlighting its support for government services, public services, social welfare, and social governance. The digital business environment will be further optimized, and the level of e-government services will be further improved, facilitating enterprises through networking, digitization, and intelligence. The service system will continue to improve, and the digital divide will be bridged at an accelerated pace. - The governance system of the digital economy will be further improved. A coordinated and unified framework and rules for the governance of the digital economy will be established, and cross-departmental and cross-regional collaborative regulatory mechanisms will be basically sound. The government's digital regulatory capabilities will be significantly enhanced, and the level of industry and market supervision will be greatly improved. A governance pattern for the digital economy led by the government, with diverse participation and legal guarantees, will be basically formed, and the level of governance will be significantly improved. The legal and regulatory system will be further improved to adapt to the development of the digital economy, and the security system of the digital economy will be further strengthened. Looking ahead to 2035, the digital economy will move towards a period of prosperity and maturity, striving to form a unified, fair, competitively ordered, and mature and complete modern market system for the digital economy. The development foundation of the digital economy and the level of industrial system development will be at the forefront of the world.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Outline of the National Informatization Development Strategy (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on July 27, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Currently, a new round of technological revolution represented by information technology is flourishing, and the Internet is increasingly becoming the driving force for innovative development. The integration of information technology with biotechnology, new energy technology, new materials technology, and other fields is triggering breakthroughs in green, intelligent, and ubiquitous technologies. Information, capital, technology, and talent are flowing rapidly on a global scale, and the Internet is driving industrial transformation, promoting the transition from industrial economy to information economy, and a new international division of labor is taking shape. The internet industry represents new productive forces and new directions for development, enhancing humanity's ability to understand and transform the world, profoundly changing people's production and lifestyle, bringing about a qualitative leap in productivity, and leading to significant changes in production relations. It has become the dominant force in reshaping the new pattern of international economic, political, cultural, social, ecological, and military development. Global informatization has entered a new stage of comprehensive penetration, cross-border integration, accelerated innovation, and leading development. With the deepening development of world multipolarity, economic globalization, cultural diversity, and social informatization, the global governance system is undergoing profound changes. Whoever occupies the commanding heights of informatization will be able to seize the initiative, gain advantages, ensure security, and win the future. Developed countries continue to promote information technology innovation, accelerate the process of economic and social digitization, and consolidate their leading advantages. Developing countries seize the opportunities of industrial chain restructuring and adjustment, promote transformation and development through informatization, and actively seek to grasp the initiative in development. Countries around the world are accelerating their strategic layout in cyberspace, and the competition for key resource acquisition and international rule-making is becoming increasingly sharp and complex. Accelerating informatization development and building a digital nation has become a global consensus.
titlelist: The basic situation of national informatization development, human society has experienced the agricultural revolution, industrial revolution, and is currently undergoing the information revolution.

name: Outline of the National Informatization Development Strategy (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on July 27, 2016)
category: '通用' translates to 'universal' or 'general' in English.
content: Currently, China ranks first in terms of the number of internet users, the volume of online retail transactions, and the scale of electronic information product manufacturing globally. A group of information technology and internet companies have entered the forefront of the world, forming a relatively complete information industry system. The application of information technology continues to deepen, the emergence of the Internet Plus has gained momentum, the pace of digital and network transformation of the economy and society has accelerated, and positive energy in the cyberspace has further converged and strengthened. The role of informatization in the overall modernization construction is increasingly prominent. At the same time, China's informatization development also faces prominent problems, mainly including: dependence on core technologies and equipment, insufficient development and utilization of information resources, low level of information infrastructure popularization, significant regional and urban-rural disparities, severe challenges in network security, urgent need to strengthen the construction of the rule of law in cyberspace, and the potential of informatization in promoting economic and social development and serving the overall national strategic layout has not been fully released. China's comprehensive national strength, international influence, and strategic initiative continue to grow, and its development is still in a period of significant strategic opportunities. From the domestic perspective, China has entered a critical period of synchronous development of new industrialization, informatization, urbanization, and agricultural modernization. The information revolution provides a historic opportunity for China to accelerate the completion of industrialization tasks, overcome the middle-income trap, and build new advantages in international competition, but it also warns us of the huge risks of falling behind, slow progress, and missed opportunities. Standing at a new historical starting point, we are fully capable of relying on the advantages of being a major country and our institutional strengths to accelerate informatization development and promote the socialist modernization of our country to a new level.
titlelist: The basic situation of national informatization development, especially since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, our country has made significant progress in informatization. However, there is still a gap compared to the goal of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects and accelerating the promotion of socialist modernization. We must adhere to the path of informatization development with Chinese characteristics, drive modernization with informatization, build a strong cyber nation, and it is urgent and imperative.

Accelerate the transformation and application of key artificial intelligence technologies based on national strategies and industrial needs. Conduct research on ethical norms for artificial intelligence and explore the establishment of legal and ethical frameworks to ensure the healthy development of artificial intelligence. Promote the healthy and orderly development of blockchain technology applications and industrial ecosystems. Focus on the research of core technologies such as cryptography, consensus mechanisms, and smart contracts, support the construction of secure, controllable, and sustainable underlying technology platforms and blockchain open-source communities. Build a system of blockchain standards and specifications, strengthen the testing and evaluation of blockchain technology, and formulate standards and specifications for blockchain industry applications in key basic fields. Carry out pilot projects for innovative blockchain applications, focusing on financial technology, supply chain services, government services, and business technology. Establish a security guarantee and supporting system that adapts to blockchain technology mechanisms. Explore and research quantum information technology. Strengthen the research and development of common key technologies and basic devices. Take the lead in the research of quantum communication, quantum computing, and quantum sensing technologies, and promote the exploration of quantum computing applications and the construction of industrial ecosystems. Explore the construction of quantum information network technology and standard systems.
titlelist: Priority action, cutting-edge breakthrough in digital technology action.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Central Committee for Cybersecurity and Informatization/December 27, 2021)

content: Action goals: By 2023, the construction of the dynamic monitoring network and regulatory system for natural resources, ecological environment, national parks, water resources, and energy will be further improved. Strengthen real-time perception, intelligent planning, and intelligent regulation of natural resources and land space. Optimize and improve basic information such as natural resources, land space, and natural geographical patterns, promote the improvement of dynamic perception technology capabilities covering natural resources development and utilization, asset management, land space planning implementation, farmland protection, ecological restoration, marine resources regulation, meteorological disasters, geological disasters, and marine disasters monitoring, and promote the construction of a three-dimensional one map of natural resources and a basic information platform for land space in accordance with the requirements of unified base map, unified standards, unified planning, and unified platform. Strengthen the intelligent application of comprehensive regulation, analysis and prediction, and macro decision-making, and provide data sharing and services for natural resources and land space. Build an intelligent and efficient digital governance system for ecological environment. Improve the intelligent monitoring and regulation level of ecological environment, improve the information platform for comprehensive management of ecological environment, support precise, scientific, and law-based pollution control. Promote regional ecological environment information-based collaborative governance, share relevant resources with public interest litigation, and enhance risk prevention and integrated protection capabilities. Support the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and the Yangtze River Delta region in building information-based demonstration areas for coordinated air environmental governance, support the construction of information-based demonstration areas for water ecological environment system governance in the Yangtze River Economic Belt, the Yellow River Basin, and the Chengdu-Chongqing Twin City Economic Circle, and support the construction of demonstration areas for green ecological cities in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Improve the Belt and Road ecological environmental protection big data service platform, promote international cooperation in ecological environment standards, data resources, monitoring networks, and cloud service resources. Enhance the perception capability of forest and grassland ecological networks, improve the digital monitoring and evaluation system for the effectiveness of ecosystem protection. Strengthen the capacity building for law enforcement and supervision of the fishing ban in the Yangtze River, and improve the intelligent monitoring, evaluation, and protection management level of aquatic organisms. Promote the construction of smart water conservancy. Promote the integration of new generation information technology and water conservancy business, improve the monitoring system of major rivers, strengthen the application of water conservancy big data, and accelerate the orderly sharing of important water conservancy data such as hydrology and water resources. Enhance the ability of water situation monitoring and intelligent scheduling based on river basins. Strengthen national comprehensive water conservancy supervision and continuously improve the information management capacity for national water conservation. Build a smart energy system. Promote deep integration of energy and information fields, improve the informatization and intelligent level of power grid, oil and gas, and coal infrastructure, and promote the construction of an energy system that integrates generation, grid, load, storage, and interaction, coordinates multiple energies, and intelligently regulates energy demand. Implement the national energy management and supervision informationization project, and formulate unified energy supervision standards and regulatory data indicators.

name: 14th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Central Committee for Cybersecurity and Informatization/December 27, 2021)

content: Action goals: By 2023, the digital transformation of the financial industry will have achieved significant results, with improved financial service models, a more diverse product supply, and a broader range of business coverage. By 2025, an advanced, reliable, and flexible infrastructure service system will have been basically established, and the financial industry will have initially achieved digitization, intelligence, and financial inclusiveness. The capacity to serve the real economy will be significantly enhanced, and a regulatory system adapted to financial technology will be formed to provide comprehensive financial support for the new development pattern. The digital financial infrastructure will be improved. The layout of infrastructure will be optimized to promote moderate competition in digital financial services. Infrastructure interconnection will be promoted to facilitate the free flow of factors. The credit system will be further improved, and the credit process and credit evaluation models in key areas will be accelerated. The payment and settlement system will be upgraded and transformed to enhance risk prevention and control and operational support capabilities. The comprehensive statistics of the financial industry will be further improved, and the construction of a national financial basic database will be accelerated. The healthy development of China's financial information service industry will be accelerated. The level of financial services for the people's livelihood will be improved. By comprehensively using technologies such as blockchain, 5G, and edge computing, a multi-level and wide-coverage new model of financial services will be created to promote the continuous maturity and improvement of digital financing, digital letters of credit, and other services, and to enhance the reach of financial services. The legitimate rights and interests of financial consumers in the use of intelligent financial products and services will be effectively protected, and efforts will be made to address the digital divide faced by groups such as the elderly. Agricultural financial product innovation will be strengthened, and the application and promotion of excellent financial technology practices in rural areas will be accelerated. The radius of financial services will be expanded, service efficiency will be improved, and a universal financial service system centered on safety, the people, and demand will be built to achieve the healthy and sustainable development of inclusive finance. The capacity of financial support for the real economy will be enhanced. Market entities will be supported in using digital technology to reconstruct financial service processes, and cross-industry development and utilization of financial data resources will be deepened while ensuring data security and personal privacy. The infrastructure for comprehensive credit services for national small and medium-sized enterprises will be improved, and the collection and sharing of credit information for enterprises in industries such as water, electricity, coal, and gas will be strengthened to improve the accessibility of financing for small and medium-sized enterprises. The establishment of a sound transaction reporting system and transaction reporting database will enhance the transparency of the financial market. The supply of financial services for industrial chain and supply chain finance will be optimized, and financial resources will be allocated to key areas and weak links in economic and social development to increase the quantity, coverage, quality, and efficiency of financial services for all types of enterprises, especially private and micro-enterprises. Soft connectivity with international and regional financial markets, rules, and standards will be strengthened to promote institutional openness in rules, regulations, management, and standards. The regulatory system for financial technology innovation will be improved. Efforts will be made to formulate basic regulatory rules, strengthen monitoring, analysis, and evaluation work, explore management mechanisms for financial technology innovation, enhance the ability of penetrative supervision, and prevent the occurrence of systemic financial risks. Financial technology regulation will be strengthened, and the comprehensive implementation of regulatory tools for financial technology innovation will be promoted. The full life-cycle management of financial technology innovation activities will be strengthened to build a firewall against financial and technological risks. The global governance of cross-border financial services in financial technology will be promoted.
titlelist: Priority Action, Digital Inclusive Financial Services Action

Strengthen the capacity for public health monitoring and early warning. Enhance the monitoring capacity for infectious disease epidemics and sudden public health events, and improve the sensitivity and accuracy of assessment and monitoring. Establish a smart multi-point triggering mechanism for early warning, improve the multi-channel monitoring and early warning mechanism, and enhance real-time analysis and centralized judgment capabilities. Support data sharing between public health institutions and medical institutions, achieve rapid information reporting, and achieve early detection, early reporting, and early disposal. Improve the emergency response capacity for sudden public health events. Strengthen the construction of a centralized, unified, and efficient public health emergency command system, and improve the emergency response mechanism for sudden public health events. Actively utilize digital technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, and cloud computing to better support epidemic monitoring and analysis, virus tracing, prevention and control, and resource allocation. Improve the unified national reserve and emergency material guarantee system, optimize the guarantee and regional layout of emergency materials, and enhance reserve efficiency.
titlelist: Priority Action, Public Health Emergency Digital Construction Action

Coordinate government and social data resources in the elderly care service field, relying on the National Population Basic Information Database, etc., to gather basic data sets such as the health records of the elderly, social security for the elderly, organization and service prices of elderly care institutions, and elderly care practitioners. Develop standardized operating standards for elderly care data resources, and form an elderly care data resource system that is driven by public demand, supervised and managed by the government, and involves social capital. Cultivate standardized smart elderly care services. Accelerate the deep application of information technologies such as the internet, big data, and artificial intelligence in the field of elderly care services, and help build an elderly care service system that coordinates home and community institutions and integrates medical care and health care. Support the research and development, upgrading, and application promotion of aging-friendly intelligent terminal products, actively develop intelligent aids, smart homes, health monitoring, and elderly care products. Promote the aging-friendly transformation and optimization of information services, and strengthen the supply of aging-friendly digital services. Optimize the functions of government service platforms at all levels to facilitate online services for the elderly. Support communities and institutions in providing digital skills training for the elderly population and maintain necessary offline service channels. Establish a comprehensive supervision system for smart elderly care services and promote the healthy development of the smart elderly care market.
