titlelist: Organize and implement, improve the policy system.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: The following is the translation of the Chinese text to English:Integrated circuit production enterprises or projects with a line width smaller than 65 nanometers (inclusive) and an operating period of over 15 years, as encouraged by the state, are exempt from corporate income tax for the first five years. From the sixth year to the tenth year, the corporate income tax is levied at a reduced rate of 25% of the statutory tax rate. Integrated circuit production enterprises or projects with a line width smaller than 130 nanometers (inclusive) and an operating period of over 10 years, as encouraged by the state, are exempt from corporate income tax for the first two years. From the third year to the fifth year, the corporate income tax is levied at a reduced rate of 25% of the statutory tax rate. For integrated circuit production enterprises with a line width smaller than 130 nanometers (inclusive) that incur losses in a tax year, they are allowed to carry forward the losses to subsequent years, with a maximum carry-forward period of 10 years. For enterprises enjoying tax preferential policies as integrated circuit production enterprises, the preferential period is calculated from the year of profitability. For projects enjoying tax preferential policies as integrated circuit production projects, the preferential period is calculated from the tax year in which the first production and operation income is obtained. The list of encouraged integrated circuit production enterprises or projects is formulated by the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and relevant departments.
titlelist: Financial and tax policies: The state encourages integrated circuit production enterprises or projects with a line width of less than 28 nanometers (inclusive) and an operating period of more than 15 years. These enterprises or projects are exempt from corporate income tax from the first year to the tenth year.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Encourage and support eligible enterprises to raise funds through listing on the Science and Technology Innovation Board and the Growth Enterprise Market, and facilitate the exit channels for relevant companies' original shareholders. Provide equity financing, equity transfer, and other services for integrated circuit enterprises and software enterprises at different stages of development through different levels of capital markets, expand direct financing channels, and increase the proportion of direct financing.
titlelist: Investment and financing policies strongly support qualified integrated circuit enterprises and software enterprises to raise funds through domestic and overseas listings. The domestic listing review process will be accelerated. Research and development expenses that meet the relevant conditions of corporate accounting standards can be capitalized.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Strengthen the construction of integrated circuit standardization organization, improve the standard system, enhance standard verification, and enhance research and development capabilities. Improve the quality of integrated circuits and software, and enhance industry competitiveness.
titlelist: Research and development policies encourage software companies to implement national standards for software quality, information security, and development management.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: The Ministry of Commerce, together with relevant departments, has established a long-term cooperation mechanism with key countries and regions, and has taken comprehensive measures to create conditions for enterprises to expand into emerging markets.
titlelist: Import and export policies, promote the export of integrated circuits, software, and information technology services, vigorously develop international service outsourcing business, and support enterprises in establishing overseas marketing networks.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Priority should be given to the construction and cultivation of integrated circuit enterprises that integrate industry and education. Pilot enterprises included in the scope of integrated industry and education enterprise construction and cultivation, whose investments in vocational education comply with regulations, can offset 30% of the education surcharge and local education surcharge payable by the enterprise for the current year. Encourage social industry investment funds to increase investment and support the construction of special resource libraries for integrated circuit talent development through collaboration between universities and enterprises. Support exemplary microelectronics colleges and specialized software colleges to cooperate with internationally renowned universities and multinational companies, introduce foreign teachers and high-quality resources, and jointly cultivate integrated circuit and software talents.
titlelist: Talent policy, encourages eligible universities to cooperate with integrated circuit enterprises to accelerate the construction of exemplary microelectronics colleges.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Through relevant talent programs, we will increase efforts to introduce top experts, outstanding talents, and teams. We will prioritize exploring policies for introducing integrated circuit and software talents in industrial clusters or related industrial agglomerations. We will formulate and implement annual plans for the introduction and training of integrated circuit and software talents, promote the construction of international training bases for national integrated circuit and software talents, and focus on strengthening the long-term training of urgently needed and scarce professional talents.
titlelist: Talent policy encourages localities to commend and reward high-end talents who have made outstanding contributions in the fields of integrated circuits and software in accordance with relevant national regulations, as well as high-level engineers and research and development designers, and improve the stock incentive mechanism.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Support integrated circuit enterprises and software enterprises in applying for intellectual property rights in accordance with the law, and provide relevant support for those that meet the relevant regulations. Vigorously develop intellectual property rights services related to integrated circuits and software.
titlelist: Intellectual property policy, encourages companies to register exclusive rights for integrated circuit layout design and software copyright.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: All computers (including mainframes, servers, microcomputers, and laptops) sold within the territory of China must be pre-installed with genuine software. It is prohibited to sell computers with pirated software pre-installed. The policy measures for government agencies to use genuine software should be fully implemented, and centralized procurement of general software should be carried out, strengthening the management of software assets. The use of genuine software in important industries and key areas should be standardized and institutionalized. Promote publicity, training, supervision, and inspection of the use of genuine software, and create a favorable environment for using genuine software.
titlelist: Intellectual Property Rights Policy, Exploring the Establishment of a Long-term Mechanism for Software Genuine Licensing Work.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Encourage government departments to purchase services to transfer service matters related to e-government construction, data center construction, and data processing that fall within the scope of government responsibilities and are suitable for market-oriented provision to qualified software and information technology service agencies. Hasten the formulation and improvement of corresponding security review and confidentiality management regulations. Encourage large and medium-sized enterprises to establish specialized software and information technology service companies by relying on information technology research and development application business organizations.
titlelist: Market application policies actively guide the development of information technology research and application business outsourcing.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Encourage domestic universities and research institutes to strengthen cooperation with high-level universities and research institutions overseas, and encourage international companies to establish research and development centers in China. Enhance communication and exchange between domestic industry associations and international industry organizations, support domestic companies in conducting cooperation with international companies both domestically and internationally, and actively participate in international market division of labor and international standard setting.
titlelist: International cooperation policy, deepening global cooperation in the integrated circuit industry and software industry, actively creating a favorable environment for international companies to invest and develop in China.

name: Several Policies to Promote the High-Quality Development of the Integrated Circuit Industry and Software Industry in the New Era (State Council [2020] No. 8) (State Council/July 27, 2020)
content: Facilitate domestic enterprises in jointly establishing research and development centers overseas, and better utilize international innovation resources to enhance the level of industrial development. Relevant departments such as the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Commerce will improve service levels and create a favorable environment for enterprises to carry out investment and other cooperation.
titlelist: International cooperation policy, promoting the integrated circuit industry and software industry to 'go global'.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: By 2015, significant progress had been made in the innovation of the institutional mechanisms for the development of the integrated circuit industry, and financing platforms and policy environments that are in line with the development laws of the industry had been established. The sales revenue of the integrated circuit industry exceeded 350 billion yuan. The design technology of integrated circuits in key areas such as mobile intelligent terminals and network communications approached the international advanced level. The 32/28-nanometer manufacturing process achieved large-scale production, and the sales revenue of mid-to-high-end packaging and testing accounted for more than 30% of the total revenue of the packaging and testing industry. Key equipment such as 65-45nm and 12-inch silicon wafers were applied in production lines. By 2020, the gap between the integrated circuit industry and the international advanced level gradually narrowed, with an average annual growth rate of sales revenue exceeding 20%, and the sustainable development capability of enterprises significantly enhanced. The design technology of integrated circuits in key areas such as mobile intelligent terminals, network communications, cloud computing, the Internet of Things, and big data reached the international leading level, and the industrial ecosystem initially formed. The 16/14-nanometer manufacturing process achieved large-scale production, and the packaging and testing technology reached the international leading level. Key equipment and materials entered the international procurement system, and a technologically advanced and secure integrated circuit industry system was basically established. By 2030, the main links of the integrated circuit industry chain reached the international advanced level, and a group of enterprises entered the international first-tier, achieving leapfrog development.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Focus on key areas of the industrial chain, strengthen the collaborative innovation of integrated circuit design, software development, system integration, content and services, and drive the development of the manufacturing industry through the rapid growth of the design industry. Recently, focus on the mobile intelligent terminal and network communication fields, develop mobile intelligent terminal chips, digital TV chips, network communication chips, smart wearable device chips, and operating systems with large quantities and wide applications, and enhance the overall competitiveness of the information technology industry. Play the role of market mechanisms, guide and promote the merger and reorganization of integrated circuit design enterprises. Accelerate the research and development of core technologies in emerging fields such as cloud computing, Internet of Things, and big data, develop key chips such as information processing, sensors, and new storage based on new formats and applications, as well as basic software such as cloud operating systems, and seize the commanding heights of future industrial development. Gradually break through key integrated circuits and embedded software in fields such as smart cards, smart grids, smart transportation, satellite navigation, industrial control, financial electronics, automotive electronics, medical electronics, etc., and improve the support capability for deep integration of informatization and industrialization.
titlelist: Main tasks and development focus, focusing on the development of integrated circuit design industry.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Seize the favorable opportunity of technological change, break through the bottleneck of investment and financing, and continue to promote the construction of advanced production lines. Accelerate the expansion of 45/40nm chip production capacity, intensify the construction of 32/28nm chip production lines, and quickly form scale production capabilities. Accelerate the development of 3D technology, promote the construction of 22/20nm and 16/14nm chip production lines. Vigorously develop special process production lines for analog and mixed-signal circuits, microelectromechanical systems (MEMS), high-voltage circuits, radio frequency circuits, and other characteristic specialties. Enhance the comprehensive capability of chip manufacturing, promote the improvement of design level through process capability enhancement, and promote the development of key equipment and material support through production line construction.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, accelerate the development of the integrated circuit manufacturing industry.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Vigorously promote the merger and reorganization of domestic packaging and testing enterprises to improve industry concentration. Adapt to the evolving and upgrading demands of integrated circuit design and manufacturing process nodes, and develop and industrialize advanced packaging and testing technologies such as chip-level packaging (CSP), wafer-level packaging (WLP), through-silicon via (TSV), and 3D packaging.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, improving the development level of advanced packaging and testing industry.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Strengthen the integration of integrated circuit equipment, materials, and processes, develop key equipment such as lithography machines, etching machines, and ion implantation machines, develop key materials such as photoresists and large-size silicon wafers, enhance collaboration between integrated circuit manufacturing companies and equipment/material companies, accelerate the industrialization process, and enhance the industry's supporting capabilities.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, breakthrough in key equipment and materials for integrated circuits.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Establish the National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Leading Group, responsible for coordinating and promoting the development of the integrated circuit industry, strengthening top-level design, integrating and mobilizing resources from all aspects, and solving major problems. Establish a consulting committee to conduct investigations and research on major issues and policy measures related to industrial development, carry out demonstration and evaluation, and provide consulting advice.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: The National Industrial Investment Fund (hereinafter referred to as the Fund) primarily attracts large enterprises, financial institutions, and social capital to support the development of industries such as integrated circuits and promote industrial transformation and upgrading. The Fund operates in a market-oriented manner, with a focus on supporting the integrated circuit manufacturing sector, while also considering design, packaging testing, equipment, and materials, to promote the improvement of companies' production capacity and implementation of mergers and reorganizations, as well as standardized corporate governance, in order to develop self-sustaining capabilities. The establishment of local integrated circuit industry investment funds is supported. Various types of venture capital and equity investment funds are encouraged to enter the integrated circuit field.
titlelist: Protective measures, establishment of national industrial investment fund.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Actively leverage the complementary advantages of policy-based and commercial finance, support China Export-Import Bank in increasing its service to integrated circuit enterprises within its business scope, encourage and guide the National Development Bank and commercial banks to further increase credit support for the integrated circuit industry, and innovate credit products and services that meet the characteristics of the integrated circuit industry. Support integrated circuit enterprises in domestic and overseas listing financing, issuance of various debt financing instruments, and accelerate development through the National SME Share Transfer System. Encourage the development of loan guarantee insurance and credit insurance businesses, and explore the development of insurance products and services suitable for the development of the integrated circuit industry.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial support.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Promote the formation of a collaborative innovation system along the industrial chain, and support the development of industry alliances. Encourage companies to establish integrated circuit technology research institutions, collaborate with research institutes and universities to carry out pre-competitive key technology research and development, introduce high-level overseas talents, and enhance the sustainable development capabilities of the industry. Strengthen the application and protection of integrated circuit intellectual property rights, establish a national major project intellectual property risk management system, guide the establishment of intellectual property strategic alliances, and actively explore direct financing methods and asset management systems related to intellectual property rights. Accelerate the establishment of standards in the field of major innovations in integrated circuits and fully leverage the role of technical standards.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the construction of enterprise innovation capability.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: Establish and improve the talent training system for integrated circuits, support the development of microelectronics disciplines, accelerate the construction and development of exemplary microelectronics colleges and vocational training institutions through joint training of talents by universities and integrated circuit enterprises. Widely carry out continuing education activities based on the knowledge update project for professional and technical talents, and vigorously cultivate and train high-level, urgently needed, and backbone professional and technical talents in the field of integrated circuits through various forms. Carry out targeted training programs for overseas training, and promote the construction of national software and integrated circuit talent international training bases. Strengthen the funding guarantee for the introduction of software and integrated circuit talents through existing channels. Further increase support for the introduction of outstanding talents in the field of integrated circuits in the Thousand Talents Program, and study and introduce preferential policies for the priority introduction of outstanding entrepreneurs and high-quality technical and management teams. Support integrated circuit enterprises to strengthen cooperation with overseas research institutions. Improve the incentive mechanism for encouraging innovation and creation, and implement equity, stock option incentives, and reward distribution policies for the transformation of scientific and technological research achievements by scientific and technological personnel.
titlelist: Enhance measures to ensure and increase efforts in talent cultivation and recruitment.

name: National Integrated Circuit Industry Development Promotion Outline (State Council/June 24, 2014)
content: 'Further optimize the environment, vigorously attract foreign funds, technology, and talents, and encourage international integrated circuit enterprises to establish research and development, production, and operation centers in the country. Encourage domestic integrated circuit enterprises to expand international cooperation, integrate international resources, and expand international markets. Play the role of cross-strait economic cooperation mechanisms and encourage cross-strait integrated circuit enterprises to strengthen technology and industrial cooperation.'
titlelist: Guarantee measures, continue to expand opening up to the outside world.

name: Further Encouraging Policies for the Development of the Software Industry and Integrated Circuit Industry (State Council [2011] No. 4) (State Council/April 28, 2011)
content: However, compared with the international advanced level, China's software industry and integrated circuit industry still have a relatively weak development foundation. By 2020, the one-number, one-window, one-network goal will be achieved nationwide, with significantly optimized service processes, more diverse service models, smoother service channels, and significantly improved public satisfaction. Relying on a unified data sharing and exchange platform, various departmental business systems will be interconnected, information will be shared, and business collaboration will be promoted, forming a service model of comprehensive front-end acceptance, classified back-end approval, and unified window delivery. Strengthen the construction of standard systems and the application of intellectual property rights. Further optimize the structure of national standards, industry standards, and military standards systems, support the development of group standards, accelerate the construction of a new generation of information technology standard system oriented towards industrialization and military-civilian integration, and research and formulate comprehensive standardization technical systems in key areas such as smart hardware, sensors, smart homes, virtual reality, cloud computing, big data, solar photovoltaics, and lithium-ion batteries. Accelerate the revision of basic standards, general standards, safety standards, testing methods, and key product standards, and continuously improve specifications and requirements in terms of technology, energy consumption, environmental protection, quality, and safety. Actively participate in the formulation of international standardization strategies, policies, and rules, promote more information and communication standards in China to become international standards, accelerate the transformation of internationally advanced standards urgently needed for China's industrial development, and promote the alignment of international and domestic standards. Establish a mechanism for guiding industrial development through patents, strengthen the reserve and strategic layout of key core technology intellectual property rights in the information industry, promote the transfer and transformation of technological innovation achievements through intellectual property rights, encourage market entities to form industrial intellectual property rights alliances, and establish mechanisms for joint creation, collaborative use, mutual protection, and risk sharing of intellectual property rights. Research and formulate intellectual property operation strategies in key areas, improve operation service systems, promote the acquisition, storage, licensing, and transfer of intellectual property rights, and support and guide industry organizations and industrial alliances in strengthening intellectual property analysis and evaluation to prevent and control intellectual property risks.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance systematic innovation capability.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Build a collaborative development industrial chain. Relying on advantageous backbone enterprises, construct and improve a number of important industrial chains such as information networks, cloud computing, big data, the Internet of Things, industrial Internet, smart terminals, and key equipment for electronic manufacturing. Form an architecture of hardware + software + content + services to create several internationally competitive industrial ecosystems. Support eligible enterprises to carry out vertical integration and cross-domain value chain expansion in the industrial chain through mergers and acquisitions, equity investment, and other means, enhancing their value creation and core competitiveness. Implement trademark brand development strategies centered around industrial clusters, improve the overall quality level of the industrial chain, strengthen the construction of group standards, intellectual property rights, and public service platforms, enhance trademark brand promotion and marketing, and create a number of internationally influential regional brands for industrial clusters. Enhance industrial basic capabilities. Develop a list of key bottlenecks in areas such as basic hardware and software, key manufacturing processes, key electronic materials, and process equipment, and organize the implementation of key breakthrough plans in these areas. Promote the special action for improving the quality of the manufacturing industry, tackle key common quality technologies that have long plagued the improvement of product quality for key products in the information industry. Strengthen reliability and measurability design, test verification, accumulate accurate and effective process parameter data, promote the adoption of advanced quality management methods, advanced molding and processing methods, online measurement and detection devices, etc., and improve the reliability, consistency, stability, and effectiveness of electronic information equipment, materials, and process technologies. Develop and improve a batch of urgently needed national metrological standards, strengthen the construction of national metrological testing centers related to the information industry, and build an information industry metrological testing service system. Promote the connection between enterprises in basic hardware and software, basic materials, and process equipment and downstream enterprises, organize the demonstration application of the first set or batch, accelerate the market application and promotion of safe and reliable basic hardware and software products. Enhance enterprise innovation vitality. Establish market-oriented investment funds in key areas of the information industry, support enterprises in mergers and acquisitions, technology introduction, and talent introduction, improve their ability and level to utilize global resources and explore international markets, and form an industrial organizational form with large enterprise groups as the core, high concentration, detailed division of labor, and efficient collaboration. Further improve and implement financial, tax, and financial policies to support the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, promote the construction of entrepreneurship and innovation bases for small and micro enterprises, and vigorously support the development of start-up and innovation-oriented enterprises in the early stage. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises to focus on segmented markets, stimulate their innovation vitality, and develop a group of specialized and excellent hidden champion enterprises. Give full play to the role of various platforms, support the innovative development of small and medium-sized enterprises in the information industry, and guide large, medium, and small enterprises to establish closer collaborative relationships. Support enterprises in transforming patented technologies with core competitiveness into standards, and improve their overall competitiveness. Guide enterprises to establish a business philosophy of prioritizing quality and putting reputation first, effectively enhance their quality and brand awareness, cultivate and promote the spirit of excellence in craftsmanship. Enhance the comprehensive application of information technology in the industry, accelerate the transformation of production methods such as personalized manufacturing, networked collaborative manufacturing, and intelligent manufacturing, innovate and develop new models, and promote the transformation of enterprises to the high-end of the value chain. Optimize the spatial layout of the industry. Implement the overall strategy for regional development and the planning of main functional areas, guide local areas to leverage their comparative advantages, and form differentiated development patterns in key areas such as integrated circuits, basic software, flat panel displays, smart terminals, information technology services, cloud computing, and big data. Focus on promoting breakthroughs in the Yangtze River Economic Belt, the Pearl River Delta, the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and other innovation resource-intensive areas, and build globally competitive innovation highlands in the information industry. Support the central and western regions to undertake the transfer of the information industry based on their own advantages, and focus on supporting several central cities with good foundations and conditions to improve their research and development capabilities and industrial levels, and form differentiated competitive advantages in characteristic areas. Reasonably guide the aggregation of talent, technology, capital, policies, and other resource factors, build a number of national new industrialization demonstration bases in the information industry, and continuously improve the level of software city construction. Solidly promote the optimization of data center layout and promote the rational utilization of data centers. Promote green development of the industry. Support the promotion of enterprise upgrading of production technology and processes, encourage the development of green products, promote green design of electronic information products, reduce energy consumption in the production and use of electronic information products, guide green production, and promote green consumption. Continuously improve the limited requirements for toxic and hazardous substances in electronic information products, strictly test the links, and ensure that the content of restricted substances complies with national standards. Research and develop traceable metrological testing technologies, methods, and devices for energy efficiency (PUE) in data centers. Encourage enterprises to research and develop energy-saving server equipment, and develop green cloud computing data centers using new energy-saving technologies such as high-voltage direct current and natural air cooling. Accelerate the energy-saving transformation of existing data centers, base stations, and other information network facilities, encourage the elimination and retirement of old and high-energy-consuming equipment, and promote the application of new green and energy-saving technologies. Promote the research and development of technologies for the disposal and resource utilization of waste electrical and electronic products, formulate relevant standards for the comprehensive utilization of waste electrical and electronic products and key dismantling products, build and promote Internet-based recycling service information platforms, promote producers' fulfillment of responsibilities for the recycling and disposal of waste electrical and electronic products, encourage the development of specialized recycling and disposal enterprises, and promote the scale development of the remanufacturing industry. Promote the establishment and implementation of a unified system for green product standards, certification, and labeling.
titlelist: The main task is to build a synergistic and optimized industrial structure.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the integration and innovation of information technology and manufacturing. Promote the close integration of manufacturing, Internet Plus, and mass entrepreneurship and innovation, accelerate the wider and deeper integration, penetration, and innovative application of new generation information technology, and promote the intelligent, green, and service-oriented development of the manufacturing industry. Establish and improve the standard system for intelligent manufacturing and the integration of the two industries, comprehensively promote the standardization of the integration of the two industries. Promote the Next Generation Numerical Control demonstration project, accelerate the breakthrough in core intelligent manufacturing information equipment such as sensors, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and industrial control systems, and improve the level of safety and reliability. Carry out pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing. Promote the research and industrialization of key technologies of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), build comprehensive verification platforms, and carry out industry application testing and pilot demonstrations. Focus on industrial cloud, industrial big data, industrial e-commerce, and system solutions, carry out pilot demonstrations of the integration of manufacturing and the Internet, and cultivate a group of leading enterprises in system solutions for intelligent manufacturing in key industries. Implement pilot projects for innovative applications of industrial cloud and industrial big data, build a number of high-quality industrial cloud services and industrial big data platforms, promote intelligent manufacturing new models such as personalized customization, networked collaborative manufacturing, and remote operation and maintenance services. Build mass entrepreneurship and innovation platforms for large-scale manufacturing enterprises and third-party service platforms serving small and medium-sized enterprises, and create a new ecosystem of collaborative development for large, medium, and small enterprises. Relying on strong foundation projects, focusing on the application needs of key links in intelligent manufacturing, support the development of a group of industrial software with good application effects, strong technological innovation, and high market recognition, and promote the popularization of advanced and applicable industrial software in key industries. Actively promote the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing industry through information technology, and strive to improve the added value of products and services. Actively promote the Internet Plus action. Relying on Internet platforms, vigorously develop crowd innovation, crowd sourcing, crowd support, and crowd funding, promote the integration and development of the Internet and the economy and society. Establish the Internet Plus standard system, accelerate the development and promotion of basic common standards and key technical standards for the Internet and its integrated applications. Integrate various resources such as government departments, telecommunications companies, Internet companies, and industry institutions, integrate resource application, open capabilities, technical support, entrepreneurship incubation, testing and certification, experimental environment, business consulting, and other entrepreneurship and innovation services, enhance the support capabilities of information and communication enterprises for mass entrepreneurship and innovation service platforms. Promote Internet Plus safety production, enhance the online monitoring, early warning, and control capabilities of key areas of safety production enterprises throughout the entire process and chain, strengthen cross-departmental and cross-regional information sharing and business collaboration. Carry out the cultivation of new types of network economy, support Internet companies, information technology service companies, and manufacturing companies in jointly creating platform economic models for service industry transformation, accelerate the development and application of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data, and other technologies in economic activities, strengthen support for smart transportation, smart energy, smart environmental protection, efficient logistics, people's livelihood services, inclusive finance, smart healthcare, modern agriculture, etc., and develop communication facilities and new businesses based on the power grid. Cultivate new forms of information consumption and expand new space for the network economy. Accelerate the development of information technology services. Focus on key areas such as government affairs, finance, energy, transportation, environmental protection, safety production, e-commerce, digital content, etc., enhance the consulting design, software development, integrated implementation, operation and maintenance, and testing and verification capabilities of information technology service enterprises. Support information technology enterprises in breaking through key technologies such as business modeling, remote intelligent inspection, large-scale resource scheduling and management, automated operation and maintenance, and data governance, develop new models and new formats such as Internet operation and maintenance services, network crowdsourcing services, microservices, and intelligent services, strengthen the application and promotion of emerging technologies such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and augmented reality in industry system solutions, and accelerate the transformation into high-end value service providers. Select cities or regions for the concentrated development of the information technology service industry and carry out application demonstrations of information technology services for manufacturing. Summarize advanced industry practices, formulate and improve relevant norms for information technology services. Accelerate the development and industrialization of integrated integration and intelligent operation and maintenance platforms, and enhance the guarantee capabilities of information technology services. Implement a five-year action plan for the standardization of information technology services, improve and promote information technology service standards (ITSS), and encourage enterprises to accelerate standardization and productization of services.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the deep integration and application of information technology.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Innovate the management of the internet industry. Adhere to the combination of policy guidance and law-based management, encourage support and regulate parallel development, and promote the sustainable and healthy development of the internet. Innovate the regulatory system, actively use advanced technologies such as big data to strengthen supervision of market entities, and form a comprehensive management system for the internet industry covering resources, access, networks, and business at all levels. Improve the management system of internet basic resources, strictly implement real-name registration for websites, domain names, IP addresses, and phone numbers. Accelerate the promotion and use of IPv6 addresses, and promote the opening of international connections for IPv6. Establish and improve a multi-department collaborative management mechanism, establish a new business filing and development guidance system, and strengthen the joint management of new business integration between the internet and the real economy. Adhere to the combination of delegation and regulation, promote the construction of a whole-process supervision support system represented by the credit system, and strengthen in-process and post-event supervision. Establish a credit evaluation system for internet market entities, rely on the national enterprise information disclosure system to establish a mechanism for collecting and sharing enterprise information, improve the system of joint incentives for trustworthy behavior and joint punishment for untrustworthy behavior, promote hierarchical market warnings, and create a fair and trustworthy market environment. Strengthen the supervision of service quality, protect user rights and personal information. Actively guide social forces to participate in the management of the internet industry, improve industry norms and self-discipline conventions, guide industry associations and third-party organizations to carry out industry self-discipline, social supervision, evaluation and certification activities, and promote the formation of a governance pattern led by the government and involving multiple parties. Improve the management of the telecommunications industry. Focus on consolidating the foundational support position of the telecommunications industry, build high-quality information infrastructure, and enhance industry service capabilities and quality. Accelerate the pilot work of universal telecommunications services. Deepen the promotion of network speed increase and fee reduction, promote the simplification of telecommunications tariff structures, improve the cost-effectiveness of telecommunications services, and regulate corporate operations, services, and charging behaviors. Further open up access to competitive market areas, do a good job in the opening pilot of the telecommunications field in free trade zones, and promote opening and cooperation with Hong Kong, Macao, and other regions. Optimize the management of radio frequency and satellite orbit resources. Optimize the allocation of national spectrum resources, strengthen radio frequency management, and maintain a safe and orderly radio wave environment. Scientifically plan and reasonably allocate radio frequency resources, coordinate the medium- and long-term frequency requirements for key business sectors and the development of strategic emerging industries, and promote the development of wireless radio services related to Broadband China, information consumption, and the Internet Plus action. Strengthen the basic, forward-looking, and strategic research on major issues related to the use of radio frequency and satellite orbit resources, strengthen the availability demonstration of satellite frequency and orbit resources, and carry out international declaration, coordination, and registration of satellite network information. Conduct radio frequency usage assessments to promote the effective development and utilization of spectrum resources. Deepen station management and strengthen in-process and post-event supervision. Increase investment in the construction of radio management infrastructure and technical facilities, strengthen the capacity building of radio supervision, realize the coverage of a wide-area and ubiquitous urban radio monitoring network, and enhance the ability to maintain radio wave order.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the management level of the information, communication, and radio industry.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Improve the management system for network and information security. Accelerate the formulation of departmental regulations and normative documents in the areas of protecting critical information infrastructure, data security, and industrial internet security. Enhance the network and information security standard system and promote the establishment of security standards in emerging fields such as 5G, Internet of Things, cloud computing, big data, and intelligent manufacturing. Strengthen the promotion of secure and reliable electronic signature applications and push for the legal recognition of electronic signatures. Establish and improve the management system for identity service providers. Clarify the responsibility for protecting critical information infrastructure and improve the supervision mechanism for the design, construction, and operation of information systems related to national security. Further strengthen the network security supervision of important network infrastructure and business systems owned or operated by internet companies. Establish a cross-industry and cross-department emergency coordination mechanism to enhance the ability to predict, monitor, and respond to network and information security incidents. Strengthen the sharing of security threat information between the government and enterprises. Accelerate the implementation of the network security review system. Enhance network data protection in the context of big data. Explore the establishment of a network data protection system in the era of big data, promote the hierarchical classification regulation of network data, strengthen the protection of network data throughout its lifecycle, and formulate policies for network data protection management. Urge companies to continuously improve the system for publicly announcing user information leaks and establish a sound big data security credit system. Accelerate the research and application of specialized technologies such as data encryption, leakage prevention, and information confidentiality, and promote the establishment of a secure and trustworthy big data technology system. Promote the development of information security technology and industry. Focus on breakthroughs in key basic software and hardware and core information security technologies, enhance capabilities in vulnerability discovery and patching, attack monitoring and tracing, and strengthen security risk response in new technologies and formats such as Internet Plus, 5G, and SDN. Implement special projects for national information security, carry out pilot demonstrations of the protection of critical information infrastructure and the security of key information system networks. Promote the research and development and industrial application of information security products and services. Give full play to the guiding role of the government, accelerate the cultivation of backbone enterprises, develop enterprises with distinctive advantages, and create a well-structured, clear-cut, and competitive industrial pattern. Enhance the capability of industrial information security assurance. Establish and improve the policy and standard system for industrial information security, develop security management policies, as well as management guidelines and evaluation capability requirements for key industries. Establish an industrial information security management system, improve inspection and evaluation, and information sharing mechanisms for industrial information security, promote security inspections, vulnerability disclosures, information notifications, and create a secure environment for industrial internet. Build industrial information security simulation, testing, and verification platforms, conduct technical research and development on testing and evaluation, security verification, and promote pilot applications of new security technologies and products, enhance the capability of industrial information security technology assurance. Column 2: Enhancing security assurance capabilities. Information security technology products. Carry out research on chip security reinforcement technology and promote the standardization and industrialization of cryptographic technology in China. Strengthen the research and development and application of information security technologies for the integration of the three networks, the Internet of Things, mobile internet, industrial internet, cloud computing, and next-generation information networks. Enhance the research and development of security chips, secure core information devices, secure operating systems, secure databases, and secure middleware. Develop products using new technologies such as content awareness, intelligent sandboxing, anomaly detection, and virtualization, support the innovation and application of network and boundary security products such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention, accelerate the prevention of advanced persistent threats (APTs) and product development, strengthen the research and development and application of security management platform products based on massive data and intelligent analysis. Strengthen the research and development and application of information security support tools such as information security evaluation, web vulnerability scanning, and software source code security checks. Information security assurance. Build a network security threat monitoring and disposal platform based on the backbone network, develop capabilities in network security threat monitoring, situational awareness, emergency response, and traceability. Implement domain name system security protection projects, enhance the access bandwidth and security protection capabilities of the national top-level domain name system, strengthen the security protection and data backup capabilities of public recursive domain name resolution systems. Construct an internet network security emergency management platform, improve the analysis, judgment, and industry-specific emergency command and dispatch capabilities for internet network security threat information and monitoring data. Build a service platform for testing, evaluation, vulnerability disclosure, and information notification of industrial control system information security, and improve the information security assurance system.
titlelist: Main task: Strengthening the capability of ensuring the security of the information industry.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Improve the level of international development in the industry. Promote the combination of investment attraction, technology attraction, and talent attraction, encourage and support information industry enterprises and overseas advantageous enterprises to carry out joint ventures and cooperation in high-end areas such as research and development innovation, new product development, standard formulation, and brand building, and improve the level of introduction. Support enterprises in establishing research and development centers overseas, fully utilize various international innovation resources. Combine with the implementation of major national strategies, take information infrastructure construction, terminal product capacity cooperation, major project integration and general contracting as the traction, drive the systematization and clustering of upstream and downstream enterprises in the industrial chain, advanced technology standards, information network equipment, supporting services, etc., to go global. Support eligible enterprises in building overseas information industry cooperation parks. Provide services such as country-specific directories and project docking for enterprises going global, guide financial institutions to carry out financial services, and reduce the risks of enterprises going global. Actively promote the promotion and use of Chinese domain names. Actively participate in the formulation of international Internet standards, improve the ability and influence to participate in the formulation of international rules. Optimize the international layout of information networks. Relying on the Belt and Road strategy, build efficient cross-border information channels, promote interconnection of information and communication facilities with neighboring countries, innovate international communication facility construction and operation models, and focus on opening up land channels such as Central Asia to West Asia, South Asia to the Indian Ocean, and Russia to Europe, and promote the construction of international submarine cables in key directions. Improve the layout of China's international communication import and export, enhance China's international Internet capabilities with Asia, Africa, Europe, and Latin America as the main directions, and accelerate the construction of overseas network service access points (PoPs) and Internet data centers (IDCs). Promote the establishment of overseas branches by telecommunications companies, strengthen the quality monitoring and service improvement of international communications, provide more comprehensive and high-quality information services for Chinese-funded enterprises and overseas users going global, and realize the overseas operation and landing of China's information business.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance the ability for international development.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Vigorously develop core basic components that meet the needs of high-end equipment, application electronics, the Internet of Things, new energy vehicles, and new generation information technology, and enhance domestic and international market competitiveness. Expand the scale application of new display devices, achieve large-scale production of high-resolution LCD displays, and mass production of active matrix organic light-emitting diode (AMOLED) products; break through core technologies such as flexible fabrication and packaging, complete production technology reserves, and develop flexible display devices larger than 10 inches. Breakthrough key common technologies such as micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) microstructure processing and high-density packaging, accelerate the development and industrialization of sensor products. Improve the performance of light-emitting diode (LED) devices, promote the application of high-end field control power electronic devices, develop next-generation power electronic devices, and support the promotion and application in typical fields. Strengthen the innovation and technological reserves of electronic-grade polysilicon, high-efficiency solar cells and module packaging processes, and improve the integration level of photovoltaic power generation systems and supporting energy storage equipment. Actively develop key electronic materials for industries such as electronic paper, lithium-ion batteries, and photovoltaics, with a focus on breaking into high-end application markets. Enhance the supply capacity of electronic special equipment, with a focus on developing 12-inch integrated circuit production line equipment, new thin-film solar cell production equipment, key materials production equipment for lithium-ion batteries, new component production equipment, and surface mount equipment. Research and develop testing equipment for semiconductors and integrated circuits, communications and networks, the Internet of Things, new electronic components, and high-performance general electronics. Column 4: Basic Electronics Enhancement Project. Basic components. Accelerate the research and industrialization of core components such as supercapacitors, high-voltage DC relays, and hub motors. Increase the market share of high-efficiency energy-saving micro motors, high-reliability long-life chip aluminum electrolytic capacitors, and other electronic components. Master the technology related to servo motors and control systems for robot reducers and micro motors. Breakthroughs in new battery energy storage technologies such as zinc-ion batteries. Develop communication network equipment components based on 400G bandwidth (backbone network), such as ultra-low-loss optical fibers, optoelectronic components, frequency components, and 56Gbps high-speed connectors. Develop ultra-small chip components and flexible components for new mobile intelligent terminals, chip surface acoustic wave filters, and other products. Develop high-end LED and new power electronic devices to support the promotion and application in typical fields. Sensors and sensitive components. Enhance research and development capabilities in sensitive mechanisms, sensitive materials, and new processes, accelerate the research and industrialization of various new sensitive materials and composite functional materials such as semiconductors, ceramics, organic polymers, and optical fibers used in physical, chemical, and biological quantities. Improve the application level of various new process technologies based on MEMS, thin films, etc. Focus on promoting the industrialization of special sensors in key areas, develop intelligent sensors for biology, motion, medicine, health, and the environment, as well as multi-parameter integrated sensors and self-calibrating, self-diagnostic, and self-compensating sensors. Improve the sensor technology standard system and measurement traceability system construction, and enhance the ability of product metrology and testing. New display devices. Achieve production of 8.5th generation and larger glass substrates, improve the supply level of key products such as high-generation mask plates and driver chips, support the development of new technologies such as electronic paper, laser displays, and flexible displays, break through advanced backplane processes such as low-temperature polysilicon (LTPS) and oxide (Oxide), and master long-life, high-efficiency, high-resolution AMOLED production processes. Accelerate the introduction of new processes and technologies, achieve stable production of low-power, 4K×2K ultra-high-resolution products, and mass production of AMOLED products. Solar photovoltaics. Support the development and industrialization of new types of batteries such as thin-film, concentrated, and perovskite, achieve mass production of ultra-high-purity, low-cost polycrystalline silicon, increase market share of high-efficiency, high-reliability battery components, and develop new-generation photovoltaic inverters and system integration equipment. Improve industrial supporting facilities, break through the industrialization bottleneck of key equipment for new photovoltaic cell production lines, and carry out pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing in the photovoltaic industry. Expand photovoltaic applications, promote distributed photovoltaic applications in industrial parks, key industries, and households, and promote the integration of new photovoltaic energy storage products. Electronic materials. With a focus on semiconductor materials, accelerate the development of electronic functional materials such as functional ceramics, low-temperature co-fired ceramics (LTCC) multilayer substrates, high-performance magnetic materials, battery materials, LEDs, and new power electronic devices. Support the development and industrialization of electronic-grade high-purity silicon materials, zone-melted silicon single crystals, high-purity metal and alloy sputtering targets for the semiconductor industry, power battery materials for new energy vehicles, drones, etc., and energy storage battery materials for communication base stations and photovoltaic systems, as well as new technologies for materials such as high-generation glass substrates, optical films, polarizers, high-performance liquid crystals, organic light-emitting diode (OLED) luminescent materials, large-size targets, photoresists, electronic chemicals, etc. Electronic special equipment. Focus on integrated circuits, thin-film transistor liquid crystal displays (TFT-LCD) and AMOLED displays, high-energy lithium-ion batteries, solar cells, LEDs, complete machine processing, etc., achieve key breakthroughs in manufacturing equipment and complete process, form supporting capabilities, and enhance domestic equipment supply capacity. Promote the research and industrialization of 3D printing equipment.
titlelist: Development focus, basic electronics.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Establish a secure and reliable basic software product system, support open source and open development models, and focus on promoting the research and development and application of basic software products such as cloud operating systems, cloud middleware, new database management systems, mobile and cloud office suites. Strengthen the synergy between technical products and terminal applications, improve the maturity of basic software, and accelerate integration, adaptation, and optimization. Promote the research and development and application of core technologies and products for industrial software and industrial control systems, with a focus on breakthroughs in core key technologies for industrial application software in key industries such as military, energy, and chemical industry, and build an advanced product system and establish evaluation standards and specifications. Breakthroughs in key technologies for industrial control systems such as high-end numerical control systems, field buses, communication protocols, high-precision high-speed control, and servo drives, and promote the research and development of high-end numerical control systems, servo systems, and control systems. Build a national industrial software security testing platform. Accelerate the layout of industrial big data software and platforms, promote the deep application of customized solutions in important industrial fields, and create an industrial cloud application service system. Column 5: Software Industry Enhancement and Development Engineering Operating System. Strengthen the research and development and industrialization of high-trust server operating systems, secure and user-friendly desktop operating systems, and trusted cloud operating systems, and develop secure and controllable operating system products. Facing digital products and intelligent complete equipment requirements, develop high-security and high-trust real-time industrial operating systems, and achieve compatibility with mainstream control devices, CPUs, and bus protocols. Develop high-end equipment embedded systems. Industrial big data platform. Build an industrial big data platform that covers the entire product lifecycle and all business activities in manufacturing, develop device-side embedded data management platforms and real-time data intelligent processing systems, and develop industrial data processing platforms for industrial data collection, storage, querying, analysis, mining, and application in the cloud. Industrial cloud and core software for manufacturing. Research and develop the architecture and standard system of the Internet+ industrial cloud system, and build resource libraries for knowledge, data, services, etc. Build industry-oriented industrial cloud service platforms and provide data-driven enterprise management, business collaboration, energy management, and other services. Accelerate the development of core software for manufacturing such as product lifecycle management, enterprise resource planning, supply chain management, and customer relationship management, and improve the level of industrialization. Industrial application software. In key areas such as aerospace equipment, high-end numerical control machine tools and robots, advanced rail transit equipment, offshore engineering equipment and high-tech ships, power equipment, agricultural machinery equipment, develop industry application software and solutions that cover the entire lifecycle, with a focus on breakthroughs in key technologies such as product innovation and development, intelligent control and analysis optimization, and equipment intelligent services, and develop industrial application software systems.
titlelist: Development focus, basic software and industrial software.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Focus on developing software platforms and application systems based on new computing frameworks and application scenarios such as cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, and the Internet of Things. Targeting key needs in government applications, public services, and industry development, concentrate on breakthroughs in key application software and industry solutions, and deepen their widespread application. Support software and information technology service enterprises to actively develop application solutions and provide information technology services in the public service field, promote deep cooperation between software enterprises and traditional industry enterprises, accelerate the development and application of software and solutions that support the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, and cultivate a group of comprehensive solution providers.
titlelist: Development focus, key application software and industry solutions.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, low-power lightweight systems, intelligent perception, and new human-machine interaction technologies are key. The focus is on developing intelligent wearable devices, smart homes, intelligent car terminals, smart healthcare, intelligent robots, intelligent unmanned systems, and other products for the next generation of mobile internet and information consumption. Customized terminal products for specific needs and specialized mobile intelligent terminal products for specific industries and special network applications are also being developed. Develop a high-level Internet+ artificial intelligence platform to enhance the supply capacity of consumer-grade and industrial-grade intelligent hardware products and services. Accelerate innovation in intelligent perception technology, with a focus on promoting the application of millimeter wave and terahertz, narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT), intelligent voice, and other technologies in key areas such as public safety and the Internet of Things. Support the development and industrialization of virtual reality products and explore applications in fields such as design and manufacturing, healthcare, and entertainment. Enrich the supply of smart home products, with a focus on increasing the supply of new consumer electronics products such as smart TVs, smart speakers, and smart service robots, and promote the improvement of the smart home industry chain, guiding the industry towards a product + service transformation and upgrade. Develop smart health and elderly care services, support the development of wearable devices for health monitoring and management, and home care. Promote innovation and application demonstrations in smart transportation, and promote the construction of smart car and smart transportation demonstration areas based on broadband mobile internet. Actively promote the research and application of industrial electronics, medical electronics, automotive electronics, energy electronics, financial electronics, and other products. Develop the Intelligent Products + Service Value Enhancement Project. content: The electronic information manufacturing industry is a strategic, foundational, and leading industry of the national economy. It serves as the technological support and material foundation for accelerating industrial transformation and upgrading, as well as the construction of an information-based society in the national economy and society. It is also an important cornerstone for ensuring national defense construction and national information security. The Twelfth Five-Year Plan period is a crucial period for China to adhere to the path of new industrialization, accelerate the transformation of economic development mode, and comprehensively build a moderately prosperous society. It is also a period for the electronic information manufacturing industry to adjust its structure, transform its mode, enhance its core competitiveness, improve the quality and efficiency of development, and become stronger. In order to implement the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development, and in accordance with the overall deployment and requirements of the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Industrial Transformation and Upgrading, the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Informationization of National Economic and Social Development, and the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for Information Industry Development, the Twelfth Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry has been formulated as a guiding document for the development of the electronic information manufacturing industry during the Twelfth Five-Year Plan period.
titlelist: Policy measures, effectively strengthen organizational implementation, the 'Twelfth Five-Year Plan' for the development of the electronic information manufacturing industry (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: In 2010, the sales revenue of China's electronic information manufacturing industry reached 6,394.5 billion yuan, doubling from 3,101 billion yuan in 2005, with an average annual growth rate of over 15% in the five-year period. Exports accounted for over 30% of the country's total foreign trade exports. The production of major electronic products such as color TVs, microcomputers, and mobile phones reached 120 million units, 250 million units, and 1 billion units respectively, accounting for over 40% of the global total production. The average annual growth rates in the five-year period were 7.4%, 24.9%, and 26.9% respectively. The number of employees in the electronic information manufacturing industry reached 8.8 million, an increase of 3.29 million from 2005, accounting for 10% of the country's industrial workforce, up from 8% in 2005. The table shows the growth of key indicators in the electronic information manufacturing industry during the 11th Five-Year Plan period (2005-2010). The indicators include sales revenue (in billion yuan), profit (in billion yuan), export volume (in billion US dollars), and number of employees (in ten thousand). The average annual growth rates are also provided. Sales revenue: 31,010 - 63,945 (15.6%); Profit: 13,582 - 25,815 (15.8%); Export volume: 26.82 - 59.12 (17.1%); Number of employees: 55 - 188 (9.8%).
titlelist: Review of the development during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, with steady expansion of industrial scale.

Actively adapting to the new trends of networking, intelligence, and service, large-scale integrated enterprises are extending into the service field, focusing on the development of emerging applications such as mobile internet, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things. The concentration of the industry has significantly increased, and the competitiveness of backbone enterprises represented by the top 100 enterprises has been significantly enhanced. From 2005 to 2010, the main business income of the top 100 electronic information enterprises increased from 964.3 billion yuan to 1.5354 trillion yuan, accounting for 1/4 of the industry's sales revenue, over 1/3 of the profit, and over 1/2 of the tax revenue. Companies such as Huawei, Lenovo, and Haier with sales revenue exceeding 100 billion yuan have emerged. The development pace in the central and western regions has accelerated. From 2008 to 2010, the sales revenue growth rate of the electronic information manufacturing industry above a certain scale was more than 10 percentage points higher than the national average for three consecutive years.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Information technology and products have played a positive role in promoting industrial transformation and upgrading, and promoting the deep integration of the two industries. The popularity rate of digital design tools in major industries such as steel, chemical, automotive, shipbuilding, and aviation exceeds 60%. The rate of key process automation exceeds 50%, and the pace of integration between manufacturing technology and information technology is accelerating. Information technology has deeply integrated and penetrated into the industrial field. The development of products and information systems in automotive electronics, machine tool electronics, medical electronics, intelligent transportation, and financial electronics, which have a large market and strong driving force, has been rapid. It has provided important technical and product support for accelerating the construction of the national economy and social informatization and ensuring information security. After five years of development, China's position as a major electronic information manufacturing country has been further consolidated, and its overall strength has reached a new level. However, there are still prominent deep-level problems and structural contradictions in the development of the industry, mainly manifested as: key core technologies are controlled by others, the industry as a whole is still in the low-end of the value chain, the proportion of contract manufacturing and processing trade is relatively high, research and development investment intensity still lags behind developed countries, resource allocation is relatively scattered, the industrial policy environment urgently needs improvement, and the mechanism for driving domestic demand is not yet sound. These problems and contradictions have constrained the transformation of China's electronic information manufacturing industry from being big to being strong, and need to be addressed during the Twelfth Five-Year Plan period.
titlelist: Review of the 11th Five-Year Plan: The Increasingly Prominent Role of Support and Leadership
