Promote the deep application of information technology and products in transportation, energy, water conservancy, environmental protection, and other fields, accelerate the intelligentization process of important national infrastructure in people's livelihood; vigorously promote the widespread application of information technology and products in medical and health care, transportation, culture and education, employment, and social security, and improve the level of public services.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, main tasks, deepening the application of information technology, serving economic and social development.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Focused on the development of basic industries and strategic emerging industries, efforts are being made to build specialized public service platforms for integrated circuits, flat panel displays, digital homes, cloud computing, the Internet of Things, solar photovoltaics, and green lighting. These platforms provide professional services such as technology research and development, achievement transformation, capital operation, intellectual property rights, standard setting, product testing, qualification certification, talent services, enterprise incubation, and brand promotion. Strengthening industrial cooperation, relying on industry organizations, promoting the construction of information technology application platforms in key industrial sectors, and providing common technical support and public services. Relying on industrial bases and specialized parks, a distinctive regional public service system is being built to guide and strengthen the construction of supporting service systems for electronic information industry clusters.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities are to improve the public service system and optimize the environment for industrial development.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Accelerate the innovation of cutting-edge computer technology, achieve breakthroughs in core technology and key areas, further enhance the independent research and development, industrial design, and motherboard manufacturing capabilities of computer products, and enhance the core competitiveness of the industry. Grasp the development trend of mobile Internet, vigorously develop mobile intelligent terminals such as lightweight and portable, low power consumption, touch, high-definition, and three-dimensional (3D) display laptops, tablet computers, as well as new types of computers such as large screens and touch-screen all-in-ones; promote the integration of the terminal + application + service industrial chain and promote the extension of whole-machine enterprises to services. Strengthen the research and industrialization of computer peripherals and consumables, develop color network laser printers, scanners, projectors, flash memory, and smart entertainment and education products. Strongly support the research and application of high-security industrial control computers, industrial control products, and systems, accelerate the research on the new generation of industrial control computer architecture, actively carry out research on the basic software and hardware platforms, security, and reliability technologies of industrial control computers, enhance the competitiveness of China's industrial control products and systems, and promote the application of industrial control products and systems in the fields of process control, safety production, energy saving and consumption reduction, environmental monitoring, intelligent transportation, intelligent buildings, and smart grids. Accelerate the research and application of secure and reliable computers, strengthen research on information security technology, vigorously promote the research and industrialization of information security products such as network security, trusted computing, and data security. With the demand for cloud computing applications as the driving force, focus on breakthroughs in core technologies of virtualization, load balancing, cloud storage, and green energy saving, support the research and industrialization of key products such as servers, network equipment, storage systems, and cloud service terminals suitable for cloud computing, establish a complete cloud computing-related industrial chain, provide complete equipment solutions for large-scale demonstration applications of cloud computing, and improve the public service system of cloud computing. Strengthen the research and development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, break through key technologies such as IoT sensing information collection, transmission, processing, and feedback control, support the research and industrialization of key products such as wireless radio frequency identification (RFID), encoding recognition devices, and sensing and processing control nodes, establish and improve the IoT standard system, and promote the application of IoT. In response to the development needs of the next generation of the Internet, focus on supporting the research and industrialization of key network devices such as high-performance routers, high-capacity aggregation switches, and smart gateways, and accelerate the internationalization of independent intellectual property technology standards.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, computer.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Seize the opportunities of the construction of the new generation communication network and the rapid development of the mobile internet. Increase the research and development efforts of TD-SCDMA terminals, promote the research and industrialization of long-term evolution technology and enhanced long-term evolution technology (LTE/LTE-Advanced). Study the key technologies of wireless and network organization, network evolution, and multi-technology coordination in the application process of LTE/LTE-Advanced, promote the research and development of key technologies and products such as new green base stations, wireless network organization, and wireless network energy-saving and emission reduction, and promote the application demonstration of TD-SCDMA/LTE/LTE-Advanced in key areas such as digital cities and rural informatization. Accelerate the research and development and industrialization process of mobile internet-related technology products and business applications, focus on supporting key technologies and products such as new mobile internet terminals, terminal core chips, operating systems, middleware, as well as IP bearer networks, access perception and control, mobile internet platforms and resource key technology research and industrialization. Support multi-mode, multi-frequency terminal chips and efficient, low-cost terminals, IPv6/v4 dual-stack network equipment and terminals, network testing special instruments, antennas, and other key supporting industrial systems. Promote the development of intelligent optical networks and high-capacity, high-speed, long-distance optical transmission, fiber-to-the-x (FTTx) and other technologies and products. Focus on supporting N×100Gbit/s wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) high-speed optical transmission equipment, N×Tbit/s cross-capacity optical transport network/packet transport network (OTN/PTN) large-capacity network scheduling optical transmission equipment, support the research and development and industrialization of intelligent control plane optical switching equipment, optical transmission equipment; support the research and development and industrialization of 10G passive optical network (PON) line-side equipment and optical network units, PON interoperability testing systems; support high-end modules such as high-speed coherent optical receivers, high-power low-noise optical amplifiers, wavelength-selective optical switches, high-speed laser chips, optoelectronic integrated components, optoelectronic integrated chips, high-speed analog-to-digital chips, etc. Promote the development of broadband wireless access, multimedia digital cluster, and digital intercom technology and industry. Support the research and development and industrialization of low-cost broadband access for wide-area coverage, ultra-high-speed wireless local area network, digital cluster communication and digital intercom technology and products for dedicated network applications, and accelerate the maturity and wider application of wireless local area network authentication and confidentiality infrastructure (WAPI) technology. Promote the application demonstration in key areas and industries such as government affairs, public safety, energy, logistics, transportation, and modern agriculture, enhance the capabilities of relevant technology products in resource dynamic allocation, management and scheduling, coordinated interference reduction, load balancing, adaptive and self-organizing networks, network security, and information confidentiality, and build a complete industrial chain of dedicated communication systems for industry sectors. Actively promote the research and development, industrialization, and application promotion of products based on the Beidou satellite communication navigation system.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, communication equipment.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Accelerate the transformation and upgrading of the color TV industry, strengthen the research and application of new backlight technology, 3D technology, laser technology, and energy-saving technology, and enhance the control capability of core technologies. Speed up the development of new products such as 3D TVs, internet TVs, and smart TVs, and continuously improve the added value of products. Support leading companies in the industry to extend into upstream areas such as panels and modules, support the research and industrialization of core chips, software, key components, integrated modules, and specialized equipment for the color TV industry, promote the integration of terminal manufacturing and content service industries, and enhance the competitiveness of the entire flat-panel TV industry chain. Focus on supporting the research and industrialization of digital home smart terminals, internet gateways, multi-service systems, and application support platforms; support the research and application of intelligent and networked video surveillance equipment and application systems; vigorously promote the demonstration application of digital homes and the construction of digital home industry bases. Accelerate the popularization of terrestrial digital TV receivers, support the application of independent audio and video standards such as AVS and DRA, and further promote the domestic and international application of terrestrial digital TV standards. Support the development of digital TV studio equipment, transmission equipment, transmission equipment, and receiving equipment, encourage the development of high-density laser disc players, digital sound systems, and digital film equipment, and promote the digital, networked, intelligent, and energy-saving development of the audiovisual industry. Support backbone enterprises to strengthen quality brand building and international operations, and create globally competitive leading companies and well-known brands. Column 1: Whole machine value chain enhancement project. Product innovation. Support the innovation of computers, communication equipment, and terminals based on mobile internet services, as well as product innovation, technological innovation, and model innovation based on cloud computing; support the research and industrialization of key products such as high-end servers and network storage systems, and promote the research and industrialization of key equipment for green intelligent data centers and various terminal products; support the research and industrialization of networked, intelligent, energy-saving digital TV products and 3D TVs; support the research and industrialization of digital home smart terminals that integrate multiple screens; promote the research on key technologies and system technologies of the next-generation terrestrial digital TV transmission system and build a multi-service platform; support the deep involvement of whole machine products in the research and industrialization of supporting chips. Model innovation. Promote large-scale electronic information product manufacturing enterprises to extend into the service field, strengthen the integration and interaction of design, manufacturing, and service, and promote the integration of the industrial chain around core value links; seize the opportunity of rapid development of emerging applications such as cloud computing and mobile internet, explore value-added services, and innovate business models; improve the industrial public service system, promote the construction of open operation platforms, content service platforms, network service platforms, product testing and certification platforms, and intellectual property service platforms. Brand building. Support digital audiovisual, computer, and communication equipment manufacturing enterprises in building independent brands, enhance the international competitiveness of domestic equipment and terminals; guide enterprises to strengthen product quality management, improve product quality management systems, and enhance brand image; encourage enterprises to strengthen international strategic cooperation, accelerate the construction of secure and controllable market channels; formulate intellectual property strategies, promote the industrialization and international application of independent intellectual property standards.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点 translates to main tasks and development priorities.发展重点 translates to development priorities.数字视听 translates to digital audiovisual.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: With the focus on whole machine and major information application as the driving force, we will strengthen technological innovation, model innovation, and institutional innovation, focus on the development of the design industry, strengthen the chip manufacturing industry, improve packaging and testing capabilities, enhance the independent development capabilities of key equipment, instruments, and materials, and promote the growth and strengthening of the integrated circuit industry. We will focus on the development of the chip design industry and develop high-performance integrated circuit products. We will break through high-end general chips such as CPU/digital signal processors (DSP)/memory, and focus on the development of network communication chips, mixed-signal chips, information security chips, digital TV chips, RFID chips, sensor chips, automotive electronic chips, and other large-scale and wide-ranging products, as well as dedicated integrated circuit products in the fields of integration of the two industries, strategic emerging industries, and key areas, to form system solution capabilities. We will strengthen the scale of chip manufacturing industry and enhance advanced and characteristic process capabilities. We will continue to support the technological upgrading and capacity expansion of 12-inch advanced process manufacturing lines and 8-inch/6-inch characteristic process manufacturing lines. We will accelerate the research and development and application of 45-nanometer and below manufacturing process technologies, strengthen the development of standard process, characteristic process module, and IP core. We will improve the level and capability of packaging and testing industry, develop advanced packaging and testing technologies and products. In line with the important development direction of diversified integrated circuit products, we will vigorously develop advanced packaging and testing technologies, promote the progress of high-density stacked three-dimensional packaging products, support the upgrading of packaging process technologies and capacity expansion. We will improve the level of testing technology and the scale of the industry. We will improve the industrial chain, break through key special equipment, instruments, materials, and electronic design automation (EDA) tools. We will promote the industrialization process of 8-inch integrated circuit equipment, support the research and development of 12-inch integrated circuit production equipment, materials, tools, and instruments, form a complete set of processes, promote the scale application of domestic equipment on production lines, promote close cooperation among various links in the integrated circuit industry chain, establish test platforms, and accelerate industrialization.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, integrated circuits.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: We will vigorously develop new chip components based on Surface Mount Technology (SMT), actively support the research and industrialization of new components based on Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) technology, and passive integrated components based on Low-Temperature Co-Fired Ceramics (LTCC) technology. We will strive to develop key electronic components such as relays, connectors, micro motors, and supercapacitors required for automotive electronic systems. We will accelerate the research and industrialization of nickel-hydrogen batteries, power-type and energy storage-type lithium-ion batteries, battery management systems, and battery grouping technologies for new energy vehicles. We will promote the development of low-cost fiber optic cables, optical devices, frequency devices, digital audio devices, and mixed integrated circuits industries around the development of next-generation communication technologies. We will actively develop high-performance and high-reliability sensors, power electronic components, ultra-thin lithium-ion batteries, and specialized vacuum electronic devices required for the development of strategic emerging industries such as the Internet of Things, new energy, and high-end equipment. We will accelerate the development of high-density interconnect boards, special printed circuit boards, printed circuit boards for light-emitting diodes (LEDs), and key core devices such as infrared focal plane detectors, ultraviolet detectors, and low-light image intensifiers required for modern optics. While focusing on the development of mature technologies, we will closely monitor future technological trends, accurately grasp innovative technological directions, prioritize the support of innovative and common technologies, provide technological reserves for sustainable industrial development, and lay an important technological and industrial foundation for the structural adjustment, industrial upgrading, and transformation of the development mode of the electronic information manufacturing industry.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,关键电子元器件 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, key electronic components in English.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: The key development of semiconductor materials includes silicon materials, compound semiconductor materials, substrate materials such as gallium nitride and silicon carbide, raw materials for epitaxy, and high-performance ceramic substrates. It also includes high-end LED packaging materials, high-brightness and high-power LED chip materials, key materials for new power electronic devices, and graphite and carbon series insulation materials. The key development of optoelectronic materials includes glass substrates for high-generation LCD displays, polarizers, color filters, liquid crystals, large-size targets, high-purity electronic gases and reagents. It also includes high-purity organic materials, conductive glass substrates, packaging materials, high-precision mask templates for organic light-emitting displays (OLEDs), glass substrates and electrode pastes for plasma display panels (PDPs), wet chemicals, glass powders, phosphors, and other supporting materials. Additionally, it includes microcapsules, inks, dielectric materials for electronic paper, large-size germanium-based materials, infrared materials such as zinc sulfide (ZnS), zinc selenide (ZnSe), silicon carbide (SiC), to meet the demand for manufacturing high-end optoelectronic products. For electronic components, it includes copper-clad laminates, electronic copper foils, piezoelectric and system information processing materials, high thermal conductivity ceramic materials and metal composite materials, small lithium batteries and power lithium battery materials, chip-type ultra-thin high-capacity electronic ceramic materials and capacitor materials, high-performance capacitor films, high-end electronic pastes, LTCC multilayer substrates, high-performance magnetic materials, etc. The focus is on breaking through the high-end supporting application market, improving product added value and technological content, enhancing the quality and efficiency of the development of the electronic materials industry, and supporting the leapfrog development of downstream industries.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,电子材料 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, electronic materials in English.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: In terms of liquid crystal display devices, the focus is on improving the performance of thin-film transistors (TFT), increasing carrier mobility and the transmittance of the liquid crystal panel, and reducing production costs. In terms of plasma display devices, research and development is focused on high-efficiency technology, high-definition technology, and ultra-thin technology, as well as studying new materials and processes to improve the performance of PDP products. In the field of organic light-emitting display devices, efforts are being made to promote the technological development and industrial application of small and medium-sized OLEDs, as well as research on large-sized OLEDs and the integration of related technologies and processes. In the field of electronic paper, active development and industrialization of active driving electronic paper display technology is being promoted, with a focus on developing large-sized, touch screen, color, and flexible active driving electronic paper displays. Active research and development of new technologies and products such as touch screens and 3D displays are being carried out to promote their industrialization. Specialized display technologies such as laser display are being developed. The development of OLED lighting technology and product development is being promoted. Great efforts are being made to develop flat panel display device production equipment and testing instruments, forming a good trend of coordinated development with complete machine demand as the driving force, the panel industry as the leader, materials and equipment instruments as the foundation, and the coordinated development of various links in the industry chain. Efforts are being made to achieve international advanced level in China's new display industry by the end of the 12th Five-Year Plan period, fully supporting the transformation and upgrading of China's color TV industry.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点 translates to main tasks and development priorities.发展重点 translates to development priorities.新型显示器件 translates to new display devices.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: In terms of electronic specialized equipment, the focus is on developing 8-inch and 12-inch semiconductor-grade single crystal growth, cutting, grinding, and polishing equipment, 8-inch integrated circuit complete production line equipment, and promoting the industrialization of key equipment for 12-inch integrated circuits. Actively promote polycrystalline silicon, single crystal silicon growth and cutting equipment, fully automatic crystalline silicon solar cell production line equipment, thin film solar cell production equipment research and industrialization, and focus on breakthroughs in high-brightness LED chip production line equipment and post-packaging equipment. Vigorously develop new component production equipment and surface mount equipment. In terms of electronic instruments, the emphasis is on the research and development of semiconductor and integrated circuit testing instruments, communication and network testing instruments, high-performance microwave/millimeter wave testing instruments, digital TV and digital audio-video testing instruments, Internet of Things testing instruments, new electronic component testing instruments, high-performance general electronic testing instruments, time and frequency testing instruments, as well as electronic application instruments for medical, environmental protection, agriculture, mining, and other fields. Consolidate the foundation for industrial development, enhance core competitiveness and sustainable development capabilities.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,电子专用设备和仪器 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, electronic specialized equipment and instruments in English.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Break through the weak links in the industrial chain, improve the technical level and industrialization capability of high-brightness, power-type LED epitaxial wafers and chips, and enhance the independent development capability of the industry. Strengthen research on packaging structure design, new packaging materials, new processes, phosphor performance, multi-primary-color phosphors, and heat dissipation mechanisms, focusing on improving the light extraction efficiency, phosphor efficiency, and heat dissipation performance of devices, and enhancing the packaging capability of power-type LED devices. Accelerate the research and industrialization of upstream raw materials for LEDs, such as substrates, metal organic compounds (MO) sources, ultra-high purity gases, phosphors, high-performance epoxy resins, and organic silicone gels, realize mass production and application of key production equipment and instruments such as metal organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD), improve the supporting capability of the industry, and perfect the LED industrial chain. Promote applications in landscape lighting, LCD backlighting, outdoor large-screen displays, and indoor commercial lighting. Accelerate the formulation of LED-related basic standards and product standards, and improve the LED standard system. Enhance product standard compliance testing, accelerate the construction of national-level LED device and light source testing institutions, and improve testing capabilities and service capabilities. Strengthen industry guidance and management, and promote the healthy, scientific, and orderly development of the LED industry.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点 translates to Main tasks and development priorities.发展重点 translates to Development priorities.发光二极管（LED） translates to Light-emitting diode (LED).

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Key support will be provided for the production of high-quality, low-energy consumption, low-cost, and high by-product utilization rate solar-grade polysilicon. Development of efficient, low-cost, and low-energy consumption silicon ingot production technology, breakthrough in thinning silicon wafer cutting technology, and improvement of silicon wafer quality. Support for the research and industrialization of high-efficiency, low-cost, and long-life solar cells, and acceleration of the development and application of ultra-efficient solar cells, new concentrator cells, and thin-film cells. Encouragement of research and development of products and technologies such as photovoltaic inverters, controllers, and energy storage systems. Key development of equipment such as plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), laser cutting, etching, screen printing, and packaging testing, and encouragement of the development of complete sets of equipment production lines for crystalline silicon and thin-film solar cells. Active development of building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) component production technology and expansion of the application scope of building-attached photovoltaic (BAPV) components. Encouragement of the development of supporting materials such as crucibles, high-purity graphite, carbon-carbon composites, ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA) adhesive, electronic paste, wire cutting fluid, and transparent conductive oxide (TCO) glass. Encouragement of photovoltaic enterprises to strengthen system integration and application expansion, actively focus on off-grid application markets and emerging grid-connected application markets, and support the research and application of small-scale photovoltaic systems, distributed photovoltaic systems, and off-grid systems. Support for capable enterprises and institutions to establish national-level photovoltaic technology research and development platforms, product testing and certification platforms, and public service platforms, and to carry out public services such as product testing, system engineering acceptance, patent pool construction, promotion of standard formulation, and key common technology research and development. Support for backbone enterprises to enhance technological innovation capabilities, improve production process levels, reduce photovoltaic power generation costs, expand photovoltaic application markets, and enhance the core competitiveness of China's photovoltaic industry. Column 2: Leapfrogging Project for Basic Electronic Industries. Integrated circuits. Breakthroughs in high-performance CPUs, mobile communication chips, DSPs, and other high-end general-purpose chips, large-area chips such as mobile Internet, analog-digital hybrid, information security, digital TV, and radio frequency identification, as well as specialized chips in key areas. Continued support for the construction of 12-inch advanced process manufacturing lines and the transformation and upgrading of 8-inch/6-inch process manufacturing lines. Acceleration of the technological upgrading and capacity expansion of advanced production lines and specialized production lines, and improvement of advanced packaging technology and testing level. Further improvement of the industrial chain, enhancement of the independent development and supply capacity of key equipment, instruments, and materials for 8-12-inch integrated circuit production lines, such as etching machines, ion implantation machines, interconnect copper plating equipment, epitaxial furnaces, and photolithography coating and development equipment, and support for large-scale application of production lines. Acceleration of the improvement of the level and capabilities of national-level integrated circuit research and development public service platforms, and organization of various forms of technological innovation platforms. Key electronic components and materials. Key support for the technological upgrading and equipment process development of microelectronic devices, optoelectronic devices, MEMS devices, semiconductor power devices, power electronics devices, RFID modules and devices, green batteries, chip resistors and capacitors, electromechanical components, electroacoustic devices, intelligent sensors, and printed circuit board products, effectively supporting the development of the Internet of Things. Active development of semiconductor materials, solar photovoltaic materials, optoelectronic materials, piezoelectric and acousto-optic materials, electronic functional ceramics, magnetic materials, battery materials, and sensor materials, as well as metal materials, non-metal materials, and polymer materials used for support, assembly, and packaging. New flat panel displays. Key support for the key technologies and new process development of TFT-LCD display panels with a size of 6th generation or above, implementation of industrialization projects for key supporting materials such as glass substrates and core production equipment, and improvement of the supporting industrial chain. Breakthroughs in PDP high luminous efficiency technology (high energy efficiency, low cost), high-definition technology (3D, dynamic clarity, ultra-high definition), and ultra-thin technology to improve the performance of PDP products. Development of high-mobility TFT driving substrate technology, overcoming key process technologies such as OLED organic film formation and device packaging, overcoming low-temperature polysilicon (LTPS) technology, and strengthening the localization of key materials and equipment. Focusing on the needs of mobile terminals, key development of small-sized display products with touch screen functionality, wide viewing angles, high resolution, and lightweight and energy-saving features. Development of new technologies such as 3D displays, electronic paper, and laser displays. Light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Key breakthroughs in epitaxial growth and chip manufacturing key technologies, improvement of domestic supply capacity for epitaxial wafers and high-end chips. Enhancement of power-type LED device packaging capabilities, increased research and development of packaging structure design, new packaging materials, new processes, phosphor performance, and heat dissipation mechanisms. Further improvement of the industrial chain, accelerated mass production of domestically produced MOCVD equipment, promotion of research and development and industrialization of substrate materials, high-purity MO sources, high-performance epoxy resins, and efficient phosphors. Acceleration of the construction of testing platforms, formulation and improvement of LED-related standards, and promotion of intellectual property rights construction. Solar photovoltaics. Support for energy-saving and consumption reduction in the polysilicon industry and industrialization of high-quality, high-efficiency, and low-cost solar cells, and encouragement of the research and development of new solar cell and high-quality, low-cost polysilicon process technologies. Comprehensive improvement of equipment technology level, breakthroughs in equipment bottlenecks such as flat-panel PECVD, fully automatic screen printing machines, and efficient cutting machines. Support for the research and industrialization of supporting components such as controllers, inverters, and materials such as graphite, crucibles, electronic paste, and TCO glass. Support for diversified and wide-ranging solar photovoltaic applications, expansion of off-grid application markets and emerging grid-connected markets.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,太阳能光伏 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, solar photovoltaic.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Increase investment in special funds for technological transformation, and provide key support for major projects in core areas. Accelerate the implementation of national major science and technology projects such as core electronic devices, high-end general-purpose chips and basic software products, large-scale integrated circuit manufacturing equipment and complete sets of processes, and new generation broadband wireless mobile communication networks, further clarify the key areas of funding support, and strengthen the supporting industrial chain. Make full use of special funds such as the Electronic Information Industry Development Fund to support the research and development and industrialization of core key technologies in the industry, and promote the demonstration and application of key products. Increase financial support for the application of information technology, with a focus on supporting the industry application of secure and reliable information technology and products. Implement special funds for strategic emerging industries and refine the funding utilization plan in the field of electronic information. Implement various financial policies to support small and medium-sized enterprises, and support financial institutions in providing more financing services for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the efficiency of fiscal fund utilization, and enhance industrial innovation capabilities.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Give full play to the guiding role of industry management departments and local governments in industrial transfer and cooperation, as well as the fundamental role of the market in resource allocation. Strengthen the integration of planning, resources, and the market, study and formulate relevant policies for the transfer and cooperation of the electronic information manufacturing industry, and establish a sound cooperation mechanism for department-province coordination and joint promotion. Promote the extension of the value chain of industries such as research and development, design, and services in advantageous regions such as the Pearl River Delta, the Yangtze River Delta, the Bohai Rim, and the coastal areas of Fujian and Xiamen, and leverage the radiating and driving role of these regions. Based on the unique advantages of the industrial receiving regions, coordinate the rational layout of major projects in the central and western regions and old industrial bases in the northeast, and guide the orderly transfer of industries. Promote the construction of demonstration bases for new industrialization and industrial parks, and promote regional coordinated development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, guide the orderly transfer of industries, and promote regional coordinated development.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Improve the policy system for promoting corporate mergers and reorganizations, guided by industrial policies, focusing on key areas of industrial development, and driven by major national projects, actively promote significant progress in corporate mergers and reorganizations. Promote the establishment of industrial investment funds, with a focus on major productive layout, encourage leading enterprises to carry out overseas mergers and reorganizations and technology acquisitions. Establish and improve the service system for small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate a group of small and medium-sized enterprises that are specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative, and form an industrial organizational system that complements and coordinates the development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Support the development of industry alliances such as AVS, FlashLink, digital home, solar photovoltaic, OLED, and strengthen the construction of industrial innovation alliances in emerging fields such as mobile Internet, cloud computing, Internet of Things, and semiconductor lighting.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote corporate mergers and reorganizations, optimize industrial organizational structure.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: '9.5G+ Industrial Internet. Promote the deep integration of 5G modules with industrial terminals such as AR/VR, remote control devices, machine vision, and AGV, accelerate the use of 5G to transform industrial intranets, create benchmark 5G fully connected factories, and form a network deployment model that integrates information technology networks with production control networks, and promote the 5G+ Industrial Internet to serve the core production processes. Focus on key industries for the development of 5G+ Industrial Internet in research and development design, production manufacturing, operation management, and product services, create typical application scenarios, continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of 5G+ Industrial Internet, support the deep application of 5G in intelligent manufacturing fields such as quality inspection, remote maintenance, multi-machine collaborative operations, and human-machine interaction, continuously strengthen demonstration and guidance, and promote the replication and promotion of mature models in more industries and fields. Build an industrial ecosystem, promote regional applications, encourage the construction of 5G+ Industrial Internet integration application pilot zones in various regions, and continuously expand the application of 5G in fields such as raw materials, equipment, consumer goods, and electronics. 10.5G+ Connected Vehicles. Strengthen collaboration between the automotive, communication, and transportation industries, enhance the connection between the government, industry organizations, and enterprises, jointly establish a comprehensive 5G and connected vehicle testing and evaluation system to ensure end-to-end interconnection and interoperability of applications. Refine typical application scenarios that can be scaled up and have a complete commercial closed-loop, and improve user acceptance. Accelerate the penetration rate of C-V2X communication modules in vehicles and the deployment of roadside infrastructure. Accelerate the exploration of business models and application scenarios, support the creation of national-level connected vehicle pilot zones, promote the coordinated planning and construction of connected vehicle infrastructure and 5G networks, select key cities, typical areas, suitable road sections, and key sections of highways, accelerate the deployment of 5G+ connected vehicles, and promote the innovative application of C-V2X technology in areas such as industrial parks, airports, ports, and mines. Establish a cross-industry and cross-regional trusted and recognized connected vehicle security communication system. 11.5G+ Smart Logistics. Strengthen innovation in the application of 5G in logistics in areas such as industrial parks, warehouses, and communities, promote the application of 5G in scenarios such as unmanned vehicle express delivery, intelligent sorting, unmanned warehousing, intelligent wearables, and intelligent recognition. Accelerate the construction of 5G-based logistics Internet of Things data access, computing, and application platforms, promote the development of logistics automation intelligent equipment and infrastructure based on edge-cloud collaboration, and help realize the automation of transportation, intelligent warehousing, and full-process monitoring in the logistics industry. 12.5G+ Smart Ports. Develop 5G-assisted positioning products suitable for port container environments, accelerate the digital transformation and construction of automated terminals and storage yards. Promote the digitalization of port construction, maintenance, and operation processes throughout the entire cycle, accelerate the construction of smart port infrastructure, promote the application of 5G in scenarios such as unmanned inspections, remote tower cranes, automated guided transportation, automated container truck driving, and intelligent cargo handling in port areas, and promote port intelligence. 13.5G+ Intelligent Mining. Accelerate the development and certification of 5G communication devices suitable for mining environments with explosion-proof requirements, promote the integration of 5G network systems in open-pit mines and underground mining areas, intelligent mining area control platforms, and enterprise cloud platforms. Promote the application of 5G in various types of mining areas such as energy minerals, metal minerals, and non-metallic minerals, expand the application scenarios of remote control and unmanned driving in the mining industry, promote remote control and cluster operations of core mining equipment in deep and high-risk areas, and achieve intelligent continuous operations and unmanned transportation in open-pit mining areas. 14.5G+ Smart Power. Breakthrough key technologies such as deterministic latency, time synchronization accuracy, and security assurance in the power industry, build a power communication management support system and edge computing platform integrated with 5G. Upgrade and transform industrial control and monitoring networks based on 5G, promote the application of scenarios such as power generation equipment maintenance, distribution automation, transmission line/substation inspection, and power consumption information collection, realize visualization of power generation, intelligent control of distribution, unmanned monitoring of transmission and transformation, and real-time collection of power consumption. 15.5G+ Smart Oil and Gas. Develop 5G special terminals suitable for complex environments in oil fields, promote the development of intelligent data collection 5G gateways and monitoring products with multiple protocols, and achieve effective connection with communication interfaces in the oil and gas field. Implement deep application of 5G in scenarios such as high-definition video monitoring in oil fields, pipeline leakage monitoring, intelligent robot inspections, and hazardous material transportation monitoring, and provide intelligent support for safe and efficient oil and gas collection, pipeline transmission, and oil and gas refining. 16.5G+ Smart Agriculture. Based on the digitalization needs of agriculture and rural areas, focus on promoting 5G technology and applications for wide coverage and low-cost scenarios. Enrich the application scenarios of 5G in smart agriculture, accelerate the innovation of 5G applications in agricultural production processes such as smart agricultural machinery and agricultural robots in unmanned agricultural operations, and develop applications of 5G in areas such as cold chain logistics for agricultural products and live streaming for e-commerce. Strengthen the integration of digital rural areas and 5G applications, improve the level of rural governance and information-based public services, extend education, culture, medical care, and other resources to rural areas using 5G, and promote rural information consumption. 17.5G+ Smart Water Conservancy. Promote the deep integration of 5G technology and the water conservancy industry, apply new technologies such as 5G, the Internet of Things, remote sensing, and edge computing to improve the perception level of water conservancy elements. Combine technologies such as Beidou positioning and artificial intelligence to study the top-level design and model algorithm implementation of artificial intelligence construction systems, and achieve breakthroughs in the application of 5G human-machine collaboration in water conservancy engineering construction scenarios.'
titlelist: Empowering key areas of 5G applications, deepening industry integration applications action.
