Continuously support the research and development, engineering breakthroughs, and industrialization of key areas such as 5G core chips, key components, basic software, and instruments, laying the foundation for industrial development.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Basic telecommunications companies further optimize the 5G SA equipment procurement testing process, clarify the testing schedule according to the construction plan, and promote the accelerated maturity of related equipment. Continuously carry out 5G enhanced technology research and development experiments, organize more extensive interoperability testing of chips and systems, and accelerate the maturity of technology and industry. Combining with the progress arrangement of national frequency planning, organize the testing of millimeter wave equipment and performance to prepare for the commercial use of 5G millimeter wave technology.
titlelist: Continuously increase the research and development efforts of 5G technology, and organize the implementation of 5G testing and verification.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: 'Support leading enterprises in utilizing 5G and integrating new technologies to create and provide industry cloud services, open capability platforms, application development environments, and other common platforms. Encourage the establishment of related open-source communities and open-source technology bases to promote open application innovation. Accelerate the construction of the 5G testing and certification platform, enhance testing, inspection, certification, and other service capabilities for various aspects of the 5G system, terminals, services, security, etc., and reduce enterprise research and development and application costs.'
titlelist: Continuously increase the research and development efforts of 5G technology, enhance the innovation support capability of 5G technology.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Accelerate the construction of a secure infrastructure for key information in 5G, strengthen network security protection for new objects such as the core system of 5G, network slicing, and mobile edge computing platforms, establish systems and mechanisms for dynamic risk assessment, and key equipment detection and certification. Research security protection guidelines and standards for typical application scenarios. Pilot the construction of 5G security monitoring methods, improve the security protection system for network security situation awareness, threat governance, event handling, and traceability.
titlelist: Efforts are being made to build a secure system for 5G, and to strengthen the security of 5G network infrastructure.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Develop and improve data security management systems and standards around various typical technologies of 5G and typical application scenarios such as vehicle networking and industrial internet. Establish a dynamic assessment and evaluation mechanism for data security risks in typical 5G scenarios and strengthen the application of assessment results. Reasonably allocate responsibilities for data security and protection of user personal information among network operators, industry service providers, etc., clarify the baseline requirements for data security in the 5G environment, and strengthen supervision and law enforcement. Promote data security compliance assessment and certification, build a comprehensive technical support system, and effectively enhance the level of 5G data security protection.
titlelist: Efforts are being made to build a 5G security guarantee system and strengthen the protection of 5G network data security.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Strengthen the core technology research and development and achievement transformation of 5G network security, and enhance the supply of security services. Vigorously promote the construction of national network security industrial parks and pilot demonstrations, accelerate the cultivation of leading enterprises in the key links of the 5G security industry chain, promote the development of small and medium-sized enterprises in the upstream and downstream of the industry, and form an integrated guarantee capability for key technologies, products, and services. Actively innovate the governance model of 5G security, and promote the construction of a security governance mechanism involving multiple entities, coordinated by multiple departments, and collaborative across multiple industries.
titlelist: Efforts are being made to build a 5G security guarantee system and cultivate the ecosystem of 5G network security industry.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Each unit should establish and improve the organizational leadership system, ensure the necessary elements, and prioritize the acceleration of 5G development as a current key task. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with local housing and urban-rural development, transportation, power, healthcare, education, and other relevant departments, and work together to promote the construction and development of 5G.
titlelist: Strengthen organization implementation, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Each unit should regularly review their experiences and practices, promptly identify deficiencies and problems, continuously adjust and optimize work measures, and timely report relevant information to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology will organize assessments of the development of 5G construction in various regions and timely release relevant progress updates.
titlelist: Strengthen organization and implementation, strengthen summary and communication.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the large-scale deployment of 10G-PON optical line terminal (OLT) equipment by basic telecommunications companies in cities and key towns, continue to optimize the upstream networking of OLT and transform and upgrade the optical distribution network (ODN) in weak areas such as old residential areas and industrial parks, and further extend the all-optical access network to end users. Upgrade home and enterprise gateway (ONT) devices that support gigabit services as needed, provide end-to-end gigabit service experience through home wiring transformation, optimization of gigabit wireless LAN networking, and guiding users to upgrade their access terminals.
titlelist: Key tasks, Gigabit City Construction Action, continuously expanding the coverage of Gigabit optical network.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the commercial use of 5G standalone network (SA) by basic telecommunications companies, with a focus on accelerating network coverage in central urban areas, key regions, and key industries. Encourage the use of various networking methods such as macro base stations, small base stations, etc., combined with other technologies such as centralized radio access network (C-RAN), to promote deep coverage of 5G networks in traffic hubs, large sports venues, scenic spots, and other areas with high traffic density. Based on industry development and application needs, timely carry out network construction based on 5G millimeter wave technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, Gigabit City Construction Action, accelerate the promotion of 5G standalone network scale deployment.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Improve the compensation mechanism for universal telecommunications services, support basic telecommunications companies in continuously deepening broadband network coverage in rural areas with large populations, production areas, and along major transportation routes, and help consolidate and expand the achievements of poverty alleviation while effectively connecting with rural revitalization. Gradually promote the construction and coverage of gigabit networks in rural and remote areas with conditions and needs.
titlelist: Key tasks, gigabit city construction action, deepening the promotion of rural network infrastructure construction and upgrading.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the continuous deepening of industry collaboration and sharing among basic telecommunications enterprises. According to the principle of intensive use of existing resources and no new construction if sharing is possible, coordinate the construction needs of tower facilities and support basic telecommunications enterprises in carrying out 5G network co-construction and sharing. Encourage the implementation of fiber optic network co-construction through methods such as cable sharing in the same trench, cable sharing on the same pole, and core sharing in the same cable. Implement sharing through core fiber replacement and fiber core leasing. Focus on improving the level of cross-industry co-construction and sharing, and further strengthen communication and cooperation with the power, railway, highway, and municipal sectors. Column 1: Hundred Cities, Thousand Megabits construction project. Accelerate the deployment of urban dual gigabit network construction. Support local governments and basic telecommunications enterprises in creating a number of demonstration communities and demonstration parks with dual gigabit capabilities, and deepen the coverage of dual gigabit networks in urban households, key areas, and key industries. Promote the development of dual gigabit users as needed. Support local governments and relevant enterprises in deploying edge cloud sinking, and build a network + platform + application integrated fixed-mobile convergence and cloud-network integration dual gigabit business system. Promote the development of new businesses such as cloud VR and ultra-high-definition video, and promote user migration to broadband speeds of 500Mbps and above and 5G networks through application traction. Organize the evaluation of gigabit cities. Based on the evaluation indicators of gigabit cities, regularly evaluate the effectiveness of gigabit city construction. By the end of 2021, more than 20 gigabit cities will be built nationwide, and by the end of 2023, more than 100 gigabit cities will be built nationwide, achieving a gigabit fiber optic network coverage rate of over 80% in urban households, and more than 12 5G base stations per ten thousand people.
titlelist: Key tasks, Gigabit City Construction Action, deepening the co-construction and sharing of telecommunications infrastructure.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote continuous expansion of backbone transmission networks for basic telecommunications enterprises, deploy backbone networks with 200/400Gbps ultra-high speed and ultra-large capacity transmission systems as needed, and enhance the comprehensive carrying capacity of backbone transmission networks. Accelerate the development and application of flexible all-optical cross-connections, intelligent management and control technologies, and improve network scheduling capabilities and service efficiency. Guide the deployment of 100Gbps and above ultra-high-speed optical transmission systems to metropolitan area networks. Encourage the use of new types of ultra-low-loss optical fibers in newly constructed trunk lines.
titlelist: Key tasks, enhancing capacity action, improving backbone transmission network carrying capacity.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the demand for high-speed interconnection of data centers by basic telecommunications companies, deploy and apply 400Gbps optical transmission systems, and encourage the construction of data center direct connection networks and directed network connections. Combined with business development, continue to promote the application of core technologies such as IPv6 Segment Routing (SRv6) and Virtual Extensible LAN (VXLAN) in DCI. Promote the application of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) technology in data center interconnection, and enhance the collaborative capacity of cloud and network.
titlelist: Key tasks, capacity enhancement action, optimizing data center interconnect (DCI) capability.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the construction of high-capacity, high-speed, and low-cost optical transmission systems for 5G front-haul and mid-haul networks in basic telecommunications enterprises, enhancing the intelligent operational capabilities of comprehensive service access and network slicing resources. Promote the on-demand deployment of 50Gbps systems in the city access layer of the 5G bearer network, and the on-demand deployment of 100Gbps or 200Gbps systems in the city aggregation layer and core layer. Gradually promote the networking of three-layer virtual private networks (L3VPN) to the edge, compatible with edge cloud data center interconnection networking.
titlelist: Key tasks, capacity enhancement action, collaborative promotion of 5G bearer network construction.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage basic telecommunications enterprises to combine with industry units' demands and deploy the construction of gigabit virtual private networks in typical industries such as industry, transportation, power grid, education, healthcare, ports, and emergency public services. Explore innovative network architectures and flexibly carry out network construction using various modes, such as sharing with the public network partially or end-to-end sharing with the public network. Deploy 5G base stations, OLT equipment, core network elements, and industry terminals within industry units as needed, supporting the localization of sensitive data processing and storage for industry units. Explore innovative operating models, encourage the opening of relevant interface functions, provide necessary management and control permissions for industry units, and serve the development of industries.
titlelist: Key tasks, industry integration empowering action, innovative deployment of gigabit industry virtual private network construction.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Support basic telecommunications companies to explore the use of new technologies such as IPv6+ to provide end-to-end deterministic service capabilities at the network layer, ensuring bandwidth, latency, and jitter performance requirements for specific business flow transmission. Newly built industry networks prioritize support for IPv6+ features such as IPv6 segment routing, network slicing, deterministic forwarding, and on-path detection, and carry out pilot applications of new multicast, service chaining, and application-aware networks. Construct benchmark projects for 2-gigabit industry virtual private networks. Promote the pilot deployment of gigabit virtual private networks in the industrial manufacturing field. Encourage basic telecommunications companies to adopt collaborative deployment of 5G, industrial passive optical networks (PON), and industrial optical transport networks (OTN), combined with new technologies such as edge computing, network slicing, and AI, to form a unified and efficient carrying capacity for industrial production, office, security, and other subnets, meet the security authentication and control capabilities of industrial enterprises for access terminal devices, and support the high-quality and rapid cloud access requirements of industrial enterprises. Promote the pilot deployment of gigabit virtual private networks in the education and medical fields. Encourage basic telecommunications companies to further enhance their network support capabilities for online education, remote medical care, and other applications based on the dual gigabit network, meet the needs of industry Internet use and management, and provide support for typical online education application scenarios such as virtual practical training, smart cloud examination rooms, smart home-school communities, teacher training, smart evaluation, as well as typical remote medical care application scenarios such as remote consultation, remote imaging, remote emergency rescue, and remote monitoring. Adopt various technical solutions such as software-defined wide area networks (SD-WAN), real-time video communication, and intelligent network scheduling to optimize network transmission quality. Promote the pilot deployment of gigabit virtual private networks in special fields. Encourage basic telecommunications companies, industry units, and others to leverage the differentiated characteristics of gigabit optical networks and 5G in scenarios with high bandwidth requirements, such as image monitoring and online quality inspection, and strong electromagnetic interference in industries such as mining, power, and stamping manufacturing, to form a batch of replicable and scalable dual gigabit deployment schemes. By the end of 2023, create 100 benchmark projects for gigabit virtual private networks.
titlelist: Key tasks, industry integration and empowerment actions, actively adopting new technologies such as 'IPv6+' to provide deterministic service capabilities.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage leading enterprises, research institutions, etc. to increase investment in the research and development of ultra-high-speed fiber optic transmission, next-generation optical network technology, wireless communication technology, etc., actively participate in international standardization work, strengthen the development of group standards, and form the core competitiveness of China's dual gigabit network technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to strengthen the industrial chain, fill in the weak links, and enhance core technology research and development and standard formulation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage terminal equipment companies to accelerate the research and development of 5G terminals, improve the performance of 5G terminals, and promote the maturity of various forms of 5G terminals such as smartphones and client devices (CPE) that support SA/NSA dual-mode and multiple frequency bands, as well as cloud XR and wearable devices. Promote the research and development and application of devices such as home gateways, enterprise gateways, and wireless routers that support high-speed wireless LAN technology, and accelerate the integration of terminals such as mobile phones, computers, and 4K/8K ultra-high-definition devices with flexible multi-access capabilities. Further reduce terminal costs, improve terminal performance and security, and stimulate the potential for information consumption.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to strengthen the industrial chain, fill the gaps in the chain, and accelerate the maturity of the end products.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage companies in the fiber optic cable, chip devices, and network equipment industries to continuously improve the level of industrial base advancement and modernization of the industrial chain, and consolidate existing industrial advantages. Focus on enhancing the research and development and manufacturing capabilities of core chips, network equipment, modules, devices, etc., promote the self-reliance and self-strengthening of China's communication industry chain, and cultivate and expand the industrial ecosystem. Implement the Double Gigabit industrial chain strengthening and supplementing project. Strengthen core technology research and development, encourage leading companies, research institutions, etc. to increase research and development investment in technologies such as 800Gbps/1Tbps ultra-high-speed fiber transmission, 50G-PON, 5GRel-17, millimeter wave communication, and high-speed wireless LAN, and achieve technological innovation. Accelerate breakthroughs in industrial weaknesses, encourage companies in the fiber optic cable, chip devices, and network equipment industries to strengthen technological research and development and improve manufacturing capabilities and process levels in weak areas such as 5G chips, high-speed PON chips, high-speed wireless LAN chips, high-speed optical modules, and high-performance devices. Build industrial clusters, rely on existing domestic industrial advantage regions, create a Double Gigabit strategic industrial cluster for networks, and form a collective force. By the end of 2023, key core technologies will achieve breakthroughs, and independent research and development capabilities will be significantly enhanced.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to strengthen the industrial chain, fill in the gaps in the chain, and continuously enhance industrial capabilities.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Expand the number of connected enterprises and the scale of traffic exchange in the new Internet exchange center, add at least 2 national-level Internet backbone direct connection points, and improve a comprehensive, multi-level, three-dimensional interconnection system. Promote cloud service companies to continuously improve their key core technology capabilities in cloud computing, promote the construction of multi-access edge computing (MEC) edge clouds, and accelerate the application of new models and technologies such as cloud-edge collaboration and cloud-network integration. Promote content delivery network (CDN) companies to accelerate the deployment of CDN nodes in the western and northeastern regions, promote CDN capacity expansion and sinking as needed, and achieve internet content access in proximity.
titlelist: Key tasks, user experience improvement action, continuous optimization of network architecture.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Guide basic telecommunications enterprises to strengthen the coordinated development of 5G and 4G networks, promote the re-cultivation and optimization upgrade of 2G, 3G, and 4G frequencies, and improve the efficiency of network resource utilization. Support the research and deployment of multi-mode base station equipment to ensure the coverage needs of different standard networks in urban hotspots, high-speed rail, and subway lines. Continuously improve the international bandwidth capacity of the Internet, and improve the experience of international Internet access. Achieve a 10Tbps expansion of inter-network bandwidth for the Internet, and converge the inter-network access performance with developed countries in Europe and America. Promote Internet companies to enhance their service capabilities, ensure basic bandwidth allocation, and improve user business access experience.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance user experience, focusing on ensuring network quality.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Urge basic telecommunications companies to effectively improve the quality of 5G services, establish and improve the 5G service standards of the company, and increase the assessment of services provided by physical business halls, customer service hotlines, and other frontline windows. Further improve the reminder mechanism, strictly adhere to marketing red lines, rigorously investigate behaviors such as aggressively promoting 5G plans, restricting users from changing plans, and exaggerating plan advertisements, and effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of users. Promote companies to reduce the average fees for broadband and dedicated lines for small and medium-sized enterprises by another 10% in 2021. Encourage the launch of exclusive preferential rates for special groups such as rural poverty-stricken households (originally registered impoverished households), the elderly, and disabled people, reasonably reducing communication costs for mobile phones, broadband, and other services. Enhance the evaluation capabilities of the Dual Gigabit network development assessment project. Improve the user experience-based evaluation index system for the development of Dual Gigabit networks. Guide relevant companies and research institutions to strengthen the construction and deployment of dedicated terminals, 5G speed measurement apps, speed measurement servers, and other technical means. Adopt comprehensive methods such as field testing, fixed-point testing, and friendly user testing to enrich data sources and form a refined network development key index evaluation capability in different regions, time periods, and network segments. Research the Dual Gigabit network evaluation system for industries. Organize relevant companies and research institutions to conduct research on the network performance requirements of different industries and scenarios, and carry out field testing in no less than 10 major industries and scenarios. Regularly release authoritative data and reports. Guide the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology to regularly release reports on fixed broadband and mobile broadband network speeds in China, timely release network development evaluation reports for key cities and locations, comprehensively and objectively reflect the development level of Dual Gigabit networks in China, and continuously optimize the service capabilities of Dual Gigabit networks in China.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance user experience, continuously improve service quality.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the coordination of network security capabilities with the planning, construction, and operation of dual gigabit network infrastructure, and enhance network security and data security capabilities. Urge relevant enterprises to fulfill their main responsibilities for network security, establish sound security management systems and work mechanisms, conduct network security risk assessments and hidden danger investigations, timely prevent various security risks in networks, equipment, physical environment, management, etc., and continuously improve network security protection capabilities.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthening security measures, enhancing network security protection capabilities.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage key cybersecurity enterprises to focus on key aspects such as network planning and construction, concentrate on critical areas of information technology products, carry out core technology research and development, build an industrial ecosystem covering underlying infrastructure, key equipment, and network security products, establish secure and trustworthy new information infrastructure, and steadily enhance the security of double gigabit networks.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthening security measures, building a secure and trustworthy new information infrastructure.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: The various local communication management bureaus have established a collaborative working mechanism with the departments of industry and information technology, housing and urban-rural development, market supervision, and internet information, among others. They have strengthened their joint law enforcement capabilities and efforts, focusing on the joint rectification of broadband access markets in commercial buildings, the implementation of national standards for fiber-to-the-home in new civil buildings, and forming a regulatory synergy. They are also coordinating with the power sector to reduce the electricity costs of 5G base stations.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthening departmental collaboration.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Standardization organizations and industry associations should fully leverage their role as technical leaders and bridge links, actively engage in international benchmarking, and promote further technological breakthroughs and collaborative innovation among telecommunications enterprises, research institutes, equipment vendors, component suppliers, chip vendors, and other stakeholders in the industry chain. Efforts should be made to strengthen the exchange and promotion of experiences in the deployment and application of dual gigabit networks and new technologies.
titlelist: Key tasks, deepen exchanges and cooperation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Basic telecommunications companies should provide tariff packages for sale to the public market in their own business halls, mobile apps, online platforms, tariff special zones, and agent channels. They should also provide a query entrance for discounted tariff packages for the elderly and disabled. Thoroughly review the names of the packages for sale to avoid misunderstandings. Promptly remind users of their data usage within the package and set a reasonable price for data usage outside the package (to be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing tariff package settings and display methods.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Basic telecommunications companies should further implement the requirements of the four reminder mechanisms and the four marketing red lines for 5G services. They should clearly specify the theoretical uplink and downlink rates in broadband service contracts, provide services as promised, ensure that users' access rates meet the standards, and inform users in an appropriate manner about the impact of hardware devices, environmental factors, etc., on broadband speed. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing the promotion methods of dual gigabit services.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Internet companies (see attached list of companies for the first batch of implementation) should provide users with a concise, clear, and easy-to-understand summary of the privacy policy for their APP products. If it involves accessing sensitive permissions such as photo albums, contacts, and location in the user's terminal, they should also inform users of the purpose of accessing such permissions in an appropriate manner, fully protecting the user's right to know. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing privacy policy and permission invocation display methods.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Internet companies should set clear and effective close buttons in the splash screen and pop-up window of their apps. The button size, position, and color should be easy to operate and recognize, allowing users to 'find it and close it'. The splash screen window of the app should not use full-screen images, videos, or other content as jump links, which may induce users to click or easily cause users to make mistaken clicks, causing inconvenience to users. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing the display method of APP splash screen pop-up information.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Relevant companies should optimize the introduction of product services and fees, clearly indicating the content of storage space, transmission rate, functional rights and benefits, and fee levels, and must not engage in misleading advertising. Under the same network conditions, the minimum upload and download speed provided to free users should ensure the basic download needs are met. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing the way of providing online storage services.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Each relevant company should establish a list of collected personal information and a list of personal information shared with third parties (the initial list of companies that have established the double list is attached), and display them in the secondary menu of the app for easy user access (to be completed by the end of December 2021). The list of collected personal information should concisely and clearly outline the basic information of user personal information collected by the app (including embedded third-party software development kits SDK), including the types of information, purposes of use, and usage scenarios. The list of personal information shared with third parties should concisely and clearly outline the basic information of user personal information shared between the app and third parties, including the types of personal information shared with third parties, purposes of use, usage scenarios, and sharing methods.
titlelist: Key task: Establishing 'dual lists' for personal information protection.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Basic telecommunications companies have added Family Network and Fixed-Mobile Convergence services for cross-regional handling. Within the same basic telecommunications company network, mobile numbers with different locations can form a family network, enabling cross-province processing. It is also possible to integrate fixed broadband and mobile numbers across local networks within the province, and basic telecommunications companies with the capability are encouraged to actively promote cross-province processing. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, four improvements in service capabilities, improving cross-regional handling capabilities.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: On the basis of fulfilling the previous commitment to open channels, basic telecommunications companies will open 10,000 new service halls nationwide that can handle number portability services. The situation of these service halls that can handle number portability services will be promptly publicized to the public. The service halls should be reasonably distributed to minimize inconvenience for users. Online application for number portability services and refund services for users who port out to a different location will be implemented. Basic telecommunications companies with the capability are encouraged to provide number portability services at service halls in different locations. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, four improvements in service capability, improving number portability service capability.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Enterprises engaged in Internet information services should establish customer service hotlines and prominently display the customer service hotline number on their websites, apps, and other platforms. Encourage eligible enterprises to provide sufficient manned customer service seats (see attached list of enterprises for the first batch of implementation) and offer direct hotline services to the elderly. The customer service hotline should strive to achieve a maximum average response time of 30 seconds per month, with a human service response rate exceeding 85% (to be completed by the end of March 2022).
titlelist: Key tasks, four improvements in service capabilities, improving customer service hotline response capabilities.

Equipment manufacturing industry big data. Support equipment manufacturing enterprises in integrating data flow throughout the entire value chain, including research and development, procurement, manufacturing, management, and after-sales, and develop data-driven product research and development, simulation optimization, intelligent production, predictive maintenance, precision management, remote operation and maintenance, and other new models and formats to improve product quality, reduce production costs, and accelerate service innovation and upgrading. Consumer goods industry big data. Support consumer goods enterprises in integrating online and offline data, develop personalized recommendation algorithms, realize customized production of products, and fine-tune channel operations to promote accurate supply and demand matching. Support companies in establishing quality traceability databases covering the entire process, accelerate integration with the national product quality supervision platform, and achieve traceable and manageable product quality. Electronic information industry big data. Support electronic information manufacturing enterprises in accelerating the application of big data in scenarios such as product sales forecasting and demand management, production planning and scheduling, supply chain analysis and optimization, product quality management and analysis, etc., accelerate product iteration and innovation, optimize production processes, improve product quality, and ensure the stability of the industrial chain and supply chain. Extend the value chain of industries. Accelerate the construction of industry big data platforms, improve the level of data development and utilization, promote the assetization and productization of industry data, and realize the re-creation and value enhancement of data. Create mature application scenarios that serve the government, society, and enterprises, and use data innovation to drive management and model innovation, and promote the vigorous development of financial technology, smart healthcare, etc. Continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of big data industry development, promote the integration and application of big data in various industries and fields, and increase the promotion of excellent application solutions. Column 4: Action for the Development and Utilization of Industry Big Data. Communication big data. Accelerate the large-scale deployment of 5G networks and promote the upgrading of gigabit fiber-optic networks. Expand the interconnection nodes of backbone networks and establish a batch of international communication entry and exit points. Improve the seismic resistance of public communication facilities in earthquake-prone areas, strengthen the construction of super base stations in mountainous areas, and plan and reserve mobile base stations to enhance the anti-destruction capability of communication public networks. Internally, strengthen the development, utilization, and security governance capabilities of data, improve enterprise management efficiency, and externally empower industry applications to support market supervision. Financial big data. Through big data actuarial, statistics, and model construction, help improve the modern financial regulatory system, fill in the gaps in regulatory institutions, and promote financial innovation under prudent regulation. Optimize risk identification, credit assessment models, and enhance data-driven risk management capabilities. Medical big data. Improve electronic health records, cases, electronic prescriptions, and other databases, and accelerate the sharing of data among medical and health institutions. Promote telemedicine and applications such as medical image-assisted interpretation and clinical diagnosis. Enhance the regulatory capacity of medical institutions and medical behaviors, and promote the reform of medical, medical insurance, and pharmaceutical linkage. Emergency management big data. Build a monitoring and perception network for safety production, aggregate and share data on natural disasters, and enhance the capability to obtain data at disaster sites. Construct and improve emergency management databases for disaster risk surveys, monitoring, and early warning, and utilize big data in monitoring and early warning, regulatory enforcement, decision-making assistance, rescue operations, and social mobilization. Promote intelligent application models such as data supervision, data disaster prevention, and data nuclear disaster, and achieve deep integration of big data and emergency management business, continuously improve the modernization level of emergency management. Agriculture and water conservancy big data. Utilize big data in agriculture production, economic operation, resource and environmental monitoring, agricultural product production and sales, etc., promote precision sowing, precise fertilization and pesticide application, and precise harvesting of field crops, and promote intelligent applications in facility horticulture, livestock and aquaculture. Promote the construction of a smart water conservancy system, improve water situation monitoring and intelligent scheduling capabilities based on river basins. Public security big data. Strengthen the compliant application of data such as identity verification. Promote the construction of an intelligent public security big data platform, coordinate the new generation of public security information infrastructure, strengthen the governance and service of police data resources, strengthen the correlation analysis of public safety data across industries and regions, continuously improve the capabilities of safety risk prediction and early warning, precise law enforcement against illegal crimes, precise intelligent security and control, and convenient and efficient public security governance. Transportation big data. Strengthen the collection and analysis of data related to vehicles and transportation infrastructure, provide support for the development and application of autonomous driving and vehicle-road coordination technologies. Innovate applications such as travel planning, traffic flow monitoring and analysis, promote intelligent management of highways, coordinated traffic signal control, and priority passage for public transportation. Promote the sharing and application of data in transportation and logistics, and promote the development of multi-modal transportation such as railways, highways, waterways, and aviation. Power big data. Based on big data analysis and mining algorithms, optimization strategies, and visualization technologies, strengthen the deep application of big data in power generation, transmission and transformation, distribution, and consumption. Use big data to assist in the intelligent upgrading of power plants, carry out extensive collection of electricity information, online energy efficiency analysis, achieve interactive optimization of power generation, grid, load, and storage, synergistic complementarity of multiple energy sources, and intelligent demand control. Credit big data. Strengthen the collection, sharing, openness, and application of credit information. Use technologies such as artificial intelligence and autonomous learning to build credit big data models, enhance the intelligent identification, judgment, analysis, and processing capabilities of credit risks. Improve a new type of regulatory mechanism based on credit, guided by credit risks, and optimize the allocation of regulatory resources. Deepen the application of credit information in financing, credit, business cooperation, public services, etc., strengthen credit risk prevention, and continuously optimize the living environment. Employment big data. Use big data from online recruitment, mobile communications, social insurance, etc., to monitor changes in the labor market, timely grasp changes in enterprise employment and labor employment and unemployment situations, better analyze and judge the employment situation, and make scientific decisions. Social security big data. Accelerate the digital transformation of social security operations, carry out data mining and application work through scientific modeling and analysis methods, build a digital panorama for insured units and individuals, support personalized services and precision supervision. Build a social security big data management system and accelerate the sharing of social security data. Improve risk prevention and control classification management, strengthen business operation monitoring, and establish a systematic and regular data audit mechanism. Urban safety big data. Build a city safety risk monitoring and early warning system, realize effective aggregation of urban operation data in areas such as urban construction, transportation, municipal services, high-risk industries, etc., use advanced technologies such as cloud computing and artificial intelligence to monitor, monitor, and early warn urban safety risks, and improve urban safety management level.

It includes general computing capability represented by CPUs, and high-performance computing capability represented by GPUs. The most commonly used unit of measurement is the number of floating-point operations executed per second (FLOPS, EFLOPS=10^18FLOPS). According to estimates, 1 EFLOPS is approximately equivalent to the computing power output of 5 Tianhe-2A supercomputers, or 500,000 mainstream server CPUs, or 2 million mainstream laptop computers. The calculation formula is: CE = CP / PCIT, where CP represents the computing power of the data center, expressed in single-precision floating-point numbers (FP32), and PCIT represents the overall power consumption of the data center's IT equipment, measured in watts (W).

content: The text is explaining the concept of Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) in data centers. PUE is the ratio of the total power consumption of a data center to the power consumption of its IT equipment. It is generally measured using the average annual PUE value. The detailed calculation and measurement requirements can be found in YDT2543 Energy Consumption Evaluation Method for Telecommunication Internet Data Centers (IDC). A PUE value greater than 1 indicates that a higher proportion of electrical energy is used for IT equipment, while the energy consumption for cooling, power supply, and other non-IT equipment is lower. The calculation formula for PUE is: PUE = PTotal / PIT, where PTotal represents the total power consumption required to maintain the normal operation of the data center (measured in kWh), and PIT represents the power consumption of the IT equipment in the data center (measured in kWh).

content: Guide the development of super-large and large-scale data center clusters, build data center clusters, promote cloud-based analysis and processing of large-scale data, focus on supporting the centralized processing of massive-scale data, support business needs such as industrial Internet, finance and securities, disaster warning, remote medical care, video calls, and artificial intelligence reasoning that require close proximity, high-frequency, real-time interaction. The end-to-end one-way network latency of data centers should ideally be within a range of 20 milliseconds. Data center clusters in Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia should prioritize backend processing, offline analysis, storage backup, and other non-real-time computing needs. In the initial stage, for national hub nodes across regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and Chengdu-Chongqing, the layout should generally not exceed 2 clusters. For national hub nodes in single administrative regions such as Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia, the layout should generally be 1 cluster. Clusters should focus on intensive development, clarify standards for data center construction scale, energy efficiency level, and deployment rate, and avoid blind investment and construction.
titlelist: Data center layout, data center cluster.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Within the urban city area, accelerate the transformation and upgrading of existing data centers to improve efficiency. Support the development of high-performance, edge data centers. Encourage data centers within the city area to serve as the edge for computing power, prioritizing the fulfillment of high-frequency trading in the financial market, virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR), ultra-high-definition video, connected vehicles, networked drones, smart power, smart factories, smart security, and other real-time business requirements. The end-to-end one-way network latency of data centers should ideally be within a range of 10 milliseconds.
titlelist: Data center layout, urban internal data center

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: With the focus on data center cluster layout, we will strengthen the construction of green data centers and enhance energy-saving and consumption reduction requirements. We will promote the use of energy-saving technologies such as high-density integration of efficient electronic information equipment, new types of precision air conditioning for computer rooms, liquid cooling, modular cabinet systems, and waste heat recovery. While ensuring safe operation and maintenance, we encourage the use of cascaded utilization products of power batteries as energy storage and backup power devices. We will accelerate the transformation and upgrading of old infrastructure. We will improve the comprehensive energy-saving evaluation standard system for data centers, which includes indicators such as energy utilization efficiency, computing power utilization efficiency, and renewable energy utilization rate.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening green and intensive construction.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Scale up the application of hardware and software products such as server chips, operating systems, databases, middleware, distributed computing and storage, and data flow models. Support and promote platform-level original technologies in big data infrastructure, distributed data operating systems, and big data analytics. Organize research institutes, universities, enterprises, and technology communities to collaborate on the development and application of key technological products, enhancing the independent innovation capability of the entire big data industry chain.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, promoting breakthroughs in core technologies.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Construct high-speed data transmission networks between data center clusters, as well as between clusters and major cities, optimize communication network structures, expand network communication bandwidth, and reduce data transfer latency. Establish a data center network monitoring system to promote efficient supply and coordinated development between data centers and network services. Establish a reasonable network settlement mechanism within national hub nodes to reduce long-distance transmission costs. Promote the construction of national new internet exchange centers and national internet backbone direct connection points around data center clusters, and facilitate interconnection and interoperability of traffic among internet companies, cloud service providers, telecommunications operators, and other parties.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, accelerating network interconnection and interoperability.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the full utilization of renewable energy such as wind energy, solar energy, tidal energy, and biomass energy in data centers. Support the establishment of renewable energy power plants to support data center clusters. Expand the scope of market-based transactions for renewable energy and encourage data center enterprises to participate in renewable energy market transactions. Support data centers in adopting methods such as direct supply for large users, dedicated power lines, and the construction of distributed photovoltaic systems to enhance the consumption of renewable energy. Ensure the availability of land and water resources for data centers.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening energy supply guarantee.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Establish a sound mechanism and technical system for monitoring energy consumption in data centers. Strengthen the coordination of energy consumption indicators in data centers, and allocate unified energy consumption indicators for data center clusters at the provincial, regional, and municipal levels. Encourage the allocation of energy consumption indicators through energy rights trading. Explore cross-provincial cooperation in sharing energy consumption and benefits. Encourage data centers to not only fulfill their minimum consumption responsibilities but also strive to achieve incentivized consumption targets.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening energy consumption monitoring and management.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Support government departments and enterprises to integrate internal computing resources, and conduct integrated scheduling of clusters and data centers within urban areas. Support the development of multi-cloud management services in public clouds, industry clouds, and other fields, and strengthen integrated resource scheduling between multiple clouds, clouds and data centers, and clouds and networks. Support the construction of an integrated access and integration verification environment, further connecting computing resources across industries, regions, and levels, and building a computing service resource pool.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, improving computing power service level.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Build data sharing, data openness, and integration of government-enterprise data into a common data circulation infrastructure platform, and establish a sound data circulation management system. Experiment with secure multi-party computation, blockchain, privacy computation, data sandbox, and other technological models to construct a trusted data circulation environment and improve data circulation efficiency. Explore the classification of data resources and research and formulate relevant specifications and standards.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, promoting orderly circulation of data.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Carry out the construction of an integrated urban data brain to provide big data support for urban industrial structure adjustment, economic operation monitoring, social services and governance, transportation, and ecological environment. Select public health, natural disasters, market supervision, and other emergency scenarios to experiment with the construction of a 'data target field' and explore the rules and collaborative mechanisms for data utilization under different emergency conditions.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, deepening the application of data intelligence.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Improve risk identification and protection technologies for aggregating and integrating massive amounts of data, data anonymization techniques, data security compliance assessment and certification, data encryption protection mechanisms, and related technical monitoring methods. Simultaneously plan, construct, and use security technology measures to ensure business stability and data security. Accelerate the construction of national internet data centers, cloud platforms, and other data security technical monitoring methods to enhance the ability to monitor sensitive data leaks and analyze abnormal data flows. Five, security measures.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, ensuring network data security.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Organize and carry out a major demonstration project for the collaborative innovation system of national integrated big data centers. Conduct pilot demonstrations in areas such as data center direct network connection, integrated computing power services, data circulation, and applications, to support the large-scale application of key software and hardware products such as server chips and cloud operating systems. Support the implementation of the 'East Data, West Computing' demonstration project to deepen the collaborative computing power between the eastern and western regions. Support the integrated verification of common technologies and mechanisms such as the development of technical platforms, resource access and scheduling, and industrial applications related to big data centers.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening engineering support.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: By 2025, a rational and green integrated infrastructure pattern will be formed for data centers nationwide. The structural balance of data centers in the eastern and western regions will be achieved, and the energy utilization efficiency of large and super-large data centers will be reduced to below 1.3. The level of data center intensification, scaling, and greening will significantly improve, and the utilization rate will be noticeably increased. The public cloud service system will initially take shape, and the cost of acquiring computing power for the whole society will be significantly reduced. The barriers to data circulation between government departments and between government and enterprises will be further broken, and the vitality of data resource circulation will be significantly enhanced. The collaborative application effect of big data will be highlighted, and a number of industry data brains and city data brains will be formed nationwide. The trend of efficient transformation of social computing resources and data resources into intellectual resources will be basically formed, and the capability of data security guarantee will steadily improve.
