content: Promote the transformation, upgrading, and acceleration of network construction while reducing costs. Focus on the low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage network needs of enterprises, and vigorously promote the construction of internal and external networks for industrial enterprises. Accelerate the construction and transformation of broadband network infrastructure, expand network coverage, and optimize and upgrade the national backbone network. Promote the IP (Internet Protocol), flat, flexible technological transformation and construction deployment of internal networks in industrial enterprises. Promote the application of new intelligent gateways and fully deploy IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6). Continue to promote the construction of dedicated lines for connecting small and medium-sized enterprises. Building upon the completion of the network acceleration and cost reduction tasks set out in the 2017 government work report, further increase network speed and reduce tariff levels, especially for significantly reducing the access fees for small and medium-sized enterprise internet dedicated lines. Strengthen resource openness and support the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Increase the guarantee of key resources such as radio spectrum. Promote the construction of identification resolution systems. Strengthen the top-level design of the industrial internet identification resolution system, establish an overall architecture, clarify development goals, roadmaps, and timetables. Establish a national management institution for industrial internet identification resolution, construct an identification resolution service system, support the construction of various levels of identification resolution nodes and public recursive resolution nodes, utilize identification to achieve precise connection between global supply chain systems and enterprise production systems, as well as cross-enterprise, cross-regional, and cross-industry product lifecycle management, and promote the integration and sharing of information resources. Column 1: Industrial Internet Infrastructure Upgrade and Transformation Project. Organize and implement the construction and upgrade of internal networks for industrial enterprises, external networks for industrial enterprises, and identification resolution systems for industrial internet. Support the transformation of internal networks for industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Passive Optical Network (PON), and industrial wireless, and upgrade and transform external networks for industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), and new cellular mobile communication technologies. Conduct network technology experiments for industrial internet applications in 5G research and coordinate the deployment of 5G in industrial enterprises. Carry out the construction of the industrial internet identification resolution system and establish and improve various levels of identification resolution nodes. By 2020, basically complete the upgrade and transformation of the next-generation internet and supporting management capabilities for advanced manufacturing, achieve the application of wireless network technologies such as Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) and Wireless Industrial Automation/Process (WIA-PA/FA) in key regions and industries, and initially establish supporting systems for industrial internet identification resolution registration and filing, with more than 10 public identification resolution service nodes and over 2 billion identification registrations. By 2025, deploy industrial wireless, Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), IPv6, and other industrial internet network technologies in large-scale industrial enterprises, achieve universal coverage of 5G networks and low-power wide-area networks for industrial internet access, and establish a fully functional industrial internet identification resolution system with more than 20 public identification resolution service nodes and over 3 billion identification registrations.
titlelist: Basic situation, solidify the network foundation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Accelerate the construction of industrial internet platforms. Break through key technological bottlenecks such as data integration, platform management, development tools, microservice frameworks, and modeling analysis, and form a technical system and industrial system that effectively support the development of industrial internet platforms. Carry out experimental verification in terms of adaptability, reliability, and security of industrial internet platforms, and promote continuous improvement of platform functions. Form a multi-level and systematic platform development system through classification, synchronous promotion, and dynamic adjustment. Relying on industrial internet platforms to create multi-level public platforms that serve mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Enhance platform operational capabilities. Strengthen the resource aggregation capabilities of industrial internet platforms, effectively integrate data resources such as product design, production processes, equipment operations, and operational management, and gather and share manufacturing resources such as design capabilities, production capabilities, software resources, and knowledge models. Carry out application innovation for different industries and scenarios, providing users with various applications including equipment health maintenance, production management optimization, collaborative design and manufacturing, and manufacturing resource leasing, and enhance service capabilities. Continuously explore business model innovation, expand platform profit space through resource rental, service provision, and industry-finance cooperation, and achieve long-term sustainable operation. Column 2: Construction and promotion of industrial internet platform engineering. Focus on both the supply and demand sides of industrial internet platforms, and carry out construction and promotion in four aspects: First, cultivate industrial internet platforms. Through enterprise-led, market-driven, and dynamically adjusted approaches, form cross-industry and cross-domain platforms, achieve interconnection and interoperability among multiple platforms, undertake functions such as resource aggregation and sharing, technology standard testing and verification, and provide services such as industrial data circulation, business resource management, and industrial operation monitoring. Promote leading enterprises to actively develop enterprise-level platforms and develop various solutions that meet the needs of enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent development. Establish and improve the technical system of industrial internet platforms. Second, conduct experimental verification of industrial internet platforms. Support industry alliances, cooperation between enterprises and research institutions to jointly build testing and verification platforms, and carry out technology verification and testing evaluation. Third, migrate millions of enterprises to the cloud. Encourage the landing of industrial internet platforms in industrial agglomeration areas, and promote local governments to encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to migrate their business systems to the cloud through financial and tax support, government procurement of services, and other means. Fourth, cultivate millions of industrial apps. Support software companies, industrial enterprises, research institutes, etc., to cooperate and cultivate a batch of industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios. By 2020, the industrial internet platform system will initially take shape, supporting the construction of about 10 cross-industry and cross-domain platforms, and building a batch of enterprise-level platforms that support enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent transformation. Cultivate 300,000 industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios, promote 300,000 enterprises to use industrial internet platforms for research and development, design, production, manufacturing, and operational management, and the fundamental and supportive role of industrial internet platforms in industrial transformation and upgrading will begin to emerge. By 2025, key industries in the industrial sector will achieve networked manufacturing, the industrial internet platform system will be basically improved, 3-5 industrial internet platforms with international competitiveness will be formed, millions of industrial apps will be cultivated, millions of enterprises will migrate to the cloud, and a new ecosystem of manufacturing industry with platform construction and platform usage mutually promoting and iterating will be formed.
titlelist: Basic situation, building platform system.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Increase the efforts in key common technology research. Conduct research on new network interconnection technologies such as time-sensitive networks, deterministic networks, and low-power industrial wireless networks, and accelerate the application research of 5G, software-defined networks, and other technologies in the industrial internet. Promote research on key technologies and secure and reliable mechanisms for industrial internet identification resolution, information management, and heterogeneous identification interoperability. Accelerate the research on core technologies such as IPv6. Promote the application research and exploration of emerging frontier technologies such as edge computing, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, virtual reality, and blockchain in the industrial internet. Build an industrial internet standard system. Establish a national industrial internet standard coordination and promotion group, an overall group, and an expert advisory group to coordinate the construction of the industrial internet standard system, optimize the promotion mechanism, and accelerate the establishment of a unified, comprehensive, and open industrial internet standard system. Develop a series of overall standards, basic common standards, application standards, and security standards. Organize standard development and test verification projects, and promote the development and promotion of standard content test verification, test verification environment construction, simulation and testing tool development. Column 3: Standard development and test verification projects. Carry out the development of industrial internet standards based on the standardization needs and standard system construction of the industrial internet. Develop overall standards such as general requirements, system architecture, and testing and evaluation; develop basic common standards such as network and digital interconnection interfaces, identification resolution, industrial internet platforms, and security; develop industry application guidelines, specific technical standards, and management specifications for key industries such as automotive, aerospace, petrochemicals, machinery manufacturing, light industry and home appliances, information electronics, etc. Organize the test verification of relevant standards and promote the development of supporting simulation and testing tools. By 2020, initially establish an industrial internet standard system, formulate more than 20 overall and key basic common standards, formulate more than 20 key industry standards, and promote the application of standards in key enterprises and industries. By 2025, basically establish a standard system covering key technologies, products, management, and applications of the industrial internet, and widely apply it in enterprises. Enhance product and solution supply capabilities. Accelerate the research and industrialization of information and communication, data integration and analysis, and focus on breakthroughs in key software and hardware products and solutions such as high-performance networks, intelligent modules, intelligent networking equipment, and industrial software. Focus on improving the integration and innovation level of data analysis algorithms with industrial knowledge, mechanisms, and experience, and develop a batch of industrial data analysis software and systems for different industrial scenarios, as well as industrial intelligence software and solutions with deep learning and other artificial intelligence technologies. Create overall industrial internet solutions closely integrated with the characteristics of the top ten key areas and traditional industries. Guide telecommunications operators, internet companies, and industrial enterprises to actively transform, strengthen their capabilities in industrial internet operation services such as network operation, identification resolution, and security, and develop innovative productive services such as industrial e-commerce, supply chain, and related financial information. Column 4: Key technology industrialization projects. Promote research and application of emerging frontier technologies such as new network interconnection and identification resolution in the industrial internet, establish technology test verification systems, and support technology and product test verification. Focus on key industrial links of the industrial internet and actively promote the industrialization of key technologies. Accelerate the industrialization of key industrial internet network equipment, develop key technologies and products such as IPv6, industrial passive optical networks, time-sensitive networks, industrial wireless, low-power wide area networks, software-defined networks, and identification resolution. Develop and promote key intelligent networked equipment, focus on key areas such as numerical control machine tools, industrial robots, large-scale power equipment, etc., achieve integrated innovation of intelligent control, intelligent sensing, industrial-grade chips, and network communication modules, and develop a series of new intelligent equipment with networking, computing, and optimization functions. Develop industrial big data analysis software, focus on key areas, develop industrial big data analysis application software for application scenarios such as production process optimization, quality analysis, predictive maintenance of equipment, and intelligent scheduling, and achieve industrial deployment. By 2020, make breakthroughs in a batch of key technologies, establish more than 5 technology test verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment with advanced domestic levels, and have active innovation in intelligent networked products, achieving quick access to functions such as industrial big data cleaning, management, and analysis, and promote the application of technology and products in key enterprises and industries, achieving initial industrialization of key industrial internet technologies. By 2025, master key core technologies, effectively support the research and experimentation of industrial internet technology products through technology test verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment that reaches international advanced levels, and achieve large-scale commercial deployment of intelligent networked products and industrial big data analysis application software, forming a relatively sound industrial internet industry system.
titlelist: Basic situation, strengthen industrial support.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the innovation and application level of industrial internet in large enterprises. Accelerate the application of industrial internet in industrial sites, strengthen the networking and data collection capabilities of equipment in complex production processes, and achieve end-to-end integration of data resources at all levels of the enterprise. Carry out data integration applications based on the industrial internet platform, form the ability of process optimization, workflow optimization, equipment maintenance, and accident risk warning based on data analysis and feedback, and realize intelligent decision-making and deep optimization of enterprise production and operation management. Encourage enterprises to integrate resources through the industrial internet platform, build a collaborative manufacturing system for design, production, and supply chain. Promote large-scale customization based on user individual needs and precise connection between product design and production in terms of quality traceability, equipment health management, and value-added services. Accelerate the popularization of industrial internet applications in small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the deployment and application of low-cost, modular industrial internet equipment and systems in small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance their digital and networked capabilities. Encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to fully utilize the cloud-based research and development design, production management, and operation optimization software of the industrial internet platform, realize the migration of business systems to the cloud, and reduce the cost of digital and intelligent transformation. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises to open up professional knowledge, design creativity, and manufacturing capabilities, and carry out innovative applications such as supply-demand matching, integrated supply chain, industrial e-commerce, and crowdsourcing and crowdfunding based on the industrial internet platform to improve the efficiency of social manufacturing resource allocation. Column 5: Industrial Internet Integration and Innovation Application Engineering. Guided by pioneering applications, organize and carry out innovative application demonstrations, and gradually explore the implementation path and application models of the industrial internet. In terms of intelligent production applications, encourage large industrial enterprises to achieve extensive interconnection between various production equipment and information systems and the integration and interoperability of related industrial data, and develop applications such as quality optimization, intelligent scheduling, and supply chain optimization based on this. In terms of remote service applications, carry out networked services for high-value intelligent equipment, realize remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and other remote service applications, and explore the development of remote services for comprehensive support in the defense industry. In terms of networked collaborative manufacturing applications, focus on the intelligent development needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, carry out collaborative design, crowdsourcing, cloud manufacturing, and other innovative applications, and realize online access to various industrial software and modular design and manufacturing resources. In terms of intelligent internet of things product applications, focus on areas such as smart homes, wearable devices, etc., integrate advanced technologies such as 5G, deep learning, and big data, and meet typical needs such as high-precision positioning, intelligent human-computer interaction, and secure and trustworthy operation and maintenance. In terms of identification resolution and integration applications, implement integrated innovation applications of industrial internet identification resolution system and industrial enterprise information system, support enterprises in exploring applications such as key product traceability based on identification services, multi-source heterogeneous data sharing, and lifecycle management. By 2020, a strong influence of industrial internet pioneering application models will be initially formed, and around 150 application pilots will be established. By 2025, expand the scope of industrial internet applications, fully promote them in the top ten key areas and key traditional industries, and achieve significant overall improvement in enterprise benefits.
titlelist: Basic situation, promoting integration and application.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Enhance security protection capabilities. Strengthen research on the security system of the industrial internet, combining technology and management, and establish a multi-level security guarantee system for the industrial internet covering equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security. Increase support for technology research and development and the transformation of achievements, with a focus on breakthroughs in core technologies such as secure identification and resolution systems, industrial internet platform security, industrial control system security, and industrial big data security. Promote the development of security products such as attack protection, vulnerability discovery, intrusion detection, situational awareness, security auditing, and trusted chips, establishing technical support capabilities that match the development of the industrial internet. Construct a security assessment and certification system for industrial internet devices, networks, and platforms, and conduct security capability assessments and certifications through third-party organizations such as industry alliances, leading to continuous improvement in the security protection capabilities of the industrial internet. Establish a data security protection system. Establish a comprehensive data security management system for the entire industrial internet industry chain, clarify the data security protection responsibilities and specific requirements of relevant entities, and strengthen the security protection capabilities of data collection, storage, processing, transfer, deletion, and other processes. Establish a classification and management system for industrial data, form a management mechanism for the flow of industrial internet data, clarify requirements for data retention and data leakage reporting, and strengthen supervision and inspection of industrial internet data security. Promote the construction of security technology means. Urge relevant enterprises in the industrial internet to fulfill their responsibilities as the main body of network security, guide enterprises to increase security investment, strengthen the construction of security protection and monitoring and disposal technology means, carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial internet security, and enhance security protection capabilities. Actively leverage the guiding role of relevant industry alliances, integrate industry resources, encourage alliance units to innovate service models, provide security operation and maintenance, security consulting, and other services, and enhance the overall security guarantee service capabilities of the industry. Give full play to the role of national professional institutions and social forces, enhance the national-level industrial internet security technology support capabilities, and focus on improving the capabilities of hazard investigation, attack detection, emergency disposal, and attack traceability. Column 7: Security protection capability enhancement project. Promote the improvement of national-level industrial internet security technology capabilities. Build platforms for monitoring, early warning, protection, and disposal of industrial internet security, platforms for core technology research and development of industrial internet security, platforms for security testing and evaluation of industrial internet, and industrial internet test fields. Guide enterprises to enhance their own industrial internet security protection capabilities. In key areas with good foundations such as automobiles, electronics, aerospace, energy, and urgent security needs such as defense industries, establish management and technical systems for industrial internet security, carry out pilot demonstrations and industry applications of security products and solutions. By 2020, conduct targeted inspections and assessments based on the distribution of important industrial internet platforms and systems; initially establish platforms for monitoring, early warning, protection, and disposal of industrial internet security; cultivate and develop 3-5 industrial internet security enterprises with core competitiveness; select and promote a batch of innovative and practical network security pilot demonstration projects. By 2025, form a series of standards covering industrial internet equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security, establish a sound industrial internet security certification system; comprehensively promote the application of industrial internet security products and services; significantly enhance the network security protection capabilities of industrial internet-related enterprises; and basically establish a national-level industrial internet security technology support system.
titlelist: Basic situation, strengthening security guarantee.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Improve the international development capabilities of enterprises. Encourage domestic and foreign enterprises to collaborate on technical research and product development in weak areas such as big data analysis, industrial data modeling, key software systems, and chips. Establish international cooperation mechanisms in industrial internet technology, products, platforms, and services, and promote the introduction and export of industrial internet platforms, integrated solutions, and more. Encourage close collaboration among domestic and foreign enterprises across different sectors and the entire industry chain. Strengthen multilateral dialogue and cooperation. Establish multi-level communication and dialogue mechanisms among governments, industry alliances, and enterprises to exchange and cooperate on major issues related to the latest development of industrial internet, global infrastructure construction, data flow, security, policies, and regulations. Enhance collaboration with international organizations to jointly formulate industrial internet standards and international rules, and build a multilateral, democratic, and transparent international governance system for the industrial internet.
titlelist: Basic situation, promoting openness and cooperation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Strengthen the role of fiscal funds in guiding, and increase support for the development of industrial internet through funds for industrial transformation and upgrading, with a focus on supporting the construction of network systems, platform systems, and security systems. Explore support methods such as first purchase and preferential purchase to promote the large-scale application of innovative products and services in the industrial internet. Encourage eligible regions to support the development of local industrial internet clusters by establishing special funds for industrial internet and establishing risk compensation funds. Implement relevant tax preferential policies to promote accelerated depreciation of fixed assets, additional deduction of enterprise R&D expenses, preferential income tax for software and integrated circuit industry enterprises, and tax preferential policies for small and micro enterprises, and encourage relevant enterprises to accelerate the development and application of industrial internet.
titlelist: Ensure support and increase financial and tax support.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Support the expansion of the proportion of direct financing, support industrial internet companies that meet the conditions to carry out equity financing in domestic and foreign capital markets at all levels, actively promote the application of project income bonds, convertible bonds, corporate bonds, and company bonds in the field of industrial internet, and guide various types of investment funds to tilt towards the field of industrial internet. Increase support for targeted credit assistance, improve the mechanism for banks to connect with enterprises, and provide loan services for technological, business, and application innovations in the field of industrial internet; encourage banking and financial institutions to innovate credit products, explore and develop pledge loan businesses such as data assets, under the premise of compliance with laws and regulations, controllable risks, and sustainable business. Extend the scope of financial services for the industrial chain, encourage eligible enterprise groups to establish financial companies to provide financial management services for industrial internet companies under the group, strengthen centralized fund management, improve the efficiency of fund utilization, and reduce the cost of funds. Expand targeted insurance services, support insurance companies in developing corresponding insurance products based on the needs of the industrial internet.
titlelist: Guarantee support, innovate financial service methods.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: (1) Overall approach. In line with the global trend of Internet Plus, fully leverage the scale advantage and application advantage of China's Internet, promote the expansion of the Internet from the consumer sector to the production sector, accelerate the improvement of industrial development level, enhance the innovation capability of various industries, and build new advantages and new driving forces for economic and social development. Adhere to reform, innovation, and market demand orientation, highlight the role of enterprises, vigorously expand the breadth and depth of Internet integration in various economic and social fields. Focus on deepening institutional and mechanism reforms, unleash development potential and vitality; focus on optimizing existing resources, promote economic quality improvement and transformation and upgrading; focus on expanding new increments, cultivate emerging industries, and create new growth points; focus on innovating government service models, solidify the foundation of Internet development, create a secure online environment, and enhance the level of public services. (2) Basic principles. Adhere to openness and sharing. Create an open and inclusive development environment, regard the Internet as an important platform for sharing production and living elements, optimize resource allocation to the maximum extent, and accelerate the formation of a new model of economic and social operation characterized by openness and sharing. Adhere to integration and innovation. Encourage traditional industries to adopt Internet thinking and actively integrate with Internet Plus. Promote the accelerated penetration of the Internet into various economic and social fields, promote innovation through integration, and maximize the innovative power of various market elements, driving the integrated emerging industries to become new driving forces and pillars of economic development. Adhere to transformation and upgrading. Fully leverage the platform role of the Internet in promoting industrial upgrading and deep integration of informatization and industrialization, guide the convergence of factor resources to the real economy, and promote changes in production methods and development models. Innovate the network-based public service model and significantly enhance public service capabilities. Adhere to leading breakthroughs. Consolidate and enhance China's advantages in Internet development, strengthen forward-looking layouts in key areas, use Internet integration and innovation as a breakthrough, cultivate and expand emerging industries, lead a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, and achieve leapfrog development. Adhere to safety and order. Improve Internet integration standards, regulations, and laws, enhance security awareness, strengthen security management and protection, and ensure network security. Establish a scientific and effective market supervision method, promote orderly market development, protect fair competition, and prevent the formation of industry monopolies and market barriers. (3) Development goals. By 2018, the integration and development of the Internet with various economic and social fields will further deepen, new forms of the Internet-based economy will become new drivers of economic growth, the role of the Internet in supporting mass entrepreneurship and innovation will be further enhanced, the Internet will become an important means of providing public services, and the development pattern of synergy between the digital economy and the real economy will be basically formed. - Economic development will further improve in terms of quality and efficiency. The Internet has achieved positive results in promoting the transformation and upgrading of industries such as manufacturing, agriculture, energy, and environmental protection, further improving labor productivity. Emerging forms of the Internet continue to emerge, and e-commerce and Internet finance are developing rapidly, highlighting their role in improving economic quality and efficiency. - Social services will become more convenient and inclusive. Internet applications in areas such as healthcare, education, and transportation will become more diverse, public services will become more varied, and online and offline integration will become closer. The allocation of social service resources will continue to be optimized, and the public will enjoy more fair, efficient, high-quality, and convenient services. - Infrastructure support will be further strengthened and improved. Network facilities and industrial foundations will be effectively consolidated and strengthened, and application support and security capabilities will be significantly enhanced. Fixed broadband networks, next-generation mobile communication networks, and next-generation Internet will accelerate development, and new infrastructure such as the Internet of Things and cloud computing will become more complete. The capabilities of technologies such as artificial intelligence and their industrialization will be significantly enhanced. - The development environment will become more open and inclusive. The understanding of Internet integration and innovation will continue to deepen throughout society, institutional and mechanism obstacles to Internet integration and development will be effectively overcome, substantial progress will be made in the opening of public data resources, and relevant standards, regulations, credit systems, and laws will be gradually improved. By 2025, the networked, intelligent, service-oriented, and collaborative Internet Plus industrial ecosystem will be basically complete, the new form of Internet Plus economy will begin to take shape, and Internet Plus will become an important driving force for innovative and developmental economic and social development.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Give full play to the innovative driving role of the Internet, with a focus on promoting entrepreneurship and innovation, and promote the gathering, openness, and sharing of various elements and resources. Vigorously develop maker spaces, open innovation, etc., guide and promote the formation of a strong atmosphere of mass entrepreneurship and innovation throughout society, and create a new engine for economic development. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Commerce, etc., with the first listed being the leading department, and the same for the following).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Entrepreneurship and Innovation

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage large-scale internet companies and basic telecommunications companies to utilize their technological advantages and integration capabilities to open up platform access, data information, computing power, and other resources to small and micro enterprises and entrepreneurial teams. Provide support and services in research and development tools, business management, and marketing, in order to improve the level of information application in small and micro enterprises and cultivate and incubate startups with good business models. Make full use of the basic conditions of the internet, improve the network of public service platforms for small and micro enterprises, gather entrepreneurial and innovative resources, and provide accessible, affordable, and guaranteed services for small and micro enterprises.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ entrepreneurship and innovation, strengthen support for entrepreneurship and innovation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Give full play to the advantages of open innovation on the internet, mobilize the entire society, and support the development of new types of crowd innovation spaces such as innovation factories, maker spaces, social laboratories, and smart small business startup bases. Make full use of existing conditions such as national independent innovation demonstration zones, technology enterprise incubators, university science and technology parks, trade enterprise agglomeration zones, and small and micro enterprise startup demonstration bases. Through market-oriented approaches, build a group of crowd innovation spaces that combine innovation and entrepreneurship, online and offline, incubation and investment, providing entrepreneurs with low-cost, convenient, all-element workspaces, online spaces, social spaces, and resource sharing spaces. Implement the double innovation action in emerging industries, establish a group of double innovation demonstration bases in emerging industries, and accelerate the development of the Internet Plus entrepreneurship network system.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ entrepreneurship and innovation, actively developing mass innovation spaces.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage various innovative entities to fully utilize the Internet, grasp market demand orientation, strengthen the sharing and cooperation of innovative resources, promote the timely transformation of cutting-edge technology and innovation achievements, and build an open innovation system. Promote the linkage and cooperation between various entrepreneurship and innovation support policies and Internet open platforms, and provide green channel services for entrepreneurial teams and individual developers. Accelerate the development of the entrepreneurship service industry, actively promote new research and development organizational models such as crowdsourcing, user participation in design, and cloud design, guide the establishment of platforms for social exchanges and cooperation, and promote the transfer and collaborative innovation of technological achievements across regions and fields.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ entrepreneurship and innovation, development of open innovation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the integration of the Internet and manufacturing industry, enhance the level of digitization, networking, and intelligence in the manufacturing industry, strengthen industrial chain collaboration, and develop new models of collaborative manufacturing based on the Internet. Promote intelligent manufacturing, large-scale personalized customization, networked collaborative manufacturing, and service-oriented manufacturing in key areas, and build a number of networked collaborative manufacturing public service platforms to accelerate the formation of a networked manufacturing industry ecosystem. (Led jointly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Science and Technology).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Collaborative Manufacturing

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: With smart factories as the development direction, we will carry out pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing, accelerate the application of technologies such as cloud computing, the Internet of Things, smart industrial robots, and additive manufacturing in the production process, promote the intelligent upgrading of production equipment, the transformation of process flows, and the sharing of basic data. We will focus on breakthroughs in key areas such as industrial control systems, intelligent sensing components, industrial cloud platforms, operating systems, and industrial software, strengthen the development and utilization of industrial big data, effectively support the intelligent transformation of the manufacturing industry, and build an open, shared, and collaborative ecosystem for the intelligent manufacturing industry.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, vigorously develop intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Support enterprises in utilizing the Internet to collect and connect with personalized user demands, promote flexible transformation in key areas such as design research and development, production manufacturing, and supply chain management, and carry out service and business model innovation based on personalized products. Encourage Internet companies to integrate market information, explore segmented market demands and development trends, and provide decision-making support for manufacturing enterprises to carry out personalized customization.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, development of large-scale personalized customization.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage backbone manufacturing enterprises to closely collaborate with various links in the industrial chain through the Internet, promote comprehensive interconnection of production, quality control, and operation management systems, and implement new models such as crowdsourcing design and development and networked manufacturing. Encourage capable Internet companies to build networked collaborative manufacturing public service platforms, provide cloud manufacturing services for segmented industries, promote the aggregation and connection of innovative resources, production capacity, and market demand, enhance the capabilities of serving small and micro enterprises, accelerate the effective collaboration of diversified manufacturing resources in the whole society, and improve the integration capability of industrial chain resources.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, to enhance the level of networked collaborative manufacturing.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage manufacturing enterprises to utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and big data to integrate data throughout the entire product lifecycle, forming decision-making service information for the entire production process, and providing data support for product optimization and upgrades. Encourage enterprises to conduct online value-added services such as fault warning, remote maintenance, quality diagnosis, and remote process optimization based on the Internet, expand the value space of products, and achieve the transformation and upgrading from manufacturing to 'manufacturing + services'.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, accelerating the transformation of manufacturing industry towards service-oriented.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Utilize the internet to enhance the level of agricultural production, operation, management, and services. Cultivate a batch of modern 'agriculture-breeding-processing' ecological agriculture new models that are networked, intelligent, and refined. Form demonstration and driving effects, accelerate the improvement of the new agricultural production and operation system, cultivate diversified agricultural internet management service models, gradually establish a traceability system for the quality and safety of agricultural by-products and agricultural materials, and promote a significant improvement in the level of agricultural modernization. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Agriculture, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Administration for Market Regulation, State Forestry Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Modern Agriculture

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage internet companies to establish agricultural service platforms, support new agricultural production and operation entities such as professional large-scale households, family farms, farmer cooperatives, and leading agricultural industrialization enterprises, strengthen the connection between production and sales, and achieve a shift in agricultural production from production-oriented to consumption-oriented. Improve the level of technological, organizational, and refined management in agricultural production and operation, promote changes in agricultural production circulation and sales methods, and transform the mode of agricultural development, enhancing agricultural production efficiency and value-added space. Standardize the use of rural land transfer public service platforms, improve the transparency of land transfer, and safeguard the rights and interests of farmers.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus modern agriculture, building a new agricultural production and operation system.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote mature and replicable agricultural Internet of Things application models. In areas and regions with a good foundation, popularize networked agricultural environmental monitoring systems based on environmental perception, real-time monitoring, and automatic control. In large-scale agricultural production areas, establish an integrated agricultural Internet of Things measurement and control system, implement precision operations such as intelligent water-saving irrigation, soil testing and formula fertilization, and precision farming with agricultural machinery positioning. In standardized large-scale livestock and poultry farming bases and healthy aquaculture demonstration bases, promote the application and interconnection of intelligent devices such as precise feed delivery, automatic disease diagnosis, and automatic waste recycling.

Support new agricultural production and operation entities in utilizing internet technology to achieve refined and informatized management of production and operation processes, accelerate the promotion and application of mobile internet, internet of things, QR codes, wireless radio frequency identification, and other information technologies in production, processing, and distribution sales, strengthen the connection and information exchange between upstream and downstream traceability systems, continuously expand the coverage of the traceability system, achieve full traceability of agricultural and sideline products from the field to the dining table, and ensure food safety.

Further strengthen the coordination between energy production and consumption, promote the application of energy substitution technologies such as electric vehicles and shore power in ports, promote demand-side management of electricity, and improve energy utilization efficiency. Based on distributed energy networks, develop user-side intelligent energy consumption, energy sharing economy, and energy free trade to promote the construction of an energy consumption ecological system.

Expand the scope of inclusive financial services, and provide effective support for the development of the real economy. Support financial institutions and internet companies in conducting online lending, online securities, online insurance, and internet fund sales in compliance with laws and regulations. Support banking financial institutions in developing consumer credit business with the help of internet technology, and support financial leasing companies in conducting financial leasing business using internet technology.

Strengthen the protection of consumer rights and interests in internet finance and investor protection, and establish a diversified mechanism for resolving financial consumer disputes. Accelerate the commercial deployment of the next-generation Internet, strengthen the management, identification, and resolution of Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) addresses, and build a future network innovation test platform. Research the network architecture system of the industrial Internet and build an open national innovation test and verification platform. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Ensure support, consolidate the foundation for development, and strengthen the network infrastructure.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Adapt to the needs of integrated innovation and development in key industries, improve wireless sensor networks, industry clouds, and new application infrastructure such as big data platforms. Implement cloud computing projects, vigorously enhance public cloud service capabilities, guide the migration of industry informatization applications to cloud computing platforms, accelerate the construction of content delivery networks, and optimize data center layouts. Strengthen research on Internet of Things network architecture, organize and carry out major national demonstrations of IoT applications, and encourage enterprises with the necessary conditions to build cross-industry IoT operation and support platforms. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, consolidate the foundation for development, strengthen the foundation for application.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Focus on breaking through the technical bottlenecks in weak links such as core chips, high-end servers, high-end storage devices, databases, and middleware, and accelerate the research and development and application of cloud operating systems, industrial control real-time operating systems, and intelligent terminal operating systems. Vigorously develop solutions such as cloud computing and big data, as well as high-end sensors, industrial control systems, human-computer interaction, and other hardware and software basic products. Apply the concept of the Internet to build a technology industry cluster with backbone enterprises as the core and efficient integration of industry, academia, research, and application, and create an internationally advanced and independently controllable industrial system. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Ensure support, consolidate the foundation for development, and solidify the industrial base.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Develop a timetable and roadmap for the development of core technical equipment in the field of national information, enhance internet security management, situational awareness, and risk prevention capabilities, strengthen the security protection of information network infrastructure and the protection of user personal information. Implement special national information security projects, carry out demonstrations of network security applications, and improve the level of core technologies and products for Internet Plus security. Strengthen the security protection of key information systems in the Internet Plus key areas in accordance with the requirements of information security level protection systems and national standards for network security. Build and improve the network security monitoring and evaluation, supervision and management, standard certification, and innovation capability system. Pay attention to the security risks brought by integration, improve the security management and technical measures for network data sharing and utilization, explore the establishment of a data security flow certification system based on administrative evaluation and third-party assessment, improve the system for managing the cross-border flow of data, and ensure data security. (Responsibilities include the Cyberspace Administration of China, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of State Security, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, etc.)
titlelist: Ensure support, consolidate the foundation for development, ensure the foundation for safety.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage the establishment of an Internet Plus industry innovation network or industry technology innovation alliance, with enterprises as the main driver and collaboration between industry, academia, research, and application. Support the construction of innovative platforms across different fields, with leading enterprises as the main body, gradually forming an innovation network. Encourage national innovation platforms to open online to enterprises, especially small and medium-sized enterprises, and increase the openness of national major scientific research infrastructure and large-scale scientific research instruments through networking. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen innovation-driven, and enhance innovation capacity building.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: According to the principles of prioritizing commonality and urgent needs, guide the development and promotion of basic common standards and key technical standards in the fields of industrial internet, smart grid, smart cities, etc. Accelerate the standardization work in sub-sectors such as industrial control systems, smart specialized equipment, smart meters, smart homes, and connected vehicles that integrate with the internet. Continuously improve the Internet Plus integration standard system, and simultaneously promote international and domestic standardization work, enhancing the influence in international organizations such as the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), and the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). (Responsibilities include the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Cyberspace Administration, and the National Energy Administration).
titlelist: Ensure support, strengthen innovation-driven development, and accelerate the formulation of integration standards.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage enterprises to independently develop software and support the open sourcing of software achievements formed through national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.) via the internet. Guide educational institutions, social organizations, enterprises, or individuals to initiate open source projects, actively participate in international open source projects, and support the establishment of open source communities and foundations. Encourage enterprises to build new ecosystems based on the internet open source model, promote the integration and cooperation between internet open source communities and institutions such as standards and intellectual property rights (responsibilities of the Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Intellectual Property Office, etc.).
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen innovation-driven, vigorously develop open-source communities.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Accelerate the construction of the social credit system, promote seamless integration of various credit information platforms, and break down information silos. Strengthen the online disclosure and sharing of credit records, risk warnings, and illegal dishonest behaviors, providing credit information inquiry and online identity authentication services for operators. Make full use of credit data accumulated on the Internet to supplement and improve the existing credit system and evaluation system, providing strong support for economic regulation, market supervision, social management, and public services. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, the People's Bank of China, the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and the Cyberspace Administration of China).
titlelist: Ensure support, create a relaxed environment, and improve the credit support system.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage enterprises to go abroad in groups. In conjunction with major national strategies such as the 'Belt and Road Initiative', support and encourage internet companies with competitive advantages to take the lead in going overseas through methods such as overseas mergers and acquisitions, joint operations, and establishment of branch offices in the fields of manufacturing, finance, information communication, etc. By leveraging each other's strengths, jointly explore international markets, promote international capacity cooperation, build cross-border industrial chain systems, and enhance global competitiveness. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Cyberspace Administration of China). Develop global market applications. Encourage 'Internet+' companies to integrate domestic and foreign resources, provide network services such as industrial cloud, supply chain management, big data analysis, etc. to the global market, and cultivate 'Internet+' application platforms with global influence. Encourage internet companies to actively expand overseas users and launch products and services suitable for different market cultures. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration of China).
titlelist: Guarantee support, expand overseas cooperation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Give full play to the role of the government, industry alliances, industry associations, and relevant intermediary organizations to form a joint force to support Internet Plus enterprises in going global. Encourage intermediary organizations to provide information consultation, legal assistance, tax intermediation, and other services for enterprises to expand overseas markets. Support industry associations and industry alliances in jointly promoting Chinese technology and Chinese standards, and use technical standards to drive the promotion and application of products and services overseas. (Responsibilities include the Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, State Taxation Administration, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, expand overseas cooperation, enhance the ability to provide services abroad.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage local governments at all levels to adopt the method of purchasing services to provide internet knowledge and skills training to the society, and support relevant research institutions and experts in conducting basic knowledge and application training for 'Internet Plus.' Encourage traditional enterprises to establish cooperation mechanisms such as information consultation and talent exchange with internet companies to promote in-depth communication and cooperation between the two sides. Strengthen internet skills training for talents, especially senior management personnel in the manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and encourage the two-way flow of internet talents and talents in traditional industries. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Cyberspace Administration of China, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen intellectual construction, enhance application capability training.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: In response to the demand for integrated development of Internet Plus, universities are encouraged to establish relevant majors based on development needs and the school's educational capabilities. Emphasis should be placed on promptly introducing cutting-edge research achievements from both domestic and international sources into relevant professional teaching. All types of schools are encouraged to hire senior talents in the field of the Internet as part-time teachers to strengthen experimental teaching in the Internet Plus field. (Responsibilities include the Ministry of Education, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, and the Cyberspace Administration of China, among others).
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen intellectual capacity building, accelerate the training of composite talents.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Implement comprehensive reform projects for industry-university cooperation, encourage collaboration between schools and enterprises, and promote training for professionals in the Internet Plus field. Deepen the integration of industry and education in the Internet sector, relying on the intellectual resources and research platforms of universities, research institutions, and enterprises to establish a number of joint training bases. Establish mechanisms for connecting enterprise technology centers with colleges and universities, and encourage enterprises to establish Internet Plus research and development institutions and experimental centers in colleges and universities. (Responsibilities include the Ministry of Education, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, and the Cyberspace Administration of China, among others).
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen intellectual capacity building, encourage joint training and development.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Make full use of existing talent introduction plans and encourage companies to establish overseas research and development centers, among other methods, to introduce and cultivate a group of high-end talents in the 'Internet+' field. Improve immigration, visa, and other systems to form a mechanism that is conducive to attracting, motivating, and guaranteeing talents, and provide favorable conditions for attracting overseas talents. Support the full utilization of global Internet talent resources through task outsourcing, industrial cooperation, academic exchanges, and other means. Attract leading talents, special talents, and talents in short supply in the Internet field to start businesses, innovate, and engage in teaching, research, and other activities in our country. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Cyberspace Administration of China, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen intellectual construction, and utilize global intellectual resources.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Give full play to the role of national science and technology programs, actively invest in the research and development of key technologies for Internet Plus integration innovation and application demonstrations that meet the conditions. Coordinate the use of existing special funds to support the construction of Internet Plus related platforms and application demonstrations. Increase the government's procurement of cloud computing services and explore new mechanisms for the construction and operation of government informationization based on cloud computing. Encourage local governments to innovate risk compensation mechanisms and explore new models for the development of Internet Plus (responsibilities of the Ministry of Finance, State Taxation Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Cyberspace Administration, etc.).
titlelist: Ensure support, strengthen guided support, and increase financial and fiscal support.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Actively play the leading role of angel investment, venture capital funds, and other investments in the Internet Plus initiative. Carry out pilot programs for internet finance innovations such as equity crowdfunding, and support the development of small and micro enterprises. Support the investment of funds established by the state in the Internet Plus initiative, and encourage social capital to increase investment in related innovative enterprises. Actively develop services such as intellectual property pledge financing, credit insurance policy financing, and encourage support for the development of Internet Plus through bond financing, and support eligible Internet Plus enterprises to issue corporate bonds. Carry out pilot programs for the integration of industry and finance, and explore financing services that combine equity and debt. Lower the threshold for listing access for innovative and growth-oriented internet companies, and support internet companies in specific growth stages with good development prospects but not yet profitable to list on the Growth Enterprise Market, in conjunction with revisions to the Securities Law and reforms to the stock issuance registration system. Promote the innovation of credit products and financial services by banking and financial institutions, and increase the intensity of loan disbursement. Encourage development financial institutions to provide effective financing support for key projects in the Internet Plus initiative. (Responsibilities of the People's Bank of China, National Development and Reform Commission, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission, China Insurance Regulatory Commission, Cyberspace Administration of China, and China Development Bank, etc.)
titlelist: Ensure support, strengthen guidance and support, improve financing services.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Allow the development of internet hospitals based on medical institutions. Medical institutions can use internet hospitals as a secondary name to provide safe and appropriate medical services using internet technology, in addition to physical hospitals. Online follow-up consultations for common and chronic diseases are allowed. After physicians have access to patients' medical records, they are allowed to issue prescriptions online for common and chronic diseases. Support medical and health institutions, as well as qualified third-party organizations, in building internet information platforms to provide remote medical services, health consultations, and health management services, and promote effective communication between hospitals, medical personnel, and patients. (Responsibility lies with the National Health Commission and the National Development and Reform Commission. The department listed first is the leading department, and the same applies to the following departments).
titlelist: Ensure support and promote the development of Internet Plus medical services, encourage medical institutions to utilize internet and other information technologies to expand the space and content of medical services, and establish an integrated online and offline medical service model that covers pre-diagnosis, during diagnosis, and post-diagnosis.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage higher-level medical institutions within medical consortia to utilize technologies such as artificial intelligence to provide remote consultation, remote electrocardiogram diagnosis, remote imaging diagnosis, and other services to grassroots levels. This will promote real-time access and mutual recognition and sharing of examination and test results among medical institutions within the consortia. Advance the coverage of remote medical services to all medical consortia and county-level hospitals nationwide, gradually extending to community health service institutions, township health centers, and village clinics, in order to enhance the capacity and efficiency of primary healthcare services. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Guarantee support, develop 'Internet+' medical services. Medical consortiums should actively utilize internet technology to accelerate the integration of medical resources, information sharing, and efficient collaboration. Convenient services such as appointment scheduling, two-way referrals, and telemedicine should be carried out to promote 'primary examination, superior diagnosis' and facilitate the establishment of an orderly hierarchical diagnosis and treatment pattern.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Explore the interconnection and real-time sharing of prescription information from medical and health institutions with retail consumption information of drugs, promote the standardized development of online drug sales and medical logistics distribution. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, and National Medical Products Administration).
titlelist: Ensure support, improve the 'Internet+' pharmaceutical supply guarantee service. For common and chronic disease prescriptions issued online, after being reviewed by pharmacists, medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies can entrust qualified third-party organizations to deliver them.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Further improve the direct settlement of hospitalization expenses for migrant workers and the majority of 'double-creation' personnel across provinces. (Responsibility of the National Healthcare Security Administration).
