Enhance the functions of the top 5 nodes and initiate the construction of disaster recovery nodes in Nanjing and Guiyang. Establish more than 20 secondary nodes for identification resolution in vertical industries, increase the registration of identifications by 2 billion, expand the coverage of networked identifications, and further enhance the support capacity of network infrastructure resources.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction of new infrastructure and enhance the improvement of the industrial Internet identification system.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Guide the platform to enhance the support capabilities of new technologies such as 5G, artificial intelligence, blockchain, augmented reality/virtual reality, etc., and strengthen the integration of digital functions throughout the entire process of design, production, operation, and management. Select 10 cross-industry and cross-domain platforms, and develop 50 key industry/regional platforms. Promote an average of 200 industrial protocols supported by key platforms, 800,000 industrial equipment connections, and 2,500 industrial apps.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction of new infrastructure and enhance the core capabilities of the industrial Internet platform.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Accelerate the construction of the national industrial internet big data center, and encourage the construction of industrial internet big data sub-centers in various regions. Establish a cooperative sharing mechanism for industrial internet data resources, initially achieve data collection, aggregation, and application for key regions and industries, and enhance the infrastructure and data resource management capabilities of the industrial internet.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction of new infrastructure and build an industrial internet big data center.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Give full play to the connecting advantages of the industrial internet in terms of all elements, the entire industrial chain, and the entire value chain. Encourage industrial and informationization authorities in various regions and enterprises to utilize the industrial internet to achieve information, technology, production capacity, and order sharing, and to achieve precise allocation and efficient integration of resources across regions and industries. Encourage large enterprises, large platforms, and solution providers to provide industrial app services free of charge to small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Accelerate the expansion of integrated innovation applications, actively utilize the industrial Internet to promote resumption of work and production.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage various regions to combine their advantages in industries, strengthen the integration and innovation of industrial internet in key sectors of the national economy such as equipment, machinery, automobiles, energy, electronics, metallurgy, petrochemicals, and mining. Highlight differentiated development, and form development models with different focuses and characteristics. Guide various regions to summarize practical experience and develop industry application guidelines for vertical segments.
titlelist: Accelerate the expansion of integrated innovation applications, deepen the application of industrial Internet.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Promote enterprises to accelerate the networking and cloud migration of industrial equipment, as well as the cloudification of business systems. Speed up the development and application of various cloud-based software for different scenarios, increase the popularity of digital tools for small and medium-sized enterprises, lower the threshold for digitalization, and accelerate the process of digital transformation.
titlelist: Accelerate the expansion of integrated innovation applications, promote enterprises to go cloud and go platform.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Expand the scope of national platform monitoring, continue to build and improve provincial-level security platforms, upgrade the monitoring system of basic telecommunications enterprises, gather data from key platforms and key enterprises, cover 150 key platforms and over 100,000 industrial Internet enterprises, strengthen comprehensive analysis, and enhance the ability to support government decision-making and ensure enterprise security.
titlelist: Accelerate the establishment of a sound security guarantee system and improve the security technology monitoring system.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Improve the mechanism for reporting, handling, and inspecting enterprise security information. Conduct on-site inspections and remote monitoring of more than 20 typical platforms and industrial enterprises to urge and guide enterprises to enhance their security levels. Carry out testing and analysis of more than 100 industrial apps to enhance their security.
titlelist: Accelerate the establishment of a sound security guarantee system, and improve the security work mechanism.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage enterprises to innovate in the design of secure products and solutions, select 10 or more exemplary products or best practices. Increase support for research and development of cybersecurity products and technical breakthroughs, and strengthen collaborative innovation in the industry. Guide the network security public service platform to provide high-quality and efficient security services for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Accelerate the improvement of the security guarantee system, strengthen the innovation of security technology products.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Speed up the construction progress of ongoing projects and increase the efforts to start new projects. Promote the early acceptance of projects that meet the conditions and select them as pilot demonstration projects in the follow-up. Give priority to those. Reserve a batch of key projects with large investment scale and strong driving capacity. Industrial and information technology authorities in various regions should strengthen supervision and management in collaboration with the Telecommunications Administration, and ensure that the responsible units fulfill their main responsibilities to ensure the high-quality completion of engineering construction.
titlelist: Accelerate the strengthening of innovative development momentum, accelerate the construction of the Industrial Internet innovation and development project.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage relevant units to accelerate technological breakthroughs in time-sensitive networks, edge computing, industrial intelligence, and other fields. Build key hardware and software products such as intelligent sensors, intelligent gateways, protocol converters, industrial mechanism model libraries, and industrial software, and expedite their deployment. Establish a number of public service platforms for industrial Internet technology, and strengthen the incubation and industrialization support for key technological products.
titlelist: Accelerate the growth of innovative development momentum and enhance the supply capacity of key technological products.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage various regions to combine their regional characteristics and industrial advantages, and create a number of demonstration zones with complementary industrial advantages, significant synergistic effects, and strong driving capabilities. Continue to promote the construction of the demonstration zone for the integrated development of the industrial internet in the Yangtze River Delta.
titlelist: Accelerate the improvement of the industrial ecological layout and promote the coordinated development of the industrial Internet in the region.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Guide the industrial Internet industry demonstration base to further focus on its main business, cultivate and introduce leading industrial Internet enterprises, accelerate the improvement of new infrastructure support capabilities and integration innovation leadership capabilities, expand and strengthen the dominant industrial chain, improve the supporting industrial chain, and enhance industrial supply capacity. Encourage the integration of advantageous resources in various regions, gather innovative elements, and cultivate industrial Internet industry clusters with regional advantages.
titlelist: Accelerate the improvement of the industrial ecological layout and enhance the capability of the industrial Internet industry cluster.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Coordinate and promote differentiated industrial internet activities in various regions. Strengthen the industrial internet industry alliance, hold industry summits, and release reports on the economic development of the industrial internet industry. Conduct high-quality industrial internet big data, industrial apps, solution, security, and other related competition activities, and organize national online training courses on industrial internet.
titlelist: Accelerate the improvement of the industrial ecological layout and organize industrial activities at a high level.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage local areas to include industrial Internet companies in the scope of policies supporting epidemic prevention and control and the resumption of work and production. Include applications based on new technologies such as 5G and identification resolution in the scope of policy support for enterprise cloud adoption. Expand the preferential policy for 5G electricity prices to the 5G+industrial Internet field. Encourage local areas to guide social capital in establishing industrial Internet industry funds. Build industrial Internet talent training bases.
titlelist: Enhance policy support and improve the level of factor protection.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Construct an operation monitoring platform for the Industrial Internet and establish an operation monitoring system. Establish an evaluation system for the Industrial Internet, regularly assess the effectiveness of its development, and publish the Industrial Internet Development Index. Units responsible for Industrial Internet innovation and development projects, pilot demonstration projects, and Industrial Internet industry demonstration bases should actively participate in the construction of the monitoring system and evaluation system.
titlelist: Increase policy support and carry out industry monitoring and evaluation.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: The Industrial Internet is the key support for the fourth industrial revolution, and 5G is an important direction for the evolution and upgrade of the new generation of information and communication technology. Both are important driving forces for achieving the digital transformation of the economy and society. The integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet will promote the transformation of the manufacturing industry from single-point, localized information technology applications to digital, networked, and intelligent ones. It will also open up a broader market space for 5G, thereby providing strong support for the construction of a manufacturing and network power. Currently, the enthusiasm of the industrial sector in promoting the integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet is continuously increasing. The coverage of the 5G+ Industrial Internet intranet construction and transformation is becoming increasingly widespread in various industries, and the application scope is continuously extending to the core links of production and manufacturing. The cumulative multiplier effect and huge application potential are constantly being released. However, the integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet are still in the early stages, and the industrial foundation needs to be further consolidated, the path and model need to be further explored, and the development environment needs to be further improved. In order to promote the accelerated implementation of the 5G+ Industrial Internet 512 Project and promote the integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet in high quality, this plan is formulated. First, development goals. By 2022, breakthroughs will be made in a number of key 5G technologies targeting specific needs of the Industrial Internet, and the industrial support capabilities of 5G+ Industrial Internet will be significantly improved. Five industrial public service platforms will be built to construct innovation carriers and public service capabilities. The pilot applications of 5G+ Industrial Internet in vertical fields will be accelerated, and the intranet construction and transformation will cover 10 key industries. A number of benchmark and model projects for the intranet construction and transformation of 5G+ Industrial Internet will be created, forming at least 20 typical industrial application scenarios. An innovative trend of integration and overlapping development of 5G and the Industrial Internet will be cultivated, promoting the digitalization, networking, and intelligent upgrading of the manufacturing industry, and promoting high-quality economic development.
titlelist: Intensify policy support, carry out industry monitoring and evaluation, and promote the '5G+ Industrial Internet' 512 Project Implementation Plan (MIIT Information Management [2019] No. 78) (MIIT Office/November 19, 2019).

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: In line with industrial production environments and existing network systems, efforts are being made to break through emerging technologies such as 5G ultra-reliable and low-latency communication, high-precision indoor positioning, deterministic networking, and high-precision time synchronization. The focus is on overcoming the bottleneck of 5G's capacity to support high real-time, high reliability, and high precision industrial applications in complex industrial scenarios. The role of the National Industrial Internet Standardization Coordination and Promotion Group, the overall group, and the expert advisory group will be leveraged to coordinate the China Communications Standards Association (CCSA) and relevant industry standardization organizations, and to research and formulate a fusion standard system for 5G + Industrial Internet, and improve fusion technology and application standards.
titlelist: Enhance the industrial capability of key technologies in the 5G+ Industrial Internet network, and strengthen the research and development of technical standards in the 5G+ Industrial Internet field.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Accelerate the research and industrialization of industrial-grade 5G chips, modules, gateways, and communication devices such as industrial multi-access edge computing (MEC), promote the integration and innovation of 5G technology with programmable logic controllers (PLC), distributed control systems (DCS), and other industrial control systems, and cultivate the characteristic industry of 5G + Industrial Internet.
titlelist: Enhance the industrial capability of key technologies in the 5G+ Industrial Internet network, accelerate the research and development and industrialization of integrated products in the 5G+ Industrial Internet field.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Based on the Industrial Internet Innovation and Development Project, we will create five Industrial Internet enterprise-based 5G network transformation and promotion service platforms. We will establish a network testing environment that meets the needs of industrial enterprises for 5G network application research and development verification. We will provide small and medium-sized enterprises with a template for the construction and transformation of 5G+ Industrial Internet intranets, as well as application consulting and research and development training, in order to enhance public service capabilities.
titlelist: Enhance the innovation and application capabilities of '5G+ Industrial Internet' and build 5 internal network construction and transformation public service platforms.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Based on the principles of widespread application, deep integration, significant industrial impact, and upstream position in the industrial chain, 10 key industries have been selected to encourage the construction of 5G+ Industrial Internet integration application pilot zones in various regions. The aim is to create 5G+ Industrial Internet park networks and lead the integration and innovation of 5G technology in vertical industries.
titlelist: Enhance the innovation and application capabilities of '5G+ Industrial Internet', select 10 key industries for '5G+ Industrial Internet'.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Relying on the Industrial Internet Innovation and Development Project and the Industrial Internet Pilot Demonstration, we will create a group of benchmark and model projects for the 5G+ Industrial Internet intranet construction and transformation. We encourage industrial enterprises to combine production process optimization with intranet construction and transformation, promote the deployment and application of 5G networks from peripheral production links to internal production links, and explore and refine at least 20 typical industrial application scenarios that are replicable and promotable, forming a demonstration and leading effect for the intranet construction and transformation of 5G+ Industrial Internet.
titlelist: Enhance the innovation and application capabilities of '5G+ Industrial Internet', and explore 20 typical application scenarios of '5G+ Industrial Internet'.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Encourage enterprises, universities, research institutions, and industry alliances to jointly build 5G+ Industrial Internet technology testbeds, and carry out research and development, testing and verification, evaluation and assessment of integrated technologies, standards, equipment, and solutions. For the 10 key industries of 5G+ Industrial Internet, encourage all parties to jointly build industry application testbeds to enhance the innovation capability of 5G applications in vertical fields.
titlelist: Enhance the innovation and application capabilities of '5G+ Industrial Internet', and establish a '5G+ Industrial Internet' testbed.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Establish a reporting mechanism for the 5G+ Industrial Internet project through multiple channels, including local industrial and informatization authorities, telecommunications management bureaus, industrial Internet industry alliances, and basic telecommunications enterprises. Select high-quality projects to be included in the project library, comprehensively grasp the actual construction needs and progress of the 5G+ Industrial Internet in our country, and continuously update the project library.
titlelist: Enhance the resource supply capacity of '5G+ Industrial Internet' and build a project library for '5G+ Industrial Internet'.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Through various means such as the Innovation and Development Project for Industrial Internet, pilot demonstrations of Industrial Internet, and the National Demonstration Base for New Industrialization (Industrial Internet direction), support will be provided to basic telecommunications enterprises, communication equipment enterprises, and industrial enterprises to combine their own advantages and focus on their respective main businesses. This will expand the construction and transformation services of the Industrial Internet intranet, and cultivate a group of solution providers who understand both 5G and industry.
titlelist: Enhance the resource supply capacity of 5G+ Industrial Internet and cultivate 5G+ Industrial Internet solution providers.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Select high-quality service providers of various types for 5G+ Industrial Internet, build a supply resource pool, and make it public to the society. Relying on industrial organizations such as the Industrial Internet Industry Alliance and the 5G Application Industry Matrix, promote practical cooperation between supply and demand sides in the construction and transformation of the internal network of 5G+ Industrial Internet.
titlelist: Enhance the supply capacity of 5G+ Industrial Internet resources and build a supply resource pool for 5G+ Industrial Internet.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Focus on the construction and transformation of the intranet of the industrial Internet, encourage various forms of activities such as 5G+ Industrial Internet themed seminars, experience exchanges, and industry summits, promote and showcase the important value and typical cases of the intranet construction and transformation of 5G+ Industrial Internet, further consolidate consensus among all parties, and create a favorable atmosphere.
titlelist: Strengthen publicity guidance and experience promotion, increase the intensity of publicity guidance.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Implement the Administrative Measures for the Security Protection of Communication Networks (Order No. 11 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology) and the series of standards for the security protection of communication networks, properly handle classification and filing, strictly implement protective measures, regularly conduct compliance evaluations and risk assessments, and promptly eliminate security risks. Strengthen the management of network and information assets, comprehensively review the list of key equipment, clarify the network security responsibility departments and personnel for each network, system, and key equipment. Reasonably divide the security domains of networks and systems, clarify network boundaries, and strengthen boundary protection. Strengthen website security protection and the security management of enterprise offices and maintenance terminals. Improve domain name system security protection measures, optimize system architecture, and enhance bandwidth guarantee. Strengthen public recursive domain name resolution system emergency backup. Strengthen risk assessments before the launch of networks and systems. Strengthen software and hardware version management and patch management, enhance the tracking, verification, risk assessment, and notification of vulnerability information, and promptly take effective remedial measures.
titlelist: Work focus: Deepening network infrastructure and business system security protection.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Thoroughly implement the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology's 'Public Internet Network Security Emergency Plan', and develop and improve the network security emergency plan of our unit. Establish a coordinated mechanism for emergency response to major distributed denial of service attacks, critical domain name system failures, large-scale user information leaks, and other sudden network security incidents. Strengthen emergency plan drills, regularly evaluate and revise emergency plans to ensure their scientific, practical, and operational nature. Enhance the monitoring and early warning capabilities for sudden network security incidents, strengthen the release and handling of early warning information, and promptly report to the competent communication authorities for incidents that may have a global impact. Strictly implement the reporting system for sudden network security incidents. Build a network security emergency command and dispatch system to improve emergency response efficiency. Provide network security support and protection for important information systems in other industries, government websites, and key news websites during major events and special periods, as required by relevant departments.
titlelist: Work focus: Enhancing the emergency response capability for sudden network security incidents.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Implement the Trojan and Botnet Monitoring and Disposal Mechanism and the Mobile Internet Malicious Program Monitoring and Disposal Mechanism issued by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and establish a sound mechanism for monitoring and disposing of phishing websites. Clearly define the responsibility and obligation of users to maintain a secure network environment in the business service contracts signed with them. Strengthen the construction of Trojan virus sample library, mobile malicious program sample library, vulnerability library, malicious website library, etc., and promote the sharing of network security threat information within the industry. Strengthen the in-depth analysis and source governance of the hacker underground industry chain, and actively cooperate with relevant law enforcement departments to combat cybercrime. Basic telecommunications companies should strengthen the promotion of user awareness and skills in network security knowledge and actively expand network security value-added services for users during business promotion and service processing.
titlelist: Work focus: maintaining a secure environment for the public internet network.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Promote the establishment of a national network security review system and implement the requirements for network security review in the telecommunications and internet industries. According to the relevant requirements of the Administrative Measures for Bidding and Tendering of Communication Engineering Construction Projects (Order No. 27 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology), network security needs should be taken into account in the overall planning of key software and hardware procurement bidding, and network security requirements for key software and hardware should be clearly stated in the bidding documents. Strengthen network security testing and evaluation before the procurement of key software and hardware, and clearly define the network security responsibilities and obligations of suppliers through contracts, requiring suppliers to sign a network security commitment letter. Increase the independent research and development efforts of important business application systems and carry out security testing of business application program source code.
titlelist: Work focus, promoting the application of secure and controllable key software and hardware.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Implement the Regulations on the Protection of Personal Information of Telecommunications and Internet Users (Order No. 24 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology) seriously, strictly regulate the collection, storage, use, and destruction of users' personal information, implement security responsibilities in all aspects, improve relevant management systems and technical means. Implement data security and user personal information security protection standards, improve security measures such as preventing theft, tampering, and data backup of network data and user information. Strengthen authorization management and auditing of internal personnel and partners, and increase the punishment for violations. In the event of a large-scale personal information leakage incident, report it immediately to the competent telecommunications authority and take timely and effective remedial measures.
titlelist: Work focus: Strengthening network data and user personal information protection.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Strengthen the security management of mobile app stores and mobile applications, urging app stores to establish a sound system for verifying the real identity information of mobile app developers, conducting app security checks, removing malicious programs, maintaining a blacklist of malicious programs, and supervising user reports. Establish a sound third-party security testing mechanism for mobile applications. Promote the establishment of third-party digital certificate signatures for mobile app developers, as well as signature verification and user prompt mechanisms for app stores and smart terminals. Improve the acceptance of reports on mobile malicious programs and the sharing mechanism of blacklists. Enhance social publicity and guide users to download and install mobile applications from legitimate app stores and install terminal security protection software.
titlelist: Work focus, strengthen mobile app store and application security management.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Strengthen the tracking and research on network security issues related to new technologies and new businesses such as cloud computing, big data, Internet of Things, mobile internet, and next-generation internet. Include the infrastructure and business systems that provide public telecommunications and internet services in the communication network security protection management system. Accelerate the development of relevant network security protection standards and improve and implement corresponding network security protection measures. Actively carry out pilot demonstrations of network security protection technologies for new technologies and new businesses. Strengthen the risk assessment of network security for new businesses and conduct network security protection inspections.
titlelist: Work focus, strengthen network security management for new technologies and new businesses.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Deepen the research on network security monitoring and early warning, vulnerability discovery, malicious code analysis, detection evaluation, and traceability and evidence collection techniques. Strengthen the research on advanced sustainable attack response technologies. Establish and improve network security protection techniques such as intrusion detection and defense, antivirus, anti-denial of service attacks, abnormal traffic monitoring, webpage tampering prevention, domain name security, vulnerability scanning, centralized account management, data encryption, and security auditing. Improve monitoring and disposal methods for network-side Trojan viruses, mobile malicious programs, and other threats. Actively research and utilize new technologies such as cloud computing and big data to enhance network security monitoring and early warning capabilities. Promote the integration of enterprise technologies with those of the telecommunications regulatory authorities, establish interface standards and specifications, and achieve data sharing in monitoring. Strengthen cooperation with network security service companies to prevent risks during the service process. When relying on security service units to carry out network security integration construction and risk assessment, units that have been assessed for their network security service capabilities by relevant industry organizations should be selected. III. Security measures.
titlelist: Work focus: Strengthen the construction of network security technology capabilities and means.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Give full play to the role of industry organizations in supporting the government and serving the industry, and vigorously carry out self-discipline work in the telecommunications and internet industry. Support relevant industry organizations and professional institutions in promoting industry-oriented network security regulations, policies, standards, and knowledge and skills training, competitions, to promote network security management and technical exchanges. Carry out network security service capability assessment to promote and regulate the healthy development of the network security service market. Establish and improve the social supervision and reporting mechanism for network security, mobilize the whole society to participate in maintaining the public internet network security environment. Carry out network security publicity and education activities for the general public, and enhance users' awareness of network security risks and self-protection capabilities.
titlelist: Work priorities, fully leverage the role of industry organizations and professional institutions.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Strengthen the top-level design of standards, build a systematic, coordinated, compatible, and open standard system, effectively guide the standardization of energy internet, and lay the foundation for formulating the standard planning for energy internet and preparing annual revision plans.
titlelist: Work focus: Building a standard system for the energy internet.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Organize the current status of existing standards, analyze the deficiencies in standards, and propose an annual work plan for standards. Coordinate planning, combining with the development process of China's energy internet and the progress of energy market construction, propose the key focus and timetable for energy internet standardization work.
titlelist: Work focus: Complete the roadmap for standardizing the Energy Internet.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Develop basic standards for energy internet terminology, conceptual models, system architecture, and general use cases; in conjunction with the development of related industries, establish standards related to interactive technologies such as active distribution networks, micro energy grids, energy storage, and electric vehicles; formulate standards for information security, demonstration pilot acceptance, and evaluation to support the acceptance and evaluation work of energy internet pilot demonstration projects.
titlelist: Work priorities, accelerate the formulation of standards in key areas.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Strengthen contacts and cooperation with international standardization organizations and international technical organizations in areas such as standard setting and international communication, and play a role in the joint construction of the Belt and Road initiative by utilizing standards. Promote the concept of a global energy internet and enhance China's influence in the international standardization of energy internet.
titlelist: Work priorities: Strengthen cooperation with international organizations and promote the development of a global energy internet.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., March 14, 2022)
content: Formulate policy measures, strengthen macro coordination of energy internet standardization, and conduct research on major issues. Three, guarantee measures.

name: Notice on the Requirements for the Compilation of Lists of Integrated Circuit Enterprises or Projects and Software Enterprises Eligible for Tax Incentives in 2022 (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., No. 390, March 14, 2022)
content: Gateway security mainly includes general security of IoT gateways, gateway communication and interface security, gateway physical environment security, gateway component security, gateway testing and evaluation, etc. (see Figure 4). Figure 4: Gateway security. (1) General security of gateways: standardize the functional architecture, security protocols, security protection, as well as security technical requirements for data transmission, processing, and storage related to IoT gateways. This mainly includes gateway security models, security architecture, security functions, security performance, data security, edge computing security, security protocols, etc. (2) Gateway communication and interface security: standardize the security communication protocols, blacklists, whitelists, authentication, etc. for communication interfaces and management interfaces when gateways are interconnected with other devices. This mainly includes the security procedures for southbound and northbound interfaces of gateways, security protocol processes, port protection, etc. (3) Gateway physical environment security: standardize the technical requirements for electromagnetic radiation, electromagnetic interference prevention, resistance to physical damage, adaptability to temperature, humidity, and salt spray environments under storage, transportation, and usage conditions of gateways. This mainly includes gateway equipment electromagnetic compatibility, mechanical environmental adaptability, climate environmental adaptability, etc. (4) Gateway component security: standardize the security design, security functions, etc. of software and hardware components related to gateway functional services, data collection, data transmission, and processing. This mainly includes gateway equipment component security architecture, open-source component security, application startup security, etc. (5) Gateway testing and evaluation: standardize the testing methods for gateway security evaluation, mainly including device security testing, component security testing, interface security testing, security management and maintenance testing, data transmission and processing security testing, environmental adaptability testing, hierarchical classification evaluation testing, etc.

name: Electronic Information Industry Adjustment and Revitalization Plan (State Council/ April 15, 2009)
content: Significant achievements have been made in promoting growth and ensuring stability. Over the next three years, the sales revenue of the electronic information industry will maintain stable growth, and its contribution to GDP growth will be no less than 0.7 percentage points. Over 1.5 million new jobs will be created, including nearly 1 million for college graduates. Foreign trade exports will be maintained steadily. New electronic information products and related services will become consumer hotspots, and the application of information technology will effectively drive the transformation of traditional industries, further integrating informatization and industrialization. Significant progress has been made in adjusting the structure and seeking transformation. The international competitiveness of key enterprises has significantly increased, and the market influence of independent brands has greatly improved. The proportion of software and information service revenue in the electronic information industry has increased from 12% to 15%. Steady progress is being made in the transformation and upgrading of electronic information processing and trade, encouraging processing and trade enterprises to extend the industrial chain and promote domestic industrial upgrading. A number of internationally influential and distinctive industrial clusters will be formed. The industrial innovation system will be further improved. Breakthroughs have been made in core technologies, and the application innovation in areas such as next-generation mobile communications, next-generation internet, and digital broadcasting and television has driven the formation of new growth points. The transformation of the industrial development model has made significant progress.

name: Electronic Information Industry Adjustment and Revitalization Plan (State Council/ April 15, 2009)
content: Improve the industrial system, maintain stable exports, expand urban and rural markets, increase the level of foreign investment utilization, leverage the advantages of industrial agglomeration, and achieve stable development of key industries such as computers, electronic components, audiovisual products, etc. Enhance the competitiveness of the computer industry. Accelerate the improvement of product research and development and industrial design capabilities, actively develop key products such as laptops, high-end servers, large-capacity storage devices, industrial control computers, etc., and build a computer industry system with design as the core and manufacturing as the foundation, with strong supporting capabilities for key components. Vigorously develop the personal computer consumer market, actively expand the industry application market, promote low-cost computers based on independently designed CPUs and products with independent intellectual property rights such as printers and tax control cash registers. Support backbone enterprises in going global and further expand the global market, especially in emerging and developing countries. Accelerate the upgrading of electronic components. Give full play to the guiding role of whole-machine demand, adjust the component product structure around domestic whole-machine support, improve the research and production capabilities of chip components, new power electronic devices, high-frequency frequency devices, semiconductor lighting, hybrid integrated circuits, new lithium-ion batteries, thin-film solar cells, and new printed circuit boards, and initially form a complete and mutually supportive electronic component industry system. Accelerate the development of pollution-free and environmentally friendly basic components and key materials, improve product performance and reliability, improve the recycling level of electronic components and basic materials, reduce logistics and management costs, further enhance the competitiveness of export products, and maintain international market share. Promote the digital transformation of the audiovisual industry. Support the vertical integration of TV companies with chip design and display module companies, promote the strong alliance of whole-machine companies, increase innovation investment, and improve international competitiveness. Accelerate the integration of 4C (computer, communication, consumer electronics, content), promote the development of digital home products and new consumer electronics products. Promote institutional and mechanism innovation, accelerate the transition from analog TV to digital TV, promote the construction of a digital broadcasting and television network that complements each other with cable, terrestrial, and satellite, enrich digital program resources, promote the broadcast of high-definition programs, promote the popularization of digital TV, drive the upgrading of digital studio equipment, transmission equipment, and satellite receiving equipment, accelerate the digitization of movies, and achieve the overall upgrading of the audiovisual industry chain.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to ensure stable growth of key industries such as computers, electronic components, audiovisual products, etc.

name: Electronic Information Industry Adjustment and Revitalization Plan (State Council/ April 15, 2009)
content: Seize the opportunity of accelerating the adjustment of the global industrial competition pattern, rely on independent innovation, strengthen international cooperation, coordinate various elements such as resources, environmental protection, market, technology, and talent, reasonably layout major project construction, achieve breakthroughs in key technologies of core industries such as integrated circuits, new display devices, and software. Improve the integrated circuit industry system. Support backbone manufacturing enterprises in integrating advantageous resources, increasing innovation input, and promoting process upgrading. Continue to guide and support international chip manufacturing companies to increase investment in China, establish production bases and research and development centers. Improve the integrated circuit design support service system and promote industrial agglomeration. Guide chip design companies to strengthen cooperation with whole machine manufacturing companies, rely on whole machine upgrading to expand domestic effective demand. Support mergers and reorganizations among design companies and cultivate large enterprises with international competitiveness. Support the combination of major integrated circuit projects and major scientific and technological special projects, promote the design, development, and industrialization of high-end general-purpose chips, realize the industrial application of some special equipment, and form a relatively advanced and complete integrated circuit industry chain. Break through the development bottleneck of the new display industry. Coordinate planning, reasonable layout, focus on panel production, and improve the new display industry system. The state arranges guided funds and combines them with corporate capital market financing to broaden financing channels and enhance enterprise innovation and development capabilities. Industrialization of mature technologies and research and development of forward-looking technologies should be carried out simultaneously to gradually grasp the initiative in the development of the display industry. Make full use of global industrial resources, focus on strengthening industrial cooperation between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait, and strive to achieve key technological breakthroughs in the fields of new display panel production, integrated design of whole machine modules, and glass substrate manufacturing. Improve the independent development capability of the software industry. Relying on national major scientific and technological special projects, focus on improving the independent innovation capability of domestic basic software. Support important application software such as Chinese language processing software (including minority language software), information security software, and industrial software, as well as embedded software technology and product research and development, to achieve independent controllability of key software in key areas and promote the interactive development of basic software and CPUs. Strengthen the promotion and application of domestic software and industry solutions, and promote the integration and development of the software industry and traditional industries. Encourage large backbone enterprises to integrate advantageous resources, enhance enterprise strength and international competitiveness. Guide small and medium-sized software enterprises to gather in industrial bases and develop jointly, and improve the level of international cooperation in the software industry.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to break through the key technologies of core industries such as integrated circuits, new display devices, software, etc.

name: Electronic Information Industry Adjustment and Revitalization Plan (State Council/ April 15, 2009)
content: Accelerate the construction of information infrastructure, vigorously promote business innovation and service model innovation, strengthen the application of information technology in the economic and social fields, actively use information technology to transform traditional industries, and drive growth through new applications. Accelerate the development of the communication equipment manufacturing industry. Seize the opportunity of building a new generation of networks, strengthen the interaction between equipment manufacturing companies and telecommunications operators, promote the integration and innovation of products and services, and promote the development of the communication equipment manufacturing industry through large-scale applications. Accelerate the construction of third-generation mobile communication networks, next-generation Internet, and broadband fiber access networks, develop new businesses and applications that meet the characteristics of the new generation of mobile communication networks and the needs of the mobile Internet, and drive the upgrading and replacement of systems and terminal products. Support the development of emerging service industries such as IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) and mobile TV. Establish a new system in which content, terminals, transmission, and operation enterprises promote each other and achieve win-win development. Accelerate the cultivation of new models and formats for information services. Grasp the trend of software service-oriented, promote innovation in information service business and models, comprehensively utilize public information resources, and further develop information service businesses that meet the needs of China's economic and social development. Actively undertake global offshore service outsourcing business, guide public service departments and enterprises to outsource non-core businesses such as data processing and information technology operation and maintenance, and establish a service outsourcing system based on information technology and networks. Improve the support service capabilities of the information service industry, initially form a public service system that is functionally perfect, reasonably laid out, structurally optimized, and meets the requirements of the international development of the industry. Strengthen the integration and application of information technology. Take key links such as research and development design, process control, enterprise management, and marketing as breakthrough points, promote the integration of information technology and traditional industries, and improve the level of industrial automation, intelligence, and management modernization. Accelerate the development and promotion of industry solutions, organize and carry out industry application pilot demonstration projects, support the development and standardization of products and systems such as RFID (radio frequency identification), automotive electronics, machine tool electronics, medical electronics, industrial control, and testing. Support multi-level cooperation between information technology companies and traditional industrial enterprises, and further promote the integration of informatization and industrialization. Combined with the implementation of national projects to improve people's livelihood, strengthen the application of information technology in education, healthcare, social security, transportation, and other fields. Improve the level of information technology services for agriculture, rural areas, and farmers, accelerate the promotion of agricultural and rural informatization, and develop and expand the agricultural electronic products and information service industry.
titlelist: The main tasks of industrial adjustment and revitalization are to cultivate new growth points in the fields of communication equipment, information services, and information technology applications.

Support the development of the domestic photovoltaic power generation market and the promotion of LED energy-saving lighting products. Establish a coordinated mechanism for major projects supported by national funds to drive the development of electronic information products and related services, and guide domestic enterprises to support each other.

titlelist: The main direction is to lead innovation-driven development and cultivate new driving forces for growth.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year National Informatization Plan (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Drive the continuous transformation of old and new driving forces. Use informatization to enhance traditional driving forces, promote capacity reduction, inventory reduction, deleveraging, cost reduction, and fill in the gaps, improve the quality and efficiency of the supply system. Use informatization to cultivate new driving forces, accelerate various types of innovation based on the Internet, build a new system for modern industries, and promote new development with new driving forces. Establish a fair, transparent, open, trustworthy, and inclusive digital market system, promote the coordinated development of emerging industries and traditional industries, and promote the overall improvement of social productivity. Support regional coordinated development. Relying on regional advantages, strengthen the interconnection of information infrastructure and the sharing of information resources between regions, promote the orderly flow of factors across regions, departments, and industries, optimize the allocation of resources, and promote coordinated environmental governance, optimize the layout of regional productivity, and promote regional coordinated development. Based on the overall strategy of developing the western region, revitalizing the northeast, rising in the central region, and leading in the eastern region, as well as major national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, and development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, implement integrated development of regional informatization, and improve regional coordinated governance and service levels. Promote the coverage of basic public services in urban and rural areas. Utilize the radiation and driving effect of informatization to improve the coverage and equalization level of basic public services through remote and networked means. Focus on education, culture, medical and health care, social security, housing security, and other areas of people's livelihood, build a three-dimensional, all-round, and wide-ranging information service system, expand the supply of public services and products, innovate service methods and means, and provide equal, efficient, and high-quality public services for urban and rural residents.
titlelist: The main direction is to promote balance and coordination, optimize the development of a new pattern.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Develop green production models. Accelerate the deep integration of informatization and ecological civilization construction, utilize new generation information technology to promote industrial linkages, clean production processes, efficient resource utilization, clean energy consumption, and networked waste recycling. Promote smart manufacturing, green manufacturing, energy internet, intelligent logistics, etc., develop a circular economy, and promote the high-end, intelligent, and green development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries. Actively promote the application of new energy-saving and emission reduction technologies in the information and communication industry, accelerate the green and energy-saving transformation of high-energy information carriers such as data centers and base stations. Promote green lifestyles. Use informatization to promote resource conservation, intensification, and recycling, strengthen the integration and application of informatization and greening in urban management, public services, and residents' lives, advocate sustainable development concepts, develop the sharing economy, and promote green consumption. Accelerate the popularization of online shopping, online education, telemedicine, intelligent transportation, digital homes, and information services for national fitness, strengthen information consumption, advocate green, low-carbon, civilized, and healthy lifestyles, and promote harmonious coexistence between humans and nature. Innovate ecological environmental governance models. Focus on solving prominent problems in the ecological environment field, deepen the application of information technology in comprehensive ecological environment governance, promote cross-basin and cross-regional joint prevention and control, achieve intelligent supervision, timely warning, and rapid response, and enhance the ability to respond to sudden ecological environmental incidents. Promote comprehensive environmental information disclosure, support the establishment of a collaborative governance system for ecological environment involving government, enterprises, and the public.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text '主攻方向,支撑绿色低碳，构建发展新模式' to English is:Main direction, supporting green and low-carbon, building a new development model.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Promote two-way opening and cooperation. Harness the role of the internet in facilitating the orderly flow of international and domestic factors, efficient allocation of resources, and deep integration of markets. Establish an information service system for the global development of enterprises, providing information services on global policies, regulations, taxation, finance, investment and financing, risk assessment, etc., to support the global development of enterprises. Expand the scope of internet openness in an orderly manner, effectively introduce foreign capital and advanced technology, and strengthen mutual benefit and win-win cooperation. Serve the construction of the Belt and Road initiative. Adhere to the principles of consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, promote internet interconnection and information exchange, advance the construction of the Digital Silk Road, promote cooperation in the digital economy, information technology, etc., and facilitate policy communication, infrastructure connectivity, trade facilitation, financial integration, and people-to-people connectivity among countries and regions along the route. Support the construction of network infrastructure and the development of the information economy in Hong Kong and Macau, and leverage the important role of Hong Kong and Macau in promoting the Belt and Road initiative. Promote the reform of the global internet governance system. Uphold the principles of respecting cyber sovereignty, maintaining peace and security, promoting open cooperation, and building a sound order. Actively participate in the construction of global internet infrastructure, create an online platform for cultural exchange and sharing, promote innovative development of the digital economy, ensure cybersecurity, and promote the establishment of a multilateral, democratic, and transparent global internet governance system. Take the initiative to propose the Chinese solution and accelerate the joint formulation of international information standards and rules.
titlelist: The main direction is to deepen opening up and cooperation, and expand new development space.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Focus on enhancing the national informationization development capability, with the information infrastructure system as the support, the information technology industry ecosystem as the driving force, and the data resource system as the core. Focus on improving the application level of informationization in key areas such as driving economic transformation and upgrading, promoting the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity, and promoting information accessibility for the people. Focus on optimizing the development environment for supporting the globalization of Internet companies, cyberspace governance, and network security, and accelerate the significant improvement of China's informationization level and security support capability.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Build an independent and advanced technological system. Develop the implementation outline for the construction of a cyber superpower, and use systematic thinking to construct a new generation of network technology system, cloud computing system, security technology system, and high-end manufacturing equipment technology system. Collaborate on key software and hardware devices such as high-end chips, core components, optical communication devices, operating systems, database systems, key network equipment, high-end servers, and security protection products, to build a cyber superpower that is strategically clear, technologically advanced, industry-leading, and secure and reliable. Coordinate the development of network security and informatization in the fields of economy, politics, culture, society, and ecological civilization, and enhance independent innovation capabilities. Strengthen the strategic layout of frontier technologies. Based on the national conditions and facing the world's technological frontier, major national needs, and the main areas of the national economy, adhere to strategic, frontier, and security orientations, focus on breakthroughs in basic technology, general technology, and asymmetric technology, and proactively deploy frontier and disruptive technologies. Accelerate the development and deployment of new technologies such as quantum communication, future networks, brain-like computing, artificial intelligence, holographic displays, virtual reality, cognitive analysis of big data, new non-volatile storage, unmanned driving vehicles, blockchain, and gene editing, and establish a leading advantage in the new competitive field. Accelerate the construction of emerging intelligent terminal industrial systems and policy environments, such as intelligent wearable devices, advanced robots, and smart cars. Encourage enterprises to carry out fundamental and cutting-edge innovation research. Column 1: Core technology surpassing project. Develop the implementation outline for the construction of a cyber superpower. List the detailed inventory and plan for the development of core technologies, implement a number of major projects, accelerate the transformation of scientific and technological innovation achievements into real productivity, and form a systematic layout in a step-by-step manner. Overcome key core technologies in high-end general chips, integrated circuit equipment, basic software, broadband mobile communication, etc., and develop several strategic leading technologies and products. Promote breakthroughs in integrated circuit innovation. Increase investment in chip design and research and development for new computing, 5G, intelligent manufacturing, industrial internet, and the Internet of Things, promote the construction of 32/28nm, 16/14nm production lines, accelerate the research and development of 10/7nm process technology, vigorously develop chip-level packaging, wafer-level packaging, silicon through-hole, and 3D packaging research and industrialization processes, and break through electronic design automation (EDA) software. Enhance the core competitiveness of cloud computing and network equipment. Focus on breakthroughs in high-end processors, storage chips, I/O chips, and key technologies such as computing resource virtualization, software-defined networks, and ultra-high-speed remote intelligent optical transmission. Promote the development and industrialization of high-end servers, intelligent terminal devices, storage devices, network and communication equipment, industrial control equipment, and security protection equipment. Improve the level of independent research and development of basic software and key application software. Promote the research and development of cloud operating systems, intelligent terminal operating systems, embedded operating systems, and related application software. Develop industrial control operating systems and industry application software covering the entire life cycle for key industrial sectors. Promote innovation and development of intelligent hardware, new sensors, etc. Improve the level of intelligent hardware technology in fields such as wearable devices, smart homes, and smart vehicles. Accelerate the research and application of high-precision, low-power, and high-reliability sensors. Establish a reporting system for major projects and key technology introductions in the field of national information. Coordinate the management of major projects in the field of informatization, major scientific and technological research, and major technology introductions. Promote collaborative innovation in the industry. Coordinate and promote the coordinated development of basic research, technological innovation, industrial development, market application, standard formulation, and network security, strengthen the integration and coordination of innovation chains, industrial chains, and value chains, and establish channels for the application and transformation of technological innovation achievements. Guide and support the deep integration of industry, academia, research, and application, promote leading enterprises and research institutions to establish open-source technology research and development teams, support the development of technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises, and build collaborative innovation clusters for industry, academia, research, and application. Accelerate the formulation of standards and patent layouts related to new generation information technology. Explore and improve capital collaboration mechanisms, establish investment companies for core technology research and development, leverage the advantages of leading enterprises to drive the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance the synergistic interaction between upstream technology research and development and downstream promotion and application. Deepen the deployment of secure and reliable applications, accelerate the construction of an open and independent industrial ecosystem, cultivate a group of leading enterprises, and consolidate the industrial foundation. Column 2: Innovation project for the information industry system. Build an advanced, secure, and controllable core technology and product system. Enhance systematic innovation capabilities in the three major areas of cloud computing and big data, next-generation information networks, and intelligent terminals and hardware. Improve the ecological environment for developing core technologies. Enhance the compatibility between underlying chips, core components, basic software, and application software, comprehensively layout the intellectual property rights of core technologies, and leverage the positive role of the capital market in the technology industry. Innovate incentive mechanisms for breakthroughs in core technologies. Explore market-oriented mechanisms for tackling key core technologies. Strengthen coordination between industry, academia, research, and application, coordinate the use of national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.) and major scientific infrastructure in the information field, support key core technology research and development and major technology experimentation and verification as required, and strengthen the supply of key common technology research and development. Support the innovation and development of open-source communities. Encourage Chinese enterprises to actively participate in international open-source organizations for major core technologies, evolve from participants to important contributors, strive to be initiators in advantageous technology areas, and actively safeguard the rights and interests of relevant standards and patents in international open-source organizations. Cultivate enterprises for core technology innovation. Cultivate a group of innovative enterprises with outstanding core technology capabilities, strong integrated innovation capabilities, and leading roles in the development of important industries, and strive to have a group of enterprises enter the Global 500.
titlelist: Major tasks and key projects, building a modern information technology and industrial ecosystem.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Promote the deep integration of informatization and industrialization. Deepen the integration and development of manufacturing industry and the internet, accelerate the construction of new manufacturing industry foundations such as automatic control and sensing technology, industrial software and hardware, industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms, and industrial internet. Establish and improve the standard system for intelligent manufacturing, enhance the basic technology and industrial support capabilities for manufacturing industry automation, digitization, and intelligence. Organize the implementation of the Chip Fire plan and the sensor industry promotion project, accelerate the research and development and industrialization of sensors, process control chips, programmable logic controllers, etc. Accelerate the research and development and industrialization of industrial software such as computer-aided design simulation, manufacturing execution systems, and product lifecycle management, strengthen the foundational role of software in supporting the manufacturing industry. Support the compatibility, interoperability, and interoperability testing and verification of key technologies, networks, platforms, and application environments, promote the integration and application of industrial software and hardware with industrial big data platforms, industrial networks, industrial information security systems, and intelligent equipment. Actively promote the double innovation of manufacturing enterprises, as well as the construction and innovation of industrial cloud, industrial big data, and industrial e-commerce service platforms, comprehensively enhance the industry's system solution capabilities. Promote the research and development and application of industrial internet, formulate the overall architecture plan for industrial internet, organize the construction of key resource management platforms and core technology experimental verification platforms for industrial internet, and accelerate the formation of a healthy development ecosystem for industrial internet. Organize the implementation of enterprise management capability improvement projects, accelerate the formulation and application promotion of standards for the integration management system of informatization and industrialization. Column 7: Development, application, and promotion of the integration of manufacturing industry and the internet. Cultivate a batch of double innovation platforms for manufacturing enterprises. Organize pilot demonstrations of the integration and development of manufacturing industry and the internet, promote the integrated application of technologies such as industrial cloud, industrial big data, and industrial e-commerce, cultivate new models such as crowdsourcing research and development, collaborative manufacturing, lean management, and remote services, develop sharing economy in the manufacturing process, and promote precise matching of supply and demand. Enhance double innovation service capabilities. Cultivate a batch of double innovation demonstration bases that support the development of the manufacturing industry.
