Support large internet companies and basic telecommunications companies in building double innovation service platforms for small and medium-sized manufacturing enterprises, encourage large manufacturing enterprises to open various resources gathered on double innovation platforms, and develop online services such as professional consulting, talent training, inspection and testing, and investment and financing. Enhance enterprise management capabilities. Strengthen the formulation and application promotion of standards for the integration management system of informatization and industrialization, promote business process reengineering and organizational transformation. Relying on the China Integration of Informatization and Industrialization Service Platform, carry out comprehensive self-assessment, self-diagnosis, and self-benchmarking of enterprises, and establish a national integration of informatization and industrialization development data map. Strengthen core technology research and development and industrialization. Promote the implementation of national key research and development programs, accelerate the construction of new infrastructure and platform facilities such as automatic control and sensing technology, core industrial software and hardware, industrial internet, and industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms. Support the construction of information-physical system monitoring and verification platforms, and build reference models and comprehensive technical standard systems. Organize pilot demonstrations of industry system solution applications and cultivate a group of system solution providers. Improve the level of industrial information system security. Carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial enterprise information security guarantee, support the construction of key common technology platforms such as system simulation testing and evaluation, promote the industrialization of core technologies such as access control, traceability, business information and privacy protection. Establish a national industrial information security guarantee center to enhance the monitoring, evaluation, verification, and emergency response capabilities of industrial information security. Promote agricultural informatization. Implement the Internet Plus Modern Agriculture action plan, focus on building modern agricultural industrial systems, production systems, and operation systems. Promote the integration of information technology with agricultural production management, operation management, market circulation, and resource environment. Promote the online and data-based development of industries and fields such as planting, animal husbandry, veterinary medicine, fisheries, seeds, agricultural machinery, agricultural reclamation, agricultural product processing, animal and plant inspection and quarantine, rural collective asset management, agricultural resource and environmental protection, rural sewage, rural energy, as well as water conservancy facilities, water resources, water-saving irrigation, and drinking water security. Accelerate the improvement of agricultural informatization, comprehensively strengthen rural informatization capacity building, and establish a spatial and intelligent new rural statistical information comprehensive service system. Focus on the development of precision agriculture and smart agriculture, improve the level of agricultural production intelligence, networked management, data-based management, and online services, promote agricultural transformation and upgrading, and ensure sustainable income growth for farmers, providing strong innovative power for accelerating agricultural modernization. Column 8: Agricultural and rural informatization project. Develop smart agriculture. Promote the application of technologies such as intelligent sensors, satellite navigation, remote sensing, and spatial geographic information, enhance the accurate monitoring capabilities of agricultural production environments. Organize the implementation of regional trials for agricultural internet of things, carry out pilot applications of internet of things technologies in areas such as field crop cultivation, facility agriculture, and large-scale livestock and aquaculture. Promote precision agricultural operations demonstration and the application of Beidou navigation technology in agricultural production. Develop agricultural and rural e-commerce. Promote the application and promotion of internet technologies in various aspects of agricultural production, processing, and circulation, promote the construction of modern rural market systems, and cultivate diversified rural e-commerce market entities. In conjunction with the construction of modern agricultural circulation systems, carry out pilot demonstrations of agricultural e-commerce and support the application of agricultural e-commerce platforms. Promote the application of agricultural and rural big data. Integrate and build national agricultural big data centers and national agricultural clouds. Build a public service platform for agriculture going global, carry out global agricultural data survey and analysis system construction, and establish an agricultural industry chain information monitoring and analysis early warning system. Establish a national platform for quality and safety supervision and traceability management of agricultural products, continuously expand the coverage of information-based supervision and traceability. Establish a platform for rural collective asset supervision, promote the institutionalization, standardization, and informatization of rural collective asset financial management, comprehensively enhance the informatization capacity and level of agricultural government affairs information. Enhance the comprehensive service capabilities of agricultural information. Vigorously promote information access to rural areas, expand the 12316 comprehensive information services for agriculture, rural areas, and farmers. Promote the informatization construction of rural communities, provide training for farmers on mobile application skills, enhance farmers' information application capabilities, promote equal access to information services between urban and rural areas, and narrow the digital divide. Establish a water conservancy big data analysis and application service project, enhance the support and guarantee service capabilities of water conservancy facilities and water resources for agricultural production and rural development. Carry out the construction of agricultural information economy demonstration zones and improve the modern agricultural information service system. Enhance the support capabilities for the development of agricultural informatization. Promote the intelligent construction of agricultural information infrastructure guided by application. Promote the leapfrog development of agricultural informatization technology and innovation capabilities, build an agricultural information technology innovation system that combines government, industry, academia, research, and application, effectively support the development of the agricultural information industry. Develop e-commerce. Regulate the competition in the e-commerce market in all aspects, accelerate the innovation of e-commerce models and market service methods, and promote the improvement of technological levels. Support the development of new e-commerce models such as mobile e-commerce, community e-commerce, rural e-commerce, and cross-border e-commerce, promote the upgrading of e-commerce quality. Promote the integration of e-commerce with traditional industries through the Internet Plus Circulation initiative, strengthen the construction of intelligent circulation infrastructure, explore various online and offline integration development modes such as networked customization, omni-channel marketing, and service to households, promote the integration of e-commerce with traditional industries. Improve the supporting service industry chain for e-commerce, vigorously develop e-commerce talents, information service industry, technology service industry, and logistics service industry, encourage the development of vertical, professional, and industry-specific e-commerce, further improve the e-commerce support system, strengthen the construction of e-commerce public service system, and expand the application of e-commerce in fields such as medical care, health, elderly care, and household services. Cultivate and develop emerging industries. Promote the Internet Plus initiative, promote the deep and extensive application of the internet, drive changes in production and organizational models, and form a networked, intelligent, service-oriented, and collaborative industrial development pattern. Vigorously develop internet-based crowdsourcing, crowdfunding, and crowd support, promote industrial organization, business model, and supply chain innovation. Promote the extension of productive service industries to specialization and high-end of the value chain, promote the transformation of lifestyle service industries to refinement and high quality. Encourage enterprises to use the internet to promote the development of service-oriented manufacturing, carry out services such as personalized customization, on-demand design, and crowdsourced design, innovate in production, manufacturing, and sales processes, and provide online services such as networked collaborative manufacturing and full lifecycle management. Develop a sharing economy characterized by openness, convenience, savings, and greenness. Promote the integrated development of new generation information technologies such as broadband networks, mobile internet, internet of things, cloud computing, big data, and convergence of the three networks, promote information consumption. Actively regulate and develop internet finance, promote the healthy development of financial information services. Gradually improve the public service system for digital copyright, promote the healthy development of the digital content industry. Promote the integration and application of the internet in various fields of tourism, cultivate innovative formats such as smart tourism and smart leisure. Column 9: Information economy innovation and development project. Establish information economy demonstration zones. Deepen the integration of information technology in modern agriculture, advanced manufacturing, innovation and entrepreneurship, finance, etc. Relying on existing new technology industrial parks and innovation parks, focus on cloud computing, big data, internet of things, machine learning, and other new generation information technology innovations, explore the establishment of a group of national-level information economy demonstration zones with strong demonstration effects and good driving benefits. Develop the sharing economy. Support the development of shared services in areas such as online car-hailing, home-sharing accommodations, short-term office space rentals, and online knowledge and skills mutual assistance. Explore the establishment of an online credit platform for the sharing economy. Develop e-commerce. Support the construction of common e-commerce infrastructure, accelerate the establishment of e-commerce integrity system, promote innovation and integrated application of e-commerce in key areas, promote the application of e-commerce in agriculture, industry, service industry, etc., vigorously cultivate e-commerce service industry. Promote the implementation of comprehensive customs clearance acceleration projects for e-commerce and the construction of international e-commerce channels. Promote the construction of cross-border e-commerce comprehensive pilot zones such as Hangzhou, and steadily expand the scope of comprehensive pilot zones. Promote entrepreneurship and innovation. Improve the network of public service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises, encourage industry-leading enterprises, universities, research institutes, etc., to provide specialized innovation and entrepreneurship services to the whole society through internet platforms, and assist the growth of small, medium, and micro enterprises and entrepreneurs. Support the development of various industrial innovation and business cooperation platforms, carry out market-oriented, specialized, integrated, and networked pilot construction of crowdsourcing space bases, strengthen the incubation and cultivation of innovative entrepreneurship projects and the ability to connect with industries. Promote smart logistics. Promote the construction of public information platforms such as electronic ports, road transportation of dangerous goods supervision platforms, and postal industry supervision information platforms. Establish cross-regional and cross-industry logistics information platforms, form an open, transparent, and shared supply chain collaboration model. Build intelligent public distribution centers and transfer distribution stations, strengthen the standardized management of logistics vehicles, and jointly build and share community pickup points and service points. Promote quality and brand building. Implement quality improvement actions, use informatization to promote quality governance, promote the construction of national quality basic capabilities, ensure national consumer quality and safety, national biosecurity, and special equipment safety. Establish a national macro quality safety monitoring and evaluation system, national quality information public service system, and national quality safety monitoring, analysis, and early warning mechanism, improve the informatization level of national quality public service.
titlelist: Major tasks and key projects, building an integrated and innovative information-based economic system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Expand the channels for people's livelihood services. Deeply implement the Information Benefits People project and accelerate the construction of national pilot cities for information benefits people. Fully carry out Internet Plus Government Services and vigorously promote one application, one window acceptance, and one-stop online processing of government services. Construct a convenient, efficient, fair, and inclusive government service information system, simplify the process of handling matters for the masses, and reduce the need for the masses to run errands while information is shared. Fully promote government transparency, strengthen government-citizen interaction and communication, establish an internet platform for government communication with the masses, and enable government departments at all levels to understand and be close to the masses through the internet, addressing their concerns and difficulties. Establish new channels for promoting people's democracy and accepting people's supervision based on the internet, and promote the one-stop online processing of government public services and the supervision of the entire administrative process. Innovate the supply model of people's livelihood services. Utilize information technology to continuously expand the coverage of high-quality educational resources, build a networked, digitized, personalized, and lifelong education system, and construct a learning society. Deeply promote the social security one card project, coordinate the comprehensive coverage of social security and social assistance systems in urban and rural areas, realize direct settlement of basic medical insurance for medical treatment in different places, and transfer and continue social insurance relationships online. Promote new models of online medical and health services. Promote the nationwide networking of information on employment, pension, education, vocational training, skill evaluation, work-related injury, childbirth, legal services, and other areas, and build an information service system that integrates online and offline services. Actively promote the development of online public welfare undertakings. Promote the interconnection of transportation smart cards, achieve interconnection across regions and transportation modes, and apply transportation smart cards in areas such as taxis, long-distance passenger transportation, intercity rail, water passenger transportation, public bicycles, and parking lots to facilitate residents' travel. Column 10: Information Benefits People project. Fully carry out Internet Plus Government Services. Vigorously promote one application, one window acceptance, and one-stop online processing of government services, construct an integrated online and offline government service system, simplify and optimize the process of handling matters for the masses, enhance the proactivity, accuracy, and convenience of government administrative efficiency, and improve the satisfaction of the masses in handling matters. Fully enhance the equal and inclusive level of people's livelihood services. Focus on the current issues of medical care, education, social security, employment, and elderly care services that are widely concerned by the masses and urgently need to be addressed, further promote inter-departmental and inter-level information sharing, promote multi-party collaboration, resource sharing, policy coordination, and institutional innovation in public services, accelerate the construction of a people-oriented public service system that covers all people, operates 24/7, and is fair and inclusive, enhance the effective supply capacity of people's livelihood services, and improve the level of convenience and benefits brought by information. Fully promote government transparency. Improve the information supervision capacity of the exercise of power, promote the construction of a rule of law government, an innovative government, an honest government, and a service-oriented government. Relying on the China Credit website, comprehensively promote the online publication of administrative licenses and administrative penalties within 7 working days from the date of making administrative decisions. Support governments at all levels to effectively utilize government websites, social media, mobile internet, and other new means to build a matrix of new media for government affairs. Attach importance to expressing public opinion on the internet, unblock channels for democratic supervision and political participation, and provide real-time online interactive government services in the fields of medical care, health, elderly care, education, and social security.
titlelist: Significant tasks and key projects, forming an inclusive and convenient information benefit system for the people.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Establish an open and win-win international cooperation system. Establish a global information cooperation service platform, actively promote the international expansion of Internet companies, accelerate the construction of China-ASEAN Information Port, China-Arab countries and other online Silk Road. Establish an alliance for Internet companies to go global, guide alliance members to cooperate in financing, intelligence integration, technological innovation, and expand international information exchange and cooperation channels. Strengthen the construction of mainstream media websites and new media international communication capabilities, accurately explain the concept of Belt and Road consultation, construction, and win-win, and create a good international public opinion atmosphere. Column 12 Information International Hub Project. Build China-ASEAN Information Port. With Guangxi as the pivot, accelerate the establishment of an international communication network system and information hub facing ASEAN and serving Southwest and Central South China, and jointly build infrastructure platforms, technology cooperation platforms, trade and economic service platforms, information sharing platforms, and cultural exchange platforms with ASEAN countries. Build the China-Arab countries online Silk Road Ningxia Hub Project. With Ningxia as the pivot, construct a China-Arab international network corridor, accelerate the pace of regional network infrastructure and communication cable construction, optimize the allocation of network basic resources, promote the popularization of 4G, public WiFi, and carry out cross-border e-commerce cooperation. Establish a database for companies going global. Dynamically collect and update information on the level of information development, political environment, degree of economic openness, bilateral relations, and local tax systems of countries and regions along the Belt and Road to serve companies going global. Provide support for a batch of cooperative projects. Establish a batch of information cooperation project libraries to support Internet companies actively participating in the construction of information infrastructure, major information systems, and data centers in countries and regions along the Belt and Road. In order to promote the construction of the Belt and Road, formulate an action plan for the construction of overseas R&D bases in the field of Internet information, clarify the overall layout, construction rules, and promotion plans, and give priority to the construction of a batch of overseas R&D bases, fully exerting their demonstration effect and driving role. Encourage and support Internet companies to go global. Increase policy support for Internet companies going global, actively build investment and financial information service platforms, and construct an information service system. Formulate supportive policies to encourage and guide cross-border mergers and acquisitions, guide Internet companies to go global through various means such as trade, greenfield investment, and overseas mergers and acquisitions, and enhance their ability to obtain global resources through multilateral and bilateral investment and trade agreements and fiscal guarantee measures. Support companies in expanding their overseas business layout, establish overseas institutions and business outlets, encourage companies to establish overseas R&D centers in countries and regions with intensive technological resources, and accelerate integration into the international innovation system. Promote regional digital economic cooperation, jointly build industrial parks, combine the global needs of Internet companies and comprehensively consider the overall layout of international scientific and technological cooperation, and build a number of high-level overseas large scientific research bases. Implement the Internet information assistance plan to help developing countries build information technology industrial parks and network space laboratories, and realize the combination of technology research and development cooperation, technology transfer demonstration, and technology training. Give full play to the enthusiasm of backbone enterprises and network social organizations, accelerate the promotion of Chinese standards going global, actively participate in the formulation of international standards, and establish multinational standard alliances. Improve the overseas service system for companies going global. Improve the consular protection mechanism, establish and improve overseas emergency and rapid response mechanisms, and maximize the protection of the interests and safety of Chinese enterprises and citizens. Strengthen enterprise awareness of intellectual property rights, strengthen the tracking, judgment, and analysis evaluation of foreign industry technology, intellectual property rights laws and regulations, industry standards, evaluation procedures, and inspection and quarantine rules, establish a public welfare patent information service platform, and provide necessary overseas patent litigation and agency services, intellectual property protection assistance for Chinese enterprises.
titlelist: Major tasks and key projects, expanding the global development service system for Internet companies.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2018, carry out research and testing of 5G network technology, deploy and commercialize Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) on a large scale. By 2020, complete the research, testing, and commercial deployment of 5G technology, fully evolve and upgrade the internet to IPv6, and achieve significant breakthroughs in future network architecture and key technologies. Accelerate the research and industrialization of 5G technology. Coordinate domestic industry, academia, research, and application forces to promote the development of key 5G technologies, conduct technology trials, and establish standards, enhance 5G network capabilities and innovative business applications. Focus on the long-term development needs of 5G technology and business, coordinate and optimize the allocation of 5G spectrum resources, and strengthen radio spectrum management. Timely launch commercial 5G services, support enterprise development in mobile internet and Internet of Things (IoT) innovation applications, actively expand the scope of 5G business applications. Accelerate the construction and integration of the next-generation broadcasting and television network. Coordinate the coordinated development of wired, wireless, and satellite networks, enhance the carrying capacity of broadcasting and television for massive video content and innovative converged media services, promote the integration of wired, wireless, and satellite networks with the internet, build an integrated broadcasting and television transmission and coverage network that is interconnected, broadband, interactive, intelligent, manageable, and controllable, and support the development of mobile, broadband, interactive, and cross-screen broadcasting and television convergence services. Promote the commercialization of the next-generation internet. Accelerate the comprehensive evolution and upgrade of network infrastructure to IPv6, enhance the rapid distribution capability of content delivery networks for IPv6 content. Accelerate the development of IPv6 terminals and application systems, promote the support of IPv6 by smart terminals, and achieve end-to-end support for IPv6 in 4G networks. Accelerate the commercialization of mobile internet based on IPv6, actively guide commercial websites, government, and public enterprise websites to migrate to IPv6. Proactively layout the future network. Layout the future network architecture, accelerate the construction of new network facilities such as industrial internet, energy internet, and space internet, and promote the compatible development of future networks with existing networks. Accelerate the construction of the future network technology system, establish a national-level network testbed, and promote key breakthroughs and testing verification of future network core technologies. Strengthen future network security, actively prevent future network security risks.
titlelist: Priority action, advanced deployment of next-generation information network technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2018, provide basic services to countries along the Belt and Road and neighboring countries; by 2020, establish the Beidou global satellite navigation system consisting of 35 satellites to provide services to global users. Coordinate the promotion of Beidou construction and application. Further improve the leadership and coordination mechanism of the Beidou satellite navigation industry, and continue to promote the development of Beidou system planning, construction, industry, and application at all levels. Accelerate the construction of ground augmentation systems, establish a high-precision positioning service platform for Beidou, and actively carry out application demonstrations. Strengthen breakthroughs in core Beidou technologies. Increase research and development support, integrate industrial resources, improve spectrum planning, comprehensively enhance the performance, power consumption, and cost of Beidou navigation chips, encourage integration with communication, computing, sensing, and other chips, promote the application of Beidou satellite navigation systems and compatible products in government departments, and enhance industrial competitiveness. Accelerate the industrialization process of Beidou. Carry out industry application demonstrations, promote the deployment of Beidou systems in national core business systems and key areas such as transportation, communication, radio and television, water conservancy, electricity, public security, surveying and mapping, housing and urban-rural development, and tourism. Promote the development and improvement of the Beidou navigation industry chain, and promote the comprehensive development of high-precision chip, terminal manufacturing, and location service industries. Explore the international market for satellite navigation services. Serve the construction of the Belt and Road initiative, implement the comprehensive service project for the international development of the satellite navigation industry, accelerate the construction of overseas Beidou ground augmentation systems, promote the construction of regional base stations and location service platforms for Beidou in the Asia-Pacific region, and accelerate the establishment of an international industrial technology alliance and patent pool.
titlelist: Priority Action, Beidou System Construction and Application Action

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year National Informatization Plan (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2018, the original innovation capabilities of cloud computing and the Internet of Things will be significantly enhanced, and the power usage effectiveness (PUE) value of newly built large-scale cloud computing data centers will not exceed 1.5. By 2020, a cloud computing and Internet of Things industry system with international competitiveness will be formed, and the PUE value of newly built large-scale cloud computing data centers will not exceed 1.4. Coordinate the planning and layout of national data center construction. Optimize the layout of large and super-large data centers, and eliminate blind construction of data centers and related parks. Accelerate the promotion of energy-saving design and renovation of existing data centers, and orderly promote the construction of green data centers. Enhance the independent innovation capability of cloud computing. Cultivate and develop a group of cloud computing backbone enterprises with international competitiveness, give full play to the role of enterprise innovation, enhance the original innovation capability of cloud computing technology, and achieve breakthroughs as soon as possible in key technologies and core software and hardware such as large-scale resource management and scheduling, operation monitoring and security guarantee, and big data mining and analysis on cloud computing platforms. Encourage backbone Internet companies to open platform resources, strengthen the construction of industry cloud service platforms, support the migration of government and industry information systems to cloud platforms, build a national scientific research information infrastructure based on cloud computing, and create the China Science and Technology Cloud. Actively promote the development of the Internet of Things. Promote the planning and layout of Internet of Things sensing facilities, and develop open-loop applications of the Internet of Things. Implement major application demonstration projects for the Internet of Things, promote regional pilot projects for the Internet of Things applications, establish city-level Internet of Things access management and data aggregation platforms, and deepen the application of the Internet of Things in urban infrastructure, production and operation, and other links.
titlelist: Priority action, application of infrastructure construction action.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2017, 80 national pilot cities for information benefiting the people will initially achieve cross-regional, cross-level, and cross-departmental one application, one window acceptance, one network access for government services, forming a convenient, fast, fair, inclusive, high-quality, and efficient government service information system. By 2020, the one application, one window, one network goal will be achieved nationwide, with significantly optimized service processes, more diverse service models, smoother service channels, and significantly improved satisfaction of the people in handling affairs. Construct a unified government service information system. Relying on a unified data sharing and exchange platform, promote interconnection, information sharing, and business coordination among various departmental business systems, forming a service model of comprehensive front desk acceptance, classified back-end approval, and unified window delivery. Expand self-service, community agency, postal express, and other service channels, construct a cross-regional, cross-level, online and offline integrated government service system, realize one-window acceptance, one-platform sharing, and one-stop service. Establish an electronic license system and a shared mutual recognition mechanism. Following the principle of combining decentralization and centralization, build a natural person electronic license database, promote the connection and integration of the certification system, business handling system, and electronic license database, realize the one-time generation and multi-party reuse of relevant information, and manage and share it in one database. Research and formulate electronic license standard specifications, establish a cross-regional electronic license mutual recognition and sharing mechanism, promote cross-level, cross-regional, and cross-departmental electronic license mutual recognition and sharing, and gradually realize business handling in different places nationwide. Establish and improve a unified identity authentication system. Using the citizen's identity number as the unique identifier, explore the use of biometric and network identity recognition technologies, connect and integrate user authentication from different channels such as physical government service halls, government websites, mobile clients, self-service terminals, and service hotlines, form a unified identity authentication system for the people's affairs based on the citizen's identity number, and realize one-time authentication, multi-point interconnection, and seamless switching for the people's affairs through multiple channels. Build a one-stop convenience service. Streamline and integrate online service resources in the fields of education, medical and health care, social assistance, social welfare, community services, marriage registration, labor and employment, housing provident fund, social security, family planning, housing security, legal services, rule of law promotion, public safety, and other areas of people's livelihood services, connect various online service channels, build a one-stop convenience service, and realize one-time authentication and one-network access.
titlelist: Priority action, 'Internet+Government Affairs Service' action.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2018, the dynamic monitoring network and regulatory system for natural resources and ecological environment will be basically established, and significant progress will be made in the construction of the energy internet. By 2020, energy utilization efficiency will be significantly improved, and the level of green production and lifestyle will be greatly enhanced. Promote the development of Internet + Smart Energy. Explore the construction of a multi-energy complementary, distributed and coordinated, open and shared energy internet, and build a clean, low-carbon, efficient and safe modern energy system. Promote the development of green energy networks, build an energy consumption ecological system, develop smart energy use at the user end, promote the development of the sharing economy and free trade of energy. Implement the national energy management and supervision informatization project, establish a public service platform for monitoring and management of regional energy production based on the internet, and build an online monitoring system for energy consumption in key energy-consuming units. Strengthen the dynamic monitoring and supervision of natural resources. Implement the natural resources monitoring and supervision information project, establish a 24/7 natural resources monitoring technical system, and build a three-dimensional monitoring system for various resources such as land, ocean, energy, mineral resources, water, forests, grasslands, and atmosphere. Strengthen the construction of basic data for land and resources, establish a basic platform for real estate registration information management and a rural land circulation management information platform, establish a vertically linked, horizontally coordinated, and interconnected natural resources information sharing service platform, and provide effective support for resource supervision and optimization of land and space development. Promote the informatization construction of surveying and mapping geographic information, strengthen the overall construction and management of national satellite navigation positioning reference stations, and build a public service platform for geographic information. Innovate in the prevention and control of regional environmental pollution and management. Implement the construction project of ecological environment monitoring network, establish a 24/7, multi-level intelligent multi-source perception system for pollutant emissions and monitoring. Support the use of Internet of Things, cloud computing, big data, remote sensing, data fusion and other technologies to carry out analysis of atmospheric, water and soil environments, and establish a list of pollution sources. Carry out pilot projects for environmental carrying capacity assessment, strengthen environmental pollution prediction and early warning, and establish a decision support system for environmental pollution source management and pollutant reduction. Promote the informatization construction of environmental monitoring in key regions and areas such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Economic Belt, and ecological forests, and improve the ability of regional basin environmental pollution prevention and control and governance. Vigorously develop green and smart industries. Use new generation information technology to improve the level of environmental protection technology and equipment and enhance environmental service capabilities. Explore the cultivation of online trading markets for energy rights, water rights, carbon emissions rights, and pollutant discharge rights. Promote the Internet + recycling and utilization of renewable resources, industrial waste resource utilization, establish a standardized and orderly recycling and utilization system, enhance the coupling degree of forward and reverse logistics, and promote the integration of waste collection and transportation systems with recycling systems. Demonstration projects will be carried out in the fields of solid waste classification and recycling in urban and rural areas, online trading of major types of recycled resources, remanufacturing, and industrial symbiosis platforms. Encourage the elimination and retirement of old and high-energy-consuming equipment, and the application of green and energy-saving new technologies, encourage enterprises to research and develop and apply energy-saving servers, and reduce equipment energy consumption.
titlelist: Priority Action, Beautiful China Informationization Special Action

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2018, establish a network poverty alleviation information service system, with pilot areas achieving basic network coverage, information coverage, and service coverage. By 2020, complete network coverage for 832 impoverished counties and 128,000 impoverished villages, with e-commerce services accessible in towns and villages. Help impoverished areas improve cultural quality, physical fitness, and employment capabilities through online education, online culture, internet healthcare, etc. Implement network coverage projects. Accelerate internet construction and application in impoverished areas, encourage telecom enterprises to actively assume social responsibilities, and ensure that broadband access reaches villages in line with poverty alleviation efforts. Accelerate the promotion of network coverage in impoverished areas, implement speed increase and fee reduction measures, and explore preferential network tariffs for impoverished households. Accelerate the research, development, production, and application of secure and reliable mobile terminals, promote the development of ethnic language voice and video technology and software, and reduce language barriers for ethnic minorities in using mobile terminals and accessing information services. Implement e-commerce poverty alleviation projects. Encourage e-commerce enterprises to promote customized online sales of specialty agricultural products in rural areas, promote the development of rural industries in impoverished areas, organize well-known e-commerce platforms to establish poverty alleviation channels for impoverished areas, and establish online exhibitions for high-quality products from impoverished counties. Relying on existing national rural tourism e-commerce platforms, develop Internet + tourism poverty alleviation, promote the online rural tourism trunk project, and the special action for the construction of one village, one product industries. Support the construction of payment service networks in remote and extremely impoverished areas. Accelerate the construction and improvement of product quality management, credit, and logistics service systems in impoverished areas. Implement network poverty alleviation and intelligence projects. Fully utilize information technology to promote distance education and facilitate the sharing of high-quality educational resources between urban and rural areas. Strengthen vocational education and skills training for personnel at the county, township, and village levels, and enrich their knowledge of network-related professions. Support university student village officials, three supports and one assistance personnel, and other grassroots service project participants and university students returning to their hometowns to carry out network entrepreneurship and innovation, and improve the employment and entrepreneurial capabilities of impoverished area residents. Implement poverty alleviation information service projects. Gradually integrate agricultural information platforms at all levels below the provincial level into a one-stop system, establish a network poverty alleviation information service system, fully utilize the national concentrated poverty alleviation and development information system and social poverty alleviation information service platform, promote cross-departmental sharing of poverty alleviation and development information, and ensure that poverty alleviation services are accessible anytime and anywhere, and poverty alleviation resources are allocated according to individual needs. Implement network public welfare projects. Accelerate the development and use of network poverty alleviation mobile applications (APPs), promote national poverty alleviation and development policies, enrich information content services, popularize agricultural technology knowledge, and cover applications in industries such as social networking, business, transportation, healthcare, education, and legal aid. Relying on the China Internet Development Foundation, China Poverty Alleviation Volunteer Service Promotion Association, and other organizations, establish a network public welfare poverty alleviation alliance, mobilize internet companies and netizens to participate in network poverty alleviation actions. Build a network system for guaranteeing people's livelihood in impoverished areas, construct a comprehensive information platform for social assistance, and provide personalized and targeted social assistance services.
titlelist: Priority Action, Internet Poverty Alleviation Action

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2018, establish a major information economy cooperation channel with countries in Central and Eastern Europe, Southeast Asia, the Arab region, and other relevant countries, promoting mutual recognition of regulations, interconnection of facilities, mutual trust among enterprises, and integration of industries. By 2020, basically form a major information economy cooperation channel covering key directions of countries and regions along the Belt and Road, with a significant expansion of the scope and areas of information economy cooperation. Construct an online Silk Road Economic Cooperation Experimental Zone. Fully leverage the enthusiasm of localities, encourage domestic cities to engage in point-to-point cooperation with key cities along the Belt and Road, respectively establishing online Silk Road Economic Cooperation Experimental Zones, and promote deep cooperation between the two sides in information infrastructure, smart cities, e-commerce, telemedicine, and Internet Plus fields. Support the establishment of international industry alliances. Fully leverage the enthusiasm of enterprises, support Chinese internet companies, research institutes, foreign internet companies, and related institutions to initiate the establishment of international industry alliances, forming the soft power of the online Silk Road, accelerating the cooperation process between Chinese internet companies and overseas enterprises, promoting the establishment of a cross-border internet industry investment and financing platform, leading the research and formulation of relevant norms in the field of information economy, and transforming the comparative advantages of China's internet industry into the dominant advantages of the global information economy. Encourage and support international expansion of enterprises. Encourage internet companies to jointly build e-commerce trading platforms, logistics information service platforms, online payment service platforms, and other forms, constructing a new type of international cooperation platform for information economy, expanding the international market for platform design, talent cultivation, creative promotion, and supply chain services in various information technology services, driving the improvement and efficiency enhancement of international commodity circulation and transportation logistics.
titlelist: Priority Action, Online Silk Road Construction Action

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Action goals: By 2018, the convenience of medical and health services facilitated by information technology will be greatly improved, and a basic remote medical service system will be formed. By 2020, new health information services based on sensing technology and products will gradually become popular, and information technology will play a significant role in achieving universal access to basic medical and health services. Build efficient and convenient smart health and medical services for the convenience and benefit of the people. Implement the National Electronic Health Information Service Plan, improve internet health consultation, appointment triage, in-clinic settlement, mobile payment, and access to test results and follow-up tracking services based on new information technology. Prioritize appointments for scheduled patients and referred patients, and fully implement appointment scheduling in different time slots. Promote a comprehensive population health information service system. Build a unified and authoritative population health information platform that is interconnected, strengthen the integration, sharing, and coordination of application information systems for public health, family planning, medical services, medical insurance, drug supply, and comprehensive management, and basically achieve standardized electronic health records and fully functional health cards for urban and rural residents. Implement the Healthy China Cloud Service Plan, build an integrated platform for health and medical services, provide remote consultations, remote imaging, pathology results, and electrocardiogram diagnostic services, and improve the mechanism for mutual recognition and sharing of examination and test results. Use the internet to enhance emergency response capabilities for major diseases and public health emergencies, and establish a health communication and remote education video system that covers medical and health institutions nationwide. Improve the global public health risk monitoring and early warning decision-making system, establish an international travel health network, and provide travel health and safety services for inbound and outbound personnel. Promote and regulate the application of health and medical big data. Promote the application of health and medical clinical and research big data, strengthen research in key areas such as rare diseases, promote the application of gene chips and sequencing technology in the diagnosis of genetic diseases, early diagnosis of cancer, and disease prevention and detection, and promote the development of precision medical technology. Promote the application of public health big data and comprehensively enhance the monitoring, evaluation, and decision-making management capabilities of public health. Promote the application of artificial intelligence, 3D bioprinting, medical robots, wearable devices, and related microsensors in disease prevention, health emergencies, health care, and daily nursing, and promote the transformation from medical treatment to health services.
titlelist: Priority Action, Healthy China Information Service Action

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Comprehensively utilize various policy tools to guide financial institutions to expand credit support for information technology enterprises. Encourage venture capital investment, equity investment funds, and other funds to actively invest in information technology development. Carry out pilot programs for internet finance innovation in an orderly manner, and support the development of small and micro enterprises. Promote innovative pilot programs that combine industry and finance, and explore financing services that combine equity and debt. Deepen the reform of the Growth Enterprise Market (GEM) and support eligible innovative and growth-oriented internet companies to raise funds through initial public offerings (IPOs). Study the institutional policies for overseas-listed companies with special equity structures to list domestically. Encourage financial institutions to strengthen product and service innovation, and increase financial support for key areas, major projects, and weak links in the field of information technology, under controllable risks. Actively develop new services such as intellectual property pledge financing and credit insurance policy financing to support eligible information and communication technology (ICT) high-tech enterprises in issuing corporate bonds and non-financial corporate debt financing instruments to raise funds. In key areas with strategic significance and long investment cycles, actively explore government and social capital cooperation (PPP) models, establish a major information technology project PPP project library, clarify risk responsibilities and profit boundaries, strengthen performance evaluation, and promote the sustainable operation of major information technology projects.
titlelist: Policy measures, opening up investment and financing channels, and stimulating development vitality.

name: Notice on Issuing the '13th Five-Year' National Informatization Plan (excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Establish a talent management system that adapts to the characteristics of the Internet, focusing on breaking through institutional barriers and achieving orderly and smooth talent mobility. Establish and improve mechanisms for the ownership and distribution of scientific research achievements and intellectual property rights, and formulate supportive policies in terms of talent equity participation, technology equity participation, and taxation, in order to increase the proportion of benefits for scientific research personnel, especially those who make significant contributions, in the transformation of scientific and technological achievements. Focus on cutting-edge directions and key areas of informatization, accelerate the introduction of leading talents in informatization relying on major talent projects such as the National Thousand Talents Program and the Changjiang Scholars Program. Open up special channels, implement special policies, and accurately introduce urgently needed and scarce special talents. Accelerate the improvement of the visa and permanent residency system for foreign talents coming to China. Establish overseas high-end talent innovation and entrepreneurship bases in the field of Internet, and improve supporting services. Establish and improve the system of expert consultation in informatization, guide the construction of industrial technology innovation alliances, and conduct forward-looking and comprehensive research on informatization-related issues. Recommend outstanding experts in the field of informatization to serve in international organizations. Support ordinary institutions of higher education, military academies, industry associations, training institutions, etc., in carrying out information literacy training, strengthen vocational information skills training, conduct rural information literacy knowledge promotion and activities to bring information technology talents to rural areas, and enhance national information literacy.
titlelist: Policy measures, focusing on team building, strengthening talent support.

name: Notice on Issuing the 13th Five-Year Plan for National Informatization (Excerpt) (State Council [2016] No. 73) (State Council/December 27, 2016)
content: Improve the standard system of informatization, establish a coordinated mechanism for standardization work in the field of national informatization, optimize the layout of standards, accelerate the revision of standards in key areas, enhance the effectiveness of standard implementation, and enhance the international discourse power of standards. Strengthen the application and protection of intellectual property rights, formulate a list of patent navigation and directional suggestions for key links in the integration field, encourage enterprises to carry out strategic reserves and layout of intellectual property rights; accelerate the opening and sharing of patent information resources, encourage large information service enterprises and manufacturing enterprises to establish cross-exchange intellectual property pools; establish a risk management system for intellectual property rights, improve the mechanism of complementary advantages and organic connection between administrative law enforcement and judicial protection of intellectual property rights, and increase the cost of infringement and illegal activities. Improve the social credit system, strengthen the construction of credit information infrastructure in various regions and departments, promote seamless connection of credit information platforms, fully implement a unified social credit code system, and build a multi-level credit and payment system; strengthen the credit construction of new business formats such as the sharing economy, and use big data to establish a new market supervision mechanism with integrity as the core. Accelerate the research and inclusion of informatization statistical indicators into the national economic and social development statistics, and establish a sound system for monitoring informatization statistics.
titlelist: Policy measures, optimizing the basic environment, promoting coordinated development.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: By 2023, the competitive advantage of our products will be further enhanced, the level of secure supply in the industrial chain will be significantly improved, and breakthroughs will be achieved in basic electronic components for important industries such as smart terminals, 5G, and industrial internet. The supply chain capabilities of key materials, equipment, and instruments will be strengthened, and the modernization level of the industrial chain and supply chain will be enhanced. - The industry scale will continue to grow. The total sales of electronic components will reach 2.1 trillion yuan, further consolidating China's position as a global producer of electronic components and fully meeting the market demand for information technology. - Technological innovation will make breakthroughs. Key technologies of electronic components will be broken through, and overall innovation investment in the industry will be further increased. The patent layout of key products such as RF filters, high-speed connectors, chip multilayer ceramic capacitors, and optoelectronic communication devices will be more perfect. - The development of enterprises will be remarkable. A group of electronic component enterprises with international competitive advantages will be formed. Efforts will be made to have 15 enterprises achieve a revenue scale of over 10 billion yuan. The revenue scale and comprehensive strength of leading enterprises will be effectively improved, and their ability to resist risks and reinvest will be significantly enhanced.
titlelist: Overall requirements, overall objectives

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Conquer key core technologies. Implement actions to enhance high-end products, focusing on key products such as circuit components, break through industry development barriers such as patents and technological barriers, fill in the gaps in the development of electronic components, and ensure the security and stability of the industrial supply chain. Column 1: Actions to enhance high-end products. Circuit components: Focus on the development of miniaturized and chip-type resistive, capacitive, and inductive components, high-frequency and high-precision frequency components, high-temperature and high-voltage resistant, low-loss, and high-reliability semiconductor discrete components and modules, miniaturized, high-reliability, and high-sensitivity electronic protection devices, high-performance, multifunctional, and high-density hybrid integrated circuits. Connection components: Focus on the development of high-frequency, high-speed, low-loss, and miniaturized optoelectronic connectors, ultra-high-speed, ultra-low-loss, and low-cost optical fiber cables, high-voltage, high-temperature resistant, and high tensile strength electrical equipment cables, high-frequency, high-speed, high-layer, high-density printed circuit boards, integrated circuit packaging substrates, and special printed circuit boards. Electromechanical components: Focus on the development of high-voltage, high-current, miniaturized, and low-power control relays, miniaturized and high-reliability switches, miniaturized, integrated, high-precision, and energy-efficient micro-special motors. Sensing components: Focus on the development of miniaturized, low-power, integrated, and high-sensitivity sensitive components, high-end sensors in categories such as temperature, gas, displacement, speed, optoelectronics, and biochemistry, new MEMS sensors and smart sensors, and miniaturized and intelligent electroacoustic devices. Functional material components: Focus on the development of high-energy product, high coercivity permanent magnetic components, high magnetic permeability, low magnetic loss soft magnetic components, high thermal conductivity, electrical insulation, low loss, and lead-free environmentally friendly electronic ceramic components. Optical communication components: Focus on the development of high-speed optical communication chips, high-speed and high-precision optics. Build a multi-level collaborative innovation system. Support enterprises, higher education institutions, and research institutes to strengthen cooperation, explore the establishment of manufacturing innovation centers in the field of electronic components, increase research and development efforts in key common technologies, cutting-edge leading technologies, modern engineering technologies, and disruptive technologies, and build a collaborative innovation and achievement transformation platform that integrates industry, academia, research, and application. Encourage regions to carry out key technology research and development and industrialization in distinctive or segmented fields to achieve differentiated development. Improve intellectual property layout. Encourage enterprises, higher education institutions, and research institutes to enhance awareness of intellectual property protection, improve intellectual property management systems, and carry out domestic and international intellectual property layout. Explore the establishment of patent pools and conduct patent analysis and early warning related to electronic components. Carry out pilot projects to cultivate enterprises in the field of intellectual property.
titlelist: Key work, enhancing industrial innovation capability.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Breakthrough key material technology. Support the research and production of electronic functional materials such as electronic ceramic materials, magnetic materials, battery materials, electronic slurry, and process and auxiliary materials, as well as high-end printed circuit board materials for packaging and assembly. Enhance supporting capabilities and promote the research and industrialization of electronic special materials in key areas. Enhance equipment and instrument supporting capabilities. Support the research and industrialization of electronic special equipment and instruments with high technical difficulty, high application value, strong universality, and great driving force for the electronic component industry, such as etching and developing equipment, micro-CT and other testing and analysis instruments, and improve the quality and reliability of equipment and instruments. Improve the industrial supporting system. Encourage and guide chemical, non-ferrous metal, light industry machinery, equipment and instrument enterprises to enter the field of electronic components, carry out research and production of key materials and equipment, promote collaborative innovation among industry, academia, research, and application, realize the coordinated development of the entire industry chain, enhance testing and verification capabilities, and improve the supporting level of key areas.
titlelist: Key work, solidify the foundation of supporting industries.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Improve the level of intelligence. Guide companies to build digital design platforms, comprehensive environmental simulation platforms, and databases for materials, processes, and failure analysis. Based on machine learning and artificial intelligence technology, promote the digitization and networking of key processes, optimize production processes and quality control systems, carry out intelligent factory construction, and improve the level of intelligent manufacturing. Column 3 promotes the intelligent design of intelligent manufacturing. Guide domestic software companies to develop various electronic component simulation design software, encourage the use of virtual reality, digital twins, and other advanced technologies for industrial design, and improve enterprise design capabilities. Accelerate intelligent transformation. Focus on connector and cable components, electronic transformers, electroacoustic devices, microspecial motors, and other branch industries with large labor demand and mainly small-batch, multi-batch orders. Explore and promote modular and digital production methods to accelerate intelligent upgrading. Cultivate industrial Internet platforms. Encourage and support branch industries with a good industrial foundation to explore industrial Internet construction models, encourage leading companies to open and share business systems to the industry, and promote collaborative design and supply chain management among upstream and downstream enterprises in the industrial chain. Promote green manufacturing. Promote energy-saving and water-saving technology transformation in the entire industry, accelerate the application of clean and efficient production processes, carry out clean production, reduce energy consumption and pollutant emissions, and achieve green production. Optimize the structural design of electronic components, develop high value-added, low consumption, and low emission products. Develop green manufacturing standards for the electronic component industry and improve the green manufacturing system. Column 4 promotes green manufacturing actions. Build green factories. Guide electronic component companies to build green factories based on the principles of intensive plant construction, harmless raw materials, clean production, waste resource utilization, and low-carbon energy. Increase investment in energy conservation and environmental protection, implement energy conservation and environmental protection technology improvement projects, encourage companies to use information technology and intelligent technology to treat pollutants and monitor them in real time, and link the implementation of environmental protection measures with the enterprise's credit rating. Produce green products. Strictly implement policies such as the Management Measures for the Restriction of the Use of Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Products, encourage backbone enterprises to carry out green design throughout the product life cycle, and accelerate the application of new types of electronic components that are lightweight, modular, integrated, highly reliable, long-lasting, and easy to recycle. Develop green parks. Strengthen cooperation between electronic component-related industrial park companies and other enterprises, and promote the joint construction and sharing of infrastructure. Develop a circular economy and strengthen the recycling of waste heat resources, waste pressure, and water resources. Build a green supply chain. Support backbone enterprises in implementing sustainable green supply chain management strategies, implement green partner-based supplier management, strengthen environmental assessments of upstream suppliers, prioritize the development of green factories as suppliers, and prioritize the purchase of green products. Cultivate high-quality enterprises. Encourage leading companies to integrate resources, expand production scale, enhance core competitiveness, and improve compliance and risk resistance capabilities through mergers and acquisitions, capital operations, and other methods. Cultivate a group of specialized and innovative small giants and manufacturing champions with independent intellectual property rights, high added value products, and core competitiveness.
titlelist: Key tasks, guiding industrial transformation and upgrading.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Strengthen standardization work. Strengthen the development of standards for key core technologies and basic common technologies, and continuously improve the quality and level of standards supply. Guide social organizations to accelerate the development and release of innovative and international group standards. Encourage enterprises, institutions, and experts to actively participate in international standardization activities and carry out the development of international standards. Enhance the benefits of quality brands. Optimize product design, upgrade technical equipment, improve inspection and testing, and promote advanced quality culture and technology. Guide enterprises to establish brand development strategies based on quality, enrich brand connotations, and enhance brand image and influence. Carry out activities such as promoting quality-driven development and brand cultivation, and regularly release quality brand reports. Optimize the market environment. Guide terminal enterprises to optimize the procurement model of electronic components, advocate for high quality and low price, avoid irrational market behaviors such as low-price vicious competition, price manipulation, and speculative activities, and promote the construction of a fair, just, open, and orderly market competition environment.
titlelist: Key work, promoting the improvement of industry quality.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Build an analysis and evaluation public platform. Support capable and qualified enterprises and institutions to establish a national-level electronic component analysis and evaluation public service platform, strengthen the construction of quality and technology classification standards, and provide services such as product testing, analysis, rating, reliability, and application verification in various fields of electronic components. Provide a basis for the design of electronic system integration and material selection. Build a science and technology service platform. Support the construction of a batch of public service platforms by local areas, parks, and enterprises and institutions, and provide services such as intellectual property training and transactions, evaluation of scientific and technological achievements, and market strategy research. Encourage the construction of dedicated electronic component production lines to provide wafer services for MEMS sensors, filters, optical communication module driver chips, etc. Build an innovation and entrepreneurship incubation platform. Support the construction of entrepreneurship support platforms such as crowdsourcing, crowdfunding, and crowd support in the field of electronic components, promote the establishment of a batch of basic electronic component industry ecological incubators and accelerators, and encourage the provision of funding, technology, market application, and promotion support for start-up companies.
titlelist: Key work, strengthen the construction of public platforms.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Establish and improve the coordination mechanism for the development of electronic components industry, strengthen collaboration and overall planning, actively promote the resolution of major issues and key tasks in industrial development. Strengthen cooperation between the central and local governments, guide local governments in coordinating the planning and layout of key projects in basic electronic components, and promote concentration of main entities and regional clustering in a timely manner. Carry out monitoring, analysis, and tracking research in key areas, strengthen the connection with existing relevant policies, and orderly advance various actions.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen industry coordination and planning.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Focus on the electronic components industry, promote cooperation in production, application, financing, and other aspects, and accelerate market-oriented promotion and application. Fully utilize channels such as industrial base reconstruction to support innovation breakthroughs. Encourage increased investment in manufacturing transformation and upgrading funds, and guide local investment funds to provide coordinated support. Harness the role of market mechanisms, encourage participation of social capital, and attract diversified funding such as venture capital and financing leasing to support industry development.
titlelist: Enhance policy support and strengthen protective measures.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Strengthen the early warning and prevention of monopolistic practices, dumping, price protection, and infringement of intellectual property rights in the electronic components industry, and maintain a fair competition and a healthy and orderly market development environment. Promote industry integrity, law-abiding taxation, energy conservation and environmental protection, and harmonious employment. Guide the construction of a credit system in the electronic components industry and implement a system of self-declaration and supervision of corporate product standards, quality, and safety.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, optimize the industrial development environment.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Basic Electronic Components Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Electronics [2021] No. 5) (MIIT/January 15, 2021)
content: Implement the Belt and Road initiative, expand international exchanges and cooperation channels in the electronic components industry, strengthen communication and exchanges with relevant international organizations and standardization institutions, and promote integration with international advanced technologies and industrial chains. Promote mutual promotion of the domestic and international electronic components industry, encourage global leading companies to establish production bases and research institutions in China, support backbone enterprises in exploring overseas markets, and engage in various forms of cooperation with overseas institutions in technology, talent, capital, etc., to build an open and cooperative industrial pattern for development and win-win cooperation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepening international exchange and cooperation.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: By 2020, a globally competitive and secure information industry ecosystem will be established, and its position in the global value chain will be further enhanced. Breakthroughs will be made in key core technologies and iconic products that have been hindering the development of the industry, and China's dominance in international standards will continue to expand. The coordination and synergy of industrial development will be significantly enhanced, and the industrial layout will be further optimized, resulting in a number of enterprises with global brand competitiveness. The energy efficiency of electronic products will continue to improve, and the energy and resource consumption in the production process will be further reduced. The information industry security guarantee system will be continuously improved, and the security guarantee capability of key information infrastructure will meet the demand, making the security industry chain more complete. Optical networks will cover both urban and rural areas comprehensively, and the commercial service of the fifth-generation mobile communication (5G) will be launched, providing high-speed, mobile, secure, and ubiquitous new generation information infrastructure. By 2020, the main indicators of information industry development are as follows:Indicator          2015 Base Value          2020 Target          Cumulative ChangeIndustry ScaleInformation Industry Revenue (trillion yuan)          17.1          26.2          [8.9%]Including:Revenue of Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry (trillion yuan)          11.1          14.7          [5.8%]Revenue of Software and Information Technology Services Industry (trillion yuan)          4.38          [13.2%]Revenue of Information and Communication Industry (trillion yuan)          1.7          3.5          [15.5%]Industry StructureNumber of Information Industry Enterprises in the Fortune Global 500          79          2Percentage of General Trade Exports of Electronic Information Products in Industry Exports (%)          25.5          30.4Technological InnovationR&D Investment Intensity of Top 100 Electronic Information Enterprises (%)          5.5          6.1          0.6Number of Domestic Information Technology Invention Patents Granted (10,000)          11.0          15.3          [6.9%]Service LevelFixed Broadband Household Penetration Rate (%)          40          70Mobile Broadband User Penetration Rate (%)          57          85Fiber Optic Coverage Rate in Administrative Villages (%)          75          98Green DevelopmentPercentage Decrease in Comprehensive Energy Consumption Ratio of Telecommunication Business Volume          -10          -10Energy Efficiency of Newly Built Large-scale Cloud Computing Data Centers (PUE)          1.5          <1.4          >0.1Note:1. The values in [] represent the average annual growth rate.2. The indicator of the number of information industry enterprises in the Fortune Global 500 refers to the number of enterprises from mainland China that have entered the Fortune 500 list.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Build an advanced core technology and product system.
