Deploy the innovation chain around the industrial chain system, allocate resources for the innovation chain, and focus on enhancing systematic innovation capabilities in the three major areas of cloud computing and big data, next-generation information networks, and intelligent hardware. Targeting major strategic needs and future industrial development high points, support professional institutions in researching and publishing guidelines for technological innovation in key areas, propose a list of bottlenecks and priorities, and guide market entities in making innovative breakthroughs. Strengthen the coordination of research and development forces between industry, academia, and research institutions, make comprehensive use of national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.), support the research and development of key core technologies and major technology test verifications, and strengthen the supply of key common technologies. Strengthen major layouts in frontier areas, with a focus on key areas such as future networks, quantum computing, stratospheric communication, satellite communication, visible light communication, connected vehicles, integrated networks for land, sea, air, and space, artificial intelligence, and neuromorphic computing. Concentrate advantageous resources to carry out original innovation and integrated innovation, enhance the ability to create new supply, and seize the initiative and high ground in industrial technological development. Build high-level innovation carriers and service platforms. Make full use of existing innovation resources, explore new mechanisms and models for government-industry-academia-research collaboration, and establish several innovation centers in strategic core areas such as integrated circuits, basic software, big data, cloud computing, the Internet of Things, and industrial internet, to carry out research and development of key common technologies and industrial demonstrations. Strengthen the position and leading role of enterprises in technological innovation, support leading enterprises in building a number of high-level technology centers and innovation laboratories, and support enterprises in jointly establishing industry-academia-research collaboration in key areas with universities and research institutions. Actively participate in and establish open source communities, support enterprises in taking the lead in undertaking major national scientific and technological research and industrialization projects. Integrate and optimize information technology resources, actively leverage the role of industry associations/unions, standardization organizations, intermediary organizations, and think tanks in strategic and policy research, statistical analysis, and public services, and build and enhance public service platforms for technological innovation, technology transfer, standardization, measurement and testing, certification and testing, and market promotion. Strengthen the construction of standard systems and the application of intellectual property rights. Further optimize the structure of national standards, industry standards, and military standards systems, support the development of group standards, accelerate the construction of a new generation of information technology standard system oriented towards industrialization and military-civilian integration, and research and formulate comprehensive standardization technical systems in key areas such as smart hardware, sensors, smart homes, virtual reality, cloud computing, big data, solar photovoltaics, and lithium-ion batteries. Accelerate the revision of basic standards, general standards, safety standards, testing methods, and key product standards, and continuously improve specifications and requirements in terms of technology, energy consumption, environmental protection, quality, and safety. Actively participate in the formulation of international standardization strategies, policies, and rules, promote more information and communication standards in China to become international standards, accelerate the transformation of internationally advanced standards urgently needed for China's industrial development, and promote the alignment of international and domestic standards. Establish a mechanism for patent-guided industrial development, strengthen the reserve and strategic layout of key core technology intellectual property rights in the information industry, promote the transfer and transformation of technological innovation achievements through intellectual property rights, encourage market entities to form industry intellectual property rights alliances, and establish mechanisms for joint creation, collaborative use, mutual protection, and risk sharing of intellectual property rights. Research and formulate intellectual property rights operation strategies in key areas, improve operation service systems, promote the acquisition, storage, licensing, and transfer of intellectual property rights, and support and guide industry organizations and industrial alliances in strengthening intellectual property rights analysis and evaluation to prevent and control intellectual property risks.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance systematic innovation capability.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Build a collaborative development industrial chain. Relying on advantageous backbone enterprises, construct and improve a number of important industrial chains such as information networks, cloud computing, big data, the Internet of Things, industrial Internet, smart terminals, and key equipment for electronic manufacturing. Form an architecture of hardware + software + content + services to create several internationally competitive industrial ecosystems. Support eligible enterprises to carry out vertical integration and cross-domain value chain expansion in the industrial chain through mergers and acquisitions, equity investment, and other means, enhancing their value creation and core competitiveness. Implement trademark brand development strategies centered around industrial clusters, improve the overall quality level of the industrial chain, strengthen the construction of group standards, intellectual property rights, and public service platforms, enhance trademark brand promotion and marketing, and create a number of internationally influential regional brands for industrial clusters. Enhance industrial basic capabilities. Develop a list of key bottlenecks in areas such as basic hardware and software, key manufacturing processes, key electronic materials, and process equipment, and organize the implementation of key breakthrough plans in these areas. Promote the special action for improving the quality of the manufacturing industry, tackle key common quality technologies that have long plagued the improvement of product quality for key products in the information industry. Strengthen reliability and measurability design, test verification, accumulate accurate and effective process parameter data, promote the adoption of advanced quality management methods, advanced molding and processing methods, online measurement and detection devices, etc., and improve the reliability, consistency, stability, and effectiveness of electronic information equipment, materials, and process technologies. Develop and improve a batch of urgently needed national metrological standards, strengthen the construction of national metrological testing centers related to the information industry, and build an information industry metrological testing service system. Promote the connection between enterprises in basic hardware and software, basic materials, and process equipment and downstream enterprises, organize the implementation of the first set or batch of demonstration applications, accelerate the market application and promotion of safe and reliable basic hardware and software products. Enhance enterprise innovation vitality. Establish market-oriented investment funds in key areas of the information industry to support enterprises in mergers and acquisitions, technology introduction, and talent introduction, improve their ability and level to utilize global resources and explore international markets, and form an industrial organizational form with large enterprise groups as the core, high concentration, detailed division of labor, and efficient collaboration. Further improve and implement financial, tax, and financial policies to support the development of small and medium-sized enterprises, promote the construction of entrepreneurship and innovation bases for small and micro enterprises, and vigorously support the development of start-up and innovation-oriented enterprises in the early stage. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises to focus on segmented markets, stimulate their innovation vitality, and develop a group of specialized and excellent hidden champion enterprises. Give full play to the role of various platforms, support the innovative development of small and medium-sized enterprises in the information industry, and guide large, medium, and small enterprises to establish closer collaborative relationships. Support enterprises in transforming patented technologies with core competitiveness into standards and improve their overall competitiveness. Guide enterprises to establish a business philosophy of prioritizing quality and putting reputation first, effectively enhance quality and brand awareness, cultivate and promote the spirit of excellence in craftsmanship. Enhance the comprehensive application of information technology in the industry, accelerate the transformation of production methods such as personalized manufacturing, networked collaborative manufacturing, and intelligent manufacturing, innovate and develop new models, and promote the transformation of enterprises to the high-end of the value chain. Optimize the spatial layout of the industry. Implement the overall strategy for regional development and the planning of main functional areas, guide local areas to leverage their comparative advantages, and form differentiated development patterns in key areas such as integrated circuits, basic software, flat panel displays, smart terminals, information technology services, cloud computing, and big data. Focus on promoting breakthroughs in the Yangtze River Economic Belt, the Pearl River Delta, the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, and other innovation resource-intensive areas, and build globally competitive innovation highlands in the information industry. Support the central and western regions to undertake the transfer of the information industry based on their own advantages, and focus on supporting several central cities with good foundations and conditions to improve their research and development capabilities and industrial levels, and form differentiated competitive advantages in characteristic areas. Reasonably guide the aggregation of talent, technology, capital, policies, and other resource factors, build a number of national new industrialization demonstration bases in the information industry, and continuously improve the level of software city construction. Solidly promote the optimization of data center layout and promote the rational utilization of data centers. Promote green development of the industry. Support the promotion of enterprise upgrading of production technology and processes, encourage the development of green products, promote green design of electronic information products, reduce energy consumption in the production and use of electronic information products, guide green production, and promote green consumption. Continuously improve the limited requirements for toxic and hazardous substances in electronic information products, strictly test the links, and ensure that the content of restricted substances complies with national standards. Research and develop traceable metrological testing technologies, methods, and devices for energy efficiency (PUE) in data centers. Encourage enterprises to research and develop energy-saving servers and develop green cloud computing data centers using new energy-saving technologies such as high-voltage direct current and natural air cooling. Accelerate the energy-saving transformation of existing data centers, base stations, and other information network facilities, encourage the elimination and retirement of old and high-energy-consuming equipment, and promote the application of new green and energy-saving technologies. Promote the research and development of technologies for the disposal and resource utilization of waste electrical and electronic products, formulate relevant standards for the comprehensive utilization of waste electrical and electronic products and key dismantling products, build and promote Internet-based recycling service information platforms, promote producers' fulfillment of responsibilities for the recycling and disposal of waste electrical and electronic products, encourage the development of specialized recycling and disposal enterprises, and promote the scale development of the remanufacturing industry. Promote the establishment and implementation of a unified system for green product standards, certification, and labeling.
titlelist: The main task is to build a synergistic and optimized industrial structure.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Promote the integration and innovation of information technology and manufacturing. Promote the close integration of manufacturing, Internet Plus, and mass entrepreneurship and innovation, accelerate the wider and deeper integration, penetration, and innovative application of new generation information technology, and promote the intelligent, green, and service-oriented development of the manufacturing industry. Establish and improve the standard system for intelligent manufacturing and the integration of the two industries, comprehensively promote the standardization of the integration of the two industries. Promote the Next Generation Numerical Control demonstration project, accelerate the breakthrough in core intelligent manufacturing information equipment such as sensors, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and industrial control systems, and improve the level of safety and reliability. Carry out pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing. Promote the research and industrialization of key technologies of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), build comprehensive verification platforms, and carry out industry application testing and pilot demonstrations. Focus on industrial cloud, industrial big data, industrial e-commerce, and system solutions, carry out pilot demonstrations of the integration of manufacturing and the Internet, and cultivate a group of leading enterprises in system solutions for intelligent manufacturing in key industries. Implement pilot projects for innovative applications of industrial cloud and industrial big data, build a number of high-quality industrial cloud services and industrial big data platforms, promote intelligent manufacturing new models such as personalized customization, networked collaborative manufacturing, and remote operation and maintenance services. Build mass entrepreneurship and innovation platforms for large-scale manufacturing enterprises and third-party service platforms serving small and medium-sized enterprises, and create a new ecosystem of collaborative development for large, medium, and small enterprises. Relying on strong foundation projects, focusing on the application needs of key links in intelligent manufacturing, support the development of a group of industrial software with good application effects, strong technological innovation, and high market recognition, and promote the popularization of advanced and applicable industrial software in key industries. Actively promote the transformation and upgrading of manufacturing industry through information technology, and strive to improve the added value of products and services. Actively promote the Internet Plus action. Relying on Internet platforms, vigorously develop crowd innovation, crowd sourcing, crowd support, and crowd funding, promote the integration and development of the Internet and the economy and society. Establish the Internet Plus standard system, accelerate the development and promotion of basic common standards and key technical standards for the Internet and its integrated applications. Integrate various resources such as government departments, telecommunications companies, Internet companies, and industry institutions, integrate resource application, open capabilities, technical support, entrepreneurship incubation, testing and certification, experimental environment, business consulting, and other entrepreneurship and innovation services, enhance the support capabilities of information and communication enterprises for mass entrepreneurship and innovation service platforms. Promote Internet Plus safety production, enhance the online monitoring, early warning, and control capabilities of key areas of safety production enterprises throughout the entire process and chain, strengthen cross-departmental and cross-regional information sharing and business collaboration. Carry out the cultivation of a new type of network economy, support Internet companies, information technology service companies, and manufacturing companies in jointly creating a platform economic model for the transformation of the service industry, accelerate the development and application of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data, and other technologies in economic activities, strengthen support for smart transportation, smart energy, smart environmental protection, efficient logistics, people's livelihood services, inclusive finance, smart healthcare, modern agriculture, and develop communication facilities and new businesses based on the power grid. Cultivate new forms of information consumption and expand new space for the network economy. Accelerate the development of information technology services. Focus on key areas such as government affairs, finance, energy, transportation, environmental protection, safety production, e-commerce, digital content, etc., enhance the consulting design, software development, integrated implementation, operation and maintenance, and testing and verification capabilities of information technology service enterprises. Support information technology enterprises in breaking through key technologies such as business modeling, remote intelligent inspection, large-scale resource scheduling and management, automated operation and maintenance, and data governance, develop new models and new formats such as Internet operation and maintenance services, network crowdsourcing services, microservices, and intelligent services, strengthen the application and promotion of emerging technologies such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and augmented reality in industry system solutions, and accelerate the transformation into high-end value service providers. Select cities or regions for the concentrated development of the information technology service industry and carry out application demonstrations of information technology services for manufacturing. Summarize advanced industry practices, formulate and improve relevant norms for information technology services. Accelerate the development and industrialization of integrated integration and intelligent operation and maintenance platforms, and enhance the guarantee capabilities of information technology services. Implement a five-year action plan for the standardization of information technology services, improve and promote information technology service standards (ITSS), and encourage enterprises to accelerate standardization and productization of services.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the deep integration and application of information technology.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Innovate the management of the internet industry. Adhere to the combination of policy guidance and law-based management, encourage support and regulate parallel development, and promote the sustainable and healthy development of the internet. Innovate the regulatory system, actively use advanced technologies such as big data to strengthen supervision of market entities, and form a comprehensive management system for the internet industry covering resources, access, networks, and business at all levels. Improve the management system of internet basic resources, strictly implement real-name registration for websites, domain names, IP addresses, and phone numbers. Accelerate the promotion and use of IPv6 addresses, and promote the opening of international connections for IPv6. Establish and improve a multi-department collaborative management mechanism, establish a new business filing and development guidance system, and strengthen the joint management of new business integration between the internet and the real economy. Adhere to the combination of delegation and regulation, promote the construction of a whole-process supervision support system represented by the credit system, and strengthen in-process and post-event supervision. Establish a credit evaluation system for internet market entities, rely on the national enterprise information disclosure system to establish a mechanism for collecting and sharing enterprise information, improve the system of joint incentives for trustworthy behavior and joint punishment for untrustworthy behavior, promote hierarchical market warnings, and create a fair and trustworthy market environment. Strengthen the supervision of service quality, protect user rights and personal information. Actively guide social forces to participate in the management of the internet industry, improve industry norms and self-discipline conventions, guide industry associations and third-party organizations to carry out industry self-discipline, social supervision, evaluation and certification activities, and promote the formation of a governance pattern led by the government and involving multiple parties. Improve the management of the telecommunications industry. Focus on consolidating the foundational support position of the telecommunications industry, build high-quality information infrastructure, and enhance industry service capabilities and quality. Accelerate the pilot work of universal telecommunications services. Deepen the promotion of network speed increase and fee reduction, promote the simplification of telecommunications tariff structures, improve the cost-effectiveness of telecommunications services, and regulate corporate operations, services, and charging behaviors. Further open up access to competitive market areas, do a good job in the opening pilot of the telecommunications field in free trade zones, and promote opening and cooperation with Hong Kong, Macao, and other regions. Optimize the management of radio frequency and satellite orbit resources. Optimize the allocation of national spectrum resources, strengthen radio frequency management, and maintain a safe and orderly radio wave environment. Scientifically plan and reasonably allocate radio frequency resources, coordinate the medium- and long-term frequency requirements for key business sectors and the development of strategic emerging industries, and promote the development of wireless radio services related to Broadband China, information consumption, and the Internet Plus action. Strengthen the basic, forward-looking, and strategic research on major issues related to the use of radio frequency and satellite orbit resources, strengthen the availability demonstration of satellite frequency and orbit resources, and carry out international declaration, coordination, and registration of satellite network information. Conduct radio frequency usage assessments to promote the effective development and utilization of spectrum resources. Deepen station management and strengthen in-process and post-event supervision. Increase investment in the construction of radio management infrastructure and technical facilities, strengthen the capacity building of radio supervision, realize the coverage of a wide-area and ubiquitous urban radio monitoring network, and enhance the ability to maintain radio wave order.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the management level of the information, communication, and radio industry.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Improve the management system for network and information security. Accelerate the formulation of departmental regulations and normative documents in the areas of protecting critical information infrastructure, data security, and industrial internet security. Enhance the network and information security standard system and promote the establishment of security standards in emerging fields such as 5G, Internet of Things, cloud computing, big data, and intelligent manufacturing. Strengthen the promotion of secure and reliable electronic signature applications and push for the legal recognition of electronic signatures. Establish and improve the management system for identity service providers. Clarify the responsibility for protecting critical information infrastructure and improve the supervision mechanism for the design, construction, and operation of information systems related to national security. Further strengthen the network security supervision of important network infrastructure and business systems owned or operated by internet companies. Establish a cross-industry and cross-department emergency coordination mechanism to enhance the ability to predict, monitor, and respond to network and information security incidents. Strengthen the sharing of security threat information between the government and enterprises. Accelerate the implementation of the network security review system. Enhance network data protection in the context of big data. Explore the establishment of a network data protection system in the era of big data, promote the hierarchical classification regulation of network data, strengthen the protection of network data throughout its lifecycle, and formulate policies for network data protection management. Urge companies to continuously improve the system for publicly announcing user information leaks and establish a sound big data security credit system. Accelerate the research, development, and application of specialized technologies such as data encryption, leakage prevention, and information confidentiality, and promote the establishment of a secure and trustworthy big data technology system. Promote the development of information security technology and industry. Focus on breakthroughs in key basic software and hardware and core information security technologies, enhance capabilities in vulnerability discovery and patching, attack monitoring and tracing, and strengthen security risk response in new technologies and formats such as Internet Plus, 5G, and SDN. Implement special national information security projects, carry out pilot demonstrations for the protection of critical information infrastructure and key information system network security. Promote the research, development, and industrial application of information security products and services. Give full play to the guiding role of the government, accelerate the cultivation of backbone enterprises, develop enterprises with distinctive advantages, and create a well-structured, clear, and competitive industrial pattern. Enhance industrial information security assurance capabilities. Establish and improve industrial information security policies and standards, develop security management policies, as well as management guidelines, evaluation capability requirements, and other security standards for key industries. Establish an industrial information security management system, improve inspection and evaluation, and information sharing mechanisms for industrial information security, promote security inspections, vulnerability disclosures, information notifications, and create a secure industrial internet environment. Build industrial information security simulation, testing, and verification platforms, conduct technical research and development on testing and evaluation, security verification, and promote pilot applications of new security technologies and products, enhance industrial information security technology assurance capabilities. Column 2: Enhancing security assurance capabilities. Information security technology products. Carry out research on chip security reinforcement technology and promote the standardization and industrialization of cryptographic technology in China. Strengthen research and development and application of information security technologies for the integration of the three networks, Internet of Things, mobile internet, industrial internet, cloud computing, and next-generation information networks. Strengthen the development of secure chips, secure core information devices, secure operating systems, secure databases, and secure middleware. Develop products using new technologies such as content awareness, intelligent sandboxing, anomaly detection, and virtualization, support innovation and application of network and boundary security products such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention, accelerate the prevention of advanced persistent threats (APTs) and product development, strengthen the research and development and application of security management platform products based on massive data and intelligent analysis. Strengthen the research and development and application of information security support tools such as information security evaluation, web vulnerability scanning, and software source code security checks. Information security assurance. Build a network security threat monitoring and disposal platform based on the backbone network, develop capabilities in network security threat monitoring, situational awareness, emergency response, and traceability. Implement domain name system security protection projects, enhance the access bandwidth and security protection capabilities of the national top-level domain name system, strengthen the security protection and data backup capabilities of public recursive domain name resolution systems. Construct an internet network security emergency management platform, improve the analysis, judgment, and industry-specific emergency command and dispatch capabilities for internet network security threat information and monitoring data. Build a service platform for testing, evaluation, vulnerability disclosure, and information notification of industrial control system information security, and improve the information security assurance system.
titlelist: Main task: Strengthening the capability of ensuring the security of the information industry.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Improve the level of international development in the industry. Promote the combination of investment attraction, technology attraction, and talent attraction, encourage and support information industry enterprises and overseas advantageous enterprises to carry out joint ventures and cooperation in high-end areas such as research and development innovation, new product development, standard formulation, and brand building, and improve the level of introduction. Support enterprises in establishing research and development centers overseas and fully utilize various international innovation resources. Combine with the implementation of major national strategies, take information infrastructure construction, terminal product capacity cooperation, major project integration and general contracting as the traction, drive the systematization and clustering of upstream and downstream enterprises in the industrial chain, advanced technology standards, information network equipment, supporting services, etc., to go global. Support eligible enterprises in building overseas information industry cooperation parks. Provide services such as country-specific directories and project docking for enterprises going global, guide financial institutions to provide financial services, and reduce the risks of enterprises going global. Actively promote the promotion and use of Chinese domain names. Actively participate in the formulation of international Internet standards, improve the ability and influence to participate in the formulation of international rules. Optimize the international layout of information networks. Relying on the Belt and Road strategy, build efficient cross-border information channels, promote interconnection of information and communication facilities with neighboring countries, innovate international communication facility construction and operation models, and focus on opening up land channels such as Central Asia to West Asia, South Asia to the Indian Ocean, and Russia to Europe, and promote the construction of international submarine cables in key directions. Improve the layout of China's international communication import and export, enhance China's international Internet capabilities with Asia, Africa, Europe, and Latin America as the main directions, and accelerate the construction of overseas network service access points (PoPs) and Internet data centers (IDCs). Promote telecommunications companies to establish overseas branches, strengthen the quality monitoring and service improvement of international communications, provide more comprehensive and high-quality information services for Chinese-funded enterprises and overseas users going global, and realize the overseas operation and landing of China's information business.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance the ability for international development.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Vigorously develop core basic components that meet the needs of high-end equipment, application electronics, the Internet of Things, new energy vehicles, and new generation information technology, and enhance domestic and international market competitiveness. Expand the scale application of new display devices, achieve large-scale production of high-resolution LCD displays, and mass production of active matrix organic light-emitting diode (AMOLED) products; break through core technologies such as flexible fabrication and packaging, complete production technology reserves, and develop flexible display devices larger than 10 inches. Breakthrough key common technologies such as micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) microstructure processing and high-density packaging, accelerate the development and industrialization of sensor products. Improve the performance of light-emitting diode (LED) devices, promote the application of high-end field control power electronic devices, develop next-generation power electronic devices, and support the promotion and application in typical fields. Strengthen the innovation and technological reserves of electronic-grade polysilicon, high-efficiency solar cells and module packaging processes, and improve the integration level of photovoltaic power generation systems and supporting energy storage equipment. Actively develop key electronic materials for industries such as electronic paper, lithium-ion batteries, and photovoltaics, with a focus on breaking into high-end application markets. Enhance the supply capacity of electronic special equipment, with a focus on developing 12-inch integrated circuit production line equipment, new thin-film solar cell production equipment, key materials production equipment for lithium-ion batteries, new component production equipment, and surface mount equipment. Research and develop testing equipment for semiconductors and integrated circuits, communications and networks, the Internet of Things, new electronic components, and high-performance general electronics. Column 4: Basic Electronics Enhancement Project. Basic components. Accelerate the research and industrialization of core components such as supercapacitors, high-voltage DC relays, and hub motors. Increase the market share of high-efficiency energy-saving micro motors, high-reliability long-life chip aluminum electrolytic capacitors, and other electronic components. Master the technology related to servo motors and control systems for robot reducers and micro motors. Breakthroughs in new battery energy storage technologies such as zinc-ion batteries. Develop communication network equipment components based on 400G bandwidth (backbone network), such as ultra-low-loss optical fibers, optoelectronic components, frequency components, and 56Gbps high-speed connectors. Develop ultra-small chip components and flexible components for new mobile intelligent terminals, chip surface acoustic wave filters, and other products. Develop high-end LED and new power electronic devices to support the promotion and application in typical fields. Sensors and sensitive components. Enhance research and development capabilities in sensitive mechanisms, sensitive materials, and new processes, accelerate the research and industrialization of various new sensitive materials and composite functional materials used in physical, chemical, and biological quantities, such as semiconductors, ceramics, polymer organics, and optical fiber. Improve the application level of various new process technologies based on MEMS, thin films, etc. Focus on promoting the industrialization of specialized sensor products in key areas, develop intelligent sensors for biology, motion, medicine, health, and the environment, as well as multi-parameter integrated sensors and self-calibrating, self-diagnostic, and self-compensating sensors. Improve the sensor technology standard system and measurement traceability system construction, and enhance the ability of product metrology and testing. New display devices. Achieve production of 8.5th generation and larger glass substrates, improve the supply level of key products such as high-generation mask plates and driver chips, support the development of new technologies such as electronic paper, laser displays, and flexible displays, break through advanced backplane processes such as low-temperature polysilicon (LTPS) and oxide, and master long-life, high-efficiency, high-resolution AMOLED production processes. Accelerate the introduction of new processes and technologies, achieve stable production of low-power, 4K×2K ultra-high-resolution products, and mass production of AMOLED products. Solar photovoltaics. Support the development and industrialization of new types of batteries such as thin-film, concentrated, and perovskite, achieve mass production of ultra-high-purity, low-cost polycrystalline silicon, increase market share of high-efficiency, high-reliability battery components, and develop new-generation photovoltaic inverters and system integration equipment. Improve industrial supporting facilities, break through the industrialization bottleneck of key equipment for new photovoltaic cell production lines, and carry out pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing in the photovoltaic industry. Expand photovoltaic applications, promote distributed photovoltaic applications in industrial parks, key industries, and households, and promote the integration of new photovoltaic energy storage products. Electronic materials. With a focus on semiconductor materials, accelerate the development of electronic functional materials such as functional ceramics, low-temperature co-fired ceramics (LTCC) multilayer substrates, high-performance magnetic materials, battery materials, LEDs, and new power electronic devices. Support the development and industrialization of electronic-grade high-purity silicon materials, zone-melted silicon single crystals, high-purity metal and alloy sputtering targets for the semiconductor industry, power battery materials for new energy vehicles, drones, etc., and energy storage battery materials for communication base stations and photovoltaic systems, as well as new technologies for materials such as high-generation glass substrates, optical films, polarizers, high-performance liquid crystals, organic light-emitting diode (OLED) luminescent materials, large-size targets, photoresists, electronic chemicals, etc. Electronic special equipment. Focus on integrated circuits, thin-film transistor liquid crystal displays (TFT-LCD) and AMOLED displays, high-energy lithium-ion batteries, solar cells, LEDs, and complete machine processing, achieve key breakthroughs in manufacturing equipment and complete process, form supporting capabilities, and enhance domestic equipment supply capacity. Promote the research and industrialization of 3D printing equipment.
titlelist: Development focus, basic electronics.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Establish a secure and reliable basic software product system, support open source and open development models, and focus on promoting the research and development and application of basic software products such as cloud operating systems, cloud middleware, new database management systems, mobile and cloud office suites. Strengthen the synergy between technical products and terminal applications, improve the maturity of basic software, and accelerate integration, adaptation, and optimization. Promote the research and development and application of core technologies and products for industrial software and industrial control systems, with a focus on breakthroughs in core key technologies for industrial application software in key industries such as military, energy, and chemical industry, and build an advanced product system and establish evaluation standards and specifications. Breakthroughs in key technologies for industrial control systems such as high-end numerical control systems, field buses, communication protocols, high-precision high-speed control, and servo drives, and promote the research and development of high-end numerical control systems, servo systems, and control systems. Build a national industrial software security testing platform. Accelerate the layout of industrial big data software and platforms, promote the deep application of customized solutions in important industrial fields, and create an industrial cloud application service system. Column 5: Software Industry Enhancement and Development Engineering Operating System. Strengthen the research and development and industrialization of high-trust server operating systems, secure and user-friendly desktop operating systems, and trusted cloud operating systems, and develop secure and controllable operating system products. Targeting digital products and intelligent complete equipment requirements, develop high-security and high-trust real-time industrial operating systems, and achieve compatibility with mainstream control devices, CPUs, and bus protocols. Develop high-end equipment embedded systems. Industrial big data platform. Build an industrial big data platform that covers the entire product lifecycle and all manufacturing business activities, develop device-side embedded data management platforms and real-time data intelligent processing systems, and develop industrial data processing platforms for industrial data collection, storage, querying, analysis, mining, and application in the cloud. Industrial cloud and core software for manufacturing. Research and develop the Internet+ industrial cloud system architecture and standard system, and build knowledge, data, service, and other resource repositories. Build industry-oriented industrial cloud service platforms and provide data-driven enterprise management, business collaboration, energy management, and other services. Accelerate the development of core software for manufacturing such as product lifecycle management, enterprise resource planning, supply chain management, and customer relationship management, and improve the level of industrialization. Industrial application software. Targeting key areas such as aerospace equipment, high-end numerical control machine tools and robots, advanced rail transit equipment, offshore engineering equipment and high-tech ships, power equipment, and agricultural machinery equipment, develop industry application software and solutions that cover the entire lifecycle, with a focus on breakthroughs in key technologies such as product innovation and development, intelligent control and analysis optimization, and equipment intelligent services, and develop an industrial application software system.
titlelist: Development focus, basic software and industrial software.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Focus on developing software platforms and application systems based on new computing frameworks and application scenarios such as cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, and the Internet of Things. Targeting key needs in government applications, public services, and industry development, concentrate on breakthroughs in key application software and industry solutions, and deepen their popularization and application. Support software and information technology service enterprises to actively develop application solutions and provide information technology services in the field of public services, promote deep cooperation between software enterprises and traditional industry enterprises, accelerate the development and application of software and solutions that support the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, and cultivate a group of comprehensive solution providers.
titlelist: Development focus, key application software and industry solutions.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Breakthroughs in artificial intelligence, low-power lightweight systems, intelligent perception, and new human-machine interaction technologies are key. The focus is on developing intelligent wearable devices, smart homes, intelligent car terminals, smart healthcare, intelligent robots, intelligent unmanned systems, and other products for the next generation of mobile internet and information consumption. Customized terminal products for specific needs and specialized mobile intelligent terminal products for specific industries and special network applications are also being developed. Develop high-level Internet+ artificial intelligence platforms to enhance the supply capacity of consumer-grade and industrial-grade intelligent hardware products and services. Accelerate innovation in intelligent perception technology, with a focus on promoting the application of millimeter wave and terahertz, cellular narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT), intelligent voice, and other technologies in key areas such as public safety and the Internet of Things. Support the development and industrialization of virtual reality products and explore applications in fields such as design and manufacturing, healthcare, and entertainment. Enrich the supply of smart home products, with a focus on increasing the supply of new consumer electronics products such as smart TVs, smart speakers, and smart service robots, and promote the improvement of the smart home industry chain, guiding the industry towards a product + service transformation and upgrade. Develop smart health and elderly care services, support the development of wearable devices for health monitoring and management, and home care. Promote innovation and application demonstrations in smart transportation, and promote the construction of smart car and smart transportation demonstration areas based on broadband mobile internet. Actively promote the research and application of industrial electronics, medical electronics, automotive electronics, energy electronics, financial electronics, and other products. Develop emerging intelligent hardware. Develop intelligent wearable, in-car, home, healthcare, service robots, and drones, strengthen low-power lightweight underlying software and hardware systems, high-precision intelligent sensors, high-performance motion and posture control, new human-machine interaction, virtual reality, fast charging, and lightweight energy storage core technologies, and develop Internet+ artificial intelligence platforms. Promote application demonstrations in key areas. Develop innovation demonstration zones and advanced innovation platforms, and strengthen the construction of standard systems. Intelligent perception. Strongly support breakthroughs in core technologies such as millimeter wave and terahertz, and carry out application demonstrations in key areas such as public safety to develop security inspection and security equipment and solutions that meet user needs, and establish and improve relevant technical standards, application specifications, and testing systems. Actively develop low-power wide-area Internet of Things technologies such as NB-IoT, support cooperation with local and backbone enterprises to promote the application demonstrations of NB-IoT technology in smart cities, environmental monitoring, industrial logistics, and other fields, and build an open and collaborative low-power wide-area Internet of Things innovation chain. Build an intelligent voice promotion and demonstration platform, promote the cloud application and service development of intelligent voice recognition in key industries. Virtual reality. Support the development of core devices such as core chips, display devices, optical devices, and sensors, accelerate the development of core technologies such as virtual reality modeling and simulation, augmented reality and human-machine interaction, integrated environments and tools, support the development and industrialization of virtual reality display terminals, interaction devices, and content acquisition and processing devices. Establish a public service platform for the development of the virtual reality industry, build a standard system for virtual reality products, systems, and services, and conduct product service quality evaluation and verification. Smart transportation. Breakthroughs in fast image processing, multi-source information fusion, and other core technologies, develop in-vehicle terminal devices that support 5G communication, dedicated network communication, Beidou navigation positioning, and dedicated radar, as well as intelligent in-vehicle operating system platforms. Establish policy coordination, technology integration, and industry-finance docking platforms, develop smart cars and smart transportation applications based on broadband mobile internet, and create integrated emerging industry clusters. Cultivate a diversified application ecosystem for in-vehicle terminals, promote the standardization of underlying operating systems and human-vehicle interaction (HMI) systems for intelligent connected vehicles, break through a batch of core key technologies for automotive electronics, and accelerate the industrial application of autonomous driving assistance systems, in-vehicle information systems, intelligent navigation systems, and active collision avoidance systems. Promote the construction of key application demonstration areas, carry out demonstrations of intelligent driving, intelligent road networks, intelligent charging, and convenient parking, and form replicable models. Smart health and elderly care services. Develop intelligent wearable devices for health management, daily health monitoring devices, home rehabilitation treatment products, monitoring devices, and self-service medical service terminals for home/community use. Support the demonstration of smart health and elderly care applications and work with relevant departments to promote supportive policies. Support enterprises in the research and development of medical and health electronic products and systems, promote the improvement of intelligent terminals and systems for health care and home-based elderly care. Promote the research and industrialization of digital universal medical diagnosis and treatment equipment, promote the research and application of key components, and enhance the industrialization capability and technological level of universal medical equipment. Digital television. Promote the transformation and upgrade of the digital television industry towards networking, intelligence, and service-oriented development, enrich the supply of smart home products, improve the industry standard system for smart TVs and smart homes, promote the research and application of smart TV chips and systems, accelerate the development of new display terminals, and improve the management services of internet TV reception terminals. Promote research and application of next-generation audio and video standards.
titlelist: Development focus: smart hardware and application electronics.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Guide the cooperation between the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain, break through the core devices such as high-end server and storage equipment core processors, memory chips, and input/output (I/O) chips, and build a complete high-end server, storage equipment, and other core information equipment industry system. Research new computing technologies such as neural computing and quantum computing. Support the development of low-power, low-cost, and green computing products, strengthen the compatibility of chips, software, systems, and application services, carry out green computing application demonstrations, enrich application service models, and promote the healthy development of the green computing ecosystem. Innovate the cooperation mechanism of the green computing industry, build a public service platform for innovative green computing products, develop and improve green computing interface standards, application specifications, and product testing and certification systems. Accelerate the research, development, and industrialization of high-performance secure industrial control computers, as well as information security products such as trusted computing, data security, and network security. Support the application of secure and reliable industrial control computers in important sectors of the national economy such as power grids, water conservancy, energy, and petrochemicals. Develop high-speed optical transmission equipment and large-capacity network scheduling optical transmission equipment, and develop intelligent optical networks and technologies and equipment such as high-speed, high-capacity, long-distance optical transmission and fiber-to-the-x (FTTx). Actively promote the research, development, and manufacturing of next-generation network devices such as 5G, IPv6, SDN, and NFV.
titlelist: Development focus: computer and communication equipment.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Breakthrough key technologies and products in big data, cultivate and strengthen the big data service industry, and improve the big data industrial system. Deepen the innovation of big data applications, develop big data services and complete solutions for the industrial sector. Encourage industrial enterprises to integrate data resources at all stages and carry out new businesses such as personalized customization, crowdsourced design, intelligent monitoring, full industry chain traceability, online monitoring and diagnosis, industrial control system security monitoring, and intelligent manufacturing based on big data applications. Guide enterprises to accelerate business and service model innovation, build a new system of livelihood services based on big data, expand and enrich the scope, form, and content of services in urban management fields such as public safety, natural disaster prevention and control, and environmental protection. Carry out the creation of big data industrial agglomeration development and application demonstration zones. Conduct application pilots in key industries, promote the secure and reliable software and hardware application of big data systems in government, finance, energy, and other important industries. Cultivate new data service industries and enterprises such as data collection, data analysis, data security, and data trading. Accelerate the development of the big data trading industry under the premise of legal compliance and controllable security, and carry out pilot demonstrations of third-party data trading platform construction. Organize the formulation of general rules for data trading circulation and information disclosure systems, gradually improve systems such as personal information protection, data security, and intellectual property protection in data trading circulation, and establish industry self-discipline and supervision mechanisms for data trading circulation.
titlelist: Development focus, big data

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Actively develop cloud services such as Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), Platform as a Service (PaaS), Software as a Service (SaaS), etc., enhance the capabilities of public cloud services, expand the scope of private cloud applications, focus on industrial, financial, telecommunications, employment, social security, transportation, education, environmental protection, safety supervision, and other key areas of application needs, support the construction of national or regional hybrid cloud service platforms. Vigorously develop cloud service applications, promote the migration of various information systems to cloud computing service platforms. Actively develop cloud-based personal information storage, online tools, learning, entertainment, and other services. Encourage large enterprises to open platform resources and strengthen the construction of industry cloud service platforms. Establish cloud computing platforms that provide basic management services such as office, production, finance, marketing, and human resources for small and medium-sized enterprises. Vigorously develop services such as cloud computing information system planning consulting, solution design, system integration, and testing and evaluation. Support third-party organizations in conducting evaluations and assessments of cloud computing service quality, reliability, and network security. Optimize the layout of cloud computing infrastructure and build a comprehensive cloud computing standard system. Improve the network information security management system in the cloud computing environment, strengthen the construction of technical management systems, enhance the evaluation of new technologies and new businesses, and prevent network information security risks.
titlelist: Development focus, cloud computing

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Implement major application demonstration projects for the Internet of Things, develop open-loop applications for the Internet of Things, accelerate the deep integration of Internet of Things technology with industrial development, livelihood services, daily consumption, urban management, energy, environmental protection, safety supervision, and other fields, and form a batch of comprehensive integrated solutions. Apply Internet of Things technology to promote precision farming, intelligent horticulture, and efficient livestock and poultry farming, and promote the development of modern agricultural management methods and organizational forms. Focus on applications such as connected cars, smart healthcare, smart homes, and smart wearable devices, and accelerate the innovation of Internet of Things applications in the consumer sector through integration with mobile internet. Promote the planning and layout of Internet of Things sensing facilities and deepen the application of the Internet of Things in smart city infrastructure management. Establish a city-level Internet of Things access management and data aggregation platform, promote unified access, centralized management, and shared use of sensing devices. Vigorously develop the industrial Internet, establish an industrial Internet industry alliance, accelerate the formulation of industrial Internet standards, and promote collaborative innovation in the industry. Organize industrial Internet pilot demonstrations, build public service platforms and management platforms, strengthen infrastructure construction, and comprehensively build a low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage industrial Internet. Column 7: Carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial Internet innovation applications in the industrial Internet industry promotion pilot demonstration project. Support enterprises to carry out innovative application demonstrations in areas such as wireless applications in factories, identification resolution, industrial Ethernet, IPv6 applications, industrial cloud computing, industrial big data, and the integration of the internet and industry. Build an industrial Internet technology experimental verification platform. Based on clarifying the development path of key technologies for China's industrial Internet, support relevant units in constructing experimental verification platforms for key technologies of the industrial Internet, and test, verify, and evaluate key technologies. Build an industrial Internet key resource management platform. Support relevant units in building an industrial Internet identification resolution system based on technologies such as big data and cloud platforms. Upgrade and transform the ICP/IP address/domain name information filing management system and build a comprehensive management platform for IPv6 address resources for the industrial Internet. Build an industrial Internet network data service platform. Meet the needs of enterprises in industrial data analysis, utilization, and circulation, provide a secure and trustworthy computing environment, and perform compliance and security audits of industrial Internet network data circulation behavior to support the management of industrial Internet network data.
titlelist: Development focus, Internet of Things

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Innovate fiscal support methods, optimize fiscal fund allocation, fully utilize policy funds such as the National Emerging Industry Venture Capital Guidance Fund, Advanced Manufacturing Industry Investment Fund, Small and Medium-sized Enterprise Development Fund, and National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund to guide social funds and support the development of major industrial projects. Strengthen resource coordination, fully utilize existing funding channels to support the layout of major productive forces, industrialization of key products, and demonstration projects of key products. Improve and implement government procurement policies that support innovation, promote the research and development and application of innovative products and services in the information industry. Encourage local governments to actively explore the use of government vouchers and other methods to support information enterprises in introducing innovative technologies, purchasing or leasing equipment, and cultivating talents. Continue to implement tax support policies for software and integrated circuits, as well as policies such as additional deduction for research and development expenses and accelerated depreciation of fixed assets, to promote equipment upgrades and the application of new technologies. Promote the inclusion of eligible major information technology equipment in the Guidance Catalog for the Promotion and Application of First Set (Batch) of Major Technical Equipment, and support the promotion and application through relevant insurance compensation pilot programs.
titlelist: Policy measures, improving financial and tax support policies.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Establish a sound multi-level capital market, support innovative and entrepreneurial enterprises in the information industry that meet the conditions to fully utilize the GEM (Growth Enterprise Market) to broaden their financing channels, and promote eligible small and medium-sized enterprises in the information industry listed on the National Equities Exchange and Quotations (NEEQ) to transfer to the GEM. Enrich direct financing tools for the information industry, actively promote the application of project income notes, project income bonds, convertible bonds, and other financial instruments. Increase the integration of production and finance information, establish and improve inter-departmental coordination mechanisms, and build service platforms. Encourage commercial banks to innovate credit products and financial services, promote financing through intellectual property pledges, equity pledges, supply chain financing, credit insurance policy pledges, and other financial product innovations. Increase financial support for the development of the information industry under the premise of risk control and commercial sustainability. Encourage development-oriented and policy-oriented financial institutions to provide credit support for eligible projects in the information industry within their business scope. In accordance with the unified deployment of the state, guide and support eligible financial institutions to explore pilot programs for investment and loan linkage in the electronic information field in pilot areas, and guide banking financial institutions to implement differentiated credit policies for key areas of the information industry involved in the Internet Plus initiative. Support eligible information industry enterprises in establishing fund management platforms. Encourage backbone enterprises in the information industry to carry out overseas mergers and acquisitions through merger notes, merger funds, merger bonds, etc.
titlelist: Policy measures, increase financial support efforts.

name: Guidelines for the Development of the Information Industry (excerpt) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 453) (MIIT, NDRC/January 17, 2017)
content: Encourage universities to strengthen the construction of emerging disciplines and majors in the information industry, formulate talent training goals and quality standards based on industry development needs, encourage school-enterprise cooperation, and establish talent training bases. Train various types of scientific research personnel, technical personnel, and compound talents urgently needed by the industry, and jointly carry out on-the-job training for employees. Continue to do a good job in the training base for national software and integrated circuit talents, give full play to the role of the base, and shorten the talent training cycle. Encourage enterprises to strengthen talent cooperation through industry associations and promote the exchange of talents between the information industry and traditional manufacturing industry. Establish a comprehensive information platform for integrated employment talents. Implement projects to improve the quality of enterprise management talents and update the knowledge of professional and technical talents, with a focus on urgently needed talents, and focus on strengthening the training of professional and technical talents and management talents in the field of information technology. Do a good job in vocational training and vocational qualification certification. Strengthen talent demand investigation and prediction, and establish a sound information database for high-level talents in the information industry. Establish databases for computer technology and software professional technical qualifications (levels) examinations and communication professional technical level examinations, and provide services for enterprise personnel selection and employment. Promote two-way talent exchange, encourage professional and technical talents to study, train, and exchange abroad, and focus on implementing special training programs for software and integrated circuit talents going abroad; continue to implement the introduction plan for foreign experts in the software and integrated circuit industries, and introduce a group of academically influential leaders and key technology project leaders. Improve talent introduction and incentive policies that meet the requirements of the information industry development, innovate introduction channels, and actively introduce high-end talents in new fields such as new displays, smart hardware, cloud computing, and big data.
titlelist: Policy measures, vigorously cultivating industry talents.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The period of the 12th Five-Year Plan is a crucial period for China to adhere to the path of new industrialization, accelerate the transformation of economic development, and comprehensively build a moderately prosperous society. It is also a period of tackling the challenges for the electronic information manufacturing industry to adjust its structure, transform its methods, enhance its core competitiveness, improve the quality and efficiency of development, and become stronger. In order to implement the Outline of the 12th Five-Year Plan for National Economic and Social Development, and in accordance with the overall deployment and requirements of the 12th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Transformation and Upgrading, the 12th Five-Year Plan for Informationization of National Economic and Social Development, and the 12th Five-Year Plan for Information Industry Development, the 12th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry has been formulated as a guiding document for the development of the electronic information manufacturing industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan period.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: In 2010, the sales revenue of China's electronic information manufacturing industry reached 6,394.5 billion yuan, doubling from 3,101 billion yuan in 2005, with an average annual growth rate of over 15% in the five-year period. Exports accounted for over 30% of the country's total foreign trade exports. The production of major electronic products such as color TVs, microcomputers, and mobile phones reached 120 million units, 250 million units, and 1 billion units respectively, accounting for over 40% of the global total production. The average annual growth rates in the five-year period were 7.4%, 24.9%, and 26.9% respectively. The number of employees in the electronic information manufacturing industry reached 8.8 million, an increase of 3.29 million from 2005, accounting for 10% of the country's industrial workforce, up from 8% in 2005. The table shows the growth of key indicators in the electronic information manufacturing industry during the 11th Five-Year Plan period (2005-2010). The indicators include sales revenue (in billion yuan), profit (in billion yuan), export volume (in billion US dollars), and number of employees (in ten thousand). The average annual growth rates are also provided.
titlelist: Review of the development during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, with steady expansion of industrial scale.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The pace of technological upgrading and replacement is accelerating, with strong growth in high-end products. In 2010, the proportion of flat-panel TVs and laptops in color TVs and computers exceeded 75%. Multiple 12-inch integrated circuit lines and the first sixth-generation LCD panel line were completed and put into production. Actively adapting to the new trends of networking, intelligence, and service, large-scale integrated enterprises are extending into the service field, focusing on the development of emerging applications such as mobile internet, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things. The concentration of the industry has significantly increased, and the competitiveness of backbone enterprises represented by the top 100 enterprises has been significantly enhanced. From 2005 to 2010, the main business income of the top 100 electronic information enterprises increased from 964.3 billion yuan to 1.5354 trillion yuan, accounting for 1/4 of the industry's sales revenue, over 1/3 of the profit, and over 1/2 of the tax revenue. Companies such as Huawei, Lenovo, and Haier with sales revenue exceeding 100 billion yuan have emerged. The development pace in the central and western regions has accelerated. From 2008 to 2010, the sales revenue growth rate of the electronic information manufacturing industry above a certain scale was more than 10 percentage points higher than the national average for three consecutive years.
titlelist: Review of the Development during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, Initial Results of Structural Adjustment

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The industrial added value, sales revenue, profits, and employment share of the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, Bohai Rim, and Fujian-Xiamen coastal areas have all exceeded 80%. These regions have established a highly refined industrial supporting division of labor system and possess a relatively complete industrial supporting capacity. They have developed into internationally-oriented production and manufacturing bases that have an impact on the global market, thereby enhancing China's position in the global industrial chain. The ability of the central and western regions to undertake industrial transfer has continuously strengthened, forming industrial bases characterized by the development of whole machine manufacturing, optoelectronics, flat panel displays, solar photovoltaics, and other industries. The agglomeration effect of industries is increasingly evident.
titlelist: Review of the development during the Eleventh Five-Year Plan period, with significant effects of industrial agglomeration development.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Information technology and products have played a positive role in promoting industrial transformation and upgrading, and promoting the deep integration of the two industries. The popularity rate of digital design tools in major industries such as steel, chemical, automotive, shipbuilding, and aviation exceeds 60%. The rate of key process automation exceeds 50%, and the pace of integration between manufacturing technology and information technology is accelerating. Information technology has deeply integrated and penetrated into the industrial field. The development of products and information systems in automotive electronics, machine tool electronics, medical electronics, intelligent transportation, and financial electronics, which have a large market and strong driving force, has been rapid. It has provided important technical and product support for accelerating the construction of the national economy and social informatization and ensuring information security. After five years of development, China's position as a major electronic information manufacturing country has been further consolidated, and its overall strength has reached a new level. However, there are still prominent deep-level problems and structural contradictions in the development of the industry, mainly manifested as: key core technologies are controlled by others, the industry as a whole is still in the low-end of the value chain, the proportion of contract manufacturing and processing trade is relatively high, research and development investment intensity still lags behind developed countries, resource allocation is relatively scattered, the industrial policy environment urgently needs improvement, and the mechanism for driving domestic demand is not yet sound. These problems and contradictions have constrained the transformation of China's electronic information manufacturing industry from being large to being strong, and need to be addressed during the Twelfth Five-Year Plan period.
titlelist: Review of the 11th Five-Year Plan: The Increasingly Prominent Role of Support and Leadership

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The boundaries of various industries in the information industry are gradually becoming blurred. Information and communication technology is increasingly being applied in various terminal products. Emerging fields such as cloud computing, the Internet of Things, and mobile internet are flourishing. There is a shift in the key links of the value chain, with the value-added of assembly and manufacturing processes decreasing. International leading companies are focusing on content and service links to accelerate the integration of the industry chain and compete for dominance in the industry chain. Manufacturing, software, operations, and content service industries are rapidly merging. New technologies, products, and models continue to emerge, bringing fierce impact to traditional industrial systems and driving significant changes in the industry landscape. This not only brings new opportunities and space for development to our country but also poses severe challenges of new rounds of technological and market monopolies.
