titlelist: The situation faced during the 12th Five-Year Plan period involves significant changes in the industrial structure driven by the integration of innovation.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: In the process of transitioning from the traditional industrialization path to a new industrialization path, and promoting the overall optimization and upgrading of industrial structure, information technology and products have been continuously and deeply applied in various fields and production processes of industry. The comprehensive integration level has been continuously improved, and it has accelerated integration with products such as automobiles, ships, machinery and equipment, and new materials, creating broad market space for industrial development. At the same time, with the rise of strategic emerging industries such as energy conservation and environmental protection, high-end equipment manufacturing, and new energy vehicles, information technology will be more deeply applied in various fields of the economy and society, forming a group of industrial growth points with wide radiation range and strong driving force, providing a solid guarantee for the sustained, stable and healthy development of the industry.
titlelist: The situation faced during the 12th Five-Year Plan period has given rise to new areas of industrial growth through industrial transformation and upgrading.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: During the 12th Five-Year Plan period, the annual average growth rate of sales revenue in China's electronic information manufacturing industry remained at around 10%, exceeding 10 trillion yuan in 2015. The annual average growth rate of industrial value-added exceeded 12%. The sales revenue of strategic emerging sectors in the electronic information manufacturing industry grew at an annual average rate of 25%. Steady progress has been made in the transformation and upgrading of processing trade, encouraging processing trade enterprises to extend the industrial chain and enhance product added value, with the proportion of general trade continuously increasing. The core competitiveness and market influence of backbone enterprises and independent brands have been significantly enhanced, with the formation of 5 to 8 large-scale backbone enterprises with sales revenue exceeding one trillion yuan, and efforts to cultivate large enterprises with sales revenue exceeding 500 billion yuan. Efforts are being made to create a number of new industrialization demonstration bases and industrial parks with international influence, distinctive features, and reasonable supporting facilities.
titlelist: The development ideas and goals of the 12th Five-Year Plan, development goals, structural goals.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The research and development investment of the top 100 companies accounts for more than 5% of their sales revenue; the cumulative total of invention patent applications in the field of information technology reaches around 1.3 million; breakthroughs have been made in a number of core key technologies in the fields of integrated circuits, new display devices, key components, important electronic materials, and electronic special equipment and instruments. Integrated circuit products meet nearly 30% of domestic market demand, and chip manufacturing technology has reached 12 inches, 32/28 nanometers. The self-sufficiency rate of flat panel TV panels is over 80%; a complete TD-LTE industrial system has been established.
titlelist: The development ideas and goals of the 12th Five-Year Plan, development goals, innovation goals.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Significantly improve the energy efficiency of computer, television, and other whole machine products; further reduce energy and resource consumption in the production process, with the average comprehensive electricity consumption of solar-grade polysilicon production below 120 kilowatt-hours per kilogram, the copper recycling rate in the printed circuit industry increased to over 80%, and the water recycling rate increased to over 30%; effectively control the use of toxic and harmful substances such as lead, mercury, and cadmium; significantly improve the recycling and reuse rate of waste electrical and electronic products.
titlelist: The development ideas and goals of the 12th Five-Year Plan, development goals, energy conservation and environmental protection goals.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Track and grasp the key directions and industrial opportunities of the new generation of information technology, with enterprises as the main body, adhere to the combination of industry, academia, research, and application, improve the innovation system, enhance innovation capabilities, and concentrate efforts and resources to break through core key technologies. Guided by the demand for complete machines, vigorously develop high-performance integrated circuit products; accelerate the development of new types of flat panel displays, sensors, and other key components, improve the supporting capabilities of dedicated electronic equipment, instruments, and materials; based on independent technologies in the fields of the new generation of mobile communications, next-generation Internet, Internet of Things, cloud computing, etc., promote the upgrading and replacement of computers, communication equipment, and audiovisual products.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, main tasks, focus on breakthroughs in core key technologies, comprehensively enhance the core competitiveness of the industry.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Increase the intensity of technological transformation in enterprises, establish and improve a long-term mechanism for technological transformation, and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of enterprises. Encourage and guide enterprise mergers and reorganizations, support leading backbone enterprises in carrying out mergers and acquisitions. Vigorously promote the integration of industrial chains, improve the management and operation level of industrial chains, and strengthen the overall competitiveness of industrial chains. Use capital as a link to promote resource integration and industrial integration, accelerate the development and formation of a group of multinational corporations that have key core technologies, outstanding innovation capabilities, high brand recognition, and strong international competitiveness. Promote the development of small and medium-sized enterprises towards the direction of specialization, refinement, uniqueness, and novelty, and jointly build a rational division of labor system with large enterprises. Explore innovative cooperation mechanisms, strengthen cooperation and collaboration between enterprises, promote the formation of a close collaborative research and development system, and support the establishment of industry alliances.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, main tasks, promote the growth and strengthening of enterprises, and construct a rational division of labor system.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Make full use of the opportunities provided by domestic informatization and urbanization construction, vigorously explore the industry application market of electronic information products, and continuously meet the diverse needs of urban and rural consumers. Actively expand the international market, continuously optimize the export structure, increase efforts in developing emerging markets, and promote diversification of the export market. Implement the going global strategy, encourage eligible backbone enterprises to establish branches overseas, expand market channels, and establish research and development centers through policy support, credit guarantees, and improvement of customs clearance services. Enhance cooperation at multiple levels with overseas technology enterprises and research institutions to enhance international competitiveness.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, main tasks, coordinate the use of domestic and foreign market resources, promote balanced industrial development.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Highlight source control and end treatment to build a green development model for the entire life cycle of products. Construct a technological support and public service platform for green industrial development, and strengthen the research and development of energy-saving and clean production technologies and processes. According to the characteristics of various industries, establish an environmental impact assessment system and an energy efficiency standard system. Improve the standards and testing levels of low-carbon and environmentally friendly electronic products, and reduce the use of toxic and harmful substances. Strictly control the discharge of three wastes and encourage the recycling, treatment, and reuse of electronic products.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, main tasks, actively promote green manufacturing, achieve sustainable and healthy development of the industry.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Support the multi-level cooperation between information technology enterprises and traditional industrial enterprises, promote the widespread application of information technology and products in various industrial fields, improve the automation, intelligence, and informatization level of industrial research and development, design, production, manufacturing, marketing, and service processes, support the research and development and industrialization of applied electronic products and systems, and effectively promote the deep integration of the two industries. Promote the deep application of information technology and products in transportation, energy, water conservancy, environmental protection, and other fields, accelerate the intelligentization process of important national infrastructure in people's livelihood; vigorously promote the widespread application of information technology and products in medical and health care, transportation, culture and education, employment, and social security, and improve the level of public services.
titlelist: Main tasks and development priorities, main tasks, deepening the application of information technology, serving economic and social development.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Focused on the development of basic industries and strategic emerging industries, efforts are being made to build specialized public service platforms for integrated circuits, flat panel displays, digital homes, cloud computing, the Internet of Things, solar photovoltaics, and green lighting. These platforms provide professional services such as technology research and development, achievement transformation, capital operation, intellectual property rights, standard setting, product testing, qualification certification, talent services, enterprise incubation, and brand promotion. Strengthening industrial cooperation, relying on industry organizations, promoting the construction of information technology application platforms in key industrial sectors, and providing common technical support and public services. Relying on industrial bases and specialized parks, a distinctive regional public service system is being built to guide and strengthen the construction of supporting service systems for electronic information industry clusters.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities are to improve the public service system and optimize the environment for industrial development.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Accelerate the innovation of cutting-edge computer technology, achieve breakthroughs in core technology and key areas, further enhance the independent research and development, industrial design, and motherboard manufacturing capabilities of computer products, and enhance the core competitiveness of the industry. Grasp the development trend of mobile Internet, vigorously develop mobile intelligent terminals such as lightweight and portable, low power consumption, touch, high-definition, and three-dimensional (3D) display laptops, tablet computers, as well as new types of computers such as large screens and touch-screen all-in-ones; promote the integration of the terminal + application + service industrial chain and promote the extension of whole-machine enterprises to services. Strengthen the research and industrialization of computer peripherals and consumables, develop color network laser printers, scanners, projectors, flash memory, and smart entertainment and education products. Strongly support the research and application of high-security industrial control computers, industrial control products, and systems, accelerate the research on the new generation of industrial control computer architecture, actively carry out research on the basic software and hardware platforms, security, and reliability technologies of industrial control computers, enhance the competitiveness of China's industrial control products and systems, and promote the application of industrial control products and systems in the fields of process control, safety production, energy saving and consumption reduction, environmental monitoring, intelligent transportation, intelligent buildings, and smart grids. Accelerate the research and application of secure and reliable computers, strengthen research on information security technology, vigorously promote the research and industrialization of information security products such as network security, trusted computing, and data security. With the application demand of cloud computing as the traction, focus on breakthroughs in core technologies of virtualization, load balancing, cloud storage, and green energy saving, support the research and industrialization of key products such as servers, network equipment, storage systems, and cloud service terminals suitable for cloud computing, establish a complete cloud computing-related industrial chain, provide complete equipment solutions for large-scale demonstration applications of cloud computing, and improve the public service system of cloud computing. Strengthen the research and development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, break through key technologies such as IoT sensing information collection, transmission, processing, and feedback control, support the research and industrialization of key products such as wireless radio frequency identification (RFID), coding recognition devices, and sensing and processing control nodes, establish and improve the IoT standard system, and promote the application of IoT. In response to the development needs of the next generation of the Internet, focus on supporting the research and industrialization of key network devices such as high-performance routers, high-capacity aggregation switches, and smart gateways, and accelerate the internationalization of independent intellectual property technology standards.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, computer.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Seize the opportunities of the construction of the new generation communication network and the rapid development of the mobile internet. Increase the research and development efforts of TD-SCDMA terminals, promote the research and industrialization of long-term evolution technology and enhanced long-term evolution technology (LTE/LTE-Advanced). Study the key technologies of wireless and network organization, network evolution, and multi-technology coordination in the application process of LTE/LTE-Advanced, promote the research and development of key technologies and products such as new green base stations, wireless network organization, and wireless network energy-saving and emission reduction, and promote the application demonstration of TD-SCDMA/LTE/LTE-Advanced in key areas such as digital cities and rural informatization. Accelerate the research and development and industrialization process of mobile internet-related technology products and business applications, focus on supporting key technologies and products such as new mobile internet terminals, terminal core chips, operating systems, middleware, as well as IP bearer networks, access perception and control, mobile internet platforms and resource key technology research and industrialization. Support multi-mode, multi-frequency terminal chips and efficient, low-cost terminals, IPv6/v4 dual-stack network equipment and terminals, network testing special instruments, antennas, and other key supporting industrial systems. Promote the development of intelligent optical networks and high-capacity, high-speed, long-distance optical transmission, fiber-to-the-x (FTTx) and other technologies and products. Focus on supporting N×100Gbit/s wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) high-speed optical transmission equipment, N×Tbit/s cross-capacity optical transport network/packet transport network (OTN/PTN) large-capacity network scheduling optical transmission equipment, support the research and development and industrialization of intelligent control plane optical switching equipment, optical transmission equipment; support the research and development and industrialization of 10G passive optical network (PON) line-side equipment and optical network units, PON interoperability testing systems; support high-end modules such as high-speed coherent optical receivers, high-power low-noise optical amplifiers, wavelength-selective optical switches, high-speed laser chips, optoelectronic integrated components, optoelectronic integrated chips, high-speed analog-to-digital chips, etc. Promote the development of broadband wireless access, multimedia digital cluster, and digital intercom technology and industry. Support the research and development and industrialization of low-cost broadband access for wide-area coverage, ultra-high-speed wireless local area network, digital cluster communication and digital intercom technology and products for dedicated network applications, and accelerate the maturity and wider application of wireless local area network authentication and confidentiality infrastructure (WAPI) technology. Promote the application demonstration in key areas and industries such as government affairs, public safety, energy, logistics, transportation, and modern agriculture, enhance the capabilities of relevant technology products in resource dynamic allocation, management and scheduling, coordinated interference reduction, load balancing, adaptive and self-organizing networks, network security, and information confidentiality, and build a complete industrial chain of dedicated communication systems for industry sectors. Actively promote the research and development, industrialization, and application promotion of products based on the Beidou satellite communication navigation system.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, communication equipment.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Accelerate the transformation and upgrading of the color TV industry, strengthen the research and application of new backlight technology, 3D technology, laser technology, and energy-saving technology, and enhance the control capability of core technologies. Speed up the development of new products such as 3D TVs, internet TVs, and smart TVs, and continuously improve the added value of products. Support leading companies in the industry to extend into upstream areas such as panels and modules, support the research and industrialization of core chips, software, key components, integrated modules, and specialized equipment for the color TV industry, promote the integration of terminal manufacturing and content service industries, and enhance the competitiveness of the entire flat-panel TV industry chain. Focus on supporting the research and industrialization of digital home smart terminals, internet gateways, multi-service systems, and application support platforms; support the research and application of intelligent and networked video surveillance equipment and application systems; vigorously promote the demonstration application of digital homes and the construction of digital home industry bases. Accelerate the popularization of terrestrial digital TV receivers, support the application of independent audio and video standards such as AVS and DRA, and further promote the domestic and international application of terrestrial digital TV standards. Support the development of digital TV studio equipment, transmission equipment, transmission equipment, and receiving equipment, encourage the development of high-density laser disc players, digital sound systems, and digital film equipment, and promote the digital, networked, intelligent, and energy-saving development of the audiovisual industry. Support backbone enterprises to strengthen quality brand building and international operations, and create globally competitive leading companies and well-known brands. Column 1: Whole machine value chain enhancement project. Product innovation. Support the innovation of computers, communication equipment, and terminals based on mobile internet services, as well as product innovation, technological innovation, and model innovation based on cloud computing; support the research and industrialization of key products such as high-end servers and network storage systems, and promote the research and industrialization of key equipment for green intelligent data centers and various terminal products; support the research and industrialization of networked, intelligent, energy-saving digital TV products and 3D TVs; support the research and industrialization of digital home smart terminals that integrate multiple screens; promote the research on key technologies and system technologies of the next-generation terrestrial digital TV transmission system and build a multi-service platform; support the deep involvement of whole machine products in chip research and industrialization. Model innovation. Promote large-scale electronic information product manufacturing enterprises to extend into the service field, strengthen the integration of design, manufacturing, and service, and promote the integration of the industrial chain around core value links; seize the opportunity of rapid development of emerging applications such as cloud computing and mobile internet, explore value-added services, and innovate business models; improve the industrial public service system, promote the construction of open operation platforms, content service platforms, network service platforms, product testing and certification platforms, and intellectual property service platforms. Brand building. Support digital audiovisual, computer, and communication equipment manufacturing enterprises in building independent brands, enhance the international competitiveness of domestic equipment and terminals; guide enterprises to strengthen product quality management, improve product quality management systems, and enhance brand image; encourage enterprises to strengthen international strategic cooperation, accelerate the construction of secure and controllable market channels; formulate intellectual property strategies, and promote the industrialization and international application of independent intellectual property standards.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, digital audiovisual.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: With the focus on whole machine and major information application as the driving force, we will strengthen technological innovation, model innovation, and institutional innovation, focus on the development of the design industry, strengthen the chip manufacturing industry, improve packaging and testing capabilities, enhance the independent development capabilities of key equipment, instruments, and materials, and promote the growth and strengthening of the integrated circuit industry. We will focus on the development of the chip design industry and develop high-performance integrated circuit products. We will break through high-end general chips such as CPU/digital signal processors (DSP)/memory, and focus on the development of network communication chips, mixed-signal chips, information security chips, digital TV chips, RFID chips, sensor chips, automotive electronic chips, and other large-scale and wide-ranging products, as well as dedicated integrated circuit products in the fields of integration of the two industries, strategic emerging industries, and key areas, to form system solution capabilities. We will strengthen the scale of chip manufacturing industry and enhance advanced and characteristic process capabilities. We will continue to support the technological upgrading and capacity expansion of 12-inch advanced process manufacturing lines and 8-inch/6-inch characteristic process manufacturing lines. We will accelerate the research and development and application of 45-nanometer and below manufacturing process technologies, strengthen the development of standard process, characteristic process module, and IP core. We will improve the level and capability of packaging and testing industry, develop advanced packaging and testing technologies and products. In line with the important development direction of diversified integrated circuit products, we will vigorously develop advanced packaging and testing technologies, promote the progress of high-density stacked three-dimensional packaging products, support the upgrading of packaging process technologies and capacity expansion. We will improve the level of testing technology and the scale of the industry. We will improve the industrial chain, break through key special equipment, instruments, materials, and electronic design automation (EDA) tools. We will promote the industrialization process of 8-inch integrated circuit equipment, support the research and development of 12-inch integrated circuit production equipment, materials, tools, and instruments, form a complete set of processes, promote the large-scale application of domestic equipment on production lines, promote close cooperation among various links in the integrated circuit industry chain, establish test platforms, and accelerate industrialization.
titlelist: The main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, integrated circuits.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: We will vigorously develop new chip components based on Surface Mount Technology (SMT), actively support the research and industrialization of new components based on Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) technology, and passive integrated components based on Low-Temperature Co-Fired Ceramics (LTCC) technology. We will strive to develop key electronic components such as relays, connectors, micro motors, and supercapacitors required for automotive electronic systems. We will accelerate the research and industrialization of nickel-hydrogen batteries, power-type and energy storage-type lithium-ion batteries, battery management systems, and battery grouping technologies for new energy vehicles. We will promote the development of low-cost fiber optic cables, optical devices, frequency devices, digital audio devices, and mixed integrated circuits industries around the development of next-generation communication technologies. We will actively develop high-performance and high-reliability sensors, power electronic components, ultra-thin lithium-ion batteries, and specialized vacuum electronic devices required for the development of strategic emerging industries such as the Internet of Things, new energy, and high-end equipment. We will accelerate the development of high-density interconnect boards, special printed circuit boards, printed circuit boards for light-emitting diodes (LEDs), and key core devices such as infrared focal plane detectors, ultraviolet detectors, and low-light image intensifiers required for modern optics. While focusing on the development of mature technologies, we will closely follow future technological trends, accurately grasp innovative technological directions, prioritize the support of innovative and common technologies, provide technological reserves for sustainable industrial development, and lay an important technological and industrial foundation for the structural adjustment, industrial upgrading, and transformation of the development mode of the electronic information manufacturing industry.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,关键电子元器件 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, key electronic components in English.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: The key development of semiconductor materials includes silicon materials, compound semiconductor materials, substrate materials such as gallium nitride and silicon carbide, raw materials for epitaxy, and high-performance ceramic substrates. It also includes high-end LED packaging materials, high-brightness and high-power LED chip materials, key materials for new power electronic devices, and graphite and carbon series insulation materials. The key development of optoelectronic materials includes glass substrates for high-generation LCD displays, polarizers, color filters, liquid crystals, large-size targets, high-purity electronic gases and reagents. It also includes high-purity organic materials, conductive glass substrates, packaging materials, high-precision mask templates for organic light-emitting displays (OLEDs), glass substrates and electrode pastes for plasma display panels (PDPs), wet chemicals, glass powders, phosphors, and other supporting materials. Additionally, it includes microcapsules, inks, dielectric materials for electronic paper, large-size germanium-based materials, infrared materials such as zinc sulfide (ZnS), zinc selenide (ZnSe), silicon carbide (SiC), to meet the demand for manufacturing high-end optoelectronic products. For electronic components, it includes copper-clad laminates, electronic copper foils, piezoelectric and system information processing materials, high thermal conductivity ceramic materials and metal composite materials, small lithium batteries and power lithium battery materials, chip-type ultra-thin high-capacity electronic ceramic materials and capacitor materials, high-performance capacitor films, high-end electronic pastes, LTCC multilayer substrates, high-performance magnetic materials, etc. The focus is on breaking through the high-end supporting application market, improving product added value and technological content, enhancing the quality and efficiency of the development of the electronic materials industry, and supporting the leapfrog development of downstream industries.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,电子材料 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, electronic materials in English.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: In terms of liquid crystal display devices, the focus is on improving the performance of thin-film transistors (TFT), increasing carrier mobility and the transmittance of the liquid crystal panel, and reducing production costs. In terms of plasma display devices, research and development is focused on high-efficiency technology, high-definition technology, and ultra-thin technology, as well as studying new materials and processes to improve the performance of PDP products. In the field of organic light-emitting display devices, efforts are being made to promote the technological development and industrial application of small and medium-sized OLEDs, as well as research on large-sized OLEDs and their technological integration. In the field of electronic paper, active development and industrialization of active driving electronic paper display technology is being promoted, with a focus on developing large-sized, touch screen, color, and flexible active driving electronic paper displays. Active research and development of new technologies and products such as touch screens and 3D displays are being carried out to promote their industrialization. Specialized display technologies such as laser display are being developed. The development of OLED lighting technology and product development is being promoted. Great efforts are being made to develop flat panel display device production equipment and testing instruments, forming a good trend of coordinated development with complete machine demand as the driving force, the panel industry as the leader, materials and equipment instruments as the foundation, and the coordinated development of various links in the industry chain. Efforts are being made to achieve international advanced level in China's new display industry by the end of the 12th Five-Year Plan period, fully supporting the transformation and upgrading of China's color TV industry.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点 translates to main tasks and development priorities.发展重点 translates to development priorities.新型显示器件 translates to new display devices.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: In terms of electronic specialized equipment, the focus is on developing 8-inch and 12-inch semiconductor-grade single crystal growth, cutting, grinding, and polishing equipment, 8-inch integrated circuit complete production line equipment, and promoting the industrialization of key equipment for 12-inch integrated circuits. Actively promote the development and industrialization of polycrystalline silicon, monocrystalline silicon growth and cutting equipment, fully automatic crystalline silicon solar cell production line equipment, thin film solar cell production equipment, and focus on breakthroughs in high-brightness LED chip production line equipment and post-packaging equipment. Vigorously develop new component production equipment and surface mount equipment. In terms of electronic instruments, the emphasis is on the research and development of semiconductor and integrated circuit testing instruments, communication and network testing instruments, high-performance microwave/millimeter wave testing instruments, digital TV and digital audio-video testing instruments, Internet of Things testing instruments, new electronic component testing instruments, high-performance general electronic testing instruments, time and frequency testing instruments, as well as electronic application instruments for medical, environmental protection, agriculture, mining, and other fields. Consolidate the foundation for industrial development, enhance core competitiveness, and sustainable development capabilities.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,电子专用设备和仪器 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, electronic specialized equipment and instruments in English.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Break through the weak links in the industrial chain, improve the technical level and industrialization capability of high-brightness, power-type LED epitaxial wafers and chips, and enhance the independent development capability of the industry. Strengthen research on packaging structure design, new packaging materials, new processes, phosphor performance, multi-primary-color phosphors, and heat dissipation mechanisms, focusing on improving the light extraction efficiency, phosphor efficiency, and heat dissipation performance of devices, and enhancing the packaging capability of power-type LED devices. Accelerate the research and industrialization of upstream raw materials for LEDs, such as substrates, metal organic compounds (MO) sources, ultra-high purity gases, phosphors, high-performance epoxy resins, and organic silicone gels, achieve mass production and application of key production equipment and instruments such as metal organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD), improve the supporting capability of the industry, and perfect the LED industrial chain. Promote applications in landscape lighting, LCD backlighting, outdoor large-screen displays, and indoor commercial lighting. Accelerate the formulation of LED-related basic standards and product standards, and improve the LED standard system. Enhance product standard compliance testing, accelerate the construction of national-level LED device and light source testing institutions, and improve testing capabilities and service capabilities. Strengthen industry guidance and management, and promote the healthy, scientific, and orderly development of the LED industry.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点 translates to Main tasks and development priorities.发展重点 translates to Development priorities.发光二极管（LED） translates to Light-emitting diode (LED).

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Key support will be provided for the production of high-quality, low-energy consumption, low-cost, and high by-product utilization rate solar-grade polysilicon. Development of efficient, low-cost, and low-energy consumption silicon ingot production technology, breakthrough in thinning silicon wafer cutting technology, and improvement of silicon wafer quality. Support for the research and industrialization of high-efficiency, low-cost, and long-life solar cells, and acceleration of the development and application of ultra-efficient solar cells, new concentrator cells, and thin-film cells. Encouragement of research and development of products and technologies such as photovoltaic inverters, controllers, and energy storage systems. Key development of equipment such as plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), laser cutting, etching, screen printing, and packaging testing, and encouragement of the development of complete sets of equipment production lines for crystalline silicon and thin-film solar cells. Active development of building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) component production technology and expansion of the application scope of building-attached photovoltaic (BAPV) components. Encouragement of the development of supporting materials such as crucibles, high-purity graphite, carbon-carbon composites, ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA) adhesive, electronic paste, wire cutting fluid, and transparent conductive oxide (TCO) glass. Encouragement of photovoltaic enterprises to strengthen system integration and application expansion, actively focus on off-grid application markets and emerging grid-connected application markets, and support the research and application of small-scale photovoltaic systems, distributed photovoltaic systems, and off-grid systems. Support for capable enterprises and institutions to establish national-level photovoltaic technology research and development platforms, product testing and certification platforms, and public service platforms, and to carry out public services such as product testing, system engineering acceptance, patent pool construction, promotion of standard formulation, and key common technology research and development. Support for backbone enterprises to enhance technological innovation capabilities, improve production process levels, reduce photovoltaic power generation costs, expand photovoltaic application markets, and enhance the core competitiveness of China's photovoltaic industry. Column 2: Leapfrogging Project for Basic Electronic Industries. Integrated circuits. Breakthroughs in high-performance CPUs, mobile communication chips, DSPs, and other high-end general-purpose chips, large-area chips such as mobile Internet, analog-digital hybrid, information security, digital TV, and radio frequency identification, as well as specialized chips in key areas. Continued support for the construction of 12-inch advanced process manufacturing lines and the transformation and upgrading of 8-inch/6-inch process manufacturing lines. Acceleration of the technological upgrading and capacity expansion of advanced production lines and specialized production lines, and improvement of advanced packaging technology and testing level. Further improvement of the industrial chain, enhancement of the independent development and supply capacity of key equipment, instruments, and materials for 8-12-inch integrated circuit production lines, such as etching machines, ion implantation machines, interconnect copper plating equipment, epitaxial furnaces, and photolithography coating and development equipment, and support for large-scale application of production lines. Acceleration of the improvement of the level and capabilities of national-level integrated circuit research and development public service platforms, and organization of various forms of technological innovation platforms. Key electronic components and materials. Key support for the technological upgrading and equipment process development of microelectronic devices, optoelectronic devices, MEMS devices, semiconductor power devices, power electronics devices, RFID modules and devices, green batteries, chip resistors and capacitors, electromechanical components, electroacoustic devices, intelligent sensors, and printed circuit board products, effectively supporting the development of the Internet of Things. Active development of semiconductor materials, solar photovoltaic materials, optoelectronic materials, piezoelectric and acousto-optic materials, electronic functional ceramics, magnetic materials, battery materials, and sensor materials, as well as metal materials, non-metal materials, and polymer materials used for support, assembly, and packaging. New flat panel displays. Key support for the key technologies and new process development of TFT-LCD display panels with a size of 6th generation or above, implementation of industrialization projects for key supporting materials such as glass substrates and core production equipment, and improvement of the supporting industrial chain. Breakthroughs in PDP high luminous efficiency technology (high energy efficiency, low cost), high-definition technology (3D, dynamic clarity, ultra-high definition), and ultra-thin technology to improve the performance of PDP products. Development of high-mobility TFT driving substrate technology, overcoming key process technologies such as OLED organic film formation and device packaging, overcoming low-temperature polysilicon (LTPS) technology, and strengthening the localization of key materials and equipment. Key development of touch screen functionality, wide viewing angle, high resolution, and lightweight and energy-saving small-sized display products around the demand for mobile terminals. Development of new technologies such as 3D display, electronic paper, and laser display. Light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Key breakthroughs in epitaxial growth and chip manufacturing key technologies, improvement of domestic supply capacity for epitaxial wafers and high-end chips. Enhancement of power-type LED device packaging capabilities, increased research and development of packaging structure design, new packaging materials, new processes, phosphor performance, and heat dissipation mechanisms. Further improvement of the industrial chain, accelerated mass production of domestically produced MOCVD equipment, promotion of research and development and industrialization of substrate materials, high-purity MO sources, high-performance epoxy resins, and efficient phosphors. Acceleration of the construction of testing platforms, formulation and improvement of LED-related standards, and promotion of intellectual property rights construction. Solar photovoltaics. Support for energy saving and consumption reduction in the polysilicon industry and the industrialization of high-quality, high-efficiency, and low-cost solar cells, and encouragement of the research and development of new solar cells and high-quality, low-cost polysilicon process technologies. Comprehensive improvement of equipment technology level, breakthroughs in equipment bottlenecks such as flat-panel PECVD, fully automatic screen printing machines, and efficient cutting machines. Support for the research and industrialization of supporting components such as controllers, inverters, and materials such as graphite, crucibles, electronic paste, and TCO glass. Support for diversified and wide-ranging solar photovoltaic applications, expansion of off-grid application markets and emerging grid-connected markets.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,太阳能光伏 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, solar photovoltaic.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Promote the widespread application of information technology in various fields, strengthen cooperation between production and use, promote the deep integration of the two industries, and further enhance the ability of the industry to support the national economy and social development. Transform and upgrade traditional industries through the application of information technology, with a focus on key areas such as research and development, design, process control, enterprise management, marketing, and human resource development. Support multi-level cooperation between information technology companies and traditional industrial enterprises, improve the level of industrial automation, intelligence, and management modernization, promote integrated application and business synergy innovation, accelerate the integration of manufacturing and services, and promote the formation of resource-saving production methods. Increase the application of information technology in various aspects of agricultural production, management, and services, promote integrated information management in agriculture, and improve the level of precision agriculture technology and agricultural production efficiency. In conjunction with the implementation of national projects to improve people's livelihood, strengthen the application of information technology in transportation, healthcare, culture and education, employment, and social security, and drive the development of electronic information products and related services. Vigorously develop the application of electronic products, focusing on application areas with large-scale and strong driving force such as industrial control, machine tool electronics, automotive electronics, medical electronics, financial electronics, and power electronics. Increase research and development investment, break through key technologies, strive for industrialization, and create new growth points. Column 3: Key application of electronic products in industrial control. Strengthen the development of distributed control systems, programmable controllers, control chips, sensors, drive actuators, touch screens, and other products to improve the integration and intelligence level of industrial control. Machine tool electronics. Break through technologies such as high-end CNC system fieldbus, communication protocols, high-precision high-speed control, and digital high-speed servo drive, and vigorously develop mid-to-high-end CNC systems; strengthen the research and application of machine tool electronic functional components (including electric spindles, electric tool holders, detection devices, testing equipment, machine tool electrical appliances, etc.). Automotive electronics. Focus on supporting the research and application of key technologies and products such as automotive electronic electrical components, automotive chips, in-vehicle information platforms and networks, power battery and management control systems, powertrain control systems, drive motor control, chassis control, body control, in-vehicle electronics, automotive safety, etc. Medical electronics. Focus on breakthroughs in advanced medical electronic products such as digital medical imaging diagnosis, clinical testing and non-invasive detection diagnosis, digital hospitals and collaborative medical and health systems, portable medical electronic devices, rehabilitation treatment equipment, organ function-assisted alternative medical electronic devices, precision intelligent surgical equipment, treatment microsystems, medical sensors, etc. Financial electronics. Focus on supporting the development and large-scale application of products such as financial IC cards, mobile payment terminals, tax control cash registers, automatic deposit/withdrawal machines, sorting machines, and financial self-service equipment, improve the level of financial informatization, and ensure financial security. Power electronics. Promote technological innovation and industrialization of high-frequency field-controlled power electronic chips and modules such as insulated gate bipolar transistors (IGBTs), metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs), and fast recovery diodes (FRDs); focus on solving manufacturing technologies such as high-resistance zone melting silicon single crystals, ceramic-coated copper boards, aluminum silicon carbide substrates, and structural components; actively carry out research and industrialization of wide-bandgap semiconductor materials (silicon carbide and gallium nitride) and devices. Support the research and development of high-power density and high-performance power electronic devices. Establish a national-level testing and testing platform for high-frequency field-controlled power electronic devices, and formulate and improve power electronic device standards.
titlelist: 主要任务与发展重点,发展重点,信息技术应用 translates to Main tasks and development priorities, development priorities, application of information technology in English.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Increase investment in special funds for technological transformation, and provide key support for major projects in core areas. Accelerate the implementation of national major science and technology projects such as core electronic devices, high-end general-purpose chips and basic software products, large-scale integrated circuit manufacturing equipment and complete sets of processes, and new generation broadband wireless mobile communication networks, further clarify the key areas of funding support, and strengthen the supporting industrial chain. Make full use of special funds such as the Electronic Information Industry Development Fund to support the research and development and industrialization of core key technologies in the industry, and promote the demonstration and application of key products. Increase financial support for the application of information technology, with a focus on supporting the industry application of secure and reliable information technology and products. Implement special funds for strategic emerging industries and refine the funding utilization plan in the field of electronic information. Implement various financial policies to support small and medium-sized enterprises, and support financial institutions in providing more financing services for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the efficiency of fiscal fund utilization, and enhance industrial innovation capabilities.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Give full play to the guiding role of industry management departments and local governments in industrial transfer and cooperation, as well as the fundamental role of the market in resource allocation. Strengthen the integration of planning, resources, and the market, study and formulate relevant policies for the transfer and cooperation of the electronic information manufacturing industry, and establish a sound cooperation mechanism for department-province coordination and joint promotion. Promote the extension of the value chain of industries such as research and development, design, and services in advantageous regions such as the Pearl River Delta, the Yangtze River Delta, the Bohai Rim, and the coastal areas of Fujian and Xiamen, and leverage the radiating and driving role of these regions. Based on the unique advantages of the industrial receiving regions, coordinate the rational layout of major projects in the central and western regions and old industrial bases in the northeast, and guide the orderly transfer of industries. Promote the construction of new industrialization demonstration bases and industrial parks, and promote regional coordinated development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, guide the orderly transfer of industries, and promote regional coordinated development.

name: Development Plan for the Electronic Information Manufacturing Industry during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/February 24, 2012)
content: Improve the policy system for promoting corporate mergers and reorganizations, guided by industrial policies, focusing on key areas of industrial development, and driven by major national projects, actively promote significant progress in corporate mergers and reorganizations. Promote the establishment of industrial investment funds, with a focus on major productive layout, encourage leading enterprises to carry out overseas mergers and reorganizations and technology acquisitions. Establish and improve the service system for small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate a group of small and medium-sized enterprises that are specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative, and form an industrial organizational system that complements and coordinates the development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Support the development of industry alliances such as AVS, FlashLink, digital home, solar photovoltaic, OLED, and strengthen the construction of industrial innovation alliances in emerging fields such as mobile Internet, cloud computing, Internet of Things, and semiconductor lighting.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote corporate mergers and reorganizations, optimize industrial organizational structure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Following the law of broadband technology evolution, fully utilizing the existing network infrastructure, focusing on the overall requirements of economic and social development and broadband development goals, strengthening and improving the overall layout, systematically addressing key issues such as broadband network access speed, coverage, and application popularization, strengthening industrial development and security guarantee, continuously improving the overall level of broadband development, and comprehensively enhancing the ability to support sustainable economic and social development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Coordinate the construction of access networks, metropolitan area networks, and backbone networks, comprehensively utilize wired and wireless technologies, and combine them with the requirements of the next-generation Internet scale commercial deployment based on Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6), and systematically promote the development of broadband networks in stages. According to the ideas of high-speed access, extensive coverage, multiple means, and adapting to local conditions, promote the construction of access networks. In urban areas, use technologies such as fiber-to-the-home and fiber-to-the-building for access network construction and transformation, combined with 3G/LTE and wireless local area network technologies, to achieve seamless coverage of broadband networks. In rural areas, adapt to local conditions and flexibly adopt wired and wireless technologies for access network construction. According to the ideas of high-speed transmission, comprehensive bearing, intelligent perception, and secure control, promote the construction of metropolitan area networks. Gradually promote the application of high-speed transmission, packetized transmission, and large-capacity routing and switching technologies in metropolitan area networks, expand the bandwidth of metropolitan area networks, and improve traffic carrying capacity. Promote the intelligent transformation of networks, and enhance the level of multi-service carrying, perception, and security control of metropolitan area networks. According to the ideas of optimizing architecture, enhancing capacity, intelligent scheduling, and efficient reliability, promote the construction of backbone networks. Optimize the architecture of backbone networks, improve the layout of international networks, comprehensively promote ultra-high-speed wavelength division multiplexing systems and cluster routing technologies, and enhance the capacity and intelligent scheduling capabilities of backbone networks to ensure the high-speed, efficient, secure, and reliable operation of the network.
titlelist: Technology roadmap and development timeline, technology roadmap.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on strengthening the construction of fiber optic networks and 3G networks, improving broadband network access speed, and enhancing user internet experience. In urban areas, efforts should be made to promote the transformation of fiber optic networks, while in rural areas, flexible wired and wireless methods should be used to accelerate the construction of broadband access networks in administrative villages, improving access speed and cost-effectiveness. Further improve the quality of urban 3G networks, expand the coverage of rural 3G networks, and carry out large-scale trials of time-division duplex long-term evolution (TD-LTE) technology for mobile communication. Accelerate the construction of the next-generation broadcasting and television network, promote the transformation from copper to fiber and the two-way transformation of networks, and promote interconnection. Simultaneously expand and upgrade the urban area network. Optimize the backbone network of the internet with interconnection as the focus. Promote website upgrades and improve website access speed. By the end of 2013, the number of fixed broadband users will exceed 210 million households, with fixed broadband penetration rates reaching 55% in urban areas and 20% in rural areas. The number of 3G/LTE users will exceed 330 million households, with a penetration rate of 25%. The proportion of administrative villages with broadband access will reach 90%. In urban areas, 80% of broadband users will have access to 20Mbps broadband, while in rural areas, 85% of broadband users will have access to 4Mbps broadband. The coverage level of wireless broadband networks in urban and rural areas will significantly improve, and wireless LAN will be basically covered in important public areas in cities. The coverage of the national cable television network interconnection platform will reach 60% of cable television network users.
titlelist: Technology roadmap and development timeline, development timeline, comprehensive acceleration phase (until the end of 2013)

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Key efforts will be made to promote the optimization and technological advancement of broadband networks, aiming to achieve world-leading levels in terms of broadband network service quality, application level, and broadband industry support capabilities. By 2020, basic broadband network infrastructure will be established, covering both urban and rural areas, providing convenient and high-speed access, and featuring advanced technologies. The number of fixed broadband users will reach 400 million households, with a household penetration rate of 70%. Fiber optic networks will be available in urban households. The number of 3G/LTE users will exceed 1.2 billion, with a user penetration rate of 85%. Broadband coverage in administrative villages will exceed 98%, and various technological approaches will be adopted to extend coverage to eligible natural villages. Broadband access speeds for urban and rural households will reach 50Mbps and 12Mbps respectively, with 50% of urban households achieving 100Mbps. In developed cities, some households will have access speeds of up to 1Gbps, and LTE coverage will be available in both urban and rural areas. The number of internet users will reach 1.1 billion, with significant improvements in broadband application service levels and capabilities. The national interconnected platform for cable television networks will cover over 95% of cable television network users. Bottlenecks hindering the development of the broadband industry will be fully overcome, with broadband technology research and development reaching international advanced levels. A well-structured and internationally competitive broadband industry chain will be established, fostering a number of world-leading innovative enterprises. The development goals and timetable for Broadband China are outlined.
titlelist: Technical roadmap and development timeline, development timeline, optimization and upgrade phase (2016-2020)
