name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Eastern Region. Support the Eastern Region to take the lead in network upgrade and application innovation. Actively utilize fiber optic and next-generation mobile communication technologies, next-generation broadcasting and television network technologies, comprehensively improve broadband network speed and performance, and strive to narrow the gap with developed countries; accelerate the deployment of next-generation Internet based on IPv6; encourage the Eastern Region to actively carry out regional pilot demonstrations in combination with local economic and social development needs, innovate broadband application services, and cultivate new businesses and new formats. Central and Western Regions. Provide policy support, support the construction of broadband networks in the central and western regions, increase fiber optic cable routing, enhance backbone network capacity, expand access network coverage, and deploy next-generation mobile communication technologies, next-generation broadcasting and television network technologies, and next-generation Internet in sync with the Eastern Region. Accelerate the construction of information content and websites in the central and western regions, promote the development of information resources with ethnic characteristics and broadband application services. Create a favorable environment and guide the establishment of large-scale cloud computing data centers in suitable areas of the central and western regions. Rural areas. Include broadband in universal telecommunication services, with a focus on solving the problem of broadband access in every village. Adapt various technologies such as fiber optic, copper wire, coaxial cable, 3G/LTE, microwave, and satellite to accelerate the extension of broadband networks from towns to administrative villages and natural villages. In densely populated rural areas, actively promote wired methods such as fiber optic to reach villages. In sparsely populated and scattered rural areas, flexibly use various wireless technologies to achieve broadband network coverage. Accelerate the research and development and promotion of low-cost smart terminals suitable for the needs of farmers. Strengthen the deep development of various agricultural information resources, improve rural informatization business platforms and service centers, and enhance the level of comprehensive network information services. Column 1 Broadband Rural project. Based on the level of rural economic development and geographical and natural conditions, flexibly select access technologies and promote the extension of broadband networks to administrative villages and eligible natural villages in a classified and phased manner. In relatively developed areas, promote fiber optic to administrative villages and broadband to natural villages after achieving broadband access in administrative villages; in underdeveloped areas, focus on solving broadband coverage in administrative villages. For remote areas, mountainous areas, islands, etc., where construction costs are high, wireless broadband technologies such as mobile and satellite can be used to solve the problem of information isolation; for vast pastoral areas with dispersed population, promote wireless broadband coverage; for newly planned and constructed contiguous new rural areas and rural settlement projects for farmers and herdsmen, actively promote fiber optic to buildings and fiber optic to households construction.
titlelist: Key task: Promote coordinated development of regional broadband networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Backbone network. Accelerate the upgrade of Internet backbone nodes, promote the construction of next-generation broadband backbone networks for broadcasting and television networks, enhance network traffic congestion capacity, and fully support IPv6. Optimize the interconnection architecture between Internet backbone networks, expand inter-network bandwidth, and ensure connectivity performance. Increase the accessibility of international submarine and land cables, improve the layout of international business nodes, enhance international interconnection bandwidth and traffic transfer capacity. Upgrade the national backbone transmission network, enhance business carrying capacity, and enhance network security and reliability. Access network and metropolitan area network. Actively utilize various social capital, coordinate wired and wireless technologies to accelerate broadband access network construction. Extend fiber optic to end users in various ways, accelerate the construction of broadband access networks for next-generation broadcasting and television networks, and gradually build a fixed broadband access network that effectively utilizes access resources such as fiber optic cables, coaxial cables, and twisted pair cables. Increase efforts in wireless broadband network construction, expand the coverage range of 3G networks, improve coverage quality, coordinate the commercial development of TD-LTE, accelerate the coverage of wireless LAN hotspots in important public areas, and accelerate the digitalization of terrestrial broadcasting and television. Promote optimization and expansion of metropolitan area networks. Accelerate the upgrade and transformation of access networks and metropolitan area networks to IPv6. Plan the simultaneous construction of communication facilities such as communication pipelines within the land use red line and residential areas and buildings, and pre-install fiber optic cables, reserve equipment rooms, and include the required investment in the corresponding construction project estimates. Explore new models of cooperative construction and sharing of broadband infrastructure. Application infrastructure. Coordinate the construction of Internet data centers, upgrade and transform them using cloud computing and green energy-saving technologies, and improve energy efficiency and intensification levels. Expand the capacity and coverage range of content delivery networks, enhance service capabilities and security management levels. Increase website access bandwidth, optimize spatial layout, and achieve high-speed access to Internet information sources. Simultaneously promote the IPv6 upgrade and transformation of government, school, enterprise, and public institution external network website systems and commercial website systems. Column 2: Broadband network optimization and speed-up project fiber city construction. Support the deployment of broadband networks in newly built areas of cities primarily using fiber-to-the-home methods, and adopt various methods to accelerate the fiber in, copper out transformation in existing areas, promote the deployment of fiber optic broadband access in government, schools, medical and health, science and technology parks, commercial buildings, hotels, and other units, and improve access rates. Wireless broadband network construction. Support urban areas to primarily use 3G/LTE networks, supplemented by wireless LAN construction, to build wireless broadband cities, continuously expand the coverage range of wireless broadband networks in rural areas, and increase the optimization of wireless networks on highways and high-speed railways. Next-generation broadband network construction for broadcasting and television. Use ultra-high-speed intelligent fiber and coaxial cable transmission technology to build next-generation broadband networks for broadcasting and television, through fiber optic to communities, fiber optic to natural villages, fiber optic to buildings, and other methods, combined with coaxial cable to households, fully utilize the advantages of the massive downstream bandwidth of the broadcasting and television network and the distribution of multiple information points indoors, meet the needs of different users for flexible access bandwidth, accelerate the optimization and speed-up of broadband networks, and promote broadband popularization. Optimization of Internet backbone networks. Promote the flattening of network structure, expand backbone link bandwidth, and enhance carrying capacity. Optimize the layout of direct interconnection points between backbone networks, explore the development model of exchange centers, strengthen monitoring of inter-network interconnection quality and exchange centers, ensure the quality of interconnection between backbone networks, and improve the access speed of Internet service providers. Optimization of backbone transmission networks. Moderately advance the construction of ultra-high-speed and large-capacity optical transmission systems, continuously improve the capacity of backbone transmission networks. Introduce and promote intelligent optical transmission network technology in a timely manner to improve the intelligence level of resource scheduling. Increase the density of optical cable routing in western regions, promote the evolution of optical cable networks towards a grid-like structure, and improve the security performance of national trunk networks.
titlelist: Key task: Accelerate broadband network optimization and upgrade.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Economic development. Continuously expand and deepen the application of broadband in production and operation, accelerate enterprise broadband interconnection and network-based process reengineering and business innovation, use information technology to transform and upgrade traditional industries, achieve networked, intelligent, intensive, and green development, and promote industrial optimization and upgrading. Continuously innovate broadband application models, cultivate new markets and new formats, accelerate the development of modern service industries such as e-commerce, modern logistics, and internet finance, and strengthen the new generation of information technology industries such as cloud computing, the Internet of Things, mobile internet, and smart terminals. Industry-specific communication should fully utilize public network resources to meet the needs of broadband development and gradually reduce the number of dedicated communication networks. Social livelihood. Focus on deepening the application of broadband networks in education, healthcare, employment, social security, and other livelihood areas. Accelerate the coverage of broadband networks in schools, actively develop online education, and achieve the sharing of high-quality educational resources. Promote the broadband interconnection of medical and health institutions, accelerate the development of remote medical and networked medical applications, and promote equalization of medical services. Accelerate the construction of employment and social security information service systems, achieve full coverage of management services, promote the application of social security cards, and accelerate the interconnection of employment and social security information across regions. Strengthen the coverage and service support of broadband networks for information infrastructure weak areas and special groups. Cultural construction. Accelerate the broadband interconnection of public cultural institutions such as cultural centers, libraries, and museums, optimize the public cultural information service system, and vigorously develop public digital culture. Enhance the support capability of broadband networks for cultural undertakings and cultural and creative industries, promote the integration of broadband networks and cultural development, develop new forms of digital cultural industries and other cultural formats, enhance cultural dissemination capabilities, improve the efficiency of public cultural services, and promote the scale and intensive development of the cultural industry, and promote cultural prosperity. National defense construction. Rely on public networks to enhance the security, reliability, emergency response, and dynamic recovery capabilities of military network facilities. Use key technological research and development achievements to improve the technical level and capabilities of military networks. Appropriately pre-provide access and channel resources for the daily combat readiness, training exercises, and non-war military operations of the military. Improve the leadership mechanism and coordination mechanism for the sharing and use of public network and military network resources and emergency organization and dispatch. Application popularization. Vigorously promote the application of information technology in education and teaching, promote universal sharing of high-quality educational resources, strengthen network civilization and network security education, and guide students to develop good internet habits and a correct view of the internet world. Establish rural public broadband internet service centers and carry out broadband internet access and application skills training. Provide broadband application skills training, e-commerce, online marketing guidance, and encourage enterprises to use broadband for business and commercial model innovation. Research and promote special-purpose information terminals and application tools for special groups. Column 3: Small and medium-sized enterprise broadband application demonstration project supports small and medium-sized enterprises' broadband internet access and promotes the integration of the internet into their production and operation processes. Support the construction of third-party e-commerce platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises, encourage online sales, procurement, customer relationship management, and other activities. Column 4: Broadband application demonstration project for impoverished schools and special education institutions supports the flexible use of different broadband access technologies, adapts to local conditions, and builds broadband network facilities for primary and secondary schools in rural areas (especially impoverished areas and ethnic minority areas) and special education institutions for people with disabilities. Develop easy-to-use internet terminals, enrich characteristic applications, increase information assistance, assistance for people with disabilities, and poverty alleviation efforts, and narrow the digital divide. Column 5: Digital culture broadband application demonstration project constructs digital cultural content platforms such as radio, film and television, cultural centers, libraries, and museums that can intelligently adapt to different broadband access networks and terminals. Improve the broadband interconnection and intercommunication level of digital cultural content platforms, combine broadband network capabilities to enhance innovative digital cultural service formats, enrich various digital cultural applications, develop intelligent terminals for digital cultural applications, carry out various broadband application demonstrations for digital culture, promote the integration of broadband networks and cultural development, and enhance cultural dissemination capabilities.
titlelist: Key task: Improve the level of broadband network application.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Key technology research and development. Promote the implementation of next-generation broadband wireless mobile communication networks, next-generation Internet, and other special projects such as the 863 Program and the Science and Technology Support Program. Strengthen the research and development of key technologies in areas such as high-speed fiber broadband access, ultra-high-speed large-capacity optical transmission, large-capacity routing and switching, digital home, large-scale resource management and scheduling, next-generation Web, new human-computer interaction, green energy-saving, and quantum communication. Focus on breakthroughs in key core technologies of broadband networks and accelerate the formation of independent intellectual property rights. Further improve the broadband network standard system and actively participate in the research and formulation of relevant international standards and specifications. Industrialization of major products. In key areas such as optical communication, next-generation mobile communication, next-generation Internet, next-generation broadcasting and television networks, mobile Internet, cloud computing, and digital home, increase support for the research and industrialization of key equipment core chips, high-end optoelectronic devices, operating systems, and other high-end products. Support the development, industrialization, and demonstration application of core equipment for broadband networks, focus on breakthroughs in industry bottlenecks, and enhance independent development capabilities. Encourage the formation of technology industry alliances in key areas, improve collaboration in the industrial chain, and promote collaborative innovation in the industry. Development of intelligent terminals. Give full play to the capabilities of wireless and wired broadband networks, actively develop cost-effective mobile terminals, Internet TVs, tablet computers, and other forms of internet access terminal products for key areas such as education, healthcare, transportation, homes, energy conservation, environmental protection, and public safety. Promote the research and development innovation of mobile Internet operating systems, core chips, key devices, etc. Accelerate the research, development, and promotion of multi-mode intelligent terminals for 3G, TD-LTE, and other technical standards. Support platform construction. Fully integrate existing resources and promote the construction of national engineering centers, laboratories, and other industrial innovation capacity platforms in the field of broadband network-related technologies. Research and formulate evaluation indicators for broadband network development, build a nationwide broadband network information testing and collection system, and achieve regular monitoring of broadband network performance. Column 6: Research and industrialization of core equipment for broadband network development. Breakthroughs in key technologies for next-generation fiber broadband access networks with large capacity, high bandwidth, and long distance, research and development of core devices and chips for optical access networks, and promotion of intelligent optical distribution networks and massive data management systems. Develop testing platforms and carry out demonstration applications. Research and development of backbone optical transmission and routing and switching equipment and pilot projects. Research and develop core equipment for next-generation optical network architecture, ultra-high-speed wavelength division multiplexing transmission and intelligent networking, packet optical transport networks, high-precision time synchronization, and large-capacity routing and switching. Breakthroughs in related core chip and high-end optoelectronic device technologies and achieve industrialization. Improve relevant international and domestic standards, conduct technical experiments and pilot applications. Research and industrialization of broadband access intelligent terminals. Organize the commercial use of independent operating systems and supporting applications for various types of terminals such as smartphones, smart TVs, smart set-top boxes, and tablet computers, as well as digital home gateways. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as intelligent terminal processors, next-generation Web, multimodal human-computer interaction, multimode intelligent terminals, and multi-screen intelligent switching. Column 7: Broadband China map construction project. Establish a broadband development monitoring system and evaluation index system, build a nationwide broadband development evaluation system, dynamically monitor information such as network coverage, access bandwidth, user scale, and access speed of major websites, and establish mechanisms for reporting broadband development status and releasing broadband maps.
titlelist: Key task: Promote continuous improvement of the broadband network industry chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Technical support capability. Strengthen research on key technologies for broadband network information security and emergency communication, improve the controllable level of basic software and hardware products, dedicated security products, and emergency communication equipment, support the research and development of technical products, improve the relevant industrial chain, and enhance the technical support capability for broadband network information security and emergency communication. Security protection system. Accelerate the formation of security guarantee capabilities that are compatible with the development of broadband networks, build a next-generation network information security protection system, enhance the capabilities of monitoring, detecting, warning, assessing, and emergency response to network and information security incidents, improve the security risk assessment and evaluation mechanisms and methods for networks and important information systems, and enhance the ability to prevent attacks on network infrastructure, respond to emergencies, and recover from disasters. Emergency communication system. Improve the reliability and resistance to destruction of broadband network infrastructure, gradually realize emergency priority services for broadband networks, and enhance the emergency communication guarantee capability of broadband networks. Strengthen the deployment of emergency communication equipment based on broadband technology and accelerate the broadband transformation of emergency communication systems. Security management mechanism. Guide and regulate the secure development of new technologies and applications, build a security evaluation and assessment system, and improve proactive security management capabilities. Strengthen the construction of information protection systems, formulate and improve laws and regulations on personal privacy protection, combating cybercrime, etc., promote industry self-discipline and public supervision, strengthen user security awareness and education, build a comprehensive social governance system, and strive to create a safe, healthy, and trustworthy online environment.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing broadband network security guarantee capability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Clarify the national wireless spectrum roadmap. Research and determine the spectrum requirements for the various stages of national broadband wireless development as soon as possible, and review the distribution and utilization of wireless spectrum. Accelerate the study of spectrum planning schemes, formulate medium and long-term spectrum plans, and clarify the timetable and roadmap for comprehensive utilization of wireless spectrum. Promote efficient utilization of spectrum resources. Support the development and application of new technologies for efficient use of spectrum resources, such as dynamic spectrum allocation. Support the research, development, and utilization of interference elimination technologies and devices, promote the sharing and coexistence of different wireless service types, and improve the overall utilization of frequency resources. Strengthen the regulation of wireless devices in public frequency bands. Coordinate the deployment of wireless local area networks and other wireless communication networks, encourage the sharing and co-building of wireless devices, avoid frequency interference, and improve the efficiency of spectrum resource utilization. Strengthen the regulation of the research, production, import, sale, and use of radio transmitting equipment to maintain order in the airwaves.
titlelist: Policy measures, optimizing spectrum planning.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Broadband China project, with a focus on fiber-optic broadband and broadband wireless mobile communication, to accelerate the upgrading of information network broadband. Promote fiber-optic access to households in urban areas and universal broadband service in administrative villages, improve access bandwidth, network speed, and broadband penetration rate. Strengthen the deep coverage of 3G networks, support the development of the TD-SCDMA and its subsequent evolution technology TD-LTE industrial chain with independent intellectual property rights, and scientifically coordinate the coordinated development of 3G and its long-term evolution technology. Accelerate the construction of the next-generation broadcasting and television network, promote the digitization, two-way communication, and interconnection transformation of the broadcasting and television network.
titlelist: Implement the Broadband China project, build next-generation information infrastructure, and accelerate the development of broadband networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Summarize the pilot experience, vigorously promote the integration of the three networks while ensuring information and cultural security, promote the two-way entry of radio, television, and telecommunications services, accelerate network upgrading and transformation, and resource sharing, strengthen resource development, information technology, and business innovation, vigorously develop integrated services, cultivate and expand the related industries and markets of the integration of the three networks. Accelerate the construction of relevant laws, regulations, and standards system, improve the institutional mechanisms that adapt to the integration of the three networks, and improve a manageable and controllable network information and cultural security guarantee system.
titlelist: Implement the Broadband China project, build next-generation information infrastructure, and accelerate the integration of the three networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the use of digital research and development design tools to accelerate the digitization of key industries' production equipment and the intelligentization of production processes. Popularize management information systems such as enterprise resource planning, supply chain, and customer relationship in a comprehensive manner. Implement major informationization demonstration projects to guide the transformation of business applications towards integrated integration and industrial chain collaborative innovation. Continue to implement the informationization promotion project for small and medium-sized enterprises and the informationization science and technology project for the manufacturing industry, and improve the level of informationization of small and medium-sized enterprises and manufacturing enterprises. Improve the evaluation and certification system for the integration of enterprise informationization and industrialization, and support the development of informationization public service platforms targeting specific industries.
titlelist: Promote the deep integration of informatization and industrialization, improve the level of informatization in economic development, and comprehensively improve the level of enterprise informatization.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Increase the support for the development of core basic products in the information industry and key technologies in network commonality through national major science and technology projects. Accelerate the research and development and application of next-generation mobile communications, basic software, embedded software, as well as manufacturing execution systems, industrial control systems, and large-scale management software. Strengthen overall planning and actively promote the research and development and application of the Internet of Things and cloud computing in an orderly manner. Implement the industrial electronic product enhancement project, promote the integration and innovation of information technology and industrial technology, and improve the intelligence level of products such as automobiles, ships, and machinery. Promote the transformation of electronic information product manufacturing enterprises from simply providing products to providing comprehensive solutions and information services.
titlelist: Promote the deep integration of informatization and industrialization, improve the level of informatization in economic development, and enhance the core competitiveness of the information industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a sound support system for security, trust, finance, logistics, and standards, explore effective regulatory models, and establish a standardized and orderly e-commerce market order. Guide e-commerce platforms to develop full-process services covering information flow, logistics, and capital flow. Encourage large and medium-sized enterprises to engage in online procurement and sales, strengthen supply chain collaboration, and focus on promoting the widespread use of e-commerce applications for small and micro enterprises. Implement pilot demonstration projects for mobile e-commerce, create pilot demonstration cities for e-commerce, innovate e-commerce development models, and improve the e-commerce development environment.
titlelist: Promote the deep integration of informatization and industrialization, improve the level of informatization in economic development, and guide the healthy development of e-commerce.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote information sharing in the banking, securities, and insurance industries, support innovation in financial products and services, promote the development of consumer finance, and improve the level of financial services for small and micro enterprises, as well as agriculture and rural areas. Accelerate the informatization of transportation, tourism, leisure, and entertainment industries. Cultivate and develop the geographic information industry, vigorously develop information system integration, internet value-added services, and information security services. Improve the level of informatization in industrial design.
titlelist: Promote the deep integration of informatization and industrialization, improve the level of informatization in economic development, and advance the informatization process in the service industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on enhancing service and regulatory capabilities, promoting government management innovation, and strengthening the top-level design of e-government. With interconnectivity as the key, establish a unified national e-government network, improve project construction management, performance evaluation, and operation and maintenance mechanisms. Solidly promote the construction of important regulatory information systems for drugs, food, housing, energy, finance, prices, etc. Promote information sharing and business collaboration in key areas, accelerate the extension of e-government services to streets, communities, and rural areas, and support pilot demonstrations of innovative management and service models by grassroots governments and communities. Strengthen the development and utilization of basic information resources such as geographic space, natural resources, population, legal entities, finance, taxation, and statistics, and promote sharing. Enhance the overall technical service capabilities of e-government, and encourage the migration of business applications to cloud computing models. Strengthen electronic document management and application.
titlelist: Accelerate the informatization of the social sector, promote the construction of advanced network culture, and enhance the capacity of e-government services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a comprehensive social management integrated information system. Improve the mechanism for sharing population information, achieve dynamic management of actual population, and enhance the ability to monitor and analyze population information dynamically. Construct a public demand information management platform and improve the way of handling public grievances. Strengthen the analysis of online public opinion and improve the mechanism for guiding and managing online public opinion dynamics. Promote the sharing of urban management information, promote the grid management model, accelerate the implementation of pilot demonstrations such as smart grids and intelligent transportation, and guide the healthy development of smart city construction.
titlelist: Accelerate the informatization of the social sector, promote the construction of advanced network culture, and improve the level of informatization in social management and urban operations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of broadband networks in schools, promote the development and sharing of high-quality digital educational resources, improve the education management information system, build a lifelong learning network and service platform for the whole population, vigorously develop distance education, and form a comprehensive information service system for education. Improve the medical service and management information system, accelerate the establishment of electronic health records and electronic medical records for residents, strengthen the sharing of national and regional medical and health information, and consolidate the foundation for the development of telemedicine. Build an information service system covering urban and rural residents' employment and social security, fully implement the application of social security cards, and promote the sharing of employment information. Promote the informatization of disaster reduction and relief, social assistance, social welfare, and charity services. Improve the information service capabilities for special groups such as people with disabilities.
titlelist: Accelerate the informatization of the social sector, promote the construction of advanced network culture, and accelerate the informatization of the people's livelihood sector.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the development of digital cultural products with Chinese characteristics and independent intellectual property rights, strengthen intellectual property protection, strengthen the digital content industry, cultivate backbone enterprises in digital content and online culture industries, and expand the digital content industry chain. Strengthen the construction of key news websites, regulate the management of comprehensive commercial websites, and build a positive and healthy new order of online communication and online atmosphere. Actively promote the construction of public cultural information infrastructure such as digital libraries, develop high-quality network popular science resources, and improve the public cultural information service system.
titlelist: Accelerate the informatization of the social sector, promote the construction of advanced network culture, and develop advanced network culture.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the research and application of information technology in agriculture. Accelerate the integration of agricultural production infrastructure, equipment, and information technology. Improve the level of informatization in crop cultivation, animal husbandry production, rural professional cooperatives, and agricultural wholesale markets. Strengthen the monitoring of agricultural production environment, production process, and industry development, and establish and improve the traceability system for agricultural product quality and safety. Actively cultivate, demonstrate, and promote applicable models of agricultural informatization.
titlelist: Promote the informatization of agriculture and rural areas, achieve strong agriculture and benefit farmers through information, and improve the level of informatization in agricultural production and management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Important information systems and telecommunications networks in the fields of energy, transportation, finance, and other areas related to national economy and people's livelihood, such as basic information networks including the internet, telecommunications networks, and broadcasting and television networks, should be planned, constructed, and operated synchronously with security protection facilities. It is necessary to strengthen technical prevention, enforce strict security management, and effectively enhance the ability to defend against attacks, tampering, viruses, paralysis, and theft of confidential information. Radio security management and the guarantee of radio frequencies for important information systems should be increased. The management of internet websites, addresses, domain names, and access service providers should be strengthened, and information sharing mechanisms should be improved to regulate the internet service market.
titlelist: Strengthen security protection and management, ensure the security of key areas of information, and guarantee the security of important information systems and basic information networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the protection and management of basic information resources such as geography, population, legal entities, and statistics, ensuring the secure interconnection of information systems and the sharing of information resources between departments. Clarify the requirements for protecting sensitive information, strengthen the responsibility of enterprises and institutions in protecting user data and national basic data in online economic activities, and strictly regulate the collection of data by enterprises and institutions within our country. Conduct pilot projects for the protection of personal information in areas such as software service outsourcing, information technology services, and e-commerce, and strengthen the protection of personal information.
titlelist: Strengthening security protection and management, ensuring the security of key areas of information, and enhancing the protection of information resources and personal information.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Research and formulate national information security strategies and plans, strengthen top-level design. Implement the information security level protection system, carry out corresponding levels of security construction and management, and ensure the registration, rectification, and supervision of information systems. Strengthen the work of emergency response for network and information security, improve emergency plans, and enhance guidance and coordination for the construction of network and information security disaster recovery facilities. Improve the information security certification and accreditation system, strengthen information security product certification work, and reduce duplicate testing and fees.
titlelist: Accelerate capacity building, enhance the level of network and information security protection, and consolidate the foundation of network and information security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a sound electronic authentication service system, promote the application of electronic signatures in key areas such as finance and e-commerce. Develop standards for e-commerce credit evaluation, establish integrity evaluation mechanisms for internet websites and e-commerce trading platforms, and support qualified third-party organizations to provide credit evaluation services. Vigorously promote the application of encryption technology in the protection of classified information systems and important information systems, strengthen the role of encryption in safeguarding electronic government affairs, e-commerce security, and the protection of citizens' personal information.
titlelist: Accelerate capacity building, enhance the level of network and information security, strengthen the construction of the network trust system and password protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Coordinate planning, integrate resources, further increase the research and development efforts in network and information security technology, and strengthen the research on information security technology in areas such as cloud computing, Internet of Things, mobile internet, and next-generation internet. Continue to organize and implement special projects for the industrialization of information security, improve relevant government procurement policies and measures, and management systems for information security, and support the development of the information security industry.
titlelist: Accelerate capacity building, enhance the level of network and information security, and expedite technological breakthroughs and industrial development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: (1) Strengthen organizational leadership. Under the leadership of the National Informatization Leading Group and the National Network and Information Security Coordination Group, relevant departments should implement their respective work tasks in accordance with their responsibilities, strengthen coordination and cooperation, form a joint force, and jointly promote the development of informatization and the safeguarding of network information security. Each region should include the safeguarding of network and information security as an important agenda item, establish and implement a network and information security responsibility system at each level, clarify the responsible leaders, determine the working institutions, be responsible for supervising the implementation of network and information security regulations, organize the development of emergency plans, handle major network and information security incidents, etc., and establish a two-level network and information security coordination mechanism at the provincial (regional, municipal) and local (municipal) levels according to local conditions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of dual gigabit networks, coordinate the layout of data centers, actively and steadily develop the industrial internet and connected vehicles, and build a new digital infrastructure system driven by technological innovation, based on the next-generation communication network, with data and computing facilities as the core, and with integrated infrastructure as the breakthrough.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Comprehensively promote the construction of 5G networks. Accelerate the large-scale deployment of standalone (SA) 5G networks, gradually build a multi-frequency band coordinated development 5G network system, and timely carry out the construction of 5G millimeter wave networks. Speed up the expansion of 5G network coverage, optimize the indoor 5G network coverage in urban areas, focus on strengthening deep coverage in traffic hubs, large sports venues, scenic spots, and other areas with high traffic density, and promote the extension of 5G networks to towns and rural areas. Optimize the coverage of 5G networks in industrial parks, ports, factories, and mines, and promote the construction of 5G industry virtual private networks. Actively promote the sharing of telecommunications infrastructure, support the co-construction and sharing of 5G access networks, promote 5G network roaming, and gradually form a mobile communication network pattern with multiple networks coexisting in hotspot areas and a single network supporting remote areas. Accelerate the retirement of 2G and 3G networks, and coordinate the coordinated development of 4G and 5G networks. Deploy the 25G network deployment project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, comprehensive deployment of next-generation communication network infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Priority should be given to completing the outdoor 5G network coverage in key areas such as the central urban area, industrial parks, ports, transportation hubs, universities, and popular tourist attractions. The goal is to provide the public with a high-quality network with a downlink speed of 100Mbps and an uplink speed of 5Mbps. Additionally, a platform for monitoring and analyzing the quality of the 5G network should be established to conduct quality assessments and promote continuous optimization.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate 5G network coverage.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the testing and verification of 5G inter-network roaming and device upgrades, so that all 5G networks in county-level and below administrative regions have inter-network roaming capabilities. Encourage basic telecommunications companies to carry out inter-network roaming under market mechanisms, and support priority pilot projects for inter-network roaming in provinces such as Tibet, Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, Qinghai, Gansu, and Heilongjiang.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, actively carry out 5G inter-network roaming.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: According to the principle of intensive use of existing resources and sharing without building new ones, further improve the coordination mechanism for co-construction and sharing, continuously deepen the co-construction and sharing of 5G infrastructure, promote the construction of a 5G co-construction and sharing big data platform, continuously enhance the level of co-construction and sharing, and support the accelerated development of 5G networks. Fully deploy gigabit fiber-optic networks. Accelerate the construction of gigabit cities, continuously expand the coverage of gigabit fiber-optic networks, promote the deployment of 10-gigabit passive optical networks (10G-PON) in cities and key towns, and upgrade the optical access network capabilities in old urban areas. Improve the coverage of gigabit fiber-optic networks in industrial parks, commercial buildings, schools, medical and health institutions, and other key locations. Promote the further extension of all-optical access networks to user terminals, promote the implementation of fiber-optic connections to rooms, desks, and machines, and upgrade user-side access devices as needed. Strengthen the coordinated construction of various network links, improve end-to-end service experience, and actively guide broadband users to migrate to gigabit fiber-optic broadband services. Accelerate the evolution and upgrade of fiber-optic access technologies, and support the advanced layout of higher-speed broadband access networks in areas with conditions. Column 3: Deployment project for gigabit fiber-optic broadband networks.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and deepening the joint construction and sharing of 5G.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Deploy 10G-PONOLT equipment in urban and key township areas, and continue to carry out the transformation of the gigabit access capacity of old residential areas' optical distribution networks. Upgrade home and enterprise gateway devices as needed, optimize home indoor wiring, and establish gigabit wireless LAN networks.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate the deployment of gigabit fiber-optic networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the pilot demonstration of gigabit broadband applications, drive the development of new services such as CloudVR and ultra-high-definition video, and guide users to upgrade to gigabit broadband with higher speeds.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, enriching the application scenarios of gigabit fiber optic.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the construction of technical means, form a comprehensive monitoring platform for broadband network capabilities and end-to-end user experience covering the whole country, and have the ability to monitor in different regions, time periods, and network segments. Continuously promote the evolution of backbone networks and the upgrading of service capabilities. Enhance the carrying capacity of backbone networks, deploy backbone networks with 200G/400G ultra-large capacity optical transmission systems, create P-bit-level backbone network transmission capabilities, guide the sinking of 100G and higher-rate optical transmission systems to metropolitan area networks, and accelerate the deployment of optical transport network (OTN) equipment to comprehensive access nodes and user sides. Coordinate the construction of important routing optical cables, enrich direct optical cables between important cities. Accelerate the evolution of backbone networks towards cloud-computing data center-centric cloud-network integration architecture, and encourage the construction of direct network connections between data centers. Promote the large-scale application of technologies such as network function virtualization (NFV), software-defined networking (SDN), IPv6 segment routing (SRv6), and equipment such as all-optical cross-connect (OXC), improve the intelligent scheduling capability of network resources and resource utilization efficiency. Enhance end-to-end IPv6 connectivity capability. Accelerate the upgrade and transformation of IPv6 in network, data centers, content delivery networks (CDN), cloud services, and other infrastructure, improve IPv6 network performance and service level. Accelerate the upgrade and transformation of IPv6 in applications and terminals, achieve double growth in IPv6 user scale and business traffic. Promote the integration and development of IPv6 with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, industrial internet, and the internet of things, support the pilot and large-scale application of IPv6+ innovative technologies in key industries such as finance, energy, transportation, education, and government affairs, and enhance the support capability of IPv6 networks for industrial digital transformation and upgrading. Column 4: IPv6 network service capability improvement project. Column 4: IPv6 network service capability improvement project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and implementation of monitoring and evaluation of gigabit network capabilities and user experience.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Optimize key performance indicators of the backbone network, mobile core network, and broadband access network for IPv6. Accelerate the transformation of existing CDN nodes, IDC nodes, and cloud computing platforms to IPv6, and build new ones that fully support IPv6. Encourage enterprises to increase innovation and large-scale deployment of IPv6+ network technology.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, optimization of infrastructure IPv6 performance and service capabilities.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the support of IPv6 for home routers, smart TVs, set-top boxes, and IoT terminals to improve the IPv6 industry ecosystem for smart homes. Accelerate the support of IPv6 for existing terminal devices that meet the requirements through firmware and system upgrades. Enhance policy requirements for terminal devices to support IPv6.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and improvement of terminal device IPv6 support capability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the detection and disposal of vulnerabilities in the IPv6 environment, continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of network security technology applications, and promote the research, development, and application of network security products and services in the IPv6 environment. Promote the incubation of IPv6 security products under research and strengthen the performance verification of IPv6 security product applications.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, strengthening IPv6 network security capabilities.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of 5GSA network using IPv6 single-stack mode, organize pilot projects for IPv6 single-stack applications in areas such as 5G, Internet of Things, and Industrial Internet, and conduct pilot projects in at least 3 regions or fields. Promote the comprehensive development of mobile Internet of Things. Promote the migration of existing 2G/3G Internet of Things services to NB-IoT/4G (including LTE-Cat1, i.e., Category 1 4G network)/5G networks, and build a comprehensive ecological system for the coordinated development of low, medium, and high-speed mobile Internet of Things. Improve NB-IoT network deployment as needed, and enhance deep coverage in demand scenarios such as transportation networks, urban management networks, industrial parks, and modern agricultural demonstration areas. Support the development of 4G (including LTE-Cat1) to meet the needs of medium-speed Internet of Things and voice services. Accelerate the construction of 5G massive machine-type communication (mMTC) application scenario networks to meet the needs of high-speed and low-latency interconnection. Column 5 mobile Internet of Things deployment project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and implementation of IPv6 single-stack network pilot.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Build NB-IoT base stations on demand, deepen LTE-Cat1 network coverage, accelerate the construction of 5G network mMTC scenarios based on standard progress and industry maturity, continuously promote network operation, monitoring, and optimization, improve network service levels, and achieve a breakthrough of over 2 billion connected mobile IoT devices.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, optimization of mobile Internet of Things network coverage.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the development and growth of mobile Internet of Things (IoT) technology development platforms, further reducing the development costs and complexity of mobile IoT devices. Support basic telecommunications companies in building mobile IoT connection management platforms and strengthen network capability openness. Guide industry application companies to build vertical industry application platforms that integrate device and data management, system operation and maintenance functions, to meet differentiated scenario application needs. Support the application and ecosystem construction of next-generation multi-platform operating systems.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate the construction of mobile Internet of Things platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Carry out the collection of excellent cases for mobile Internet of Things applications, create a benchmark project for mobile Internet of Things, encourage the construction of national-level mobile Internet of Things industrial bases in areas with solid industrial foundations, and promote the large-scale development of mobile Internet of Things applications and the maturity of the industry ecosystem.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, expansion of mobile Internet of Things applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Track and analyze the development of the Internet of Things to provide evaluation support for business migration, application expansion, and industrial development. Accelerate the layout of satellite communications. Strengthen the top-level design and overall layout of satellite communications, promote high-orbit satellites, and coordinate the development of medium and low-orbit satellites. Promote the deep integration of satellite communication systems and ground information communication systems, initially forming a global, integrated information network, and providing global information network services for various users in land, sea, air, and space. Actively participate in the formulation of international standards for satellite communications. Encourage innovation in satellite communication applications, promote the large-scale application of the Beidou satellite navigation system in the field of information communication, and promote its application in aviation, navigation, public safety and emergency, transportation, and energy. Column 6: Satellite communication construction and the large-scale application of the Beidou satellite navigation system.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, establishment of monitoring indicators and mechanisms for the development of the mobile Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the coordinated layout of high, medium, and low orbit satellite networks, achieve the integration of 5G terrestrial cellular communication and satellite communication, initially establish a global satellite information network, and carry out the development and pilot demonstration of satellite communication applications.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and acceleration of satellite communication construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop plans for the use of satellite frequencies and orbit resources in relevant fields, strengthen centralized and unified management, and carry out tasks such as application, coordination, registration, and maintenance. Build a globally accessible information infrastructure. Optimize the layout of international communication entry and exit points, support the upgrading of regional international communication entry and exit points in border provinces, accelerate the expansion of international internet entry and exit bandwidth, and improve the quality of international information and communication services. Strengthen the top-level design of submarine cable construction, optimize the planning and layout of submarine cable landing stations, coordinate the construction of submarine cables in important directions such as North America and Europe, and establish smooth international submarine cable channels in Central and Western Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Europe. Establish and improve emergency mechanisms and protection systems for submarine cable protection and maintenance, establish a mechanism for mutual backup and sharing of submarine cables among enterprises, and enhance the emergency repair and operation monitoring capabilities of communication submarine cables. With basic telecommunications as the main body, establish a national submarine cable maintenance center, support the domestic shipbuilding of submarine cable maintenance vessels, strengthen the allocation of submarine cable maintenance vessels, and enhance the security capabilities of maritime communication network infrastructure. Optimize the layout of overseas information infrastructure, expand the coverage of overseas network service access points (POP), and increase overseas cloud computing data centers and CDN nodes. Column 7: International submarine cable construction and protection projects. Column 7: International submarine cable construction and protection projects.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, strengthening satellite frequency and orbit resource management and utilization.

content: Establishing international submarine cable landing stations, further enriching submarine cable resources in the 'Belt and Road' and other directions, improving submarine cable routing backup, supporting enterprises to participate in international submarine cable construction projects, further optimizing the international submarine cable layout, and significantly enhancing submarine cable connectivity.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate international submarine cable construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen cooperation with neighboring countries in infrastructure construction, increase the direction of cross-border land cables, expand the capacity of cross-border land cable systems, further optimize the international land cable layout, and significantly enhance land cable connectivity.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and establishment of international land cable channels.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the construction of two self-owned cable maintenance ships in our country, establish two national-level cable protection bases in the East China Sea and the South China Sea, and have the ability to simultaneously handle six communication cable faults, forming an internationally competitive cable construction and maintenance force.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and increased protection of submarine cables.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Expand the backbone network interconnection nodes, optimize data center cross-network and cross-regional data exchange, improve the quality of interconnection between basic telecommunications enterprises and Internet enterprises, and provide high-quality data transmission services. Establish a direct network connection between regional data center clusters and between clusters and major cities, providing high-quality data transmission services.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and promotion of the integration of data centers and networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the use of efficient cooling solutions such as liquid cooling and water cooling in the construction of new large-scale and super-large-scale data centers. Promote efficient power supply and distribution solutions such as direct current power supply, high-voltage distribution, and distributed power supply. Utilize modular data centers and high-efficiency IT equipment to improve the utilization of renewable energy and construct green data centers at a high level. Accelerate the energy-saving and greening transformation of small and scattered data centers with poor efficiency and high energy consumption. Encourage data center operators to strengthen internal energy consumption data monitoring and management to improve energy utilization efficiency.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, continuous improvement of the green development level of data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the large platform of data centers in China, the online monitoring platform for data center networks, establish a data-network collaboration linkage mechanism, and enhance the network service capabilities of data centers. Build a monitoring platform for cloud computing facilities, enhance monitoring capabilities in terms of industry distribution, industry scale, cloud service availability, cloud platform network quality, cloud supply, and cloud usage. Enhance the service capabilities of artificial intelligence infrastructure. Construct standardized public data sets for industry applications, enhance the level of public data openness and empowerment. Create an artificial intelligence algorithm framework, encourage enterprises to accelerate the iteration and upgrade of algorithm frameworks. Build an advanced algorithm model library, create a general and industry-specific artificial intelligence algorithm platform, and strengthen software and chip compatibility. Support enterprises and research institutions in building inclusive open innovation platforms for artificial intelligence. Construct blockchain infrastructure. Promote the construction of a blockchain public infrastructure network based on consortium chains, providing developers with a unified blockchain operating environment and underlying technical services. Build blockchain infrastructure based on distributed identification, support cross-chain interoperability between homogeneous chains and heterogeneous chains, and enhance the interconnection capabilities between blockchain systems. Support the construction of general-purpose and dedicated blockchain public service platforms that can be deployed in the cloud, and layout blockchain-as-a-service (BaaS) cloud service platforms.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and monitoring the quality and development of data centers and cloud computing facilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Build a comprehensive interconnected industrial internet. Accelerate the construction of an industrial internet network that covers all regions and industries. Support the collaboration between basic telecommunications companies and industrial enterprises, and use new network technologies and advanced applicable technologies to build and transform enterprise intranets. Create benchmark enterprise intranet upgrades and transformations and 5G fully connected factories for key industries. Improve the industrial internet identification and resolution system, enhance the service capabilities of national top-level nodes, optimize the layout of secondary nodes and recursive nodes, accelerate the application of identification resolution services in various industries, and promote the deployment of active identification carriers on a large scale. Improve the multi-level industrial internet platform system, cultivate a number of comprehensive platforms that cross industries and domains, build characteristic industrial internet platforms for key industries, support the development of professional industrial internet platforms for specific technical fields, and accelerate the cloud-based platform for industrial equipment and business systems. Construct and improve the national, regional, and industry-level industrial internet big data center system, and utilize industrial internet big data in accordance with laws and regulations. Column 9: Industrial Internet Innovation and Development Project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, actively developing efficient and collaborative integrated infrastructure.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a high-performance, highly reliable, and highly secure enterprise extranet to support industrial enterprises in building their intranets using new network technologies such as 5G, Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), and edge computing. Accelerate the network transformation of industrial equipment, enhance industrial data collection and interoperability capabilities. Create 150 benchmarking cases for upgrading and transforming enterprise intranets, establish 5G fully connected factories in 20 key industries, and build 8 5G+ industrial Internet public service platforms.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, upgrading and transformation of industrial internet intranet and extranet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enhance the comprehensive service capabilities of the country's top-level nodes, accelerate the construction and operation of second-level nodes for identification resolution and public recursive nodes, with more than 150 second-level nodes and a total registration volume of no less than 50 billion.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, improvement of industrial Internet identification and resolution system.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build three comprehensive industrial Internet platforms with international influence, establish 70 industry-specific regional platforms, improve the quality of technical supply and application services of industrial Internet platforms, and double the number of industrial enterprises on cloud and platform.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and acceleration of industrial Internet platform construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build 20 regional-level sub-centers and 10 industry-level sub-centers. Construct an industrial microservice and industrial APP resource pool.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, construction of industrial internet big data center.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Form around 200 fusion application pilot demonstrations with industry characteristics in various specialized fields, support the construction of innovation and promotion centers for industrial internet platform applications, and create a group of industrial internet industry demonstration bases with regional characteristics and strong driving capabilities.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and implementation of pilot demonstrations for the integration of industrial internet applications.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Guide localities to actively promote the creation of a batch of national industrial internet demonstration zones, accelerate the technological breakthroughs and promotion of industrial internet, and build a highland for the development of industrial internet. Accelerate the deployment and application of connected vehicles. Strengthen the top-level design of the deployment of C-V2X-based connected vehicle infrastructure, promote the upgrade and transformation of highway connected vehicles through the integration of blocks and sections, and construct national pilot zones for connected vehicles. Coordinate the development of smart city infrastructure and intelligent connected vehicles, actively carry out urban pilots, and promote multi-scenario applications. Promote the coordinated construction of C-V2X, 5G networks, intelligent transportation, and smart cities, accelerate large-scale deployment on major urban roads, and explore pilot applications on certain sections of highways. Promote the research and development and testing verification of key technologies for connected vehicles, and explore innovation in the operation entities and business models of connected vehicles. Coordinate with the automotive, transportation, and other industries to promote the application of connected vehicles and accelerate the penetration of connected vehicle end-users. Coordinate the deployment of new types of infrastructure for social life. Further strengthen the construction of remote medical network capabilities. Encourage enterprises to participate in the construction of smart medical systems such as remote medical platforms. Cooperate with the education department, fully utilize national public communication resources, and accelerate the construction of education virtual private networks. Support basic telecommunications companies to cooperate with power grid companies in building smart power IoT using technologies such as the Internet of Things and network slicing. Support the construction of application scenarios such as high-definition remote interactive teaching and VR immersive teaching based on 5G networks. Actively promote the coordinated layout and construction of intelligent sensing facilities and multifunctional poles for typical scenarios such as environmental monitoring, public security, and emergency rescue. Support the construction of new urban infrastructure. Promote the intelligent upgrade of traditional infrastructure using technologies such as 5G, the Internet of Things, big data, and artificial intelligence. Accelerate the construction of the City Information Model (CIM) platform and operation management service platform; implement the intelligent transformation of municipal infrastructure, promote the application of intelligent sensing facilities for water supply, drainage, gas, and heat facilities, and improve the operational efficiency and safety performance of facilities; construct a fusion sensing system for urban roads, buildings, and public facilities, and coordinate the development of smart cities and intelligent connected vehicles; establish a smart property management service platform, promote the integration of online and offline property services, and build smart communities; promote the coordinated development of intelligent construction and industrialization of construction, implement projects to enhance intelligent construction capabilities, cultivate intelligent construction industrial bases, build a big data platform for the construction industry, and realize intelligent production, intelligent design, intelligent construction, and intelligent operation and maintenance.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and acceleration of the construction of national industrial internet demonstration zones.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the use of various technologies such as SDN/NFV, artificial intelligence, etc., actively promote the intelligent transformation and green upgrade of network facilities, and reduce the power consumption of data centers, mobile base stations, and other facilities. Encourage energy-saving transformations in existing data centers with high energy consumption and low energy utilization rates, accelerate the retirement or upgrade of old and high-energy-consuming traditional equipment in the existing network, and adopt energy-saving and emission reduction technologies and equipment for new information infrastructure. Actively promote the use of renewable energy such as wind energy and solar energy. Accelerate the empowerment of information technology in various sectors of society for energy conservation and emission reduction, build an intelligent+ green ecological system, and reduce overall social energy consumption.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, promotion of energy conservation, emission reduction, and green development in the industry.
