Build an industrial ecosystem, promote regional applications, encourage the construction of 5G+ Industrial Internet integration application pilot zones in various regions, and continuously expand the application of 5G in fields such as raw materials, equipment, consumer goods, and electronics. 10.5G+ Connected Vehicles. Strengthen collaboration in the automotive, communication, and transportation industries, enhance the connection between government, industry organizations, and enterprises, jointly establish a comprehensive 5G and connected vehicle testing and evaluation system to ensure end-to-end interconnection and interoperability of applications. Refine typical application scenarios that can be scaled up and have a complete commercial closed-loop, and improve user acceptance. Accelerate the penetration rate of C-V2X communication modules in vehicles and roadside deployment. Accelerate the exploration of business models and application scenarios, support the creation of national-level connected vehicle pilot zones, promote the coordinated planning and construction of connected vehicle infrastructure and 5G networks, select key cities, typical areas, suitable road sections, and key sections of highways, accelerate the deployment of 5G+ connected vehicles, and promote the innovative application of C-V2X technology in areas such as industrial parks, airports, ports, and mines. Establish a cross-industry and cross-regional trusted and recognized connected vehicle security communication system. 11.5G+ Smart Logistics. Strengthen innovation in the application of 5G in logistics in areas such as industrial parks, warehouses, and communities, promote the application of 5G in scenarios such as unmanned vehicle express delivery, intelligent sorting, unmanned warehousing, intelligent wearables, and intelligent recognition. Accelerate the construction of 5G-based logistics Internet of Things data access, computing, and application platforms, promote the development of logistics automation intelligent equipment and infrastructure based on edge-cloud collaboration, and help realize the automation of transportation, intelligent warehousing, and full-process monitoring in the logistics industry. 12.5G+ Smart Ports. Develop 5G-assisted positioning products suitable for port container environments, accelerate the digital transformation and construction of automated terminals and storage yards. Promote the digitalization of port construction, maintenance, and operation processes throughout the entire cycle, accelerate the construction of smart port infrastructure, promote the application of 5G in scenarios such as unmanned inspections, remote tower cranes, automated guided transportation, automated container truck driving, and intelligent cargo handling in port areas, and promote port intelligence. 13.5G+ Intelligent Mining. Accelerate the development and certification of 5G communication equipment suitable for mining environments with explosion-proof requirements, promote the integration of 5G network systems in open-pit mines and underground mining areas, intelligent mining area control platforms, and enterprise cloud platforms. Promote the application of 5G in various types of mining areas such as energy minerals, metal minerals, and non-metallic minerals, expand the application scenarios of remote control and unmanned driving in the mining industry, promote remote control and clustering of core mining equipment in deep and high-risk areas, and achieve intelligent continuous operation and unmanned transportation in open-pit mining areas. 14.5G+ Smart Power. Breakthrough key technologies such as deterministic latency, time synchronization accuracy, and security assurance in the power industry, build a power communication management support system and edge computing platform integrated with 5G. Upgrade and transform industrial control and monitoring networks based on 5G, promote the application of scenarios such as power generation equipment maintenance, distribution automation, transmission line/substation inspection, and power consumption information collection, realize visualization of power generation, intelligent control of distribution, unmanned monitoring of transmission and transformation, and real-time collection of power consumption. 15.5G+ Smart Oil and Gas. Develop 5G special terminals suitable for complex environments in oil fields, promote the development of intelligent data collection 5G gateways and monitoring products with multiple protocols, and achieve effective connection with communication interfaces in the oil and gas field. Implement deep application of 5G in scenarios such as high-definition video monitoring in oil fields, pipeline leakage monitoring, intelligent robot inspections, and hazardous material transportation monitoring, and provide intelligent support for safe and efficient oil and gas collection, pipeline transmission, and oil and gas refining. 16.5G+ Smart Agriculture. Based on the digitalization needs of agriculture and rural areas, focus on promoting 5G technology and applications for wide coverage and low-cost scenarios. Enrich the application scenarios of 5G in smart agriculture, accelerate the innovation of 5G applications in unmanned agricultural operations such as smart agricultural machinery and agricultural robots, and develop applications of 5G in areas such as cold chain logistics for agricultural products and live streaming e-commerce. Strengthen the integration of digital rural areas and 5G applications, improve the level of rural governance and public service informatization, use 5G to extend education, culture, medical care, and other resources to rural areas, and promote rural information consumption. 17.5G+ Smart Water Conservancy. Promote the deep integration of 5G technology and the water conservancy industry, apply new technologies such as 5G, the Internet of Things, remote sensing, and edge computing to improve the perception level of water conservancy elements. Combine technologies such as Beidou positioning and artificial intelligence to study the top-level design and model algorithm implementation of artificial intelligence construction systems, and achieve breakthroughs in the application of 5G human-machine collaboration in construction scenarios.'
titlelist: Empowering key areas of 5G applications, deepening industry integration applications action.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: '18.5G+ Smart Education. Accelerate the research and development of 5G teaching terminal devices and AR/VR teaching digital content, combine AR/VR, holographic projection, and other technologies to achieve scenario-based interactive teaching, and create an immersive classroom. Promote the support of 5G technology for the education private network, study and formulate technical specifications for online education key links such as networks, applications, and terminals, combined with specific application scenarios. Increase the promotion of 5G in smart classrooms, holographic teaching, campus security, education management, student comprehensive evaluation, and other scenarios, enhance the informatization capabilities of teaching, management, scientific research, services, and other aspects. 19.5G+ Smart Healthcare. Carry out research and development of 5G medical robots, 5G ambulances, 5G medical access gateways, intelligent medical devices, and other products. Strengthen the deployment of 5G medical and health network infrastructure, focus on optimizing coverage in national tertiary hospitals, disease prevention and control centers, convenient medical points, medical and nursing combined institutions, and other places, and create 5G networks and 5G medical edge clouds for in-hospital medical care and remote medical care. Enrich the application scenarios of 5G technology in the medical and health industry, focus on promoting the application of 5G in emergency treatment, remote diagnosis, health management, and other scenarios, and accelerate the cultivation of new formats of smart medical services that are technologically advanced, superior in performance, and have obvious effects. 20.5G+ Culture and Tourism. Breakthrough key common technologies of digital content, promote the research and development of key technologies such as ultra-high-definition video coding and decoding, end-cloud collaborative rendering, 3D reconstruction, and develop AR/VR immersive content, 4K/8K videos, and other applications adapted to 5G networks. Build AR/VR business support platforms and cloud content aggregation and distribution platforms, promote the development of interactive content industries such as social networking, broadcasting and viewing, e-sports, digital art, combined with 5G. Promote the integration and innovation of 5G with cultural and tourism equipment, cultural preservation equipment, and ice and snow equipment. Promote the development of online digital experience products in scenic spots, museums, etc., cultivate new formats such as cloud tourism, cloud live streaming, cloud exhibitions, online broadcasting, encourage the development of new cultural and tourism consumption models such as customization, experience, intelligence, and interaction, and create immersive cultural and tourism experience new scenes. 21.5G+ Smart City. Increase the application of products such as ultra-high-definition video surveillance, patrol robots, smart police terminals, smart emergency terminals, etc., in urban security and emergency management, and build a real-time and accurate security and control system. Accelerate the deployment of smart metering and other products in municipal management, environmental monitoring, and other fields, explore the construction of digital twin cities, and improve urban perception capabilities. Speed up the promotion of smart government services based on 5G technology for information benefit and convenience. Accelerate the digital transformation of communities, parks, blocks, etc., and form a batch of comprehensive solutions for 5G smart communities, providing all-round digital community life services. Promote the innovative application of 5G technology in the construction of new urban infrastructure based on digitization, networking, and intelligence, and comprehensively improve the level of urban construction and operational efficiency.'
titlelist: Empowering key areas of 5G applications, promoting inclusive actions for social and livelihood services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of independent 5G networks, expand 5G network coverage in urban and rural areas, continuously build high-quality 5G networks, and promote the coordinated development of dual gigabit networks. The newly built 5G network fully supports IPv6 and focuses on improving IPv6 traffic in 5G networks. Strengthen the coverage of 5G networks in indoor scenarios, underground spaces, key transportation hubs, and along main routes, promote high-speed rail on the 5G public network, and improve the quality of network services in typical scenarios. Promote the use of mid and low-frequency bands to expand 5G network coverage in rural and remote areas.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, strengthen the foundation of 5G network capabilities, and improve the coverage level of 5G networks for the public.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the improvement of key technical support capabilities such as end-to-end network slicing, edge computing, and high-precision indoor positioning, and promote 5G coverage in key areas such as free trade zones, industrial parks, enterprise factory areas, and medical institutions. Support local areas in building 5G industry virtual private networks based on regional needs, explore new network construction models, and create regional leading effects.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, strengthen the foundation of 5G network capabilities, and enhance the supply capability of 5G networks for industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Continue to do a good job in coordinating the interference of radio stations such as 5G base stations and satellite earth stations. Promote the frequency migration of the 700MHz band broadcasting and television services, accelerate the deployment of 5G networks in the 700MHz band, timely release the frequency planning of 5G millimeter wave, explore the implementation of bidding system for 5G millimeter wave frequency licenses, conduct research on the demand for 5G industrial dedicated frequencies and compatibility with other radio systems, and study and formulate suitable models and management rules for the use of 5G industrial dedicated frequencies in China.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, strengthen the foundation of 5G network capabilities, and strengthen the guarantee of 5G frequency resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support telecommunications operators, communication equipment, vertical industries, information technology, and internet companies to combine their own advantages and carry out 5G integration application technology innovation, integration innovation, service innovation, and data application innovation. Deepen the integration and innovation of 5G, cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, blockchain, and other technologies, play a good combination punch of technology, continuously cultivate new blue oceans of 5G applications. Build a group of application solution providers who understand both 5G and industries, form a directory of 5G application solution providers, support the digital transformation of thousands of industries, promote the scale development of chip modules, and promote cross-border collaboration between upstream and downstream.
titlelist: Enhancing the support capability of 5G applications, promoting the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and accelerating cross-domain integration and innovative development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage and support the integration of regional characteristics and industry advantages in various places, open up 5G application scenarios, and accelerate the implementation of local characteristic applications. Build a leading area for 5G application innovation with significant synergistic effects, strong radiation driving capabilities, and clear business models. Explore new models for application promotion, and promote the large-scale application of key industries in a focused and comprehensive manner.
titlelist: Enhancing the support capability of 5G applications, promoting the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and driving policy innovation for 5G integrated applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Relying on the 5G application industry matrix, with leading enterprises and research institutions as the main creators, we will establish a number of 5G integrated application innovation centers to carry out technology and industrial services for application innovation. Relying on industry-leading enterprises, universities, and research institutes, we will accelerate the construction of 5G application incubators and maker spaces, and improve the operation mode of innovation carriers. We will leverage the regional industrial agglomeration advantages of incubators and maker spaces, combine local industrial characteristics, and promote the transfer and transformation of 5G technology and application solution achievements.
titlelist: Enhancing the support capability of 5G applications, promoting the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and carrying out the construction of innovative carriers for 5G applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Facing the key common technology needs in industrial manufacturing, transportation, healthcare, and other key sectors, we rely on industry-leading enterprises, higher education institutions, and research institutes to carry out joint research and development of key technologies for 5G industry applications. We aim to build key industry common technology platforms to solve the technological bottlenecks that hinder the replication and promotion of industry applications. We will focus on supporting the construction of common technology platforms that combine 5G with outdoor high-precision positioning using Beidou, indoor 5G cellular independent positioning, artificial intelligence, ultra-high-definition video, augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR), and other technologies. These platforms will provide cross-industry basic capabilities for 5G applications.Column 3: Cultivating a demonstration project for the innovation ecosystem of 5G applications. We will cultivate suppliers of 5G application solutions and promote industry-leading enterprises to leverage their technological and market advantages to launch overall 5G application solutions and integrated products for key industries. This will create a group of leading suppliers of 5G application solutions with strong innovation capabilities and significant driving effects. We will also guide small and medium-sized enterprises with technological advantages and industry knowledge and experience to launch 5G application solutions and mature products that are deeply integrated with industry needs. This will create a group of 5G application solution suppliers focused on key industry segments.We will build industry-leading benchmarks. By mobilizing the enthusiasm of key industry-leading enterprises and leveraging their demand-driven and resource integration roles, we will establish key links in 5G application development, create a group of benchmark 5G application cases, and provide demonstration and guidance for the large-scale application of 5G.We will establish a 5G integrated application innovation center. We will promote collaborative innovation across the entire 5G application industry chain, conduct product engineering research and development, and improve the efficiency of scientific and technological innovation and achievement transformation. We will continue to build and improve the 5G application repository, strengthen the connection between innovation elements supply and demand, and share resources. We will provide high-end research and development services and productive services for 5G applications, support the construction of application testing and verification laboratories for key industry needs, and accelerate the development of 5G application technology verification and quality testing services.We will create a leading area for 5G application innovation. We will stimulate innovation vitality in various regions, actively carry out pilot projects for application innovation policies, optimize the development environment for 5G applications, explore new models for 5G network construction and application development, and create a group of leading areas for 5G application innovation. We will coordinate and promote differentiated 5G applications across the country, leverage the industrial agglomeration effects of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, strengthen regional cooperation, and promote the construction of a group of 5G industrial bases. We will encourage localities with conditions to increase support and create a group of replicable and promotable 5G application projects. We will continue to hold the Blossom Cup 5G application solicitation competition, timely release excellent cases of 5G integrated applications, and accelerate the landing and promotion of 5G applications.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, promote the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and strengthen the support of common technical platforms for 5G applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a comprehensive security management mechanism for the entire lifecycle of 5G applications, guide enterprises to incorporate the 5G application security risk assessment mechanism into the 5G application development and promotion workflow, simultaneously plan and implement security management and technical measures for construction and operation, and implement them synchronously with 5G applications. Carry out supervision and inspection of 5G applications and critical information infrastructure to enhance the security level of 5G applications.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, take action to improve the security of 5G applications, and strengthen the risk assessment of 5G application security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of 5G security evaluation institutions that are in line with international standards, establish a 5G application and network infrastructure security evaluation system, and carry out evaluations and certifications of 5G application and infrastructure security capabilities.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, enhance the action of improving the security of 5G applications, enhance the capability of security evaluation and certification of 5G applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a solid foundation for cultivating 5G talents, support the precise cultivation of higher education institutions, scientific research institutes, and enterprises in collaboration, encourage the joint establishment of laboratories, training bases, professional research institutes, or interdisciplinary research centers between enterprises and higher education institutions, scientific research institutes, and strengthen the construction of shared engineering internship bases. Promote the upgrading and digital transformation of 5G-related majors, implement the pilot system of 1+X certificates in 5G-related fields, organize security technology skills competitions, organize 5G-related vocational training and certification, enrich channels for discovering and selecting 5G talents, and cultivate a group of talents who understand both 5G communication technology and industry expertise. Carry out public education on 5G knowledge to enhance the digital skills of the general public.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, cultivate talent pool.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of overseas promotion channels and service platforms for 5G applications, and promote the internationalization of mature 5G applications. Play a coordinating role in international organizations and encourage companies to participate in the work of international standardization organizations for 5G. Encourage domestic companies to strengthen overseas cooperation in 5G applications, provide higher quality products and services for countries or regions along the Belt and Road initiative, and create a new platform for international cooperation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote international cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen policy effectiveness evaluation and dynamic adjustment, establish a 5G development monitoring system, construct a panoramic 5G network map, regularly monitor the progress of 5G applications and industries, and promote the comprehensive and coordinated development of 5G. Annex: 5G development application indicators. Serial number Indicator Indicator meaning Indicator value. 1 5G personal user penetration rate (%) 5G personal user penetration rate = 5G mobile phone users / national population. Where 5G mobile phone users refer to individuals using 5G networks. 2 5G network access traffic ratio (%) The proportion of 5G network access traffic to total mobile internet access traffic. 3 5G penetration rate in large industrial enterprises (%) The proportion of large industrial enterprises in China that have implemented 5G applications in production and operation processes. 4 Average annual growth rate of 5G IoT terminal users (%) Average annual growth rate of 5G IoT terminal users in the industry. 200. 5 Number of 5G base stations per 10,000 people (units) The average number of 5G base stations per 10,000 people nationwide. 6 Number of 5G industry virtual private networks (units) The number of 5G virtual networks constructed for industry enterprises using the 5G public network. 3000. 7 Number of 5G application benchmarks per key industry (units) The number of 5G application benchmarks selected for each key industry. 100. Note: 1. Large industrial enterprises are large-scale industrial enterprises determined by the National Bureau of Statistics based on China's industrial enterprise size classification standards. 2. The number of 5G IoT terminal users is counted based on SIM cards.
titlelist: Ensure measures, conduct monitoring and evaluation.

content: Research on 5G networking and access solutions for intelligent power plants, carry out construction of 5G wireless network coverage for power plants, comprehensively utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, edge computing, etc., ensure the safety of power plants, and build a comprehensive industrial Internet of Things and data transmission network that adapts to the complex environment of power plants based on demand. Carry out the upgrade and transformation of industrial control and monitoring networks based on 5G communication, realize technical verification and deep application of typical business scenarios such as production control, intelligent inspection, operation and maintenance, and safety emergency, and form a batch of typical 5G application scenarios in the fields of thermal power, nuclear power, hydropower, and new energy. titlelist: Guarantee measures, further expanding 5G application scenarios in the energy field, intelligent inspection.

content: Based on 5G and cloud technology, artificial intelligence, data mining, and other technologies, it comprehensively achieves functions such as intelligent monitoring and perception of equipment status, intelligent evaluation of equipment status, intelligent diagnosis and early warning of equipment failures, AR-assisted maintenance, and remote expert support.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, further expanding 5G application scenarios in the energy field, intelligent operation and maintenance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Based on technologies such as 5G, it enhances the disaster recovery capability of communication systems, while comprehensively achieving technical control and visual management of personnel safety, hazardous chemical safety, high-risk operation safety, and other safety aspects. It realizes human-machine collaboration and remote operation assistance in emergency rescue and rapid response situations.
titlelist: Security measures, further expanding 5G application scenarios in the energy field, and ensuring safety in emergencies.

content: Accelerate the development of customized equipment for the 5G communication terminal, module prototypes, and other industry-specific devices. name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Based on the high-speed, large connectivity characteristics, and edge computing technologies of the 5G network, activities such as robot inspections for power transmission and distribution, drone inspections, and high-definition video monitoring are carried out to promote the deep application of micro-meteorological regional monitoring and auxiliary decision-making, transmission line disaster monitoring and intelligent decision-making, and all-weather remote channel visualization.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, further expanding 5G application scenarios in the energy field, transmission and distribution operation monitoring.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Based on the low latency, high reliability characteristics of 5G network, as well as edge computing and other technologies, real-time data interaction is achieved for modules such as clean energy resource assessment, distributed energy storage regulation capacity assessment, power generation prediction, and station operation analysis, promoting the integration of new energy generation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, further expanding 5G application scenarios in the energy field, new energy and energy storage grid connection.

content: Based on the high-speed characteristics of 5G network and technologies such as edge computing, it realizes the self-organizing network and feedback of various multimedia equipment at emergency communication sites, as well as high-definition video cluster communication and command decision-making.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, further expanding 5G application scenarios in the energy field, comprehensive application of emergency on-site self-organizing networks.

content: Constructing the 5G network infrastructure for coal mines, both above and below ground, and establishing intelligent coal mine integration control platforms, enterprise cloud platforms, and big data processing centers, among other infrastructure, to create a 'cloud-edge-end' architecture for the mining industry's industrial internet. content: Based on the high-speed and high-reliability characteristics of the 5G network, underground visualization is achieved.
