name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the rapid development of high-speed fiber broadband networks. Complete the transformation of old residential areas' fiber networks, achieve fiber network coverage in urban areas, and provide access services with a capacity of over 1,000 gigabits per second. Achieve a bandwidth of over 100 megabits per second for home users in large and medium-sized cities. Basically achieve fiber optic access in administrative villages, provide access services with a capacity of over 100 megabits per second in areas with conditions, and achieve a bandwidth of over 50 megabits per second for over half of rural households. Promote the application of ultra-high-speed and large-capacity optical transmission technology, upgrade the backbone transmission network, and enhance high-speed transmission, flexible scheduling, and intelligent adaptation capabilities. Accelerate the construction of advanced ubiquitous wireless broadband networks. Promote the coordinated development of wireless broadband networks in urban and rural areas, and achieve deep and wide coverage of 4G networks. Improve WLAN coverage in urban hotspots. Strengthen the connection between urban communication infrastructure special planning and overall urban planning to meet the construction needs of communication infrastructure such as communication pipelines, equipment rooms, and base stations. Coordinate the construction of satellite communication systems and realize complementary development with ground information communication infrastructure. Based on demand, flexibly select wireless broadband access technologies and accelerate network coverage in remote mountainous areas, pastoral areas, and islands. Optimize network structure layout. Take data centers as the core, break the traditional regional and administrative network configuration model, promote the transformation and upgrading of traditional networks, and build a new type of network that supports the development of Internet services. Expand the interconnection bandwidth of the backbone network and improve the quality of interconnection. Promote the construction of new Internet exchange centers and coordinate development with backbone direct connection points. Promote the construction of international communication network nodes and reasonably set up overseas IDC, CDN, and POP points. Promote the construction of an international Internet access performance monitoring platform and enhance the ability to guarantee the quality of international network services. Strengthen the infrastructure of IPv6 networks, complete the upgrade and transformation of domestic Internet IPv6, and construct IPv6 international entry and exit points. Column 2: Network architecture upgrade and optimization project. Project goal: Upgrade and optimize network structure to meet the needs of Internet service development. Project content: Accelerate the application of new technologies such as NFV and SDN. Promote the migration of traditional telecommunications services to cloud computing platforms. Increase the deployment of cluster routers and expand the backbone Internet bandwidth. Improve the hierarchy of data center nodes and promote the flattening of data-carrying network structures. Deploy CDN on a large scale to alleviate network traffic pressure. Strengthen top-level design, reasonably layout backbone direct connection points, and build new Internet exchange centers. Construct and improve the operation and interconnection monitoring system of the Internet network. Incorporate the demand for data center nodes into the unified backbone transmission network, and prioritize traffic diversion from ring networks to mesh networks. Increase the connectivity of optical cables in the areas where data centers are located. Column 3: International communication network deployment project. Project goal: Improve the layout of international submarine and land cables and achieve interconnection with more operators. Project content: First, the construction of international submarine and land cables. Construct international submarine cable projects that connect North America, Asia-Pacific, Europe, Africa, Latin America, and other directions, with a focus on cross-border land cable construction in the China-Russia, China-ASEAN, China-South Asia, and China-Central Asia directions. Continue to carry out cross-border optical cable construction with neighboring countries and establish direct cross-border optical cables with countries and regions that have conditions based on business development. Expand and optimize existing cross-border systems in a timely manner and explore cross-border interconnection. Second, the construction of overseas POP points. Focus on deploying overseas POP points in neighboring countries and regions, as well as in European, African, and Latin American countries.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, improve infrastructure, build a new generation of information and communication infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the overall planning of data center construction, and guide large and super-large data centers to prioritize deployment in areas with cold climate, abundant energy, and fewer natural disasters. Guide small and medium-sized data centers to prioritize deployment in areas close to users and with convenient access to energy, and flexibly deploy according to market demand. Encourage existing data center enterprises to integrate, transform, and upgrade using advanced technologies such as cloud computing and green energy. Guide and support enterprises in carrying out CDN construction and operation, expand network capacity, coverage, and service capabilities, and gradually build a technologically advanced and secure CDN network. Coordinate the development of cloud computing and big data platforms, support the migration of government and industry information systems to cloud platforms, encourage backbone enterprises to open up their own cloud platform resources, and guide interconnection between platforms. Make full use of existing information and communication infrastructure, enhance the support capacity for Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) access. Select key application areas such as energy and power, urban management and transportation, industrial manufacturing, and modern agriculture. Combine with the construction of communication network facilities to deploy various IoT sensing devices such as video collection terminals, RFID tags, multiple types of barcodes, and composite sensor nodes at key locations such as power transmission lines, multifunctional information poles in cities, industrial workshop production lines, and cultivation and processing facilities. Column 4: Narrowband Internet of Things Engineering Objectives: Build and improve the infrastructure of the Narrowband Internet of Things, and achieve large-scale applications in urban operation management and key industries. Engineering content: First, improve the nationwide network that supports the Narrowband Internet of Things, upgrade and transform wireless, core networks, and supporting network management and operation systems to achieve effective coverage nationwide. Second, realize the large-scale application of the Narrowband Internet of Things in smart cities, key industries, etc. Research and establish demonstration projects for Narrowband Internet of Things applications, provide appropriate support for typical applications and innovation, explore business models, and promote the maturity of the industry chain.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, improve infrastructure, consolidate the foundation of Internet and Internet of Things applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Information and communication technology is used to drive energy conservation throughout society. By promoting the development of the 'Internet+' and sharing economy, traditional industries are encouraged to transform and upgrade, specialized energy management systems are applied in key industries to optimize resource allocation, improve resource utilization, and reduce overall energy consumption in society. Safe and controllable new energy and energy-saving technologies are actively promoted in various industries. The concept of low-carbon circulation and green environmental protection is integrated into every aspect of data center construction, equipment procurement, installation, and network operation and maintenance. The goal is to completely retire circuit switches and accelerate the green transformation of high-energy-consuming network equipment and data centers. Explorations are being made to establish benchmarks for mobile base stations based on energy consumption PUE, promote overall energy consumption control of mobile base stations, establish energy-saving and environmental protection evaluation mechanisms, and promote the development of energy-saving and environmental protection evaluation technologies and platforms.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, improve infrastructure, promote green and low-carbon development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The deep-level interaction and collaboration of the industrial chain from research and development to application, expanding the scope of information services, and improving the level and quality of information services. Strengthen the planning and layout of infrastructure such as communication networks and data centers, and enhance the support capabilities of the Internet in information aggregation, analysis, and processing. Give full play to the leading role and dominant position of Internet companies, use technological innovation as a breakthrough, and promote the research and industrialization of core technologies in areas such as mobile Internet, 5G, cloud computing, big data, the Internet of Things, virtual reality, artificial intelligence, 3D printing, and quantum communication. Actively promote industrial collaboration, fully tap into the potential of the Internet in supporting intelligent manufacturing, promoting industrial upgrading, and serving society, and gradually realize the independent development, innovative development, and balanced development of the Internet industry. Cultivate industrial clusters with enterprises as the main body and prominent industry characteristics, and strengthen a group of enterprises with international influence and industrial leadership. Further improve the management level of the Internet, continuously optimize the market competition structure, regulate the competition order, and actively create an innovative, standardized, efficient, and well-guaranteed market development environment.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, innovative service applications, development of a modern Internet industry system based on open Internet capabilities for research and development, application aggregation centers, integrating upstream and downstream industry elements, promoting...

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen policy support and guidance, actively cultivate and expand new Internet businesses, new applications, new formats, and new models. Vigorously promote the development of Internet applications such as e-commerce, video, entertainment, social media, and search websites and mobile apps. Encourage companies to further deepen customer-centric product development concepts and operating models, explore new demands, and support positive and healthy innovation and creation of online text, video, and audio content. Strengthen intellectual property protection and services for small and medium-sized enterprises, especially innovative enterprises. Fully deepen the utilization of Internet data resources, enhance the integration and mining capabilities of data resources, cultivate and standardize new applications and markets based on data resources. Encourage companies to innovate business models, accelerate horizontal integration in various Internet sectors, and use the flow of information to drive efficient flows of technology, capital, talent, and materials, achieving diversified profit models for enterprises.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, innovative service applications, and deepening the development of new forms of the Internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Further leverage the integration and leading role of information and communication enterprises in the industrial chain of the Internet of Things, promote the integration and development of the Internet of Things with mobile internet, cloud computing, big data, and other new formats, cultivate and expand new professional services related to the Internet of Things, and improve the level of operation and application services. Support the construction of various Internet of Things operation service platforms, strengthen the extensive coverage and deep application of Internet of Things technology in industries such as industry, agriculture, transportation, and energy. Deepen the innovative application of industrial cyber-physical systems in research and development, design, production, and manufacturing processes. Actively promote the application of the Internet of Things in major processes such as agricultural product processing, storage, preservation, and marketing, and improve the level of agricultural intelligence and precision. Strengthen the application of the Internet of Things in smart cities, vigorously promote the achievements and experiences of the Internet of Things in urban public safety, infrastructure management, energy management, flood monitoring, hazardous chemical regulation, environmental monitoring, and other fields. Expand the application of the Internet of Things in personal consumption fields such as smart homes and connected vehicles.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, innovative service applications, promoting the deep development of the Internet of Things applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the development of the industrial Internet system, research and formulate the overall plan for the development of the industrial Internet in China, accelerate the establishment of the industrial Internet standard system, transform and upgrade the existing factory network and public Internet, and create a high-speed, low-latency, secure and reliable network within and outside the factory. Build industrial cloud and industrial big data platforms, accelerate the research and development and industrialization of key software and hardware devices and systems for the industrial Internet. Support enterprises in the areas of network technology and interconnection within and outside the factory, identification resolution, IPv6 application, industrial cloud computing, industrial big data, etc., to carry out innovative application demonstrations. Construct an industrial Internet experimental verification platform, carry out key technology verification, and build an industrial Internet identification resolution system, an industrial Internet IPv6 address resource comprehensive management platform, and a network data flow management platform. Column 8: Industrial Internet industry promotion pilot demonstration project objectives: Consolidate the industrial Internet technology industry foundation and build an industrial Internet ecological system. Project content: First, support enterprises in the areas of network technology and interconnection within and outside the factory, identification resolution, IPv6 application, industrial cloud computing, industrial big data, and the integration of the Internet and industry, to carry out innovative application demonstrations. Second, based on clarifying the key technology path of the industrial Internet in China, support relevant units to build experimental verification platforms for key technologies of the industrial Internet, and test, verify, and evaluate key technologies. Third, organize the construction of the industrial Internet identification resolution system. Fourth, upgrade and transform the ICP/IP address/domain name information filing management system, and build an IPv6 address resource comprehensive management platform for the industrial Internet. Fifth, support the construction of an industrial Internet network data flow management platform, providing public support for the open, transaction, and management of industrial Internet network data.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, innovative service applications, and promoting the accelerated development of the industrial Internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Actively support the implementation of the national Internet Plus major project, promote deep integration of the Internet with various industries and fields of the economy and society, promote various innovations based on the Internet, such as business models, service models, management models, supply chains, and logistics chains, cultivate the Internet Plus ecosystem, and form a new pattern of networked collaborative division of labor. Encourage format innovation and actively develop the sharing economy. Promote various emerging consumer activities that are carried out online and offline using the Internet as a carrier. Encourage Internet companies to actively participate in construction projects related to people's livelihood, promote the rapid development of emerging service industries such as medical care, health, elderly care, education, tourism, and social security based on the Internet. Encourage telecommunications companies and large Internet companies to open up various equipment resources, network resources, data resources, and business platforms to small and micro enterprises and entrepreneurial teams, and guide basic telecommunications companies, large Internet companies, and small and innovative enterprises to establish cooperative mechanisms. Create an open innovation environment based on the Internet, enhance the support capabilities of double innovation service platforms, establish a number of low-cost, convenient, open co-creation spaces and virtual innovation communities. Give full play to the advantages of the Internet, implement Internet Plus education, Internet Plus medical care, Internet Plus culture, etc., and promote equalization of basic public services. Column 9: Enhancing the support capabilities of double innovation service platforms. Project goal: Promote the opening of various resources by industry enterprises and improve the level of double innovation services. Project content: Enhance the support capabilities of double innovation service platforms. Promote basic telecommunications companies, Internet companies, and other large enterprises to further open up resources and integrate services on double innovation platforms led by them, effectively utilize infrastructure, data resources, and business platforms, and provide comprehensive data, entrepreneurial incubation, online testing, innovation sharing, and entrepreneurial consulting services to small, micro, innovative, and entrepreneurial enterprises to meet their needs for entrepreneurship and innovation.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, innovative service applications, comprehensive expansion of Internet+ services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Regarding the 'Belt and Road' strategy, we will coordinate the global deployment of submarine cables and cross-border land cables, construct the online Silk Road, and strengthen the interconnection of information infrastructure with Europe, Africa, Latin America, and neighboring countries/regions. We encourage research and development, manufacturing, consulting, construction, and operation enterprises to leverage their respective advantages, continuously explore different overseas cooperation models such as joint ventures, mergers and acquisitions, equity participation, and controlling stakes, cultivate advantageous brands, and enhance international competitiveness. We will promote the comprehensive participation of communication equipment manufacturing, construction, operation services, and technical standards in international competition. We will create an environment for the industry to 'go global,' strengthen planning guidance and classification guidance, establish a resource sharing platform, improve enterprise assessment mechanisms, actively seek support from various special funds, and promote the overall globalization of the industry chain. We will improve the international exchange and cooperation mechanisms of the industry, fully utilize multilateral and bilateral mechanisms, encourage the active participation of various forces in internet management activities of the United Nations, regional and international organizations, and enhance international discourse power.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, innovative service applications, accelerate the pace of the information and communication industry going global.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on the application of Internet business, highlight support for innovative development and strengthen basic management. Promote the establishment of a comprehensive interdepartmental management mechanism, establish a new business filing and development guidance system, further clarify the classification of new businesses and the determination of management responsibilities. Improve the Internet operation monitoring and statistical classification system, and promote the connection with national statistical classification standards. Improve the mechanism for the coordinated management of illegal and irregular information and website disposal, establish a provincial-level coordinated and shared security supervision platform, achieve information sharing and real-time querying, improve the efficiency of cross-provincial disposal of illegal and irregular information and websites, and effectively support the needs of national Internet security supervision work. Establish a mechanism for managing unfair competition on the Internet, improve the long-term regulatory mechanism that combines administrative and judicial measures, enhance the sense of mission and responsibility of Internet companies, actively guide social forces to participate in the governance of the Internet industry, promote the formation of a multi-party governance pattern under the government's overall coordination, and jointly promote the sustainable and healthy development of the Internet. Adhere to the combination of delegation and regulation, accelerate the construction of a regulatory support system that covers the entire process, represented by the credit system, and strengthen in-process and post-event supervision. Promote the aggregation of functions in the existing Internet regulatory system, innovate and improve the Internet service quality management system, support domestic third parties in the creation of relevant technical means in testing, evaluation, certification, and evidence collection, and accelerate the construction of monitoring platforms for the Internet industry and mobile Internet applications. Improve technical support capabilities. Further implement the requirements of real-name registration on the Internet, actively promote real-name registration for websites, domain names, IP addresses, and phone numbers, strengthen the management of mobile resale companies, continuously improve the accuracy of registration information, and achieve real-time online verification of real-name information on the Internet.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthen industry management, and enhance internet-based industry management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Implement and strengthen the relevant provisions on protecting user rights, improve the internet service quality supervision system for user rights, establish management systems for reporting, notification, and satisfaction evaluation, regulate business operations, services, and fees, and crack down on infringement and illegal activities. Enhance personal data protection, promote the establishment of a collaborative mechanism for personal data sharing and protection, and strictly combat illegal disclosure and sale of personal data. Promote the formulation of standards for user information protection in instant messaging, app stores, e-commerce, etc., urge companies to implement user information classification and hierarchical protection requirements, regulate the collection, transmission, storage, use, and destruction of user information. Deepen the governance of harmful online information, promote the establishment of long-term mechanisms for managing spam messages, harassing calls, and harmful apps, strengthen the development of technical means, urge companies to fulfill their responsibilities, and provide smooth channels for user reports. Promote the nationwide implementation of mobile phone number portability services. Guide companies to formulate and implement measures to increase speed and reduce fees based on economic and social development needs and user concerns, promote the gradual elimination of mobile roaming fees, further optimize tariff structures, simplify tariff plans, enhance tariff transparency, and effectively enhance user satisfaction.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthen industry management, improve the quality of industry services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Make good overall planning and scientific allocation of number resources, and timely carry out the allocation and recovery of new business numbers, to promote the standardized use and effective utilization of number resources. Optimize the allocation of national spectrum resources, strengthen the management of radio spectrum, and maintain a safe and orderly electromagnetic wave order. Scientifically plan and reasonably allocate radio frequency resources, coordinate medium and long-term frequency usage needs, and ensure the development of key areas. Carry out radio spectrum utilization assessment to promote efficient use of spectrum resources. Strengthen the centralized and unified management of satellite frequency and orbit resources, carry out various work such as declaration, coordination, registration, and maintenance of satellite networks, and strengthen the availability demonstration of frequency and orbit resources in satellite engineering project planning and approval. Strengthen the management and international coordination of Internet basic resources such as IP addresses and domain names, promote the application for IPv6 addresses, plan and use IPv6 addresses reasonably, explore the establishment of a credit record system for domain name institutions, encourage innovative applications of domain names, and promote the promotion and application of national top-level domains such as .CN and .China and Chinese domain names.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthen industry management, strengthen the management of important basic resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the top-level design of big data standards, establish and improve a comprehensive big data standard system covering infrastructure, technology, products, platforms, applications, transactions, and management. Establish a big data management system, clarify the scope boundaries, responsible entities, and specific requirements for data collection, transmission, storage, use, and openness, to ensure efficient and trustworthy applications. Promote the interconnection, openness, and sharing of government information systems and public data, and promote the opening of data resources to society in accordance with the law. Encourage telecommunications and internet companies to provide data resources and analysis capabilities to support social management in areas such as public safety, urban management, market supervision, as well as cross-domain applications in transportation, tourism, healthcare, and other livelihood services, while ensuring data security and personal privacy.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthen industry management, strengthen the application and management of big data resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a sound hierarchical and dynamically adjustable network infrastructure security protection system. Strengthen the network security management of Internet companies and enhance network security protection in emerging key areas such as cloud computing and the Internet of Things. Implement the national network security review system and prudently organize industry network security review work. Continuously carry out network security pilot demonstration work for basic telecommunications companies, Internet companies, security companies, etc. Relying on the security enhancement project, guide and promote enterprises to strengthen their network security situational awareness capabilities, strengthen the sharing and linkage of government, enterprises, and industry forces in security monitoring data, utilize big data technology to enhance correlation analysis, and improve overall and holistic situational awareness capabilities. Improve the Internet security monitoring and disposal mechanism, strengthen the disposal notification of daily network security incidents, establish a sound monitoring and disposal mechanism for phishing websites, strengthen the construction of Trojan virus sample libraries, mobile malicious program sample libraries, vulnerability libraries, etc., and enhance the ability to timely detect and effectively identify security threats. Build a security threat information sharing mechanism among the government, enterprises, and users. Deepen the special activities for the governance of network threats such as mobile malicious programs and build a trusted network environment. Column 10: Security Enhancement Project objectives: Promote the construction of network and information security technology guarantee capabilities and enhance network security guarantee levels. Project content: Build a network security threat monitoring and disposal platform based on the backbone network to achieve capabilities such as network security threat monitoring, situational awareness, emergency disposal, and traceability. Implement the domain name system security guarantee project to enhance the security protection and data backup capabilities of public recursive domain name resolution systems. Build an Internet network security emergency management platform to improve the analysis, judgment, and industry emergency command and dispatch capabilities for Internet network security threat information and monitoring data.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthening security guarantees, and enhancing the security protection of network infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop and implement guiding documents for data security in the information and communication industry, implement classified and graded management of network data resources, and ensure secure, efficient, and trustworthy applications. Strengthen the security protection of data resources, clarify the strategies for industry data openness, sharing, and utilization, as well as security protection in cross-border data flow scenarios. Establish relevant standards for data security assessment, establish and improve mechanisms for sensitive data operation auditing, and build a new data protection management system that involves cooperation between the government and enterprises at the national and local levels. Strengthen the supervision of enterprise data security, promote the development of technical means for enterprise data protection, and standardize enterprise data cooperation. Enhance the ability to protect personal information of network users in big data scenarios, effectively prevent the leakage, destruction, and illegal use of users' personal information through security management and technical measures, and urge telecommunications and internet companies to fulfill their responsibilities for protecting users' personal information. Establish and improve mechanisms for disclosing and reporting data and personal information breaches, urge companies to conduct self-inspections in a timely manner, identify security risks, publicly announce the disposal of such risks, and eliminate security risks.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthen security guarantees, strengthen network data security management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the emergency management system for network and information security, promote the construction of emergency mechanisms, emergency systems, and emergency standards, and enhance the institutionalized response, standardized disposal, and procedural level of network and information security incidents. Strengthen the emergency management of public internet network security, revise and improve emergency plans, establish a coordinated disposal mechanism for network security emergency response involving government unified command, enterprises, and supporting units. Strengthen network security emergency drills within and across industries. Make every effort to ensure network counter-terrorism and the security of network information for major events, and resolutely safeguard national security and social stability.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthening security guarantees, strengthening network and information security emergency management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the legislative process in key areas of the information and communication industry. Promote the legislation of laws and regulations such as the Telecommunications Law and the Cybersecurity Law. Establish and improve relevant legal systems in the information and communication industry, further regulate the protection of key infrastructure, network security, cross-border data flow, personal information protection, the development of new technologies and new businesses, telecommunications business operation permits, and internet basic resource management. Encourage local communication management bureaus to accelerate the legislative process according to local conditions and promote the improvement of the legal and regulatory system. Enhance awareness of administrative law enforcement, strengthen the institutionalization, standardization, and proceduralization of law enforcement at all levels, strengthen the connection between market order regulation, law enforcement, and judiciary, and enhance the level of legal system in the information and communication industry.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, accelerate the promotion of the construction of the rule of law.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen government guidance, with enterprises as the main body, mobilize the entire society to build information and communication infrastructure and develop the application of information and communication technology. Widely solicit opinions from all parties in policy, standard formulation, and planning, and improve transparency and social participation. Encourage localities to strengthen internet monitoring and analysis, and increase support for internet development. Encourage the establishment of industry-academia-research-application alliances, strengthen communication and collaboration in strategy, technology, standards, markets, etc., and promote collaborative innovation. Guide industry associations and other social organizations to jointly formulate internet regulations with enterprises, encourage enterprises to actively fulfill social responsibilities, and promote industry self-discipline. Fully leverage the strengths of the government, enterprises, society, and other parties to create an environment for industry development that is honest, transparent, open, and fair.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, creating an environment for multiple parties to participate.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage and guide government departments and key enterprises to improve the talent cultivation mechanism in the information and communication industry, reform the supporting systems for talent introduction, optimize the talent utilization and incentive mechanisms, enhance the enthusiasm and initiative of professional and technical talents in independent innovation and participation in the industrialization of scientific research achievements, and support outstanding talents in innovation and entrepreneurship. Strengthen the optimization of educational disciplines allocation, promote the establishment of multi-party joint training mechanisms, encourage enterprises, universities, research institutes, associations, and societies to jointly cultivate talents in the fields of communication, the Internet, the Internet of Things, and network and information security. Make full use of various channels and methods such as academic education, non-academic education, and short-term training to accelerate the cultivation of interdisciplinary, internationalized, high-level, innovative, and practical information technology talents and service teams. Utilize various talent attraction and intelligence introduction programs to attract overseas students and talents in high-tech fields from various countries to develop in China, promote the cultivation of domestic talents, and promote the improvement of domestic scientific research level and the transformation of scientific research achievements.
titlelist: Guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, strengthening the training of professional talents.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on the major scientific frontiers of artificial intelligence, taking into account current needs and long-term development. The key focus is to break through the theoretical bottlenecks of artificial intelligence applications and proactively lay out basic research that may trigger a paradigm shift in artificial intelligence. This will promote interdisciplinary integration and provide a strong scientific foundation for the continuous development and deep application of artificial intelligence. The breakthrough in basic theoretical bottlenecks includes strengthening research on big data intelligence, cross-media perception computing, human-machine hybrid intelligence, collective intelligence, autonomous collaboration and decision-making. In big data intelligence theory, the focus is on breaking through difficult problems such as unsupervised learning and comprehensive deep reasoning, establishing data-driven cognitive computing models with natural language understanding as the core, and developing the ability to transform big data into knowledge and decision-making. In cross-media perception computing theory, the focus is on breaking through theoretical methods such as low-cost and low-energy intelligent perception, active perception in complex scenarios, natural environment auditory and speech perception, and multimedia autonomous learning. The goal is to achieve superhuman perception and high-dimensional, multi-mode distributed perception in large-scale scenes. In hybrid augmented intelligence theory, the focus is on breaking through the theoretical understanding and decision-making learning of human-machine coexistence, intuitive reasoning and causal models, memory and knowledge evolution. The aim is to achieve hybrid augmented intelligence that approaches or surpasses human intelligence in learning and thinking. In collective intelligence theory, the focus is on breaking through the theory and methods of organizing, emerging, and learning collective intelligence, establishing expressive and computable algorithms and models for collective intelligence based on the Internet, and forming a theoretical system of collective intelligence. In autonomous collaborative control and optimized decision-making theory, the focus is on breaking through the theory of collaborative perception and interaction for autonomous unmanned systems, autonomous collaborative control and optimized decision-making, and knowledge-driven human-machine-object trilateral collaboration and interoperability. The aim is to establish an innovative theoretical system architecture for autonomous intelligent unmanned systems. Layout for cutting-edge basic theoretical research includes forward-looking research on advanced machine learning, brain-like intelligent computing, quantum intelligent computing, and other interdisciplinary basic theoretical research that may trigger a paradigm shift in artificial intelligence. In advanced machine learning theory, the focus is on breaking through theoretical methods such as adaptive learning and autonomous learning, to achieve artificial intelligence with high interpretability and strong generalization ability. In brain-like intelligent computing theory, the focus is on breaking through the theory of information encoding, processing, memory, learning, and reasoning in the brain, forming theories and methods for complex brain-like systems and brain-inspired control, and establishing new models for large-scale brain-like intelligent computing and brain-inspired cognitive computing models. In quantum intelligent computing theory, the focus is on breaking through quantum-accelerated machine learning methods, establishing hybrid models of high-performance computing and quantum algorithms, and forming efficient, accurate, and autonomous architectures for quantum artificial intelligence systems. Conduct interdisciplinary exploratory research by promoting the integration of artificial intelligence with neuroscience, cognitive science, quantum science, psychology, mathematics, economics, sociology, and other related basic disciplines. Strengthen the mathematical foundation theory research that leads the development of artificial intelligence algorithms and models, pay attention to the basic theoretical problems of artificial intelligence law and ethics, support original and non-consensus exploratory research, encourage scientists to explore freely, and be brave in tackling the frontier scientific challenges of artificial intelligence, proposing more original theories, and making more original discoveries. Column 1: Basic Theory.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, establish a new generation of artificial intelligence basic theoretical system.

content: Research on new methods of artificial intelligence that combine data-driven and knowledge-guided approaches, cognitive computing theories and methods with natural language understanding and image graphics as the core, comprehensive theories and methods of deep reasoning and creative artificial intelligence, foundational theories and frameworks for intelligent decision-making under incomplete information, and data-driven general artificial intelligence mathematical models and theories.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, big data intelligence theory.

content: Research on perception acquisition beyond human visual capabilities, active visual perception and computation for the real world, auditory perception and computation for natural acoustic scenes, speech perception and computation for natural interactive environments, humanoid perception and computation for asynchronous sequences, autonomous learning for media intelligent perception, and a comprehensive intelligent perception and reasoning engine for cities.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, cross-media perception computing theory.

content: Research on human-in-the-loop hybrid augmented intelligence, symbiotic human-machine intelligence, behavior enhancement and brain-machine coordination, machine intuitive reasoning and causal models, associative memory models and knowledge evolution methods, hybrid augmented intelligence learning methods for complex data and tasks, cloud robot collaborative computing methods, situational understanding in real-world environments, and human-machine group collaboration.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, hybrid augmented intelligence theory.

content: Research on the theory and organizational methods of collective intelligence structure, the mechanisms and emergence principles of collective intelligence motivation, the theory and methods of collective intelligence learning, and the general computing paradigms and models of collective intelligence.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, collective intelligence theory.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research on the basic theory of statistical learning, uncertainty reasoning and decision-making, distributed learning and interaction, privacy-preserving learning, small-sample learning, deep reinforcement learning, unsupervised learning, semi-supervised learning, active learning, and other learning theories and efficient models.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, advanced machine learning theory.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Research on theories and methods related to brain-like perception, brain-like learning, brain-like memory mechanisms and computational integration, brain-like complex systems, and brain-like control.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, and brain-like intelligent computing theory.

content: Explore the quantum patterns and intrinsic mechanisms of brain cognition, study efficient quantum intelligent models and algorithms, high-performance and high-qubit quantum artificial intelligence processors, and real-time quantum artificial intelligence systems capable of interacting with the external environment.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, quantum intelligent computing theory.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: In order to enhance the international competitiveness of artificial intelligence in our country, the research and development deployment of the next generation of key common technologies in artificial intelligence should be centered around algorithms, based on data and hardware, with a focus on improving perception recognition, knowledge computation, cognitive reasoning, motion execution, and human-computer interaction capabilities. This will form an open, compatible, stable, and mature technical system. Key breakthroughs should be made in knowledge processing, deep search, and visual interaction core technologies, to achieve continuous automatic acquisition of knowledge, with the ability for concept recognition, entity discovery, attribute prediction, knowledge evolution modeling, and relationship mining. This will form a cross-media knowledge graph covering billions of entities, multiple sources, multiple disciplines, and multiple data types. Key breakthroughs should also be made in cross-media analysis and reasoning technologies, including cross-media unified representation, correlation understanding and knowledge mining, knowledge graph construction and learning, knowledge evolution and reasoning, intelligent description and generation. This will enable cross-media knowledge representation, analysis, mining, reasoning, evolution, and utilization, and the construction of analysis and reasoning engines. Key breakthroughs should be made in group intelligence technologies, including internet-based mass collaboration, knowledge resource management, and open sharing technologies. This will establish a framework for group intelligence representation, enabling knowledge acquisition based on group intelligence perception and group intelligence fusion and enhancement in open dynamic environments. This will support nationwide scale group perception, collaboration, and evolution. Key breakthroughs should be made in hybrid augmented intelligence architectures and technologies, including integrated models of perception and execution in human-machine collaboration, new types of sensors for intelligent computing, and general-purpose hybrid computing architectures. This will enable the construction of autonomous adaptive environments for hybrid augmented intelligence systems, human-machine group hybrid augmented intelligence systems, and supporting environments. Key breakthroughs should be made in intelligent technologies for autonomous unmanned systems, including autonomous unmanned system computing architectures, complex dynamic scene perception and understanding, real-time accurate positioning, and adaptive intelligent navigation in complex environments. This includes intelligent technologies for autonomous control of drones, as well as autonomous driving for cars, ships, and rail transportation, and core technologies for service robots and special robots. This will support the application and development of unmanned systems and industries. Key breakthroughs should be made in virtual reality intelligent modeling technologies, including intelligent behavior modeling for virtual objects, to enhance the sociality, diversity, and interactive realism of intelligent object behavior in virtual reality. This will achieve the organic integration and efficient interaction between virtual reality, augmented reality, and artificial intelligence technologies. Key breakthroughs should be made in intelligent computing chips and systems, including high-efficiency, reconfigurable neuromorphic computing chips and brain-like visual sensor technologies with computational imaging capabilities. This will involve the development of high-performance brain-like neural network architectures and hardware systems with autonomous learning capabilities, enabling brain-like intelligent systems with multimedia perception, understanding, intelligent growth, and common sense reasoning abilities. Key breakthroughs should be made in natural language processing technologies, including core technologies for grammar logic, character concept representation, and deep semantic analysis of natural language. This will promote effective communication and free interaction between humans and machines, enabling intelligent understanding and generation of natural language in multiple styles, languages, and domains. Key common technologies are discussed in column 2.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, establish a new generation of artificial intelligence key common technology system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Research knowledge computing and visual interaction engines, research innovative design, digital creativity, and knowledge service technologies centered around visual media, and carry out knowledge discovery of large-scale biological data.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, knowledge computing engine, and knowledge service technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research on cross-media unified representation, correlation understanding and knowledge mining, knowledge graph construction and learning, knowledge evolution and reasoning, intelligent description and generation technologies, and develop cross-media analysis and reasoning engines and verification systems.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, cross-media analysis and reasoning technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Carry out key technology research on active perception and discovery, knowledge acquisition and generation, collaboration and sharing, evaluation and evolution, human-machine integration and enhancement, self-sustainability and secure interaction in the development of collective intelligence. Construct a service system architecture for collective intelligence space and study the collaborative decision-making and control technology of mobile collective intelligence.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, key technologies for collective intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research on core technologies for hybrid enhanced intelligence, cognitive computing frameworks, new hybrid computing architectures, human-machine co-driving, online intelligent learning technologies, and hybrid enhanced intelligence frameworks for parallel management and control.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, blending augmented intelligence new architecture and new technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research on autonomous control of drones and intelligent technologies for autonomous driving of cars, ships, and rail transportation, as well as service robots, space robots, marine robots, and polar robots. Research on intelligent technologies for unmanned vehicle workshops/smart factories, high-end intelligent control technologies, and autonomous unmanned operating systems. Research on autonomous control technologies for robots and robotic arms based on computer vision for positioning, navigation, recognition, and other tasks in complex environments.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, intelligent technology for autonomous unmanned systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Research on mathematical expressions and modeling methods for intelligent behaviors of virtual objects, problems related to natural, continuous, and in-depth interaction between virtual objects, virtual environments, and users, and the technical and methodological system for intelligent object modeling.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, virtual reality intelligent modeling technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Research and develop neural network processors, as well as high-efficiency, reconfigurable neuromorphic computing chips. Explore new perception chips and systems, intelligent computing architectures and systems, and artificial intelligence operating systems. Study hybrid computing architectures suitable for artificial intelligence.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, intelligent computing chips and systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research on computational and analytical techniques for short texts, cross-language text mining techniques, semantic understanding techniques for machine cognitive intelligence, and human-computer dialogue systems for multimedia information understanding.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, natural language processing technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a big data artificial intelligence open-source software foundation platform, an artificial intelligence cloud service platform that integrates terminals and the cloud, a new type of multi-intelligent sensor component and integration platform, a new product design platform based on artificial intelligence hardware, and a big data intelligent service platform in the future network.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, artificial intelligence open-source software and hardware foundation platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a platform for supporting collective intelligence and mass innovation computing, a science and technology mass innovation service system, a collective intelligence software development and verification automation system, a collective intelligence software learning and innovation system, a collective intelligence decision-making system in an open environment, and a collective intelligence sharing economy service system.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, and a collective intelligence service platform.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish artificial intelligence supercomputing center, large-scale super intelligent computing support environment, online intelligent education platform, human in the loop driving brain, intelligent platform for complex analysis and risk assessment of industrial development, intelligent support platform for nuclear power safety operation, human-machine co-driving technology research and testing platform, etc.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, hybrid augmented intelligence support platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a common core technology support platform for autonomous unmanned systems, autonomous control of drones, and support platforms for autonomous driving of cars, ships, and rail transportation. Also, support platforms for service robots, space robots, marine robots, and polar robots, as well as technology support platforms for smart factories and intelligent control equipment.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, autonomous unmanned system support platform.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build public data resource libraries, standard test datasets, and cloud service platforms for artificial intelligence. Establish testing and evaluation models for the security of artificial intelligence algorithms and platforms. Develop a toolkit for evaluating the security of artificial intelligence algorithms and platforms.
titlelist: Overall requirements, build an open and collaborative artificial intelligence technology innovation system, artificial intelligence basic data and security testing platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the cultivation of the artificial intelligence industry with significant leading and driving roles, promote deep integration of artificial intelligence with various industries, and form an intelligent economic form characterized by data-driven, human-machine collaboration, cross-border integration, and co-creation and sharing. Data and knowledge become the primary factors driving economic growth, human-machine collaboration becomes the mainstream production and service mode, cross-border integration becomes an important economic model, and co-creation and sharing become the basic characteristics of the economic ecosystem. Personalized demands and customization become the new trend of consumption, productivity greatly improves, leading the industry towards the high-end of the value chain, providing strong support for the development of the real economy, and comprehensively improving the quality and efficiency of economic development.
titlelist: Overall requirements, cultivating a high-end and efficient intelligent economy.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the transformation and application of key artificial intelligence technologies, promote technology integration and business model innovation, drive innovation in intelligent products in key areas, actively cultivate emerging formats of artificial intelligence, layout high-end industrial chains, and build internationally competitive artificial intelligence industry clusters. Intelligent software and hardware. Develop key foundational software for artificial intelligence, such as operating systems, databases, middleware, and development tools, break through core hardware such as graphics processors, research intelligent system solutions such as image recognition, speech recognition, machine translation, intelligent interaction, knowledge processing, and control decision-making, and cultivate and strengthen the foundational software and hardware industry for artificial intelligence applications. Intelligent robots. Overcome core components and specialized sensors for intelligent robots, improve hardware interface standards, software interface protocol standards, and safety usage standards for intelligent robots. Develop intelligent industrial robots, intelligent service robots, achieve large-scale applications, and enter the international market. Develop and promote special intelligent robots such as space robots, marine robots, and polar robots. Establish intelligent robot standards and safety regulations. Intelligent transportation vehicles. Develop autonomous driving cars and rail transit systems, strengthen the integration and support of technologies such as onboard perception, autonomous driving, vehicle-to-vehicle communication, and the Internet of Things, develop intelligent transportation perception systems, form an independent autonomous driving platform technology system and product assembly capability, and explore shared modes for autonomous driving cars. Develop consumer and commercial drones and unmanned ships, establish specialized service systems for testing, identification, testing, and competition, and improve airspace and water management measures. Virtual reality and augmented reality. Breakthrough key technologies such as high-performance software modeling, content capture and generation, augmented reality and human-computer interaction, integrated environments and tools, develop virtual display devices, optical devices, high-performance true 3D displays, development engines, and other products, establish technical, product, service standards, and evaluation systems for virtual reality and augmented reality, and promote integration applications in key industries. Intelligent terminals. Accelerate the research and development of core technologies and products for intelligent terminals, develop next-generation intelligent mobile phones, in-vehicle intelligent terminals, and other mobile intelligent terminal products and devices, encourage the development of smartwatches, smart headphones, smart glasses, and other wearable terminal products, expand product forms and application services. Internet of Things basic devices. Develop high-sensitivity, high-reliability intelligent sensors and chips that support the next generation of the Internet of Things, overcome core technologies such as radio frequency identification, short-range machine communication, and low-power processors, and other key devices.
titlelist: Overall requirements, cultivate high-end and efficient intelligent economy, vigorously develop emerging industries of artificial intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the integration and innovation of artificial intelligence in various industries, and carry out pilot demonstrations of artificial intelligence applications in key industries and fields such as manufacturing, agriculture, logistics, finance, commerce, and home furnishings. Promote the large-scale application of artificial intelligence and comprehensively enhance the level of intelligent development in the industry.Intelligent manufacturing. Focus on the major needs of building a strong manufacturing country, promote the integration and application of key technologies and equipment for intelligent manufacturing, core supporting software, industrial internet, etc. Develop intelligent products and intelligent interconnectivity products, intelligent manufacturing enabling tools and systems, intelligent manufacturing cloud service platforms. Promote new manufacturing models such as process intelligent manufacturing, discrete intelligent manufacturing, networked collaborative manufacturing, remote diagnosis and operation and maintenance services. Establish an intelligent manufacturing standard system and promote the intelligence of manufacturing activities throughout the entire lifecycle.Intelligent agriculture. Develop agricultural intelligent sensing and control systems, intelligent agricultural equipment, autonomous systems for field operations, etc. Establish a comprehensive intelligent agriculture information remote sensing monitoring network. Establish a typical agricultural big data intelligent decision analysis system and carry out integrated application demonstrations of intelligent farms, intelligent plant factories, intelligent ranches, intelligent fish farms, intelligent orchards, intelligent agricultural product processing workshops, and intelligent green supply chains.Intelligent logistics. Strengthen the research and development and promotion of intelligent logistics equipment such as intelligent loading and unloading, sorting and packaging, and processing and distribution. Build a deep perception intelligent warehousing system to improve warehousing operation and management efficiency. Improve the intelligent logistics public information platform and command system, product quality certification and traceability system, intelligent distribution and scheduling system.Intelligent finance. Establish a financial big data system to enhance the processing and understanding capabilities of multimedia financial data. Innovate intelligent financial products and services and develop new forms of finance. Encourage the application of technologies and equipment such as intelligent customer service and intelligent monitoring in the financial industry. Establish an intelligent early warning and risk control system for finance.Intelligent commerce. Encourage the application of new technologies such as cross-media analysis and reasoning, knowledge computing engines, and knowledge services in the field of commerce. Promote new types of business services and decision-making systems based on artificial intelligence. Build cross-media big data platforms covering geographic location, network media, and urban basic data to support enterprises in conducting intelligent commerce. Encourage the provision of customized business intelligence decision-making services based on individual needs and enterprise management.Intelligent home furnishings. Strengthen the integration and application of artificial intelligence technology and home building systems to improve the level of intelligence in building equipment and home products. Develop home interconnectivity protocols and interface standards that adapt to different application scenarios, and enhance the perception and connectivity capabilities of home products such as home appliances and durable goods. Support innovative service models for intelligent home furnishing companies and provide interconnection and sharing solutions.
titlelist: Overall requirements, cultivate high-end and efficient intelligent economy, accelerate the upgrading of industrial intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the large-scale upgrading of enterprise intelligence. Support and guide enterprises in applying new artificial intelligence technologies in core business areas such as design, production, management, logistics, and marketing, to build new organizational structures and operational models for enterprises, and to form integrated formats combining manufacturing and service, and financial intelligence. Develop personalized customization and expand the supply of intelligent products. Encourage large internet companies to build cloud manufacturing platforms and service platforms, providing key industrial software and model libraries online for manufacturing enterprises, and offering manufacturing capacity outsourcing services to promote the intelligent development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the application of intelligent factories. Strengthen the application demonstration of key technologies and systematic methods in intelligent factories, focusing on promoting technologies such as production line reconstruction and dynamic intelligent scheduling, intelligent IoT and cloud-based data collection for production equipment, and multidimensional human-machine and object collaboration and interoperability. Encourage and guide enterprises to build factory big data systems and networked distributed production facilities to achieve networked production equipment, visualized production data, transparent production processes, and unmanned production sites, thereby enhancing the intelligence level of factory operation and management. Accelerate the cultivation of leading enterprises in the artificial intelligence industry. Accelerate the development of global leading enterprises and brands in advantageous areas such as drones, voice recognition, and image recognition. Accelerate the cultivation of leading enterprises in emerging fields such as intelligent robots, intelligent vehicles, wearable devices, and virtual reality. Support artificial intelligence enterprises in strengthening patent layout and leading or participating in the formulation of international standards. Promote the establishment of the China Artificial Intelligence Industry Technology Innovation Alliance by domestic leading enterprises, industry organizations, research institutions, and universities. Support leading backbone enterprises in building open hardware factories and open-source software platforms, forming an innovative ecosystem that aggregates various resources, and promoting the development and application of artificial intelligence in small and micro enterprises in various fields. Support various institutions and platforms in providing specialized services to artificial intelligence enterprises.
titlelist: Overall requirements, cultivate high-end and efficient intelligent economy, vigorously develop intelligent enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Combine the foundations and advantages of various regions, and categorize the relevant industrial layout according to the application areas of artificial intelligence. Encourage local areas to focus on the artificial intelligence industry chain and innovation chain, gather high-end elements, high-end enterprises, and high-end talents, and create clusters of artificial intelligence industries and innovation hubs. Carry out pilot demonstrations of innovative applications of artificial intelligence. In regions with good foundations and great development potential in artificial intelligence, organize national innovation experiments in artificial intelligence, explore major reforms in system mechanisms, policies and regulations, and talent cultivation, promote the transformation of artificial intelligence achievements, major product integration innovation, and demonstration applications, and form replicable and scalable experiences, leading and driving the development of intelligent economy and intelligent society. Build national artificial intelligence industrial parks. Relying on national independent innovation demonstration zones and national high-tech industrial development zones and other innovative carriers, strengthen the optimization and combination of science and technology, talents, finance, policies, and other elements, accelerate the cultivation and construction of artificial intelligence industry innovation clusters. Build national artificial intelligence mass entrepreneurship bases. Relying on areas with concentrated universities and research institutes engaged in artificial intelligence research, establish new types of entrepreneurial service organizations such as specialized innovation platforms in the field of artificial intelligence, build a batch of low-cost, convenient, all-element, and open artificial intelligence mass entrepreneurship spaces, improve the incubation service system, promote the transfer and transformation of artificial intelligence scientific and technological achievements, and support artificial intelligence innovation and entrepreneurship.
titlelist: Overall requirements: Cultivate a high-end and efficient intelligent economy, and build a highland of artificial intelligence innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: By focusing on the goal of improving people's living standards and quality, accelerating the deep application of artificial intelligence, and creating an intelligent environment that is omnipresent, the level of intelligence in society is significantly enhanced. More and more simple, repetitive, and dangerous tasks are completed by artificial intelligence, allowing individual creativity to be greatly unleashed and creating more high-quality and comfortable job positions. Precision intelligent services become more diverse, allowing people to enjoy high-quality services and convenient lives to the maximum extent. The level of intelligent social governance is greatly improved, making social operations safer and more efficient.
titlelist: Overall requirements, building a safe and convenient smart society.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the innovation and application of artificial intelligence to meet urgent needs in education, healthcare, and elderly care, and provide personalized, diversified, and high-quality services to the public. In terms of intelligent education, use intelligent technology to accelerate the reform of talent training models and teaching methods, and build a new education system that includes intelligent learning and interactive learning. Carry out the construction of intelligent campuses and promote the full-process application of artificial intelligence in teaching, management, and resource development. Develop three-dimensional integrated teaching venues and online learning platforms based on intelligent big data. Develop intelligent education assistants and establish an intelligent, fast, and comprehensive education analysis system. Establish a learner-centered educational environment, provide precise educational services, and achieve customized daily and lifelong education. In terms of intelligent healthcare, promote the application of new models and methods of artificial intelligence treatment, and establish a fast and accurate intelligent healthcare system.
