Strengthen the application of big data in government governance, social management, etc., improve situation judgment, scientific decision-making, and precise management capabilities, reduce external environmental uncertainties, and enhance the risk response capabilities of various entities. Strengthen the application of big data in all aspects of the manufacturing industry, continuously optimize the design, manufacturing, management, and service processes, promote new models such as digital prototypes, flexible manufacturing, business intelligence, and predictive maintenance, and promote production mode transformation. Strengthen the application of big data in information consumption, financial technology, and other fields, promote new models such as precision profiling and intelligent recommendations, and promote business model innovation.
titlelist: The main task is to leverage the advantages of big data characteristics.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Improve infrastructure. Fully deploy the next-generation communication network infrastructure and increase efforts in the construction of 5G networks and gigabit optical networks. Combine with the digital transformation of industries and the development of smart cities to accelerate the layout of industrial internet, connected vehicles, smart pipelines, smart grids, and other areas, promoting efficient data collection and transmission across all domains. Accelerate the construction of a national integrated big data center system, promote the construction of national industrial internet big data centers, strengthen intelligent scheduling of computing power, and build several national hub nodes and big data center clusters. Construct high-performance computing clusters and deploy supercomputing centers reasonably. Strengthen technological innovation. Focus on improving the general technology level of data generation, collection, storage, processing, analysis, security, and privacy protection. Fill in the gaps in key technologies, particularly enhancing the underlying support capabilities of independent basic software and hardware, promoting the development of independent open-source frameworks, components, and tools, developing open-source communities for big data, nurturing open-source ecosystems, and comprehensively enhancing technological breakthroughs and market cultivation capabilities. Promote the integration of cutting-edge technologies, driving the integration and innovation of big data with artificial intelligence, blockchain, edge computing, and other new-generation information technologies. Strengthen standard leadership. Collaboratively promote national standards, industry standards, and group standards, accelerate the formulation and revision of key standards in technology research and development, product services, data governance, transaction circulation, industry applications, etc. Establish national standard verification and testing points in the field of big data, select key industries, sectors, and regions to carry out standard trial verification and pilot demonstrations, improve the evaluation system for compliance with big data standards, and accelerate the application and promotion of standards. Strengthen communication and cooperation between domestic and international big data standardization organizations, encourage enterprises, universities, research institutes, industry organizations, etc. to actively participate in the formulation of international big data standards. Column 2 focuses on the formulation and application promotion of key standards. Accelerate the formulation of key standards. Based on the development needs of the big data industry, accelerate the formulation of basic general standards such as data open interfaces and interoperability, data resource planning, data governance, data asset evaluation, data services, digital transformation, data security, as well as key application areas such as industrial big data-related national standards and industry standards. Strengthen the construction of the standard compliance evaluation system. Increase the promotion and dissemination of key national standards for big data systems, data management, and data open sharing. Promote the cultivation of a standard compliance evaluation system covering data product evaluation, data resource planning, data governance implementation, data asset evaluation, data service capabilities, etc. Accelerate the international standardization process. Encourage domestic experts to actively participate in the work of international standardization organizations such as ISO, IEC, ITU, and accelerate the promotion of international standards proposals. Strengthen the applicability analysis of international standards and encourage the adoption of excellent international standards. Support relevant units to participate in international standardization work and undertake related positions, host international standardization activities, and increase international contribution rates.
titlelist: Main task, solidify the foundation for industrial development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a high-end product chain. Sort out key links in big data products such as data generation, collection, storage, processing, analysis, service, and security, and establish a big data product map. In the data generation and collection process, focus on improving the compatibility of heterogeneous data sources and the efficiency of large-scale data collection and processing. In the data storage and processing process, focus on promoting the research and development of high-performance storage and computing systems and edge computing systems, and create dedicated hyper-converged hardware solutions. In the data analysis and service process, focus on promoting the research and development and application of systems such as multi-mode data management, big data analysis, and governance. Innovate high-quality service chains. Accelerate the development of big data services towards specialization, engineering, and platformization, focusing on data cleaning, data annotation, data analysis, data visualization, and other needs. Innovate new service models and formats for big data services, develop intelligent services, value network collaboration, integrated development and operation, and other new service models. Encourage companies to open up data in search, e-commerce, social networking, and develop the third-party big data service industry. Cultivate high-quality big data service providers around comprehensive service needs such as diagnostic consulting, architecture design, system integration, and operation and maintenance. Optimize the industrial value chain. Taking the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry as the lead, cultivate specialized and scenario-based big data solutions for research and development design, production manufacturing, operation management, sales services, and other processes. Build a multi-level industrial Internet platform system, enrich platform databases, algorithm libraries, and knowledge bases, and cultivate a batch of industrial apps for specific scenarios. Promote the deep application of industrial big data, cultivate new models such as data-driven platform design, networked collaboration, personalized customization, intelligent production, extended services, and digital management, and standardize the development of new formats such as gig economy, shared manufacturing, industrial e-commerce, and supply chain finance. Column 3: Industrial Big Data Value Enhancement Action. Raw material industry big data. Support comprehensive use of equipment IoT, production and operation, and external environment data by raw material enterprises such as steel, petroleum, pipeline networks, hazardous chemicals, non-ferrous metals, building materials, etc., establish analysis models, improve the intelligent and precise level of resource exploration, mining, processing, storage, transportation, etc., and achieve process optimization, energy saving and emission reduction, and safe production. Equipment manufacturing industry big data. Support equipment manufacturing enterprises in integrating data flows throughout the entire value chain, including research and development, procurement, manufacturing, management, and after-sales, and develop data-driven product research and development, simulation optimization, intelligent production, predictive maintenance, precision management, remote operation and maintenance, and other new models and formats to improve product quality, reduce production costs, and accelerate service innovation and upgrading. Consumer goods industry big data. Support consumer goods enterprises in integrating online and offline data, develop personalized recommendation algorithms, realize customized production of products, and fine-tune channel operations to promote accurate supply and demand matching. Support companies in establishing quality traceability databases covering the entire process, accelerate integration with the national product quality supervision platform, and achieve traceable and manageable product quality. Electronic information industry big data. Support electronic information manufacturing enterprises in accelerating the application of big data in scenarios such as product sales forecasting and demand management, production planning and scheduling, supply chain analysis and optimization, and product quality management, accelerate product iteration and innovation, optimize production processes, improve product quality, and ensure the stability of the industrial chain and supply chain. Extend the value chain of industries. Accelerate the construction of industry big data platforms, improve the level of data development and utilization, promote the assetization and productization of industry data, and realize the re-creation and value enhancement of data. Create mature application scenarios that serve the government, society, and enterprises, and use data innovation to drive management and model innovation, and promote the vigorous development of financial technology, smart healthcare, and other fields. Continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of big data industry development, promote the integration and application of big data in various industries and fields, and increase the promotion of excellent application solutions. Column 4: Action for the Development and Utilization of Industry Big Data. Communication big data. Accelerate the large-scale deployment of 5G networks and promote the upgrading of gigabit fiber-optic networks. Expand the interconnection nodes of backbone networks and establish a batch of international communication entry and exit points. Improve the seismic resistance of public communication facilities in earthquake-prone areas, strengthen the construction of super base stations in mountainous areas, and plan and reserve mobile base stations to enhance the anti-destruction capability of communication public networks. Internally, strengthen the development, utilization, and security governance capabilities of data, improve enterprise management efficiency, and externally empower industry applications to support market supervision. Financial big data. Through big data actuarial, statistics, and model construction, help improve the modern financial regulatory system, fill in the gaps in regulatory institutions, and promote financial innovation under prudent regulation. Optimize risk identification, credit assessment models, and enhance data-driven risk management capabilities. Medical big data. Improve electronic health records, cases, electronic prescriptions, and other databases, and accelerate the sharing of data among medical and health institutions. Promote telemedicine and applications such as medical image-assisted interpretation and clinical diagnosis. Enhance the regulatory capacity of medical institutions and medical behaviors, and promote the reform of medical, medical insurance, and pharmaceutical linkage. Emergency management big data. Build a monitoring and perception network for safety production, increase the aggregation and sharing of natural disaster data, and enhance the capability of acquiring data at disaster sites. Construct and improve emergency management databases for disaster risk surveys, monitoring, and early warning, and leverage big data in monitoring and early warning, regulatory enforcement, decision-making assistance, rescue operations, and social mobilization. Promote intelligent application models such as data supervision, data disaster prevention, and data nuclear disaster, realize deep integration of big data and emergency management business, and continuously improve the modernization level of emergency management. Agriculture and water conservancy big data. Utilize big data in agriculture production, economic operation, resource and environmental monitoring, and agricultural product production and sales, promote precision sowing, precise fertilization and pesticide application, and precise harvesting of field crops, and promote intelligent applications in facility horticulture, livestock and aquaculture. Promote the construction of a smart water conservancy system, improve water situation monitoring and intelligent scheduling capabilities based on river basins. Public security big data. Strengthen the compliant application of data such as identity verification. Promote the construction of an intelligent public security big data platform, coordinate the new generation of public security information infrastructure, strengthen the governance and service of police data resources, strengthen the correlation analysis of public safety data across industries and regions, continuously improve the capabilities of safety risk prediction and early warning, precise crackdown on illegal crimes, precise intelligent security and control, and convenient and efficient public security governance. Transportation big data. Strengthen the collection and analysis of data related to vehicles and transportation infrastructure, provide support for the development and application of autonomous driving and vehicle-road coordination technologies. Innovate applications such as travel planning, traffic flow monitoring and analysis, promote intelligent management of highways, coordinated traffic signal control, and priority passage for public transportation. Promote the sharing and application of data in transportation and logistics, and promote the development of multi-modal transportation such as railways, highways, waterways, and aviation. Power big data. Based on big data analysis and mining algorithms, optimization strategies, and visualization technologies, strengthen the deep application of big data in power generation, transmission and transformation, distribution, and consumption. Use big data to assist in the intelligent upgrading of power plants, carry out extensive collection of electricity information, online energy efficiency analysis, achieve interactive optimization of power generation, grid, load, and storage, synergistic complementarity of multiple energy sources, and intelligent demand response. Credit big data. Strengthen the collection, sharing, openness, and application of credit information. Use technologies such as artificial intelligence and autonomous learning to build credit big data models and enhance the ability to intelligently identify, judge, analyze, and handle credit risks. Improve a new type of regulatory mechanism based on credit, guided by credit risks, and optimize the allocation of regulatory resources. Deepen the application of credit information in financing, credit, business cooperation, public services, and other fields, strengthen credit risk prevention, and continuously optimize the living environment. Employment big data. Use big data from online recruitment, mobile communications, social insurance, etc., to monitor changes in the labor market, timely grasp changes in enterprise employment and labor employment and unemployment situations, better analyze and judge the employment situation, and make scientific decisions. Social security big data. Accelerate the digital transformation of social security operations, carry out data mining and application work through scientific modeling and analysis methods, build a digital panorama for insured units and individuals, support personalized services and precision supervision. Build a social security big data management system and accelerate the sharing of social security data. Improve risk prevention and control classification management, strengthen business operation monitoring, and establish a systematic and regular data audit mechanism. Urban safety big data. Build a city safety risk monitoring and early warning system, realize effective aggregation of urban operation data in areas such as urban construction, transportation, municipal services, high-risk industries, etc., use advanced technologies such as cloud computing and artificial intelligence to monitor, monitor, and early warn urban safety risks, and improve urban safety management level.
titlelist: The main task is to build a stable and efficient industrial chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Cultivate and strengthen the main body of enterprises. Give full play to the role of leading enterprises as research and development entities, collaborative entities, user entities, and demonstration entities, continuously enhance their ability for independent innovation, product competition, and intellectual property layout, and utilize the capital market to strengthen and optimize. Encourage the development of small and medium-sized enterprises with specialization, expertise, and innovation, continuously improve their innovation capabilities and professional levels. Guide leading enterprises to provide data, algorithms, computing power, and other resources to small and medium-sized enterprises, promote the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises, and promote collaborative innovation in the industrial chain. Support vertically integrated enterprises with conditions to carry out the separation and reorganization of big data businesses, enhance their professional, scaled, and market-oriented service capabilities, and accelerate enterprise development. Column 5: Action to promote the development of enterprise entities to a higher level. Stimulate the innovation vitality of small and medium-sized enterprises. Implement special actions to empower small and medium-sized enterprises with digitalization, and promote the improvement of development quality through digitalization, networking, and intelligent empowerment. Promote the supply and demand integration of big data technologies, talents, capital, and other factors through various forms of activities such as matchmaking meetings and entrepreneurship competitions. Strengthen tracking services for key enterprises. Around the key links of the big data industry chain such as data resources, basic hardware, general software, industry applications, and security guarantees, compile a list of key big data enterprises, and establish a close and clear contact mechanism. Column 5: Action to promote the development of enterprise entities to a higher level. Transparent communication channels to make corporate demands smoother. Optimize public services for big data. Build a collaborative research and development platform for big data, promote joint research and development among government, industry, academia, and research institutes. Build carriers such as the Big Data Application Innovation Promotion Center to promote the industrialization of technological achievements. Strengthen the construction of public data training sets, build big data testing and certification platforms, experience centers, and training bases to improve the level of evaluation and consultation, supply and demand integration, entrepreneurship incubation, and talent training. Build a monitoring system for the operation of the big data industry, strengthen public management capabilities such as operation analysis, trend judgment, and scientific decision-making. Promote the development of industrial clusters. Promote the high-level construction of national new industrialization demonstration bases in the field of big data, guide the differentiated development of the big data industry in various regions, and continuously enhance the radiation and driving capabilities of industrial clusters. Encourage regions with conditions to conduct pilot projects based on national-level new areas, economic special zones, free trade zones, etc., focusing on data factor market mechanisms, international exchanges and cooperation, etc. Play the role of association alliances as bridges and links, support the organization of industry forums, industry competitions, and other activities, and create a good atmosphere for industrial development.
titlelist: The main task is to build a prosperous and orderly industrial ecosystem.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the data security guarantee system. Strengthen the top-level design of big data security, implement relevant laws, regulations, and policy standards on network security and data security. Encourage industries, localities, and enterprises to promote data classification and hierarchical management, data security sharing and utilization, and carry out assessments of data security maturity and certifications of data security management. Enhance the capacity building of data security guarantee, guide the construction of data security situational awareness platforms, and improve the monitoring, analysis, and disposal capabilities of security risks such as sensitive data leakage and illegal cross-border data flow. Promote the development of the data security industry. Support key industries in developing data security technologies, improve data security protection levels and emergency response capabilities. Strengthen the research and development and application of data security products, and promote the application of big data technologies in the security protection of digital infrastructure. Enhance the research and development and application of data security technologies and products such as privacy computing, data anonymization, and encryption, improve the supply capacity of data security products, and expand and strengthen the data security industry. Fifth, guarantee measures.
titlelist: Main task: Build a solid defense line for data security protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the popularization of big data knowledge, promote industry typical achievements through various means such as media publicity, forums and exhibitions, competitions and events, experience centers, etc., and enhance the public's awareness of big data. Increase training on theoretical knowledge of big data, enhance the society's ability to acquire, analyze, and utilize data, and strengthen the ability to use data for innovation in various fields. Promote the Chief Data Officer system, strengthen the strategic orientation driven by data, establish new mechanisms based on big data decision-making, and accelerate organizational and management changes through data utilization.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance data thinking.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Coordinate the relationship between the government and the market, promote the marketization of resource allocation, further stimulate the vitality of market entities, and promote better integration between an effective market and an active government. Establish and improve the governance system for the platform economy, and promote the standardized and healthy development of the platform economy. Coordinate policy implementation, establish a coordinated mechanism for the development and application of national big data, and strengthen departmental collaboration in areas such as policy, market, regulation, and security. Strengthen coordination between the central and local governments, establish a unified method for calculating the big data industry, guide local governments to conduct regular evaluations and dynamic adjustments, and guide local governments to combine with reality to ensure the implementation of various tasks in the plan.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the promotion mechanism.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Reform the project approval and organizational implementation methods for technological research and development, strengthen demand orientation, establish and improve innovative mechanisms that operate in a market-oriented, professionalized, and platform-based manner. Encourage eligible regions to deepen reforms related to the use rights, disposal rights, and income rights of big data-related scientific and technological achievements. Carry out pilot projects to grant scientific research personnel ownership or long-term use rights of technological achievements as part of their job duties, and improve mechanisms for technology transfer incentives and equity sharing. Cultivate and develop technology transfer institutions and technology managers in the field of big data, and enhance the professional service capabilities of technology transfer.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen technological supply.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen investment in the research and development of big data infrastructure software and hardware, as well as key core technologies, to fill industry gaps and enhance basic capabilities. Encourage government industry funds, venture capital, and social capital to increase investment in big data enterprises based on market principles. Encourage local governments to strengthen support for the development of the big data industry, and provide financial rewards and subsidies for pilot demonstration projects and DCMM compliance in the development of the big data industry. Encourage banks to engage in intellectual property pledge financing and support qualified big data enterprises in going public for financing.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen financial support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage universities to optimize the establishment of big data disciplines, deepen the construction of new engineering disciplines, increase efforts in related discipline construction, and explore the development of new forms of digital teaching resources based on knowledge graphs. Encourage vocational colleges to deepen cooperation with big data enterprises, establish training bases, promote professional upgrading and adjustment, align with industry demands, and cultivate high-quality technical talents. Encourage companies to strengthen on-the-job training, explore new models of remote vocational training, and provide training for big data engineering technicians, job skills enhancement, and entrepreneurship and innovation. Innovate talent introduction to attract big data talents to return to China for employment and entrepreneurship.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate talent development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the role of multilateral and bilateral international cooperation mechanisms, support domestic and foreign big data enterprises in deepening cooperation in areas such as technology research and development, standard setting, product services, and intellectual property rights. Promote big data enterprises to go global and actively explore international markets in countries and regions along the Belt and Road initiative. Encourage multinational companies and research institutions to establish big data research and development centers and education training centers in China. Actively participate in the formulation of international rules and digital technology standards in areas such as data security, digital currency, and digital taxation.
titlelist: The main task is to promote international cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the appropriate acceleration of the construction progress of new data center clusters in national hub nodes such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and Chengdu-Chongqing, to achieve large-scale deployment of computing power and meet the needs of implementing major regional development strategies. Focus on improving the quality and utilization efficiency of computing power services in national hub nodes such as Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia, and build non-real-time computing power guarantee bases for the whole country.
titlelist: Main tasks, optimization of the layout of new data center construction, and acceleration of the construction of national hub nodes.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In areas outside the national hub nodes, efforts are being made to integrate and fully utilize existing data center resources, and accelerate the improvement of the utilization rate of existing data centers. Based on local business needs and considering factors such as energy supply and network conditions, new data centers will be built as needed to create computing power services with local characteristics, serving the local area and of an appropriate scale.
titlelist: The main task is to optimize the layout of the construction of new data centers and construct new data centers in each province according to demand.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Actively build an edge computing supply system within the city, supporting the computation, storage, and transmission of edge data to meet the demands of new business applications with extremely low latency. Guide the collaborative deployment of urban edge data centers with substations, base stations, communication rooms, and other urban infrastructure to ensure the necessary space, power, and other resources.
titlelist: Main tasks, optimization action for the construction layout of new data centers, and flexible deployment of edge data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Old and outdated small-scale data centers. Classify and promote the transformation and upgrading of existing old and outdated small-scale data centers in batches. Accelerate the application of high-density, high-efficiency IT equipment and infrastructure systems in old data centers, and accelerate the migration and integration of small-scale data centers to improve the energy utilization efficiency and computing power supply capacity of old and outdated small-scale data centers, better meeting the local edge computing application needs. Gradually establish new data centers overseas. Support domestic data center industry chain enterprises to go global, with a focus on establishing new data centers overseas in countries along the Belt and Road initiative, strengthen effective coordination with international communication infrastructure such as submarine cables, and gradually enhance global service capabilities. Column 1: Cloud-edge collaboration project. Accelerate the construction of new data center clusters in national hub nodes. Promote the construction of national hub nodes according to high reliability, high availability, high security, and green energy-saving standards. Combine with the selection of national new industrialization industry demonstration bases (data centers) to accelerate the development of new data center cluster demonstrations, and better provide scalable computing and storage services to meet various business needs. Support the creation of edge data center application scenarios. Carry out benchmarking activities for edge data center applications based on key application scenarios such as 5G and industrial Internet, and create more than 50 benchmark projects to form a leading demonstration effect. Publish guidelines for cloud-edge collaboration construction. Based on the demonstrations of new data center clusters and typical applications of edge data centers, conduct quality assessments of cloud-edge collaboration development and publish the Guidelines for Cloud-Edge Collaboration Construction Applications.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the transformation and upgrade of the layout optimization action for the construction of new data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Driven by the demand for high-speed interconnection in new data centers, we will promote the upgrading of backbone networks, continuously optimize the layout of national Internet backbone direct connection points, and improve the quality of interconnection between networks. We will actively promote the optimization of data center network architecture and traffic diversion paths in the eastern and western regions, support the eastern data, western computation project, reduce network latency between national hub nodes, and continuously improve network quality.
titlelist: Main tasks, network quality upgrade action, enhancing the support capability of new data center networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Priority support is given to the direct connection of the network between the new data center clusters within the national hub nodes, and the construction of the national new internet exchange center is steadily and orderly promoted to facilitate data exchange across networks, regions, and enterprises, and to support high-frequency real-time interactive business needs. It guides basic telecommunications companies to establish a reasonable network settlement mechanism within the national hub nodes, gradually reducing major communication costs such as long-distance transmission.
titlelist: The main tasks include upgrading network quality and optimizing the interconnection capability of regional new data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the interconnection between edge data centers, as well as between edge data centers and new types of data center clusters, to facilitate the coordinated development of data centers, cloud computing, and networks. Based on business scenarios, match the computing and storage capabilities of edge data centers, optimize network configurations, reduce network latency, improve user service experience, and support business applications with extremely low latency requirements. Column 2: Network Collaboration Engineering. Establish a new type of data center network collaboration mechanism. Promote basic telecommunications companies, internet companies, and third-party data center companies to jointly establish a mechanism for network collaboration and linkage, combining the current network situation and expansion rules, and promote effective coordination between data center network demand and network supply. Improve the monitoring system for new types of data center networks. Through measures such as formulating data center network monitoring standards, improving data center network monitoring platforms, and deploying network monitoring devices, promote quality monitoring of network collaboration and continuously enhance the network capabilities of data centers. Publish a quality monitoring report for new types of data center networks. Based on network quality monitoring data and comprehensive national data center operations, publish the National Data Center Network Quality Report.
titlelist: Main tasks, network quality upgrade action, promoting interconnection of edge data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Guide the intensive, high-density, and intelligent construction of new data centers, steadily increase the scale of individual data centers and the power of single racks, accelerate the deployment of high-performance and intelligent computing centers, promote the improvement of heterogeneous computing power such as CPU and GPU, gradually increase the proportion of independently developed computing power deployment, promote the diversification of computing power supply in new data centers, and support various intelligent applications.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance computing power and accelerate the improvement of computing power and efficiency.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage relevant enterprises to accelerate the construction of digital cloud platforms. Strengthen demand traction and supply-demand integration, promote enterprises to deeply migrate to the cloud and use cloud services. Improve the construction of service systems and the maturity model of IT digital transformation, supporting the acceleration of digital transformation in key areas such as industry.
titlelist: The main tasks are to enhance computing power and empower actions, and to strengthen the support capacity for industrial digital transformation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the development of new data centers to meet the needs of government services and people's livelihood, improve the supply of public computing resources, optimize the computing service system, and enhance the scheduling capability of computing services. Encourage enterprises to provide public computing resources through cloud services and other means, reduce the cost of computing usage, and enhance the enabling role of applications. Column 3: Cloud Collaboration Project. Carry out computing power and efficiency evaluation. Establish a new data center computing power and efficiency evaluation system, improve evaluation standards, publish evaluation guidelines, and guide regions and enterprises to organize evaluation work accordingly. Improve the computing resource service system. Thoroughly analyze the current supply and demand situation of computing resources nationwide, build a computing service evaluation system, and roll out the National Data Center Application Development Guide. Update and promote the implementation guide for enterprise cloud migration, rely on digital cloud platforms and public service platforms, continuously gather cloud computing resources, conduct evaluations on the effects of enterprise cloud migration, and regularly publish enterprise cloud migration index reports. Organize demonstrations of computing resource-enabled applications. Carry out selection of outstanding applications supported by new data centers for industry digital transformation, and form 30 excellent application cases as references for enterprises.
titlelist: Main tasks, enhancing computing power to empower actions, promoting ubiquitous application of public computing power.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage enterprises to increase investment in technology research and development, carry out technical research and development in new types of data center prefabrication, liquid cooling, and other facility layers, as well as specialized servers, storage arrays, and other IT layers. Accelerate the development of key technologies and product innovations in software layers such as the operation and management of new types of data centers, as well as cloud-native and cloud-edge integration platforms, to enhance the synergy between software and hardware.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the industrial chain and enhance core technology research and development.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish and improve a new data center standard system, promote the development of IT and network standards such as cloud-edge servers, software-defined storage, and intelligent lossless Ethernet. name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Computing power is the ability of data center servers to process data and produce output results. It is a comprehensive indicator for measuring the computing capability of a data center, with a larger value indicating a stronger overall computing capability. It includes general computing capability represented by CPUs, and high-performance computing capability represented by GPUs. The most commonly used unit of measurement is the number of floating-point operations executed per second (FLOPS, EFLOPS=10^18FLOPS). According to estimates, 1 EFLOPS is approximately equivalent to the computing power output of 5 Tianhe-2A supercomputers, or 500,000 mainstream server CPUs, or 2 million mainstream laptop computers. The calculation formula is: CP = CP general + CP high-performance.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen platform support and computational power (CP).

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The text translates to: Refers to the computing power for executing computationally intensive tasks such as graphics display, signal processing, artificial intelligence, and physical simulation, mainly represented by GPU (graphics processing unit), FPGA (field-programmable gate array), NPU (network processing unit), etc.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen platform support and high-performance computing.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The text translates to English as follows:CE refers to the ratio of computational power to power consumption in a data center, which represents the efficiency of the data center by considering both computational performance and power consumption. A higher value indicates a stronger computational power per unit of power and higher efficiency. The calculation formula is: CE = CP / PCIT, where CP represents the computational capability of the data center, expressed in single-precision floating-point numbers (FP32). PCIT represents the overall power consumption of the data center's IT equipment, measured in watts (W).
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen platform support and improve computational efficiency (CE).

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The text is explaining the concept of Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) in data centers. PUE is the ratio of the total power consumption of a data center to the power consumption of its IT equipment. It is generally measured using the average annual PUE value. The detailed calculation and measurement requirements can be found in YDT2543 Energy Consumption Evaluation Method for Telecommunication Internet Data Centers (IDC). A PUE value greater than 1 indicates that a higher proportion of electrical energy is used for IT equipment, while the energy consumption for cooling, power supply, and other non-IT equipment is lower. The calculation formula for PUE is: PUE = PTotal / PIT, where PTotal represents the total power consumption required to maintain the normal operation of the data center (measured in kWh), and PIT represents the power consumption of the IT equipment in the data center (measured in kWh).
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen platform support and improve the power usage effectiveness (PUE) of data center.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: 'WUE refers to the ratio of the total water consumption of a data center to the power consumption of its IT equipment (unit: L/kWh). It is generally measured as the annual average WUE value. A smaller WUE value indicates a higher efficiency in utilizing water resources in the data center. The calculation formula is: WUE = (Σ total water consumption) / Σ PIT. Total water consumption refers to the total amount of water input into the data center, measured in liters (L). PIT refers to the power consumption of IT equipment in the data center, measured in kilowatt-hours (kWh).'
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen platform support and improve the water usage effectiveness of data centers.

Implement preferential tax policies for energy-saving, water-saving, and environmental protection special equipment, as well as support the establishment of green data centers through green credit, and the compensation mechanism for the first set of major technological equipment insurance. Prioritize providing electricity discounts and policy support for green data centers in terms of direct power supply, large industrial electricity, and multiple power supply introductions. Increase government procurement policy support, and guide national institutions, enterprises, and institutions to prioritize the procurement of services such as data center leasing, cloud services, and big data provided by green data centers.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational support, strengthen policy support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: For large-scale users with strong application demands in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta region, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the Chengdu-Chongqing region, it is important to coordinate the layout of data centers within cities and surrounding areas, achieve coordinated and sustainable deployment of large-scale computing power with land, energy, water, electricity, and other resources, optimize the supply structure of data centers, expand the space for computing power growth, and meet the needs of implementing major regional development strategies. For nodes in Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, Ningxia, and other regions with abundant renewable energy, suitable climate, and great potential for green development of data centers, it is important to improve the quality and efficiency of computing services, fully leverage resource advantages, strengthen basic guarantees such as networks, actively undertake non-real-time computing needs such as background processing, offline analysis, and storage backup nationwide, and build non-real-time computing support bases for the whole country. For areas outside the national hub nodes, it is important to promote the construction of data centers that meet local business needs, strengthen the green and intensive management of data centers, and create computing services with local characteristics, serving the local area with an appropriate scale. Strengthen network connectivity with neighboring national hub nodes. In the future, national hub nodes will be added as needed according to development requirements.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Guide the development of super-large and large-scale data center clusters, build data center clusters, promote cloud-based analysis and processing of large-scale data, focus on supporting the centralized processing of massive-scale data, support business needs such as industrial Internet, finance and securities, disaster warning, remote medical care, video calls, and artificial intelligence reasoning that require close proximity, high-frequency, real-time interaction. The end-to-end one-way network latency of data centers should ideally be within a range of 20 milliseconds. Data center clusters in Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia should prioritize backend processing, offline analysis, storage backup, and other non-real-time computing needs. In the initial stage, for national hub nodes across regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and Chengdu-Chongqing, the layout should generally not exceed 2 clusters. For national hub nodes in single administrative regions such as Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia, the layout should generally be 1 cluster. Clusters should focus on intensive development, clarify standards for data center construction scale, energy efficiency level, and deployment rate, and avoid blind investment and construction.
titlelist: Data center layout, data center cluster

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Within the urban city area, accelerate the transformation and upgrading of existing data centers to improve efficiency. Support the development of high-performance, edge data centers. Encourage data centers within the city area to serve as the edge for computing power, prioritizing the fulfillment of high-frequency trading in the financial market, virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR), ultra-high-definition video, connected vehicles, networked drones, smart power, smart factories, smart security, and other real-time business demands. The end-to-end one-way network latency of data centers should ideally be within a range of 10 milliseconds.
titlelist: Data center layout, urban internal data center

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: With the focus on data center cluster layout, we will strengthen the construction of green data centers and enhance energy-saving and consumption reduction requirements. We will promote the use of energy-saving technologies such as high-density integration of efficient electronic information equipment, new types of precision air conditioning for computer rooms, liquid cooling, modular cabinet systems, and waste heat recovery. While ensuring safe operation and maintenance, we encourage the use of cascaded utilization products of power batteries as energy storage and backup power devices. We will accelerate the transformation and upgrading of old infrastructure. We will improve the comprehensive energy-saving evaluation standard system for data centers, which includes indicators such as energy utilization efficiency, computing power utilization efficiency, and renewable energy utilization rate.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening green and intensive construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Scale up the application of hardware and software products such as server chips, operating systems, databases, middleware, distributed computing and storage, and data flow models. Support and promote platform-level original technologies in big data infrastructure, distributed data operating systems, and big data analytics. Organize research institutes, universities, enterprises, and technology communities to collaborate on the development and application of key technological products, enhancing the independent innovation capability of the entire big data industry chain.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, promoting breakthroughs in core technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Construct high-speed data transmission networks between data center clusters, as well as between clusters and major cities, optimize communication network structures, expand network communication bandwidth, and reduce data transfer latency. Establish a data center network monitoring system to promote efficient supply and coordinated development between data centers and network services. Establish a reasonable network settlement mechanism within national hub nodes to reduce long-distance transmission costs. Promote the construction of national new internet exchange centers and national internet backbone direct connection points around data center clusters, and facilitate interconnection and interoperability of traffic among internet companies, cloud service providers, telecommunications operators, and other parties.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, accelerating network interconnection and interoperability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the full utilization of renewable energy such as wind energy, solar energy, tidal energy, and biomass energy in data centers. Support the establishment of renewable energy power plants to support data center clusters. Expand the scope of market-based transactions for renewable energy and encourage data center enterprises to participate in renewable energy market transactions. Support data centers in adopting methods such as direct supply for large users, dedicated power lines, and the construction of distributed photovoltaic systems to enhance the consumption of renewable energy. Ensure the availability of land and water resources for data centers.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening energy supply guarantee.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a sound mechanism and technical system for monitoring energy consumption in data centers. Strengthen the coordination of energy consumption indicators in data centers, and allocate unified energy consumption indicators for data center clusters at the provincial, regional, and municipal levels. Encourage the allocation of energy consumption indicators through energy rights trading. Explore cross-provincial cooperation in sharing energy consumption and benefits. Encourage data centers to not only fulfill their minimum consumption responsibilities but also strive to achieve incentivized consumption targets.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening energy consumption monitoring and management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support government departments and enterprises to integrate internal computing resources, and conduct integrated scheduling of clusters and data centers within urban areas. Support the development of multi-cloud management services in public clouds, industry clouds, and other fields, and strengthen integrated resource scheduling between multiple clouds, between clouds and data centers, and between clouds and networks. Support the construction of an integrated access and integration verification environment, further connecting computing resources across industries, regions, and levels, and building a computing service resource pool.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, improving computing power service level.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build data sharing, data openness, and integration of government-enterprise data into a common data circulation infrastructure platform, and establish a sound data circulation management system. Experiment with secure multi-party computation, blockchain, privacy computation, data sandbox, and other technological models to construct a trusted data circulation environment and improve data circulation efficiency. Explore the classification of data resources and research and formulate relevant specifications and standards.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, promoting orderly circulation of data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Carry out the construction of an integrated urban data brain to provide big data support for urban industrial structure adjustment, economic operation monitoring, social services and governance, transportation, and ecological environment. Select public health, natural disasters, market supervision, and other emergency scenarios to experiment with the construction of a 'data target field' and explore the rules and collaborative mechanisms for data utilization under different emergency conditions.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, deepening the application of data intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Improve risk identification and protection technologies for aggregating and integrating massive amounts of data, data anonymization techniques, data security compliance assessment and certification, data encryption protection mechanisms, and related technical monitoring methods. Simultaneously plan, construct, and use security technology measures to ensure business stability and data security. Accelerate the construction of national internet data centers, cloud platforms, and other data security technical monitoring methods to enhance the ability to monitor sensitive data leaks and analyze abnormal data flows. Five, security measures.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, ensuring network data security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Organize and carry out a major demonstration project for the coordinated innovation system of national integrated big data centers. Conduct pilot demonstrations in areas such as data center direct network connection, integrated computing power services, data circulation, and applications. Support the large-scale application of key software and hardware products such as server chips and cloud operating systems. Support the demonstration project of 'Eastern Data, Western Computing' to deepen the collaborative computing power between the eastern and western regions. Support the integrated verification of common technologies and mechanisms such as the development of related technical platforms for big data centers, resource access and scheduling, and industrial applications.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening engineering support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: By 2025, a rational and green integrated infrastructure pattern will be formed for data centers nationwide. The structural balance of data centers in the eastern and western regions will be achieved, and the energy utilization efficiency of large and super-large data centers will be reduced to below 1.3. The level of data center intensification, scaling, and greening will significantly improve, and the utilization rate will be noticeably increased. The public cloud service system will initially take shape, and the cost of acquiring computing power for the whole society will be significantly reduced. The barriers to data circulation between government departments and between government and enterprises will be further broken, and the vitality of data resource circulation will be significantly enhanced. The collaborative application effect of big data will be highlighted, and a number of industry data brains and city data brains will be formed nationwide. The trend of efficient transformation of social computing resources and data resources into intellectual resources will be basically formed, and the capability of data security guarantee will steadily improve.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Optimize the layout of the national Internet backbone direct connection points, promote the construction of new Internet exchange centers, improve the quality of interconnection between telecommunications operators and Internet companies, optimize cross-network and cross-regional data exchange in data centers, and achieve higher quality data transmission services. Actively promote the establishment of direct network connections between regional data center clusters and between clusters and major cities. Increase monitoring of the quality and guarantee capacity of data center networks, and improve network communication quality. Promote the reduction of major communication costs such as inter-provincial digital dedicated lines and Internet access bandwidth within the country. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, responsible for various regions).
titlelist: Optimize data center layout and promote network interconnection and interoperability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Explore the establishment of a coordinated operation mechanism between the power grid and data network, and further reduce the electricity cost of data centers. Accelerate the formulation of national standards for data center energy efficiency and promote the improvement of the green data center standard system. Guide the development and use of clean energy, and accelerate the promotion and application of advanced energy-saving technologies. Encourage data center operators to strengthen internal energy consumption data monitoring and management, and improve energy utilization efficiency. Encourage regions to combine layout guidance and explore optimized energy consumption policies, and explore cross-provincial energy consumption and benefit sharing cooperation within the regional scope. Promote the construction of green data centers and accelerate the energy-saving and greening transformation of data centers. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the National Energy Administration, with responsibilities assigned to various regions).
titlelist: Optimize data center layout and strengthen energy supporting mechanisms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the establishment and improvement of cloud resource access and integrated scheduling mechanisms, provide computing resources in the form of cloud services, and reduce the cost and threshold of computing power usage. Support the construction of high-level cloud service platforms to further enhance resource scheduling capabilities. Support government-enterprise cooperation to create public computing power services that integrate basic computing resources and utilize public data development environments, providing low-cost, wide coverage, reliable, and secure computing power services to the government, enterprises, and the public. Support enterprises in playing the role of market entities, innovating technology models and service experiences, creating industry computing power services that integrate professional computing resources and industry data development environments, and supporting the digital transformation of industries and the cultivation of new formats and models. (Led by the Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with responsibilities divided among various regions and departments).
titlelist: Promote the service-oriented utilization of computing resources and build an integrated computing service system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Taking application-oriented approach, fully leveraging the advantages of cloud-based scheduling, guiding various industries to make rational use of computing resources, and improving the efficiency of infrastructure utilization. For businesses that require background processing and storage, with low network latency requirements, support is provided for scheduling to data center clusters in energy-rich and climate-appropriate regions. For businesses that require high-frequency service calls and have extremely high network latency requirements, support is provided for scheduling to city-level high-performance, edge data centers. For other computing needs, support is provided for scheduling to data center clusters within the local region. (Responsibilities are assigned to different regions and departments).
titlelist: Promote the service-oriented utilization of computing power resources and optimize the structure of computing power resource demand.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on the common needs of big data applications, encourage the construction of integrated natural language processing, video and image analysis, data visualization, voice intelligent question answering, multilingual machine translation, data mining and analysis, and other functions of big data general algorithm models and control libraries, and provide standardized and unified big data service support. (Responsibility of various regions and departments).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application and strengthen the support for public services of big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of an 'industry data brain' and promote the integrated application of big data in various industries. Guide and support industries to migrate to the cloud, enrich the supply of cloud-based applications, and accelerate the pace of digital transformation. Promote the development of new formats and models through big data and cloud services, support the integration of online and offline business for enterprises, and cultivate data-driven enterprises. (Responsibilities of various regions and departments).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application and promote the digital transformation and upgrading of industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of industrial internet big data centers according to standards, strengthen the aggregation, sharing, and innovative application of industrial internet data, and empower the high-quality development of the manufacturing industry. Encourage the construction of databases for key industries and major projects to provide data support for monitoring, analyzing, and predicting the development trends of the industrial sector. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with responsibilities divided among different regions and departments according to their functions).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application and promote the construction of industrial big data platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of the 'City Data Brain', improve the government's social collaborative governance mechanism, accelerate the formation of a unified, standardized, interconnected, and secure urban data supply chain, and provide data support for urban governance, public services, and industrial development. Accelerate the construction of a comprehensive application platform for urban big data, connect the urban data perception, analysis, decision-making, and execution processes, and promote the improvement of urban governance and service capabilities. (Responsibility lies with each region).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application, accelerate the innovation and application of urban big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Each region and department should combine with the actual situation, adhere to the principle of small incisions and large driving forces, actively explore in areas such as big data mechanism management, industrial layout, technological innovation, security assessment, standard formulation, and application coordination, and accumulate and promote advanced experiences. Encourage each region to innovate related supporting policies, formulate integrated big data center construction plans and collaborative innovation implementation plans that are in line with their own characteristics, and accelerate implementation. (Responsibility lies with each region and department).
titlelist: Guarantee measures, focus on implementing tasks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Taking the construction of digital capabilities as the main line to promote the digital development of quality management, accelerate the innovative application of digital technology in quality management, optimize and reconstruct the business processes of quality management, break down barriers to cooperation between different management levels, functional departments, and enterprises, empower enterprises in diversified product innovation, refined production control, high value-added service development, and personalized experience enhancement, respond quickly and effectively to uncertain changes, and continuously build differentiated competitive advantages.
titlelist: Protective measures, centered around a main line.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the reshaping of the concept of quality development in the digital era, promote the transformation of the scope of quality management from enterprise quality control to ecosystem collaboration, strengthen the management of product lifecycle, industrial chain supply chain, and even ecosystem collaboration quality; promote the transformation of key links in quality management from focusing mainly on manufacturing processes to giving equal importance to research and development, design, manufacturing, and services, deepen the collection, integration, and sharing of quality data across departments, links, and enterprises, promote quality collaboration and quality management innovation; shift the focus of quality management from mainly focusing on large-scale production to giving equal importance to large-scale production and personalization, differentiation, and refinement, actively collaborate on production mode and organizational innovation, and proactively adapt to dynamic market changes.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, accelerate the three major transformations.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises in the early stage of digitization should select key business processes such as research and development, design, procurement, production, testing, warehousing, logistics, sales, and services based on actual needs, and focus on promoting the application of digital technology. They should fully utilize digital tools to strengthen the collection, analysis, and utilization of quality information in business processes, carry out digital design verification, quality control, quality inspection, quality analysis, and quality improvement, and enhance the refinement and intelligence level of quality process control, thereby improving the efficiency and effectiveness of enterprise quality management.
titlelist: Clearly define the key scenarios for digital quality management, and focus on digitizing quality management in key business processes for enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: For enterprises that have achieved good digitization and integrated operation of business, it is necessary to promote the integration of research and development, design, production, and service based on digital product models. Strengthening the quality information traceability of the entire product lifecycle, enhancing the sharing and utilization of quality data in the industrial chain and supply chain, promoting data model-driven quality planning, control, and improvement of the entire product lifecycle and industry chain, strengthening the linkage of quality management in the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain and supply chain, and promoting innovation in diversified and high-value-added product services.
titlelist: Clearly define the key scenarios of digital quality management, focusing on quality collaboration throughout the entire product lifecycle and the entire industry chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises with platform-based operations and social collaboration capabilities should promote the online, modular, and platform-based transformation of quality management-related resources, capabilities, and businesses. They should collaborate with ecosystem partners to build a quality management platform, strengthen the collection, organization, sharing, circulation, and development of quality ecological data, promote the external output and iterative optimization of quality management knowledge and experience, and build a customer-oriented, data-driven, and ecologically beneficial quality management system and business model. Gradually, they should create a new ecosystem of quality symbiosis and win-win. Key industries for digital quality management include the raw materials industry. Targeting industries such as steel, petrochemicals, chemicals, and building materials, efforts should be made to promote the digital quality control of production and manufacturing. By deeply applying technologies such as sensors, machine vision, automation control, and advanced measurement instruments in the production process, the level of internal control within enterprises should be strengthened. Automatic collection and processing of quality data in the production process should be promoted, and online monitoring, diagnosis, and optimization of the entire quality process should be conducted. Intelligent warning control limits should be set based on market and process quality indicators to continuously improve the level of quality control. Supply chain quality management coordination should be strengthened between upstream and downstream, and upstream and downstream enterprises should jointly build supply chain management systems and platforms. Channels for quality information transmission between upstream and downstream enterprises should be established, and based on interconnected and orderly data sharing, the level of quality collaborative control and full life cycle quality traceability management should be improved from procurement and sourcing to production and sales. In the equipment manufacturing industry, efforts should be made to promote product quality design based on digital models. Technologies such as artificial intelligence and simulation should be applied in the product research and development design process. Product-level and component-level digital simulation models should be built, and failure mode analysis, prevention, assembly, and logistics simulation should be conducted to identify optimal design solutions. Quality design should be improved through intelligent quality planning to reduce the risk of quality loss. Promote digital control of production and manufacturing, and deeply apply technologies such as sensors, machine vision, automation control, and advanced measurement instruments in the production process to improve the level of lean production process quality control. Promote service quality improvement based on product life cycle management. Connect the entire machine and component status recognition and tracking through online platforms, conduct product failure warning and prediction, maintenance service warning prompts, and other extended services to promote product high-end development. In the consumer goods industry, promote digital quality control in the production and manufacturing processes of the light industry and textile industry. Promote the widespread application of technologies such as sensors, machine vision, and automation control in the light textile production process to improve online monitoring levels. For industries such as pharmaceuticals and food, promote quality traceability throughout the product life cycle. Jointly establish product unique identification standards with upstream and downstream partners, carry out quality traceability system construction, provide real-time traceability and query services, strengthen the collaborative control of the entire life cycle quality, and ensure consumer confidence in consumption.
