titlelist: Clarify the key scenarios of digital quality management, and build a quality ecosystem and knowledge sharing oriented towards social collaboration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should combine the development goals and planning of the integration of the two industries, optimize the quality policy and quality objectives, and formulate a digital improvement path for quality management. Clearly define the responsible departments, responsibilities, and authorities for promoting the digitalization of quality management work, innovate the collaborative organizational model between the quality department and the business department, coordinate planning and select key scenarios for digital quality management, determine resource guarantees, and promote implementation step by step. In the operation and management of the quality management system, the improvement effect of digital capabilities should be regularly evaluated and reported to the top management.
titlelist: Improve the digital work mechanism for enterprise quality management and strengthen the digital organizational leadership for quality management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should be user-oriented, clarify the quality management requirements of key scenarios, and use methods such as the integration of information technology and industrialization to plan digital activities for quality management, including process optimization, equipment upgrading, information system integration, data resource utilization, and updating of operating procedures. They should use digital technology to bridge process breakpoints, strengthen the tracking, online monitoring, and dynamic optimization of business process status, and enhance the closed-loop control of quality objectives and quality activities.
titlelist: Improve the digital work mechanism for enterprise quality management and strengthen the planning of digital activities for quality management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage enterprises to rely on industrial internet platforms, data integration platforms, etc., to build a unified quality management platform, realizing the modelization and platformization of quality management knowledge, methods, and experiences. Strengthen the development and utilization of digital design tools, apply technologies such as digital analysis modeling, digital twins, reliability design and simulation, quality fluctuation analysis, etc., to improve product user experience and quality design level. Encourage leading enterprises to build industry chain quality collaboration platforms, promote quality information sharing and knowledge co-creation among enterprises, explore new models of industry chain quality management linkage, and enhance the level of collaborative development in the industry chain quality.
titlelist: Improve the digital work mechanism for enterprise quality management and promote the integration of digital resources for quality management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should strengthen the participation of all staff in the digitalization of quality management activities, improve evaluation and incentive mechanisms, and turn the promotion of digitalization of quality management into proactive and capable actions by employees. In line with the development needs of digital transformation, a digital skills enhancement plan should be formulated for personnel in relevant positions that affect quality, in order to improve their ability to use information systems and apply quality management techniques in digital conditions. Appropriate assessment and evaluation should be conducted for personnel in positions that have a significant impact, to ensure that they have the ability to fulfill quality responsibilities in digital conditions.
titlelist: Enhance the digital operational capability of enterprise quality management and improve digital job skills at various positions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should strengthen necessary production equipment transformation according to the requirements of digital core competence in quality management, improve the level of process control automation, intelligence, and precision, ensure process stability, and reduce quality fluctuations. In combination with the process of equipment digital transformation, design and develop corresponding quality management system platforms, form data-driven online quality control and autonomous decision-making capabilities, and lay a solid foundation for process improvement and product innovation.
titlelist: Enhance the digital operational capability of enterprise quality management and promote the digital transformation and upgrading of equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should improve the methods and procedures of inspection and testing in accordance with the requirements of digital quality management. They should promote the upgrading of online inspection, measurement, and other instruments, and promote the interconnection between manufacturing equipment and inspection and testing equipment to improve the efficiency of quality inspection, measurement precision, and dynamic perception level. By utilizing technologies such as machine vision and artificial intelligence, they can enhance the comprehensiveness, accuracy, and predictive warning level of production quality inspection.
titlelist: Enhance the digital operational capability of enterprise quality management and strengthen digital management of inspection and testing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should include quality data in the scope of data asset management. Strengthen standardized management of quality data and carry out capacity building for enterprise data management. Enhance the overall management of quality data collection, management, processing, analysis, and application, clarifying responsibilities and authorities at each stage, and strengthening the construction of cross-departmental and intra-departmental data management mechanisms. Improve data architecture design to promote efficient exchange and sharing of quality data between business activities.
titlelist: Strengthen the development and utilization of quality data throughout the product lifecycle, and enhance quality data management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should carry out quality analysis, control, and improvement based on the quality knowledge base, using big data throughout the entire process, lifecycle, and value chain. This will promote data-driven quality collaboration in the industrial and supply chains, explore the value of quality data, and timely identify quality risks and opportunities. Develop and deploy data-based quality control and decision-making models to enhance the timeliness of quality response and handling, reduce the risk of quality business decisions, implement more effective quality prevention and improvement, improve user experience, and strengthen flexible response capabilities and levels to uncertainties.
titlelist: Strengthen the development and utilization of quality data throughout the product lifecycle, and deepen the modeling and analysis of quality data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Enterprises should implement the 'Data Security Law' and relevant administrative regulations, strengthen data security awareness, and fulfill data security protection obligations. Strengthen security capabilities such as situational awareness, testing and evaluation, early warning and disposal, and disaster backup, to ensure the quality data security of the enterprise itself and its users, and build a multi-dimensional quality data security protection barrier covering network security, system security, and business security.
titlelist: Strengthen the development and utilization of quality data throughout the product lifecycle, and enhance the level of quality data security management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In the fields of biomedicine, new materials, aerospace, shipbuilding and marine engineering, electronic manufacturing, new energy, and intelligent connected vehicles, it is encouraged for relevant industry associations and leading enterprises to establish public service platforms for product quality big data. These platforms will provide services such as online quality information inquiry, quality risk analysis, quality cost analysis, and quality traceability. Professional institutions are encouraged to provide services such as digital level assessment and diagnosis of quality management based on the platform, continuously building and improving diagnostic benchmark models, strengthening the diagnosis, training, and guidance of digital quality management for small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhancing the overall performance of quality management.
titlelist: Innovative quality management digital public services, exploring platform-based data sharing services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Based on the relevant standards and specifications already published in the existing field, it is encouraged for standardization organizations, industry associations, social groups, and key enterprises to establish standards and specifications for digital quality management. This includes strengthening the promotion of standards, application services, and implementation effectiveness evaluation. For industrial clusters, efforts should be made to establish and improve public service systems for digital quality management, including standard development, industrial metrology, and testing and certification. Additionally, professional institutions should be cultivated to provide comprehensive services for digital quality management, such as consulting, diagnosis, project implementation, and operation maintenance.
titlelist: Innovative quality management digital public services, improving standards and testing certification services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The industrial and informationization authorities in various regions should combine with the local reality, strengthen coordination and cooperation with market supervision and other relevant departments in the digital development of quality management, major issues, major policies, and major projects, and establish a sound mechanism for collaborative promotion among the government, industry, enterprises, research institutes, and professional institutions. Make full use of existing fiscal funds and industrial investment funds, and increase support for weak links in digital quality management in the manufacturing industry and public service platforms.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, strengthen organizational implementation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage industrial and informationization authorities in various regions to increase the promotion of digital quality management, strengthen policy dissemination and interpretation, popularize knowledge of digital quality management, enhance awareness and practical capabilities of enterprises in promoting digital quality management, and continuously expand the influence of digital quality management in enterprises. Support industry associations, industrial alliances, and enterprises in jointly promoting digital quality management-related products, technologies, standards, and services, and promote the export of system solutions.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, strengthen promotion and guidance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage industry alliances, industry associations, professional institutions, etc. to establish a digital checklist for quality management in different industries, and continuously explore new digital models for quality management. Summarize and extract typical cases of digital quality management, cultivate and discover a group of typical experiences that have strong driving force and can be replicated and promoted. Strengthen communication and promotion, lead the overall improvement of industry quality level with benchmark enterprises that have achieved significant results, and create a favorable atmosphere for the digital development of quality management.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, create benchmark demonstrations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote deepened cooperation between industry alliances, industry associations, universities, and research institutes to jointly establish a digital innovation joint laboratory for quality management, and carry out training on advanced digital quality methods. Encourage the joint construction of a number of digital skills training bases by schools and enterprises to cultivate quality management talents with knowledge, skills, and innovation.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, strengthen talent cultivation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Persist in coordinating the promotion of epidemic prevention and control of COVID-19 and economic and social development, supported by the new generation of information technology and applications, with the goal of enhancing the crisis response capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises and consolidating the foundation for sustainable development. Gather a group of digital service providers targeting small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate and promote a batch of digital platforms, system solutions, products, and services that meet the needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and help promote the digitalization, networking, and intelligent empowerment of small and medium-sized enterprises to achieve resumption of work and production, add momentum to development, and improve development quality. Second, key tasks.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote new applications such as travel cards and health codes to achieve real-time monitoring and sharing of personnel flow information, and accelerate the return of enterprise employees to work premises on the premise of ensuring effective epidemic prevention and control. Utilize mini-programs and toolkits for medical supplies guarantee, epidemic warning, inventory and logistics distribution, resource allocation, etc., to scientifically and accurately prevent and control the epidemic, and promote orderly resumption of work and production.
titlelist: Action objective: Strengthening epidemic prevention and control through the use of information technology.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support small and medium-sized enterprises in using online office, financial management, intelligent communication, remote collaboration, video conferencing, collaborative development, and other products and solutions to quickly resume production management, achieve digital operation management, and encourage digital service providers to waive usage fees for small and medium-sized enterprises during the epidemic prevention and control period. Support digital service providers in building intelligent office platforms, launching solutions such as virtual cloud desktops, ultra-high-definition videos, holographic projection videos, etc., to meet the new demands of upgrading remote office scenarios such as virtual team management and sensitive data control.
titlelist: Action goal, utilize digital tools to resume production and operation as soon as possible.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Guide digital service providers to launch cloud manufacturing platforms and cloud service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), supporting the migration of SMEs' equipment and business systems to the cloud. Help SMEs access resources and application services from the cloud, meeting their needs for cloud-based R&D, design, production, manufacturing, operations management, and marketing systems. Accelerate the integration of cloud + intelligence to help SMEs access more productive services from the cloud. Encourage digital service providers to open up platform interfaces, data, computing capabilities, and other digital resources to SMEs and startup teams, enhancing SMEs' capabilities for secondary development.
titlelist: Action goal, promoting small and medium-sized enterprises to go cloud and use cloud.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a digital platform with high technical level, strong integration capability, and wide industry application. Apply emerging technologies such as Internet of Things, big data, edge computing, 5G, artificial intelligence, augmented reality/virtual reality, etc. Integrate general-purpose operating systems, software, and toolkits for engineering design, electronic design, modeling, simulation, product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations management, and automation control. Flexibly deploy industrial apps with strong generality, security, reliability, and easy secondary development. Promote the digitization of production factors, the flexibility of production processes, and the integration of system services for small and medium-sized enterprises. Build an industrial app testing and evaluation platform and a trusted blockchain innovation collaboration platform to provide testing and certification services for small service providers and small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Action goal, solidify the functionality of the digital platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Developing convenient and cost-effective digital solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in different industries, addressing their specific needs and scenarios. These solutions enable online collaboration in various business functions such as research and development, design, procurement, production, sales, logistics, and inventory management. Promoting the adoption of centralized procurement, resource integration, shared production, collaborative logistics, and new retail solutions, as well as integrating online purchasing and sales, optimal offline inventory and unmanned delivery, and intelligent logistics into a supply chain system and distribution network. This aims to enhance the ability of SMEs to respond to sudden crises and improve operational efficiency.
titlelist: Action goals, innovative digital operational solutions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In response to typical application scenarios for small and medium-sized enterprises, encourage the integration of innovative industrial internet, 5G, artificial intelligence, and industrial app fusion application models and technologies. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises with a foundation and conditions to accelerate the digital transformation of traditional manufacturing equipment, such as networking and key process digitization. Apply low-cost, modular, easy-to-use, and easy-to-maintain advanced intelligent equipment and systems, optimize process flow and equipment technology, build intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and intelligent factories, and achieve lean production, agile manufacturing, fine management, and intelligent decision-making.
titlelist: Action goal, improving the level of intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the establishment of data communication channels between different systems for industrial clusters and upstream and downstream enterprises in the supply chain, to achieve smooth data information flow, shared manufacturing resources, and collaborative production processes. Support the development of new data products and services, encourage the exploration of specialized business models such as data collection, data cleaning, data exchange, and data annotation, and promote the development of foundational data processing cloud services such as elastic distributed computing and data storage, as well as online machine learning, natural language processing, image understanding, speech recognition, knowledge graphs, data visualization, and digital twins for data analysis services. Help small and medium-sized enterprises improve their data development and application capabilities.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text '行动目标,加强数据资源共享和开发利用' to English is:Action goal: Strengthen data resource sharing and development utilization.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the development of new models and formats such as online office, online education, telemedicine, unmanned delivery, and new retail that have emerged during the epidemic prevention and control period. Cultivate and strengthen service-oriented manufacturing new formats such as shared manufacturing and personalized customization. Tap into the value of industrial data, explore new models such as enterprise manufacturing capacity trading and industrial knowledge trading, encourage the development of algorithm and data industries, and cultivate a group of small and medium-sized digital service providers. Build an open-source industrial app developer community and an open platform for small and medium-sized enterprises. Establish a resource library and demand pool for small and medium-sized enterprises, and develop models such as crowdsourcing, crowd innovation, cloud sharing, and cloud leasing.
titlelist: Action goals, developing new models and new formats of the digital economy.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build an industry supply chain docking platform, create an online procurement and distribution model, and provide services such as matching raw materials for small and medium-sized enterprises, sharing rework personnel, configuring automated production lines, mutual assistance in mold resources, procurement of protective materials, and connecting sales and logistics resources. Based on the industrial Internet platform, promote the deep integration of small and medium-sized enterprises into the supply chain and innovation chain of large enterprises. Support large enterprises to establish a shared platform for resources and capabilities based on the common needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and achieve equipment sharing, capacity docking, and production collaboration in key areas.
titlelist: Action goal, strengthen the support of supply chain docking platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the acceleration of digital infrastructure transformation and upgrading in small and micro enterprise entrepreneurship and innovation bases, maker spaces, and other small and medium-sized enterprise industrial agglomeration areas. Construct digital public technology service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises and establish digital innovation demonstration parks for small and medium-sized enterprises. Support small and medium-sized enterprises within industrial clusters to compensate for individual enterprise resource and capability deficiencies through networked collaboration, integrate dispersed manufacturing capabilities through collaborative manufacturing platforms, and achieve technology, production capacity, order, and employee sharing.
titlelist: Action objective: Promote the digital development of industrial clusters.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote cooperation among small and medium-sized enterprises, digital service providers, and financial institutions, etc., to build a service system for enterprise credit monitoring, intelligent supply-demand matching, and big data risk control. Provide financial services such as credit assessment, credit loans, financing leasing, and pledge guarantees based on real-time production and operation data. Help enterprises obtain low-cost financing and enhance the financing capacity and efficiency of small and medium-sized enterprises. Create a public service platform to promote credit enhancement for small and medium-sized enterprise financing, apply next-generation information technology, provide online multi-party contract signing and evidence storage services, transmit credit value in the supply chain, and stimulate the vitality of small and medium-sized enterprise data assets.
titlelist: Action goal: Improve the service level of the integration platform between production and finance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support telecommunications operators to carry out special actions such as speeding up and benefiting enterprises, cloud-based benefits for enterprises, and enterprises going to the cloud, to enhance high-speed broadband network capabilities, strengthen basic network security, and further increase speed and reduce fees. Accelerate the promotion of 5G and industrial Internet applications, expand industrial Internet identification applications, and strengthen the construction of digital infrastructure such as network, computing, and security for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Action objectives, strengthen support for digital resource services such as networking, computing, and security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the implementation of the requirements of the Cybersecurity Law and other laws, regulations, and technical standards for small and medium-sized enterprises, and strengthen network and data security measures. Establish an industrial internet security public service platform to provide network and data security technical support services to a wide range of small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage security service providers to innovate security service models, enhance security service supply capabilities, and tailor 24/7, all-round, and three-dimensional security solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Action objective: Strengthening network and data security protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The competent departments of small and medium-sized enterprises in various regions should strengthen the overall coordination of the work of digital empowerment for small and medium-sized enterprises. The government, service agencies, and enterprises should work together to promote and implement special actions. Small and medium-sized enterprises should play a leading role, actively adapt to the new situation, promote self-transformation and digital empowerment, and enhance their ability to respond to risks and sustainable development. Mobilize the enthusiasm of digital service providers, leverage the role of small and medium-sized enterprise public service demonstration platforms and platform networks, help enterprises accurately prevent and control the epidemic, orderly resume work and production, and accelerate digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation.
titlelist: Promote measures, strengthen organizational support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Include the digital transformation and upgrading of small and medium-sized enterprises into the 'specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative' cultivation system for small and medium-sized enterprises and the construction of demonstration bases for small and micro enterprises' entrepreneurship and innovation, and provide key support. Following the approach of 'enterprises contribute, service providers assist, and the government supplements,' encourage localities to include the digitalization of small and medium-sized enterprises in the scope of key financial support, such as special funds for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises. For small and medium-sized enterprises that encounter temporary difficulties in liquidity but have good development prospects, financial institutions should give priority support in preferential interest rate loans for promoting resumption of work and production and transformational development through digital transformation and upgrading.
titlelist: Promote measures and improve incentive mechanisms.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a trustworthy service provider for digitalization of small and medium-sized enterprises, and establish an evaluation system for excellent digital products and services. Collect, cultivate, and promote a group of digital service providers and excellent digital products and services that have strong technical capabilities, good service effects, and are highly welcomed by small and medium-sized enterprises. Through online live streaming, video exhibitions, online connections, etc., achieve interactive display and transaction of digital products and services, guide enterprises to scientifically formulate deployment models, and allocate resources and services reasonably. Hold the 2020 Informationization Service Information Release Conference for small and medium-sized enterprises. Organize activities such as integration and innovation of large, medium, and small enterprises, and docking of digital products and solutions, and promotion of digital applications in the Innovation China campaign.
titlelist: Promote measures, organize supply and demand docking.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: The second-level data is only open to authorized institutions and relevant personnel who truly need to obtain this level of data. The third-level data is generally not shared, and if necessary, the scope of knowledge should be strictly controlled.
titlelist: Promote measures, hierarchical management, encourage enterprises to appropriately share first and second-level data on the premise of good data management, and fully unleash the potential value of industrial data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: When it involves three-level data, the event should be promptly reported to the provincial industrial and information technology authorities where the data is located. The situation of event handling should also be supplemented and reported within 30 days after the completion of emergency work.
titlelist: Promotion measures, hierarchical management. When industrial data is tampered with, damaged, leaked, or illegally utilized, enterprises should immediately carry out emergency disposal according to the pre-established emergency plan.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: With application-oriented approach, breakthrough key technologies of big data, promote the research and development and industrialization of products and solutions, innovate technology service models, and form a technologically advanced and ecologically complete technical product system. Accelerate the research and development of key technologies of big data. Focus on forward-looking layout in areas such as data science theory system, big data computing systems and analysis, and big data application models, strengthen basic research on big data. Play the role of enterprise innovation main body, integrate industry, academia, research, and application resources to jointly tackle key technologies of big data collection, transmission, storage, management, processing, analysis, application, visualization, and security. Breakthrough key technologies of big data basic technologies such as large-scale heterogeneous data fusion, cluster resource scheduling, distributed file systems, general-purpose computing framework technologies for multitasking, as well as computing engine technologies such as stream computing and graph computing. Support frontier technology innovations such as deep learning, brain-like computing, cognitive computing, blockchain, and virtual reality, enhance data analysis and processing capabilities and knowledge discovery. Combine with industry applications, develop intelligent data application technologies such as big data analysis, understanding, prediction, decision support, and knowledge services. Breakthrough new chip and integration architectures for big data computing, storage, sensing, communication, etc., such as new computing, storage, sensing, and communication chips and fusion architectures for big data, memory computing with billion-level concurrency, EB-level storage, green computing, etc., promote the coordinated development of software and hardware. Cultivate a secure and controllable big data product system. With application as the traction, emphasize independent research and development as well as introduction and absorption, accelerate the formation of a secure and controllable big data product system. Focus on breakthroughs in core information technology equipment for big data application infrastructure, information security products, as well as basic products such as new transaction-oriented relational databases, columnar databases, NoSQL databases, large-scale graph databases, and next-generation distributed computing platforms. Accelerate the development of next-generation business intelligence, data mining, data visualization, semantic search, and other software products. Combine with the demand for data lifecycle management, cultivate platform products such as big data collection and integration, big data analysis and mining, big data interactive perception, and data resource management based on semantic understanding. Develop technology products for big data retrieval, analysis, and display with industry characteristics, targeting key industry application needs, and form mature big data solutions and services in vertical fields. Innovate big data technology service models. Accelerate the innovation of big data service models, cultivate new models and new formats of data-as-a-service, enhance big data service capabilities, and reduce the threshold and cost of big data applications. Develop technical services such as data collection, cleaning, analysis, transaction, and security protection around the needs of the entire data lifecycle. Promote the integration of big data and cloud computing service models, promote the development of public cloud computing services such as massive data, large-scale distributed computing, and intelligent data analysis, and enhance the capabilities of third-party big data technology services. Promote the deep integration of big data technology services with industries and cultivate big data service models for vertical fields.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, strengthen the research and development of big data technology products.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the construction planning and layout of industrial big data infrastructure, promote the application of big data in the entire product life cycle and the entire industrial chain, promote the integration and development of industrial big data with automatic control and sensing hardware, industrial core software, industrial internet, industrial cloud, and intelligent service platforms, form a data-driven new model for industrial development, support the Made in China 2025 strategy, and explore the establishment of industrial big data centers. Accelerate the construction of industrial big data infrastructure. Accelerate the construction of low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage industrial internet for intelligent manufacturing units, smart factories, and IoT applications, and enhance the service capabilities of industrial network infrastructure. Accelerate the deployment and application of data collection devices such as industrial sensors, radio frequency identification (RFID), and optical communication devices, promote the construction of industrial IoT standard system, promote the upgrade and transformation of industrial control systems, gather multi-source data such as sensing, control, management, and operation, and enhance the networking, digitization, and intelligence level of products, equipment, and enterprises. Promote the full-process application of industrial big data. Support the construction of industrial big data platforms, promote the application of big data in various key industrial sectors, enhance the level of deep integration of informatization and industrialization, and promote industrial transformation and upgrading. Strengthen the application capability of R&D and design big data, use big data to accurately perceive user needs, promote innovation design based on data and knowledge, and improve R&D efficiency. Accelerate the application of production and manufacturing big data, optimize assembly line operations through big data monitoring, strengthen fault prediction and health management, optimize product quality, and reduce energy consumption. Improve the level of application of big data in business management, enhance the integration level of key business processes such as human resources, finance, production and manufacturing, and procurement, improve management efficiency and decision-making level, and achieve intelligent business activities. Promote the deep application of big data in customer service, promote innovative applications of big data in pre-sales, in-sales, and after-sales services. Promote the integration of data resources, connect data chains in various links, and form a full-process data closed loop. Cultivate data-driven manufacturing new models. Deepen the integration of manufacturing and the Internet, adhere to innovation-driven development, accelerate the deep integration and application of industrial big data with emerging technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and cyber-physical systems in the manufacturing industry, build a double innovation platform for manufacturing enterprise big data, and cultivate new technologies, new formats, and new models. Use big data to promote the participation of specialized, refined, unique, and new small and medium-sized enterprises in the industrial chain. Vigorously develop personalized customization based on big data, promote the development of customer-to-manufacturer (C2M) and other manufacturing models, and improve the intelligence and flexibility of the manufacturing process. Use big data to accelerate the development of manufacturing-as-a-service models and promote the transformation from production-oriented manufacturing to service-oriented manufacturing. Column 3: Industrial Big Data Innovation and Development Project. Strengthen the research and development and application of key technologies for industrial big data. Accelerate the application of key technologies such as big data acquisition, storage, analysis, mining, and application in the industrial field, focus on the research of programmable logic controllers, high-throughput computing engines, data acquisition and monitoring systems, develop new industrial big data analysis and modeling tools, and carry out the collection and promotion of excellent industrial big data products, services, and application cases. Build a public service platform for industrial big data, and enhance the application capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises in big data. Support the construction of industrial big data service platforms for typical industries and small and medium-sized enterprises, realize the sharing and exchange of industry data resources, and dynamically monitor, predict, and warn about products, markets, and economic operations, and enhance the service capabilities for small and medium-sized enterprises. Construction of key area big data platforms and application demonstrations. Support the development and application of industrial big data platforms for discrete manufacturing enterprises in aerospace equipment, marine engineering equipment, high-tech ships, advanced rail transportation equipment, energy-saving and new energy vehicles, as well as process manufacturing enterprise groups in petroleum, chemical, and power industries, integrate group data resources, and enhance the collaborative R&D capabilities and centralized control level of group enterprises. Explore innovative models for industrial big data. Support the construction of a number of industrial big data innovation centers, promote the exploration of new models and mechanisms for industrial big data innovation by enterprises, universities, and research institutes, promote breakthroughs in core technologies of industrial big data, establishment of industry standards, application demonstrations, promotion, and introduction of professional talent training, and promote the transformation of research results.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, deepening the innovative application of industrial big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the deep application of big data in key industries, promote the integration and innovation of big data across industries, enhance the application capability of big data in government governance and people's livelihood services, and promote the integration and development of big data in various industries. Promote the application of big data in key industries. Promote the application of big data in industries such as telecommunications, energy, finance, commerce, agriculture, food, cultural creativity, and public safety, promote the collection, integration, sharing, and utilization of industry data resources, fully unleash the transformative role of big data in industrial development, accelerate the transformation of traditional industry management methods, innovation in service and business models, and reconstruction of the industrial value chain system. Promote cross-industry integration and innovation of big data. Break through institutional barriers, bridge data silos, innovate cooperation models, and cultivate cross-integration new formats of big data applications. Support the leading fields with good information infrastructure such as telecommunications, the Internet, industry, finance, health, and transportation to carry out cross-domain and cross-industry big data applications, and cultivate new models of big data applications. Support the strengthening of technology and resource integration between big data-related companies and traditional industries, jointly explore diversified cooperation and operation models, and promote the integration and application of big data. Strengthen the application of big data in social governance and public services. Guided by the needs of the people, taking e-government and smart city construction as the starting point, and data concentration and sharing as the approach, promote the construction of a national integrated national big data center, promote technological integration, business integration, and data integration, and achieve cross-level, cross-regional, cross-system, cross-department, and cross-business collaborative management and services. Promote the application of big data in people's livelihood areas such as government affairs, transportation, education, health, social security, and employment, explore data governance models involving public participation, enhance social governance and urban management capabilities, and provide intelligent, accurate, efficient, and convenient public services to the masses. Promote the application of big data in the supervision and service of market entities, build key industry operation analysis service platforms based on big data, strengthen the monitoring of the economic operation of key industries and backbone enterprises, and improve the timeliness, accuracy, and foresight of industry operation supervision and service. Promote the integration of government data and enterprise data, and provide strong support for enterprise innovation and development and social governance.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects promote the development of big data applications in the industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Guide the development layout of the big data in the region, promote innovation and entrepreneurship based on big data, cultivate a group of leading enterprises and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, and form a multi-level, tiered innovation main body and a reasonable industrial layout to prosper the big data ecosystem. Utilize big data to boost innovation and entrepreneurship. Encourage resource-rich and technologically advanced leading big data companies to build big data platforms, open platform data, computing power, development environment, and other basic resources, and reduce the cost of innovation and entrepreneurship. Encourage large enterprises to rely on the Internet double innovation platform to provide innovation and entrepreneurship services based on big data. Organize algorithm competitions, application innovation competitions, crowdsourcing, and crowdfunding activities to stimulate innovation and entrepreneurship vitality. Support deep cooperation between big data companies and research institutions, bridge the gap between scientific and technological innovation and industrialization, and form a data-driven research and innovation model. Build a pattern of coordinated development among enterprises. Support leading enterprises in integrating and utilizing domestic and foreign resources such as technology, talent, and patents, accelerate the research and development of big data technology and product innovation, improve the international market share and brand influence of products and services, and form a group of internationally competitive comprehensive and specialized leading enterprises. Support small and medium-sized enterprises to deeply cultivate segmented markets, accelerate service model innovation and business model innovation, and improve the innovation capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage cooperation among enterprises in various links of the ecological chain, build a multi-party collaboration and mutually beneficial industrial ecology, and create a good situation of coordinated development among large, medium, and small enterprises. Optimize the regional layout of the big data industry. Guide local areas to combine their own conditions, highlight regional advantages, clarify key development directions, deepen the application of big data, position reasonably, plan scientifically, and form a scientific and orderly division of labor and regional layout. Build several national comprehensive pilot zones for big data across the country, carry out systematic exploration and experimentation in areas such as big data institutional innovation, public data opening and sharing, big data innovation application, big data industry agglomeration, data element circulation, data center integration, and international exchange and cooperation in big data, and accumulate experience for the development and application of big data nationwide. Build a group of big data industry agglomeration areas in regions with obvious advantages in the big data industry, create demonstration bases for the new industrialization of big data, give full play to the role of industrial agglomeration and synergy, lead the development of big data nationwide with focal points, and coordinate the cross-regional layout of big data. Utilize big data to promote information sharing, information consumption, resource docking, and complementary advantages, and promote coordinated economic and social development in the region.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, accelerate the cultivation of the main body of the big data industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the top-level design of big data standardization, gradually improve the standard system, and play an important supporting role of standardization in industrial development. Accelerate the development and promotion of key big data standards. Establish and continuously improve a big data standard system that covers infrastructure, data, technology, platforms/tools, management, security, and applications, in accordance with the needs of big data industry development. Accelerate the development of national standards for basic and key application areas. Select key industries, sectors, and regions to carry out standard trial verification and pilot demonstrations, and strengthen promotion and implementation. Establish a standard conformity assessment system, strengthen the support role of standards in market cultivation, service capability enhancement, and industry management. Strengthen the connection and coordination among various types of standards, including national standards, industry standards, and group standards. Actively participate in international standardization work for big data. Strengthen communication and cooperation between China's big data standardization organizations and relevant international organizations. Organize domestic academic, research, and industrial resources to accelerate the promotion of international standard proposals. Support relevant units to participate in international standardization work and undertake related positions, host international standardization activities, and expand international influence. Column 6: Key standard development and application demonstration projects for big data. Accelerate the development of key national standards. Focus on the major needs of big data standardization, carry out data resource classification, open sharing, transactions, identification, statistics, product evaluation, data capabilities, data security, and other basic general standards, as well as the development of key national standards in industrial big data and other key application areas. Establish a verification and testing platform. Establish a standard trial verification and conformity testing platform, focusing on data openness, sharing, product evaluation, data capability maturity, data quality, data security, and other key standards for trial verification and conformity testing. Carry out standard application demonstrations. Prioritize supporting the establishment of standard demonstration bases in comprehensive big data test zones and big data industry clusters, and carry out application demonstration work for key standards.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, promoting the construction of a big data standard system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Coordinate the layout of big data infrastructure, build innovative service platforms for the development of the big data industry, establish a statistical and development evaluation system for big data, and create a favorable environment for industrial development. Reasonably plan the construction of big data infrastructure. Guide local governments and relevant enterprises to coordinate the construction of data centers, fully utilize existing government and social data center resources, integrate and transform small-scale, inefficient, and energy-consuming decentralized data centers to avoid waste of resources and space. Encourage the widespread use of renewable energy and waste equipment recycling in the construction of big data infrastructure, and guide the development of a green, intensive, well-planned, moderately scaled, and high-speed interconnected big data infrastructure system. Accelerate the construction and upgrade of network infrastructure. Optimize network structure and improve the quality of interconnection. Build public service platforms for the development of the big data industry. Make full use of and integrate existing innovation resources to form a batch of big data testing, certification, and public service platforms. Support the establishment of public technology innovation platforms such as big data-related open-source communities, encourage developers, enterprises, and research institutions to actively participate in big data open-source projects, enhance their influence in the open-source community, and improve innovation capabilities. Establish a development evaluation system for big data. Research and establish a development evaluation system for the big data industry, monitor, analyze, and evaluate the construction status, openness and sharing level, industrial development capabilities, and application levels of big data resources in China and various regions, compile and release the big data industry development index, and guide and evaluate the national big data development. Column 7: Construction of the big data public service system. Establish a public service platform for the big data industry, provide services such as policy consultation, generic technical support, intellectual property rights, investment and financing docking, brand promotion, talent training, and entrepreneurship incubation, and promote the rapid growth of big data enterprises. Support third-party organizations in establishing testing and certification platforms, and provide services such as testing, evaluation, and certification of big data usability, reliability, security, and scale quality. Establish a big data open-source community, incubate and cultivate local big data open-source communities and projects with independent innovative technologies, and build a big data industry ecosystem.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, improving the support system for the big data industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: In response to the new situation of network information security, we will strengthen the research and development of big data security technology products, utilize big data to improve security management mechanisms, and build a strong big data security guarantee system. We will focus on the research and development of unified account, authentication, authorization, and auditing systems, as well as big data encryption and classification management systems in the big data environment. We will break through key technologies such as differential privacy, multi-party secure computation, data flow monitoring, and traceability. We will promote big data protection technologies such as leakage prevention, anti-theft, and anonymization, and develop big data security protection products and solutions. We will strengthen the research and industrialization of big data security support technologies, such as cloud platform virtual machine security technology, virtualization network security technology, cloud security auditing technology, and cloud platform security unified management technology. We will also strengthen the discovery and reinforcement of vulnerabilities in cloud computing and big data basic software systems. We will enhance the support capabilities of big data for network information security. By comprehensively using multi-source data, we will strengthen big data mining and analysis, and enhance the ability to perceive, warn, and respond to network information security risks. We will strengthen the research and development of new information security products based on big data, promote the application of big data technology in the security protection of critical information infrastructure, and ensure the security of important information systems in finance, energy, power, communication, transportation, and other fields. We will establish a big data platform for network information security situation awareness and a national industrial control system security monitoring and early warning platform, promote the collection and sharing of network information security threat data, and establish a unified, efficient, collaborative, and interconnected network security risk reporting, intelligence sharing, and judgment and disposal system. Fifth, security measures.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, enhancing the capability of big data security protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a talent cultivation and evaluation mechanism that adapts to the development needs of big data. Strengthen the cultivation of big data talents, integrate resources from universities, enterprises, and society, promote the establishment of innovative talent cultivation models, and establish a sound multi-level and multi-type big data talent cultivation system. Encourage universities to explore the establishment of mechanisms for cultivating professional talents and interdisciplinary talents in the field of big data. Support universities and enterprises in establishing internship training mechanisms, and enhance the vocational practical skills of big data talents. Encourage enterprises to provide training in big data skills for employees, actively cultivate talents in big data technology and application innovation. Relying on social education resources, carry out popularization of big data knowledge and education and training, and improve the overall social awareness and application level. Encourage industry organizations to explore the establishment of a big data talent competency evaluation system. Improve supporting measures, cultivate innovative leading talents in the field of big data, and attract high-level overseas talents in big data to come to China for employment and entrepreneurship.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, building a multi-level talent team.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: According to the overall requirements of building a strong cyber nation and in conjunction with major national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, accelerate the development of international markets, export advantageous technologies and services, and form a group of big data enterprises and products with international competitiveness. Make full use of international cooperation and exchange mechanisms and platforms to strengthen communication and cooperation in key technologies research, product development, data openness and sharing, standardization, talent cultivation, and other aspects of big data. Adhere to the principle of cyber sovereignty, actively participate in the construction of international rules systems for data security and cross-border data flow, promote open cooperation, and build a sound order.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, promoting international development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Vigorously develop public cloud computing services, implement cloud computing projects, and support information technology companies in accelerating their transformation into cloud computing product and service providers. Vigorously develop computing and storage resource leasing and application software development and deployment platform services, as well as online application services for enterprise management, research and development, and design, to reduce the threshold and innovation cost of enterprise informatization, and support the development and entrepreneurial activities of small and medium-sized enterprises. Actively develop cloud-based personal information storage, online tools, learning, entertainment, and other services to cultivate information consumption. Develop secure and trustworthy cloud computing outsourcing services and promote government business outsourcing. Support the integration, development, and innovative application of cloud computing with technologies and services such as the Internet of Things, mobile internet, internet finance, and e-commerce, and actively cultivate new formats and models. Encourage large enterprises to open platform resources and create a collaborative and win-win cloud computing service ecosystem. Guide the orderly development of private clouds, encourage enterprises to innovate their information construction ideas, based on fully utilizing public cloud computing service resources, rely on their own needs, use secure and reliable private cloud solutions, integrate information resources, optimize business processes, and improve management levels. Vigorously develop services such as information system planning consulting, solution design, system integration, and testing and evaluation for cloud computing.
titlelist: 'Cloud computing, enhancing cloud computing service capabilities'

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the close connection and overall coordination of basic research, application research, technology development, market cultivation, and industrial policy related to cloud computing. Play the role of enterprises as the main force of innovation, drive technological innovation through service innovation, enhance original innovation capabilities, focus on breakthroughs in key technologies such as large-scale resource management and scheduling of cloud computing platforms, operation monitoring and security assurance, exabyte-level data storage and processing, and big data mining and analysis, and improve the research and development and industrialization level of related software and hardware products. Strengthen the integration of core electronic devices, high-end general-purpose chips, and basic software products with the needs of the cloud computing industry, actively promote the application of secure and reliable cloud computing products and solutions in various fields. Fully integrate and utilize domestic and foreign innovation resources, strengthen the construction of cloud computing-related technology research laboratories, engineering centers, and enterprise technology centers. Establish industrial innovation alliances, give play to the leading role of backbone enterprises, cultivate a group of innovative small and medium-sized enterprises with distinctive characteristics, and improve the industrial ecosystem. Improve the public support system for cloud computing, strengthen the protection and utilization of intellectual property rights, standard development, and related evaluation and assessment work, and promote collaborative innovation.
titlelist: 'Cloud computing, enhancing the independent innovation capability of cloud computing.'

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the application of cloud computing technology to integrate and transform existing electronic government information systems, achieve overall deployment and co-construction of government information systems in various fields, and significantly reduce the number of government-owned data centers. The construction of new electronic government systems must undergo strict demonstration and approval procedures. Government departments should increase their efforts to procure cloud computing services, actively carry out pilot demonstrations, explore new mechanisms for the operation of government informationization based on cloud computing, promote the sharing of government information resources and business collaboration, promote streamlining administration and delegating power, strengthen mid-term and post-event supervision, create greater market space for cloud computing, and drive the rapid development of the cloud computing industry.
titlelist: Cloud computing, exploring new models for the development of e-government cloud computing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the aggregation role of cloud computing in data resources, achieve the integration and sharing of data resources, and promote big data mining, analysis, application, and services. Carry out pilot reforms for the open use of public data, issue regulations on the management of government agency data openness, actively explore the opening of geographic, population, intellectual property, and other relevant management agency data resources to society, promote data sharing among government departments, and enhance social management and public service capabilities. Focus on areas such as public safety, disease prevention and control, disaster prevention, employment and social security, transportation and logistics, education and scientific research, e-commerce, etc., carry out cloud computing-based big data application demonstrations, and support government agencies and enterprises in innovating big data service models. Give full play to the service support role of cloud computing and big data in the construction of smart cities, strengthen promotion and application, tap into market potential, and serve the economic and social development of cities.
titlelist: Cloud computing, strengthening big data development and utilization.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Revise the classification catalog of telecommunications services, improve the market access system for cloud computing services, and support eligible cloud computing service enterprises in applying for relevant business qualifications. Research and support network policies for large-scale cloud computing services. Support third-party organizations in conducting evaluations and assessments of cloud computing service quality, reliability, and network security. Guide cloud computing service enterprises to strengthen internal management, improve service quality and integrity, and gradually establish a cloud computing trust system. Strengthen the supervision and technical support for interconnection of the Internet backbone network, adjust settlement policies for interconnection between networks, and ensure efficient and smooth interconnection between networks. Support cloud computing data centers that meet layout principles and energy consumption standards to participate in direct power supply pilot projects, meet the conditions for large-scale industrial electricity consumption, and provide guarantees in terms of network and municipal supporting facilities, as well as priority land allocation. Guide state-owned enterprises to use cloud computing technology to improve management levels, and promote the application of secure and reliable cloud computing products and solutions.
titlelist: Cloud computing, improving the market environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the research, development, and application of common and key technologies for digital transformation. Support the exploration and integrated innovation of new generation digital technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, digital twins, 5G, Internet of Things, and blockchain in industries and enterprises that have the necessary conditions. Increase support for common development platforms, open source communities, common solution schemes, and basic software and hardware support. Encourage the open-source development of relevant codes, standards, and platforms.
titlelist: The main direction is to build a foundation and solidify the technological support for digital transformation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Cultivate enterprise technology centers, industrial innovation centers, and innovation service complexes. Accelerate the improvement of digital infrastructure, promote the opening of enterprise-level digital infrastructure, promote the application of industrial data middle platform, and share middle platform business resources with small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the opening of core resources of enterprises. Support platforms in providing basic business services for free, and appropriately charge rent based on the effectiveness of value-added services to compensate for the investment in basic business. Encourage companies with core technologies to open source code, hardware design, and application services. Guide platform companies and industry leaders to integrate and open up resources, encourage the construction of digital technology and solution communities based on regions, industries, and parks, build industrial Internet platforms, and empower small and medium-sized enterprises with digital transformation.
titlelist: Main direction, building a platform, constructing a multi-level interconnected industrial internet platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Deepen digital transformation services, promote the separation of light and heavy assets based on cloud services cooperation. Encourage platform enterprises to carry out digital transformation of core business processes such as research and development design, operation management, production processing, and logistics after-sales. Encourage internet platform enterprises to provide intelligent data analysis services to small and micro enterprises based on their own advantages. Promote the digital transformation of small and micro enterprises, encourage platform enterprises to innovate lightweight applications and microservices, provide low-cost, low-threshold, and fast deployment services to small and micro enterprises, and accelerate the cultivation of a group of leading enterprises and hidden champions in segmented fields. Cultivate key industry application scenarios, accelerate the development of networked manufacturing, personalized customization, service-oriented production, promote applications such as digital villages, digital farms, smart homes, and intelligent logistics, and create an upgraded version of Internet Plus.
titlelist: Main direction, promote transformation, accelerate enterprises' cloud computing and data intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the digitization of supply chain elements and the supply chainization of data elements, supporting the development of a digital industrial chain of research and development + production + supply chain and the creation of an ecosystem with a digital supply chain. Encourage traditional enterprises to engage in joint innovation with internet platform enterprises, industry-specific platform enterprises, financial institutions, etc., sharing resources such as technology, general assets, data, talent, markets, channels, facilities, and platforms, and explore the cultivation of service-oriented economies in traditional industries. Accelerate the organic integration of digital transformation, business process reshaping, organizational structure optimization, and business model transformation, and build a digital ecosystem that combines production services + business models + financial services across boundaries.
titlelist: The main direction is to build an ecological system and establish a digitally integrated cross-border ecosystem.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Vigorously develop the sharing economy, digital trade, gig economy, support new retail, online consumption, contactless delivery, internet healthcare, online education, one-stop travel, shared employees, remote work, and the 'stay-at-home economy' and other new business formats, smooth policy obstacles and difficulties. Guide cloud services to expand into the production and manufacturing sectors and small and micro enterprises. Encourage the development of flexible employment models such as shared employees, fully leveraging the reservoir effect of the digital economy.
titlelist: Main direction, developing new business models, expanding new space for economic development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage various platforms, open source communities, and third-party organizations to provide development tools and public services needed for digital transformation to small and medium-sized enterprises. Support the construction of digital transformation service consulting agencies and regional digital service carriers, enrich the digital service functions of various parks and characteristic towns. Innovate financial products and services such as order financing, supply chain finance, and credit guarantees. Expand multi-level talent and professional skills training services for digital transformation. Encourage platforms to provide free or discounted services to small and medium-sized enterprises and flexible workers through government procurement services, special subsidies, and other means.
titlelist: Main direction, strong service, and increased support for digital transformation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The room is reported to the National Internet Information Office for approval according to the procedure. The results of the cloud computing service security assessment will be released by the office.
titlelist: Recent work initiatives, other factors that may affect cloud service security, and the recommendations of the cloud computing service security assessment expert group have been reviewed and approved through the coordination mechanism.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: 'Expiration of validity requires extension and maintenance. In the event of an evaluation result, cloud service providers should apply for re-evaluation to the office at least 6 months before the expiration. If there are changes in the controlling shareholder or controlling rights due to equity changes or corporate restructuring during the validity period, cloud service providers should reapply for security assessment.'
titlelist: Recent work measures, other factors that may affect cloud service security, the validity period of cloud computing service security assessment results is 3 years.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In the evaluation process, if one refuses to provide materials as required or intentionally provides false materials, their evaluation will not pass.
titlelist: Recent work measures, other factors that may affect cloud service security, cloud service providers are responsible for the authenticity of the materials provided for declaration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Cloud computing is a concentrated embodiment of the development of information technology and the innovation of service models. It is a major transformation and inevitable trend in the development of informatization. Supporting enterprises to migrate to the cloud is beneficial for accelerating the digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation of enterprises, improving their innovation capability, business strength, and development level.
