It is also beneficial for accelerating the development of the software and information technology service industry, deepening the supply-side structural reform, promoting the deep integration of the Internet, big data, artificial intelligence, and the real economy, and accelerating the construction of a modern economic system.
titlelist: Recent work measures, other factors that may affect cloud service security, without the consent of the cloud service provider, the relevant institutions and personnel participating in the assessment work shall not disclose the undisclosed materials submitted by the cloud service provider and other non-public information obtained during the assessment work, and shall not use the information provided by the cloud service provider for purposes other than assessment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: By combining enterprise operations with information technology applications, we can achieve information system upgrades, promote business innovation, process restructuring, and management changes, accelerate enterprise digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation, and effectively improve enterprise management capabilities and overall competitiveness.
titlelist: In recent work initiatives, enterprises should take improving their development capabilities and solving practical business problems as the starting point for cloud adoption.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: One, the use of information systems has obvious peak and off-peak periods, requiring dynamic allocation of resources and elastic expansion. Two, information systems need to be quickly iterated and launched to enhance business innovation speed. Three, information systems need to reduce operating and maintenance costs, improve emergency response, fault recovery, and information security capabilities. Four, information systems need to utilize cloud services such as big data and artificial intelligence to achieve business expansion.
titlelist: In recent work initiatives, companies can prioritize the migration of information systems to the cloud that align with business characteristics and demonstrate clear value and benefits of cloud computing.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: One is the computing resource service. By using various elastic computing services on the cloud platform, it achieves centralized management, dynamic allocation, elastic expansion, and reduces the burden of operation and maintenance for computing resources. The second is the storage resource service. By using cloud storage services such as block storage and object storage on the cloud platform, it improves the economy, security, and reliability of data storage. The third is the network resource service. By using network services such as virtual private cloud, virtual private network, and load balancing on the cloud platform, it efficiently and securely utilizes cloud platform network resources. The fourth is the security protection service. By using security services such as cloud host security protection, network attack protection, application firewall, key/certificate management, and data encryption protection on the cloud, it enhances information security capabilities.
titlelist: Choose cloud services on demand and reasonably, infrastructure-based cloud services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: One is database services. Utilizing cloud database systems to achieve cross-platform and cross-business collaborative management of various types of data. Two is big data analysis services. Utilizing cloud-based big data platforms to promote data resource aggregation, including data collection, storage, analysis, mining, and collaborative applications. Three is middleware platform services. Utilizing cloud-based middleware services to build distributed system architectures to meet the needs of the Internet+ transformation. Four is Internet of Things (IoT) platform services. Connecting massive IoT terminal devices to the cloud platform to achieve efficient and visualized online device management. Five is software development platform services. Through cloud-based development platforms, software lifecycle management is conducted to quickly build development, testing, and runtime environments, standardize development processes, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. Six is artificial intelligence platform services. Utilizing the computing resources of the cloud platform to develop intelligent services such as speech recognition, image recognition, and facial recognition, thereby enhancing business intelligence levels.
titlelist: Choose cloud services and platform system services according to demand and reason.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: One is collaborative office services. By using cloud services such as email, meetings, and communication, a low-cost and efficient office system is formed to improve office efficiency. Two is business management application services. By using cloud services for enterprise human resources management, administrative management, financial management, etc., the scientificity and efficiency of enterprise management are improved. Three is operation management services. By using cloud services for procurement management, production management, sales management, supply chain management, customer resource management, etc., the level of enterprise operation management is enhanced. Four is research and development design services. By using cloud services such as computer-aided design, product development, etc., the development and design environment is deployed in the cloud to improve research and development efficiency and innovation level. Five is production control services. By moving MES (Manufacturing Execution System), production data, and other systems to the cloud, the production control process is optimized to enhance production efficiency and level. Six is intelligent application services. By integrating enterprise-wide data, intelligent applications such as intelligent research and development, intelligent production, intelligent marketing, and intelligent services are created to enhance the level of enterprise intelligence.
titlelist: Choose cloud services and business application services according to demand and reason.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: (1) Can moving to the cloud enhance the development capabilities of the enterprise and solve practical business problems? (2) Is the information system suitable for elastic expansion? Does it require rapid deployment? Are the cloud platform and application services compatible with the existing information system? If not compatible, the cost and risks of migration and transformation need to be evaluated. (3) Evaluate whether the data storage method and data security meet the requirements. (4) Evaluate whether the cloud migration method (online/offline, etc.) meets the business requirements. Is the cloud migration time within an acceptable range of business interruption? Can it meet the experience requirements of different types of users after moving to the cloud? (5) Evaluate the switching plan, parallel operation plan, and failure rollback plan for the existing system and the system after moving to the cloud. Evaluate the potential risks during system transformation, data migration, and application migration, and provide corresponding suggestions.
titlelist: Steadily and orderly promote enterprise cloud adoption. Enterprises can combine their own business development plans and, with the support of third-party institutions or cloud platform service providers, comprehensively sort out information system business types, user profiles, usage characteristics, performance indicators, database usage, system interrelationships, and more.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: (1) Promote the cloudification of development and testing environments, build simulated environments, including migrating source and target environments. (2) Implement simulated cloudification, conduct functional testing, performance testing, backup testing, and disaster recovery testing, and modify and improve the cloudification plan based on this. (3) Prepare resources including personnel, environments, implementation tools, etc., according to the cloudification plan, implement the cloudification process, carry out data migration and application migration, and implement rollback plans in case of failure.
titlelist: Steadily and orderly promote enterprises to migrate to the cloud. Enterprises can, with the support of cloud platform service providers or third-party institutions, build a simulated environment according to the cloud migration plan, conduct cloud migration drills, continuously optimize and improve the cloud migration plan, and execute the cloud migration process.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Deepen the evaluation of cloud service capabilities and the assessment of service reliability, promote the improvement of cloud computing enterprise service levels and service quality. Actively explore the use of insurance models to provide protection for cloud-based enterprises.
titlelist: Strengthen policy guarantees, support industrial and information technology authorities in various regions to establish and improve public service platforms, and provide various services such as information system planning consultation, program design, supervision, and training for enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support various types of enterprises and entrepreneurs to utilize cloud computing platforms as a foundation, and actively cultivate new formats and models such as platform economy and sharing economy by leveraging new technologies such as big data, Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, and blockchain.
titlelist: Strengthen policy guarantees and encourage all regions to accelerate the promotion of cloud-based innovation and entrepreneurship.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Continuously enhance key core technical capabilities. Support leading large-scale professional cloud computing enterprises in establishing manufacturing innovation centers in the field of cloud computing, in collaboration with research institutes and higher education institutions. Organize and implement a batch of key industrial innovation projects to grasp the high ground of cloud computing development. Actively develop new virtualization technologies such as containers, microkernels, and hyper-convergence, and improve the processing capacity, efficiency, and user resource isolation level of virtual machine live migration. Continuously enhance the management efficiency and energy efficiency management level of large-scale distributed storage and computing resources to meet the needs of large-scale data processing, in-memory computing, scientific computing, and other applications. Support enterprises, research institutions, and industry organizations to participate in mainstream open-source communities, utilize open-source community technologies and developer resources, and improve cloud computing software technology and system service capabilities. Guide enterprises to strengthen the core patent layout in the field of cloud computing, conduct analysis and risk assessment of cloud computing intellectual property rights, publish analysis and early warning research results, and guide enterprises to strengthen intellectual property rights layout. Carry out intellectual property-related laws and regulations publicity and training to improve enterprise intellectual property awareness and management level. Accelerate the improvement of the cloud computing standard system. Implement the Guidelines for the Construction of Comprehensive Standardization System for Cloud Computing and promote the improvement of the standard system framework. Guide standardization organizations to expedite the development of key urgently needed technologies, services, and application standards such as cloud computing resource monitoring, service metering and billing, application and data migration, industrial cloud service capabilities, and cloud computing server technical requirements. Actively carry out the promotion, implementation, and application demonstration of standards, and test and improve standards in practice. Explore innovative forms of standardization work, actively cultivate and develop group standards, and guide and support standard organizations, industry alliances, core enterprises, and other entities in formulating and publishing high-quality cloud computing standard achievements. Support backbone enterprises and industry associations in substantial participation in the formulation of international standards for cloud computing technology, management, services, and other aspects. Conduct in-depth cloud service capability evaluations. Relying on third-party testing organizations and backbone enterprises, based on relevant national, industry, and group standards, and guided by user needs, establish a sound evaluation index system and workflow for personnel, technology, processes, resources, and other key aspects of cloud computing services. Carry out cloud computing service capability and reliability evaluations, guide cloud computing enterprises to improve service levels, ensure service quality, and enhance security capabilities. Actively promote mutual recognition of results with international mainstream evaluation systems.
titlelist: Overall thinking and development goals, action to enhance technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support software companies in transitioning to cloud computing. Support local regulatory authorities in collaboration with backbone cloud computing enterprises to establish a public service platform for cloud computing development and testing, providing consulting, training, research and development, and business services. Support software and information technology service companies in developing products, services, and solutions based on the development and testing platform, accelerating the transition to cloud computing, enriching and improving enterprise-level SaaS services such as office, production management, financial management, marketing management, and human resources management, developing cloud services for personal information storage, home life, learning, and entertainment, and cultivating new hotspots in information consumption. Accelerate the cultivation of backbone leading enterprises. Increase support in terms of funding, credit, talent, and other aspects to meet the innovative development needs of key industries, accelerate the cultivation of cloud computing enterprises and cloud computing platforms with certain technical strength, business scale, outstanding innovation capabilities, good market prospects, and strong influence. Support backbone leading enterprises in diversifying service types, improving service capabilities, innovating business models, building an ecological system, and promoting the formation of an industrial echelon in the field of cloud computing, continuously enhancing China's systematic development strength in the field of cloud computing. Promote the construction of an industrial ecological system. Build a number of new industrial demonstration bases in the field of cloud computing and improve the construction of industrial carriers. Relying on industry organizations such as industry alliances, fully leverage the driving role and technology spillover effects of backbone cloud computing enterprises, accelerate the research and industrialization of key cloud computing equipment, and guide enterprises in the fields of chips, basic software, servers, storage, networks, etc., to achieve technological and product breakthroughs in software-defined networks, new architecture computing devices, hyper-converged devices, green data centers, modular data centers, storage devices, information security products, etc., driving the development of the information industry and strengthening industrial support capabilities. Vigorously develop information system planning consulting, solution design, system integration, and testing and evaluation services for cloud computing.
titlelist: Overall thinking and development goals, industrial development actions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Actively develop industrial cloud services. Implement the Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet and promote the pilot demonstration of industrial cloud applications. Support leading manufacturing companies and cloud computing companies to jointly build industrial cloud platforms in specialized areas of manufacturing, gathering resources such as tool libraries, model libraries, and knowledge libraries, and providing cloud services such as industrial-specific software, industrial data analysis, online virtual simulation, and collaborative research and development design. Promote manufacturing companies to accelerate business model and commercial model innovation based on cloud computing, develop collaborative innovation, personalized customization, and other business forms, cultivate the cloud manufacturing model, enhance the agility, serviceability, and intelligence of the manufacturing industry, and promote the transformation, upgrading, and improvement of the manufacturing industry. Support key industry associations, professional institutions, and backbone cloud computing companies in the steel, automobile, light industry, and other manufacturing sectors to cooperate in building industry cloud platforms, promote the migration of various information systems to cloud platforms, enrich professional cloud service content, promote the application of cloud computing in segmented industries of the manufacturing industry, and improve the level of industry development and management. Collaboratively promote government cloud applications. Promote cloud computing-based government informatization construction models, encourage local government departments to increase the use of cloud computing services, apply cloud computing to integrate and transform existing e-government information systems, and improve government operational efficiency. Actively develop secure and reliable cloud computing solutions, explore the use of cloud computing system architecture and models to compensate for the insufficient performance of software and hardware products in the construction of important information systems and critical infrastructure, and promote the large-scale application of secure and reliable software and hardware products. Support cloud computing-based innovation and entrepreneurship. Promote the double innovation of large enterprises, encourage and support the development of entrepreneurship and innovation platforms using cloud computing, promote the aggregation of online and offline resources through the establishment of open platforms, establishment of venture capital funds, and provision of entrepreneurial guidance, and drive collaborative innovation among small and medium-sized enterprises. Support small and medium-sized enterprises and individual developers to develop and industrialize new technologies and businesses such as big data, the Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, and blockchain based on cloud computing platforms through events such as maker competitions, and cultivate emerging formats such as platform economy and sharing economy based on cloud computing, further expanding the scope of cloud computing applications.
titlelist: The overall thinking and development goals, promote application and drive progress.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the upgrade of network infrastructure. Implement the Broadband China strategy and its implementation plan, guide basic telecommunications and internet companies to accelerate network upgrade and transformation, guide the construction of a batch of all-optical network provinces and cities, promote the fiber-optic broadband access process, implement co-construction and sharing, and further enhance the capacity of fiber-optic broadband networks. Promote the construction of internet backbone networks, expand the bandwidth of backbone direct connection points, and continuously optimize the network structure. Improve regulatory measures for the cloud computing market. Further clarify the regulatory requirements for cloud computing-related businesses, and carry out approval and post-approval supervision of internet data centers (IDCs), internet resource collaboration services, and other related business operations in accordance with the law. Speed up the introduction of management requirements for regulating the operation of the cloud service market, standardize the market order, and promote the healthy and orderly development of the cloud service market. Implement the guidance on data center layout. Further promote the implementation of the Guidance on Data Center Construction Layout, enhance capacity on the supply side, establish high-level benchmarks through demonstrations, guide benchmarking and improve data center utilization and construction application levels; on the demand side, guide docking, classify domestic data centers according to capacity, service coverage areas, suitable business types, etc. through the development of guidelines, guide users to reasonably choose and use data center resources according to their needs, and promote cross-regional resource sharing. Fourth, guarantee measures.
titlelist: Overall thinking and development goals, environmental optimization actions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote policy banks, industrial investment institutions, and guarantee institutions to increase support for cloud computing enterprises, launch targeted products and services, increase credit support, simplify procedures and formalities, and support the development of cloud computing enterprises. Learn from the first insurance model and explore the use of insurance to accelerate the migration of important information systems to cloud computing platforms. Support cloud computing enterprises in accessing capital market financing, conducting mergers and acquisitions, expanding markets, and accelerating their growth.
titlelist: Overall thinking and development goals, optimizing investment and financing environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support the innovative development of industry organizations such as the Cloud Computing Industry Alliance, organize activities for technological innovation, showcase experiences, and promote applications in the field of cloud computing. Build a well-known domestic and international platform for industrial development. Increase the promotion and recognition of excellent cloud computing enterprises, products, services, platforms, and application cases, and enhance the visibility of China's cloud computing brand. Strengthen the promotion of exemplary cloud computing industry demonstration bases and industry organizations, and stimulate enthusiasm from all sectors to promote the development of cloud computing.
titlelist: Overall thinking and development goals, strengthen the building of industrial brands.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Utilize international cooperation mechanisms such as Sino-German, Sino-European, Sino-Japanese-Korean, etc., to accelerate the establishment and improvement of international cooperation and communication platforms in the field of cloud computing. Combine with the implementation of national strategies such as the Belt and Road initiative to gradually establish an overseas market service system oriented towards specialization and marketization. Support leading cloud computing enterprises in expanding overseas by establishing overseas research and development centers, sales networks, broadening overseas market channels, conducting cross-border mergers and acquisitions, and enhancing international market expansion capabilities.
titlelist: Overall thinking and development goals, promoting international exchange and cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the outsourcing of information technology, business processes, and knowledge processes in sync, focusing on the development of high-tech, high-value-added service outsourcing businesses, and promoting the extension of the industrial value chain to the high-end. Regularly release the Guiding Catalog for Key Development Areas of the Service Outsourcing Industry to strengthen guidance for the development of the service outsourcing industry. Actively expand the service outsourcing industry in areas such as software and information technology, design, research and development, the internet, healthcare, industry, and energy. Accelerate the development of service outsourcing in fields such as cultural creativity, education, transportation logistics, healthcare, technology services, wholesale and retail, and leisure and entertainment. Actively develop financial service outsourcing, encouraging financial institutions to outsource non-core businesses.
titlelist: Cultivate new competitive advantages, clarify the direction of industrial development.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support all types of ownership enterprises to engage in service outsourcing business, encourage the professionalization, scale, and branding development of service outsourcing enterprises. Promote the improvement of research and development innovation level of service outsourcing enterprises, guide and support enterprises to carry out research and development of integrated design, comprehensive solutions, and related technology projects through national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.). Encourage service outsourcing enterprises to strengthen business model and management model innovation, actively develop long-term contract-based service outsourcing business. Cultivate a group of leading service outsourcing enterprises with strong innovation capabilities, high level of integrated services, and international competitiveness. Support a group of small and medium-sized service outsourcing enterprises that are specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative. Encourage enterprises, especially industrial enterprises, to break the integrated pattern of large and comprehensive or small and comprehensive and purchase professional services for non-core businesses. Guide service outsourcing enterprises to optimize the allocation of resources such as funds, technology, and talents through mergers and reorganizations, and achieve complementary advantages. Government departments should continuously expand the scope of purchasing services and entrust outsourced businesses to professional service enterprises.
titlelist: Cultivate new competitive advantages, cultivate and strengthen market entities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enhance the quality of bilateral economic and trade cooperation, orderly promote practical cooperation in the service outsourcing industry within the existing framework, and create an international environment conducive to common development. Increase support for service outsourcing companies to participate in international exhibitions, project negotiations, and other activities. Combine the implementation of the 'going global' strategy and foreign aid, comprehensively utilize various measures such as trade, export credit, foreign investment cooperation, and foreign aid to support eligible service outsourcing companies to 'go global' and engage in high value-added project cooperation such as research and development outsourcing, knowledge process outsourcing, and business process outsourcing. Encourage enterprises and institutions to purchase high-tech and innovative high-end services in the international market, introduce advanced technology, advanced business models, and management experience, and accelerate the transformation and upgrading of the domestic service outsourcing industry.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures, deepen international exchanges and cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the existing fiscal fund policies, optimize fund allocation and utilization, enhance support methods, increase support for international service outsourcing businesses, encourage the development of international service outsourcing research and development, talent training, qualification certification, public services, etc. Fully leverage the guiding role of fiscal funds, guide social funds to increase investment in enterprises undertaking international service outsourcing businesses through market-oriented support methods such as establishing an international service outsourcing industry guidance fund, and promote the expansion of service exports.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures and increase financial support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Expand the scope of the tax preferential policy for technology advanced service enterprises to pay corporate income tax at a reduced rate of 15% and deduct employee education expenses not exceeding 8% of the total wages and salaries before tax. Taking into account the layout of service outsourcing industry agglomeration zones, the number of Chinese service outsourcing demonstration cities will increase from 21 to 31 in an orderly manner, considering the cities in the eastern, central, and western regions. Implement zero tax rate and tax exemption policies for value-added tax in international service outsourcing.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures, improve tax policies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Broaden the investment and financing channels for service outsourcing enterprises. Encourage financial institutions to innovate financial products and services that comply with regulatory policies and adapt to the characteristics of the service outsourcing industry, based on the principles of risk control and commercial sustainability. Promote the pledging of accounts receivable, patents, copyrights, and other intellectual property rights. Support policy-based financial institutions in lawfully and compliantly innovating and developing under the guidance of relevant departments and regulatory agencies, and increase support for service outsourcing enterprises in expanding international markets, conducting overseas mergers and acquisitions, and strengthening key project construction in the service outsourcing sector. Encourage insurance institutions to innovate insurance products, improve insurance services, expand the scale and coverage of export credit insurance, and enhance underwriting and claims efficiency. Utilize existing financial policies to guide financing guarantee institutions in strengthening financing guarantee services for small and medium-sized enterprises in the service outsourcing industry. Support eligible service outsourcing enterprises to access financing through the SME board, the Growth Enterprise Market, and the SME share transfer system. Support eligible service outsourcing enterprises to expand financing through the issuance of corporate bonds, company bonds, non-financial corporate debt financing instruments, and other means, in order to achieve diversified financing channels.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures, enhance financial services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Deepen the reform of the overseas investment approval system, promote the facilitation of overseas investment, implement a management approach focused on filing, minimize the scope of approval, and simplify approval procedures. Further enhance the level of facilitation in customs clearance, innovate the customs supervision mode for service outsourcing. Innovate the inspection and quarantine supervision mode for service outsourcing, simplify the approval procedures for prototypes, samples, reagents, and other items required for international service outsourcing business, implement classified management, and provide facilitation in customs clearance. Accelerate the implementation of measures to facilitate foreign exchange management, eligible service outsourcing enterprises can apply to participate in the pilot reform of foreign exchange management for overseas investment in service outsourcing, and timely study and promote based on the pilot situation. Encourage the use of RMB settlement in cross-border trade and investment. Provide convenient entry and residence for foreign high-end management and technical personnel engaged in international service outsourcing business. Improve the level of international communication services, support basic telecommunications operators in providing convenience for network access and international line leasing for service outsourcing enterprises.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures and enhance the level of convenience.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research and improve the legal system of the service outsourcing industry, promote industry development and regulate business practices. Effectively safeguard national security, and hold legally responsible those who intentionally or negligently disclose state secrets or harm national security. Increase law enforcement and supervision of intellectual property rights such as copyrights, patents, and trademarks in the field of service outsourcing. Establish a credit record and credit evaluation system for service outsourcing companies, punish dishonesty, crack down on fraud, and improve the integrity system of service outsourcing companies. Encourage mature regions to carry out local legislation, and timely introduce local regulations and government rules related to the service outsourcing industry.
titlelist: Strengthening service guarantees, building a rule of law-based business environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: The embassies and consulates abroad should increase their guidance and coordination efforts in cooperating with overseas service outsourcing companies. They should actively strengthen communication and cooperation with domestic regulatory authorities, provide timely and effective information and policy recommendations. They should leverage the role of industry associations to improve service quality and promotion, enhance industry self-discipline, research and formulate service and talent standards, and establish the China Service brand. They should fully utilize existing platforms for service outsourcing exchange and cooperation, attract multinational companies to transfer international service outsourcing business, and encourage research institutions, business associations, universities, and enterprises to engage in various forms of practical cooperation. They should strengthen public information services for service outsourcing, and promptly release international and domestic market dynamics and policy information.
titlelist: Improve service guarantee and enhance the level of public services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Human society is entering a new stage of development characterized by digital productivity. Software plays an important role in the digital process, providing essential support and driving development towards networking, platformization, and intelligence. It accelerates the iteration and innovation of new generation information technologies such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, 5G, blockchain, industrial internet, and quantum computing, and speeds up the pace of digital industrialization. Software enables, empowers, and enhances the integration and development, comprehensively promoting the transformation and upgrading of the economy and society towards digitization, networking, and intelligence. It continuously stimulates innovation vitality of data elements, strengthens security guarantees for equipment, networks, control, data, and applications, accelerates the digitalization process of industries, opens up broad development space for the digital economy, and promotes the quality, efficiency, and dynamic changes in China's development.
titlelist: Development situation, software expands new digital development space.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Software-defined is a new feature and new symbol of the new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, and has become an important driving force for future development. Software-defined expands the functionality of products, transforms the value creation model of products, gives rise to new manufacturing models such as platform-based design, personalized customization, networked collaboration, intelligent production, extended services, and digital management, and promotes the flourishing of platform economy and sharing economy. Software-defined endows enterprises with new capabilities, and aerospace, automotive, major equipment, steel, petrochemical and other industries have accelerated their transformation towards software, making software capabilities the core competitiveness of industrial enterprises. Software-defined endows infrastructure with new capabilities and flexibility, becoming an important engine for upgrading production methods, transforming production relations, and developing emerging industries.
titlelist: Development Situation: 'Software Defined' Empowers New Transformation of the Real Economy

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on the software industry chain, accelerate the 'shortcomings, strengths, and service optimization' to solidify the upstream basic software capabilities in the development environment, tools, and other industrial chain, enhance the software level in the middle of the industrial chain such as industrial software, application software, platform software, embedded software, etc., increase the supply of information technology service products in the downstream of the industrial chain, and improve the modernization level of the software industry chain. Focus on strengthening basic software. Improve desktop, server, mobile terminal, and in-vehicle operating system products and supporting toolkits, promote the integration, adaptation, and optimization of operating systems with databases, middleware, office suites, security software, and various applications. Accelerate the research and development and application promotion of distributed databases, hybrid transactional analysis processing databases, shared memory database clusters, and other products. Carry out the research and development of high-performance and high-reliability middleware key products and components. Enrich security software products and services such as data backup, disaster recovery, and industrial control system protection. Promote the research and development and application promotion of related products of software integrated development environment and key testing tools. Focus on breakthroughs in industrial software. Develop computer-aided design, simulation, calculation, and other tool software, vigorously develop key industrial control software, and accelerate the industrial deployment of high-value-added operation and maintenance and business management software. Develop industry-specific industrial software for key areas such as CNC machine tools, integrated circuits, aerospace equipment, ships, as well as new energy and intelligent connected vehicles, strengthen integration and verification, and form systematic service capabilities. Column 1: Key basic software shortcomings. Operating system. Strengthen the overall architecture design and technical path planning of the operating system, promote joint research and development of key operating system technologies among chip design, operating system, system integration enterprises, research institutes, and universities, improve the compatibility of the operating system with underlying hardware and interoperability with upper-layer applications. Database. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as full-memory high-speed data engines, high-reliability data storage engines, distributed data processing and task scheduling architectures, large-scale parallel graph data processing, etc. Promote the application of high-performance databases in key industries such as finance, telecommunications, and energy. Development support software. Improve the integration and stability of software development tools, break through key technologies such as code resource reuse and recommendation, large-scale cross-language analysis, etc. Accelerate the research and development of testing tools such as program static analysis, dynamic testing, simulation testing, and automated testing platforms. Design and simulation system software. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as three-dimensional geometric modeling engines, constraint solving engines, etc., explore open industrial software architecture, system-level design and simulation, and other technical paths. Focus on supporting the development of three-dimensional computer-aided design, multi-physics field computer-aided calculation such as structure/fluid, model-based system engineering, and other product research and development. Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Establish a joint technical research and development mechanism for EDA developers, chip design companies, foundries, etc., break through key technologies for the entire process of digital, analog, and mixed-signal circuit design, verification, physical implementation, and manufacturing testing, and improve advanced process toolkits. Industrial control software. Focus on industrial control systems such as programmable logic controllers (PLC), distributed control systems (DCS), safety instrumented systems (SIS), etc., carry out joint research and development and adaptation migration of software products with multi-point, low-latency, high-reliability, and low-energy consumption, promote the development of safety monitoring and management systems for manufacturing enterprise-side, and accelerate the integrated application of products in key industries. Collaborative development of application software. Focus on key industries such as finance, construction, energy, transportation, etc., accelerate breakthroughs in financial core business systems, building information modeling and fire simulation, smart energy management, intelligent traffic management, intelligent office, etc. Research and develop and promote software products related to the Beidou satellite navigation system. Develop new-generation software integration application infrastructure around new infrastructure construction such as 5G base stations, big data centers, etc. Encourage leading companies in the industry to collaborate with software companies to jointly develop industry-specific software products. Proactively layout emerging platform software. Accelerate the cultivation of internationally competitive software technologies and products in fields such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, 5G, blockchain, industrial internet, etc. Support the development of new lightweight platforms such as mini-programs and quick applications. Accelerate the research and development of software technologies in frontier areas such as the sixth-generation mobile communication (6G), quantum information, satellite internet, brain-like intelligence, and cultivate a batch of landmark products. Column 2: Strengthen emerging platform software strengths. Cloud computing. Accelerate the research and development of technologies such as ultra-large-scale distributed storage, elastic computing, virtual isolation, heterogeneous resource scheduling, etc., speed up the iteration and upgrade of cloud operating systems, and layout the next-generation cloud computing software system. Encourage enterprises to build high-performance cloud platforms, optimize the layout of public clouds, industry-specific clouds, and regional hybrid cloud platforms. Improve cloud security levels and intelligent cloud service capabilities. Big data. Support key technological innovations such as high-performance data acquisition, high-capacity storage, massive information processing, heterogeneous data management, real-time monitoring of sensitive information, chip integration of storage and computing, platform security control, etc. In key areas such as industry, communication, finance, medical care, emergency response, agriculture, public security, transportation, power, etc., develop a batch of leading software products and solutions. Artificial intelligence. Support the research and development of artificial intelligence algorithm libraries, toolkits, etc. Accelerate the development of new machine learning, biometric recognition, natural language understanding, new human-computer interaction, intelligent control and decision-making, and other products and services. Promote the construction of open platforms for artificial intelligence. Blockchain. Accelerate the research and development of key technologies such as blockchain consensus algorithms, encryption algorithms, efficient and secure smart contracts, distributed systems, etc. Support the construction of underlying technology platforms and blockchain service platforms. Strengthen applications in key areas such as financial technology, supply chain management, and government services. Virtual reality and augmented reality. Promote technological innovations such as three-dimensional graphics production, dynamic environment modeling, real-time motion capture, fast rendering processing, etc., develop virtual reality-related development tool software and industry solutions. Actively cultivate embedded software. Carry out research and development of embedded software systems for major equipment needs such as CNC machine tools, intelligent robots, new energy and intelligent connected vehicles, communication equipment, aerospace engines, etc. Breakthroughs in embedded operating systems, embedded database core technologies, and accelerate the research and development and application promotion of related products. Optimize information technology services. Facing the needs of digitalization, networking, and intelligent applications, strengthen algorithm services in typical scenarios, promote technological innovations related to enterprise-level business continuity management (BCM). Improve the information technology service system around digital management consulting, integrated integration, intelligent operation and maintenance, etc., and enhance specialized information technology service capabilities in key industries and fields. Support the construction of an information technology service ecosystem with perception, control, and decision-making capabilities. Column 3: Demonstrations of information technology service applications. Strengthen the research and development of key information technology services. Carry out technological research and development in data governance, data analysis, knowledge graphs, data security containers, intelligent monitoring and early warning, multi-source data integration, etc., and build a new information technology service technical system. Promote intelligent service applications for industry enterprises. For industries such as finance, telecommunications, energy, etc., promote the construction and application of intelligent information technology service platforms and build an intelligent service system. Select key enterprises to carry out the construction and application of digital transformation support platforms, and cultivate a group of digital transformation solution providers.
titlelist: Development situation, promoting the upgrading of the software industry chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the development foundation of common technologies, basic resource libraries, basic components, etc., enhance the basic guarantee capabilities of quality standards, value evaluation, intellectual property rights, etc., and promote the advanced development of industrial foundations. Strengthen the research and development of common technologies. Strengthen basic research such as software and system engineering methods, programming languages, key core algorithms, etc. Develop data models and interface standards to enhance system interoperability, architectural openness, and application programming interface (API) standardization capabilities. In response to the common needs of software development, build basic algorithm libraries, component libraries, and general model libraries to promote the open sharing of basic resources. Strengthen the supply of basic components. Promote the development of software kernels such as operating systems, browsers, and industrial software. Accelerate breakthroughs in programming language development frameworks and enrich third-party libraries. Vigorously develop emerging platform software development frameworks such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain. Promote the development of software development kits (SDKs) and encourage innovation in SDKs in specific functional areas. Strengthen open source code security testing to ensure the security of open source code component supply. Promote the software development of basic resource management and services such as domain names and identifiers. Improve the quality standards system. Build a software industry quality service system, promote advanced quality management models and methods, and guide enterprises to carry out quality brand construction. Improve the software industry standard system, focus on key areas, accelerate the formulation of technical, product, service, management, evaluation, and other standards, and improve the level of standard generalization. Improve the software product and service testing and certification evaluation system. Support the enhancement of software value. Establish a software value evaluation mechanism that meets the requirements of high-quality development, promote the use of software cost measurement standards, strengthen supervision of software product and service prices, and maintain market price order. Strengthen the creation, application, protection, management, and service capabilities of intellectual property rights in the software and information technology fields, increase the protection of software intellectual property rights, and encourage enterprises to strengthen cooperation in software intellectual property rights. Continuously promote the legalization of software and crack down on all types of software infringement and piracy. Increase efforts to combat unfair competition in the software field and legally protect the trade secrets of software industry enterprises. Column 4: Enhancing industrial basic capabilities. Enhance software engineering capabilities. Carry out pilot demonstrations of software engineering capabilities, promote advanced software engineering technologies and methods, and promote product lifecycle management. Develop third-party service organizations, strengthen product development in software engineering, testing certification, etc., and build software engineering service guarantee capabilities. Enhance software product and data capabilities. Improve the maturity standard system for software product and data capabilities, combine industry user needs, promote the evaluation and assessment of software and data maturity, and build relevant public service systems. Enhance software standardization capabilities. Establish a mechanism for coordinated promotion of product development and standard formulation, promote standard promotion and application demonstrations, establish national standard verification and testing points, and establish a standard conformity assessment system. Support domestic enterprises and institutions to participate deeply in international standard formulation. Enhance software quality management capabilities. Support the development of tools such as configuration management, code review, test verification, quality analysis, etc., and enhance quality monitoring, early warning, and evaluation capabilities. Promote enterprises to establish product development and quality control systems that are in line with international standards and improve software development quality. Enhance software value assurance capabilities. Develop software value evaluation specifications, establish evaluation systems, and strengthen software value calculation and statistics. Support priority examination of intellectual property rights in key areas of the software industry and improve the intellectual property rights intermediary service system. Enhance public service capabilities in software. Promote the construction of specialized service organizations for quality standards, investment and financing, intellectual property rights transactions, evaluation and certification, etc. Encourage the development of public service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Development situation, improving the level of industrial foundation guarantee.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the collaborative research and development between government, industry, academia, and research institutes, strengthen and expand innovative carriers, fully unleash the innovation vitality of software-defined, accelerate mode innovation and mechanism innovation, and build a collaborative and controllable industrial innovation system. Strengthen the collaborative innovation between industry, academia, research, and application. Enhance the position of enterprises as the main body of innovation, support leading enterprises in forming joint innovation bodies with user units and universities and research institutes, and carry out key core technology research. Build a software industry innovation platform for collaborative research and development, enhance integration and systematic innovation capabilities. Build software and hardware adaptation centers around typical application scenarios in key industries, carry out public services such as product research and development, integration verification, and achievement display, and accelerate the industrialization of innovative achievements. Deepen software-defined. Accelerate the development of software-defined computing, software-defined storage, and software-defined networking, with a focus on industrial Internet, cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and autonomous driving and other emerging software-defined platforms. Guide enterprises to develop relevant system architecture and application specifications, and promote innovative applications. Column 5: Cultivate innovative applications of software-defined. Build a software-defined technology system. Strongly support the research on software-defined and ubiquitous operating system platform theories and technologies, strengthen the connection between government, industry, academia, research, and application, and build a core technology system of software-defined. Cultivate the innovative application ecology of software-defined. Establish software-defined solutions for typical industries such as consumer electronics, high-end equipment, intelligent connected vehicles, and smart cities, and organize pilot demonstrations. Cultivate a group of core technology, product, and system solution providers, and promote the construction of industry alliances. Explore the development and operation models of the software-defined ecosystem. Promote mode and mechanism innovation. Innovate software development models, promote the popularization of software development clouds and intelligent development tools. Innovate software operation service models, promote software subscription, pay-per-use services, and achieve integration of software delivery, product upgrades, and operation and maintenance services. Establish a market-oriented innovation mechanism, explore the establishment of a shared responsibility application guarantee mechanism, and further improve the integration and innovation mechanism of software and key areas. Strengthen the information technology application innovation system. Carry out integrated adaptation of software, hardware, applications, and services, and gradually improve the technology and product system. Promote software companies to establish product quality lifecycle guarantee mechanisms, promote technological innovation and product iteration through the testing of information technology application innovation products. Continuously promote supply-demand integration, cultivate a group of projects and high-end brands with high industrial levels and strong driving capabilities through large-scale applications in key areas. Use information technology application innovation industrial parks as carriers to promote industrial agglomeration.
titlelist: Developing situation, strengthening the ability of industrial innovation and development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage key areas to take the lead in conducting pilot applications of key products, promote the deep integration of software with production, distribution, circulation, and consumption, accelerate digital development, and promote higher-level development of demand-driven supply and supply-driven demand. Promote major applications comprehensively. Deepen the application of basic software in the office field, enhance system development, integrated services, and operation and maintenance capabilities. Accelerate the application of key software in key areas, promote joint application adaptation research and development between user units and software companies, and improve the testing, evaluation, and comprehensive guarantee system. Coordinate the application of key software in major projects, establish full lifecycle service guarantee capabilities, and form a batch of replicable and promotable excellent solutions. Support the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry. Continuously expand the breadth and depth of software applications in various links of the manufacturing industry, build a new manufacturing system that is software-defined, data-driven, platform-supported, service-added, and intelligence-led. Accelerate the construction of comprehensive, characteristic, and professional industrial Internet platforms, carry out research and development and deployment of industrial mechanism models, microservices, industrial software, and industrial apps, and promote data interoperability and capability synergy between platforms. Systematically guide manufacturing companies to accelerate their business and equipment cloudification. Support third-party service providers in providing platform construction, data mining, and other solutions. Column 6: Promote the development and application of industrial technology software. Carry out theoretical and technical research on the industrial technology software process, and make breakthroughs in key core technologies such as knowledge engineering and low-code production system and production relationship optimization. Organize a series of training, pilot demonstration selection, and supply-demand docking work for industrial technology software. Cultivate high-quality industrial apps. Promote the development of industry-specific and enterprise-specific industrial apps. Carry out activities such as quality evaluation of industrial apps, collection of excellent solutions, and industrial app competitions. Support the construction of a dynamic monitoring platform for industrial apps. Develop industrial app stores to facilitate the circulation of industrial apps. Promote digital development in key areas. Support the innovative application of new-generation information technology in inclusive finance and develop related software products. Cultivate software solutions for various links in logistics such as transportation, sorting, warehousing, and distribution, and improve the level of logistics digitization. Promote the application of transportation software to improve the efficiency of transportation resource utilization and the level of management refinement. Support innovative applications of software such as urban information models, geographic information systems, building information models, and building fire simulation, implement projects to enhance intelligent construction capabilities, and promote the digitalization, networking, and intelligent breakthroughs in the construction industry. Support the development and application of agricultural basic resource databases, intelligent monitoring and control systems, agricultural product quality and safety traceability systems, strengthen comprehensive information services, and improve the level of digitalization in agriculture and rural areas. Continuously collect and promote typical solutions for smart cities, support urban-level innovative applications such as smart city brains, precision benefits for the people, smart government affairs, and urban health examinations, and cultivate new models, applications, and formats for the integration of software and smart society. Expand and upgrade service information consumption. Focus on areas such as commerce, tourism, health, home, catering, culture, education, and entertainment, accelerate the improvement of the supply capacity of software products and services such as e-commerce, mobile payment, social networks, location services, and online audiovisuals, and develop new models such as intelligence, refinement, and customization. Cultivate a batch of new information consumption demonstration projects, build a batch of comprehensive and characteristic information consumption demonstration cities, encourage regions with conditions to establish information consumption halls, experience centers, and public service platforms, and hold activities such as information consumption competitions, city tours, and experience weeks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In response to the characteristics of the building materials industry, focusing on key processes such as mining, raw material preparation, crushing and grinding, kiln control, logistics and warehousing, online testing, etc., we have refined and developed several sets of intelligent, digital, and integrated system solutions with functions such as intelligent perception, automatic execution, deep learning, intelligent decision-making, and password protection. These solutions promote the automation, intelligence, and unmanned transformation of production methods in industries such as cement, glass, ceramics, etc. Column 1: System solutions for key segments of the building materials industry. Cement industry: Key solutions include digital planning and design, intelligent factory construction, automatic ore selection and blending, kiln optimization control, one-click start-stop for grinding machines, equipment diagnosis and maintenance, remote production monitoring, intelligent quality control, energy and water consumption management, clean packaging and shipping, safety and environmental management, and coordinated disposal of solid waste. Glass industry: Key solutions include raw material selection and blending, intelligent thermal control of melting furnaces, tin baths, and annealing kilns, digital simulation of melting and forming, optimization control of the cold end, online defect detection, automatic stacking and paper laying, automatic cutting and slicing, and intelligent coding and warehousing. Ceramics industry: Key solutions include standard data for raw materials, press control and management, intelligent high-pressure slurry injection, control of green body drying, unmanned loading and unloading of materials, kiln optimization control, glazing and polishing of products, automatic detection and sorting, and intelligent warehousing and logistics. Stone industry: Key solutions include automatic mining, intelligent sawing and cutting, grinding and polishing, automatic cutting, special-shaped processing, as well as inspection, repair, packaging, and disposal of waste materials. Refractory materials industry: Key solutions include raw material preparation, press control, kiln optimization, online monitoring, and fully automated three-dimensional warehouses. Wall materials industry: Key solutions include precise preparation of raw materials, cutting and shaping of green bodies, drying (steam pressing) and curing, kiln optimization control, automatic quality inspection, intelligent packaging and logistics, automatic unloading and stacking, and pollution emission control. Insulation materials industry: Key solutions include homogenization of raw material blending, automatic feeding and charging, kiln optimization control, online quality monitoring, equipment failure warning, intelligent cutting (sorting) and packaging, digital warehousing and logistics. Concrete and cement products industry: Key solutions include integrated systems for the entire concrete industry chain, including manufacturing execution management, intelligent logistics and distribution, and online quality monitoring. For cement products, key solutions include centralized mixing and delivery, automatic molding control, skeleton welding and transportation, and intelligent maintenance. Waterproof materials industry: Key solutions include automatic feeding and metering, process quality control, manufacturing execution management, and packaging and warehousing logistics. Non-metallic mineral industry: Key solutions include data management for geological exploration, fine raw material mining, material weighing and homogenization, intelligent control of material selection, mineral processing optimization, online quality monitoring, and finished product packaging and logistics. High-performance fiber and composite materials industry: Key solutions include control of tank and kiln drawing, online quality monitoring, automatic material transportation, injection molding, extrusion winding, equipment control and failure warning. Mechanism sand and gravel industry: Key solutions include crushing and shaping, grading adjustment, quality monitoring, dust collection, wastewater treatment, and material storage and transportation. Wood building materials industry: Key solutions include raw material sorting, automatic processing, production control, online monitoring, and logistics and warehousing. Inorganic non-metallic new materials: Key solutions include integrated systems for material research and development and design, which combine calculation, experimentation, and data, as well as intelligent grading, purification, modification, growth, processing, and application.
titlelist: Development situation, intelligent manufacturing technology innovation action in the building materials industry, forming a batch of systematic solutions.

Big data: Use big data collection, analysis, mining, and other technologies to improve intelligent operation capabilities such as monitoring and traceability, predictive maintenance, quality control, supply chain management, and energy management. Strengthen the analysis and utilization of industry public data, unify data standards and formats, and promote data integration among building materials industry enterprises and platforms. Industrial Internet platform: Use Internet of Things technology to realize intelligent perception, recognition, positioning, tracking, and management, promote enterprises to migrate infrastructure, business systems, and equipment products to the cloud, cultivate industrial APPs, and build industrial Internet platforms for the building materials industry. Blockchain: Support building materials enterprises to use blockchain technology to achieve product transactions, information traceability, quality management, and other functions with upstream and downstream industrial chains, ensure data security, and gradually deepen application. 5G communication: Guide enterprises to use the advantages of 5G communication technology such as high bandwidth, low latency, and large connections to achieve interconnection and encourage integrated innovative applications in areas such as unmanned driving, remote blasting, and equipment maintenance. Artificial intelligence: Promote the application of advanced algorithms, machine learning, and intelligent chips in the fields of intelligent production, intelligent decision-making, intelligent logistics, intelligent monitoring, and intelligent traceability in the building materials industry. Building Information Modeling: Use Building Information Modeling (BIM) technology to promote seamless connection between building materials and construction, vigorously develop modular building materials, and realize the traceability, predictability, maintainability, and recyclability of building materials throughout the life cycle. Digital twin: Use computational modeling, real-time sensing, virtual reality, simulation technology, and other means to achieve the mapping of building material factories in a virtual environment, promote the full-cycle optimization management of design, installation, and operation of complete production equipment, and realize the visualization, predictability, maintainability, and recyclability of building material factories.
