Promote the expansion of internet, Internet of Things, and artificial intelligence applications in different fields between panel companies and terminal companies, cultivate new growth points in the mid-to-high-end consumer market, and further expand the application scope of online health care, security monitoring, smart homes, and other fields. Deepen the development of intelligent connected vehicles. Promote the construction of supporting platforms such as technology testing, formulate guidelines for the construction of the vehicle networking industry development standard system, promote the research and development of key technological products such as in-vehicle intelligent chips, autonomous driving operating systems, and vehicle intelligent algorithms, build an integrated intelligent vehicle platform, and cultivate diversified applications. Promote the construction of smart cars and intelligent transportation projects based on broadband mobile internet. By 2020, establish a reliable, secure, and real-time intelligent connected vehicle computing platform, form relevant platform standards, and support highly automated driving (Level HA).
titlelist: Main Actions, Action to Improve the Supply System of New Information Products

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Organize the Enterprise Cloud Migration campaign. Carry out publicity and training for industry enterprises, promote deep cooperation between cloud computing service providers and industry enterprises, improve enterprise management efficiency through software applications and data services on the cloud, and organize the selection of typical benchmark application cases. Promote the migration of small and medium-sized enterprise operations to the cloud. By 2020, achieve rapid formation of information technology capabilities for small and medium-sized enterprises through cloud services, and create 100 typical cloud application cases for enterprises. Enhance the level of research and development and application of information technology services. Promote the construction of new smart cities, support comprehensive research and development and application of cloud computing, big data, and the Internet of Things, and accelerate the improvement of residents' convenience in information consumption. Organize pilot projects for the application of new technologies such as blockchain. Release the Information Technology Service Standard (ITSS) System 5.0 version, continue to carry out standardization activities, support enterprises to accelerate the improvement of comprehensive integration service capabilities guided by standards, and have over 2,000 standardized enterprises by 2020. Cultivate industry information consumption support services. Actively develop industrial e-commerce, deepen the integration of manufacturing and the Internet, and build a number of influential and driving vertical e-commerce platforms. Support the development of network payment, modern logistics, supply chain management, and other support services for the entire process of information consumption. By 2020, achieve a 60% penetration rate of e-commerce among key industry backbone enterprises. Promote the development of double innovation in the field of information consumption. Support large enterprises in establishing double innovation platforms based on the Internet, cultivate new formats and models for the integration and development of information consumption, and build a number of national public service demonstration platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises, providing information, technology, entrepreneurship, training, financing, and other services. Announce a batch of national small and micro enterprise entrepreneurship and innovation demonstration bases, widely attract small and medium-sized enterprises to settle in, guide demonstration bases to actively integrate social service resources, provide services in various forms and aspects, and promote innovative development in information consumption.
titlelist: Main Action, Action to Enhance Information Technology Service Capability

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the acceleration and reduction of fees for information infrastructure. Implement the Broadband China strategy, organize and implement the construction of new generation information infrastructure projects, promote deep coverage of fiber broadband and fourth-generation mobile communication (4G) networks, accelerate research on fifth-generation mobile communication (5G) standards and technology trials, promote the construction of 5G scale networks and application demonstration projects. Deepen the pilot of universal telecommunication services and improve information access capabilities in rural areas. Increase efforts to reduce network fees and fully unleash the dividends of network acceleration and fee reduction. Conduct pilot demonstrations in industrial, agricultural, transportation, energy, municipal, environmental protection, and other fields, and achieve optical network coverage in urban areas by 2020, providing access services with speeds of over 1000Mbps; achieve fiber optic coverage and 4G network coverage in 98% of administrative villages, and provide access services with speeds of over 100Mbps in areas with conditions; ensure the commercialization of 5G. Implement consumer information skills training projects. Relying on the construction of pilot demonstration cities for information consumption, organize information consumption training for various consumer groups, especially for farmers, herdsmen, the elderly, and other groups with relatively weak information skills, popularize knowledge related to information application, online payment, risk identification, etc. Encourage enterprises, industry associations, and other social forces to organize a series of competitions in information-related vocational skills, entrepreneurship, and innovation, combining local characteristics and advantages, to enhance information consumption skills. Before 2020, select more than 100 key areas to implement information skills training projects. Organize information consumption experience activities. Organize Information Consumption City Tours to expand the influence of information consumption through policy interpretation, exhibition displays, interactive experiences, on-site visits, and other forms. Support local organizations in conducting information consumption experience weeks, building information consumption experience halls, and other activities, actively use virtual/augmented reality, interactive entertainment, and other technologies to deepen user participation in application scenario customization, product function design, digital content provision, etc., improve consumer satisfaction, enrich information consumption experiences, and cultivate information consumption habits.
titlelist: Main actions, empowering actions for information consumers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The industrial and information technology departments in various regions should strengthen the coordination and organization of major decisions, projects, and issues related to information consumption. They should establish and improve a collaborative mechanism for the development of information consumption, clarify the goals and implementation plans for local information consumption development, increase the assessment of the effectiveness of information consumption work, and ensure the implementation of action plans. They should also support the establishment of expert advisory committees on information consumption development in eligible regions to provide reference and support for the work.
titlelist: Main actions, strengthen work organization and coordination.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Increase the level of financial support, support the research and development of cutting-edge technologies in information consumption, and expand various types of new products and integrated applications. Local industrial and information technology departments, as well as development and reform authorities, should further implement several policies to encourage the development of the software and integrated circuit industries, and increase efforts to implement existing tax policies that support small and micro enterprises. Encourage eligible regions to establish special funds for information consumption, promote the introduction of policies that support the development of information consumption, effectively improve the financing environment for enterprises, and increase support for small and micro enterprises in the field of information consumption.
titlelist: Main actions, increase policy support efforts.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the construction plan and management methods for the demonstration cities of information consumption, encourage local governments to increase support, and create a group of pilot demonstration cities with strong industrial foundations, complete industrial chains, obvious agglomeration effects, and distinctive regional characteristics. Select a group of demonstration projects with good development prospects, significant driving effects, and strong demonstration effects in the areas of life information consumption, public service information consumption, industry information consumption, and new information product consumption.
titlelist: Main actions, promote the implementation of pilot demonstrations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the bridging and linking role of industry organizations such as associations and alliances, integrate resources from backbone enterprises, higher education institutions, research institutes, and other sectors, promote in-depth cooperation among production, academia, and research, innovate management and operation mechanisms in areas such as information consumption standard formulation, technology verification, product incubation, and international expansion, and create a multi-party collaborative and mutually beneficial industrial ecosystem.
titlelist: Main action, building an industry cooperation platform.

content: - Promote the development of secure and reliable industrial apps with high support value for key projects, major engineering projects, and important equipment development needs in the domestic manufacturing industry.- Develop basic common industrial apps with strong universality and high reuse rate in the four industrial foundations areas, including key basic materials, core components, advanced basic processes, and industrial technology foundations.- Develop and promote industry-specific industrial apps with high value and strong driving force for industries such as automotive, aerospace, petrochemicals, machinery manufacturing, light industry appliances, and information electronics.- Develop enterprise-specific industrial apps with high application value to meet the personalized needs of manufacturing companies.- By 2020, cultivate 300,000 industrial apps targeting specific industries and scenarios, covering key needs in research and development, production, operation and maintenance, and business management in the manufacturing industry.- Breakthrough key common technologies for industrial software, establish industrial app standards, cultivate a number of high-value and high-quality industrial apps with significant support significance, and form a number of internationally competitive industrial app enterprises.- Achieve positive results in the application of industrial apps, with the software rate of key business processes in innovative application enterprises reaching 50%.- Formulate a market-oriented circulation and sustainable development capability for industrial app applications, and preliminarily demonstrate the support role in promoting the prosperity of the industrial Internet platform application ecosystem, improving industrial quality and efficiency, and transforming and upgrading the industry.- The main tasks are as follows: [task details not provided]

content: Support the establishment of provincial-level industrial technology software innovation centers in advanced regions, deepen cross-industry and cross-domain cooperation, promote the accumulation, openness, and reuse of craftsman knowledge and experience (such as technology, processes, models, algorithms, etc.), achieve technology diffusion and commercialization, and accelerate the process of industrial technology software. Encourage leading enterprises, industry associations, professional institutions, etc., to establish specialized departments to promote industrial technology software, integrate industrial chain resources, and enhance engineering capabilities.
titlelist: Main actions, solidify the foundation of industrial technology software, enhance the software capabilities of industrial enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: 'Open-source community for apps. content: Support the construction of microservice resource pools for industrial Internet platform enterprises, gather microservice components such as tools, algorithms, models, etc., open software development kits (SDKs) and application programming interfaces (APIs), enhance the comprehensive integration, testing and verification, quality control, lifecycle management, and service capabilities of industrial apps. Promote the open sharing of manufacturing capabilities. Organize and promote double innovation activities in the field of industrial apps, guide enterprises to connect supply and demand information, innovate business models, utilize the industrial Internet to open up their own research and development and manufacturing capabilities, and optimize resource allocation efficiency. Incorporate the opening of manufacturing capabilities based on the industrial Internet into the evaluation system for the integration of the two industries, and promote popularization through various means such as standardization.
titlelist: Main actions, promote the convergence of industrial apps towards platforms, enhance the capabilities of industrial Internet platforms.

content: 'APP marketization circulation. Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights for industrial APPs, improve the transaction rules and service rules for industrial APPs, and promote the marketization circulation of industrial APPs. content: Promote the application of key industries. Industry regulatory departments in various regions should guide local enterprises to fulfill their responsibilities as the main body of industrial APP information security, and comply with relevant laws and regulations on information security.'

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Before December 2018, the Industrial APP Development White Paper was released, and the Industrial APP Cultivation Guidelines were introduced, establishing an organization for industrial technology software standardization. Efforts were made to build 1-2 provincial-level industrial technology software manufacturing innovation centers and develop a batch of excellent industrial technology software solutions. Give full play to the role of local governments, industry associations, industry alliances, and scientific research institutes, integrate the strengths of industry, academia, research, and application, and form a collaborative work pattern.

titlelist: Progress arrangement, policy guidance

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the guiding role of fiscal funds, focusing on supporting the research and development of common key technologies and the construction of standard testing capabilities, and guiding social capital to increase investment in open source communities and innovation centers. Encourage local governments to establish special funds and increase support for the cultivation of industrial apps. Explore the establishment of industrial funds and other market-oriented, diversified funding mechanisms to encourage social capital to participate in the cultivation of industrial apps.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, financial support

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: The software and information technology services industry has entered a period of accelerated innovation, rapid iteration, and collective breakthroughs, speeding up the evolution towards networking, platformization, service-oriented, intelligent, and ecological development. Rapid development and integration innovation in cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, and the Internet of Things, as well as advancements in advanced computing, high-end storage, artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and neuroscience, are further reshaping the technical architecture, computing models, development models, product forms, and business models of software. New technologies, products, models, and formats are becoming increasingly mature, accelerating the transition to a qualitative change period. Open source, crowdsourcing, and other crowd-intelligence research and development models have become the mainstream direction of technological innovation, and industrial competition is shifting from single technology, single product, and single model to multi-technology, integration, convergence, platform systems, and ecosystem competition. Ecosystem competition has become the key point of industrial development. Software companies rely on technology platforms such as cloud computing and big data to strengthen the integration and innovation of core elements such as technology, products, content, and services, accelerate business restructuring, process optimization, and service improvement, and achieve transformational development.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, continuous deepening of industrial transformation through the core of 'technology + mode + ecology' in collaborative innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The data-driven software-defined is becoming a prominent feature of integrated applications. On one hand, data-driven information technology is driving industry transformation, accelerating the cross-border integration and innovative development of the new generation of information technology. Through software-defined hardware, software-defined storage, software-defined networking, software-defined systems, etc., it brings more new products, services, and innovative models, giving rise to new formats and economic growth points, and promoting data as a strategic asset. On the other hand, software-defined accelerates the integration, innovation, and transformation of various industries. Software-defined manufacturing stimulates innovation in research and development design, simulation verification, production manufacturing, and business management, accelerating the development of new models such as personalized customization, networked collaboration, service-oriented manufacturing, and cloud manufacturing, promoting the transformation of manufacturing from production-oriented to service-oriented. Software-defined services profoundly affect the development of industries such as finance, logistics, transportation, culture, and tourism, giving birth to a group of new industry entities, business platforms, integrated formats, and new types of consumption. It has triggered multidimensional and deep-level changes in areas such as resident consumption, livelihood services, and social governance, and has emerged numerous new models of network economy such as sharing economy, platform economy, and algorithm economy, nurturing and strengthening the development of new driving forces.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, the fusion application characterized by 'software-defined' opens up a new landscape of the information economy.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on key links in the industrial chain, strengthen basic technology research, advance research and development of cutting-edge technologies, build a core technology system, accelerate innovation in information technology services, improve the industrial innovation system that combines enterprises as the main body, application-oriented, and integrates government, industry, academia, research, and application. Accelerate breakthroughs in common basic technologies. Targeting major industry applications and information security needs, aim at the development of key technologies in the technology industry, and increase support for the research, development, and application of basic software technologies and products such as operating systems, databases, middleware, and office software. Vigorously develop basic software platforms for new intelligent terminals, intelligent equipment, and major integrated application platforms for various industries. Accelerate the development of software engineering methods, tools, and environments that adapt to the trends of platformization, networking, and intelligence, and enhance the support capabilities of common basic technologies. Layout research and development of cutting-edge technologies. Conduct research on big data theory and methods, computing systems and analysis, key application technologies and models, and layout the development of cloud computing and big data cutting-edge technologies. Support research on basic theories, common technologies, and application technologies of artificial intelligence, with a focus on breakthroughs in natural language understanding, computer vision and audio, new human-computer interaction, and intelligent control and decision-making. Accelerate research and innovation in areas such as unmanned driving, virtual reality, 3D printing, blockchain, and human-machine integration computing. Strengthen innovation in information technology services. In response to the application needs of key industries, further enhance the basic capabilities of information technology services and improve the level of comprehensive integration of Internet Plus applications. Establish engineering, platform-based, and networked information technology service capabilities for new system architectures and application scenarios, develop new service models such as microservices, intelligent services, and integrated development and operation, and enhance the level of information technology services. Accelerate the development of new online operation services for mobile intelligent terminals, intelligent connected vehicles, robots, etc., such as mobile payment, location services, social networking services, digital content services, intelligent applications, virtual reality, etc. Accelerate the cultivation of technology service platforms and solutions in the fields of digital marketing, Internet finance, e-commerce, game animation, artificial intelligence, etc. Vigorously develop high-end outsourcing services based on new generation information technology. Strengthen the construction of industrial innovation mechanisms and carriers. In key areas such as basic software, high-end industrial software, cloud computing, big data, information security, and artificial intelligence, strengthen the integration of industry, academia, research, and application, layout the construction of national innovation centers, establish a mechanism for continuous improvement of innovation results guided by rapid application, and accelerate the transformation of core technological achievements. Highlight the role of enterprises in technological innovation, promote the construction of enterprise technology innovation centers, and continuously enhance enterprise innovation capabilities. Guide large Internet companies to further open up and provide advantageous platform resources and services to society through market-oriented approaches. Strengthen the construction of industrial alliances, explore and improve mechanisms for joint participation, shared results, and risk sharing, and strengthen collaborative innovation. Leverage the support and promotion role of open source communities in innovation, strengthen the application of open source technology achievements in innovation, and build an open, collaborative, and international open source ecosystem conducive to innovation. Column 1: Software Soul Casting Project. Accelerate breakthroughs in basic general-purpose software. Based on the strategic goal of developing from following to keeping pace with basic general-purpose software, use pilot projects for secure and reliable applications as a starting point to achieve breakthroughs in core basic technologies in areas such as operating systems and databases, and establish a secure and reliable basic software product system. Build a joint platform for secure and reliable software and hardware research and development, support enterprises and research institutions in building general technology innovation and application platforms. Develop software engineering methods, tools, and environments such as requirements analysis and design, programming languages and compilers, software testing and verification, process improvement and maturity evaluation, and integrated development, improve the development and application ecosystem of basic general-purpose software. Strengthen networked software competitive advantages. Based on the strategic goal of developing from keeping pace to leading in networked software, break through core technologies such as virtual resource scheduling, large-scale parallel analysis, and distributed memory computing, guide backbone enterprises to accelerate the development of operating systems, database systems, new middleware, and office suites for cloud computing, mobile Internet, and the Internet of Things. Take the lead in developing intelligent software. Based on the strategic goal of taking the lead in intelligent software, break through core technologies such as virtual resource scheduling, data storage and processing, large-scale parallel analysis, distributed memory computing, lightweight container management, visualization, etc., in cloud computing and big data technologies, as well as virtual reality, augmented reality, blockchain, and other technologies. Support the research and industrialization of key technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, knowledge graphs, computer vision and audio, biometric recognition, complex environment recognition, new human-computer interaction, natural language understanding, intelligent control and decision-making, brain-like intelligence, etc., and promote the deep application and development of artificial intelligence. Build an open and open innovation and application ecosystem for technical products. Support enterprises, universities, research institutes, etc. to participate in and lead international open source projects, leverage platforms such as open source communities, industry alliances, forums, and conferences, gather excellent open source resources at home and abroad, and enhance the integration and utilization capabilities of open source resources. Support the establishment of open source funds and other means to support the construction of public welfare ecological environments based on the open source model, strengthen the innovation of open source technology and products, talent cultivation, and enhance the support capabilities of the open source community for industrial development. Column 2: Information Technology Service Capability Enhancement Project. Strengthen the construction of basic service capabilities. Innovate the methodology of basic general-purpose information technology services, encourage enterprises to establish networked, intelligent, and multi-industry knowledge bases. Support enterprises in developing key supporting tools such as networked development and integration platforms, heterogeneous cloud environment resource scheduling and management, microservice management, etc. Support the improvement of information technology consulting, information system solution design, integrated implementation, remote operation and maintenance, and encourage relevant enterprises to establish information technology service management systems. Build and improve a number of public technology service platforms to enhance testing and verification, integration and adaptation, and other service support capabilities. Develop new service models and formats. Innovate the concept of software-defined services, encourage the development of new-generation information technology-driven new formats of information technology services. Integrate resources, support key enterprises in enhancing key technology service capabilities in areas such as containers, blockchain, and integrated development and operation, and accelerate the cultivation of various new service models and formats to promote the sharing and utilization of information service resources. Organize pilot demonstrations of intelligent services for Internet Plus based on national new industrialization industry demonstration bases (software and information services) and industrial parks. Promote the transformation and development of enterprise services. Support key industry enterprises in leveraging their basic advantages, accelerate the application level of information technology, and develop new service businesses based on cloud computing and big data analysis. Support software companies in accelerating the transformation to networking, service-oriented, and platform-oriented models, develop comprehensive application solutions, and promote cross-industry cooperation with key industry enterprises to achieve win-win results.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, comprehensively improve innovation and development capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In response to the innovation and development trends of the new generation of information technology, we are focusing on the research and development of key software products and solutions in emerging fields such as cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, and the Internet of Things. We encourage the development of platform-based enterprises and industries, accelerate the cultivation of new formats and models, and form a collaborative development pattern of platform, data, application, service, and security.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, actively cultivating and strengthening emerging industries.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the development of cloud computing products, services, and solutions, promote the migration of information systems in various industries to cloud platforms, and promote innovation in business models and commercial models based on cloud computing. Support the integration and innovative application of cloud computing with big data, the Internet of Things, mobile internet, and other technologies, and actively cultivate new products and new formats. Support large enterprises in opening up cloud platform resources, promote the adoption of cloud services by small and medium-sized enterprises, and create a collaborative and win-win cloud platform service environment. Develop secure and trustworthy cloud computing outsourcing services and promote government business outsourcing. Guide the establishment of cloud service platforms for personal information storage, online development tools, learning, and entertainment, and cultivate new hotspots in information consumption. Improve and promote the comprehensive standard system for cloud computing, strengthen the research and development of cloud computing evaluation tools and the construction of evaluation systems, and improve the standardization level and service capabilities of cloud computing. Column 3: Development of secure and trustworthy cloud computing for intelligent manufacturing. Encourage backbone enterprises to develop trustworthy cloud computing resource pools for intelligent manufacturing resources and services, support various activities throughout the lifecycle of intelligent manufacturing. Support software and information technology services. Encourage cross-industry cooperation among enterprises to develop new formats and models such as personalized customized services, lifecycle management, precision online marketing, and online support services. Carry out cloud computing application demonstrations. Organize industrial cloud service innovation pilots, promote the open sharing of resources in research and development design, production manufacturing, marketing services, and testing and verification, and build an industrial cloud ecosystem. Support the development of third-party proprietary cloud solutions, carry out industry application pilot demonstrations in areas such as government affairs, finance, and healthcare, and promote the migration of core business systems to private clouds. Improve public cloud service capabilities. Carry out the construction of a public cloud service enterprise capability evaluation system, research and improve cloud service evaluation and measurement billing standards, and support backbone enterprises in building high-level public cloud computing service platforms. Encourage government departments, public service institutions, and industry backbone enterprises to use public cloud services to build information solutions.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, actively cultivating and strengthening emerging business models, innovating cloud computing applications and services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a big data industry system. Strengthen the research and development and application of key big data technologies, and cultivate a big data product system. Develop specialized data service new formats such as big data collection and resource construction, big data resource circulation and transaction, and big data maturity assessment, and promote the circulation and sharing of big data resources. Cultivate leading big data enterprises and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, and create a multi-level and tiered industrial innovation main body. Optimize the layout of the big data industry, and build big data industry agglomeration zones and comprehensive test zones. Support the construction of big data public service platforms, develop services such as big data standard verification and evaluation certification, and improve the public service system for the big data industry. Develop industrial big data. Support the research and development of big data analysis technologies and platforms for key links such as research and development design, production manufacturing, operation management, marketing, and operation and maintenance services, promote the establishment of a comprehensive big data resource integration and analysis platform for the entire industry chain, and carry out application innovation and pilot demonstrations of big data in the industrial field. Relying on data-intensive industrial agglomeration zones such as high-end equipment and electronic information, support the construction of a batch of industrial big data innovation centers, industry platforms, and service demonstration bases, enrich industrial big data service content and innovate service models. Deepen the application of big data services. Develop and promote big data products and solutions for key industries such as finance, energy, agriculture, logistics, and transportation, promote the integration and application of big data across industries, and support the transformation and development of key industries. With a focus on serving the needs of the people, accelerate the application of big data in fields such as healthcare, education, transportation, tourism, employment, social security, environmental protection, and emergency management. Support the establishment of big data platforms for government affairs, social governance, and network security, strengthen top-level design, integrate resources, promote the in-depth application of big data technology, and enhance government governance capabilities and service levels. Column 4: Big data technology research and application demonstration project. Strengthen the research and industrialization of key big data technology products. Carry out research on key technologies and tools such as next-generation relational databases, distributed databases, new big data processing engines, integrated data management platforms, and data security, fully utilize the achievements of open source technology, and promote the construction of a big data technology system. Develop scalable and high-quality computing platforms and related software systems for big data, enhance data analysis and processing capabilities, knowledge discovery capabilities, and decision-making capabilities, and form a relatively sound big data product system. Vigorously develop big data solutions that deeply integrate with the business processes and data application needs of key industry sectors. Promote the application demonstration of big data. Carry out the creation of big data industry agglomeration zones and support regions with conditions to carry out pilot demonstrations of big data applications. Promote the integration and development of big data with cloud computing, industrial internet, cyber-physical systems, etc., support the establishment of big data analysis and application platforms for different industrial sectors and different business links, select key industrial sectors, typical enterprises, and key regions to carry out industrial big data application demonstrations, and improve the level of big data application services in the industrial field.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, actively cultivate and strengthen emerging industries, accelerate the development and application of big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the development of mobile internet application software and services, targeting the innovative development needs of emerging media, medical health, cultural education, transportation, finance, commerce, and other fields. Encourage the establishment of sharing economy platforms, support the development of mobile, social, and personalized information services based on software and mobile internet, and actively cultivate new models of internet economy. Strengthen the research and development and application of software platforms and application development environments for the Internet of Things, further deepen the integration and application of IoT software technology in smart manufacturing, smart agriculture, transportation, and other fields. Accelerate the development of new applications such as connected vehicles and Beidou navigation, and support the development of intelligent connected vehicle technology, Beidou navigation software technology, and application platforms.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, actively cultivating and strengthening emerging business models, deepening software innovation and application in fields such as mobile internet and Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Fully leverage the deep integration, penetration, and coupling effects of software, accelerate the integration and application of software in various industries, develop key application software, industry solutions, and integrated application platforms, strengthen application innovation and business model innovation, enhance the level of service-oriented manufacturing, cultivate and expand information consumption, and provide support services for initiatives such as the 'Internet Plus' Action Plan.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, deepening the promotion of application innovation and integrated development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on key aspects of the manufacturing industry, and provide support for the research and application of high-end industrial software, new industrial apps, etc. Develop industrial operating systems and industrial big data management systems to improve the supply capacity of industrial software products and strengthen the foundational role of software in manufacturing. Cultivate a group of system solution providers, develop system solutions for key industries such as intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and intelligent factories, carry out pilot demonstrations, and enhance the capability of intelligent manufacturing system solutions. Promote the research and industrialization of key technologies in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), and conduct industry application testing and pilot demonstrations. Promote the integration and development of software and information technology service enterprises with manufacturing enterprises, and create new research and development design patterns, production and manufacturing methods, and service management models. Column 5: Industrial Technology Software Promotion Project. Research and development and application of industrial software and solutions. Support the development of a batch of industrial software products and application solutions with good application effects, strong technological innovation, and high market recognition, such as computer-aided design and simulation, manufacturing execution systems, enterprise management systems, and product lifecycle management, to meet the application needs of key aspects of intelligent manufacturing. Further breakthroughs in core technologies and products of industrial control systems, such as high-end distributed control systems, data acquisition and monitoring systems, and programmable logic controllers, to enhance safety and reliability and comprehensive integration and application capabilities, and promote in-depth application in key industries. Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems verification testing platform and industry application demonstrations. Support the research and industrialization of key technologies and system solutions for industrial Cyber-Physical Systems. Support the establishment of industrial Cyber-Physical Systems verification testing platforms and security testing and evaluation platforms. Carry out application demonstrations of Cyber-Physical Systems in key industries such as aviation, automotive, electronics, petrochemical, and metallurgy. Research and development and pilot demonstrations of industrial software platforms and apps. Support software enterprises to collaborate with industrial enterprises to build basic common software platforms and new industrial app libraries for key industries, and establish an industrial technology software system, and carry out pilot demonstrations. Support the construction of industrial app sharing and trading platforms in eligible regions or industries to enrich the industrial technology software ecosystem. Column 6: Development Project for Information Technology Services for Service-oriented Manufacturing. Support the transformation of the manufacturing industry towards production service-oriented acceleration. Guide manufacturing enterprises to establish open innovation and interaction platforms, online design centers, fully connect with user needs, and develop research and design service models based on the Internet, such as on-demand, crowdsourcing, and crowd innovation. Encourage large-scale manufacturing enterprises to develop services based on Internet platforms, such as cloud manufacturing and supply chain management, targeting the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain. Support key industrial sectors to utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and big data to develop new online service models such as product monitoring and traceability, remote diagnosis and maintenance, and product lifecycle management, and promote the upgrading of products to the high-end of the value chain. Encourage enterprises to carry out supply chain finance, financing leasing, and other new businesses based on product intelligence and online supply chain. Develop information technology services for the manufacturing industry. Promote information technology service enterprises to develop integrated solutions for the manufacturing industry, provide information technology consulting, design, and operation and maintenance services, and carry out demonstration applications and promotion. In key areas such as construction machinery, rail transportation, aviation, and shipbuilding, encourage and support the application of information technology services in smart factories, digital workshops, and green manufacturing, and promote the application and promotion of intelligent manufacturing models such as personalized customization, networked collaborative manufacturing, and service-oriented manufacturing. Vigorously develop e-commerce, encourage innovation and development of industry e-commerce platforms, support supply chain management and market sales for the manufacturing industry. Strengthen service support with supply-demand matching as the core. Explore the establishment of a public service platform for information technology services for the manufacturing industry, providing common services such as research and development testing, simulation and modeling, talent training, and equipment leasing. Strengthen the dual-drive of supply and demand, build a platform for information technology service enterprises and manufacturing enterprises to match supply and demand, establish a sound matching mechanism, promote advanced experiences, and promote cross-domain cooperation. Accelerate the development and application of information technology service standards (ITSS) for the manufacturing industry and build a sound standard system.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, deepening the promotion of application innovation and integrated development, supporting the integration of manufacturing industry and the Internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In response to the development needs of Internet Plus modern agriculture, we support the development of relevant application software, intelligent control systems, product quality and safety traceability systems, as well as the application of agricultural big data and agricultural e-commerce, focusing on agricultural production management, operation management, market circulation, and other aspects. In response to the development needs of Internet Plus energy, we support the development of key application software and solutions for the energy industry, promoting the coordination and matching of energy production and consumption. We adhere to the combination of encouraging innovation and guiding standardization, develop software products, services, and solutions related to Internet finance, and strengthen support for Internet Plus finance. We support the construction of logistics information service platforms, intelligent warehousing systems, and the research and development of embedded software for logistics equipment, enhancing the level of intelligent development in logistics. We support the research and development of software products and systems for transportation, supporting the construction of intelligent transportation, and improving the efficiency of transportation resource utilization and management precision.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, deepening the promotion of application innovation and integrated development, supporting the transformation and development of key industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: In order to address the new situation and security needs of information security development, support should be provided for the research and industrialization of key technological products, the development of specialized services such as security evaluation and certification, consulting, and early warning response, and the enhancement of information security support capabilities. The information security industry should be developed. Support should be given to the research and industrialization of information security products in the areas of basic, network and boundary security, terminal and digital content security, and security management in the cloud-edge environment. Support should also be provided for the development of security consulting and integration, security operation and maintenance management, security evaluation and certification, security risk assessment, security training, and new types of information security services. Efforts should be made to cultivate leading enterprises and develop several enterprises with strong professional capabilities and distinctive features. The integration of electronic certification with new technologies such as cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, and biometric identification should be promoted, and the promotion of reliable electronic signature applications and innovative electronic certification service models should be accelerated. Core technologies in the fields of personal data protection, trusted identity protection, identity management and verification systems should be strengthened in terms of research and development and application promotion. The industrial information security guarantee system should be improved. A coordinated design, collaborative research, information sharing, and collaborative protection system for industrial information security should be constructed. Following the principle of small core, large collaboration, a national-level research institution for industrial information system security should be established to carry out the construction of technical platforms such as national-level industrial information security simulation testing, computational analysis, and big data application, and to form national capabilities in industrial information security situation awareness, security protection, emergency support, risk warning, and industrial promotion. The policy, standard, management, technology, industry, and service systems should be improved, and policies and standards for the protection of industrial control system information security should be formulated. The inspection and assessment of industrial control system security should be strengthened, and support should be provided for the research and development of industrial control systems and their security technology products. Enterprises should be encouraged to carry out security assessments, risk verification, and security reinforcement services. Column 8: Enhance the development of key information security technologies and products for information security guarantee capabilities. Breakthroughs should be made in information security core technologies such as cryptography, trusted computing, data security, system security, and network security in emerging fields such as cloud computing, big data, and mobile internet. Support should be provided for basic security products, network and boundary security products using new technologies such as content awareness, intelligent sandboxing, anomaly detection, and virtualization, security management products based on massive data and intelligent analysis, as well as the research and application of security support tools such as security evaluation, web vulnerability scanning, internal network penetration scanning, network security protection, and source code security inspection. The construction of industrial information security guarantee capabilities should be strengthened. Typical industrial control systems and their equipment should be selected to carry out research and testing verification of key network security protection products such as industrial firewalls and identity authentication. In industries such as petrochemicals, metallurgy, and equipment manufacturing, a group of key enterprises should be selected to demonstrate the application of network security protection products. Support should be provided for the research and deployment of real-time monitoring tools for industrial control system network security in key enterprises. A number of industrial information system security laboratories should be established to prioritize the construction of public service platforms such as the verification of industrial control products and system information security standards, simulation testing, communication protocol security evaluation, monitoring and early warning, and the cultivation of third-party service organizations.
titlelist: Schedule, further enhance information security capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Persist in open innovation, grasp the opportunities of implementing national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, coordinate the use of domestic and foreign innovative elements and market resources, strengthen international exchanges and cooperation in technology, industry, talent, standardization, and other fields, take leading enterprises as the driving force to deeply integrate into the global industrial ecosystem, and enhance the level and scale of international development. Enhance the international development capabilities of industries. Support leading enterprises in establishing and improving overseas operating institutions, research and development centers, and service systems, construct overseas cooperation zones, encourage the development of cross-border e-commerce, service outsourcing, and other outward-oriented businesses, accelerate the export of software and information technology services, and build international brands. Relying on bilateral and multilateral cooperation mechanisms and platforms, strengthen the linkage between government and enterprises, carry out major cooperative demonstration projects with leading enterprises as the main body, support enterprise alliances, leverage the synergistic advantages of the industrial chain, and promote cluster-based going global. Strengthen the construction of channels and mechanisms for introducing original technologies, deepen industrial cooperation with countries and regions with strong original technological capabilities, accelerate the introduction of talents, technologies, intellectual property rights, and other advantageous innovative resources, and improve the level and utilization of cooperation in bringing in industries. Strengthen international service support. Encourage local governments to increase support and promotion for the international development of industries in terms of policies, funds, projects, etc. Support enterprises, research institutions, and other entities to actively participate in the formulation of international rules and standardization work in the field of software and information technology services, and enhance international discourse power. Play the role of intermediary organizations such as industry associations, chambers of commerce, industry alliances, and open source alliances, and provide market-oriented and socialized services for the international development of enterprises. Fully utilize means such as knowledge renewal projects and overseas talent training, support software companies in cultivating international talents and attracting outstanding overseas talents. Fifth, guarantee measures.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, accelerate the improvement of international development level.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Several Policies to Further Encourage the Development of the Software Industry and Integrated Circuit Industry (State Council Document [2011] No. 4) in depth, and study and formulate policy measures that adapt to the new characteristics of industrial development under new circumstances. Improve policy measures and mechanisms to stimulate innovation, strengthen support for the first purchase and subscription of innovative software products and services, and encourage software companies to increase research and development investment. Guide and encourage increased investment in software and information security in information technology construction. Support the formulation of policy measures to promote the integration of software technology with other industries. Further improve the relevant mechanisms and measures for encouraging government procurement of services. Support pilot projects for innovative industrial policies in areas with conditions. Encourage local areas to research and formulate policy measures to accelerate the going global of enterprises. Strengthen the implementation, evaluation, and supervision of industrial policies. Promote the improvement of the industrial-related regulatory system.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, perfecting the policy and regulatory system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Innovate fiscal funding support policies, coordinate the use of existing financial resources, and increase support for the development of the software and information technology service industry. Adopt government guidance and market-oriented operation methods to explore the establishment of a national software and information technology service industry investment fund. Support qualified localities, large enterprises, and investment institutions in setting up special funds or industry funds, innovation and entrepreneurship funds, angel investment funds, equity and mergers and acquisitions funds, and other types of funds. Encourage the use of government and social capital cooperation (PPP) model to guide social capital participation in major project construction. Improve financial service policies related to overseas mergers and acquisitions, cross-border settlements, and other areas. Deepen the integration of industry and finance, under the premise of controllable risks, promote commercial banks to innovate credit products and financial services, support the innovative development of software and information technology service enterprises, and encourage policy banks to provide credit support to eligible enterprises within the scope of their functions and positioning. Improve the financing guarantee system, perfect the risk compensation mechanism, encourage financial institutions to carry out equity mortgage, intellectual property pledge business, pilot credit insurance, technology insurance, and study the legal status and feasibility of contract pledge and qualification mortgage. Encourage enterprises to expand direct financing, support eligible enterprises to carry out accounts receivable financing, corporate credit bonds, and other new financing methods.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, increase financial and monetary support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a coordinated promotion mechanism among departments, industries, and regions, and strengthen collaborative cooperation in areas such as collaborative innovation, standard formulation, industry management, market supervision, and financial support. Guide and promote the development of industries in different regions and departments according to local conditions, reasonably arrange major application demonstration and industrialization projects, and coordinate and promote them in an orderly manner. Guide and encourage enterprises to establish multi-level cooperative innovation mechanisms with enterprises in other industries, and achieve coordinated development in areas such as technological research and development, application promotion, security guarantee, and resource allocation and utilization. Strengthen dynamic monitoring and evaluation of planning implementation to ensure the quality of planning implementation.
titlelist: Progress arrangement, strengthen overall coordination.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the transformation, upgrading, and acceleration of network construction while reducing costs. Focus on the low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage network needs of enterprises, and vigorously promote the construction of internal and external networks for industrial enterprises. Accelerate the construction and transformation of broadband network infrastructure, expand network coverage, and optimize and upgrade the national backbone network. Promote the IP (Internet Protocol), flat, flexible technological transformation and construction deployment of internal networks in industrial enterprises. Promote the application of new intelligent gateways and fully deploy IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6). Continue to promote the construction of dedicated lines for connecting small and medium-sized enterprises. Building upon the completion of the network acceleration and cost reduction tasks set out in the 2017 government work report, further increase network speed and reduce tariff levels, especially for significantly reducing the access fees for small and medium-sized enterprise internet dedicated lines. Strengthen resource openness and support the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Increase the guarantee of key resources such as radio spectrum. Promote the construction of identification resolution systems. Strengthen the top-level design of the industrial internet identification resolution system, formulate an overall architecture, clarify development goals, roadmaps, and timetables. Establish a national management institution for industrial internet identification resolution, build an identification resolution service system, support the construction of various levels of identification resolution nodes and public recursive resolution nodes, use identification to achieve precise connection between global supply chain systems and enterprise production systems, as well as cross-enterprise, cross-regional, and cross-industry product lifecycle management, and promote the integration and sharing of information resources. Column 1: Industrial Internet Infrastructure Upgrade and Transformation Project. Organize and implement the construction and upgrade of internal networks for industrial enterprises, external networks for industrial enterprises, and identification resolution systems. Support the transformation of internal networks for industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Passive Optical Network (PON), and industrial wireless, and upgrade and transform external networks for industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), and new cellular mobile communication technologies. Conduct network technology experiments for industrial internet applications in 5G research and coordinate the deployment of 5G in industrial enterprises. Carry out the construction of the industrial internet identification resolution system and establish and improve various levels of identification resolution nodes. By 2020, basically complete the upgrade and transformation of the next-generation internet and supporting management capabilities for advanced manufacturing, achieve the application of wireless network technologies such as Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) and Wireless Industrial Automation/Process (WIA-PA/FA) in key regions and industries, and initially establish supporting systems for industrial internet identification resolution registration and filing, with more than 10 public identification resolution service nodes and over 2 billion identification registrations. By 2025, widely deploy industrial internet network technologies such as industrial wireless, Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), and IPv6 in large-scale industrial enterprises; achieve universal coverage of 5G networks and low-power wide-area networks for industrial internet access; establish a fully functional industrial internet identification resolution system, with more than 20 public identification resolution service nodes and over 3 billion identification registrations.
titlelist: Basic situation, solidify network foundation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of industrial internet platforms. Break through key technological bottlenecks such as data integration, platform management, development tools, microservice frameworks, and modeling analysis, and form a technical system and industrial system that effectively support the development of industrial internet platforms. Carry out experimental verification in terms of adaptability, reliability, and security of industrial internet platforms, and promote continuous improvement of platform functions. Form a multi-level and systematic platform development system through classification, synchronous promotion, and dynamic adjustment. Relying on industrial internet platforms to create multi-level public platforms that serve mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Enhance platform operational capabilities. Strengthen the resource aggregation capabilities of industrial internet platforms, effectively integrate data resources such as product design, production processes, equipment operations, and operational management, and gather and share manufacturing resources such as design capabilities, production capabilities, software resources, and knowledge models. Carry out application innovation for different industries and scenarios, providing users with various applications including equipment health maintenance, production management optimization, collaborative design and manufacturing, and manufacturing resource leasing, and enhance service capabilities. Continuously explore business model innovation, expand platform profit space through resource rental, service provision, industry-finance cooperation, etc., and achieve long-term sustainable operation. Column 2: Construction and promotion of industrial internet platform engineering. Focus on both the supply and demand sides of industrial internet platforms, and carry out construction and promotion in four aspects: First, cultivate industrial internet platforms. Through enterprise-led, market-driven, and dynamically adjusted approaches, form cross-industry, cross-domain platforms, achieve interconnection and interoperability among multiple platforms, undertake functions such as resource aggregation and sharing, technology standard testing and verification, and provide services such as industrial data circulation, business resource management, and industrial operation monitoring. Promote leading enterprises to actively develop enterprise-level platforms and develop various solutions that meet the needs of enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent development. Establish and improve the technical system of industrial internet platforms. Second, conduct trial verification of industrial internet platforms. Support industry alliances, cooperation between enterprises and research institutions to jointly build test verification platforms, and carry out technology verification and testing evaluation. Third, migrate millions of enterprises to the cloud. Encourage the landing of industrial internet platforms in industrial agglomeration areas, and promote local governments to encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to migrate their business systems to the cloud through financial and tax support, government procurement of services, and other means. Fourth, cultivate millions of industrial apps. Support software companies, industrial enterprises, research institutes, etc., to cooperate and cultivate a batch of industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios. By 2020, the industrial internet platform system will initially take shape, supporting the construction of about 10 cross-industry, cross-domain platforms, and building a batch of enterprise-level platforms that support enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent transformation. Cultivate 300,000 industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios, promote 300,000 enterprises to use industrial internet platforms for research and development, design, production, manufacturing, and operational management, and the fundamental and supportive role of industrial internet platforms in industrial transformation and upgrading will begin to emerge. By 2025, key industries in the industrial sector will achieve networked manufacturing, the industrial internet platform system will be basically improved, 3-5 industrial internet platforms with international competitiveness will be formed, millions of industrial apps will be cultivated, millions of enterprises will migrate to the cloud, and a new manufacturing ecology of mutual iteration and promotion of platform construction and platform utilization will be formed.
titlelist: Basic situation, building platform system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Increase the efforts in key common technology research. Conduct research on new network interconnection technologies such as time-sensitive networks, deterministic networks, and low-power industrial wireless networks, and accelerate the application research of 5G, software-defined networks, and other technologies in the industrial internet. Promote research on key technologies and secure and reliable mechanisms for industrial internet identification resolution, information management, and heterogeneous identification interoperability. Accelerate the research on core technologies such as IPv6. Promote the application research and exploration of emerging frontier technologies such as edge computing, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, virtual reality, and blockchain in the industrial internet. Build an industrial internet standard system. Establish a national industrial internet standard coordination and promotion group, an overall group, and an expert advisory group to coordinate the construction of the industrial internet standard system, optimize the promotion mechanism, and accelerate the establishment of a unified, comprehensive, and open industrial internet standard system. Develop a series of overall standards, basic common standards, application standards, and security standards. Organize standard development and test verification projects, and promote the development and promotion of standard content test verification, test verification environment construction, simulation and testing tool development. Column 3: Standard development and test verification projects. Carry out the development of industrial internet standards based on the standardization needs and standard system construction of the industrial internet. Develop overall standards such as general requirements, system architecture, and testing and evaluation; develop basic common standards such as network and digital interconnection interfaces, identification resolution, industrial internet platforms, and security; develop industry application guidelines, specific technical standards, and management specifications for key industries such as automotive, aerospace, petrochemical, machinery manufacturing, light industry and home appliances, information electronics, etc. Organize the test verification of relevant standards and promote the development of supporting simulation and testing tools. By 2020, initially establish an industrial internet standard system, formulate more than 20 overall and key basic common standards, formulate more than 20 key industry standards, and promote the application of standards in key enterprises and industries. By 2025, basically establish a standard system covering key technologies, products, management, and applications of the industrial internet, and widely apply it in enterprises. Enhance product and solution supply capabilities. Accelerate the research and industrialization of information and communication, data integration and analysis, and focus on breakthroughs in key software and hardware products and solutions such as high-performance networks, intelligent modules, intelligent networking equipment, and industrial software. Focus on improving the integration and innovation level of data analysis algorithms with industrial knowledge, mechanisms, and experience, and develop a batch of industrial data analysis software and systems for different industrial scenarios, as well as industrial intelligence software and solutions with deep learning and other artificial intelligence technologies. Create overall solutions for the industrial internet closely integrated with industry characteristics to meet the needs of the top ten key areas and the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries. Guide telecommunications operators, internet companies, and industrial enterprises to actively transform, strengthen the operation services of the industrial internet such as network operation, identification resolution, and security, and develop innovative productive services such as industrial e-commerce, supply chain, and related financial information. Column 4: Key technology industrialization projects. Promote research and application of emerging frontier technologies such as new network interconnection and identification resolution in the industrial internet, establish technology test verification systems, and support technology and product test verification. Focus on key industrial links of the industrial internet and actively promote the industrialization of key technologies. Accelerate the industrialization of key network equipment for the industrial internet, develop key technologies and products such as IPv6, industrial passive optical networks, time-sensitive networks, industrial wireless networks, low-power wide area networks, software-defined networks, and identification resolution. Develop and promote key intelligent networked equipment, focus on key areas such as numerical control machine tools, industrial robots, large-scale power equipment, etc., achieve integrated innovation of intelligent control, intelligent sensing, industrial-grade chips, and network communication modules, and develop a series of new intelligent equipment with networking, computing, and optimization functions. Develop industrial big data analysis software, focus on key areas, develop industrial big data analysis application software around application scenarios such as production process optimization, quality analysis, predictive maintenance of equipment, intelligent scheduling, etc., and achieve industrial deployment. By 2020, make breakthroughs in a batch of key technologies, establish more than 5 technology test verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment with advanced domestic levels, and have active innovation in intelligent networked products, achieving quick access to functions such as industrial big data cleaning, management, and analysis, and promote the application of technology and products in key enterprises and industries, and achieve initial industrialization of key technologies of the industrial internet. By 2025, master key core technologies, effectively support the research and experimentation of industrial internet technology products through technology test verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment that reaches international advanced levels, achieve large-scale commercial deployment of intelligent networked products and industrial big data analysis application software, and form a relatively sound industrial internet industry system.
titlelist: Basic situation, strengthen industrial support.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the innovation and application level of industrial internet in large enterprises. Accelerate the application of industrial internet in industrial sites, strengthen the networking and data collection capabilities of equipment in complex production processes, and achieve end-to-end integration of data resources at all levels of the enterprise. Carry out data integration applications based on the industrial internet platform, form the ability of process optimization, workflow optimization, equipment maintenance, and accident risk warning based on data analysis and feedback, and realize intelligent decision-making and deep optimization of enterprise production and operation management. Encourage enterprises to integrate resources through the industrial internet platform, build a collaborative manufacturing system for design, production, and supply chain. Promote large-scale customization based on user individual needs and precise connection between product design and production in terms of quality traceability, equipment health management, and value-added services. Accelerate the popularization of industrial internet applications in small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the deployment and application of low-cost, modular industrial internet equipment and systems in small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance their digital and networked capabilities. Encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to fully utilize the cloud-based research and development design, production management, and operation optimization software of the industrial internet platform, realize the migration of business systems to the cloud, and reduce the cost of digital and intelligent transformation.
