Guide small and medium-sized enterprises to open up professional knowledge, design creativity, and manufacturing capabilities, and carry out innovative applications such as supply-demand docking, integrated supply chain, industrial e-commerce, and crowdsourcing and crowdfunding based on the industrial internet platform to improve the efficiency of social manufacturing resource allocation. Column 5: Industrial Internet Integration and Innovation Application Engineering. Guided by pioneering applications, organize and carry out innovative application demonstrations, and gradually explore the implementation path and application models of the industrial internet. In terms of intelligent production applications, encourage large industrial enterprises to achieve extensive interconnection between various production equipment and information systems and the integration and interoperability of related industrial data, and develop applications such as quality optimization, intelligent scheduling, and supply chain optimization based on this. In terms of remote service applications, carry out networked services for high-value intelligent equipment, realize remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and other remote service applications, and explore the development of remote services for comprehensive support in the defense industry. In terms of networked collaborative manufacturing applications, focus on the intelligent development needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, carry out collaborative design, crowdsourcing, cloud manufacturing, and other innovative applications, and realize online access to various industrial software and modular design and manufacturing resources. In terms of intelligent internet of things product applications, focus on areas such as smart homes, wearable devices, etc., integrate advanced technologies such as 5G, deep learning, and big data, and meet typical needs such as high-precision positioning, intelligent human-computer interaction, and secure and trustworthy operation and maintenance. In terms of identification resolution and integration applications, implement integrated innovation applications of industrial internet identification resolution system and industrial enterprise information system, support enterprises in exploring key product traceability based on identification services, multi-source heterogeneous data sharing, and lifecycle management applications. By 2020, a strong influence of industrial internet pioneering application models will be initially formed, and around 150 application pilots will be established. By 2025, expand the scope of industrial internet applications, fully promote them in the top ten key areas and key traditional industries, and achieve significant overall improvement in enterprise efficiency.
titlelist: Basic situation, promoting integration and application.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Enhance security protection capabilities. Strengthen research on the security system of the industrial internet, combining technology and management, and establish a multi-level security guarantee system for the industrial internet covering equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security. Increase support for technology research and development and the transformation of achievements, with a focus on breakthroughs in core technologies such as secure identification and resolution systems, industrial internet platform security, industrial control system security, and industrial big data security. Promote the development of security products such as attack protection, vulnerability discovery, intrusion detection, situational awareness, security auditing, and trusted chips, establishing technical support capabilities that match the development of the industrial internet. Build a security assessment and certification system for industrial internet devices, networks, and platforms, and conduct security capability assessments and certifications through third-party organizations such as industry alliances, leading to continuous improvement in the security protection capabilities of the industrial internet. Establish a data security protection system. Establish a comprehensive data security management system for the entire industrial internet industry chain, clarify the data security protection responsibilities and specific requirements of relevant entities, and strengthen the security protection capabilities of data collection, storage, processing, transfer, deletion, and other processes. Establish a classification and management system for industrial data, form a management mechanism for the flow of industrial internet data, clarify requirements for data retention and data leakage reporting, and strengthen supervision and inspection of industrial internet data security. Promote the construction of security technology means. Urge relevant enterprises in the industrial internet to fulfill their responsibilities as the main body of network security, guide enterprises to increase security investment, strengthen the construction of security protection and monitoring and disposal technology means, carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial internet security, and enhance security protection capabilities. Actively leverage the guiding role of relevant industry alliances, integrate industry resources, encourage alliance units to innovate service models, provide security operation and maintenance, security consulting, and other services, and enhance the overall security guarantee service capabilities of the industry. Give full play to the role of national professional institutions and social forces, enhance the national-level industrial internet security technology support capabilities, and focus on improving the capabilities of hazard investigation, attack detection, emergency disposal, and attack traceability. Column 7: Security protection capability enhancement project. Promote the improvement of national-level industrial internet security technology capabilities. Build platforms such as industrial internet security monitoring, early warning, and protection and disposal platforms, industrial internet security core technology research and development platforms, industrial internet security testing and evaluation platforms, and industrial internet test fields. Guide enterprises to enhance their own industrial internet security protection capabilities. In key areas with good foundations such as automobiles, electronics, aerospace, energy, and urgent security needs such as the defense industry, establish industrial internet security management and technology systems, carry out pilot demonstrations and industry applications of security products and solutions. By 2020, conduct targeted inspections and assessments based on the distribution of important industrial internet platforms and systems; initially establish an industrial internet security monitoring, early warning, and protection and disposal platform; cultivate and form 3-5 industrial internet security enterprises with core competitiveness; select a batch of innovative and practical network security pilot demonstration projects for promotion. By 2025, form a series of standards covering industrial internet equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security, establish a sound industrial internet security certification system; comprehensively promote the application of industrial internet security products and services; significantly enhance the network security protection capabilities of industrial internet-related enterprises; and basically establish a national-level industrial internet security technology support system.
titlelist: Basic situation, strengthening security guarantee.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the international development capabilities of enterprises. Encourage domestic and foreign enterprises to collaborate on technical research and product development in weak areas such as big data analysis, industrial data modeling, key software systems, and chips. Establish international cooperation mechanisms in industrial internet technology, products, platforms, and services, and promote the introduction and export of industrial internet platforms, integrated solutions, and more. Encourage close collaboration among domestic and foreign enterprises across different sectors and the entire industry chain. Strengthen multilateral dialogue and cooperation. Establish multi-level communication and dialogue mechanisms among governments, industry alliances, and enterprises to exchange and cooperate on major issues related to the latest development of industrial internet, global infrastructure construction, data flow, security, policies, and regulations. Enhance collaboration with international organizations to jointly formulate industrial internet standards and international rules, and build a multilateral, democratic, and transparent international governance system for the industrial internet.
titlelist: Basic situation, promoting openness and cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the role of fiscal funds in guiding, and increase support for the development of industrial internet through funds for industrial transformation and upgrading, with a focus on supporting the construction of network systems, platform systems, and security systems. Explore support methods such as first purchase and preferential purchase to promote the large-scale application of innovative products and services in the industrial internet. Encourage eligible regions to support the development of local industrial internet clusters by establishing special funds for industrial internet and establishing risk compensation funds. Implement relevant tax preferential policies to promote accelerated depreciation of fixed assets, additional deduction of enterprise R&D expenses, tax incentives for software and integrated circuit industry enterprises, and tax incentives for small and micro enterprises, and encourage relevant enterprises to accelerate the development and application of industrial internet.
titlelist: Ensure support and increase financial and tax support.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the expansion of the proportion of direct financing, support industrial internet companies that meet the conditions to carry out equity financing in domestic and foreign capital markets at all levels, actively promote the application of project income bonds, convertible bonds, corporate bonds, and company bonds in the field of industrial internet, and guide various types of investment funds to tilt towards the field of industrial internet. Increase support for targeted credit assistance, improve the mechanism for banks to connect with enterprises, and provide loan services for technological, business, and application innovations in the field of industrial internet; encourage banking and financial institutions to innovate credit products, explore and develop pledge loan businesses such as data assets, under the premise of compliance with laws and regulations, controllable risks, and sustainable business. Extend the scope of financial services for the industrial chain, encourage eligible enterprise groups to establish financial companies to provide financial management services for industrial internet companies under the group, strengthen centralized fund management, improve the efficiency of fund utilization, and reduce the cost of funds. Expand targeted insurance services, support insurance companies in developing corresponding insurance products based on the needs of the industrial internet.
titlelist: Guarantee support, innovate financial service methods.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the innovative driving role of the Internet, with a focus on promoting entrepreneurship and innovation, and promote the gathering, openness, and sharing of various elements and resources. Vigorously develop maker spaces, open innovation, etc., guide and promote the formation of a strong atmosphere of mass entrepreneurship and innovation throughout society, and create a new engine for economic development. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Commerce, etc., with the first listed being the leading department, and the same for the following).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Entrepreneurship and Innovation

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage large-scale internet companies and basic telecommunications companies to utilize their technological advantages and integration capabilities to open up platform access, data information, computing power, and other resources to small and micro enterprises and entrepreneurial teams. Provide support and services in research and development tools, business management, and marketing, etc., to improve the level of information application in small and micro enterprises and cultivate and incubate entrepreneurial enterprises with good business models. Make full use of the basic conditions of the internet, improve the public service platform network for small and micro enterprises, gather entrepreneurial and innovative resources, and provide accessible, affordable, and guaranteed services for small and micro enterprises.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ entrepreneurship and innovation, strengthen support for entrepreneurship and innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the advantages of open innovation on the Internet, mobilize the entire society, and support the development of new types of crowd innovation spaces such as innovation factories, maker spaces, social laboratories, and smart small business incubators. Make full use of existing conditions such as national independent innovation demonstration zones, technology enterprise incubators, university science and technology parks, trade enterprise clusters, and small and micro enterprise entrepreneurship demonstration bases. Through market-oriented approaches, build a group of crowd innovation spaces that combine innovation and entrepreneurship, online and offline, incubation and investment, providing entrepreneurs with low-cost, convenient, all-element workspaces, online spaces, social spaces, and resource sharing spaces. Implement the double innovation action in emerging industries, establish a group of demonstration bases for double innovation in emerging industries, and accelerate the development of the Internet Plus entrepreneurship network system.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ entrepreneurship and innovation, actively developing mass innovation spaces.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage various innovative entities to fully utilize the Internet, grasp market demand orientation, strengthen the sharing and cooperation of innovative resources, promote the timely transformation of cutting-edge technology and innovation achievements, and build an open innovation system. Promote the linkage and cooperation between various entrepreneurship and innovation support policies and Internet open platforms, and provide green channel services for entrepreneurial teams and individual developers. Accelerate the development of the entrepreneurship service industry, actively promote new research and development organizational models such as crowdsourcing, user participation in design, and cloud design, guide the establishment of platforms for social exchanges and cooperation, and promote the transfer and collaborative innovation of technological achievements across regions and fields.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ entrepreneurship and innovation, development of open innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the integration of the Internet and manufacturing industry, enhance the level of digitization, networking, and intelligence in the manufacturing industry, strengthen industrial chain collaboration, and develop new models of collaborative manufacturing based on the Internet. Promote intelligent manufacturing, large-scale personalized customization, networked collaborative manufacturing, and service-oriented manufacturing in key areas, and build a number of networked collaborative manufacturing public service platforms to accelerate the formation of a networked manufacturing industry ecosystem. (Led jointly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Science and Technology).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Collaborative Manufacturing

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: With smart factories as the development direction, we will carry out pilot demonstrations of intelligent manufacturing, accelerate the application of technologies such as cloud computing, the Internet of Things, smart industrial robots, and additive manufacturing in the production process, promote the intelligent upgrading of production equipment, the transformation of process flows, and the sharing of basic data. We will focus on breakthroughs in key areas such as industrial control systems, intelligent sensing components, industrial cloud platforms, operating systems, and industrial software, strengthen the development and utilization of industrial big data, effectively support the intelligent transformation of the manufacturing industry, and build an open, shared, and collaborative ecosystem for the intelligent manufacturing industry.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, vigorously develop intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support enterprises in utilizing the Internet to collect and connect with personalized user demands, promote flexible transformation in key areas such as design research and development, production manufacturing, and supply chain management, and carry out service and business model innovation based on personalized products. Encourage Internet companies to integrate market information, explore segmented market demands and development trends, and provide decision-making support for manufacturing enterprises to carry out personalized customization.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, development of large-scale personalized customization.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage backbone manufacturing enterprises to closely collaborate with various links in the industrial chain through the Internet, promote comprehensive interconnection of production, quality control, and operation management systems, and implement new models such as crowdsourcing design and development and networked manufacturing. Encourage capable Internet companies to build networked collaborative manufacturing public service platforms, provide cloud manufacturing services for segmented industries, promote the aggregation and connection of innovative resources, production capacity, and market demand, enhance the capabilities of serving small and micro enterprises, accelerate the effective collaboration of diversified manufacturing resources in the whole society, and improve the integration capability of industrial chain resources.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, improving the level of networked collaborative manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage manufacturing enterprises to utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and big data to integrate data throughout the entire product lifecycle, forming decision-making service information for the entire production process. Provide data support for product optimization and upgrades. Encourage enterprises to conduct online value-added services such as fault warning, remote maintenance, quality diagnosis, and remote process optimization based on the Internet, expanding the value space of products and achieving the transformation and upgrading from manufacturing to 'manufacturing + services'.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ collaborative manufacturing, accelerating the transformation of manufacturing industry towards service-oriented.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Utilize the internet to enhance the level of agricultural production, operation, management, and services. Cultivate a batch of modern 'agriculture-breeding-processing' ecological agriculture new models that are networked, intelligent, and refined. Form demonstration and driving effects, accelerate the improvement of the new agricultural production and operation system, cultivate diversified agricultural internet management service models, gradually establish a traceability system for the quality and safety of agricultural by-products and agricultural materials, and promote a significant improvement in the level of agricultural modernization. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Agriculture, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Administration for Market Regulation, State Forestry Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Modern Agriculture

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage internet companies to establish agricultural service platforms, support new agricultural production and operation entities such as professional large-scale households, family farms, farmer cooperatives, and leading agricultural industrialization enterprises, strengthen the connection between production and sales, and achieve a shift in agricultural production from production-oriented to consumption-oriented. Improve the level of technological, organizational, and refined management in agricultural production and operation, promote changes in agricultural production circulation and sales methods, and transform the development mode of agriculture, enhancing agricultural production efficiency and value-added space. Standardize the use of rural land transfer public service platforms, improve the transparency of land transfer, and safeguard the rights and interests of farmers.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus modern agriculture, building a new agricultural production and operation system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote mature and replicable agricultural Internet of Things application models. In areas and regions with a good foundation, popularize networked agricultural environmental monitoring systems based on environmental perception, real-time monitoring, and automatic control. In large-scale agricultural production areas, establish an integrated agricultural Internet of Things measurement and control system, implement precision operations such as intelligent water-saving irrigation, soil testing and formula fertilization, and precision farming with agricultural machinery positioning. In standardized large-scale livestock and poultry farming bases and healthy aquaculture demonstration bases, promote the application and interconnection of intelligent devices such as precise feed delivery, automatic disease diagnosis, and automatic waste recycling.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ modern agriculture, developing precision production methods.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Deepen the pilot project of bringing information into villages and households, and encourage the use of mobile internet to provide farmers with information services on policies, markets, technology, insurance, and other aspects of production and life. Support cooperation between internet companies and agricultural production and operation entities, comprehensively utilize technologies such as big data and cloud computing, establish an agricultural information monitoring system, and provide services for disaster warning, farmland quality monitoring, prevention and control of major animal and plant epidemics, market fluctuation prediction, and scientific decision-making in operations.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ modern agriculture, improving the level of networked services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Make full use of existing internet resources to build a public service platform for the traceability of agricultural and sideline products' quality and safety, promote institutional and standard construction, and establish a mechanism for connecting the origin certification and market access. Support new agricultural production and operation entities in utilizing internet technology to achieve refined and informatized management of production and operation processes, accelerate the promotion and application of mobile internet, internet of things, QR codes, wireless radio frequency identification, and other information technologies in production, processing, and distribution sales, strengthen the connection and information exchange of upstream and downstream traceability systems, continuously expand the coverage of the traceability system, achieve full traceability of agricultural and sideline products from the field to the dining table, and ensure food safety.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + modern agriculture, improving the quality and safety traceability system of agricultural and sideline products.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the flattening of the energy system through the Internet, advance the revolution of energy production and consumption patterns, improve energy efficiency, and promote energy conservation and emission reduction. Strengthen the construction of distributed energy networks, increase the proportion of renewable energy, and promote the optimization of energy utilization structure. Accelerate the intelligent transformation of power generation facilities, power consumption facilities, and power grids, and improve the safety, stability, and reliability of the power system. (Responsibilities include the Energy Bureau, Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, etc.).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Smart Energy

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a public service network for monitoring, managing, and dispatching energy production operations, strengthen the information exchange and intelligent production and consumption of upstream and downstream enterprises in the energy industry chain, support the coordinated operation of power plants and power grids, and promote the collaborative generation of non-fossil energy and fossil energy. Encourage energy companies to use big data technology to analyze, mine, and predict data such as equipment status and power load, carry out precise scheduling, fault diagnosis, and predictive maintenance, and improve energy utilization efficiency and the level of safe and stable operation.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + Smart Energy, promoting intelligent energy production.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a multi-energy coordinated and complementary energy internet with renewable energy such as solar energy and wind energy as the main body. Breakthrough key technologies such as distributed generation, energy storage, smart microgrids, and active distribution networks, and construct an intelligent power operation monitoring and management technology platform. Enable bidirectional communication and intelligent control of power equipment and electricity end-users based on the Internet, achieve timely and effective access of distributed power sources, and gradually build an open and shared energy network.
titlelist: Key action, Internet +  smart energy, construction of distributed energy network.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the pilot of the green power trading service area, advance the development of a green energy network that integrates energy storage facilities, the Internet of Things, smart power consumption facilities, as well as carbon trading and internet finance services, with the intelligent power grid as the distribution platform and e-commerce as the trading platform. This aims to achieve point-to-point trading and real-time distribution of green power, as well as subsidy settlement. Further strengthen the coordination between energy production and consumption, promote the application of energy substitution technologies such as electric vehicles and shore power in ports, promote demand-side management of electricity, and improve energy utilization efficiency. Based on distributed energy networks, develop intelligent energy consumption at the user end, energy sharing economy, and energy free trade to promote the construction of an energy consumption ecological system.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + Smart Energy, exploring new models of energy consumption.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the project of bringing electricity optical fiber to households and improve the information communication system of the energy internet. Coordinate the deployment of network infrastructure that deeply integrates power grids and communication networks, achieve transmission through the same cable, and promote joint construction and sharing to avoid redundant construction. Encourage the development of new businesses such as home energy efficiency management based on smart grids.
titlelist: Key action, Internet +  smart energy, development of communication facilities and new businesses based on the power grid.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the healthy development of internet finance, comprehensively enhance the internet finance service capabilities and inclusiveness, encourage the integration and innovation of the internet with banking, securities, insurance, and funds, provide the public with abundant, secure, and convenient financial products and services, better meet the investment and financing needs of entities at different levels of the real economy, and cultivate a group of internet finance innovative enterprises with industry influence. (Responsible parties include the People's Bank of China, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, China Securities Regulatory Commission, China Insurance Regulatory Commission, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration of China, etc.)
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Inclusive Finance

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Explore the construction of an internet financial cloud service platform for internet companies. Based on ensuring technological maturity and business security, support financial enterprises to cooperate with cloud computing technology providers to carry out financial public cloud services, providing diversified, personalized, and precise financial products. Support banks, securities, and insurance companies in implementing system architecture transformation in a stable manner, encourage exploration of conducting core financial business using cloud service platforms, and provide public services such as credit, authentication, and interfaces based on the financial cloud service platform.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus inclusive finance, explore and promote the construction of Internet financial cloud service platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage financial institutions to utilize technologies such as cloud computing, mobile internet, and big data to accelerate innovation in financial products and services, and provide convenient financial services such as loans, payment settlements, and credit intermediation platforms in a wider range of areas. Expand the scope of inclusive financial services, and provide effective support for the development of the real economy. Support financial institutions and internet companies in conducting online lending, online securities, online insurance, and internet fund sales in compliance with laws and regulations. Expand the pilot program for specialized internet insurance companies, and fully leverage the role of the insurance industry in preventing risks in internet finance. Promote the comprehensive application of financial integrated circuit cards (IC cards), and enhance the usage and convenience of electronic cash. Harness the role of the Mobile Financial Security and Trustworthy Public Service Platform (MTPS), actively promote commercial banks to develop innovative applications in mobile finance, and facilitate the large-scale application of mobile finance in e-commerce, public services, and other fields. Support banking financial institutions in developing consumer credit business with the help of internet technology, and support financial leasing companies in conducting financial leasing business using internet technology.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus inclusive finance, encourages financial institutions to use the Internet to expand service coverage.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage internet companies to provide innovative financial products and services in compliance with the law, in order to better meet the investment and financing needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, innovative enterprises, and individuals. Regulate the development of online lending and internet consumer credit businesses, and explore innovations in internet financial services. Actively guide venture capital funds, private equity investment funds, and industrial investment funds to invest in internet financial enterprises. Utilize big data to develop market-oriented personal credit services and accelerate the construction of online credit and credit evaluation systems. Strengthen the protection of consumer rights and interests in internet finance and investor protection, and establish a diversified mechanism for resolving financial consumer disputes. Improve and enhance the regulation of internet finance, enhance the security of financial services, and effectively prevent internet financial risks and their spillover effects.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus inclusive finance, actively expanding the depth and breadth of innovation in internet financial services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the efficient and convenient advantages of the Internet, improve resource utilization efficiency, and reduce service consumption costs. Vigorously develop emerging consumption that is carried out through the Internet and involves online and offline interactions, accelerate the development of emerging services based on the Internet, such as healthcare, elderly care, education, tourism, and social security, innovate government service models, and enhance the government's scientific decision-making ability and management level. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Civil Affairs, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Administration for Market Regulation, Forestry Bureau, Tourism Bureau, Cyberspace Administration, and Bureau of Letters and Calls).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Benefiting the People's Services

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop the experience economy, support physical retailers to comprehensively utilize online stores, mobile payments, smart fitting rooms, and other new technologies to create an experiential shopping model. Develop the community economy, cultivate new models of community services that combine online and offline in the fields of catering, entertainment, and household services. Develop the sharing economy, regulate the development of online car rental services, actively promote online rental housing, and focus on overcoming barriers such as high entry thresholds, lack of service standards, and personal credit constraints. Develop internet-based cultural, media, and tourism services, and cultivate diverse new formats. Actively promote urban services based on mobile internet access, carry out online social security processing, personal social security rights inquiries, cross-regional medical insurance settlements, and other internet applications, allowing the general public to enjoy convenient and efficient services without leaving their homes.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ benefits the people's services, developing new formats of convenient services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the innovation and application of smart health products, promote comprehensive quantified health lifestyles. Encourage health service institutions to build public information platforms using technologies such as cloud computing and big data, providing personalized health management services with long-term tracking, prediction, and early warning. Develop third-party online health market research, consulting evaluation, prevention management, and other application services to improve standardization and professional operation levels. Relying on existing internet resources and social forces, build a network platform for elderly information services based on communities, providing home-based elderly care services such as nursing, health management, and rehabilitation. Encourage elderly service institutions to use portable devices based on mobile internet, such as portable medical examinations and emergency call monitoring, to improve the level of elderly care services.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus benefits the people's services, promotes the development of the smart healthcare and elderly care industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage internet companies and social educational institutions to develop digital educational resources and provide online education services based on market demand. Encourage schools to gradually explore new models of online education using digital educational resources and educational service platforms, expand the coverage of high-quality educational resources, and promote educational equity. Encourage schools to collaborate with internet companies and other means to integrate online and offline educational resources, explore new ways of providing public services in basic education and vocational education. Promote the sharing of online course resources for academic education, promote large-scale online open courses and other online learning models, explore the establishment of systems for recognizing and converting credits in online learning, and accelerate the transformation of higher education service models.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus benefits the people's services, exploring new ways of providing educational services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of a cross-industry and cross-regional logistics information service platform to improve the efficiency of logistics supply and demand information docking and utilization. Encourage the application of big data and cloud computing in the field of logistics, build an intelligent warehousing system, optimize logistics operation processes, enhance the automation, intelligence, and operational efficiency of logistics warehousing, and reduce logistics costs. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Transport, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Key Action, Internet+ Efficient Logistics

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Leverage the advantages of internet information aggregation, integrate various logistics information resources, encourage leading logistics companies and third-party organizations to build logistics information service platforms for the society, integrate warehousing, transportation, and distribution information, carry out full-process monitoring and early warning of logistics, improve logistics safety, environmental protection, and integrity levels, and coordinate and optimize the allocation of social logistics resources. Construct an interconnected logistics information network that connects provinces, cities, counties, and rural areas, establish mechanisms for data integration of various open data, accelerate the improvement of logistics information exchange open standards system, and promote full sharing and interconnection of logistics information in a wider range.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ efficient logistics, building a logistics information sharing and interconnection system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the application of Internet of Things sensing technologies such as QR codes and wireless radio frequency identification in various storage units at all levels, as well as big data technologies, to achieve real-time tracking of storage facilities and goods, networked management, and highly shared inventory information, thereby improving the efficiency of goods dispatching. Encourage the use of intelligent logistics equipment to enhance the efficiency of storage, transportation, sorting, packaging, and other operations, improve the handling capacity of various complex orders, alleviate the bottleneck constraints of goods accumulation and stagnation, and enhance the level and efficiency of storage and transportation management.
titlelist: Key action, Internet +  efficient logistics, construction of deep perception intelligent warehousing system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the promotion of the networking of freight vehicles and the interconnection of logistics parks, storage facilities, and distribution points, etc., to facilitate efficient matching of personnel, goods, and vehicles information, effectively reduce the empty running rate of trucks, and improve distribution efficiency. Encourage the development of new community-based delivery models such as community pick-up lockers, cold chain storage lockers, and collection service points, combined with the construction of logistics information interconnection networks, to accelerate the development of logistics distribution networks from counties to villages and the construction of village-level distribution points, and solve the last mile problem of logistics distribution.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ efficient logistics, improve intelligent logistics distribution and allocation system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Consolidate and enhance the leading advantage of China's e-commerce development, vigorously develop rural e-commerce, industry e-commerce, and cross-border e-commerce, and further expand the development space of e-commerce. The integration of e-commerce with other industries continues to deepen, and networked production, circulation, and consumption are becoming more popular. The supporting environment, such as standardization, regulations, and public services, is basically improved. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture, General Administration of Customs, State Taxation Administration, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and Cyberspace Administration, etc.).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus E-commerce

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote comprehensive demonstrations of e-commerce in rural areas, support the integration of new agricultural management entities and agricultural products/agricultural supplies wholesale markets with e-commerce platforms, and actively develop a production-oriented sales model. Improve the rural e-commerce distribution and comprehensive service network, focus on solving key issues such as standardization of agricultural and sideline products, logistics standardization, and cold chain warehousing construction, and develop personalized customization services for agricultural products. Carry out pilot projects for fresh agricultural products and agricultural production materials e-commerce, and promote the development of e-commerce for agricultural commodities.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus e-commerce, actively developing rural e-commerce.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage companies in industries such as energy, chemicals, steel, electronics, textiles, and pharmaceuticals to actively utilize e-commerce platforms to optimize their procurement and distribution systems, and enhance operational efficiency. Promote the online transformation of various professional markets, guide the integration of traditional trade and distribution enterprises with e-commerce companies, and actively transition towards supply chain collaboration platforms. Encourage manufacturing companies to deepen the application of e-commerce in response to personalized and customized consumer demands, support equipment manufacturing companies in providing financing and leasing services through e-commerce platforms, and encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to expand their use of e-commerce. Vigorously promote electronic bidding and tendering in accordance with market-oriented and specialized directions.
titlelist: Key action, vigorously developing industry e-commerce through 'Internet+'.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage enterprises to utilize the big data resources of e-commerce platforms, enhance their precision marketing capabilities, and stimulate market consumption demand. Establish a mechanism for tracing the quality of e-commerce products, construct a cloud platform for quality testing of after-sales services in e-commerce, improve the public service system for internet quality information, and address issues such as difficulties in consumer rights protection, returns, and product liability tracing. Strengthen the construction of the monitoring and regulatory system for the internet food and drug market. Actively explore innovative models for the e-commerce sales and regulation of prescription drugs. Encourage enterprises to utilize new channels such as mobile social media and new media to develop new models of network marketing, such as social e-commerce and fan economy.
titlelist: Key action, 'Internet+' e-commerce, promoting innovation in e-commerce applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the development of various cross-border e-commerce service providers, improve the cross-border logistics system, and expand global economic and trade cooperation. Promote the construction of a comprehensive service system for key processes such as customs clearance, inspection and quarantine, and foreign exchange settlement in cross-border e-commerce through a single window. Innovate cross-border rights protection mechanisms, utilize qualification assessment methods, and promote international mutual recognition. Innovate cross-border e-commerce management, promote smooth information networks, convenient cross-border logistics, unimpeded payment and settlement, standardized tax regulations, and mutual recognition of market and trade rules.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus e-commerce, strengthen international cooperation in e-commerce.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the deep integration of the Internet and transportation sector, promote the Internet-based development of convenient transportation services through infrastructure, transportation tools, operational information, etc., significantly improve the efficiency of transportation resource utilization and the level of refined management, comprehensively enhance the service quality and scientific governance capabilities of the transportation industry. (Led jointly by the National Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Transport).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Convenient Transportation

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote transportation authorities and enterprises to open up service-oriented data resources to the public. Encourage internet platforms to provide real-time traffic operation status inquiries, travel route planning, online ticketing, smart parking, and other services to the general public. Advance the integration of various travel information services based on internet platforms and one-stop services. Accelerate the improvement of automobile health records, maintenance diagnosis, and service quality information service platform construction.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + convenient transportation, improve the quality of transportation services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things and mobile internet to further strengthen the collection of operational status and traffic information of key facilities in transportation networks such as highways, railways, civil aviation, and ports. Promote interconnection and interoperability of transportation information across regions and modes, and popularize the application of intelligent technologies such as ship networking and vehicle networking, forming a more comprehensive transportation perception system. Improve the level of online resources for infrastructure, transportation vehicles, and operational information, fully supporting fault warning, operation maintenance, and intelligent scheduling.
titlelist: Key action, Internet+ convenient transportation, promote the online integration of transportation resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the deep integration of the Internet and ecological civilization construction, improve the monitoring and information release system for pollutants, establish a dynamic monitoring network for resource and environmental carrying capacity covering major ecological elements, and achieve interconnection and open sharing of ecological environment data. Give full play to the role of the Internet as a platform in the reverse logistics recycling system, promote the convenient, interactive, and transparent utilization of recycled resources, and promote the greening of production and lifestyle (responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Commerce, State Forestry Administration, etc.).
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Green Ecology

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In order to address various ecological elements such as energy, mineral resources, water, atmosphere, forests, grasslands, wetlands, and oceans, we will fully utilize multidimensional geographic information systems, smart maps, and other technologies. By combining them with big data analysis from the internet, we will optimize the layout of monitoring stations, expand the scope of dynamic monitoring, and establish a three-dimensional monitoring system for resource and environmental carrying capacity. With the support of existing internet and cloud computing platforms, we will gradually achieve interconnection and sharing of dynamic monitoring information on resource and environment at all levels of government. We will also strengthen online monitoring of energy consumption and big data analysis for key energy-consuming units.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus green ecology, strengthen dynamic monitoring of resources and environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Utilizing smart monitoring devices and mobile internet, improve the online monitoring system for pollutant emissions, increase the types of pollutants monitored, expand the monitoring scope, and establish a 24/7, multi-level intelligent multi-source perception system. Establish an environmental information data sharing mechanism, unify data exchange standards, promote the disclosure of information on regional pollutant emissions, air quality, water quality, etc., and achieve online public access and customized push notifications through the internet. Strengthen the collection and organization of environmental credit data for enterprises, and incorporate the records of environmental credit into a nationwide unified credit information sharing and exchange platform. Improve the environmental warning and risk monitoring information network, enhance the prevention level and emergency response capabilities for key risks such as heavy metals, hazardous waste, and hazardous chemicals.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus green ecology, vigorously develop smart environmental protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Utilize the Internet of Things and big data to carry out information collection, data analysis, and flow monitoring, in order to optimize the layout of reverse logistics nodes. Support the use of Internet of Things technologies such as electronic tags and QR codes to track the flow of electronic waste, encourage internet companies to participate in building urban waste recycling platforms, and innovate recycling models for renewable resources. Accelerate the standardization, normalization, and interconnection of the automobile insurance information system, the trade-in for new management system, and the scrapped vehicle management system. Strengthen the information management of the recycling and utilization of scrapped vehicles and components, and provide data support for internet companies to carry out business innovation and convenient services.
titlelist: Key action, Internet Plus green ecology, improve the system of recycling and utilization of waste resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage internet companies to actively participate in the construction of various industrial park waste information platforms, promote the transformation and upgrading of existing backbone renewable resource trading markets by combining online and offline methods, gradually establish industry-specific, regional, and national online trading systems for industrial waste and renewable resources, improve online credit evaluation and supply chain financing systems, conduct online bidding, publish price transaction indices, enhance stable supply capabilities, and strengthen the pricing power of major renewable resource varieties.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + Green Ecology, establish an online waste trading system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Relying on internet platforms to provide artificial intelligence public innovation services, accelerate breakthroughs in core AI technologies, promote the widespread application of AI in smart homes, smart terminals, smart cars, robots, and other fields, cultivate several leading global AI development backbone enterprises and innovation teams, and form an innovative, active, open, and collaborative industrial ecosystem. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Key Action, Internet Plus Artificial Intelligence

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a new type of computing cluster to support ultra-large-scale deep learning, construct a massive training resource library including data such as speech, images, videos, and maps, strengthen the construction of innovative platforms such as artificial intelligence basic resources and public services. Further promote the research and industrialization of key technologies such as computer vision, intelligent speech processing, biometric recognition, natural language understanding, intelligent decision control, and new human-machine interaction, promote the large-scale commercial use of artificial intelligence in intelligent products, industrial manufacturing, and other fields, and solidify the foundation for the intelligent upgrading of industries.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + Artificial Intelligence, cultivate and develop emerging industries of artificial intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage traditional home furnishing companies to integrate with internet companies, continuously improve the intelligence level and service capabilities of home products, and create new consumer market space. Promote the establishment of cross-border innovation platforms between automobile companies and internet companies, accelerate the research and development and application of technologies such as intelligent assisted driving, complex environment perception, and in-car intelligent devices. Support cooperation between security companies and internet companies, develop and promote big data analysis technologies such as image precision recognition, and enhance the intelligence service level of security products.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + Artificial Intelligence, promoting innovation in intelligent products in key areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on expanding the market size of high-end mobile intelligent terminal products and services, and improve the research and development and industrialization capabilities of core technologies for mobile intelligent terminals. Encourage companies to actively conduct differentiated market demand analysis, vigorously enrich the application services of wearable devices, and enhance user experience. Promote the deep application of Internet technology and intelligent technologies such as intelligent perception, pattern recognition, intelligent analysis, and intelligent control in the field of robotics, and greatly improve the performance and intelligence level of robot products in sensing, interaction, control, and other aspects, and enhance core competitiveness.
titlelist: Key action, Internet + Artificial Intelligence, enhances the intelligence level of terminal products.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the implementation of the Broadband China strategy, organize and implement the construction of the national new generation information infrastructure project, promote the fiber-optic transformation of broadband networks, accelerate the improvement of mobile communication network service capabilities, promote interconnection between networks, significantly improve network access speed, effectively reduce network fees, improve the universal telecommunications service compensation mechanism, support broadband construction and operation maintenance in rural and remote areas, enable the sinking of the Internet for use in all industries, sectors, and regions, and establish an infrastructure for ubiquitous interconnection of people, machines, and things. Enhance the global service capabilities of the Beidou satellite system and build an integrated space-ground interconnected network. Accelerate the commercial deployment of the next-generation Internet, strengthen the management, identification, and resolution of Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) addresses, and build a future network innovation test platform. Research the network architecture system of the industrial Internet and build an open national innovation test and verification platform. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Ensure support, consolidate the foundation for development, and strengthen the network infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Adapt to the needs of integrated innovation and development in key industries, improve wireless sensor networks, industry clouds, and other new application infrastructure such as big data platforms. Implement cloud computing projects, vigorously enhance public cloud service capabilities, guide the migration of industry informatization applications to cloud computing platforms, accelerate the construction of content delivery networks, and optimize data center layouts. Strengthen research on Internet of Things network architecture, organize and carry out major national demonstrations of IoT applications, and encourage eligible enterprises to build cross-industry IoT operation and support platforms. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, consolidate the foundation for development, strengthen the foundation for application.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on breaking through the technical bottlenecks in weak links such as core chips, high-end servers, high-end storage devices, databases, and middleware, and accelerate the research and development and application of cloud operating systems, industrial control real-time operating systems, and intelligent terminal operating systems. Vigorously develop solutions such as cloud computing and big data, as well as high-end sensors, industrial control systems, human-computer interaction, and other hardware and software basic products. Apply the concept of the Internet to build a technology industry cluster with backbone enterprises as the core and efficient integration of industry, academia, research, and application, and create an internationally advanced and independently controllable industrial system. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Ensure support, consolidate the foundation for development, and solidify the industrial base.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop a timetable and roadmap for the development of core technical equipment in the field of national information, enhance internet security management, situational awareness, and risk prevention capabilities, strengthen the security protection of information network infrastructure and the protection of user personal information. Implement special national information security projects, carry out demonstrations of network security applications, and improve the level of core technologies and products for Internet Plus security. Strengthen the security protection of key information systems in the Internet Plus key areas in accordance with the requirements of information security level protection systems and national standards for network security. Build and improve the network security monitoring and evaluation, supervision and management, standard certification, and innovation capability system. Pay attention to the security risks brought by integration, improve the security management and technical measures for network data sharing and utilization, explore the establishment of a data security flow certification system based on administrative evaluation and third-party assessment, improve the system for managing the cross-border flow of data, and ensure data security. (Responsibilities of the Cyberspace Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of State Security, General Administration of Quality Supervision, etc.)
titlelist: Ensure support, consolidate the foundation for development, ensure the foundation for safety.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the establishment of an Internet Plus industry innovation network or industry technology innovation alliance, with enterprises as the main driver and collaboration between industry, academia, research, and application. Support the construction of innovative platforms in cross-border and cross-disciplinary fields, with leading enterprises as the main body, and gradually form an innovation network. Encourage national innovation platforms to open online to enterprises, especially small and medium-sized enterprises, and increase the openness of national major scientific research infrastructure and large-scale scientific research instruments through networking. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen innovation-driven, and enhance innovation capacity building.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: According to the principles of prioritizing commonality and urgent needs, guide the development and promotion of basic common standards and key technical standards in the fields of industrial internet, smart grid, smart cities, etc. Accelerate the standardization work in sub-sectors such as industrial control systems, smart specialized equipment, smart meters, smart homes, and connected vehicles that integrate with the internet. Continuously improve the Internet Plus integration standard system, and simultaneously promote international and domestic standardization work, enhancing the influence in international organizations such as the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), and the International Telecommunication Union (ITU). (Responsibilities include General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration, and National Energy Administration).
titlelist: Ensure support, strengthen innovation-driven development, and accelerate the formulation of integration standards.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage enterprises to independently develop software and share the results through the internet, which are supported by national science and technology programs (special projects, funds, etc.). Guide educational institutions, social organizations, enterprises, or individuals to initiate open-source projects, actively participate in international open-source projects, and support the establishment of open-source communities and foundations. Encourage enterprises to build new ecosystems based on the internet open-source model, and promote the integration and cooperation between internet open-source communities and institutions such as standards, regulations, and intellectual property rights (responsibilities of the Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Intellectual Property Office, etc.).
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen innovation-driven, vigorously develop open-source communities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of the social credit system, promote seamless integration of various credit information platforms, and break down information silos. Strengthen the online disclosure and sharing of credit records, risk warnings, and illegal dishonest behaviors, providing credit information inquiry and online identity authentication services for operators. Make full use of credit data accumulated on the Internet to supplement and improve the existing credit system and evaluation system, providing strong support for economic regulation, market supervision, social management, and public services. (Responsibilities include the Development and Reform Commission, the People's Bank of China, the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and the Cyberspace Administration of China).
titlelist: Ensure support, create a relaxed environment, and improve the credit support system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage enterprises to go global together. In conjunction with major national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, support and encourage internet companies with competitive advantages to take the lead in going overseas through methods such as overseas mergers and acquisitions, joint operations, and establishment of branch offices in the fields of manufacturing, finance, and information communication. By leveraging each other's strengths, jointly explore international markets, promote international capacity cooperation, build cross-border industrial chain systems, and enhance global competitiveness. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Cyberspace Administration of China). Develop global market applications. Encourage Internet Plus companies to integrate domestic and foreign resources, provide network services such as industrial cloud, supply chain management, and big data analysis to the global market, and cultivate Internet Plus application platforms with global influence. Encourage internet companies to actively expand overseas users and launch products and services suitable for different market cultures. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Cyberspace Administration of China).
titlelist: Guarantee support, expand overseas cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the role of the government, industry alliances, industry associations, and relevant intermediary organizations to form a joint force to support Internet Plus enterprises in going global. Encourage intermediary organizations to provide information consultation, legal assistance, tax intermediation, and other services for enterprises to expand overseas markets. Support industry associations and industry alliances in jointly promoting Chinese technology and Chinese standards, and use technical standards to drive the promotion and application of products and services overseas. (Responsibilities include the Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, State Taxation Administration, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, Cyberspace Administration, etc.)
titlelist: Guarantee support, expand overseas cooperation, enhance the ability to provide services abroad.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage local governments at all levels to adopt the method of purchasing services to provide internet knowledge and skills training to the society, and support relevant research institutions and experts in conducting basic knowledge and application training for 'Internet Plus.' Encourage traditional enterprises to establish cooperation mechanisms such as information consultation and talent exchange with internet companies to promote in-depth communication and cooperation between the two sides. Strengthen internet skills training for talents, especially senior management personnel in the manufacturing and agricultural sectors, and encourage the two-way flow of internet talents and talents in traditional industries. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, and the Cyberspace Administration of China).
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen intellectual construction, enhance application capability training.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: In response to the demand for integrated development of the Internet Plus initiative, universities are encouraged to establish relevant majors based on development needs and the school's educational capabilities. Emphasis should be placed on promptly incorporating cutting-edge research achievements from both domestic and international sources into relevant professional teaching. All types of schools are encouraged to hire senior talents in the field of the Internet as part-time teachers to strengthen experimental teaching in the Internet Plus field. (Responsibilities include the Ministry of Education, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Science and Technology, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, and the Cyberspace Administration of China, among others).
titlelist: Guarantee support, strengthen intellectual capacity building, accelerate the training of composite talents.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement comprehensive reform projects for industry-university cooperation, encourage collaboration between schools and enterprises, and promote training for Internet+ professional and technical talents. Deepen the integration of industry and education in the Internet field, relying on the intellectual resources and research platforms of universities, research institutions, and enterprises, establish a number of joint training bases.
