name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Innovate the price regulation method, guide e-commerce platforms to gradually separate commodity pricing from express delivery service pricing, and promote the development of value-added services for express delivery companies targeting consumers. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce, and State Post Bureau) Innovate the management method of public service facilities, clarify the public nature of intelligent parcel lockers and comprehensive service places for express delivery terminals, and provide supporting policies such as land guarantee for specialized, public, platform-based, and intensive express delivery terminal outlets. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, and State Post Bureau).
titlelist: Strengthen institutional innovation, optimize the policy and regulatory environment for coordinated development, and innovate industry support policies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the self-discipline of industry associations, and promote the introduction of industry self-discipline conventions to strengthen the responsibility of enterprises, encourage the signing of self-discipline commitment letters, and promote the healthy development of the industry. Guide platform-based enterprises such as e-commerce, logistics, and express delivery to improve platform service agreements, transaction rules, and credit evaluation systems, effectively maintain a fair competition order, and protect consumer rights and interests. Encourage the opening of data, technology, and other resources to empower small and medium-sized enterprises in the upstream and downstream, and achieve open cooperation and mutually beneficial cooperation between industries and enterprises. (The Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Transport, and the State Post Bureau are responsible in conjunction with relevant departments).
titlelist: Strengthen institutional innovation, optimize the policy and regulatory environment for coordinated development, and improve the collaborative governance model.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Taking into account factors such as regional location, functional positioning, and development level, we will coordinate the planning of e-commerce and express logistics development. In response to the characteristics of e-commerce, such as omni-channel, multi-platform, and online-offline integration, we will scientifically guide the construction of express logistics infrastructure and build an express logistics service system that is suitable for the development of e-commerce. The land for express logistics-related facilities such as warehousing, distribution, and delivery must comply with the overall land use planning and be included in urban and rural planning. Intelligent express lockers and comprehensive service facilities for express end-points should be included in relevant planning for public service facilities. We will strengthen effective coordination and unified management among relevant plans (responsibility lies with provincial-level governments, the Ministry of Land and Resources, and the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development).
titlelist: Strengthen planning guidance, improve e-commerce express logistics infrastructure, and enhance planning coordination and guidance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the existing relevant land use policies to ensure the construction of land for electronic commerce express logistics infrastructure. For projects that utilize existing real estate and land resources to construct electronic commerce express logistics facilities without changing the land subject and planning conditions, the original land use and rights type can be maintained for 5 years without the need to go through relevant land procedures. After the expiration of the 5-year period, if relevant land procedures need to be handled, an agreement can be reached (responsibility lies with the provincial people's governments and the Ministry of Land and Resources).
titlelist: Strengthen planning guidance, improve e-commerce express logistics infrastructure, and ensure the construction land for infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Guide express logistics enterprises to rely on national and regional logistics hub cities, national e-commerce demonstration cities, and express demonstration cities to improve and optimize the layout of express logistics networks. Strengthen the construction of network nodes such as express processing centers, aviation and land transportation hubs, and grassroots service points to build an e-commerce express logistics network that is hierarchical, appropriately scaled, and meets demand. Optimize the allocation of rural express resources and improve the rural distribution network supported by county-level logistics distribution centers, township distribution nodes, and village-level public service points. (Responsibility of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce, and State Post Bureau).
titlelist: Strengthen planning guidance, improve e-commerce express logistics infrastructure, and enhance infrastructure network construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the development of e-commerce parks and express logistics parks, form industrial agglomeration effects, and enhance regional radiation capabilities. Guide the integrated development of national e-commerce demonstration bases, e-commerce industrial parks, and express logistics parks. Encourage traditional logistics parks to adapt to the development needs of e-commerce and express delivery industries, transform and upgrade, and improve comprehensive management and service levels in warehousing, transportation, distribution, information, etc. (Responsibilities of provincial governments, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce, and State Post Bureau).
titlelist: Strengthen planning guidance, improve e-commerce express logistics infrastructure, and promote park construction and upgrading.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Guide various regions to improve urban distribution vehicle traffic management policies, reasonably determine the areas and time periods for vehicle passage, and provide convenient passage for express delivery vehicles and other urban distribution vehicles. Promote the improvement of facilities such as parking, loading and unloading, and charging in commercial areas, residential areas, and higher education institutions, and promote time-based parking and staggered parking to further improve the utilization rate of parking facilities. (Responsibility of provincial governments, Ministry of Transport, State Post Bureau, Ministry of Public Security).
titlelist: Strengthen standardized operations, optimize e-commerce delivery traffic management, and facilitate the passage of delivery vehicles.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage express delivery companies to carry out delivery service cooperation, establish comprehensive service places for express delivery terminals, and implement joint collection and joint delivery. Promote the effective organization and coordinated use of express delivery terminal distribution and service resources, encourage cooperation between express logistics companies, e-commerce companies, chain commercial institutions, convenience stores, property service companies, and higher education institutions, and provide diversified and personalized services such as intensive distribution and online ordering store pickup. (Responsibility of the State Post Bureau in conjunction with relevant departments).
titlelist: Strengthen service innovation, enhance the end-to-end delivery service capability, and encourage the intensification of delivery end services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage express delivery and logistics companies to adopt advanced and applicable technologies and equipment, and improve the automation and specialization level of express delivery and logistics equipment. (Responsibility of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the State Post Bureau) Strengthen the application of modern information technologies and equipment such as big data, cloud computing, and robots in the fields of e-commerce and express delivery and logistics, vigorously promote inventory pre-positioning, intelligent warehousing, scientific loading, and route optimization, and strive to achieve information synergy and service intelligence. (Responsibility of the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Commerce, and the State Post Bureau in conjunction with relevant departments).
titlelist: Strengthen standardization and intelligence, improve collaborative operational efficiency, and enhance the level of technological application.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the construction of the express delivery logistics standard system, promote the establishment of data interface standards for e-commerce and express delivery logistics, and promote the integration of facilities, equipment, operation processes, and information exchange. (Responsibilities of the National Standards Commission, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, and State Post Bureau) Guide e-commerce enterprises and express delivery logistics enterprises to strengthen system interconnection and business linkage, jointly improve the level of information system security protection. (Responsibilities of the Ministry of Commerce and State Post Bureau) Encourage the construction of comprehensive express delivery logistics information service platforms, optimize resource allocation, and achieve real-time sharing and intelligent matching of supply and demand information. (Responsibility of the State Post Bureau).
titlelist: Strengthen standardization and intelligence, improve collaborative operational efficiency, and encourage information interconnection and interoperability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the development of intelligent warehousing in storage, express delivery, and third-party technology service enterprises, extend the service chain, and optimize the supply chain management of e-commerce enterprises. Develop integrated warehousing and distribution services, encourage enterprises to integrate various information technologies, integrate and share upstream and downstream resources, and promote seamless and efficient flow of commerce, logistics, information, and funds. Improve the collaborative efficiency of the supply chain between e-commerce enterprises and express logistics enterprises. (Responsibility of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce, and State Post Bureau).
titlelist: Strengthen standardization and intelligence, improve collaborative operational efficiency, and promote supply chain collaboration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage e-commerce companies and express logistics companies to carry out green supply chain process reengineering, improve resource reuse rate, and reduce enterprise costs. Strengthen energy management, establish green, energy-saving, and low-carbon operation management processes and mechanisms, and promote the application of new technologies and equipment such as water-saving, electricity-saving, and energy-saving in places such as warehouses, distribution centers, data centers, and management centers to improve energy utilization efficiency. (Responsibilities of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Environmental Protection, and Ministry of Industry and Information Technology).
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, and promote resource efficiency.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support industrial enterprises in transforming dumb devices in industrial sites into networked devices, enabling diverse industrial data collection. Enhance the interoperability of heterogeneous industrial networks and promote cross-protocol communication among industrial equipment. Develop interoperability standards for heterogeneous network information, establish a multi-level network information model system, and achieve interoperability across systems.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, take strong actions to build a network system, and accelerate the network transformation of industrial equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support industrial enterprises in using new network technologies and advanced applicable technologies to transform and construct their internal networks, explore the deployment of new networks and systems on existing systems, and promote the integration of information technology (IT) networks and production control (OT) networks. Build industrial Internet park networks.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, take strong actions to improve network infrastructure, and promote the upgrading of corporate intranets.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote basic telecommunications companies to provide high-performance, highly reliable, highly flexible, and highly secure network services. Explore new technology deployments such as cloud-network integration, deterministic networking, and IPv6 segment routing (SRv6). Promote the connection of industrial enterprises, industrial Internet platforms, identification resolution nodes, and security facilities to high-quality external networks. Explore the construction of industrial Internet exchange centers and study new mechanisms for interconnection.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, take action to strengthen the foundation of the network system, and carry out external network construction for enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of 5G fully connected factories for industrial enterprises, promote the penetration of 5G applications from peripheral auxiliary links to core production links, and accelerate the promotion of typical scenarios. Explore the construction and operation models of 5G private networks, plan dedicated frequencies for the industrial Internet of Things, and carry out pilot projects for industrial 5G private networks. Build public service platforms to provide services such as 5G network transformation, application incubation, and testing and verification.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, strengthen the foundation of the network system, and deepen 5G+ Industrial Internet.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build the industrial Internet network's public service capabilities that cover various cities and key industrial sectors nationwide, and construct a panoramic view of the construction, operation, and application of the industrial Internet network, providing comprehensive support services for network construction, usage, and management. Column 1: Industrial Internet network interconnection project. Implement the benchmarking plan for the internal networks of industrial Internet enterprises. Support industrial enterprises in comprehensively utilizing technologies such as 5G, Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), and edge computing to enhance the network level of various production processes. Implement the demonstration plan for industrial Internet park networks. Support local areas and leading enterprises in building 10 industrial Internet park networks and conducting pilot demonstrations of network interconnection for leading enterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises. Explore the construction of industrial Internet exchange centers. Select key regions and industries to explore the construction of industrial Internet exchange centers, and support enterprises in achieving network interconnection and platform interconnection through the use of exchange centers. Establish an industrial Internet network information model laboratory. Develop over 100 network information models for fields such as instruments, CNC machine tools, and robots. Continuously promote the integration application of 5G+industrial Internet. Cultivate around 30 typical application scenarios for key industries. Compile and release the 5G+industrial Internet development index. Timeframe: By 2023, build 50 benchmark internal network transformation projects, achieve basic high-quality external network coverage for all industrial enterprises above a certain scale, and establish 8 5G+industrial Internet public service platforms. Responsible departments: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, take strong actions to build a network system foundation, and construct an industrial Internet network map.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Industrial Internet Identification Management Measures and establish a mechanism for coordinating the allocation of identification codes. Enhance the service capabilities of national top-level nodes. Guide the construction and operation of second-level nodes and recursive nodes for identification resolution. Build a compatible, open, and globally serving identification resolution service system, promote the integration and innovation of identification resolution with technologies such as blockchain and big data, enhance comprehensive data service capabilities, and strengthen the support capabilities for network infrastructure resources such as domain names.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, enhance action in label analysis, and improve the construction of label analysis systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the industrialization of core software and hardware for identity resolution. Support the development and large-scale application of identity resolution middleware, and strengthen the compatibility between identity resolution systems and industrial enterprise information systems. Enhance the public service capabilities of identity resource docking, testing, and certification, and establish a mechanism for sharing data resources in the industrial chain supply chain identification. Column 2: Strengthening the Industrial Internet Identity Resolution System Enhancement Project. Continuously build identity resolution nodes. Strengthen the construction and connection of root nodes, enhance the national top-level nodes' support capabilities for identification, domain names, and other network infrastructure resources, and build an industrial Internet operation analysis platform based on identification. Guide enterprises to establish no less than 120 secondary nodes and no less than 20 recursive nodes. Build a blockchain infrastructure based on identity resolution, support the deployment of no less than 20 fusion nodes in various regions, and provide basic services such as identification resource allocation, management, and interoperability based on blockchain. Strengthen the promotion of large-scale application of identification. Cultivate a group of system integration solution providers and expand the scale application in areas such as cold chain logistics, emergency supplies, and smart cities. Organize the National Industrial Internet Identity Innovation Competition and select 100 typical application cases. Promote the large-scale deployment of active identification carriers. Accelerate the large-scale application of active identification carriers based on technologies such as 5G and Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) in key areas such as automobiles, ships, and instruments, with a deployment of no less than 30 million units and the construction of trustworthy management platforms for various types of active identification carriers. Strengthen the cultivation of the identity industry ecosystem. Build a collaborative development platform for software and hardware, and develop a batch of high-performance and highly reliable specialized devices. Establish an identity data service resource pool to improve the efficiency of industry and industrial data services. Time node: By 2023, the national top-level nodes will have comprehensive service capabilities for identification, domain names, blockchain, etc., with a total registration volume of over 15 billion and a daily resolution volume reaching tens of millions. Responsible departments: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Health Commission, Ministry of Emergency Management, State Administration for Market Regulation.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, enhance action through identification analysis, and strengthen the cultivation of identification ecological support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a dynamic evaluation mechanism, build an industrial Internet platform with international influence, deepen the aggregation of industrial resources and elements, and accelerate the innovation and transformation of production methods and industrial forms.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, expand the platform system, and select comprehensive industrial Internet platforms across industries and fields through rolling selection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on key industries with a strong foundation in digital technology and driving force, build industry-specific industrial internet platforms, and promote the accumulation and aggregation of industry knowledge and experience on the platforms. Targeting regions with high concentration of manufacturing resources and urgent need for industrial transformation, build regional industrial internet platforms with distinctive features, and promote the implementation of the platforms in block economy industrial clusters. Indeed, it is the native of Beijing.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, expand the platform system, and build characteristic industrial Internet platforms targeting key industries and regions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build a technology-oriented industrial Internet platform around specific industrial scenarios and cutting-edge information technology, promote the integration of cutting-edge technology and industrial mechanism models, support the construction of a new manufacturing system driven by data, software-defined, platform-supported, service-added, and intelligent-led.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, expand platform systems, and develop professional industrial Internet platforms for specific technical fields.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen platform equipment access, knowledge accumulation, application development, and other support capabilities. Break through basic industrial software in research and development, production, management, etc., accelerate the migration of existing industrial software to the cloud, and form a microservice resource pool covering the entire industrial process. Promote the softwareization and modelization of industrial knowledge such as basic processes, control methods, and operating mechanisms, and accelerate the construction of industrial mechanism models and knowledge graphs. Deepen the integration and application capabilities of platform + 5G, platform + artificial intelligence, platform + blockchain, and other technologies.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, expand platform systems, and improve the quality of platform technology supply.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop guidelines for implementing cloud computing in industrial equipment, establish an industrial equipment data dictionary, cultivate a public service platform for cloud-based equipment, promote the cloud transformation of core business systems in leading companies in the industry, and encourage the migration of business systems to the cloud for small and medium-sized enterprises in the industrial chain. Encourage local governments to reduce the threshold and cost of cloud adoption through innovative vouchers and service vouchers, and innovate new economic indicators such as the excavator index and air compressor index.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, expand platform systems, and accelerate the cloud-based platform for industrial equipment and business systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Develop and promote platform-based and modular industrial Internet industry system solutions, cultivate solution service providers, establish platform solution resource pools and classification directories, and conduct service provider capability evaluations. Develop and improve the industrial Internet platform monitoring and evaluation index system, support the construction of platform monitoring and analysis systems, and provide platform industry operation data analysis services. Column 3: Industrial Internet platform systematic upgrading project. Accelerate platform promotion and application. Guide cross-industry and cross-domain platforms to gather a wider range of production factor resources, targeting key industries and industrial clusters such as raw materials, equipment, consumer goods, electronic information, energy, medical and pharmaceutical, and construction. Support the construction of 50 industry and regional characteristic platforms, support the construction of technology professional platforms such as cloud simulation, digital twins, data processing, fault prediction, and health management (PHM), and accelerate the application of information technology innovation. Deepen multi-level platform testing and verification. Support the construction of 20 regional integrated platforms in regions with good development foundations, carry out testing and verification of technology, products, services, and solutions, promote the orderly flow and coordinated development of regional factor resources, accelerate the sharing of regional industrial resources and cloud-based equipment, and promote regional industrial collaboration and ecological construction. Cultivate platform innovation solutions. Strengthen the platform's industrial data integration management and industrial mechanism modeling capabilities such as process, control, and operation and maintenance, develop and build digital twin innovation tools, and create a batch of platform + product, platform + model, platform + industry/region innovative solutions. Establish platform data monitoring and operation analysis systems. Improve the platform data dictionary, carry out automated collection of platform basic capabilities, operational services, and industrial support data, develop platform operation monitoring and industry operation analysis models, and compile and release the Industrial Internet platform development index. Timeframe: By 2023, the number of industrial enterprises and equipment on the cloud will double compared to 2020, and 3-5 comprehensive industrial Internet platforms with international influence, 70 industry and regional characteristic platforms, and a batch of specialized platforms in specific technical fields will be built. Responsible units: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Education, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, strengthen platform systems, and improve platform application service levels.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Continuously enhance the data aggregation, analysis, and application capabilities of the national center, and promote the construction of regional and industry sub-centers. Research mechanisms for determining data ownership, value assessment, resource exchange, and benefit sharing in the industrial internet, and formulate standards and specifications for data exchange interfaces, promoting efficient circulation of data resources between the national center, regional centers, and industry sub-centers.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, aggregate data to empower actions, and promote the construction of industrial Internet big data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Provide industrial economic and industrial operation monitoring and command, emergency event warning coordination, and other services to the government. Provide data management capability enhancement, industrial resource sharing, solution promotion, and other services to the industry. Provide services such as equipment and business system cloud migration, production and financing cooperation, and supply-demand connection to enterprises. Cultivate high-quality industrial apps. Promote the accumulation and refinement of common experiential knowledge, develop basic and reusable industrial apps, and adaptive industrial apps based on knowledge graphs and intelligent algorithms. Create a group of industry-specific and widely applicable industrial apps with high economic value and strong promotion effects. Cultivate a group of enterprise-specific industrial apps to meet personalized needs in specific fields and scenarios. Develop industrial intelligent solutions based on digital twin technology, support open source community and developer community construction, develop industrial app stores, and promote the circulation of industrial app transactions.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, gather data to empower actions, and build comprehensive service capabilities for industrial Internet big data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Build a platform data dictionary mutual recognition mechanism, unify the calling interfaces of industrial data, algorithm models, microservices, etc. Encourage joint research and complementary cooperation, establish interface specifications between platforms, promote cross-platform calling and subscription of mechanism models and industrial apps, and create a collaborative development and multi-level systematic platform system.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, aggregate data to empower actions, and promote data interconnection and interoperability between platforms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Industrial Internet + Safety Production. Focusing on improving the level of intrinsic safety, targeting key industries such as raw materials, hazardous chemicals, mining, civil explosives, fireworks, and firecrackers, constructing a safety production perception, monitoring, early warning, disposal, and evaluation system based on the Industrial Internet. Establishing a risk feature library, failure database, safety production evaluation model, and toolset to enhance the level of safety production in industrial enterprises. Column 4: National Industrial Internet Big Data Center Construction Project. Constructing an industrial Internet big data center system. Targeting process industries such as energy, steel, petrochemicals, chemicals, building materials, non-ferrous metals, pharmaceuticals, and discrete industries such as electronics, automobiles, equipment, and construction, constructing industry-specific data sub-centers, and strengthening industry data resource management. Strengthening the linkage between the promotion and application of industrial Internet and the digital transformation of banking and insurance institutions, building a data integration and sharing platform for small and medium-sized micro-enterprises based on the industrial Internet, and exploring the application of industrial Internet big data in financial services. In areas where the integration and development of the industrial Internet is relatively good, constructing a number of unified and standardized regional-level industrial Internet big data sub-centers, aggregating data resources to reach the PB level. Building scenario-driven high-quality data sets and encouraging industrial algorithm innovation. Carrying out innovative applications of data to enhance the resilience of industrial chain and supply chain. Constructing industrial Internet big data center disaster recovery centers, providing data disaster recovery services, and enhancing emergency support service capabilities. Timeframe: By 2023, the national industrial Internet big data center system will be basically completed, with the construction of 20 regional-level sub-centers and 10 industry-level sub-centers. Building a high-quality industrial microservice and industrial APP resource pool, with the number of industrial APPs reaching 500,000. Responsible units: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Emergency Management, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, and National Energy Administration.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, gather data to empower actions, and continue to deepen.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage large enterprises to increase the application of digital technologies such as 5G, big data, and artificial intelligence, comprehensively enhance the level of intelligence in research and development design, process simulation, production manufacturing, equipment management, product testing, etc., and achieve dynamic optimization and precise decision-making throughout the entire process.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, cultivate new models, and promote intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Supporting leading enterprises to build a networked configuration system that spans the supply chain and covers multiple fields, based on extensive connections and aggregation of resources such as equipment, technology, data, models, and knowledge. This includes the development of new models such as collaborative design, crowdsourcing, shared manufacturing, and distributed manufacturing.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, cultivate new models, and enhance networked collaboration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support equipment manufacturing enterprises in building product interconnection networks and service platforms, and carry out product model construction and data analysis based on technologies such as digital twins, artificial intelligence, and blockchain, to create predictive maintenance of equipment, equipment energy efficiency optimization, and product derivative services.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, cultivate new models, and expand service-oriented extensions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the integrated development model that allows large enterprises to lead promotion and widespread application by small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage leading enterprises to promote supply chain systems and networked organizational platforms, and create digital platforms, system solutions, products, and services that meet the needs of small and medium-sized enterprises. Drive the digital capabilities enhancement of small and medium-sized enterprises and promote the sharing of orders, production capacity, resources, and more.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, deepen integrated application actions, and enhance the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the promotion of advanced production models, resource organization methods, innovative management, and service capabilities based on the industrial Internet in the primary and tertiary industries. Build cross-industry data hubs and service platforms, and create integrated ecosystems such as industrial-finance cooperation and smart cities. Column 6: Industrial Internet integration application engineering. Promote the digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises. With the support of new generation information technology applications, promote the aggregation of a group of digital service providers for small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate and promote a batch of digital platforms, system solutions, products, and services that meet the needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and empower them with digital, networked, and intelligent capabilities. Implement the plan for the integrated development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries. Encourage the demonstration and promotion of integrated application training, and support the establishment of demonstration centers for integrated applications in fields such as medical, education, and finance. Encourage the organization of industrial Internet integration application competitions, explore integrated application scenarios based on the industrial Internet in the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries, and create typical models such as industrial-finance cooperation and industrial tourism. Continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of industry integration applications. In the process manufacturing industry, popularize models such as high-value equipment asset management, optimized safety and environmental protection management, and integrated optimization of the entire process, to enhance the digital transformation and connectivity level of equipment and control systems. In the discrete manufacturing industry, promote models such as in-process quality inspection, equipment health management, large-scale customization, supply chain traceability, and cross-domain integrated services, to accelerate the digital transformation and precise control of the entire production process for enterprises. Support industry associations, research institutions, leading enterprises, etc., in formulating and issuing industry application promotion guidelines. Timeline: By 2023, approximately 150 pilot demonstration projects with distinct industry characteristics and strong driving effects will be formed in key industries. Build a model resource library and service platform that supports integrated applications, and create approximately 40 typical scenarios of integrated applications. Responsible departments: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Emergency Management, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, integrate and deepen actions, and accelerate the integrated development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the role of the National Industrial Internet Standard Coordination and Promotion Group, the General Group, and the Expert Advisory Group, systematically promote the research of the Industrial Internet Standard Planning System and the implementation of related policy measures, and strengthen the overall coordination and collaboration of important standardization matters across departments, industries, and fields.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, key standard construction actions, strengthen work mechanisms.

content: Fully considering the integration of the industrial Internet, we will continue to carry out the selection of industrial Internet industry demonstration bases, encourage the development of the eastern region as a priority, and promote the accelerated development of the northeastern and central-western regions. We will guide the industrial Internet industry demonstration bases to focus on their main businesses, strengthen infrastructure support, and enhance their ability to lead integrated innovation. We encourage the construction of pilot zones for the integration of '5G+ industrial Internet' applications in various regions, and explore development models with regional and industrial characteristics.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, promote coordinated development of industries, and carry out industrial demonstration base construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of the national demonstration zone for the industrial internet in the Yangtze River Delta, and encourage local areas to combine regional characteristics and industrial advantages to create a group of demonstration zones with significant synergistic effects and strong radiation-driven capabilities. Column 9: Industrial Internet Industry Ecological Cultivation Project. Cultivate system solution providers. Build a data resource pool and provide services such as classification and grading of industrial data resources, and management of data assets and algorithm libraries. Select 5 national-level industrial internet industry demonstration bases, build 10 5G+ Industrial Internet integrated application pilot zones, establish a group of platform application innovation promotion centers, and layout a group of industrial internet demonstration zones. content: Strengthen collaborative innovation, focusing on key core areas such as PLC, data acquisition and monitoring control systems (SCADA), and remote information processors (T-BOX). Support leading industrial enterprises in the equipment and electronic information industries to build a number of influential security public service platforms. titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, enhance security measures, and strengthen innovation breakthroughs in network security supply.

titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, enhance security measures, and promote the development and growth of the cybersecurity industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the self-protection of enterprises, encourage and support key enterprises in building centralized security situational awareness and comprehensive protection systems, and enhance their network and data security technology capabilities. Strengthen regional monitoring and support, guide provincial industry regulatory authorities to accelerate the construction of local industrial internet security situational awareness, online monitoring, and other technical means, expand the monitoring scope, and enrich platform functions. Support key cities in accelerating the construction of 5G+ industrial internet security brain. Enhance the security linkage and support capabilities of key regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Chengdu-Chongqing. Improve the coordination and service level of the national platform, strengthen situational analysis using artificial intelligence and big data technology, and create a multi-party collaborative and efficient technical service support system. Strengthen the construction of industrial internet password application security evaluation capabilities. Column 10: Enhancing the comprehensive security support capabilities of industrial internet. Implement enterprise network security capability benchmarking plans. Industry regulatory authorities shall formulate classified and graded series of security standards and specifications, clarify the basic requirements for security protection of enterprise equipment, control, network, platform, application, data, etc., and carry out dynamic security testing and evaluation of key equipment such as PLC, important systems such as SCADA, industrial internet platforms, and industrial APPs. Provincial-level (key city) regulatory authorities shall organize enterprise surveys, conduct enterprise classification and grading, and formulate lists of key enterprises and catalogs of important data protection. Carry out promotion and benchmarking for key industries and enterprises, implement self-assessment and security transformation for enterprises, and select a group of benchmarking demonstration enterprises. Implement plans to enhance technical support capabilities. Build a two-library-one-mechanism around key industries such as raw materials, equipment, and electronic information, construct a national industrial internet security vulnerability database that gathers information on security vulnerabilities, malicious code, ransomware, etc., improve the basic resource database covering industrial protocols, equipment fingerprints, IP/domain names, important systems, etc., and establish a number of network security testing environments and attack-defense simulation fields. Improve and perfect closed-loop mechanisms for monitoring and early warning, information sharing, and collaborative disposal. Timeframe: By 2023, the classified and graded management model will be widely promoted nationwide. Select benchmarking demonstration enterprises from key industries such as raw materials, equipment, and electronic information. Build 20 intensive security operation service centers and influential key industry security public service platforms, and create 10 advanced demonstration areas for network security innovation applications in key industrial internet application areas. Responsible departments: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Ecology and Environment, State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, National Energy Administration, State Administration of Science, Technology and Industry for National Defense.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, enhance security measures, and strengthen network security technology capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: By 2020, a relatively complete top-level design of the Industrial Internet network will be formed, and the infrastructure and technological industrial system of the Industrial Internet will be initially established. Firstly, it is to construct benchmark networks for the external networks of Industrial Internet enterprises that meet the requirements of testing and commercial use, and initially build enterprise external network infrastructure that is suitable for Industrial Internet with high reliability, wide coverage, large bandwidth, and supports Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) customization. Construct benchmark networks for the internal networks of a group of Industrial Internet enterprises, forming typical models for the construction and transformation of enterprise internal networks, and completing the construction and upgrading of more than 100 enterprise internal networks. Secondly, establish an open public service platform that integrates network technology innovation, standard formulation, testing and certification, application demonstration, industrial promotion, and international cooperation. Build a group of Industrial Internet network experimental environments for key technologies and industries, construct more than 20 network technology innovation and industry application test beds, and initially form an Industrial Internet network innovation base. Thirdly, form an advanced and systematic Industrial Internet network technology system and standard system, build a group of Industrial Internet application innovation demonstration projects in the network field, establish an evaluation and certification mechanism for Industrial Internet network transformation, and construct a network technology industry ecosystem that adapts to the development of the Industrial Internet. Fourthly, initially construct an Industrial Internet identification resolution system, build a group of second-level identification resolution nodes for industries or regions, and develop and improve management measures for identification registration and resolution. The number of identification registrations exceeds 2 billion.
titlelist: Strengthen green concepts, develop green ecological chains, work objectives.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The Industrial Internet is the key support for the fourth industrial revolution, and 5G is an important direction for the evolution and upgrade of the new generation of information and communication technology. Both are important driving forces for achieving the digital transformation of the economy and society. The integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet will promote the transformation of the manufacturing industry from single-point, localized information technology applications to digital, networked, and intelligent ones. It will also open up a broader market space for 5G, thereby providing strong support for the construction of a manufacturing and network power. Currently, the enthusiasm of the industrial sector in promoting the integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet is continuously increasing. The coverage of the 5G+ Industrial Internet intranet construction and transformation is becoming increasingly widespread in various industries, and the application scope is continuously extending to the core links of production and manufacturing. The cumulative multiplier effect and huge application potential are constantly being released. However, the integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet are still in the early stages, and the industrial foundation needs to be further consolidated, the path and model need to be further explored, and the development environment needs to be further improved. In order to promote the accelerated implementation of the 5G+ Industrial Internet 512 Project and promote the integration and innovative development of 5G and the Industrial Internet in high quality, this plan is formulated. First, development goals. By 2022, breakthroughs will be made in a number of key 5G technologies targeting specific needs of the Industrial Internet, and the industrial support capabilities of 5G+ Industrial Internet will be significantly improved. Five industrial public service platforms will be built to construct innovation carriers and public service capabilities. The pilot applications of 5G+ Industrial Internet in vertical fields will be accelerated, and the intranet construction and transformation will cover 10 key industries. A number of benchmark and model projects for the intranet construction and transformation of 5G+ Industrial Internet will be created, forming at least 20 typical industrial application scenarios. An innovative trend of integration and overlapping development of 5G and the Industrial Internet will be cultivated, promoting the digitalization, networking, and intelligent upgrading of the manufacturing industry, and driving high-quality economic development.
titlelist: Intensify policy support, carry out industry monitoring and evaluation, and promote the '5G+ Industrial Internet' 512 Project Implementation Plan (MIIT Information Management [2019] No. 78) (MIIT Office/November 19, 2019).

The role of the National Industrial Internet Standardization Coordination and Promotion Group, the overall group, and the expert advisory group will be leveraged to coordinate the China Communications Standards Association (CCSA) and relevant industry standardization organizations, and to research and formulate a fusion standard system for 5G + Industrial Internet, and improve fusion technology and application standards.
titlelist: Enhance the industrial capability of key technologies in the 5G+ Industrial Internet network, and strengthen the research and development of technical standards in the 5G+ Industrial Internet.

titlelist: Enhance the innovation and application capabilities of '5G+ Industrial Internet', and explore 20 typical application scenarios of '5G+ Industrial Internet'.

content: Encourage enterprises, universities, research institutions, and industry alliances to jointly build 5G+ Industrial Internet technology testbeds, and carry out research and development, testing and verification, evaluation and assessment of integrated technologies, standards, equipment, and solutions. For the 10 key industries of 5G+ Industrial Internet, encourage all parties to jointly build industry application testbeds to enhance the innovation capability of 5G applications in vertical fields.
titlelist: Enhance the innovation and application capabilities of '5G+ Industrial Internet', and establish a '5G+ Industrial Internet' testbed.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a reporting mechanism for the 5G+ Industrial Internet project through multiple channels, including local industrial and informatization authorities, telecommunications management bureaus, industrial Internet industry alliances, and basic telecommunications enterprises. Select high-quality projects to be included in the project library, comprehensively grasp the actual construction needs and progress of the 5G+ Industrial Internet in our country, and continuously update the project library.
titlelist: Enhance the resource supply capacity of '5G+ Industrial Internet' and build a project library for '5G+ Industrial Internet'.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Through various means such as the Innovation and Development Project for Industrial Internet, pilot demonstrations of Industrial Internet, and the National Demonstration Base for New Industrialization (Industrial Internet direction), support will be provided to basic telecommunications enterprises, communication equipment enterprises, and industrial enterprises to combine their own advantages and focus on their respective main businesses. This will expand the construction and transformation services of the Industrial Internet intranet, and cultivate a group of solution providers who understand both 5G and industry.
titlelist: Enhance the resource supply capacity of 5G+ Industrial Internet and cultivate 5G+ Industrial Internet solution providers.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Select high-quality service providers of various types for 5G+ Industrial Internet, build a supply resource pool, and make it public to the society. Relying on industrial organizations such as the Industrial Internet Industry Alliance and the 5G Application Industry Matrix, promote practical cooperation between supply and demand sides in the construction and transformation of the internal network of 5G+ Industrial Internet.
titlelist: Enhance the supply capacity of '5G+ Industrial Internet' resources and build a supply resource pool for '5G+ Industrial Internet'.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on the construction and transformation of the intranet of the industrial Internet, encourage various forms of activities such as 5G+ Industrial Internet themed seminars, experience exchanges, and industry summits, promote and showcase the important value and typical cases of the intranet construction and transformation of 5G+ Industrial Internet, further consolidate consensus among all parties, and create a favorable atmosphere.
titlelist: Strengthen publicity guidance and experience promotion, increase the intensity of publicity guidance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Administrative Measures for the Security Protection of Communication Networks (Order No. 11 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology) and the series of standards for the security protection of communication networks, properly handle classification and filing, strictly implement protective measures, regularly conduct compliance evaluations and risk assessments, and promptly eliminate security risks. Strengthen the management of network and information assets, comprehensively review the list of key equipment, clarify the network security responsibility departments and personnel for each network, system, and key equipment. Reasonably divide the security domains of networks and systems, clarify network boundaries, and strengthen boundary protection. Strengthen website security protection and the security management of enterprise offices and maintenance terminals. Improve domain name system security protection measures, optimize system architecture, and enhance bandwidth guarantee. Strengthen public recursive domain name resolution system emergency backup. Strengthen risk assessments before the launch of networks and systems. Strengthen software and hardware version management and patch management, enhance the tracking, verification, risk assessment, and notification of vulnerability information, and promptly take effective remedial measures.
titlelist: Work focus: Deepening network infrastructure and business system security protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Thoroughly implement the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology's 'Public Internet Network Security Emergency Plan', and develop and improve the network security emergency plan of our unit. Establish a coordinated mechanism for emergency response to major distributed denial of service attacks, critical domain name system failures, large-scale user information leaks, and other sudden network security incidents. Strengthen emergency plan drills, regularly evaluate and revise emergency plans to ensure their scientific, practical, and operational nature. Enhance the monitoring and early warning capabilities for sudden network security incidents, strengthen the release and handling of early warning information, and promptly report to the competent communication authorities for incidents that may have a global impact. Strictly implement the reporting system for sudden network security incidents. Build a network security emergency command and dispatch system to improve emergency response efficiency. Provide network security support and protection for important information systems in other industries, government websites, and key news websites during major events and special periods, as required by relevant departments.
titlelist: Work focus: Enhancing the emergency response capability for sudden network security incidents.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Trojan and Botnet Monitoring and Disposal Mechanism and the Mobile Internet Malicious Program Monitoring and Disposal Mechanism issued by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and establish a sound mechanism for monitoring and disposing of phishing websites. Clearly define the responsibility and obligation of users to maintain a secure network environment in the business service contracts signed with them. Strengthen the construction of Trojan virus sample library, mobile malicious program sample library, vulnerability library, malicious website library, etc., and promote the sharing of network security threat information within the industry. Strengthen the in-depth analysis and source governance of the hacker underground industry chain, and actively cooperate with relevant law enforcement departments to combat cybercrime. Basic telecommunications companies should strengthen the promotion of user awareness and skills in network security knowledge and actively expand network security value-added services for users during business promotion and service processing.
titlelist: Work focus: maintaining a secure environment for the public internet network.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the establishment of a national network security review system and implement the requirements for network security review in the telecommunications and internet industries. According to the relevant requirements of the Administrative Measures for Bidding and Tendering of Communication Engineering Construction Projects (Order No. 27 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology), consider the network security needs in the bidding for key software and hardware, and clearly specify the network security requirements for key software and hardware in the bidding documents. Strengthen the network security testing and evaluation before the procurement of key software and hardware, and clearly define the supplier's network security responsibilities and obligations through contracts, requiring suppliers to sign a network security commitment letter. Increase the independent research and development efforts of important business application systems and conduct security testing of business application program source code.
titlelist: Work focus, promoting the application of secure and controllable key software and hardware.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Provisions on the Protection of Personal Information of Telecommunications and Internet Users (Order No. 24 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology) seriously, strictly regulate the collection, storage, use, and destruction of users' personal information, implement security responsibilities in various links, improve relevant management systems and technical means. Implement data security and user personal information security protection standards, improve security measures such as preventing theft, tampering, and data backup of network data and user information. Strengthen authorization management and auditing of internal personnel and partners, and increase the punishment for violations. After a large-scale personal information leakage incident occurs, report it immediately to the competent telecommunications authority and take timely and effective remedial measures.
titlelist: Work focus: Strengthening network data and user personal information protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the security management of mobile app stores and mobile applications, urging app stores to establish a sound system for verifying the real identity information of mobile app developers, conducting app security checks, removing malicious programs, maintaining a blacklist of malicious programs, and supervising user reports. Establish a sound third-party security testing mechanism for mobile applications. Promote the establishment of third-party digital certificate signatures for mobile app developers, as well as signature verification and user prompt mechanisms for app stores and smart terminals. Improve the acceptance of reports on mobile malicious programs and the sharing mechanism of blacklists. Enhance social publicity, guiding users to download and install mobile applications from legitimate app stores and install terminal security protection software.
titlelist: Work focus, strengthen mobile app store and application security management.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the tracking and research on network security issues related to new technologies and new businesses such as cloud computing, big data, Internet of Things, mobile internet, and next-generation internet. Include the infrastructure and business systems involved in providing public telecommunications and internet services in the communication network security protection management system. Accelerate the development of relevant network security protection standards and improve and implement corresponding network security protection measures. Actively carry out pilot demonstrations of network security protection technologies for new technologies and new businesses. Strengthen the assessment of network security risks and network security protection inspections for new businesses.
titlelist: Work focus, strengthen network security management for new technologies and new businesses.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Deepen the research on network security monitoring and early warning, vulnerability discovery, malicious code analysis, detection evaluation, and traceability and evidence collection techniques. Strengthen the research on advanced sustainable attack response technologies. Establish and improve network security protection techniques such as intrusion detection and defense, antivirus, anti-denial of service attacks, abnormal traffic monitoring, webpage tampering prevention, domain name security, vulnerability scanning, centralized account management, data encryption, and security auditing. Improve monitoring and disposal methods for network-side Trojan viruses, mobile malicious programs, and other threats. Actively research and utilize new technologies such as cloud computing and big data to enhance network security monitoring and early warning capabilities. Promote the integration of enterprise technologies with those of the telecommunications regulatory authorities, establish interface standards and specifications, and achieve data sharing in monitoring. Strengthen cooperation with network security service companies to prevent risks during the service process. When relying on security service units to carry out network security integration construction and risk assessment, units that have been assessed for their network security service capabilities by relevant industry organizations should be selected. III. Security measures.
titlelist: Work focus: Strengthen the construction of network security technology capabilities and means.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the role of industry organizations in supporting the government and serving the industry, and vigorously carry out self-discipline work in the telecommunications and internet industry. Support relevant industry organizations and professional institutions in promoting industry-oriented network security regulations, policies, standards, and knowledge and skills training, competitions, to promote network security management and technical exchanges. Carry out network security service capability assessment to promote and regulate the healthy development of the network security service market. Establish and improve the social supervision and reporting mechanism for network security, mobilize the whole society to participate in maintaining the public internet network security environment. Carry out network security publicity and education activities for the general public, and enhance users' awareness of network security risks and self-protection capabilities.
titlelist: Work priorities, fully leverage the role of industry organizations and professional institutions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the top-level design of standards, build a systematic, coordinated, compatible, and open standard system, effectively guide the standardization of energy internet, and lay the foundation for formulating the standard planning for energy internet and preparing annual revision plans.
titlelist: Work focus: Building a standard system for the energy internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Organize the current status of standards, analyze the deficiencies in standards, and propose an annual work plan for standards. Coordinate planning, combining with the development process of China's energy internet and the progress of energy market construction, propose the key points and timetable for standardization work of the energy internet.
titlelist: Work focus: Complete the roadmap for standardizing the Energy Internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Develop basic standards for energy internet terminology, conceptual models, system architecture, and general use cases; in conjunction with the development of related industries, establish standards related to interactive technologies such as active distribution networks, micro energy grids, energy storage, and electric vehicles; formulate standards for information security, demonstration pilot acceptance, and evaluation to support the acceptance and evaluation work of energy internet pilot demonstration projects.
titlelist: Work priorities, accelerate the formulation of standards in key areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen contacts and cooperation with international standardization organizations and international technical organizations in areas such as standard setting and international communication, and play a role in the joint construction of the Belt and Road initiative by utilizing standards. Promote the concept of a global energy internet and enhance China's influence in the international standardization of energy internet.
titlelist: Work priorities: Strengthen cooperation with international organizations and promote the development of a global energy internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Formulate policy measures, strengthen macro coordination of energy internet standardization, and conduct research on major issues. Three, guarantee measures.
titlelist: Work focus: Establish a coordination mechanism and technical support institution for the standardization of the energy internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage group standards to play a role in the standardization work of the energy internet. Explore various forms of standard achievements based on the characteristics of different types of standards. Establish a more timely mechanism for updating standards to meet the rapid development needs of the energy internet technology.
titlelist: Work focus, innovate standardized work methods.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Actively strive for various types of special support from the state, guide industry and local funds to invest, mobilize corporate enthusiasm, and form a pattern of multi-channel investment and multi-party participation.
titlelist: Work priorities, increase investment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Utilize demonstration pilot projects and standardized major events, leverage media such as newspapers and the internet, increase the publicity efforts of energy internet standardization work, and enhance the influence of energy internet standardization work.
titlelist: Work focus, increase publicity efforts.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In the process of network planning, construction, operation, management, maintenance, and disposal, energy-saving measures should be considered simultaneously. Accelerate the upgrade and transformation of public backbone networks, metropolitan area networks, Internet data centers (IDC), business systems, and support systems to IPv6, and improve the performance of network equipment. Speed up the deployment and upgrade of public mobile, wired, and wireless broadband access networks, as well as IPv6. Upgrade and expand demonstration backbone networks, local networks, and support systems, and enhance functions related to transition, security, and operation management. Promote the IPv6 upgrade and transformation of government, school, enterprise, and public institution external website systems, as well as commercial website systems.
titlelist: Development roadmap and timetable, construction of broadband, integrated, secure, and ubiquitous next-generation national information infrastructure for network information infrastructure, strengthening resource co-construction and sharing, further narrowing the digital divide.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: It mainly includes high-performance routing chips and terminal chips, high-speed routing and switching equipment, access equipment, multifunctional terminal devices, high-performance IPv4 and IPv6 network interconnection equipment, sensor network devices, various basic software, application software, and business platforms; supporting systems such as authentication and authorization, domain name resolution, address allocation query, network management, customer service, and integrated billing; security protection devices such as traffic control, firewall, and intrusion detection; network equipment function and performance testing instruments, large-scale network performance testing equipment and systems.
titlelist: Development roadmap and timetable, focusing on product research and development and industrialization research support for IPv, to meet the requirements of energy saving and consumption reduction for the next generation of key chips, equipment, software, and systems for the Internet, accelerate industrialization and network deployment, and form a relatively complete industrial collaborative innovation system.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
