content: Strengthen the deployment and management of core network infrastructure such as domain name servers, digital certificate servers, and key application servers; enhance the planning and management of network addresses and domain name systems; promote work on security level protection, personal information protection, risk assessment, disaster backup and recovery, and effectively implement various security requirements in network planning, construction, operation, management, maintenance, and disposal; accelerate the development of the information security industry, cultivate leading enterprises, increase efforts in talent training and recruitment, and improve information security technology support and capabilities.
titlelist: Development roadmap and timetable, strengthen network and information security, comprehensively enhance the security and credibility of the next generation internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: With the goal of achieving breakthrough technological innovation by mastering principles, grasping the direction of technological development, focusing on applications and industrial needs, clarifying development priorities, and strengthening the research and industrialization of low-cost, low-power, high-precision, high-reliability, and intelligent sensors, efforts will be made to break through the core common technologies of the Internet of Things, such as chips, software, and instruments. Accelerating the research and development of key technologies such as sensor networks, smart terminals, big data processing, intelligent analysis, and service integration, promoting the integration and development of the Internet of Things with new generation mobile communications, cloud computing, next-generation Internet, satellite communications, and other technologies. Fully utilizing and integrating existing innovative resources, establishing a number of Internet of Things technology research and development laboratories, engineering centers, and enterprise technology centers, promoting cooperation between application units and relevant technology, product, and service providers, strengthening collaborative research, and breaking through the bottleneck of industrial development.
titlelist: Internet of Things, accelerate technological research and development, break through industry bottlenecks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: In important fields such as industry, agriculture, commercial circulation, energy conservation and environmental protection, and safety production, as well as important infrastructure such as transportation, energy, and water conservancy, we will promote the integrated application of Internet of Things (IoT) technology around production and manufacturing, commercial circulation, logistics distribution, and business management processes. We will focus on a batch of exemplary application demonstration projects that have outstanding effects, strong driving force, and high relevance. We will actively use IoT technology to transform traditional industries, promote refined management and scientific decision-making, improve production and operation efficiency, promote energy conservation and emission reduction, ensure safety production, innovate development models, and promote industrial upgrading.
titlelist: The Internet of Things, promoting application demonstrations, and promoting economic development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In the fields of public safety, social security, healthcare, urban management, and livelihood services, we will focus on innovative management and service models, implement typical application demonstration projects of the Internet of Things, and build a more convenient, efficient, and secure intelligent social management and public service system. We will leverage the advantages of the Internet of Things technology to promote the informatization of social management and public services, expand and extend the scope of services, improve the level of management and services, and enhance the quality of people's lives.
titlelist: Internet of Things, improving social management, enhancing public services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Guide and urge localities to reasonably determine the development orientation of the Internet of Things based on their own conditions. Combine scientific research capabilities, application foundations, industrial parks, and other characteristics and advantages to plan scientifically, adapt to local conditions, and promote the development of the Internet of Things in an orderly manner. Regions with a good foundation in informatization and the information industry should strengthen the research and development, industrialization, and demonstration applications of the Internet of Things technology. Regions with a weaker foundation in informatization and the information industry should focus on promoting mature applications of the Internet of Things. Accelerate the construction of the Wuxi National Sensor Network Innovation Demonstration Zone. When building smart cities using new generation information technologies such as the Internet of Things, it is necessary to strengthen overall planning, focus on effectiveness, and highlight characteristics.
titlelist: The Internet of Things, highlighting regional characteristics, develops in a scientific and orderly manner.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen overall coordination and collaboration, relying on cross-departmental and cross-industry standardized collaboration mechanisms, to coordinate and promote the construction of the Internet of Things (IoT) standard system. Following the principles of addressing urgent needs first and addressing commonalities first, accelerate the research and formulation of basic common standards such as coding identification, interfaces, data, and information security, as well as key technical standards and key application standards. Encourage and support domestic institutions to actively participate in international standardization work, and enhance the international discourse power of independent technical standards.
titlelist: Internet of Things, strengthen overall design, improve standard system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the development of key core industries in the Internet of Things, enhance the development level of perception and identification manufacturing industries, build a complete industrial chain for IoT communication network manufacturing and services, and develop related industries such as IoT applications and software. Vigorously cultivate backbone enterprises in the Internet of Things with international competitiveness, actively develop innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, construct characteristic industrial bases and industrial parks, continuously improve the industrial public service system, and form a highly competitive IoT industry cluster. Strengthen the combination of industrial cultivation and application demonstration, encourage and support enterprises and research units in equipment manufacturing, software development, and service integration to participate in application demonstration project construction.
titlelist: Internet of Things, strengthen the core industry, improve support capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Actively explore new business models that promote win-win cooperation in the upstream and downstream of the Internet of Things industry chain. Strongly support the development of Internet of Things professional services and value-added services that contribute to expanding market demand, promote the marketization of application services, drive the development of service outsourcing industry, and cultivate emerging service industries. Encourage and support telecommunications operators, information services, system integrators, and other enterprises to participate in the operation and promotion of Internet of Things application demonstration projects.
titlelist: IoT, innovative business models, cultivating emerging industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the level of information security management and data protection in the Internet of Things (IoT), strengthen the research and development of information security technology, promote the construction of information security guarantee system, establish and improve supervision, inspection, and security assessment mechanisms, effectively ensuring the security and controllability of various links such as information collection, transmission, processing, and application in the IoT. For important IoT applications involving national public security and infrastructure, their system solutions, core equipment, and operational services must be based on security and controllability.
titlelist: IoT, strengthen protection management, ensure information security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Make full use of existing public communication and network infrastructure to carry out Internet of Things applications. Promote interconnection, resource sharing, and business collaboration between information systems, and avoid the formation of new information islands. Attach importance to the intelligent analysis and comprehensive utilization of information resources, and avoid heavy data collection, light data processing, and comprehensive application. Strengthen investment benefit analysis and risk assessment of Internet of Things construction projects to avoid redundant construction and irrational investment. Three, security measures.
titlelist: Internet of Things, strengthening resource integration, promoting collaborative sharing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a coordinated mechanism for the development of the Internet of Things (IoT) among departments, industries, regions, and the military, fully leveraging the role of the inter-ministerial joint conference system for IoT development. Research major issues, coordinate the formulation of policies, measures, and action plans, strengthen the coordination of application promotion, technological research and development, standard formulation, industrial chain construction, infrastructure development, information security, and wireless spectrum resource allocation and utilization. Form a working pattern of resource sharing and collaborative advancement, with each link supporting and promoting each other's collaborative development effects. Strengthen the connection and coordination of IoT-related planning, major scientific and technological projects, and industrialization projects, reasonably layout major IoT application demonstrations and industrialization projects, and strengthen the supporting industries and regional division of labor cooperation.
titlelist: IoT, strengthen overall coordination to form a collaborative force for development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish and improve a policy system that is conducive to the promotion of Internet of Things applications, innovation incentives, and orderly competition. Urgently promote the formulation and improvement of laws and regulations related to information security and privacy protection. Establish a market access mechanism that encourages fair entry of diverse capital. Accelerate the construction of public service platforms for Internet of Things-related standards, testing, certification, etc., and improve the supporting service system. Strengthen intellectual property protection, actively conduct intellectual property analysis and evaluation of Internet of Things-related technologies, and accelerate the promotion of Internet of Things-related patent layout.
titlelist: Internet of Things, creating a favorable development environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the joint research and development of manufacturing enterprises and information technology enterprises, promote the integration and application of technologies such as artificial intelligence, 5G, and advanced sensing, cultivate industrial-grade intelligent hardware, intelligent robots, intelligent connected vehicles, intelligent ships, drones, smart wearable devices, smart homes, and other new intelligent products. Develop scenario-based applications based on intelligent products, accelerate the promotion of intelligent product applications in key industries such as industry, transportation, healthcare, education, national defense, and elderly care, and provide support for industrial transformation and upgrading as well as consumer upgrading.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating new products, new models, new formats, new intelligent products.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: By establishing a seamless data connection within enterprises, and utilizing technologies such as intelligent sensing and the Internet of Things (IoT), we aim to promote real-time data collection and comprehensive integration across the entire business chain. This will help build a digital supply chain management system, guide enterprises in creating a digital cockpit, and achieve visualization and transparency in operational management. We encourage enterprises to reconstruct their strategic layout, operational management, and market services based on production and operation data, in order to form an efficient data-driven operational management model. This will enhance capabilities in intelligent decision-making, lean manufacturing, and precision services.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating new products, new models, new formats, digital management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Relying on the industrial internet platform, achieve high-level and high-efficiency lightweight design, parallel design, agile design, interactive design, and model-based design, transform traditional design methods, enhance research and development quality and efficiency. Develop platform-based, virtualized simulation design tools, cultivate platform-based design new models, promote the integration of design, process, manufacturing, and operation and maintenance, realize production without physical prototypes, shorten the new product development cycle, and enhance product competitiveness.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating new products, new models, new formats, platform-based design.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Enhance the application capability of enterprise information technology, accelerate the digital transformation of the entire production process, promote the construction of intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, and intelligent workshops, and achieve dynamic perception, interconnection, data integration, and intelligent control of all elements and links. Promote the deep application of advanced process control systems in enterprises, accelerate the cloud deployment and optimization upgrade of manufacturing execution systems, deepen the integration and application of artificial intelligence, and improve production efficiency, product quality, and safety levels through comprehensive perception, real-time analysis, scientific decision-making, and precise execution, while reducing production costs and energy resource consumption.
titlelist: Development situation, cultivating new products, new models, new formats, intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote data interoperability and business connectivity among enterprises, and facilitate the sharing of various resources between upstream and downstream companies in the supply chain and their partners, to achieve networked collaborative design, production, and services. Promote new software tools such as cloud-based design software (CAX), cloud-based enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), cloud-based manufacturing execution systems (MES), and cloud-based supply chain management systems (SCM), to share design models, production data, user usage information, product databases, etc., and improve manufacturing resource allocation efficiency based on the industrial Internet.
titlelist: Development situation, cultivating new products, new models, new formats, and networked collaboration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: To meet the personalized needs of consumers, develop systems such as customer demand analysis, agile product development and design, flexible intelligent production, and precise delivery services. Enhance user engagement throughout the product lifecycle, achieve accurate matching of supply and demand, and improve efficiency. Encourage personalized customization enterprises with mature experience and service models to cultivate a batch of system solutions that integrate user demand acquisition, research and development design, flexible production, and delivery services based on their own personalized customization platforms and model libraries. Accelerate the demonstration and promotion of large-scale personalized customization models.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating new products, new models, new formats, personalized customization.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the digital upgrade of the industrial enterprise's product supply and service chain, extending from the original manufacturing business to the high-value-added links at both ends of the value chain. Develop new services such as equipment health management, remote product maintenance, equipment financing and leasing, shared manufacturing, supply chain finance, and general integration and contracting, to achieve a transition from simply selling products to selling products + services. Encourage industrial engineering service providers to deepen the application of new technologies such as digital simulation and manufacturing information modeling (MIM), improve the digital level of factory construction and operation and maintenance, and achieve a transition from turnkey projects to engineering construction + operation and maintenance services.
titlelist: Development situation, cultivating new products, new models, new formats, and extending services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Targeting industries such as petrochemicals, steel, non-ferrous metals, building materials, and energy, we aim to promote the digitization of production processes and management, accelerate the interconnection and integration of business systems, and achieve integrated production control. We support the construction of industry-wide operational data models, based on data analysis, to achieve process improvement, operational optimization, and quality control, thereby enhancing overall productivity. We will also develop and promote industrial Internet platforms, facilitate the cloud-based integration of key equipment, and focus on areas such as energy management, predictive maintenance, and environmental safety warnings. Additionally, we will cultivate and promote a range of process management industrial apps and solutions.
titlelist: Development situation, promote the digital transformation of the industry field, raw materials.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Enhance the support capability of intelligent manufacturing supply, carry out key common technology research and integration application in the processes of design, technology, testing, production and processing, accelerate the industrialization of technology software, overcome a batch of major equipment and major technical equipment shortcomings. Focus on key equipment areas such as machinery, automobiles, aviation, aerospace, ships, weapons, electronics, and power, build digital workshops and intelligent factories, construct digital twin systems for the entire equipment lifecycle, promote the scale application of model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and rely on industrial Internet platforms to achieve predictive maintenance and health management of equipment.
titlelist: Development situation, promote the digital transformation of industry sectors, equipment manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Ultra HD Video + 5G + AI + VR fusion innovation application project to promote the innovative application of new technology products in typical scenarios of consumer goods industries such as industrial visualization, defect detection, product assembly positioning guidance, and robot inspection. Promote the construction of automated, continuous, and flexible production systems in industries such as textiles, clothing, furniture, and home appliances, support the construction of product information traceability systems in industries such as food and pharmaceuticals, and achieve flexible production and supply-demand integration in the consumer goods industry based on the industrial Internet platform. Carry out service innovations such as user demand mining based on consumer data, product research and development, intelligent production, and data value-added, promote large-scale personalized customization, shared manufacturing, and other new models and formats, and meet the diverse and personalized consumer upgrade demands.
titlelist: Development situation, promote the digital transformation of industry sectors, consumer goods.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Guide electronic industry enterprises to deepen the innovative application of technologies such as 5G, big data, artificial intelligence, and edge computing, improve the level of software and hardware collaboration, and accelerate the development of new applications and models such as human-machine collaborative assembly and intelligent quality inspection. Support enterprises in strengthening supply chain collaborative management based on the industrial Internet platform, achieve dynamic and precise collaboration in electronic component procurement, production, inventory, quality, logistics, and other links, optimize the allocation efficiency of the entire supply chain resources, and strengthen the collaborative management level of the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain. For electronic information industry clusters, promote the platformization, convergence, and sharing of equipment and capabilities in design, manufacturing, testing, and other aspects, and enhance the collaborative development and risk prevention capabilities of industrial clusters.
titlelist: Development situation, promote the digital transformation of industry sectors, electronic information.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the Internet Plus green manufacturing action, guide enterprises to apply new generation information technology to build online monitoring systems for pollutant emissions, underground pipeline leakage detection systems, smart management platforms for industrial wastewater recycling, and energy management centers. Carry out dynamic monitoring, precise control, and optimized management of resource energy and pollutant processes, promote carbon reduction, and help achieve carbon peak and carbon neutrality. Accelerate the digitization of the green manufacturing system, promote the software packaging of green technologies, cultivate a batch of digital and modular green manufacturing solutions, and promote the innovative application of mature green manufacturing technologies. Establish an information engineering platform for ecological environmental protection in the industrial field, focus on key industries and key products throughout their life cycle, strengthen data sharing and governance among departments, build a public database of resource energy and pollutants, and improve resource energy management level.
titlelist: Developing situation, promoting digital transformation and green manufacturing in the industry sector.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Collaboratively carry out the 'Industrial Internet + Safety Production' initiative, promote the transformation of key industries through industrial internet, accelerate the networked connection, platform-based aggregation, and intelligent analysis of safety production elements. Construct a national industrial internet big data center safety production industry sub-center and data support platform, develop safety production model libraries and toolkits for different industries, and promote the software-based accumulation of safety production management knowledge and experience. Deepen the integration of industrial internet applications, guide industrial enterprises to accelerate the construction of a new capability system for safety production, which includes rapid perception, comprehensive monitoring, early warning, coordinated disposal, and systematic evaluation.
titlelist: Development situation, promote digital transformation in the industry field, and ensure safety in production.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction and application of 5G network on a large scale, formulate key industry development plans for 5G, and accelerate the construction of a nationwide, high-quality, efficient, and globally leading 5G infrastructure network. Improve the industrial Internet identification and resolution system, promote the application of new network technologies such as 5G, gigabit fiber optic network, IPv6, time-sensitive network (TSN), and software-defined network (SDN) in the industrial field, and accelerate the transformation of industrial enterprises' internal and external networks. Build an industrial Internet security monitoring system, implement classified and graded management of network security for industrial Internet enterprises, and promote standardization actions. Establish a national industrial Internet big data center system, promote the collection, transmission, processing, storage, and sharing of industrial data resources, and build a cross-regional, cross-industry industrial big data support service system.
titlelist: Develop the situation, establish a new foundation for integrated development, and build new information infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: By integrating applications to drive technological progress, we will establish an integrated platform for industry, academia, research, and application, as well as a public service platform for common technologies. We will conduct research on cutting-edge key technologies such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, and digital twins, and break through core technological bottlenecks in electronic components and basic software to accelerate the process of digital industrialization. Through product testing, marketization, and industrialization guidance, we will accelerate the integration and support of industrial chipsets, intelligent sensors, industrial control systems, and industrial software to cultivate and develop industries, enhancing the capacity of industrial infrastructure support. We will support enterprises in building a basic product system with independent intellectual property rights, utilize the insurance compensation policy for the first major technological equipment to promote the large-scale application of innovative products, leverage tax incentives, and increase the promotion of information technology innovation products. We will iterate and improve the readiness and maturity of hardware and software products and systems, and enhance the integrity and competitiveness of the industrial chain.
titlelist: Develop the situation, build a new foundation for integrated development, and enhance the capability of key core technology support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the aggregation of industrial data, conduct investigations on industrial data resources, establish a multi-level linkage national industrial basic database, and industry-specific databases for raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, etc. Implement the Guidelines for Industrial Data Classification and Grading (Trial), carry out national standardization of enterprise data management maturity assessment, and improve the level of enterprise data management. Support the construction of a secure and trustworthy industrial data sharing space by upstream and downstream companies in the industrial chain, deepen the application of industrial data, activate the potential of data elements, develop new models and formats driven by data, and promote the value enhancement of industrial data.
titlelist: Developing situation, building a new foundation for integrated development, promoting innovative development of industrial big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Establish and improve the standard system for deep integration of the two industries, relying on various professional technical organizations such as the National Technical Committee for the Integration of the Two Industries (TC573), research institutes, and alliance groups. Carry out the revision of national standards, industry standards, and group standards in key areas such as the degree of integration of the two industries, the management system for the integration of the two industries, digital transformation, industrial internet, cyber-physical systems (CPS), digital twins, digital supply chains, cloud-based equipment, data dictionaries, digital simulation in manufacturing, and industrial information security. Strengthen the promotion and dissemination of key standards such as the degree of integration of the two industries, organize the evaluation of the degree of integration of the two industries, clarify the development focus and improvement path for enterprises with different degrees of integration, and guide enterprises to gradually improve their level of information technology integration application.
titlelist: Develop the situation, build a new foundation for integrated development, and improve the standard system for deep integration of the two industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote dissemination and reuse, and build a new ecosystem for manufacturing based on platforms. Facilitate interconnection and interoperability between platforms, explore cross-platform deployment and invocation mechanisms for industrial mechanism models, microservices, and industrial apps by establishing data migration standards between platforms, and achieve data interoperability, capability collaboration, and service sharing between platforms. Column 1: Construction of the Industrial Internet Platform System. Develop comprehensive platforms across industries and domains: construct comprehensive platforms covering multiple industries such as raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, as well as multiple domains including R&D design, production manufacturing, and operation and maintenance services, providing services such as industrial resource aggregation and sharing, industrial data integration and utilization, and optimization and innovation of industrial production and services. Construct characteristic platforms targeting key industries and regions: focus on key industries with good digital foundations and strong driving effects, target regions with high concentration of manufacturing resources and urgent need for industrial transformation, construct characteristic platforms targeting key industries and regions, leverage the role of platforms in knowledge accumulation and transformation, and resource coordination and allocation, and provide driving force for industry transformation and regional coordinated development. Cultivate professional platforms in specific technical fields: build professional platforms focusing on specific industrial scenarios, such as cloud simulation, cloud-based equipment, and big data modeling, in specific technical fields, and carry out innovative applications integrating cutting-edge technologies and industrial mechanism models.
titlelist: Development situation, stimulate new vitality of enterprise entities, cultivate ecological aggregation-type platform enterprises, cultivate competitive industrial Internet platform enterprises, build a batch of comprehensive platforms across industries and fields, characteristic platforms for key industries and regions, and professional platforms for specific technologies and scenarios. Strengthen the development of industrial big data, manufacturing resource allocation, and solution aggregation capabilities, accelerate the accumulation of industrial knowledge.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support enterprises in using new technologies and applications to comprehensively transform in all aspects, angles, and chains, and cultivate a group of leading enterprises with strong innovation capabilities and outstanding brand influence in integrated applications. Give full play to the leading role of industry backbone enterprises, encourage enterprises to take the lead in exploring new technologies, new products, and new models based on their technological and industrial advantages, cultivate advanced industry system solutions, and enhance professional service capabilities. Support backbone enterprises in establishing close cooperation between technology development and innovative applications, promote the replication and promotion of industry system solutions, and lead the overall transformation and upgrading of the industry.
titlelist: Developing situation, stimulate new vitality of enterprise entities, and build exemplary leading backbone enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Implement the project to enhance the innovation capability and specialization level of small and medium-sized enterprises, incubate millions of innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate 100,000 provincial-level specialized and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, and 10,000 specialized and innovative small giants enterprises. Carry out special actions to empower digitalization for small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate and promote a batch of digital products and services that meet the needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and reduce the cost of digital transformation for small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage large enterprises to cooperate with small and medium-sized enterprises through open platforms and other forms for mutual benefit, focusing on industry advantages and key links in the industrial chain, and promoting innovation and integration among the upstream, midstream, and downstream of the industrial chain, as well as between large, medium, and small enterprises.
titlelist: Develop the situation, stimulate the new vitality of enterprise entities, and strengthen the specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: To meet the needs of digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation in the manufacturing industry, we aim to cultivate system solution providers who can offer services such as planning and design, development and implementation, integrated application, diagnostic consultation, and operation and maintenance. We focus on the application of new technologies, optimization of specific scenarios, and overall improvement of enterprises, and cultivate system solution providers with technical expertise, specialization, and comprehensiveness. We encourage the establishment of solution resource pools at the local level, and accelerate the application and promotion of high-quality solutions through service vouchers and other means, in order to lower the threshold for digital transformation of enterprises.
titlelist: Development situation, stimulate new vitality of enterprise entities, develop specialized system solution providers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the collaborative transformation of the entire industry chain through data empowerment, deepen the application of new generation information technologies such as 5G, Internet, big data, and blockchain, reconstruct the structure, processes, and models of the industry chain, strengthen the intelligent management and dynamic optimization of the industry chain across all channels, promote the transformation of the industry chain into an industry network, enhance the adaptability and self-repairing ability of the industry chain, and improve the stability and competitiveness of the industry chain. Promote end-to-end cloud collaboration in the supply chain, guide upstream and downstream enterprises to strengthen digital management and integrated collaboration in the supply chain, carry out collaborative procurement, collaborative manufacturing, and collaborative distribution based on platforms, promote the establishment of a secure management system for the supply chain, and build an agile, efficient, secure, and stable digital supply chain and supply chain network. Deepen the application of new technologies such as the Internet and blockchain, promote international capacity cooperation, accelerate the internationalization of key enterprise industrial chains, and help Chinese enterprises deeply integrate into the global industrial system.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating a new ecosystem of cross-border integration, and promoting the upgrading of industrial chain and supply chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction and co-construction of digital infrastructure such as communication networks, data centers, and energy management centers in industrial clusters, to achieve online resource utilization, flexible production capacity, and collaborative industrial chain, and enhance the overall competitiveness of industrial clusters. Guide cluster enterprises to go cloud and go platform, rely on industrial internet platforms to achieve online release, collaboration, and transaction of manufacturing capabilities, optimize the efficiency of manufacturing resource allocation, and promote the transformation of cluster enterprises towards high-end, intelligent, and green manufacturing. Create a number of industrial internet demonstration zones, build industrial internet industry demonstration bases and application innovation promotion centers, accelerate the technological breakthroughs and promotion of industrial internet, and create a highland for the development of industrial internet.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating a new ecosystem of cross-border integration, promoting the digital transformation of industrial clusters.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthening the cooperation between industry, academia, research, and application, establishing an innovative system with enterprises as the main body and coordinated industry-academia-research-application, supporting enterprises in leading the construction of national manufacturing innovation centers, cultivating a group of technology innovation sources with original innovation capabilities, and accelerating the two-way iteration of scientific and technological research and development and the application of scientific and technological achievements. Improving the mechanism for cooperation between industry and finance, exploring the establishment of a credit mechanism and financing model based on production and operation data, and guiding the capital market to increase investment in digital transformation, industrial internet, and other fields. Consolidating the foundation of integration between industry and education, supporting the construction of new engineering disciplines in information technology, improving the mechanism for cooperation between schools and enterprises, encouraging the strengthening of talent cultivation in the field of deep integration of the two industries through joint education and the construction of practical training bases, and relying on national major talent projects to increase support for leading talents in integrated development.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating a new ecosystem of cross-border integration, deepening cooperation between industry, academia, research, and application.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the coordinated development of double innovation in the manufacturing industry and the industrial internet, build a double innovation system based on the industrial internet platform, accelerate the digital transformation, online aggregation, and platform-based sharing of entrepreneurial and innovative resources such as research and development, manufacturing, management, business, logistics, and incubation. Develop new business formats such as platform economy and gig economy, and create an upgraded version of double innovation in the manufacturing industry. Adhere to the people-oriented approach, encourage companies to establish a compensation system and performance evaluation mechanism based on contributions, fully stimulate employees' enthusiasm, initiative, and creativity, and enhance the innovation vitality of enterprises.
titlelist: Developing situation, cultivating a new ecosystem of cross-border integration, and enhancing the level of innovation and entrepreneurship in the manufacturing industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a work promotion mechanism that promotes cross-departmental collaboration and inter-provincial linkage, and promote the formation of a work pattern for the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry that is market-driven, government-guided, industry-involved, enterprise-oriented, and collaborative between academia, research, and application. Develop a roadmap for digital transformation in key industries. Build an evaluation and assessment system for digital transformation in the manufacturing industry, and develop a series of implementation guidelines and toolkits for promoting digital transformation in enterprises. Promote the accelerated digital transformation in key industries such as raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, green manufacturing, and safety production. Build a digital transformation capability system for manufacturing enterprises. Organize pilot demonstrations of the integration of next-generation information technology and the manufacturing industry, with a focus on enhancing new capabilities such as integrated management, data interoperability, software development, intelligent applications, and security protection, and guide enterprises to develop new models such as digital management, platform-based design, intelligent manufacturing, networked collaboration, personalized customization, and extended services. Column 2 focuses on the digital transformation of key industries. Key industries focus on the digital transformation. In the steel industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as inefficient equipment maintenance, opaque production processes, fragmented downstream demand, and increased environmental pressure. Starting with process optimization, accelerate the digital transformation towards intelligent equipment operation and maintenance, transparent production processes, coordinated supply chain, and clean environmental management. In the petrochemical industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as opaque equipment management, difficulties in knowledge transfer, low level of upstream and downstream collaboration in the industrial chain, and high pressure on safety production. Starting with intelligent equipment control, carry out digital transformation in areas such as equipment health management, intelligent refining and production, supply chain collaboration, and safety monitoring. In the coal industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as environmental pollution, high production risks, and difficulties in equipment management. Starting with safety production, promote the accelerated digital transformation towards intelligent, unmanned, and green production by focusing on production, management, logistics, and maintenance. In the aerospace industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as differences in data sources, poor model adaptability, weak management adjustment capabilities, and poor fault prediction capabilities. Starting with networked collaboration, carry out digital transformation in areas such as integrating research and development resources, restructuring production paradigms, transforming management models, and improving maintenance efficiency. In the shipbuilding industry, the focus is on optimizing and improving the quality and efficiency of the entire chain from ship design, research and development, production, management to services. Starting with networked collaboration and extended services, carry out digital transformation in areas such as collaborative design, intelligent manufacturing, lean management, online financing, and product services. In the automotive industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as long design cycles, personalized downstream demand, and inefficient after-sales service. Starting with mass customization production, accelerate digital transformation towards collaborative research and development, flexible production, coordinated manufacturing and supply, and service-oriented manufacturing. In the construction machinery industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as low efficiency in resource allocation, difficulties in equipment operation and maintenance, and incomplete financial ecosystem. Starting with equipment health management, accelerate digital transformation towards intelligent equipment operation and maintenance, lean management, and service-oriented production and manufacturing. In the home appliance industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as low level of intelligent production, low efficiency of supply chain collaboration, and slowing industry revenue growth. Starting with personalized customization, accelerate digital transformation towards flexible production methods, platform-based management, and product-service ecosystem. In the electronics industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as long production cycles for new products, insufficient equipment management accuracy, and labor-intensive processes. Starting with intelligent equipment, carry out digital transformation in areas such as equipment health management, intelligent production, product quality testing, and supply chain collaboration.
titlelist: Key projects, formulation of action plans for the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Carry out the standard formulation and evaluation promotion work for the integration of the two industries. Organize the formulation of standards for the integration of the two industries, clarify the criteria and levels of information technology integration application for enterprises at different integration levels, organize the implementation of the integration level standard for enterprises, evaluate the level of automation, digitization, networking, and intelligence of enterprises through integration levels, guide enterprises to form integration capabilities, and drive enterprises to improve integration levels. Build an upgraded version of the integrated management system for the two industries. Guide local governments, central enterprise groups, industry organizations, etc., to innovate and carry out pilot demonstrations and hierarchical integrated assessment of the integrated management system for the two industries, accelerate the full coverage of the integrated management system for the two industries in key areas and advantageous industries, and promote its scale in small and medium-sized enterprise clusters. Improve the market-oriented service system for the promotion of standard application. Construct and improve the standardized public service platform for the integration of the two industries, develop automated tools for integrated standardization of the two industries, provide full-process services for integrated standardization, and continuously improve the market-oriented service capabilities and quality of integrated standardization.
titlelist: Key Projects, Integration of Two Industries Leading the Action

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Cultivate and form a batch of high-value industry solutions in various industries and links, including equipment monitoring and early warning, lean research and development, lean production, and industrial chain collaboration, to support the creation of a solution resource pool and effectively enhance the specialization and integration level of industry system solutions. Cultivate and promote cloud-based solutions for industrial equipment. Focus on key equipment such as high-energy-consuming equipment, general power equipment, new energy equipment, and intelligent equipment, accelerate the cultivation of high-quality cloud-based solutions for equipment, continuously improve the standard system and evaluation indicators for equipment cloudization, explore the release of performance rankings and related indices for equipment cloudization, and guide enterprises to promote equipment cloudization in an orderly and standardized manner. Improve and perfect the application and promotion ecosystem of solutions. Accelerate the development of a group of system solution providers around comprehensive service needs such as planning and design, development and implementation, integrated application, diagnostic consultation, and operation and maintenance, promote the integrated development of solution providers with industrial software and intelligent equipment enterprises, and create a good ecosystem for precise matching of supply and demand and win-win cooperation among all parties. Column 3 focuses on cloudization of key industrial equipment. Potential application scenarios for pain points of key industrial equipment. Inefficient management of ironmaking blast furnace equipment, extensive environmental management, opaque production processes, low level of equipment interconnection, health management, green production, production process optimization, and production line collaborative control. Inefficient energy management of industrial boilers, opaque combustion status, high safety risks, efficient energy management, combustion control, and health management. High energy consumption, high safety risks, large shutdown losses, and difficult operation of petrochemical equipment, energy saving and consumption reduction, safety warning, predictive maintenance, and simulation operation. Diesel generator core equipment relies on imports, complex equipment operating conditions, equipment prone to failure, intelligent research and development, online management, intelligent maintenance, and intelligent production. Low utilization efficiency, high maintenance costs, high safety risks, high energy consumption costs of large and medium-sized motors, state monitoring, fault warning, intelligent operation and maintenance, and energy consumption optimization. Difficulties in operation monitoring of large air compressors, extensive energy management, and huge consequences of hidden dangers, operation and maintenance control, equipment energy saving optimization, and after-sales service operation and maintenance. Difficulties in wind power data collection, high equipment operation and maintenance costs, and low efficiency of wind farm management, virtual wind farm design, equipment predictive maintenance, and wind farm management optimization. Low operating efficiency and high cost of photovoltaic equipment, unstable energy utilization rate, and huge hidden dangers in safe operation, panoramic monitoring, intelligent analysis, and digital management. Multiple equipment failures, low construction efficiency, and imperfect financial system for construction machinery equipment, remote operation and maintenance, intelligent construction, and financing leasing. High operation and maintenance costs of CNC machine tools, low equipment utilization efficiency, poor real-time production management, and difficulties in equipment transformation and upgrading, production capacity sharing, intelligent operation and maintenance of cutting tools, and enterprise operation decision-making.
titlelist: Key projects, action to enhance the capability of system solution, building a resource pool for system solutions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Develop and promote digital management standards for the supply chain. Organize the development of key urgently needed standards for digital supply chain management, and carry out pilot projects in key industries such as aviation, electronics, and automotive to guide enterprises in adopting digital tools and solutions for the supply chain, and enhance their digital management capabilities. Improve the level of digitalization in key areas of the industrial chain supply chain. In key industries such as electronics, medical, and engineering machinery, guide industry organizations, research institutes, leading enterprises, etc., to deepen the application of technologies such as big data, blockchain, and industrial internet, and improve the level of digitalization in the industrial chain supply chain, enhancing the accuracy and agility of collaborative operations in the industrial chain supply chain. Accelerate the development of industrial e-commerce. Guide large manufacturing enterprises to transform their procurement and sales platforms into industry e-commerce platforms, and improve the level of supply chain collaboration. Guide third-party industrial e-commerce platforms to extend their services to online transactions, payment settlements, supply chain finance, big data analysis, and other comprehensive services, enhancing their operational service capabilities. V. Guarantee measures. (1) Improve the implementation mechanism. Strengthen inter-departmental, inter-provincial, and central-local cooperation, coordinate the promotion of key projects and action plans such as innovation and development of industrial internet, digital transformation of manufacturing industry, intelligent manufacturing, and development of industrial big data. Localities should formulate supporting policies and plans based on their actual conditions, implement the overall requirements, goals, and tasks of the plans, and play a good combination of policies. Give full play to the bridging role of multiple entities such as research institutes, industry organizations, and industrial alliances, clarify division of responsibilities, and strengthen collaborative linkage. Optimize and improve the monitoring, analysis, performance evaluation, and supervision and assessment mechanisms for the deep integration of the two industries, and regularly carry out tracking and evaluation of plan implementation to ensure effective implementation of the plans.
titlelist: Key project, digital upgrading action of industrial chain and supply chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Make full use of mechanisms such as major special projects and the manufacturing industry transformation and upgrading fund to increase financial support for the construction and promotion of digital 'new infrastructure', industrial internet platform construction, research and development, and industrialization of common technologies for deep integration of the two industries. Encourage eligible regions to establish special funds in accordance with regulations, explore the establishment of diversified and multi-channel mechanisms for social investment, and strengthen financial support for the digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises. Implement tax preferential policies well to create a favorable development environment for manufacturing enterprises.
titlelist: Key projects, increase financial and tax funding support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Establish efficient interdepartmental linkage mechanisms, relying on internet platforms, big data platforms, etc., to promote cross-departmental, cross-level, and cross-regional data sharing and process interoperability, continuously strengthen the synergy of integrated development. Relax market access restrictions on new products, new models, and new formats, clear institutional barriers that restrict the free flow of talents, capital, technology, data, etc., and strengthen the fundamental position of competition policy. Promote full alignment of relevant industries in technology, standards, policies, etc., strengthen intellectual property protection, and create an external environment conducive to deep integration of the two industries. Carry out various forms of publicity, promotion, and training exchanges, enhance the understanding of various participating entities such as government, enterprises, industry organizations, research institutes, etc., on the deep integration of the two industries, strengthen internet thinking, big data thinking, and enhance the ability to utilize innovation in the new generation of information technology. Strengthen international exchanges and cooperation. Make full use of bilateral and multilateral international exchange and cooperation mechanisms to deepen the international cooperation in the fields of deep integration, industrial internet, open-source software, supply chain finance, etc., strengthen international standardization work, and carry out overseas intellectual property layout. Expand the opening-up of the manufacturing industry, encourage foreign-funded enterprises to establish research and development institutions in the country. Implement the Belt and Road Initiative, support global collaboration of excellent enterprises, products, and technologies, and strengthen the international promotion of the integrated development Chinese solution.
titlelist: Key projects, optimizing the environment for integrated development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: By integrating 'cloud, network, and end', we systematically deploy the innovation chain around key links in the industrial chain such as information perception, information transmission, and information processing. We implement the 'ranking system' to encourage and support backbone enterprises to increase their efforts in key core technology research and development, break through key common technologies such as intelligent perception, new short-distance communication, and high-precision positioning, fill the gaps in high-end sensors, IoT chips, and other industries, and further enhance the supply capacity of high-performance and universal IoT perception terminals.
titlelist: Key projects, action to enhance innovation capabilities, breakthrough in key core technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Facing '5G + Internet of Things', fully utilize the high reliability, low latency, and large connectivity characteristics of the 5G network, enrich the supply of communication technology, and expand the application scenarios of the Internet of Things; facing 'big data + Internet of Things', achieve efficient collaborative processing of data, and deeply explore the value of physical world data; facing 'artificial intelligence + Internet of Things', establish an intelligent service of 'perception terminal + platform + scenario'; facing 'blockchain + Internet of Things', establish a credit system for perception terminals to ensure data ownership and value circulation.
titlelist: Key projects, action to enhance innovation capabilities, promoting technological integration and innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage local leading enterprises, research institutes, and universities to establish a batch of Internet of Things (IoT) technology incubation and innovation centers, to connect the chain of technology transfer, and to promote the trial and commercial application of technological achievements. Encourage leading enterprises to form IoT industry technology alliances with upstream and downstream companies, and explore the development model of patent + standard + open-source community to stimulate innovation vitality. Relying on foundations and open-source communities, gather developer and user resources to jointly create mature open-source products and application solutions, and form a collaborative innovation ecosystem with international competitiveness. Column 1: Guidelines for enhancing innovation capabilities. Key core technologies. Support the research and development of intelligent sensing technologies that enable multi-source and massive data access, promote the development of new short-range communication technologies with low power consumption, high security, and high speed, strengthen the research and development of high-reliability and wide-coverage Beidou positioning and high-precision indoor positioning technologies, break through the design and manufacturing of MEMS sensors and IoT chips, and develop lightweight/distributed IoT operating systems. Accelerate the research and development and application of edge computing, digital twins, IPv6, and other technologies. Technological integration and innovation. Continuously optimize technologies such as low latency, low power consumption, and large connectivity, and enhance the communication support of 5G for the IoT. Conduct research on big data technologies such as perception data cleaning, standard modeling and feature analysis of physical world data, and integration and sharing of multi-source heterogeneous data sets, to further unleash the value of IoT data. Conduct research on artificial intelligence technologies such as speech recognition, video recognition, machine learning, models of object behavior, and knowledge graphs, enrich the interaction methods of perception terminals, and enhance the knowledge model accumulation and professional level upgrade in IoT services. Conduct in-depth research on the applicability of lightweight, low-energy consumption distributed ledgers, asymmetric encryption, and other blockchain technologies in the deployment of IoT applications.
titlelist: Key projects, action to enhance innovation capabilities, and building a collaborative innovation mechanism.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Cultivate a group of leading companies with advanced technology and strong resource integration capabilities, deepen the collaboration between industry, academia, and research institutions, promote efficient allocation of innovation chains, industrial chains, and capital chains, and promote the large-scale deployment of perception terminals, platforms, and network infrastructure. Cultivate a group of specialized and innovative small giants in the field of the Internet of Things, targeting specific scenarios and niche areas, and become suppliers of advanced technology products and applicable solutions. Cultivate a group of Internet of Things service providers, providing services such as program design, integrated implementation, network operation and maintenance, business management, and network information security protection.
titlelist: Key projects, industrial ecological cultivation action, cultivating diversified market entities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of new industrialization demonstration bases for the Internet of Things in regions with distinctive industrial characteristics, good basic conditions, and outstanding application demonstration effects, and continue to leverage the brand awareness and influence of existing demonstration bases. Accelerate the development of industrial agglomeration, carry out pilot projects for new products, new services, and new models, and optimize the allocation of policy, talent, technology, and capital resources. Column 2: Guidelines for the cultivation of industrial ecology. Diversify market entities. Encourage leading enterprises to develop universal and serialized software and hardware products around perception terminals and platforms, shift from single-point efforts to the construction of an ecological system, and promote the scale and intensive development of the Internet of Things. Encourage little giant enterprises specializing in the Internet of Things to focus on key areas with strong market demand and clear application models, and promote mature technology products and solutions through a combination of online and offline methods. Relying on Internet of Things service providers, launch replicable and easily promotable operation models, and provide differentiated service models for cities, enterprises, consumers, etc., to stimulate business model innovation. Strengthen the development of industrial agglomeration. Combining regional development strategies such as the coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta, the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the comprehensive revitalization of the Northeast, the development of the western region, and the construction of the Chengdu-Chongqing twin-city economic circle, construct and improve the industrial chain of the Internet of Things, promote local digital transformation and intelligent upgrading, cultivate several national demonstration bases for the new industrialization of the Internet of Things, and enhance the level of industrial agglomeration development.
titlelist: Key projects, industrial ecological cultivation action, strengthening the development of industrial agglomeration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Using agriculture, manufacturing, construction, ecological environment, cultural tourism, and other digital transformation and intelligent upgrading as driving forces, accelerate the deployment of sensing terminal applications such as data collection terminals, meters, and controllers, support the use of new network technologies to transform enterprise intranets and industry-specific networks, and build platforms that provide services such as environmental monitoring, information tracing, status warning, and identification resolution. Create a batch of industry-adapted solutions and application benchmarks. Column 4: Industry Application Construction Guidelines. Smart agriculture. Promote the deployment of sensing terminals such as information perception and data collection in agricultural production, environmental monitoring, biological ontology recognition, plant pests and diseases prevention and control, as well as livestock and aquaculture, dynamic monitoring of fishing vessels, and quality and safety control. Build an agricultural and rural monitoring network, establish platforms for traceability of agricultural products, remote monitoring of fisheries law enforcement, and monitoring of aquatic biological resources, and promote the digital transformation of agricultural production, operation, and management services. Intelligent manufacturing. Accelerate the deployment of sensing devices such as radio frequency identification, intelligent sensors, and visual recognition, promote the transformation of dumb devices data collection and networking capabilities in industrial sites, and realize real-time monitoring of production status, production environment, and materials. Encourage industrial enterprises to use time-sensitive networks, 5G, and other new network technologies to upgrade and transform enterprise intranets and extranets. Encourage IoT companies to collaborate with industrial enterprises to build IoT platforms around typical applications such as equipment health management, integrated operation and control, and on-site assembly. Smart construction. Accelerate the application of IoT technologies such as intelligent sensors, radio frequency identification (RFID), QR codes, near-field communication, and low-power wide-area networks in the production, procurement, and transportation of building materials, BIM collaborative design, smart construction sites, smart operation and maintenance, and smart buildings. Use IoT technology to enhance the intelligent management and supervision level of construction quality, personnel safety, and green construction. Smart environmental protection. Promote the application deployment of low-power, miniaturized, and intelligent ecological environment sensing terminals in water, marine, atmospheric, soil, solid waste, nuclear and radiation safety, carbon emissions, and other aspects. Build a comprehensive management and data sharing platform for ecological environment, create typical applications such as pollution source management, ecological environment monitoring, ecological protection, and supervision and law enforcement, and enhance the ecological environment perception capability and intelligent management decision-making level. Smart cultural tourism. Promote the construction and application of intelligent gates, smart screens in scenic areas, electronic tickets, mobile tour guides, and other sensing terminals. Especially accelerate the application deployment of sensing terminals such as environmental monitoring, micro-environment regulation, and video passenger counters in cultural relic protection, and promote the construction of comprehensive tourism service platforms. Evaluate immersive experiences, virtual exhibition halls, high-definition live broadcasts, and other new cultural tourism services, and provide tourists with safer, more convenient, and comfortable quality tourism services.
titlelist: Key projects, integrated application development actions, industry application areas.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the deployment of perception terminals and smart products in homes, buildings, and communities. Build smart homes with heterogeneous product interconnection and centralized control, and construct low-carbon, environmentally friendly, safe, and comfortable smart buildings and new communities. Encourage cross-industry cooperation between IoT companies and sports equipment manufacturers, rehabilitation aid producers, elderly care institutions, sports venues, etc., to accelerate the popularization of wearable devices, smart medical and health products, and smart sports equipment applications. Column 5: Guidelines for Livelihood Consumption. Smart homes. Accelerate the integration of multi-modal biometric recognition, interconnection, over-the-air (OTA) downloading, and other technologies with home appliances, lighting, door locks, home gateways, etc., develop and promote apps based on unified application programming interfaces (APIs), and enhance user experience. Promote the deployment of perception terminals such as video surveillance, smart access control, energy management, fire warning, etc., strengthen personal privacy protection, data security, and security supervision, and promote the construction of integrated management platforms for buildings and communities. Smart health. Research and develop smart wearable devices with personal health monitoring functions, and promote the clinical application of perception terminals with medical and diagnostic performance. Promote the application of smart sports equipment in swimming, ice and snow training, and competitions. Utilize indoor precise positioning, digital twinning, and other technologies to create smart venues with features such as unmanned operation, energy saving and environmental protection, and digital operation.
titlelist: Key projects, integrated application development action, people's livelihood consumption field.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the technical standards and specifications for the detection of Internet of Things (IoT) terminal access, and clarify the requirements for IPv6 network access. Promote the upgrading and use of IPv6 in IoT platforms, terminals, gateway devices, etc. for public networks, and encourage new products to support and enable IPv6 functionality by default. Guide and encourage enterprises to adopt IPv6-based application solutions for industry applications, and promote the application of IoT terminals and modules that support IPv6. Peking University Law Information. Possess the capability to allocate IPv6 addresses to mobile IoT users. Conduct pilot demonstrations of IPv6-based IoT applications in the industry. Organize pilot projects for IoT applications based on IPv6, and solicit applications for demonstration of technology platforms and innovative projects based on IPv6 for IoT. Promote the completion of IPv6 transformation for more than 3 large-scale smart home platforms and over 50 household IoT terminals in the field of smart homes, and support IPv6-based access management. Promote the IPv6 transformation of smart IoT terminals in the fields of household water, electricity, and gas, and newly deployed smart IoT terminals for household water, electricity, and gas should support IPv6 and have IPv6 functionality enabled by default.
titlelist: Key projects, optimization of support systems, and promotion of large-scale application of IPv6.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Optimize and improve the Internet of Things (IoT) standard system, establish a comprehensive standard framework for the entire IoT industry chain, accelerate the revision of national and industry standards for new technology products, infrastructure construction, and industry applications, and encourage the trial implementation of group standards. Continuously participate deeply in international standardization organizations such as the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), and the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), and enhance China's contribution to international standardization activities. Strengthen the implementation and evaluation of key standards.
titlelist: Key projects, optimization of support system actions, strengthening the construction of standard systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the innovative thinking and concepts of professional service organizations, enhance their capabilities in intellectual property, technology transfer, talent training, and investment and financing services. Build a public service platform for technology and standards, and provide services such as new technology verification, testing and certification, product quality grading, and system evaluation.
