Guide local industry associations, industrial parks, research institutes, and leading enterprises to jointly establish resource-sharing platforms, and open up resources such as scientific research instruments, testing equipment, and research and development capabilities.
titlelist: Key projects, optimization of support system, improvement of public service system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate research on security technologies related to perception, access, transmission, data, and applications. Accelerate the construction of security monitoring, early warning analysis, and response and disposal techniques for the Internet of Things (IoT), and enhance the security level of perception terminals, networks, data, and systems. Strengthen the security management of IoT cards and promote the establishment of a comprehensive life cycle management system for IoT cards, including pre-sale risk assessment, classification registration during sales, and post-sale usage monitoring. Speed up the application and promotion of commercial encryption technologies and products in the field of IoT, establish a detection platform for cryptographic applications in the IoT field, and enhance the security and application level of commercial encryption in the IoT field. Strengthen the adaptability of IoT application scenarios and spectrum resource utilization to ensure the security of IoT frequency usage. Relying on alliance associations, carry out the Hundred Enterprises, Thousand Products program for cultivating basic security in the IoT, establish a secure public service platform, conduct security capability assessments, and create IoT Trustworthy Products. Three, security measures.
titlelist: Key projects, optimization of support system actions, strengthening safety support and guarantee.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Improve the statistical system of the Internet of Things industry to provide a scientific basis for evaluating the effectiveness of action plans. Continuously strengthen the quality evaluation of new industrialization demonstration bases for the Internet of Things, standardize the process management and third-party evaluation of key actions such as revealing the list and appointing the leader.
titlelist: Key projects, establish a sound statistical and evaluation mechanism.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support and guide ordinary higher education institutions and vocational colleges to increase the cultivation of talent in the field of the Internet of Things, and fill the talent gap. Encourage enterprises to jointly establish laboratories and training bases with colleges and research institutions, and enhance the supply of innovative, applied, and composite talents in the Internet of Things. Promote the improvement and perfection of the occupational technical skills standard system for Internet of Things talents.
titlelist: Key projects, improving the talent training system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the leading and driving role of fiscal funds, encourage local governments to establish special funds for the Internet of Things (IoT), and guide financial institutions to participate in the construction of new IoT infrastructure. Implement tax preferential policies such as additional deduction for research and development expenses to promote increased R&D investment by enterprises. Promote the integration of social capital with small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to address the financing issues of the IoT.
titlelist: Key projects, increase financial and taxation support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Relying on the Belt and Road initiative, fully utilizing cooperation mechanisms such as the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), promote exchanges and cooperation in areas such as technological research and development, industrialization promotion, infrastructure construction, and talent cultivation. Support domestic Internet of Things (IoT) companies in establishing branches overseas, actively expand international cooperation channels, and enhance the level of international development.
titlelist: Key projects, deepening international exchanges and cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the research and innovation of NB-IoT technology, accelerate the research and formulation of international and domestic standards. Based on the completed NB-IoT 3GPP international standard, combined with domestic NB-IoT network deployment planning, application strategies, and industry demands, accelerate the formulation of domestic NB-IoT device, module, and other technical requirements and testing methods standards. Enhance the research on NB-IoT enhancement and evolution technology, and ensure the orderly connection with 5G massive IoT technology to guarantee the continuous evolution of NB-IoT.
titlelist: Strengthen the research on NB-IoT standards and technologies, build a complete industrial system, lead international standard research, and accelerate the implementation of NB-IoT standards domestically.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research is conducted on key technologies such as positioning functionality, mobility management, power saving, security mechanisms, and transmission performance optimization in response to the application requirements of different vertical industries. This ensures that the NB-IoT system can provide reliable services for different businesses in different environments. Accelerate the research on the application of eSIM/soft SIM in NB-IoT networks.
titlelist: Strengthen the research on NB-IoT standards and technologies, build a complete industrial system, carry out key technology research, and enhance NB-IoT service capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Relevant companies need to accelerate product research and development in NB-IoT dedicated chips, modules, network equipment, IoT application products, and service platforms. They should strengthen collaboration and innovation in all aspects, overcome weaknesses in modules and other areas, and build a complete industrial chain that spans all aspects of NB-IoT products. This will provide diverse products and application systems that meet market demands.
titlelist: Strengthen the research on NB-IoT standards and technologies, build a complete industrial system, promote comprehensive industrial development, and establish a sound NB-IoT complete industrial chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage localities to adapt to local conditions, combining urban management and industrial development needs to expand new applications, models, and formats based on NB-IoT technology. Carry out NB-IoT pilot demonstrations and gradually expand the scope of application industries and fields. Through pilot demonstrations, further clarify the applicable scenarios of NB-IoT technology, strengthen interoperability among different suppliers' products, and promote the healthy development of NB-IoT technology and industry. By 2017, achieve over 20 million M2M (machine-to-machine) connections based on NB-IoT, and by 2020, the total number of connections will exceed 600 million.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, carry out pilot demonstration projects for NB-IoT applications, and promote the maturity of technology and industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the application of NB-IoT technology in smart homes, wearable devices, childcare and elderly care, pet tracking, and consumer electronics. Strengthen business model innovation, enhance the supply capacity of consumer-oriented NB-IoT products, serve the diverse lives of the people, and promote information consumption.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, and drive the application of NB-IoT in personal life, promoting the development of information consumption.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Explore the application scenarios combining NB-IoT technology with industrial Internet and intelligent manufacturing, promote integrated innovation, utilize NB-IoT technology to monitor and control the production and manufacturing process, expand the application of NB-IoT technology in fields such as logistics and agriculture, and contribute to the construction of a manufacturing powerhouse.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, explore the application of NB-IoT in the industrial manufacturing sector, and serve the construction of a manufacturing powerhouse.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage 'double innovation' enterprises such as shared bicycles and smart hardware to use NB-IoT technology for technical and business innovation. Basic telecommunications companies should open up and provide services in areas such as access, security, billing, business QoS guarantee, cloud platform, and big data processing, in order to reduce the usage costs for small and medium-sized enterprises and entrepreneurs, and to support the development of the 'Internet+' and 'double innovation'.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, encourage the application of NB-IoT in new technologies and new businesses, and support innovation and entrepreneurship.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Taking into account the needs of 3G, 4G, and future 5G networks, and considering the requirements of business scenarios based on NB-IoT, it is necessary to allocate the working frequency bands of the NB-IoT system reasonably. Based on the scale and demand of NB-IoT business development, proper planning, scientific allocation, and adjustment of code and resource management should be carried out.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, reasonably allocate the working frequency of the NB-IoT system, and coordinate the planning and allocation of code and resource.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the establishment of NB-IoT network security management mechanisms, clarify the security responsibilities and obligations of different entities such as operators, product and service providers, and strengthen NB-IoT device management. Establish a network security system that covers the perception layer, transmission layer, and application layer. Establish and improve relevant mechanisms to strengthen the protection of user information, personal privacy, and important data.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable conditions for sustainable development, establish a sound NB-IoT network and information security guarantee system, and enhance security protection capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the integration of smart cities, Internet Plus, and innovation-driven entrepreneurship in various regions, strengthen the integration and innovation between the information industry and vertical industries, actively support the development of NB-IoT, establish a policy system conducive to the promotion, innovation incentives, and orderly competition of NB-IoT applications, and create a favorable development environment.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, actively guide integrated innovation, and create a favorable development environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Support research institutions, basic telecommunications companies, chip, module and equipment manufacturing companies, business operation companies, and other related units in the industrial chain to form an industry alliance. Strengthen public services such as NB-IoT-related research, testing and verification, and industrial promotion. Summarize the experience of excellent pilot demonstration cases and provide technical support for the large-scale commercial use of NB-IoT.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, organize the establishment of industry alliances, and build NB-IoT public service platforms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The basic telecommunications enterprises, pilot demonstration sites, local industrial and information technology authorities, and industry alliances should improve the relevant data statistics and information collection mechanisms, and timely track and understand the development trends of the NB-IoT industry.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, improve the data statistics mechanism, and track the basic development of the NB-IoT industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of a collaborative innovation system. Take enterprises as the main body and accelerate the construction of an innovation system that combines government, industry, academia, research, and application. Coordinate the development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, technology transfer, product manufacturing, and application deployment, fully mobilize various innovation resources, create industry-oriented innovation centers, key laboratories, and other integrated innovation carriers, and strengthen research and development and collaborative innovation. Continue to support the development of various IoT industries and technology alliances, guide alliances to strengthen cooperation and resource sharing, strengthen intellectual property management for technology transfer and diffusion, promote industry-demand integration, and effectively integrate upstream and downstream collaboration in the industrial chain. Support enterprises in establishing IoT research and development institutions and laboratories to enhance innovation capabilities and levels. Encourage enterprises to collaborate with universities and scientific research institutions, and facilitate the transformation of scientific research achievements. Integrate and utilize international innovation resources, support and encourage enterprises to carry out cross-border mergers and acquisitions, establish joint ventures with foreign companies for joint development, introduce high-end talents, and achieve innovation at a high level and starting point. Breakthrough in key core technologies. Research on low-power processor technology and integrated circuit design processes for IoT applications, carry out research and development of high-performance, low-cost, integrated, miniaturized, and low-power intelligent sensor technology and products for key areas, enhance the technological level in the fields of intelligent sensor design, manufacturing, packaging and integration, multi-sensor integration and data fusion, and reliability. Research on service-oriented IoT network architecture, communication technology, and networking intelligent transmission technology, accelerate the development of low-power wide area network technologies such as NB-IoT and network virtualization technology. Research on intelligent information processing technologies such as IoT perception data and knowledge representation, intelligent decision-making, cross-platform and capability open processing, and open public data services, support the research and industrialization of IoT operating systems and data sharing service platforms, further improve basic functional components, application development environments, and peripheral modules. Develop a secure and controllable identification management system that supports multiple applications. Strengthen the integration and innovation of IoT with mobile Internet, cloud computing, big data, and other fields, and focus on the research and development of intelligent information service systems and key technologies that meet the needs of IoT services. Strengthen the accumulation and layout of various intellectual property rights. Special Column 1: Key Technology Breakthrough Project.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, perfecting the technological innovation system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Core sensitive components: sensitive materials such as experimental biological materials, graphene, and special functional ceramics, to seize the first-mover advantage in the frontier sensitive materials field; strengthen the research on the sensitive mechanism, structure, and packaging process of silicon-based sensors, and accelerate the research and industrialization of various sensitive devices. Sensor integration, miniaturization, and low power consumption: carry out research on technology and processes such as integrating similar and different types of sensors, supporting circuits, and sensitive components. Support the formation of different types of sensitive chips based on MEMS processes and thin film process technology, and carry out packaging and packaging process innovation for various different structural forms. Support the development of modular devices with external energy self-collection, power-off sleep self-starting, and energy storage and power control. Key application areas: support the research and development of high-performance sensors and application technologies such as inertia, pressure, magnetic force, acceleration, light, image, temperature and humidity, distance, and actively overcome new types of sensor products.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, improving the technology innovation system, sensor technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Continuously track and study the evolution trend of the Internet of Things architecture, actively promote interconnection and standardization between different IoT network architectures, with a focus on supporting trusted system architecture and interoperability technology research in network communication and data sharing. Strengthen research on resource abstraction, resource access, semantic technology, as well as component technology for key entities, interface protocols, and general capabilities in the Internet of Things.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, improving the technological innovation system, system architecture common technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: User interactive operating system: Promote the porting of mobile terminal operating systems to IoT terminals, with a focus on supporting the research and development of IoT operating systems in key areas such as smart homes and wearable devices. Real-time operating system: Focus on supporting the research and development of IoT operating systems in key areas such as industrial control, aerospace, etc., and develop various peripheral modules such as file systems and network protocol stacks that adapt to the characteristics of the IoT, as well as various development interfaces and tools. Support enterprises in launching open-source operating systems and opening up kernel development documents, and encourage users to engage in secondary development of the operating system.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, improve the technological innovation system, operating system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Focus on mobile terminals, with emphasis on supporting research on human-computer interaction, micro-intelligent sensors, integrated MEMS sensors, ultra-high frequency or microwave RFID, and fusion communication modules suitable for mobile terminals. Focus on research on operating systems, data sharing service platforms, and other technologies for the integration of the Internet of Things. Breakthrough key technologies in data collection and exchange, compression, indexing, storage, and multidimensional query of massive high-frequency data. Develop distributed basic software platforms for big data stream computing and real-time in-memory computing. Combine with typical application scenarios such as industry, intelligent transportation, and smart cities to break through key technologies in IoT data analysis, mining, and visualization, and form specialized application software products and services.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, improving the technological innovation system, key technologies for the integration of the Internet of Things and mobile Internet, and big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Improve standardized top-level design. Establish and improve the standard system for the Internet of Things, and publish guidelines for the standardization of the Internet of Things. Further promote the coordinated development of national standards, industry standards, and group standards for the Internet of Things, with enterprises as the main body for standard formulation, actively incorporating innovative achievements into international standards, accelerating the construction of technical standard testing and verification environments, and improving standardized information services. Strengthen the formulation of key common technology standards. Accelerate the formulation of perception technology and equipment standards such as sensors, instruments, radio frequency identification, multimedia collection, and geographic coordinate positioning. Organize the formulation of network technology standards such as wireless sensor networks, low-power wide area networks, network virtualization, and heterogeneous network integration. Formulate information processing standards such as operating systems, middleware, data management and exchange, data analysis and mining, and service support. Formulate basic common standards such as Internet of Things identification and resolution, network and information security, reference models and evaluation tests. Promote the development of industry application standards. Vigorously carry out the formulation of urgently needed application standards for industries such as connected vehicles, health services, and smart homes, and continue to promote standardization work in application areas such as industry, agriculture, public safety, transportation, and environmental protection. Strengthen organization and coordination, establish a joint working mechanism for standard formulation, experimental verification, and application promotion, strengthen information exchange and sharing, promote the joint formulation of cross-industry standards by standardization organizations, and encourage the development of group standards. Support alliances and leading enterprises in formulating industry application standards.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, constructing a comprehensive standard system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) and the manufacturing industry. Digitize, network, and intelligentize key processes such as manufacturing units, production lines, workshops, and factory construction to enable deep perception, dynamic monitoring, data aggregation, and intelligent decision-making throughout the entire production process, industry chain, and product lifecycle. Through real-time perception and advanced modeling analysis of on-site industrial data, intelligent decision-making and control can be achieved. Improve industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms, enhance the development and utilization of industrial big data, realize personalized customization, intelligent production, networked collaboration, and service-oriented transformation of the industrial system, accelerate pilot demonstrations of smart manufacturing, and extensively deploy the Internet of Things and Industrial Internet in discrete and process manufacturing industries, forming a new cross-border integrated manufacturing ecosystem. Accelerate the deep integration of the Internet of Things with various industries. Organize and implement major application demonstration projects in important fields such as agriculture, logistics, energy, environmental protection, and healthcare, promote the integration and innovation of the Internet of Things, and support its large-scale application. Implement regional pilot projects for agricultural IoT, promote the application of agricultural IoT, and improve the level of agricultural intelligence and precision. Deepen the large-scale application of the Internet of Things in logistics fields such as warehousing, transportation, distribution, and ports, support multimodal transportation, and build an intelligent and efficient logistics system. Increase the promotion and application of the Internet of Things in pollution source monitoring, ecological environment monitoring, and other aspects to improve pollution control and environmental protection. Deepen the application of the Internet of Things in energy production, transmission, storage, consumption, and other aspects such as power, oil and gas, and public building energy efficiency, enhance the level of energy management intelligence and refinement, and improve energy utilization efficiency. Promote the application of the Internet of Things technology in fields such as pharmaceutical circulation and use, patient care, and electronic medical record management, actively promote telemedicine, clinical data application demonstrations, and other medical applications. Promote innovation in the application of the Internet of Things in the consumer sector. Encourage innovation in IoT technology, business, and models, actively cultivate new models and formats, and promote rapid growth in applications such as connected cars, smart homes, and health services in the consumer sector. Strengthen innovation and application demonstrations of connected car technology, develop applications such as autonomous driving, safety and energy saving, and location-based services in connected cars. Promote the large-scale development of smart home applications such as home security, smart appliance control, and home environment management, and create a thriving smart home ecosystem. Develop IoT applications for community health services, carry out remote health management based on smart wearable devices, elderly care, and other health services, and promote innovative applications and service development of big health data. Deepen the application of the Internet of Things in the field of smart cities. Promote the planning and layout of IoT sensing facilities, combine municipal facilities, communication network facilities, and industry facility construction, and deploy various IoT sensing facilities such as video collection terminals, RFID tags, multiple types of barcodes, and composite sensor nodes. Deepen the application of the Internet of Things in key areas such as underground pipe network monitoring, fire facility management, urban power balance management, water resource management, urban traffic management, e-government, hazardous chemical management, and energy conservation and environmental protection. Establish a city-level IoT access management and data aggregation platform, promote unified access, centralized management, and shared use of sensing devices. Establish a data open mechanism, formulate a government data sharing and open catalog, promote the opening of data resources to society, encourage and guide enterprises, industry associations, and others to open and trade data resources, and deepen the integration and utilization of government and social data. Support the establishment of data sharing service platforms to provide intelligent information services for the public, industries, and city management. Column 2: Key field application demonstration projects.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, promoting the large-scale application of the Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: In response to the structural reform of the supply side and the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry, the development of cyber-physical systems and industrial internet is promoted to facilitate the transformation of production and operation management towards intelligence, refinement, and networking. Through technologies such as RFID, electronic identification of relevant production materials is implemented to achieve intelligent management of production processes and supply chains. Sensor technologies are utilized to enhance real-time collection and data analysis of production status information, thereby improving efficiency and quality, promoting safety production, and energy conservation. By embedding capabilities such as sensing, positioning, and identification in products, remote maintenance of products is realized, facilitating the transformation of manufacturing industry towards service-oriented.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, promoting the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: To meet the needs of intelligent agricultural production and refined management of agricultural product circulation, extensive demonstrations of agricultural Internet of Things applications are being carried out. This includes implementing demonstration projects for facility agriculture and precision cultivation of field crops based on Internet of Things technology, intelligent horticultural planting, efficient livestock and poultry farming, quality and safety traceability of agricultural by-products, regulation of grain and economic crop storage and transportation, and agricultural input services. These applications aim to promote the development of modern agricultural management methods and organizational forms, and enhance the level of agricultural modernization in China.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, promoting the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, smart agriculture.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: To meet the public's demands for home safety, comfort, and versatility, we are carrying out applications such as smart elderly care, remote medical care and health management, childcare, home security, smart metering for water, electricity, and gas, home air purification, smart control of household appliances, and household robots. These applications aim to improve people's quality of life. By standardizing underlying communication technologies, device interconnectivity, and application interactions through demonstrations, we promote interoperability among products from different manufacturers, driving breakthroughs in smart home technology and products as a whole.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, promoting the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, smart homes.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the intelligent application of traffic management and services, carry out application demonstrations of intelligent maritime services, urban intelligent transportation, automotive electronic identification, intelligent management of electric bicycles, passenger transportation and intelligent public transportation systems, etc., to enhance command and dispatch, traffic control, and information service capabilities. Carry out demonstrations of new technologies in the field of connected vehicles, including autonomous driving, safety and energy conservation, emergency rescue, collision prevention, illegal vehicle inspection and seizure, and crackdown on vehicle-related crimes.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, promoting the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, intelligent transportation, and vehicle networking.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the integration of technologies such as the Internet of Things and big data with modern medical management services, and carry out application demonstrations of the Internet of Things in drug circulation and use, patient care, electronic medical record management, remote diagnosis, remote medical education, remote surgical guidance, and electronic health records. Actively promote the medical model of community healthcare combined with tertiary hospitals. Utilize Internet of Things technology to achieve traceability of medical waste, rapid tracking and positioning of problematic drugs, and reduce regulatory costs. Establish a clinical data application center and carry out precise medical applications based on Internet of Things intelligent sensing and big data analysis. Carry out remote health management using smart wearable devices, elderly care, and other health service applications, and promote the innovation and development of health big data applications and services.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, promoting the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, smart healthcare, and elderly care.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the application of the Internet of Things in the fields of pollution source monitoring and ecological environment monitoring, carry out waste management, comprehensive environmental governance, water quality monitoring, air quality monitoring, pollution source pollution control facility operation monitoring, import waste raw material monitoring, forestry resource security monitoring, and other applications. Promote the application of the Internet of Things in the production, transmission, storage, and consumption of energy such as electricity and oil and gas, and improve the intelligence and refinement level of energy management. Establish a city-level building energy consumption monitoring and service platform to monitor the energy consumption of public buildings and large-scale buildings, and achieve intelligent control and fine management of building energy use. Encourage the establishment of energy management platforms to provide contract energy management services for large industrial parks.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, promoting the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, intelligent energy conservation and environmental protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Build an integrated public service platform for the Internet of Things. Coordinate and integrate the existing public service resources related to the Internet of Things industry in various regions and industries, guide various investments to participate in the construction of the Internet of Things public service capacity, and form a resource-sharing and complementary public service platform system. Relying on existing laboratories, engineering centers, enterprise technology centers, university science and technology parks, and other innovative carriers, integrate innovative resources, strengthen open source community construction, promote resource flow and open sharing, and provide public technical services such as Internet of Things technology research and development, identification resolution, standard testing, inspection and testing. Give full play to the role of various alliances in the Internet of Things, strengthen the coordination of the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain, and promote the connection between supply and demand and the transformation of achievements. Encourage leading companies to strengthen the layout of the industrial ecosystem, provide third-party development capabilities and solutions, and promote the coordinated development of small and medium-sized enterprises in the Internet of Things. Continue to promote the construction of comprehensive public service platforms such as science and technology finance, investment and financing guarantee, policy consultation, intellectual property services, achievement transformation, and talent training, and identify a batch of demonstration platforms for public services in the Internet of Things. Explore the establishment of a commercial model for multi-party participation and win-win cooperation in public service platforms, promote the market-oriented and professional operation of public service platforms, achieve self-generation of platforms, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of public services. Strengthen statistics, monitoring, and development evaluation of the Internet of Things. Establish an Internet of Things statistics and monitoring platform and improve the statistical indicator system. Strengthen the analysis of industrial operations, grasp the laws of industrial development, optimize industrial-related policies, and guide and coordinate the development of the Internet of Things nationwide. Establish an evaluation system for the development of the Internet of Things, analyze and evaluate the development of the Internet of Things industry in various regions, and provide support for promoting the orderly and healthy development of the Internet of Things industry. Enhance security capabilities. Promote the research and industrialization of key security technologies. Guide information security companies to cooperate with Internet of Things technology research and application companies, research institutions, and universities to strengthen the research and development of key technologies and products such as Internet of Things architecture security, heterogeneous network security, data security, and personal information security. Strengthen the research, verification, and implementation of security standards, promote the transformation and industrialization of security technology achievements, and meet the requirements of the Internet of Things technology and product service guarantee in public safety systems such as safety production, disaster prevention and reduction, social security and control, and emergency response. Establish and improve security guarantee systems. Strengthen the construction of Internet of Things security technology service platforms and vigorously develop third-party security assessment and guarantee services. Establish and improve the Internet of Things security protection system, and carry out security evaluation and assessment of Internet of Things products and systems. For Internet of Things applications related to public safety and infrastructure in industries such as industry, energy, electricity, and transportation, strengthen the testing and evaluation of their system solutions, core equipment, and operation services, and study and formulate security guarantee mechanisms of early detection, defense, and quick recovery to ensure the security and controllability of important systems. For Internet of Things applications in medical care, health, elderly care, and home, strengthen the evaluation, assessment, and supervision of related products and services, and enhance personal information protection. Fourth, guarantee measures.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, improving the public service system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the role of the inter-ministerial joint conference system for the development of the Internet of Things, coordinate and coordinate the overall situation between departments, industries, regions, and military-civilian integration, as well as coordinate and coordinate the overall situation of technology research and development, standard formulation, industrial development, application promotion, and security guarantee, forming a working pattern of industry chain support, regional division of labor and cooperation, resource sharing, and collaborative promotion. Give full play to the think tank role of the expert advisory committee for the development of the Internet of Things, and strengthen research on major policies and major issues.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, strengthen overall coordination.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen policy formulation and overall coordination, break through institutional and mechanistic barriers to the deep integration of the Internet of Things with industries, and support innovative development of IoT applications such as connected vehicles and health services. Promote cross-departmental opening, sharing, and collaboration of IoT data resources, develop open-loop applications for the Internet of Things, and advance the construction of smart cities. Conduct research on policies and regulations for data security and personal information protection. Reasonably plan and allocate resources such as frequencies, identifiers, and codes to promote the construction of IoT infrastructure. Increase efforts to promote, implement, and popularize IoT standards, and strengthen the protection and utilization of intellectual property rights.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, and the establishment and improvement of policies and regulations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Actively promote the exchange and cooperation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology. Relying on intergovernmental dialogue mechanisms, deepen cooperation in IoT standards, public service platforms, and application demonstrations. Support domestic enterprises and international leading enterprises in strengthening the research and development cooperation of key IoT technologies and products, and jointly establish an international industrial technology alliance. Support Chinese IoT enterprises in going global, encourage enterprises to establish research and development institutions overseas, actively participate in the formulation of international standards, and seize the commanding heights of international competition.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, strengthen international cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop a comprehensive and multi-level talent training and service system for the Internet of Things. Support universities and research institutes in strengthening interdisciplinary integration, enhancing the construction of IoT disciplines, and cultivating versatile professionals in the field of IoT. Support the establishment of IoT training bases, encourage collaboration between universities and enterprises, leverage the role of professional societies and associations, and enhance IoT skills and business training. Relying on national science and technology programs, demonstration projects, and international cooperation, cultivate high-level and leading talents, and accelerate the introduction of international high-end talents. Establish a mechanism for the mobility of high-end talents, promote rational talent mobility, and build specialized enterprise management teams.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, increase efforts in building the talent pool.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Make full use of various innovative resources, accelerate the development and application of key components and systems for intelligent connected vehicles, and focus on breakthroughs in core technologies such as complex environment perception for intelligent connected vehicles, new electronic and electrical architectures, and vehicle platform line control. Accelerate the joint development and transformation of perception devices such as in-vehicle vision systems, laser/millimeter-wave radar, multi-domain controllers, and inertial navigation. Accelerate the research and development of key components such as intelligent in-vehicle terminals and automotive-grade chips, and promote the industrial application of new generation artificial intelligence, high-precision positioning, and dynamic mapping technologies in intelligent connected vehicles. Accelerate the development and industrialization of high-performance vehicle intelligent driving, line control dynamics, line control steering, and electronic stability systems, achieving precise, coordinated, and reliable control of vehicles.
titlelist: Breakthrough key technologies, promote industrial development, accelerate the key core technology research and development of intelligent connected vehicles.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Strongly support the research and industrialization of key wireless communication technologies such as LTE-V2X and 5G-V2X. Accelerate the application of technologies such as multi-access edge computing, network function virtualization, and 5G network slicing in industries, build a system architecture that combines communication and computing, enhance the agility of multi-access edge computing, and achieve more business innovation. Accelerate the deployment and product development of V2X computing platforms, gradually build a multi-level distributed V2X computing platform system consisting of center, region, edge, and terminal, and meet the demands of V2X services.
titlelist: Breakthrough key technologies, promote industrial development, strengthen research and development and industrialization of wireless communication technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the fundamental, guiding, and regulatory role of the standard system in the industrial ecology of the Internet of Vehicles, accelerate the implementation of the Guidelines for the Construction of the National Standard System for the Internet of Vehicles Industry, and timely update and supplement it according to the needs of industry development. Accelerate the formulation and improvement of basic general, technical, testing and evaluation, service specification, and safety certification standards, and increase the effective supply of standards. Encourage the simultaneous promotion of international standardization of key technologies to lead technological development and improvement through standards. Accelerate the revision of standards related to basic general intelligent connected vehicles, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), autonomous driving, information security, and networked functions, and conduct research and formulation of standards and specifications for automatic driving testing and evaluation with testing scenarios as the starting point and whole vehicle functional evaluation as the goal. Carry out research and standard formulation for 5G-V2X technology development and standardization, and promote the integration innovation and standard research of multi-access edge computing and LTE-V2X technology. Strengthen the connection with relevant infrastructure standards such as smart city construction, and accelerate the research and formulation of technical requirements and testing methods for base station equipment, roadside units, and onboard terminal devices. Promote the formulation of end-to-end interconnection standards between Internet of Vehicles service platforms and traffic control information service platforms. Establish interconnection and data exchange standards between electric vehicles, charging piles, and platforms. Promote the research and formulation of relevant standards for wireless communication security in the Internet of Vehicles, Internet of Vehicles platforms and application security, data security, and user personal information protection.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing, verification, and demonstration applications, and strengthen the standard system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Regulations on the management of the 5905-5925MHz frequency band for the deployment of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) direct communication. Frequency usage permits will be issued in a timely manner based on the technological and industrial development situation and frequency applications from relevant units. Promote research on the frequency requirements for 5G-V2X. Strengthen research on LTE-V2X infrastructure operation qualifications and Connected Vehicle business qualifications.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing, verification, and demonstration applications, and accelerate frequency and business licensing verification.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Build an intelligent connected vehicle testing and evaluation system, improve the testing methods and standards for individual technologies and whole vehicle products, and comprehensively enhance testing and verification capabilities. Strengthen the construction of testing demonstration zones, promote the standardization of testing and the sharing of databases. Promote the construction of a Chinese road traffic scenario library to provide basic support for product development testing, safety assessment, and functional evaluation. Expand the scope of public road testing for intelligent connected vehicles and explore pilot testing on highways. Improve the technical testing and verification of onboard terminals, roadside units, and other devices in different electromagnetic environments, build a vehicle-to-vehicle cloud platform testing and verification system, and enhance relevant testing and verification capabilities. Study the requirements for electromagnetic environment protection in vehicle-to-vehicle communication and improve the management methods for the admission of wireless communication devices in vehicles. Promote the development of simulation testing, road test testing, and other technologies to form comprehensive experimental verification capabilities for laboratories, closed roads, semi-closed roads, and open roads.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing and verification, and demonstrate application, promote testing and verification.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen cooperation with the Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Transport, and other departments, as well as local governments, encourage participation from all parties in the industrial chain, carry out testing and verification in semi-open areas and public roads, ensure the reliability, compatibility, and security of communication between in-vehicle terminals, roadside units, and cloud platforms, gradually complete end-to-end technical verification and interoperability testing. Demonstrate applications of autonomous driving commuting, intelligent logistics distribution, and smart sanitation in airports, ports, express bus lanes, and industrial parks. Promote regional demonstration applications in Shanghai, Beijing-Hebei, Chongqing, Wuxi, Hangzhou, Wuhan, Changchun, Guangzhou, and Changsha, support the application of the Internet of Vehicles in the Beijing Winter Olympics and Xiong'an New Area. Build a national-level pilot zone for the Internet of Vehicles, continuously improve the level of intelligent traffic management and residents' travel service experience.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing, verification, and demonstration applications, and promote demonstration applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the transformation and upgrade of LTE networks to meet the large-scale application of connected vehicles. Improve the coverage level of LTE-V2X networks on major highways and some main roads in cities, refine the data access specifications of roadside units, enhance the integration and access capabilities of roadside units with road infrastructure and intelligent control facilities, and promote the organic combination of LTE-V2X network upgrades and roadside unit deployment. Establish 5G-V2X demonstration application networks in key areas and key road sections, providing wireless communication services with ultra-low latency, ultra-high reliability, and ultra-large bandwidth. Digitally transform and construct road infrastructure and traffic sign identification in stages and in specific areas, accelerate the deployment of narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) networks at road critical nodes such as bridges and tunnels.
titlelist: Cooperation and joint construction, promoting the improvement of the infrastructure of the connected car industry, and improving communication network facilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the interconnection of various types of vehicle networking platforms, promote the interaction and data sharing of intelligent connected vehicles, road infrastructure, communication base stations, vehicle networking platforms, and application services, and establish a market mechanism for data utilization and maintenance to ensure the safe and effective operation of vehicles. Encourage the construction of cross-industry and cross-department comprehensive big data and cloud platforms to support the scale development and continuous innovation of vehicle networking applications.
titlelist: Cooperation and joint construction, promoting the improvement of the infrastructure of the connected car industry, promoting the construction and management of big data and cloud platforms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the deep integration of network communication technology, artificial intelligence technology, and road traffic infrastructure to provide necessary conditions for the application of new technologies such as connected vehicles and autonomous driving. Deploy edge computing capabilities for typical scenarios and hotspots, and build a low-latency, high-bandwidth, and high-computing power vehicle-road cooperative environment. Support the construction of facilities such as the Beidou satellite navigation system and differential base stations to enhance the scale application level of high-precision spatiotemporal services for vehicles and meet the high-precision positioning and navigation needs of vehicles. Support the construction of intelligent infrastructure environments that integrate sensing, communication, and computing capabilities on certain highways and major roads in cities.
titlelist: Cooperation and joint construction, promoting the improvement of the Internet of Vehicles industry infrastructure, and building intelligent road infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage telecommunications operators to launch preferential tariffs and other incentive measures, and vigorously develop connected car users. Support automobile companies in installing connected car information service terminals, and increase the adoption rate of driving assistance systems in new vehicles. Support public buses, large trucks, taxis, and ride-hailing vehicles to improve their connectivity rates.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the increase in market penetration rate, and expand the scale of connected car users.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop innovative applications such as smart travel, road rescue, and data services for passenger vehicles, improve comprehensive information services and remote monitoring systems for various commercial vehicles, promote traffic services in areas such as public security traffic management, commercial transportation vehicle dispatching, and road transportation supervision, and develop new formats such as shared cars. Innovate business models and promote the integrated development of the connected car industry with smart tourism and smart business.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and develop comprehensive information services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Develop real-time online monitoring systems and big data analysis capabilities for electric vehicles, achieving goals such as charging warning, optimizing charging and battery swapping scheduling, and improving charging and battery swapping efficiency. Support strengthening the monitoring of core components such as electric vehicle batteries, encourage the identification, classification, and sequential utilization of retired batteries. Expand the internet of things applications for electric vehicles, promote interconnection and data exchange between electric vehicles, charging stations, charging service platforms, power battery traceability systems, and online monitoring platforms, realizing safe management throughout the lifecycle of electric vehicles and improving the safety level of electric vehicles.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and expand the application of electric vehicle networking.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the collaborative interaction of people-vehicle-road-cloud based on LTE-V2X, 5G-V2X, and other technologies, actively carry out applications in traffic safety and energy efficiency. When the relevant technologies, products, and commercial operating conditions are mature, promote the large-scale application of traffic incident warning, accident reporting, traffic control, and other vehicle-road interaction information services. Promote the application of accident warning and collaborative control technology based on vehicle-vehicle/vehicle-human communication, enhance the ability of traffic safety and congestion proactive control. Promote the application of vehicle-road communication technology in vehicles and road traffic infrastructure, improve the level of traffic safety. Promote the application of driving strategy guidance for different road conditions, highway truck platooning, and other applications to improve traffic efficiency.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and advance the application of traffic safety and energy efficiency technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a network-based integrated system for car design, manufacturing, and service, and build an intelligent connected car data management system. Through the Internet of Vehicles, collect, analyze, and utilize vehicle operation data to create diverse application services and system management, providing assurance for safe vehicle operation. Promote precise marketing and promotion of vehicles, customized maintenance services, personalized insurance packages, transparent repair services, and differentiated car usage experiences, achieving large-scale application of personalized car services based on big data platforms. Utilize Internet of Vehicles technology to enhance vehicle recycling and recycling levels.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and create a full lifecycle service for automobiles.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: With a focus on the operational safety, network security, and data security of products and systems, clarify the responsibilities of relevant parties and conduct regular security supervision and inspections. Improve the security management work of event reporting, emergency response, and responsibility determination for the network and data security of connected vehicles.
titlelist: Integrating technology and management, promoting the improvement of the security guarantee system, and establishing a sound security management system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Key breakthroughs in the core technology research and development of functional safety, network security, and data security in the industry, supporting the research and development of a series of security products such as security protection, vulnerability mining, intrusion detection, and situational awareness. Urging enterprises to strengthen network security protection and data security protection, building a comprehensive security detection and evaluation system for intelligent connected vehicles, wireless communication networks, car networking data, and networks, and conducting security capability assessments.
titlelist: Integrating technology management to promote the improvement of the security guarantee system and enhance security protection capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Enhance the technical support capability for industrial safety, focus on improving the level of hazard investigation, risk detection, and emergency response, and build security platforms such as monitoring and early warning, threat analysis, risk assessment, testing and verification, and data security. Promote enterprises to increase investment in safety, innovate security operation and maintenance, and consulting service models, and enhance the industry's security guarantee service capability.
titlelist: Integrating technology management to promote the improvement of the security guarantee system, and promoting the construction of security technology means.

name: Notice on the Issuance of the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accurately grasp the evolution trend of global mobile Internet of Things (IoT) technology standards and industrial patterns, promote the migration and transformation of 2G/3G IoT services, establish a comprehensive ecosystem for the coordinated development of Narrowband IoT (NB-IoT), 4G (including LTE-Cat1, i.e. Category 1 of 4G networks), and 5G mobile IoT. Based on deepening the coverage of 4G networks and accelerating the construction of 5G networks, use NB-IoT to meet the requirements of most low-rate scenarios, use LTE-Cat1 (referred to as Cat1 below) to meet the requirements of medium-rate IoT and voice, and use 5G technology to meet the requirements of higher-rate, low-latency networking. By the end of 2020, NB-IoT networks will achieve widespread coverage in urban areas at the county level and above, with deep coverage in key areas; the number of mobile IoT connections will reach 1.2 billion; promote the convergence of NB-IoT module prices with 2G modules, and guide the migration of new IoT terminals to NB-IoT and Cat1; create a number of benchmark projects and million-scale application scenarios for NB-IoT. Second, key tasks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the construction of 5G networks, continue to deepen the coverage of 4G networks, and support the development of Cat1. Further increase the deployment of NB-IoT networks, construct NB-IoT base stations as needed, achieve universal coverage in county-level and above urban areas, and achieve deep coverage in application scenarios such as indoor areas, transportation networks, underground pipe networks, and modern agricultural demonstration areas. Focus on network operation, monitoring, optimization, and other work to improve network service levels.
titlelist: The main goal is to accelerate the construction of the mobile Internet of Things network.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the inclusion of NB-IoT standards into the ITU IMT-2020 5G standards; promote the development and implementation of technical standards and interoperability standards for mobile IoT terminals, platforms, and other key areas such as smart homes, smart agriculture, industrial manufacturing, energy metering, fire alarms, logistics tracking, and financial payments, in order to enhance the standardization level of industry applications.
titlelist: The main objectives are to strengthen the research on mobile Internet of Things standards and technologies, and to formulate standards for the integration of mobile Internet of Things with vertical industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Focusing on different vertical industry application environments and business needs, we will strengthen research on emerging key technologies such as network slicing, edge computing, high-precision positioning, intelligent sensing, secure chips, miniaturized low-power intelligent instruments, and cross-domain collaboration, and carry out related experiments.
titlelist: The main objectives are to strengthen the research on mobile Internet of Things standards and technologies, and to carry out research on key technologies of mobile Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the innovative development of the Internet of Things (IoT) in three major directions: industrial digitization, governance intelligence, and smart living. In terms of industrial digitization, deepen the application of IoT in areas such as industrial manufacturing, warehousing logistics, smart agriculture, and smart healthcare, promote device networking and data collection, and improve production efficiency. In terms of governance intelligence, focus on areas such as energy metering, fire detection, public facility management, and environmental monitoring to enhance public service capabilities, strengthen urban resilience, and improve the ability to respond to emergencies. In terms of smart living, promote the application of IoT technology in products such as smart homes, wearable devices, childcare and elderly care, and pet tracking.
titlelist: The main goal is to enhance the breadth and depth of mobile Internet of Things applications and promote the development of mobile Internet of Things applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Build a mobile Internet of Things resource library, carry out the collection and storage of innovative and practical application cases, and provide services such as communication promotion and matchmaking for investment and financing needs. Select a group of best cases from the resource library to create a benchmark project for the mobile Internet of Things, and drive the innovative development of million-level connected application scenarios through the benchmark project. Further expand the applicable scenarios of mobile Internet of Things technology, and explore new products, new formats, and new models based on mobile Internet of Things technology.
titlelist: The main goal is to enhance the breadth and depth of mobile Internet of Things applications and create a benchmark project for mobile Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage the establishment of special support and innovation funds in various regions to support the research and development of NB-IoT and Cat1 dedicated chips, modules, devices, and other products, improve chip research and development and manufacturing capabilities, and meet the demand for large-scale shipments; build a complete NB-IoT industry chain, provide diversified products and application systems that meet market demand; further reduce the cost of NB-IoT modules, reaching the same level as 2G modules by 2020; increase the research and development of Cat1 chips and modules, promote the reduction of module costs, and promote large-scale applications.
titlelist: The main goal is to build a high-quality industrial development system and improve the mobile Internet of Things industry chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support the construction of mobile Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity management platforms for basic telecommunications enterprises, strengthen network capacity openness, support rapid access of IoT sensing devices, and support massive concurrent application scenarios; guide industry application enterprises to build vertically integrated intelligent equipment, intelligent equipment and data management, and intelligent system operation and maintenance application platforms, gradually forming a mobile IoT platform system, further reducing the development cost and complexity of mobile IoT devices, and meeting the needs of complex application scenarios. Encourage capable enterprises to establish open laboratories to provide testing, verification, and development support services for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: The main goal is to build a high-quality industrial development system and accelerate the construction of a service platform for cloud management and edge collaboration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Give full play to the rapid and flexible response mechanism and cross-industry advantage resource capabilities of mobile communication resale enterprises, and carry out innovative mobile Internet of Things business in vertical industry application areas such as industrial Internet and connected vehicles, promoting the integration and development with the real economy.
