content: The basic security standards of the Internet of Things mainly refer to the security standards of key basic elements such as IoT terminals, gateways, platforms, etc. The IoT basic security standard system includes five major categories of standards: overall security, terminal security, gateway security, platform security, and security management (see Figure 1). Figure 1 shows the framework of the IoT basic security standard system.
titlelist: Construction content, standard system framework

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: 'Table 2 Overall Security (1) Definition of basic security terms for the Internet of Things: standardize the concept of basic security for the Internet of Things and unify related terminology for understanding and use. (2) Internet of Things basic security architecture model: mainly propose the framework of the basic security system for the Internet of Things and its various components. Reference models are used to clarify and define the functions, relationships, roles, boundaries, responsibilities, and other content of the cloud, management, and end layers. (3) Internet of Things basic security scenarios: mainly provide examples and specifications for security requirements in different types of scenarios. (4) Integration of Internet of Things basic security: in the process of planning, integrating, and implementing Internet of Things systems, ensure the security and reliability of objects at various levels of the infrastructure system through the establishment of security models and other methods. (5) Internet of Things basic security classification: clarify the basic principles, dimensions, methods, examples, and other requirements for the classification of Internet of Things basic security, providing a basic support for the implementation of classified security management. (6) Internet of Things basic security protocols: mainly refer to the basic security protocols between the Internet of Things platform, gateway, terminal itself, and devices, including wired protocol security, wireless protocol security, storage protocol security, etc.'
titlelist: The content of construction, key areas, overall security. Overall security is the fundamental, guiding, and general standard of IoT basic security. It mainly includes the definition of IoT basic security terms, architecture models, security scenarios, security integration, security classification, security protocols, etc. (see Figure 2).

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: 'Security, communication chip security, card security, industry terminal security, terminal testing and evaluation, etc. (see Figure 3). Figure 3 Terminal Security. (1) General terminal security: mainly includes IoT terminal hardware security, operating system security, software security, access authentication, data security, protocol security, privacy protection, certificate specifications, firmware security, plugin/component security, etc. (2) Module security: specifies the security requirements of communication modules in access authentication, data interaction, data transmission, and electromagnetic interference resistance, including cellular communication modules and other types of communication modules. (3) Communication chip security: mainly includes communication encryption algorithms, key management, encryption/decryption capabilities, signature verification, data storage, chip security baseline requirements, etc. (4) Card security: divided into management requirements and technical requirements. The management requirements mainly regulate the sales, registration, and use management of IoT cards, while the technical requirements mainly include card identity authentication, classification, technical means construction, etc. (5) Industry terminal security: mainly refers to the specific security requirements of IoT terminals closely related to various vertical industries and with specific functions, such as smart locks, monitoring devices, and other specific industry terminal security requirements. (6) Terminal testing and evaluation: mainly includes IoT card security testing, hardware security testing, operating system security testing, software security testing, access authentication security testing, data security testing, communication protocol security testing, firmware security testing, etc.'
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, terminal security. Terminal security is the standard for the perception layer in the basic security system of the Internet of Things, mainly including general terminal security and modules.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Gateway security mainly includes general security of IoT gateways, gateway communication and interface security, gateway physical environment security, gateway component security, gateway testing and evaluation, etc. (see Figure 4). Figure 4: Gateway security. (1) General security of gateways: standardize the functional architecture, security protocols, security protection, as well as security technical requirements for data transmission, processing, and storage related to IoT gateways. This mainly includes gateway security models, security architecture, security functions, security performance, data security, edge computing security, security protocols, etc. (2) Gateway communication and interface security: standardize the security communication protocols, blacklists, whitelists, authentication, etc. for communication interfaces and management interfaces when gateways are interconnected with other devices. This mainly includes the security procedures for southbound and northbound interfaces of gateways, security protocol processes, port protection, etc. (3) Gateway physical environment security: standardize the technical requirements for electromagnetic radiation, electromagnetic interference prevention, resistance to physical damage, adaptability to temperature, humidity, and salt spray environments under storage, transportation, and usage conditions of gateways. This mainly includes gateway equipment electromagnetic compatibility, mechanical environmental adaptability, climate environmental adaptability, etc. (4) Gateway component security: standardize the security design, security functions, etc. of software and hardware components related to gateway functional services, data collection, data transmission, and processing. This mainly includes gateway equipment component security architecture, open-source component security, application startup security, etc. (5) Gateway testing and evaluation: standardize the testing methods for gateway security evaluation, mainly including device security testing, component security testing, interface security testing, security management and maintenance testing, data transmission and processing security testing, environmental adaptability testing, hierarchical classification evaluation testing, etc.
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, gateway security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The Internet of Things platform includes device management platform, connectivity management platform, application enablement platform, business analysis platform, situational awareness and risk disposal platform, etc. The security standards of the Internet of Things platform mainly include platform general security, platform security protection, platform interaction security, platform security monitoring, platform testing and evaluation, etc. (see Figure 5). Figure 5 Platform Security (1) Platform General Security: Standardize the requirements for general data security, communication security, identity authentication, security monitoring, physical security, security trustworthiness, etc. of various types of Internet of Things platforms, mainly including general security framework, platform trusted computing, etc. (2) Platform Security Protection: Standardize the access control, anti-reverse engineering, security audit, tampering and injection prevention, etc. of the Internet of Things platform and industry business systems developed based on the Internet of Things platform. The security protection requirements for external application components, mainly including platform business basic security, platform security protection requirements, etc. (3) Platform Interaction Security: Standardize the security requirements for data interaction, encrypted transmission, interaction interface configuration and audit between Internet of Things platforms, between platforms and upper-level business systems or management systems, and between platforms and lower-level access devices, mainly including interaction between different Internet of Things platforms, interaction between platforms and southbound and northbound, etc. (4) Platform Security Monitoring: Standardize the construction of security monitoring, situational summary, and other functions of the Internet of Things platform, mainly including Internet of Things network security monitoring and early warning platform, Internet of Things network security situational awareness platform, etc. (5) Platform Testing and Evaluation: Standardize the testing and evaluation methods for general security, platform security protection, interaction security between platform internals and between platforms, platform security management, etc. of the Internet of Things platform, mainly including Internet of Things platform capability evaluation, security protection testing, interaction security testing, and security management evaluation, etc.
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, platform security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: The safety management standards are used to guide industries in implementing general safety management requirements, mainly including data security management, secure information collaboration, management and maintenance of security, security certification, etc. (see Figure 6). Figure 6: Safety Management. (1) Data Security Management: It focuses on various types of data generated by IoT business applications, ensuring the security, controllability, and use of data in various stages, mainly including data security basic management and technical support in key stages such as collection, transmission, storage, processing, sharing, and destruction. (2) Secure Information Collaboration: It addresses the numerous types of IoT protocols, clarifies the standards for interconnection and interoperability of basic security-related data in IoT, and achieves secure interconnection and interoperability across protocols, mainly including interface specifications, testing methods, etc. (3) Management and Maintenance of Security: It standardizes the operation and maintenance management of terminals, gateways, and platforms in different IoT scenarios, mainly including system construction, security organization, personnel management, operational security, asset management, configuration management, remote maintenance security, vulnerability detection, emergency response and management, disaster recovery, etc. (4) Security Certification: It standardizes the certification management of different types of IoT terminals, gateways, and platforms, used for the mutual recognition and interoperability of security certification for different types of devices, mainly including certificate generation, certificate management, certificate replacement, etc.
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, safety management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Aiming at the development trend of intelligent manufacturing, we will improve the development foundation of metrology, standards, information infrastructure, and security, and strive to build a comprehensive, reliable, advanced, and secure support system. We will promote standardization work in depth. We will continuously optimize the top-level design of standards, coordinate the construction of the national intelligent manufacturing standard system and industry application standard system. We will accelerate the revision of basic commonality and key technology standards, strengthen the optimization and coordination of existing standards, and promote the formation of a coordinated and complementary standard group consisting of national standards, industry standards, group standards, and enterprise standards in areas such as intelligent equipment and intelligent factories. We will accelerate the implementation of standards and support enterprises in carrying out intelligent workshop/factory construction based on standards. We will actively participate in international standardization work and promote the synchronous development of high maturity national standards and international standards. Column 6: Leading Action on Intelligent Manufacturing Standards. 01: Regularly revise the Guidelines for the Construction of the National Intelligent Manufacturing Standard System and construct industry application standard systems in sub-sectors such as textiles, petrochemicals, building materials, automobiles, aviation, ships, power equipment, rail transit equipment, household appliances, food, steel, non-ferrous metals, and new energy sources. 02: Standard formulation. We will increase the strength of standard testing and verification, promote the revision of basic commonality and key technology standards such as digital twins, data dictionaries, human-machine collaboration, smart supply chains, system reliability, and information security and functional safety integration, meet the needs of technological evolution and industrial development, and accelerate the formulation of industry application standards. 03: Standard promotion and application. We will carry out pilot projects for the application of intelligent manufacturing standards in areas such as intelligent workshop/factory construction, new model applications, supply chain collaboration, and new technology applications, form a coordinated and supporting standard group consisting of national standards, industry standards, and group standards, and promote the application of pilot project results in small and medium-sized enterprises and peer enterprises. 04: International standard cooperation. We will continue to strengthen the cooperation on intelligent manufacturing/Industry 4.0 standards between China and Germany, expand cooperation with Japan, the UK, and other countries, actively participate in international standardization activities, continuously enhance the contribution of Chinese solutions to international standards, deepen bilateral and multilateral standardization exchanges, and form a batch of standardization achievements. Improve information infrastructure. We will accelerate the large-scale deployment of new network infrastructures such as industrial Internet, Internet of Things, 5G, and gigabit optical networks, encourage enterprises to upgrade and transform their internal and external networks, and enhance on-site perception and data transmission capabilities. We will strengthen the construction of computing infrastructure such as industrial data centers and intelligent computing centers to support the application of new technologies such as artificial intelligence. We will support large-scale group enterprises and industrial parks in establishing industrial Internet platforms with distinctive features based on internal resource integration, full lifecycle management of products, collaborative supply chain of industrial chains, services for small and medium-sized enterprises, and industrial data processing and analysis, to achieve effective integration and management of all-factor and full-industrial chain data. Strengthen security guarantees. We will strengthen the risk assessment of intelligent manufacturing security, promote the synchronous development of network security, data security, and functional safety, and promote the in-depth application of cryptographic technology. We will implement classified and graded management of enterprise network security and urge enterprises to fulfill their main responsibilities for network security. We will improve the multi-level monitoring and early warning network for industrial control information security at the national, local, and enterprise levels, and accelerate the construction of an industrial Internet security technology monitoring service system. We will explore the establishment of a mechanism for filing and supervision of cross-border data transmission. We will establish a technical protection system and security management system that meet policy and standard requirements. We will cultivate security service institutions, promote the application of network security technology products, and enhance the capacity of diagnosis, consultation, design, and implementation services. Strengthen talent cultivation. We will regularly compile reports on the demand forecast for intelligent manufacturing talents and a catalog of talents in short supply, and research and formulate professional standards in the field of intelligent manufacturing. Relying on institutions such as high-skilled talent training bases, we will carry out large-scale vocational training. We will strengthen the digital skills training of graduates, in-service personnel, and job changers, promote the construction of industry-education integration enterprises, promote deep cooperation between intelligent manufacturing enterprises and vocational colleges, and explore the establishment of a Chinese-style apprenticeship system. Deepen the construction of new engineering disciplines, establish a number of modern industrial colleges and specialized demonstration software colleges in the field of intelligent manufacturing, optimize discipline majors and courses, and accelerate the cultivation of high-end talents. Promote entrepreneurship and innovation in intelligent manufacturing through entrepreneurship competitions and skills competitions. Fourth, guarantee measures.
titlelist: Current situation and prospects, solidify the foundation support, construct new guarantees for intelligent manufacturing.

content: Intelligent hardware refers to emerging Internet terminal products that have information collection, processing, and connectivity capabilities, and can achieve functions such as intelligent perception, interaction, and big data services. It is an important carrier of Internet+ artificial intelligence. After the intelligentization of terminal products such as mobile phones and televisions, the new generation of information technology is accelerating integration and integration with personal wearables, transportation, medical health, production and manufacturing, etc., giving rise to the booming development of the intelligent hardware industry, driving innovation and efficiency improvement. Currently, China's intelligent hardware industry faces both opportunities and challenges. On the one hand, China is a major producer of electronic information products and has the world's largest Internet user base, providing a vast market space for intelligent hardware. On the other hand, issues and risks such as insufficient supply of key technologies and high-end products, incomplete innovation support system, lack of interaction between production and use, and fragmented ecology cannot be ignored. This special action aims to promote the innovative development of the intelligent hardware industry, enhance the effective supply of high-end common technologies and products, meet the diversified needs of social production and life for intelligent hardware, and cultivate new driving forces for the growth of the information technology industry. Second, the overall approach. Deeply implement the supply-side structural reform and innovation-driven development strategy, take the promotion of intelligentization of terminal products and application systems as the main line, focus on strengthening technological breakthroughs, breakthroughs in basic software and hardware, core algorithms and analysis prediction models, advanced industrial design and key applications, and improve the innovation capability of intelligent hardware. Focus on optimizing the development environment, accelerating the popularization of intelligent hardware applications, strengthening the construction of industry public service platforms, and consolidating the foundation for the development of intelligent hardware. Focus on thriving the industry ecosystem, establishing a linkage mechanism between standards, intellectual property rights, entrepreneurship and innovation platforms, and application demonstration, and cultivating new models and formats. Innovation-driven. Guide and encourage enterprises to strengthen research and development investment, optimize resource allocation globally, attract high-end talents, master advanced technologies, break through key technological bottlenecks, improve high-end effective supply, and enhance the core competitiveness of the industry. Integration and collaboration. Promote the upgrading of the industrial chain and the construction of the ecological chain, strengthen the organization and coordination of resources along the industrial chain, promote the integration of production and use, and the integration of industry and finance, and improve the ecological environment for industrial development. Adaptation to local conditions. Give full play to the initiative and proactiveness of localities, support localities in formulating policy measures suitable for their local industrial development, improve public services, explore differentiated and specialized development paths, promote regional coordination, and guide the high-end aggregation of industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the construction of a digital design system, coordinate architectural structures, mechanical and electrical equipment, components, assembly construction, and decoration, and promote integrated design. Actively apply independent and controllable BIM technology, accelerate the construction of a digital design foundation platform and integrated system, and achieve design, process, and manufacturing collaboration. Accelerate the digitalization and intelligent upgrading of components and parts production, promote the application of digital technology, system integration technology, intelligent equipment, and construction robots, and achieve a factory with fewer or even no workers. Accelerate the application of human-machine intelligent interaction, intelligent logistics management, additive manufacturing, and other technologies and intelligent equipment. Focus on key production processes in factory production, such as reinforcement production and installation, mold assembly and disassembly, concrete pouring, steel component cutting and welding, partition board and integrated kitchen and bathroom processing, and promote the digitalization of process flow and the application of construction robots. Based on the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform, further promote the extension to production management subsystems and achieve information management of factory production. Promote the application of construction robots and intelligent control tower cranes and other integrated construction equipment in on-site construction processes such as material distribution, reinforcement processing, spraying, tile laying, partition board installation, and high-altitude welding.
titlelist: Development goals, improving the level of informatization.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Explore new organizational methods, processes, and management models suitable for the collaborative development of intelligent construction and industrialization in the construction industry. Accelerate the cultivation of engineering general contracting enterprises with the capability of intelligent construction system solutions, coordinate the entire construction industry chain, promote close cooperation and collaborative innovation among enterprises in various forms, and gradually form an open industrial system with engineering general contracting enterprises as the core and deep involvement of relevant leading enterprises. Encourage enterprises to establish multi-party collaborative intelligent construction platforms for engineering general contracting projects, strengthen the collaborative work of intelligent construction upstream and downstream, and form an industry chain covering design, production, construction, and technical services.
titlelist: Development goals, cultivating industrial systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Implement green construction throughout the entire lifecycle of engineering construction projects, with the core focus on resource conservation and environmental protection. Through the coordinated development of intelligent construction and industrialization of construction, improve resource utilization efficiency, reduce the generation of construction waste, and significantly reduce energy consumption, material consumption, and water consumption. Promote the establishment of a green supply chain in the construction industry, promote circular production methods, and improve the comprehensive utilization level of construction waste. Increase research and development efforts for advanced energy-saving and environmental protection technologies, processes, and equipment, improve energy efficiency, accelerate the elimination of outdated equipment and technologies, and promote the green transformation and upgrading of the construction industry.
titlelist: Development goals, actively promoting green construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the construction of intelligent construction and the application of industrialized construction, promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, major product integration innovation, and demonstration applications. Utilize key projects and large-scale projects as demonstration and leading roles, increase the promotion efforts, expand the application scope of various technologies, and initially form a comprehensive application model integrating research and development design, data training, pilot application, and science and technology finance. Play the leading role of leading enterprises, create machine replacing human application scenarios in prefabricated construction factories, and promote the establishment of intelligent construction bases. Sort out the intelligent construction-related technologies that have been maturely applied, regularly release a mature technology catalog, and promote application in areas with good basic conditions and urgent needs.
titlelist: Development goals, open expansion of application scenarios.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Each region should timely evaluate the implementation of policies related to the coordinated development of intelligent construction and construction industrialization. The key areas of evaluation include the implementation and completion of intelligent construction development goals, industrial development, policy formulation, and standard specification compilation, among others. The results should be reported.
titlelist: Development goals, establish evaluation mechanisms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: To strengthen publicity and promotion, fully leverage the role of relevant enterprises, institutions, industry associations, and academic societies, and carry out policy promotion, technical guidance, exchange and cooperation, and result dissemination for intelligent construction. Build an international innovation cooperation mechanism, enhance international exchanges, promote open cooperation, and create a favorable environment for the healthy development of intelligent construction.
titlelist: Development goals, creating a favorable environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Research and formulate an action plan for the intelligent development of coal mines, clarify the direction, implementation path, and policy measures for intelligent development. Encourage relevant departments of local governments to study and formulate plans for the intelligent development of coal mines, taking into account regional characteristics, coal seam occurrence conditions, technological foundations, and other factors, scientifically guiding the progress and scale of intelligent development in coal mines. Support coal enterprises in formulating implementation plans for the intelligent development of coal mines, implementing construction tasks, technological systems, and construction progress, and accelerating the pace of intelligent development in coal mines.
titlelist: Development goals, strengthen top-level design, scientifically plan the intelligent construction of coal mines.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In accordance with the division of responsibilities among departments, coordinate the revision of standards for the intelligentization of coal mines, strengthen the revision of basic, key technology standards, and management standards; accelerate the revision of technical specifications, product standards, and testing and inspection specifications related to terminology, data management, technical equipment, and coal mine robots in the construction of intelligent coal mines. Carry out special work on the construction of the standard system for intelligent coal mines, accelerate the implementation of the plan to enhance the standards for intelligent coal mines, formulate norms and implementation guidelines for the construction, evaluation, and acceptance of intelligent coal mines; promote the establishment of a consistency and compliance testing system and technical platform for intelligent coal mine standards, and form a closed-loop management system for standard revision, promotion and application, consulting services, and implementation supervision.
titlelist: Development goals, strengthen standard leadership, enhance the basic capabilities of coal mine intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the basic theoretical research on the intelligence of coal mines, promote the construction of national key laboratories and engineering (research) centers, support the construction of innovation and research platforms for intelligent coal mine technology, and strengthen the research and development of common key technologies such as core components, advanced basic processes, and key basic materials. Focus on breakthroughs in precise geological exploration, precise positioning and efficient continuous data transmission, intelligent rapid excavation, intelligent fully mechanized mining under complex conditions, continuous auxiliary transportation, unmanned continuous operation in open-pit mining, intelligent perception and early warning of major hazards, coal mine robots, and underground digital electronic detonators. Accelerate the construction of intelligent factories and digital workshops, promote the research and development and industrial application of large-scale coal mining equipment and coal mine robots, implement special actions for mechanization and automation to reduce labor, and improve the standardization and localization level of intelligent equipment.
titlelist: Development goals, promote technological innovation, and improve the level of intelligent technology and equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Accelerate the intelligent transformation of coal mines that meet the conditions, and carry out intelligent optimization and improvement in production and operation management processes such as mining (stripping), power supply, water supply and drainage, ventilation, main and auxiliary transportation, safety monitoring, and coal washing. Promote unmanned operation of fixed positions and robot operation of dangerous positions, and achieve the intelligent transformation and upgrading of traditional coal mines. Promote the intelligent design of newly built coal mines, innovate the intelligent mining (stripping) mode of coal mines, and build an integrated platform that integrates multiple systems and functions such as intelligent production, safety assurance, and operation management, to achieve intelligent applications such as coordinated coal mine production, transportation, and sales, decision-making control, and integrated operation. Encourage the accelerated intelligent construction of mines with serious disaster threats, and take the lead in improving the level of intelligence.
titlelist: Development goals, accelerate the intelligent transformation of coal mines in production, and enhance the level of intelligence in newly built coal mines.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In response to the different coal seam occurrence conditions in various mining areas in our country, a scientific, reasonable, and advanced coal mine intelligent construction plan is formulated and implemented from the perspectives of construction concept, system architecture, intelligent technology and equipment, comprehensive management, and economic investment. The focus is on promoting systematic intelligent construction in large-scale coal mines, prioritizing the implementation of intelligent mining (stripping) and robot replacement for hazardous positions in mines with severe hazards such as rock burst and coal and gas outburst. A number of intelligent demonstration coal mines will be built to refine replicable intelligent mining models, technological equipment, management experience, etc., and promote their application in similar condition coal mines.
titlelist: Development goals, play a leading role in driving, and build a smart demonstration coal mine.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: With data as the core resource, promote the development of intelligent technology and innovative application models in coal mine, and enhance the core competitiveness of coal enterprises. Extend the industrial chain of intelligent coal machinery manufacturing, transforming from mainly providing coal machinery products to providing products and services, to providing overall solutions, and to providing system integration and general contracting, promoting the coordinated development of manufacturing and services. Carry out applications and transactions between large-scale coal mining enterprises, big data professional service providers, and other data platforms, cultivate new service models such as coal mine big data development, financing leasing, and data credit. Build a new industry for the research, development, and manufacturing of intelligent equipment and coal mine robots, and establish influential intelligent equipment and robot industrial bases.
titlelist: Development goals, exploring new service models, and continuously extending the industrial chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Support and encourage universities to strengthen the construction of disciplines and majors related to coal mine intelligence, promote interdisciplinary integration, and cultivate a group of composite talents with knowledge and skills in mining engineering, software engineering, information engineering, robotics engineering, artificial intelligence, and other fields. Deepen the integration of industry and education, encourage cooperation between universities and enterprises to innovate the talent training model for coal mine intelligence, jointly build exemplary internship and practical bases, establish a platform for engineering teachers to exercise their skills, and jointly build modern industrial colleges to meet the urgent needs of the industry. Actively carry out training in intelligence and information technology for in-service personnel, establish and improve mechanisms for career development channels, and optimize the development system for knowledge-based, skill-based, and management-based talents.
titlelist: Development goals, accelerate talent cultivation, and improve the ability to guarantee the talent pool.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: With the research and application of advanced technology and equipment in the intelligentization of coal mines as the core, cross-domain, interdisciplinary, and cross-professional collaborative cooperation is carried out to support the establishment of technology transfer centers. Strengthen the alignment with the energy development strategies of countries along the Belt and Road initiative, establish a platform for technological exchange in the intelligentization of coal mines, explore strategic partnerships with enterprises and relevant institutions in countries along the route, deepen mutual trust and cooperation, and promote mutual benefit and win-win outcomes. Seizing the opportunity of international cooperation, promote the internationalization of China's intelligentization technology, equipment, standards, and services in coal mines, while introducing advanced international intelligentization technology, equipment, management concepts, and service models, cultivate internationally influential branded products, and enhance the level of openness in China's coal industry. Third, ensure measures are in place.
titlelist: Development goals, strengthen international cooperation, actively participate in the construction of the Belt and Road initiative.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen the cultivation and protection of high-quality and high-value patents in the field of common key technologies, track the development of advanced technologies abroad, make proactive international patent applications and layouts, and avoid technology export risks. Encourage the construction of an intellectual property protection system for intelligent coal mine construction, protect the achievements of intelligent coal mine construction, and form industrial competitive advantages. Encourage and support enterprises to use intellectual property rights to participate in market competition and cultivate a group of coal enterprises with intellectual property advantages in intelligent coal mine construction.
titlelist: Development goals, strengthen intellectual property protection, enhance core technology controllability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Under the guidance of national and provincial departments, coal mine intelligent innovation alliances and regional innovation institutions are formed, with industry associations, research institutions, technology companies, design institutes, universities, finance, equipment manufacturers, and coal enterprises as the main participants. They fully leverage their respective professional advantages to achieve collaborative innovation and cross-industry integration, providing support for the construction of intelligent coal mines.
titlelist: Development goals, gathering consensus from all parties, promoting intelligent cross-border cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council, August 16, 2013)
content: Establish a mechanism for the intelligent construction of coal mines, and increase the guidance and coordination efforts for the intelligent construction of coal mines. Relevant departments of local governments should issue implementation opinions based on the actual situation in their respective regions, and accelerate the intelligent construction and upgrading of coal mines. Strengthen the publicity and interpretation of relevant policies for the intelligent development of coal mines, and improve the awareness of these policies. Summarize new typical cases, models, and mechanisms for the intelligent construction of coal mines, promote the experience and achievements of intelligent development in coal mines, and create a favorable atmosphere for the intelligent development of coal mines.
titlelist: Development goals, strengthen organizational leadership, and form a collective force for intelligent development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Promote the advancement of industrial robots towards the mid-to-high-end market. In response to the needs of the top ten key sectors and other key industries in the national economy, focus on intelligent production and intelligent logistics, overcome key technologies of industrial robots, enhance operability and maintainability, and prioritize the development of six iconic industrial robot products: arc welding robots, vacuum (clean) robots, fully autonomous programming intelligent industrial robots, human-robot collaboration robots, dual-arm robots, and heavy-duty AGVs. Guide the development of industrial robots in China towards the mid-to-high-end market. Promote the development of service robots in a wider range of fields. In areas such as elderly and disabled assistance, home services, medical rehabilitation, rescue and disaster relief, energy security, public safety, and major scientific research, cultivate the demand for smart living, modern services, and special operations. Focus on the development of four iconic products: fire rescue robots, surgical robots, intelligent public service robots, and intelligent care robots. Promote the serialization of professional service robots and the commercialization of personal/home service robots.
titlelist: Taiwan, with a growth rate of 78% compared to the previous year, is advancing the breakthrough of major landmark products.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: In order to address the issues of poor performance, reliability, and short lifespan of key components used in industrial robots with 6 degrees of freedom or more, efforts are being made to improve the quality stability and mass production capabilities of five key components: high-precision reducers, high-performance servo motors and drivers specifically designed for robots, high-speed and high-performance controllers, sensors, and end effectors. This is being done through optimization design, material selection, processing technology, assembly techniques, dedicated manufacturing equipment, and industrialization capabilities. The goal is to break through technological barriers and end the long-term dependence on imports.
titlelist: The output has increased by 78% compared to the previous year, and there is a strong focus on developing key components for robots.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen research on common key technologies. Focus on breaking through the common key technologies that restrict the development of robotics in China, in response to the demand for industrial robots in intelligent manufacturing and industrial transformation and upgrading, as well as the demand for service robots in smart living, modern services, and special operations. Actively track the future development trends of robotics and proactively lay out research on next-generation robotics technologies. Establish and improve innovation platforms for robotics. Make full use of and integrate existing scientific and technological resources and research and development capabilities, establish robotics innovation centers that serve the entire industry, and create a collaborative innovation carrier that tightly integrates government, industry, academia, research, and application. Focus on research on cutting-edge technologies and common key technologies. Strengthen the construction of the robotics standard system. Carry out top-level design of the robotics standard system, construct and improve the industrial standard system for robotics, accelerate the research and formulation of various technical standards urgently needed by the industry, support the research and verification of robotics evaluation standards, and actively participate in the revision of international standards. Establish a robotics testing and certification system. Establish and improve robotics inspection and certification institutions represented by the National Robotics Testing and Evaluation Center, promote the establishment of a third-party evaluation and certification system for robotics, and carry out testing and certification work for complete robotics and key functional components.
titlelist: 'Taiwan, with a growth rate of 78% compared to the previous year, strengthens its industrial innovation capabilities.'

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: To meet the strategic needs of the country and the major demands of the people's livelihood, we will strengthen the construction of quality brands and actively promote the application of robots. Focusing on key areas of the manufacturing industry, we will implement a number of exemplary industry application demonstration projects that have outstanding effects, strong driving force, and high relevance. We will focus on industrial sectors with high demand, high environmental requirements, and high labor intensity, as well as disaster relief, rescue, medical rehabilitation, and other service sectors. We will gradually and systematically promote the application of segmented industries, cultivate key areas of robot application system integrators and comprehensive solution service providers, and fully utilize outsourcing services, new leasing models, and other methods to expand the market space for industrial robots and service robots.
titlelist: 'Tai, with a growth of 78% compared to the previous year, is actively promoting application demonstrations.'

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Guide enterprises to develop in the direction of differentiation around segmented markets, carry out horizontal and vertical integration of the industrial chain, support the close integration of internet companies and traditional robot companies, accelerate the cultivation of leading enterprises with advanced management level, strong innovation capability, high efficiency, good performance, and strong market competitiveness, and create internationally renowned robot brands with high visibility, comprehensive competitiveness, and high product added value. Vigorously promote the close integration of research institutes, colleges and universities with the robot industry, give full play to the leading role of leading enterprises, form a good industrial ecological environment led by leading enterprises, drive the development of small and medium-sized enterprises towards the direction of specialization, refinement, uniqueness, and novelty, and form a situation of coordinated development of the entire industry chain. Fourth, guarantee measures.
titlelist: 'Taiwan, with a growth rate of 78% compared to the previous year, actively cultivates leading enterprises.'

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Strengthen top-level design, coordinate and integrate the resources and efforts of various departments such as industrial management, development and reform, science and technology, and finance, form a joint force, support independent innovation, and promote the healthy development of China's robotics industry; strengthen guidance on regional industrial policies, form a nationally and locally coordinated industrial policy system; encourage regions and parks with conditions to develop robotics industry clusters, and guide the concentration and aggregation of the robotics industry chain and production factors.
titlelist: Taiwan, with a growth rate of 78% compared to the previous year, strengthens overall planning and resource integration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Encourage banks and funds of all kinds to support robot projects that are technologically advanced, have clear advantages, and have strong driving and supporting roles within their business scope; encourage financial institutions to establish a community of shared interests with robot enterprises and provide long-term support for the development of the industry; actively support qualified robot enterprises to directly raise funds and engage in domestic and overseas mergers and acquisitions in the capital markets; guide financial institutions to innovate products and services that are in line with the characteristics of the robot industry chain and promote the leasing model for robots.
titlelist: Taiwan, increased by 78% compared to last year, expanding investment and financing channels.

name: Notice on Issuing the Broadband China Strategy and Implementation Plan (State Council [2013] No. 31) (State Council/August 16, 2013)
content: Make full use of various channels and levels, such as government, industry organizations, and enterprises, to carry out international exchanges and cooperation in technology, standards, intellectual property rights, testing and certification, etc., and continuously expand the scope of cooperation; encourage enterprises to actively explore overseas markets, strengthen technological cooperation, and provide comprehensive services such as system integration, product supply, operation and maintenance.
titlelist: 'Taiwan, with a growth rate of 78% compared to the previous year, is expanding international exchanges and cooperation.'

name: State Council General Office forwards the Notice of the Ministry of Information Industry and the National Development and Reform Commission on Accelerating the Development of the Mobile Communications Industry (State Council General Office Document No. [1999] 5) (State Council General Office, January 21, 1999)
content: According to the approval contract and the system of network access license for communication products, mobile communication product manufacturers are strictly regulated, and the production of mobile phones is included in the national guiding plan. The Ministry of Information Industry proposes plans based on market demand and industrial development needs, and submits them to the National Development and Reform Commission to be included in the national annual guiding production plan. The Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation approves the import of supporting components and parts required for production according to the above plan, and strictly controls the import of mobile communication products (including mobile switches, base stations, and mobile phones).

name: State Council General Office forwards the Notice of the Ministry of Information Industry and the National Development and Reform Commission on Accelerating the Development of the Mobile Communications Industry (State Council General Office Document No. [1999] 5) (State Council General Office, January 21, 1999)
content: For mobile communication products without a network access license, the Ministry of Commerce shall not approve imports, and the customs shall not release them. The Ministry of Information Industry should also strengthen the management of mobile communication products and cooperate with relevant departments to do a good job.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Accelerate the construction of dual gigabit networks, coordinate the layout of data centers, actively and steadily develop the industrial internet and connected vehicles, and build a new digital infrastructure system driven by technological innovation, based on the next-generation communication network, with data and computing facilities as the core, and with integrated infrastructure as the breakthrough.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Comprehensively promote the construction of 5G networks. Accelerate the large-scale deployment of 5G standalone (SA) networks, gradually build a multi-frequency band coordinated development 5G network system, and timely carry out the construction of 5G millimeter wave networks. Speed up the expansion of 5G network coverage, optimize the indoor 5G network coverage in urban areas, focus on strengthening deep coverage in traffic hubs, large sports venues, scenic spots, and other areas with high traffic density, and promote the extension of 5G networks to towns and rural areas. Optimize the coverage of 5G networks in industrial parks, ports, factories, and mines, and promote the construction of 5G industry virtual private networks. Actively promote the sharing of telecommunications infrastructure, support the co-construction and sharing of 5G access networks, promote 5G network roaming, and gradually form a mobile communication network pattern with multiple networks coexisting in hotspot areas and a single network supporting remote areas. Accelerate the retirement of 2G and 3G networks, and coordinate the coordinated development of 4G and 5G networks. Deploy the 25G network deployment project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, comprehensive deployment of next-generation communication network infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Priority should be given to completing the outdoor 5G network coverage in key areas such as the central urban area, industrial parks, ports, transportation hubs, universities, and popular tourist attractions. The goal is to provide high-quality networks to the public with a downlink speed of 100Mbps and an uplink speed of 5Mbps. Additionally, a platform for monitoring and analyzing the quality of the 5G network should be established to conduct quality evaluations and promote continuous optimization.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate 5G network coverage.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Accelerate the testing and verification of 5G inter-network roaming and device upgrades, so that all 5G networks in county-level and below administrative regions have inter-network roaming capabilities. Encourage basic telecommunications enterprises to carry out inter-network roaming under market mechanisms, and support priority pilot projects for inter-network roaming in provinces such as Tibet, Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, Qinghai, Gansu, and Heilongjiang.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, actively carry out 5G inter-network roaming.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: According to the principle of intensive utilization of existing resources and sharing without new construction, further improve the coordination mechanism for co-construction and sharing, continuously deepen the co-construction and sharing of 5G infrastructure, promote the construction of a 5G co-construction and sharing big data platform, continuously enhance the level of co-construction and sharing, and support the accelerated development of 5G networks. Fully deploy gigabit fiber-optic networks. Accelerate the construction of gigabit cities, continuously expand the coverage of gigabit fiber-optic networks, promote the deployment of 10-gigabit passive optical network (10G-PON) equipment in cities and key towns, and upgrade the optical access network capabilities of old residential areas in towns. Improve the coverage of gigabit fiber-optic networks in industrial parks, commercial buildings, schools, medical and health institutions, and other key locations. Promote the further extension of all-optical access networks to user terminals, promote the implementation of fiber-optic connections to rooms, desks, and machines, and upgrade user-side access devices as needed. Strengthen the coordinated construction of various network links, improve end-to-end service experience, and actively guide broadband users to migrate to gigabit fiber-optic broadband services. Accelerate the evolution and upgrade of fiber-optic access technologies, support the advanced layout of higher-speed broadband access networks in areas with conditions. Column 3: Deployment project for gigabit fiber-optic broadband networks.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and deepening the joint construction and sharing of 5G.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Deploy 10G-PONOLT equipment in urban and key township areas, and continue to carry out the transformation of the gigabit access capacity of old residential areas' optical distribution networks. Upgrade home and enterprise gateway devices as needed, optimize home indoor wiring, and establish gigabit wireless LAN networks.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate the deployment of gigabit fiber-optic networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the pilot demonstration of gigabit broadband applications, drive the development of new services such as CloudVR and ultra-high-definition video, and guide users to upgrade to gigabit broadband with higher speeds.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, enriching the application scenarios of gigabit fiber optics.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen the construction of technical means, form a comprehensive monitoring platform for broadband network capabilities and end-to-end user experience covering the whole country, and have the ability to monitor in different regions, time periods, and network segments. Continuously promote the evolution of backbone networks and the upgrading of service capabilities. Enhance the carrying capacity of backbone networks, deploy backbone networks with 200G/400G ultra-large capacity optical transmission systems, create P-bit-level backbone network transmission capabilities, guide the sinking of 100G and higher-rate optical transmission systems to metropolitan area networks, and accelerate the deployment of optical transport network (OTN) equipment to comprehensive access nodes and user sides. Coordinate the construction of important routing optical cables, enrich direct optical cables between important cities. Accelerate the evolution of backbone networks towards cloud-network integration architecture with cloud computing data centers as the core, and encourage the construction of direct network connections between data centers. Promote the large-scale application of technologies such as network function virtualization (NFV), software-defined networking (SDN), IPv6 segment routing (SRv6), and equipment such as all-optical cross-connect (OXC), improve the intelligent scheduling capability of network resources and resource utilization efficiency. Enhance end-to-end IPv6 connectivity capability. Accelerate the upgrade and transformation of IPv6 in network, data centers, content delivery networks (CDN), cloud services, and other infrastructure, improve the performance and service level of IPv6 networks. Accelerate the upgrade and transformation of applications and terminals to IPv6, achieve double growth in the scale of IPv6 users and business traffic. Promote the integration and development of IPv6 with artificial intelligence, cloud computing, industrial Internet, Internet of Things, and support the pilot and large-scale application of IPv6+ innovative technologies in key industries such as finance, energy, transportation, education, and government affairs, enhance the support capability of IPv6 networks for industrial digital transformation and upgrading. Column 4: IPv6 network service capability improvement project. Column 4: IPv6 network service capability improvement project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and implementation of monitoring and evaluation of gigabit network capabilities and user experience.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Optimize key performance indicators of the backbone network, mobile core network, and broadband access network for IPv6. Accelerate the transformation of existing CDN nodes, IDC nodes, and cloud computing platforms to IPv6, and build new ones that fully support IPv6. Encourage enterprises to increase innovation and large-scale deployment of IPv6+ network technology.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, optimization of infrastructure IPv6 performance and service capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the support of IPv6 for home routers, smart TVs, set-top boxes, and IoT terminals to improve the IPv6 industry ecosystem for smart homes. Accelerate the support of IPv6 for existing terminal devices that meet the conditions through firmware and system upgrades. Improve policy requirements for terminal devices to support IPv6.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and improvement of terminal device IPv6 support capability.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen the detection and disposal of vulnerabilities in the IPv6 environment, continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of network security technology applications, and promote the research, development, and application of network security products and services in the IPv6 environment. Promote the incubation of IPv6 security products under research and development, and enhance the application performance verification of IPv6 security products.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, strengthening IPv6 network security capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Support the construction of 5GSA network using IPv6 single-stack mode, organize pilot projects for IPv6 single-stack applications in areas such as 5G, Internet of Things, and Industrial Internet, and conduct pilot projects in at least 3 regions or fields. Promote the comprehensive development of mobile Internet of Things. Promote the migration of existing 2G/3G Internet of Things services to NB-IoT/4G (including LTE-Cat1, i.e., Category 1 4G network)/5G networks, and build a comprehensive ecological system for the coordinated development of low, medium, and high-speed mobile Internet of Things. Improve NB-IoT network deployment as needed, and enhance deep coverage in demand scenarios such as transportation networks, urban management networks, industrial parks, and modern agricultural demonstration areas. Support the development of 4G (including LTE-Cat1) to meet the needs of medium-speed Internet of Things and voice services. Accelerate the construction of 5G massive machine-type communication (mMTC) application scenario networks to meet the needs of high-speed and low-latency interconnection. Column 5 mobile Internet of Things deployment project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and implementation of IPv6 single-stack network pilot.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build NB-IoT base stations on demand, deepen LTE-Cat1 network coverage, accelerate the construction of 5G network mMTC scenarios based on standard progress and industry maturity, continuously promote network operation, monitoring, and optimization, improve network service levels, and achieve a breakthrough of over 2 billion connected mobile IoT devices.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, optimization of mobile Internet of Things network coverage.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Encourage the development and growth of mobile Internet of Things technology development platforms, further reducing the development costs and complexity of mobile IoT devices. Support basic telecommunications companies in building mobile IoT connection management platforms and strengthen network capability openness. Guide industry application companies to build vertical industry application platforms that integrate device and data management, system operation and maintenance functions to meet differentiated scenario application needs. Support the application and ecological construction of next-generation multi-platform operating systems.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate the construction of mobile Internet of Things platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Carry out the collection of excellent cases for mobile Internet of Things applications, create a benchmark project for mobile Internet of Things, encourage the construction of national-level mobile Internet of Things industrial bases in areas with solid industrial foundations, and promote the large-scale development of mobile Internet of Things applications and the maturity of the industry ecosystem.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, expansion of mobile Internet of Things applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Track and analyze the development of the Internet of Things to provide evaluation support for business migration, application expansion, and industrial development. Accelerate the layout of satellite communications. Strengthen the top-level design and overall layout of satellite communications, promote high-orbit satellites, and coordinate the development of medium and low-orbit satellites. Promote the deep integration of satellite communication systems and ground information communication systems, initially forming a global, integrated information network, and providing global information network services for various users in land, sea, air, and space. Actively participate in the formulation of international standards for satellite communications. Encourage innovation in satellite communication applications, promote the large-scale application of the Beidou satellite navigation system in the field of information communication, and promote its application in aviation, navigation, public safety and emergency response, transportation, and energy. Column 6: Satellite communication construction and the large-scale application project of the Beidou satellite navigation system.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, establishment of monitoring indicators and mechanisms for the development of the mobile Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Improve the coordinated layout of high, medium, and low orbit satellite networks, achieve the integration of 5G terrestrial cellular communication and satellite communication, initially establish a global satellite information network, and carry out the development and pilot demonstration of satellite communication applications.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and acceleration of satellite communication construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Develop plans for the use of satellite frequencies and orbit resources in relevant fields, strengthen centralized and unified management, and carry out tasks such as application, coordination, registration, and maintenance. Build a globally accessible information infrastructure. Optimize the layout of international communication entry and exit points, support the upgrading of regional international communication entry and exit points in border provinces, accelerate the expansion of international internet entry and exit bandwidth, and improve the quality of international information and communication services. Strengthen the top-level design of submarine cable construction, optimize the planning and layout of submarine cable landing stations, coordinate the construction of submarine cables in important directions such as North America and Europe, and establish smooth international submarine cable channels in Central and Western Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, and Europe. Establish and improve emergency mechanisms and protection systems for submarine cable protection and maintenance, establish a mechanism for mutual backup and sharing of submarine cables among enterprises, and enhance the emergency repair and operation monitoring capabilities of communication submarine cables. With basic telecommunications as the main body, establish a national submarine cable maintenance center, support the domestic shipbuilding of submarine cable maintenance vessels, strengthen the allocation of submarine cable maintenance vessels, and enhance the security capabilities of maritime communication network infrastructure. Optimize the layout of overseas information infrastructure, expand the coverage of overseas network service access points (POP), and increase overseas cloud computing data centers and CDN nodes. Column 7: International submarine cable construction and protection projects. Column 7: International submarine cable construction and protection projects.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, strengthening satellite frequency and orbit resource management and utilization.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Establishing international submarine cable landing stations, further enriching submarine cable resources in the 'Belt and Road' and other directions, improving submarine cable routing backup, supporting enterprises to participate in international submarine cable construction projects, further optimizing the international submarine cable layout, and significantly enhancing submarine cable connectivity.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, accelerate international submarine cable construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen cooperation with neighboring countries in infrastructure construction, increase the direction of cross-border land cables, expand the capacity of cross-border land cable systems, further optimize the international land cable layout, and significantly enhance land cable connectivity.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and establishment of international land cable channels.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of two self-owned cable maintenance ships in our country, establish two national-level cable protection bases in the East China Sea and the South China Sea, and have the ability to simultaneously handle six communication cable faults, forming an internationally competitive cable construction and maintenance force.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and increased protection of submarine cables.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Expand the backbone network interconnection nodes, optimize data center cross-network and cross-regional data exchange, improve the quality of interconnection between basic telecommunications enterprises and Internet enterprises, and provide high-quality data transmission services. Establish a direct network connection between regional data center clusters and between clusters and major cities, providing high-quality data transmission services.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and promotion of the integration of data centers and networks.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Encourage the use of efficient cooling solutions such as liquid cooling and water cooling in the construction of new large-scale and super-large-scale data centers. Promote efficient power supply and distribution solutions such as direct current power supply, high-voltage distribution, and distributed power supply. Utilize modular data centers and high-efficiency IT equipment to improve the utilization of renewable energy and construct green data centers at a high level. Accelerate the energy-saving and greening transformation of small and scattered data centers with poor efficiency and high energy consumption. Encourage data center operators to strengthen internal energy consumption data monitoring and management to improve energy utilization efficiency.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, continuous improvement of the green development level of data centers.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Improve the large platform of data centers in China, the online monitoring platform for data center networks, establish a data-network collaboration linkage mechanism, and enhance the network service capabilities of data centers. Build a monitoring platform for cloud computing facilities, enhance monitoring capabilities in terms of industry distribution, industry scale, cloud service availability, cloud platform network quality, cloud supply, and cloud usage. Enhance the service capabilities of artificial intelligence infrastructure. Construct standardized public data sets for industry applications, enhance the level of public data openness and empowerment. Create an artificial intelligence algorithm framework, encourage enterprises to accelerate the iteration and upgrade of algorithm frameworks. Build an advanced algorithm model library, create a general and industry-specific artificial intelligence algorithm platform, and strengthen software and chip compatibility. Support enterprises and research institutions in building inclusive open innovation platforms for artificial intelligence. Construct blockchain infrastructure. Promote the construction of a blockchain public infrastructure network based on consortium chains, providing developers with a unified blockchain operating environment and underlying technical services. Build blockchain infrastructure based on distributed identification, support cross-chain interoperability between homogeneous chains and heterogeneous chains, and enhance the interconnection capabilities between blockchain systems. Support the construction of general-purpose and dedicated blockchain public service platforms that can be deployed in the cloud, and layout blockchain-as-a-service (BaaS) cloud service platforms.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and monitoring the quality and development of data centers and cloud computing facilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
