content: Build a comprehensive interconnected industrial internet. Accelerate the construction of an industrial internet network that covers all regions and industries. Support the collaboration between basic telecommunications companies and industrial enterprises, utilize new network technologies and advanced applicable technologies to construct and transform enterprise intranets, and create benchmark examples of upgraded and transformed intranets for key industries and 5G fully connected factories. Improve the industrial internet identification and resolution system, enhance the service capabilities of national top-level nodes, optimize the layout of secondary nodes and recursive nodes, accelerate the application of identification resolution services in various industries, and promote the large-scale deployment of active identification carriers. Improve the multi-level industrial internet platform system, cultivate a number of comprehensive platforms that cross industries and domains, construct characteristic industrial internet platforms for key industries, support the development of professional industrial internet platforms for specific technical fields, and accelerate the cloud-based deployment of industrial equipment and business systems. Construct and improve a national, regional, and industry-level industrial internet big data center system, and utilize industrial internet big data in accordance with laws and regulations. Column 9: Industrial Internet Innovation and Development Project.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, actively developing efficient and collaborative integrated infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build a high-performance, highly reliable, and highly secure enterprise extranet to support industrial enterprises in building their intranets using new network technologies such as 5G, Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), and edge computing. Accelerate the network transformation of industrial equipment, enhance industrial data collection and interoperability capabilities. Create 150 benchmarking cases for upgrading and transforming enterprise intranets, establish 5G fully connected factories in 20 key industries, and build 8 5G+ industrial Internet public service platforms.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, upgrading and transformation of industrial internet intranet and extranet.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Enhance the comprehensive service capabilities of the country's top-level nodes, accelerate the construction and operation of second-level nodes for identification resolution and public recursive nodes, with more than 150 second-level nodes and a total registration volume of no less than 50 billion.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, improvement of industrial Internet identification and resolution system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build three comprehensive industrial Internet platforms with international influence, establish 70 industry-specific regional platforms, improve the quality of technology supply and application services of industrial Internet platforms, and double the number of industrial enterprises on cloud and platform.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and acceleration of industrial Internet platform construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build 20 regional-level sub-centers and 10 industry-level sub-centers. Construct an industrial microservice and industrial APP resource pool.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, construction of industrial internet big data center.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Form around 200 fusion application pilot demonstrations with industry characteristics in various specialized fields, support the construction of innovation and promotion centers for industrial internet platform applications, and create a group of industrial internet industry demonstration bases with regional characteristics and strong driving capabilities.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and implementation of pilot demonstrations for the integration of industrial internet applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Guide localities to actively promote the creation of a batch of national industrial internet demonstration zones, accelerate the technological breakthroughs and promotion of industrial internet, and build a highland for the development of industrial internet. Accelerate the deployment and application of connected vehicles. Strengthen the top-level design of the deployment of C-V2X-based connected vehicle infrastructure, promote the upgrade and transformation of highway connected vehicles through the integration of blocks and sections, and construct national pilot zones for connected vehicles. Coordinate the development of smart city infrastructure and intelligent connected vehicles, actively carry out urban pilots, and promote multi-scenario applications. Promote the coordinated construction of C-V2X, 5G networks, intelligent transportation, and smart cities, accelerate large-scale deployment on major urban roads, and explore pilot applications on certain sections of highways. Promote the research and development and testing verification of key technologies for connected vehicles, and explore innovation in the operation entities and business models of connected vehicles. Coordinate with the automotive, transportation, and other industries to promote the application of connected vehicles and accelerate the penetration of connected vehicle end-users. Coordinate the deployment of new types of infrastructure for social life. Further strengthen the construction of remote medical network capabilities. Encourage enterprises to participate in the construction of smart medical systems such as remote medical platforms. Cooperate with the education department, fully utilize national public communication resources, and accelerate the construction of education virtual private networks. Support basic telecommunications companies to cooperate with power grid companies in building smart power IoT using technologies such as the Internet of Things and network slicing. Support the construction of application scenarios such as high-definition remote interactive teaching and VR immersive teaching based on 5G networks. Actively promote the coordinated layout and construction of intelligent sensing facilities and multifunctional poles for typical scenarios such as environmental monitoring, public security, and emergency rescue. Support the construction of new urban infrastructure. Promote the intelligent upgrade of traditional infrastructure using technologies such as 5G, the Internet of Things, big data, and artificial intelligence. Accelerate the construction of the City Information Model (CIM) platform and operation management service platform; implement the intelligent transformation of municipal infrastructure, promote the application of intelligent sensing facilities for water supply, drainage, gas, and heat facilities, and improve the operational efficiency and safety performance of facilities; construct a fusion sensing system for urban roads, buildings, and public facilities, and coordinate the development of smart cities and intelligent connected vehicles; establish a smart property management service platform, promote the integration of online and offline property services, and build smart communities; promote the coordinated development of intelligent construction and industrialization of construction, implement projects to enhance intelligent construction capabilities, cultivate intelligent construction industrial bases, build a big data platform for the construction industry, and realize intelligent production, intelligent design, intelligent construction, and intelligent operation and maintenance.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and acceleration of the construction of national industrial internet demonstration zones.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Encourage the use of various technologies such as SDN/NFV, artificial intelligence, etc., actively promote the intelligent transformation and green upgrade of network facilities, and reduce the power consumption of data centers, mobile base stations, and other facilities. Encourage energy-saving renovations in existing data centers with high energy consumption and low energy utilization rates, accelerate the retirement or upgrade of old and high-energy-consuming traditional equipment in the existing network, and adopt energy-saving and emission reduction technologies and equipment for new information infrastructure. Actively promote the use of renewable energy such as wind energy and solar energy. Accelerate the application of information technology to enable energy-saving and emission reduction in various sectors of society, build an intelligent+ green ecological system, and reduce overall social energy consumption.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, promotion of energy conservation, emission reduction, and green development in the industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Increase support for research and development of network technologies such as optical communication, millimeter wave, 5G enhancement, 6G, and quantum communication. Track and accelerate the research of open wireless network technologies. Speed up the industrialization and application promotion of communication network chips, devices, and facilities. Strengthen the research on network intelligence, promote the deep integration of 5G and artificial intelligence technologies, improve network operation and maintenance efficiency, and enhance service quality and user experience. Enhance the research and development of key core technologies and products in areas such as cloud computing centers, Internet of Things, industrial Internet, and connected vehicles. Accelerate the deep integration and development of new technologies such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, digital twins, and virtual reality with traditional industries. Promote the establishment of a standard system for integrated development in emerging fields, accelerate the formulation and promotion of common standards for digital infrastructure and key technologies. Give full play to the technology spillover and integration role of leading companies, strengthen the collaborative research and development among industry, academia, research, and application, support cross-disciplinary research and development, solve a batch of bottleneck technical problems, build a technology system and innovation ecosystem with core competitiveness, achieve effective connection between the industrial chain and the innovation chain, and overall enhance the basic capabilities of the industrial chain and the security level of the supply chain. Column 10: Mobile Communication Core Technology Evolution and Industrial Promotion Engineering.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, strengthening core technology research and innovation breakthroughs.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Focus on the forefront of new generation information and communication technology, gather the forces of all parties in the industry chain, including upstream and downstream, industry, academia, research, and application, and strengthen the top-level design of the standard system and the formulation of industry standards.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, systematic promotion of information and communication technology standard construction and improvement.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the work of 5G standards, research and development, trials, and other related activities, improve the standards for 5G integration in various industries, and ensure that the number of technical standards documents and patents for 5G enhanced technologies remains in a leading position.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, strengthening research and development of 5G enhancement technology and standard formulation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen the research and development of 5G products, accelerate the maturity of 5G SA modules, terminals, and other devices, make efforts to overcome the shortcomings of 5G millimeter wave devices, and promote the optimization and upgrading of the 5G industry chain. Speed up the large-scale application of 5G, promote the standardization, normalization, and large-scale development of 5G industry applications.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and promotion of rapid maturity of the 5G industry chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build the vision, typical application scenarios, and key capability index system for 6G, encourage enterprises to conduct in-depth research on potential 6G technologies, break through technological and industrial bottlenecks, actively participate in 6G standard research, and form a batch of core research achievements for 6G.
titlelist: Development focus, construction of new digital infrastructure, and research and development of 6G basic theory and key technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Driven by technologies such as 5G and other information communication technologies, focusing on ten major scenarios including transportation, energy, manufacturing, agriculture, water conservancy, education, healthcare, tourism, community, and home, we aim to expand new applications in the digital life, production, and social public governance fields. We will accelerate the construction of the digital service application industry ecosystem, create advantages in massive data and diverse application scenarios, enhance the level of digital intelligence in public services and social governance, and promote the deep integration of the digital economy and the economy and society.
titlelist: Development focus, expanding the space for digital development.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Accelerate the cultivation of new models and new formats in the Internet industry. Strengthen policy support and guidance, encourage enterprises to achieve dual-drive innovation in technology and business models, and actively explore innovative Internet services. Develop and promote new applications and products based on 5G, mobile Internet of Things, and artificial intelligence, and promote the integration, intelligence, and unmanned upgrading of life-oriented services. Support the digital transformation and upgrading of offline business formats, actively develop new Internet formats such as platform economy and sharing economy, and vigorously expand convenient online service applications such as smart homes, online education, online office, and Internet healthcare. Promote the popularization of Internet accessibility. Focus on the needs of information barrier groups such as the elderly, disabled people, and culturally diverse populations, enhance product and service supply, and fill the gaps in information inclusiveness. Promote the transformation and optimization of Internet applications for accessibility, support website access service providers to build Internet information accessibility common technology service platforms. Accelerate the research and application of new technologies such as 5G and artificial intelligence in information accessibility, such as guidance for the blind, voice control, body control, and sign language translation, support the intelligent transformation of facilities in education, healthcare, employment, transportation, and other fields to have accessibility features, adhere to the combination of traditional services and intelligent innovation, and promote the optimization and upgrading of basic public services in terms of information accessibility.
titlelist: Development focus, expanding the space for digital development, innovating high-quality internet lifestyle services.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Focus on various areas of social governance, provide services to various regions in carrying out epidemic prevention and control, industry supervision, emergency response, public safety, and cybersecurity work, and help enhance the modernization level of national governance capabilities.
titlelist: Development focus, expanding digital development space, innovative service applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of innovation laboratories, explore technological and product innovation, and ensure platform capabilities and service quality.
titlelist: Development focus, expand digital development space, create pilot demonstrations.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Deepen the flow of data elements. Accelerate the realization of data value, speed up the resourceization, assetization, and capitalization of data, and achieve profound transformation and optimization of traditional production factors. Support information and communication enterprises and industrial enterprises in accelerating digital transformation and upgrading, and promote data openness and cooperation, jointly building a secure and trustworthy data space, and promoting comprehensive data collection, efficient interconnection, and high-quality aggregation. Establish rules for the circulation of data in the information and communication industry and the industrial sector, promote market-oriented development and application mechanisms, and promote orderly data flow. Carry out industrial big data management capability assessment, establish a value evaluation system, study and formulate rules for industrial data transactions, and regulate data trading behavior. Accelerate the cultivation of data element markets, encourage various types of enterprises to participate in the construction of factor trading platforms, and conduct data trading in accordance with the law. Establish basic systems and standard specifications for data resource property rights, transaction circulation, cross-border transmission, and security, and improve data property rights trading and industry self-discipline mechanisms. Deepen the integration and innovation of big data applications. Promote the deep integration and application of big data with technologies such as cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and blockchain. Give full play to the role of the national industrial big data platform, promote industry monitoring and analysis, and empower enterprise innovation and development. Support enterprises in applying big data in all aspects of industrial production and the entire industrial chain, develop data-driven new models and new formats of manufacturing, and guide enterprises in making good use of data in various aspects. Open data service resources to small and medium-sized enterprises, enhance enterprise data application capabilities, and cultivate a group of industrial big data solution providers for key industries. Promote the elementization and datafication of data, and cultivate new models such as data-driven integration of industry and finance, and collaborative innovation.
titlelist: Development focus, expand digital development space, promote the flow of data elements and application innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen the collaborative innovation of the industrial chain. Guide basic telecommunications companies, internet companies, hardware manufacturing companies, information and communication technology integration companies, etc., to collaborate on key technology breakthroughs, terminal product development, and integrated application exploration, and jointly build an advantageous and complementary, cooperative and win-win industrial ecosystem. Enrich the variety of 5G chips, terminals, modules, gateways, and other products, accelerate the promotion of smart products, and expand the supply of high-end products such as smart homes and smart connected cars. Support the expansion of traditional offline cultural and entertainment formats to online platforms, enrich ultra-high-definition videos, VR/AR, and other new multimedia content sources. Carry out pilot demonstrations of 5G new air interface (NR) + broadcasting and television, and promote the development of the 5G+ broadcasting and television business industrial chain. Improve the industrial development environment. Implement the 5G application innovation action plan, actively cultivate the 5G industrial ecosystem. Promote the construction of small and micro enterprise entrepreneurship and innovation demonstration bases and other carriers, give full play to the role of internet platforms, and enhance the entrepreneurial and innovative capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises. Carry out pilot demonstration projects for integrated applications, cultivate a group of specialized application solution providers, and promote the formation of distinctive industrial clusters and demonstration bases. Create a group of information consumption demonstration cities, support the construction of information consumption experience centers and other carriers in various regions, enhance consumers' information usage skills, promote the construction of information consumption monitoring platforms, and improve the information consumption statistical monitoring system. Column 125G application innovation and industrial ecosystem cultivation project.
titlelist: Development focus, expand digital development space, improve digital service application industry ecology.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Accelerate the development and industrialization process of 5G chips, modules, terminals, gateways, and other industry-oriented products. Promote chip companies to enrich their product systems, accelerate the hierarchical classification research and development of modules, optimize module environmental adaptability, continuously reduce power consumption and costs, and enhance original innovation capabilities and industrial foundation support capabilities. Support and guide the intelligent transformation of high-end equipment, pre-install 5G capabilities in production and research and development, open interface protocols, and strengthen the underlying support capabilities for 5G industry applications. Promote the construction of public service platforms such as 5G testing laboratories and innovation centers.
titlelist: Development focus, expand digital development space, strengthen research and development of basic products and high-end equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote and apply 5G in key industries such as industry, energy, culture and tourism, transportation, healthcare, and education, and establish a number of 5G application demonstration benchmarks. Strengthen the collaboration among basic telecommunications companies, communication equipment companies, industry application companies, information technology companies, and internet companies, and cultivate a group of 5G industry application solution providers to foster the prosperity of the 5G application industry ecosystem.
titlelist: Development focus, expand the space for digital development, promote innovative applications of 5G in key areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Grasp the new trends in industry development, focus on the overall goal of modernizing the national governance system and governance capacity, accelerate the construction of a new type of industry management system, strive to enhance basic management and market supervision capabilities, significantly improve network operation, emergency support, and industry service levels, create a favorable development environment, promote industry innovation and development, deepen reform and opening up, and support high-quality development.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen internet infrastructure management. Strengthen network access management, improve the filing and approval system for internet information services such as websites, regulate the registration and use of internet resources such as domain names and IP addresses, comprehensively promote real-name registration for internet access, improve the application environment for Chinese domain names, and further promote the popularization and application of Chinese domain names. Strengthen internet routing management, establish a sound mechanism for collecting and verifying domestic internet routing information, and further enhance the reliability of internet interconnection. Strengthen network addressing management, orderly introduce internet root mirror servers. Enhance the coordinated management capability of resources and applications, build a comprehensive management platform for basic resources and application services, and effectively support the supervision of various fields of the internet. Strengthen radio spectrum resource management. Based on the level of industrial development and frequency usage status in China, orderly cultivate and optimize resource allocation, improve spectrum utilization efficiency, give full play to the leading role of spectrum resources in technological progress and industrial development, achieve dual improvement in economic and social benefits. Develop special frequency plans for 5G/6G, comprehensively leverage the characteristics of low, medium, and high frequency bands, cultivate 2G/3G/4G frequencies for 5G/6G, allocate additional mid-frequency spectrum resources, introduce phased plans for 5G millimeter-wave frequencies, evaluate the utilization rate and effectiveness of public mobile communication system frequencies, promote the market-oriented allocation of commercial spectrum resources, and coordinate the long-term spectrum needs of public mobile communication industry. Introduce special frequency plans for the Internet of Things, industrial internet, terahertz, and support the construction of new infrastructure. Improve the full-process management mechanism of frequency resource management, establish a closed-loop mechanism for spectrum resource division, planning, licensing, supervision, evaluation, adjustment, and recovery. Promote the coordination and management of satellite radio frequency resources, and reasonably plan and utilize satellite frequency and orbit resources. Enhance radio security capabilities comprehensively, and coordinate the border coordination of 5G public mobile communication frequencies. Strengthen the management of telecommunication network numbering resources. Revise the Telecommunication Network Numbering Resource Management Measures, improve the lifecycle management mechanism for telecommunication network numbering resources planning, allocation, adjustment, and recovery. Develop a numbering plan for mobile network user numbers starting with 9, increase the efforts to recover telecommunication network numbering resources, and expand dedicated number ranges for IoT services and other purposes. Enhance the monitoring capability of telecommunication network numbering access and activation data, optimize and improve the supervision system for telecommunication network numbering. Strengthen data resource management. Research and formulate regulations for the open and flow of public data in the information and communication field, explore the establishment of a data resource management system and data element market that covers the entire process of data application processing, data product standardization, data rights confirmation, data pricing, data transaction trust, and data open utilization. Promote pilot applications of data classification and grading, clarify rules for the protection of personal information data, sharing and trading of enterprise data, and the use of national data strategic resources, and explore mechanisms for the sharing of data of public interest by large platform enterprises with the government and third parties. Strengthen data resource supervision and industry self-discipline. Accelerate the formulation of technical standards for data circulation and sharing, improve data quality and standardization. Guide enterprises to comply with national standards for data management capabilities, encourage local governments to introduce policies and measures to increase financial support for funding, personnel training, and pilot compliance. Expand the management of industrial internet resources. Implement the Industrial Internet Identification Management Measures, strengthen the construction and connection of industrial internet identification resolution root nodes, enhance the national top-level nodes' support capabilities for identification, domain names, and other network infrastructure resources. Establish a coordination mechanism for identification code allocation, guide the standardized development of identification resolution root node operating organizations, national top-level node operating organizations, identification registration management organizations, identification registration service organizations, and recursive node operating organizations, and enhance the governance capacity of the identification resolution system. Column 13 Internet Source Gathering Project. Build a comprehensive management platform. Establish a comprehensive management platform for basic resources and application services based on real-name registration, controllable resources, application filing, and precise management. Establish a basic information database. Comprehensive collection of basic information such as filing and approval information for internet information services such as websites, as well as registration, allocation, resolution, and use of internet resources such as domain names and IP addresses.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, and comprehensively enhancing basic management capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Establish sound technical management standards, utilize new technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain, build comprehensive management methods for the digital economy, including full-scale verification, real-time online access, one-click direct access, and secure and efficient means, and create comprehensive management capabilities of real-time monitoring, all-domain collection, shared utilization, collaborative linkage, and intelligent analysis.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, improving technical means.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen information sharing with relevant departments, fully leverage platform regulatory capabilities, and effectively support the modernization of national governance capabilities.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, optimizing capacity output.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Establish a new market access management model of government setting standards, enterprises making commitments, post-certification strict supervision, and punishment for dishonesty, comprehensively promote the approval of value-added telecommunications business through notification commitments, implement online verification of electronic licenses, achieve full-process online handling and one-stop online handling of national telecommunications business, and enhance government service capabilities.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, establishing a new type of market access management model.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Based on the list of poor operation and dishonesty in the telecommunications business, a credit management system has been established, supplemented by a credit scoring mechanism. The new credit-based regulatory mechanism is more comprehensive, achieving full record of corporate credit, online public disclosure of poor and dishonesty lists, real-time access to corporate credit scores, and effectively enhancing the efficiency of credit supervision.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, constructing a credit management system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build a unified, standardized, and efficient law enforcement accountability system, establish a nationwide unified law enforcement platform, promote Internet Plus supervision, effectively implement various law enforcement systems through network monitoring, digital evidence collection, data sharing, etc., and enhance the level of law enforcement that is in accordance with the law, standardized, fair, and efficient.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, and improving the law enforcement accountability system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Establish a system for creating a list of key internet companies, focusing on rectifying issues such as disrupting market order and infringing upon user rights in the internet industry. With compliance regulation as the core, strengthen joint regulation between central and local authorities, and construct a multi-pronged internet market management mechanism that includes self-assessment by companies, technological testing, law enforcement accountability, centralized supervision, and social oversight.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, improving the management mechanism of the internet market.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Revise and improve emergency plans for communication security at all levels and in all types, establish a sound emergency communication coordination mechanism, and establish a new pattern of emergency communication security with multiple participants.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new industry management system, building a new pattern of emergency communication.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build a highly reliable, integrated and interconnected national communication network emergency communication command and dispatch system and network, strengthen the construction of capabilities such as prevention and early warning, decision analysis, and emergency response.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, enhancing command and dispatch capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Accelerate the construction progress of satellite mobile communication networks, promote the innovative applications of 5G and drones in emergency communication, and realize the construction of a public communication network with multiple routes, multiple nodes, and a backup system for critical infrastructure.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, constructing a multi-dimensional integrated emergency communication guarantee network.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Improve service supervision policies and measures. Promote the improvement of relevant laws, regulations, and standards for telecommunications services, and research and formulate service standards and specifications for 5G services, industrial internet, cloud computing, and major internet applications. Improve the evaluation methods for telecommunications service quality and establish evaluation methods for internet service quality. Construct a comprehensive service supervision system and real-time monitoring mechanism covering basic telecommunications enterprises and value-added telecommunications enterprises. Optimize the mechanism for handling user complaints and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of users. Strengthen the protection of user rights and interests. Promote the improvement of relevant laws, regulations, and standards for personal information protection, establish a comprehensive supervision system covering internet information service providers, application stores, network access service providers, third-party service providers, and mobile terminal manufacturers, and construct a comprehensive supervision pattern involving government regulation, corporate self-discipline, media supervision, social organizations, and user participation. Enhance technical means comprehensively, achieve real-time monitoring and automated, standardized testing, and promptly detect and handle violations. Focus on solving problems such as spam messages and harassing phone calls, and create a favorable environment for information and communication services. Column 16 Internet Service Focus Project.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, comprehensively improving the level of industry services.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build a mobile internet service quality and personal information protection detection platform, actively utilize new technologies and methods such as artificial intelligence and big data, form platform automation detection capabilities, gather data from multiple sources, and form data monitoring and management capabilities.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, constructing a testing platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build a unified APP authentication signature system, establish an APP signature service system that serves developers, testers, and distributors, and enhance the traceability of various links in the APP supply chain.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, building a traceability system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Systematically sort out the information and communication industry's related resources, establish a comprehensive and feasible data collection mechanism, build a network-wide data collection capability, and form an industry data resource catalog. Strengthen data analysis and mining, develop multi-dimensional dynamic perception, real-time monitoring, and cross-verification capabilities, and achieve visualized decision-making and intelligent disposal.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, strengthening data support capability.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: In the face of the new situation of everything being interconnected, it is necessary to develop technology capabilities that are iterative, customizable, and forward-looking, in order to support policy-making, industry regulation, and public services in the information and communication industry. It is important to promote the upgrading of application capabilities, continuously expand the direction of applications, and explore new application scenarios, in order to promote the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity through informatization.
titlelist: Development focus, building a new type of industry management system, strengthening technological application innovation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Resolutely implement the 'Four Adherences' in national cybersecurity work, closely focus on the main task of preventing and resolving major cybersecurity risks, strive to improve the protection of network infrastructure and the security system of network data, continuously promote the security management level of new digital infrastructure, build a prosperous and developing cybersecurity industry and a trustworthy network ecosystem, comprehensively enhance the emergency response and disposal of cybersecurity incidents in the industry, serve the high-quality development of the industry, and support the construction of a new pattern of national cybersecurity.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Implement the Cybersecurity Law and the requirements for the security protection of national key information infrastructure, establish a system for implementing certification of network infrastructure security protection capabilities and maturity evaluation, and construct an industry framework for managing network security risks and an evaluation system for effectiveness. Promote the integration of the network security guarantee system and capacity building with planning, construction, and operation, deepen mechanisms such as the management of security vulnerabilities in network products, network security risk assessment, and network security monitoring and reporting, establish a national-level network security public service system, and continuously enhance the level of basic network security protection. Accelerate the development of monitoring and defense capabilities for important network nodes and key business systems, focus on enhancing the defense capabilities against large-scale network attacks, strengthen the capacity building for public domain name service security, and prevent and control major network security incidents. Improve the industry network security review system, promote the security testing and certification of network key equipment, establish supply chain risk management systems such as supplier network security maturity certification, steadily and orderly promote the use of commercial encryption, and enhance the security protection level of network infrastructure.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, enhance the security guarantee capability of industry critical information infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build internationally leading 5G security capabilities. Establish a comprehensive 5G network, equipment, and application security evaluation system, and create an internationally top-level 5G security testing laboratory. Strengthen the role and position of enterprises, enhance standard specifications and guidelines, comprehensively improve the security level of 5G applications, and form a technologically advanced, application-rich, and sustainable development ecosystem for 5G security. Strengthen the management of basic security for the Internet of Things (IoT) in the context of 5G large-scale connectivity and integration applications, establish a sound supervision mechanism for the entire lifecycle security of IoT cards, and research and establish security labeling mechanisms for IoT terminals, gateways, and platforms, comprehensively constructing a basic security management system. Safeguard the innovative development of industrial internet security. Improve the implementation of a classified and graded management system for industrial internet enterprise network security, promote enterprises to accelerate the construction of network security capabilities, and strengthen the implementation of enterprise network security responsibilities. Encourage key network security companies and industrial enterprises to collaborate, break through a batch of key core technologies for industrial internet security, and create devices and products embedded with security functions. Continuously build and improve a widely covered, multi-party collaborative, and operationally efficient industrial internet security technology monitoring service system, establish a sound closed-loop mechanism for monitoring, analyzing, reporting, and tracing industrial internet security threats, and efficiently prevent and respond to industrial internet security threats. Support local governments and key industry enterprises in innovatively creating intensive industrial internet security operation service centers and other public service platforms to improve the level of public service supply for industrial internet security. Simultaneously construct a security guarantee system for integrated applications and new infrastructure networks. Accelerate the establishment of a security guarantee system for the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), solidly promote real-name registration management for IoV cards, establish and improve technical means for the security management of IoV cards, enhance the system for IoV network security protection, inspection, reporting, and disposal, build a professional database for security vulnerabilities in IoV products, promote the construction of IoV identity authentication and security trust capabilities, accelerate the construction of a technology platform for IoV security situational awareness, and enhance the security guarantee capabilities for IoV. Implement the Security to the Cloud project for enterprises, enhance the security guarantee level of cloud facilities such as cloud-network integration, cloud-edge collaboration, and cloud-based applications in data centers. Simultaneously establish a security guarantee system for satellite internet networks, and proactively plan for the security of new technologies such as 6G, quantum communication, and artificial intelligence. Establish and improve cross-departmental and cross-domain collaborative security mechanisms with key industries such as industry, energy, transportation, and healthcare, and enhance the level of collaborative security for integrated applications. Column 185G and Industrial Internet Security Innovation Project.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, continuously improve the level of security management of new digital infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Deepen the construction of a three-level coordinated and linked industrial Internet security technology monitoring service system at the national, provincial, and enterprise levels, accelerate the key technological breakthroughs in industrial Internet security such as source code security testing and high-traffic protocol analysis, develop and apply a batch of industrial equipment products with embedded security functions, establish a batch of standardized local industrial Internet security operation service centers and key industry security public service platforms. Create a group of industrial Internet enterprises that serve as benchmarks for network security classification and grading management, as well as 100 exemplary solutions for typical scenarios.
titlelist: Development focus: comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, enhance the security guarantee capability of industrial Internet.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen the integration of supply and demand in the network security industry. Enhance technological innovation in network security and promote the construction of an advanced and comprehensive network security product system. Innovate network security services and improve the public service system for network security. Encourage companies to shift from providing network security products to a focus on both products and services. Increase the application of security solutions in scenarios related to new infrastructure security demands, and accelerate the deployment of network security solutions in key areas such as 5G, industrial internet, connected vehicles, Internet of Things, and smart cities. Enhance the demonstration and application of network security innovation. Deepen pilot demonstrations of network security technology applications, select outstanding security technologies, products, services, and solutions, and promote their implementation to create a resource pool of security technology products and solutions. Improve the network security product evaluation system and innovate the security + industry and security + regional service models. Establish a network security excellence verification demonstration center, support the construction of advanced demonstration areas for network security innovation applications, and lead the scale application of network security products and services. Foster a prosperous ecosystem for the network security industry. Coordinate the layout of national network security industrial parks, support the construction of public service platforms for network security, and form a development pattern of multiple support, nationwide radiation, and coordinated development in the parks to promote the concentration and development of the network security industry. Strengthen the leading position of network security enterprises, optimize the industrial policy environment, and cultivate a group of specialized and outstanding network security companies. Enhance the integration of network security and finance, strengthen the cultivation of innovative, applied, and skilled network security talents, fully leverage the role of alliances and associations, and improve the network security industry ecosystem. Column 19: Ecological Cultivation Project for Network Security Technology Industry.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, vigorously promote the innovative development of the network security industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build more than 50 network security characteristic laboratories, overcome a batch of key network security technologies and products. Deeply implement pilot demonstrations of network security technology applications, improve the network security product evaluation system, establish a network security excellence verification demonstration center, support the construction of advanced demonstration areas for network security innovation and application at the local level, and improve the supply and service system of network security technology products.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, promote the innovative development of the network security industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the establishment of national network security industrial parks in regions with good industrial foundations, such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, the Pearl River Delta, the Chengdu-Chongqing region, and the Changsha-Zhuzhou-Xiangtan region. Support the cultivation of a group of leading network security enterprises. Through various forms such as integration of industry and education, cooperation between schools and enterprises, and practical training and selection, strengthen the construction of the network security talent system, and annually train and select 10,000 outstanding talents in the field of network security.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, optimize the policy environment for the network security industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of a network security response center, gathering industry talents, data resources, and technical means for network security emergency response and major event protection, to create a high-level command hub. Coordinate the aggregation of data resources such as government and industry enterprise network assets, basic resources, and threat intelligence, promote the integration of network security technical means, and build a comprehensive and collaborative monitoring and early warning, situational awareness, information dissemination, emergency response technical support, and command system across all domains and networks. Improve the contingency plans for major event network security protection and sudden network security incidents, continuously improve the public internet emergency response mechanism, strengthen the linkage between the industry and national network security emergency response and disposal, and enhance the level of capability in preventing and responding to major network security risks. Column 20: Network Security Intelligent Brain Project.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, comprehensively enhance the level of network security emergency response.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Gather government and enterprise network assets, basic resources, threat intelligence, and other data resources to promote the integration of various network security technologies such as basic telecommunications networks, industrial Internet, and connected vehicles, and form an industry network security basic data resource library.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, and establish an industry network security basic resource library.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build a comprehensive management platform, share and utilize big data, and establish a collaborative and interconnected system, forming a unified technical architecture consisting of infrastructure layer, data platform layer, and business application layer.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, optimize the technical architecture of network security management.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Fully utilize new generation information technologies such as big data and artificial intelligence to construct an industry network security comprehensive command and control technology system that encompasses comprehensive collection, multidimensional analysis, and real-time collaboration. This system effectively supports industry security supervision and national governance work.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, enhance the systematic guarantee capability of network security emergency command.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Carry out research and tackle key technologies for network trust certification, establish a network trust technology standard system, and form a technologically advanced and functionally complete network trust certification system.
titlelist: Development focus, comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, and develop network trust certification technology capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Build a trustworthy service platform for the information and communication industry, enhance the governance capabilities of industries such as finance, taxation, healthcare, and transportation, and promote the secure development of integrated applications in areas such as 5G, industrial Internet, and connected vehicles.
titlelist: Development focus: comprehensively strengthen the network and data security guarantee system and capacity building, and promote the establishment of a trusted identity center for telephone numbers.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Strengthen forward-looking thinking, overall planning, strategic layout, and comprehensive promotion; deepen regional coordinated development, promote urban-rural coordinated development, fully implement the rural revitalization strategy, promote cross-industry integration and co-construction, coordinate domestic and international markets, optimize international market layout, and promote balanced and coordinated development of the information and communication industry.
titlelist: Development focus, strengthen cross-regional and cross-industry overall coordination.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Explore the establishment of mechanisms for regional strategic coordination, market integration, and regional cooperation and mutual assistance. Implement major regional strategies such as coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt, construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta, ecological protection and high-quality development of the Yellow River Basin, and strengthen the integrated and coordinated development of relevant regions in areas such as information and communication technology research and development and innovation, construction of new digital infrastructure, and expansion of digital service applications. Support the advancement of the Western Development, comprehensive revitalization of the Northeast, rise of the central region, and leading development of the eastern region. In developed areas in the east, take the lead in carrying out network upgrades and application innovations, radiate and drive other regions, and gradually deepen the coordinated development; provide policy support to the central and western regions and the northeast, build international communication hubs with locational advantages facing ASEAN and Central Asia, and support the construction of a number of major new digital infrastructure projects in provinces and cities in the central and western regions that meet the conditions; promote the construction of industrial internet and other facilities in old industrial bases such as the northeast region. Support the optimization and improvement of the level of new digital infrastructure in city clusters such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta, the Pearl River Delta, Chengdu-Chongqing, and the central reaches of the Yangtze River, give play to the leading role of central cities, and build benchmark cities for the high-quality development of the information and communication industry.
titlelist: Development focus, strengthen cross-regional and cross-industry overall coordination, deepen regional coordinated development.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Continuously improve the level of rural communication network infrastructure. Implement a new round of universal telecommunications service projects, increase support for broadband network upgrades in rural areas, revolutionary old areas, ethnic areas, border areas, and poverty-stricken areas, especially in key counties for national rural revitalization. Promote the breadth and depth of rural fiber optic and 4G network coverage. Gradually promote the construction of gigabit fiber optic networks in rural and remote areas with conditions and needs, and accelerate the use of low-frequency to expand rural 5G network coverage. Fill the gaps in communication network infrastructure in border areas, and comprehensively use satellite communication and other access methods to provide broadband network access services to users. Actively promote the coverage of mobile Internet of Things in rural areas and increase the deployment of NB-IoT in agricultural production scenarios. Strengthen the daily operation and maintenance of rural communication networks, and continue to implement precise fee reductions for households lifted out of poverty and households under poverty monitoring. Column 22: New round of universal telecommunications service projects.
titlelist: Development focus, strengthen cross-regional and cross-industry overall coordination, promote digital rural construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Improve the 4G network coverage in densely populated areas, poverty alleviation and relocation sites, production and operation areas, transportation arteries, agricultural and forestry fields, and other regions.
titlelist: Development focus, strengthen cross-regional and cross-industry overall coordination, deepen 4G network coverage in rural and remote areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Gradually improve the 4G network coverage of public institutions such as border village schools, clinics, as well as border ports, border checkpoints, and surrounding roads.
titlelist: Development focus, strengthen cross-regional and cross-industry overall coordination, strengthen 4G network coverage in border areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote the extension of low-frequency 5G networks to rural and remote areas, prioritize the construction of 5G networks in key administrative villages with conditions, promote the popularization of 5G applications in precision agriculture, telemedicine, online education, and other fields, and achieve an 80% 5G coverage rate in administrative villages by 2025. Significantly improve the level of digital applications in rural areas. Insist on the simultaneous popularization of digital applications and the construction of information infrastructure in rural areas, encourage the extension and popularization of production-oriented and public service-oriented platforms such as e-commerce platforms, internet hospitals, and online classrooms to rural areas. Encourage enterprises to use technologies such as cloud computing, big data, and artificial intelligence to accelerate the integration and innovation in rural life, production, and social governance, and actively promote the expansion of applications such as e-commerce, logistics distribution, and shared transportation to rural areas. Develop rural internet characteristic applications according to local conditions, promote the integration of agriculture with industries such as tourism, elderly care, and health, achieve the integrated development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries, accelerate the modernization of agriculture and rural areas, and contribute to rural revitalization.
titlelist: Development focus, strengthen cross-regional and cross-industry overall coordination, promote rural 5G network coverage.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Information and Communication Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 164) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Actively promote the establishment of a three-tier management system for the information and communication industry at the national, provincial, and municipal levels. Increase financial and fiscal support for the innovative development of the information and communication industry, leverage the role of national government investment funds to guide, encourage social capital to explore the establishment of market-oriented industrial investment funds, and encourage the establishment of special funds for the development of digital infrastructure such as 5G, industrial internet, and IPv6 networks at the local level. Collaborate with relevant departments to continue increasing policy support for the power supply, construction, and application of digital infrastructure such as 5G, gigabit fiber, data centers, and IPv6 networks, and encourage and support the high-level internationalization of the information and communication industry. Strengthen financial support and policy support to address the issue of border network coverage. Increase policy and financial support for information and communication technology research and development, implement policies for deducting enterprise research and development expenses, and incentivize enterprises to increase research and development investment. Deepen industry-finance cooperation, optimize industry-finance cooperation platforms, support pilot cities for industry-finance cooperation to increase investment in the information and communication industry, promote financial institutions to innovate financial products and services, expand credit lending to information and communication enterprises and network security enterprises, support eligible innovative and growth-oriented internet companies to go public and raise funds, and support eligible information and communication enterprises to raise funds through issuing corporate bonds and non-financial corporate debt financing instruments.
titlelist: Enhance policy and financial support measures.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the Green and High-Quality Development of New Infrastructure such as Data Centers and 5G in accordance with the requirements of achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 1742 of 2021) (issued on November 30, 2021).
content: By 2025, data centers and 5G will basically form a green and intensive integrated operational pattern. The energy utilization efficiency and renewable energy utilization rate of data centers will significantly improve. The average energy utilization efficiency of newly built large and super-large data centers nationwide will be reduced to below 1.3, and the energy utilization efficiency of national hub nodes will be further reduced to below 1.25, reaching a green and low-carbon level of 4A or above. The overall utilization rate of data centers nationwide will significantly improve, with the utilization rate of data centers in the western region increasing from 30% to over 50%, achieving a more balanced supply and demand of computing power between the eastern and western regions. The energy efficiency of 5G base stations will increase by more than 20%. The dynamic monitoring mechanism for energy consumption of data centers and 5G will be basically established, and the comprehensive output calculation system and statistical methods will be basically sound. Based on the green and high-quality development of data centers and 5G, it will comprehensively support the digital transformation and upgrading of various industries, especially traditional high-energy-consuming industries, help achieve the overall goal of peaking carbon emissions, and lay a solid foundation for achieving carbon neutrality.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the Green and High-Quality Development of New Infrastructure such as Data Centers and 5G in accordance with the requirements of achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 1742 of 2021) (issued on November 30, 2021).
content: Support basic telecommunications operators to carry out 5G network co-construction, sharing, and cross-network roaming, and strengthen resource reuse. Accelerate the retirement and upgrade of old, high-energy-consuming equipment, and promote the construction of intelligent multifunctional street lamps. Accelerate the construction of green data centers and release a list of national green data centers. The energy utilization efficiency of newly built large and extra-large data centers should not exceed 1.3, and gradually carry out energy-saving and carbon reduction transformations for data centers with energy utilization efficiency exceeding 1.5. For regions with an overall data center deployment rate (operational for more than 1 year) below 50%, no support will be provided for planning new data center clusters or for the construction of large and extra-large data center projects.
titlelist: The main task is to improve computational power efficiency.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the Green and High-Quality Development of New Infrastructure such as Data Centers and 5G in accordance with the requirements of achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 1742 of 2021) (issued on November 30, 2021).
content: Encourage the use of efficient and environmentally friendly refrigeration technology to reduce energy consumption. Support data centers in adopting new types of precision air conditioning, liquid cooling, cabinet-based modular, and waste heat utilization methods for data center construction. Promote energy-saving technologies for refrigeration systems, optimize airflow organization, and gradually improve dynamic adaptability with IT equipment operation status through intelligent means. Accelerate the promotion and application of energy-saving 5G base stations, support the development of efficient energy-saving technologies such as silicon carbide RF devices, and reduce energy consumption of base station equipment through new processes, materials, solutions, and designs.
titlelist: The main task is to innovate energy-saving technologies.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the Green and High-Quality Development of New Infrastructure such as Data Centers and 5G in accordance with the requirements of achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 1742 of 2021) (issued on November 30, 2021).
content: Encourage the application of artificial intelligence technology in data center and 5G network management, strengthen automated and intelligent energy consumption management, and improve overall energy efficiency. Support the application of intelligent symbol silence, deep sleep, and channel silence technologies in 5G networks, without affecting user experience. Encourage the exploration of using idle industrial buildings with suitable conditions, as well as special geographical conditions such as caves, mountain gaps, underwater, and along rivers, lakes, and coastlines to develop data centers, fully leveraging natural advantages such as climate, hydrology, and topography to promote energy-saving and consumption reduction in data centers according to local conditions.
titlelist: The main task is to optimize the energy-saving mode.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the Green and High-Quality Development of New Infrastructure such as Data Centers and 5G in accordance with the requirements of achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 1742 of 2021) (issued on November 30, 2021).
content: Encourage the use of renewable energy such as wind energy and solar energy, improve the level of green electricity usage in data centers through self-built transmission lines or bilateral trading, and promote the local consumption of renewable energy. Support the large-scale promotion and application of modular hydrogen batteries and solar panel houses in small or edge data centers. Combine new technologies such as energy storage and hydrogen energy to increase the proportion of renewable energy in data center energy supply. Support data centers with the necessary conditions to develop new energy power supply lines. Coordinate the layout of 5G and distributed generation of renewable energy, actively promote the simplification and optimization of power supply and air conditioning systems, and strictly control the disposal of waste facilities.
titlelist: The main task is to utilize green energy.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the Green and High-Quality Development of New Infrastructure such as Data Centers and 5G in accordance with the requirements of achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 1742 of 2021) (issued on November 30, 2021).
content: Give full play to the important supporting role of data centers and 5G in promoting the digital transformation of traditional industries, and promote the acceleration of cloud computing and data intelligence in traditional industries such as coal, steel, cement, non-ferrous metals, petrochemicals, and chemicals, optimize management processes, and achieve cost savings. Release a list of national new data centers to create computing power infrastructure and promote the benchmarking of digital transformation in traditional industries. Encourage the development of labor-intensive industries such as data processing, data cleaning, and data content services around data centers in energy-rich areas in the western region, transforming watt industries into bit industries, and relying on industrial leapfrogging to achieve low-carbon and green development.
titlelist: The main task is to promote transformation and upgrading.

name: Implementation Plan for Promoting the Green and High-Quality Development of New Infrastructure such as Data Centers and 5G in accordance with the requirements of achieving peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 1742 of 2021) (issued on November 30, 2021).
content: Coordinate and coordinate communication networks, power and energy, ecological environment, fiscal and tax-related forces to create favorable policy support for green and low-carbon development.
