For newly built data center projects that meet the conditions and are included in the national hub node data center cluster, actively coordinate and arrange energy consumption indicators to provide appropriate support, and give priority consideration to projects that have achieved outstanding results in eastern calculation and western calculation. Coordinate the resolution of major issues such as facility planning, investment, construction, supervision, and evaluation, and organize pilot explorations in industry access and market regulation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen coordination, and adopt multiple measures.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: By 2023, China's level of development in 5G applications will significantly improve, and its comprehensive strength will continue to enhance. A new ecosystem of deep integration of IT (Information Technology), CT (Communication Technology), and OT (Operational Technology) will be created, achieving breakthroughs in both the depth and breadth of 5G applications in key areas. A dual-pillar system of technology industry and standards will be established, and the basic capabilities of networks, platforms, and security will be further enhanced, gradually forming a situation where 5G applications set sail for distant voyages. - Key indicators of 5G applications will greatly improve. The penetration rate of 5G personal users will exceed 40%, with a user base of over 560 million. 5G network access traffic will account for over 50%, and the efficiency of 5G network usage will significantly improve. The annual growth rate of 5G IoT terminal users will exceed 200%.- The effectiveness of 5G applications in key areas will be highlighted. In the personal consumption sector, a batch of new businesses, models, and formats of 5G+ will be created, significantly improving user experience. In vertical industries, the penetration rate of 5G applications in large industrial enterprises will exceed 35%, and the scale replication and promotion of 5G applications in sectors such as power and mining will be achieved. The pilot scope of 5G+ connected vehicles will be further expanded, promoting the digital transformation and upgrading of traditional industries such as agriculture and water conservancy. In the social livelihood sector, a number of 5G+ smart education, 5G+ smart healthcare, and 5G+ cultural tourism model projects will be created, further enhancing the level of 5G+ smart city construction. Over 100 benchmark 5G applications will be developed in each key industry.- The ecosystem for 5G applications will continue to improve. Mechanisms for cross-departmental, cross-industry, and cross-domain collaboration will be initially established, forming an innovative model of 5G application integration guided by government departments, driven by leading enterprises, and coordinated by small and medium-sized enterprises. A number of influential 5G application solution providers will be cultivated, forming over 100 5G application solutions. The framework for basic common and key industry 5G application standards will be completed, and over 30 key industry standards will be developed.- Key foundational support capabilities will significantly enhance. The coverage level of 5G networks will continue to improve, with over 18 5G base stations per 10,000 people and the construction of over 3,000 5G industry virtual private networks. A number of 5G integrated application innovation centers will be built, further enhancing the capabilities of public service platforms for application innovation. The security guarantee capability of 5G applications will be further enhanced, with the establishment of 10-20 5G application security innovation demonstration centers and the establishment of 3-5 regional demonstration benchmarks, forming a security guarantee system that is compatible with the development of 5G applications.
titlelist: Overall requirements, overall objectives.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Strengthen the overall coordination of important matters related to cross-departmental, cross-industry, and cross-domain standardization. Establish and improve the cooperation mechanism of relevant standardization organizations, achieve mutual agreement and recognition of standards as soon as possible, systematically promote the construction of the 5G industry application standard system, and implement related policies and measures. Accelerate the formulation of integrated application standards. Give full play to the advantages of the 5G application industry organization and promote the implementation of integrated application standards.
titlelist: Breakthrough in key aspects of 5G application, action to build 5G application standard system, accelerate the integration of cross-industry protocol standards.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Systematically promote the research on the standardization of 5G integrated applications in key industries, clarify the key directions of standardization, strengthen the development of basic common standards, integrated equipment standards, and key industry solution standards, accelerate the process of standardization and generalization, and make breakthroughs in the research and formulation of integrated standards in key areas.
titlelist: Breakthrough in key aspects of 5G application, action to build 5G application standard system, development of standards for integration applications in key industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Leverage the leading role of key industry leaders to further strengthen collaboration and jointly promote the iteration, evaluation, and optimization of 5G industry application standards, and promote the application of relevant standards in key industries. Column 1: Construction and promotion of the 5G application standard system. Build the 5G application standard system. Accelerate the development of basic common standards such as chips/modules, networks, platforms, security system architecture, application requirements, and terminology definitions. Conduct research on enhanced technical standards for industry needs, such as deterministic networking, enhanced uplink rates, high-precision positioning, and anti-electromagnetic interference, to accelerate the transformation of innovative technologies and applications into standards. Accelerate the formulation of integrated application standards for key industries and promote the development of industry-integrated terminals and network construction standards. Promote key industry 5G application standards, select key areas such as healthcare, industry, and media, and take the lead in promoting the implementation of 5G application standards. Enhance the public service capabilities of 5G application standards. Conduct testing, evaluation, and certification of industry 5G application standards, and promote the transformation of innovative technological achievements into standards. By the end of 2023, establish a basic common and key industry 5G application standard system and complete the development of more than 30 key industry critical standards.
titlelist: Breakthrough in key aspects of 5G application, action to build 5G application standard system, implementation of key standards in a batch of key industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Continuously promote the research and development of 5G enhanced technology base stations, and consolidate the industrial capabilities of mid-band 5G. Organize the development and end-to-end testing of 5G millimeter wave base stations, accelerate the maturity of technology and products, and establish the industrial foundation for commercialization of 5G millimeter wave. According to the phased characteristics of different versions of the 5G international standard, the R15 version focuses on high-speed and large-bandwidth applications, the R16 version focuses on high-reliability and low-latency applications, and the R17 version focuses on medium-high-speed and large-connection applications. Technological development, industrialization, and application introduction will be carried out in stages.
titlelist: Breakthrough in key aspects of 5G applications, strengthening actions in the foundation of the 5G industry, and enhancing research and development of critical system equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Increase investment in baseband chips, RF chips, key RF front-end devices, etc., accelerate the breakthrough of technological and industrial bottlenecks, and promote the overall level improvement of design tools, manufacturing processes, key materials, core IP, and other industries. Speed up the research and industrialization of lightweight 5G chip modules and millimeter-wave devices, further improve the cost-effectiveness of terminal modules, meet the personalized needs of industry applications, and enhance the industrial foundation support capabilities. Support the development of high-precision, high-sensitivity, and wide dynamic range 5G RF, protocol, performance, and other instruments, driving the rapid breakthrough of high-end chips, core devices, and other instruments.
titlelist: Breakthrough in key aspects of 5G applications, strengthen the foundation of the 5G industry, and accelerate the remediation of industry weaknesses.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Promote the popularization of consumer products based on 5G, such as wearable devices, smart home products, and ultra-high-definition video terminals. Drive the in-depth development of embedded SIM (eSIM) wearable device services and explore further application scenarios. Promote the engineering breakthrough of immersive devices such as virtual reality/augmented reality, with a focus on key core technologies such as near-eye display, rendering processing, perceptual interaction, and content creation, aiming to reduce product power consumption and improve product supply levels. Column 2: Tackle the engineering challenges of 5G products for industry needs. Enhance the adaptability of 5G base stations to various industries. Develop dedicated 5G base stations tailored to industry needs in special scenarios such as high temperature, high humidity, and explosion-proof environments. Increase research and development efforts for new types of base stations that meet the demands of large uplink, low latency, massive connectivity, and high-precision positioning, to meet the requirements of 5G industry applications. Promote the large-scale commercialization of 5G modules. Build a hierarchical industrial system for module classification, guide industries to carry out precise product development based on differentiated scene requirements, continuously improve the environmental adaptability of modules, and reduce the threshold for large-scale application. Establish an industry terminal product system. Enrich the forms of terminal products for various industries, truly realizing the application of 5G industry terminals in the field, on the production line, and in industrial parks. Accelerate the research, development, and iterative evolution of various industry terminals based on 5G modules, such as high-definition cameras, industrial-grade routers/gateways, vehicle networking devices, and automated guided vehicles (AGVs). Promote the pre-installation of 5G capabilities and open interfaces in the research, development, and production of high-end equipment in the industry. By the end of 2023, the supply capacity of 5G base stations and modules that meet industry needs will be significantly enhanced, and 5G industry terminal products and high-end equipment will gradually mature.
titlelist: Breakthrough in key aspects of 5G applications, strengthening actions in the foundation of the 5G industry, and accelerating the maturity of new consumer terminals.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: '7.5G+ Information Consumption. Promote the integration of 5G and smart home, deepen the application of technology such as sensing control, voice control, and remote control, develop smart home appliances, smart lighting, smart security monitoring, smart speakers, new wearable devices, service robots, etc. based on 5G technology, and continuously enrich the application carriers of 5G. Accelerate the promotion of intelligent products such as cloud AR/VR headsets, 5G+4K cameras, 5G panoramic VR cameras, etc., drive the consumption of new products and new content, and promote the development of new experiential consumption. 8.5G+ Integrated Media. Promote the use of equipment such as 5G backpacks, ultra-high-definition cameras, 5G broadcasting vehicles, etc., and use 5G technology to accelerate the intelligent upgrading of various processes such as traditional media production, interviews, editing, and broadcasting. Promote high-tech video services, promote the landing application of 5G new air interface (NR) broadcasting and television, and provide broadcasting and television, emergency broadcasting, and other services. Carry out 5G+8K live broadcasting, 5G+panoramic interactive audiovisual services, cultivate a 360-degree viewing experience, and promote the popularization of 5G in large-scale sports events, including the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics and Paralympics.'
titlelist: Empowering key areas of 5G applications, a new action to upgrade information consumption.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: '9.5G+ Industrial Internet. Promote the deep integration of 5G modules with industrial terminals such as AR/VR, remote control devices, machine vision, and AGV, accelerate the use of 5G to transform industrial intranets, create benchmark 5G fully connected factories, and form a network deployment model that integrates information technology networks with production control networks, and promote the 5G+ Industrial Internet to serve the core production processes. Focus on key industries for the development of 5G+ Industrial Internet in research and development design, production manufacturing, operation management, and product services, create typical application scenarios, continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of 5G+ Industrial Internet, support the deep application of 5G in intelligent manufacturing fields such as quality inspection, remote maintenance, multi-machine collaborative operations, and human-machine interaction, continuously strengthen demonstration and guidance, and promote the replication and promotion of mature models in more industries and fields. Build an industrial ecosystem, promote regional applications, encourage the construction of 5G+ Industrial Internet integration application pilot zones in various regions, and continuously expand the application of 5G in fields such as raw materials, equipment, consumer goods, and electronics. 10.5G+ Connected Vehicles. Strengthen collaboration between the automotive, communication, and transportation industries, enhance the connection between the government, industry organizations, and enterprises, jointly establish a comprehensive 5G and connected vehicle testing and evaluation system to ensure end-to-end interconnection and interoperability of applications. Refine typical application scenarios that can be scaled up and have a complete commercial closed-loop, and improve user acceptance. Accelerate the penetration rate of C-V2X communication modules in vehicles and the deployment of roadside infrastructure. Accelerate the exploration of business models and application scenarios, support the creation of national-level connected vehicle pilot zones, promote the coordinated planning and construction of connected vehicle infrastructure and 5G networks, select key cities, typical areas, suitable road sections, and key sections of highways, accelerate the deployment of 5G+ connected vehicles, and promote the innovative application of C-V2X technology in areas such as industrial parks, airports, ports, and mines. Establish a cross-industry and cross-regional trusted and recognized connected vehicle security communication system. 11.5G+ Smart Logistics. Strengthen innovation in the application of 5G in logistics in areas such as industrial parks, warehouses, and communities, promote the application of 5G in scenarios such as unmanned vehicle express delivery, intelligent sorting, unmanned warehousing, intelligent wearables, and intelligent recognition. Accelerate the construction of 5G-based logistics Internet of Things data access, computing, and application platforms, promote the development of logistics automation intelligent equipment and infrastructure based on edge-cloud collaboration, and help realize the automation of transportation, intelligent warehousing, and full-process monitoring in the logistics industry. 12.5G+ Smart Ports. Develop 5G-assisted positioning products suitable for port container environments, accelerate the digital transformation and construction of automated terminals and storage yards. Promote the digitalization of port construction, maintenance, and operation processes throughout the entire cycle, accelerate the construction of smart port infrastructure, promote the application of 5G in scenarios such as unmanned inspections, remote tower cranes, automated guided transportation, automated container truck driving, and intelligent cargo handling in port areas, and promote port intelligence. 13.5G+ Intelligent Mining. Accelerate the development and certification of 5G communication devices suitable for mining environments with explosion-proof requirements, promote the integration of 5G network systems in open-pit mines and underground mining areas, intelligent mining area control platforms, and enterprise cloud platforms. Promote the application of 5G in various types of mining areas such as energy minerals, metal minerals, and non-metallic minerals, expand the application scenarios of remote control and unmanned driving in the mining industry, promote remote control and clustering of core mining equipment in deep and high-risk areas, and achieve intelligent continuous operation and unmanned transportation in open-pit mining areas. 14.5G+ Smart Power. Breakthrough key technologies such as deterministic latency, time synchronization accuracy, and security assurance in the power industry, build a power communication management support system and edge computing platform integrated with 5G. Upgrade and transform industrial control and monitoring networks based on 5G, promote the application of scenarios such as power generation equipment maintenance, distribution automation, transmission line/substation inspection, and power consumption information collection, and realize visualization of power generation, intelligent control of distribution, unmanned monitoring of transmission and transformation, and real-time collection of power consumption. 15.5G+ Smart Oil and Gas. Develop 5G special terminals suitable for complex environments in oil fields, promote the development of intelligent data collection 5G gateways and monitoring products with multiple protocols, and achieve effective connection with communication interfaces in the oil and gas field. Implement deep application of 5G in scenarios such as high-definition video monitoring in oil fields, pipeline leakage monitoring, intelligent robot inspections, and hazardous material transportation monitoring, and provide intelligent support for safe and efficient oil and gas collection, pipeline transmission, and oil and gas refining. 16.5G+ Smart Agriculture. Based on the digitalization needs of agriculture and rural areas, focus on promoting 5G technology and applications for wide coverage and low-cost scenarios. Enrich the application scenarios of 5G in smart agriculture, accelerate the innovation of 5G applications in agricultural production processes such as smart agricultural machinery and agricultural robots in unmanned agricultural operations, and develop applications of 5G in areas such as cold chain logistics for agricultural products and live streaming for e-commerce. Strengthen the integration of digital rural areas and 5G applications, improve the level of rural governance and information-based public services, use 5G to extend education, culture, medical care, and other resources to rural areas, and promote rural information consumption. 17.5G+ Smart Water Conservancy. Promote the deep integration of 5G technology and the water conservancy industry, apply new technologies such as 5G, the Internet of Things, remote sensing, and edge computing to improve the perception level of water conservancy elements. Combine technologies such as Beidou positioning and artificial intelligence to study the top-level design and model algorithm implementation of artificial intelligence construction systems, and achieve breakthroughs in the application of 5G human-machine collaboration in water conservancy engineering construction scenarios.'
titlelist: Empowering key areas of 5G applications, deepening industry integration applications action.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: '18.5G+ Smart Education. Accelerate the research and development of 5G teaching terminal devices and AR/VR teaching digital content, combine AR/VR, holographic projection, and other technologies to achieve scenario-based interactive teaching, and create an immersive classroom. Promote the support of 5G technology for the education private network, study and formulate technical specifications for online education key links such as networks, applications, and terminals, combined with specific application scenarios. Increase the promotion of 5G in smart classrooms, holographic teaching, campus security, education management, student comprehensive evaluation, and other scenarios, enhance the informatization capabilities of teaching, management, scientific research, services, and other aspects. 19.5G+ Smart Healthcare. Carry out research and development of 5G medical robots, 5G ambulances, 5G medical access gateways, intelligent medical devices, and other products. Strengthen the deployment of 5G medical and health network infrastructure, focus on optimizing coverage in national tertiary hospitals, disease prevention and control centers, convenient medical points, medical and nursing combined institutions, and other places, and create 5G networks and 5G medical edge clouds for in-hospital medical care and remote medical care. Enrich the application scenarios of 5G technology in the medical and health industry, focus on promoting the application of 5G in emergency treatment, remote diagnosis, health management, and other scenarios, and accelerate the cultivation of new formats of smart medical services that are technologically advanced, superior in performance, and have obvious effects. 20.5G+ Culture and Tourism. Breakthrough key common technologies of digital content, promote the research and development of key technologies such as ultra-high-definition video coding and decoding, end-cloud collaborative rendering, and 3D reconstruction, and develop AR/VR immersive content, 4K/8K videos, and other applications adapted to 5G networks. Build AR/VR business support platforms and cloud-based content aggregation and distribution platforms, promote the development of interactive content industries such as social networking, broadcasting and viewing, e-sports, digital art, and others combined with 5G. Promote the integration and innovation of 5G with cultural and tourism equipment, cultural preservation equipment, and ice and snow equipment. Promote the development of online digital experience products in scenic spots, museums, and other places, cultivate new formats such as cloud tourism, cloud live streaming, cloud exhibitions, online broadcasting, and encourage the development of new cultural and tourism consumption models such as customization, experience, intelligence, and interaction, and create immersive cultural and tourism experience new scenes. 21.5G+ Smart City. Increase the application of products such as ultra-high-definition video surveillance, patrol robots, smart police terminals, smart emergency terminals, and others in urban security and emergency management, and build a real-time and accurate security and control system. Accelerate the deployment of smart metering and other products in municipal management, environmental monitoring, and other fields, explore the construction of digital twin cities, and improve urban perception capabilities. Speed up the promotion of smart government services based on 5G technology for the benefit and convenience of the people. Accelerate the digital transformation of communities, parks, blocks, and other basic units, form a batch of comprehensive solutions for 5G smart communities, and provide all-round digital community life new services. Promote the innovative application of 5G technology in the construction of new urban infrastructure based on digitization, networking, and intelligence, and comprehensively improve the level of urban construction and operational efficiency.'
titlelist: Empowering key areas of 5G applications, promoting inclusive actions for social and livelihood services.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Accelerate the construction of independent 5G networks, expand 5G network coverage in urban and rural areas, continuously build high-quality 5G networks, and promote the coordinated development of dual gigabit networks. The newly built 5G network fully supports IPv6 and focuses on improving IPv6 traffic in 5G networks. Strengthen the coverage of 5G networks in indoor scenarios, underground spaces, key transportation hubs, and along main routes, promote high-speed rail on the 5G public network, and improve the quality of network services in typical scenarios. Promote the use of mid and low-frequency bands to expand 5G network coverage in rural and remote areas.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, strengthen the foundation of 5G network capabilities, and improve the coverage level of 5G networks for the public.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Accelerate the improvement of key technical support capabilities such as end-to-end network slicing, edge computing, and high-precision indoor positioning, and promote 5G coverage in key areas such as free trade zones, industrial parks, enterprise factory areas, and medical institutions. Support local areas in building 5G industry virtual private networks based on regional needs, explore new network construction models, and create regional leading effects.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, strengthen the foundation of 5G network capabilities, and enhance the supply capability of 5G networks for industries.

Promote the frequency migration of the 700MHz band broadcasting and television services, accelerate the deployment of 5G networks in the 700MHz band, timely release the frequency planning of 5G millimeter wave, explore the implementation of bidding system for 5G millimeter wave frequency licenses, conduct research on the demand for 5G industrial dedicated frequencies and compatibility with other radio systems, and study and formulate suitable models and management rules for the use of 5G industrial dedicated frequencies in China.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, strengthen the foundation of 5G network capabilities, and strengthen the guarantee of 5G frequency resources.

titlelist: Enhancing the support capability of 5G applications, promoting the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and accelerating cross-domain integration and innovative development.

titlelist: Enhancing the support capability of 5G applications, promoting the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and driving policy innovation for 5G integrated applications.

content: Relying on the 5G application industry matrix, with leading enterprises and research institutions as the main creators, we will establish a number of 5G integrated application innovation centers to carry out technology and industrial services for application innovation. Relying on industry-leading enterprises, universities, and research institutes, we will accelerate the construction of 5G application incubators and maker spaces, and improve the operation mode of innovation carriers. We will leverage the regional industrial agglomeration advantages of incubators and maker spaces, combine local industrial characteristics, and promote the transfer and transformation of 5G technology and application solution achievements.
titlelist: Enhancing the support capability of 5G applications, promoting the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and carrying out the construction of innovative carriers for 5G applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Facing the key common technology needs in industrial manufacturing, transportation, healthcare, and other key sectors, we rely on industry-leading enterprises, higher education institutions, and research institutes to carry out joint research and development of key technologies for 5G industry applications. We aim to build key industry common technology platforms to solve the technological bottlenecks that hinder the replication and promotion of industry applications. We will focus on supporting the construction of common technology platforms that combine 5G with outdoor high-precision positioning using Beidou, indoor 5G cellular independent positioning, artificial intelligence, ultra-high-definition video, augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR), and other technologies. These platforms will provide cross-industry basic capabilities for 5G applications.Column 3: Cultivating a demonstration project for the innovation ecosystem of 5G applications. We will cultivate suppliers of 5G application solutions and promote industry-leading enterprises to leverage their technological and market advantages to launch overall 5G application solutions and integrated products for key industries. This will create a group of leading suppliers of 5G application solutions with strong innovation capabilities and significant driving effects. We will also guide small and medium-sized enterprises with technological advantages and industry knowledge and experience to launch 5G application solutions and mature products that are deeply integrated with industry needs. This will create a group of 5G application solution suppliers focused on key industry segments.We will build industry-leading benchmarks. By mobilizing the enthusiasm of key industry-leading enterprises and leveraging their demand-driven and resource integration roles, we will establish key links in 5G application development, create a group of benchmark 5G application cases, and provide demonstration and guidance for the large-scale application of 5G.We will establish a 5G integrated application innovation center. We will promote collaborative innovation across the entire 5G application industry chain, conduct product engineering research and development, and improve the efficiency of scientific and technological innovation and achievement transformation. We will continue to build and improve the 5G application repository, strengthen the connection between innovation elements supply and demand, and share resources. We will provide high-end research and development services and productive services for 5G applications, support the construction of application testing and verification laboratories for key industry needs, and accelerate the development of 5G application technology verification and quality testing services.We will create a leading area for 5G application innovation. We will stimulate innovation vitality in various regions, actively carry out pilot projects for application innovation policies, optimize the development environment for 5G applications, explore new models for 5G network construction and application development, and create a group of leading areas for 5G application innovation. We will coordinate and promote differentiated 5G applications across the country, leverage the industrial agglomeration effects of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta, and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, strengthen regional cooperation, and promote the construction of a group of 5G industrial bases. We will encourage regions with conditions to increase support and create a group of replicable and promotable 5G application projects. We will continue to hold the Blossom Cup 5G application solicitation competition, timely release excellent cases of 5G integrated applications, and accelerate the landing and promotion of 5G applications.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, promote the integration of the 5G application ecosystem, and strengthen the support of common technical platforms for 5G applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Build a comprehensive security management mechanism for the entire lifecycle of 5G applications, guide enterprises to incorporate the 5G application security risk assessment mechanism into the 5G application development and promotion workflow, simultaneously plan and implement security management and technical measures for construction and operation, and implement them synchronously with 5G applications. Carry out supervision and inspection of 5G applications and critical information infrastructure to enhance the security level of 5G applications.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, elevate the action of improving 5G application security, strengthen the risk assessment of 5G application security.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Support the construction of 5G security evaluation institutions that are in line with international standards, establish a 5G application and network infrastructure security evaluation system, and carry out evaluations and certifications of 5G application and infrastructure security capabilities.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, enhance the action of improving the security of 5G applications, enhance the capability of security evaluation and certification of 5G applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Support the innovation and transformation of core technologies in 5G security technology, and encourage the entry of 5G security innovation enterprises into national network security industrial parks. Strengthen the innovation of 5G security service models, promote cooperation and capability sharing in 5G security technology, and encourage the development of integrated application scenario security service solutions across industries and domains. Enhance the discovery, sharing, and collaborative disposal of 5G network security threat information. Column 4: 5G application security capability forging project. Enhance the management capability of 5G application security. Improve the 5G application security standard system and strengthen standard promotion. Support eligible enterprises and units to strengthen the construction of 5G application security evaluation, testing, and certification capabilities, and support self-assessment and third-party evaluation of 5G application security. Enhance the supply of 5G application security products and services. Promote the development of key security products such as endogenous security, zero trust security, and dynamic isolation, and innovate in risk identification, situational awareness, security evaluation, network identity trust management, and other 5G application security services to enhance service-based 5G application security assurance capabilities. Promote the popularization of 5G application security solutions. Form atomized and fine-grained 5G application security solutions for different scenarios and businesses, support relevant enterprises in building a batch of 5G application security innovation demonstration centers, and carry out collaborative research and development, demonstration and promotion, testing and training of security solutions. Support eligible regions and industrial parks to concentrate on conducting pilot demonstrations of 5G application security. Take multiple measures to promote the popularization of 5G application security solutions. By the end of 2023, build 10-20 5G application security innovation demonstration centers, establish 3-5 regional demonstration benchmarks, and basically form a security guarantee system that is compatible with the development of 5G applications.
titlelist: Enhance the support capability of 5G applications, take action to enhance the security of 5G applications, and strengthen the supply of support services for 5G application security.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Strengthen departmental coordination and inter-provincial linkage, ensuring organic connection in terms of standards, industry, construction, application, policies, and other aspects. Relevant industry regulatory departments will prioritize 5G application in industry development plans and action plans, fully utilizing relevant special funds, continuously guiding industry enterprises to increase investment, and accelerating the development of 5G industry applications. Encourage local governments at all levels to focus on the implementation of 5G applications, ecosystem construction, industry cultivation, network construction, and actively introduce and implement policy measures to promote the accelerated implementation of 5G integrated applications. Support deep coupling and close connection between upstream and downstream enterprises to form an efficient and organic cooperation model. Establish a 5G application promotion expert advisory committee to provide guidance and decision-making support for strategic and forward-looking issues in application promotion.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen coordination and linkage.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Increase government procurement expenditure towards the 5G application field, take the lead in promoting 5G applications in public services such as urban management, education, healthcare, and culture, and increase the publicity efforts for 5G application model projects and demonstration benchmarks. Relying on the production and finance integration platform to create a 5G+ finance development ecosystem, carry out production and finance docking activities for 5G application scenario innovation based on production and finance integration pilot projects. Improve the service system for innovative enterprises in 5G applications, increase support for small and medium-sized enterprises, and encourage more market entities to enter the field of 5G application innovation and entrepreneurship. Guide various types of social capital to establish 5G application investment funds in an orderly manner, and increase investment in key industries and key industrial links of 5G. Encourage and support eligible 5G application innovative enterprises to raise funds through listing on the Science and Technology Innovation Board and the Growth Enterprise Market, and broaden corporate financing channels. Adhere to the principles of inclusive and prudent regulation, strengthen collaborative regulation, accelerate the research on relevant laws and regulations for key areas of 5G applications such as autonomous driving and remote medical care, and explore new regulatory models.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, optimize development environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Build a solid foundation for cultivating 5G talents, support the precise joint training of higher education institutions, research institutes, and enterprises, encourage the establishment of laboratories, training bases, professional research institutes, or interdisciplinary research centers by enterprises in collaboration with higher education institutions and research institutes, and strengthen the construction of shared engineering internship bases. Carry out public education on 5G knowledge to enhance the digital skills of the general public.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, cultivate talent pool.

name: Notice on Issuing the 5G Application 'Sailing' Action Plan (2021-2023) (MIIT Unicom Letter [2021] No. 77) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/July 5, 2021)
content: Support the construction of overseas promotion channels and service platforms for 5G applications, and promote the internationalization of mature 5G applications. Play a coordinating role in international organizations and encourage companies to participate in the work of international standardization organizations for 5G. Encourage domestic companies to strengthen overseas cooperation in 5G applications, provide higher quality products and services for countries or regions along the Belt and Road initiative, and create a new platform for international cooperation.

name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: In the next 3-5 years, a number of typical 5G application scenarios will be developed around intelligent power plants, smart grids, intelligent coal mines, smart oil and gas, integrated energy, intelligent manufacturing and construction, etc. A number of 5G industry private networks or virtual private networks will be built, and a batch of competitive business models that are replicable and easy to promote will be explored. name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: The overall development of 5G applications in the energy sector is still in the early stage, and there is a need to further explore application scenarios, improve supporting systems, and cultivate competitive business models. This implementation plan is based on the current development stage and outlines typical application scenarios that are believed to have certain development prospects, as well as the corresponding supporting technologies, infrastructure, and security system construction tasks. With technological advancements, it is expected that other application scenarios will also be further expanded, giving rise to diverse and varied new models and formats.

content: Research on 5G networking and access solutions for intelligent power plants, carry out construction of 5G wireless network coverage for power plants, comprehensively utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, edge computing, etc., ensure the safety of power plants, and build a comprehensive industrial Internet of Things and data transmission network that adapts to the complex environment of power plants based on demand. content: Based on technologies such as 5G and edge computing, AI processing, machine vision, etc., various intelligent devices such as smart cameras, intelligent robots, inspection instruments, personal wearable devices, etc. are connected to the 5G network to achieve interconnection and interoperability between various production personnel and intelligent devices.
titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and intelligent inspection.

name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Based on 5G and cloud technology, artificial intelligence, data mining, and other technologies, it comprehensively achieves functions such as intelligent monitoring and perception of equipment status, intelligent evaluation of equipment status, intelligent diagnosis and early warning of equipment failures, AR-assisted maintenance, and remote expert support.
titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and intelligent operation and maintenance.

name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Based on technologies such as 5G, it enhances the disaster recovery capability of communication systems, while comprehensively achieving technical control and visual management of personnel safety, hazardous chemical safety, high-risk operation safety, and other safety aspects. It realizes human-machine collaboration and remote operation assistance in emergency rescue and rapid response situations.
titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and ensure safety in emergencies.

name: Implementation Plan for 5G Applications in the Energy Sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Accelerate the development of customized equipment for the 5G communication terminal, module prototypes, and other industry-specific devices. Conduct end-to-end slicing security testing, research the operating system standards for 5G Internet of Things devices in the power industry. Build a power communication management support system and edge computing platform that integrates 5G. Focus on conducting on-site verification and in-depth application of typical business scenarios such as transmission and distribution operation monitoring, distribution network protection and control, integration of new energy and energy storage, and coordinated scheduling and stable control of the power grid. titlelist: The main task is to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field, including the smart grid + 5G.

name: Implementation Plan for 5G Applications in the Energy Sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Based on the high-speed, large connectivity characteristics, and edge computing technologies of the 5G network, activities such as robot inspections for power transmission and distribution, drone inspections, and high-definition video monitoring are carried out to promote the deep application of micro-meteorological regional monitoring and auxiliary decision-making, transmission line disaster monitoring and intelligent decision-making, and all-weather remote channel visualization.
titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and to monitor the operation of power transmission and distribution.

Utilizing the high speed, low latency, large connectivity, and high reliability characteristics of 5G, the focus is on developing and applying systems such as underground inspection and security, unmanned driving, and exploring pilot applications in intelligent mining and production control, environmental monitoring and safety protection, virtual interaction, etc., to promote the construction of intelligent coal mines. titlelist: The main task is to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field, including intelligent coal mines + 5G.

content: Based on the high-speed and high-reliability characteristics of the 5G network, underground visualization is achieved. Communication, real-time high-definition video transmission, and environmental monitoring data collection meet the massive high-definition video data carrying requirements for environmental monitoring and safety protection, providing intelligent safety warnings for the entire mine and entire process.
titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field, environmental monitoring, and safety protection.

content: Based on the high-speed, low-latency, high-reliability characteristics of the 5G network and the high-precision positioning technology of 5G, the construction and application of unmanned mining systems are carried out using advanced driver assistance systems to reduce on-site personnel, achieve safety and staff reduction, and support enterprises in reducing costs and increasing efficiency.
titlelist: The main task is to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field, including unmanned driving in open-pit/underground mines.

titlelist: The main task is to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field, virtual interaction.

titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and intelligent exploration.

titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and to develop smart refineries.

content: Based on the characteristics of 5G, such as large-scale connectivity, low latency, and high reliability, as well as edge computing technology, real-time collection and transmission of production data, equipment status, and environmental information in the station area can be achieved. This enables monitoring of pipeline status, leak detection, geological disaster monitoring, as well as emergency communication, intelligent inspection, and drone inspection for long-distance pipelines.
titlelist: The main task is to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and intelligent pipeline transportation.

content: Relying on the 5G network to achieve flexible access to multiple energy sources such as electricity, gas, cold, and heat, comprehensively integrate energy control parameters, energy operation, energy use, and other data, realize intelligent measurement, demand response, transmission network, and service platform management, construct an interactive regulation system of source-network-load-storage, focus on carrying out typical business scenarios of 5G deep application such as production control, distributed energy management, virtual power plants, intelligent inspection, and operation and maintenance, support the construction of a flexible, interactive, open, and shared comprehensive energy innovation service system. titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field, and to implement intelligent inspection and maintenance.

content: Based on the characteristics of 5G network, such as large connectivity, high speed, and low latency, it enables the visualization management of energy equipment manufacturing processes and efficient resource allocation, reducing production and auxiliary operation time. content: Based on the high-speed, low-latency characteristics of 5G and technologies such as edge computing and AR, remote online inspection witnessing, automatic report recording, front-end and back-end interaction support, and intelligent assistance functions are realized to achieve automatic measurement of construction quality, construction processes, construction frequency, and construction standards. titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and remote monitoring and manufacturing.

content: Based on the high-speed characteristics of 5G and technologies such as facial recognition, big data processing, and edge computing, video surveillance and analysis of human behavior are conducted to achieve safety control over personnel, vehicles, hazardous materials, high-risk operations, and cross operations. The application of 5G+AR/VR is used to change traditional training methods and provide safety training in an experiential and interactive manner.
titlelist: The main tasks are to further expand the application scenarios of 5G in the energy field and ensure construction site safety.

name: Implementation Plan for 5G Applications in the Energy Sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Accelerate the construction of network slicing, multi-access edge computing, and customized core networks required for 5G virtual private network (VPN) development. Research and industrialize key equipment such as network elements and 5G LAN, as well as technology solutions for industrial Internet of Things (IoT) and IoT based on dedicated network frequencies such as 230MHz. Implement large-scale applications of 5G industry virtual private networks in the energy sector. Research a virtual interactive application platform based on 5G networks to enable applications such as device detection, production training, video surveillance, and expert support. Study the application of 5G unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)/robots for remote inspection, remote control, and 5G automated guided vehicle (AGV) technology in complex environments and multiple scenarios. Research the integration of 5G technology with IoT devices such as Beidou, cameras, and gyroscopes to achieve low-power, low-cost, and accurate positioning, identification, and early warning functions. Study low-power design solutions for 5G terminals to establish the foundation for the application of 5G massive machine-type communications (mMTC) in the energy sector. Research 5G autonomous driving technology to improve efficiency and working environments.
