name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: For special needs such as nuclear power safety supervision, radiation environment, and information security, research and development of 5G equipment for nuclear radiation protection and reinforcement technology, electromagnetic compatibility technology. For complex operating environments of hydropower projects, carry out engineering adaptability and reliability verification of 5G base station security, electromechanical equipment electromagnetic compatibility, end-to-end networking, etc. For the weak coverage of 5G signals underground in coal mines, power, and other industries, research and develop dedicated technologies such as underground unmanned driving, high-definition video transmission, industrial remote control, robot intelligent inspection, virtual interaction, and supporting products such as 5G base stations for coal mines, function-customized core networks, real-time communication terminals, and IoT gateways. For special operating conditions of offshore platforms such as offshore oil and offshore wind power, research and develop 5G dedicated technologies and products that are resistant to high humidity and high salt corrosion. For complex petroleum refining environments, severe metal shielding, flammable and explosive issues, research and develop dedicated technologies such as 5G wireless channel models, integrated networking, high-precision wireless positioning, and explosion-proof terminal equipment.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the research and development of 5G dedicated technology in the energy sector, and develop a batch of dedicated technology and products for corresponding scenarios.

name: Implementation Plan for 5G Applications in the Energy Sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Based on a thorough analysis of typical application scenarios, and following the principles of practicality, industry orientation, and internationalization, we will accelerate research and establish a 5G application technology standard system in the energy sector that covers both vertical aspects (end terminals, networks, platforms) and horizontal aspects (technology, testing, planning, construction, operation and maintenance). This system will take into account the technical requirements of both general and specific scenarios, and standardize the promotion and application of 5G technology in the energy sector. Based on the demands of typical application scenarios, we will expedite the formulation of design requirements, technical specifications for equipment procurement, safety requirements, construction standards, and other urgently needed technical standards. We will also encourage domestic organizations to actively participate in the formulation of standards by authoritative international organizations in the wireless field, such as 3GPP and ITU.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the research and development of 5G dedicated technology in the energy field, and to study the establishment of a technical standard system for 5G application in the energy field.

name: Implementation Plan for 5G Applications in the Energy Sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Build an end-to-end 5G trial and verification network, establish 5G application scenario-related business verification environments for smart power plants, smart grids, smart coal mines, smart oil and gas, integrated energy, smart manufacturing and construction, etc. Conduct adaptability, security, and reliability verification of 5G network performance, network slicing, customized private networks, network security, business security, as well as comprehensive business carrying capacity in the special environment of the energy industry.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate the research and development of 5G dedicated technology in the energy sector, and to promote the testing and verification of 5G application technology in the energy sector.

name: Implementation Plan for 5G Applications in the Energy Sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Translate the following Chinese text to English:'Around the key common technologies and supporting specialized technologies related to 5G applications in the energy field, research and establish a national energy research and development innovation platform for the integration of advanced information technologies such as 5G, big data, and artificial intelligence. Encourage collaboration between energy and information communication companies to promote deep cooperation between industry, academia, and research, and establish cross-disciplinary and cross-sector innovation platforms for enterprises related to 5G with the goal of integrating technology applications. Support the establishment of an innovation alliance for 5G applications in the energy sector, develop a diversified investment and financing system, accelerate the construction and improvement of the industrial ecosystem, and form a sustainable collaborative development cluster.'
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the research and development of 5G dedicated technology in the energy sector, and support the construction of innovative platforms for 5G application-related technologies.

name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Encourage power grid enterprises to strengthen cooperation with telecommunications operators, tower companies, etc., to ensure safety, compliance with regulations, and clear responsibilities. This can be achieved by attaching communication antennas and optical cables to power towers, as well as sharing resources such as power optical cables, fiber cores, and substation sites, to support telecommunications operators in the efficient construction of 5G networks. Support power companies in strengthening cooperation with basic telecommunications companies, and change the power supply mode for supporting facilities such as base stations and equipment rooms from power supply through transfer to direct power supply. Encourage substation micro-energy storage stations to provide power supply for telecommunications company equipment, and support telecommunications companies in participating in power market transactions.
titlelist: The main tasks are to increase the construction of relevant infrastructure and security capabilities, and promote the joint construction and sharing of basic resources.

name: Implementation Plan for 5G Applications in the Energy Sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Relying on advanced technologies such as advanced encryption, identity authentication, and encrypted communication, research is being conducted on the information communication security protection system for the transmission, storage, and distribution of information between users, data, devices, and networks in the 5G application scenarios in the energy field. This is to ensure the security of the network infrastructure and core systems related to the integration of 5G applications. The aim is to establish sound security technology standards for 5G applications in the energy field, establish mechanisms to ensure stable network operation, secure authentication for power terminal access to the network, network slicing isolation security, and scenario-based business security evaluation and monitoring mechanisms. This will enhance the reliability of 5G networks as the basic communication networks for the energy sector and avoid compromising energy sector security production under extreme conditions. Encouragement is given to national authoritative evaluation agencies to carry out security evaluation and certification work for 5G application networks in the energy field. The implementation of the 5G network security guidelines will be coordinated with security and development, and the security guarantee for 5G network will be incorporated into the entire process and all aspects of 5G applications in the energy field.
titlelist: The main tasks are to increase the construction of relevant infrastructure and security capabilities, and to build a 5G application security system.

name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Promote the integrated development of energy and information communication infrastructure, optimize the layout of sensing, information, communication, control, and other components in the energy system, promote the connection and deep integration of energy networks and 5G-related information infrastructure. Accelerate the integration and development of the 5G public network and the power dedicated network, achieve infrastructure sharing and reuse, and avoid redundant construction, while meeting relevant safety requirements and specifications. Encourage energy and information communication-related enterprises to carry out collaborative innovation around 5G network construction, network security, dedicated technology, supporting products, and integrated applications, and research and formulate relevant standards and specifications for cross-industry integration applications. Encourage deep cooperation between energy companies and operators, strengthen joint monitoring and management of the 5G dedicated network, and ensure the security and stability of the 5G dedicated network.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote collaborative innovation.

name: Implementation plan for 5G applications in the energy sector (National Development and Reform Commission and other departments/June 7, 2021)
content: Encourage regions and enterprises that meet the conditions to carry out various 5G application pilot demonstrations in the energy sector according to local conditions and industry characteristics. Deeply explore and take the lead in technological innovation, supporting products, business models, development formats, institutional mechanisms, and other aspects. Organize a competition for innovative 5G applications in the energy sector, select a batch of replicable and easily promotable scenarios and benchmark applications from enterprises, and cultivate a group of solution providers and integrated application service providers.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, carry out pilot applications.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Basic telecommunications companies need to further optimize the workflow of equipment procurement, survey and design, and project construction, seize the construction period, and minimize the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Support basic telecommunications companies in aiming for 5G standalone network (SA), control the scale of non-standalone network (NSA) construction, accelerate the network construction in major cities, and gradually extend coverage to key counties and towns with conditions.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction and deployment of 5G networks, and speed up the progress of 5G network construction.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Encourage local governments to include the necessary site locations and supporting facilities for the construction of 5G networks in various levels of land and spatial planning, and strictly implement them in controlled detailed planning. When constructing new, renovated, or expanded public transportation, public places, parks, buildings, and other projects, consider the deployment needs of 5G site locations in a coordinated manner. Accelerate the opening and sharing of public facilities and social site resources such as electricity, transportation, public security, municipal services, education, and healthcare. For regions with strong support, telecommunications companies should increase investment and prioritize the development of 5G.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction and deployment of 5G networks, and increase support for base station site resources.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Support basic telecommunications companies to strengthen cooperation with power companies, accelerate the transformation of power supply for qualified supporting facilities such as base stations and equipment rooms from indirect supply to direct supply; actively carry out network greening transformation, and promote the application and popularization of advanced energy-saving technologies. Adjust the frequency usage plan for the 700MHz frequency band, accelerate the implementation of 700MHz frequency band 5G frequency usage licenses; timely release frequency usage plans for some 5G millimeter wave frequency bands, conduct research on frequency planning for 5G industries (including industrial internet), and implement technology trial frequency licenses as appropriate. Further improve the coordination of interference between mid-band 5G base stations and other radio stations such as satellite earth stations.
titlelist: Accelerate the construction and deployment of 5G networks, strengthen power and frequency protection.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: 'Further deepen the co-construction and sharing of iron towers, indoor distribution systems, pole lines, pipelines, and supporting facilities. Guide basic telecommunications enterprises to strengthen coordination and cooperation, fully leverage market mechanisms, integrate advantageous resources, carry out 5G network sharing and cross-network roaming, accelerate the formation of a network pattern with multiple networks coexisting in hotspot areas and a single network supporting remote areas, and create a resource-intensive and operationally efficient 5G network.'
titlelist: Accelerate the construction and deployment of 5G networks, promote network sharing and cross-network roaming.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Encourage basic telecommunications companies to promote 5G terminal consumption and accelerate user migration to 5G through measures such as package upgrades, preferential offers, and credit purchases. Promote applications such as 5G+VR/AR, live streaming of events, gaming entertainment, and virtual shopping to stimulate new forms of information consumption. Encourage collaboration between basic telecommunications companies, radio and television media companies, and content providers to enrich the sources of new multimedia content in fields such as education, media, and entertainment, including 4K/8K, VR/AR, and more.
titlelist: Enriching 5G technology application scenarios, cultivating new consumer models.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Promote the construction of the 5G smart healthcare system, establish a 5G smart healthcare demonstration network and medical platform, and accelerate the application and promotion of 5G in epidemic warning, pre-hospital emergency care, remote diagnosis and treatment, and intelligent image-assisted diagnosis. Further optimize and promote excellent applications of 5G in the fight against the COVID-19 pandemic, promote remote physical examinations, consultations, medical assistance, and other services, and promote the sharing of medical resources.
titlelist: Enriching 5G technology application scenarios, promoting the innovative development of '5G+ healthcare'.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Promote the integration of the Internet of Vehicles into the national new information infrastructure construction project, and facilitate the large-scale deployment of LTE-V2X. Establish national-level pilot zones for the Internet of Vehicles, enrich application scenarios, and explore and improve business models. Combine with the commercial deployment of 5G, guide key areas to plan ahead, strengthen inter-departmental coordination, and promote 5G and LTE-V2X as important communication standards and protocols for the construction of smart cities and intelligent transportation. Carry out the development and research verification of 5G-V2X standards.
titlelist: Enriching 5G technology application scenarios, promoting the coordinated development of '5G+Internet of Vehicles'.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Through platforms such as the 5G application industry matrix, various parties including application demand, research and development, integration, and capital are gathered to facilitate key aspects of 5G application promotion. The organization of the third Blossom Cup 5G application solicitation competition highlights the implementation of applications and cultivates innovative enterprises in the 5G application field. It promotes the development of the 5G Internet of Things. Using innovation centers, joint research and development bases, incubation platforms, demonstration parks, and other carriers, it promotes the integration and application innovation of 5G in various industries and fields.
titlelist: Enriching 5G technology application scenarios, building a 5G application ecosystem.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Strengthen the research and development of 5G technology and standards. Organize research and pilot projects on 5G industry virtual private networks, and connect key links such as standards, technology, applications, and deployment. Accelerate the development of 5G application modules to support the scale application of industrial production, wearable devices, and other terminals. Continuously support the research and development, engineering breakthroughs, and industrialization of key areas such as 5G core chips, key components, basic software, and instruments, laying the foundation for industrial development.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Basic telecommunications companies further optimize the 5G SA equipment procurement testing process, clarify the testing schedule according to the construction plan, and promote the accelerated maturity of related equipment. Continuously carry out 5G enhanced technology research and development experiments, organize more extensive interoperability testing of chips and systems, and accelerate the maturity of technology and industry. Combining with the progress arrangement of national frequency planning, organize the testing of millimeter wave equipment and performance to prepare for the commercial use of 5G millimeter wave technology.
titlelist: Continuously increase the research and development efforts of 5G technology, and organize the implementation of 5G testing and verification.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Support leading enterprises in utilizing 5G and integrating new technologies to create and provide industry cloud services, open capability platforms, application development environments, and other common platforms. Encourage the establishment of related open-source communities and open-source technology bases to promote open application innovation. Accelerate the construction of the 5G testing and certification platform, enhance testing, inspection, certification, and other service capabilities for various aspects of the 5G system, terminals, services, security, etc., and reduce enterprise research and development and application costs.
titlelist: Continuously increase the research and development efforts of 5G technology, enhance the innovation support capability of 5G technology.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Accelerate the construction of a secure infrastructure for key information in 5G, strengthen network security protection for new objects such as the core system of 5G, network slicing, and mobile edge computing platforms, establish systems and mechanisms for dynamic risk assessment, and key equipment detection and certification. Research security protection guidelines and standards for typical application scenarios. Pilot the construction of 5G security monitoring methods, improve the security protection system for network security situation awareness, threat governance, event handling, and traceability.
titlelist: Efforts are being made to build a secure system for 5G, and to strengthen the security of 5G network infrastructure.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Develop and improve data security management systems and standards around various typical technologies of 5G and typical application scenarios such as vehicle networking and industrial internet. Establish a dynamic assessment and evaluation mechanism for data security risks in typical 5G scenarios and strengthen the application of assessment results. Reasonably allocate responsibilities for data security and protection of user personal information among network operators, industry service providers, etc., clarify the baseline requirements for data security in the 5G environment, and strengthen supervision and law enforcement. Promote data security compliance assessment and certification, build a comprehensive technical support system, and effectively enhance the level of 5G data security protection.
titlelist: Efforts are being made to build a 5G security guarantee system and strengthen the protection of 5G network data security.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Strengthen the core technology research and development and achievement transformation of 5G network security, and enhance the supply of security services. Vigorously promote the construction of national network security industrial parks and pilot demonstrations, accelerate the cultivation of leading enterprises in the key links of the 5G security industry chain, promote the development of small and medium-sized enterprises in the upstream and downstream of the industry, and form an integrated guarantee capability for key technologies, products, and services. Actively innovate the governance model of 5G security, and promote the construction of a security governance mechanism involving multiple entities, coordinated by multiple departments, and collaborative across multiple industries.
titlelist: Efforts are being made to build a 5G security guarantee system and cultivate the ecosystem of 5G network security industry.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Each unit should establish and improve the organizational leadership system, ensure the necessary elements, and prioritize the acceleration of 5G development as a current key task. Strengthen coordination and cooperation with local housing and urban-rural development, transportation, power, medical, and education departments, and work together to promote the construction and development of 5G.
titlelist: Strengthen organization implementation, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Notice on Promoting the Accelerated Development of 5G (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 49) (MIIT/24th March 2020)
content: Each unit should regularly review their experiences and practices, promptly identify problems and deficiencies, continuously adjust and optimize work measures, and timely report relevant information to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology will organize assessments of the development of 5G construction in various regions and timely release relevant progress updates.
titlelist: Strengthen organization and implementation, strengthen summary and communication.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. March 24, 2021. Dual Gigabit Network Collaborative Development Action Plan (2021-2023). The Dual Gigabit network, represented by gigabit optical network and 5G, can provide individual users with gigabit access capability for both fixed and mobile networks. It features ultra-high bandwidth, ultra-low latency, and advanced reliability. The two complement and promote each other, serving as an important component and supporting foundation of new infrastructure. In order to implement the requirements of the Government Work Report, promote the mutual promotion of Dual Gigabit network construction, complementary advantages in application, and innovative business integration, and further leverage the important role of Dual Gigabit network in driving effective investment, promoting information consumption, and assisting the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry, this action plan is formulated to accelerate the construction of a new development pattern.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: In three years, the Dual Gigabit network infrastructure will be basically completed, covering urban areas and eligible towns, achieving universal Gigabit to the home capability for both fixed and mobile networks. The development of Gigabit optical network and 5G users will be accelerated, leading to continuous improvement in user experience. High-bandwidth applications such as Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality (AR/VR) and Ultra HD video will be further integrated into production and daily life, forming exemplary models for Gigabit applications in typical industries. The core technologies and industrial competitiveness of Gigabit optical network and 5G will maintain an international advanced level, while the modernization level of the industrial chain and supply chain will steadily improve. The security capabilities of the Dual Gigabit network will be significantly enhanced.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/25th March 2021)
content: - Gigabit fiber optic network has the capability to cover 400 million households, with a scale of 10G-PON and above ports. There are over 10 million gigabit broadband users, surpassing 30 million households.- 5G network has achieved basic coverage in areas above the township level and key administrative villages.- The Double Hundred goal has been achieved: constructing 100 gigabit cities and creating 100 gigabit industry virtual private networks. This is a benchmark project.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives, by the end of 2023.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/25th March 2021)
content: Promote the large-scale deployment of 10G-PON optical line terminal (OLT) equipment by basic telecommunications companies in cities and key towns, continue to optimize the upstream networking of OLT and transform and upgrade the optical distribution network (ODN) in weak areas such as old residential areas and industrial parks, and further extend the all-optical access network to end users. Upgrade home and enterprise gateway (ONT) devices that support gigabit services as needed, provide end-to-end gigabit service experience through home wiring transformation, optimization of gigabit wireless LAN networking, and guiding users to upgrade their access terminals.
titlelist: Key tasks, Gigabit City Construction Action, continuously expanding the coverage of Gigabit optical network.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Promote the commercial use of 5G standalone network (SA) by basic telecommunications companies, with a focus on accelerating network coverage in central urban areas, key regions, and key industries. Encourage the use of various networking methods such as macro base stations, small base stations, etc., combined with other technologies such as centralized radio access network (C-RAN), to promote deep coverage of 5G networks in traffic hubs, large sports venues, scenic spots, and other areas with high traffic density. Based on industry development and application needs, timely carry out network construction based on 5G millimeter wave technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, Gigabit City Construction Action, accelerate the promotion of 5G standalone network scale deployment.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Improve the compensation mechanism for universal telecommunications services, support basic telecommunications companies in continuously deepening broadband network coverage in rural areas with large populations, production areas, and along major transportation routes, and help consolidate and expand the achievements of poverty alleviation while effectively connecting with rural revitalization. Gradually promote the construction and coverage of gigabit networks in rural and remote areas with conditions and needs.
titlelist: Key tasks, gigabit city construction action, deepening the promotion of rural network infrastructure construction and upgrading.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/25th March 2021)
content: Promote the continuous deepening of industry collaboration and sharing among basic telecommunications enterprises. According to the principle of intensive use of existing resources and no new construction if sharing is possible, coordinate the construction needs of tower facilities and support basic telecommunications enterprises in carrying out 5G network co-construction and sharing. Encourage the implementation of fiber optic network co-construction through methods such as cable sharing in the same trench, cable sharing on the same pole, and core sharing in the same cable. Implement sharing through core fiber replacement and fiber core leasing. Focus on improving the level of cross-industry co-construction and sharing, and further strengthen communication and cooperation with the power, railway, highway, and municipal sectors. Column 1: Hundred Cities, Thousand Megabits construction project. Accelerate the deployment of urban dual gigabit network construction. Support local governments and basic telecommunications enterprises in creating a number of demonstration communities and demonstration parks with dual gigabit capabilities, and deepen the coverage of dual gigabit networks in urban households, key areas, and key industries. Promote the development of dual gigabit users as needed. Support local governments and relevant enterprises in deploying edge cloud sinking, and build a network + platform + application integrated fixed-mobile convergence and cloud-network integration dual gigabit business system. Promote the development of new businesses such as cloud VR and ultra-high-definition video, and promote user migration to broadband speeds of 500Mbps and above and 5G networks through application traction. Organize the evaluation of gigabit cities. Based on the evaluation indicators of gigabit cities, regularly evaluate the effectiveness of gigabit city construction. By the end of 2021, more than 20 gigabit cities will be built nationwide, and by the end of 2023, more than 100 gigabit cities will be built nationwide, achieving a gigabit fiber optic network coverage rate of over 80% in urban households, and more than 12 5G base stations per ten thousand people.
titlelist: Key tasks, Gigabit City Construction Action, deepening the co-construction and sharing of telecommunications infrastructure.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/25th March 2021)
content: Promote continuous expansion of backbone transmission networks for basic telecommunications enterprises, deploy backbone networks with 200/400Gbps ultra-high speed and ultra-large capacity transmission systems as needed, and enhance the comprehensive carrying capacity of backbone transmission networks. Accelerate the development and application of flexible all-optical cross-connections, intelligent management and control technologies, and improve network scheduling capabilities and service efficiency. Guide the deployment of 100Gbps and above ultra-high-speed optical transmission systems to metropolitan area networks. Encourage the use of new types of ultra-low-loss optical fibers in newly constructed trunk lines.
titlelist: Key tasks, enhancing capacity action, improving backbone transmission network carrying capacity.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Promote the demand for high-speed interconnection of data centers by basic telecommunications companies, deploy and apply 400Gbps optical transmission systems, and encourage the construction of data center direct connection networks and directed network connections. Combined with business development, continue to promote the application of core technologies such as IPv6 Segment Routing (SRv6) and Virtual Extensible LAN (VXLAN) in DCI. Promote the application of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) technology in data center interconnection, and enhance the collaborative capacity of cloud and network.
titlelist: Key tasks, capacity enhancement action, optimizing data center interconnect (DCI) capability.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Promote the construction of high-capacity, high-speed, and low-cost optical transmission systems for 5G front-haul and mid-haul networks in basic telecommunications enterprises, enhancing the intelligent operational capabilities of comprehensive service access and network slicing resources. Promote the on-demand deployment of 50Gbps systems in the city access layer of the 5G bearer network, and the on-demand deployment of 100Gbps or 200Gbps systems in the city aggregation layer and core layer. Gradually promote the networking of three-layer virtual private networks (L3VPN) to the edge, compatible with edge cloud data center interconnection networking.
titlelist: Key tasks, capacity enhancement action, collaborative promotion of 5G bearer network construction.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Encourage basic telecommunications enterprises to combine with industry units' needs and deploy the construction of gigabit virtual private networks in typical industries such as industry, transportation, power grid, education, healthcare, ports, and emergency public services. Explore innovative network architectures and flexibly carry out network construction using various modes such as sharing with the public network partially or end-to-end. Deploy 5G base stations, OLT equipment, core network elements, and industry terminals within industry units as needed, supporting the localization of sensitive data processing and storage for industry units. Explore innovative operating models, encourage the opening of relevant interface functions, provide necessary management and control permissions for industry units, and serve the development of industries.
titlelist: Key tasks, industry integration empowering action, innovative deployment of gigabit industry virtual private network construction.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Support basic telecommunications companies to explore the use of new technologies such as IPv6+ to provide end-to-end deterministic service capabilities at the network layer, ensuring bandwidth, latency, and jitter performance requirements for specific business flow transmission. Newly built industry networks prioritize support for IPv6+ features such as IPv6 segment routing, network slicing, deterministic forwarding, and on-path detection, and carry out pilot applications of new multicast, service chaining, and application-aware networks. Construct benchmark projects for 2Gbps industry virtual private networks. Promote the pilot deployment of 1Gbps virtual private networks in the industrial manufacturing field. Encourage basic telecommunications companies to adopt collaborative deployment of 5G, industrial passive optical networks (PON), and industrial optical transport networks (OTN), combined with new technologies such as edge computing, network slicing, and AI, to form a unified and efficient carrying capacity for industrial production, office, security, and other subnets, meeting the security authentication and control capabilities of industrial enterprises for access terminal devices, and supporting the high-quality and rapid cloud access requirements of industrial enterprises. Promote the pilot deployment of 1Gbps virtual private networks in the education and medical fields. Encourage basic telecommunications companies to further enhance their network support capabilities for online education, remote medical care, and other applications based on the dual 1Gbps network, meeting the industry's internet usage and management needs, and providing support for typical online education application scenarios such as virtual practical training, smart cloud examination rooms, smart home-school communities, teacher training, smart evaluation, as well as typical remote medical care application scenarios such as remote consultation, remote imaging, remote emergency care, and remote monitoring. Adopt various technical solutions such as software-defined wide area networks (SD-WAN), real-time video communication, and intelligent network scheduling to optimize network transmission quality. Promote the pilot deployment of 1Gbps virtual private networks in special fields. Encourage basic telecommunications companies, industry units, and others to leverage the differentiated characteristics of 1Gbps optical networks and 5G in scenarios with high bandwidth requirements, such as image monitoring and online quality inspection, and strong electromagnetic interference in mining, power, stamping manufacturing, etc., to form a batch of replicable and scalable dual 1Gbps deployment schemes. By the end of 2023, create 100 benchmark projects for 1Gbps virtual private networks.
titlelist: Key tasks, industry integration and empowerment actions, actively adopting new technologies such as 'IPv6+' to provide deterministic service capabilities.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/25th March 2021)
content: Encourage leading enterprises, research institutions, etc. to increase investment in the research and development of ultra-high-speed fiber optic transmission, next-generation optical network technology, wireless communication technology, etc., actively participate in international standardization work, strengthen the development of group standards, and form the core competitiveness of China's dual gigabit network technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to strengthen the industrial chain, fill in the weak links, and enhance core technology research and development and standard formulation.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/25th March 2021)
content: Encourage terminal equipment companies to accelerate the research and development of 5G terminals, improve the performance of 5G terminals, and promote the maturity of various forms of 5G terminals such as smartphones, customer premises equipment (CPE), cloud XR, and wearable devices that support SA/NSA dual-mode and multi-frequency band. Promote the research and development and application of devices such as home gateways, enterprise gateways, and wireless routers that support high-speed wireless LAN technology, and accelerate the integration of terminals such as smartphones, computers, and 4K/8K ultra-high-definition devices with flexible multi-access capabilities. Further reduce terminal costs, improve terminal performance and security, and stimulate the potential for information consumption.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to strengthen the industrial chain, fill the gaps in the chain, and accelerate the maturity of the end products.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Encourage companies in the fiber optic cable, chip devices, and network equipment industries to continuously improve the level of industrial base advancement and modernization of the industrial chain, and consolidate existing industrial advantages. Focus on enhancing the research and development and manufacturing capabilities of core chips, network equipment, modules, devices, etc., promote the self-reliance and self-strengthening of China's communication industry chain, and cultivate and expand the industrial ecosystem. Implement the Double Gigabit industrial chain strengthening and supplementing project. Strengthen core technology research and development, encourage leading companies, research institutions, etc. to increase research and development investment in technologies such as 800Gbps/1Tbps ultra-high-speed fiber transmission, 50G-PON, 5GRel-17, millimeter wave communication, and high-speed wireless LAN, and achieve technological innovation. Accelerate breakthroughs in industrial weaknesses, encourage companies in the fiber optic cable, chip devices, and network equipment industries to strengthen technological research and development and improve manufacturing capabilities and process levels in weak areas such as 5G chips, high-speed PON chips, high-speed wireless LAN chips, high-speed optical modules, and high-performance devices. Build industrial clusters, rely on existing domestic industrial advantage regions, create a Double Gigabit strategic industrial cluster for network development, and form a collective force. By the end of 2023, key core technologies will achieve breakthroughs, and independent research and development capabilities will be significantly enhanced.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to strengthen the industrial chain, fill in the gaps in the chain, and continuously enhance industrial capabilities.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Expand the number of connected enterprises and the scale of traffic exchange in the new Internet exchange center, add at least 2 national-level Internet backbone direct connection points, and improve a comprehensive, multi-level, three-dimensional interconnection system. Promote cloud service companies to continuously improve their key core technology capabilities in cloud computing, promote the construction of multi-access edge computing (MEC) edge clouds, and accelerate the application of new models and technologies such as cloud-edge collaboration and cloud-network integration. Promote content delivery network (CDN) companies to accelerate the deployment of CDN nodes in the western and northeastern regions, promote CDN capacity expansion and sinking as needed, and achieve internet content access in proximity.
titlelist: Key tasks, user experience improvement action, continuous optimization of network architecture.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/25th March 2021)
content: Guide basic telecommunications enterprises to strengthen the coordinated development of 5G and 4G networks, promote the re-cultivation and optimization upgrade of 2G, 3G, and 4G frequencies, and improve the efficiency of network resource utilization. Support the research and deployment of multi-mode base station equipment to ensure the coverage needs of different standard networks in urban hotspots, high-speed rail, and subway lines. Continuously improve the international bandwidth capacity of the Internet, and improve the experience of international Internet access. Achieve a 10Tbps expansion of inter-network bandwidth for the Internet, and achieve performance convergence with developed countries in Europe and America in terms of inter-network access. Promote Internet companies to enhance their service capabilities, ensure basic bandwidth allocation, and improve user business access experience.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance user experience, focusing on ensuring network quality.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Urge basic telecommunications companies to effectively improve the quality of 5G services, establish and improve the 5G service standards of the company, and increase the assessment of services provided by physical business halls, customer service hotlines, and other frontline windows. Further improve the reminder mechanism, strictly adhere to marketing red lines, rigorously investigate behaviors such as aggressively promoting 5G plans, restricting users from changing plans, and exaggerating plan advertisements, and effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of users. Promote companies to reduce the average fees for broadband and dedicated lines for small and medium-sized enterprises by another 10% in 2021. Encourage the launch of exclusive preferential rates for special groups such as rural poverty-stricken households (originally registered impoverished households), the elderly, and disabled people, reasonably reducing communication costs for mobile phones, broadband, and other services. Enhance the evaluation capabilities of the Dual Gigabit network development assessment project. Improve the user experience-based evaluation index system for the development of Dual Gigabit networks. Guide relevant companies and research institutions to strengthen the construction and deployment of dedicated terminals, 5G speed measurement apps, speed measurement servers, and other technical means. Adopt comprehensive methods such as field testing, fixed-point testing, and friendly user testing to enrich data sources and form a refined evaluation capability for key network development indicators in different regions, time periods, and network segments. Research the Dual Gigabit network evaluation system for industries. Organize relevant companies and research institutions to conduct research on the network performance requirements of different industries and scenarios, and carry out field testing in no less than 10 major industries and scenarios. Regularly release authoritative data and reports. Guide the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology to regularly publish reports on fixed broadband and mobile broadband network speeds in China, timely release evaluation reports on network development in key cities and locations, comprehensively and objectively reflect the development level of Dual Gigabit networks in China, and continuously optimize the service capabilities of Dual Gigabit networks in China.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance user experience, continuously improve service quality.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Promote the coordination of network security capabilities with the planning, construction, and operation of dual gigabit network infrastructure, and enhance network security and data security capabilities. Urge relevant enterprises to fulfill their main responsibilities for network security, establish sound security management systems and work mechanisms, conduct network security risk assessments and hidden danger investigations, timely prevent various security risks in networks, equipment, physical environments, management, etc., and continuously improve network security protection capabilities.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthening security measures, enhancing network security protection capabilities.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT, March 25, 2021)
content: Encourage key cybersecurity enterprises to focus on key aspects such as network planning and construction, concentrate on critical areas of information technology products, carry out core technology research and development, build an industrial ecosystem covering underlying infrastructure, key equipment, and network security products, establish secure and trustworthy new information infrastructure, and steadily enhance the security of double gigabit networks.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthening security measures, building a secure and trustworthy new information infrastructure.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT, March 25, 2021)
content: Encourage basic telecommunications enterprises, network security enterprises, industry units, etc. to strengthen the coordination of network security work in key industries such as medical, education, and industry, and provide diversified services for various scenarios, access methods, and device forms. Strengthen the security risk prevention and response guidance for gigabit industry virtual private networks, and promote the joint construction and sharing of network infrastructure security.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen security measures, and ensure cross-industry network security.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: The various local communication management bureaus have established a collaborative working mechanism with the departments of industry and information technology, housing and urban-rural development, market supervision, and internet information, among others. They have strengthened their joint law enforcement capabilities and efforts, focusing on the joint rectification of broadband access markets in commercial buildings, the implementation of national standards for fiber-to-the-home in new civil buildings, and forming a regulatory synergy. They are also coordinating with the power sector to reduce the electricity costs of 5G base stations.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen departmental coordination.

name: Action Plan for the Coordinated Development of Dual Gigabit Networks (2021-2023) (MIIT Communication [2021] No. 34) (MIIT/March 25, 2021)
content: Standardization organizations and industry associations should fully leverage their role as technical leaders and bridge connectors, actively engage in international benchmarking, and promote further technological breakthroughs and collaborative innovation among the upstream and downstream sectors of the telecommunications industry, research institutes, equipment vendors, component suppliers, and chip vendors. Strengthen the exchange and promotion of experiences in the deployment and application of dual gigabit networks and new technologies.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepen exchanges and cooperation.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Basic telecommunications companies should provide tariff packages for sale to the public market in their own business halls, mobile apps, online platforms, tariff special zones, and agent channels. They should also provide a query entrance for discounted tariff packages for the elderly and disabled. Thoroughly review the names of the packages for sale to avoid misunderstandings. Promptly remind users of their data usage within the package and set a reasonable price for data usage outside the package (to be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing tariff package settings and display methods.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Basic telecommunications companies should further implement the requirements of the four reminder mechanisms and the four marketing red lines for 5G services. They should clearly specify the theoretical uplink and downlink rates in broadband service contracts, provide services as promised, ensure that users' access rates meet the standards, and inform users in an appropriate manner about the impact of hardware devices, environmental factors, etc., on broadband speed. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing the promotion methods of dual gigabit services.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Internet companies (see attached list of companies for the first batch of implementation) should provide users with a concise, clear, and easy-to-understand summary of the privacy policy for their APP products. If it involves accessing sensitive permissions such as photo albums, contacts, and location in the user's terminal, they should also inform users of the purpose of accessing such permissions in an appropriate manner, fully protecting the user's right to know. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing privacy policy and permission invocation display methods.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Internet companies should set clear and effective close buttons in the splash screen and pop-up window of their apps. The button size, position, and color should be easy to operate and recognize, allowing users to 'find it and close it'. The splash screen window of the app should not use full-screen images, videos, or other content as jump links, which may induce users to click or easily cause users to make mistaken clicks, causing inconvenience to users. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing the display method of APP splash screen pop-up information.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Relevant companies should optimize the introduction of product services and fees, clearly indicating the content of storage space, transmission rate, functional rights and benefits, and fee levels, and must not engage in misleading advertising. Under the same network conditions, the minimum upload and download speed provided to free users should ensure the basic download needs are met. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, service measures 'five optimizations', optimizing the way of providing online storage services.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Each relevant company should establish a list of collected personal information and a list of personal information shared with third parties (the initial list of companies that have established the double list is attached), and display them in the secondary menu of the app for easy user access (to be completed by the end of December 2021). The list of collected personal information should concisely and clearly outline the basic information of user personal information collected by the app (including embedded third-party software development kits SDK), including the types of information, purposes of use, and usage scenarios. The list of personal information shared with third parties should concisely and clearly outline the basic information of user personal information shared between the app and third parties, including the types of personal information shared with third parties, purposes of use, usage scenarios, and sharing methods.
titlelist: Key task: Establishing 'dual lists' for personal information protection.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Basic telecommunications companies have added Family Network and Fixed-Mobile Convergence services for cross-regional handling. Within the same basic telecommunications company network, mobile numbers with different locations can form a family network, enabling cross-province processing. It is also possible to integrate fixed broadband and mobile numbers across local networks within the province, and basic telecommunications companies with the capability are encouraged to actively promote cross-province processing. (To be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, four improvements in service capabilities, improving cross-regional handling capabilities.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: On the basis of fulfilling the previous commitment to open channels to the outside, basic telecommunications companies will open 10,000 new service halls nationwide that can handle number portability services. The situation of these service halls that can handle number portability services will be promptly publicized to the public. The service halls should be reasonably distributed to minimize inconvenience for users. Online application for number portability services and refund of remaining balance for users switching to another location will be implemented. Basic telecommunications companies with the capability are encouraged to provide number portability services at service halls in different locations (to be completed by the end of December 2021).
titlelist: Key tasks, four improvements in service capability, improving number portability service capability.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Enterprises engaged in Internet information services should establish a customer service hotline and prominently display the hotline number on their website, app, and other platforms. Encourage eligible enterprises to provide sufficient manned customer service seats (see attached list of first batch of implementing enterprises) and offer direct hotline services to the elderly. The customer service hotline should strive to achieve a maximum average response time of 30 seconds per month, with a human service response rate exceeding 85% (to be completed by the end of March 2022).
titlelist: Key tasks, four improvements in service capabilities, improving customer service hotline response capabilities.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: All units should attach great importance to the improvement of the quality of information and communication services, prioritize the protection of users' legitimate rights and interests, strengthen organizational leadership, improve management systems, clarify task division, consolidate main responsibilities, take effective measures, and ensure that all work achieves practical results.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational implementation.

name: Notice on Carrying out the Action of Enhancing Perception of Information and Communication Services (MIIT Letter [2021] No. 292) (MIIT/November 1, 2021)
content: Promote collaborative governance through government regulation, social supervision, corporate self-discipline, and user participation, to achieve a positive interaction between service quality improvement and perception enhancement. All relevant companies should take this opportunity of improving the perception of information and communication services to fully exert their initiative and creativity, innovate service models and methods, and provide users with more comprehensive, caring, and convenient services.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote collaborative governance.
