Utilize various channels such as angel investment, venture capital, entrepreneurial investment funds, and capital market financing to guide social capital to support the development of artificial intelligence. Actively utilize government and social capital cooperation models to guide social capital participation in the implementation of major artificial intelligence projects and the application of scientific and technological achievements.
titlelist: Resource allocation, establishing a financial-guided and market-led funding support mechanism.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: Support domestic artificial intelligence enterprises to collaborate with international leading universities, research institutes, and teams in the field of artificial intelligence. Encourage domestic artificial intelligence enterprises to go global and provide convenience and services for capable artificial intelligence enterprises to carry out overseas mergers and acquisitions, equity investments, venture capital, and establish overseas research and development centers. Encourage foreign artificial intelligence enterprises and research institutions to establish research and development centers in China. Relying on the Belt and Road strategy, promote the construction of international science and technology cooperation bases and joint research centers for artificial intelligence, and accelerate the promotion and application of artificial intelligence technology in countries along the Belt and Road. Promote the establishment of international organizations for artificial intelligence and jointly formulate relevant international standards. Support industry associations, alliances, and service organizations to build global service platforms for artificial intelligence enterprises.
titlelist: Resource allocation, coordinating international and domestic innovation resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: In response to the practical requirements of promoting the healthy and rapid development of artificial intelligence in our country, we need to properly address the challenges that artificial intelligence may bring, establish institutional arrangements that adapt to the development of artificial intelligence, build an open and inclusive international environment, and strengthen the social foundation for the development of artificial intelligence.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: Implement preferential financial and tax policies for small and medium-sized enterprises and startups in the field of artificial intelligence, support the development of AI companies through policies such as tax incentives for high-tech enterprises and additional deductions for research and development expenses. Improve the implementation of policies related to data openness and protection, carry out pilot reforms in the utilization of public data, support the public and enterprises in fully exploring the commercial value of public data, and promote innovation in the application of artificial intelligence. Study and improve policy systems in education, healthcare, insurance, social assistance, and other areas to adapt to artificial intelligence and effectively address the social issues brought about by AI.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve key policies supporting the development of artificial intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: Strengthen research on the framework system of artificial intelligence standards. Adhere to the principles of safety, usability, interoperability, and traceability, gradually establish and improve technical standards for artificial intelligence in areas such as basic commonality, interconnection, industry applications, network security, and privacy protection. Accelerate the development of relevant standards by industry associations and alliances in specific application areas such as autonomous driving and service robots. Encourage AI companies to participate in or lead the development of international standards, promoting the overseas application and promotion of AI products and services through technical standards. Enhance intellectual property protection in the field of artificial intelligence, establish a mechanism that supports the interaction between technological innovation, patent protection, and standardization in the field of artificial intelligence, and promote the intellectual property transformation of AI innovation achievements. Establish a public patent pool for artificial intelligence to facilitate the utilization and diffusion of new AI technologies.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, establish artificial intelligence technology standards and intellectual property system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: Accelerate research on the changes in employment structure and employment methods brought about by artificial intelligence, as well as the skill requirements for new types of professions and job positions. Establish a lifelong learning and employment training system that adapts to the needs of the intelligent economy and intelligent society. Support higher education institutions, vocational schools, and social training institutions in providing artificial intelligence skills training. Significantly enhance the professional skills of employed individuals to meet the demand for high-skilled and high-quality job positions brought about by the development of artificial intelligence in our country. Encourage enterprises and various institutions to provide artificial intelligence skills training for their employees. Strengthen training and guidance for reemployment of workers to ensure a smooth transition for laborers engaged in simple repetitive work and those who have become unemployed due to artificial intelligence.
titlelist: Protective measures, vigorously strengthen artificial intelligence labor training.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: Support various forms of popular science activities for artificial intelligence, encourage technology workers to engage in popular science and promotion of artificial intelligence, comprehensively improve the overall understanding and application level of artificial intelligence in society. Implement a national intelligence education program, set up artificial intelligence-related courses in primary and secondary schools, gradually promote programming education, encourage social forces to participate in the development and promotion of educational programming software and games. Build and improve the infrastructure for popular science of artificial intelligence, fully leverage the popular science role of various artificial intelligence innovation base platforms, encourage artificial intelligence companies and research institutions to build open platforms, and open artificial intelligence research and development platforms, production facilities, or exhibition halls to the public. Support the organization of artificial intelligence competitions and encourage diverse forms of popular science creation in artificial intelligence. Encourage scientists to participate in popular science of artificial intelligence.
titlelist: Protective measures, widely carry out artificial intelligence popular science activities.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: Strengthen the decomposition of planning tasks, clarify the responsible units and schedule arrangements, and formulate annual and phased implementation plans. Establish monitoring and evaluation mechanisms for the implementation of planning, including annual evaluations and midterm evaluations. Adapt to the rapid development of artificial intelligence, and strengthen the dynamic adjustment of planning and projects based on the progress of tasks, the completion of stage goals, and new trends in technological development.
titlelist: Organize and implement, ensure implementation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt) (State Council [2017] No. 35) (State Council/July 20, 2017)
content: Specific plans should be formulated for major tasks and key policy measures in artificial intelligence, and pilot demonstrations should be conducted. Strengthen overall guidance for pilot demonstrations in various departments and regions, and promptly summarize and promote replicable experiences and practices. By taking the lead in pilot demonstrations and guiding through demonstrations, promote the healthy and orderly development of artificial intelligence.
titlelist: Organize and implement, pilot and demonstrate.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: By 2023, we will establish and construct around 20 pilot zones, innovate a batch of practical and effective policy tools, form a number of typical models that deeply integrate artificial intelligence with economic and social development, accumulate a set of replicable and scalable experiences and practices, and create a group of significant leading and driving forces in the field of artificial intelligence innovation.
titlelist: Overall requirements, construction goals

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: Artificial intelligence technology applications are being demonstrated in various fields such as manufacturing, agriculture and rural areas, logistics, finance, commerce, home furnishings, healthcare, education, government affairs, transportation, environmental protection, security, urban management, assistance for the disabled and elderly, and domestic services, in response to the urgent needs for local economic development and improvement of people's livelihoods. These applications aim to expand the scope of application scenarios and accelerate the deep integration of artificial intelligence with the real economy, promoting the widespread application of artificial intelligence in social and livelihood areas.
titlelist: Key tasks: Carry out demonstrations of artificial intelligence technology applications, explore new paths to promote the deep integration of artificial intelligence and economic and social development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: Strong network infrastructure, big data infrastructure, and computing infrastructure construction, enhance the intelligence level of traditional infrastructure, and form an infrastructure system that supports the widespread application of the new generation of artificial intelligence. Build artificial intelligence research and development bases and open innovation platforms, promote the orderly opening of public data security, and strengthen the basic conditions for supporting artificial intelligence research and development innovation.
titlelist: Key tasks: Promote the construction of artificial intelligence infrastructure and strengthen the conditions supporting the innovation and development of artificial intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: Universities should have the establishment of artificial intelligence colleges or research institutes, possess high-level research and development institutions in the field of artificial intelligence basic research or key technologies, and have a group of high-level artificial intelligence innovation teams.
titlelist: Application requirements, abundant scientific and educational resources.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: In principle, it should be the city where the national independent innovation demonstration zone or national high-tech zone is located, and it has clearly identified the development of artificial intelligence as a key industrial direction. The core industry of artificial intelligence has a scale of over 5 billion yuan, and the related industry of artificial intelligence has a scale of over 20 billion yuan.
titlelist: Application requirements, good industrial foundation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: The data resources are abundant, with relevant data platforms, big data centers, and cloud computing centers. The network infrastructure, such as mobile communication, Internet of Things, and industrial Internet, is relatively well-developed. Priority support is given to cities that have already established national new-generation artificial intelligence open innovation platforms.
titlelist: Application requirements, sound infrastructure.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: Local governments attach great importance to the development of artificial intelligence and have issued plans or implementation opinions for the development of artificial intelligence. Local governments provide clear financial and policy support for artificial intelligence, establish special funds for artificial intelligence, and government departments have dedicated mechanisms or institutions for promoting artificial intelligence. For some counties with obvious advantages in the artificial intelligence industry, sound intelligent infrastructure, prominent application scenarios, and strong technological research and development and achievement transformation capabilities, they can also apply to establish national new generation artificial intelligence innovation and development pilot zones.
titlelist: Application requirements, support measures are clear.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Experimental Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: The Ministry of Science and Technology organizes experts to conduct comprehensive demonstrations on the construction plan of the experimental zone. The experts conducting the demonstrations mainly consist of the National Consultative Committee for the New Generation Artificial Intelligence Strategy and the National Professional Committee for the Governance of the New Generation Artificial Intelligence. The committee includes experts from universities, research institutes, enterprises, and policy experts in the field of artificial intelligence technology.
titlelist: Construction procedures, comprehensive demonstration

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: The Ministry of Science and Technology, based on the opinions of the evaluation, comprehensively considers the overall layout of the pilot zone construction. For places that meet the construction conditions and have relatively mature construction plans, they will be approved and supported to start the construction of the pilot zone according to the procedures, and this will be announced to the public.
titlelist: Construction process, initiate construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: The Ministry of Science and Technology provides support to the construction of pilot zones in terms of policies and resources. Local governments should increase financial investment in the construction of pilot zones, design policies for the construction of pilot zones, and actively guide enterprises and social forces to participate in the construction of pilot zones.
titlelist: 保障措施,支持方式 translates to safeguard measures, support methods in English.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National New Generation Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Experimental Zones (Guokefa [2019] No. 298) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 29, 2019)
content: Strengthen the policy interpretation of the construction of the pilot zone, regularly conduct exchanges and seminars, promptly publicize the new progress, new achievements, and new breakthroughs in the construction of the pilot zone, summarize experiences and practices, and create a favorable atmosphere for the innovation and development of artificial intelligence in the whole society.
titlelist: Protection measures, publicity and guidance

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: Guided by the major application demands of artificial intelligence, relying on open innovation platforms, we promote the development of fundamental theories, key core technologies, hardware and software support systems, and product application development in the field of artificial intelligence. Our goal is to create innovative achievements in artificial intelligence that have international influence and wide coverage.
titlelist: The translation of the Chinese text '建设原则,应用为牵引' to English is: Construction principles, guided by application.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: Encourage leading enterprises in the field of artificial intelligence to build open-source and open platforms, open up artificial intelligence technology research and development resources to the public, provide artificial intelligence technology services to society, promote the industry application of artificial intelligence technology, cultivate industry-leading enterprises, and support the growth of small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Construction principle, enterprise as the main body

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: Encourage the adoption of market-oriented organizational management mechanisms, with the relying units serving as the main funding body for open innovation platforms. This can be achieved through technology transfer authorization, paid use of technology, and other means to provide continuous support for the development of open innovation platforms.
titlelist: Construction principles, market-oriented mechanisms

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: Encourage local governments, industries, research institutes, universities, and others to jointly participate in promoting the construction of open innovation platforms. Through the integration of resources such as talents, technology, data, and industrial chains, build an open ecosystem and promote the industrialization of core technological achievements.
titlelist: Construction principles, collaborative innovation

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: The open innovation platform is mainly led by leading enterprises in the artificial intelligence industry, encouraging joint participation from research institutes and universities to provide intellectual and technical support. The open innovation platform should focus on the construction of specific areas with significant application needs as outlined in the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan. In principle, each specific area should have a national open innovation platform for the next generation of artificial intelligence. Different open innovation platforms should have clear distinctions and emphasis in their respective areas. Open innovation platforms applying for construction should meet the following basic requirements.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: By combining open innovation platforms with existing technological foundations and industrial resources in specific fields, we gather the innovative forces of advantageous enterprises, research institutes, and universities to collaboratively promote the basic theories, model methods, and fundamental hardware and software research of artificial intelligence. This serves to support and facilitate the innovation of cutting-edge basic theories and key technologies in artificial intelligence.
titlelist: Key task: Carry out technological innovation in specific fields.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: Actively explore the transformation and application mechanism of open innovation platforms, take innovation achievements as the driving force, effectively integrate relevant technologies, industrial chains, and financial resources, gather upstream and downstream innovation forces, build a complete technological and industrial ecosystem, and promote high-quality economic and social development and improvement of people's livelihood.
titlelist: Key task: promoting the diffusion and application of achievements.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: Open innovation platforms are being established to create standardized test datasets for specific fields, promoting data openness and sharing. This will lead to the development of standardized, modular models, middleware, and application software. These services will be provided to society through open interfaces, model libraries, algorithm packages, and other means of software and hardware sharing.
titlelist: Key tasks, providing open and shared services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: Build knowledge sharing and experience exchange communities in specific fields, guide technology-based small and medium-sized enterprises and innovative entrepreneurs to carry out product research and development, application testing based on open innovation platforms. Reduce the barriers to technology and resource utilization, and create a favorable environment for collaborative innovation and entrepreneurship across the industry.
titlelist: Key tasks: guiding small and medium-sized enterprises and industry developers to innovate and start businesses.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: The translation of the Chinese text to English is as follows:Based on the above-mentioned application conditions, the construction entity that is willing to provide public innovation services should combine its own technological foundation and development positioning. It should select a specific and clear sub-field, and write an application for the construction of the National Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Open Innovation Platform. The application should be submitted to the Ministry of Science and Technology through self-recommendation by the relying unit or recommendation by the provincial-level science and technology authority, with priority given to outstanding applications.
titlelist: Organizational management, recommendation application

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: The Ministry of Science and Technology organizes experts to conduct comprehensive demonstrations. The panel of experts consists of comprehensive experts and domain experts. Among them, the comprehensive experts are selected from the members of the consultation expert group for the major project New Generation Artificial Intelligence in the Science and Technology Innovation 2030 program, as well as the leaders of established open innovation platforms. The domain experts are mainly selected from the experts involved in the compilation of major project guidelines. The comprehensive demonstrations are mainly conducted through conference discussions. The experts review the application for the construction of open innovation platforms, listen to reports from the applicant units, and conduct comprehensive inquiries and judgments from various aspects such as the rationality of the application direction, the foundation and capabilities of the supporting units, the feasibility of the construction plan, and the expected effects of open services, in order to form comprehensive demonstration opinions.
titlelist: Organizational management, comprehensive demonstration

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence Open Innovation Platforms (National Science and Technology Development Agency High [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: The Ministry of Science and Technology, based on the opinions of the evaluation, comprehensively considers the overall layout of the development needs and construction direction of the new generation of artificial intelligence technology. It selects and determines the open innovation platforms and their supporting units in a prioritized manner, and recognizes and announces them to the society according to the procedures.
titlelist: Organizational management, recognition and announcement

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for the Construction of National Open Innovation Platforms for Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence (No. Gao Ke Fa [2019] No. 265) (Ministry of Science and Technology/August 1, 2019)
content: The host unit is the main body and responsible body for the construction of the national new generation artificial intelligence open innovation platform. It encourages the host unit to actively explore efficient organizational management models that are suitable for its own development characteristics based on national strategies and actual fields. It also encourages the establishment of effective resource integration, collaborative innovation, open services, and benefit distribution mechanisms, and encourages the establishment of technical cooperation, experience exchange, and resource sharing mechanisms among various open innovation platforms. The establishment of an annual report and major issue reporting system is required. Open innovation platforms should regularly summarize their work, compile annual summary reports, and submit them to the provincial science and technology authorities for review before submitting them to the Ministry of Science and Technology. The Ministry of Science and Technology actively supports the construction of open innovation platforms and promotes their coordinated development with the construction of national new generation artificial intelligence innovation and development pilot zones. Provincial science and technology authorities should actively promote the construction of open innovation platforms based on regional development characteristics, support technology promotion and application, and provide relevant policy support conducive to their development. An exit mechanism for open innovation platforms should be established. The host units of open innovation platforms should follow the Principles of Governance for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence and develop responsible artificial intelligence. They should actively and steadily promote technological innovation and industrial development in artificial intelligence, and continuously explore performance management and evaluation mechanisms for open innovation platforms. Provincial science and technology authorities should promptly provide feedback to the Ministry of Science and Technology on any problems encountered during the construction of open innovation platforms. The Ministry of Science and Technology will revoke open innovation platforms that are unable to continue fulfilling their responsibilities or have a serious negative impact on society.
titlelist: Organizational management, operational management

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Artificial intelligence has significant spillover effects, which will further drive the progress of other technologies, promote breakthroughs in strategic emerging industries, and become a new driving force for advancing supply-side structural reforms, revitalizing the real economy, and building a strong manufacturing and network country. In order to implement the Development Plan for the New Generation of Artificial Intelligence, seize historical opportunities, break through key areas, promote the development of the artificial intelligence industry, enhance the level of intelligent manufacturing, promote deep integration of artificial intelligence and the real economy, this action plan is formulated.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: By implementing four key tasks, we strive to achieve a series of landmark artificial intelligence products by 2020. Important breakthroughs will be made to form international competitive advantages in several key areas, further deepening the integration of artificial intelligence and the real economy, and optimizing the industrial development environment. Key developments include the scale development of artificial intelligence products, significant improvement in the level of intelligent connected vehicle technology, large-scale application of intelligent service robots, globally competitive intelligent drones, expanded clinical applications of medical imaging-assisted diagnosis systems, and internationally advanced products in video image recognition, intelligent voice, and intelligent translation. Overall core capabilities in artificial intelligence will be significantly enhanced, breakthroughs will be made in intelligent sensor technology products, design, contract manufacturing, and testing technology will reach international standards, neural network chips will be mass-produced and applied on a large scale in key areas, and open development platforms will possess the preliminary ability to support rapid industrial development. Intelligent manufacturing will deepen its development, with accelerated integration and application of artificial intelligence technologies such as complex environment recognition and new human-machine interaction in key technical equipment. The application level of intelligent production, large-scale personalized customization, predictive maintenance, and other new models will be significantly improved. The level of intelligence in key industrial sectors will be significantly enhanced. The support system for the artificial intelligence industry will be basically established, with a certain scale of high-quality annotated data resource libraries and standard test data sets being built and opened. The framework for artificial intelligence standards, testing and evaluation systems, and security assurance systems will be initially established, and the infrastructure system for intelligent networks will gradually take shape, creating a more favorable industrial development environment.
titlelist: Overall requirements, action goals.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Support the development of key technologies and products such as vehicle intelligent computing platform architecture, in-vehicle intelligent chips, autonomous driving operating systems, and vehicle intelligent algorithms. Build an integrated software, hardware, and algorithm vehicle intelligent platform. By 2020, establish a reliable, safe, and real-time intelligent connected network. Formulate platform-related standards to support highly automated driving (Level HA).
titlelist: Cultivate intelligent products, intelligent connected vehicles.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Support the research and development of key technologies such as intelligent interaction, intelligent operation, and multi-machine collaboration, improve the intelligence level of home service robots in areas such as cleaning, elderly care, rehabilitation, disability assistance, and children's education, and promote the innovative application of public service robots such as inspection and guidance robots, as well as firefighting and rescue robots. Develop key technologies such as 3D imaging positioning, intelligent precise safety control, and human-machine collaboration interface, support the development of surgical robot operating systems, and promote the application of surgical robots in clinical medicine. By 2020, breakthroughs will be made in key technologies such as environmental perception, natural interaction, autonomous learning, and human-machine collaboration for intelligent service robots. Mass production and application of intelligent home service robots and intelligent public service robots will be achieved. Prototype production of medical rehabilitation, elderly and disability assistance, firefighting and disaster relief robots will be completed, and technology and functional verification will be achieved, with more than 20 application demonstrations.
titlelist: Cultivating intelligent products, intelligent service robots.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Support the research and application of key technologies such as intelligent obstacle avoidance, automatic cruising, autonomous flight in complex environments, and group operations. Promote the application of new generation communication and positioning navigation technologies in unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission, link control, and monitoring management. Carry out research and development of key components such as intelligent flight control systems and highly integrated dedicated chips. By 2020, the precision of the intelligent consumer-grade drone's three-axis mechanical stabilizer gimbal will reach 0.005 degrees, achieving 360-degree omnidirectional perception and obstacle avoidance, and realizing automatic intelligent mandatory avoidance of airspace control areas.
titlelist: Cultivate intelligent products, intelligent drones.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Promote the standardization and normalization of medical imaging data collection, support the research and development of medical imaging-assisted diagnosis technologies in typical disease areas such as brain, lung, eye, bone, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular, and breast, and accelerate the productization and clinical application of medical imaging-assisted diagnosis systems. By 2020, the detection rate of advanced multimodal medical imaging-assisted diagnosis systems for the above-mentioned typical diseases in China will exceed 95%, with a false negative rate of less than 1% and a false positive rate of less than 5%.
titlelist: Cultivating intelligent products, medical imaging assisted diagnosis system.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Supporting technological innovations such as biometric recognition, video understanding, and cross-media integration, developing typical applications such as identity verification, video surveillance, image search, and video summarization, and expanding applications in key areas such as security and finance. By 2020, the effective detection rate of face recognition in complex dynamic scenes will exceed 97%, the correct recognition rate will exceed 90%, and it will support face recognition with different regional features.
titlelist: Cultivating intelligent products, video image identity recognition system.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Support innovative applications of new generation speech recognition frameworks, colloquial speech recognition, personalized speech recognition, intelligent dialogue, audio-video integration, and speech synthesis technologies. Promote applications in key areas such as intelligent manufacturing and smart homes. By 2020, achieve an average accuracy rate of 96% for Chinese speech recognition in various scenarios, a recognition rate of over 92% for far-field recognition at a distance of 5 meters, and a user dialogue intent recognition accuracy rate of over 90%.
titlelist: Cultivate intelligent products, intelligent voice interaction system.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Promote the application of high-precision intelligent translation systems, focusing on typical scenarios such as multilingual translation and simultaneous interpretation, and utilize machine learning technology to improve accuracy and practicality. By 2020, significant breakthroughs will be achieved in multilingual intelligent translation, with translation accuracy exceeding 85% in Chinese-to-English and English-to-Chinese scenarios. The intelligent translation accuracy between minority languages and Chinese will also be significantly improved.
titlelist: Cultivate intelligent products, intelligent translation system.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Support the application of technologies such as smart sensing, Internet of Things, and machine learning in smart home products, enhance the intelligence, practicality, and security of household appliances, smart network devices, water and electricity meters, and other products, develop smart security, smart furniture, smart lighting, smart sanitary ware, and other products, establish a number of smart home testing and evaluation, demonstration application projects, and promote them. By 2020, the category of smart home products will be significantly enriched, with a penetration rate of smart TVs reaching over 90%, and the level of intelligence in security products significantly improved.
titlelist: Cultivate intelligent products, smart home products.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Support the research and development of key technologies such as miniaturization and reliability design, precision manufacturing, integrated development tools, and embedded algorithms. Support the research and development and application of intelligent sensors based on new requirements, new materials, new processes, and new principles. Develop new types of intelligent sensors with broad market prospects, such as bio sensors, gas sensors, pressure sensors, flow sensors, inertial sensors, distance sensors, image sensors, and acoustic sensors. Promote technological innovation in materials such as piezoelectric materials, magnetic materials, infrared radiation materials, and metal oxides. Support the research and development of new intelligent sensors based on microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) integration processes. Develop intelligent sensors based on new principles such as magnetic sensing, ultrasonic waves, non-visible light, and biochemistry for new application scenarios. Promote high-precision, high-reliability, low-power, and low-cost intelligent sensors. By 2020, significant improvements in the performance of piezoelectric sensors, magnetic sensors, infrared sensors, and gas sensors will be achieved. Acoustic sensors with a signal-to-noise ratio of 70dB and an acoustic overload point of 135dB will be mass-produced. Pressure sensors with an absolute accuracy of less than 100Pa and a noise level of less than 0.6Pa will be commercially available. Magnetic sensors with a weak magnetic field resolution of 1pT will be mass-produced. Achieve international advanced levels in analog simulation, design, MEMS processes, packaging, and personalized testing technologies. Possess system design capabilities in key areas such as mobile wearable devices, the Internet, and automotive electronics.
titlelist: Breakthrough core foundation, intelligent sensors.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Facing machine learning training applications, develop high-performance, highly scalable, and low-power cloud neural network chips. Develop low-power, high-performance terminal neural network chips suitable for machine learning calculations for terminal applications. Develop industrial support tools such as compilers, driver software, and development environments that are compatible with neural network chips. By 2020, breakthrough progress will be made in neural network chip technology, launching cloud neural network chips with performance reaching 128TFLOPS (16-bit floating point) and energy efficiency exceeding 1TFLOPS/watt. Also, launch terminal neural network chips with energy efficiency exceeding 1TOPS/watt (based on 16-bit floating point), supporting one or several mainstream neural network algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM). Achieve large-scale commercialization of neural network chips in key areas such as intelligent terminals, autonomous driving, intelligent security, and smart homes.
titlelist: Breakthrough in core foundation, neural network chip.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: For common technologies such as machine learning, pattern recognition, intelligent semantic understanding, and key industry applications such as autonomous driving, support will be provided for the research and development of development frameworks, algorithm libraries, toolkits, etc. that support cloud-based training and terminal execution. This includes support for open development platforms, open technology networks, and open source community development. Encouragement will be given to the construction of open computing service platforms that meet complex training needs, and backbone leading enterprises will be encouraged to build a new industrial ecosystem based on open source technology, including software, hardware, data, and application collaboration. By 2020, the open development platform for cloud-based training will support large-scale distributed clusters, multiple hardware platforms, and various algorithms. The open development platform for terminal execution will possess characteristics such as lightweight, modularization, and reliability.
titlelist: Breakthrough core foundation, open source open platform.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Improve the self-testing, self-calibration, self-adaptation, self-organization, and intelligence level of high-end CNC machine tools and industrial robots. Use artificial intelligence technology to improve the processing accuracy and product quality of additive manufacturing equipment. Optimize the perception, cognition, and control capabilities of intelligent sensors and control equipment such as distributed control systems (DCS), programmable logic controllers (PLC), data acquisition systems (SCADA), and high-performance and high-reliability embedded control systems in complex working environments. Enhance the measurement accuracy and efficiency of intelligent detection equipment such as digital non-contact precision measurement and online non-destructive testing systems. Improve the flexibility of assembly equipment. Enhance the intelligence level of logistics equipment such as high-speed sorting machines, multi-layer shuttle cars, and high-density storage shuttle boards, and achieve precise, flexible, and efficient material distribution and unmanned intelligent warehousing. By 2020, the intelligence level of high-end CNC machine tools will be further improved, and the new generation of industrial robots with human-machine coordination, natural interaction, and autonomous learning capabilities will achieve mass production and application. The forming efficiency of additive manufacturing equipment will be greater than 450cm3/h, and the continuous working time will be greater than 240h. Integrated applications of intelligent sensing and control equipment will be realized in fields such as machine tools, robots, petrochemicals, and rail transportation. The accuracy of industrial field visual recognition of intelligent detection and assembly equipment will reach 90%, and the measurement accuracy and speed will meet actual production needs. Develop more than 10 intelligent logistics and warehousing equipment.
titlelist: Deepening the development of intelligent manufacturing, key technologies and equipment for intelligent manufacturing.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Encourage discrete manufacturing enterprises to base their production equipment on networking and intelligence, apply machine learning technology to analyze and process on-site data, and achieve functions such as online equipment diagnosis and real-time control of product quality. Encourage process manufacturing enterprises to establish fully integrated and intelligent production management and security systems, achieving intelligent management of continuous production and safety. Build a networked collaborative manufacturing platform to enhance the collaborative research, design, and production capabilities guided by artificial intelligence. Develop personalized customization service platforms to improve the deep learning and analysis capabilities of user demand characteristics, optimize product modular design capabilities, and personalized combination methods. Establish control and automatic diagnostic systems based on standardized information collection, accelerate the training and optimization of fault prediction models and user usage habit information models, and enhance the lifecycle analysis capabilities of products and core components. By 2020, the operating costs of digital workshops will be reduced by 20%, and the product development cycle will be shortened by 20%; the defect rate of intelligent factory products will be reduced by 10%, and the energy utilization rate will be improved by 10%; the aerospace, automotive, and other industries will accelerate the promotion of new models for internal and external parallel organization and collaborative optimization; the clothing, home appliance, and other industries will generally improve the flexible production and collaborative optimization capabilities of large-scale, small-batch personalized orders throughout the process; in the equipment manufacturing, parts manufacturing, and other fields, promote the development of remote operation and maintenance services such as intelligent equipment health monitoring and early warning.
titlelist: Deepening the development of intelligent manufacturing, a new model of intelligent manufacturing.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Facing the basic fields of speech recognition, visual recognition, natural language processing, and industrial, medical, financial, transportation, and other industries, support the construction of high-quality artificial intelligence training resource libraries, standard test datasets, and promote sharing. Encourage the construction of open cloud platforms that provide common services such as knowledge graphs, algorithm training, and product optimization. By 2020, the volume of public training data for basic speech, video images, and text conversations will be significantly increased, and a certain scale of industry application data will be gathered in industrial, medical, financial, transportation, and other fields to support entrepreneurship and innovation.
titlelist: Building a support system, industry training resource library.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Build an artificial intelligence industry standard and specification system, establish and improve technical standards for basic commonality, interconnection, security and privacy, and industry applications, and encourage the industry to actively participate in international standardization work. Construct an artificial intelligence product evaluation and testing system to evaluate the intelligence level, reliability, and security of key intelligent products and services, and improve the quality of artificial intelligence products and services. Research and establish a mechanism for the collaborative use of artificial intelligence technology patents, support the construction of patent collaborative operation platforms and intellectual property service platforms. By 2020, preliminarily establish an artificial intelligence industry standard system, build a third-party pilot testing platform, and carry out evaluation and testing services; in the fields of pattern recognition, semantic understanding, autonomous driving, intelligent robots, etc., build a knowledge property service platform with basic support capabilities.
titlelist: Building a support system, standard testing, and intellectual property service platform.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Accelerate the deployment and construction of the highly intelligent next-generation Internet, the fifth-generation mobile communication (5G) network with high speed, large capacity, and low latency, the navigation network with fast and high-precision positioning, and the integrated information network of ubiquitous fusion and efficient interconnection. Accelerate the construction of the industrial Internet and the Internet of Vehicles, gradually forming an intelligent network infrastructure system, and enhancing support service capabilities. By 2020, the broadband access speed and latency in over 90% of the country's regions will meet the needs of the artificial intelligence industry. More than 10 key enterprises will achieve industrial Internet demonstration construction covering the entire production process, and the initial construction of the Internet of Vehicles network facilities in key areas will be completed.
titlelist: Building a support system, intelligent network infrastructure.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Regarding key products or industry applications of artificial intelligence such as smart connected cars and smart homes, we will carry out vulnerability exploration, security testing, threat warning, attack detection, emergency response, and other security technology research to promote the deep application of advanced artificial intelligence technology in the field of network security. We will accelerate the construction of shared resources such as vulnerability databases, risk databases, and case collections. By 2020, we will improve the layout of the artificial intelligence network security industry, establish a framework for artificial intelligence security prevention and control system, and initially build a security assurance platform with basic capabilities such as artificial intelligence security situational awareness, testing and evaluation, threat information sharing, and emergency response.
titlelist: Build a support system, network security guarantee system.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Give full play to the guiding role of existing funds such as industrial transformation and upgrading, as well as major projects and national science and technology plans (special projects, funds), support the research and development of artificial intelligence landmark products and basic software and hardware, application pilot demonstrations, and support platform construction that meet the conditions. Encourage local governments to increase investment in related areas. With major needs and industry applications as the driving force, build typical test environments, establish platforms for product reliability and safety verification, organize collaborative research, support the research and development and adaptation of key artificial intelligence application technologies, and support innovative product design, system integration, and industrialization. Support the connection and cooperation between artificial intelligence enterprises and financial institutions, and guide the participation of multiple parties in industrial development through market mechanisms. In the policy of compensating insurance premiums for the first set of major technical equipment, explore the introduction of artificial intelligence integration in key areas such as technical equipment and production lines.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase support efforts.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Accelerate the construction and continuous improvement of manufacturing innovation centers in the field of artificial intelligence, such as intelligent connected vehicles, intelligent voice, intelligent sensors, and robots. Establish key laboratories in the field of artificial intelligence. Support enterprises, research institutes, and universities in jointly conducting research and development and industrialization of key technologies in artificial intelligence. Encourage the organization of artificial intelligence innovation and entrepreneurship competitions and encourage large manufacturing enterprises, internet companies, and basic telecommunications companies to establish double innovation platforms, play a leading role in backbone enterprises, strengthen cooperation in technology research and development and application, and enhance the innovation and international competitiveness of industrial development. Cultivate benchmark enterprises in artificial intelligence innovation and establish a platform for innovation exchange among artificial intelligence enterprises.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, encourage innovation and entrepreneurship.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for Promoting the Development of the Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Industry (2018-2020) (MIIT Science [2017] No. 315) (MIIT/December 31, 2017)
content: Carry out research on policies and laws and regulations related to artificial intelligence, and create a favorable environment for the healthy development of the industry. Strengthen industry integration, promote the reasonable opening of data in the industry, actively apply new technologies and new businesses, and promote the integration and development of artificial intelligence and industries. Encourage government departments to take the lead in using artificial intelligence to improve business efficiency and management services. Make full use of bilateral and multilateral international cooperation mechanisms, seize the opportunity of the Belt and Road construction, encourage domestic and foreign research institutes, enterprises, and industry organizations to broaden communication channels, carry out extensive cooperation, and achieve complementary advantages and win-win cooperation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, optimize development environment.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Main tasks: Accelerate the construction of a massive training resource library and a public platform for basic resource services for various types of data, such as literature, voice, images, videos, and maps. Construct a new type of computing cluster that supports large-scale deep learning and establish a comprehensive industrial public service platform. Research on network security full-cycle services and provide integrated and comprehensive security services for cloud and network. Further promote the research and industrialization of key technologies such as computer vision, intelligent speech processing, biometric recognition, natural language understanding, intelligent decision control, and new human-machine interaction, in order to solidify the foundation for the upgrading of industrial intelligence.

name: Implementation Plan for the 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence Three-Year Action (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 18, 2016)
content: Strengthen the cooperation between industry, academia, research, and application, support the construction of national engineering laboratories, national engineering (technology) research centers, and other innovation platforms, establish national-level innovation centers, and jointly promote research on the basic theory, common technologies, and application technologies of artificial intelligence. Promote the research and development of deep learning technologies based on perceptual data, multimedia, natural language, and other big data, and conduct cutting-edge theoretical and technological research in the field of brain-like intelligence, such as brain-like neural computing systems and brain-like information processing. Support the development of basic software and hardware technologies in the field of artificial intelligence, including chips, sensors, operating systems, storage systems, high-end servers, key network devices, network security technology devices, middleware, etc., and support the development of open-source software and hardware platforms and ecosystems. Accelerate the research and industrialization of application technologies based on artificial intelligence, such as computer vision and audiovisual perception, biometric recognition, complex environment recognition, novel human-computer interaction, natural language understanding, machine translation, intelligent decision-making and control, network security, etc. Strengthen the layout of cutting-edge technologies and construct the foundation for future integrated innovation technologies.
titlelist: Developing and nurturing the emerging industry of artificial intelligence, core technology research and development, and industrialization engineering.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Build an open-to-the-public repository of massive training resources and standardized test datasets for various types of artificial intelligence, including literature, voice, images, videos, maps, and industry application data. Construct basic resource service platforms that meet the needs of deep learning and other intelligent computing, such as a new type of computing cluster sharing platform, cloud-based intelligent analysis and processing service platform, algorithm and technology open platform, intelligent system security public service platform, and basic identity authentication platform for various biometric recognition. These platforms aim to reduce the cost of artificial intelligence innovation. Support the construction of a brain-like basic service platform that simulates the cognitive information processing process of a real brain neural system, and promote the development of artificial intelligence through brain-like intelligence research. Integrate resources from government, industry, academia, research, and application, and establish an industry public service platform. Promote cooperation between public service platforms, leading enterprises, and innovative enterprises, gather resources for artificial intelligence innovation and entrepreneurship, and provide specialized innovation and entrepreneurship services such as related research and development tools, testing and evaluation, security, standards, intellectual property rights, and entrepreneurship consulting.
titlelist: Cultivating and developing the emerging industry of artificial intelligence, the Basic Resources Public Service Platform Project.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Main tasks: Promote the integration and innovation of the Internet and traditional industries, accelerate the widespread application of artificial intelligence technology in areas such as home, automotive, unmanned systems, and security, enhance the network security capabilities in key areas, and improve the level of intelligent services in production and life. Support pilot demonstrations of artificial intelligence applications in important areas such as manufacturing, education, environment, transportation, commerce, healthcare, network security, and social governance, promote the large-scale application of artificial intelligence, and comprehensively enhance China's cluster-based innovation and entrepreneurship capabilities in artificial intelligence.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Encourage home furnishing companies to integrate industry chain resources, enhance the intelligence level and service capabilities of home appliances, durable goods, and other home products, and create new consumer market space. Support innovative service models for smart home companies, carry out application service innovation demonstrations in the fields of health care, smart entertainment, home security, environmental monitoring, energy management, etc., and provide interconnected sharing solutions. Carry out customized design of smart home products for hotels, office buildings, shopping malls, communities, households, etc., and provide big data application services.
titlelist: Promote innovation in key areas of intelligent products, smart home demonstration project.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Support the deep cooperation between backbone automobile enterprises and internet enterprises, and establish cross-border integration innovation platforms. Accelerate the research and development and application of software and hardware products such as intelligent assisted driving, complex environment perception, and in-vehicle intelligent devices. Support the research and development of technologies such as adaptive cruise control, automatic parking, and safe driving. Promote the technological research and development, application, and ecological construction of autonomous driving vehicles, develop key technologies such as intelligent automobile chips, in-vehicle intelligent operating systems, high-precision maps and positioning, intelligent perception, intelligent decision-making, and control, and gradually achieve the maturity of autonomous driving vehicle technology and products. Implement intelligent vehicle pilot projects in areas with conditions, build a safe, ubiquitous, and intelligent cloud-network-end integrated vehicle networking system, and promote typical applications of intelligent vehicles.
titlelist: Promote innovation in key areas of intelligent products, research and development of intelligent automobiles, and industrialization engineering.

name: Implementation Plan for the 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence Three-Year Action (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 18, 2016)
content: Promote the integration and application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of unmanned systems, and develop various forms of unmanned devices such as unmanned aircraft and unmanned ships. Accelerate the commercialization process of consumer-grade and industry-grade unmanned systems, improve the airworthiness management, safety management, and operation mechanisms of unmanned aircraft and other unmanned systems. Support the research and application of micro and lightweight intelligent unmanned systems, break through the technology of structural design, intelligent materials, automatic cruising, remote control, image transmission, and other technologies of high-performance unmanned systems. Promote the application demonstration of intelligent unmanned systems based on demand, enhance the intelligence level of unmanned systems, and promote innovative applications in important industries such as logistics, agriculture, surveying and mapping, power line inspection, security patrol, emergency rescue, and other important industries.
titlelist: Promote innovation in key areas of intelligent products, application engineering of intelligent unmanned systems.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Main tasks: Accelerate the research and development as well as industrialization of core technologies for smart terminals, enrich the services and forms of mobile smart terminals, wearable devices, virtual reality, and other products, and improve the supply level of high-end products. Formulate special action plans for the innovative development of the smart hardware industry, and guide the healthy and orderly development of the smart hardware industry. Promote the deep integration of artificial intelligence and robotics technology, and enhance the technology and application level of industrial robots, special robots, service robots, and other intelligent robots.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Support the development of intelligent applications that involve cloud and terminal collaboration, such as intelligent interaction and intelligent translation. Support the research and development of intelligent terminal hardware and software, including optimized image processing, operating systems, and applications. Encourage innovation in service models and formats, and promote the development of diverse supply models such as personalization and specialization. Accelerate the innovation and development of intelligent terminal products to meet the needs of individuals, households, automotive driving, medical health, production, and manufacturing.
titlelist: Enhancing the intelligence level of terminal products, improving the application capabilities of smart terminals.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Breakthroughs in key technologies such as lightweight operating systems, low-power high-performance chips, flexible displays, high-density energy storage, fast wireless charging, virtual reality, and augmented reality, accelerate the application of technological achievements in smart wearable devices. Encourage companies to actively conduct differentiated market demand analysis in areas such as health, medical, sports, personal safety, industry, and commerce, promote the innovation of wearable devices using artificial intelligence technology, greatly enrich application services, and enhance user experience.
titlelist: Improving the intelligence level of terminal products, development project of intelligent wearable devices.

name: Implementation Plan for the 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence Three-Year Action (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 18, 2016)
content: Promote the deep application of Internet technology and intelligent technologies such as intelligent perception, pattern recognition, intelligent analysis, and intelligent control in the field of robotics, vigorously improve the performance and intelligence level of robot products in sensing, interaction, control, collaboration, and decision-making, and enhance core competitiveness. Support the demonstration of intelligent industrial robot applications in industries with high labor intensity, high degree of danger, and high requirements for cleanliness and flexibility in the production environment. Promote the application and popularization of intelligent special-purpose robots in special fields such as disaster relief, anti-terrorism, and riot control. Promote the research and application of intelligent service robots in specific scenarios such as medical rehabilitation, education and entertainment, and home services.
titlelist: Enhancing the intelligence level of terminal products, research and application engineering of intelligent robots.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Build a standardized system for the integration of artificial intelligence, establish and improve technical standards for basic commonality, interconnection, industry applications, network security, and privacy protection, and conduct assessments of the intelligence level of artificial intelligence systems. Strengthen the standardization work in hot subfields such as smart homes, smart cars, smart robots, and smart wearable devices, including networks, software and hardware, data, systems, and testing, to ensure open collaboration and fair competition in the artificial intelligence industry and form a healthy development ecosystem. Encourage relevant departments, research institutions, standardization organizations, industry organizations, and enterprises to actively participate in international standardization work in the field of artificial intelligence, and establish a standard exchange and cooperation mechanism with international standardization organizations, influential international academic and industrial organizations. Promote the internationalization of standards in the field of artificial intelligence in China and continuously enhance our international discourse power.
titlelist: 保障措施,标准体系 translates to safeguard measures, standard system in English.

name: Implementation Plan for the 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence Three-Year Action (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 18, 2016)
content: Encourage enterprises to strengthen patent layout in key areas of artificial intelligence technology and applications. Strengthen research on intellectual property policies in artificial intelligence, and enhance the effective connection between standards and patent policies. Establish patent cooperation authorization mechanisms and patent risk prevention and control mechanisms in the field of artificial intelligence, and promote the transformation of intellectual property achievements in the field of artificial intelligence. Accelerate the opening and sharing of basic patent information resources, establish a public patent pool for artificial intelligence, support the construction of online intellectual property public service platforms, encourage innovative service models, and enhance the added value of intellectual property services.
titlelist: 保障措施,知识产权 translates to Protection measures, intellectual property rights in English.

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
content: Encourage relevant research institutions, universities, and experts to carry out training on the basic knowledge and applications of artificial intelligence. Relying on national major talent projects, accelerate the cultivation and introduction of a group of high-end and versatile talents. Improve the establishment of artificial intelligence-related majors and curriculum in universities, emphasizing the integration of artificial intelligence with other disciplines. Encourage cooperation between universities, research institutes, and enterprises, and establish a number of artificial intelligence training bases. Support high-end talents in the field of artificial intelligence to go abroad for academic exchanges on cutting-edge technologies, standards, etc., and enhance the level of technical exchange.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, talent cultivation

name: Implementation Plan for the Three-Year Action of 'Internet Plus' Artificial Intelligence (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2016] No. 1078) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on May 18, 2016)
