content: In line with major national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, encourage artificial intelligence companies with competitive advantages to take the lead in going global, actively expand overseas users, and jointly explore international markets. Encourage cooperation in artificial intelligence technology research and application with relevant countries, integrate domestic and foreign innovation resources, and enhance the innovation capability and international competitiveness of the artificial intelligence industry. Support industry associations, industry alliances, and commercial service organizations in building service platforms to provide international cooperation and overseas innovation services for innovative enterprises in the field of artificial intelligence.
titlelist: 保障措施,国际合作 translates to safeguard measures, international cooperation in English.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Using data flow to lead technological flow, material flow, capital flow, and talent flow, it will profoundly influence the organizational models of social division of labor and cooperation, promote the intensification and innovation of production organization methods. Big data promotes the networked sharing, intensive integration, collaborative development, and efficient utilization of social production factors, changing traditional production methods and economic operation mechanisms, and significantly improving the level and efficiency of economic operation. Big data continuously stimulates business model innovation, constantly giving rise to new business forms, and has become an important driving force for promoting business value-added and enhancing core values of enterprises in emerging fields such as the Internet. The big data industry is becoming a new economic growth point and will have a significant impact on the future information industry landscape.
titlelist: Development situation and important significance, big data has become a new driving force for promoting economic transformation and development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Establish a national macroeconomic regulation and control data system, timely release relevant statistical indicators and data, strengthen the utilization of internet data resources and information services, enhance the correlation analysis and integrated utilization with government data resources, and provide information support for the government's dynamic monitoring of financial, taxation, auditing, statistical, agricultural, planning, consumption, investment, import and export, urban and rural construction, labor employment, income distribution, electricity and industrial operation, quality and safety, energy conservation and emission reduction, etc., as well as analysis and decision-making on transforming development modes, in order to improve the scientific, predictive, and effective nature of macroeconomic regulation and control.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate the government's open sharing of data, promote resource integration, enhance governance capabilities, and support the scientific macroeconomic regulation and control.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Accelerate the establishment of a unified social credit code system for citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, relying on a national unified credit information sharing and exchange platform. Construct an enterprise credit information disclosure system and the Credit China website, share and integrate credit information from various regions and sectors, and provide one-stop services for the public to inquire about registration, administrative licensing, administrative penalties, and other types of credit information. Actively use big data methods to simplify the handling procedures in the comprehensive implementation of the reform of the three certificates in one and one license, one code registration system for business licenses, organization code certificates, and tax registration certificates. Establish a project parallel approval platform, form an online approval big data resource pool, achieve unified acceptance, synchronous review, information sharing, and transparent disclosure of cross-departmental and cross-level project approval, approval, and filing. Encourage government departments to efficiently collect, effectively integrate, and fully utilize government data and social data, grasp enterprise needs, promote the optimization and reengineering of administrative management processes, and provide more convenient, effective, and targeted services in business services such as registration and market access. Utilize big data and other methods to closely track the operation of small and medium-sized enterprises, especially newly established micro-enterprises, and provide support for improving relevant policies.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate the government's open sharing of data, promote resource integration, enhance governance capabilities, and advance the convenience of business services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Strengthen the flow of data between relevant law enforcement departments, enhance the collection, exploration, and correlation analysis of data in the field of social governance, and strengthen data support for handling major public emergencies, in order to improve public security capabilities and promote the construction of an intelligent prevention and control system and comprehensive governance system for public security, and safeguard national security and social stability. Column 3: Government Governance Big Data Project. Promote the application of big data in macroeconomic regulation decision-making support, risk warning, and execution supervision. Coordinate the use of government and social data resources, explore the establishment of a national application system for macroeconomic regulation decision-making support, risk warning, and execution supervision. By 2018, carry out pilot projects for the development and utilization of big data in government and social cooperation, improve the mechanisms for collecting and utilizing national economic-related data in areas such as finance, taxation, auditing, statistics, agriculture, planning, consumption, investment, import and export, urban and rural construction, labor and employment, income distribution, electricity and industrial operation, quality and safety, energy conservation and emission reduction, etc., promote data collection and comprehensive utilization at all levels of government according to a unified system, and strengthen support for macroeconomic regulation decision-making. Promote the sharing mechanism and construction of credit information systems. Accelerate the establishment of a unified social credit code system and establish a credit information sharing and exchange mechanism. Make full use of various social information resources, promote the integration of public credit data with the Internet, mobile Internet, e-commerce, and other data, encourage Internet companies to use big data technology to establish market-oriented third-party credit information sharing platforms, fully leverage the authority of the government-led credit system and the scale effect of the Internet big data credit platform, rely on a nationwide unified credit information sharing and exchange platform, establish an enterprise credit information disclosure system, achieve comprehensive and accurate sharing of basic credit information covering all levels of government and various types of credit subjects, and initially build a social credit system to provide comprehensive and accurate basic credit information services for efficient economic operation. Build a social governance big data application system. By 2018, explore and carry out a batch of application pilots in areas such as enterprise supervision, quality and safety, quality integrity, energy conservation and consumption reduction, environmental protection, food safety, safety production, credit system construction, and tourism services, focusing on the implementation of regional coordinated development, new urbanization, and other major strategies and functional area planning, break through the data barriers between government departments and enterprises and institutions, and achieve cooperative development and comprehensive utilization. Real-time collection and analysis of data from government departments and enterprises and institutions in market supervision, inspection and testing, illegal and dishonest acts, enterprise production and operation, sales and logistics, complaints and reports, consumer rights protection, etc., effectively promote the improvement of social governance capabilities at all levels of government.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate the government's open sharing of data, promote resource integration, enhance governance capabilities, and promote the efficiency of security guarantees.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Combining the development of new urbanization, the implementation of information-benefiting projects, and the construction of smart cities, the focus is on optimizing and improving people's livelihood services, stimulating social vitality, and promoting the market-oriented application of big data services. It guides and encourages enterprises and social organizations to carry out innovative application research, deeply explore public service data, and demonstrate the application of big data in areas such as urban and rural construction, living environment, health care, social assistance, elderly care services, labor and employment, social security, quality and safety, cultural education, transportation and tourism, consumer rights protection, and urban and rural services. It promotes the convergence and integration of traditional public service data with Internet, mobile Internet, wearable devices, and other data, develops various convenient applications, optimizes the allocation of public resources, and improves the level of public services. Column 4: Public Service Big Data Project. Medical and health service big data. Construct an electronic health record and electronic medical record database, and build a big data application system for medical and health management and services that covers public health, medical services, medical insurance, drug supply, family planning, and comprehensive management. Explore services such as appointment registration, hierarchical diagnosis and treatment, telemedicine, sharing of inspection and test results, integration of prevention and treatment, integration of medical care and elderly care, and health consultation to optimize and establish standardized, shared, and trusted diagnosis and treatment processes. Encourage and regulate research and application of medical and health big data innovation by relevant enterprises and institutions, and build comprehensive health service applications. Social security service big data. Build a unified social assistance, social welfare, and social security big data platform that extends from cities to rural areas, strengthen data connection and information sharing with relevant departments, and support the application of big data in labor employment and social security fund supervision, medical insurance monitoring of medical service behavior, labor security supervision, internal control audit, and tracking and evaluation of the effects of human resources and social security related policies. Use innovative service models of big data to provide more personalized and targeted services to the public. Education and culture big data. Improve the public service platform for education management, promote the accompanying collection and nationwide sharing of basic education data. Establish basic databases for age-appropriate enrollment population, student basic information, and lifelong electronic student records, and achieve vertical integration of student records in different stages of education. Promote the formation of a nationwide, collaborative, and interconnected education resource cloud service system. Explore the supporting role of big data in transforming education methods, promoting educational equity, and improving educational quality. Strengthen the construction of public welfare facilities such as digital libraries, archives, museums, art galleries, and cultural centers, build a comprehensive service platform for cultural communication big data, promote Chinese culture, and provide cultural services to society. Transportation and tourism service big data. Explore the integration and collaborative innovation of cross-departmental and cross-regional data in transportation, public security, meteorology, safety supervision, earthquake monitoring, and surveying and mapping. Establish a comprehensive transportation service big data platform, jointly utilize big data to enhance collaborative management and public service capabilities, actively attract high-quality social resources, and use transportation big data to provide value-added services such as travel information services and traffic guidance. Establish a full-media interactive center for tourism complaints and evaluations, monitor, warn, and timely divert tourist flows in tourist cities and key scenic areas, and provide strong support for regulating market order, facilitating tourist travel, improving tourism service levels, and promoting tourism consumption and the transformation and upgrading of the tourism industry.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate the government's open sharing of data, promote resource integration, enhance governance capabilities, and accelerate the universalization of public services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Promote the application of big data in various stages of the product lifecycle and the entire process of the industrial chain, including industrial research and development design, production manufacturing, business management, marketing, and after-sales service. Analyze and perceive user needs, enhance product added value, and build smart factories. Establish industrial big data resource aggregation and analysis platforms for different industries and stages. Seize the opportunity of cross-border integration of the Internet, promote the integrated application of big data, the Internet of Things, cloud computing, 3D printing technology, personalized customization, and other technologies in the manufacturing industry's entire industrial chain, and promote manufacturing mode transformation and industrial transformation and upgrading.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote industrial innovation and development, cultivate emerging industries, support economic transformation, and develop industrial big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Vigorously cultivate new formats such as internet finance, data services, data mining, data chemistry, data materials, and data pharmaceuticals, enhance the collection, acquisition, analysis, and utilization capabilities of big data resources in related industries, fully tap into the potential of data resources to support innovation, drive technological research and development system innovation, management method reform, business model innovation, and industrial value chain system reconstruction, promote cross-domain, cross-industry data integration and collaborative innovation, promote the development of strategic emerging industries, innovation in the service industry, and expansion of information consumption, explore and form new formats and models of collaborative development, and cultivate new economic growth points. Column 5: Industrial and emerging industry big data engineering. Application of industrial big data. Utilize big data to promote the deep integration of informatization and industrialization, research and promote the application of big data in various links of the industrial chain such as research and development design, production manufacturing, operation management, marketing, and after-sales service, develop big data analysis application platforms for different industries and links, select typical enterprises, key industries, and key regions to carry out pilot projects for the application of big data in industrial enterprises, and actively promote the networking and intelligence of the manufacturing industry. Application of service industry big data. Utilize big data to support brand establishment, product positioning, precision marketing, certification and accreditation, quality and integrity enhancement, and customized services in the service industry, develop big data solutions for the service industry, expand the scope of services, enhance service capabilities, improve service quality, encourage innovative business models, service content, and service forms. Cultivate new formats for data application. Actively promote the aggregation of big data in different industries, the integration of big data with other industries, and vigorously cultivate new formats such as internet finance, data services, data processing and analysis, data film and television, data mining, data chemistry, data materials, and data pharmaceuticals. Application of e-commerce big data. Promote the application of big data in e-commerce, fully utilize the big data resources formed in e-commerce to serve the government's market supervision and regulation services, and e-commerce companies should submit data to government departments in accordance with the law.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote industrial innovation and development, cultivate emerging industries, support economic transformation, and develop big data for emerging industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Build a comprehensive information service system for agriculture and rural areas, providing comprehensive, efficient, and convenient information services for farmers' production and life, narrowing the urban-rural digital divide, and promoting integrated urban-rural development. Strengthen the construction of agricultural and rural economic big data, improve the infrastructure for data collection, transmission, and sharing at the village and county levels. Establish a data collection, computation, application, and service system for agriculture and rural areas, strengthen rural ecological environment governance, and enhance rural social governance capabilities. Coordinate domestic and international agricultural data resources, strengthen the aggregation and utilization of agricultural resource element data, and enhance forecasting and early warning capabilities. Integrate and build a national agricultural big data center, promote the sharing and openness of agricultural data resources in various regions, industries, and fields, and strengthen the exploration and utilization of data resources. Accelerate the research and development of key technologies for agricultural big data, increase demonstration efforts, and enhance the capabilities and levels of intelligent production, networked operation, efficient management, and convenient services. Column 6: Modern Agricultural Big Data Engineering. Comprehensive information services for agriculture and rural areas. Make full use of existing data resources, improve the functions of data collection and sharing, improve the data collection and information dissemination functions of village-level stations for information entering villages and households, establish a system for investigating and analyzing global agricultural production, consumption, inventory, import and export, prices, costs, etc. of agricultural products, build a comprehensive information service platform for agriculture and rural areas, covering agricultural production, operation, management, services, and rural environmental improvement, integrating public services, convenience services, e-commerce, and network services, providing comprehensive, efficient, and convenient information services for agricultural and rural farmers' production and life, strengthening global agricultural investigation and analysis, guiding domestic agricultural production and consumption, improving the mechanism for agricultural product price formation, narrowing the urban-rural digital divide, and promoting integrated urban-rural development. Sharing of agricultural resource element data. Utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and satellite remote sensing to establish a monitoring system for resource element data of agricultural land, grassland, forest land, water facilities, water resources, agricultural facilities and equipment, new types of operating entities, agricultural labor, financial capital, etc. in China, promote the sharing of agricultural environmental, meteorological, ecological, and other information, and build a platform for sharing agricultural resource element data, providing agricultural resource data query services for governments at all levels, enterprises, and farmers, encouraging various market entities to fully explore platform data and develop services such as soil testing and formula fertilization, integrated pest management, and agricultural insurance. Information services for agricultural product quality and safety. Establish a data sharing mechanism for ecological environment, production materials, production processes, market circulation, processing and storage, inspection and testing, and other data in agricultural production, promote the automation of data collection, network transmission, standardized processing, and visualized application, improve the authenticity, accuracy, timeliness, and relevance of data, and connect and share with agricultural e-commerce and other trading platforms, realize information query, source traceability, destination tracking, and accountability in various links, promote the traceability of important production materials such as seeds, pesticides, and fertilizers, and provide information services on agricultural product quality and safety for producers, consumers, and regulators, promoting the safety of agricultural product consumption.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote industrial innovation and development, cultivate emerging industries, support economic transformation, and develop agricultural and rural big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Adapt to the national innovation-driven development strategy, implement the big data innovation action plan, encourage enterprises and the public to explore and utilize open data resources, stimulate innovation and entrepreneurship vitality, promote the deep integration of innovation chains and industrial chains, promote the organic combination of big data development and scientific research innovation, and form a big data-driven scientific research and innovation model. Open up the channel between technological innovation and economic and social development, promote mass innovation, open innovation, and collaborative innovation. Column 7: Mass Innovation Big Data Project. Big data innovation application. Encourage enterprises and the public to explore and utilize open data resources, stimulate innovation and entrepreneurship vitality through application innovation development competitions, service outsourcing, social crowdsourcing, promotion plans, subsidies, and application training. Big data innovation services. Develop a batch of big data public service products to meet the needs of economic and social development, achieve the integration of big data in different industries and fields, expand the service scope, and improve service capabilities. Develop scientific big data. Actively promote the gradual opening and sharing of scientific data obtained and generated by public welfare scientific research activities supported by national public finances, build a national major infrastructure for scientific big data, achieve authoritative collection, long-term preservation, integrated management, and comprehensive sharing of important scientific and technological data, and develop scientific big data application service centers to support the resolution of major issues in economic and social development and national security. Knowledge service big data application. Utilize big data, cloud computing, and other technologies to integrate knowledge in various fields on a large scale, build a hierarchical, comprehensive, and accurate knowledge resource library cluster, establish a national knowledge service platform and knowledge resource service center, form a national knowledge service system with the national platform as the hub and industry platforms as the support, covering the main areas of the national economy, with reasonable distribution and interconnectedness, and provide precise and high-level knowledge services for production and life. Improve the production and supply capacity of China's knowledge resources.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote industrial innovation and development, cultivate emerging industries, support economic transformation, and develop mass innovation big data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Focus on the forward-looking layout of major basic research on the theoretical system of data science, big data computing systems and analysis theory, and explorations of disruptive application models driven by big data. Conduct research on data science, and guide and encourage exploration in areas such as big data theory, methods, and key application technologies. Adopt a collaborative innovation model combining government, industry, academia, and research, as well as an open innovation model based on open-source communities. Strengthen key technology breakthroughs in areas such as massive data storage, data cleaning, data analysis and exploration, data visualization, information security, and privacy protection, to form a secure and reliable big data technology system. Support innovation in artificial intelligence technologies such as natural language understanding, machine learning, and deep learning, to enhance data analysis and processing capabilities, knowledge discovery capabilities, and decision-making assistance capabilities.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote industrial innovation and development, cultivate emerging industries, support economic transformation, and advance basic research and core technology breakthroughs.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Around the processes of data collection, organization, analysis, exploration, presentation, and application, support the development of large-scale general-purpose data storage and management software, big data analysis and exploration software, data visualization software, as well as hardware products such as massive data storage devices and big data integrated machines. This will drive the development of information technology core products such as chips and operating systems, and create a relatively sound big data product system. Vigorously develop big data solutions that deeply integrate with key industry business processes and data application needs. Establish a column for the research and industrialization of eight key big data technologies and products. Support the research and development of key big data technologies that meet the criteria through optimized integration of national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.). Strengthen basic research on big data. Integrate mathematical sciences, computer science, social sciences, and other applied disciplines to study relevance and complex networks, and explore the establishment of a discipline system for data science. Research new systems and theories for big data computing and analysis, and break through the technological bottlenecks in big data cognition and processing. Explore the establishment of models for data science-driven industry applications in key areas such as networks, security, finance, genomics, and healthcare. Research and develop big data technology products. Increase investment and strengthen the research and development of technology products in areas such as data storage, organization, analysis, processing, visualization, information security, and privacy protection, and break through key technological bottlenecks. By 2020, form a number of internationally competitive big data processing, analysis, visualization software, and hardware support platforms. Enhance the capability of big data technology services. Promote deep integration of big data with various industries, form a number of representative application cases, and use applications to drive the research and development of big data technology and products, forming mature big data solutions for various industries.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote industrial innovation and development, cultivate emerging industries, support economic transformation, and establish a big data product system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Support enterprises to carry out third-party data analysis and exploration services, technology outsourcing services, and knowledge process outsourcing services based on big data. Encourage enterprises to actively develop new formats such as internet finance and mobile finance based on their data resources and business characteristics. Promote the deep integration of big data with mobile internet, Internet of Things, and cloud computing, deepen the innovative application of big data in various industries, actively explore innovative collaborative win-win application models and business models. Strengthen the construction of innovative capabilities for big data application, establish a coordinated development of government-industry-university-research-use, and a big data industry system for the coordinated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Establish and improve the public service support system for the big data industry, form a big data open source community and industry alliance, promote collaborative innovation, accelerate the construction of quality technical foundations such as measurement, standardization, inspection and testing, and certification and accreditation in the big data industry, and accelerate the popularization of big data applications. Column 9: Big Data Industry Support Capability Enhancement Project. Cultivate backbone enterprises. Improve the policy system, focus on creating a good environment with excellent service and low factor costs, and accelerate the cultivation of leading backbone enterprises in big data. Give full play to the leading role of backbone enterprises, form a big data industry ecosystem where large, medium, and small enterprises support each other and cooperate with each other. By 2020, cultivate 10 internationally leading core enterprises in big data and 500 enterprises in big data application, service, and product manufacturing. Public services for the big data industry. Integrate high-quality public service resources, gather massive data resources, form public service platforms for the big data-related fields, and provide enterprises and users with public services such as research and development design, technology industrialization, human resources, market promotion, evaluation and assessment, certification and accreditation, inspection and testing, publicity and display, application promotion, industry consultation, investment and financing, education and training. Public services for small and micro enterprises' big data. Integrate the existing public service system and data resources for small and micro enterprises, connect with the online management systems for small and micro enterprises established in various provinces (regions, cities), and form a unified national big data platform for public services for small and micro enterprises, providing various types of public services such as scientific and technological services, comprehensive services, and trade services for small and micro enterprises.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote industrial innovation and development, cultivate emerging industries, support economic transformation, and improve the big data industry chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Strengthen research on network security issues in the big data environment and research on big data-based network security technologies, implement network security systems such as information security level protection and risk assessment, and establish a sound big data security assurance system. Establish a big data security assessment system. Effectively strengthen the security protection of key information infrastructure, conduct reliable and secure evaluations of big data platforms and service providers, application security evaluations, monitoring and early warning, and risk assessment. Clearly define the scope boundaries, responsible entities, and specific requirements for ensuring network security in various stages of data collection, transmission, storage, use, and openness, and effectively strengthen the protection of information related to national interests, public safety, trade secrets, personal privacy, military research and production, etc. Properly handle the relationship between development and innovation and security assurance, exercise prudent supervision, protect innovation, explore and improve security and confidentiality management norms and measures, and effectively ensure data security.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen security guarantees, improve management level, promote healthy development, and establish a sound big data security guarantee system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Adopt safe and trustworthy products and services to enhance the security and reliability of critical equipment in infrastructure. Establish a national network security information aggregation, sharing, and correlation analysis platform to promote the integration of network security-related data and the rational allocation of resources, and improve the emergency response capabilities for major network security incidents. Deepen the construction of network security protection systems and situational awareness capabilities, and enhance the protection of network space and the ability to identify security incidents. Carry out security monitoring and early warning notification work, strengthen the monitoring, early warning, control, and emergency response capabilities for preventing attacks, leaks, and theft in the big data environment. Column 10: Network and Big Data Security Assurance Project. Construction of network and big data security support systems. Adopt safe and reliable products and services in areas related to national security and stability, and achieve the security and reliability of critical equipment in key sectors by 2020. Improve the network security confidentiality protection system. Construction of big data security assurance system. Clarify the scope boundaries, responsible entities, and specific requirements for ensuring network security in various stages of data collection, transmission, storage, use, and openness, and establish and improve the security and confidentiality protection systems for important data resources and information systems in finance, energy, transportation, telecommunications, statistics, radio and television, public security, and public utilities. Construction of network security information sharing and big data support system for identifying major risks. Through tracking and analyzing the characteristics, methods, and patterns of network security threats, timely identification and effective protection against new technologies and methods of network security threats can be achieved. Strengthen resource integration and information sharing, establish a network security information sharing mechanism, promote the sharing of network risk information among governments, industries, and enterprises, and through big data analysis, provide early warning, assessment, and command for major network security incidents.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen security guarantees, improve management level, promote healthy development, and enhance security support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Establish a market-oriented mechanism for data application, support social capital participation in public service construction while ensuring fair competition. Encourage cooperation between the government, enterprises, and social organizations, and reduce social management costs by relying on professional enterprises to carry out government big data applications through various methods such as government procurement, service outsourcing, and social crowdsourcing. Guide the cultivation of a big data trading market, conduct pilot projects for application-oriented data trading markets, explore the trading of big data derivative products, encourage market entities in various links of the industrial chain to exchange and trade data, promote the circulation of data resources, establish a sound mechanism for data resource trading and pricing, and regulate trading behavior.
titlelist: Policy mechanisms, sound market development mechanisms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Innovative talent cultivation models, establishing a comprehensive and multi-level big data talent cultivation system. Encouraging universities to establish majors related to data science and data engineering, with a focus on training specialized data engineers and other big data professionals. Encouraging interdisciplinary talent cultivation in big data through methods such as cross-school joint training, with an emphasis on developing talents with knowledge in statistics, computer technology, and economic management. Encouraging collaboration between higher education institutions, vocational colleges, and enterprises to strengthen practical training for vocational skills talents, actively cultivating talents in big data technology and application innovation. Leveraging social educational resources to promote knowledge dissemination and education training in big data, enhancing overall social awareness and application capabilities.
titlelist: Policy mechanisms, strengthening the cultivation of professional talents.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data (State Council [2015] No. 50) (State Council, August 31, 2015)
content: Adhering to the principles of equality, cooperation, mutual benefit, and win-win outcomes, we will establish and improve international cooperation mechanisms, actively promote the exchange and cooperation of big data technologies, fully utilize international innovation resources, and promote the development of big data-related technologies. In line with the innovation needs of big data applications, we will actively introduce high-level and leading talents in the field of big data, improve supporting measures, and encourage overseas high-end talents to return to China for employment and entrepreneurship. We will guide domestic enterprises to strengthen research and development cooperation on key technologies and products in big data with international leading enterprises, support domestic enterprises in participating in global market competition, actively explore international markets, and cultivate several big data enterprises and products with international competitiveness.
titlelist: Policy mechanisms to promote international exchange and cooperation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Implement the national health security informatization project, based on the principles of prioritizing safety and protecting privacy, fully relying on the national e-government extranet and unified data sharing and exchange platform, expanding and improving existing infrastructure resources, and comprehensively establishing interconnected and shared national, provincial, municipal, and county-level population health information platforms. Strengthen the collection, integration, sharing, and collaborative use of application information system data in public health, family planning, medical services, medical security, drug supply, and comprehensive management. Innovate management models and promote online registration for childbirth. Eliminate data barriers, establish channels for data sharing among departments, regions, and industries, explore mechanisms for socialized health and medical data information exchange, and promote the aggregation of health and medical data on the platform, handling of business matters on the platform, and government decision-making relying on platform support.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, solidify the foundation for the application of health big data, accelerate the construction of a unified, authoritative, and interconnected population health information platform.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Encourage all types of medical and health institutions to promote the collection and storage of health medical big data, strengthen application support and operation and maintenance technology guarantee, and establish a data resource sharing channel. Accelerate the construction and improvement of a basic database with resident electronic health records, electronic medical records, electronic prescriptions, and other core elements. Establish close cooperation and unified management of health and family planning, traditional Chinese medicine and education, science and technology, industry and information technology, public security, civil affairs, human resources and social security, environmental protection, agriculture, commerce, safety supervision, inspection and quarantine, food and drug regulation, sports, statistics, tourism, meteorology, insurance regulation, and disabled persons' federation, among other departments, for sharing health medical data. Explore and promote the standardized access of data resources generated by wearable devices, smart health electronic products, and health medical mobile applications to the population health information platform. Establish a national health medical data resource catalog system, formulate policies and regulations for the open application of health medical big data in a classified, graded, and segmented manner, and steadily promote the opening of health medical big data.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, solidify the foundation for the application of health and medical big data, promote the sharing and openness of health and medical big data resources.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Build a number of clinical medical data demonstration centers for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, tumor, geriatric, and pediatric diseases based on existing resources. Integrate national medical big data resources such as genomics and proteomics to construct a clinical decision support system. Promote the application of gene chips and sequencing technology in the diagnosis of hereditary diseases, early diagnosis of cancer, and disease prevention and detection. Strengthen the management of population genetic information security and promote the development of precision medicine technology. Establish a data fusion and sharing mechanism for drug side effect prediction and innovative drug development, focusing on the research and development of drugs for major diseases and common key technologies for drug industrialization. Make full use of advantageous resources, optimize the layout of biomedical big data, rely on national clinical medical research centers and collaborative research networks, systematically strengthen the integration and sharing of clinical and scientific research data resources, enhance the efficiency of medical research and application, and promote the development of smart healthcare.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, comprehensively deepen the application of health and medical big data, promote the application of health and medical clinical and scientific research big data.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Strengthen the construction of the public health business information system, improve the information systems for national immunization programs, online reporting, online emergency response, occupational disease prevention and control, port public health risk warning decision-making, as well as the application functions of mobile emergency business platforms. Promote information sharing and business collaboration among medical institutions, public health institutions, and port inspection and quarantine institutions, and comprehensively enhance the capacity for public health monitoring, assessment, and decision-making. Integrate social network public information resources, improve disease sensitivity information early warning mechanisms, timely grasp and dynamically analyze the occurrence trends of diseases in the entire population and international public health risks such as global infectious disease epidemics, and enhance the capacity for early warning and emergency response to public health emergencies. Integrate multiple monitoring data on environmental health, drinking water, health hazards, port medical vector biology, and nuclear, biological, and chemical hazards, and effectively evaluate social factors that affect health. Carry out key monitoring of infectious diseases, occupational diseases, port-related infectious diseases, and medical vector biology, integrate multi-source monitoring data on infectious diseases and occupational diseases, establish a network system for rapid identification of laboratory pathogen test results, and effectively prevent and control major diseases. Promote the monitoring and assessment of disease risk factors, as well as intelligent applications for maternal and child health care, elderly health care, and international travel health care, and popularize healthy lifestyles.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, comprehensively deepen the application of health and medical big data, promote the application of public health big data.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Strengthen key technological breakthroughs in the storage, cleaning, analysis, mining, and security and privacy protection of massive health and medical data. Actively encourage social forces to innovate and develop the health and medical business, promote the deep integration of health and medical business with big data technology, accelerate the construction of the health and medical big data industry chain, and continuously promote the coordinated development of health and medical services with home health, elderly care, and domestic services. Develop home health information services, regulate online pharmacies and third-party delivery services for pharmaceutical logistics, and promote the development of traditional Chinese medicine health preservation, healthy aging, health management, health consultation, health culture, sports and fitness, health and medical tourism, health environment, and healthy diet industries.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, comprehensively deepen the application of health and medical big data, cultivate new formats of health and medical big data applications.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Leverage the leading role of high-quality medical resources, encourage social forces to participate, integrate online and offline resources, standardize the management of medical Internet of Things and health medical applications (APPs), vigorously promote applications such as internet health consultation, online appointment triage, mobile payment, and inspection and test result inquiries, follow-up tracking, etc., optimize and establish standardized, shared, and trusted diagnosis and treatment processes. Explore internet health medical service models. Based on family doctor contract services, promote the integration of resident health cards, social security cards, etc., activate the application of resident electronic health records, and promote integrated electronic health services covering the entire life cycle of prevention, treatment, rehabilitation, and health management.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, standardize and promote 'Internet + health care' services, develop smart and convenient health care services for the benefit of the people.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Implement the Healthy China Cloud Service Plan, build a comprehensive platform for health and medical services, provide remote consultation, remote imaging, remote pathology, and remote electrocardiogram diagnostic services, and improve the mechanism for mutual recognition and sharing of examination and laboratory results. Promote the sharing of data resources and business collaboration between large hospitals and grassroots medical and health institutions, as well as between general practitioners and specialists. Improve the hierarchical diagnosis and treatment information system based on the Internet and big data technology, extend and enhance the service capabilities of medical and health institutions, and promote the targeted shift of focus and sinking of resources.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, standardize and promote the 'Internet + Health and Medical' services, comprehensively establish a remote medical application system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Support the establishment of a cloud-based health and medical education training platform, with the National Health and Medical Open University as the foundation and the China Health and Medical Education MOOC Alliance as the support. Encourage the development of MOOC health and medical training materials, explore new internet teaching models and methods, organize high-quality faculty to promote the open sharing of online medical education resources, online interaction, remote training, remote surgical demonstrations, and learning effectiveness assessment. Facilitate lifelong education for medical personnel and enhance the capacity of grassroots medical and health services.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, standardize and promote the 'Internet + Health and Medical' services, promote the application of health and medical education and training.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Establish and improve laws and regulations for the development of health and medical big data applications, strengthen the standardized management of residents' health information services, clarify information usage permissions, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of all parties involved. Improve the data open sharing support service system, establish a management system of hierarchical authorization, classified application, and consistent rights and responsibilities. Standardize the entry standards in the field of health and medical big data applications, establish a credibility mechanism and exit mechanism for big data applications, and strictly regulate the development, mining, and application behaviors of big data. Establish unified standards for disease diagnosis coding, clinical medical terminology, examination and inspection specifications, drug application coding, information data interfaces, and transmission protocols, etc., to promote the standardization of health and medical big data products and service processes.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, strengthen the construction of a robust health and medical big data security system, strengthen the construction of regulatory and standard systems.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Strengthen the digital identity management of health and medical personnel, and establish a national unified identification system for trusted medical digital identities of healthcare personnel and institutions, electronic real-name authentication, data access control information systems. Actively promote the application of electronic signatures, gradually establish a new model of health and medical management that includes service management traceability, secure operation of diagnosis and treatment data, and multi-party collaboration.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, strengthen the construction of a robust health and medical big data security system, and promote the construction of a trusted network system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Accelerate the construction of a secure health and medical data system, establish a data security management responsibility system, and formulate rules for identification coding, scientific classification, risk grading, and security review. Develop a plan for the security of population health information, strengthen the national and regional population health information engineering technical capabilities, focus on content security and technical security, and ensure the independent controllability, stability, and security of national key information infrastructure and core systems. Conduct reliability, controllability, and security evaluations of big data platforms and service providers, as well as security evaluations and risk assessments of applications, and establish software evaluation and security review systems for security protection, system interconnection and sharing, and citizen privacy protection. Strengthen big data security monitoring and early warning, establish a mechanism for security information notification and emergency response coordination, establish a sound mechanism for the security of Internet + health and medical services, improve measures for resolving and responding to risks and hazards, strengthen the protection of important information related to national interests, public security, patient privacy, and trade secrets, and enhance security precautions in medical schools, research institutions, and other areas.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, strengthen the construction of a health and medical big data security system, strengthen the security of health and medical data.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting and Regulating the Development of Health and Medical Big Data Applications (State Council Document No. [2016] 47) (State Council/June 24, 2016)
content: Research and formulate government support policies to provide necessary support for the development of health and medical big data applications from the aspects of finance, taxation, investment, and innovation. Promote the use of the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model to encourage and guide the participation of social capital in the infrastructure, application development, and operational services of health and medical big data. Encourage cooperation between the government, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations, explore ways such as government procurement and crowdsourcing to achieve the integration of government and social applications in the field of health and medical big data. Fully leverage the established investment funds, stimulate the enthusiasm of social and private capital participation, encourage innovative and diverse investment mechanisms, improve risk prevention and regulatory systems, and support the development of health and medical big data applications.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational implementation and increase policy support.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Improve the ability to use big data and enhance the effectiveness of government services and supervision. Efficiently collect, effectively integrate, and fully utilize government data and social data, improve the working mechanism of government's use of big data, and regard the use of big data as an important means to enhance government governance capabilities, continuously improve the targeted and effectiveness of government services and supervision. Promote streamlining administration and delegating power and the transformation of government functions, promote law-abiding and honest operation of market entities. Use big data to improve the government's public service capabilities, strengthen in-process and post-process supervision of market entities, and provide basic support for promoting streamlining administration and delegating power and the transformation of government functions. Based on a nationally unified credit information sharing and exchange platform, use big data to promote the construction of a social credit system, establish a cross-regional and multi-department credit linkage reward and punishment mechanism, and create a fair and honest market environment. Improve the level of government services and the efficiency of supervision, and reduce the costs of services and supervision. Fully utilize the concepts, technologies, and resources of big data, improve all-round services for market entities, and strengthen the full life-cycle supervision of market entities. According to the needs of services and supervision, orderly promote government purchasing services and continuously reduce government operating costs. Combine government supervision with social supervision to build a comprehensive market supervision system. Improve the transparency of market entities' production and operation activities through government information disclosure, data openness, and sharing of social information resources. Effectively mobilize social forces to supervise the enthusiasm of market entities and form a wide-ranging market supervision pattern with the participation of the whole society.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Encourage government departments to utilize websites and emerging media such as Weibo and WeChat, closely integrate with the needs of enterprises, integrate relevant information to provide services for enterprises, and organize activities such as connecting enterprises with financial institutions for financing and connecting upstream and downstream enterprises for cooperation. Fully leverage the role of public credit service agencies to provide basic and public credit record inquiry services for judicial and administrative agencies, social credit service agencies, and the general public.
titlelist: Using big data to improve the level of service for market entities and enhance the level of information services.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: In the process of market supervision and public services, under equal conditions, a 'green channel' support and incentive policy shall be implemented for honest and trustworthy individuals, including priority processing and simplified procedures. In the processes of financial subsidies, government procurement, government purchasing of services, and government investment project bidding, market entities' credit records should be checked or they should be required to provide credit reports issued by qualified credit service agencies, with priority given to market entities with better credit status.
titlelist: Using big data to improve the level of service for market entities and establish a sound credit incentive mechanism.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Innovate statistical survey information collection and mining analysis techniques. Strengthen cross-department data correlation and comparison analysis and other processing services, fully tap the value of government data. Based on macroeconomic data, industry development trends, market supply and demand conditions, quality management conditions and other information, fully utilize big data technology to improve economic operation monitoring, forecasting, and risk warning, and timely release relevant information to the society, reasonably guiding market expectations.
titlelist: Using big data to improve the level of service for market entities, strengthening statistical monitoring and data processing services.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Give full play to the role of government organization and coordination, on the basis of lawfully and orderly opening up government information resources, formulate practical and effective policy measures to support banks, securities, trusts, financial leasing, guarantees, insurance, and other professional service institutions, industry associations, and chambers of commerce in using big data to provide more convenient and efficient services for enterprises, and support enterprise development. Support and promote financial information service enterprises to actively use big data technology to develop new products and effectively safeguard national financial information security.
titlelist: Using big data to improve the service level for market entities, guiding professional institutions and industry organizations to use big data to enhance services.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Based on the pilot project of the social credit information system, fully leverage the fundamental role of the national population basic information database, the legal person unit information resource database, and the reliance on the enterprise credit information disclosure system. Establish a national unified credit information sharing and exchange platform, integrate credit information from various fields such as finance, industrial and commercial registration, tax payment, social security payment, traffic violations, safety production, quality supervision, and statistical investigation, and achieve the co-construction and sharing of credit information among different regions and departments. Departments with market supervision responsibilities should accurately collect credit records of market entities during their performance, establish departmental and industry credit information systems, and incorporate them into the national unified credit information sharing and exchange platform as required.
titlelist: Utilize big data to strengthen and improve market supervision, and accelerate the establishment of a unified credit information sharing and exchange platform.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Governments at all levels should embed the use of credit information and credit reports into various areas and processes of administrative management and public services, as necessary conditions or important reference criteria. They should fully leverage the comprehensive regulatory effectiveness in areas such as administration, judiciary, finance, and society, in order to establish cross-departmental coordinated response and dishonesty constraint mechanisms. These mechanisms should be applied in market access, administrative approval, qualification recognition, enjoying fiscal subsidies and tax preferential policies, examination of the qualifications of legal representatives and responsible persons of enterprises, government procurement, government purchasing services, bank credit, bidding and tendering, state-owned land transfer, enterprise listing, customs clearance of goods, tax collection and payment, social security contributions, foreign exchange management, labor employment, price setting, e-commerce, product quality, food and drug safety, consumer product safety, intellectual property rights, environmental protection, public security management, population management, immigration and emigration management, and the granting of honorary titles, among other aspects. They should restrict or prohibit illegal and dishonest entities in accordance with the law. The establishment of industry-specific blacklist systems and market exit mechanisms should be promoted. The good credit status of applicants should be regarded as a necessary condition for various types of administrative permits.
titlelist: Utilize big data to strengthen and improve market supervision, establish a sound joint punishment mechanism for dishonesty.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Strictly implement the Interim Measures for the Public Disclosure of Enterprise Information, accelerate the implementation of the system for listing enterprises with abnormal operations and the system for listing enterprises with serious violations of laws and regulations. Establish a national enterprise credit information disclosure system, publicly disclose basic credit information such as enterprise registration, administrative licensing, administrative penalties, as well as annual reports of enterprises, lists of enterprises with abnormal operations, and lists of enterprises with serious violations of laws and regulations in accordance with the law, improve market transparency, and achieve organic connection and information sharing with the national unified credit information sharing platform. Support the exploration of socialized credit information disclosure services. Establish the Credit China website, collect and integrate credit information that should be made public by various regions and departments, realize one-stop access to credit information, and facilitate the understanding of the credit status of market entities by society. Government websites at all levels and their departments should be connected to the Credit China website and publicly disclose their government affairs information and relevant market entities' information on violations and irregularities on the Credit China website.
titlelist: Promote the open sharing of government and social information resources, and vigorously promote the public disclosure of market entity information.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: 'Support credit reporting agencies in lawfully collecting credit information from market transactions and social interactions. Support internet companies, industry organizations, news media, research institutions, and other social forces in lawfully collecting relevant information. Guide various social organizations to integrate and open up data, build mechanisms for government and social interaction in information collection, sharing, and application, and form a big data resource that integrates government information with social information.'
titlelist: Promote the open and shared access to government and social information resources, and systematically advance the open and shared access to information resources across society.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Build a sound national electronic government network, integrate network resources, achieve interconnection, and provide services for governments at all levels and their departments to fulfill their functions. Accelerate the construction of the national government informationization project, coordinate the establishment of national information resource databases for population, legal entities, natural resources and spatial geography, macroeconomics, etc., accelerate the construction and improvement of important national information systems, and enhance the level of government informationization.
titlelist: Enhance the government's ability to utilize big data and strengthen the construction of e-government.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: 'Support credit reporting agencies to collaborate extensively with government departments, enterprises, institutions, and social organizations, among others, in accordance with the law to carry out credit reporting business. Establish a credit reporting system that targets individuals, legal entities, and other organizations. Collect, organize, process, and store credit information formed in market transactions and social interactions in accordance with the law. Take reasonable measures to ensure the accuracy of credit information and establish comprehensive credit records covering all sectors and links of the economy and society.'
titlelist: Actively cultivate and develop socialized credit reporting services, promote credit reporting agencies to establish credit records for market entities.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Guiding credit reporting agencies to strengthen credit service product innovation and provide specialized credit services according to market demand. Establishing and strictly implementing internal risk prevention, avoiding conflicts of interest, and ensuring information security through sound regulations. Providing convenient and efficient credit services to customers in accordance with the law. Further expanding the application of credit reports in administrative management, public services, and sectors such as banking, securities, and insurance.
titlelist: Actively cultivate and develop socialized credit reporting services, and encourage credit reporting agencies to provide specialized credit reporting services.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Encourage the development of credit service industries such as credit consulting, credit assessment, credit guarantee, and credit insurance. Credit service institutions that meet the requirements shall enjoy preferential policies related to modern service industries and high-tech industries at the national and local levels, as stipulated. Strengthen the supervision of the credit service market, further enhance the market credibility and social influence of the credit service industry. Support and encourage domestic credit service institutions with strength to participate in international cooperation, expand international markets, and provide services for overseas mergers and acquisitions and international bidding by Chinese enterprises.
titlelist: Actively cultivate and develop socialized credit reporting services, vigorously cultivate and develop the credit service industry.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Further improve the innovation system, encourage relevant enterprises, universities, and research institutions to carry out industry-university-research cooperation, promote the collaborative integration of big data, accelerate breakthroughs in key common technologies of big data such as large-scale data warehouses, non-relational databases, data mining, data intelligent analysis, and data visualization, support the innovation of high-performance computers, storage devices, network equipment, smart terminals, and large-scale general-purpose database software, etc. Support enterprises and institutions to establish public technology service platforms for big data. Encourage big data enterprises with independent intellectual property rights and technological innovation capabilities to become stronger and bigger. Promote innovation applications of big data in various fields, enhance the level of social governance, public services, and scientific decision-making, and cultivate new growth points. Implement and improve policies in finance, taxation, industry, talent, and other areas to support the development of the big data industry and promote its rapid development.
titlelist: Strengthen security measures, enhance organizational leadership, and improve industrial support capabilities.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Implement the requirements of the national information security level protection system, strengthen the management of important data related to national security, enhance the risk assessment and security management of big data-related technologies, equipment, and service providers. Increase investment in research and development of network and information security technologies, establish a sound information security guarantee system. Take necessary management and technical measures to effectively protect national information security as well as the information security of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations.
titlelist: Strengthen security measures, enhance organizational leadership, and strengthen network and information security protection.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: Encourage universities, human resources service agencies, and enterprises to focus on cultivating interdisciplinary and innovative professional talents in the field of big data, and improve the training system for big data technology, management, and service talents. Strengthen the training of government personnel and enhance their ability to use big data.
titlelist: Strengthen security measures, enhance organizational leadership, and strengthen the construction of talent teams.

name: Opinions on Strengthening the Use of Big Data to Improve Services and Supervision of Market Entities (State Council General Office [2015] No. 51) (State Council General Office/July 1, 2015)
content: All regions and departments should effectively strengthen the organization and leadership of the use of big data. According to their respective responsibilities, they should research and formulate specific plans and implementation methods, and carry out the use of big data in their local areas and departments, continuously improving their service and regulatory capabilities.
titlelist: Strengthen security measures, enhance organizational leadership, strengthen leadership, and clarify division of labor.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: The industry maintains rapid growth. By 2025, the estimated scale of the big data industry will exceed 3 trillion yuan, with an average annual compound growth rate of around 25%. A modern big data industry system with strong innovation, high added value, and independent controllability will be basically formed. The value system is initially formed. The data element value evaluation system is preliminarily established, with element prices determined by the market, autonomous and orderly data flow, efficient and fair resource allocation, and the cultivation of a number of mature trading platforms, forming a basic market mechanism. The industrial foundation continues to be solid. Key core technologies achieve breakthroughs, and the leading role of standards is significantly enhanced.
