A number of high-quality open-source big data projects are formed, and infrastructure such as storage, computing, and transmission reach international advanced levels. The industrial chain is stable and efficient. The full life cycle industrial system of data collection, labeling, storage, transmission, management, application, and security is coordinated and developed, deeply integrated with the innovation chain and value chain, and new models and formats continue to emerge, forming a number of technologically advanced and widely used big data products and services. The industrial ecology develops in a positive manner. The society's understanding of big data continues to improve, enterprise data management capabilities are significantly enhanced, the development environment continues to optimize, and an internationally influential digital industry cluster is formed, with comprehensive deepening of international exchanges and cooperation.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Establish a value system for data elements. Improve property rights based on the nature of the data, establish basic systems and standards for data resource property rights, transaction circulation, cross-border transmission, and security, and improve mechanisms for data property rights transactions and industry self-discipline. Develop a framework and guidelines for evaluating the value of data elements, including basic principles, methods, and evaluation processes for value accounting. Conduct pilot evaluations of data element value in areas with well-established data management foundations such as the internet, finance, communications, and energy, summarize experiences, and provide demonstrations. Improve market rules for data elements. Promote the establishment of market pricing and government regulation mechanisms for data element markets, develop market operation systems for data asset evaluation, registration and settlement, transaction matching, and dispute arbitration. Cultivate big data trading markets, encourage enterprises of all ownership types to participate in the construction of element trading platforms, and explore various forms of data trading models. Strengthen market supervision and improve risk prevention and disposal mechanisms. Establish a mechanism for emergency allocation of data elements, improve the efficient coordination of data elements in emergency management, epidemic prevention and control, resource allocation, and other emergency situations. Enhance the role of data element allocation. Accelerate the data element transformation, carry out pilot demonstrations of market-oriented allocation reforms for elements, leverage the multiplier effect of data elements in connecting innovation, activating funds, cultivating talents, etc., and cultivate new models of data-driven production and finance integration, collaborative innovation, etc. Promote the datafication of elements, guide various entities to enhance their data-driven production factor allocation capabilities, promote the rational allocation of labor, capital, technology, and other factors between industries, sectors, and regions, and improve total factor productivity.
titlelist: Main task: accelerate the development of the data element market.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Accelerate the aggregation of big volume data. Support enterprises in upgrading information systems, deploying IoT sensing devices, and other methods to promote the collection of data in all aspects of research and development, production, operation, and services. Conduct a national survey of data resources and create a national data resource map. Establish a multi-level linked national industrial basic database and industry databases for raw materials, equipment, consumer goods, electronic information, etc., to promote comprehensive aggregation of industrial data. Strengthen the processing of data diversity. Enhance the diversified processing capabilities of numerical, textual, graphical, image, audio, and video data. Promote the correlation of multidimensional heterogeneous data, innovate data fusion models, enhance the comprehensive processing level of multimodal data, and improve cognition through data integrity. Build an industry data resource catalog to promote cross-level, cross-regional, cross-system, cross-department, and cross-business data integration and development. Promote the flow of data timeliness. Establish a data resource catalog and dynamic updating mechanism to adapt to the dynamic updating of data. Take the lead in building a secure and trustworthy data sharing space in industries and other fields, forming a data sharing mechanism that accurately matches supply and demand and responds in a timely manner, and enhancing the ability to efficiently share data. Develop a cloud-edge-end collaborative big data storage and computing model to support efficient transmission and distribution of big data and improve data flow efficiency. Strengthen data high-quality governance. Focus on the entire data lifecycle and improve data quality through quality monitoring, diagnostic evaluation, cleaning and repair, data maintenance, and other methods to ensure data availability and usability. Improve the data management capability assessment system, implement the data security management certification system, promote the national standards of Data Management Capability Maturity Model (DCMM), data security management, and continuously improve the data management level of enterprises and institutions. Strengthen data classification and hierarchical management, promote data resource planning, build a scientific, accurate, and orderly data governance system, and promote data authenticity and credibility. Column 1: Action to enhance data governance capabilities. Enhance enterprise data management capabilities. Guide enterprises to implement the national standard of DCMM, collect excellent data management cases in key areas such as manufacturing, energy, finance, and carry out publicity and promotion. Encourage eligible regions to introduce policies and measures to increase financial support in terms of funding subsidies, personnel training, and standard implementation pilots. Build an industry data governance system. Encourage research on data governance-related technologies, theories, tools, and standards, build a data governance system covering planning, implementation, evaluation, and improvement, and enhance enterprise awareness of data governance. Cultivate data governance consulting and solution service capabilities and improve the level of industry data governance. Promote the transformation of data high value. Strengthen the application of big data in government governance, social management, etc., improve situation judgment, scientific decision-making, and precise management capabilities, reduce external environmental uncertainties, and enhance the risk response capabilities of various entities. Strengthen the application of big data in all aspects of the manufacturing industry, continuously optimize the design, manufacturing, management, and service processes, promote new models such as digital prototypes, flexible manufacturing, business intelligence, and predictive maintenance, and promote production mode transformation. Strengthen the application of big data in information consumption, financial technology, and other fields, promote new models such as precise profiling and intelligent recommendations, and promote business model innovation.
titlelist: The main task is to leverage the advantages of big data characteristics.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Improve infrastructure. Fully deploy the next-generation communication network infrastructure and increase efforts in the construction of 5G networks and gigabit optical networks. Combine with the digital transformation of industries and the development of smart cities to accelerate the layout of industrial internet, connected vehicles, smart pipelines, smart grids, and other areas, promoting efficient data collection and transmission across all domains. Accelerate the construction of a national integrated big data center system, promote the construction of national industrial internet big data centers, strengthen intelligent scheduling of computing power, and build several national hub nodes and big data center clusters. Construct high-performance computing clusters and deploy supercomputing centers reasonably. Strengthen technological innovation. Focus on improving the general technology level of data generation, collection, storage, processing, analysis, security, and privacy protection. Fill in the gaps in key technologies, particularly enhancing the underlying support capabilities of independent basic software and hardware, promoting the development of independent open-source frameworks, components, and tools, developing open-source communities for big data, nurturing open-source ecosystems, and comprehensively enhancing technological breakthroughs and market cultivation capabilities. Promote the integration of cutting-edge technologies, driving the integration and innovation of big data with artificial intelligence, blockchain, edge computing, and other new-generation information technologies. Strengthen standard leadership. Collaboratively promote national standards, industry standards, and group standards, accelerate the formulation and revision of key standards in technology research and development, product services, data governance, transaction circulation, industry applications, etc. Establish national standard verification and testing points in the field of big data, select key industries, sectors, and regions to carry out standard trial verification and pilot demonstrations, improve the evaluation system for compliance with big data standards, and accelerate the application and promotion of standards. Strengthen communication and cooperation between domestic and international big data standardization organizations, encourage enterprises, universities, research institutes, industry organizations, etc. to actively participate in the formulation of international big data standards. Column 2 focuses on the formulation and application promotion of key standards. Accelerate the formulation of key standards. Based on the development needs of the big data industry, accelerate the formulation of basic general standards such as data open interfaces and interoperability, data resource planning, data governance, data asset evaluation, data services, digital transformation, data security, as well as key application areas such as industrial big data, national standards, and industry standards. Strengthen the construction of the standard compliance evaluation system. Increase the promotion and dissemination of key national standards for big data systems, data management, and data open sharing. Promote the cultivation of a standard compliance evaluation system covering data product evaluation, data resource planning, data governance implementation, data asset evaluation, data service capabilities, etc. Accelerate the international standardization process. Encourage domestic experts to actively participate in the work of international standardization organizations such as ISO, IEC, ITU, and accelerate the promotion of international standards proposals. Strengthen the analysis of the applicability of international standards, encourage the adoption of excellent international standards. Support relevant units to participate in international standardization work and undertake related positions, host international standardization activities, and increase international contribution rates.
titlelist: Main task, solidify the foundation for industrial development.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Build a high-end product chain. Sort out key links in big data products such as data generation, collection, storage, processing, analysis, services, and security, and establish a big data product map. In the data generation and collection process, focus on improving the compatibility of heterogeneous data sources and the efficiency of large-scale data collection and processing. In the data storage and processing process, focus on promoting the research and development of high-performance storage and computing systems and edge computing systems, and create dedicated hyper-converged hardware solutions. In the data analysis and service process, focus on promoting the research and development and application of systems such as multi-mode data management, big data analysis, and governance. Innovate high-quality service chains. Accelerate the development of big data services towards specialization, engineering, and platformization, focusing on data cleaning, data annotation, data analysis, data visualization, and other needs. Innovate new service models and formats for big data services, develop new service models such as intelligent services, value network collaboration, and integrated development and operation. Encourage companies to open up data in search, e-commerce, social networking, and develop third-party big data service industries. Cultivate high-quality big data service providers around comprehensive service needs such as diagnostic consulting, architecture design, system integration, and operation and maintenance. Optimize the industrial value chain. Taking the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry as the guide, cultivate specialized and scenario-based big data solutions for the entire process of research and development design, production manufacturing, operation management, and sales services. Build a multi-level industrial Internet platform system, enrich the platform's database, algorithm library, and knowledge base, and cultivate a batch of industrial apps for specific scenarios. Promote the deep application of industrial big data, cultivate new models such as data-driven platform design, networked collaboration, personalized customization, intelligent production, extended services, and digital management, and standardize the development of new formats such as gig economy, shared manufacturing, industrial e-commerce, and supply chain finance. Column 3: Industrial Big Data Value Enhancement Action. Raw material industry big data. Support comprehensive use of equipment IoT, production and operation, and external environment data by raw material enterprises such as steel, petroleum, pipeline networks, hazardous chemicals, non-ferrous metals, and building materials, establish analysis models, improve the intelligent and precise level of resource exploration, mining, processing, storage, transportation, etc., and achieve process optimization, energy saving and emission reduction, and safe production. Equipment manufacturing industry big data. Support equipment manufacturing enterprises in integrating data flow throughout the entire value chain of research and development, procurement, manufacturing, management, and after-sales, and develop new models and formats such as data-driven product research and development, simulation optimization, intelligent production, predictive maintenance, precision management, and remote operation and maintenance, to improve product quality, reduce production costs, and accelerate service innovation and upgrading. Consumer goods industry big data. Support consumer goods enterprises in integrating online and offline data, develop personalized recommendation algorithms, realize customized production of products, and fine-tune channel operations to promote accurate supply and demand matching. Support companies in establishing quality traceability databases covering the entire process, accelerate integration with the national product quality supervision platform, and achieve traceable and manageable product quality. Electronic information industry big data. Support electronic information manufacturing enterprises in accelerating the application of big data in scenarios such as product sales forecasting and demand management, production planning and scheduling, supply chain analysis and optimization, and product quality management, accelerate product iteration and innovation, optimize production processes, improve product quality, and ensure the stability of the industrial chain and supply chain. Extend the value chain of industries. Accelerate the construction of industry big data platforms, improve the level of data development and utilization, promote the assetization and productization of industry data, and realize the re-creation and value enhancement of data. Create mature application scenarios that serve the government, society, and enterprises, and use data innovation to drive management and model innovation, and promote the vigorous development of financial technology, smart healthcare, etc. Continuously carry out pilot demonstrations of big data industry development, promote the integration and application of big data in various industries and fields, and increase the promotion of excellent application solutions. Column 4: Action for the Development and Utilization of Industry Big Data. Communication big data. Accelerate the large-scale deployment of 5G networks and promote the upgrading of gigabit fiber-optic networks. Expand the interconnection nodes of backbone networks and establish a number of international communication entry and exit points. Improve the seismic resistance of public communication facilities in earthquake-prone areas, strengthen the construction of super base stations in mountainous areas, and plan and reserve mobile base stations to enhance the anti-destruction capability of public communication networks. Internally, strengthen the development, utilization, and security governance capabilities of data, improve enterprise management efficiency, and externally empower industry applications to support market supervision. Financial big data. Through big data actuarial, statistics, and model construction, help improve the modern financial regulatory system, fill in the gaps in regulatory institutions, and promote financial innovation under prudent regulation. Optimize risk identification, credit assessment models, and enhance data-driven risk management capabilities. Medical big data. Improve electronic health records, cases, electronic prescriptions, and other databases, and accelerate the sharing of data among medical and health institutions. Promote telemedicine and applications such as medical image-assisted interpretation and clinical diagnosis. Enhance the regulatory capacity of medical institutions and medical behaviors, and promote the reform of medical, medical insurance, and pharmaceutical linkage. Emergency management big data. Build a monitoring and perception network for safety production, increase the aggregation and sharing of natural disaster data, and enhance the capability of obtaining data at disaster sites. Build and improve emergency management databases for disaster risk surveys, monitoring and early warning, and play the role of big data in monitoring and early warning, regulatory law enforcement, decision-making assistance, rescue operations, and social mobilization. Promote intelligent application models such as data supervision, data disaster prevention, and data nuclear disaster, and achieve deep integration of big data and emergency management business, continuously improve the modernization level of emergency management. Agriculture and water conservancy big data. Utilize big data in agriculture production, economic operation, resource and environmental monitoring, and agricultural product production and sales, promote precision sowing, precise fertilization and pesticide application, and precise harvesting of field crops, and promote intelligent applications in facility horticulture and livestock and aquaculture. Promote the construction of a smart water conservancy system, improve water situation monitoring and intelligent scheduling capabilities based on river basins. Public security big data. Strengthen the compliant application of data such as identity verification. Promote the construction of an intelligent public security big data platform, coordinate the new generation of public security information infrastructure, strengthen the governance and service of police data resources, strengthen the correlation analysis of public safety data across industries and regions, continuously improve the capabilities of safety risk prediction and early warning, precise crackdown on illegal crimes, precise intelligent security and control, and convenient and efficient public security governance. Transportation big data. Strengthen the collection and analysis of data related to vehicles and transportation infrastructure, provide support for the development and application of autonomous driving and vehicle-road coordination technologies. Innovate applications such as travel planning, traffic flow monitoring and analysis, promote intelligent management of highways, coordinated traffic signal control, and priority passage for public transportation. Promote the sharing and application of data in transportation and logistics, and promote the development of multi-modal transportation such as railways, highways, waterways, and aviation. Power big data. Based on big data analysis and mining algorithms, optimization strategies, and visualization technologies, strengthen the deep application of big data in power generation, transmission and transformation, distribution, and consumption. Use big data to assist in the intelligent upgrading of power plants, carry out extensive collection of electricity information, and online energy efficiency analysis, achieve interactive optimization of power generation, grid, load, and storage, synergistic complementarity of multiple energy sources, and intelligent demand control. Credit big data. Strengthen the collection, sharing, openness, and application of credit information. Use technologies such as artificial intelligence and autonomous learning to build credit big data models, improve the intelligent identification, judgment, analysis, and processing capabilities of credit risks. Improve a new type of regulatory mechanism based on credit, guided by credit risks, and optimize the allocation of regulatory resources. Deepen the application of credit information in financing, credit, business cooperation, public services, etc., strengthen credit risk prevention, and continuously optimize the living environment. Employment big data. Use big data such as online recruitment, mobile communication, and social insurance to monitor changes in the labor market, timely grasp changes in enterprise employment and labor employment and unemployment situations, better analyze and judge the employment situation, and make scientific decisions. Social security big data. Accelerate the digital transformation of social security operations, carry out data mining and application work through scientific modeling and analysis methods, build a digital panorama for insured units and individuals, support personalized services and precision supervision. Build a social security big data management system and accelerate the sharing of social security data. Improve risk prevention and control classification management, strengthen business operation monitoring, and establish a systematic and regular data audit mechanism. Urban safety big data. Build a city safety risk monitoring and early warning system, realize effective aggregation of urban operation data in areas such as urban construction, transportation, municipal services, and high-risk industries, use advanced technologies such as cloud computing and artificial intelligence to monitor, monitor, and early warn urban safety risks, and improve urban safety management level.
titlelist: The main task is to build a stable and efficient industrial chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Cultivate and strengthen the main body of enterprises. Give full play to the role of leading enterprises as research and development entities, collaborative entities, user entities, and demonstration entities, continuously enhance their ability for independent innovation, product competition, and intellectual property layout, and utilize the capital market to strengthen and optimize. Encourage the development of small and medium-sized enterprises with specialization, expertise, and innovation, continuously improve their innovation capabilities and professional levels. Guide leading enterprises to provide data, algorithms, computing power, and other resources to small and medium-sized enterprises, promote the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises, and promote collaborative innovation in the industrial chain. Support vertically integrated enterprises with conditions to carry out the separation and reorganization of big data businesses, enhance their professional, scaled, and market-oriented service capabilities, and accelerate enterprise development. Column 5: Action to promote the development of enterprise entities. Stimulate the innovation vitality of small and medium-sized enterprises. Implement special actions to empower small and medium-sized enterprises with digitalization, and promote the improvement of development quality through digitalization, networking, and intelligent empowerment. Promote the supply and demand integration of big data technologies, talents, capital, and other factors through various forms of activities such as matchmaking meetings and entrepreneurship competitions. Strengthen tracking services for key enterprises. Around the key links of the big data industry chain such as data resources, basic hardware, general software, industry applications, and security guarantees, compile a list of key big data enterprises, and establish a close and clear contact mechanism. Column 5: Action to promote the development of enterprise entities. Transparent communication channels to make corporate demands smoother. Optimize public services for big data. Build a collaborative research and development platform for big data, promote joint research and development among government, industry, academia, and research institutes. Build carriers such as the Big Data Application Innovation Promotion Center to promote the industrialization of technological achievements. Strengthen the construction of public data training sets, build big data testing and certification platforms, experience centers, and training bases to improve the level of evaluation and consultation, supply and demand integration, entrepreneurship incubation, and talent training. Build a monitoring system for the operation of the big data industry, strengthen public management capabilities such as operation analysis, trend judgment, and scientific decision-making. Promote the development of industrial clusters. Promote the high-level construction of national new industrialization demonstration bases in the field of big data, guide the differentiated development of the big data industry in various regions, and continuously enhance the radiation and driving capabilities of industrial clusters. Encourage regions with conditions to conduct pilot projects based on national-level new areas, economic special zones, free trade zones, etc., focusing on data factor market mechanisms, international exchanges and cooperation, etc. Play the role of association alliances as bridges and links, support the organization of industry forums, industry competitions, and other activities, and create a good atmosphere for industrial development.
titlelist: The main task is to build a prosperous and orderly industrial ecosystem.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Improve the data security guarantee system. Strengthen the top-level design of big data security, implement relevant laws, regulations, and policy standards for network security and data security. Encourage industries, localities, and enterprises to promote data classification and hierarchical management, data security sharing and utilization, and carry out assessments of data security maturity and certifications of data security management. Enhance the capacity building of data security guarantee, guide the construction of data security situational awareness platforms, and improve the monitoring, analysis, and disposal capabilities of security risks such as sensitive data leakage and illegal cross-border data flow. Promote the development of the data security industry. Support key industries in the construction of data security technology means, enhance data security protection levels and emergency response capabilities. Strengthen the research and development and application of data security products, and promote the application of big data technology in the security protection of digital infrastructure. Strengthen the research and development and application of data security technologies and products such as privacy computing, data desensitization, and encryption, improve the supply capacity of data security products, and expand and strengthen the data security industry.
titlelist: Main task: Build a solid defense line for data security protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Strengthen the popularization of big data knowledge, promote industry typical achievements through various means such as media publicity, forums and exhibitions, competitions and events, experience centers, etc., and enhance the public's awareness of big data. Increase training on theoretical knowledge of big data, enhance the society's ability to acquire, analyze, and utilize data, and strengthen the ability to use data for innovation in various fields. Promote the system of Chief Data Officers, strengthen the strategic orientation driven by data, establish new mechanisms based on big data decision-making, and accelerate organizational and management changes through data utilization.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, enhance data thinking.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Coordinate the relationship between the government and the market, promote the marketization of resource allocation, further stimulate the vitality of market entities, and promote the better integration of effective markets and proactive government. Establish a sound governance system for the platform economy and promote the standardized and healthy development of the platform economy. Coordinate policy implementation, improve the coordination mechanism for the development and application of national big data, and strengthen departmental collaboration in policy, market, regulation, and security. Strengthen coordination between the central and local governments, establish a unified method for calculating the big data industry, guide local governments to conduct regular evaluations and dynamic adjustments, and guide local governments to combine reality to ensure the implementation of various tasks in the plan.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve promotion mechanisms.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Reform the project approval and organizational implementation methods for technological research and development, strengthen demand orientation, establish and improve innovative mechanisms that operate in a market-oriented, professionalized, and platform-based manner. Encourage eligible regions to deepen reforms related to the use rights, disposal rights, and income rights of big data-related scientific and technological achievements. Carry out pilot projects to grant scientific research personnel ownership or long-term use rights of technological achievements as part of their job duties, and improve mechanisms for technology transfer incentives and equity sharing. Cultivate and develop technology transfer institutions and technology managers in the field of big data, and enhance the professional service capabilities of technology transfer.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthening technological supply.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Strengthen investment in the research and development of big data infrastructure software and hardware, as well as key core technologies, to fill industry gaps and enhance basic capabilities. Encourage government industry funds, venture capital, and social capital to increase investment in big data enterprises based on market principles. Encourage local governments to strengthen support for the development of the big data industry, and provide financial rewards and subsidies for pilot demonstration projects and DCMM compliance in the development of the big data industry. Encourage banks to engage in intellectual property pledge financing and support qualified big data enterprises in going public for financing.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen financial support.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Encourage universities to optimize the establishment of big data disciplines, deepen the construction of new engineering disciplines, increase efforts in related discipline construction, and explore the development of new forms of digital teaching resources based on knowledge graphs. Encourage vocational colleges to deepen cooperation with big data enterprises, establish training bases, promote professional upgrading and adjustment, align with industry demands, and cultivate high-quality technical talents. Encourage companies to strengthen on-the-job training, explore new models of remote vocational training, and provide training for big data engineering technicians, job skills enhancement, and entrepreneurship and innovation. Innovate talent recruitment to attract big data professionals to return to China for employment and entrepreneurship.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, accelerate talent cultivation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: Give full play to the role of multilateral and bilateral international cooperation mechanisms, support domestic and foreign big data enterprises in deepening cooperation in areas such as technology research and development, standard setting, product services, and intellectual property rights. Promote big data enterprises to go global and actively explore international markets in countries and regions along the Belt and Road initiative. Encourage multinational companies and research institutions to establish big data research and development centers and education training centers in China. Actively participate in the formulation of international rules and digital technology standards in areas such as data security, digital currency, and digital taxation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote international cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: The new type of data center is oriented towards supporting the digital transformation, intelligent upgrading, and integrated innovation of the economy and society. It is driven by the demands of applications such as 5G, industrial internet, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence. It brings together diverse data resources, utilizes green and low-carbon technologies, possesses secure and reliable capabilities, provides efficient computing services, and empowers applications in various industries. It has high technology, computing power, energy efficiency, and security features. With the rapid development of the new generation of information technology, the storage, computing, and application demands of data resources have significantly increased. Traditional data centers are accelerating their integration with networks and cloud computing, and are evolving towards new types of data centers. In order to promote the development of new types of data centers, build an intelligent computing ecosystem centered around new types of data centers, and play a role in empowering and driving the digital economy, this action plan is formulated.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of the Big Data Industry (MIIT Order [2021] No. 179) (MIIT/November 15, 2021)
content: In three years, a new development pattern of data centers will be formed, which is characterized by reasonable layout, advanced technology, green and low-carbon, and adaptive computing power scale to digital economic growth. The overall layout will continue to be optimized, with national hub nodes, provincial data centers, and edge data centers being strategically positioned. Technological capabilities will significantly improve, the industrial chain will continue to be perfected, and international competitiveness will steadily increase. The level of computing power and efficiency will be significantly enhanced, network quality will be noticeably improved, and the coordinated development of data networks, cloud computing, and edge computing will be promoted. Energy efficiency will steadily improve, with the power usage effectiveness (PUE) gradually decreasing and the utilization of renewable energy gradually increasing. By the end of 2021, the average utilization rate of data centers nationwide will strive to exceed 55%, the total computing power will exceed 120 EFLOPS, and the PUE of newly built large-scale data centers and above will be reduced to below 1.35. By the end of 2023, the annual average growth rate of data center racks nationwide will be maintained at around 20%, the average utilization rate will strive to exceed 60%, the total computing power will exceed 200 EFLOPS, and the proportion of high-performance computing power will reach 10%. The computing power scale of national hub nodes will account for over 70%. The PUE of newly built large-scale data centers and above will be reduced to below 1.3, and in severely cold and cold regions, it will strive to be reduced to below 1.25. The end-to-end network one-way delay within national hub nodes should ideally be less than 20 milliseconds.

PUE is the ratio of the total power consumption of a data center to the power consumption of its IT equipment. It is generally measured using the average annual PUE value. The detailed calculation and measurement requirements can be found in YDT2543 Energy Consumption Evaluation Method for Telecommunication Internet Data Centers (IDC). A PUE value greater than 1 indicates that a higher proportion of electrical energy is used for IT equipment, while the energy consumption for cooling, power supply, and other non-IT equipment is lower. The calculation formula for PUE is: PUE = PTotal / PIT, where PTotal represents the total power consumption required to maintain the normal operation of the data center (measured in kWh), and PIT represents the power consumption of the IT equipment in the data center (measured in kWh).

content: Accelerate the application of data throughout the entire process, develop data-driven new models and new formats for manufacturing, and guide enterprises in effectively utilizing data in various business processes.
titlelist: Deepen data application, promote deep application of industrial data.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Organize and carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial big data applications, summarize and promote methods for industrial big data applications, establish evaluation standards for the level of industrial big data applications, and strengthen the evaluation of the current status of local and enterprise applications.
titlelist: Deepen data application, carry out industrial data application demonstrations.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Leverage the advantages of the industrial internet platform to enhance the platform's data processing capabilities. Open up data service resources to small and medium-sized enterprises to improve their data application capabilities. Accelerate the software development of industrial knowledge, technology, and experience, and cultivate a batch of industrial apps for different scenarios.
titlelist: Deepen data application, enhance the support role of data platform.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Focus on cultivating a group of industrial big data solution providers for key industries. Encourage the industry's innovative applications by organizing industrial big data competitions. Increase efforts in publicity and promotion, and conduct online and offline data application training activities.
titlelist: Deepen data application, build industrial data application ecosystem.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Promote the national standard Data Management Capability Maturity Assessment Model, establish an industrial big data management capability assessment system, and guide enterprises to enhance their data management capabilities. Encourage governments at all levels to strengthen policy guidance and financial support in implementing standards, personnel training, and performance evaluation.
titlelist: Improve data governance and carry out standardized assessment of data management capabilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Strengthen the construction of the industrial big data standard system, accelerate the development of key standards such as data quality, data governance, and data security, and carry out experimental verification and pilot promotion in industries and regions where conditions are ripe.
titlelist: Improve data governance, promote standard development and application.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Implement the Guidelines for Industrial Data Classification and Grading (Trial Implementation) to achieve data scientific management and promote the establishment of an industrial data classification and grading management system with enterprises as the main body.
titlelist: Improve data governance and strengthen the classification and hierarchical management of industrial data.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Clarify the main responsibilities of enterprises and the supervisory and management responsibilities of governments at all levels, and establish an industrial data security responsibility system. Strengthen the construction of industrial big data security capabilities such as situational awareness, testing and evaluation, early warning and disposal, and achieve closed-loop management to comprehensively ensure data security.
titlelist: Strengthen data security and build an industrial data security management system.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Carry out research and development on security technologies such as encrypted transmission, access control, and data anonymization, to enhance the ability to prevent tampering, theft, and leakage. Accelerate the cultivation of security backbone enterprises, strengthen data security services, and foster a healthy security industry ecosystem.
titlelist: Strengthen data security, enhance the research and development of industrial data security products.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Accelerate the research and application of common technologies such as data aggregation, modeling analysis, application development, resource scheduling, and monitoring management, and promote the deployment and integration of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, and edge computing.
titlelist: Promote industrial development, break through key common technologies in industrial data.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Promote the development of related products in the areas of industrial big data collection, storage, processing, analysis, and services, and build a foundational and universal product system for big data. Cultivate a group of data resource service providers and leading data service enterprises, and develop a group of third-party service organizations focusing on data standard formulation, testing and evaluation, research, and consulting.
titlelist: Promote industrial development and build an industrial data product and service system.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Support the construction of an industrial big data innovation platform that promotes collaboration between industry, academia, and research. Focus on addressing major common needs and industry pain points, accelerate the transformation of technological achievements, and promote the advancement of industrial foundations and the modernization of industrial chains.
titlelist: Promote industrial development, focus on building an innovative ecosystem for industrial data.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: The provincial-level industrial and information technology authorities (the department in charge of the big data industry) should establish a mechanism to promote the development of industrial big data and coordinate the development of local industrial big data. Encourage local areas to strengthen policy innovation according to local conditions, conduct research on major issues, implement policy evaluation and consultation, and support the innovation and application of industrial big data.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational support and improve work promotion mechanisms.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Give full play to the guiding role of fiscal funds, and promote policy banks to increase targeted credit support. Encourage financial institutions to innovate products and services, and support innovation and entrepreneurship in industrial big data. Improve the talent training system and cultivate composite talents who possess both big data technical capabilities and familiarity with industry needs.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational support, enhance financial and talent support.

name: Guiding Opinions on the Development of Industrial Big Data (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 67) (MIIT/April 28, 2020)
content: Promote cooperation and exchange in the field of industrial big data in a larger scope, wider range, and deeper level, focusing on policies, technologies, standards, talents, and enterprises, continuously enhancing the level of international development.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational support and promote international exchange and cooperation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Establish a sound evaluation system and energy resource management system for green data centers, create a group of advanced and exemplary green data centers, develop innovative green technology products and solutions, and cultivate a group of professional third-party green service organizations. By 2022, the average energy consumption of data centers will basically reach the international advanced level, the energy efficiency of newly built large and super-large data centers will be below 1.4, high-energy-consuming old equipment will be phased out, water resource utilization efficiency and the proportion of clean energy application will be significantly improved, and waste electrical and electronic products will be effectively recycled and reused.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Strengthen the green design guidance for newly built data centers in areas such as IT equipment, rack layout, cooling and ventilation systems, power supply and distribution systems, and clean energy utilization systems. Encourage the adoption of efficient system design solutions such as liquid cooling, distributed power supply, modular data centers, virtualization, and cloud-based IT resources, taking into full consideration the precise matching of power environmental systems and the operational status of IT equipment. Encourage the construction of natural cold sources, the utilization of waste heat recovery systems or renewable energy generation systems in self-owned facilities. Encourage the use of numerical simulation technology for thermal field analysis to verify design cooling capacity and data center airflow characteristics. Guide large and super-large data centers to design energy usage efficiency values not exceeding 1.4.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the level of green development in newly built data centers and strengthening green design.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Guide the implementation of green construction in the construction of new and renovated data centers, while ensuring quality and safety requirements, maximizing energy and resource conservation, reducing negative environmental impacts, and achieving energy saving, land saving, water saving, material saving, and environmental protection. Strictly implement the Management Measures for the Restriction of Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Products and the Limitation Requirements for Restricted Substances in Electronic and Electrical Products (GB/T26572) and other regulatory requirements, encourage data centers to use green electricity and green products that meet the requirements of green design product evaluation, and gradually establish a sound green supply chain management system.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the level of green development in newly built data centers, deepening green construction and procurement.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Promote the orderly implementation of energy-saving and greening transformation projects in data centers, especially in old data centers with low energy resource utilization efficiency. Strengthen the technical transformation and optimization upgrade in equipment layout, cooling architecture, peripheral protection structure (sealing, shading, insulation, etc.), power supply and distribution methods, single cabinet power density, and intelligent operation strategies of various systems. Encourage green evaluation of transformation projects. Strive to achieve an energy utilization efficiency value of no more than 1.8 for existing large and super-large data centers through transformation.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthen green operation and transformation of existing data centers, and promote energy conservation and green transformation in an orderly manner.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Accelerate the elimination of high-energy-consuming equipment, guide data centers to scientifically formulate plans for updating old equipment, establish standardized and traceable product application records, and jointly establish a waste electrical and electronic product recycling system with product manufacturers and qualified recycling companies. Under the premise of meeting reliability requirements, pilot the use of power batteries as energy storage batteries for data centers to smooth out peak and off-peak electricity demand. Promote product manufacturers and recycling companies to accelerate the resource utilization of waste electrical and electronic products, implement source control and green production, and maximize resource utilization efficiency throughout the product lifecycle.
titlelist: Key tasks: strengthen green operation and transformation of existing data centers, and enhance the disposal of waste electrical and electronic products.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Encourage backbone enterprises, research institutes, industry organizations, and others in the data center industry to strengthen technological collaboration and cooperation, and build a collaborative green data center technological innovation system that integrates industry, academia, research, and application, promoting the development of green industrial clusters. Focus on accelerating the development and innovation of new technologies and products in areas such as energy efficiency improvement, water efficiency enhancement, control of toxic and hazardous substances, recycling of waste equipment and batteries, information management and control systems, simulation and thermal management, renewable energy, distributed energy supply, and microgrid utilization. Research and formulate relevant technical product standards and specifications.
titlelist: Key tasks: accelerate the innovation and promotion of green technology products, accelerate the research and development innovation of green key and common technology products.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Give full play to the supporting role of standards in the construction of green data centers, and promote the upgrading of green data centers. Establish a sound green data center standard system covering design, construction, operation and maintenance, evaluation, and technical products, strengthen the promotion of standards, and enhance the coordination of standards. Strengthen the discourse power of international standards, actively promote mutual trust and recognition with international standards. Based on relevant evaluation standards, establish a green data center evaluation mechanism that combines self-evaluation, social evaluation, and government guidance, and explore the formation of open and transparent channels for publishing evaluation results.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing green support service capabilities and improving the standard system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Accelerate the cultivation of third-party service organizations with public welfare characteristics, encourage them to innovate green evaluation and service models, and provide consulting, testing, evaluation, auditing, and other services to data centers. Encourage data centers to independently use third-party service organizations to conduct green evaluations, and carry out effective green technology transformation and operation and maintenance optimization based on the evaluation results. Rely on higher education institutions, research institutes, third-party service organizations, and other institutions to establish a diversified talent training system for green data centers, and strengthen the training of talents for green data centers.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing green support service capabilities and cultivating third-party service agencies.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Encourage data centers and energy-saving service companies to expand contract energy management, study energy-saving trading mechanisms, and explore financial service models such as green data center leasing. Encourage data centers to directly engage in power trading with renewable energy generation companies and purchase renewable energy green power certificates. Explore the establishment of incentive mechanisms and financing platforms for technological innovation and promotion of green data centers, and improve diversified investment and financing systems.
titlelist: Key tasks, exploring and innovating market promotion mechanisms.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the State Administration of Government Affairs, and the National Energy Administration have established a coordination mechanism to strengthen communication and collaboration in policies, standards, and industry management, and to enhance guidance on local related work. Industrial and information technology, government affairs, and energy authorities in various regions should fully recognize the importance of green data center construction, formulate relevant policies and measures based on actual conditions, fully leverage the role of industry associations, industrial alliances, and other institutions as bridges and links, and effectively promote the construction of green data centers.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Fully utilize existing funding channels for green manufacturing, energy conservation, and emission reduction. Implement preferential tax policies for energy-saving, water-saving, and environmental protection special equipment, as well as support the establishment of green data centers through green credit, and the compensation mechanism for the first set of major technological equipment insurance. Prioritize providing electricity discounts and policy support for green data centers in terms of direct power supply, large industrial electricity, and multiple power supply introductions. Increase government procurement policy support, and guide national institutions, enterprises, and institutions to prioritize the procurement of services such as data center leasing, cloud services, and big data provided by green data centers.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen policy support

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Integrate existing industry resources, establish a national public service platform for green data centers that combines policy promotion, technical exchange and promotion, talent training, and data analysis and diagnosis services. Strengthen the construction and management of expert databases, and leverage the positive role of experts in decision-making advice, theoretical guidance, and professional consulting. Continuously release the Catalog of Advanced and Applicable Technologies for Green Data Centers to accelerate the transformation and industrialization of innovative achievements. Encourage relevant enterprises, institutions, and industry organizations to actively carry out technology product exchange and promotion activities, and encourage eligible enterprises, universities, and research institutes to establish laboratories or engineering centers for key and common technologies of green data centers.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen public services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of Green Data Centers (MIIT Joint Letter [2019] No. 24) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/January 21, 2019)
content: Make full use of existing international cooperation and exchange mechanisms and platforms, strengthen communication and cooperation in green data center technology products, standard formulation, talent cultivation, etc., organize professional training, technical and policy seminars, forums, and other activities, build a batch of internationally competitive green data centers, and form integrated solutions for related technology products. Combine with major national strategies such as the Belt and Road initiative to accelerate the development of international markets and promote the export of advantageous technologies and services.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen international exchange and cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: For large-scale users with strong application demands in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, the Yangtze River Delta region, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the Chengdu-Chongqing region, it is important to coordinate the layout of data centers within cities and surrounding areas, achieve coordinated and sustainable deployment of large-scale computing power with land, energy, water, electricity, and other resources, optimize the supply structure of data centers, expand the space for computing power growth, and meet the needs of implementing major regional development strategies. For nodes in Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, Ningxia, and other regions with abundant renewable energy, suitable climate, and great potential for green development of data centers, it is important to improve the quality and efficiency of computing services, fully leverage resource advantages, strengthen basic guarantees such as networks, actively undertake non-real-time computing needs such as background processing, offline analysis, and storage backup nationwide, and build non-real-time computing support bases for the whole country. For areas outside the national hub nodes, it is important to promote the construction of data centers that meet local business needs, strengthen the green and intensive management of data centers, and create computing services with local characteristics, serving the local area with an appropriate scale. Strengthen network connectivity with neighboring national hub nodes. In the future, national hub nodes will be added as needed according to development requirements.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Guide the development of super-large and large-scale data center clusters, build data center clusters, promote cloud-based analysis and processing of large-scale data, focus on supporting the centralized processing of massive-scale data, support business needs such as industrial Internet, finance and securities, disaster warning, remote medical care, video calls, and artificial intelligence reasoning that require close proximity, high-frequency, real-time interaction. The end-to-end one-way network latency of data centers should ideally be within a range of 20 milliseconds. Data center clusters in Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia should prioritize backend processing, offline analysis, storage backup, and other non-real-time computing needs. In the initial stage, for national hub nodes across regions such as Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and Chengdu-Chongqing, the layout should generally not exceed 2 clusters. For national hub nodes in single administrative regions such as Guizhou, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, and Ningxia, the layout should generally be 1 cluster. Clusters should focus on intensive development, clarify standards for data center construction scale, energy efficiency level, and deployment rate, and avoid blind investment and construction.
titlelist: Data center layout, data center cluster

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Within the urban city area, accelerate the transformation and upgrading of existing data centers to improve efficiency. Support the development of high-performance, edge data centers. Encourage data centers within the city area to serve as the edge for computing power, prioritizing the fulfillment of high-frequency trading in the financial market, virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR), ultra-high-definition video, connected vehicles, networked drones, smart power, smart factories, smart security, and other real-time business demands. The end-to-end one-way network latency of data centers should ideally be within a range of 10 milliseconds.
titlelist: Data center layout, urban internal data center

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: By focusing on the layout of data center clusters, we will strengthen the construction of green data centers and enhance energy-saving and consumption reduction requirements. We will promote the use of energy-saving technologies such as high-density integration of efficient electronic information equipment, new types of precision air conditioning for computer rooms, liquid cooling, modular cabinet systems, and waste heat recovery. While ensuring safe operation and maintenance, we encourage the use of cascaded utilization products of power batteries as energy storage and backup power devices. We will accelerate the transformation and upgrading of old infrastructure. We will improve the comprehensive energy-saving evaluation standard system for data centers, which includes indicators such as energy utilization efficiency, computing power utilization efficiency, and renewable energy utilization rate.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening green and intensive construction.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Scale up the application of hardware and software products such as server chips, operating systems, databases, middleware, distributed computing and storage, and data flow models. Support and promote platform-level original technologies in big data infrastructure, distributed data operating systems, and big data analytics. Organize research institutes, universities, enterprises, and technology communities to collaborate on the development and application of key technological products, enhancing the independent innovation capability of the entire big data industry chain.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, promoting breakthroughs in core technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Construct high-speed data transmission networks between data center clusters, as well as between clusters and major cities, optimize communication network structures, expand network communication bandwidth, and reduce data transfer latency. Establish a data center network monitoring system to promote efficient supply and coordinated development between data centers and network services. Establish a reasonable network settlement mechanism within national hub nodes to reduce long-distance transmission costs. Promote the construction of national new internet exchange centers and national internet backbone direct connection points around data center clusters, and facilitate interconnection and interoperability of traffic among internet companies, cloud service providers, telecommunications operators, and other parties.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, accelerating network interconnection and interoperability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Promote the full utilization of renewable energy such as wind energy, solar energy, tidal energy, and biomass energy in data centers. Support the establishment of renewable energy power plants to support data center clusters. Expand the scope of market-based transactions for renewable energy and encourage data center enterprises to participate in renewable energy market transactions. Support data centers in adopting methods such as direct supply for large users, dedicated power lines, and the construction of distributed photovoltaic systems to enhance the consumption of renewable energy. Ensure the availability of land and water resources for data centers.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening energy supply guarantee.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Establish a sound mechanism and technical system for monitoring energy consumption in data centers. Strengthen the coordination of energy consumption indicators in data centers, and allocate unified energy consumption indicators for data center clusters at the provincial, regional, and municipal levels. Encourage the allocation of energy consumption indicators through energy rights trading. Explore cross-provincial cooperation in sharing energy consumption and benefits. Encourage data centers to not only fulfill their minimum consumption responsibilities but also strive to achieve incentivized consumption targets.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, strengthening energy consumption monitoring and management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Support government departments and enterprises to integrate internal computing resources, and conduct integrated scheduling of clusters and data centers within urban areas. Support the development of multi-cloud management services in public clouds, industry clouds, and other fields, and strengthen integrated resource scheduling between multiple clouds, between clouds and data centers, and between clouds and networks. Support the construction of an integrated access and integration verification environment, further connecting computing resources across industries, regions, and levels, and building a computing service resource pool.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, improving computing power service level.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Build data sharing, data openness, and integration of government-enterprise data into a common data circulation infrastructure platform, and establish a sound data circulation management system. Experiment with secure multi-party computation, blockchain, privacy computation, data sandbox, and other technological models to construct a trusted data circulation environment and improve data circulation efficiency. Explore the classification of data resources and research and formulate relevant specifications and standards.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, promoting orderly circulation of data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Carry out the construction of an integrated urban data brain to provide big data support for urban industrial structure adjustment, economic operation monitoring, social services and governance, transportation, and ecological environment. Select public health, natural disasters, market supervision, and other emergency scenarios to experiment with the construction of a 'data target field' and explore the rules and collaborative mechanisms for data utilization under different emergency conditions.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, deepening the application of data intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Improve risk identification and protection technologies for aggregating and integrating massive amounts of data, data anonymization techniques, data security compliance assessment and certification, data encryption protection mechanisms, and related technical monitoring methods. Simultaneously plan, construct, and use security technology measures to ensure business stability and data security. Accelerate the construction of national Internet data centers, cloud platforms, and other data security technical monitoring methods to enhance the ability to monitor sensitive data leaks and analyze abnormal data flows.
titlelist: Key tasks of national hub nodes, ensuring network data security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System Computing Power Hub (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2021] No. 709) (Development and Reform Commission and other departments/May 24, 2021)
content: Organize and carry out a major demonstration project for the coordinated innovation system of national integrated big data centers. Conduct pilot demonstrations in areas such as data center direct network connection, integrated computing power services, data circulation, and applications. Support the large-scale application of key software and hardware products such as server chips and cloud operating systems. Support the demonstration project of 'Eastern Data, Western Computing' to deepen the collaborative computing power between the eastern and western regions. Support the integrated verification of common technologies and mechanisms such as the development of related technical platforms for big data centers, resource access and scheduling, and industrial applications.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen project protection.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: By 2025, a rational and green integrated infrastructure pattern will be formed for data centers nationwide. The structural balance of data centers in the eastern and western regions will be achieved, and the energy utilization efficiency of large and super-large data centers will be reduced to below 1.3. The level of data center intensification, scaling, and greening will significantly improve, and the utilization rate will be noticeably increased. The public cloud service system will initially take shape, and the cost of acquiring computing power for the whole society will be significantly reduced. The barriers to data circulation between government departments and between government and enterprises will be further broken, and the vitality of data resource circulation will be significantly enhanced. The collaborative application effect of big data will be highlighted, and a number of industry data brains and city data brains will be formed nationwide. The trend of efficient transformation of social computing resources and data resources into intellectual resources will be basically formed, and the capability of data security guarantee will steadily improve.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese means man or male.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
