content: Optimize the layout of the national Internet backbone direct connection points, promote the construction of new Internet exchange centers, improve the quality of interconnection between telecommunications operators and Internet companies, optimize cross-network and cross-regional data exchange in data centers, and achieve higher quality data transmission services. Actively promote the establishment of direct network connections between regional data center clusters and between clusters and major cities. Increase monitoring of the quality and guarantee capacity of data center networks, and improve network communication quality. Promote the reduction of major communication costs such as inter-provincial digital dedicated lines and Internet access bandwidth within the country. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, responsible for various regions).
titlelist: Optimize data center layout and promote network interconnection and interoperability.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Explore the establishment of a coordinated operation mechanism between the power grid and data network, and further reduce the electricity cost of data centers. Accelerate the formulation of national standards for data center energy efficiency and promote the improvement of the green data center standard system. Guide the development and use of clean energy, and accelerate the promotion and application of advanced energy-saving technologies. Encourage data center operators to strengthen internal energy consumption data monitoring and management, and improve energy utilization efficiency. Encourage regions to combine layout guidance and explore optimized energy consumption policies, and explore cross-provincial energy consumption and benefit sharing cooperation within the regional scope. Promote the construction of green data centers and accelerate the energy-saving and greening transformation of data centers. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the National Energy Administration, with responsibilities assigned to various regions).
titlelist: Optimize data center layout and strengthen energy supporting mechanisms.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Accelerate the establishment and improvement of cloud resource access and integrated scheduling mechanisms, provide computing resources in the form of cloud services, and reduce the cost and threshold of computing power usage. Support the construction of high-level cloud service platforms to further enhance resource scheduling capabilities. Support government-enterprise cooperation to create public computing power services that integrate basic computing resources and utilize public data development environments, providing low-cost, wide coverage, reliable, and secure computing power services to the government, enterprises, and the public. Support enterprises in playing the role of market entities, innovating technology models and service experiences, creating industry computing power services that integrate professional computing resources and industry data development environments, and supporting the digital transformation of industries and the cultivation of new formats and models. (Led by the Development and Reform Commission and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with responsibilities divided among various regions and departments).
titlelist: Promote the service-oriented utilization of computing resources and build an integrated computing service system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Taking application-oriented approach, fully leveraging the advantages of cloud-based scheduling, guiding various industries to make rational use of computing resources, and improving the efficiency of infrastructure utilization. For businesses that require background processing and storage, with low network latency requirements, support is provided for scheduling to data center clusters in energy-rich and climate-appropriate regions. For businesses that require high-frequency service calls and have extremely high network latency requirements, support is provided for scheduling to city-level high-performance, edge data centers. For other computing needs, support is provided for scheduling to data center clusters within the local region. (Responsibilities are assigned to different regions and departments).
titlelist: Promote the service-oriented utilization of computing power resources and optimize the structure of computing power resource demand.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Focus on the common needs of big data applications, encourage the construction of integrated natural language processing, video and image analysis, data visualization, voice intelligent question answering, multilingual machine translation, data mining and analysis, and other functions of big data general algorithm models and control libraries, and provide standardized and unified big data service support. (Responsibility of various regions and departments).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application and strengthen the support of big data public services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Support the construction of an 'industry data brain' and promote the integrated application of big data in various industries. Guide and support industries to migrate to the cloud, enrich the supply of cloud-based applications, and accelerate the pace of digital transformation. Promote the development of new formats and models through big data and cloud services, support the integration of online and offline business for enterprises, and cultivate data-driven enterprises. (Responsibilities of various regions and departments).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application and promote the digital transformation and upgrading of industries.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Support the construction of industrial internet big data centers according to standards, strengthen the aggregation, sharing, and innovative application of industrial internet data, and empower the high-quality development of the manufacturing industry. Encourage the construction of databases for key industries and major projects to provide data support for monitoring, analyzing, and predicting the development trends of the industrial sector. (Led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, with responsibilities divided among different regions and departments according to their functions).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application and promote the construction of industrial big data platform.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Support the construction of the 'City Data Brain', improve the government's social collaborative governance mechanism, accelerate the formation of a unified, standardized, interconnected, and secure urban data supply chain, and provide data support for urban governance, public services, and industrial development. Accelerate the construction of a comprehensive application platform for urban big data, connect the urban data perception, analysis, decision-making, and execution processes, and promote the improvement of urban governance and service capabilities. (Responsibility lies with each region).
titlelist: Deepen the innovation of big data application, accelerate the innovation and application of urban big data.

name: Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Construction of a National Integrated Big Data Center Collaborative Innovation System (Development and Reform Commission High-Tech [2020] No. 1922) (Issued by the Development and Reform Commission and other departments on December 23, 2020)
content: Each region and department should combine with the actual situation, adhere to the principle of small incisions and large driving forces, actively explore in the areas of big data mechanism management, industrial layout, technological innovation, security assessment, standard formulation, and application coordination, and accumulate and promote advanced experiences. Encourage each region to innovate related supporting policies, formulate integrated big data center construction plans and collaborative innovation implementation plans that are in line with their own characteristics, and accelerate implementation. (Responsibility lies with each region and department).
titlelist: Guarantee measures, focus on implementing tasks.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Promoting the digitization of quality management in the manufacturing industry is a systematic project. The goal is to improve quality and efficiency, and promote quality transformation. It should be laid out according to the principles of focusing on one main line, accelerating three major transformations, and grasping four principles. Enterprises should play a leading role, strengthen digital thinking, continuously deepen the application of digital technology in manufacturing quality management, and innovate quality management activities. Professional institutions should focus on improving services, accelerate the research and application of digital tools and methods for quality management, and provide public services such as software platforms. Industrial and information technology authorities at all levels should focus on improving policy guarantees and supporting environments, and ensure effective implementation.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Taking the construction of digital capabilities as the main line to promote the digital development of quality management, accelerating the innovative application of digital technology in quality management, optimizing and reconstructing the business processes of quality management, breaking down barriers to cooperation between different management levels, functional departments, and enterprises, empowering enterprises in diversified product innovation, refined production control, high value-added service development, and personalized experience enhancement, rapidly and effectively responding to uncertain changes, and continuously building differentiated competitive advantages.
titlelist: Overall requirements, focusing on one main theme.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Accelerate the reshaping of the concept of quality development in the digital era, promote the transformation of the scope of quality management from enterprise quality control to ecosystem collaboration, strengthen the management of product lifecycle, industrial chain supply chain, and even ecosystem collaboration quality; promote the transformation of key links in quality management from focusing mainly on manufacturing processes to giving equal importance to research and development, design, manufacturing, and services, deepen the collection, integration, and sharing of quality data across departments, links, and enterprises, promote quality collaboration and quality management innovation; shift the focus of quality management from mainly focusing on large-scale production to giving equal importance to large-scale production and personalization, differentiation, and refinement, actively collaborate on production mode and organizational innovation, and proactively adapt to dynamic market changes.
titlelist: Overall requirements, accelerate the three major transformations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises in the early stage of digitization should select key business processes such as research and development, design, procurement, production, testing, warehousing, logistics, sales, and services based on actual needs, and focus on promoting the application of digital technology. They should fully utilize digital tools to strengthen the collection, analysis, and utilization of quality information in business processes, carry out digital design verification, quality control, quality inspection, quality analysis, and quality improvement, and enhance the refinement and intelligence level of quality process control, thereby improving the efficiency and effectiveness of enterprise quality management.
titlelist: Clearly define the key scenarios for digital quality management, and focus on digitizing quality management in key business processes for enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: For enterprises that have achieved good digitization and integrated operation of business, it is necessary to promote the integration of research and development, design, production, and service based on digital product models. Strengthen the quality information traceability of the entire product lifecycle, enhance the sharing and utilization of quality data in the industrial chain and supply chain, promote data model-driven quality planning, control, and improvement of the entire product lifecycle and industry chain. Strengthen the linkage of quality management in the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain and supply chain, and promote innovation in diversified and high-value-added product services.
titlelist: Clearly define the key scenarios of digital quality management, focusing on quality collaboration throughout the entire product lifecycle and the entire industry chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises with platform-based operations and social collaboration capabilities should promote the online, modular, and platform-based transformation of quality management-related resources, capabilities, and businesses. They should collaborate with ecosystem partners to build a quality management platform, strengthen the collection, organization, sharing, circulation, and development of quality ecological data, promote the external output and iterative optimization of quality management knowledge and experience, and build a customer-oriented, data-driven, and ecologically beneficial quality management system and business model. Gradually, they should create a new ecosystem of quality symbiosis and win-win. Key industries for digital quality management include the raw materials industry. Targeting industries such as steel, petrochemicals, chemicals, and building materials, they should promote the digital quality control of production and manufacturing. By deeply applying technologies such as sensors, machine vision, automation control, and advanced measurement instruments in the production process, they should enhance the level of internal control within enterprises, promote the automatic collection and processing of quality data in the production process, carry out online monitoring, diagnosis, and optimization of the entire quality process, and set intelligent warning control limits based on market and process quality indicators to continuously improve the level of quality control. They should strengthen the linkage of quality management in the supply chain, jointly build a supply chain management system and platform with upstream and downstream enterprises, establish channels for the transmission of quality information between upstream and downstream enterprises in the supply chain, and improve the level of collaborative control of quality throughout the entire process from procurement and sourcing to production and sales, as well as the quality traceability management throughout the entire lifecycle. In the equipment manufacturing industry, targeting industries such as machinery and transportation equipment manufacturing, they should promote product quality design based on digital models. By applying technologies such as artificial intelligence and simulation in the product research and development design process, they should establish digital simulation models at the product and component levels, conduct failure mode analysis and prevention, assembly and logistics simulation, identify optimal design solutions, and improve the level of quality design through intelligent quality planning to reduce the risk of quality loss. They should promote digital control of production and manufacturing, deeply apply technologies such as sensors, machine vision, automation control, and advanced measurement instruments in the production process, and improve the level of quality control in lean production processes. They should also promote service quality improvement based on product lifecycle management. By connecting online platforms to achieve the identification and tracking of complete machines and components, they should conduct product failure warning and prediction, maintenance service warning prompts, and other extended services to promote product high-end development. In the consumer goods industry, targeting industries such as light industry and textiles, they should promote the digital quality control of production and manufacturing processes. They should promote the widespread application of technologies such as sensors, machine vision, and automation control in the production process of light industry and textiles, and improve the level of online monitoring. For industries such as pharmaceuticals and food, they should promote the quality traceability of products throughout the entire lifecycle. They should collaborate with upstream and downstream partners to establish product unique identification standards, carry out the construction of quality traceability systems, provide real-time traceability and query services, strengthen the collaborative control of quality throughout the entire lifecycle, and ensure consumer confidence in consumption.
titlelist: Clarify the key scenarios of digital quality management, and build a quality ecosystem and knowledge sharing oriented towards social collaboration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should combine the development goals and planning of the integration of the two industries, optimize the quality policy and quality objectives, and formulate a digital improvement path for quality management. Clearly define the responsible departments, responsibilities, and authorities for promoting the digitalization of quality management work, innovate the collaborative organizational model between the quality department and the business department, coordinate planning and select key scenarios for digital quality management, determine resource guarantees, and promote implementation step by step. In the operation and management of the quality management system, the improvement effect of digital capabilities should be regularly evaluated and reported to the top management.
titlelist: Improve the digital work mechanism for enterprise quality management and strengthen the digital organizational leadership for quality management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should be user-oriented, clarify the quality management requirements of key scenarios, and use methods such as the integration of information technology and industrialization to plan digital activities for quality management, including process optimization, equipment upgrading, information system integration, data resource utilization, and updating of operating procedures. They should use digital technology to bridge process breakpoints, strengthen the tracking, online monitoring, and dynamic optimization of business process status, and enhance the closed-loop control of quality objectives and quality activities.
titlelist: Improve the digital work mechanism for enterprise quality management and strengthen the planning of digital activities for quality management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Encourage enterprises to rely on industrial internet platforms, data integration platforms, etc., to build a unified quality management platform, realizing the modelization and platformization of quality management knowledge, methods, and experiences. Strengthen the development and utilization of digital design tools, apply technologies such as digital analysis modeling, digital twins, reliability design and simulation, quality fluctuation analysis, etc., to improve product user experience and quality design level. Encourage leading enterprises to build industry chain quality collaboration platforms, promote quality information sharing and knowledge co-creation among enterprises, explore new models of industry chain quality management linkage, and enhance the level of collaborative development in the industry chain quality.
titlelist: Improve the digital work mechanism for enterprise quality management and promote the integration of digital resources for quality management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should strengthen the participation of all staff in the digitalization of quality management activities, improve evaluation and incentive mechanisms, and turn the promotion of digitalization of quality management into proactive and capable actions by employees. In line with the development needs of digital transformation, a digital skills enhancement plan should be formulated for personnel in relevant positions that affect quality, in order to improve their ability to use information systems and apply quality management techniques in digital conditions. Appropriate assessment and evaluation should be conducted for personnel in positions that have a significant impact, to ensure that they have the ability to fulfill quality responsibilities in digital conditions.
titlelist: Enhance the digital operational capability of enterprise quality management and improve digital job skills.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should strengthen necessary production equipment transformation according to the requirements of digital core competence in quality management, improve the level of process control automation, intelligence, and precision, ensure process stability, and reduce quality fluctuations. In combination with the process of equipment digital transformation, design and develop corresponding quality management system platforms, form data-driven online quality control and autonomous decision-making capabilities, and lay a solid foundation for process improvement and product innovation.
titlelist: Enhance the digital operational capability of enterprise quality management and promote the digital transformation and upgrading of equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should improve the methods and procedures of inspection and testing according to the requirements of digital quality management. They should promote the upgrading of online inspection, measurement, and other instruments, and promote the interconnection between manufacturing equipment and inspection and testing equipment to improve the efficiency of quality inspection, measurement precision, and dynamic perception level. By using technologies such as machine vision and artificial intelligence, they can enhance the comprehensiveness, accuracy, and predictive warning level of production quality inspection.
titlelist: Enhance the digital operational capability of enterprise quality management and strengthen digital management of inspection and testing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should include quality data in the scope of data asset management. Strengthen standardized management of quality data and carry out capacity building for enterprise data management. Enhance the overall management of quality data collection, management, processing, analysis, and application, clarifying responsibilities and authorities at each stage, and strengthening the construction of cross-departmental and intra-departmental data management mechanisms. Improve data architecture design to promote efficient exchange and sharing of quality data between business activities.
titlelist: Strengthen the development and utilization of quality data throughout the product lifecycle, and enhance quality data management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should carry out quality analysis, control, and improvement based on the quality knowledge base, using big data throughout the entire process, lifecycle, and value chain. This will promote data-driven quality collaboration in the industrial and supply chains, explore the value of quality data, and timely identify quality risks and opportunities. Develop and deploy data-based quality control and decision-making models to enhance the timeliness of quality response and handling, reduce the risk of quality business decisions, implement more effective quality prevention and improvement, improve user experience, and strengthen flexible response capabilities and levels to uncertainties.
titlelist: Strengthen the development and utilization of quality data throughout the product lifecycle, and deepen the modeling and analysis of quality data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Enterprises should implement the 'Data Security Law' and relevant administrative regulations, strengthen data security awareness, and fulfill data security protection obligations. Strengthen security capabilities such as situational awareness, testing and evaluation, early warning and disposal, and disaster backup, to ensure the quality data security of the enterprise itself and its users, and build a multi-dimensional quality data security protection barrier covering network security, system security, and business security.
titlelist: Strengthen the development and utilization of quality data throughout the product lifecycle, and enhance the level of quality data security management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: In the fields of biomedicine, new materials, aerospace, shipbuilding and marine engineering, electronic manufacturing, new energy, and intelligent connected vehicles, it is encouraged for relevant industry associations and leading enterprises to establish public service platforms for product quality big data. These platforms will provide services such as online quality information inquiry, quality risk analysis, quality cost analysis, and quality traceability. Professional institutions are encouraged to provide services such as digital level assessment and diagnosis of quality management based on the platform. Continuous efforts will be made to construct and improve diagnostic benchmark models, strengthen the diagnosis, training, and guidance of digital quality management for small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance the overall performance of quality management.
titlelist: Innovative quality management digital public services, exploring platform-based data sharing services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Based on the relevant standards and specifications already published in the existing field, it is encouraged for standardization organizations, industry associations, social groups, and key enterprises to establish standards and specifications for digital quality management. This includes strengthening the promotion of standards, application services, and implementation effectiveness evaluation. For industrial clusters, efforts should be made to establish and improve public service systems for digital quality management, including standard development, industrial metrology, and testing and certification. Additionally, professional institutions should be cultivated to provide comprehensive services for digital quality management, such as consulting, diagnosis, project implementation, and operation maintenance.
titlelist: Innovative quality management digital public services, improving standards and testing certification services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: The industrial and informationization authorities in various regions should combine with the local reality, strengthen coordination and cooperation with market supervision and other relevant departments in the digital development of quality management, major issues, major policies, and major projects, and establish a sound mechanism for collaborative promotion among the government, industry, enterprises, research institutes, and professional institutions. Make full use of existing fiscal funds and industrial investment funds, and increase support for weak links in digital quality management in the manufacturing industry and public service platforms.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, strengthen organizational implementation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Encourage industrial and informationization authorities in various regions to increase the promotion of digital quality management, strengthen policy dissemination and interpretation, popularize knowledge of digital quality management, enhance awareness and practical capabilities of enterprises in promoting digital quality management, and continuously expand the influence of digital quality management in enterprises. Support industry associations, industrial alliances, and enterprises in jointly promoting digital quality management-related products, technologies, standards, and services, and promote the export of system solutions.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, strengthen publicity and guidance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Encourage industry alliances, industry associations, professional institutions, etc. to establish a digital checklist for quality management in different industries, and continuously explore new digital models for quality management. Summarize and extract typical cases of digital quality management, cultivate and discover a group of typical experiences that have strong driving force and can be replicated and promoted. Strengthen communication and promotion, lead and promote the overall improvement of the industry's quality level with benchmark enterprises that have achieved significant results, and create a favorable atmosphere for the digital development of quality management.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, create benchmark demonstrations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Digitalization of Quality Management in Manufacturing Industry (Trial) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 59) (MIIT Office/December 30, 2021)
content: Promote deepened cooperation between industry alliances, industry associations, universities, and research institutes, and jointly establish a digital innovation joint laboratory for quality management. Conduct training on advanced digital quality methods. Encourage the joint construction of a number of digital skills training bases by schools and enterprises to cultivate quality management talents with knowledge, skills, and innovation.
titlelist: Improve policy guarantees and support environment, strengthen talent cultivation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Persist in coordinating the promotion of epidemic prevention and control of COVID-19 and economic and social development, supported by the new generation of information technology and applications, with the goal of enhancing the crisis response capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises and consolidating the foundation for sustainable development. Gather a group of digital service providers targeting small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate and promote a batch of digital platforms, system solutions, products, and services that meet the needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and help promote the resumption of work and production, enhance development momentum, and improve development quality through digitalization, networking, and intelligent empowerment for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Promote new applications such as travel cards and health codes to achieve real-time monitoring and sharing of personnel flow information, and accelerate the return of enterprise employees to work premises on the premise of ensuring effective epidemic prevention and control. Utilize mini-programs and toolkits for medical supplies guarantee, epidemic warning, inventory and logistics distribution, resource allocation, etc., to scientifically and accurately prevent and control the epidemic, and promote orderly resumption of work and production.
titlelist: Key task: Strengthening epidemic prevention and control through the use of information technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Support small and medium-sized enterprises in using online office, financial management, intelligent communication, remote collaboration, video conferencing, collaborative development, and other products and solutions to quickly resume production management, achieve digital operation management, and encourage digital service providers to waive usage fees for small and medium-sized enterprises during the epidemic prevention and control period. Support digital service providers in building intelligent office platforms, launching solutions such as virtual cloud desktops, ultra-high-definition videos, holographic projection videos, etc., to meet the new demands of upgrading remote office scenarios such as virtual team management and sensitive data control.
titlelist: Key task: Utilize digital tools to resume production and operations as soon as possible.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Guide digital service providers to launch cloud manufacturing platforms and cloud service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), supporting the migration of SMEs' equipment and business systems to the cloud. Help SMEs access resources and application services from the cloud, meeting their needs for cloud-based R&D, design, production, manufacturing, operations management, and marketing systems. Accelerate the integration of cloud + intelligence to help SMEs access more productive services from the cloud. Encourage digital service providers to open up platform interfaces, data, computing capabilities, and other digital resources to SMEs and startup teams, enhancing SMEs' capabilities for secondary development.
titlelist: Key task, promoting small and medium-sized enterprises to go cloud and use cloud.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Build a digital platform with high technical level, strong integration capability, and wide industry application. Apply emerging technologies such as Internet of Things, big data, edge computing, 5G, artificial intelligence, augmented reality/virtual reality, etc. Integrate general-purpose operating systems, software, and toolkits for engineering design, electronic design, modeling, simulation, product lifecycle management, manufacturing operations management, and automation control. Flexibly deploy industrial apps with strong generality, security, reliability, and easy secondary development. Promote the digitization of production factors, the flexibility of production processes, and the integration of system services for small and medium-sized enterprises. Build an industrial app testing and evaluation platform and a trusted blockchain innovation collaboration platform to provide testing and certification services for small service providers and small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Key task, solidify the functionality of the digital platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Developing convenient and cost-effective digital solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in different industries, targeting their specific needs and scenarios. These solutions enable online collaboration in various business functions such as research and development, design, procurement, production, sales, logistics, and inventory management. Promoting the adoption of centralized procurement, resource integration, shared production, collaborative logistics, and new retail solutions, as well as integrating online purchasing and sales, optimal offline inventory and unmanned delivery, and intelligent logistics into a supply chain system and distribution network. This aims to enhance the ability of SMEs to respond to sudden crises and improve operational efficiency.
titlelist: Key task, innovative digital operation solution

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: In response to typical application scenarios for small and medium-sized enterprises, encourage the integration of innovative industrial internet, 5G, artificial intelligence, and industrial app fusion application models and technologies. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises with a foundation and conditions to accelerate the digital transformation of traditional manufacturing equipment, such as networking and key process digitization. Apply low-cost, modular, easy-to-use, and easy-to-maintain advanced intelligent equipment and systems, optimize process flow and equipment technology, build intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and intelligent factories, and achieve lean production, agile manufacturing, fine management, and intelligent decision-making.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing the level of intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Support the establishment of data communication channels between different systems for industry clusters and upstream and downstream enterprises in the supply chain, to achieve smooth data information flow, shared manufacturing resources, and collaborative production processes. Support the development of new data products and services, encourage the exploration of specialized business models such as data collection, data cleaning, data exchange, and data annotation. Develop basic data processing cloud services such as elastic distributed computing and data storage, as well as online machine learning, natural language processing, image understanding, speech recognition, knowledge graphs, data visualization, and digital twins for data analysis services. Help small and medium-sized enterprises improve their data development and application capabilities.
titlelist: Key task: Strengthening data resource sharing and development utilization.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Accelerate the development of new models and formats such as online office, online education, telemedicine, unmanned delivery, and new retail that have emerged during the epidemic prevention and control period. Cultivate and strengthen service-oriented manufacturing new formats such as shared manufacturing and personalized customization. Tap into the value of industrial data, explore new models such as enterprise manufacturing capacity trading and industrial knowledge trading, encourage the development of algorithm and data industries, and cultivate a group of small and medium-sized digital service providers. Build an open-source industrial app developer community and an open platform for small and medium-sized enterprises. Establish a resource library and demand pool for small and medium-sized enterprises, and develop models such as crowdsourcing, crowd innovation, cloud sharing, and cloud leasing.
titlelist: Key tasks: Developing new models and new formats of the digital economy.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Build an industry supply chain docking platform, create an online procurement and distribution model, and provide services such as matching raw materials for small and medium-sized enterprises, sharing rework personnel, configuring automated production lines, mutual assistance in mold resources, procurement of protective materials, and connecting sales and logistics resources. Based on the industrial Internet platform, promote the deep integration of small and medium-sized enterprises into the supply chain and innovation chain of large enterprises. Support large enterprises to establish a shared platform for resources and capabilities based on the common needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and achieve equipment sharing, capacity docking, and production collaboration in key areas.
titlelist: Key task, strengthen support for supply chain integration platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Support the acceleration of digital infrastructure transformation and upgrading in small and micro enterprise entrepreneurship and innovation bases, maker spaces, and other small and medium-sized enterprise industrial agglomeration areas. Construct digital public technology service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises and establish digital innovation demonstration parks for small and medium-sized enterprises. Support small and medium-sized enterprises within industrial clusters to compensate for individual enterprise resource and capability deficiencies through networked collaboration, integrate dispersed manufacturing capabilities through collaborative manufacturing platforms, and achieve technology, production capacity, order, and employee sharing.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the digital development of industrial clusters.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Promote cooperation among small and medium-sized enterprises, digital service providers, and financial institutions, etc., to build a service system for enterprise credit monitoring, intelligent supply-demand matching, and big data risk control. Provide financial services such as credit assessment, credit loans, financing leasing, and pledge guarantees based on real-time production and operation data. Help enterprises obtain low-cost financing and enhance the financing capacity and efficiency of small and medium-sized enterprises. Create a public service platform to promote credit enhancement for small and medium-sized enterprise financing, apply next-generation information technology, provide online multi-party contract signing and evidence storage services, transmit credit value in the supply chain, and stimulate the vitality of small and medium-sized enterprise data assets.
titlelist: Key task: Improve the service level of the integration platform between production and finance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Support telecommunications operators to carry out special actions such as speeding up and benefiting enterprises, cloud-based benefits for enterprises, and enterprises going to the cloud, to enhance high-speed broadband network capabilities, strengthen basic network security, and further increase speed and reduce fees. Accelerate the promotion of 5G and industrial Internet applications, expand industrial Internet identification applications, and strengthen the construction of digital infrastructure such as network, computing, and security for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen digital resource service support such as network, computing, and security.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Promote the implementation of the requirements of the Cybersecurity Law and other laws, regulations, and technical standards for small and medium-sized enterprises, and strengthen network and data security measures. Establish an industrial internet security public service platform to provide network and data security technical support services to a wide range of small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage security service providers to innovate security service models, enhance security service supply capabilities, and tailor 24/7, all-round, and three-dimensional security solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Key task: Strengthening network and data security protection.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: The competent departments of small and medium-sized enterprises in various regions should strengthen the overall coordination of the work of digital empowerment for small and medium-sized enterprises. The government, service agencies, and enterprises should work together to promote and implement special actions. Small and medium-sized enterprises should play a leading role, actively adapt to the new situation, promote self-transformation and digital empowerment, and enhance their ability to respond to risks and sustainable development. Mobilize the enthusiasm of digital service providers, leverage the role of small and medium-sized enterprise public service demonstration platforms and platform networks, help enterprises accurately prevent and control the epidemic, orderly resume work and production, and accelerate digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation.
titlelist: Promote measures, strengthen organizational support.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Include the digital transformation and upgrading of small and medium-sized enterprises into the cultivation system for the development of specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as the construction of demonstration bases for small and micro enterprises' entrepreneurship and innovation, and provide key support. Following the approach of 'enterprises contribute, service providers assist, and the government supplements,' encourage local governments to include the digitalization of small and medium-sized enterprises in the scope of key financial support, such as special funds for the development of small and medium-sized enterprises. For small and medium-sized enterprises that encounter temporary difficulties in liquidity but have good development prospects, financial institutions should prioritize support for their digital transformation and upgrading to promote resumption of work and production and transformational development through preferential interest rate loans.
titlelist: Promote measures, improve incentive mechanisms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Empowering Digitalization of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MIIT Enterprise [2020] No. 10) (MIIT Office/March 18, 2020)
content: Establish a trustworthy service provider for digitalization of small and medium-sized enterprises, and establish an evaluation system for excellent digital products and services. Collect, cultivate, and promote a group of digital service providers and excellent digital products and services that have strong technical capabilities, good service effects, and are highly welcomed by small and medium-sized enterprises. Through online live streaming, video exhibitions, online connections, etc., achieve interactive display and transaction of digital products and services, guide enterprises to scientifically formulate deployment models, and allocate resources and services reasonably. Hold the 2020 Informationization Service Information Release Conference for small and medium-sized enterprises. Organize activities such as integration and innovation of large, medium, and small enterprises, and docking of digital products and solutions, and promotion of digital applications in the Innovation China campaign.
titlelist: Promote measures, organize supply and demand docking.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for Industrial Data Classification and Grading (Trial Implementation) (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 6) (MIIT General Office/February 27, 2020)
content: The second-level data is only open to authorized institutions and relevant personnel who truly need to obtain this level of data. The third-level data is generally not shared, and if necessary, the scope of knowledge should be strictly controlled.
titlelist: Tiered management, encouraging companies to appropriately share first and second-level data on the premise of good data management, fully unleashing the potential value of industrial data.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guidelines for Industrial Data Classification and Grading (Trial Implementation) (MIIT Letter [2020] No. 6) (MIIT General Office/February 27, 2020)
content: When it involves three-level data, the event should be promptly reported to the provincial industrial and information technology authorities where the data is located. The situation of event handling should also be supplemented and reported within 30 days after the completion of emergency work.
titlelist: Under the hierarchical management system, when industrial data is tampered with, damaged, leaked, or illegally utilized, enterprises should immediately carry out emergency disposal according to the pre-established emergency plan.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: By 2020, a technologically advanced, prosperous, and well-supported big data industry system will be basically formed. The revenue from big data-related products and services will exceed 1 trillion yuan, with an average annual compound growth rate of around 30%. The construction of a data powerhouse will be accelerated, providing strong industrial support for the realization of a manufacturing and network powerhouse. - Advanced and controllable technological products. Secure and controllable technological products will be developed in the field of big data infrastructure software and hardware. The international advanced level will be achieved in data acquisition, storage management, and processing platform technologies. Leading positions will be held in algorithms and tools for data mining, analysis, and application. A number of independently innovative and technologically advanced products, solutions, and services that meet major application needs will be developed.- Enhanced application capabilities. Industrial big data applications will comprehensively support intelligent manufacturing and industrial transformation and upgrading. Big data will be widely and deeply applied in innovation, entrepreneurship, government management, and people's livelihood services. The capabilities of technology integration, business integration, and data integration will be significantly improved, enabling collaborative management and services across levels, regions, systems, departments, and businesses. A new model of data-driven innovation and development will be formed. Based on existing statistics on the electronic information industry and industry sampling estimates, the revenue of China's big data industry was about 280 billion yuan in 2015.- Prosperous development of the ecological system. Several big data backbone enterprises with outstanding innovation capabilities will be formed. A number of specialized data service innovative small and medium-sized enterprises will be cultivated. Ten internationally leading core big data enterprises and 500 big data application and service enterprises will be nurtured. A relatively complete big data industry chain and preliminary big data industry system will be formed. Ten to fifteen comprehensive big data pilot zones will be established, along with several big data industrial clusters. Several demonstration bases for new industrialization of big data will be created.- Strengthened support capabilities. A comprehensive big data standard system covering technology, products, and management will be established. Regional and industry-specific big data industry and application alliances and organizations will be established. Specialized service institutions for big data consulting, research, testing and evaluation, technology and intellectual property rights, investment and financing, etc., will be nurtured. One to two open-source communities with standardized operations and certain international influence will be built.- Strong data security guarantee. Data security technology will reach international advanced levels. The national data security protection system will be basically established. The data security technology guarantee capability and security system will basically meet the needs of national strategy and market applications. The regulations and systems for data security and personal privacy protection will be relatively sound.
titlelist: The guiding ideology and development goals, development goals.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: With application-oriented approach, breakthrough key technologies of big data, promote the research and development and industrialization of products and solutions, innovate technology service models, and form a technologically advanced and ecologically complete technical product system. Accelerate the research and development of key technologies of big data. Focus on forward-looking layout in areas such as data science theory system, big data computing systems and analysis, and big data application models, strengthen basic research on big data. Play the role of enterprise innovation main body, integrate industry, academia, research, and application resources to jointly tackle key technologies of big data collection, transmission, storage, management, processing, analysis, application, visualization, and security. Breakthrough key technologies of big data basic technologies such as large-scale heterogeneous data fusion, cluster resource scheduling, distributed file systems, general-purpose computing framework technologies for multitasking, as well as computing engine technologies such as stream computing and graph computing. Support frontier technology innovations such as deep learning, brain-like computing, cognitive computing, blockchain, and virtual reality, enhance data analysis and processing capabilities and knowledge discovery capabilities. Combine with industry applications, develop intelligent data application technologies such as big data analysis, understanding, prediction, decision support, and knowledge services. Breakthrough new chip and integration architectures, memory computing with billion-level concurrency, EB-level storage, green computing, and other technologies for computing, storage, sensing, communication, etc. for big data, promote the coordinated development of software and hardware. Cultivate a secure and controllable big data product system. With application as the traction, emphasize independent research and development as well as introduction and absorption, accelerate the formation of a secure and controllable big data product system. Focus on breakthroughs in core information technology equipment for big data application infrastructure, information security products, as well as basic products such as new transaction-oriented relational databases, columnar databases, NoSQL databases, large-scale graph databases, and next-generation distributed computing platforms. Accelerate the development of next-generation business intelligence, data mining, data visualization, semantic search, and other software products. Combine with the demand for data lifecycle management, cultivate platform products for big data collection and integration, big data analysis and mining, big data interactive perception, and data resource management based on semantic understanding. Develop technology products for big data retrieval, analysis, and display with industry characteristics, targeting key industry application needs, and form mature big data solutions and services in vertical fields. Innovate big data technology service models. Accelerate the innovation of big data service models, cultivate new models and new formats for data-as-a-service, enhance big data service capabilities, and reduce the threshold and cost of big data applications. Develop technical services for data collection, cleaning, analysis, transaction, security protection, and other stages of the data lifecycle. Promote the integration of big data and cloud computing service models, promote the development of public cloud computing services such as massive data, large-scale distributed computing, and intelligent data analysis, and enhance the capabilities of third-party big data technology services. Promote the deep integration of big data technology services with industries and cultivate big data service models for vertical fields.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, strengthen the research and development of big data technology products.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Strengthen the construction planning and layout of industrial big data infrastructure, promote the application of big data in the entire product life cycle and the entire industrial chain, promote the integration and development of industrial big data with automatic control and sensing hardware, industrial core software, industrial internet, industrial cloud, and intelligent service platforms, form a data-driven new model for industrial development, support the Made in China 2025 strategy, and explore the establishment of industrial big data centers. Accelerate the construction of industrial big data infrastructure. Accelerate the construction of low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage industrial internet for intelligent manufacturing units, smart factories, and IoT applications, and enhance the service capabilities of industrial network infrastructure. Accelerate the deployment and application of data collection devices such as industrial sensors, radio frequency identification (RFID), and optical communication devices, promote the construction of industrial IoT standard system, promote the upgrade and transformation of industrial control systems, gather multi-source data such as sensing, control, management, and operation, and enhance the networking, digitization, and intelligence level of products, equipment, and enterprises. Promote the full-process application of industrial big data. Support the construction of industrial big data platforms, promote the application of big data in various key industrial sectors, enhance the level of deep integration of informatization and industrialization, and promote industrial transformation and upgrading. Strengthen the application capability of R&D and design big data, use big data to accurately perceive user needs, promote innovation design based on data and knowledge, and improve R&D efficiency. Accelerate the application of production and manufacturing big data, optimize assembly line operations through big data monitoring, strengthen fault prediction and health management, optimize product quality, and reduce energy consumption. Improve the level of application of big data in business management, enhance the integration level of key business processes such as human resources, finance, production and manufacturing, and procurement, improve management efficiency and decision-making level, and achieve intelligent business activities. Promote the deep application of big data in customer service, promote innovative applications of big data in pre-sales, in-sales, and after-sales services. Promote the integration of data resources, connect data chains in various links, and form a full-process data closed loop. Cultivate data-driven manufacturing new models. Deepen the integration of manufacturing and the Internet, adhere to innovation-driven development, accelerate the deep integration and application of industrial big data with emerging technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and cyber-physical systems in the manufacturing industry, build a double innovation platform for manufacturing enterprise big data, and cultivate new technologies, new formats, and new models. Use big data to promote the participation of specialized, refined, unique, and new small and medium-sized enterprises in the industrial chain. Vigorously develop personalized customization based on big data, promote the development of customer-to-manufacturer (C2M) and other manufacturing models, and improve the intelligence and flexibility of the manufacturing process. Use big data to accelerate the development of manufacturing-as-a-service models and promote the transformation from production-oriented manufacturing to service-oriented manufacturing. Column 3: Industrial Big Data Innovation and Development Project. Strengthen the research and development and application of key technologies for industrial big data. Accelerate the application of key technologies such as big data acquisition, storage, analysis, mining, and application in the industrial field, focus on researching programmable logic controllers, high-throughput computing engines, data acquisition and monitoring systems, develop new industrial big data analysis and modeling tools, and carry out the collection and promotion of excellent industrial big data products, services, and application cases. Build a public service platform for industrial big data and enhance the application capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises in big data. Support the construction of industrial big data service platforms for typical industries and small and medium-sized enterprises, realize the sharing and exchange of industry data resources, and dynamically monitor, predict, and warn about products, markets, and economic operations, and enhance the service capabilities for small and medium-sized enterprises. Construction of key area big data platforms and application demonstrations. Support the development and application of industrial big data platforms for discrete manufacturing enterprises in aerospace equipment, marine engineering equipment, high-tech ships, advanced rail transportation equipment, energy-saving and new energy vehicles, as well as process manufacturing enterprise groups in petroleum, chemical, and power industries, integrate group data resources, and enhance the collaborative R&D capabilities and centralized control level of group enterprises. Explore innovative models for industrial big data. Support the construction of a number of industrial big data innovation centers, promote the exploration of new models and mechanisms for industrial big data innovation by enterprises, universities, and research institutes, promote breakthroughs in core technologies of industrial big data, establishment of industry standards, promotion of application demonstrations, and introduction of professional talents, and promote the transformation of research results.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, deepening the innovative application of industrial big data.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Strengthen the deep application of big data in key industries, promote the integration and innovation of big data across industries, enhance the application capability of big data in government governance and people's livelihood services, and promote the integration and development of big data in various industries. Promote the application of big data in key industries. Promote the application of big data in industries such as telecommunications, energy, finance, commerce, agriculture, food, cultural creativity, and public safety, promote the collection, integration, sharing, and utilization of industry data resources, fully unleash the transformative role of big data in industrial development, accelerate the transformation of traditional industry management methods, innovation in service models and business models, and reconstruction of the industrial value chain system. Promote the integration and innovation of big data across industries. Break through institutional and mechanistic barriers, break down data silos, innovate cooperation models, and cultivate cross-integration new formats of big data applications. Support the cross-domain and cross-industry application of big data in areas with good information infrastructure such as telecommunications, the Internet, industry, finance, health, and transportation, and cultivate new models of big data application. Support the strengthening of technology and resource integration between big data-related enterprises and traditional industries, jointly explore diversified cooperation and operation models, and promote the integration and application of big data. Strengthen the application of big data in social governance and public services. Guided by the needs of the people's livelihood, taking e-government and smart city construction as the starting point, and data concentration and sharing as the approach, promote the construction of a national integrated national big data center, promote technological integration, business integration, and data integration, and achieve cross-level, cross-regional, cross-system, cross-department, and cross-business collaborative management and services. Promote the application of big data in people's livelihood areas such as government affairs, transportation, education, health, social security, and employment, explore data governance models involving public participation, enhance social governance and urban management capabilities, and provide intelligent, accurate, efficient, and convenient public services to the masses. Promote the application of big data in the field of market entity supervision and services, build key industry operation analysis service platforms based on big data, strengthen the monitoring of the economic operation of key industries and backbone enterprises, and improve the timeliness, accuracy, and foresight of industry operation supervision and services. Promote the integration of government data and enterprise data, and provide strong support for enterprise innovation and development and social governance.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects promote the development of big data applications in the industry.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Guide the development layout of the big data in the region, promote innovation and entrepreneurship based on big data, cultivate a group of leading enterprises and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, and form a multi-level, tiered innovation main body and a reasonable industrial layout to prosper the big data ecosystem. Utilize big data to boost innovation and entrepreneurship. Encourage resource-rich and technologically advanced leading big data companies to build big data platforms, open platform data, computing power, development environment, and other basic resources, and reduce the cost of innovation and entrepreneurship. Encourage large enterprises to rely on the Internet double innovation platform to provide innovation and entrepreneurship services based on big data. Organize algorithm competitions, application innovation competitions, crowdsourcing, and crowdfunding activities to stimulate innovation and entrepreneurship vitality. Support deep cooperation between big data companies and research institutions, bridge the gap between scientific and technological innovation and industrialization, and form a data-driven research and innovation model. Build a pattern of coordinated development among enterprises. Support leading enterprises in integrating and utilizing domestic and foreign resources such as technology, talent, and patents, accelerate the research and development of big data technology and product innovation, improve the international market share and brand influence of products and services, and form a group of internationally competitive comprehensive and specialized leading enterprises. Support small and medium-sized enterprises in deepening the subdivision market, accelerating service model innovation and business model innovation, and improving the innovation capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage cooperation among enterprises in various links of the ecological chain, build a multi-party collaboration and mutually beneficial industrial ecology, and create a good situation of coordinated development among large, medium, and small enterprises. Optimize the regional layout of the big data industry. Guide local areas to combine their own conditions, highlight regional advantages, clarify key development directions, deepen the application of big data, position reasonably, plan scientifically, and form a scientific and orderly division of labor and regional layout. Build several national comprehensive pilot zones for big data across the country, carry out systematic exploration and experimentation in areas such as big data institutional innovation, public data opening and sharing, big data innovation application, big data industry agglomeration, data element circulation, data center integration, and international exchange and cooperation in big data, and accumulate experience for the development and application of big data nationwide. Build a group of big data industry agglomeration areas in regions with obvious advantages in the big data industry, create demonstration bases for the new industrialization of big data, give full play to the role of industrial agglomeration and synergy, lead the development of big data nationwide with focal points, and coordinate the cross-regional layout of big data. Utilize big data to promote information sharing, information consumption, resource docking, and complementary advantages, and promote coordinated economic and social development in the region.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, accelerate the cultivation of the main body of the big data industry.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Strengthen the top-level design of big data standardization, gradually improve the standard system, and play an important supporting role of standardization in industrial development. Accelerate the development and promotion of key big data standards. Establish and continuously improve a big data standard system that covers infrastructure, data, technology, platforms/tools, management, security, and applications, in accordance with the needs of big data industry development. Accelerate the development of national standards for basic and key application areas. Select key industries, sectors, and regions to carry out standard trial verification and pilot demonstrations, and strengthen promotion and implementation. Establish a standard conformity assessment system, strengthen the support role of standards in market cultivation, service capability enhancement, and industry management. Strengthen the connection and coordination among national standards, industry standards, and group standards. Actively participate in international standardization work for big data. Strengthen communication and cooperation between China's big data standardization organizations and relevant international organizations. Organize domestic academic, research, and industrial resources to accelerate the promotion of international standard proposals. Support relevant units to participate in international standardization work and undertake related positions, host international standardization activities, and expand international influence. Column 6: Key standard development and application demonstration projects for big data. Accelerate the development of key national standards. Focus on the major needs of big data standardization, carry out data resource classification, open sharing, transactions, identification, statistics, product evaluation, data capabilities, data security, and other basic general standards, as well as the development of key national standards in industrial big data and other related application areas. Establish a verification and testing platform. Establish a standard trial verification and conformity testing platform, focusing on data openness, sharing, product evaluation, data capability maturity, data quality, data security, and other key standards for trial verification and conformity testing. Carry out standard application demonstrations. Prioritize supporting the establishment of standard demonstration bases in comprehensive big data test zones and big data industry clusters, and carry out application demonstration work for key standards.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, promoting the construction of a big data standard system.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Coordinate the layout of big data infrastructure, build innovative service platforms for the development of the big data industry, establish a statistical and development evaluation system for big data, and create a favorable environment for industrial development. Reasonably plan the construction of big data infrastructure.
