Guide local governments and relevant enterprises to coordinate the construction of data centers, fully utilize existing government and social data center resources, integrate and transform small-scale, inefficient, and energy-consuming decentralized data centers to avoid waste of resources and space. Encourage the widespread use of renewable energy and waste equipment recycling in the construction of big data infrastructure, and guide the development of a green, intensive, well-planned, moderately scaled, and high-speed interconnected big data infrastructure system. Accelerate the construction and upgrade of network infrastructure. Optimize network structure and improve the quality of interconnection. Build public service platforms for the development of the big data industry. Make full use of and integrate existing innovative resources to form a batch of big data testing, certification, and public service platforms. Support the establishment of public technology innovation platforms such as big data-related open-source communities, encourage developers, enterprises, and research institutions to actively participate in big data open-source projects, enhance their influence in the open-source community, and improve innovation capabilities. Establish a development evaluation system for big data. Research and establish a development evaluation system for the big data industry, monitor, analyze, and evaluate the construction status, openness and sharing level, industrial development capabilities, and application levels of big data resources in China and various regions, compile and release the big data industry development index, and guide and evaluate the national big data development. Column 7: Construction of the big data public service system. Establish a public service platform for the big data industry, provide services such as policy consultation, generic technical support, intellectual property rights, investment and financing docking, brand promotion, talent training, and entrepreneurship incubation, and promote the rapid growth of big data enterprises. Support third-party organizations in establishing testing and certification platforms, and provide services such as testing, evaluation, and certification of big data usability, reliability, security, and scale quality. Establish a big data open-source community, incubate and cultivate local big data open-source communities and projects with independent innovative technologies, and build a big data industry ecosystem.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, improving the support system for the big data industry.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: In response to the new situation of network information security, we will strengthen the research and development of big data security technology products, utilize big data to improve security management mechanisms, and build a strong big data security guarantee system. We will focus on the research and development of unified account, authentication, authorization, and auditing systems, as well as big data encryption and classification management systems in the big data environment. We will break through key technologies such as differential privacy, multi-party secure computation, data flow monitoring, and traceability. We will promote big data protection technologies such as leakage prevention, anti-theft, and anonymization, and develop big data security protection products and solutions. We will strengthen the research and industrialization of big data security support technologies such as cloud platform virtual machine security technology, virtualization network security technology, cloud security auditing technology, and cloud platform security unified management technology. We will also strengthen the discovery and reinforcement of vulnerabilities in cloud computing and big data basic software systems. We will enhance the support capabilities of big data for network information security. By comprehensively using multi-source data, we will strengthen big data mining and analysis, and enhance the ability to perceive, warn, and respond to network information security risks. We will strengthen the research and development of new information security products based on big data, promote the application of big data technology in the security protection of critical information infrastructure, and ensure the security of important information systems in finance, energy, power, communication, transportation, and other fields. We will build a big data platform for network information security situation awareness and a national industrial control system security monitoring and early warning platform, promote the collection and sharing of network information security threat data, and establish a unified, efficient, collaborative, and interconnected network security risk reporting, intelligence sharing, and judgment and disposal system.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, enhancing the capability of big data security protection.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Combine the Action Plan for Promoting the Development of Big Data, Made in China 2025, the Internet Plus Action Plan, and the decision to cultivate and develop strategic emerging industries to formulate financial and government procurement policies and measures for the development of the big data industry, and implement relevant tax policies. Fully leverage the role of national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.) in supporting policies, encourage eligible regions to establish special funds for the development of big data, and support the development of basic technologies, key products, services, and applications in big data. Encourage industrial investment institutions and guarantee institutions to increase support for big data enterprises, guide financial institutions to prioritize credit support for technologically advanced, driving, and widely beneficial big data projects, encourage big data enterprises to access capital markets for financing, and create a more relaxed market environment for corporate restructuring and mergers. Support eligible big data enterprises to enjoy corresponding preferential policies.
titlelist: Enhance policy support and strengthen protective measures.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Establish a talent cultivation and evaluation mechanism that adapts to the development needs of big data. Strengthen the cultivation of big data talents, integrate resources from universities, enterprises, and society, promote the establishment of innovative talent cultivation models, and establish a sound multi-level and multi-type big data talent cultivation system. Encourage universities to explore the establishment of mechanisms for cultivating professional talents and interdisciplinary talents in the field of big data. Support universities and enterprises in establishing internship training mechanisms, and enhance the vocational practical skills of big data talents. Encourage enterprises to provide training in big data skills for employees, actively cultivate talents in big data technology and application innovation. Relying on social education resources, carry out popularization of big data knowledge and education and training, and improve the overall social awareness and application level. Encourage industry organizations to explore the establishment of a big data talent competency evaluation system. Improve supporting measures, cultivate innovative leading talents in the field of big data, and attract high-level overseas talents in big data to come to China for employment and entrepreneurship.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, building a multi-level talent team.

name: Development Plan for the Big Data Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 412) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: According to the overall requirements of building a strong cyber nation and in conjunction with major national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, accelerate the development of international markets, export advantageous technologies and services, and form a group of big data enterprises and products with international competitiveness. Make full use of international cooperation and exchange mechanisms and platforms to strengthen communication and cooperation in key technologies research, product development, data openness and sharing, standardization, talent cultivation, and other aspects of big data. Adhere to the principle of cyber sovereignty, actively participate in the construction of international rules systems for data security and cross-border data flow, promote open cooperation, and build a sound order.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promoting international development.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: By 2017, the application of cloud computing in key areas has deepened, the industrial chain has become basically sound, and a preliminary pattern of cloud computing development has been formed, with strong security guarantees and coordinated promotion of service innovation, technological innovation, and management innovation, driving the rapid development of related industries. The service capabilities have been greatly improved. Several backbone service enterprises with strong innovation capabilities in public cloud computing have been formed. Cloud computing services for small and medium-sized enterprises and individuals are diverse, achieving large-scale operations. The integration capability of cloud computing systems has significantly improved. The innovation capability has noticeably increased. The original innovation and basic innovation capabilities have been enhanced, breaking through a batch of key technologies and products such as cloud computing platform software, exabyte-level cloud storage systems, and big data mining and analysis. Cloud computing technology is approaching international advanced levels, and the cloud computing standard system has been basically established. The driving effect of service innovation on technological innovation has significantly increased, and the level of collaborative development between industry, academia, and research has greatly improved. The demonstration effects of applications are significant. In several key areas with obvious social benefits, strong industrial driving force, and prominent demonstration effects, public data openness, integration of information technology resources, and government procurement service reforms are promoted. A hundred cloud computing and big data application demonstration projects are carried out, achieving positive results in reducing the threshold for entrepreneurship, serving the people's livelihood, cultivating new business models, and exploring new models for e-government construction. The number of government-owned data centers has decreased by more than 5%. The infrastructure continues to be optimized. The regional layout of cloud computing data centers has been initially optimized, and the energy utilization efficiency (PUE) of newly built large-scale cloud computing data centers is better than 1.5. The policy environment for broadband development is gradually improving, and the broadband network infrastructure that meets the needs of cloud computing development has been initially established. The security guarantees are basically sound. A regulatory system and standard specification system that adapt to the development needs of cloud computing have been initially established. The industrialization level of key technologies and products for cloud computing security and network security protection capabilities have significantly improved, making the cloud computing development environment more secure and reliable. By 2020, cloud computing applications will be widely popularized, and the service capabilities of cloud computing will reach international advanced levels. Key technologies of cloud computing will be mastered, and several backbone enterprises with strong international competitiveness in cloud computing will be formed. The information security regulatory system and legal system for cloud computing will be sound. The capability of big data mining and analysis will significantly improve. Cloud computing will become an important form of informatization in China and an important support for building a network powerhouse, promoting a significant improvement in the level of informatization in various economic and social fields.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, development goals.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: Vigorously develop public cloud computing services, implement cloud computing projects, and support information technology companies in accelerating their transformation into cloud computing product and service providers. Vigorously develop computing and storage resource leasing and application software development and deployment platform services, as well as online application services for enterprise management, research and development, and design, to reduce the threshold and innovation cost of enterprise informatization, and support the development and entrepreneurial activities of small and medium-sized enterprises. Actively develop cloud-based personal information storage, online tools, learning, entertainment, and other services to cultivate information consumption. Develop secure and trustworthy cloud computing outsourcing services and promote government business outsourcing. Support the integration, development, and innovative application of cloud computing with technologies and services such as the Internet of Things, mobile internet, internet finance, and e-commerce, and actively cultivate new formats and models. Encourage large enterprises to open platform resources and create a collaborative and win-win cloud computing service ecosystem. Guide the orderly development of private clouds, encourage enterprises to innovate their information construction ideas, based on fully utilizing public cloud computing service resources, rely on their own needs, use secure and reliable private cloud solutions, integrate information resources, optimize business processes, and improve management levels. Vigorously develop services such as information system planning consulting, solution design, system integration, and testing and evaluation for cloud computing.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance cloud computing service capabilities.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: Strengthen the close connection and overall coordination of basic research, application research, technology development, market cultivation, and industrial policy related to cloud computing. Play the role of enterprises as the main force of innovation, drive technological innovation through service innovation, enhance original innovation capabilities, focus on breakthroughs in key technologies such as large-scale resource management and scheduling of cloud computing platforms, operation monitoring and security assurance, exabyte-level data storage and processing, and big data mining and analysis, and improve the research and development and industrialization level of related software and hardware products. Strengthen the integration of core electronic devices, high-end general-purpose chips, and basic software products with the needs of the cloud computing industry, actively promote the application of secure and reliable cloud computing products and solutions in various fields. Fully integrate and utilize domestic and foreign innovation resources, strengthen the construction of cloud computing-related technology research laboratories, engineering centers, and enterprise technology centers. Establish industrial innovation alliances, give play to the leading role of backbone enterprises, cultivate a group of innovative small and medium-sized enterprises with distinctive characteristics, and improve the industrial ecosystem. Improve the public support system for cloud computing, strengthen the protection and utilization of intellectual property rights, standard development, and related evaluation and assessment work, and promote collaborative innovation.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance the independent innovation capability of cloud computing.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: Encourage the application of cloud computing technology to integrate and transform existing electronic government information systems, achieve overall deployment and co-construction of government information systems in various fields, and significantly reduce the number of government-owned data centers. The construction of new electronic government systems must undergo strict demonstration and approval procedures. Government departments should increase their efforts to procure cloud computing services, actively carry out pilot demonstrations, explore new mechanisms for the operation of government informationization based on cloud computing, promote the sharing of government information resources and business collaboration, promote streamlining administration and delegating power, strengthen mid-term and post-event supervision, create greater market space for cloud computing, and drive the rapid development of the cloud computing industry.
titlelist: The main task is to explore new models for the development of e-government cloud computing.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: Give full play to the aggregating role of cloud computing in data resources, achieve the integration and sharing of data resources, and promote big data mining, analysis, application, and services. Carry out pilot reforms for the open and utilization of public data, issue regulations on the management of government agency data openness, actively explore the opening of geographic, population, intellectual property rights, and other relevant management agency data resources to society, promote data sharing among government departments, and enhance social management and public service capabilities. Focus on areas such as public safety, disease prevention and control, disaster prevention, employment and social security, transportation and logistics, education and scientific research, e-commerce, etc., carry out cloud computing-based big data application demonstrations, and support government agencies and enterprises in innovating big data service models. Give full play to the service support role of cloud computing and big data in the construction of smart cities, strengthen promotion and application, tap into market potential, and serve the economic and social development of cities.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the development and utilization of big data.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: Revise the classification catalog of telecommunications services, improve the market access system for cloud computing services, and support eligible cloud computing service enterprises in applying for relevant business qualifications. Research and support network policies for large-scale cloud computing services. Support third-party organizations in conducting evaluations and assessments of cloud computing service quality, reliability, and network security. Guide cloud computing service enterprises to strengthen internal management, improve service quality and integrity, and gradually establish a cloud computing trust system. Strengthen the supervision and technical support for the interconnection of the Internet backbone network, adjust the settlement policies for interconnection between networks, and ensure efficient and smooth interconnection between networks. Support cloud computing data centers that meet layout principles and energy consumption standards to participate in direct power supply pilot projects, meet the conditions for large-scale industrial electricity consumption, and provide guarantees in terms of network and municipal supporting facilities, as well as priority land allocation. Guide state-owned enterprises to use cloud computing technology to improve operational management levels and promote the use of secure and reliable cloud computing products and solutions.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the market environment.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: Guide the establishment of a number of cloud computing venture capital funds. Accelerate the establishment of a multi-level guarantee system, including fiscal investment and social capital input, and increase the financing guarantee support for cloud computing enterprises. Promote financial institutions to provide credit support to major cloud computing projects that are technologically advanced and have strong driving and supporting roles. Actively support eligible cloud computing enterprises to raise funds directly in the capital market.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve investment and financing policies.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Innovative Development of Cloud Computing and Cultivating New Forms of Information Industry (State Council [2015] No. 5) (State Council/January 6, 2015)
content: Encourage regular universities, vocational colleges, research institutes, and enterprises to collaborate in cultivating talent related to cloud computing, strengthen the effective connection between school education and industrial development, and provide high-level intellectual support for the development of cloud computing. Improve incentive mechanisms to cultivate a group of leaders and technical pioneers in the field of cloud computing. Make full use of existing talent introduction plans to attract high-end talent in the international cloud computing field. Outstanding contributions in the field of cloud computing may be recognized and rewarded according to relevant national regulations, and priority arrangements may be made in terms of professional title evaluation and household registration policies. Support enterprises and educational institutions in conducting training for talent in cloud computing applications.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the construction of talent teams.

name: Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting the Cloud Computing and Big Data Empowerment Action to Cultivate the Development of the New Economy (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 552 of 2020) (April 7, 2020)
content: On the basis of existing work, vigorously cultivate new forms of digital economy, promote the digital transformation of enterprises, create data supply chains, and use data flow to lead the flow of goods, talents, technologies, and funds, forming a digital ecological system that integrates upstream and downstream of the industrial chain and cross-industry integration. Build a typical paradigm of digitalization from equipment digitalization, production line digitalization, workshop digitalization, factory digitalization, enterprise digitalization, industrial chain digitalization to digital ecology. Build digital enterprises. On the basis of work such as moving to the cloud, promote the digital transformation of business operations such as research and development, production and processing, management, and sales and services. Support platform enterprises in helping small and micro enterprises overcome difficulties, providing multi-level and diversified services, reducing costs, lowering barriers, shortening cycles, improving the success rate of transformation, and enhancing the vitality of enterprise development. Build a digital industrial chain. Open up data channels for upstream and downstream enterprises in the industrial chain, promote all-channel and all-link supply-demand allocation and precise docking, use data supply chains to lead the material chain, promote efficient collaboration in the industrial chain, and provide strong support for the advanced development of the industrial foundation and the modernization of the industrial chain. Cultivate a digital ecosystem. Break through traditional business models, promote the cross-border integration of production-oriented service industries such as industry and finance, logistics, trading markets, and social networks, and focus on promoting agricultural and industrial service-oriented innovation and cultivating new forms of business. Based on digital platforms, build a digital ecosystem of production services + business models + financial services, create new entities in the digital economy, and fully tap into new domestic demand.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting the Cloud Computing and Big Data Empowerment Action to Cultivate the Development of the New Economy (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 552 of 2020) (April 7, 2020)
content: Accelerate the research, development, and application of common and key technologies for digital transformation. Support the exploration and integrated innovation of new generation digital technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, digital twins, 5G, Internet of Things, and blockchain in industries and enterprises that have the necessary conditions. Increase support for common development platforms, open source communities, common solution schemes, and basic software and hardware support. Encourage the open-source development of relevant codes, standards, and platforms.
titlelist: The main direction is to build a foundation and solidify the technological support for digital transformation.

name: Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting the Cloud Computing and Big Data Empowerment Action to Cultivate the Development of the New Economy (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 552 of 2020) (April 7, 2020)
content: Cultivate enterprise technology centers, industrial innovation centers, and innovation service complexes. Accelerate the improvement of digital infrastructure, promote the opening of enterprise-level digital infrastructure, promote the application of industrial data middle platform, and share middle platform business resources with small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the opening of core resources of enterprises. Support platforms in providing basic business services for free, and appropriately charge rent based on the effectiveness of value-added services to compensate for the investment in basic business. Encourage companies with core technologies to open source code, hardware design, and application services. Guide platform companies and industry leaders to integrate and open up resources, encourage the construction of digital technology and solution communities based on regions, industries, and parks, build industrial Internet platforms, and empower small and medium-sized enterprises with digital transformation.
titlelist: Main direction, building a platform, constructing a multi-level interconnected industrial internet platform.

name: Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting the Cloud Computing and Big Data Empowerment Action to Cultivate the Development of the New Economy (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 552 of 2020) (April 7, 2020)
content: Deepen digital transformation services, promote the separation of light and heavy assets based on cloud services cooperation. Encourage platform enterprises to carry out digital transformation of core business processes such as research and development design, operation management, production processing, and logistics after-sales. Encourage internet platform enterprises to provide intelligent data analysis services to small and micro enterprises based on their own advantages. Promote the digital transformation of small and micro enterprises, encourage platform enterprises to innovate lightweight applications and microservices, provide low-cost, low-threshold, and fast deployment services to small and micro enterprises, and accelerate the cultivation of a group of leading enterprises and hidden champions in segmented fields. Cultivate key industry application scenarios, accelerate the development of networked manufacturing, personalized customization, service-oriented production, promote applications such as digital villages, digital farms, smart homes, and intelligent logistics, and create an upgraded version of Internet Plus.
titlelist: Main direction, promote transformation, accelerate enterprises' cloud computing and data intelligence.

name: Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting the Cloud Computing and Big Data Empowerment Action to Cultivate the Development of the New Economy (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 552 of 2020) (April 7, 2020)
content: Promote the digitization of supply chain elements and the supply chainization of data elements, supporting the development of a digital industrial chain of research and development + production + supply chain and the creation of an ecosystem with a digital supply chain. Encourage traditional enterprises to engage in joint innovation with internet platform enterprises, industry-specific platform enterprises, financial institutions, etc., sharing resources such as technology, general assets, data, talent, markets, channels, facilities, and platforms, and explore the cultivation of service-oriented economies in traditional industries. Accelerate the organic integration of digital transformation, business process reshaping, organizational structure optimization, and business model transformation, and build a digital ecosystem that combines production services + business models + financial services across boundaries.
titlelist: The main direction is to build an ecological system and establish a digitally integrated cross-border ecosystem.

name: Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting the Cloud Computing and Big Data Empowerment Action to Cultivate the Development of the New Economy (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 552 of 2020) (April 7, 2020)
content: Vigorously develop the sharing economy, digital trade, gig economy, support new retail, online consumption, contactless delivery, internet healthcare, online education, one-stop travel, shared employees, remote work, and the 'stay-at-home economy' and other new business formats, smooth policy obstacles and difficulties. Guide cloud services to expand into the production and manufacturing sectors and small and micro enterprises. Encourage the development of flexible employment models such as shared employees, fully leveraging the reservoir effect of the digital economy.
titlelist: Main direction, developing new business models, expanding new space for economic development.

name: Notice on the Implementation Plan for Promoting the Cloud Computing and Big Data Empowerment Action to Cultivate the Development of the New Economy (National Development and Reform Commission, etc., Document No. 552 of 2020) (April 7, 2020)
content: Encourage various platforms, open-source communities, and third-party organizations to provide development tools and public services needed for digital transformation to small and medium-sized enterprises. Support the construction of digital transformation service consulting agencies and regional digital service carriers, enrich the digital service functions of various parks and characteristic towns. Innovate financial products and services such as order financing, supply chain finance, and credit guarantees. Expand multi-level talent and professional skills training services for digital transformation. Encourage platforms to provide free or discounted services to small and micro enterprises and flexible employees through government procurement services, special subsidies, and other means.
titlelist: Main direction, strong service, and increased support for digital transformation.

name: Announcement on the Release of Measures for the Security Assessment of Cloud Computing Services (No. 2 of 2019) (issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China and other departments on July 2, 2019)
content: The room is reported to the National Internet Information Office for approval according to the procedure. The results of the cloud computing service security assessment will be released by the office.
titlelist: Other factors that may affect cloud service security, the recommendations of the cloud computing service security assessment expert group, after coordination and review by the mechanism, office...

name: Announcement on the Release of Measures for the Security Assessment of Cloud Computing Services (No. 2 of 2019) (issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China and other departments on July 2, 2019)
content: 'Expiration of validity requires extension and maintenance. In the case of evaluation results, cloud service providers should apply for re-evaluation to the office at least 6 months before the expiration. If there are changes in the controlling shareholder or controlling rights due to equity changes or corporate restructuring during the validity period, cloud service providers should reapply for security assessment.'
titlelist: Other factors that may affect cloud service security, the validity period of cloud computing service security assessment results is 3 years.

name: Announcement on the Release of Measures for the Security Assessment of Cloud Computing Services (No. 2 of 2019) (issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China and other departments on July 2, 2019)
content: In the evaluation process, if one refuses to provide materials as required or intentionally provides false materials, their evaluation will not pass.
titlelist: Other factors that may affect cloud service security, cloud service providers are responsible for the authenticity of the materials provided.

name: Announcement on the Release of Measures for the Security Assessment of Cloud Computing Services (No. 2 of 2019) (issued by the Cyberspace Administration of China and other departments on July 2, 2019)
content: Cloud computing is a concentrated embodiment of the development of information technology and the innovation of service models. It is a major transformation and inevitable trend in the development of informatization. Supporting enterprises to migrate to the cloud is beneficial for accelerating the digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation of enterprises, improving their innovation capability, business strength, and development level. It is also beneficial for accelerating the development of the software and information technology service industry, deepening the structural reform of the supply side, promoting the deep integration of the Internet, big data, artificial intelligence, and the real economy, and accelerating the construction of a modern economic system.
titlelist: Other factors that may affect cloud service security: without the consent of the cloud service provider, the relevant institutions and personnel involved in the assessment work shall not disclose the undisclosed materials submitted by the cloud service provider, as well as other non-public information obtained during the assessment work. The information provided by the cloud service provider shall not be used for purposes other than assessment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology coordinates the work of enterprises migrating to the cloud, organizes the development of standards for evaluating the effectiveness of cloud migration, and guides local industrial and information technology authorities and third-party organizations to collaborate. Local industrial and information technology authorities should strengthen cloud computing platform services and operational capabilities based on local conditions, focus on accelerating the migration of key industries to the cloud, ensure the improvement of supporting services, develop work plans and implementation measures, organize promotional training, promote the integration of cloud platform service providers and industry enterprises, and orderly advance the process of enterprise cloud migration. By 2020, efforts will be made to further optimize the cloud environment for enterprises, significantly improve the awareness and enthusiasm of industry enterprises for cloud migration, significantly increase the proportion and depth of cloud adoption, widely popularize the application of cloud computing in enterprise production, operation, and management, add 1 million new cloud-based enterprises nationwide, and establish more than 100 exemplary benchmark applications and a number of influential and driving cloud platforms and enterprise cloud experience centers.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: By combining enterprise operations with information technology applications, we can achieve information system upgrades, promote business innovation, process restructuring, and management changes, accelerate enterprise digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation, and effectively improve enterprise management capabilities and overall competitiveness.
titlelist: The overall requirement is that enterprises should take improving their development capabilities and solving practical business problems as the starting point when migrating to the cloud.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: One, the use of information systems has obvious peak and off-peak periods, requiring dynamic allocation of resources and elastic expansion. Two, information systems need to be quickly iterated and launched to enhance business innovation speed. Three, information systems need to reduce operating and maintenance costs, improve emergency response, fault recovery, and information security capabilities. Four, information systems need to utilize cloud services such as big data and artificial intelligence to achieve business expansion.
titlelist: The overall requirement is that enterprises should prioritize the migration of information systems to the cloud that align with the business characteristics and evident value benefits of cloud computing.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: One is the computing resource service. By using various elastic computing services on the cloud platform, it achieves centralized management, dynamic allocation, elastic expansion, and reduces the burden of operation and maintenance for computing resources. The second is the storage resource service. By using cloud storage services such as block storage and object storage on the cloud platform, it improves the economy, security, and reliability of data storage. The third is the network resource service. By using network services such as virtual private cloud, virtual private network, and load balancing on the cloud platform, it efficiently and securely utilizes cloud platform network resources. The fourth is the security protection service. By using security services such as cloud host security protection, network attack protection, application firewall, key/certificate management, and data encryption protection on the cloud, it enhances information security capabilities.
titlelist: Choose cloud services on demand and reasonably, infrastructure-based cloud services.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: One is database services. Utilizing cloud database systems to achieve cross-platform and cross-business collaborative management of various types of data. Two is big data analysis services. Utilizing cloud-based big data platforms to promote data resource aggregation, including data collection, storage, analysis, mining, and collaborative applications. Three is middleware platform services. Utilizing cloud-based middleware services to build distributed system architectures to meet the needs of the Internet+ transformation. Four is Internet of Things (IoT) platform services. Connecting massive IoT terminal devices to the cloud platform to achieve efficient and visualized online device management. Five is software development platform services. Through cloud-based development platforms, software lifecycle management is conducted to quickly build development, testing, and runtime environments, standardize development processes, reduce costs, and improve efficiency. Six is artificial intelligence platform services. Utilizing the computing resources of the cloud platform to develop intelligent services such as speech recognition, image recognition, and facial recognition, thereby enhancing business intelligence levels.
titlelist: Choose cloud services and platform system services according to demand and reason.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: One is collaborative office services. By using cloud services such as email, meetings, and communication, a low-cost and high-efficiency office system is formed to improve office efficiency. Two is business management application services. By using cloud services for enterprise human resources management, administrative management, financial management, etc., the scientificity and efficiency of enterprise management are improved. Three is operation management services. By using cloud services for procurement management, production management, sales management, supply chain management, customer resource management, etc., the level of enterprise operation management is enhanced. Four is research and development design services. By using cloud services such as computer-aided design, product development, deploying development and design environments in the cloud, the efficiency and innovation level of research and development are improved. Five is production control services. By moving MES (Manufacturing Execution System), production data, and other systems to the cloud, the production control process is optimized to enhance production efficiency and level. Six is intelligent application services. By integrating enterprise-wide data, intelligent applications such as intelligent research and development, intelligent production, intelligent marketing, and intelligent services are created to enhance the level of enterprise intelligence.
titlelist: Choose cloud services and business application services according to demand and reason.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: (1) Can moving to the cloud enhance the development capabilities of the enterprise and solve practical business problems? (2) Is the information system suitable for elastic expansion? Does it require rapid deployment? Are the cloud platform and application services compatible with the existing information system? If not compatible, the cost and risks of migration and transformation need to be evaluated. (3) Evaluate whether the data storage method and data security meet the requirements. (4) Evaluate whether the cloud migration method (online/offline, etc.) meets the business requirements. Is the cloud migration time within an acceptable range of business interruption? Can it meet the experience requirements of different types of users after moving to the cloud? (5) Evaluate the switching plan, parallel operation plan, and failure rollback plan for the existing system and the system after moving to the cloud. Evaluate the potential risks during system transformation, data migration, and application migration, and provide corresponding suggestions.
titlelist: Steadily and orderly promote enterprise cloud adoption. Enterprises can combine their own business development plans and, with the support of third-party institutions or cloud platform service providers, comprehensively sort out information system business types, user profiles, usage characteristics, performance indicators, database usage, system interrelationships, and more.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: (1) Promote the cloudification of development and testing environments, build simulated environments, including migrating source and target environments. (2) Implement simulated cloudification, conduct functional testing, performance testing, backup testing, and disaster recovery testing, and modify and improve the cloudification plan based on this. (3) Prepare resources including personnel, environments, implementation tools, etc., according to the cloudification plan, implement the cloudification process, carry out data migration and application migration, and implement rollback plans in case of failure.
titlelist: Steadily and orderly promote enterprises to migrate to the cloud. Enterprises can, with the support of cloud platform service providers or third-party institutions, build a simulated environment according to the cloud migration plan, conduct cloud migration drills, continuously optimize and improve the cloud migration plan, and execute the cloud migration process.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: Deepen the evaluation of cloud service capabilities and the assessment of service reliability, promote the improvement of cloud computing enterprise service levels and service quality. Actively explore the use of insurance models to provide protection for cloud-based enterprises.
titlelist: Strengthen policy guarantees, support industrial and information technology authorities in various regions to establish and improve public service platforms, and provide various services such as information system planning consultation, program design, supervision, and training for enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Guidelines for Promoting Enterprise Cloud Adoption (2018-2020) (MIIT Letter of Information Technology and Software [2018] No. 135) (MIIT/July 23, 2018)
content: Support various types of enterprises and entrepreneurs to utilize cloud computing platforms as a foundation, and actively cultivate new formats and models such as platform economy and sharing economy by leveraging new technologies such as big data, Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, and blockchain.
titlelist: Strengthen policy guarantees and encourage all regions to accelerate the promotion of cloud-based innovation and entrepreneurship.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: By 2019, the scale of China's cloud computing industry reached 430 billion yuan, breaking through a number of core key technologies. The cloud computing service capabilities reached an international advanced level, significantly enhancing the driving effect on the development of the new generation information industry. The application level of cloud computing in manufacturing, government affairs, and other fields has significantly improved. The layout of cloud computing data centers has been optimized, with significantly improved utilization and intensification levels, and continuous improvement in green energy-saving levels. The PUE value of newly built data centers is generally better than 1.4. Over 20 cloud computing-related standards have been released, forming a relatively complete cloud computing standard system and third-party evaluation service system. The international influence of cloud computing enterprises has significantly increased, with 2-3 leading enterprises emerging with a large market share in the global cloud computing market. The security assurance capability of cloud computing network has significantly improved, and the network security supervision system and regulatory system have gradually become sound. Cloud computing has become the main form of information construction and an important support for building a strong network and manufacturing country, promoting a substantial improvement in the level of informatization in various economic and social fields.
titlelist: The overall thinking and development goals, development goals.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: Continuously enhance key core technical capabilities. Support leading large-scale professional cloud computing enterprises in establishing manufacturing innovation centers in the field of cloud computing, in collaboration with research institutes and higher education institutions. Organize and implement a batch of key industrial innovation projects to grasp the high ground of cloud computing development. Actively develop new virtualization technologies such as containers, microkernels, and hyper-convergence, and improve the processing capacity, efficiency, and user resource isolation level of virtual machine live migration. Continuously enhance the management efficiency and energy efficiency management level of large-scale distributed storage and computing resources to meet the needs of large-scale data processing, in-memory computing, scientific computing, and other applications. Support enterprises, research institutions, and industry organizations to participate in mainstream open-source communities, utilize open-source community technologies and developer resources, and improve cloud computing software technology and system service capabilities. Guide enterprises to strengthen the core patent layout in the field of cloud computing, conduct analysis and risk assessment of cloud computing intellectual property rights, publish analysis and early warning research results, and guide enterprises to strengthen intellectual property rights layout. Carry out intellectual property-related laws and regulations publicity and training to improve enterprise intellectual property awareness and management level. Accelerate the improvement of the cloud computing standard system. Implement the Guidelines for the Construction of Comprehensive Standardization System for Cloud Computing and promote the improvement of the standard system framework. Guide standardization organizations to expedite the development of key urgently needed technologies, services, and application standards such as cloud computing resource monitoring, service metering and billing, application and data migration, industrial cloud service capabilities, and cloud computing server technical requirements. Actively carry out the promotion, implementation, and application demonstration of standards, and test and improve standards in practice. Explore innovative forms of standardization work, actively cultivate and develop group standards, and guide and support standard organizations, industry alliances, core enterprises, and other entities in formulating and publishing high-quality cloud computing standard achievements. Support backbone enterprises and industry associations in substantial participation in the formulation of international standards for cloud computing technology, management, services, and other aspects. Conduct in-depth cloud service capability evaluations. Relying on third-party testing organizations and the strength of backbone enterprises, based on relevant national, industry, and group standards, and guided by user needs, establish a sound evaluation index system and workflow for personnel, technology, processes, resources, and other key aspects of cloud computing services. Carry out cloud computing service capability and trustworthiness evaluations, guide cloud computing enterprises to improve service levels, ensure service quality, and enhance security capabilities. Actively promote mutual recognition of results with international mainstream evaluation systems.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance technology.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: Support software companies in transitioning to cloud computing. Support local regulatory authorities in collaboration with backbone cloud computing enterprises to establish public service platforms for cloud computing development and testing, providing consulting, training, research and development, and business services. Support software and information technology service companies in developing products, services, and solutions based on the development and testing platform, accelerating the transition to cloud computing, enriching and improving enterprise-level SaaS services such as office, production management, financial management, marketing management, and human resources management, developing cloud services for personal information storage, home life, learning, and entertainment, and cultivating new hotspots in information consumption. Accelerate the cultivation of backbone leading enterprises. Increase support in terms of funding, credit, talent, and other aspects to meet the innovative development needs of key industries, accelerate the cultivation of cloud computing enterprises and cloud computing platforms with certain technical strength, business scale, outstanding innovation capabilities, good market prospects, and strong influence. Support backbone leading enterprises in diversifying service types, improving service capabilities, innovating business models, building an ecological system, and promoting the formation of an industrial echelon in the field of cloud computing, continuously enhancing China's systematic development strength in the field of cloud computing. Promote the construction of an industrial ecological system. Build a number of new industrial demonstration bases in the field of cloud computing and improve the construction of industrial carriers. Relying on industry organizations such as industry alliances, fully leverage the driving role and technology spillover effects of backbone cloud computing enterprises, accelerate the research and industrialization of key cloud computing equipment, and guide enterprises in the fields of chips, basic software, servers, storage, networks, etc., to achieve technological and product breakthroughs in software-defined networks, new architecture computing devices, hyper-converged devices, green data centers, modular data centers, storage devices, information security products, etc., driving the development of the information industry and strengthening industrial support capabilities. Vigorously develop services such as information system planning consulting, solution design, system integration, and testing and evaluation for cloud computing.
titlelist: Key tasks, industrial development action

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: Actively develop industrial cloud services. Implement the Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet and promote the pilot demonstration of industrial cloud applications. Support leading manufacturing companies and cloud computing companies in jointly building industrial cloud platforms for the manufacturing industry, gathering resources such as tool libraries, model libraries, and knowledge libraries, and providing cloud services such as industrial-specific software, industrial data analysis, online virtual simulation, and collaborative research and development design. Promote manufacturing companies to accelerate business model and commercial model innovation based on cloud computing, develop collaborative innovation, personalized customization, and other business forms, cultivate the cloud manufacturing model, enhance the agility, serviceability, and intelligence of the manufacturing industry, and promote the transformation, upgrading, and improvement of the manufacturing industry. Support key industry associations, professional institutions, and backbone cloud computing companies in the steel, automobile, light industry, and other manufacturing sectors to cooperate in building industry cloud platforms, promote the migration of various information systems to cloud platforms, enrich professional cloud service content, promote the application of cloud computing in segmented industries of the manufacturing industry, and improve the level of industry development and management. Coordinate the promotion of government cloud applications. Promote the cloud computing-based government informationization construction model, encourage local government departments to increase the use of cloud computing services, apply cloud computing to integrate and transform existing e-government information systems, and improve government operational efficiency. Actively develop secure and reliable cloud computing solutions. In the construction of important information systems and key infrastructure, explore the use of cloud computing system architecture and models to compensate for the insufficient performance of software and hardware products, and promote the large-scale application of secure and reliable software and hardware products. Support cloud computing-based innovation and entrepreneurship. Promote the double innovation of large enterprises, encourage and support the development of entrepreneurial and innovative platforms using cloud computing, promote the aggregation of online and offline resources through the establishment of open platforms, establishment of venture capital funds, and provision of entrepreneurial guidance, and drive collaborative innovation among small and medium-sized enterprises. Support small and medium-sized enterprises and individual developers to develop and industrialize new technologies and businesses such as big data, the Internet of Things, artificial intelligence, and blockchain based on cloud computing platforms through events such as maker competitions, cultivate a batch of emerging business models such as platform economy and sharing economy based on cloud computing, and further expand the scope of cloud computing applications.
titlelist: Key tasks, application promotes progress.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: Promote the upgrade of network infrastructure. Implement the Broadband China strategy and its implementation plan, guide basic telecommunications and internet companies to accelerate network upgrade and transformation, guide the construction of a batch of all-optical network provinces and cities, promote the fiber-optic broadband access process, implement co-construction and sharing, and further enhance the capacity of fiber-optic broadband networks. Promote the construction of internet backbone networks, expand the bandwidth of backbone direct connection points, and continuously optimize the network structure. Improve regulatory measures for the cloud computing market. Further clarify the regulatory requirements for cloud computing-related businesses, and carry out approval and post-approval supervision of Internet data centers (IDCs), internet resource collaboration services, and other related business operations in accordance with the law. Speed up the introduction of management requirements for regulating the operation of the cloud service market, standardize the market order, and promote the healthy and orderly development of the cloud service market. Implement the guidance on data center layout. Further promote the implementation of the Guidance on Data Center Construction Layout, enhance capacity on the supply side, establish high-level benchmarks through demonstrations, guide benchmarking and improve data center utilization and construction application levels; on the demand side, guide docking, classify domestic data centers according to capacity, service coverage areas, suitable business types, etc. through the development of guidelines, guide users to reasonably choose and use data center resources according to their needs, and promote cross-regional resource sharing.
titlelist: Key tasks, environmental optimization action

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: Promote policy banks, industrial investment institutions, and guarantee institutions to increase support for cloud computing enterprises, launch targeted products and services, increase credit support, simplify procedures and formalities, and support the development of cloud computing enterprises. Learn from the first insurance model and explore the use of insurance to accelerate the migration of important information systems to cloud computing platforms. Support cloud computing enterprises in accessing capital market financing, conducting mergers and acquisitions, expanding markets, and accelerating their growth.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, optimizing investment and financing environment.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: Support the innovative development of industry organizations such as the Cloud Computing Industry Alliance, organize activities for technological innovation, showcase experiences, and promote applications in the field of cloud computing. Build a well-known domestic and international platform for industrial development. Increase the promotion and recognition of excellent cloud computing enterprises, products, services, platforms, and application cases, and enhance the visibility of China's cloud computing brand. Strengthen the promotion of exemplary cloud computing industry demonstration bases and industry organizations, and stimulate enthusiasm from all sectors to promote the development of cloud computing.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the building of industrial brands.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Development of Cloud Computing (2017-2019) (MIIT XRS [2017] No. 49) (MIIT/March 30, 2017)
content: Utilize international cooperation mechanisms such as Sino-German, Sino-European, Sino-Japanese-Korean, etc., to accelerate the establishment and improvement of international cooperation and communication platforms in the field of cloud computing. Combine with the implementation of national strategies such as the Belt and Road initiative to gradually establish an overseas market service system oriented towards specialization and marketization. Support leading cloud computing enterprises in expanding overseas by establishing overseas research and development centers, sales networks, broadening overseas market channels, conducting cross-border mergers and acquisitions, and enhancing international market expansion capabilities.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote international exchange and cooperation.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Promote the outsourcing of information technology, business processes, and knowledge processes in sync, focusing on the development of high-tech, high-value-added service outsourcing businesses, and promoting the extension of the industrial value chain to the high-end. Regularly release the Guiding Catalog for Key Development Areas of the Service Outsourcing Industry to strengthen guidance for the development of the service outsourcing industry. Actively expand the service outsourcing industry in areas such as software and information technology, design, research and development, the internet, healthcare, industry, and energy. Accelerate the development of service outsourcing in fields such as cultural creativity, education, transportation logistics, healthcare, technology services, wholesale and retail, and leisure and entertainment. Actively develop financial service outsourcing, encouraging financial institutions to outsource non-core businesses.
titlelist: Cultivate new competitive advantages, clarify the direction of industrial development.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Support all types of ownership enterprises to engage in service outsourcing business, encourage the professionalization, scale, and branding development of service outsourcing enterprises. Promote the improvement of research and development innovation level of service outsourcing enterprises, guide and support enterprises to carry out research and development of integrated design, comprehensive solutions, and related technology projects through national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.). Encourage service outsourcing enterprises to strengthen business model and management model innovation, actively develop long-term contract-based service outsourcing business. Cultivate a group of leading service outsourcing enterprises with strong innovation capabilities, high level of integrated services, and international competitiveness. Support a group of small and medium-sized service outsourcing enterprises that are specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative. Encourage enterprises, especially industrial enterprises, to break the integrated pattern of large and comprehensive or small and comprehensive and purchase professional services for non-core businesses. Guide service outsourcing enterprises to optimize the allocation of resources such as funds, technology, and talents through mergers and reorganizations, and achieve complementary advantages. Government departments should continuously expand the scope of purchasing services and entrust outsourced businesses to professional service enterprises.
titlelist: Cultivate new competitive advantages, cultivate and strengthen market entities.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Promote the quality of bilateral economic and trade cooperation, orderly advance practical cooperation in the outsourcing service industry within the existing framework, and create an international environment conducive to common development. Increase support for outsourcing service enterprises to participate in international exhibitions, project negotiations, and other activities. Combine the implementation of the going global strategy and foreign aid, comprehensively utilize various measures such as trade, export credit, foreign investment cooperation, and foreign aid to support eligible outsourcing service enterprises to go global and engage in high value-added project cooperation such as research and development outsourcing, knowledge process outsourcing, and business process outsourcing. Encourage enterprises and institutions to purchase high-tech and innovative high-end services in the international market, introduce advanced technology, advanced business models, and management experience, and accelerate the transformation and upgrading of the domestic outsourcing service industry.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures, deepen international exchanges and cooperation.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Improve the existing fiscal fund policies, optimize fund allocation and utilization, enhance support methods, increase support for international service outsourcing businesses, encourage the development of international service outsourcing research and development, talent training, qualification certification, public services, etc. Fully leverage the guiding role of fiscal funds, guide social funds to increase investment in enterprises undertaking international service outsourcing businesses through market-oriented support methods such as establishing an international service outsourcing industry guidance fund, and promote the expansion of service exports.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures and increase financial support.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Expand the scope of the tax preferential policy for technology advanced service enterprises to pay corporate income tax at a reduced rate of 15% and deduct employee education expenses not exceeding 8% of the total wages and salaries before tax. Taking into account the layout of service outsourcing industry clusters, the number of Chinese service outsourcing demonstration cities will increase from 21 to 31 in an orderly manner, considering the eastern, central, and western cities. Implement zero tax rate and tax exemption policies for value-added tax on international service outsourcing.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures and improve tax policies.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Broaden the investment and financing channels for service outsourcing enterprises. Encourage financial institutions to innovate financial products and services that comply with regulatory policies and adapt to the characteristics of the service outsourcing industry, based on the principles of risk control and commercial sustainability. Promote the pledging of accounts receivable, patents, copyrights, and other intellectual property rights. Support policy-based financial institutions in lawfully and compliantly innovating and developing under the guidance of relevant departments and regulatory agencies, and increase support for service outsourcing enterprises in expanding international markets, conducting overseas mergers and acquisitions, and strengthening key project construction in the service outsourcing sector. Encourage insurance institutions to innovate insurance products, improve insurance services, expand the scale and coverage of export credit insurance, and enhance underwriting and claims efficiency. Utilize existing financial policies to guide financing guarantee institutions in strengthening financing guarantee services for small and medium-sized enterprises in the service outsourcing industry. Support eligible service outsourcing enterprises to raise funds through listing on the SME board, the Growth Enterprise Market, and the SME share transfer system. Support eligible service outsourcing enterprises to diversify their financing channels by issuing corporate bonds, company bonds, and non-financial corporate debt financing instruments.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures, enhance financial services.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Deepen the reform of the overseas investment approval system, promote the facilitation of overseas investment, implement a management approach focused on filing, minimize the scope of approval, and simplify approval procedures. Further enhance the level of facilitation in customs clearance, innovate the customs supervision mode for service outsourcing. Innovate the inspection and quarantine supervision mode for service outsourcing, simplify the approval procedures for prototypes, samples, reagents, and other items required for international service outsourcing business, implement classified management, and provide facilitation in customs clearance. Accelerate the implementation of measures to facilitate foreign exchange management, eligible service outsourcing enterprises can apply to participate in the pilot reform of foreign exchange management for overseas investment in service outsourcing, and timely study and promote based on the pilot situation. Encourage the use of RMB settlement in cross-border trade and investment. Provide convenient entry and residence for foreign high-end management and technical personnel engaged in international service outsourcing business. Improve the level of international communication services, support basic telecommunications operators in providing convenience for network access and international line leasing for service outsourcing enterprises.
titlelist: Strengthen policy measures and enhance the level of convenience.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: Research and improve the legal system of the service outsourcing industry, promote industry development and regulate business practices. Effectively safeguard national security, and hold legally responsible those who intentionally or negligently disclose state secrets or harm national security. Strengthen law enforcement and supervision of intellectual property rights such as copyrights, patents, and trademarks in the field of service outsourcing. Establish a credit record and credit evaluation system for service outsourcing companies, punish dishonesty, crack down on fraud, and improve the integrity system of service outsourcing companies. Encourage mature regions to carry out local legislation, and timely introduce local regulations and government rules related to the service outsourcing industry.
titlelist: Strengthening service guarantees, building a rule of law-based business environment.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Development of the Service Outsourcing Industry (State Council [2014] No. 67) (State Council/December 24, 2014)
content: The embassies and consulates abroad should increase their guidance and coordination efforts in cooperating with overseas service outsourcing companies. They should actively strengthen communication and cooperation with domestic regulatory authorities, provide timely and effective information and policy recommendations. They should leverage the role of industry associations to improve service quality and promotion, enhance industry self-discipline, research and formulate service and talent standards, and establish the China Service brand. They should fully utilize existing platforms for service outsourcing exchange and cooperation, attract multinational companies to transfer international service outsourcing business, and encourage research institutions, business associations, universities, and enterprises to engage in various forms of practical cooperation. They should strengthen public information services for service outsourcing, and promptly release international and domestic market dynamics and policy information.
titlelist: Improve service guarantee and enhance the level of public services.

name: Notice on the Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 180) (MIIT/November 30, 2020)
content: Human society is entering a new stage of development characterized by digital productivity. Software plays an important role in the digital process, providing essential support and driving development towards networking, platformization, and intelligence. This in turn drives the iterative innovation and breakthroughs of new generation information technologies such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, 5G, blockchain, industrial internet, and quantum computing, accelerating the pace of digital industrialization. Software enables integration and development, empowering, valuing, and enlightening, comprehensively promoting the digitalization, networking, and intelligence transformation and upgrading of the economy and society, continuously stimulating innovative vitality of data elements, solidifying security guarantees for equipment, networks, control, data, and applications, accelerating the process of industrial digitalization, opening up broad development space for the digital economy, and promoting quality, efficiency, and dynamic changes in China's development.
titlelist: Development situation, software expands new digital development space.

name: Notice on the Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 180) (MIIT/November 30, 2020)
content: Software-defined is a new feature and new symbol of the new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, and has become an important driving force for future development. Software-defined expands the functionality of products, transforms the value creation model of products, gives rise to new manufacturing models such as platform-based design, personalized customization, networked collaboration, intelligent production, extended services, and digital management, and promotes the flourishing of platform economy and sharing economy. Software-defined endows enterprises with new capabilities, and aerospace, automotive, major equipment, steel, petrochemical and other industries have accelerated their transformation towards software.
