Software capability has become the core competitiveness of industrial enterprises. Software-defined endows infrastructure with new capabilities and flexibility, becoming an important engine for upgrading production methods, transforming production relations, and developing emerging industries.
titlelist: Development situation, software-defined empowers new transformation of the real economy.

name: Notice on the Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 180) (MIIT/November 30, 2020)
content: The open, equal, collaborative, and shared open-source model accelerates software iteration and upgrade, promotes collaborative innovation in production, and drives the improvement of industrial ecology, becoming the dominant model for global software technology and industrial innovation. Currently, open source has covered the entire domain of software development, building a new software technology innovation system, leading the development of the new generation of information technology innovation. 97% of global software developers and 99% of enterprises use open-source software. Most basic software, industrial software, and emerging platform software are based on open source. Open-source software has become a source of innovation and a standard component library for the software industry. At the same time, open source has opened up new competition tracks for the industry, and the open-source ecosystem based on the collective research, use, and creation of global developers is accelerating its formation.
titlelist: Development situation, open source reshapes the new ecology of software development.

name: Notice on the Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 180) (MIIT/November 30, 2020)
content: Focus on the software industry chain, accelerate the 'shortcomings, strengths, and service optimization' to solidify the upstream basic software capabilities in the development environment, tools, and other industrial chain, enhance the software level in the middle of the industrial chain such as industrial software, application software, platform software, embedded software, etc., increase the supply of information technology service products in the downstream of the industrial chain, and improve the modernization level of the software industry chain. Focus on strengthening basic software. Improve desktop, server, mobile terminal, and in-vehicle operating system products and supporting toolkits, promote the integration, adaptation, and optimization of operating systems with databases, middleware, office suites, security software, and various applications. Accelerate the research and development and application promotion of distributed databases, hybrid transactional analysis processing databases, shared memory database clusters, and other products. Carry out the research and development of high-performance and high-reliability middleware key products and components. Enrich security software products and services such as data backup, disaster recovery, and industrial control system protection. Promote the research and development and application promotion of related products of software integrated development environment and key testing tools. Focus on breakthroughs in industrial software. Develop computer-aided design, simulation, calculation, and other tool software, vigorously develop key industrial control software, and accelerate the industrial deployment of high-value-added operation and maintenance and business management software. Develop industry-specific industrial software for key areas such as CNC machine tools, integrated circuits, aerospace equipment, ships, as well as new energy and intelligent connected vehicles, strengthen integration and verification, and form systematic service capabilities. Column 1: Key basic software shortcomings. Operating system. Strengthen the overall architecture design and technical path planning of the operating system, promote joint research and development of key operating system technologies among chip design, operating system, system integration enterprises, research institutes, and universities, improve the compatibility of the operating system with underlying hardware and interoperability with upper-layer applications. Database. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as full-memory high-speed data engines, high-reliability data storage engines, distributed data processing and task scheduling architectures, large-scale parallel graph data processing, etc. Promote the application of high-performance databases in key industries such as finance, telecommunications, and energy. Development support software. Improve the integration and stability of software development tools, break through key technologies such as code resource reuse and recommendation, large-scale cross-language analysis, etc. Accelerate the research and development of testing tools such as program static analysis, dynamic testing, simulation testing, and automated testing platforms. Design and simulation system software. Breakthroughs in key technologies such as three-dimensional geometric modeling engines, constraint solving engines, etc., explore open industrial software architecture, system-level design and simulation, and other technical paths. Focus on supporting the development of three-dimensional computer-aided design, multi-physics field computer-aided calculation such as structure/fluid, model-based system engineering, and other product research and development. Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Establish a joint technical research and development mechanism for EDA developers, chip design companies, foundries, etc., break through key technologies for the entire process of digital, analog, and mixed-signal circuit design, verification, physical implementation, and manufacturing testing, and improve advanced process toolkits. Industrial control software. Focus on industrial control systems such as programmable logic controllers (PLCs), distributed control systems (DCS), safety instrumented systems (SIS), etc., carry out joint research and development and adaptation migration of software products with multi-point, low-latency, high-reliability, and low-energy consumption, promote the development of safety monitoring and management systems for manufacturing enterprise-side security functions, and accelerate the integrated application of products in key industries. Collaborative development of application software. Focus on key industries such as finance, construction, energy, transportation, etc., accelerate breakthroughs in financial core business systems, building information modeling and fire simulation, smart energy management, intelligent traffic management, intelligent office, etc. Research and promote software products related to the Beidou satellite navigation system. Develop new-generation software integration application infrastructure around new infrastructure construction such as 5G base stations, big data centers, etc. Encourage leading companies in the industry to collaborate with software companies to jointly develop industry-specific software products. Proactively layout emerging platform software. Accelerate the cultivation of internationally competitive software technologies and products in fields such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, 5G, blockchain, industrial internet, etc. Support the development of new lightweight platforms such as mini-programs and quick applications. Accelerate the research and development of software technologies in frontier areas such as the sixth-generation mobile communication (6G), quantum information, satellite internet, brain-like intelligence, and cultivate a batch of landmark products. Column 2: Strengthen emerging platform software strengths. Cloud computing. Accelerate the research and development of technologies such as ultra-large-scale distributed storage, elastic computing, virtual isolation, heterogeneous resource scheduling, etc., speed up the iteration and upgrade of cloud operating systems, and layout the next-generation cloud computing software system. Encourage enterprises to build high-performance cloud platforms, optimize the layout of public clouds, industry-specific clouds, and regional hybrid cloud platforms. Improve cloud security levels and intelligent cloud service capabilities. Big data. Support key technological innovations such as high-performance data acquisition, high-capacity storage, massive information processing, heterogeneous data management, real-time monitoring of sensitive information, chip integration of storage and computing, platform security control, etc. In key areas such as industry, communication, finance, medical care, emergency response, agriculture, public security, transportation, power, etc., develop a batch of leading software products and solutions. Artificial intelligence. Support the research and development of artificial intelligence algorithm libraries, toolkits, etc. Accelerate the development of new machine learning, biometric recognition, natural language understanding, new human-computer interaction, intelligent control and decision-making, and other products and services. Promote the construction of open platforms for artificial intelligence. Blockchain. Accelerate the research and development of key technologies such as blockchain consensus algorithms, encryption algorithms, efficient and secure smart contracts, distributed systems, etc. Support the construction of underlying technology platforms and blockchain service platforms. Strengthen key areas of application such as financial technology, supply chain management, and government services. Virtual reality and augmented reality. Promote technological innovations such as three-dimensional graphics production, dynamic environment modeling, real-time motion capture, fast rendering processing, etc., develop virtual reality-related development tool software and industry solutions. Actively cultivate embedded software. Carry out research and development of embedded software systems for major equipment needs such as CNC machine tools, intelligent robots, new energy and intelligent connected vehicles, communication equipment, aerospace engines, etc. Breakthroughs in embedded operating systems, embedded database core technologies, accelerate the research and development and application promotion of related products. Optimize information technology services. Facing the needs of digitalization, networking, and intelligent applications, strengthen algorithm services in typical scenarios, promote technological innovations related to enterprise-level business continuity management (BCM). Improve the information technology service system around digital management consulting, integrated integration, intelligent operation and maintenance, etc., and enhance specialized information technology service capabilities in key industries and fields. Support the construction of an information technology service ecosystem with perception, control, and decision-making capabilities. Column 3: Demonstration of information technology service applications. Strengthen the research and development of key information technology services. Carry out technological research and development in data governance, data analysis, knowledge graphs, data security containers, intelligent monitoring and early warning, multi-source data integration, etc., and build a new information technology service technical system. Promote intelligent service applications for industry enterprises. For industries such as finance, telecommunications, energy, etc., promote the construction and application of intelligent information technology service platforms and build an intelligent service system. Select key enterprises to carry out the construction and application of digital transformation support platforms, and cultivate a group of digital transformation solution providers.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the upgrading of the software industry chain.

name: Notice on the Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 180) (MIIT/November 30, 2020)
content: Strengthen the development foundation of common technologies, basic resource libraries, basic components, etc., enhance the basic guarantee capabilities of quality standards, value evaluation, intellectual property rights, etc., and promote the advanced development of industrial foundations. Strengthen the research and development of common technologies. Strengthen basic research such as software and system engineering methods, programming languages, key core algorithms, etc. Develop data models and interface standards to enhance system interoperability, architectural openness, and application programming interface (API) standardization capabilities. In response to the common needs of software development, build basic algorithm libraries, component libraries, and general model libraries to promote the open sharing of basic resources. Strengthen the supply of basic components. Promote the development of software kernels such as operating systems, browsers, and industrial software. Accelerate breakthroughs in programming language development frameworks and enrich third-party libraries. Vigorously develop emerging platform software development frameworks such as cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain. Promote the development of software development kits (SDKs) and encourage innovation in SDKs in specific functional areas. Strengthen open source code security testing to ensure the security of open source code component supply. Promote the software development of basic resource management and services such as domain names and identifiers. Improve the quality standards system. Build a software industry quality service system, promote advanced quality management models and methods, and guide enterprises to carry out quality brand construction. Improve the software industry standard system, focus on key areas, accelerate the formulation of technical, product, service, management, evaluation, and other standards, and improve the level of standard generalization. Improve the software product and service testing and certification evaluation system. Support the enhancement of software value. Establish a software value evaluation mechanism that meets the requirements of high-quality development, promote the use of software cost measurement standards, strengthen supervision of software product and service prices, and maintain market price order. Strengthen the creation, application, protection, management, and service capabilities of intellectual property rights in the software and information technology fields, increase the protection of software intellectual property rights, and encourage enterprises to strengthen cooperation in software intellectual property rights. Continuously promote the legalization of software and crack down on all types of software infringement and piracy. Increase efforts to combat unfair competition in the software field and legally protect the trade secrets of software industry enterprises. Column 4: Enhancing industrial basic capabilities. Enhance software engineering capabilities. Carry out pilot demonstrations of software engineering capabilities, promote advanced software engineering technologies and methods, and promote product lifecycle management. Develop third-party service organizations, strengthen product development in software engineering, testing certification, etc., and build software engineering service guarantee capabilities. Enhance software product and data capabilities. Improve the maturity standard system for software product and data capabilities, combine industry user needs, promote the evaluation and assessment of software and data maturity, and build relevant public service systems. Enhance software standardization capabilities. Establish a mechanism for coordinated promotion of product development and standard formulation, promote standard promotion and application demonstrations, establish national standard verification and testing points, and establish a standard conformity assessment system. Support domestic enterprises and institutions to participate deeply in international standard formulation. Enhance software quality management capabilities. Support the development of tools such as configuration management, code review, test verification, quality analysis, etc., and enhance quality monitoring, early warning, and evaluation capabilities. Promote enterprises to establish product development and quality control systems that are in line with international standards and improve software development quality. Enhance software value protection capabilities. Develop software value evaluation specifications, establish evaluation systems, and strengthen software value calculation and statistics. Support priority examination of intellectual property rights in key areas of the software industry and improve the intellectual property rights intermediary service system. Enhance public service capabilities in software. Promote the construction of specialized service organizations for quality standards, investment and financing, intellectual property rights transactions, evaluation and certification, etc. Encourage the development of public service platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the level of industrial infrastructure support.

name: Notice on the Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry during the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (MIIT Regulation [2021] No. 180) (MIIT/November 30, 2020)
content: Strengthen the collaborative research and development between government, industry, academia, and research institutes, strengthen and expand innovative carriers, fully unleash the innovation vitality of software-defined, accelerate mode innovation and mechanism innovation, and build a collaborative and controllable industrial innovation system. Strengthen the collaborative innovation between industry, academia, research, and application. Enhance the position of enterprises as the main body of innovation, support leading enterprises in forming joint innovation bodies with user units and universities and research institutes, and carry out key core technology research. Build a software industry innovation platform for collaborative research and development, enhance integration and systematic innovation capabilities. Build software and hardware adaptation centers around typical application scenarios in key industries, carry out public services such as product research and development, integration verification, and achievement display, and accelerate the industrialization of innovative achievements. Deepen software-defined. Accelerate the development of software-defined computing, software-defined storage, and software-defined networking, with a focus on industrial Internet, cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and autonomous driving and other emerging software-defined platforms. Guide enterprises to develop relevant system architecture and application specifications, and promote innovative applications. Column 5: Cultivate innovative applications of software-defined. Build a software-defined technology system. Strongly support the research on software-defined and ubiquitous operating system platform theories and technologies, strengthen the connection between government, industry, academia, research, and application, and build a core technology system of software-defined. Cultivate the innovative application ecology of software-defined. Establish software-defined solutions for typical industries such as consumer electronics, high-end equipment, intelligent connected vehicles, and smart cities, and organize pilot demonstrations. Cultivate a group of core technology, product, and system solution providers, and promote the construction of industry alliances. Explore the development and operation models of the software-defined ecosystem. Promote mode and mechanism innovation. Innovate software development models, promote the popularization of software development clouds and intelligent development tools. Innovate software operation service models, promote software subscription, pay-per-use services, and achieve integration of software delivery, product upgrades, and operation and maintenance services. Establish a market-oriented innovation mechanism, explore the establishment of a shared responsibility application guarantee mechanism, and further improve the integration and innovation mechanism of software and key areas. Strengthen the information technology application innovation system. Carry out integrated adaptation of software, hardware, applications, and services, and gradually improve the technology and product system. Promote software companies to establish product quality lifecycle guarantee mechanisms, promote technological innovation and product iteration through the testing of information technology application innovation products. Support the construction of a dynamic monitoring platform for industrial apps. Develop industrial app stores to facilitate the circulation of industrial apps. Promote the digital development of key areas. Support the innovative application of new-generation information technology in inclusive finance and develop related software products. Promote the application of transportation software to improve the efficiency of transportation resource utilization and management refinement. Support the innovative application of software such as urban information models, geographic information systems, building information models, and building fire simulation, implement projects to enhance intelligent construction capabilities, and promote the digitalization, networking, and intelligent breakthroughs in the construction industry. Support the development and application of agricultural basic resource databases, intelligent monitoring and control systems, agricultural product quality and safety traceability systems, strengthen comprehensive information services, and improve the level of digitalization in agriculture and rural areas. Continuously collect and promote typical solutions for smart cities, support urban-level innovative applications such as smart city brains, precision benefits for the people, smart government affairs, and urban health examinations, and cultivate new models, applications, and formats for the integration of software and smart society. Expand and upgrade service information consumption. Focus on areas such as commerce, tourism, health, home, catering, culture, education, and entertainment, accelerate the improvement of the supply capacity of software products and services such as e-commerce, mobile payment, social networks, location services, and online audiovisual, and develop new models such as intelligence, refinement, and customization. Cultivate a batch of new information consumption demonstration projects, build a batch of comprehensive and characteristic information consumption demonstration cities, encourage regions with conditions to establish information consumption halls, experience centers, and public service platforms, and hold activities such as information consumption competitions, city tours, and experience weeks.

content: Cultivate and strengthen market entities, accelerate the prosperity of the open-source ecosystem, improve the level of industry agglomeration, and form a diverse, open, win-win, and sustainable industrial ecosystem. content: Give full play to the role of multilateral and bilateral international cooperation mechanisms, support enterprises in deepening cooperation in technology research and development, standard setting, product services, intellectual property rights, and continuously improve the mutually beneficial global software industry cooperation system. content: The main responsibilities of organizing and managing the national software enterprise certification work are as follows: (1) guiding, supervising, and inspecting the national software enterprise certification work; (2) publicizing and filing the list of certified software enterprises and the annual review list; (3) accepting and handling reexamination applications for software enterprise certification results and annual review results; (4) accepting and handling relevant complaints and reports regarding software enterprise certification and annual review; (5) guiding and managing the China Double Soft Certification Network to provide public services.

content: The competent department for software industry (hereinafter referred to as the provincial competent department) is responsible for managing the certification of software enterprises within this administrative region. name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)
content: In response to the characteristics of the building materials industry, focusing on key processes such as mining, raw material preparation, crushing and grinding, kiln control, logistics and warehousing, online testing, etc., we have refined and developed several sets of intelligent, digital, and integrated system solutions with functions such as intelligent perception, automatic execution, deep learning, intelligent decision-making, and password protection. These solutions promote the automation, intelligence, and unmanned transformation of production methods in industries such as cement, glass, ceramics, etc. Column 1: System solutions for key segments of the building materials industry. Cement industry: Key solutions include digital planning and design, intelligent factory construction, automatic ore selection and blending, kiln optimization control, one-click start-stop for grinding machines, equipment diagnosis and maintenance, remote production monitoring, intelligent quality control, energy and water consumption management, clean packaging and shipping, safety and environmental management, and coordinated disposal of solid waste. Glass industry: Key solutions include raw material selection and blending, intelligent thermal control for melting furnaces, tin baths, and annealing kilns, digital simulation of melting and forming, optimization control for the cold end, online defect detection, automatic stacking and paper laying, automatic cutting and slicing, and intelligent coding and warehousing. Ceramics industry: Key solutions include standard data for raw materials, press control and management, intelligent high-pressure slurry injection, control of body drying, unmanned loading and unloading of materials, kiln optimization control, glazing and polishing of products, automatic detection and sorting, and intelligent warehousing and logistics. Stone industry: Key solutions include automatic mining, intelligent sawing and cutting, grinding and polishing, automatic cutting, special-shaped processing, as well as inspection, repair, packaging, and disposal of waste materials. Refractory materials industry: Key solutions include raw material preparation, press control, kiln optimization, online monitoring, and fully automated three-dimensional warehouses. Wall materials industry: Key solutions include precise preparation of raw materials, cutting and shaping of blanks, drying (steam pressing) and curing, kiln optimization control, automatic quality inspection, intelligent packaging and logistics, automatic unloading and stacking, and pollution emission control. Insulation materials industry: Key solutions include homogenization of raw material blending, automatic feeding and charging, kiln optimization control, online quality monitoring, equipment failure warning, intelligent cutting (sorting) and packaging, digital warehousing and logistics. Concrete and cement products industry: Key solutions include integrated systems for the entire concrete industry chain, including manufacturing execution management, intelligent logistics and distribution, and online quality monitoring. For cement products, key solutions include centralized mixing and delivery, automatic molding control, skeleton welding and transportation, and intelligent maintenance. Waterproof materials industry: Key solutions include automatic feeding and metering, process quality control, manufacturing execution management, and packaging and warehousing logistics. Non-metallic mineral industry: Key solutions include data management for geological exploration, fine raw material mining, material weighing and homogenization, intelligent control of material selection, mineral processing optimization, online quality monitoring, and finished product packaging and logistics. High-performance fiber and composite materials industry: Key solutions include control of tank and kiln drawing, online quality monitoring, automatic material transportation, injection molding, extrusion winding, equipment control, and equipment failure warning. Mechanism sand and stone industry: Key solutions include crushing and shaping, grading adjustment, quality monitoring, dust collection, wastewater treatment, and material storage and transportation. Wood building materials industry: Key solutions include raw material sorting, automatic processing, production control, online monitoring, and logistics and warehousing. Inorganic non-metallic new materials: Key solutions include integrated systems for material research and development and design, which combine calculation, experimentation, and data, as well as intelligent grading, purification, modification, growth, processing, and application.
titlelist: Key tasks, intelligent manufacturing technology innovation action in the building materials industry, forming a batch of systematic solutions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)
content: Build a network, platform, and security three major functional systems, encourage enterprises to actively explore 5G+ Industrial Internet, and promote the deep integration of industrial Internet and building materials industry. Promote the construction of secondary node for industrial Internet identification resolution in the building materials industry, and deepen the application of identification resolution. Vigorously develop the industrial Internet innovation application platform in the building materials industry, accelerate the development of building materials industrial APP, promote building materials enterprises and equipment to go cloud and go platform, and realize the interconnection of manufacturing resources and manufacturing capabilities. Build an industrial Internet password support system and accelerate the deep application of commercial passwords in the building materials industry. Focus on the integration of the new generation of information and communication technology in the column. Big data: Use big data collection, analysis, mining, and other technologies to improve intelligent operation capabilities such as monitoring and traceability, predictive maintenance, quality control, supply chain management, and energy management. Strengthen the analysis and utilization of industry public data, unify data standards and formats, and promote data integration among building materials industry enterprises and platforms. Industrial Internet platform: Use Internet of Things technology to realize intelligent perception, recognition, positioning, tracking, and management, promote enterprises to migrate infrastructure, business systems, and equipment products to the cloud, cultivate industrial APP, and build an industrial Internet platform for the building materials industry. Blockchain: Support building materials enterprises to use blockchain technology to achieve product transactions, information traceability, quality management, and other functions with upstream and downstream industrial chains, ensure data security, and gradually deepen application. 5G communication: Guide enterprises to use the advantages of 5G communication technology such as high bandwidth, low latency, and large connections to achieve interconnection and encourage integrated innovative applications in areas such as unmanned driving, remote blasting, and equipment maintenance. Artificial intelligence: Promote the application of advanced algorithms, machine learning, and intelligent chips in the fields of intelligent production, intelligent decision-making, intelligent logistics, intelligent monitoring, and intelligent traceability in the building materials industry. Building Information Modeling: Use Building Information Modeling (BIM) technology to promote seamless connection between building materials and construction, vigorously develop modular building materials, and realize the traceability, predictability, maintainability, and recyclability of building materials throughout the life cycle. Digital twin: Use computational modeling, real-time sensing, virtual reality, simulation technology, and other means to achieve the mapping of building material factories in a virtual environment, promote the full-cycle optimization management of design, installation, and operation of complete production equipment, and realize the visualization, predictability, maintainability, and recyclability of building material factories.
titlelist: Key tasks, innovation action of intelligent manufacturing technology in the building materials industry, innovation of a batch of industrial Internet scenarios.

According to the regulations and standards for intelligent factory construction, cultivate a group of intelligent factories in the building materials industry that integrate intelligent production, intelligent operation and maintenance, and intelligent management, effectively improving product quality, operational efficiency, equipment management, and safety and environmental protection levels. Utilize methods such as 3D simulation, intelligent selection, automated ore blending, unmanned driving, and disaster monitoring to implement mechanization and automation, creating a group of safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly digital mines.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)
content: Focus on key links in the production and operation of the building materials industry, accelerate the promotion of advanced technology solutions such as optimized control of kilns, intelligent warehousing and logistics, equipment inspection and maintenance, online monitoring and testing, batch customization, network integration outsourcing, product quality traceability, and digital design and operation. Cultivate a number of typical projects for single application. Accelerate the implementation of machine substitution in heavy and dangerous positions such as handling and stacking, feeding and loading, polishing and glazing, painting and polishing, high-temperature kilns, as well as high-precision positions such as image recognition, cutting and sorting, pressure forming, and sampling and testing. Promote the coordinated disposal of industrial solid waste, household waste, hazardous waste, and other technologies in kilns, and promote the green development of the building materials industry.
titlelist: Key tasks, promotion and application of intelligent manufacturing in the building materials industry, focusing on advancing typical applications in key areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)
content: Support the construction of industrial Internet platforms for large enterprises, implement industrial chain collaboration and integration of resources among large, medium, and small enterprises through network collaboration, platform integration, online connection, and other methods, and promote the transformation and development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Combined with the special action of digital empowerment for small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate information technology suppliers and product solutions for small and medium-sized building materials enterprises, establish a third-party industrial Internet public service platform, and provide online services such as industrial software, research and development design, marketing, logistics, and warehousing to promote small and medium-sized enterprises to go online and onto platforms, and support the process of digital transformation.
titlelist: Key task: Promote the application of intelligent manufacturing in the building materials industry and accelerate the improvement of informationization level for small and medium-sized building materials enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)
content: The industrial and informationization authorities in various regions should strengthen coordination and establish a sound mechanism for promoting the digital transformation of the local building materials industry. Clear timelines and progress should be defined, and all tasks should be implemented. Building materials industry associations should develop work plans based on their respective industry scale, technological characteristics, and development levels, and clarify responsible departments while proposing policy recommendations. Relevant industry alliances, key enterprises, research institutes, government-affiliated units, and universities should enhance communication and cooperation to generate collaborative efforts. An expert committee for intelligent manufacturing in the building materials industry should be established to provide strategic, technological, and policy consultation and recommendations.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)
content: Deepen the integration of industry and finance, increase financial support, encourage the establishment of investment funds for digital transformation in intelligent manufacturing of building materials by industry and financial capital, with a focus on innovative applications in the field of building materials such as artificial intelligence, big data, industrial software, 5G communication, and industrial internet. Support eligible building materials intelligent technology equipment enterprises to enjoy tax benefits and financing guarantee policies according to regulations, and apply for relevant insurance compensation and financial support.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase policy support

name: Notice on Issuing the Action Plan for the Digital Transformation of Intelligent Manufacturing in the Building Materials Industry (2021-2023) (MIIT Original [2020] No. 39) (MIIT Office/September 16, 2020)
content: Carry out the evaluation of the informatization level of building materials enterprises, promptly summarize advanced experiences and shortcomings, and promote continuous improvement and enhancement in various regions and industries. Organize diagnostic consulting services, collect and organize relevant cases, and strengthen communication and promotion. Deepen international exchanges and cooperation in technology, management, standards, and other aspects.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, create a good environment.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (Departments of Commerce, etc./January 6, 2020)
content: By 2025, the position of China's offshore service outsourcing as the main channel for exporting productive services will be further consolidated. The proportion of high-tech and high-value-added digital businesses will continue to increase. Service outsourcing will become an important channel for introducing advanced technology and upgrading the value chain of industries. Information technology outsourcing (ITO) and knowledge process outsourcing (KPO) enterprises will accelerate their transformation into digital service providers. Business process outsourcing (BPO) enterprises will significantly enhance their professional capabilities. The layout of service outsourcing demonstration cities will be further optimized, developing into globally influential and competitive service outsourcing hubs. By 2035, the annual output value per capita of China's service outsourcing practitioners will reach a world-leading level. The innovative leading role of service outsourcing demonstration cities will become more prominent. Service outsourcing will become an important means of promoting high-quality trade development and building a digital China, supported by digital technology and guided by high-end services. It will become a core competitive advantage in creating the China Service and Made in China brands.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Incorporate the research and application of information technology such as cloud computing, basic software, integrated circuit design, and blockchain into the scope of support for national science and technology plans (special projects, funds, etc.). Cultivate a group of demonstration enterprises that integrate the development of information technology outsourcing and manufacturing.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate the process of digital transformation and support the development of information technology outsourcing.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Relying on 5G technology, vigorously develop new models such as crowdsourcing, cloud outsourcing, and platform subcontracting. Actively promote innovation and integrated application of industrial Internet, cultivate a batch of digital manufacturing outsourcing platforms, and develop new formats such as service-oriented manufacturing.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the process of digital transformation and cultivate new models and new formats.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Relying on the pilot areas for innovative development of service trade and the demonstration cities for service outsourcing, we will establish a number of digital service export bases.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the process of digital transformation and create a cluster zone for digital service exports.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Include the new format and model of using big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things (IoT) in the statistics of service outsourcing business.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate the process of digital transformation and improve the definition scope of statistics.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Apart from those prohibited from entering the country, goods and items imported from overseas by enterprises within the comprehensive bonded zone for use in biopharmaceutical research and development are exempt from submitting permits. The imported consumables are verified based on actual research and development consumption.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the development of key areas and the development of pharmaceutical research and development outsourcing.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Build a group of national-level service design centers. Support various leading enterprises and research institutes in opening innovative design centers, enhance design outsourcing capabilities, support national-level industrial design centers and the National Industrial Design Research Institute in carrying out design service outsourcing. Implement special actions to enhance manufacturing design capabilities.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the development of key areas and support design outsourcing.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Government departments at all levels should continuously expand the scope of purchasing services while ensuring safety. Encourage enterprises, especially state-owned enterprises, to legally and compliantly divest non-core businesses and purchase operational services such as supply chain, call centers, internet marketing and promotion, financial support, and procurement.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the development of key areas and support business operations outsourcing.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Improve the dynamic management mechanism of service outsourcing demonstration cities with both entry and exit, and support more eligible cities in the central and western regions as well as the northeastern region to create service outsourcing demonstration cities.
titlelist: The main tasks are to build a global service network system and gradually increase the number of demonstration cities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. No. 12, 2020) (January 6, 2020)
content: Include more non-commercial overseas outsourcing exhibitions in the scope of support for overseas exhibition activities. Support service outsourcing enterprises in exploring international markets through various means such as export credit insurance. Encourage contracting in markets along the 'Belt and Road' countries and regions, and support the internationalization of Chinese technology and standards.
titlelist: The main task is to build a global service network system and increase efforts to expand the international market.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Assess the implementation effect of the export credit preferential measures enjoyed by service outsourcing enterprises undertaking international service outsourcing projects in the demonstration cities for service outsourcing, and promote them nationwide in a timely manner.
titlelist: The main tasks are to build a global service network system and evaluate and optimize export credit preferential measures.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Promote provinces and cities to include high-end talents in the corresponding talent development plans for service outsourcing. Encourage eligible service outsourcing enterprises to implement equity incentives for key technical personnel and management personnel.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen talent cultivation and vigorously cultivate and introduce high-end talents.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. No. 12, 2020) (Departments of Commerce, etc. / January 6, 2020)
content: For service outsourcing enterprises that meet the requirements and absorb college graduates for employment, as well as provide pre-job training, corresponding subsidies shall be given according to regulations. Support the organization of relevant innovation and entrepreneurship competitions, and provide preferential treatment in accordance with relevant policies for award-winning individuals, teams, or projects.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen talent cultivation and encourage college students to seek employment and start businesses.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. No. 12, 2020) (January 6, 2020)
content: Improve the socialized service outsourcing talent training system, including regular higher education institutions, vocational colleges, social training institutions, and enterprises. Encourage cooperation between universities and enterprises, accelerate the construction of new engineering disciplines, and establish a number of service outsourcing colleges focusing on new generation information technology.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen talent cultivation and deepen the integration of industry and education.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: According to market principles, fully leverage the role of the service trade innovation development guidance fund to stimulate increased investment from social capital in the service outsourcing industry. Support qualified comprehensive service providers in obtaining financing through listing.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate and strengthen market entities and innovate financial support methods.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: According to legal approval, industrial enterprises that aim to increase the plot ratio of their own industrial land for self-operated productive service industries can proceed with relevant procedures for the new purpose.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate and strengthen market entities and reduce business operating costs.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Timely revise the 'Guiding Catalogue for Key Development Areas in the Service Outsourcing Industry', improve the support policies for key development areas, and guide localities and enterprises to develop service outsourcing business according to local conditions.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate and strengthen market entities, actively cultivate the domestic market.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Accelerated Transformation and Upgrading of Service Outsourcing (Ministry of Commerce, etc. [2020] No. 12) (January 6, 2020)
content: Utilize special funds for the development of foreign trade to establish a number of service outsourcing public service platforms that radiate across the country. Support the development of think tanks and industry associations in the field of service outsourcing, fully leveraging their positive role in theoretical research and trade promotion. Transform the China International Service Outsourcing Trade Fair into a high-quality exhibition with international influence.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate and strengthen market entities and vigorously build public service platforms.

name: Notice on Strengthening the Information Security Management of Industrial Control Systems (MIIT Cooperation [2011] No. 451) (MIIT/September 30, 2011)
content: Geographical, mineral, raw material, and other national basic data, as well as the collection, transmission, storage, and utilization of other important sensitive data, should be protected through measures such as access control, data encryption, security auditing, and disaster backup, in order to effectively safeguard personal rights, corporate interests, and national information resource security.
titlelist: Clarify the information security management requirements and data management requirements for key areas of industrial control systems.

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: The scale of consumption has significantly increased. By 2020, the scale of information consumption will reach 6 trillion yuan, with an average annual growth rate of over 11%. The driving role of information technology in the consumption field has significantly strengthened, driving the output of related industries to reach 15 trillion yuan. The coverage benefits the entire population. By 2020, 98% of administrative villages will have access to fiber optics and 4G network coverage, accelerating the development of shortcomings and unleashing the dividends of network speed increase and fee reduction. The construction of carriers is steadily advancing. Create a number of new information consumption demonstration cities, build regional highlands for innovative applications of information consumption, and cultivate projects with good development prospects, strong driving effects, and strong demonstration effects. The industrial system is gradually improving. Strengthen core technology research and development, promote innovation and industrialization of information products, improve product quality and core competitiveness. Promote Internet Plus in various fields such as medical care, elderly care, education, and culture, promote the growth of new consumption based on network platforms, and develop a new ecology of online and offline collaborative interactive consumption. The consumption environment is becoming increasingly perfect. The legal and regulatory system for information consumption is becoming increasingly perfect, and an efficient, convenient, safe, reliable, fair, and orderly information consumption environment is basically formed, striving to enable consumers to consume, dare to consume, and be willing to consume.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: Improve the level of innovation in the supply of consumer electronics products. Utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, big data, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence to promote the intelligent upgrading of electronic products. Enhance the quality of mid-to-high-end supply systems for various terminal products such as smartphones, computers, color televisions, and audio equipment. Promote the research and industrialization of smart wearable devices, virtual/augmented reality, ultra-high-definition terminal devices, consumer drones, and other products. Accelerate the popularization of ultra-high-definition video in various social applications. Develop portable health monitoring devices, home service robots, and other intelligent health and elderly care service products to meet diverse and personalized health and elderly care needs in different application environments such as households, communities, and institutions. Accelerate the development of new display products. Support companies in increasing investment in technological innovation, breaking through mass production technologies such as new backplanes, ultra-high-definition, and flexible panels, driving product innovation, and achieving structural adjustments. Promote the expansion of internet, Internet of Things, and artificial intelligence applications in different fields between panel companies and terminal companies, cultivate new growth points in the mid-to-high-end consumer market, and further expand the application scope of online health care, security monitoring, smart homes, and other fields. Deepen the development of intelligent connected vehicles. Promote the construction of supporting platforms such as technology testing, formulate guidelines for the construction of the vehicle networking industry development standard system, promote the research and development of key technological products such as in-vehicle intelligent chips, autonomous driving operating systems, and vehicle intelligent algorithms, build an integrated intelligent vehicle platform, and cultivate diversified applications. Promote the construction of smart cars and intelligent transportation projects based on broadband mobile internet. By 2020, establish a reliable, secure, and real-time intelligent connected vehicle computing platform, form relevant platform standards, and support highly automated driving (Level HA).
titlelist: Main Actions, Action to Improve the Supply System of New Information Products

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: Organize the Enterprise Cloud Migration campaign. Carry out publicity and training for industry enterprises, promote deep cooperation between cloud computing service providers and industry enterprises, improve enterprise management efficiency through software applications and data services on the cloud, and organize the selection of typical benchmark application cases. Promote the migration of small and medium-sized enterprise operations to the cloud. By 2020, achieve rapid formation of information technology capabilities for small and medium-sized enterprises through cloud services, and create 100 typical cloud application cases for enterprises. Enhance the level of research and development and application of information technology services. Promote the construction of new smart cities, support comprehensive research and development and application of cloud computing, big data, and the Internet of Things, and accelerate the improvement of residents' convenience in information consumption. Organize pilot projects for the application of new technologies such as blockchain. Release the Information Technology Service Standard (ITSS) System 5.0 version, continue to carry out standardization activities, support enterprises to accelerate the improvement of comprehensive integration service capabilities guided by standards, and have over 2,000 standardized enterprises by 2020. Cultivate industry information consumption support services. Actively develop industrial e-commerce, deepen the integration of manufacturing and the Internet, and build a number of influential and driving vertical e-commerce platforms. Support the development of network payment, modern logistics, supply chain management, and other support services for the entire process of information consumption. By 2020, achieve a 60% penetration rate of e-commerce among key industry backbone enterprises. Promote the development of double innovation in the field of information consumption. Support large enterprises in establishing double innovation platforms based on the Internet, cultivate new formats and models for the integration and development of information consumption, and build a number of national public service demonstration platforms for small and medium-sized enterprises, providing information, technology, entrepreneurship, training, financing, and other services. Announce a batch of national small and micro enterprise entrepreneurship and innovation demonstration bases, widely attract small and medium-sized enterprises to settle in, guide demonstration bases to actively integrate social service resources, provide services in various forms and aspects, and promote innovative development in information consumption.
titlelist: Main Action, Action to Enhance Information Technology Service Capability

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: Promote the acceleration and reduction of fees for information infrastructure. Implement the Broadband China strategy, organize and implement the construction of new generation information infrastructure projects, promote deep coverage of fiber broadband and fourth-generation mobile communication (4G) networks, accelerate research on fifth-generation mobile communication (5G) standards and technology trials, promote the construction of 5G scale networks and application demonstration projects. Deepen the pilot of universal telecommunication services and improve information access capabilities in rural areas. Increase efforts to reduce network fees and fully unleash the dividends of network acceleration and fee reduction. Conduct pilot demonstrations in industrial, agricultural, transportation, energy, municipal, environmental protection, and other fields, and achieve optical network coverage in urban areas by 2020, providing access services with speeds of over 1000Mbps; achieve fiber optic coverage and 4G network coverage in 98% of administrative villages, and provide access services with speeds of over 100Mbps in areas with conditions; ensure the commercialization of 5G. Implement consumer information skills training projects. Relying on the construction of pilot demonstration cities for information consumption, organize information consumption training for various consumer groups, especially for farmers, herdsmen, the elderly, and other groups with relatively weak information skills, popularize knowledge related to information application, online payment, risk identification, etc. Encourage enterprises, industry associations, and other social forces to organize a series of competitions in information-related vocational skills, entrepreneurship, and innovation, combining local characteristics and advantages, to enhance information consumption skills. Before 2020, select more than 100 key areas to implement information skills training projects. Organize information consumption experience activities. Organize Information Consumption City Tours to expand the influence of information consumption through policy interpretation, exhibition displays, interactive experiences, on-site visits, and other forms. Support local organizations in conducting information consumption experience weeks, building information consumption experience halls, and other activities, actively use virtual/augmented reality, interactive entertainment, and other technologies to deepen user participation in application scenario customization, product function design, digital content provision, etc., improve consumer satisfaction, enrich information consumption experiences, and cultivate information consumption habits.
titlelist: Main actions, empowering actions for information consumers.

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: The industrial and information technology departments in various regions should strengthen the coordination and organization of major decisions, projects, and issues related to information consumption. They should establish and improve a collaborative mechanism for the development of information consumption, clarify the goals and implementation plans for local information consumption development, increase the assessment of the effectiveness of information consumption work, and ensure the implementation of action plans. They should also support the establishment of expert advisory committees on information consumption development in eligible regions to provide reference and support for the work.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen work organization and coordination.

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: Increase the level of financial support, support the research and development of cutting-edge technologies in information consumption, and expand various types of new products and integrated applications. Local industrial and information technology departments, as well as development and reform authorities, should further implement several policies to encourage the development of the software and integrated circuit industries, and increase efforts to implement existing tax policies that support small and micro enterprises. Encourage eligible regions to establish special funds for information consumption, promote the introduction of policies that support the development of information consumption, effectively improve the financing environment for enterprises, and increase support for small and micro enterprises in the field of information consumption.
titlelist: Enhance policy support and strengthen protective measures.

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: Improve the construction plan and management methods for the demonstration cities of information consumption, encourage local governments to increase support, and create a group of pilot demonstration cities with strong industrial foundations, complete industrial chains, obvious agglomeration effects, and distinctive regional characteristics. Select a group of demonstration projects with good development prospects, significant driving effects, and strong demonstration effects in the areas of life information consumption, public service information consumption, industry information consumption, and consumption of new types of information products.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote the implementation of pilot demonstrations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Information Consumption (2018-2020) (MIIT Joint Letter [2018] No. 140) (MIIT, NDRC/July 27, 2018)
content: Give full play to the bridging and linking role of industry organizations such as associations and alliances, integrate resources from backbone enterprises, higher education institutions, research institutes, and other sectors, promote in-depth cooperation among production, academia, and research, innovate management and operation mechanisms in areas such as information consumption standard formulation, technology verification, product incubation, and international expansion, and create a multi-party collaborative and mutually beneficial industrial ecosystem.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, building an industrial cooperation platform.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: - Promote the development of secure and reliable industrial apps with high support value for key projects, major engineering implementation, and important equipment research and development needs in the domestic manufacturing industry.- Develop basic common industrial apps with strong universality and high reuse rate in the four industrial bases areas, including key basic materials, core basic components (parts), advanced basic processes, and industrial technological foundations.- Develop and promote industry-specific industrial apps with high value and strong driving force for industries such as automotive, aerospace, petrochemical, machinery manufacturing, light industry appliances, and information electronics.- Develop enterprise-specific industrial apps with high application value to meet the personalized needs of manufacturing companies.
titlelist: Overall requirements, key directions.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: By 2020, we will cultivate 300,000 industrial apps targeting specific industries and scenarios, fully covering key demands in various sectors of the manufacturing industry, including research and development, design, production, operation and maintenance, and business management. We will break through a number of common key technologies in industrial software development, establish a standard system for industrial apps, cultivate a number of high-value and high-quality industrial apps with significant support, and foster a group of industrial app enterprises with international competitiveness. The industrial app adoption will achieve positive results, with the software development rate of key business processes in innovative enterprises reaching 50%. The market circulation and sustainable development capabilities of industrial apps will begin to take shape, and their support role in promoting the prosperity of industrial Internet platform applications, improving industrial quality and efficiency, and facilitating transformation and upgrading will begin to emerge.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: 'Common key technologies of APP. Targeting the high points of industrial development, organizing and implementing a batch of key industrial innovation projects, promoting the research and development of common key technologies such as complex system modeling, operation instruction set adaptation, visual programming, and execution control engine, and advancing the research and development of core key components such as industrial communication protocol adaptation, data exchange, and heterogeneous system integration. Supporting industrial Internet platform enterprises and research institutes in developing industrial APP development tools, constructing an integrated development environment for industrial APPs, and promoting collaborative development, continuous integration, and automatic deployment of industrial APPs.'
titlelist: The main task is to solidify the foundation of industrial technology software and break through industrial...

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: Support the establishment of provincial-level industrial technology software innovation centers in advanced regions, deepen cross-industry and cross-domain cooperation, promote the accumulation, openness, and reuse of artisan knowledge and experience (such as craftsmanship, processes, models, algorithms, etc.), achieve technology diffusion and commercialization, and accelerate the process of industrial technology software development. Encourage leading enterprises, industry associations, professional institutions, etc., to establish specialized departments to promote industrial technology software development, integrate industrial chain resources, and enhance engineering capabilities.
titlelist: The main tasks are to solidify the foundation of industrial technology software and enhance the software capabilities of industrial enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: 'Open-source community for apps. Support the establishment of an industrial app open-source community and foundation, encourage large manufacturing enterprises, internet companies, and software companies to build industrial app cultivation new models based on open-source, promote the gathering, sharing, and openness of innovative resource elements. Guide manufacturing enterprises, software companies, research institutes, and developers to initiate industrial technology software open-source projects and actively participate in international open-source projects. Encourage third-party organizations to conduct research on open-source licensing agreements and open-source intellectual property protection, and promote the application of open-source projects.'
titlelist: The main task is to solidify the foundation of industrial technology software and develop the industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: Support the construction of microservice resource pools for industrial Internet platform enterprises, gather microservice components such as tools, algorithms, models, etc., open software development kits (SDKs) and application programming interfaces (APIs), enhance the comprehensive integration, testing and verification, quality control, lifecycle management, and service capabilities of industrial apps. Promote the open sharing of manufacturing capabilities. Organize and promote double innovation activities in the field of industrial apps, guide enterprises to connect supply and demand information, innovate business models, utilize the industrial Internet to open up their own research and development and manufacturing capabilities, and optimize resource allocation efficiency. Incorporate the opening of manufacturing capabilities based on the industrial Internet into the evaluation system for the integration of the two industries, and promote popularization through various means such as standardization.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the convergence of industrial apps towards platforms and enhance the capabilities of industrial Internet platforms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: 'APP market circulation. Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights for industrial apps, improve the transaction rules and service rules for industrial apps, and promote the market circulation of industrial apps. Guide and support internet platform companies, associations, and third-party organizations in establishing industrial app stores, providing specialized services for industrial app launch and download.'
titlelist: The main task is to promote the convergence of industrial apps towards platforms and facilitate industrial development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: Promote the application of key industries. Support the Industrial APP Competition, promote the application of industrial APPs in industries such as automotive, aerospace, petrochemical, machinery manufacturing, light industry and household appliances, information electronics, etc. Targeting real application scenarios and needs, cultivate industrial technology software application solutions. Support the promotion and application of excellent industrial APPs and application solutions within the industry. Accelerate the development and application of industrial data resources. Include industrial APPs in the pilot demonstration projects for industrial big data applications, support industrial enterprises in using industrial APPs to strengthen the collection of data on machinery and equipment, business systems, product models, etc., and carry out data integration, mining, analysis, and modeling to enhance the innovation and application capabilities of industrial big data.
titlelist: Main task: Accelerate innovation in industrial APP applications.

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: 'APP standard testing system. Promote the establishment of an industrial technology software standardization organization, accelerate the formulation of basic standards such as industrial APP application reference architecture, microservice framework, industrial knowledge encapsulation, as well as key technical standards such as interfaces, protocols, data, quality, and security. Support the development of heterogeneous protocol and data, interoperability and portability, complex application scenarios, and other testing capabilities for industrial Internet platform enterprises and professional testing institutions, and build an integrated testing and verification environment for industrial APPs.'
titlelist: The main task is to improve the quality of industrial APP development and build an industrial...

name: Notice on Issuing the Implementation Plan for the Industrial Internet APP Cultivation Project (2018-2020) (MIIT XRS [2018] No. 79) (MIIT/April 27, 2018)
content: 'APP Cultivation Guidance. Organize the compilation of the Industrial APP Development White Paper to guide third-party organizations in compiling the Industrial APP Cultivation Guidelines and guide local authorities in strengthening the dynamic monitoring and analysis of industrial APP cultivation. Industry regulatory departments in various regions should guide local enterprises to fulfill their responsibilities as the main body of industrial APP information security, and comply with relevant laws and regulations on information security.'
titlelist: The main task is to improve the quality of industrial app development and strengthen industrial.
