content: Before December 2018, the Industrial APP Development White Paper was released, and the Industrial APP Cultivation Guidelines were introduced, establishing an organization for industrial technology software standardization. The goal is to promote the construction of 1-2 provincial-level industrial technology software manufacturing innovation centers and develop a number of excellent industrial technology software solutions. By December 2019, further expansion of the scale of industrial APP applications is planned. Breakthroughs in key technologies of industrial technology software will be made, and the industrial technology software rate of key business processes in innovative application enterprises will reach 30%. The scale of industrial APPs targeting specific industries and scenarios will reach 100,000, and a number of high-value, high-quality industrial APPs with significant support will be cultivated and deployed. By December 2020, the industrial technology software rate of key business processes in innovative application enterprises will reach 50%. 300,000 industrial APPs targeting specific industries and scenarios will be cultivated, and a number of internationally competitive industrial APP software enterprises will emerge, demonstrating initial support for the prosperity of the industrial Internet platform application ecosystem and the promotion of industrial quality improvement, efficiency enhancement, and transformation and upgrading.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: The software and information technology services industry has entered a period of accelerated innovation, rapid iteration, and collective breakthroughs, speeding up the evolution towards networking, platformization, service-oriented, intelligent, and ecological development. Rapid development and integration innovation in cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, and the Internet of Things, as well as advancements in advanced computing, high-end storage, artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and neuroscience, are further reshaping the technical architecture, computing models, development models, product forms, and business models of software. New technologies, products, models, and formats are becoming increasingly mature, accelerating the transition to a qualitative change period. Open source, crowdsourcing, and other crowd-intelligence research and development models have become the mainstream direction of technological innovation, and industrial competition is shifting from single technology, single product, and single model to multi-technology, integration, convergence, platform systems, and ecosystem competition. Ecosystem competition has become the key point of industrial development. Software companies rely on technology platforms such as cloud computing and big data to strengthen the integration and innovation of core elements such as technology, products, content, and services, accelerate business restructuring, process optimization, and service improvement, and achieve transformational development.
titlelist: The development situation is characterized by the continuous deepening of industrial transformation through the core of technology + model + ecology in collaborative innovation.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: The data-driven software-defined is becoming a prominent feature of integrated applications. On one hand, data-driven information technology is driving industry transformation, accelerating the cross-border integration and innovative development of the new generation of information technology. Through software-defined hardware, software-defined storage, software-defined networking, software-defined systems, etc., it brings more new products, services, and innovative models, giving rise to new formats and economic growth points, and promoting data as a strategic asset. On the other hand, software-defined is accelerating the integration, innovation, and transformation of various industries. Software-defined manufacturing stimulates innovation in research and development design, simulation verification, production manufacturing, and business management, accelerating the development of new models such as personalized customization, networked collaboration, service-oriented manufacturing, and cloud manufacturing, promoting the transformation of manufacturing from production-oriented to service-oriented. Software-defined services profoundly impact the development of industries such as finance, logistics, transportation, culture, and tourism, giving birth to a new group of industry entities, business platforms, integrated formats, and new types of consumption. It triggers multidimensional and deep-level changes in areas such as resident consumption, livelihood services, and social governance, leading to the emergence of various new network economic models such as the sharing economy, platform economy, and algorithm economy, nurturing and strengthening the development of new driving forces.
titlelist: Development situation, the integration of applications characterized by 'software-defined' opens up a new landscape for the information economy.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: By 2020, the industrial scale will further expand, the technological innovation system will be more complete, the effective supply capacity of the industry will greatly increase, the integration support benefits will be further highlighted, a number of leading enterprises with strong international influence and competitiveness will be cultivated and strengthened, and a globally competitive industrial ecological system will be basically formed. - Industrial scale. By 2020, business revenue will exceed 8 trillion yuan, with an average annual growth rate of over 13%, accounting for over 30% of the information industry, of which information technology service revenue will account for 55% of business revenue. Information security product revenue will reach 200 billion yuan, with an average annual growth rate of over 20%. Software exports will exceed 68 billion US dollars. The number of software professionals will reach 9 million. - Technological innovation. The industrial innovation system, with enterprises as the main body, will be further improved. The research and development investment of the top 100 software companies in terms of business revenue will continue to increase, forming innovative leading capabilities and obvious competitive advantages in key areas. Breakthroughs will be made in collaborative innovation of basic software, and several competitive platform solutions will be developed and implemented on a large scale. Innovation in fields such as artificial intelligence, virtual reality, and blockchain will reach international advanced levels. Innovation and development in fields such as cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, the Internet of Things, and information security will leap to higher levels. Significant progress will be made in standardization in key areas, and the international discourse power of standards will be further enhanced. - Integration support. The level of integration with economic and social development will be greatly improved. The maturity, reliability, and security of industrial software and system solutions will be comprehensively improved, basically meeting the system integration application, collaborative operation, and comprehensive service needs of key links in intelligent manufacturing. The industrial information security guarantee system will be continuously improved, and the security guarantee capability will be significantly enhanced. The support service capabilities of key application software and industry solutions in industrial transformation, people's livelihood services, and social governance will be comprehensively improved. - Enterprise cultivation. Cultivate a number of leading enterprises with strong international influence and competitiveness, with more than 20 companies in the software and information technology service sector achieving annual revenue in the tens of billions, and 5 to 8 companies achieving annual revenue in the hundreds of billions. Support a group of innovative and promising small and medium-sized enterprises and build a group of well-known brands. - Industrial agglomeration. The construction of China's software cities and national new industrialization demonstration bases (software and information services) will reach a higher level, and the agglomeration and demonstration effects of the industry will further expand, with more than 20 cities achieving industrial revenue of over 100 billion yuan.
titlelist: The guiding ideology and development goals, development goals.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order No. 425 [2016]) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Focus on key links in the industrial chain, strengthen basic technology research, advance research and development of cutting-edge technologies, build a core technology system, accelerate innovation in information technology services, improve the industrial innovation system that combines enterprises as the main body, application-oriented, and integrates government, industry, academia, research, and application. Accelerate breakthroughs in common basic technologies. Targeting major industry applications and information security needs, aim at the development of key technologies in the technology industry, and increase support for the research, development, and application of basic software technologies and products such as operating systems, databases, middleware, and office software. Vigorously develop basic software platforms for new intelligent terminals, intelligent equipment, and major integrated application platforms for various industries. Accelerate the development of software engineering methods, tools, and environments that adapt to the trends of platformization, networking, and intelligence, and enhance the support capabilities of common basic technologies. Layout research and development of cutting-edge technologies. Conduct research on big data theory and methods, computing systems and analysis, key application technologies and models, and layout the development of cloud computing and big data cutting-edge technologies. Support research on basic theories, common technologies, and application technologies of artificial intelligence, with a focus on breakthroughs in natural language understanding, computer vision and audio, new human-computer interaction, and intelligent control and decision-making. Accelerate research and innovation in areas such as unmanned driving, virtual reality, 3D printing, blockchain, and human-machine integration computing. Strengthen innovation in information technology services. In response to the application needs of key industries, further enhance the basic capabilities of information technology services and improve the level of comprehensive integration of Internet Plus applications. Establish engineering, platform-based, and networked information technology service capabilities for new system architectures and application scenarios, develop new service models such as microservices, intelligent services, and integrated development and operation, and enhance the level of information technology services. Accelerate the development of new online operation services for mobile intelligent terminals, intelligent connected vehicles, robots, etc., such as mobile payment, location services, social networking services, digital content services, intelligent applications, virtual reality, etc. Accelerate the cultivation of technology service platforms and solutions in the fields of digital marketing, Internet finance, e-commerce, game animation, artificial intelligence, etc. Vigorously develop high-end outsourcing services based on new generation information technology. Strengthen the construction of industrial innovation mechanisms and carriers. In key areas such as basic software, high-end industrial software, cloud computing, big data, information security, and artificial intelligence, strengthen the integration of industry, academia, research, and application, layout the construction of national innovation centers, establish a mechanism for continuous improvement of innovation results guided by rapid application, and accelerate the transformation of core technological achievements. Highlight the role of enterprises in technological innovation, promote the construction of enterprise technology innovation centers, and continuously enhance enterprise innovation capabilities. Guide large Internet companies to further open up and provide advantageous platform resources and services to society through market-oriented approaches. Strengthen the construction of industrial alliances, explore and improve mechanisms for joint participation, shared results, and risk sharing, and strengthen collaborative innovation. Leverage the support and promotion role of open source communities in innovation, strengthen the application of open source technology achievements in innovation, and build an open, collaborative, and international open source ecosystem conducive to innovation. Column 1: Software Soul Casting Project. Accelerate breakthroughs in basic general-purpose software. Based on the strategic goal of developing from following to keeping pace with basic general-purpose software, use pilot projects for secure and reliable applications as a starting point to achieve breakthroughs in core basic technologies in areas such as operating systems and databases, and establish a secure and reliable basic software product system. Build a platform for joint research and development of secure and reliable software and hardware, support enterprises and research institutions in building general technology innovation and application platforms. Develop software engineering methods, tools, and environments such as requirements analysis and design, programming languages and compilers, software testing and verification, process improvement and maturity evaluation, and integrated development, and improve the development and application ecosystem of basic general-purpose software. Strengthen networked software competitive advantages. Based on the strategic goal of developing from keeping pace to leading in networked software, break through core technologies such as virtual resource scheduling, large-scale parallel analysis, and distributed memory computing, and guide backbone enterprises to accelerate the development of operating systems, database systems, new middleware, and office suites for cloud computing, mobile Internet, and the Internet of Things. Take the lead in developing intelligent software. Based on the strategic goal of taking the lead in intelligent software, break through core technologies such as virtual resource scheduling, data storage and processing, large-scale parallel analysis, distributed memory computing, lightweight container management, visualization, etc., in cloud computing and big data technologies, as well as virtual reality, augmented reality, blockchain, and other technologies. Support the research and industrialization of key technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, knowledge graphs, computer vision and audio, biometric recognition, complex environment recognition, new human-computer interaction, natural language understanding, intelligent control and decision-making, brain-like intelligence, etc., and promote the deep application and development of artificial intelligence. Build an open and open innovation and application ecosystem for technical products. Support enterprises, universities, research institutes, etc. to participate in and lead international open source projects, leverage platforms such as open source communities, industry alliances, forums, and conferences, gather excellent open source resources at home and abroad, and enhance the integration and utilization capabilities of open source resources. Support the establishment of open source funds and other means to support the construction of public ecological environments based on the open source model, strengthen the innovation of open source technology and products, talent cultivation, and enhance the support capabilities of the open source community for industrial development. Column 2: Information Technology Service Capability Enhancement Project. Strengthen the construction of basic service capabilities. Innovate the methodology of basic general-purpose information technology services, encourage enterprises to establish networked, intelligent, and multi-industry knowledge bases. Support enterprises in developing key supporting tools such as networked development and integration platforms, heterogeneous cloud environment resource scheduling and management, microservice management, etc. Support the improvement of information technology consulting, information system solution design, integrated implementation, remote operation and maintenance, and encourage relevant enterprises to establish information technology service management systems. Build and improve a number of public technology service platforms to enhance testing and verification, integration and adaptation, and other service support capabilities. Develop new service models and formats. Innovate the concept of software-defined services, encourage the development of new-generation information technology-driven new formats of information technology services. Integrate resources, support key enterprises in enhancing key technology service capabilities in areas such as containers, blockchain, and integrated development and operation, and accelerate the cultivation of various new service models and formats to promote the sharing and utilization of information service resources. Organize pilot demonstrations of intelligent services for Internet Plus based on national new industrialization industry demonstration bases (software and information services) and industrial parks. Promote the transformation and development of enterprise services. Support key industry enterprises in leveraging their basic advantages, accelerate the application level of information technology, and develop new service businesses based on cloud computing and big data analysis. Support software companies in accelerating the transformation to networking, service-oriented, and platform-oriented, develop comprehensive application solutions, and promote cross-industry cooperation with key industry enterprises to achieve win-win results.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, comprehensively enhance innovation and development capabilities.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order No. 425 [2016]) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order No. 425 [2016]) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Support the development of cloud computing products, services, and solutions, promote the migration of information systems in various industries to cloud platforms, and promote innovation in business models and commercial models based on cloud computing. Support the integration and innovative application of cloud computing with big data, the Internet of Things, mobile internet, and other technologies, and actively cultivate new products and new formats. Support large enterprises in opening up cloud platform resources, promote the adoption of cloud services by small and medium-sized enterprises, and create a collaborative and win-win cloud platform service environment. Develop secure and trustworthy cloud computing outsourcing services and promote government business outsourcing. Guide the establishment of cloud service platforms for personal information storage, online development tools, learning, and entertainment, and cultivate new hotspots in information consumption. Improve and promote the comprehensive standard system for cloud computing, strengthen the research and development of cloud computing evaluation tools and the construction of evaluation systems, and improve the standardization level and service capabilities of cloud computing. Column 3: Development of secure and trustworthy cloud computing for intelligent manufacturing. Encourage backbone enterprises to develop trustworthy cloud computing resource pools for intelligent manufacturing resources and services, support various activities throughout the lifecycle of intelligent manufacturing. Support software and information technology services. Encourage cross-industry cooperation among enterprises to develop new formats and models such as personalized customized services, lifecycle management, precision online marketing, and online support services. Carry out cloud computing application demonstrations. Organize industrial cloud service innovation pilots, promote the open sharing of resources in research and development design, production manufacturing, marketing services, and testing and verification, and build an industrial cloud ecosystem. Improve public cloud service capabilities. Carry out the construction of a public cloud service enterprise capability evaluation system, research and improve cloud service evaluation and measurement billing standards, and support backbone enterprises in building high-level public cloud computing service platforms. Encourage government departments, public service institutions, and industry backbone enterprises to use public cloud services to build information solutions.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, actively cultivating and strengthening emerging industries, innovating cloud computing applications and services.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Build a big data industry system. Strengthen the research and development and application of key big data technologies, and cultivate a big data product system. Develop specialized data service new formats such as big data collection and resource construction, big data resource circulation and transaction, and big data maturity assessment, and promote the circulation and sharing of big data resources. Cultivate leading big data enterprises and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, and create a multi-level and tiered industrial innovation main body. Optimize the layout of the big data industry, and build big data industry agglomeration zones and comprehensive test zones. Support the construction of big data public service platforms, develop services such as big data standard verification and evaluation certification, and improve the public service system of the big data industry. Develop industrial big data. Support the research and development of big data analysis technologies and platforms for key links such as research and development design, production manufacturing, operation management, marketing, and operation and maintenance services, promote the establishment of a comprehensive big data resource integration and analysis platform for the entire industry chain, and carry out application innovation and pilot demonstrations of big data in the industrial field. Relying on data-intensive industrial agglomeration zones such as high-end equipment and electronic information, support the construction of a batch of industrial big data innovation centers, industry platforms, and service demonstration bases, enrich industrial big data service content and innovate service models. Deepen the application of big data services. Develop and promote big data products and solutions for key industries such as finance, energy, agriculture, logistics, and transportation, promote the integration and application of big data across industries, and help promote the transformation and development of key industries. With a focus on serving the needs of the people's livelihood, accelerate the application of big data in fields such as healthcare, education, transportation, tourism, employment, social security, environmental protection, and emergency management. Support the establishment of big data platforms for government affairs, social governance, and network security, strengthen top-level design, integrate resources, promote the in-depth application of big data technology, and enhance government governance capabilities and service levels. Column 4: Big data technology research and application demonstration project. Strengthen the research and industrialization of key big data technology products. Carry out research on key technologies and tools such as next-generation relational databases, distributed databases, new big data processing engines, integrated data management platforms, and data security, fully utilize the achievements of open source technology, and promote the construction of a big data technology system. Develop scalable and high-quality computing platforms and related software systems for big data, enhance data analysis and processing capabilities, knowledge discovery capabilities, and decision-making capabilities, and form a relatively sound big data product system. Vigorously develop big data solutions that deeply integrate with the business processes and data application needs of key industry sectors. Promote the application demonstration of big data. Carry out the creation of big data industry agglomeration zones and support regions with conditions to carry out pilot demonstrations of big data applications. Promote the integration and development of big data with cloud computing, industrial internet, and cyber-physical systems, support the establishment of big data analysis and application platforms for different industrial sectors and different business links, select key industrial sectors, typical enterprises, and key regions to carry out industrial big data application demonstrations, and improve the service level of big data applications in the industrial field.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, actively cultivating and strengthening emerging industries, accelerating the development and application of big data.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Accelerate the development of mobile internet applications and services, targeting the innovative development needs of emerging media, healthcare, culture and education, transportation, finance, commerce, and circulation. Encourage the establishment of sharing economy platforms, support the development of mobile, social, and personalized information services based on software and mobile internet, and actively cultivate new models of internet economy. Strengthen the research and development and application of software platforms and application development environments for the Internet of Things, further deepen the integration and application of IoT software technology in smart manufacturing, smart agriculture, transportation, and other fields. Accelerate the development of new applications such as connected vehicles and Beidou navigation, and support the development of intelligent connected vehicle technology, Beidou navigation software technology, and application platforms.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, actively cultivating and strengthening emerging industries, deepening software innovation and application in fields such as mobile internet and Internet of Things.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Fully leverage the deep integration, penetration, and coupling effects of software, accelerate the integration and application of software in various industries, develop key application software, industry solutions, and integrated application platforms, strengthen application innovation and business model innovation, enhance the level of service-oriented manufacturing, cultivate and expand information consumption, and provide support services for initiatives such as the 'Internet Plus' Action Plan.
titlelist: Focus on tasks and major projects, deepen the promotion of application innovation and integrated development.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Focus on key aspects of the manufacturing industry, and provide support for the research and application of high-end industrial software, new industrial apps, etc. Develop industrial operating systems and industrial big data management systems to improve the supply capacity of industrial software products and strengthen the foundational role of software in manufacturing. Cultivate a group of system solution providers, develop system solutions for key industries such as intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and intelligent factories, carry out pilot demonstrations, and enhance the capability of intelligent manufacturing system solutions. Promote the research and industrialization of key technologies in Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS), and conduct industry application testing and pilot demonstrations. Promote the integration and development of software and information technology service enterprises with manufacturing enterprises, and create new research and development design patterns, production and manufacturing methods, and service management models. Column 5: Industrial Technology Software Promotion Project. Research and development and application of industrial software and solutions. Support the development of a batch of industrial software products and application solutions with good application effects, strong technological innovation, and high market recognition, such as computer-aided design and simulation, manufacturing execution systems, enterprise management systems, and product lifecycle management, to meet the application needs of key aspects of intelligent manufacturing. Further breakthroughs in core technologies and products of industrial control systems, such as high-end distributed control systems, data acquisition and monitoring systems, and programmable logic controllers, to enhance safety and reliability and comprehensive integration and application capabilities, and promote in-depth application in key industries. Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems verification testing platform and industry application demonstrations. Support the research and industrialization of key technologies and system solutions for industrial Cyber-Physical Systems. Support the establishment of industrial Cyber-Physical Systems verification testing platforms and security testing and evaluation platforms. Carry out application demonstrations of Cyber-Physical Systems in key industries such as aviation, automotive, electronics, petrochemical, and metallurgy. Research and development and pilot demonstrations of industrial software platforms and apps. Support software enterprises to collaborate with industrial enterprises to build basic common software platforms and new industrial app libraries for key industries, and establish an industrial technology software system, and carry out pilot demonstrations. Support the construction of industrial app sharing and trading platforms in eligible regions or industries to enrich the industrial technology software ecosystem. Column 6: Development Project for Information Technology Services for Service-oriented Manufacturing. Support the transformation of the manufacturing industry towards production service-oriented acceleration. Guide manufacturing enterprises to establish open innovation and interaction platforms, online design centers, fully connect with user needs, and develop research and design service models based on the Internet, such as on-demand, crowdsourcing, and crowd innovation. Encourage large-scale manufacturing enterprises to develop services based on Internet platforms, such as cloud manufacturing and supply chain management, targeting the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain. Support key industrial sectors to utilize technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, and big data to develop new online service models such as product monitoring and traceability, remote diagnosis and maintenance, and product lifecycle management, and promote the upgrading of products to the high-end of the value chain. Encourage enterprises to carry out supply chain finance, financing leasing, and other new businesses based on product intelligence and online supply chain. Develop information technology services for the manufacturing industry. Promote information technology service enterprises to develop integrated solutions for the manufacturing industry, provide information technology consulting, design, and operation and maintenance services, and carry out demonstration applications and promotion. In key areas such as construction machinery, rail transportation, aviation, and shipbuilding, encourage and support the application of information technology services in smart factories, digital workshops, and green manufacturing, and promote the application and promotion of intelligent manufacturing models such as personalized customization, networked collaborative manufacturing, and service-oriented manufacturing. Vigorously develop e-commerce, encourage innovation and development of industry e-commerce platforms, support supply chain management and market sales for the manufacturing industry. Strengthen service support with supply-demand matching as the core. Explore the establishment of a public service platform for information technology services for the manufacturing industry, providing common services such as research and development testing, simulation and modeling, talent training, and equipment leasing. Strengthen the dual-drive of supply and demand, build a platform for information technology service enterprises and manufacturing enterprises to match supply and demand, establish a sound matching mechanism, promote advanced experiences, and promote cross-domain cooperation. Accelerate the development and application of information technology service standards (ITSS) for the manufacturing industry and build a sound standard system.
titlelist: Focus on key tasks and major projects, deepen the promotion of application innovation and integrated development, support the integration of manufacturing industry and the Internet.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: In order to address the new situation and security needs of information security development, support should be provided for the research and industrialization of key technological products, the development of specialized services such as security evaluation and certification, consulting, and early warning response, and the enhancement of information security support capabilities. The information security industry should be developed. Support should be given to the research and industrialization of information security products in the areas of basic, network and boundary security, terminal and digital content security, and security management in the cloud-edge environment. Support should also be provided for the development of security consulting and integration, security operation and maintenance management, security evaluation and certification, security risk assessment, security training, and new types of information security services. Efforts should be made to cultivate leading enterprises and develop several enterprises with strong professional capabilities and distinctive features. The integration of electronic certification with new technologies such as cloud computing, big data, mobile internet, and biometric identification should be promoted, and the promotion of reliable electronic signature applications and innovative electronic certification service models should be accelerated. Core technologies in the fields of personal data protection, trusted identity identification protection, identity management and verification systems, etc., should be strengthened in terms of research and development and application promotion. The industrial information security guarantee system should be improved. A coordinated design, collaborative research, information sharing, and collaborative protection system for industrial information security should be constructed. Following the principle of small core, large collaboration, a national-level research institution for industrial information system security should be established to carry out the construction of technical platforms such as national-level industrial information security simulation testing, computational analysis, and big data application, and to form national capabilities in industrial information security situation awareness, security protection, emergency support, risk warning, and industrial promotion. The policy, standard, management, technology, industry, and service systems should be improved, and policies and standards for the protection of industrial control system information security should be formulated. The inspection and assessment of industrial control system security should be strengthened, and support should be provided for the research and development of industrial control systems and their security technology products. Enterprises should be encouraged to carry out security assessments, risk verification, security reinforcement, and other services. Column 8: Enhance the development of key information security technologies and products for improving information security support capabilities. Breakthroughs should be made in core information security technologies such as cryptography, trusted computing, data security, system security, and network security in emerging fields such as cloud computing, big data, and mobile internet. Support should be provided for basic security products, network and boundary security products using new technologies such as content awareness, intelligent sandboxing, anomaly detection, and virtualization, security management products based on massive data and intelligent analysis, as well as the research and application of security support tools such as security evaluation, web vulnerability scanning, internal network penetration scanning, network security protection, and source code security inspection. The construction of industrial information security support capabilities should be strengthened. Typical industrial control systems and their equipment should be selected to carry out research and testing verification of key network security protection products such as industrial firewalls and identity authentication. In industries such as petrochemicals, metallurgy, and equipment manufacturing, a group of key enterprises should be selected to demonstrate the application of network security protection products. Support should be provided for the research and deployment of real-time monitoring tools for industrial control system network security in key enterprises. A number of industrial information system security laboratories should be established, with priority given to the construction of public service platforms such as the verification of industrial control products and system information security standards, simulation testing, communication protocol security evaluation, monitoring and early warning, and the cultivation of third-party service organizations.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, further enhancing information security capabilities.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order No. 425 [2016]) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Persist in openness and innovation, seize the opportunities of implementing national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, coordinate the use of domestic and foreign innovative elements and market resources, strengthen international exchanges and cooperation in technology, industry, talent, standardization, and other fields, deeply integrate into the global industrial ecosystem led by leading enterprises, and enhance the level and scale of international development. Enhance the international development capabilities of industries. Support leading enterprises in establishing and improving overseas operating institutions, research and development centers, and service systems, construct overseas cooperation zones, encourage the development of cross-border e-commerce, service outsourcing, and other outward-oriented businesses, accelerate the export of software and information technology services, and build international brands. Relying on bilateral and multilateral cooperation mechanisms and platforms, strengthen the linkage between government and enterprises, carry out major cooperative demonstration projects led by leading enterprises, support enterprise alliances, leverage the synergistic advantages of industrial chains, and promote cluster-based internationalization. Strengthen the construction of channels and mechanisms for introducing original technologies, deepen industrial cooperation with countries and regions with strong original technological capabilities, accelerate the introduction of talents, technologies, intellectual property rights, and other advantageous innovative resources, and improve the level and utilization of cooperation in bringing in industries. Strengthen international service support. Encourage local governments to increase support and efforts in terms of policies, funds, projects, and other aspects for the international development of industries. Support enterprises, research institutions, and other entities to actively participate in the formulation of international rules and standardization work in the field of software and information technology services, and enhance international discourse power. Play the role of intermediary organizations such as industry associations, chambers of commerce, industry alliances, and open-source alliances, and provide market-oriented and socialized services for the international development of enterprises. Fully utilize means such as knowledge renewal projects and overseas talent training, support software companies in cultivating international talents and attracting outstanding overseas talents.
titlelist: Key tasks and major projects, accelerate the improvement of international development level.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order No. 425 [2016]) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Implement the Several Policies to Further Encourage the Development of the Software Industry and Integrated Circuit Industry (State Council Document [2011] No. 4) in depth, and study and formulate policy measures that adapt to the new characteristics of industrial development under new circumstances. Improve policy measures and mechanisms to stimulate innovation, strengthen support for the first purchase and subscription of innovative software products and services, and encourage software companies to increase research and development investment. Guide and encourage increased investment in software and information security in information technology construction. Support the formulation of policy measures to promote the integration of software technology with other industries. Further improve the relevant mechanisms and measures for encouraging government procurement of services. Support pilot projects for innovative industrial policies in areas with conditions. Encourage local areas to research and formulate policy measures to accelerate the going global of enterprises. Strengthen the implementation, evaluation, and supervision of industrial policies. Promote the improvement of the industrial-related regulatory system.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the policy and regulatory system.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 425) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Innovate fiscal funding support policies, coordinate the use of existing financial resources, and increase support for the development of the software and information technology service industry. Adopt government guidance and market-oriented operation methods to explore the establishment of a national software and information technology service industry investment fund. Support qualified localities, large enterprises, and investment institutions in setting up special funds or industry funds, innovation and entrepreneurship funds, angel investment funds, equity and mergers and acquisitions funds, and other types of funds. Encourage the use of government and social capital cooperation (PPP) model to guide social capital participation in major project construction. Improve financial service policies related to overseas mergers and acquisitions, cross-border settlements, and other areas. Deepen the integration of industry and finance, under the premise of controllable risks, promote commercial banks to innovate credit products and financial services, support the innovative development of software and information technology service enterprises, and encourage policy banks to provide credit support to eligible enterprises within the scope of their functions and positioning. Improve the financing guarantee system, perfect the risk compensation mechanism, encourage financial institutions to carry out equity mortgage, intellectual property pledge business, pilot credit insurance, technology insurance, and study the legal status and feasibility of contract pledge and qualification mortgage. Encourage enterprises to expand direct financing, support eligible enterprises to carry out accounts receivable financing, corporate credit bonds, and other new financing methods.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial and fiscal support.

name: Development Plan for the Software and Information Technology Services Industry (2016-2020) (excerpt) (MIIT Order No. 425 [2016]) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Establish a coordinated promotion mechanism among departments, industries, and regions, and strengthen collaborative cooperation in areas such as collaborative innovation, standard formulation, industry management, market supervision, and financial support. Guide and promote the development of industries in different regions and departments according to local conditions, reasonably arrange major application demonstration and industrialization projects, and coordinate and promote them in an orderly manner. Guide and encourage enterprises to establish multi-level cooperative innovation mechanisms with enterprises in other industries, and achieve coordinated development in areas such as technological research and development, application promotion, security guarantee, and resource allocation and utilization. Strengthen dynamic monitoring and evaluation of planning implementation to ensure the quality of planning implementation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen overall coordination.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Based on the national conditions and looking towards the future, we will build an industrial internet ecosystem that is compatible with the development of our country's economy. We aim to make our country's level of industrial internet development at the forefront internationally, striving to achieve and even lead. By 2025, we will have basically formed a foundation of infrastructure and industrial systems with international competitiveness. The industrial internet network infrastructure will be established in various regions and industries. The industrial internet identification and resolution system will be continuously improved and scaled up. We will establish 3-5 industrial internet platforms that reach international standards. The industrial system will be relatively sound, with mastery of key core technologies and significantly enhanced supply capabilities, forming a group of internationally competitive leading enterprises. We will establish a relatively complete and reliable industrial internet security system. New technologies, new models, and new formats will be widely promoted and applied, pushing forward the integration of the two industries to a new level. In the initial stage from 2018 to 2020, we will initially build a low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage industrial internet network infrastructure. We will initially construct an industrial internet identification and resolution system and initially form a platform system for industrial internet development with different focuses and collaborative aggregation. We will also establish an initial industrial internet security system. By 2035, we will have built internationally leading industrial internet network infrastructure and platforms, formed internationally advanced technology and industrial systems, comprehensively and deeply applied industrial internet, and developed innovative capabilities in advantageous industries. The security capabilities will be comprehensively enhanced, and key areas will achieve international leadership. By the middle of this century, the industrial internet network infrastructure will comprehensively support economic and social development. The innovation and development capabilities, technological and industrial systems, and integrated applications of the industrial internet will reach international advanced levels. Our comprehensive strength will enter the forefront of the world.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Promote the transformation, upgrading, and acceleration of network construction while reducing costs. Focus on the low-latency, high-reliability, and wide-coverage network needs of enterprises, and vigorously promote the construction of internal and external networks for industrial enterprises. Accelerate the construction and transformation of broadband network infrastructure, expand network coverage, and optimize and upgrade the national backbone network. Promote the IP (Internet Protocol), flat, flexible technological transformation and construction deployment of internal networks in industrial enterprises. Promote the application of new intelligent gateways and fully deploy IPv6 (Internet Protocol version 6). Continue to promote the construction of dedicated lines for connecting small and medium-sized enterprises. Building upon the completion of the network acceleration and cost reduction tasks set out in the 2017 government work report, further increase network speed and reduce tariff levels, especially for significantly reducing the access fees for small and medium-sized enterprise internet dedicated lines. Strengthen resource openness and support the integrated development of large, medium, and small enterprises. Increase the guarantee of key resources such as radio spectrum. Promote the construction of identification resolution systems. Strengthen the top-level design of the industrial internet identification resolution system, establish an overall architecture, clarify development goals, roadmaps, and timetables. Establish a national management institution for industrial internet identification resolution, construct an identification resolution service system, support the construction of various levels of identification resolution nodes and public recursive resolution nodes, utilize identification to achieve precise connection between global supply chain systems and enterprise production systems, as well as cross-enterprise, cross-regional, and cross-industry product lifecycle management, and promote the integration and sharing of information resources. Column 1: Industrial Internet Infrastructure Upgrade and Transformation Project. Organize and implement the construction and upgrade of internal networks for industrial enterprises, external networks for industrial enterprises, and identification resolution systems for industrial internet. Support the transformation of internal networks for industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Passive Optical Network (PON), and industrial wireless, and upgrade and transform external networks for industrial enterprises using technologies such as IPv6, Software-Defined Networking (SDN), and new cellular mobile communication technologies. Conduct network technology experiments for industrial internet applications in 5G research and coordinate the deployment of 5G in industrial enterprises. Carry out the construction of the industrial internet identification resolution system and establish and improve various levels of identification resolution nodes. By 2020, basically complete the upgrade and transformation of the next-generation internet and supporting management capabilities for advanced manufacturing, achieve the application of wireless network technologies such as Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) and Wireless Industrial Automation/Process (WIA-PA/FA) in key regions and industries, and initially establish supporting systems for industrial internet identification resolution registration and filing, with more than 10 public identification resolution service nodes and over 2 billion identification registrations. By 2025, deploy industrial wireless, Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN), IPv6, and other industrial internet network technologies in large-scale industrial enterprises, achieve universal coverage of 5G networks and low-power wide-area networks for industrial internet access, and establish a fully functional industrial internet identification resolution system with more than 20 public identification resolution service nodes and over 3 billion identification registrations.
titlelist: Main task, solidify network foundation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Accelerate the construction of industrial internet platforms. Break through key technological bottlenecks such as data integration, platform management, development tools, microservice frameworks, and modeling analysis, and form a technical system and industrial system that effectively support the development of industrial internet platforms. Carry out experimental verification in terms of adaptability, reliability, and security of industrial internet platforms, and promote continuous improvement of platform functions. Form a multi-level and systematic platform development system through classification, synchronous promotion, and dynamic adjustment. Relying on industrial internet platforms to create multi-level public platforms that serve mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Enhance platform operation capabilities. Strengthen the resource aggregation capabilities of industrial internet platforms, effectively integrate data resources such as product design, production processes, equipment operations, and operation management, and gather and share manufacturing resources such as design capabilities, production capabilities, software resources, and knowledge models. Carry out application innovation for different industries and scenarios, providing users with various applications including equipment health maintenance, production management optimization, collaborative design and manufacturing, and manufacturing resource leasing, and enhance service capabilities. Continuously explore business model innovation, expand platform profit space through resource rental, service provision, and industry-finance cooperation, and achieve long-term sustainable operation. Column 2: Construction and promotion of industrial internet platform engineering. Act on both the supply and demand sides of industrial internet platforms, and carry out construction and promotion in four aspects: First, cultivate industrial internet platforms. Through enterprise-led, market-driven, and dynamically adjusted methods, form cross-industry and cross-domain platforms, achieve interconnection and interoperability of multiple platforms, undertake functions such as resource aggregation and sharing, technology standard testing and verification, and provide services such as industrial data circulation, business resource management, and industrial operation monitoring. Promote leading enterprises to actively develop enterprise-level platforms and develop various solutions that meet the needs of enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent development. Establish and improve the technical system of industrial internet platforms. Second, conduct experimental verification of industrial internet platforms. Support industry alliances, cooperation between enterprises and research institutions to jointly build testing and verification platforms, and carry out technology verification and testing evaluation. Third, migrate millions of enterprises to the cloud. Encourage the landing of industrial internet platforms in industrial agglomeration areas, and promote local governments to encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to migrate their business systems to the cloud through financial and tax support, government procurement of services, and other means. Fourth, cultivate millions of industrial apps. Support software companies, industrial enterprises, research institutes, etc., to cooperate and cultivate a batch of industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios. By 2020, the industrial internet platform system will initially take shape, supporting the construction of about 10 cross-industry and cross-domain platforms, and building a batch of enterprise-level platforms that support enterprise digitization, networking, and intelligent transformation. Cultivate 300,000 industrial apps for specific industries and scenarios, promote 300,000 enterprises to use industrial internet platforms for research and development, design, production, manufacturing, and operation management, and the fundamental and supportive role of industrial internet platforms in industrial transformation and upgrading will begin to emerge. By 2025, key industries in the industrial sector will achieve networked manufacturing, the industrial internet platform system will be basically improved, 3-5 industrial internet platforms with international competitiveness will be formed, millions of industrial apps will be cultivated, millions of enterprises will migrate to the cloud, and a new ecosystem of manufacturing industry with platform construction and platform usage mutually promoting and iterating will be formed.
titlelist: The main task is to build a platform system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Increase the efforts in key common technology research. Conduct research on new network interconnection technologies such as time-sensitive networks, deterministic networks, and low-power industrial wireless networks, and accelerate the application research of 5G, software-defined networks, and other technologies in the industrial internet. Promote research on key technologies and secure and reliable mechanisms for industrial internet identification resolution, information management, and heterogeneous identification interoperability. Accelerate the research on core technologies such as IPv6. Promote the application research and exploration of emerging frontier technologies such as edge computing, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, virtual reality, and blockchain in the industrial internet. Build an industrial internet standard system. Establish a national industrial internet standard coordination and promotion group, an overall group, and an expert advisory group to coordinate the construction of the industrial internet standard system, optimize the promotion mechanism, and accelerate the establishment of a unified, comprehensive, and open industrial internet standard system. Develop a series of overall standards, basic common standards, application standards, and security standards. Organize standard development and test verification projects, and promote the development and promotion of standard content test verification, test verification environment construction, simulation and testing tool development. Column 3: Standard development and test verification projects. Carry out the development of industrial internet standards based on the standardization needs and standard system construction of the industrial internet. Develop overall standards such as general requirements, system architecture, and testing and evaluation; develop basic common standards such as network and digital interconnection interfaces, identification resolution, industrial internet platforms, and security; develop industry application guidelines, specific technical standards, and management specifications for key industries such as automotive, aerospace, petrochemicals, machinery manufacturing, light industry and home appliances, information electronics, etc. Organize the test verification work of relevant standards and promote the development of supporting simulation and testing tools. By 2020, initially establish an industrial internet standard system, formulate more than 20 overall and key basic common standards, formulate more than 20 key industry standards, and promote the application of standards in key enterprises and industries. By 2025, basically establish a standard system covering key technologies, products, management, and applications of the industrial internet, and widely apply it in enterprises. Enhance product and solution supply capabilities. Accelerate the research and industrialization of information and communication, data integration and analysis, and focus on breakthroughs in key software and hardware products and solutions such as high-performance networks, intelligent modules, intelligent networking equipment, and industrial software. Focus on improving the integration and innovation level of data analysis algorithms with industrial knowledge, mechanisms, and experience, and develop a batch of industrial data analysis software and systems for different industrial scenarios, as well as industrial intelligence software and solutions with deep learning and other artificial intelligence technologies. Create overall industrial internet solutions closely integrated with the characteristics of the top ten key areas and traditional industries. Guide telecommunications operators, internet companies, and industrial enterprises to actively transform, strengthen their capabilities in industrial internet operation services such as network operation, identification resolution, and security, and develop innovative productive services such as industrial e-commerce, supply chain, and related financial information. Column 4: Key technology industrialization projects. Promote research and application of emerging frontier technologies such as new network interconnection and identification resolution in the industrial internet, establish technology test verification systems, and support technology and product test verification. Focus on key industrial internet industry links and actively promote the industrialization of key technologies. Accelerate the industrialization of key industrial internet network equipment, develop key technologies and products such as IPv6, industrial passive optical networks, time-sensitive networks, industrial wireless networks, low-power wide area networks, software-defined networks, and identification resolution. Develop and promote key intelligent networked equipment, focus on key areas such as numerical control machine tools, industrial robots, large-scale power equipment, etc., achieve integrated innovation of intelligent control, intelligent sensing, industrial-grade chips, and network communication modules, and form a series of new intelligent equipment with networking, computing, and optimization functions. Develop industrial big data analysis software, focus on key areas, develop industrial big data analysis application software around application scenarios such as production process optimization, quality analysis, predictive maintenance of equipment, intelligent scheduling, etc., and achieve industrial deployment. By 2020, make breakthroughs in a batch of key technologies, establish more than 5 technology test verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment with advanced domestic levels, and have active innovation in intelligent networked products, achieve quick access to functions such as industrial big data cleaning, management, and analysis, promote the application of technology and products in key enterprises and industries, and initially realize the industrialization of key technologies in the industrial internet. By 2025, master key core technologies, effectively support the research and experimentation of industrial internet technology products through technology test verification systems, launch a batch of industrial internet network equipment that reaches international advanced levels, achieve large-scale commercial deployment of intelligent networked products and industrial big data analysis application software, and form a relatively sound industrial internet industry system.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen industrial support.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Promote the innovation and application level of industrial internet in large enterprises. Accelerate the application of industrial internet in industrial sites, strengthen the networking and data collection capabilities of equipment in complex production processes, and achieve end-to-end integration of data resources at all levels of the enterprise. Carry out data integration applications based on the industrial internet platform, form the ability of process optimization, workflow optimization, equipment maintenance, and accident risk warning based on data analysis and feedback, and realize intelligent decision-making and deep optimization of enterprise production and operation management. Encourage enterprises to integrate resources through the industrial internet platform, build a collaborative manufacturing system for design, production, and supply chain. Promote large-scale customization based on user individual needs and precise connection between product design and production in terms of quality traceability, equipment health management, and value-added services. Accelerate the popularization of industrial internet applications in small and medium-sized enterprises. Promote the deployment and application of low-cost, modular industrial internet equipment and systems in small and medium-sized enterprises, and enhance their digital and networked capabilities. Encourage small and medium-sized enterprises to fully utilize the cloud-based research and development design, production management, and operation optimization software of the industrial internet platform, realize the migration of business systems to the cloud, and reduce the cost of digital and intelligent transformation. Guide small and medium-sized enterprises to open up professional knowledge, design creativity, and manufacturing capabilities, and carry out innovative applications such as supply-demand matching, integrated supply chain, industrial e-commerce, and crowdsourcing and crowdfunding based on the industrial internet platform to improve the efficiency of social manufacturing resource allocation. Column 5: Industrial Internet Integration and Innovation Application Engineering. Guided by pioneering applications, organize and carry out innovative application demonstrations, and gradually explore the implementation path and application models of the industrial internet. In terms of intelligent production applications, encourage large industrial enterprises to achieve extensive interconnection between various production equipment and information systems and the integration and interoperability of related industrial data, and develop applications such as quality optimization, intelligent scheduling, and supply chain optimization based on this. In terms of remote service applications, carry out networked services for high-value intelligent equipment, realize remote monitoring, predictive maintenance, fault diagnosis, and other remote service applications, and explore the development of remote services for comprehensive support in the defense industry. In terms of networked collaborative manufacturing applications, focus on the intelligent development needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, carry out collaborative design, crowdsourcing, cloud manufacturing, and other innovative applications, and realize online access to various industrial software and modular design and manufacturing resources. In terms of intelligent networking product applications, focus on areas such as smart homes, wearable devices, etc., integrate advanced technologies such as 5G, deep learning, and big data, and meet typical needs such as high-precision positioning, intelligent human-machine interaction, and secure and trustworthy operation and maintenance. In terms of identification resolution and integration applications, implement integrated innovation applications of industrial internet identification resolution system and industrial enterprise information system, support enterprises to explore key product traceability based on identification services, multi-source heterogeneous data sharing, and lifecycle management applications. By 2020, a strong influence of industrial internet pioneering application models will be initially formed, and around 150 application pilots will be established. By 2025, expand the scope of industrial internet applications, fully promote them in the top ten key areas and key traditional industries, and achieve significant overall improvement in enterprise benefits.
titlelist: The main task is to promote integrated applications.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Enhance security protection capabilities. Strengthen research on the security system of the industrial internet, combining technology and management, and establish a multi-level security guarantee system for the industrial internet covering equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security. Increase support for technology research and development and the transformation of achievements, with a focus on breakthroughs in core technologies such as secure identification and resolution systems, industrial internet platform security, industrial control system security, and industrial big data security. Promote the development of security products such as attack protection, vulnerability discovery, intrusion detection, situational awareness, security auditing, and trusted chips, and establish technical support capabilities that match the development of the industrial internet. Build a security assessment and certification system for industrial internet devices, networks, and platforms, and conduct security capability assessments and certifications through third-party organizations such as industry alliances to continuously improve the security protection capabilities of the industrial internet. Establish a data security protection system. Establish a comprehensive data security management system for the entire industrial internet industry chain, clarify the data security protection responsibilities and specific requirements of relevant entities, and strengthen the security protection capabilities of data collection, storage, processing, transfer, deletion, and other processes. Establish a classification and management system for industrial data, form a management mechanism for the flow of industrial internet data, clarify requirements for data retention and data leakage reporting, and strengthen supervision and inspection of industrial internet data security. Promote the construction of security technology means. Urge relevant enterprises in the industrial internet to fulfill their responsibilities as the main body of network security, guide enterprises to increase security investment, strengthen the construction of security protection and monitoring and disposal technology means, carry out pilot demonstrations of industrial internet security, and enhance security protection capabilities. Actively play the guiding role of relevant industry alliances, integrate industry resources, encourage alliance units to innovate service models, provide security operation and maintenance, security consulting, and other services, and enhance the overall security guarantee service capabilities of the industry. Give full play to the role of national professional institutions and social forces, enhance the national-level industrial internet security technology support capabilities, and focus on improving the capabilities of hazard investigation, attack detection, emergency disposal, and attack traceability. Column 7: Enhancing security protection capabilities project. Promote the improvement of national-level industrial internet security technology capabilities. Build platforms for monitoring, early warning, protection, and disposal of industrial internet security, platforms for core technology research and development of industrial internet security, platforms for security testing and evaluation of industrial internet, and industrial internet test fields. Guide enterprises to enhance their own industrial internet security protection capabilities. In key areas with a good foundation such as automobiles, electronics, aerospace, energy, and urgent security needs such as the defense industry, establish management and technical systems for industrial internet security, and carry out pilot demonstrations and industry applications of security products and solutions. By 2020, conduct targeted inspections and assessments based on the distribution of important industrial internet platforms and systems; initially establish platforms for monitoring, early warning, protection, and disposal of industrial internet security; cultivate and form 3-5 industrial internet security enterprises with core competitiveness; select a batch of innovative and practical network security pilot demonstration projects for promotion. By 2025, form a series of standards covering industrial internet equipment security, control security, network security, platform security, and data security, establish a sound industrial internet security certification system; comprehensively promote the application of industrial internet security products and services; significantly enhance the network security protection capabilities of industrial internet-related enterprises; and basically establish a national-level industrial internet security technology support system.
titlelist: Main task, strengthen security guarantee.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Improve the international development capabilities of enterprises. Encourage domestic and foreign enterprises to collaborate on technical research and product development in weak areas such as big data analysis, industrial data modeling, key software systems, and chips. Establish international cooperation mechanisms in industrial internet technology, products, platforms, and services, and promote the introduction and export of industrial internet platforms, integrated solutions, and more. Encourage close collaboration among domestic and foreign enterprises across different sectors and the entire industry chain. Strengthen multilateral dialogue and cooperation. Establish multi-level communication and dialogue mechanisms among governments, industry alliances, and enterprises to exchange and cooperate on major issues related to the latest development of industrial internet, global infrastructure construction, data flow, security, policies, and regulations. Enhance collaboration with international organizations to jointly formulate industrial internet standards and international rules, and build a multilateral, democratic, and transparent international governance system for the industrial internet.
titlelist: The main task is to promote openness and cooperation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Strengthen the role of fiscal funds in guiding, and increase support for the development of industrial internet through funds for industrial transformation and upgrading, with a focus on supporting the construction of network systems, platform systems, and security systems. Explore support methods such as first purchase and preferential purchase to promote the large-scale application of innovative products and services in the industrial internet. Encourage eligible regions to support the development of local industrial internet clusters by establishing special funds for industrial internet and establishing risk compensation funds. Implement relevant tax preferential policies to promote accelerated depreciation of fixed assets, additional deduction of enterprise R&D expenses, preferential income tax for software and integrated circuit industry enterprises, and tax preferential policies for small and micro enterprises, and encourage relevant enterprises to accelerate the development and application of industrial internet.
titlelist: Ensure support and increase financial and tax support.

name: Guiding Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Development of Industrial Internet in the Context of 'Internet Plus Advanced Manufacturing' (State Council/November 19, 2017)
content: Support the expansion of the proportion of direct financing, support industrial internet companies that meet the conditions to carry out equity financing in domestic and foreign capital markets at all levels, actively promote the application of project income bonds, convertible bonds, corporate bonds, and company bonds in the field of industrial internet, and guide various types of investment funds to tilt towards the field of industrial internet.
