This will promote real-time access and mutual recognition and sharing of examination and test results among medical institutions within the consortia. Advance the coverage of remote medical services to all medical consortia and county-level hospitals nationwide, gradually extending to community health service institutions, township health centers, and village clinics, in order to enhance the capacity and efficiency of primary healthcare services. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, and State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Develop Internet Plus medical services. Medical consortiums should actively use Internet technology to accelerate the integration of medical resources, information sharing, and efficient collaboration. This will facilitate convenient services such as appointment scheduling, two-way referrals, and telemedicine. It will also promote primary examination, superior diagnosis and advance the establishment of an orderly hierarchical diagnosis and treatment pattern.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Explore the interconnection and real-time sharing of prescription information from medical and health institutions with retail consumption information of drugs, promote the standardized development of online drug sales and medical logistics distribution. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, and National Medical Products Administration).
titlelist: Improve the 'Internet+' pharmaceutical supply guarantee service. For common and chronic disease prescriptions issued online, after being reviewed by pharmacists, medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies can entrust qualified third-party organizations to handle the distribution.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Further improve the direct settlement of hospitalization expenses for migrant workers and the majority of 'double-creation' personnel across provinces. (Responsibility of the National Healthcare Security Administration).
titlelist: Promote the Internet Plus healthcare settlement service, continue to expand the scope of networked designated medical institutions, and gradually include more primary healthcare institutions in direct settlement for medical treatment in different places.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Build a networked, digitized, personalized, and lifelong medical education and training system, encourage medical workers to engage in discussions and exchanges on difficult and complex cases and major diseases, and improve professional competence. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission, Ministry of Education, and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security).
titlelist: Strengthen Internet+ medical education and popular science services, encourage the establishment of a cloud platform for medical and health education and training, and provide diverse online medical courses and medical education.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Support the application of intelligent auxiliary systems for the differentiation and treatment of traditional Chinese medicine, and enhance the capacity of primary-level TCM diagnosis and treatment services. Carry out demonstrations of mobile healthcare based on artificial intelligence technology and medical health intelligent devices, realizing real-time monitoring and assessment of personal health, disease warning, chronic disease screening, and proactive intervention. (Responsibilities are divided among the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Health Commission, and State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Promote the application of Internet+ artificial intelligence services, develop clinical diagnosis and treatment decision support systems based on artificial intelligence, carry out intelligent medical image recognition, pathological classification, multidisciplinary consultation, and intelligent voice technology applications in various medical and health scenarios, and improve the efficiency of medical services.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: In response to the trend of innovation and development in the industrial internet, we aim to enhance the digitalization and intelligent manufacturing level of medical and health equipment, and promote industrial upgrading. (Responsibilities are divided among the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, National Health Commission, etc.)
titlelist: Promote the application and service of Internet Plus artificial intelligence, strengthen the integration, sharing, and application of clinical and scientific research data, support the development of artificial intelligence technologies, medical robots, large-scale medical equipment, emergency rescue medical equipment, 3D bioprinting technology, and wearable devices related to medical and health.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Significantly enhance the level of information application in medical institutions. Secondary and above hospitals should improve the functionality of their hospital information platforms, integrate various internal system resources, and improve hospital management efficiency. Tertiary hospitals should achieve interconnection and sharing of medical service information within the hospital by 2020, and hospitals with conditions should strive to achieve this as soon as possible. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission).
titlelist: Improve the support system for Internet + Medical and Health, accelerate the realization of medical and health information interconnection and sharing, accelerate the construction of basic resource information databases, and improve databases such as comprehensive population, electronic health records, and electronic medical records.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: By 2020, secondary and tertiary hospitals will generally provide online services such as appointment scheduling in different time slots, intelligent triage by medical guides, waiting time reminders, inquiry of test results, in-clinic settlement, and mobile payment. Medical and health institutions with the necessary conditions can also offer services such as mobile nursing, online monitoring of vital signs, intelligent medical image recognition, and home monitoring. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission and the State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Improve the support system for Internet + healthcare, enhance hospital management and convenience services, focus on the growing needs of the people, utilize information technology, optimize service processes, improve service efficiency, and enhance the matching degree between medical service supply and demand.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Promote the connection between pre-hospital emergency ambulance monitoring systems and regional or hospital information platforms, and ensure the standardized sharing of patient information, remote emergency guidance, and in-hospital emergency preparedness, in order to improve emergency response efficiency. Promote the 'smart Chinese medicine pharmacy' and improve the level of pharmaceutical services for Chinese herbal medicines, herbal decoctions, and formulated preparations. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine).
titlelist: Improve the support system for Internet + Medical and Health, enhance the level of hospital management and convenience services, support the collaboration between medical testing institutions, medical and health institutions, and internet companies, and develop medical and health services such as disease prevention, testing, and detection.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Promote telecommunications companies to accelerate the pace of broadband network evolution and upgrade, deploy high-capacity fiber broadband networks, and provide high-speed network access. Improve mobile broadband network coverage to support the development of remote diagnosis and treatment in ambulance vehicles. (The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Health Commission are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Improve the support system for Internet + Medical Health, enhance the infrastructure guarantee capability of medical institutions, and focus on supporting the universal coverage of high-speed broadband networks in medical institutions at all levels in urban and rural areas. Carry out pilot projects for universal telecommunications services, and promote the extension of fiber broadband networks to rural medical institutions.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Development of 'Internet + Medical and Health' further improves medical insurance payment policies. Gradually include eligible internet diagnosis and treatment services in the scope of medical insurance payment, establish cost-sharing mechanisms, facilitate people seeking medical treatment nearby, and promote the effective utilization of high-quality medical resources. Improve the charging policies for internet diagnosis and treatment, strengthen usage management, promote the formation of a reasonable benefit distribution mechanism, and support the sustainable development of internet medical services. (Responsibility of the National Healthcare Security Administration). Improve the policy for physicians to practice at multiple locations, encourage practicing physicians to carry out 'Internet + Medical and Health' services. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission).
titlelist: Improve the support system for Internet + healthcare, enhance the infrastructure guarantee capability of medical institutions, and adapt to...

name: Opinions on Promoting the Development of Internet Plus Medical and Health (State Council Document No. [2018] 26) (State Council/April 25, 2018)
content: Strictly implement regulations on information security and the confidentiality of health and medical data, establish a sound system for protecting personal privacy information, strictly manage patient information, user profiles, genetic data, etc., and punish illegal buying and selling and information leakage in accordance with the law and regulations. (Responsibility of the National Health Commission, Cyberspace Administration of China, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security).
titlelist: Strengthen industry supervision and security guarantees, ensure the security of data information, and research and formulate regulations on the rights, openness, circulation, transaction, and protection of health and medical big data.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: By the end of 2018, the penetration rate of Internet double innovation platforms in key industries of the manufacturing sector reached 80%. Compared to the end of 2015, the number of industrial cloud enterprise users doubled, the research and development cycle for new products shortened by 12%, inventory turnover rate increased by 25%, and energy utilization rate improved by 5%. The manufacturing industry's Internet double innovation platforms have become a new source of momentum for promoting the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry. They have formed a number of demonstration and leading effects in new manufacturing models, initially forming a cross-border integrated manufacturing industry ecosystem. The digitization, networking, and intelligence of the manufacturing industry have made significant progress, becoming the core driving force to consolidate China's position as a manufacturing power and accelerate the transition to a manufacturing powerhouse. By 2025, the integration and development of manufacturing and the Internet will reach a new level, with a basically complete integrated double innovation system, widely popularized integrated development models, and a basic formation of a new manufacturing system. The comprehensive competitiveness of the manufacturing industry will be greatly enhanced.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Organize and implement the construction project of the manufacturing industry's Internet-based 'double innovation' platform, supporting manufacturing enterprises in building Internet-based 'double innovation' platforms. Deepen the integrated application of industrial cloud, big data, and other technologies, gather collective wisdom, accelerate the construction of new research and development, production, management, and service models, promote technological product innovation and optimize business management, and enhance the overall innovation capability and level of enterprises. Encourage large-scale manufacturing enterprises to open up various resources gathered on the 'double innovation' platform, strengthen cooperation with various entrepreneurship and innovation bases, and provide specialized services to the whole society, establishing a resource-rich, innovation-active, and efficiently collaborative 'double innovation' new ecosystem. Deepen the reform of state-owned enterprises and the reform of the scientific and technological system, promote the deep integration and open sharing of resources for 'double innovation' in production, education, and research, support manufacturing enterprises in collaborating with research institutes, universities, and various innovation platforms, and accelerate the construction of a 'double innovation' system that supports collaborative research and development and technology diffusion.
titlelist: The main task is to build an Internet + innovation and entrepreneurship platform for manufacturing enterprises.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Organize and implement the 'Double Innovation' service platform support capability enhancement project, support large-scale internet companies and basic telecommunications companies in building 'Double Innovation' service platforms for manufacturing enterprises, especially small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage basic telecommunications companies to increase support for broadband network infrastructure construction in 'Double Innovation' bases, further accelerate cost reduction, improve the 'Double Innovation' service system for the manufacturing industry, create a new environment for cooperation and win-win between large, medium, and small enterprises, and create a new situation of joint innovation and entrepreneurship among enterprises of different sizes. Encourage local areas to rely on national new industrialization industry demonstration bases, national economic and technological development zones, national high-tech industrial development zones, and other industrial agglomeration areas to accelerate the improvement of talent, capital, and other policy environments, fully utilize the internet, actively develop new types of maker spaces, innovation workshops, open-source communities, and other crowd innovation spaces, and combine them with the construction of 'Double Innovation' demonstration bases to cultivate a batch of 'Double Innovation' demonstration bases that support the development of the manufacturing industry. Organize and implement the enterprise management capability enhancement project, accelerate the formulation and application promotion of informationization and industrialization integration management system standards, promote business process reengineering and organizational transformation, and establish new models of organizational management.
titlelist: The main task is to promote Internet companies in building a double innovation service system for the manufacturing industry.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Encourage manufacturing enterprises to form joint ventures and partnerships with internet companies to cultivate new business entities, establish a technology system, standards, specifications, business models, and competition rules that are adaptable to integrated development, and form a pattern of complementary advantages and win-win cooperation in integrated development. Promote the comprehensive integration of manufacturing resources of small and medium-sized enterprises with internet platforms, realize the online release, collaboration, and transaction of manufacturing capabilities, actively develop a sharing economy for the manufacturing process, break down enterprise boundaries, share technology, equipment, and services, and enhance the rapid response and flexible and efficient supply capabilities of small and medium-sized enterprises. Support manufacturing enterprises and e-commerce companies in strategic investment, brand cultivation, online sales, and logistics distribution, integrate online and offline transaction resources, expand sales channels, and create an efficient and collaborative production and circulation integration new ecosystem in manufacturing, marketing, logistics, and other fields.
titlelist: The main task is to support the cross-border integration between manufacturing enterprises and internet enterprises.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Implement major projects such as intelligent manufacturing, covering the entire production process, the entire industry chain, and the entire product life cycle. Support enterprises in deepening the integration of quality management and the Internet, promote quality control throughout the industry chain through online measurement, online testing, and other means, and vigorously develop new production models such as networked collaborative manufacturing. Support enterprises in collecting and connecting personalized user demands through the Internet, carry out research and development, production, service, and business model innovation based on personalized products, and promote accurate matching of supply and demand. Promote enterprises to provide online value-added services through the Internet, encourage the development of product life cycle management and services for smart products and equipment, expand the value space of products, and achieve a transformation and upgrade from manufacturing to manufacturing + services. Actively cultivate new formats such as industrial e-commerce, support key industry backbone enterprises in establishing industry online procurement, sales, and service platforms, and promote the construction of a number of third-party e-commerce service platforms.
titlelist: Main task: Cultivating a new model of integration between manufacturing industry and the internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Promote the implementation of national key research and development programs, strengthen the basic technologies and industrial support capabilities of manufacturing automation, digitization, and intelligence, and accelerate the construction of new manufacturing foundations such as automatic control and perception, industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms, and industrial Internet. Organize the implementation of the Core Fire plan and the sensor industry promotion project, accelerate the industrialization of sensors, process control chips, programmable logic controllers, etc. Accelerate the industrialization of industrial software such as computer-aided design simulation, manufacturing execution systems, and product lifecycle management, and strengthen the software support and definition of the foundational role of manufacturing. Build a reference model and comprehensive technical standard system for cyber-physical systems, establish testing and verification platforms and comprehensive verification testbeds, and support compatibility, interoperability, and interoperability testing and verification.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the basic support for integrated development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Implementing the capability enhancement project for integrated development, promoting technological breakthroughs and standard development in identification resolution, data exchange, communication protocols, and other areas related to the interconnection of industrial products. This project is aimed at key industries such as intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, intelligent workshops, and intelligent factories. It aims to cultivate a group of system solution providers, organize pilot demonstrations of industry system solution applications, and provide standardized and specialized system solutions for small and medium-sized enterprises. It also supports eligible enterprises in carrying out business restructuring in system solution services, promotes the professionalization, scale, and marketization of system solution services, and fully leverages the role of system solutions as a binding agent in promoting the integration of manufacturing industry and the Internet.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance the ability to develop integrated solutions.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Implement the Industrial Control System Security Enhancement Project, formulate and improve policies and regulations for industrial information security management, establish a sound industrial information security standard system, establish a mechanism for collecting, summarizing, analyzing, and reporting industrial control system security risks, and organize inspections and risk assessments of industrial control system information security in key industries. Organize pilot demonstrations of information security assurance in industrial enterprises, support the construction of key common technology platforms such as system simulation testing and evaluation verification, promote the industrialization of core technical products such as access control, traceability, commercial information, and privacy protection. Focus on enhancing the capabilities of industrial information security monitoring, evaluation, verification, and emergency response, rely on existing research institutions, and establish a national industrial information security assurance center to provide security support for the integration of manufacturing and the Internet.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the security level of industrial information systems.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Deepen the reform of streamlining administration, delegating power, combining decentralization with regulation, and optimizing services. Relax market access restrictions for new products and new business models, strengthen mid-term and post-event supervision, enhance the ability and level of serving enterprises, and create an environment conducive to the integrated development of manufacturing and the internet. Adapt to the trend of cross-border integration between manufacturing and the internet, actively play the bridging role of industry associations and intermediary organizations, encourage the establishment of new cross-industry and cross-disciplinary alliances for production, education, research, and application, and carry out key common technology research, integration standard formulation, and public service platform construction. Improve relevant policies and regulations to meet the intellectual property protection needs of new business models, and build a well-structured, clearly defined, and sustainable development intellectual property operation service network.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the system and mechanism for integrated development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Combine with the comprehensive promotion of the pilot program for replacing business tax with value-added tax (VAT), further expand the scope of VAT deduction for manufacturing enterprises, implement preferential VAT policies, and support manufacturing enterprises to independently carry out new businesses based on the Internet or through joint ventures with Internet companies. Implement preferential income tax policies such as additional deduction for research and development expenses and high-tech enterprises, actively study and improve tax policies for science and technology enterprise incubators. Select a group of key cities and key enterprises to carry out pilot projects for integrating production and finance, support the development of financial products and services innovation such as credit loans, financing leasing, and pledge guarantees. Encourage financial institutions to utilize the double innovation platform to provide one-stop systematic financial services such as settlement, financing, wealth management, and consulting, further promote intellectual property pledge, innovate guarantee methods, and actively explore diversified credit risk sharing mechanisms.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve tax and financial policies that support integrated development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Support manufacturing enterprises to develop new businesses and new formats that integrate manufacturing industry with the Internet by utilizing existing real estate and land resources without changing the main body of land use and planning conditions, and implement a policy of maintaining the original land use and rights type unchanged during a 5-year transition period. Encourage localities with conditions to introduce supportive policies according to local conditions, actively activate idle industrial plants, enterprise warehouses, and logistics facilities, and provide subsidies for office space, water and electricity, network, and other expenses, to provide low-cost, efficient, and convenient professional services for entrepreneurs committed to the development of the integration of manufacturing industry and the Internet.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the integration and development of land and housing services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Integration of Manufacturing and the Internet Development (State Council [2016] No. 28) (State Council, May 13, 2016)
content: Actively initiate or participate in multilateral or regional negotiations on rules in the field of the Internet, in order to enhance influence and discourse power. Promote the establishment of government-to-government and people-to-people dialogue and communication mechanisms between China and foreign countries. Conduct technical exchanges and cooperation around the construction of double innovation platforms for large-scale manufacturing enterprises on the Internet, the formulation of integrated development standards, and application demonstrations. Combine the implementation of major national strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, utilize financial resources such as the Silk Road Fund, China-Africa Development Fund, and China-Africa Production Capacity Cooperation Fund, support industry associations, industrial alliances, and enterprises in jointly promoting the products, technologies, standards, and services of China's manufacturing industry and Internet integration development, and promote the going global of the integration of manufacturing industry and the Internet throughout the entire value chain, expanding overseas markets. Enhance the ability and level of bringing in by utilizing global talents, technologies, intellectual property rights, and other innovative resources, learning from international advanced management models, and supporting and promoting the integration development of China's manufacturing industry and the Internet. All regions and departments should attach great importance to deepening the integration development of manufacturing industry and the Internet, unify their thinking, raise their awareness, increase their efforts, and effectively implement this opinion. The National Leading Group for Building a Manufacturing Powerhouse should coordinate research and improve the promotion mechanism for the integration development of manufacturing industry and the Internet, strengthen comprehensive coordination of major issues, policies, and projects, deploy supervision and inspection, and promote the implementation of various tasks. Relevant departments should strengthen coordination and cooperation in accordance with their respective responsibilities, provide guidance and coordination, promptly issue supporting policies, improve relevant rules and regulations, strengthen follow-up inspections, and timely help solve difficulties and problems encountered by relevant parties. The National Strategic Advisory Committee for Building a Manufacturing Powerhouse should give full play to its role, organize basic, forward-looking, and strategic research, and provide consultation for major decision-making and the implementation of related projects. All regions should establish and improve work mechanisms based on their actual situations, formulate specific implementation plans, strengthen assessment and evaluation, and ensure the implementation of various tasks for integrated development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, promote integrated development of international cooperation and exchanges.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: By 2020, a unified, open, orderly competition, honest and law-abiding, safe and reliable large-scale e-commerce market will be basically established. E-commerce will deeply integrate with other industries, becoming an important platform for promoting entrepreneurship, stable employment, and improving people's livelihood services. It plays a crucial role in the synchronized development of industrialization, informatization, urbanization, and agricultural modernization.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and main objectives, main objectives.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Enterprises engaged in e-commerce activities, which have been recognized as high-tech enterprises, shall enjoy relevant preferential policies for high-tech enterprises in accordance with the law. Small and micro enterprises shall enjoy preferential tax policies in accordance with the law. (Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation) Accelerate the promotion of the business tax to value-added tax reform, gradually include tourism e-commerce, life service e-commerce, and other related industries into the scope of the reform. (Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation).
titlelist: Create a relaxed development environment, reduce taxes and burdens reasonably.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Establish and improve diversified and multi-channel investment and financing mechanisms that adapt to the development of e-commerce. (Relevant departments are responsible for their respective duties.) Research and encourage eligible internet companies to go public domestically and other related policies. (China Securities Regulatory Commission) Support commercial banks, collateral management institutions, and e-commerce companies to provide various forms of financing services such as intangible asset and chattel pledge. Encourage commercial banks, commercial factoring institutions, and e-commerce companies to develop supply chain finance and commercial factoring services, further expanding the financing channels for e-commerce companies. (People's Bank of China, Ministry of Commerce) Guide and promote venture capital funds, increase support for start-up e-commerce companies. (National Development and Reform Commission).
titlelist: Create a relaxed development environment and increase financial service support.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Standardize the competition behavior in the e-commerce market and promote the establishment of an open, fair, and healthy e-commerce market competition order. Research and formulate measures for the supervision and management of e-commerce product quality, explore the establishment of a supervision mechanism for e-commerce product quality that includes risk monitoring, online random inspections, traceability of sources, and local investigations, and improve the sharing of regulatory information and functional coordination mechanisms between departments and regions. Crack down on illegal activities such as false online advertising, production and sale of counterfeit and inferior products, violation of national export control regulations, cross-border sales of dual-use goods and technologies, and unfair competition in accordance with the law. Organize actions to improve the quality of e-commerce products and promote legal and honest business operations (responsibilities are divided among the State Administration for Market Regulation, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Ministry of Public Security, and Ministry of Commerce). Focus on investigating issues related to monopoly agreements and abuse of market dominance, prevent behaviors that exclude or restrict market competition through anti-monopoly reviews of business concentration (responsibilities are divided among the National Development and Reform Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation, and Ministry of Commerce). Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights in the field of e-commerce, and study further efforts to protect invention patents in the field of online business methods (responsibilities are divided among the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, General Administration of Customs, State Administration for Market Regulation, National Radio and Television Administration, and National Intellectual Property Administration, among other departments). Further increase the government's use of e-commerce platforms for procurement (Ministry of Finance). Government departments at all levels shall not designate suppliers to provide public services for e-commerce through administrative orders, and shall not abuse administrative power to exclude or restrict e-commerce competition (relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Create a relaxed development environment and maintain fair competition.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Incorporate the promotion of employment through the development of e-commerce into the employment development plans and overall e-commerce development plans of various regions. Establish a statistical system for e-commerce employment and social security indicators. Employees of online merchants registered through industrial and commercial registration shall enjoy the same employment and entrepreneurship support policies. Employees of online merchants who have not registered through industrial and commercial registration can be recognized as flexible employees and enjoy support policies for flexible employees. Among them, entrepreneurs of online merchants who are registered with real names on online platforms, operate stably, and have good credit can enjoy small guarantee loans and interest subsidy policies as stipulated. Support the application of e-commerce by small and medium-sized enterprises and expand their business areas. Encourage areas with conditions to establish e-commerce entrepreneurship parks and guide various types of entrepreneurship incubation bases to provide venue support and entrepreneurship incubation services for e-commerce entrepreneurs. Strengthen employment services for e-commerce enterprises and improve the mechanism for matching supply and demand of e-commerce talents. (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Commerce, National Bureau of Statistics, local governments at all levels).
titlelist: Promote employment and entrepreneurship, encourage employment and entrepreneurship in the field of e-commerce.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Support school, enterprise, and social organization cooperation in running schools, explore practical training-based e-commerce talent cultivation and training mechanisms. Promote the national e-commerce professional and technical talent knowledge update project, guide various training institutions to increase e-commerce skills training programs, support e-commerce enterprises in conducting pre-job training, skills enhancement training, and high-skilled talent training, accelerate the cultivation of high-quality specialized talents and technical skills talents in the field of e-commerce. Individuals participating in vocational training and vocational skills assessment, as well as e-commerce enterprises organizing employee training, may enjoy vocational training subsidies and vocational skills assessment subsidy policies as stipulated. Encourage vocational colleges, social training institutions, and e-commerce enterprises with conditions to carry out online entrepreneurship training. (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Finance).
titlelist: Promote employment and entrepreneurship, strengthen talent development and training.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Standardize the labor employment of e-commerce enterprises, especially online merchants. Those who have obtained a business license through industrial and commercial registration should sign labor contracts with their employees in accordance with the law. Those who have not completed industrial and commercial registration can also sign civil agreements with their employees in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Labor Contract Law, clarifying the rights, responsibilities, and obligations of both parties. Network practitioners should be included in various social insurance schemes as required. For online merchants who have not completed industrial and commercial registration, their practitioners can participate in social insurance according to the flexible employment personnel insurance payment methods. Eligible individuals facing employment difficulties and college graduates can enjoy social insurance subsidies for flexible employment personnel. Online merchants employing five or more people on a long-term basis can register for social insurance at the place of industrial and commercial registration and participate in various social insurance schemes for enterprise employees. Online merchants that meet the conditions for preferential social insurance policies in the coordinated region can enjoy social insurance preferential policies. (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security).
titlelist: Promote employment and entrepreneurship, safeguard the labor rights and interests of workers.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Actively expand new channels for information consumption, innovate mobile e-commerce applications, support the development of e-commerce platforms that provide daily consumption, household services, remote payment, health care, and other commercial and comprehensive services for urban and rural residents' communities. Accelerate the deep integration of traditional media and emerging media, enhance the network service capabilities of cultural enterprises, support the development of e-commerce platforms for cultural products, and regulate the online cultural market. Support service enterprises in education, exhibition, consulting, advertising, catering, entertainment, etc. to deepen the application of e-commerce. (Relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties) Encourage and support tourist attractions, hotels, etc. to carry out online marketing, standardize the development of online travel booking market, and promote innovation in the online tourism service model. (Tourism Bureau, General Administration of Industry and Commerce) Accelerate the establishment of the national 12315 Internet platform, improve the online transaction complaint and after-sales rights protection mechanism, study and formulate detailed rules for implementing a 7-day no reason return policy, and promote the healthy and rapid development of online shopping consumption. (General Administration of Industry and Commerce).
titlelist: Promote transformation and upgrading, innovate ways to serve the people's livelihood.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Encourage large-scale retail enterprises with conditions to establish online shopping malls, actively utilize information technologies such as mobile internet, geolocation services, big data, etc., to improve circulation efficiency and service quality. Support small and medium-sized retail enterprises to complement e-commerce platforms, strengthen the integration of service resources, and promote the integration and interaction of online and offline transactions. (Ministry of Commerce) Promote the construction of online markets for various professional markets, accelerate the transformation to a networked market through online and offline integration, and study and improve relevant measures for the standardized development of e-commerce platforms in industries such as energy, chemicals, steel, forestry, etc. (Relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties) Develop and improve the management measures for the supervision and administration of internet food and drug operations, regulate the online operations of food, health food, drugs, cosmetics, and medical devices, strengthen the construction of the monitoring and supervision system for the internet food and drug market, and promote the development of pharmaceutical e-commerce. (State Administration for Market Regulation of Food and Drug, National Health Commission, Ministry of Commerce).
titlelist: Promote transformation and upgrading, promote the development of traditional commercial and trade enterprises in e-commerce.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Strengthen the integration and development of the Internet and agriculture in rural areas, introduce modern management concepts and methods such as industrial chain, value chain, and supply chain, study and formulate opinions to promote the development of rural e-commerce, and introduce supportive policies and measures. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Agriculture) Strengthen the construction of fresh agricultural product standard system, animal and plant quarantine system, safety traceability system, quality assurance and safety supervision system, and vigorously develop agricultural product cold chain infrastructure. (General Administration of Quality Supervision, Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Agriculture, State Administration for Market Regulation of Food and Drug) Carry out comprehensive demonstrations of e-commerce in rural areas, promote information access to households in villages, and improve the e-commerce service environment in rural areas through the use of the thousands of villages and towns market network. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Agriculture) Establish technical standards system for geographical indication products and product quality assurance system, support the use of e-commerce platforms to promote and sell geographical indication products, and encourage e-commerce platforms to serve one village, one product and promote the export of branded agricultural products. Encourage the development of e-commerce by agricultural production material enterprises. (Ministry of Agriculture, General Administration of Quality Supervision, State Administration for Industry and Commerce) Support the development of e-commerce in forestry, gradually establish a credibility system for forest product transactions, and a service system for forest product and forest rights transactions. (Forestry Bureau).
titlelist: Promote transformation and upgrading, actively develop rural e-commerce.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Support the application of information technologies such as the Internet of Things, cloud computing, big data, 3D design and printing, etc. in various stages of production and manufacturing for manufacturing enterprises. Establish a networked manufacturing management system that integrates with customer e-commerce systems to improve the response speed and flexibility of processing orders. Establish a network-based business management model to meet the personalized needs of online consumers, and develop production methods such as sales-based production and personalized customization. (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Commerce) Encourage e-commerce enterprises to vigorously carry out brand management, optimize the allocation of advantageous resources such as research and development, design, production, and logistics, and meet the needs of online consumers. (Ministry of Commerce, State Administration for Industry and Commerce, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection, and Quarantine) Encourage creative services, explore the establishment of productive innovation service platforms, and provide innovative entrepreneurship services such as design, testing, production, financing, and operation for start-ups and creative groups. (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology).
titlelist: Promote transformation and upgrading, innovate industrial production organization methods.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Promote the construction of smart logistics information platforms that span regions and industries, and encourage the development of new logistics distribution models such as joint delivery within the scope of the law. (Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Commerce, State Post Bureau, National Development and Reform Commission) Support the construction of logistics (express) delivery stations, intelligent parcel lockers, and other logistics facilities, and encourage community property, village-level information service stations, convenience stores, and others to provide parcel delivery services. Support the extension of express delivery service networks to rural areas. (Local governments at all levels, Ministry of Commerce, State Post Bureau, Ministry of Agriculture are responsible according to their respective duties) Promote the coordinated development of e-commerce and logistics express delivery. (Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Commerce, State Post Bureau) Encourage schools, express delivery companies, and third-party entities to strengthen cooperation according to local conditions, promote express delivery on campuses through the establishment of intelligent parcel lockers or delivery rooms, entrusting campus post offices for delivery, and establishing shared delivery sites, etc. (Local governments at all levels, State Post Bureau, Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Education) Study and promote e-commerce and smart delivery of daily necessities for regulated individuals according to law enforcement needs. (Ministry of Justice) Cities with conditions should include the construction of supporting logistics (express) delivery stations and intelligent terminal facilities in urban community development plans, and encourage e-commerce and logistics (express) companies to recycle and reuse packaging materials for online shopping products. (Relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Improve logistics infrastructure, support the construction of logistics distribution terminals and smart logistics platforms.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Actively initiate or participate in multilateral or regional negotiations and exchanges on e-commerce rules, study the establishment of a mutual recognition mechanism between China and internationally recognized organizations, rely on China's certification and accreditation system, improve the qualification assessment mechanism for e-commerce enterprises and products, and enhance international organizations and institutions. Strive for recognition of the certification results of Chinese e-commerce enterprises and products, and strive for the initiative in the formulation of international e-commerce regulations and the discourse power in the development of cross-border e-commerce. (Ministry of Commerce, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine).
titlelist: Enhance the level of opening up to the outside world and strengthen international cooperation in e-commerce.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Actively promote the construction of a comprehensive service system for key processes such as cross-border e-commerce customs clearance, inspection and quarantine, foreign exchange settlement, and import tax payment through the 'single window' approach. Simplify and improve the customs clearance process for cross-border e-commerce goods return and re-export, and enhance customs clearance efficiency. (General Administration of Customs, Ministry of Finance, State Taxation Administration, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Administration of Foreign Exchange) Explore the establishment of a negative list and risk monitoring system for cross-border e-commerce goods, improve the supervision mode for customs clearance and inspection and quarantine of cross-border e-commerce goods, establish a credibility-based classification management system for cross-border e-commerce and related logistics enterprises, and prevent the introduction of epidemics, invasive alien species, and loss of species resources. (General Administration of Customs, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, according to their respective responsibilities) Strongly support the pilot program of the China (Hangzhou) Cross-border E-commerce Comprehensive Experimental Zone, and quickly form replicable and scalable experiences to accelerate nationwide promotion. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission).
titlelist: Enhance the level of opening up to the outside world, improve the efficiency of cross-border e-commerce customs clearance.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Urgently study and formulate guiding opinions to promote the development of cross-border e-commerce. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, General Administration of Customs, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, People's Bank of China, State Administration of Taxation, State Administration for Industry and Commerce, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Administration of Foreign Exchange) Encourage policy banks to increase loan support for overseas investment and mergers and acquisitions of e-commerce enterprises within their business scope, and study and formulate standardized management policies for overseas listing of e-commerce enterprises. (People's Bank of China, China Securities Regulatory Commission, Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology) Simplify the foreign exchange registration procedures for overseas direct investment of e-commerce enterprises and broaden the channels for foreign exchange registration and change registration for overseas direct investment. (State Administration of Foreign Exchange) Support e-commerce enterprises in establishing overseas marketing channels and creating their own brands. Overseas institutions should increase their service efforts for e-commerce enterprises going global. Further open up the e-commerce market to Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, and promote the establishment of cross-strait e-commerce economic cooperation experimental zones. Encourage the development of e-commerce cooperation with countries along the Belt and Road initiative, expand comprehensive pilot projects for cross-border e-commerce, establish dialogue mechanisms at various levels involving governments, enterprises, experts, etc., and initiate and lead multilateral cooperation in e-commerce. (Relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Promote the level of opening up to the outside world and promote the development of e-commerce going global.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: E-commerce companies should comply with the national information security level protection management specifications and relevant technical standards requirements, adopt secure and controllable information equipment and network security products, establish a comprehensive network security protection system, data resource security management system, and network security emergency response system. Encourage e-commerce companies to obtain information security management system certification and improve their own information security management level. Encourage e-commerce companies to strengthen cooperation with network security professional service organizations and relevant management departments, share network security threat warning information, eliminate network security risks, and jointly prevent illegal activities such as network attacks, destruction, and theft of citizens' personal information. (Ministry of Public Security, National Certification and Accreditation Administration, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, State Cryptography Administration).
titlelist: Build a security defense line to ensure the security of e-commerce networks.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Research and formulate a management system for the security of electronic commerce transactions, clarifying the security responsibilities and obligations of all parties involved in electronic commerce transactions. (State Administration for Industry and Commerce, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security) Establish an electronic authentication trust system to promote the mutual recognition of digital certificates by electronic authentication institutions and the interoperability of digital certificate applications, and promote the application of digital certificates in the field of electronic commerce transactions. Establish a standardized management mechanism for electronic transaction credentials such as electronic contracts to ensure the legitimate rights and interests of all parties in online transactions. Strengthen the protection of information for all parties involved in electronic commerce transactions and ensure the security of personal information of electronic commerce consumers. (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, State Administration for Industry and Commerce, Bureau of Cryptography, and other relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Build a security defense line to ensure the security of e-commerce transactions.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: E-commerce enterprises must effectively fulfill their responsibilities and obligations, such as inspecting and clearing prohibited goods information, retaining transaction records and logs, reporting illegal and criminal clues, strengthening the qualification review of online merchants selling controlled goods, monitoring abnormal and illegal transactions, preventing e-commerce online payments from facilitating money laundering and providing technical support for combating online illegal and criminal activities. They should also enhance cooperation and coordination with relevant regulatory departments, establish cross-agency cooperation mechanisms, and intensify efforts to combat the production and sale of counterfeit and inferior goods, online theft, online fraud, and other illegal and criminal activities. (The Ministry of Public Security, the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the People's Bank of China, the China Banking Regulatory Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Commerce, and other relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Build a security defense line, prevent and combat illegal activities in the field of e-commerce.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Accelerate the legislative process of e-commerce laws, study and formulate or timely revise relevant regulations, clarify the legal effect of electronic bills, electronic contracts, electronic inspection and quarantine reports and certificates, and various types of electronic transaction vouchers as legitimate credentials for handling related businesses. (Relevant departments shall be responsible according to their respective division of duties.) Establish a complaint management system suitable for the characteristics of e-commerce, formulate standards for the publication of product quality information for e-commerce transactions based on unified product codes, and establish mechanisms for resolving e-commerce disputes and guaranteeing product quality. (The State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and other departments shall be responsible according to their respective division of duties.) Gradually promote electronic invoices and electronic accounting archives, improve relevant technical standards and regulations. (The State Taxation Administration, the Ministry of Finance, the State Archives Administration, and the National Standardization Administration shall be responsible.) Establish and improve the e-commerce statistical system, expand the coverage of e-commerce statistics, and enhance the timeliness and authenticity of statistics. (The National Bureau of Statistics, the Ministry of Commerce) Unified identification of product codes for online and offline goods, improve the e-commerce standard specification system, research fundamental key standards for e-commerce, and actively lead and participate in the formulation of international e-commerce standards. (The National Standardization Administration, the Ministry of Commerce).
titlelist: Establish a sound support system and a sound regulatory and standard system.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Establish and improve the credit information management system for e-commerce, and promote the disclosure of credit information of e-commerce enterprises. Open up information resources such as population, legal entities, trademarks, and product quality to e-commerce enterprises and credit service agencies, gradually reducing the cost of inquiries and utilization. (The State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Public Security, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and other departments are responsible according to their respective duties.) Promote the exchange and sharing of e-commerce credit information with relevant information in other social fields, promote e-commerce credit evaluation, and establish and improve the joint disciplinary mechanism for dishonesty in the field of e-commerce. (The National Development and Reform Commission, the People's Bank of China, the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, and the Ministry of Commerce) Promote the application of network identity cards in the field of e-commerce, improve the real-name system for online stores, and encourage the development of credible certification services for social e-commerce websites. (The Ministry of Public Security, the State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine) Develop public services for trustworthy e-commerce transactions, improve the system for guaranteeing credit services in e-commerce, and promote the application and promotion of third-party credit services and products such as credit investigation, credit evaluation, and credit guarantee in e-commerce. (The State Administration for Industry and Commerce, the General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine).
titlelist: Strengthening the support system and enhancing the construction of the credit system.

name: Opinions on vigorously developing e-commerce and accelerating the cultivation of new economic drivers (State Council [2015] No. 24) (State Council, May 7, 2015)
content: Conduct research on the basic theory and development laws of e-commerce. Strengthen research and development of core key technologies in the field of e-commerce, such as cloud computing, big data, Internet of Things, and intelligent transactions. Implement technology research and application demonstration projects for network customization services, network platform services, network transaction services, network trade services, and network transaction security services. Strengthen the construction of enterprise technology centers, engineering technology centers, and key laboratories that combine industry, academia, and research. Encourage enterprises to establish collaborative innovation alliances between industry, academia, and research. Explore the establishment of an e-commerce discipline system, guide higher education institutions to strengthen the construction of e-commerce disciplines and talent cultivation, and provide more high-level compound specialized talents for the development of e-commerce. (Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Education, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Commerce) Establish mechanisms for promoting knowledge and providing services related to preventing online fraud, ensuring transaction security, and protecting personal information. (Ministry of Public Security, State Administration for Industry and Commerce, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection, and Quarantine).
titlelist: Strengthening the support system, enhancing support for science and education.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: The global Internet based on Internet Protocol version 4 (IPv4) is facing constraints such as exhaustion of network addresses and difficulty in ensuring service quality. IPv6 can provide sufficient network addresses and vast innovation space, making it the globally recognized next-generation solution for Internet commercial applications. Vigorously developing the next-generation Internet based on IPv6 will significantly enhance China's Internet carrying capacity and service level, better integrate into the international Internet, share global development achievements, and provide strong support for economic and social development, winning the initiative for future development.
titlelist: 重要意义,互联网演进升级的必然趋势 translates to Significant Significance, the Inevitable Trend of Internet Evolution and Upgrading in English.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Promoting the large-scale deployment of IPv6 is a comprehensive upgrade of the Internet technology industry ecosystem, profoundly influencing the innovation and transformation of network information technology, industry, and applications. Vigorously developing the next-generation Internet based on IPv6 helps enhance China's independent innovation capability in network information technology and the high-end development level of the industry, efficiently supporting the rapid development of mobile Internet, Internet of Things, industrial Internet, cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and other emerging fields, continuously giving rise to new technologies and new industries, promoting further prosperity of network applications, and building an advanced and open ecosystem for the next generation of Internet technology industry.
titlelist: 重要意义,技术产业创新发展的重大契机 translates to Significant opportunity for the innovation and development of the technology industry.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Accelerating the large-scale application of IPv6 provides a new platform for addressing network security issues and offers new ideas for improving network security management efficiency and innovative network security mechanisms. Vigorously developing the next generation of Internet based on IPv6 helps further innovate means of network security protection, continuously improve the network security protection system, significantly enhance the awareness of network security situation and the ability to respond quickly, greatly enhance the level of protection for important data resources and personal information, and further strengthen the security, trustworthiness, and comprehensive governance capabilities of the Internet.
titlelist: Significant importance, the urgent need to strengthen cybersecurity capabilities.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: In 5 to 10 years, form the next generation of independent Internet technology system and industrial ecosystem, build the world's largest-scale commercial application network for IPv6, achieve deep integration and application of the next generation of the Internet in various economic and social fields, and become an important driving force for the global development of the next generation of the Internet.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Follow the development path of typical application first, mobile and fixed development together, and incremental driving stock. Take applications as the entry point and breakthrough, focus on strengthening the IPv6 upgrade of typical Internet applications with a large number of users and wide usage, strengthen the innovation of characteristic applications based on IPv6, and drive the coordinated development of networks and terminals. Seize the opportunity of mobile network upgrade and replacement and the development trend of optical fiber in, copper out in fixed networks, coordinate the development of IPv6 in mobile and fixed networks, and achieve comprehensive network upgrade. Newly added network equipment, applications, and terminals fully support IPv6, driving the acceleration of stock equipment and application replacement, and achieving smooth evolution and upgrade of various aspects of the next-generation Internet.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development path

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Promote the comprehensive support of IPv6 for network services and applications such as portals, social media, video, e-commerce, search, games, app stores, and online applications with a large user base and wide service coverage.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the upgrade of Internet application services, continuously enrich network information sources, upgrade typical applications.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Support the innovation and demonstration of IPv6 applications with high demand for address requirements, and increase the promotion and application of IPv6 in major strategic actions such as Broadband China, Internet Plus, new smart cities, industrial Internet, cloud computing, Internet of Things, intelligent manufacturing, and artificial intelligence.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the upgrade of Internet application services, continuously enrich network information sources, and innovate distinctive applications.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Taking advantage of the opportunity presented by the commercial application of LTE voice (VoLTE) services and the transformation of fiber-to-the-home, we will comprehensively deploy LTE mobile networks and fixed broadband access networks that support IPv6.
titlelist: Key tasks: carry out the transformation of network infrastructure, improve the level of network services, upgrade and transform mobile and fixed networks.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Establish a comprehensive IPv6 backbone network interconnection system, upgrade and transform the interconnection nodes of China's Internet backbone network, and achieve interconnection and interoperability of IPv6 between the Internet and the broadcasting network backbone networks.
titlelist: Key tasks: carry out the transformation of network infrastructure, improve the level of network services, and achieve interconnection of backbone networks.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Gradually expand the IPv6 international inbound and outbound bandwidth, while ensuring network security, to achieve efficient interconnection with the next generation of the global Internet.
titlelist: Key tasks: carry out the renovation of network infrastructure, improve the level of network services, and expand international access.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Taking the opportunity of the construction of a nationwide cable television interconnection platform, accelerate the promotion of platforms, networks, terminals, and other support for IPv6 in the broadcasting and television field, and promote business innovation and upgrading in the cultural and media sectors.
titlelist: Key tasks: carry out the transformation of network infrastructure, improve the level of network services, upgrade and transform the radio and television network.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Strengthen the construction of Internet data center access capabilities, complete the internal network and export transformation of Internet data centers, and provide users with IPv6 access channels.
titlelist: Key tasks: accelerate the transformation of application infrastructure, optimize traffic scheduling capabilities, upgrade and transform internet data centers.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Accelerate the transformation of content delivery networks and cloud service platforms to IPv6, comprehensively enhancing the optimization and scheduling capabilities of IPv6 network traffic.
titlelist: Key tasks: accelerate the transformation of application infrastructure, optimize traffic scheduling capabilities, upgrade and transform content delivery networks and cloud service platforms.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Accelerate the comprehensive transformation of the Internet Domain Name System (DNS), build the full-chain IPv6 support capability for domain name registration, resolution, and management, and carry out innovation and experimentation of a new root domain name service system for IPv6.
titlelist: Key tasks: accelerate the transformation of application infrastructure, optimize traffic scheduling capabilities, upgrade and transform the domain name system.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Construct a national-level IPv6 development monitoring platform, comprehensively monitor and deeply analyze the development of IPv6 in terms of internet networks, applications, terminals, users, traffic, etc., and provide services to promote the large-scale deployment of IPv6.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate the transformation of application infrastructure, optimize traffic scheduling capabilities, and build monitoring platforms.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Further upgrade and transform the existing network security protection system, enhance the capabilities of network security situation awareness, rapid response, and investigation and counterattack.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen network security protection, safeguard national cyber security, upgrade security systems.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Coordinate the management of IPv6 address application, allocation, filing, and other related tasks, strictly implement the IPv6 network address coding planning scheme, and collaborate to promote the deployment of IPv6 and network real-name system.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen network security protection, maintain national network security, strengthen address management.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Carry out work on network security level protection, personal information protection, risk assessment, notification and early warning, disaster backup and recovery, etc., targeting IPv6.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen network security protection, safeguard national cyber security, and enhance security defense.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Strengthen research on network security technologies, management, and mechanisms in the fields of industrial internet, internet of things, connected vehicles, cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence, and other emerging areas under the IPv6 environment, and enhance the capability to ensure network security in these emerging fields.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen network security protection, maintain national network security, and build security capabilities in emerging fields.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Support key technological innovations such as network transition, network security, and new types of routing.
