Support the research and development of core equipment systems such as network processors, embedded operating systems, important application software, terminals and network devices, security devices and systems, and network measurement instruments. Strengthen the development of IPv6 technology standards.
titlelist: Key tasks, breakthrough in key cutting-edge technologies, build an independent technology industry ecosystem, strengthen research and development of key IPv6 technologies.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Handle the relationship between the development of IPv6 and the innovation of network technology, as well as the long-term evolution of the Internet, strengthen the top-level design and overall planning of the next-generation Internet. Proactively layout new network architecture, addressing routing, network virtualization, network intelligence, IPv6 security and trust system, and other technology research and development, accelerate the construction of major scientific research infrastructure such as the national future network test facility, support the construction of innovative platforms for advanced network infrastructure of the next-generation Internet under IPv6, and further increase support for fundamental, forward-looking, and innovative research in network technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, breakthrough key cutting-edge technologies, build an independent technology industry ecosystem, strengthen innovation in network cutting-edge technologies.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: (1) Internet application upgrade (rolling). Continue to encourage and support mainstream Internet portals, social media, video, e-commerce, search, gaming, and other applications, as well as mainstream mobile app stores, internet browsers, email, file downloads, and other application software to upgrade and deploy IPv6. Encourage and support the top 100 domestic commercial websites and applications to support IPv6 access. In the case of IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack connection, the above applications must prioritize IPv6 access.(2) IPv6 transformation of municipal government websites. Continue to promote the upgrade and transformation of existing e-government systems and complete the upgrade of the e-government external network. Complete the upgrade and transformation of municipal government portal websites. Complete the transformation of public management and public welfare service platforms in areas such as public security, finance, healthcare, etc.(3) IPv6 transformation of news and radio and television media websites at the municipal level and above. Complete the upgrade and transformation of news and radio and television media websites at the municipal level and above, and fully support IPv6 for new businesses and applications.(4) Industrial Internet IPv6 application (rolling). Continuously carry out network transformation in factories and enterprises, promote the large-scale deployment of innovative applications in the industrial Internet, and continuously improve the relevant standards for industrial Internet IPv6 applications, management, security, etc.
titlelist: Implementation steps, key tasks for 2017-2018, internet applications.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: (1) Backbone network IPv6 interconnection (rolling). Add and expand the interconnection nodes of China's IPv6 backbone network, with interconnection bandwidth reaching 5Tbps. (2) Expansion of IPv6 network international entry and exit points (rolling). Continuously expand the international entry and exit points of the IPv6 network, further enhancing the interconnection capability with the international next-generation internet. (3) Construction of IPv6 capabilities for broadcasting and television networks (rolling). Improve the broadcasting and television IPv6 backbone network, implement IPv6 upgrade and transformation of cable television access networks in western regions, and basically achieve IPv6 deployment throughout the process of broadcasting and television content, platforms, networks, and terminals. (4) Upgrade of mobile and fixed terminals (rolling). Fully deploy IPv6-supported mobile terminals, fixed network terminals, and broadcasting and television integrated terminals, and accelerate the elimination and replacement of existing terminals.
titlelist: Implementation steps, key tasks for 2017-2018, network infrastructure.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: (1) Upgrade of IPv6 in large-scale data centers (rolling). Carry out the transformation of large-scale data centers, complete relevant system upgrades, and achieve coordinated development with network infrastructure.(2) Upgrade of IPv6 in content delivery networks and cloud service platforms (rolling). Complete the transformation of all cloud products in the top 10 ranking content delivery networks and top 10 ranking cloud service platforms, forming optimized scheduling capabilities for IPv6 traffic.(3) Construction of IPv6 development monitoring platform (rolling). Increase monitoring indicators and objects, continuously improve the functionality and performance of the monitoring platform. Regularly conduct evaluations of the development of IPv6 in enterprises, industries, and regions.
titlelist: Implementation steps, key tasks for 2017-2018, application infrastructure.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: IPv6 Network Security Enhancement Plan (Rolling). Continuously upgrade and transform relevant network security assurance systems. Thoroughly implement the network security level protection system, network real-name system, and IPv6 address filing management measures. Continue to carry out research on related network security technologies, management, and mechanisms, strengthen network data security management and personal information protection capabilities, and ensure network security.
titlelist: Implementation steps, key tasks for 2017-2018, network security.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: 1. Internet Applications. (1) Upgrade of Internet applications (rolling). Continue to encourage and support mainstream Internet portals, social media, video, e-commerce, search, gaming, and other applications, as well as mainstream mobile app stores, internet browsers, email, file downloads, and other application software for IPv6 upgrade and deployment. Encourage and support the top 100 domestic commercial websites and applications to support IPv6 access. In the case of IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack connection, the above applications must prioritize support for IPv6 access. (2) IPv6 transformation of city-level and above government websites. Continue to promote the upgrade and transformation of existing e-government systems, complete the upgrade of the e-government external network, complete the upgrade and transformation of city-level and above government portal websites, and complete the transformation of public management and public welfare service platforms in areas such as public security, finance, healthcare, etc. (3) IPv6 transformation of city-level and above news and broadcasting television media websites. Complete the upgrade and transformation of city-level and above news and broadcasting television media websites, and fully support IPv6 for new businesses and applications. (4) IPv6 application in industrial internet (rolling). Continuously carry out network transformation in factories and enterprises, promote the large-scale deployment of innovative applications in the industrial internet, and continuously improve the relevant standards for IPv6 application, management, security, etc. in the industrial internet.2. Network Infrastructure. (1) IPv6 interconnection of backbone networks (rolling). Add and expand IPv6 backbone network interconnection nodes in China, with interconnection bandwidth reaching 5Tbps. (2) Expansion of IPv6 network international entry and exit points (rolling). Continuously expand the international entry and exit points of IPv6 networks, further enhancing the interconnection capability with the international next-generation internet. (3) Construction of IPv6 capabilities in broadcasting and television networks (rolling). Improve the IPv6 backbone network of broadcasting and television, implement IPv6 upgrade and transformation of cable television access networks in western regions, and basically achieve IPv6 deployment throughout the process of broadcasting and television content, platforms, networks, and terminals. (4) Upgrade of mobile and fixed terminals (rolling). Fully deploy IPv6-supported mobile terminals, fixed network terminals, and broadcasting and television integrated terminals, and accelerate the replacement of existing terminals.3. Application Infrastructure. (1) IPv6 upgrade of large-scale data centers (rolling). Carry out the transformation of large-scale data centers, complete the relevant system upgrades, and achieve coordinated development with network infrastructure. (2) IPv6 upgrade of content delivery networks and cloud service platforms (rolling). Complete the transformation of the top 10 content delivery networks and the top 10 cloud service platforms, forming optimized scheduling capabilities for IPv6 traffic. (3) Construction of IPv6 development monitoring platform (rolling). Increase monitoring indicators and objects, continuously improve the functionality and performance of the monitoring platform. Regularly evaluate the development of IPv6 in enterprises, industries, and regions.4. Network Security. IPv6 network security enhancement plan (rolling). Continuously upgrade and transform relevant network security protection systems. Thoroughly implement the network security level protection system, network real-name system, and IPv6 address record management measures. Continue to carry out research on relevant network security technologies, management, and mechanisms, strengthen network data security management and personal information protection capabilities, and ensure network security.5. Key cutting-edge technologies. Next-generation internet technology innovation projects (rolling). Continuously carry out technological breakthroughs and industrialization of IPv6-supported chips, operating systems, terminals, network devices, and security systems. Further accelerate the innovation of internet new architecture, as well as cutting-edge basic technologies such as new addressing and routing, intrinsic network security, network virtualization, etc. Strengthen the experimental verification and application demonstration of new network technologies and applications, continuously improve the productivity transformation level of innovation achievements, significantly enhance the independent innovation capability of network information technology, and form future network technology advantages.
titlelist: Implementation Steps, Key Tasks for 2019-2020

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Establish a collaborative mechanism among departments such as the Internet Information Office, Development and Reform Commission, Industry and Information Technology, Education, Science and Technology, Public Security, Security, and News Publishing and Broadcasting, strengthen overall coordination, clarify division of responsibilities, enhance cooperation between departments, industries, and regions, solidly promote the implementation of action plans, and study the key tasks of promoting the large-scale deployment of IPv6. Improve the expert consultation system, fully leverage the role of investigation and research and decision-making consultation, and provide high-quality consulting opinions. Encourage industry organizations and third-party institutions to participate extensively and improve communication and coordination mechanisms between government and enterprises.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational leadership.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Coordinate funds, increase support, guide the investment of social capital, fully leverage the role of enterprises, and promote the development of IPv6 technology innovation, infrastructure transformation, application deployment, and security assurance. Promote the establishment of an IPv6 network interconnection and settlement system, study and introduce measures for IPv6 terminal and traffic preferential treatment, and guide users to migrate to IPv6. Accelerate the construction of disciplines related to the next-generation Internet, increase efforts in cultivating talents in next-generation Internet technology, management, and international governance, and establish an international talent pool.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, optimize development environment.

name: Action Plan for the Large-scale Deployment of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6) (State Council/7th May 2015)
content: Closely track the research, experimentation, technology, industry, and applications of the next generation of the internet worldwide. Strengthen cooperation with international standardization organizations, actively participate in the development of standards related to the next generation of the internet, expand China's international influence in standards, and jointly promote the international standardization process. Promote greater involvement of Chinese institutions and organizations in international basic resource management organizations, enhance cooperation and communication between governments and enterprises, establish a more scientific and rational mechanism for IPv6 address allocation and internet domain name management, and promote the establishment of a new international governance order for the next generation of the internet.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepening international cooperation

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Promote the comprehensive coverage of the fourth-generation mobile communication (4G) network in urban areas, gradually cover rural areas, and prioritize coverage in impoverished areas. Accelerate the research and development of fifth-generation mobile communication (5G) technology, coordinate the formulation of standards, system verification, and commercial deployment. Enhance network service capabilities, simplify telecommunications tariff structures, achieve reasonable reductions in network tariffs, and improve cost-effectiveness and user experience. Innovate investment and operation models, expand the scope of broadband access for users, accelerate the construction and application of wireless local area networks in public places such as civil aviation aircraft, high-speed railways, and urban transportation, and promote the coverage and free access of wireless local area networks in commercial service places. Accelerate the construction and optimization of new application infrastructure such as content distribution networks, cloud computing, and big data platforms. Open up private capital to compete in the basic telecommunications field, promote the development of mobile communication resale services, and form a market pattern of infrastructure co-construction, sharing, and mutual competition in business services. Improve the quality of interconnection of the Internet backbone network, optimize the interconnection architecture, explore the establishment of a long-term incremental cost-based inter-network settlement mechanism, better meet the needs of users for number portability, and create a favorable market competition environment.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of mobile internet and accelerate the evolution and upgrade of information infrastructure.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Adhere firmly to the strategy of innovation-driven development, concentrate efforts on research and development, accelerate breakthroughs in core technologies such as mobile chips, mobile operating systems, smart sensors, and location services. Promote the formulation of series standards for core hardware and software, development environments, and peripheral devices. Intensify the layout of emerging key technologies in the mobile internet field, such as artificial intelligence, virtual reality, augmented reality, and micro-electromechanical systems, and strive to achieve breakthroughs in some cutting-edge and disruptive technologies ahead of the world. Implement policies for deducting research and development expenses for enterprises, innovate the mechanism for investment in core technology research and development, explore the market-oriented approach to key core technology breakthroughs, and focus on enhancing the contribution and discourse power of our backbone enterprises and research institutions in the global open-source community for core technologies. Actively promote the construction of the open-source community for core technologies in China.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of mobile internet and achieve systematic breakthroughs in core technologies.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Coordinate the basic research, technological innovation, industrial development, and application deployment of the mobile internet, and strengthen the coordination and interaction of various links in the industrial chain. Encourage and support enterprises to become the main body of research and development, innovation, and industry, accelerate the establishment of industry-university-research-application alliances, and promote the integration and innovation of information service companies, telecommunications companies, terminal manufacturers, equipment manufacturers, basic software and hardware companies, and other upstream and downstream industries. Promote the integrated development of strategic emerging industries such as information technology and digital creativity. Improve the value-added of products and services, and accelerate the migration of the mobile internet industry to the high-end of the value chain. Improve the public service system for coverage standard formulation, achievement transformation, testing and verification, and industrial investment and financing evaluation. Accelerate the layout of next-generation internet technology standards, industrial ecology, and security guarantee system, and comprehensively evolve and upgrade to Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6). Coordinate the promotion of the strategic planning, scientific and technological special projects, and industrial development of the Internet of Things, and build a number of exemplary Internet of Things application demonstration projects with outstanding effects, strong driving force, and high relevance.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of mobile internet, promote the collaborative innovation of the industrial ecosystem.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Carry out patent navigation work in the field of mobile internet, formulate a list of suggestions for patent layout direction, encourage enterprises to carry out intellectual property strategic layout in strategic frontiers and cross-integration areas, and enrich the reserve of core technology patents. Promote the construction of intellectual property operation, transaction, and service platforms, accelerate the opening and sharing of patent information resources, encourage large mobile internet companies to jointly establish patent pools, and establish mechanisms for resource sharing and benefit distribution. Establish a system for intellectual property risk management, strengthen intellectual property early warning and cross-border dispute legal assistance. Strengthen the protection of intellectual property rights for innovative achievements in mobile internet technology, business models, etc., study and improve laws and regulations, regulate the order of network services, increase the cost of infringement and illegal activities, and effectively deter infringement.
titlelist: Promote the innovative development of mobile internet, strengthen the application and protection of intellectual property rights.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Accelerate the formulation and improvement of policies and measures for the development of the information economy, incorporate the development of mobile internet into the overall promotion of national information economy demonstration zones, encourage the leading technologies and innovative applications of mobile internet to be tested and implemented first, support innovation and entrepreneurship based on mobile internet technology, promote economic transformation and upgrading, and improve quality and efficiency. Speed up the implementation of the Internet Plus action plan and the national big data strategy, vigorously promote the deep integration of mobile internet with agriculture, industry, and service industries, use the flow of information to drive the flow of technology, capital, talent, and materials, promote optimal allocation of resources, and improve total factor productivity. Innovate the development model of the information economy, enhance the supply capacity of secure and high-quality mobile internet products and services, actively cultivate and regulate the sharing economy based on mobile internet, such as ride-hailing, renting, and payment services. Promote rapid growth of information consumption and a healthy and active information consumption market.
titlelist: Strengthen the driving role of mobile internet, stimulate the vitality of the information economy.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Fully utilize national policies and measures to promote innovation and development of small and medium-sized internet enterprises in the mobile internet field, and support and promote mass entrepreneurship and innovation. Further leverage the role of policy-oriented funds such as the National Small and Medium-sized Enterprise Development Fund and the National Innovation Fund to guide and support, implement tax and fee reduction policies, provide strong support in credit guarantee, financing and listing, government procurement of services, and eliminate institutional restrictions that hinder and affect mass entrepreneurship and innovation in the mobile internet sector. Actively support the development of various types of small and micro enterprises in new technologies, applications, and businesses in the mobile internet, create collaborative innovation platforms and new incubators in the mobile internet, develop new models such as mass creation, crowdsourcing, crowd support, and crowdfunding, and expand domestic private capital and venture capital financing channels. Give full play to the leading role of basic telecommunications companies and large internet companies, actively support the development of small and micro enterprises in the upstream and downstream through production collaboration, open platforms, and shared resources. Restrain the abuse of market dominance by enterprises to disrupt the order of competition and create a fair and orderly market competition environment.
titlelist: Strengthen the driving role of mobile internet, support the development and growth of small and medium-sized internet enterprises.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Establish a firm understanding of the correct concept of network security and dynamic, comprehensive protection, adhere to the principle of ensuring security while promoting development, comprehensively and continuously perceive the security situation of the mobile internet, continuously strengthen the security guarantee capability of the mobile internet basic information network, vigorously promote the application of network space security technologies and standards with independent intellectual property rights. Enhance network security defense capabilities, implement network security responsibility system, formulate and improve network security standards for critical information infrastructure security, big data security, etc., clarify protection objects, protection levels, and protection measures. Strengthen network security inspections comprehensively, understand the situation, recognize risks, identify vulnerabilities, supervise rectification, establish a unified and efficient network security risk reporting mechanism, intelligence sharing mechanism, and judgment and disposal mechanism.
titlelist: Prevent mobile internet security risks and enhance the level of network security protection.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Improve the system for protecting user information in the mobile internet, strictly regulate the collection and use of personal information such as user identity, geographic location, contact information, communication content, and consumption records, and safeguard the rights of users to be informed, choose, and have privacy. Urge mobile internet companies to effectively fulfill user service agreements and related commitments, improve service quality management systems, establish sound complaint handling mechanisms, and provide safer, higher quality, more convenient, and practical products and services. Increase efforts to combat activities that infringe upon user rights, such as the use of fake base stations, illegal websites, and malicious software, and effectively safeguard consumer rights and industry order.
titlelist: Prevent mobile internet security risks and safeguard users' legitimate rights and interests.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Resolutely crack down on illegal criminal activities such as using mobile internet to advocate overthrowing the state power, inciting religious extremism, promoting ethnic separatist ideas, and instigating violence and terrorism. Strictly investigate and deal with illegal criminal acts such as spreading rumors and defamation, telecommunications and internet fraud, attacking and stealing confidential information, piracy and infringement, and illegal sale of personal information. Thoroughly clean up illegal and irregular information such as gambling, pyramid schemes, illegal fundraising, obscene pornography, and involvement with firearms and explosives.
titlelist: Prevent mobile internet security risks and combat cybercrime.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Strengthen the management of network infrastructure resources, standardize basic telecommunications services, implement the main bodies of basic telecommunications business operators, access service providers, internet information service providers, and domain name service providers. Innovate management methods, strengthen research, response, and security assessment of new technologies, new applications, and new business formats. Improve information service management, regulate dissemination behavior, and maintain a good communication order on the mobile internet.
titlelist: Prevent mobile internet security risks and enhance network management capabilities.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Surrounding the national strategy of the 'Belt and Road Initiative', promote international cooperation on the online Silk Road, facilitate interconnection of mobile internet infrastructure, and vigorously develop cross-border mobile e-commerce. Actively participate in the formulation of international standards and exchange cooperation in key technologies and important areas such as 5G, next-generation internet, Internet of Things, and network security. Support mobile internet companies in going global, encourage the exploration of international markets through various means, increase the overseas promotion of mobile internet applications, products, and services, establish a sound cross-border industrial chain system, and continuously expand overseas development opportunities.
titlelist: Deepen international exchanges and cooperation in the mobile internet sector, expand international cooperation opportunities.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Deepen cultural exchanges between China and foreign countries, actively utilize various social platforms, effectively utilize various communication channels, adopt concepts, categories, and expressions that integrate Chinese and foreign elements, tell China's story well, and showcase China's image. Build influential international media outlets, innovate in multilingual and cross-platform interactive communication, and continuously enhance the influence of international communication on the mobile internet.
titlelist: Deepen international exchanges and cooperation in the mobile internet sector, strengthen the construction of international communication capabilities.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Encourage broad participation from all sectors of society in the governance of the mobile internet, accelerate the construction of social organizations in the mobile internet sector, and support various forces such as the China Internet Development Foundation and the China Internet Association to actively carry out online public welfare activities. Guide the majority of mobile internet users to surf the internet in a civilized manner, actively participate in purifying the online environment, and maintain online order. Improve the industry credit evaluation system and service evaluation system, and enhance industry management, corporate self-discipline, and social supervision mechanisms.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational leadership and work support, expand social participation.

name: Opinions on Promoting the Healthy and Orderly Development of the Mobile Internet (Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on January 15, 2017)
content: Accelerate the legislative process for the internet, improve regulatory measures in accordance with the law, and resolve internet risks. Fully implement the Cybersecurity Law, expedite the progress of foundational legislation such as the E-commerce Law, and formulate or revise administrative regulations such as the Internet Information Service Management Measures, Regulations on the Security Protection of Key Information Infrastructure, and Regulations on the Protection of Minors in Cyberspace. Improve judicial interpretations and policy interpretations, promote the extension of existing laws and regulations to apply to mobile internet management. Establish and improve key management systems for network data management and personal information protection. Enhance coordination mechanisms among multiple departments for law enforcement in mobile internet management, accelerate the construction of law enforcement information technology systems, and improve capabilities in identifying, collecting evidence, coordinating investigations, and combating internet-related illegal activities. Strengthen public legal education on the internet, reinforce the concept of the rule of law among internet users, and enhance the overall internet literacy of the general public.
titlelist: Strengthen organizational leadership and work guarantee, and enhance the guarantee of the rule of law.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Relax the registration requirements for residence (business premises). If operators conduct business activities through e-commerce platforms, they can use the network business premises provided by the platform to apply for individual business registration. Guide and urge localities to explore the reform of one license, multiple addresses, further simplifying the procedures for establishing branch offices of platform enterprises. Relax the restrictions on the registration of names for emerging industry enterprises, allowing the use of words that reflect the characteristics of new business forms as company names. Promote the standardization of business scope registration and timely include the description of business scope that reflects the characteristics of new business forms in the registration scope. (Responsibility of the State Administration for Market Regulation).
titlelist: Optimize and improve market access conditions, reduce compliance costs for enterprises, and promote the facilitation of registration and registration of platform economy-related market entities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Relax the restrictions on the access of inclusive products and services, and allow relevant market entities to enter as long as they do not violate laws and regulations. Clean up and standardize administrative licenses, qualifications, and other matters that restrict the healthy development of the platform economy. For platforms that only provide information intermediation and transaction matching services, unless they directly involve personal health, public safety, social stability, and there are other regulations in the fields of finance, news, etc., they should not be required to obtain business licenses similar to those of platform operators. (Respective departments are responsible according to their duties) Guide and supervise relevant localities to assess the implementation of policies in areas such as online car-hailing and tourist accommodations, optimize and improve access conditions, approval processes, and services, and accelerate the compliance process for participants in the platform economy. (Respective departments such as the Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Culture and Tourism are responsible according to their duties) For emerging industries that are still in the early stages of development and conducive to promoting the transformation of old and new driving forces, they should be given the opportunity to explore and experiment, and market access policies should be cautiously introduced. (Responsibility lies with respective regions and departments).
titlelist: Optimize and improve market access conditions, reduce compliance costs for enterprises, and establish reasonable industry access regulations and permits.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: For emerging industries that lack standards, relevant product and service standards should be promptly formulated and implemented to provide guarantees for the entry of new products and services into the market. For some relatively mature emerging formats, leading enterprises and industry associations should be encouraged to actively formulate corporate standards, participate in the formulation of industry standards, and improve product quality and service levels. (Led by the State Administration for Market Regulation, with respective responsibilities assigned to relevant departments) Second, innovate regulatory concepts and methods, and implement inclusive and prudent regulation.
titlelist: Optimize and improve market access conditions, reduce compliance costs for enterprises, and accelerate the improvement of the standard system for new business formats.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Formulate and implement relevant regulations on the supervision and management of online transactions, and investigate and punish illegal activities such as the abuse of market dominance and unfair competition in the Internet sector in accordance with the law. Prohibit platforms from unilaterally signing exclusive service contracts, and ensure fair participation of market entities related to the platform economy in market competition. Maintain market price order, develop regulatory measures targeting the characteristics of price violations in the Internet sector, regulate the pricing, labeling, and promotional activities of platforms and operators within the platforms, and guide enterprises to operate legally and in compliance with regulations. (Responsibility of the State Administration for Market Regulation).
titlelist: Optimize and improve market access conditions, reduce compliance costs for enterprises, and maintain a fair and competitive market order.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Support the entry of social capital into emerging service sectors based on the Internet, such as healthcare, education and training, elderly care and household services, culture, tourism, and sports. Transform and upgrade the network infrastructure for education and healthcare, expand the supply of high-quality services, and meet the diverse needs of the population at different levels. Encourage platforms to further expand their service scope, strengthen brand building, improve service quality, develop new convenient service formats, extend the industrial chain, and promote job creation. Encourage commodity trading markets to adapt to the new trends and requirements of the platform economy, enhance innovative circulation capabilities, and promote better integration of production and sales. (The Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the National Health Commission, the General Administration of Sports, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and other relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Encourage the development of new forms of platform economy, accelerate the cultivation of new growth points, and actively develop the 'Internet Plus service industry'.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: To adapt to the needs of industrial upgrading, promote the deep integration of internet platforms with industrial and agricultural production, enhance production technology, improve innovative service capabilities, vigorously promote the application of the Internet of Things and big data in the real economy, promote the development of the digital economy and digital industries, and advance intelligent manufacturing and service-oriented manufacturing. To advance the innovation and development of the industrial internet, accelerate the construction and widespread application of cross-industry, cross-domain, and enterprise-level industrial internet platforms, achieve extensive interconnection between various types of production equipment and information systems, promote the integration and sharing of manufacturing resources, data, etc., and promote the integrated development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries, as well as large, medium, and small enterprises. (The relevant departments such as the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, etc., are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Encourage the development of new forms of platform economy, accelerate the cultivation of new growth points, and vigorously develop 'Internet Plus Production'.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Accelerate the creation of an upgraded version of double innovation, improve the comprehensive entrepreneurship and innovation service system relying on internet platforms, achieve a healthy interaction between online and offline, and organically integrate entrepreneurship and innovation resources. Encourage platforms to carry out innovative task crowdsourcing, open up more shared resources to small and medium-sized enterprises, support them in carrying out technological, product, management, and business model innovations, and further enhance the efficiency of entrepreneurship and innovation. (Led by the Development and Reform Commission, with each relevant department responsible according to their duties).
titlelist: Encourage the development of new forms of platform economy, accelerate the cultivation of new growth points, and promote the deep integration of 'Internet Plus Entrepreneurship and Innovation'.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Deeply implement the 'Broadband China' strategy, accelerate the construction of new generation information infrastructure such as 5G, optimize and enhance network performance and speed, promote the construction of the next generation internet, broadcasting and television network, and Internet of Things. Further reduce the average broadband tariff level for small and medium-sized enterprises, and provide strong support for the development of the platform economy. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Development and Reform Commission, and other relevant departments are responsible according to their respective duties.
titlelist: Encourage the development of new forms of platform economy, accelerate the cultivation of new growth points, and strengthen the construction of network support capabilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Increase the openness of the national credit information sharing platform, legally share credit information that can be made public with relevant enterprises, and support the platform in improving its management level. Utilize platform data to supplement and improve existing credit system information, strengthen the restraint and punishment of dishonest subjects within the platform. (Responsibility of the National Development and Reform Commission and the State Administration for Market Regulation)Improve the credit system for new business formats, establish and improve mechanisms such as identity authentication, two-way evaluation, and credit management in areas such as online ride-hailing, shared bicycles, and car-sharing. Regulate the behavior of participants in the platform economy. (Responsibility of the National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Transport, and other relevant departments according to their respective responsibilities).
titlelist: Optimize the development environment of the platform economy, consolidate the foundation for the growth of new business formats, and promote the improvement of the social credit system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Various regions and departments should fully listen to the demands of participants in the platform economy, conduct targeted research, and propose solutions to provide strong guarantees for platform innovation, development, and job creation. (Responsibility lies with various regions and departments) By the end of 2019, a nationwide unified electronic invoice public service platform should be established, providing free value-added tax electronic ordinary invoice issuance services, and accelerating the research and promotion of the electronicization of value-added tax special invoices. (Responsibility lies with the State Taxation Administration) Rules related to information disclosure and sporadic small-value transactions in the implementation of the e-commerce law should be formulated as soon as possible. (Responsibility lies with the Ministry of Commerce, State Administration for Market Regulation, and Ministry of Justice, respectively) Encourage banking and financial institutions to innovate and develop financial products and services that meet the financing needs of platform economy-related enterprises based on internet and big data technologies, and provide support for the development of the platform economy. Allow internet platforms with strength and conditions to apply for insurance agency qualifications. (Responsibility lies with the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission and other relevant departments, respectively) Promote international exchanges and cooperation in the regulation and service of the platform economy, strengthen policy communication, and create favorable external conditions for platform enterprises to go global. (Responsibility lies with the Ministry of Commerce and other relevant departments, respectively).
titlelist: Optimize the development environment of the platform economy, consolidate the foundation for the growth of new business formats, and create a favorable policy environment.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Supervise the platform to establish and improve trading rules and service agreements based on the principles of openness, fairness, and impartiality, and clarify regulations on platform entry and exit, quality and safety assurance of goods and services, protection of platform practitioners' rights and interests, and protection of consumer rights. (Led by the Ministry of Commerce and the State Administration for Market Regulation, with respective responsibilities assigned to relevant departments). Urgently study and improve social security policies for platform enterprises' employment and flexible employment of practitioners, carry out pilot projects for occupational injury protection, actively promote universal social insurance programs, and encourage more platform practitioners to participate in social insurance. Strengthen vocational skills training for platform practitioners and include them in the action plan for improving vocational skills. (Responsibility of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security). Enhance awareness of intellectual property protection. Crack down on online fraud and extortion activities carried out under the guise of counterfeit fighting in accordance with the law. (Responsibility of the State Administration for Market Regulation and the National Intellectual Property Administration).
titlelist: Effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of participants in the platform economy, strengthen the legal guarantee for the development of the platform economy, and protect the rights and interests of platforms, operators within the platform, and platform practitioners.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Standardized and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy (State Council Document No. [2019] 38) (State Council General Office/1st August 2019)
content: Supervise the establishment and improvement of a consumer complaint and reporting mechanism on the platform, publicly disclose the complaint and reporting hotline, ensure that there are staff members available to answer the hotline, establish an information sharing mechanism with the market supervision department's complaint and reporting platform, promptly accept and handle complaints and reports, encourage industry organizations to establish third-party platforms for consumer complaints and rights protection in accordance with the law and regulations. Encourage platforms to establish online dispute resolution mechanisms and formulate and publicize dispute resolution rules. Strictly crack down on acts that harm consumer rights, such as the leakage and abuse of user information, in accordance with the law. (The relevant departments, such as the General Administration of Market Supervision, are responsible according to their respective duties).
titlelist: Effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of participants in the platform economy, strengthen the legal guarantee for the development of the platform economy, and enhance the protection of consumer rights and interests in the field of the platform economy.

name: Opinions on Deepening the Implementation of the Action Plan for 'Internet Plus Circulation' (State Council Document No. [2016] 24) (State Council General Office/April 21, 2016)
content: With meeting consumer demands as the center, actively carry out omni-channel operations, support enterprises in highlighting the characteristics of goods and services, fully utilize information technologies such as mobile internet, Internet of Things, and big data, interact online and offline in marketing, payment, after-sales service, etc., and comprehensively and round-the-clock meet consumer needs, reducing consumption costs. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television, local governments at all levels) Vigorously develop experiential consumption, guide eligible enterprises to use existing commercial facilities to transform and develop experiential consumption demonstration centers, reasonably layout experiential consumption formats such as shopping, dining, leisure, entertainment, culture, training, sports, health, etc., and enhance the service capabilities of physical stores in terms of experiential and full-process services. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Culture, State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film and Television, General Administration of Sport, local governments at all levels) Focus on improving supply chain management and control capabilities, encourage department stores and other retail formats to actively develop the buyer system, continuously increase the proportion of self-operated and self-owned brand products, reduce costs and increase efficiency through the development of chain operations, purchasing alliances, and other organizational forms, and improve the ability to transform and upgrade through the use of information technology, networking, and intelligent technology. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, local governments at all levels) Enhance the influence of traditional brands such as time-honored brands, actively use the Internet, innovate production processes and business models, promote excellent traditional culture such as national culture and craftsmanship, carry out the creation of well-known brand demonstration areas, and promote the online and offline interaction and dissemination of Chinese brands. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Culture, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, local governments at all levels) Promote the use of innovative business models on the internet in commodity trading markets, expand service functions, accelerate platform-based development, optimize market structure, improve quality and efficiency through transformation and upgrading, drive industrial optimization and restructuring, and play a good role in guiding production and promoting consumption. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Land and Resources, local governments at all levels).

name: Opinions on Deepening the Implementation of the Action Plan for 'Internet Plus Circulation' (State Council Document No. [2016] 24) (State Council General Office/April 21, 2016)
content: Encourage cities with the necessary conditions to explore the construction of experiential smart business districts that integrate online and offline development. Promote complementary advantages of different business models and formats, interconnected information, and shared consumer resources within the business district. Transform towards proactive service, intelligent service, three-dimensional service, and personalized service, and improve the ability to integrate resources and the level of consumer aggregation within the business district. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, local governments at all levels) Accelerate the implementation of characteristic commercial block demonstration construction projects, tap into local resource endowments, improve the specialization, differentiation, precision, and digital marketing promotion capabilities of products and services, and revitalize urban commercial areas. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, National Tourism Administration, local governments at all levels) Expand the field of intelligent consumption, actively develop new artificial intelligence technologies and services such as virtual reality and augmented reality, vigorously promote intelligent products such as wearable devices and life service robots, and improve the supply capacity and level of intelligent products and services. (National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Science and Technology, local governments at all levels).

name: Opinions on Deepening the Implementation of the Action Plan for 'Internet Plus Circulation' (State Council Document No. [2016] 24) (State Council General Office/April 21, 2016)
content: Promote green products and restrict the circulation and consumption of high-energy-consuming, highly polluting, and environmentally hazardous products. Carry out demonstration activities for green markets, vigorously promote and implement national and industry standards for green markets, and create a group of green markets that integrate energy-saving renovations, sales of energy-saving products, and waste recycling. Promote the green development of warehousing, distribution, and packaging, and improve the level of green development in commercial logistics. Promote innovation in the Internet + recycling model, optimize the layout of reverse logistics nodes using technologies such as big data and cloud computing, encourage online recycling, and strengthen the organic connection between household waste classification and recycling and the recycling of renewable resources. Carry out theme publicity activities such as green products entering the market, green consumption entering the community, and green recycling entering schools to promote the formation of a consumption concept and lifestyle that advocates thrift, science, and greenness. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Environmental Protection, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film, and Television, All-China Federation of Supply and Marketing Cooperatives, and local governments at all levels).

name: Opinions on Deepening the Implementation of the Action Plan for 'Internet Plus Circulation' (State Council Document [2016] No. 24) (State Council General Office/April 21, 2016)
content: Adhere to market operation and fully leverage the driving force and creativity of various market entities participating in the development of rural e-commerce. Promote the online sales of agricultural products, guided by market demand, encourage various market entities such as supply and marketing cooperatives to expand the range of agricultural products, agricultural production materials, and leisure agriculture products and services suitable for online sales. Guide e-commerce companies to establish various forms of joint cooperation with new agricultural management entities, agricultural product wholesale markets, chain supermarkets, etc., broaden the channels for agricultural products to enter cities, break through the bottleneck of cold chain transportation of agricultural products, promote farmers' income increase, and enrich urban supply. Smooth the circulation of agricultural products, effectively reduce the costs of platform usage and market promotion for online sales of agricultural products, and improve the application capabilities of rural internet and information technology. Encourage e-commerce companies to expand the rural consumer market, improve the structured matching capabilities of goods and services from the supply side based on rural consumption habits, consumption capacity, and consumption demands, and promote the flow of industrial products to rural areas, facilitating rural consumption. Encourage postal enterprises and other market entities to integrate rural logistics resources, construct and transform rural logistics public service centers and village-level outlets, effectively solve the first mile problem of agricultural products entering cities and the last mile problem of industrial products going to rural areas. (Ministry of Commerce, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Transport, Ministry of Agriculture, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, National Tourism Administration, State Post Bureau, Supply and Marketing Cooperative Federation, China Post Group Corporation, local governments at all levels).

name: Opinions on Deepening the Implementation of the Action Plan for 'Internet Plus Circulation' (State Council Document No. [2016] 24) (State Council General Office/April 21, 2016)
content: Vigorously develop community e-commerce, encourage the development of shopping service applications in communities, strengthen the integration and interaction between e-commerce enterprises and community business outlets, provide services such as logistics distribution, self-pickup of parcels, and electronic payment, improve the informatization, standardization, normalization, and intensification level of community commerce, and enhance the quality of life for community residents. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection, and Quarantine, local governments at all levels) Improve the one-stop convenience service consumption function, support the use of idle rooms, underground spaces, etc. in old residential areas to create multi-level, multi-form convenience service points, integrate scattered community service resources online and offline, coordinate the construction and transformation of catering, accommodation, housekeeping, laundry, beauty salons, repairs, logistics, finance, culture, entertainment, and leisure service outlets, increase the number of stores, and improve the convenience of urban residents' lives and the competitiveness of urban development. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Land and Resources, Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Culture, State Administration of Press, Publication, Radio, Film, and Television, local governments at all levels).

content: Actively promote the Internet + circulation initiative, focus on reducing circulation costs, improving circulation efficiency, expanding effective supply, encourage eligible regions to establish Internet + circulation development funds, and guide social capital and foreign capital to increase investment in the application of Internet and other information technologies in the circulation field. (Local governments at all levels).

content: Encourage the integration and construction of a business public service cloud platform, connect with relevant department service resources, provide policy and basic information services for the circulation field, and provide general commercial technology application services for small and medium-sized enterprises. Accelerate the establishment of a sound e-commerce statistical monitoring system, build a real and accurate database of e-commerce basic information such as enterprises, products, orders, contracts, invoices, and logistics waybills, and support the efficient and standardized operation of the e-commerce market. (Ministry of Commerce, National Bureau of Statistics, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, State Administration for Industry and Commerce, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine, State Post Bureau, local governments at all levels) Increase efforts to adjust the education and training structure, strengthen continuing education for e-commerce talents, improve online and offline interactive practical abilities, and cultivate talents who understand both circulation and creative innovation and network operation. Guide and support various e-commerce innovation and entrepreneurship competitions, connect with industry institutions and investment and financing institutions, and discover excellent entrepreneurial and innovative projects and talents. (Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Education).
