Establish and improve network security protection techniques such as intrusion detection and defense, antivirus, anti-denial of service attacks, abnormal traffic monitoring, webpage tampering prevention, domain name security, vulnerability scanning, centralized account management, data encryption, and security auditing. Improve monitoring and disposal methods for network-side Trojan viruses, mobile malicious programs, and other threats. Actively research and utilize new technologies such as cloud computing and big data to enhance network security monitoring and early warning capabilities. Promote the integration of enterprise technologies with those of telecommunications regulatory authorities, establish interface standards and specifications, and achieve data sharing in monitoring. Strengthen cooperation with network security service companies to prevent risks during the service process. When relying on security service units to carry out network security integration construction and risk assessment, select units that have been assessed for their network security service capabilities by relevant industry organizations.
titlelist: Work focus: Strengthen the construction of network security technology capabilities and means.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Network Security in the Telecommunications and Internet Industry (MIIT Order No. 368, August 28, 2014)
content: Give full play to the role of industry organizations in supporting the government and serving the industry, and vigorously carry out self-discipline work in the telecommunications and internet industry. Support relevant industry organizations and professional institutions in promoting industry-oriented network security regulations, policies, standards, and knowledge and skills training, competitions, to promote network security management and technical exchanges. Carry out network security service capability assessment to promote and regulate the healthy development of the network security service market. Establish and improve the social supervision and reporting mechanism for network security, mobilize the whole society to participate in maintaining the public internet network security environment. Carry out network security publicity and education activities for the general public, and enhance users' awareness of network security risks and self-protection capabilities.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, fully leverage the role of industry organizations and professional institutions.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Network Security in the Telecommunications and Internet Industry (MIIT Order No. 368, August 28, 2014)
content: Basic telecommunications companies should develop their own network security special plans. While increasing investment in network and business development, they should also increase investment in network security and include network security funds in the annual budget. Internet domain name registration management and service organizations, as well as value-added telecommunications companies, should increase their investment in network security funds according to their actual situation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase funding support.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening Network Security in the Telecommunications and Internet Industry (MIIT Order No. 368, August 28, 2014)
content: Basic telecommunications companies should actively carry out professional skills assessment for network security positions, establish and improve the system of certified employment for network security professional positions; strengthen network security training, and incorporate relevant training into employee training plans; actively organize and participate in network security knowledge and skills competitions, and form a positive mechanism for cultivating, selecting, attracting, and utilizing network security talents.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the construction of talent teams.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: By 2020, complete the standardization work roadmap and standard system framework construction for the energy internet. Develop more than 30 basic and general standards for the energy internet, covering technical requirements such as terminology, conceptual models, system architecture, general use cases, information security, demonstration pilot acceptance, and evaluation, to meet the needs of energy internet demonstration pilot project construction and gradual application. By 2025, form a standard system that can support the development and application needs of the energy internet industry. Develop more than 50 energy internet standards, covering interactive technology standards such as active distribution networks, micro energy networks, energy storage, and electric vehicles, comprehensively supporting energy internet project construction and technology promotion and application. China's influence in international standardization work for the energy internet significantly increases, playing a leading role.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Strengthen the top-level design of standards, build a systematic, coordinated, compatible, and open standard system, effectively guide the standardization of energy internet, and lay the foundation for formulating the standard planning for energy internet and preparing annual revision plans.
titlelist: Key task: Building a standard system for the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Organize the current status of standards, analyze the deficiencies in standards, and propose an annual work plan for standards. Coordinate planning, combining with the development process of China's energy internet and the progress of energy market construction, propose the key focus and timetable for standardization work on the energy internet.
titlelist: Key task: Complete the roadmap for standardizing the Energy Internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Develop basic standards for energy internet terminology, conceptual models, system architecture, and general use cases; in conjunction with the development of related industries, establish standards related to interactive technologies such as active distribution networks, micro energy grids, energy storage, and electric vehicles; formulate standards for information security, demonstration pilot acceptance, and evaluation to support the acceptance and evaluation work of energy internet pilot demonstration projects.
titlelist: Key task, accelerate the formulation of standards in key areas.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Strengthen contacts and cooperation with international standardization organizations and international technical organizations in areas such as standard setting and international communication, and play a role in the joint construction of the Belt and Road initiative by utilizing standards. Promote the concept of a global energy internet and enhance China's influence in the international standardization of energy internet.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthen cooperation with international organizations and promote the development of a global energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Formulate policy measures, strengthen macro coordination of energy internet standardization, and research major issues.
titlelist: Key task: Establishing a coordination mechanism and technical support institution for the standardization of the energy internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Encourage group standards to play a role in the standardization work of the energy internet. Explore various forms of standard achievements based on the characteristics of different types of standards. Establish a more timely mechanism for updating standards to meet the rapid development needs of the energy internet technology.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, innovative standardization work methods.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Actively strive for various types of special support from the state, guide industry and local funds to invest, mobilize corporate enthusiasm, and form a pattern of multi-channel investment and multi-party participation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase investment in funds.

name: Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization of Energy Internet Work (National Standardization Committee Joint [2019] No. 19) (National Standardization Administration, National Energy Administration / May 15, 2019)
content: Utilize demonstration pilot projects and standardized major events, leverage media such as newspapers and the internet, increase the publicity efforts of energy internet standardization work, and enhance the influence of energy internet standardization work.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase publicity efforts.

name: Opinions on the Development and Construction of the Next Generation Internet during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Document No. 705 of the National Development and Reform Commission) (Issued by the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments on March 27, 2012)
content: In the process of network planning, construction, operation, management, maintenance, and disposal, energy-saving measures should be considered simultaneously. Accelerate the upgrade and transformation of public backbone networks, metropolitan area networks, Internet data centers (IDC), business systems, and support systems to IPv6, and improve the performance of network equipment. Speed up the deployment and upgrade of public mobile, wired, and wireless broadband access networks, as well as IPv6. Upgrade and expand demonstration backbone networks, local networks, and support systems, and enhance functions related to transition, security, and operation management. Promote the IPv6 upgrade and transformation of government, school, enterprise, and public institution external website systems, as well as commercial website systems.
titlelist: Key tasks include the construction of broadband, convergence, security, and ubiquitous next-generation national information infrastructure, strengthening resource co-construction and sharing, and further narrowing the digital divide.

name: Opinions on the Development and Construction of the Next Generation Internet during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Document No. 705 of the National Development and Reform Commission) (Issued by the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments on March 27, 2012)
content: It mainly includes high-performance routing chips and terminal chips, high-speed routing and switching equipment, access equipment, multifunctional terminal devices, high-performance IPv4 and IPv6 network interconnection equipment, sensor network devices, various basic software, application software, and business platforms; supporting systems such as authentication and authorization, domain name resolution, address allocation query, network management, customer service, and integrated billing; security protection devices such as traffic control, firewall, and intrusion detection; network equipment function and performance testing instruments, large-scale network performance testing equipment and systems.
titlelist: Key tasks, key product research and development, and industrialization research and development support for IPv, to meet the requirements of energy saving and consumption reduction for the next generation of Internet key chips, equipment, software, and systems, accelerate industrialization and network deployment, and form a relatively complete industrial collaborative innovation system.

name: Opinions on the Development and Construction of the Next Generation Internet during the 12th Five-Year Plan Period (Document No. 705 of the National Development and Reform Commission) (Issued by the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments on March 27, 2012)
content: Strengthen the deployment and management of core network infrastructure such as domain name servers, digital certificate servers, and key application servers; enhance the planning and management of network addresses and domain name systems; promote work on security level protection, personal information protection, risk assessment, disaster backup and recovery, and effectively implement various security requirements in network planning, construction, operation, management, maintenance, and disposal; accelerate the development of the information security industry, cultivate leading enterprises, increase efforts in talent training and recruitment, and improve information security technology support and capabilities.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen the work of network and information security protection, comprehensively enhance the security and credibility of the next generation internet.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Overall goal. To achieve widespread application of the Internet of Things in various economic and social fields, master key core technologies of the Internet of Things, and basically form a secure and controllable, internationally competitive industrial system of the Internet of Things, becoming an important force in promoting the intelligent and sustainable development of the economy and society. Short-term goals. By 2015, achieve large-scale demonstration applications of the Internet of Things in important economic and social fields, break through a batch of core technologies, initially form an industrial system of the Internet of Things, and significantly improve security capabilities. - Collaborative innovation. The research and development level and innovation capability of the Internet of Things technology have significantly improved, breakthroughs have been made in core technologies in the perception field, the gap with developed countries has significantly narrowed, the network communication field has kept pace with international advanced levels, and key technologies in the information processing field have initially reached international advanced levels. Achieve collaborative development of technological innovation, management innovation, and business model innovation. Innovative resources and elements are effectively converged and deeply cooperated. - Demonstration applications. Realize pilot demonstration applications of the Internet of Things in fields such as industry, agriculture, energy conservation and environmental protection, trade and circulation, transportation and energy, public safety, social services, urban management, safety production, and national defense construction. The level of large-scale application in some fields has significantly improved, and a group of Internet of Things application service advantage enterprises are cultivated. - Industrial system. Develop and strengthen a group of backbone enterprises, cultivate a group of specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, form a group of distinctive industrial clusters, and build a relatively complete industrial chain of the Internet of Things, initially forming an industrial system of the Internet of Things. - Standard system. Formulate a batch of basic common standards, key technical standards, and key application standards urgently needed for the development of the Internet of Things, and initially form a standard system that meets the requirements of large-scale application and industrialization of the Internet of Things. - Security guarantee. Improve the security level protection system, establish and improve mechanisms such as security evaluation, risk assessment, security prevention, and emergency response for the Internet of Things, enhance the security guarantee capabilities of the Internet of Things infrastructure, major systems, and important information, and form an Internet of Things application system that is secure and available and has trustworthy data security.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and development goals, development goals.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: With the goal of achieving breakthrough technological innovation by mastering principles, grasping the direction of technological development, focusing on applications and industrial needs, clarifying development priorities, and strengthening the research and industrialization of low-cost, low-power, high-precision, high-reliability, and intelligent sensors, efforts will be made to break through the core common technologies of the Internet of Things, such as chips, software, and instruments. Accelerating the research and development of key technologies such as sensor networks, smart terminals, big data processing, intelligent analysis, and service integration, promoting the integration and development of the Internet of Things with new generation mobile communications, cloud computing, next-generation Internet, satellite communications, and other technologies. Fully utilizing and integrating existing innovative resources, establishing a number of Internet of Things technology research and development laboratories, engineering centers, and enterprise technology centers, promoting cooperation between application units and relevant technology, product, and service providers, strengthening collaborative research, and breaking through the bottleneck of industrial development.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate technological research and development and break through industrial bottlenecks.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: In important fields such as industry, agriculture, commercial circulation, energy conservation and environmental protection, and safety production, as well as important infrastructure such as transportation, energy, and water conservancy, we will promote the integrated application of Internet of Things (IoT) technology around production and manufacturing, commercial circulation, logistics distribution, and business management processes. We will focus on a batch of exemplary application demonstration projects that have outstanding effects, strong driving force, and high relevance. We will actively use IoT technology to transform traditional industries, promote refined management and scientific decision-making, improve production and operation efficiency, promote energy conservation and emission reduction, ensure safety production, innovate development models, and promote industrial upgrading.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote application demonstrations and stimulate economic development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: In the fields of public safety, social security, healthcare, urban management, and livelihood services, we will focus on innovative management and service models, implement typical application demonstration projects of the Internet of Things (IoT), and build a more convenient, efficient, and secure intelligent social management and public service system. By leveraging the advantages of IoT technology, we will promote the informatization of social management and public services, expand and extend the scope of services, improve the level of management and services, and enhance the quality of people's lives.
titlelist: The main tasks are to improve social management and enhance public services.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Guide and urge localities to reasonably determine the development orientation of the Internet of Things based on their own conditions. Combine scientific research capabilities, application foundations, industrial parks, and other characteristics and advantages to scientifically plan and promote the development of the Internet of Things in an appropriate and orderly manner. Regions with a good foundation in informatization and the information industry should strengthen the research and development, industrialization, and demonstration applications of the Internet of Things technology. Regions with a weaker foundation in informatization and the information industry should focus on promoting mature applications of the Internet of Things. Accelerate the construction of the Wuxi National Sensor Network Innovation Demonstration Zone. When constructing smart cities using new generation information technologies such as the Internet of Things, it is necessary to strengthen overall planning, focus on effectiveness, and highlight characteristics.
titlelist: The main task is to highlight regional characteristics and promote scientific and orderly development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Strengthen overall coordination and collaboration, relying on cross-departmental and cross-industry standardized collaboration mechanisms, to coordinate and promote the construction of the Internet of Things (IoT) standard system. Following the principles of addressing urgent needs first and addressing commonalities first, accelerate the research and formulation of basic common standards such as coding identification, interfaces, data, and information security, as well as key technical standards and key application standards. Encourage and support domestic institutions to actively participate in international standardization work, and enhance the international discourse power of independent technical standards.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen overall design and improve the standard system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Accelerate the development of key core industries in the Internet of Things, enhance the development level of perception and identification manufacturing industries, build a complete industrial chain for IoT communication network manufacturing and services, and develop related industries such as IoT applications and software. Vigorously cultivate backbone enterprises in the Internet of Things with international competitiveness, actively develop innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, construct characteristic industrial bases and industrial parks, continuously improve the industrial public service system, and form a highly competitive IoT industry cluster. Strengthen the combination of industrial cultivation and application demonstration, encourage and support enterprises and research institutions in equipment manufacturing, software development, and service integration to participate in application demonstration project construction.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen the core industries and enhance their supporting capabilities.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Actively explore new business models that promote win-win cooperation in the upstream and downstream of the Internet of Things industry chain. Strongly support the development of Internet of Things professional services and value-added services that contribute to expanding market demand, promote the marketization of application services, drive the development of service outsourcing industry, and cultivate emerging service industries. Encourage and support telecommunications operators, information services, system integrators, and other enterprises to participate in the operation and promotion of Internet of Things application demonstration projects.
titlelist: The main tasks are to innovate business models and cultivate emerging industries.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Improve the level of information security management and data protection in the Internet of Things (IoT), strengthen the research and development of information security technology, promote the construction of information security guarantee system, establish and improve supervision, inspection, and security assessment mechanisms, effectively ensuring the security and controllability of various links such as information collection, transmission, processing, and application in the IoT. For important IoT applications involving national public security and infrastructure, their system solutions, core equipment, and operational services must be based on security and controllability.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen protection management and ensure information security.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Make full use of existing public communication and network infrastructure to carry out Internet of Things applications. Promote interconnection, resource sharing, and business collaboration among information systems, and avoid the formation of new information silos. Emphasize the intelligent analysis and comprehensive utilization of information resources, and avoid excessive data collection, light data processing, and integrated applications. Strengthen investment benefit analysis and risk assessment of Internet of Things construction projects, and avoid redundant construction and irrational investment.
titlelist: The main tasks are to strengthen resource integration and promote collaborative sharing.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Establish a coordinated mechanism for the development of the Internet of Things (IoT) among departments, industries, regions, and the military, fully leveraging the role of the inter-ministerial joint conference system for IoT development. Research major issues, coordinate the formulation of policies, measures, and action plans, strengthen the coordination of application promotion, technological research and development, standard formulation, industrial chain construction, infrastructure development, information security, and wireless spectrum resource allocation and utilization. Form a working pattern of resource sharing and collaborative advancement, with each link supporting and promoting each other's collaborative development effects. Strengthen the coordination and connection of IoT-related planning, major scientific and technological projects, and industrialization projects, reasonably layout major IoT application demonstrations and industrialization projects, and strengthen the supporting industries and regional division of labor cooperation.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen overall coordination to form a synergy for development.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Establish and improve a policy system that is conducive to the promotion of Internet of Things applications, innovation incentives, and orderly competition. Urgently promote the formulation and improvement of laws and regulations related to information security and privacy protection. Establish a market access mechanism that encourages fair entry of diverse capital. Accelerate the construction of public service platforms for Internet of Things-related standards, testing, certification, etc., and improve the supporting service system. Strengthen intellectual property protection, actively conduct intellectual property analysis and evaluation of Internet of Things-related technologies, and accelerate the promotion of Internet of Things-related patent layout.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, create a favorable development environment.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Encourage financial capital, venture capital, and private capital to invest in the development of Internet of Things applications and industries. Accelerate the establishment of a multi-level guarantee system, including fiscal contributions and social capital investment, and increase the level of financing guarantee support for Internet of Things enterprises. Prioritize credit support for major Internet of Things projects that are technologically advanced, have obvious advantages, and have strong driving and supporting roles. Actively support eligible Internet of Things enterprises to directly raise funds in domestic and overseas capital markets. Encourage the establishment of Internet of Things equity investment funds and establish a batch of Internet of Things venture capital funds through the national emerging industry venture capital plan.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve investment and financing policies.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Orderly and Healthy Development of the Internet of Things (State Council [2013] No. 7) (State Council/February 17, 2013)
content: Actively promote the exchange and cooperation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, and fully utilize international innovation resources. Encourage foreign companies to establish IoT research and development institutions in our country, and guide foreign investment into the IoT industry. Based on improving the application level and core competitiveness of IoT in our country, guide domestic enterprises to strengthen research and development cooperation on key IoT technologies and products with international leading companies. Support domestic enterprises in participating in the global IoT market competition, promote the internationalization of independent technologies and standards in our country, and encourage companies and research institutions to participate in international standard setting.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, enhance the level of international cooperation.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: By 2025, the integration and development of informatization and industrialization will be achieved in a wider range, deeper level, and higher level. The new generation of information technology will accelerate its penetration into various fields of manufacturing, significantly expanding its scope, deepening its level, and greatly improving its quality. The pace of digital transformation in the manufacturing industry will accelerate significantly, and the national index of integration and development of the two industries will reach 105. New models and new formats will be widely popularized. The digitalization rate of enterprise management will reach 80%, and the form of enterprises will accelerate the transformation towards flatness, platformization, and ecologicalization. The popularization rate of digital R&D design tools will reach 85%. Platform-based design will be widely promoted. The rate of key process digitization will reach 68%, and networked, intelligent, and personalized production methods will be deeply applied in key areas. The effectiveness of digital transformation in key industries such as raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, green manufacturing, and safety production will be significantly improved. The continuous improvement of the integrated support system. The construction of new information infrastructure will be upgraded, digital technology will progress rapidly, the industrial big data industry will flourish, the application effectiveness of the industrial Internet will further emerge, the standard system for the integration of the two industries will continue to improve, and the industrial foundation will move towards advanced levels. The vitality of enterprise integration and development will be fully stimulated. The popularization rate of industrial Internet platforms will reach 45%, the service capabilities of system solutions will be significantly enhanced, and a new pattern of platform enterprises empowering large, medium, and small enterprises will be formed. The prosperous development of the integrated ecological system. The double innovation system in the manufacturing industry will continue to improve, the digitalization level of the industrial chain and supply chain will continue to improve, driving the accelerated integration of the industrial chain, innovation chain, talent chain, and value chain, and a number of industrial clusters with a higher level of digitalization will emerge, forming a rapidly developing integrated development ecosystem.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Support the joint research and development of manufacturing enterprises and information technology enterprises, promote the integration and application of technologies such as artificial intelligence, 5G, and advanced sensing, cultivate industrial-grade intelligent hardware, intelligent robots, intelligent connected vehicles, intelligent ships, drones, smart wearable devices, smart homes, and other new intelligent products. Develop scenario-based applications based on intelligent products, accelerate the promotion of intelligent product applications in key industries such as industry, transportation, healthcare, education, national defense, and elderly care, and provide support for industrial transformation and upgrading as well as consumer upgrading.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate new products, new models, new formats, and new intelligent products.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: By establishing a seamless data connection within enterprises, and utilizing technologies such as intelligent sensing and the Internet of Things (IoT), we aim to promote real-time data collection and comprehensive integration across the entire business chain. This will help build a digital supply chain management system, guide enterprises in creating a digital cockpit, and achieve visualization and transparency in operational management. We encourage enterprises to reconstruct their strategic layout, operational management, and market services based on production and operation data, in order to form an efficient data-driven operational management model. This will enhance capabilities in intelligent decision-making, lean manufacturing, and precision services.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate new products, new models, new formats, and digitize management.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Relying on the industrial internet platform, achieve high-level and high-efficiency lightweight design, parallel design, agile design, interactive design, and model-based design, transform traditional design methods, enhance research and development quality and efficiency. Develop platform-based, virtualized simulation design tools, cultivate platform-based design new models, promote the integration of design, process, manufacturing, and operation and maintenance, realize production without physical prototypes, shorten the new product development cycle, and enhance product competitiveness.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate new products, new models, new formats, and platform-based design.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Enhance the application capability of enterprise information technology, accelerate the digital transformation of the entire production process, promote the construction of intelligent manufacturing units, intelligent production lines, and intelligent workshops, and achieve dynamic perception, interconnection, data integration, and intelligent control of all elements and links. Promote the deep application of advanced process control systems in enterprises, accelerate the cloud deployment and optimization upgrade of manufacturing execution systems, deepen the integration and application of artificial intelligence, and improve production efficiency, product quality, and safety levels through comprehensive perception, real-time analysis, scientific decision-making, and precise execution, while reducing production costs and energy resource consumption.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate new products, new models, new formats, and intelligent manufacturing.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Promote data interoperability and business connectivity among enterprises, and facilitate the sharing of various resources between upstream and downstream companies in the supply chain and their partners, to achieve networked collaborative design, production, and services. Promote new software tools such as cloud-based design software (CAX), cloud-based enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), cloud-based manufacturing execution systems (MES), and cloud-based supply chain management systems (SCM), to share design models, production data, user usage information, product databases, etc., and improve manufacturing resource allocation efficiency based on the industrial Internet.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate new products, new models, new formats, and networked collaboration.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: To meet the personalized needs of consumers, develop systems such as customer demand analysis, agile product development and design, flexible intelligent production, and precise delivery services. Enhance user engagement throughout the product lifecycle, achieve accurate matching of supply and demand, and improve efficiency. Encourage personalized customization enterprises with mature experience and service models to cultivate a batch of system solutions that integrate user demand acquisition, research and development design, flexible production, and delivery services based on their own personalized customization platforms and model libraries. Accelerate the demonstration and promotion of large-scale personalized customization models.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate new products, new models, new formats, and personalized customization.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Promote the digital upgrade of the industrial enterprise's product supply and service chain, extending from the original manufacturing business to the high-value-added links at both ends of the value chain. Develop new services such as equipment health management, remote product maintenance, equipment financing and leasing, shared manufacturing, supply chain finance, and general integration and contracting, to achieve a transition from simply selling products to selling products + services. Encourage engineering service providers in the industrial field to deepen the application of new technologies such as digital simulation and manufacturing information modeling (MIM), improve the digital level of factory construction and operation and maintenance, and achieve a transition from turnkey projects to engineering construction + operation and maintenance services.
titlelist: The main tasks are to cultivate new products, new models, and new formats, and to extend services.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Targeting industries such as petrochemicals, steel, non-ferrous metals, building materials, and energy, we aim to promote the digitization of production processes and management, accelerate the interconnection and integration of business systems, and achieve integrated production control. We support the construction of industry-wide operational data models, based on data analysis, to achieve process improvement, operational optimization, and quality control, thereby enhancing overall productivity. We will also develop and promote industrial Internet platforms, facilitate the cloud-based integration of key equipment, and focus on areas such as energy management, predictive maintenance, and environmental safety warnings. Additionally, we will foster and promote a range of process management industrial apps and solutions.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the digital transformation of the industry and raw materials.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Enhance the supply support capability of intelligent manufacturing, carry out key common technology research and integrated application in the processes of design, technology, testing, production and processing, accelerate the industrialization of technology software, overcome a batch of major equipment and major technological equipment shortcomings. Focus on key equipment areas such as machinery, automobiles, aviation, aerospace, ships, weapons, electronics, and power, build digital workshops and intelligent factories, construct digital twin systems for the entire equipment lifecycle, promote the scale application of model-based systems engineering (MBSE), and rely on industrial Internet platforms to achieve predictive maintenance and health management of equipment.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the digital transformation of the industry and equipment manufacturing.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Implement the Ultra HD Video + 5G + AI + VR fusion innovation application project to promote the innovative application of new technology products in typical scenarios of consumer goods industries such as industrial visualization, defect detection, product assembly positioning guidance, and robot inspection. Promote the construction of automated, continuous, and flexible production systems in industries such as textiles, clothing, furniture, and home appliances, support the construction of product information traceability systems in industries such as food and pharmaceuticals, and achieve flexible production and supply-demand integration in the consumer goods industry based on the industrial Internet platform. Carry out service innovations such as user demand mining based on consumer data, product research and development, intelligent production, and data value-added, promote large-scale personalized customization, shared manufacturing, and other new models and formats, and meet the diverse and personalized consumer upgrade demands.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the digital transformation of the industry and consumer goods sector.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Guide electronic industry enterprises to deepen the innovative application of technologies such as 5G, big data, artificial intelligence, and edge computing, improve the level of software and hardware collaboration, and accelerate the development of new applications and models such as human-machine collaborative assembly and intelligent quality inspection. Support enterprises in strengthening supply chain collaborative management based on the industrial Internet platform, achieve dynamic and precise collaboration in electronic component procurement, production, inventory, quality, logistics, and other links, optimize the allocation efficiency of the entire supply chain resources, and strengthen the collaborative management level of the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain. For electronic information industry clusters, promote the platformization, convergence, and sharing of equipment and capabilities in design, manufacturing, testing, and other aspects, and enhance the collaborative development and risk prevention capabilities of industrial clusters.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the digital transformation of the industry and electronic information.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Implement the Internet Plus green manufacturing action, guide enterprises to apply new generation information technology to build online monitoring systems for pollutant emissions, underground pipeline leakage detection systems, smart management platforms for industrial wastewater recycling, and energy management centers. Carry out dynamic monitoring, precise control, and optimized management of resource energy and pollutant processes, promote carbon reduction, and help achieve carbon peak and carbon neutrality. Accelerate the digitization of the green manufacturing system, promote the software packaging of green technologies, cultivate a batch of digital and modular green manufacturing solutions, and promote the innovative application of mature green manufacturing technologies. Establish an information engineering platform for ecological environmental protection in the industrial field, focus on key industries and key products throughout their life cycle, strengthen data sharing and governance among departments, build a public database of resource energy and pollutants, and improve resource energy management level.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the digital transformation and green manufacturing in the industry sector.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Collaboratively carry out the 'Industrial Internet + Safety Production' initiative, promote the transformation of key industries through industrial internet, accelerate the networked connection, platform-based aggregation, and intelligent analysis of safety production elements. Construct a national industrial internet big data center safety production industry sub-center and data support platform, develop safety production model libraries and toolkits for different industries, and promote the software-based accumulation of safety production management knowledge and experience. Deepen the integration of industrial internet applications, guide industrial enterprises to accelerate the construction of a new capability system for safety production, which includes rapid perception, comprehensive monitoring, early warning, coordinated disposal, and systematic evaluation.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the digital transformation in the industry and ensure safety in production.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Accelerate the construction and application of 5G network on a large scale, formulate key industry development plans for 5G, and accelerate the construction of a 5G infrastructure network that covers the entire country, has excellent quality, efficient operation, and is globally leading. Improve the industrial Internet identification and resolution system, promote the application of new network technologies such as 5G, gigabit fiber optic network, IPv6, time-sensitive network (TSN), and software-defined network (SDN) in the industrial field, and accelerate the transformation of industrial enterprises' internal and external networks. Build an industrial Internet security monitoring system, implement classified and graded management of network security for industrial Internet enterprises, and promote standardization actions. Establish a national industrial Internet big data center system, promote the collection, transmission, processing, storage, and sharing of industrial data resources, and build a cross-regional, cross-industry industrial big data support service system.
titlelist: The main task is to build a solid foundation for integrated development and construct new information infrastructure.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: By integrating applications to drive technological progress, we will establish an integrated platform for industry, academia, research, and application, as well as a public service platform for common technologies. We will conduct research on cutting-edge key technologies such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, and digital twins, and break through core technological bottlenecks in electronic components and basic software to accelerate the process of digital industrialization. Through product testing, marketization, and industrialization guidance, we will accelerate the integration and support of industrial chipsets, intelligent sensors, industrial control systems, and industrial software to cultivate and develop industries, enhancing the capacity of industrial infrastructure support. We will support enterprises in building a basic product system with independent intellectual property rights, utilize the insurance compensation policy for the first major technological equipment to promote the large-scale application of innovative products, leverage tax incentives, and increase the promotion of information technology innovation products. We will iterate and improve the readiness and maturity of hardware and software products and systems, and enhance the integrity and competitiveness of the industrial chain.
titlelist: The main task is to build a solid foundation for integrated development and enhance the capability of key core technology support.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Accelerate the aggregation of industrial data, conduct investigations on industrial data resources, establish a multi-level linkage national industrial basic database, and industry-specific databases for raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, etc. Implement the Guidelines for Industrial Data Classification and Grading (Trial), carry out national standardization of enterprise data management maturity assessment, and improve the level of enterprise data management. Support the construction of a secure and trustworthy industrial data sharing space by upstream and downstream companies in the industrial chain, deepen the application of industrial data, activate the potential of data elements, develop new models and formats driven by data, and promote the value enhancement of industrial data.
titlelist: The main task is to build a solid foundation for integrated development and promote the innovative development of industrial big data.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Establish and improve the standard system for deep integration of the two industries, relying on various professional technical organizations such as the National Technical Committee for Integration of the Two Industries (TC573), research institutes, and alliance groups. Carry out the revision of national standards, industry standards, and group standards in key areas such as the degree of integration of the two industries, the management system for the integration of the two industries, digital transformation, industrial internet, cyber-physical systems (CPS), digital twins, digital supply chains, cloud-based equipment, data dictionaries, digital simulation in manufacturing, and industrial information security. Strengthen the promotion and dissemination of key standards such as the degree of integration of the two industries, organize the evaluation of the degree of integration of the two industries, clarify the development focus and improvement path for enterprises with different degrees of integration, and guide enterprises to gradually improve their level of information technology integration application.
titlelist: The main task is to build a new foundation for integrated development and improve the standard system for deep integration of the two industries.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Promote dissemination and reuse, and build a new ecosystem for manufacturing based on platforms. Facilitate interconnection and interoperability between platforms, explore cross-platform deployment and invocation mechanisms for industrial mechanism models, microservices, and industrial apps by establishing data migration standards between platforms, and achieve data interoperability, capability collaboration, and service sharing between platforms. Column 1: Construction of the industrial Internet platform system. Develop comprehensive platforms across industries and domains: construct comprehensive platforms covering multiple industries such as raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, as well as multiple domains including R&D design, production manufacturing, and operation and maintenance services, providing services such as industrial resource aggregation and sharing, industrial data integration and utilization, and optimization and innovation of industrial production and services. Construct characteristic platforms targeting key industries and regions: focus on key industries with good digital foundations and strong driving effects, target regions with high concentration of manufacturing resources and urgent need for industrial transformation, construct characteristic platforms targeting key industries and regions, leverage the role of platform knowledge accumulation and resource coordination, and provide driving force for industry transformation and regional coordinated development. Cultivate professional platforms in specific technical fields: build professional platforms focusing on specific industrial scenarios, such as cloud simulation, cloud-based equipment, and big data modeling, and carry out innovative applications integrating cutting-edge technologies and industrial mechanism models.
titlelist: Main tasks include stimulating new vitality of enterprise entities, cultivating ecological aggregation-type platform enterprises, cultivating competitive industrial Internet platform enterprises, constructing a batch of comprehensive platforms across industries and fields, characteristic platforms targeting key industries and regions, as well as professional platforms targeting specific technologies and scenarios. It is important to strengthen the development of industrial big data, manufacturing resource allocation, and solution aggregation capabilities, accelerate the accumulation of industrial knowledge...

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Support enterprises in using new technologies and applications to comprehensively transform in all aspects, angles, and chains, and cultivate a group of leading enterprises with strong innovation capabilities and prominent brand influence in integrated applications. Give full play to the leading role of industry backbone enterprises, encourage enterprises to take the lead in exploring new technologies, new products, and new models based on their technological and industrial advantages, cultivate advanced industry system solutions, and enhance professional service capabilities. Support backbone enterprises in establishing close cooperation between technology development and innovative applications, promote the replication and promotion of industry system solutions, and lead the overall transformation and upgrading of the industry.
titlelist: The main task is to stimulate the new vitality of enterprise entities and build exemplary leading backbone enterprises.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Implement the project to enhance the innovation capability and specialization level of small and medium-sized enterprises, incubate millions of innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate 100,000 provincial-level specialized and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, and 10,000 specialized and innovative small giants enterprises. Carry out special actions to empower digitalization for small and medium-sized enterprises, cultivate and promote a batch of digital products and services that meet the needs of small and medium-sized enterprises, and reduce the cost of digital transformation for small and medium-sized enterprises. Encourage large enterprises to cooperate with small and medium-sized enterprises through open platforms and other forms for mutual benefit, focusing on industry advantages and key links in the industrial chain, and promoting innovation and integration among the upstream, midstream, and downstream of the industrial chain, as well as between large, medium, and small enterprises.
titlelist: The main task is to stimulate the new vitality of enterprise entities and strengthen the specialized, refined, distinctive, and innovative small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: To meet the needs of digitalization, networking, and intelligent transformation in the manufacturing industry, we aim to cultivate system solution providers who can offer services such as planning and design, development and implementation, integrated application, diagnostic consultation, and operation and maintenance. We focus on the application of new technologies, optimization of specific scenarios, and overall improvement of enterprises, and cultivate system solution providers with technical expertise, specialization, and comprehensiveness. We encourage the establishment of solution resource pools at the local level, and accelerate the application and promotion of high-quality solutions through service vouchers and other means, in order to lower the threshold for digital transformation of enterprises.
titlelist: The main task is to stimulate the new vitality of enterprise entities and develop specialized system solution providers.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Promote the collaborative transformation of the entire industry chain through data empowerment, deepen the application of new generation information technologies such as 5G, Internet, big data, and blockchain, reconstruct the structure, processes, and models of the industry chain, strengthen the intelligent management and dynamic optimization of the industry chain across all channels, promote the transformation of the industry chain into an industry network, enhance the adaptability and self-repairing ability of the industry chain, and improve the stability and competitiveness of the industry chain. Promote end-to-end cloud collaboration in the supply chain, guide upstream and downstream enterprises to strengthen digital management and integrated collaboration in the supply chain, carry out collaborative procurement, collaborative manufacturing, and collaborative distribution based on platforms, promote the establishment of a secure management system for the supply chain, and build an agile, efficient, secure, and stable digital supply chain and supply chain network. Deepen the application of new technologies such as the Internet and blockchain, promote international capacity cooperation, accelerate the internationalization of key enterprise industrial chains, and help Chinese enterprises deeply integrate into the global industrial system.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate a new cross-border integration ecosystem and promote the upgrading of the industrial chain and supply chain.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Support the construction and co-construction of digital infrastructure such as communication networks, data centers, and energy management centers in industrial clusters, to achieve online resource utilization, flexible production capacity, and collaborative industrial chain, and enhance the overall competitiveness of industrial clusters. Guide cluster enterprises to go cloud and go platform, rely on industrial internet platforms to achieve online release, collaboration, and transaction of manufacturing capabilities, optimize the efficiency of manufacturing resource allocation, and promote the transformation of cluster enterprises towards high-end, intelligent, and green manufacturing. Create a number of industrial internet demonstration zones, build industrial internet industry demonstration bases and application innovation promotion centers, accelerate the technological breakthroughs and promotion of industrial internet, and create a highland for the development of industrial internet.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate a new cross-border integration ecosystem and promote the digital transformation of industrial clusters.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Strengthening the cooperation between industry, academia, research, and application, establishing an innovative system with enterprises as the main body and coordinated industry-academia-research-application, supporting enterprises in leading the construction of national manufacturing innovation centers, cultivating a group of technology innovation sources with original innovation capabilities, and accelerating the two-way iteration of scientific and technological research and development and the application of scientific and technological achievements. Improving the mechanism for cooperation between industry and finance, exploring the establishment of a credit mechanism and financing model based on production and operation data, and guiding the capital market to increase investment in digital transformation, industrial internet, and other fields. Consolidating the foundation of integration between industry and education, supporting the construction of new engineering disciplines in information technology, improving the mechanism for cooperation between schools and enterprises, encouraging the strengthening of talent cultivation in the field of deep integration of the two industries through joint education and the construction of practical training bases, and relying on national major talent projects to increase support for leading talents in integrated development.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate a new ecosystem of cross-border integration and deepen cooperation between industry, academia, research, and application.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Promote the coordinated development of double innovation in the manufacturing industry and the industrial internet, build a double innovation system based on the industrial internet platform, accelerate the digital transformation, online aggregation, and platform-based sharing of entrepreneurial and innovative resources such as research and development, manufacturing, management, business, logistics, and incubation. Develop new business formats such as platform economy and gig economy, and create an upgraded version of double innovation in the manufacturing industry. Adhere to the people-oriented approach, encourage companies to establish a compensation system and performance evaluation mechanism based on contributions, fully stimulate employees' enthusiasm, initiative, and creativity, and enhance the innovation vitality of enterprises.
titlelist: The main task is to cultivate a new cross-border integration ecosystem and enhance the level of double innovation in the manufacturing industry.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Establish a work promotion mechanism that promotes cross-departmental collaboration and inter-provincial linkage, and promote the formation of a work pattern for the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry that is market-driven, government-guided, industry-involved, enterprise-oriented, and collaborative between academia, research, and application. Develop a roadmap for digital transformation in key industries. Build an evaluation and assessment system for digital transformation in the manufacturing industry, and develop a series of implementation guidelines and toolkits for promoting digital transformation in enterprises. Promote the accelerated digital transformation in key industries such as raw materials, equipment manufacturing, consumer goods, electronic information, green manufacturing, and safety production. Build a digital transformation capability system for manufacturing enterprises. Organize pilot demonstrations of the integration of next-generation information technology and the manufacturing industry, with a focus on enhancing new capabilities such as integrated management, data interoperability, software development, intelligent applications, and security protection, and guide enterprises to develop new models such as digital management, platform-based design, intelligent manufacturing, networked collaboration, personalized customization, and extended services. Column 2 focuses on the digital transformation of key industries. Key industries focus on the digital transformation. In the steel industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as inefficient equipment maintenance, opaque production processes, fragmented downstream demand, and increased environmental pressure. Starting with process optimization, accelerate the digital transformation towards intelligent equipment operation and maintenance, transparent production processes, coordinated supply chain, and clean environmental management. In the petrochemical industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as opaque equipment management, difficulties in knowledge transfer, low level of upstream and downstream collaboration in the industrial chain, and high pressure on safety production. Starting with intelligent equipment control, carry out digital transformation in areas such as equipment health management, intelligent refining and production, supply chain collaboration, and safety monitoring. In the coal industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as environmental pollution, high production risks, and difficulties in equipment management. Starting with safety production, promote the accelerated digital transformation towards intelligent, unmanned, and green production by focusing on production, management, logistics, and maintenance. In the aerospace industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as differences in data sources, poor model adaptability, weak management adjustment capabilities, and poor fault prediction capabilities. Starting with networked collaboration, carry out digital transformation in areas such as integrating research and development resources, restructuring production paradigms, transforming management models, and improving maintenance efficiency. In the shipbuilding industry, the focus is on optimizing and improving the quality and efficiency of the entire chain from ship design, research and development, production, management to services. Starting with networked collaboration and extended services, carry out digital transformation in areas such as collaborative design, intelligent manufacturing, lean management, online financing, and product services. In the automotive industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as long design cycles, personalized downstream demand, and inefficient after-sales service. Starting with mass customization production, accelerate digital transformation towards collaborative research and development, flexible production, coordinated manufacturing and supply, and service-oriented manufacturing. In the construction machinery industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as low efficiency in resource allocation, difficulties in equipment operation and maintenance, and incomplete financial ecosystem. Starting with equipment health management, accelerate digital transformation towards intelligent equipment operation and maintenance, lean management, and service-oriented production and manufacturing. In the home appliance industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as low level of intelligent production, low efficiency of supply chain collaboration, and slowing industry revenue growth. Starting with personalized customization, accelerate digital transformation towards flexible production methods, platform-based management, and product-service ecosystem. In the electronics industry, the focus is on addressing pain points such as long production cycles for new products, insufficient equipment management accuracy, and labor-intensive processes. Starting with intelligent equipment, carry out digital transformation in areas such as equipment health management, intelligent production, product quality testing, and supply chain collaboration.
titlelist: Key projects, formulation of action plans for the digital transformation of the manufacturing industry.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Carry out the work of formulating and evaluating the promotion of standards for the integration of the two industries. Organize the formulation of standards for the integration of the two industries, clarify the criteria and levels of information technology integration application for enterprises at different integration levels, organize the implementation of the integration level standard for enterprise integration, evaluate the level of enterprise automation, digitization, networking, and intelligence through integration level, guide enterprises to form integration capabilities, and drive enterprises to improve integration levels. Build an upgraded version of the integrated management system for the integration of the two industries. Guide local governments, central enterprise groups, industry organizations, etc., to innovate and carry out pilot demonstrations and hierarchical integrated assessment of the integrated management system for the integration of the two industries, accelerate the full coverage of the integrated management system for the integration of the two industries in key areas and advantageous industries, and promote its scale in small and medium-sized enterprise clusters. Improve the market-oriented service system for the promotion of standard application. Construct and improve the standardized public service platform for the integration of the two industries, develop automated tools for integrated standardization of the two industries, provide full-process services for integrated standardization, and continuously improve the market-oriented service capabilities and quality of integrated standardization.
titlelist: Key Projects, Integration of Two Industries Leading the Action

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/November 17, 2021)
content: Cultivate and form a batch of high-value industry solutions in various industries and links, including equipment monitoring and early warning, lean research and development, lean production, and industrial chain collaboration, to support the creation of a solution resource pool and effectively enhance the specialization and integration level of industry system solutions. Cultivate and promote cloud-based solutions for industrial equipment. Focus on key equipment such as high-energy-consuming equipment, general power equipment, new energy equipment, and intelligent equipment, accelerate the cultivation of high-quality cloud-based solutions for equipment, continuously improve the standard system and evaluation indicators for equipment cloudization, explore the release of performance rankings and related indices for equipment cloudization, and guide enterprises to promote equipment cloudization in an orderly and standardized manner. Improve and perfect the application and promotion ecosystem of solutions. Accelerate the development of a group of system solution providers around comprehensive service needs such as planning and design, development and implementation, integrated application, diagnostic consultation, and operation and maintenance, promote the integrated development of solution providers with industrial software and intelligent equipment enterprises, and create a good ecosystem for precise matching of supply and demand and win-win cooperation among all parties. Focus on cloudization of key industrial equipment. Potential application scenarios for pain points of key industrial equipment. Inefficient management of blast furnace equipment in iron and steel industry, extensive environmental management, opaque production process, low level of equipment interconnection, health management, green production, production process optimization, and production line collaborative control. Inefficient energy management of industrial boilers, opaque combustion status, high safety risks, efficient energy management, combustion control, and health management.
