High energy consumption, high safety risks, large shutdown losses, and difficult operation of petrochemical equipment, energy saving and consumption reduction, safety warning, predictive maintenance, and simulation operation. Core equipment of diesel generators relies on imports, complex operating conditions, equipment prone to failure, intelligent research and development, online management, intelligent maintenance, and intelligent production. Low utilization efficiency, high maintenance costs, high safety risks, and high energy consumption costs of large and medium-sized motors, state monitoring, fault warning, intelligent operation and maintenance, and energy consumption optimization. Difficulties in operation monitoring of large-scale air compressors, extensive energy management, and huge consequences of hidden dangers, operation and maintenance control, equipment energy saving optimization, and after-sales service operation and maintenance. Difficulties in wind data collection, high equipment operation and maintenance costs, and low efficiency of wind farm management, virtual wind farm design, equipment predictive maintenance, and wind farm management optimization. Low operating efficiency and high cost of photovoltaic equipment, unstable energy utilization rate, and huge hidden dangers in safe operation, panoramic monitoring, intelligent analysis, and digital management. Multiple equipment failures, low construction efficiency, and imperfect financial system in construction machinery equipment, remote operation and maintenance, intelligent construction, and financing leasing. High operation and maintenance costs, low equipment utilization efficiency, poor real-time production management, and difficulties in equipment transformation and upgrading of CNC machine tools, production capacity sharing, intelligent operation and maintenance of cutting tools, and enterprise operation decision-making.
titlelist: Key projects, action to enhance the capability of system solution, creating a resource pool for system solutions.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Develop and promote digital management standards for supply chains. Organize the development of key urgently needed standards such as the Supply Chain Digital Management Guidelines, and carry out pilot projects for standardization in key industries such as aviation, electronics, and automotive. Use standards to guide enterprises in adopting digital tools and solutions for supply chain management, and enhance their digital management capabilities. Improve the digitalization level of supply chains in key industries. Targeting key industries such as electronics, healthcare, and engineering machinery, guide industry organizations, research institutes, and leading enterprises to deepen the application of technologies such as big data, blockchain, and industrial internet, and enhance the digitalization level of industrial supply chains, thereby improving the accuracy and agility of supply chain collaboration. Accelerate the development of industrial e-commerce. Guide large manufacturing enterprises to transform their procurement and sales platforms into industry e-commerce platforms, and improve the level of supply chain collaboration. Guide third-party industrial e-commerce platforms to extend their services to online transactions, payment settlements, supply chain finance, big data analysis, and other comprehensive services, thereby enhancing their operational service capabilities.
titlelist: Key project, digital upgrading action of industrial chain and supply chain.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Make full use of mechanisms such as major special projects and the manufacturing industry transformation and upgrading fund to increase financial support for the construction and promotion of digital 'new infrastructure,' industrial internet platform construction, research and development, and industrialization of common technologies for deep integration of the two industries. Encourage eligible regions to establish special funds in accordance with regulations, explore the establishment of diversified and multi-channel mechanisms for social investment, and strengthen financial support for the digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises. Implement tax preferential policies well to create a favorable development environment for manufacturing enterprises.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial and fiscal support.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Establish efficient interdepartmental linkage mechanisms, relying on internet platforms, big data platforms, etc., to promote cross-departmental, cross-level, and cross-regional data sharing and process interoperability, continuously strengthen the synergy of integrated development. Relax market access restrictions on new products, new models, and new formats, clear institutional barriers that restrict the free flow of talents, capital, technology, data, etc., and strengthen the fundamental position of competition policy. Promote full alignment of relevant industries in technology, standards, policies, etc., strengthen intellectual property protection, and create an external environment conducive to deep integration of the two industries. Carry out various forms of publicity, promotion, and training exchanges, enhance the understanding of various participating entities such as government, enterprises, industry organizations, research institutes, etc., on the deep integration of the two industries, strengthen internet thinking, big data thinking, and enhance the ability to utilize innovation in the new generation of information technology.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, optimize the environment for integrated development.

name: Plan for the Deep Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in the 14th Five-Year Plan Period (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Document No. 182 [2021]) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, November 17, 2021)
content: Make full use of bilateral and multilateral international exchange and cooperation mechanisms to deepen integration of the two industries. Strengthen international cooperation in areas such as deep integration, industrial internet, open-source software, and supply chain finance. Enhance international standardization work and carry out overseas intellectual property layout. Expand the opening-up of the manufacturing industry and encourage foreign-funded enterprises to establish research and development institutions within the country. Implement the Belt and Road Initiative, support excellent enterprises, products, and technology in global collaboration, and strengthen the international promotion of the integrated development of the 'Chinese solution'.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen international exchanges and cooperation.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: With the acceleration of the digital transformation of the economy and society, as well as the advancement of intelligent upgrades, the Internet of Things (IoT) has become an important component of the new infrastructure. In order to implement the 14th Five-Year Plan and the Long-Range Objectives Through the Year 2035 for National Economic and Social Development of the People's Republic of China, and to build a modern infrastructure system that is comprehensive, efficient, practical, intelligent, green, safe, and reliable, and to promote the construction of new IoT infrastructure, and fully leverage the important role of the IoT in promoting the development of the digital economy and empowering the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, this plan is formulated.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese means man or male.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: By the end of 2023, a new type of Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructure will be initially established in major cities in China, providing a more solid foundation for social modernization, industrial digital transformation, and the upgrading of people's livelihood and consumption. Key common technologies that have been hindering the development of the IoT will be overcome, and a number of exemplary entities and operators in IoT construction will be cultivated to drive the industry. Replicable, promotable, and sustainable operation service models will be created, and a set of sound and comprehensive IoT standards and security systems will be established. In terms of innovation, breakthroughs will be made in high-end sensors, IoT chips, IoT operating systems, and new short-range communication technologies, significantly improving their technological level and market competitiveness. The deep integration and application of IoT with 5G, artificial intelligence, blockchain, big data, IPv6, and other technologies will achieve industrial breakthroughs. New IoT technologies, products, and models will continue to emerge. The industrial ecosystem will be continuously improved, with efforts to promote the growth of 10 IoT companies into leading enterprises with an output value of over 10 billion yuan, capable of driving the integrated development of small and medium-sized enterprises. Support will be provided for the development of a group of specialized and innovative hidden champions enterprises, and the cultivation of several national IoT new industrialization demonstration bases to accelerate the development of the IoT industry towards scale, intensification, and high value. The scale of applications will continue to expand. In key areas such as smart cities, digital villages, intelligent transportation, smart agriculture, intelligent manufacturing, smart construction, and smart homes, the deployment of sensing terminals, networks, and platforms will be accelerated, forming a number of industry solutions based on independently innovative technological products with large-scale promotion value, which will effectively support the construction of new infrastructure. The large-scale application of IPv6 in the field of IoT will be promoted, and the number of IoT connections will exceed 2 billion. The supporting system will be more robust. The IoT standard system will be improved, with the completion of the revision of more than 40 national standards or industry standards. A security system for IoT, focusing on network security, data security, and personal information protection, will be established. Public service platforms for testing and inspection, intellectual property services, technology transfer, and talent development will be built.
titlelist: Overall requirements, action goals.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: By integrating 'cloud, network, and end', we systematically deploy the innovation chain around key links in the industrial chain such as information perception, information transmission, and information processing. We implement the 'ranking system' to encourage and support backbone enterprises to increase their efforts in key core technology research and development, break through key common technologies such as intelligent perception, new short-distance communication, and high-precision positioning, fill the gaps in high-end sensors, IoT chips, and other industries, and further enhance the supply capacity of high-performance and universal IoT perception terminals.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance innovation capability, breakthrough in key core technologies.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Facing '5G + Internet of Things', fully utilize the high reliability, low latency, and large connectivity characteristics of the 5G network, enrich the supply of communication technology, and expand the application scenarios of the Internet of Things; facing 'big data + Internet of Things', achieve efficient collaborative processing of data, and deeply explore the value of physical world data; facing 'artificial intelligence + Internet of Things', establish an intelligent service of 'perception terminal + platform + scenario'; facing 'blockchain + Internet of Things', establish a credit system for perception terminals to ensure data ownership and value circulation.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance innovation capability, promote technological integration and innovation.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Encourage local leading enterprises, research institutes, and universities to establish a batch of Internet of Things (IoT) technology incubation and innovation centers, to connect the chain of technology transfer, and to promote the trial and commercial application of technological achievements. Encourage leading enterprises to form IoT industry technology alliances with upstream and downstream companies, and explore the development model of patent + standard + open-source community to stimulate innovation vitality. Relying on foundations and open-source communities, gather developer and user resources to jointly create mature open-source products and application solutions, and form a collaborative innovation ecosystem with international competitiveness. Column 1: Guidelines for enhancing innovation capabilities. Key core technologies. Support the research and development of intelligent sensing technologies that enable multi-source and massive data access, promote the development of new short-range communication technologies with low power consumption, high security, and high speed, strengthen the research and development of high-reliability and wide-coverage Beidou positioning and high-precision indoor positioning technologies, break through the design and manufacturing of MEMS sensors and IoT chips, and develop lightweight/distributed IoT operating systems. Accelerate the research and development and application of edge computing, digital twins, IPv6, and other technologies. Technological integration and innovation. Continuously optimize technologies such as low latency, low power consumption, and large connectivity, and enhance the communication support of 5G for the IoT. Conduct research on big data technologies such as perception data cleaning, standard modeling and feature analysis of physical world data, and integration and sharing of multi-source heterogeneous data sets, to further unleash the value of IoT data. Conduct research on artificial intelligence technologies such as speech recognition, video recognition, machine learning, models of object behavior, and knowledge graphs, enrich the interaction methods of perception terminals, and enhance the knowledge model accumulation and professional level upgrade in IoT services. Conduct in-depth research on the applicability of lightweight, low-energy consumption distributed ledgers, asymmetric encryption, and other blockchain technologies in the deployment of IoT applications.
titlelist: Key tasks, action to enhance innovation capability, and building a collaborative innovation mechanism.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Cultivate a group of leading companies with advanced technology and strong ability to integrate resources, deepen the collaboration between industry, academia, and research institutions, promote efficient allocation of innovation chain, industrial chain, and capital chain, and promote the large-scale deployment of perception terminals, platforms, and network facilities. Cultivate a group of specialized and innovative small giants in the field of the Internet of Things, targeting specific scenarios and niche areas, to become suppliers of advanced technology products and applicable solutions. Cultivate a group of Internet of Things service providers, providing services such as solution design, integrated implementation, network operation and maintenance, business management, and network information security protection.
titlelist: Key tasks, industrial ecological cultivation action, cultivating diversified market entities.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Support the construction of new industrialization demonstration bases for the Internet of Things in regions with distinctive industrial characteristics, good basic conditions, and outstanding application demonstration effects, and continue to leverage the brand awareness and influence of existing demonstration bases. Accelerate the development of industrial agglomeration, carry out pilot projects for new products, new services, and new models, and optimize the allocation of policy, talent, technology, and capital resources. Column 2: Guidelines for the cultivation of industrial ecology. Diversify market entities. Encourage leading enterprises to develop universal and serialized software and hardware products around perception terminals and platforms, shift from single-point efforts to the construction of an ecological system, and promote the scale and intensive development of the Internet of Things. Encourage little giant enterprises specializing in the Internet of Things to focus on key areas with strong market demand and clear application models, and promote mature technology products and solutions through a combination of online and offline methods. Relying on Internet of Things service providers, launch replicable and easily promotable operation models, and provide differentiated service models for cities, enterprises, consumers, etc., to stimulate business model innovation. Strengthen the development of industrial agglomeration. Combining regional development strategies such as the coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, the integrated development of the Yangtze River Delta, the construction of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the comprehensive revitalization of the Northeast, the development of the western region, and the construction of the Chengdu-Chongqing twin-city economic circle, construct and improve the industrial chain of the Internet of Things, promote local digital transformation and intelligent upgrading, cultivate several national demonstration bases for the new industrialization of the Internet of Things, and enhance the level of industrial agglomeration development.
titlelist: Key tasks, industrial ecological cultivation action, strengthening the development of industrial agglomeration.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Using agriculture, manufacturing, construction, ecological environment, cultural tourism, and other digital transformation and intelligent upgrading as driving forces, accelerate the deployment of sensing terminal applications such as data collection terminals, meters, and controllers, support the use of new network technologies to transform enterprise intranets and industry-specific networks, and build platforms that provide services such as environmental monitoring, information tracing, status warning, and identification resolution. Create a batch of industry-adapted solutions and application benchmarks. Column 4: Industry Application Construction Guidelines. Smart agriculture. Promote the deployment of sensing terminals such as information perception and data collection in agricultural production, environmental monitoring, biological ontology recognition, plant pests and diseases prevention and control, as well as livestock and aquaculture, dynamic monitoring of fishing vessels, and quality and safety control. Build an agricultural and rural monitoring network, establish platforms for traceability of agricultural products, remote monitoring of fisheries law enforcement, and monitoring of aquatic biological resources, and promote the digital transformation of agricultural production, operation, and management services. Intelligent manufacturing. Accelerate the deployment of sensing devices such as radio frequency identification, intelligent sensors, and visual recognition, promote the transformation of dumb devices data collection and networking capabilities in industrial sites, and realize real-time monitoring of production status, production environment, and materials. Encourage industrial enterprises to use time-sensitive networks, 5G, and other new network technologies to upgrade and transform enterprise intranets and extranets. Encourage IoT companies to collaborate with industrial enterprises to build IoT platforms around typical applications such as equipment health management, integrated operation and control, and on-site assembly. Smart construction. Accelerate the application of IoT technologies such as intelligent sensors, radio frequency identification (RFID), QR codes, near-field communication, and low-power wide-area networks in the production, procurement, and transportation of building materials, BIM collaborative design, smart construction sites, smart operation and maintenance, and smart buildings. Use IoT technology to enhance the intelligent management and supervision level of construction quality, personnel safety, and green construction. Smart environmental protection. Promote the application deployment of low-power, miniaturized, and intelligent ecological environment sensing terminals in water, marine, atmospheric, soil, solid waste, nuclear and radiation safety, carbon emissions, and other aspects. Build a comprehensive management and data sharing platform for ecological environment, create typical applications such as pollution source management, ecological environment monitoring, ecological protection, and supervision and law enforcement, and enhance the ecological environment perception capability and intelligent management decision-making level. Smart cultural tourism. Promote the construction and application of intelligent gates, smart screens in scenic areas, electronic tickets, mobile tour guides, and other sensing terminals. Especially accelerate the application deployment of sensing terminals such as environmental monitoring, micro-environment regulation, and video passenger counters in cultural relic protection, and promote the construction of comprehensive tourism service platforms. Evaluate immersive experiences, virtual exhibition halls, high-definition live broadcasts, and other new cultural tourism services, and provide tourists with safer, more convenient, and comfortable quality tourism services.
titlelist: Key tasks, integration and application development actions, industry application areas.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Promote the deployment of perception terminals and smart products in homes, buildings, and communities. Build smart homes with heterogeneous product interconnection and centralized control, and construct low-carbon, environmentally friendly, safe, and comfortable smart buildings and new communities. Encourage cross-industry cooperation between IoT companies and sports equipment manufacturers, rehabilitation aid producers, elderly care institutions, sports venues, etc., to accelerate the popularization of wearable devices, smart medical and health products, and smart sports equipment applications. Column 5: Guidelines for Livelihood Consumption. Smart homes. Accelerate the integration of multi-modal biometric recognition, interconnection, over-the-air (OTA) downloading, and other technologies with home appliances, lighting, door locks, home gateways, etc., develop and promote apps based on unified application programming interfaces (APIs), and enhance user experience. Promote the deployment of perception terminals such as video surveillance, smart access control, energy management, fire warning, etc., strengthen personal privacy protection, data security, and security supervision, and promote the construction of integrated management platforms for buildings and communities. Smart health. Research and develop smart wearable devices with personal health monitoring functions, and promote the clinical application of perception terminals with medical and diagnostic performance. Promote the application of smart sports equipment in swimming, ice and snow training, and competitions. Utilize indoor precise positioning, digital twinning, and other technologies to create smart venues with features such as unmanned operation, energy saving and environmental protection, and digital operation.
titlelist: Key tasks, integrated application development action, people's livelihood consumption field.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Improve the technical standards and specifications for the detection of Internet of Things (IoT) terminal access, and clarify the requirements for IPv6 network access. Promote the upgrading and use of IPv6 in IoT platforms, terminals, gateway devices, etc. for public networks, and encourage new products to support and enable IPv6 functionality by default. Guide and encourage enterprises to adopt IPv6-based application solutions for industry applications, and promote the application of IoT terminals and modules that support IPv6. Peking University Law Information. Possess the capability to allocate IPv6 addresses to mobile IoT users. Conduct pilot demonstrations of IPv6-based IoT applications in the industry. Organize pilot projects for IoT applications based on IPv6, and solicit applications for demonstration of technology platforms and innovative projects based on IPv6 for IoT. Promote the completion of IPv6 transformation for more than 3 large-scale smart home platforms and over 50 household IoT terminals in the field of smart homes, and support IPv6-based access management. Promote the IPv6 transformation of smart IoT terminals in the fields of household water, electricity, and gas, and newly deployed smart IoT terminals for household water, electricity, and gas should support IPv6 and have IPv6 functionality enabled by default.
titlelist: Key tasks, optimize support system actions, promote the large-scale application of IPv6.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Optimize and improve the Internet of Things (IoT) standard system, establish a comprehensive standard map for the entire IoT industry chain, accelerate the revision of national and industry standards for new technology products, infrastructure construction, and industry applications, and encourage the trial implementation of group standards. Continuously participate deeply in international standardization organizations such as the International Organization for Standardization (ISO), the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), and the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC), and enhance China's contribution to international standardization activities. Strengthen the implementation and evaluation of key standards.
titlelist: Key tasks, support system optimization actions, strengthen standard system construction.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Support the innovative thinking and concepts of professional service organizations, enhance their capabilities in intellectual property, technology transfer, talent training, and investment and financing services. Build a public service platform for technology and standards, and provide services such as new technology verification, testing and certification, product quality grading, and system evaluation. Guide local industry associations, industrial parks, research institutes, and leading enterprises to jointly establish resource-sharing platforms, and open up resources such as research instruments, testing equipment, and research and development capabilities.
titlelist: Key tasks, support system optimization actions, and improvement of the public service system.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Accelerate research on security technologies related to perception, access, transmission, data, and applications. Accelerate the construction of security monitoring, early warning analysis, and response and disposal techniques for the Internet of Things (IoT), and enhance the security level of perception terminals, networks, data, and systems. Strengthen the security management of IoT cards and promote the establishment of a comprehensive lifecycle management system for IoT cards, including pre-sale risk assessment, classification registration during sales, and post-sale usage monitoring. Speed up the application and promotion of commercial cryptography technologies and products in the field of IoT, establish a cryptography application detection platform for the IoT field, and enhance the security and application level of commercial cryptography in the IoT field. Enhance the adaptability of IoT application scenarios and spectrum resource usage to ensure the security of IoT frequency usage. Relying on alliance associations, carry out the Hundred Enterprises, Thousand Products program for cultivating basic security in the IoT, establish a secure public service platform, conduct security capability assessments, and create IoT Trustworthy Products.
titlelist: Key tasks, optimization of support system actions, strengthening security support and guarantee.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Improve the statistical system of the Internet of Things industry to provide a scientific basis for evaluating the effectiveness of action plans. Continuously strengthen the quality evaluation of new industrialization demonstration bases for the Internet of Things, standardize the process management and third-party evaluation of key actions such as revealing the list and taking the lead.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve statistical and evaluation mechanisms.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Support and guide ordinary higher education institutions and vocational colleges to increase the cultivation of talent in the field of the Internet of Things, and fill the talent gap. Encourage enterprises to jointly establish laboratories and training bases with colleges and research institutions, and enhance the supply of innovative, applied, and composite talents in the Internet of Things. Promote the improvement and perfection of the occupational technical skill standard system for Internet of Things talents.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve the talent training system.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Give full play to the leading and driving role of fiscal funds, encourage local governments to establish special funds for the Internet of Things (IoT), and guide financial institutions to participate in the construction of new IoT infrastructure. Implement tax preferential policies such as additional deduction for research and development expenses to promote increased R&D investment by enterprises. Promote the integration of social capital with small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to address the financing issues of the IoT.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial and taxation support.

name: Three-Year Action Plan for the Construction of New Infrastructure for the Internet of Things (2021-2023) (MIIT Lianke [2021] No. 130) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/September 10, 2021)
content: Relying on the Belt and Road initiative, fully utilizing cooperation mechanisms such as the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), promote exchanges and cooperation in areas such as technological research and development, industrialization promotion, infrastructure construction, and talent cultivation. Support domestic Internet of Things (IoT) companies in establishing branches overseas, actively expand international cooperation channels, and enhance the level of international development.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepening international exchanges and cooperation.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 6, 2017)
content: Strengthen the research and innovation of NB-IoT technology, accelerate the research and formulation of international and domestic standards. Based on the completed NB-IoT 3GPP international standard, combined with domestic NB-IoT network deployment planning, application strategies, and industry demands, accelerate the formulation of domestic NB-IoT device, module, and other technical requirements and testing methods standards. Enhance the research on NB-IoT enhancement and evolution technology, and ensure the orderly connection with 5G massive IoT technology to guarantee the continuous evolution of NB-IoT.
titlelist: Strengthen the research on NB-IoT standards and technologies, build a complete industrial system, lead international standard research, and accelerate the implementation of NB-IoT standards domestically.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Research is conducted on key technologies such as positioning functionality, mobility management, power saving, security mechanisms, and transmission performance optimization in response to the application requirements of different vertical industries. This ensures that the NB-IoT system can provide reliable services for different businesses in different environments. Accelerate the research on the application of eSIM/soft SIM in NB-IoT networks.
titlelist: Strengthen NB-IoT standard and technology research, build a complete industrial system, carry out key technology research, and enhance NB-IoT service capabilities.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Relevant companies need to accelerate product research and development in NB-IoT dedicated chips, modules, network equipment, IoT application products, and service platforms. They should strengthen collaboration and innovation in all aspects, overcome weaknesses in modules and other areas, and build a complete industrial chain that spans all aspects of NB-IoT products. This will provide diverse products and application systems that meet market demands.
titlelist: Strengthen the research on NB-IoT standards and technologies, build a complete industrial system, promote comprehensive industrial development, and establish a sound NB-IoT complete industrial chain.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Encourage localities to adapt to local conditions, combining urban management and industrial development needs to expand new applications, models, and formats based on NB-IoT technology. Carry out NB-IoT pilot demonstrations and gradually expand the scope of application industries and fields. Through pilot demonstrations, further clarify the applicable scenarios of NB-IoT technology, strengthen interoperability among different suppliers' products, and promote the healthy development of NB-IoT technology and industry. By 2017, achieve over 20 million M2M (machine-to-machine) connections based on NB-IoT, and by 2020, the total number of connections will exceed 600 million.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, carry out pilot demonstration projects for NB-IoT applications, and promote the maturity of technology and industry.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Accelerate the application of NB-IoT technology in smart homes, wearable devices, childcare and elderly care, pet tracking, and consumer electronics. Strengthen business model innovation, enhance the supply capacity of consumer-oriented NB-IoT products, serve the diverse lives of the people, and promote information consumption.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, and drive the application of NB-IoT in personal life, promoting the development of information consumption.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Explore the application scenarios combining NB-IoT technology with industrial Internet and intelligent manufacturing, promote integrated innovation, utilize NB-IoT technology to monitor and control the production and manufacturing process, expand the application of NB-IoT technology in fields such as logistics and agriculture, and contribute to the construction of a manufacturing powerhouse.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, explore the application of NB-IoT in the industrial manufacturing sector, and serve the construction of a manufacturing powerhouse.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Encourage 'double innovation' enterprises such as shared bicycles and smart hardware to use NB-IoT technology for technical and business innovation. Basic telecommunications companies should open up and provide services in areas such as access, security, billing, business QoS guarantee, cloud platform, and big data processing, in order to reduce the usage costs for small and medium-sized enterprises and entrepreneurs, and to support the development of the 'Internet+' and 'double innovation'.
titlelist: Promote the application of NB-IoT in specific fields, gradually forming a scalable application system, encourage the application of NB-IoT in new technologies and new businesses, and support innovation and entrepreneurship.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 6, 2017)
content: Taking into account the needs of 3G, 4G, and future 5G networks, and considering the requirements of business scenarios based on NB-IoT, it is necessary to allocate the working frequency bands of the NB-IoT system reasonably. Based on the scale and demand of NB-IoT business development, proper planning, scientific allocation, and adjustment of code and resource management should be carried out.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, reasonably allocate the working frequency of the NB-IoT system, and coordinate the planning and allocation of code and resource.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Promote the establishment of NB-IoT network security management mechanisms, clarify the security responsibilities and obligations of different entities such as operators, product and service providers, and strengthen NB-IoT device management. Establish a network security system that covers the perception layer, transmission layer, and application layer. Establish and improve relevant mechanisms to strengthen the protection of user information, personal privacy, and important data.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable conditions for sustainable development, establish a sound NB-IoT network and information security guarantee system, and enhance security protection capabilities.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: Encourage the integration of smart cities, Internet Plus, and innovation-driven entrepreneurship in various regions, strengthen the integration and innovation between the information industry and vertical industries, actively support the development of NB-IoT, establish a policy system conducive to the promotion, innovation incentives, and orderly competition of NB-IoT applications, and create a favorable development environment.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, actively guide integrated innovation, and create a favorable development environment.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology/June 6, 2017)
content: Support research institutions, basic telecommunications companies, chip, module and equipment manufacturing companies, business operation companies, and other units related to the industrial chain to form an industry alliance, strengthen NB-IoT-related research, testing and verification, and industry promotion and other public services, summarize the experience of excellent pilot demonstration cases, and provide technical support for the large-scale commercial use of NB-IoT.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, organize the establishment of industry alliances, and build NB-IoT public service platforms.

name: Comprehensively promote the construction and development of the Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) (MIIT Communication Letter [2017] No. 351) (MIIT/June 6, 2017)
content: The basic telecommunications enterprises, pilot demonstration sites, local industrial and information technology authorities, and industry alliances should improve the relevant data statistics and information collection mechanisms, and timely track and understand the development trends of the NB-IoT industry.
titlelist: Optimize the policy environment for NB-IoT applications, create favorable and sustainable development conditions, improve the data statistics mechanism, and track the basic development of the NB-IoT industry.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: By 2020, a globally competitive industrial system for the Internet of Things (IoT) will have been basically formed, with an overall industry scale exceeding 1.5 trillion yuan, including perception manufacturing, network transmission, and intelligent information services. The proportion of intelligent information services will have significantly increased. The planning and layout of IoT perception facilities will be promoted, and the number of public network M2M connections will exceed 1.7 billion. The level of IoT technology research and development and innovation capabilities will have significantly improved, and a preliminary standard system adapted to industrial development will have been formed. The scale application of IoT will continue to expand, and the ubiquitous security IoT system will have basically taken shape. - Technological innovation: A technology innovation system combining industry, academia, and research will have been basically formed. Enterprises' research and development investment will continue to increase. Significant breakthroughs will have been made in IoT architecture, perception technology, operating systems, and security technology. Key technologies in the fields of network communication and information processing will have reached international advanced levels, and the number of core patents granted will have significantly increased. - Standard improvement: More than 200 national and industry standards will have been researched and formulated. The standard system to meet the needs of large-scale IoT applications and industrialization will gradually improve. The basic common standards, key technology standards, and key application standards of IoT will have been established. China's influence in the international IoT standard field will gradually increase. - Application promotion: A number of integrated application solutions will be promoted in industries such as industrial manufacturing and modern agriculture, as well as in consumer sectors such as smart homes and health services. A batch of large-scale characteristic applications will be formed. In the construction and management of smart cities, cross-domain data opening and sharing mechanisms will be established, and open-loop applications of IoT will be developed. - Industrial upgrading: Ten characteristic industrial agglomeration areas will be built. About 200 backbone enterprises with an output value exceeding 1 billion yuan will be cultivated and developed, as well as a group of small and medium-sized enterprises and innovation carriers with specialization, expertise, and novelty. A number of public service platforms with wide coverage and strong support capabilities will be constructed to build a globally competitive industrial system. - Security guarantee: Significant breakthroughs will be made in the research and development of core IoT security technologies and dedicated security products, and a number of national and industry standards will be formulated. Mechanisms such as IoT security evaluation, risk assessment, security prevention, and emergency response will be established, greatly enhancing the security capabilities of IoT infrastructure, major systems, and important information.
titlelist: Development ideas and goals, development goals.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Accelerate the construction of a collaborative innovation system. Take enterprises as the main body and accelerate the construction of an innovation system that combines government, industry, academia, research, and application. Coordinate the development of Internet of Things (IoT) technology, technology transfer, product manufacturing, and application deployment, fully mobilize various innovation resources, create a batch of industry-oriented innovation centers, key laboratories, and other integrated innovation carriers, and strengthen research and development and collaborative innovation. Continue to support the development of various IoT industries and technology alliances, guide alliances to strengthen cooperation and resource sharing, strengthen intellectual property management for technology transfer and diffusion purposes, promote the integration of supply and demand, and effectively integrate collaborative innovation in the industrial chain. Support enterprises in establishing IoT research and development institutions and laboratories to enhance innovation capabilities and levels. Encourage enterprises to collaborate with universities and scientific research institutions, and facilitate the transformation of scientific research achievements. Integrate and utilize international innovation resources, support and encourage enterprises to carry out cross-border mergers and acquisitions, establish joint ventures with foreign companies for joint development, introduce high-end talents, and achieve high-level and high-starting-point innovation. Breakthrough in key core technologies. Research on low-power processor technology and integrated circuit design processes for IoT applications, carry out research and development of high-performance, low-cost, integrated, miniaturized, and low-power intelligent sensor technologies and products for key areas, enhance the technological level in the fields of intelligent sensor design, manufacturing, packaging and integration, multi-sensor integration and data fusion, and reliability. Research on service-oriented IoT network architecture, communication technology, and networking intelligent transmission technology, accelerate the development of low-power wide area network technologies such as NB-IoT and network virtualization technology. Research on intelligent information processing technologies such as IoT sensing data and knowledge representation, intelligent decision-making, cross-platform and capability open processing, and open public data services, support the research and industrialization of IoT operating systems and data sharing service platforms, further improve basic functional components, application development environments, and peripheral modules. Develop a secure and controllable identification management system that supports multiple applications. Strengthen the integration and innovation of IoT with mobile Internet, cloud computing, big data, and other fields, focus on the research and development of intelligent information service systems and key technologies that meet the needs of IoT services. Strengthen the accumulation and layout of various intellectual property rights. Special Column 1: Key Technology Breakthrough Project.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the system of technological innovation.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Core sensitive components: sensitive materials such as experimental biological materials, graphene, and special functional ceramics, to seize the first-mover advantage in the field of sensitive materials; strengthen the research on the sensitive mechanism, structure, and packaging process of silicon-based sensors, and accelerate the research and industrialization of various sensitive devices. Sensor integration, miniaturization, and low power consumption: carry out research on technology and processes such as integrating similar and different types of sensors, supporting circuits, and sensitive components. Support the formation of different types of sensitive chips based on MEMS processes and thin film process technology, and carry out packaging and packaging process innovation for various different structural forms. Support the development of modular devices with external energy self-collection, power-off sleep self-starting, and energy storage and power control. Key application areas: support the research and development of high-performance sensors and application technologies such as inertia, pressure, magnetic force, acceleration, light, image, temperature and humidity, distance, and actively overcome new types of sensor products.
titlelist: The main tasks are to improve the technology innovation system and sensor technology.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Continuously track and study the evolution trend of the Internet of Things architecture, actively promote interconnection and standardization between different IoT network architectures, with a focus on supporting trusted system architecture and interoperability technology research in network communication and data sharing. Strengthen research on resource abstraction, resource access, semantic technology, as well as component technology for key entities, interface protocols, and general capabilities in the Internet of Things.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the system of technological innovation and the common technology architecture.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: User interactive operating system: Promote the porting of mobile terminal operating systems to IoT terminals, with a focus on supporting the research and development of IoT operating systems in key areas such as smart homes and wearable devices. Real-time operating system: Focus on supporting the research and development of IoT operating systems in key areas such as industrial control, aerospace, etc., and develop various peripheral modules such as file systems and network protocol stacks that adapt to the characteristics of the IoT, as well as various development interfaces and tools. Support enterprises in launching open-source operating systems and opening up kernel development documents, and encourage users to engage in secondary development of the operating system.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the technical innovation system and operating system.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Focus on mobile terminals, with emphasis on supporting research on human-computer interaction, micro-intelligent sensors, integrated MEMS sensors, ultra-high frequency or microwave RFID, and fusion communication modules suitable for mobile terminals. Focus on research on operating systems, data sharing service platforms, and other technologies for the integration of the Internet of Things. Breakthrough key technologies in data collection and exchange, compression, indexing, storage, and multidimensional query of massive high-frequency data. Develop distributed basic software platforms for big data stream computing and real-time in-memory computing. Combine with typical application scenarios such as industry, intelligent transportation, and smart cities to break through key technologies in IoT data analysis, mining, and visualization, and form specialized application software products and services.
titlelist: The main tasks include improving the technological innovation system and integrating key technologies of the Internet of Things, mobile internet, and big data.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Improve standardized top-level design. Establish and improve the standard system for the Internet of Things, and publish guidelines for the standardization of the Internet of Things. Further promote the coordinated development of national standards, industry standards, and group standards for the Internet of Things, with enterprises as the main body for standard formulation, actively incorporating innovative achievements into international standards, accelerating the construction of technical standard testing and verification environments, and improving standardized information services. Strengthen the formulation of key common technology standards. Accelerate the formulation of perception technology and equipment standards such as sensors, instruments, radio frequency identification, multimedia collection, and geographic coordinate positioning. Organize the formulation of network technology standards such as wireless sensor networks, low-power wide area networks, network virtualization, and heterogeneous network integration. Formulate information processing standards such as operating systems, middleware, data management and exchange, data analysis and mining, and service support. Formulate basic common standards such as Internet of Things identification and resolution, network and information security, reference models and evaluation tests. Promote the development of industry application standards. Vigorously carry out the formulation of urgently needed application standards for industries such as connected vehicles, health services, and smart homes, and continue to promote standardization work in application areas such as industry, agriculture, public safety, transportation, and environmental protection. Strengthen organization and coordination, establish a joint working mechanism for standard formulation, experimental verification, and application promotion, strengthen information exchange and sharing, promote the joint formulation of cross-industry standards by standardization organizations, and encourage the development of group standards. Support alliances and leading enterprises in formulating industry application standards.
titlelist: The main task is to build a comprehensive standard system.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Promote the integration of the Internet of Things (IoT) and the manufacturing industry. Digitize, network, and intelligentize key processes such as manufacturing units, production lines, workshops, and factory construction to enable deep perception, dynamic monitoring, data aggregation, and intelligent decision-making throughout the entire production process, industry chain, and product lifecycle. Through real-time perception and advanced modeling analysis of on-site industrial data, intelligent decision-making and control can be achieved. Improve industrial cloud and intelligent service platforms, enhance the development and utilization of industrial big data, realize personalized customization, intelligent production, networked collaboration, and service-oriented transformation of the industrial system, accelerate pilot demonstrations of smart manufacturing, and extensively deploy the Internet of Things and Industrial Internet in discrete and process manufacturing industries, forming a new cross-border integrated manufacturing ecosystem. Accelerate the deep integration of the Internet of Things with various industries. Organize and implement major application demonstration projects in important fields such as agriculture, logistics, energy, environmental protection, and healthcare, promote the integration and innovation of the Internet of Things, and support its large-scale application. Implement regional pilot projects for agricultural IoT, promote the application of agricultural IoT, and improve the level of agricultural intelligence and precision. Deepen the large-scale application of the Internet of Things in logistics fields such as warehousing, transportation, distribution, and ports, support multimodal transportation, and build an intelligent and efficient logistics system. Increase the promotion and application of the Internet of Things in pollution source monitoring, ecological environment monitoring, and other aspects to improve pollution control and environmental protection. Deepen the application of the Internet of Things in energy production, transmission, storage, consumption, and other aspects such as power, oil and gas, and public building energy efficiency, enhance the level of energy management intelligence and refinement, and improve energy utilization efficiency. Promote the application of the Internet of Things technology in fields such as pharmaceutical circulation and use, patient care, and electronic medical record management, actively promote telemedicine, clinical data application demonstrations, and other medical applications. Promote innovation in the application of the Internet of Things in the consumer sector. Encourage innovation in IoT technology, business, and models, actively cultivate new models and formats, and promote rapid growth in applications such as connected cars, smart homes, and health services in the consumer sector. Strengthen innovation and application demonstrations of connected car technology, develop applications such as autonomous driving, safety and energy saving, and location-based services in connected cars. Promote the large-scale development of smart home applications such as home security, smart appliance control, and home environment management, and create a thriving smart home ecosystem. Develop IoT applications for community health services, carry out remote health management based on smart wearable devices, elderly care, and other health services, and promote innovative applications and service development of big health data. Deepen the application of the Internet of Things in the field of smart cities. Promote the planning and layout of IoT sensing facilities, combine municipal facilities, communication network facilities, and industry facility construction, and deploy various IoT sensing facilities such as video collection terminals, RFID tags, multiple types of barcodes, and composite sensor nodes. Deepen the application of the Internet of Things in key areas such as underground pipe network monitoring, fire facility management, urban power balance management, water resource management, urban traffic management, e-government, hazardous chemical management, and energy conservation and environmental protection. Establish a city-level IoT access management and data aggregation platform, promote unified access, centralized management, and shared use of sensing devices. Establish a data open mechanism, formulate a government data sharing and open catalog, promote the opening of data resources to society, encourage and guide enterprises, industry associations, and others to open and trade data resources, and deepen the integration and utilization of government and social data. Support the establishment of data sharing service platforms to provide intelligent information services for the public, industries, and city management. Column 2: Key field application demonstration projects.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the large-scale application of the Internet of Things.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: In response to the structural reform of the supply side and the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry, the development of cyber-physical systems and industrial internet is promoted to facilitate the transformation of production and operation management towards intelligence, refinement, and networking. Through technologies such as RFID, electronic identification of relevant production materials is implemented to achieve intelligent management of production processes and supply chains. Sensor technologies are utilized to enhance real-time collection and data analysis of production status information, thereby improving efficiency and quality, promoting safety production, and energy conservation. By embedding capabilities such as sensing, positioning, and identification in products, remote maintenance of products is realized, facilitating the transformation of manufacturing industry towards service-oriented.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the large-scale application of the Internet of Things and intelligent manufacturing.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: To meet the needs of intelligent agricultural production and refined management of agricultural product circulation, extensive demonstrations of agricultural Internet of Things applications are being carried out. This includes implementing demonstration projects for facility agriculture and precision cultivation of field crops based on Internet of Things technology, intelligent horticultural planting, efficient livestock and poultry farming, quality and safety traceability of agricultural by-products, regulation of grain and economic crop storage and transportation, and agricultural input services. These applications aim to promote the development of modern agricultural management methods and organizational forms, and enhance the level of agricultural modernization in China.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the large-scale application of the Internet of Things and smart agriculture.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: To meet the public's demands for home safety, comfort, and versatility, we are carrying out applications such as smart elderly care, remote medical care and health management, childcare, home security, smart metering for water, electricity, and gas, home air purification, smart control of household appliances, and household robots. These applications aim to improve people's quality of life. By standardizing underlying communication technologies, device interconnectivity, and application interactions through demonstrations, we promote interoperability among products from different manufacturers, driving breakthroughs in smart home technology and products as a whole.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the large-scale application of the Internet of Things and smart homes.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Promote the intelligent application of traffic management and services, carry out application demonstrations of intelligent maritime services, urban intelligent transportation, automotive electronic identification, intelligent management of electric bicycles, passenger transportation and intelligent public transportation systems, etc., to enhance command and dispatch, traffic control, and information service capabilities. Carry out demonstrations of new technologies in the field of connected vehicles, including autonomous driving, safety and energy conservation, emergency rescue, collision prevention, illegal vehicle inspection and seizure, and crackdown on vehicle-related crimes.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, intelligent transportation, and vehicle networking.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Promote the integration of technologies such as the Internet of Things and big data with modern medical management services, and carry out application demonstrations of the Internet of Things in drug circulation and use, patient care, electronic medical record management, remote diagnosis, remote medical education, remote surgical guidance, and electronic health records. Actively promote the medical model of community healthcare combined with tertiary hospitals. Utilize Internet of Things technology to achieve traceability of medical waste, rapid tracking and positioning of problematic drugs, and reduce regulatory costs. Establish a clinical data application center and carry out precise medical applications based on Internet of Things intelligent sensing and big data analysis. Carry out remote health management using smart wearable devices, elderly care, and other health service applications, and promote the innovation and development of health big data applications and services.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the large-scale application of the Internet of Things, smart healthcare, and elderly care.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Promote the application of the Internet of Things in the fields of pollution source monitoring and ecological environment monitoring, and carry out applications such as waste supervision, comprehensive environmental governance, water quality monitoring, air quality monitoring, pollution source pollution control facility condition monitoring, import waste raw material monitoring, and forestry resource security monitoring. Promote the application of the Internet of Things in the production, transmission, storage, and consumption of energy such as electricity and oil and gas, and improve the intelligence and refinement level of energy management. Establish a city-level building energy consumption monitoring and service platform to monitor the energy consumption of public buildings and large-scale buildings, and achieve intelligent control and fine management of building energy use. Encourage the establishment of energy management platforms to provide contract energy management services for large industrial parks.
titlelist: The main tasks are to promote the large-scale application of the Internet of Things and to promote smart energy conservation and environmental protection.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Build an integrated public service platform for the Internet of Things. Coordinate and integrate the existing public service resources related to the Internet of Things industry in various regions and industries, guide various investments to participate in the construction of public service capabilities for the Internet of Things, and form a public service platform system that promotes resource sharing and complementary advantages. Relying on existing laboratories, engineering centers, enterprise technology centers, university science and technology parks, and other innovative carriers, integrate innovative resources, strengthen open source community construction, promote resource flow and open sharing, and provide public technical services such as Internet of Things technology research and development, identification resolution, standard testing, inspection, and testing. Give full play to the role of various Internet of Things alliances, strengthen the coordination of the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain, promote the connection between supply and demand and the transformation of achievements. Encourage leading enterprises to strengthen the layout of the industrial ecosystem, provide third-party development capabilities and solutions, and promote the coordinated development of small and medium-sized enterprises in the Internet of Things. Continue to promote the construction of comprehensive public service platforms such as science and technology finance, investment and financing guarantee, policy consultation, intellectual property services, achievement transformation, and talent training, and identify a batch of demonstration platforms for public services in the Internet of Things. Explore the establishment of a commercial model for multi-party participation and win-win cooperation in public service platforms, promote the market-oriented and professional operation of public service platforms, achieve self-generation of platforms, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of public services. Strengthen statistics monitoring and development evaluation of the Internet of Things. Establish a statistics monitoring platform for the Internet of Things and improve the statistical indicator system. Strengthen the analysis of industrial operations, grasp the laws of industrial development, optimize industrial-related policies, and guide and coordinate the development of the national Internet of Things. Establish an evaluation system for the development of the Internet of Things, analyze and evaluate the development of the Internet of Things industry in various regions, and provide support for promoting the orderly and healthy development of the Internet of Things industry.
titlelist: The main task is to improve the public service system.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Promote the research and industrialization of key security technologies. Guide information security companies to cooperate with IoT technology research and application companies, research institutions, and universities, strengthen the research and development of key technologies and products such as IoT architecture security, heterogeneous network security, data security, and personal information security. Strengthen the formulation, verification, and implementation of security standards, promote the transformation and industrialization of security technology achievements, and meet the requirements of IoT technology and product service guarantee in public safety systems such as safety production, disaster prevention and reduction, public security prevention and control, and emergency response. Establish a sound security guarantee system. Strengthen the construction of IoT security technology service platforms and vigorously develop third-party security assessment and guarantee services. Establish a sound IoT security protection system and carry out security evaluation and assessment of IoT products and systems. For IoT applications related to public safety and infrastructure in industries such as industry, energy, electricity, and transportation, strengthen the testing and evaluation of their system solutions, core equipment, and operation services, and research and formulate security guarantee mechanisms of early detection, defense, and quick recovery to ensure the security and controllability of important systems. For IoT applications in healthcare, elderly care, and home automation, strengthen the evaluation, assessment, and supervision of related products and services, and enhance personal information protection.
titlelist: The main task is to enhance security capabilities.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Give full play to the role of the inter-ministerial joint conference system for the development of the Internet of Things, coordinate and coordinate the overall situation between departments, industries, regions, and military-civilian integration, as well as the overall coordination of technology research and development, standard formulation, industrial development, application promotion, and security guarantee, forming a working pattern of industry chain support, regional division of labor cooperation, resource sharing, and collaborative advancement. Give full play to the think tank role of the expert advisory committee for the development of the Internet of Things, and strengthen research on major policies and major issues.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen overall coordination.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Strengthen policy formulation and overall coordination, break through institutional and mechanistic barriers to the deep integration of the Internet of Things with industries, and support innovative development of IoT applications such as connected vehicles and health services. Promote cross-departmental opening, sharing, and collaboration of IoT data resources, develop open-loop applications for the Internet of Things, and advance the construction of smart cities. Conduct research on policies and regulations for data security and personal information protection. Reasonably plan and allocate resources such as frequencies, identifiers, and codes to promote the construction of IoT infrastructure. Increase efforts to promote, implement, and popularize IoT standards, and strengthen the protection and utilization of intellectual property rights.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, improve and perfect policies and regulations.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Actively promote the exchange and cooperation of Internet of Things (IoT) technology. Relying on intergovernmental dialogue mechanisms, deepen cooperation in IoT standards, public service platforms, and application demonstrations. Support domestic enterprises and international leading enterprises in strengthening the research and development cooperation of key IoT technologies and products, and jointly establish an international industrial technology alliance.
