Support Chinese IoT enterprises in going global, encourage enterprises to establish research and development institutions overseas, actively participate in the formulation of international standards, and seize the commanding heights of international competition.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen international cooperation.

name: Development Plan for the Internet of Things in the Information and Communication Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Regulation [2016] No. 424) (MIIT/December 18, 2016)
content: Develop a comprehensive and multi-level talent training and service system for the Internet of Things. Support universities and research institutes in strengthening interdisciplinary integration, enhancing the construction of IoT disciplines, and cultivating versatile professionals in the field of IoT. Support the establishment of IoT training bases, encourage collaboration between universities and enterprises, leverage the role of professional societies and associations, and enhance IoT skills and business training. Relying on national science and technology programs, demonstration projects, and international cooperation, cultivate high-level and leading talents, and accelerate the introduction of international high-end talents. Establish a mechanism for the mobility of high-end talents, promote rational talent mobility, and build specialized enterprise management teams.
titlelist: Enhance measures to ensure and strengthen the construction of the talent team.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Developing the connected car industry is beneficial for enhancing the level of car networking and intelligence, achieving autonomous driving, developing intelligent transportation, promoting information consumption, and is of great significance to China's supply-side structural reform, the construction of a manufacturing and network power, and achieving high-quality development. Currently, China's connected car industry has entered the fast lane, with increasingly active technological innovation, vigorous development of new applications, and continuous expansion of the industry scale. However, there are also issues that need to be addressed, such as breakthroughs in key core technologies, improvement of the industry ecosystem, and the need for sound policies and regulations. In order to further promote the sustained and healthy development of the industry, this action plan is formulated.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Make full use of various innovative resources, accelerate the development and application of key components and systems for intelligent connected vehicles, and focus on breakthroughs in core technologies such as complex environment perception for intelligent connected vehicles, new electronic and electrical architectures, and vehicle platform line control. Accelerate the joint development and transformation of perception devices such as in-vehicle vision systems, laser/millimeter-wave radar, multi-domain controllers, and inertial navigation. Accelerate the research and development of key components such as intelligent in-vehicle terminals and automotive-grade chips, and promote the industrial application of new generation artificial intelligence, high-precision positioning, and dynamic mapping technologies in intelligent connected vehicles. Accelerate the development and industrialization of high-performance vehicle intelligent driving, line control dynamics, line control steering, and electronic stability systems, achieving precise, coordinated, and reliable control of vehicles.
titlelist: Breakthrough key technologies, promote industrial development, accelerate the key core technology research and development of intelligent connected vehicles.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Strongly support the research and industrialization of key wireless communication technologies such as LTE-V2X and 5G-V2X. Accelerate the application of technologies such as multi-access edge computing, network function virtualization, and 5G network slicing in industries, build a system architecture that combines communication and computing, enhance the agility of multi-access edge computing, and achieve more business innovation. Accelerate the deployment and product development of V2X computing platforms, gradually build a multi-level distributed V2X computing platform system consisting of center, region, edge, and terminal, and meet the demands of V2X services.
titlelist: Breakthrough key technologies, promote industrial development, strengthen research and development and industrialization of wireless communication technology.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Give full play to the fundamental, guiding, and regulatory role of the standard system in the industrial ecology of the Internet of Vehicles, accelerate the implementation of the Guidelines for the Construction of the National Standard System for the Internet of Vehicles Industry, and timely update and supplement it according to the needs of industry development. Accelerate the formulation and improvement of basic general, technical, testing and evaluation, service specification, and safety certification standards, and increase the effective supply of standards. Encourage the simultaneous promotion of international standardization of key technologies to lead technological development and improvement through standards. Accelerate the revision of standards related to basic general intelligent connected vehicles, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), autonomous driving, information security, and networked functions, and conduct research and formulation of standards and specifications for automatic driving testing and evaluation with testing scenarios as the starting point and whole vehicle functional evaluation as the goal. Carry out research and standard formulation for 5G-V2X technology development and standardization, and promote the integration innovation and standard research of multi-access edge computing and LTE-V2X technology. Strengthen the connection with relevant infrastructure standards such as smart city construction, and accelerate the research and formulation of technical requirements and testing methods for base station equipment, roadside units, and onboard terminal devices. Promote the formulation of end-to-end interconnection standards between Internet of Vehicles service platforms and traffic control information service platforms. Establish interconnection and data exchange standards between electric vehicles, charging piles, and platforms. Promote the research and formulation of relevant standards for wireless communication security in the Internet of Vehicles, Internet of Vehicles platforms and application security, data security, and user personal information protection.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing, verification, and demonstration applications, and strengthen the standard system.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Regulations on the management of the 5905-5925MHz frequency band for the deployment of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) direct communication. Frequency usage permits will be issued in a timely manner based on the technological and industrial development situation and frequency applications from relevant units. Promote research on the frequency requirements for 5G-V2X. Strengthen research on LTE-V2X infrastructure operation qualifications and Connected Vehicle business qualifications.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing, verification, and demonstration applications, and accelerate frequency and business licensing verification.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Build an intelligent connected vehicle testing and evaluation system, improve the testing methods and standards for individual technologies and whole vehicle products, and comprehensively enhance testing and verification capabilities. Strengthen the construction of testing demonstration zones, promote the standardization of testing and the sharing of databases. Promote the construction of a Chinese road traffic scenario library to provide basic support for product development testing, safety assessment, and functional evaluation. Expand the scope of public road testing for intelligent connected vehicles and explore pilot testing on highways. Improve the technical testing and verification of onboard terminals, roadside units, and other devices in different electromagnetic environments, build a vehicle-to-vehicle cloud platform testing and verification system, and enhance relevant testing and verification capabilities. Study the requirements for electromagnetic environment protection in vehicle-to-vehicle communication and improve the management methods for the licensing of wireless communication devices for vehicles. Promote the development of simulation testing, road test testing, and other technologies to form comprehensive experimental verification capabilities for laboratories, closed roads, semi-closed roads, and open roads.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing and verification, and demonstrate application, promote testing and verification.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Strengthen cooperation with the Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Transport, and other departments, as well as local governments, encourage participation from all parties in the industrial chain, carry out testing and verification in semi-open areas and public roads, ensure the reliability, compatibility, and security of communication between in-vehicle terminals, roadside units, and cloud platforms, gradually complete end-to-end technical verification and interoperability testing. Demonstrate applications of autonomous driving commuting, intelligent logistics distribution, and smart sanitation in airports, ports, express bus lanes, and industrial parks. Promote regional demonstration applications in Shanghai, Beijing-Hebei, Chongqing, Wuxi, Hangzhou, Wuhan, Changchun, Guangzhou, and Changsha, support the application of the Internet of Vehicles in the Beijing Winter Olympics and Xiong'an New Area. Build a national-level pilot zone for the Internet of Vehicles, continuously improve the level of intelligent traffic management and residents' travel service experience.
titlelist: Improve the standard system, promote testing, verification, and demonstration applications, and promote demonstration applications.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Promote the transformation and upgrade of LTE networks to meet the large-scale application of connected vehicles. Improve the coverage level of LTE-V2X networks on major highways and some main roads in cities, refine the data access specifications of roadside units, enhance the integration and access capabilities of roadside units with road infrastructure and intelligent control facilities, and promote the organic combination of LTE-V2X network upgrades and roadside unit deployment. Establish 5G-V2X demonstration application networks in key areas and key road sections, providing wireless communication services with ultra-low latency, ultra-high reliability, and ultra-large bandwidth. Digitally transform and construct road infrastructure and traffic sign identification in stages and in specific areas, accelerate the deployment of narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) networks at key road nodes such as bridges and tunnels.
titlelist: Cooperation and joint construction, promoting the improvement of the infrastructure of the connected car industry, and improving communication network facilities.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Promote the interconnection of various types of vehicle networking platforms, promote the interaction and data sharing of intelligent connected vehicles, road infrastructure, communication base stations, vehicle networking platforms, and application services, and establish a market mechanism for data utilization and maintenance to ensure the safe and efficient operation of vehicles. Encourage the construction of cross-industry and cross-department comprehensive big data and cloud platforms to support the scale development and continuous innovation of vehicle networking applications.
titlelist: Cooperation and joint construction, promoting the improvement of the infrastructure of the connected car industry, promoting the construction and management of big data and cloud platforms.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Promote the deep integration of network communication technology, artificial intelligence technology, and road traffic infrastructure to provide necessary conditions for the application of new technologies such as connected vehicles and autonomous driving. Deploy edge computing capabilities for typical scenarios and hotspots, and build a low-latency, high-bandwidth, and high-computing power vehicle-road cooperative environment. Support the construction of facilities such as the Beidou satellite navigation system and differential base stations to enhance the scale application level of high-precision spatiotemporal services for vehicles and meet the high-precision positioning and navigation needs of vehicles. Support the construction of intelligent infrastructure environments that integrate sensing, communication, and computing capabilities on certain highways and major roads in cities.
titlelist: Cooperation and joint construction, promoting the improvement of the Internet of Vehicles industry infrastructure, and building intelligent road infrastructure.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Encourage telecommunications operators to launch preferential tariffs and other incentive measures, and vigorously develop connected car users. Support automobile companies in installing connected car information service terminals, and increase the adoption rate of driving assistance systems in new vehicles. Support public buses, large trucks, taxis, and ride-hailing vehicles to improve their connectivity rates.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the increase in market penetration rate, and expand the scale of connected car users.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Develop innovative applications such as smart travel, road rescue, and data services for passenger vehicles, improve comprehensive information services and remote monitoring systems for various commercial vehicles, promote traffic services in areas such as public security traffic management, commercial transportation vehicle dispatching, and road transportation supervision, and develop new formats such as shared cars. Innovate business models and promote the integrated development of the connected car industry with smart tourism and smart business.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and develop comprehensive information services.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Develop real-time online monitoring systems and big data analysis capabilities for electric vehicles, achieving goals such as charging warning, optimizing charging and battery swapping scheduling, and improving charging and battery swapping efficiency. Support strengthening the monitoring of core components such as electric vehicle batteries, encourage the identification, classification, and sequential utilization of retired batteries. Expand the internet of things applications for electric vehicles, promote interconnection and data exchange between electric vehicles, charging stations, charging service platforms, power battery traceability systems, and online monitoring platforms, realizing safe management throughout the lifecycle of electric vehicles and improving the safety level of electric vehicles.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and expand the application of electric vehicle networking.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Promote the collaborative interaction of people-vehicle-road-cloud based on LTE-V2X, 5G-V2X, and other technologies, actively carry out applications in traffic safety and energy efficiency. When the relevant technologies, products, and commercial operating conditions are mature, promote the large-scale application of traffic incident warning, accident reporting, traffic control, and other vehicle-road interaction information services. Promote the application of accident warning and collaborative control technology based on vehicle-vehicle/vehicle-human communication, enhance the ability of traffic safety and congestion proactive control. Promote the application of vehicle-road communication technology in vehicles and road traffic infrastructure, improve the level of traffic safety. Promote the application of driving strategy guidance for different road conditions, highway truck platooning, and other applications to improve traffic efficiency.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and advance the application of traffic safety and energy efficiency technologies.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Establish a network-based integrated system for car design, manufacturing, and service, and build an intelligent connected car data management system. Through the Internet of Vehicles, collect, analyze, and utilize vehicle operation data to create diverse application services and system management, providing assurance for safe vehicle operation. Promote precise marketing and promotion of vehicles, customized maintenance services, personalized insurance packages, transparent repair services, and differentiated car usage experiences, achieving large-scale application of personalized car services based on big data platforms. Utilize Internet of Vehicles technology to enhance vehicle recycling and recycling levels.
titlelist: Develop comprehensive applications, promote the improvement of market penetration rate, and create a full lifecycle service for automobiles.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: With a focus on the operational safety, network security, and data security of products and systems, clarify the responsibilities of relevant parties and conduct regular security supervision and inspections. Improve the security management work of event reporting, emergency response, and responsibility determination for the network and data security of connected vehicles.
titlelist: Integrating technology and management, promoting the improvement of the security guarantee system, and establishing a sound security management system.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Key breakthroughs in the core technology research and development of functional safety, network security, and data security in the industry, supporting the research and development of a series of security products such as security protection, vulnerability mining, intrusion detection, and situational awareness. Urging enterprises to strengthen network security protection and data security protection, establish a comprehensive security detection and evaluation system for intelligent connected vehicles, wireless communication networks, vehicle-to-vehicle data, and networks, and conduct security capability assessments.
titlelist: Integrating technology management to promote the improvement of the security guarantee system and enhance security protection capabilities.

name: Action Plan for the Development of Connected Vehicles (Intelligent Connected Vehicles) Industry (MIIT Science [2018] No. 283) (MIIT/December 25, 2018)
content: Enhance the technical support capability for industrial security, focus on improving the level of hazard investigation, risk detection, and emergency response, and build security platforms such as monitoring and early warning, threat analysis, risk assessment, testing and verification, and data security. Promote enterprises to increase security investment, innovate security operation and maintenance, and consulting service models, and enhance the industry's security guarantee service capability.
titlelist: Integrating technology management to promote the improvement of the security guarantee system, and promoting the construction of security technology means.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Accurately grasp the evolution trend of global mobile Internet of Things (IoT) technology standards and industrial patterns, promote the migration and transformation of 2G/3G IoT services, establish a comprehensive ecosystem for the coordinated development of Narrowband IoT (NB-IoT), 4G (including LTE-Cat1, i.e. Category 1 of 4G networks), and 5G mobile IoT. Based on deepening the coverage of 4G networks and accelerating the construction of 5G networks, use NB-IoT to meet the requirements of most low-rate scenarios, use LTE-Cat1 (referred to as Cat1 below) to meet the requirements of medium-rate IoT and voice, and use 5G technology to meet the requirements of higher-rate and low-latency networking. By the end of 2020, NB-IoT networks will achieve widespread coverage in urban areas at the county level and above, with deep coverage in key areas. The number of mobile IoT connections will reach 1.2 billion. Promote the convergence of NB-IoT module prices with 2G modules, and guide the migration of new IoT terminals to NB-IoT and Cat1. Build a number of benchmark projects and million-scale application scenarios for NB-IoT applications.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Accelerate the construction of 5G networks, continue to deepen the coverage of 4G networks, and support the development of Cat1. Further increase the deployment of NB-IoT networks, construct NB-IoT base stations as needed, achieve universal coverage in county-level and above urban areas, and achieve deep coverage in application scenarios such as indoor areas, transportation networks, underground pipe networks, and modern agricultural demonstration areas. Focus on network operation, monitoring, optimization, and other work to improve network service levels.
titlelist: Key task, accelerate the construction of mobile Internet of Things networks.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Promote the inclusion of NB-IoT standards into the ITU IMT-2020 5G standards; promote the development and implementation of technical standards and interoperability standards for mobile IoT terminals, platforms, and other key areas such as smart homes, smart agriculture, industrial manufacturing, energy metering, fire alarms, logistics tracking, and financial payments, in order to enhance the standardization level of industry applications.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthen research on mobile Internet of Things standards and technologies, and formulate standards for the integration of mobile Internet of Things with vertical industries.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Focusing on different vertical industry application environments and business needs, we will strengthen research on emerging key technologies such as network slicing, edge computing, high-precision positioning, intelligent sensing, secure chips, miniaturized low-power intelligent instruments, and cross-domain collaboration, and carry out related experiments.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen the research on mobile Internet of Things standards and technologies, and carry out research on key technologies of mobile Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Promote the innovative development of the Internet of Things (IoT) in three major directions: industrial digitization, governance intelligence, and smart living. In terms of industrial digitization, deepen the application of IoT in areas such as industrial manufacturing, warehousing and logistics, smart agriculture, and smart healthcare, promote device connectivity and data collection, and improve production efficiency. In terms of governance intelligence, focus on areas such as energy metering, fire detection, public facility management, and environmental monitoring to enhance public service capabilities, strengthen urban resilience, and improve the ability to respond to emergencies. In terms of smart living, promote the application of IoT technology in products such as smart homes, wearable devices, childcare and elderly care, and pet tracking.
titlelist: Key tasks, enhance the breadth and depth of mobile Internet of Things applications, promote the development of mobile Internet of Things applications.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Build a mobile Internet of Things resource library, carry out the collection and storage of innovative and practical application cases, and provide services such as communication promotion and matchmaking for investment and financing needs. Select a group of best cases from the resource library to create a benchmark project for the mobile Internet of Things, and drive the innovative development of million-level connected application scenarios through the benchmark project. Further expand the applicable scenarios of mobile Internet of Things technology, and explore new products, new formats, and new models based on mobile Internet of Things technology.
titlelist: Key tasks, enhance the breadth and depth of mobile Internet of Things applications, and create a benchmark project for mobile Internet of Things.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Encourage the establishment of special support and innovation funds in various regions to support the research and development of NB-IoT and Cat1 dedicated chips, modules, devices, and other products, improve chip research and development and manufacturing capabilities, and meet the demand for large-scale shipments; build a complete NB-IoT industry chain, provide diversified products and application systems that meet market demand; further reduce the cost of NB-IoT modules, reaching the same level as 2G modules by 2020; increase the research and development of Cat1 chips and modules, promote the reduction of module costs, and promote large-scale applications.
titlelist: Key tasks: building a high-quality industrial development system, and improving the mobile Internet of Things industry chain.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Support the construction of mobile Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity management platforms for basic telecommunications enterprises, strengthen network capacity openness, support rapid access of IoT sensing devices, and support massive concurrent application scenarios; guide industry application enterprises to build vertically integrated intelligent equipment, intelligent equipment and data management, and intelligent system operation and maintenance application platforms, gradually forming a mobile IoT platform system, further reducing the development cost and complexity of mobile IoT devices, and meeting the needs of complex application scenarios. Encourage capable enterprises to establish open laboratories to provide testing, verification, and development support services for small and medium-sized enterprises.
titlelist: Key tasks, building a high-quality industrial development system, accelerating the construction of a service platform for cloud-edge collaboration.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Give full play to the rapid and flexible response mechanism and cross-industry advantage resource capabilities of mobile communication resale enterprises, carry out innovative mobile Internet of Things business in vertical industry application fields such as industrial Internet and connected vehicles, and promote the integrated development with the real economy.
titlelist: Key tasks: Building a high-quality industrial development system to support mobile communication resale enterprises in carrying out mobile Internet of Things (IoT) business.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Establish a network security management mechanism for the mobile Internet of Things, clarifying the security responsibilities and obligations of different entities such as operating enterprises, product providers, and service providers. Strengthen the security testing of mobile Internet of Things network facilities and enhance the guidance and norms for collecting, reporting, and fixing network security vulnerabilities. Support the core technology research and development of network security through pilot demonstrations, industrial Internet innovation and development projects, etc. Conduct security evaluations of key products in the mobile Internet of Things, accelerating the development of products, services, and solutions that match the characteristics and security requirements of the mobile Internet of Things scenarios. Strengthen the protection of mobile Internet of Things user information, personal privacy, and important data.
titlelist: Key tasks: Establish and improve the security guarantee system for the Internet of Things (IoT) and strengthen the security protection and data protection of the mobile IoT.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Establish a framework for mobile Internet of Things (IoT) security standards, and develop a series of graded and classified security management standards for key components such as IoT cards, terminals, and gateways. Encourage enterprises and research institutions to increase research and application of trusted authentication technologies for mobile IoT terminals, blockchain traceability, and other security techniques. Accelerate the development of technical means for mobile IoT security supervision, enhance real-time monitoring capabilities for security situation awareness, card-terminal management, risk warning, and other aspects.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: In accordance with the laws of the evolution of mobile communication technology, the trends in industry development, and the requirements for efficient use of resources, NB-IoT and Cat1 are used together to undertake the connection of 2G/3G Internet of Things (IoT) devices, thereby improving spectrum utilization efficiency. While ensuring the service level of existing IoT terminal networks, it also guides new IoT terminals to no longer use 2G/3G networks, and promotes the migration of existing 2G/3G IoT services to NB-IoT/4G (Cat1)/5G networks.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, formulate development roadmap.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Establish a model for the development index of the mobile Internet of Things (attached), improve data statistics and information collection mechanisms, unify data statistics standards, track and monitor the basic development of the mobile Internet of Things industry, and compile a development report on the mobile Internet of Things. Objectively measure and evaluate the level of development of the mobile Internet of Things industry, fully stimulate the motivation of all parties to develop the mobile Internet of Things.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, carry out assessment of development level.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Encourage various regions to consider the needs of smart applications in the construction of industrial (industrial) parks, smart cities, beautiful rural areas, as well as urban roads, bridges, municipal pipe networks, comprehensive pipe corridors, transportation logistics, green landscapes, and other infrastructure. Make advance preparations for the construction or reservation of facilities related to the Internet of Things.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen infrastructure planning.

name: Notice on Deepening the Comprehensive Development of Mobile Internet of Things (MIoT) (MIIT Communication [2020] No. 25) (MIIT Office, April 30, 2020)
content: Mobile Internet of Things (IoT) enterprises should incorporate IoT services into the control system for nuisance calls and spam messages, establish a monitoring, detection, and disposal mechanism for IoT nuisance calls and spam messages, strictly regulate the use of SMS, voice, and other functions based on the requirements of IoT card functionality restrictions, and open IoT functions for users according to the principle of 'minimum necessary'. Strengthen the supervision of mobile IoT product access to the network, guide enterprises to launch various types of mobile IoT terminal products in accordance with laws and regulations. Enhance in-process and post-process supervision, strengthen punishment for various illegal and non-compliant behaviors, and create a fair and good market environment.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, create an orderly market environment.

name: Notice on the Issuance of Guidelines for the Construction of the Internet of Things Basic Security Standard System (2021 Edition) (MIIT Science and Technology [2021] No. 34) (MIIT Office/September 23, 2021)
content: By 2022, a preliminary Internet of Things (IoT) basic security standard system will be established, with the development of more than 10 key industry standards. This will clarify the security requirements for key basic elements such as IoT terminals, gateways, and platforms, in order to meet the basic security needs of the IoT and promote the enhancement of IoT basic security capabilities. By 2025, efforts will be made to form a more comprehensive IoT basic security standard system, with the development of more than 30 industry standards. This will improve the coverage of standards in specific industries and fields, enhance the level of security for cross-industry IoT applications, and ensure the safe use of consumers.
titlelist: Overall requirements, construction goals

name: Notice on the Issuance of Guidelines for the Construction of the Internet of Things Basic Security Standard System (2021 Edition) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 34) (MIIT Office/September 23, 2021)
content: The basic security standards of the Internet of Things mainly refer to the security standards of key basic elements such as IoT terminals, gateways, platforms, etc. The IoT basic security standard system includes five major categories of standards: overall security, terminal security, gateway security, platform security, and security management (see Figure 1). Figure 1 shows the framework of the IoT basic security standard system.
titlelist: Construction content, standard system framework

name: Notice on the Issuance of Guidelines for the Construction of the Internet of Things Basic Security Standard System (2021 Edition) (MIIT Science and Technology [2021] No. 34) (MIIT Office/September 23, 2021)
content: 'Table 2 Overall Security (1) Definition of basic security terms for the Internet of Things: standardize the concept of basic security for the Internet of Things and unify related terminology for understanding and use. (2) Internet of Things basic security architecture model: mainly propose the framework of the basic security system for the Internet of Things and its various components. Reference models are used to clarify and define the functions, relationships, roles, boundaries, responsibilities, and other content of the cloud, management, and end layers. (3) Internet of Things basic security scenarios: mainly provide examples and specifications for security requirements in different types of scenarios. (4) Integration of Internet of Things basic security: in the process of planning, integrating, and implementing Internet of Things systems, ensure the security and reliability of objects at various levels of the infrastructure system through the establishment of security models and other methods. (5) Internet of Things basic security classification: clarify the basic principles, dimensions, methods, examples, and other requirements for the classification of Internet of Things basic security, providing a basic support for the implementation of classified security management. (6) Internet of Things basic security protocols: mainly refer to the basic security protocols between the Internet of Things platform, gateway, terminal itself, and devices, including wired protocol security, wireless protocol security, storage protocol security, etc.'
titlelist: The construction content and key areas of overall security are the fundamental, guiding, and general standards of IoT basic security. They mainly include the definition of IoT basic security terms, architecture models, security scenarios, security integration, security classification, security protocols, etc. (see Figure 2).

content: 'Security, communication chip security, card security, industry terminal security, terminal testing and evaluation, etc. (see Figure 3). Figure 3 Terminal Security. (1) General terminal security: mainly includes IoT terminal hardware security, operating system security, software security, access authentication, data security, protocol security, privacy protection, certificate specifications, firmware security, plugin/component security, etc. (2) Module security: specifies the security requirements of communication modules in access authentication, data interaction, data transmission, and electromagnetic interference resistance, including cellular communication modules and other types of communication modules. (3) Communication chip security: mainly includes communication encryption algorithms, key management, encryption/decryption capabilities, signature verification, data storage, chip security baseline requirements, etc. (4) Card security: divided into management requirements and technical requirements. The management requirements mainly regulate the sales, registration, and use management of IoT cards, while the technical requirements mainly include card identity authentication, classification, technical means construction, etc. (5) Industry terminal security: mainly refers to the specific security requirements of IoT terminals closely related to various vertical industries and with specific functions, such as smart locks, monitoring devices, and other specific industry terminal security requirements. (6) Terminal testing and evaluation: mainly includes IoT card security testing, hardware security testing, operating system security testing, software security testing, access authentication security testing, data security testing, communication protocol security testing, firmware security testing, etc.'
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, terminal security. Terminal security is the standard for the perception layer in the basic security system of the Internet of Things, mainly including general terminal security and modules.

name: Notice on the Issuance of Guidelines for the Construction of the Internet of Things Basic Security Standard System (2021 Edition) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 34) (MIIT Office/September 23, 2021)
content: Gateway security mainly includes general security of IoT gateways, gateway communication and interface security, gateway physical environment security, gateway component security, gateway testing and evaluation, etc. (see Figure 4). Figure 4: Gateway security. (1) General security of gateways: standardize the functional architecture, security protocols, security protection, as well as security technical requirements for data transmission, processing, and storage related to IoT gateways. This mainly includes gateway security models, security architecture, security functions, security performance, data security, edge computing security, security protocols, etc. (2) Gateway communication and interface security: standardize the security communication protocols, blacklists, whitelists, authentication, etc. for communication interfaces and management interfaces when gateways are interconnected with other devices. This mainly includes the security procedures for southbound and northbound interfaces of gateways, security protocol processes, port protection, etc. (3) Gateway physical environment security: standardize the technical requirements for electromagnetic radiation, electromagnetic interference prevention, resistance to physical damage, adaptability to temperature, humidity, and salt spray environments under storage, transportation, and usage conditions of gateways. This mainly includes gateway equipment electromagnetic compatibility, mechanical environmental adaptability, climate environmental adaptability, etc. (4) Gateway component security: standardize the security design, security functions, etc. of software and hardware components related to gateway functional services, data collection, data transmission, and processing. This mainly includes gateway equipment component security architecture, open-source component security, application startup security, etc. (5) Gateway testing and evaluation: standardize the testing methods for gateway security evaluation, mainly including device security testing, component security testing, interface security testing, security management and maintenance testing, data transmission and processing security testing, environmental adaptability testing, hierarchical classification evaluation testing, etc.
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, gateway security.

name: Notice on the Issuance of Guidelines for the Construction of the Internet of Things Basic Security Standard System (2021 Edition) (MIIT Science and Technology [2021] No. 34) (MIIT Office/September 23, 2021)
content: The Internet of Things platform includes device management platform, connectivity management platform, application enablement platform, business analysis platform, situational awareness and risk disposal platform, etc. The security standards of the Internet of Things platform mainly include platform general security, platform security protection, platform interaction security, platform security monitoring, platform testing and evaluation, etc. (see Figure 5). Figure 5 Platform Security (1) Platform General Security: Standardize the requirements for general data security, communication security, identity authentication, security monitoring, physical security, security trustworthiness, etc. of various types of Internet of Things platforms, mainly including general security framework, platform trusted computing, etc. (2) Platform Security Protection: Standardize the access control, anti-reverse engineering, security audit, tampering and injection prevention, etc. of the Internet of Things platform and industry business systems developed based on the Internet of Things platform. The security protection requirements for external application components, mainly including platform business basic security, platform security protection requirements, etc. (3) Platform Interaction Security: Standardize the security requirements for data interaction, encrypted transmission, interaction interface configuration and audit between Internet of Things platforms, between platforms and upper-level business systems or management systems, and between platforms and lower-level access devices, mainly including interaction between different Internet of Things platforms, interaction between platforms and southbound and northbound, etc. (4) Platform Security Monitoring: Standardize the construction of security monitoring, situational summary, and other functions of the Internet of Things platform, mainly including Internet of Things network security monitoring and early warning platform, Internet of Things network security situational awareness platform, etc. (5) Platform Testing and Evaluation: Standardize the testing and evaluation methods for general security, platform security protection, interaction security between platform internals and between platforms, platform security management, etc. of the Internet of Things platform, mainly including Internet of Things platform capability evaluation, security protection testing, interaction security testing, and security management evaluation, etc.
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, platform security.

name: Notice on the Issuance of Guidelines for the Construction of the Internet of Things Basic Security Standard System (2021 Edition) (MIIT Science [2021] No. 34) (MIIT Office/September 23, 2021)
content: The safety management standards are used to guide industries in implementing general safety management requirements, mainly including data security management, secure information collaboration, management and maintenance of security, security certification, etc. (see Figure 6). Figure 6: Safety Management. (1) Data Security Management: It focuses on various types of data generated by IoT business applications, ensuring the security, controllability, and use of data in various stages, mainly including data security basic management and technical support in key stages such as collection, transmission, storage, processing, sharing, and destruction. (2) Secure Information Collaboration: It addresses the numerous types of IoT protocols, clarifies the standards for interconnection and interoperability of basic security-related data in IoT, and achieves secure interconnection and interoperability across protocols, mainly including interface specifications, testing methods, etc. (3) Management and Maintenance of Security: It standardizes the operation and maintenance management of terminals, gateways, and platforms in different IoT scenarios, mainly including system construction, security organization, personnel management, operational security, asset management, configuration management, remote maintenance security, vulnerability detection, emergency response and management, disaster recovery, etc. (4) Security Certification: It standardizes the certification management of different types of IoT terminals, gateways, and platforms, used for the mutual recognition and interoperability of security certification for different types of devices, mainly including certificate generation, certificate management, certificate replacement, etc.
titlelist: Construction content, key areas, safety management.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Healthy Development of Smart Cities (NDRC High-Tech [2014] No. 1770) (Issued by the National Development and Reform Commission and other departments on August 27, 2014)
content: By 2020, a number of distinctive smart cities will be built, with significantly enhanced gathering and radiating driving effects, and obvious improvement in comprehensive competitive advantages. Significant achievements will be made in guaranteeing and improving people's livelihood services, innovating social management, and maintaining network security. Public services will become more convenient. In the fields of education and culture, medical and health care, family planning, labor and employment, social security, housing security, environmental protection, transportation, disaster prevention and reduction, inspection and testing, a basic information service system covering urban and rural residents, migrant workers, and their accompanying family members will be established, making it more convenient, timely, and efficient for the public to access basic public services. Urban management will become more refined. The informatization system in the fields of municipal administration, population management, traffic management, public safety, emergency management, social integrity, market supervision, inspection and quarantine, food and drug safety, and drinking water safety will be basically formed. The digitalization and precision of urban planning and urban infrastructure management will be greatly improved, promoting a significant increase in government administrative efficiency and urban management level. The livability of the living environment will be improved. The digitalization level of residents' lives will be significantly improved. The intelligent monitoring system for water, air, noise, soil, and natural vegetation environment, as well as the online prevention and control system for pollutant emissions and energy consumption, will be basically established, promoting the improvement of urban living environment. Infrastructure will become more intelligent. The next-generation information infrastructure with broadband, convergence, security, and ubiquity will be basically established. The level of intelligence in public infrastructure such as electricity, gas, transportation, water, and logistics will be greatly improved, and operation management will be precise, coordinated, and integrated. Industrialization and informatization will be deeply integrated, and the information service industry will accelerate its development. Network security will become long-term. The urban network security guarantee system and management system will be basically established. The security of basic networks and key information systems will be controllable, and the security of important information resources will be effectively guaranteed, protecting the information of residents, enterprises, and the government.
titlelist: The guiding ideology, basic principles, and main objectives, main objectives.

content: The city government should study and formulate a smart city construction plan based on the strategic overall situation of urban development. The plan should emphasize serving the people, deepen the application of smart technologies in key areas, and provide more convenient, efficient, and cost-effective social services. It should also specify specific measures to promote the sharing and social development and utilization of information resources, strengthen information security, ensure the accuracy and reliability of information, and simultaneously strengthen the construction of the credit environment, improve regulations and standards, etc. It should strengthen the connection with the overall planning of the national economy and social development, the planning of main functional areas, the development planning of relevant industries, regional planning, urban and rural planning, as well as relevant special planning, and coordinate the layout of urban and rural development.
titlelist: Scientifically formulate the top-level design for the construction of smart cities, and strengthen the top-level design.

Encourage the development of tourism service systems and tourism management information platforms based on mobile internet.

Promote the construction of a new innovation network. Around key areas such as key processes, industrial hosts, digital twins, and industrial intelligence, support leading companies in the industry to jointly build a batch of manufacturing innovation carriers with universities, research institutes, and upstream and downstream enterprises. Encourage research and development institutions to innovate development mechanisms, strengthen data sharing and platform construction, and carry out collaborative innovation. Promote industrialization. Promote organizational construction and accelerate the transfer and transformation of innovation achievements. Build a batch of trial and verification platforms to accelerate the promotion and application of intelligent manufacturing equipment and systems.
titlelist: Key tasks, accelerate systemic innovation, enhance the new driving force of integrated development.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Intelligent Manufacturing (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 207) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/December 21, 2021)
content: Relying on a strong domestic market, accelerate the development of equipment, software, and system solutions, cultivate and develop emerging industries in intelligent manufacturing, accelerate the improvement of the adaptability of the supply system, and lead the optimization and upgrading of the industrial system. Vigorously develop intelligent manufacturing equipment. Strengthen collaborative innovation between industry, academia, and research institutions to overcome weaknesses in perception, control, decision-making, and execution, and break through a batch of bottleneck basic components and devices. Promote the deep integration of advanced processes, information technology, and manufacturing equipment, and drive the accelerated development and iterative upgrading of general and specialized intelligent manufacturing equipment through the construction of intelligent workshops/factories. Promote the innovative application of new technologies such as digital twins and artificial intelligence, and develop a number of internationally advanced new intelligent manufacturing equipment. Column 4: Actions for the Innovation and Development of Intelligent Manufacturing Equipment. 01: Research and development of basic components and devices such as micro-nano displacement sensors, flexible tactile sensors, high-resolution vision sensors, online composition analyzers, advanced controllers, high-precision servo drive systems, high-performance and high-reliability reducers, wearable human-machine interaction devices, industrial site positioning equipment, and intelligent numerical control systems. 02: Research and development of general intelligent manufacturing equipment such as intelligent vertical/horizontal five-axis machining centers, turn-mill compound machining centers, and high-precision CNC grinding machines; industrial robots such as intelligent welding robots, intelligent mobile robots, and semiconductor (clean) robots; additive manufacturing equipment such as laser/electron beam selective melting equipment and laser selective sintering equipment; advanced laser processing equipment such as ultrafast lasers; industrial control equipment such as high-end distributed control systems, programmable logic controllers, monitoring and control systems, and data acquisition systems; intelligent detection equipment and instruments such as digital non-contact precision measurement, online non-destructive testing, and laser tracking measurement; intelligent logistics equipment such as intelligent multi-layer and multi-directional shuttle vehicles and intelligent large-scale warehouses. 03: Research and development of specialized intelligent manufacturing equipment such as efficient processing and near-net shaping equipment for automobile engines and transmissions, intelligent laying, forming, processing, and testing equipment for large-scale aerospace composite materials, intelligent assembly equipment for aerospace, laser welding equipment for ship plate, high-precision intelligent hot/cold rolling equipment, intelligent ethylene equipment with a capacity of over one million tons, new dry-process cement fully automated production lines, intelligent complete sets of equipment for high-viscosity fluid filling in the food industry, continuous knitting fabric/polyester fabric dyeing and finishing equipment, intelligent complete sets of equipment for sterile raw materials in compliance with GMP requirements, large-scale integrated circuit manufacturing equipment, and new flat panel display manufacturing equipment. 04: Research and development of new intelligent manufacturing equipment that integrates new technologies such as digital twins, big data, artificial intelligence, edge computing, virtual reality/augmented reality (VR/AR), 5G, Beidou, and satellite internet, including intelligent industrial control systems, intelligent workstations, collaborative robots, and adaptive robots. Focus on the development of industrial software products. Promote collaboration between equipment manufacturers, universities, research institutes, user enterprises, and software companies, jointly develop core software for the entire product lifecycle and manufacturing process, develop embedded industrial software and integrated development environments, and develop integrated industrial software platforms for specific industries. Promote the software-based industrial knowledge and open architecture, and accelerate the deployment of industrial software in the cloud. Carry out demonstrations of secure and controllable industrial software applications based on major projects and backbone enterprises. Column 5: Actions to Enhance Industrial Software Breakthroughs and Upgrades. 01: Research and development of design software, including computer-aided design (CAD), computer-aided engineering (CAE), computer-aided process planning (CAPP), computer-aided manufacturing (CAM), process simulation, electronic design automation (EDA), and product data management (PDM). 02: Research and development of production and manufacturing software, including manufacturing execution systems (MES), advanced planning and scheduling systems (APS), factory material distribution and control systems (TMS), energy management systems (EMS), fault prediction and health management software (PHM), maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) comprehensive management, safety management systems, and environmental and carbon emission management systems. 03: Research and development of business management software, including enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), supply chain management systems (SCM), customer relationship management systems (CRM), human resources management (HRM), quality management systems (QMS), and asset performance management systems (APM). 04: Research and development of control and execution software, including industrial operating systems, industrial control software, and configuration programming software for embedded industrial software and integrated development environments. 05: Development of industry-specific software, including basic knowledge bases such as model libraries and process libraries for specific industries and processes, fully integrated optimization software for the petrochemical and metallurgical industries, design/production/maintenance integrated platform software for large-scale equipment, and comprehensive management platform software for small and medium-sized enterprises. 06: Development of new software, including industrial apps, cloud-based software, and cloud-native software. Focus on building system solutions. Encourage interaction and collaborative innovation between intelligent manufacturing system solution providers and users, promote the system integration and deep integration of processes, equipment, software, and networks, and develop solutions for typical scenarios and specific industries. Focus on the characteristics and needs of small and micro enterprises, and develop lightweight, easy-to-maintain, and low-cost solutions. Accelerate the cultivation of system solution providers, promote standardized development, and guide the provision of professional, high-level, one-stop integrated services.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthening self-sufficiency and enhancing the new advantages of the industrial system.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Intelligent Manufacturing (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 207) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/December 21, 2021)
content: Aiming at the development trend of intelligent manufacturing, we will improve the development foundation of metrology, standards, information infrastructure, and security, and strive to build a comprehensive, reliable, advanced, and secure support system. We will promote standardization work in depth. We will continuously optimize the top-level design of standards, coordinate the construction of the national intelligent manufacturing standard system and industry application standard system. We will accelerate the revision of basic commonality and key technology standards, strengthen the optimization and coordination of existing standards, and promote the formation of a coordinated and complementary standard group consisting of national standards, industry standards, group standards, and enterprise standards in areas such as intelligent equipment and intelligent factories. We will accelerate the implementation of standards and support enterprises in carrying out intelligent workshop/factory construction based on standards. We will actively participate in international standardization work and promote the synchronous development of high maturity national standards and international standards. Column 6: Leading Action on Intelligent Manufacturing Standards. 01: Regularly revise the Guidelines for the Construction of the National Intelligent Manufacturing Standard System and construct industry application standard systems in sub-sectors such as textiles, petrochemicals, building materials, automobiles, aviation, ships, power equipment, rail transit equipment, household appliances, food, steel, non-ferrous metals, and new energy sources. 02: Standard formulation. We will increase the strength of standard testing and verification, promote the revision of basic commonality and key technology standards such as digital twins, data dictionaries, human-machine collaboration, smart supply chains, system reliability, and information security and functional safety integration, meet the needs of technological evolution and industrial development, and accelerate the formulation of industry application standards. 03: Standard promotion and application. We will carry out pilot projects for the application of intelligent manufacturing standards in areas such as intelligent workshop/factory construction, new model applications, supply chain collaboration, and new technology applications, form a coordinated and supporting standard group consisting of national standards, industry standards, and group standards, and promote the application of pilot project results in small and medium-sized enterprises and peer enterprises. 04: International standard cooperation. We will continue to strengthen the cooperation on intelligent manufacturing/Industry 4.0 standards between China and Germany, expand cooperation with Japan, the UK, and other countries, actively participate in international standardization activities, continuously enhance the contribution of Chinese solutions to international standards, deepen bilateral and multilateral standardization exchanges, and form a batch of standardization achievements. Improve information infrastructure. We will accelerate the large-scale deployment of new network infrastructures such as industrial Internet, Internet of Things, 5G, and gigabit optical networks, encourage enterprises to upgrade and transform their internal and external networks, and enhance on-site perception and data transmission capabilities. We will strengthen the construction of computing infrastructure such as industrial data centers and intelligent computing centers to support the application of new technologies such as artificial intelligence. We will support large group enterprises and industrial parks in establishing industrial Internet platforms with distinctive features based on internal resource integration, full life cycle management of products, collaborative supply chain of industrial chains, services for small and medium-sized enterprises, and industrial data processing and analysis, so as to achieve effective integration and management of all-factor and full-industrial chain data. Strengthen security guarantees. We will strengthen the assessment of security risks in intelligent manufacturing, promote the simultaneous development of network security, data security, and functional safety, and promote the in-depth application of cryptographic technology. We will implement classified and graded management of enterprise network security and urge enterprises to fulfill their main responsibilities for network security. We will improve the multi-level monitoring and early warning network for industrial control information security at the national, local, and enterprise levels, and accelerate the construction of an industrial Internet security technology monitoring service system. We will explore the establishment of a mechanism for filing and supervision of cross-border data transmission. We will establish a technical protection system and security management system that meet policy and standard requirements. We will cultivate security service institutions, promote the application of network security technology products, and enhance the capacity of diagnosis, consultation, design, and implementation services. Strengthen talent development. We will regularly compile reports on the demand forecast for intelligent manufacturing talents and a catalog of talents in short supply, and research and formulate professional standards in the field of intelligent manufacturing. Relying on institutions such as high-skilled talent training bases, we will carry out large-scale vocational training. We will strengthen the digital skills training of graduates, in-service personnel, and job changers, promote the construction of industry-education integration enterprises, promote deep cooperation between intelligent manufacturing enterprises and vocational colleges, and explore the establishment of a Chinese-style apprenticeship system. We will deepen the construction of new engineering disciplines, establish a number of modern industrial colleges and specialized demonstration software colleges in the field of intelligent manufacturing, and optimize discipline majors and curricula. We will accelerate the training of high-end talents. We will promote entrepreneurship and innovation in intelligent manufacturing through entrepreneurship competitions and skills competitions.
titlelist: Key tasks, solidify the foundation support, build new guarantees for intelligent manufacturing.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Intelligent Manufacturing (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 207) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/December 21, 2021)
content: Strengthen departmental coordination, coordinate the implementation of smart manufacturing projects, carry out in-depth technical research, equipment innovation, demonstration applications, standardization, and talent development. Strengthen cooperation between the central and local governments, encourage local governments to introduce supporting policies and laws and regulations, guide the aggregation of various social resources, and form a systematic work pattern. Give full play to the role of the Smart Manufacturing Expert Advisory Committee, relevant universities, research institutions, and professional think tanks, and conduct forward-looking and strategic research on major issues in smart manufacturing. Encourage companies to accelerate the implementation of smart manufacturing based on their own practical situations and continue to do well in safety production and environmental protection.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen overall coordination.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Intelligent Manufacturing (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 207) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/December 21, 2021)
content: Strengthen support for the field of intelligent manufacturing in major national science and technology projects, national key research and development programs, etc. Implement support policies such as the deduction of expenses for the first set of major technical equipment and research and development costs. Encourage national industry funds and social capital to increase investment in intelligent manufacturing. Utilize the role of national production and financing cooperation platforms to guide financial institutions in providing medium- to long-term loan support for enterprise intelligent transformation, and develop financial products such as supply chain finance and financing leasing that are in line with the characteristics of intelligent manufacturing. Encourage eligible enterprises to carry out direct financing through equity, debt, and other means.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase financial and fiscal support.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Intelligent Manufacturing (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 207) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/December 21, 2021)
content: Encourage industry organizations, local governments, industrial parks, universities, research institutes, leading enterprises, etc. to build smart manufacturing public service platforms, support the improvement of inspection and testing, consulting and diagnosis, measurement and testing, safety assessment, training and promotion capabilities of standard testing and verification platforms and existing service institutions. Develop specifications for smart manufacturing public service platforms and build a service network with complementary advantages and coordinated development. Establish a long-term evaluation mechanism, encourage third-party organizations to conduct assessments of smart manufacturing maturity, and research and publish industry and regional smart manufacturing development indices.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, enhance public service capabilities.

name: Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year Plan for the Development of Intelligent Manufacturing (MIIT Joint Regulation [2021] No. 207) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/December 21, 2021)
content: Strengthen communication with relevant countries, regions, and international organizations, and carry out cooperation in intelligent manufacturing technology, standards, talents, etc. Encourage multinational companies, foreign research institutions, etc. to establish intelligent manufacturing research and development centers, demonstration factories, training centers, etc. in China. Strengthen intellectual property protection and promote the establishment of basic systems and standard specifications for data resource property rights, transaction circulation, cross-border transmission, and security protection. Relying on the joint construction of the Belt and Road initiative, the BRICS cooperation mechanism, the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP), etc., encourage the going global of intelligent manufacturing equipment, software, standards, and solutions.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, deepen opening and cooperation.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Smart hardware refers to emerging Internet terminal products that have information collection, processing, and connectivity capabilities, and can achieve functions such as intelligent perception, interaction, and big data services. It is an important carrier of the 'Internet+' artificial intelligence. After the realization of intelligence in terminal products such as mobile phones and televisions, the new generation of information technology is accelerating integration and fusion with personal wearables, transportation, medical health, production manufacturing, and other fields, giving rise to the booming development of the smart hardware industry, driving innovation and efficiency improvement. Currently, China's smart hardware industry faces both opportunities and challenges. On the one hand, China is a major producer of electronic information products and has the world's largest Internet user base, providing a vast market space for smart hardware. On the other hand, issues and risks such as insufficient supply of key technologies and high-end products, incomplete innovation support systems, lack of interaction between production and use, and fragmented ecosystems cannot be ignored. This special action aims to promote the innovative development of the smart hardware industry, enhance the effective supply of high-end common technologies and products, meet the diversified needs of social production and life for smart hardware, and cultivate new driving forces for the growth of the information technology industry.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: By 2018, China's global market share of smart hardware exceeded 30%, with an industry scale of over 500 billion yuan. Significant breakthroughs were made in key technological areas such as low-power lightweight system design, low-power wide-area intelligent IoT, virtual reality, intelligent human-computer interaction, and high-performance motion and posture control, fostering a group of industry-leading listed companies. Participation, contribution, and influence in the international mainstream ecosystem significantly increased, with overseas patents accounting for over 10%. Three major supporting platforms were established for standard development, product and application testing, and monitoring of industrial supply capabilities, with smart hardware standardization and public service capabilities reaching international advanced levels. Several high-level innovation platforms with advanced technology, outstanding features, and complementary advantages were established, significantly enhancing entrepreneurial and innovative support capabilities. Industrial-grade smart hardware products such as intelligent industrial sensors, intelligent PLCs, and intelligent unmanned systems formed scale demonstrations, driving a productivity increase of over 20%. A number of replicable and promotable industry application solutions were developed, demonstrating the convenience and benefits of the industry.
