name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Improve the quality and brand added value of intelligent hardware products in the high-end segments of the value chain, strengthen the design capabilities for product functionality, usability, and value-added features, develop diversified, personalized, and customized supply models, enhance application services and business model innovation, and enhance the supply capabilities of high-end intelligent wearable, intelligent automotive, intelligent medical health, intelligent service robots, and industrial-grade intelligent hardware products.
titlelist: Key task: Enhancing the effective supply of high-end intelligent hardware products.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Support enterprises in meeting the needs of consumers in sports, entertainment, socializing, and other areas. Accelerate the research, development, and industrialization of wearable devices such as smartwatches, smart bracelets, smart clothing, and virtual reality. Enhance product functionality, performance, and industrial design, and promote the development of products towards excellent craftsmanship, rich features, accurate data, reliable performance, convenient operation, energy conservation, and environmental protection. Strengthen cross-platform application development and supporting infrastructure, enhance data exchange and interactive control between different products, and improve the capabilities of big data collection, analysis, processing, and services.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the effective supply of high-end intelligent hardware products, intelligent wearable devices.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Support enterprises to strengthen cross-border cooperation, develop intelligent car-mounted radar, intelligent rearview mirrors, intelligent recorders, intelligent car navigation and other devices to meet the transportation needs of drivers and passengers, and enhance the safety, convenience, and practicality of products. Promote the integrated application of new generation information technologies such as intelligent operating systems, Beidou navigation, broadband mobile communication, and big data in car-mounted devices, enriching vehicle networking information services such as driving services, vehicle health management, and emergency assistance. Develop the certification capability for chip, component, and complete machine equipment to meet automotive regulations, and improve the supporting supply system.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the effective supply of high-end intelligent hardware products, intelligent in-car devices.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: To meet the needs of the general public in terms of health monitoring, remote diagnosis, and home care, we will develop and apply smart home medical devices, smart health monitoring devices, and smart analysis and diagnostic devices. We encourage collaboration between terminal companies and medical institutions, focusing on improving product quality, performance, and data credibility. We will strengthen the interconnection and interoperability of different devices and systems, including interfaces, protocols, and data, and promote data integration between smart hardware and digital medical devices, as well as related medical and health service platforms.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the effective supply of high-end intelligent hardware products, intelligent medical and health equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Develop and promote the development of technologies such as multimodal human-machine interaction, environmental understanding, autonomous navigation, and intelligent decision-making for applications in areas such as family, education, business, and public services. Develop open intelligent service robot software and hardware platforms and solutions, improve standards such as communication control, security, and design platforms for intelligent service robot programming and operation graphical user interfaces, enhance the intelligence level of service robots, and expand the market for product applications.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the effective supply of high-end intelligent hardware products, intelligent service robots.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: To meet the needs of industrial production, we develop high-reliable intelligent industrial sensors, intelligent industrial gateways, intelligent PLCs, industrial-grade wearable devices, and unmanned systems, as well as provide related products and services. We support the industrialization of new industrial communication, industrial safety protection, remote maintenance, industrial cloud computing, and services, and enhance the development, optimization, comprehensive simulation, and testing capabilities of industrial intelligent systems.
titlelist: Key tasks: Enhancing the effective supply of high-end intelligent hardware products, industrial-grade intelligent hardware equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Aim at the high point of industrial development, organize and implement a batch of key industrial innovation projects, support the development of key software and hardware IP cores, and the construction of collaborative research and development platforms. Master a batch of intelligent hardware common technologies with global influence and strong driving force. Strengthen international industrial exchange and cooperation, encourage domestic and foreign enterprises to open source or open chip, software technology, and solution resources, build an open ecosystem, and promote the gathering, exchange, openness, and sharing of various innovative element resources.
titlelist: Key task: Strengthening innovation in core key technologies of intelligent hardware.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Develop low-power chips and lightweight operating systems suitable for smart hardware, and develop integrated solutions and application development tools for software and hardware. Support backbone enterprises to gather resources and build standards around the underlying software and hardware systems, expand applications, and create an ecosystem.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen the innovation of core key technologies in intelligent hardware, low power consumption lightweight underlying software and hardware technologies.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Develop new human-computer interaction, new display devices, GPUs, high-speed digital interfaces, and multi-axis low-power sensors for virtual reality products. Innovate in dynamic environment modeling, real-time 3D image generation, stereoscopic display, and sensing technologies for augmented reality. Build a research and development environment for virtual/augmented reality application systems platforms and development tools.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthen innovation in core key technologies of intelligent hardware, virtual reality/augmented reality technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Develop high-precision and high-reliable intelligent sensing and recognition technologies and algorithms for biological signals, environmental monitoring, etc., to support breakthroughs in new generation perception technologies such as millimeter wave and terahertz, speech recognition, machine vision, etc., and accelerate the integrated innovation with new generation information and communication technologies such as cloud computing and big data.
titlelist: Key tasks, strengthen the innovation of core key technologies in intelligent hardware, high-performance intelligent perception technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Develop low-cost, wide-coverage, low-power consumption intelligent hardware wide and narrowband IoT technology and solutions with large-scale concurrency, high sensitivity, and long battery life. Support the development of related protocol stacks and IP, accelerate the development and application of low-power wide area network (LPWAN) connectivity chips and microprocessors in system-on-chip (SoC) designs, and leverage leading enterprises' market, standard, and technology diffusion capabilities in the industry chain to create an open and collaborative smart IoT innovation ecosystem.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthening the innovation of core key technologies in intelligent hardware, low-power wide-area intelligent Internet of Things technology.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Support the linkage between the upstream and downstream of the industrial chain, build a secure and reliable end-to-cloud integrated intelligent hardware service development framework and platform, develop end-to-cloud full-chain security capabilities from chips to the cloud, and develop integrated applications such as trusted identity authentication, intelligent voice and image recognition, and mobile payment.
titlelist: Key tasks: Strengthening the innovation of core key technologies in intelligent hardware, and collaborative technology integration of edge and cloud.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Deeply explore the application needs of intelligent hardware in the fields of health care for the elderly, education, medical care, and industry, strengthen the intelligent upgrading in key areas, and promote the integrated application and promotion of intelligent hardware products.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting the intelligent upgrading of key areas.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Encourage the integration of smart hardware companies with health and elderly care institutions, integrate and manage health data, achieve data integration and application with relevant health and elderly care service platforms, develop smart hardware applications such as sports and sleep data collection, real-time monitoring of vital signs, emergency assistance, and real-time positioning, in order to improve the quality and efficiency of health and elderly care services.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting the intelligent improvement of key areas, in the field of health and elderly care.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: 'Support smart hardware companies to meet the needs of education, apply smart hardware technology in areas such as remote education, smart classrooms, virtual classrooms, online learning, and enhance the level of education intelligence. Combine the development of smart hardware product forms, build a matching high-quality teaching resource library, connect online and offline educational resources, expand the coverage of high-quality educational resources, and promote educational equity.'
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting the intelligent upgrading of key areas, education sector.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Encourage medical institutions to accelerate the process of informatization construction, promote the application of intelligent medical and health devices in diagnosis, treatment, care, rehabilitation, and other aspects, strengthen the construction of medical data cloud platforms, promote remote diagnosis, remote surgery, remote treatment, and other models, support the digitalization, customization, and remote development of medical resources and services, promote the coordinated information services of community, household, medical care institutions, and elderly care institutions, and improve the level of medical security services.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting the intelligent upgrading of key areas, medical field.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for the Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Encourage industrial enterprises to collaborate with smart hardware manufacturers, carry out integrated adaptation of industrial-grade smart hardware systems, accelerate the process of intelligent transformation in key areas, improve agile manufacturing and flexible manufacturing capabilities, and develop emerging services such as industrial remote maintenance and industrial big data analysis based on smart hardware.
titlelist: Key tasks, promoting the intelligent upgrading of key areas, industrial sector.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Research and develop intelligent hardware technology standards and application specifications. Develop key control interface protocol specifications to promote open sharing of data formats and standard protocols between devices, and promote interconnection between products and systems. Encourage industry alliances and industry associations to carry out group standard pilot projects, improve the rapid connection mechanism with industry standards and national standards. Establish a standardization and public service platform for intelligent hardware, support product testing services for standard compliance, software and hardware collaboration, interconnection, user experience, security and reliability, etc.
titlelist: Promote measures and improve the standard testing system.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Select advantageous regions to build high-level provincial-level intelligent hardware entrepreneurship and innovation platforms, support local development of intelligent hardware crowdsourcing, crowdfunding, and assistance platforms through means such as test beds and innovation platforms, and promote investments in angel, entrepreneurship, and industry. Implement the 'Fire of Chips' plan to advance entrepreneurship and innovation in the field of intelligent hardware basic chips. Support the organization of intelligent hardware entrepreneurship and innovation competitions, gather high-end talents in intelligent hardware entrepreneurship and innovation, and promote the connection between projects with development potential and the market.
titlelist: Promote measures, develop entrepreneurial and innovative platforms.

name: Notice on Issuing the Special Action Plan for the Innovation and Development of the Intelligent Hardware Industry (2016-2018) (MIIT Lian Electronic [2016] No. 302) (MIIT, NDRC/September 9, 2016)
content: Establish an intelligent hardware industry supply capacity monitoring platform to timely track domestic and international technological paths and industry development trends. Establish an intelligent hardware working group within the framework of the artificial intelligence industry development alliance, compile an industry development white paper, and provide services for industry development and decision-making support. Encourage public service departments to innovate application models and accelerate the orderly opening of data resources. Strengthen research on intellectual property rights policies for intelligent hardware, provide consultation and services for intellectual property layout, patent risk prevention and control mechanisms, etc. Encourage backbone enterprises in the intelligent hardware industry to carry out research and development and application of products based on software and hardware IP cores in key areas such as industry, medical, and automotive. Support third-party organizations to conduct evaluations and promote the publicity of intelligent hardware products and solutions. Strengthen user information security protection, carry out market supervision and industry self-discipline, and maintain a good reputation for the industry.
titlelist: Promotion measures to build an industrial ecological system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: By 2025, China's policy system and industrial system for the coordinated development of intelligent construction and construction industrialization will be basically established. The levels of construction industrialization, digitization, and intelligence will be significantly improved. The construction industry Internet platform will be initially established. The industrial foundation, technological equipment, scientific and technological innovation capabilities, and construction safety and quality levels will be comprehensively improved. Labor productivity will be significantly improved, energy and resource consumption, as well as pollution emissions, will be greatly reduced, and the environmental protection effect will be significant. Efforts will be made to form a group of leading intelligent construction enterprises, leading and driving the transformation and upgrading of a large number of small and medium-sized enterprises towards intelligent construction, and creating an upgraded version of Made in China Construction. By 2035, China's intelligent construction and construction industrialization will make significant progress, with greatly enhanced enterprise innovation capabilities and significantly increased overall advantages of the industry. The core competitiveness of Made in China Construction will be world-leading, and construction industrialization will be fully realized, entering the ranks of intelligent construction world powers.
titlelist: The word 'nan' in Chinese can have multiple meanings depending on the context. It can mean man or male when used as a noun, or it can mean difficult or hard when used as an adjective. Without further context, it is difficult to provide an accurate translation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Vigorously develop prefabricated buildings and promote the establishment of a specialized, large-scale, and information-based production system based on standard components. Accelerate the coordinated development of new generation information technology and industrialization technology in construction, and increase the integration and innovative application of new technologies such as Building Information Modeling (BIM), the Internet, the Internet of Things, big data, cloud computing, mobile communication, artificial intelligence, and blockchain throughout the construction process. Promote the research, development, manufacturing, and application of advanced manufacturing equipment, intelligent equipment, and related equipment for smart construction sites, improve the performance and efficiency of various construction tools, and increase the level of mechanization in construction. Accelerate the application of building Internet of Things technologies such as sensors, high-speed mobile communication, wireless radio frequency, near-field communication, and QR code recognition, and enhance the utilization of data resources and information service capabilities. Accelerate the construction of an Internet platform for the construction industry and promote the application of intelligent manufacturing production lines for steel structural components and prefabricated concrete components.
titlelist: Key task: Accelerate the upgrading of construction industrialization.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Strengthen technological research and development, promote the research, transfer, diffusion, and commercial application of basic common technologies and key core technologies in intelligent construction and construction industrialization. Accelerate breakthroughs in modern manufacturing processes for components, intelligent control and optimization, new sensing and perception, engineering quality inspection and monitoring, data collection and analysis, fault diagnosis and maintenance, specialized software, and other core technologies. Explore the mass application of construction robots with human-machine coordination, natural interaction, and autonomous learning capabilities. Develop systematic software and data platforms with independent intellectual property rights, as well as integrated construction platforms. Promote the integration and application of industrial internet platforms in the construction field, establish construction industry internet platforms, and develop applications for the construction field. Accelerate the transformation and application of intelligent construction scientific and technological achievements, cultivate a number of technology innovation centers, key laboratories, and other scientific and technological innovation bases. Establish an advanced and applicable standard system for intelligent construction and construction industrialization, focusing on digital design, intelligent production, and intelligent construction. Conduct research on basic common standards, key technology standards, and industry application standards.
titlelist: Key task, strengthen technological innovation.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Promote the construction of a digital design system, coordinate architectural structures, mechanical and electrical equipment, components, assembly construction, and decoration, and promote integrated design. Actively apply independent and controllable BIM technology, accelerate the construction of a digital design foundation platform and integrated system, and achieve design, process, and manufacturing collaboration. Accelerate the digitalization and intelligent upgrading of components and parts production, promote the application of digital technology, system integration technology, intelligent equipment, and construction robots, and achieve a factory with fewer or even no workers. Accelerate the application of human-machine intelligent interaction, intelligent logistics management, additive manufacturing, and other technologies and intelligent equipment. Focus on key production processes in factory production, such as reinforcement production and installation, mold assembly and disassembly, concrete pouring, steel component cutting and welding, partition board and integrated kitchen and bathroom processing, and promote the digitalization of process flow and the application of construction robots. Based on the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform, further promote the extension to production management subsystems and achieve information management of factory production. Promote the application of construction robots and intelligent control tower cranes and other integrated construction equipment in on-site construction processes such as material distribution, reinforcement processing, spraying, tile laying, partition board installation, and high-altitude welding.
titlelist: Key task, improving the level of informatization.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Explore new organizational methods, processes, and management models suitable for the collaborative development of intelligent construction and industrialization in the construction industry. Accelerate the cultivation of engineering general contracting enterprises with the capability of intelligent construction system solutions, coordinate the entire construction industry chain, promote close cooperation and collaborative innovation among enterprises in various forms, and gradually form an open industrial system with engineering general contracting enterprises as the core and deep involvement of related leading enterprises. Encourage enterprises to establish multi-party collaborative intelligent construction platforms for engineering general contracting projects, strengthen the collaborative work of intelligent construction upstream and downstream, and form an industry chain covering design, production, construction, and technical services.
titlelist: Key tasks, cultivating industrial system.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Implement green construction throughout the entire lifecycle of engineering construction projects, with the core focus on resource conservation and environmental protection. Through the coordinated development of intelligent construction and industrialization of construction, improve resource utilization efficiency, reduce the generation of construction waste, and significantly reduce energy consumption, material consumption, and water consumption. Promote the establishment of a green supply chain in the construction industry, promote circular production methods, and improve the comprehensive utilization level of construction waste. Increase research and development efforts for advanced energy-saving and environmental protection technologies, processes, and equipment, improve energy efficiency, accelerate the elimination of outdated equipment and technologies, and promote the green transformation and upgrading of the construction industry.
titlelist: Key task, actively promoting green construction.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Strengthen the construction of intelligent construction and the application of industrialized construction, promote the transformation of scientific and technological achievements, major product integration innovation, and demonstration applications. Utilize key projects and large-scale project demonstrations to increase the promotion efforts, expand the application scope of various technologies, and initially form a comprehensive application model integrating research and development design, data training, pilot applications, and science and technology finance. Play a leading role in demonstration by leading enterprises, create machine replacing human scenarios in prefabricated construction factories, and promote the establishment of intelligent construction bases. Sort out the intelligent construction-related technologies that have already been applied, regularly release a catalog of mature technologies, and prioritize the promotion and application in regions with good basic conditions and urgent needs.
titlelist: Key tasks, open and expand application scenarios.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Each region should further tilt existing industrial support policies towards the field of intelligent construction, and increase support for key technologies research, development of basic software and hardware, development of intelligent systems and equipment, and application demonstrations of intelligent construction. Intelligent construction companies that have been recognized and obtained the qualification of high-tech enterprises can enjoy relevant preferential policies as stipulated. Enterprises that purchase and use major technological equipment for intelligent construction can enjoy policies such as corporate income tax and import tax preferences as stipulated. Promote the establishment and improvement of a diversified investment and financing system for intelligent construction with enterprise investment as the main body, and encourage venture capital and industrial investment in the field of intelligent construction. Relevant departments should strengthen cross-department and cross-level coordination to promote the resolution of bottlenecks encountered in the development of intelligent construction.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, increase policy support

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: Each region should timely evaluate the implementation of policies related to the coordinated development of intelligent construction and industrialization of construction. The key areas of evaluation include the implementation and completion of development goals for intelligent construction, industrial development, policy formulation, and standard specification development, among others. The results should be reported.
titlelist: Safeguard measures, establish evaluation mechanisms.

name: Guiding Opinions on Promoting the Synergistic Development of Intelligent Construction and Industrialization of Construction (Jian Shi [2020] No. 60) (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other departments/July 3, 2020)
content: To strengthen publicity and promotion, fully leverage the role of relevant enterprises, institutions, industry associations, and academic societies, and carry out policy promotion, technological guidance, exchange and cooperation, and result dissemination for intelligent construction. Build an international innovation cooperation mechanism, enhance international exchanges, promote open cooperation, and create a favorable environment for the healthy development of intelligent construction.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, create a good environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: - By 2021, various types and different models of intelligent demonstration coal mines will be built, and an information transmission and automatic operation technology system for key processes such as coal mine development and design, geological assurance, production, and safety will be initially formed. The goal is to achieve reduced manpower and improved efficiency in the advancing working face, fewer or no personnel operation within the comprehensive mining working face, and unmanned and remote monitoring of fixed positions in underground and open-pit coal mines.- By 2025, large-scale coal mines and coal mines with severe disasters will basically achieve intelligence, forming a technical specification and standard system for coal mine intelligent construction. This will enable intelligent decision-making and automated collaborative operation of key systems such as development and design, geological assurance, mining (stripping), transportation, ventilation, and coal washing logistics. Underground key positions will be operated by robots, and open-pit coal mines will achieve intelligent continuous operation and unmanned transportation.- By 2035, various types of coal mines will basically achieve intelligence, constructing a coal mine intelligent system that integrates multiple industrial chains and systems. An intelligent perception, intelligent decision-making, and automatic execution coal mine intelligent system will be established.
titlelist: Overall requirements, main objectives

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Intelligent Development of Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: Research and formulate an action plan for the intelligent development of coal mines, clarify the direction, implementation path, and policy measures for intelligent development. Encourage relevant departments of local governments to study and formulate plans for the intelligent development of coal mines, taking into account regional characteristics, coal seam occurrence conditions, technological foundations, and other factors, scientifically guiding the progress and scale of intelligent development in coal mines. Support coal enterprises in formulating implementation plans for the intelligent development of coal mines, implementing construction tasks, technological systems, and construction progress, and accelerating the pace of intelligent development in coal mines.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen top-level design and scientifically plan the intelligent construction of coal mines.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Intelligent Development of Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: In accordance with the division of responsibilities among departments, coordinate the revision of standards for the intelligentization of coal mines, strengthen the revision of basic, key technology standards, and management standards; accelerate the revision of technical specifications, product standards, and testing and inspection specifications related to terminology, data management, technical equipment, and coal mine robots in the construction of intelligent coal mines. Carry out special work on the construction of the standard system for intelligent coal mines, accelerate the implementation of the plan to enhance the standards for intelligent coal mines, formulate norms and implementation guidelines for the construction, evaluation, and acceptance of intelligent coal mines; promote the establishment of a consistency and compliance testing system and technical platform for intelligent coal mine standards, and form a closed-loop management system for standard revision, promotion and application, consulting services, and implementation supervision.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen standard leadership and enhance the basic capabilities of coal mine intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy Bureau [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: Strengthen the basic theoretical research on the intelligence of coal mines, promote the construction of national key laboratories and engineering (research) centers, support the construction of innovation and research platforms for the intelligence of coal mines, and strengthen the research and development of common key technologies such as core basic components, advanced basic processes, and key basic materials. Key breakthroughs include precise geological detection, precise positioning and efficient continuous data transmission, intelligent rapid excavation, intelligent comprehensive mining under complex conditions, continuous auxiliary transportation, unmanned continuous operation in open-pit mining, intelligent perception and early warning of major hazards, coal mine robots, and underground digital electronic detonators. Accelerate the construction of intelligent factories and digital workshops, promote the research and development and industrial application of large-scale coal mining equipment and coal mine robots, implement special actions for mechanization and automation to reduce human labor, and improve the standardization and localization level of intelligent equipment.
titlelist: The main task is to promote technological innovation and improve the level of intelligent technology and equipment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy Bureau [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: Accelerate the intelligent transformation of coal mines that meet the conditions, and carry out intelligent optimization and improvement in production and operation management processes such as mining (stripping), power supply, water supply and drainage, ventilation, main and auxiliary transportation, safety monitoring, and coal washing. Promote unmanned operation of fixed positions and robot operation of dangerous positions, and achieve the intelligent transformation and upgrading of traditional coal mines. Promote the intelligent design of newly built coal mines, innovate the intelligent mining (stripping) mode of coal mines, and build an integrated platform that integrates multiple systems and functions such as intelligent production, safety assurance, and operation management, to achieve intelligent applications such as coordinated coal mine production, transportation, and sales, decision-making control, and integrated operation. Encourage the accelerated intelligent construction of mines with serious disaster threats, and take the lead in improving the level of intelligence.
titlelist: The main task is to accelerate the intelligent transformation of coal mines and improve the level of intelligence in newly built coal mines.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy Bureau [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: In response to the different coal seam occurrence conditions in various mining areas in our country, a scientific, reasonable, and advanced coal mine intelligent construction plan is formulated and implemented from the perspectives of construction concept, system architecture, intelligent technology and equipment, comprehensive management, and economic investment. The focus is on promoting systematic intelligent construction in large-scale coal mines, prioritizing the implementation of intelligent mining (stripping) and robot replacement for hazardous positions in mines with severe hazards such as rock burst and coal and gas outburst. A number of intelligent demonstration coal mines will be built to refine replicable intelligent mining models, technological equipment, management experience, etc., and promote their application in similar condition coal mines.
titlelist: The main task is to play a leading role and promote the construction of intelligent demonstration coal mines.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: With data as the core resource, promote the development of intelligent technology and innovative application models in coal mine, and enhance the core competitiveness of coal enterprises. Extend the industrial chain of intelligent coal machinery manufacturing, transforming from mainly providing coal machinery products to providing products and services, to providing overall solutions, and to providing system integration and general contracting, promoting the coordinated development of manufacturing and services. Carry out applications and transactions between large-scale coal mining enterprises, big data professional service providers, and other data platforms, cultivate new service models such as coal mine big data development, financing leasing, and data credit. Build a new industry for the research, development, and manufacturing of intelligent equipment and coal mine robots, and establish influential intelligent equipment and robot industrial bases.
titlelist: The main tasks are to explore new service models and continuously extend the industrial chain.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Intelligent Development of Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: Support and encourage universities to strengthen the construction of disciplines and majors related to coal mine intelligence, promote interdisciplinary integration, and cultivate a group of composite talents with knowledge and skills in mining engineering, software engineering, information engineering, robotics engineering, artificial intelligence, and other fields. Deepen the integration of industry and education, encourage cooperation between universities and enterprises to innovate the talent training model for coal mine intelligence, jointly build exemplary internship and practical bases, establish a platform for engineering teachers to exercise their skills, and jointly build modern industrial colleges to meet the urgent needs of the industry. Actively carry out training in intelligence and information technology for in-service personnel, establish and improve mechanisms for career development channels, and optimize the development system for knowledge-based, skill-based, and management-based talents.
titlelist: The main tasks are to accelerate talent cultivation and improve the ability to guarantee the talent pool.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: With the research and application of advanced technology and equipment in the intelligentization of coal mines as the core, cross-domain, interdisciplinary, and cross-professional collaborative cooperation is carried out to support the establishment of technology transfer centers. Strengthen the alignment with the energy development strategies of countries along the Belt and Road initiative, build a platform for technological exchange in the intelligentization of coal mines, explore strategic partnerships with enterprises and relevant institutions in countries along the route, deepen mutual trust and cooperation, and promote mutual benefit and win-win outcomes. Seizing the opportunity of international cooperation, promote the internationalization of China's intelligentization technology, equipment, standards, and services in coal mines, while introducing advanced technology, equipment, management concepts, and service models in international coal mine intelligentization, cultivate internationally influential branded products, and enhance the level of openness in China's coal industry.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen international cooperation and actively participate in the construction of the Belt and Road initiative.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy Bureau [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: Strengthen the cultivation and protection of high-quality and high-value patents in the field of common key technologies, track the development of advanced technologies abroad, make proactive international patent applications and layouts, and avoid technology export risks. Encourage the construction of an intellectual property protection system for intelligent coal mine construction, protect the achievements of intelligent coal mine construction, and form industrial competitive advantages. Encourage and support enterprises to use intellectual property rights to participate in market competition and cultivate a group of coal enterprises with intellectual property advantages in intelligent coal mine construction.
titlelist: Protective measures, strengthen intellectual property rights protection, enhance core technology controllable capability.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy Bureau [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: Under the guidance of national and provincial departments, coal mine intelligent innovation alliances and regional innovation institutions are formed, with industry associations, research institutions, technology companies, design institutes, universities, finance, equipment manufacturers, and coal enterprises as the main participants. They fully leverage their respective professional advantages to achieve collaborative innovation and cross-industry integration, providing support for the construction of intelligent coal mines.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, consolidate consensus among all parties, and promote cross-border cooperation in intelligence.

name: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the Development of Intelligent Coal Mines (National Development and Reform Commission, Energy [2020] No. 283) (Departments of the National Development and Reform Commission, etc./February 25, 2020)
content: Establish a mechanism for the intelligent construction of coal mines, and increase the guidance and coordination efforts for the intelligent construction of coal mines. Relevant departments of local governments should issue implementation opinions based on the actual situation in their respective regions, and accelerate the intelligent construction and upgrading of coal mines. Strengthen the publicity and interpretation of relevant policies for the intelligent development of coal mines, and improve the awareness of these policies. Summarize new typical cases, models, and mechanisms for the intelligent construction of coal mines, promote the experience and achievements of intelligent development in coal mines, and create a favorable atmosphere for the intelligent development of coal mines.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen organizational leadership, and form a collective force for intelligent development.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: The scale of the industry continues to grow. The annual production of domestic brand industrial robots has reached 100,000 units, and the annual production of six-axis and above industrial robots has exceeded 50,000 units. The annual sales revenue of service robots exceeds 30 billion yuan, achieving small-scale production and application in areas such as elderly care, disability assistance, and medical rehabilitation. Cultivate more than three leading enterprises with international competitiveness and build more than five robot supporting industry clusters. The technological level has significantly improved. The main technical indicators of industrial robots, such as speed, payload, accuracy, and self-weight ratio, have reached the level of similar foreign products, and the average mean time between failures (MTBF) has reached 80,000 hours. The technological level of service robots in fields such as medical health, home services, anti-terrorism and riot control, disaster relief, and scientific research is close to international standards. Breakthroughs have been made in the new generation of robot technology, and intelligent robots have achieved innovative applications. Significant breakthroughs have been made in key components. The performance, accuracy, and reliability of precision reducers, servo motors and drivers, and controllers for robots have reached the level of similar foreign products. Batch applications have been achieved in six-axis and above industrial robots, with a market share of over 50%. Significant achievements have been made in integrated applications. More than 30 comprehensive application solutions for robots in typical fields have been completed, and corresponding standards and specifications have been formed. The scale application of robots in key industries has been realized, and the robot density has reached 150 or more.
titlelist: Overall requirements, development goals

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Promote the advancement of industrial robots towards the mid-to-high-end market. In response to the needs of the top ten key sectors and other key industries in the national economy, focus on intelligent production and intelligent logistics, overcome key technologies of industrial robots, enhance operability and maintainability, and prioritize the development of six iconic industrial robot products: arc welding robots, vacuum (clean) robots, fully autonomous programming intelligent industrial robots, human-robot collaboration robots, dual-arm robots, and heavy-duty AGVs. Guide the development of industrial robots in China towards the mid-to-high-end market. Promote the development of service robots in a wider range of fields. In areas such as elderly and disabled assistance, home services, medical rehabilitation, rescue and disaster relief, energy security, public safety, and major scientific research, cultivate the demand for smart living, modern services, and special operations. Focus on the development of four iconic products: fire rescue robots, surgical robots, intelligent public service robots, and intelligent care robots. Promote the serialization of professional service robots and the commercialization of personal/home service robots.
titlelist: The main task is to promote the breakthrough of major landmark products in advance.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: In order to address the issues of poor performance, reliability, and short lifespan of key components used in industrial robots with 6 degrees of freedom or more, efforts are being made to improve the quality stability and mass production capabilities of five key components: high-precision reducers, high-performance servo motors and drivers specifically designed for robots, high-speed and high-performance controllers, sensors, and end effectors. This is being done through optimization design, material selection, processing technology, assembly techniques, dedicated manufacturing equipment, and industrialization capabilities. The goal is to break through technological barriers and end the long-term dependence on imports.
titlelist: The main task is to vigorously develop key components for robots.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Strengthen research on common key technologies. Focus on breaking through the common key technologies that restrict the development of robotics in China, in response to the demand for industrial robots in intelligent manufacturing and industrial transformation and upgrading, as well as the demand for service robots in smart living, modern services, and special operations. Actively track the future development trends of robotics and lay out research on next-generation robotics technologies in advance. Establish and improve innovation platforms for robotics. Make full use of and integrate existing scientific and technological resources and research and development capabilities, establish robotics innovation centers that serve the entire industry, and create a collaborative innovation carrier that closely combines government, industry, academia, research, and application. Focus on research on cutting-edge technologies and common key technologies. Strengthen the construction of the robotics standard system. Carry out top-level design of the robotics standard system, construct and improve the industrial standard system for robotics, accelerate the research and formulation of various technical standards urgently needed by the industry, support the research and verification of robotics evaluation standards, and actively participate in the revision of international standards. Establish a robotics testing and certification system. Establish and improve robotics inspection and certification institutions represented by the National Robotics Testing and Evaluation Center, promote the establishment of a third-party evaluation and certification system for robotics, and carry out testing and certification work for complete robots and key functional components.
titlelist: The main task is to strengthen the innovation capability of industries.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: To meet the strategic needs of the country and the major demands of the people's livelihood, we will strengthen the construction of quality brands and actively promote the application of robots. Focusing on key areas of the manufacturing industry, we will implement a number of exemplary industry application demonstration projects that have outstanding effects, strong driving force, and high relevance. We will focus on industrial sectors with high demand, high environmental requirements, and high labor intensity, as well as disaster relief, rescue, medical rehabilitation, and other service sectors. We will gradually and systematically promote the application of segmented industries, cultivate key areas of robot application system integrators and comprehensive solution service providers, and fully utilize outsourcing services, new leasing models, and other methods to expand the market space for industrial robots and service robots.
titlelist: Main tasks, focus on promoting application demonstrations.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Guide enterprises to develop in the direction of differentiation around segmented markets, carry out horizontal and vertical integration of the industrial chain, support the close integration of internet companies and traditional robot companies, accelerate the cultivation of leading enterprises with advanced management level, strong innovation capability, high efficiency, good benefits, and strong market competitiveness, and create internationally renowned robot brands with high visibility, comprehensive competitiveness, and high product added value. Vigorously promote the close integration of research institutes, colleges and universities with the robot industry, give full play to the leading role of leading enterprises, form a good industrial ecological environment led by leading enterprises, drive the development of small and medium-sized enterprises towards the direction of specialization, refinement, uniqueness, and novelty, and form a situation of coordinated development of the entire industry chain.
titlelist: The main task is to actively cultivate leading enterprises.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Strengthen top-level design, coordinate and integrate the resources and efforts of various departments such as industrial management, development and reform, science and technology, and finance, form a joint force, support independent innovation, and promote the healthy development of China's robotics industry; strengthen guidance on regional industrial policies, form a nationally and locally coordinated industrial policy system; encourage regions and parks with conditions to develop robotics industry clusters, and guide the concentration and aggregation of the robotics industry chain and production factors.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen overall planning and resource integration.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Encourage banks and funds of all kinds to support robot projects that are technologically advanced, have clear advantages, and have strong driving and supporting roles within their business scope; encourage financial institutions to establish a community of shared interests with robot enterprises and provide long-term support for the development of the industry; actively support qualified robot enterprises to directly raise funds and engage in domestic and overseas mergers and acquisitions in the capital markets; guide financial institutions to innovate products and services that are in line with the characteristics of the robot industry chain and promote the leasing model for robots.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, broaden investment and financing channels.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Establish industrial robot industry standards and conditions, promote the concentration of various resources to advantageous enterprises, encourage the high-end development of the robot industry, and prevent low-level redundant construction; research and formulate a robot certification and accreditation system, projects supported by national financial funds should purchase certified robots, and encourage local governments to establish robot certification and accreditation systems; strengthen the construction of robot intellectual property protection system; research and establish a robot industry statistical system; fully leverage the role of industry associations, industry alliances, and service organizations to build a robot industry service platform.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, creating a favorable market environment.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Organize and implement a talent development plan for the robotics industry, strengthen the construction of robotics-related disciplines in vocational colleges and universities, increase the intensity of vocational training and education for robotics, accelerate the cultivation of high-level talents in technology research and development, management, operation, maintenance, and other fields urgently needed in the robotics industry; utilize the National Thousand Talents Program to attract overseas high-end talent for innovation and entrepreneurship in robotics.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, strengthen the construction of talent teams.

name: Notice on Issuing the Development Plan for the Robot Industry (2016-2020) (MIIT Joint Regulation [2016] No. 109) (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other departments/March 21, 2016)
content: Make full use of various channels and levels, such as government, industry organizations, and enterprises, to carry out international exchanges and cooperation in technology, standards, intellectual property rights, testing and certification, etc., and continuously expand the scope of cooperation; encourage enterprises to actively explore overseas markets, strengthen technological cooperation, and provide comprehensive services such as system integration, product supply, operation and maintenance.
titlelist: Guarantee measures, expand international exchanges and cooperation.
